text:
I was playing my favorite video game about pirates. My character swam to a secret island to find treasure. I fought a big skeleton boss with my sword. He was scary but I knew I could win.

"Take that you bony monster!" I yelled at the TV.

My health bar grew smaller and smaller. I had to search for a health potion fast. I found one near a rock. Then I used my magic compass bearing to find the gold. The compass needle pointed north.

"Finally, I found the meeting spot for the treasure," I said.

A storm brewed in the game and it got dark. I opened the chest and won the level! Then my mom called me for dinner.

My friends and I went exploring in the dark woods. We were pretending to be in a big hero league. We walked for a long time and saw a cave. 

"Look at that weird light!" I screamed. 

We saw a glowing ghost floating inside. It was very scary and we started running. I was bumping into trees and rocks. We reached a big hill and started climbing up fast. Then we heard a loud ringing sound below us. 

"Maybe it simply wants to be friends," said Tom.

But then the ghost made a foreign noise like a monster. It was screaming loudly. We kept running until we saw my house. My mom was loading the car. We were safe but I lost my favorite scissors. I ran inside and hugged my stuffed lamb tight.

My cat Fluffy thinks he is the king of everything. He likes to reign over the backyard like it is his castle. One day, I saw him chasing a squirrel near the big oak tree. The squirrel was super fast and ran up the bark. Fluffy jumped high, but he missed and crashed into the bushes.

"That was a huge failure," I grinned at him.

Fluffy just grumbled a weird meow and licked his paw. He didn't like losing. He sat there for an hour just staring at the tree. I tried to wrap him in a blanket later, but he ran away. My mom said he needed a grounding for scratching the couch. He is not smart, but he has a funny brain. I don’t think he will catch a squirrel today either.

One day I was walking on the rocky ground. I saw a giant green beetle glowing near a mountain. It looked like an alien bug from space. I feared it would bite me but I got closer. Suddenly the beetle started to sneeze loud green slime everywhere.

"Eww, that is so gross!" I yelled at the bug.

The beetle looked at me and actually started talking.

"Sorry, I just have a cold," the beetle grumbled sadly.

I did not understand how a bug could talk. It told me it was earning money for a spaceship. It didn't have enough gold coins to fly home yet. I immediately gave him my lunch money to help him out. The beetle smiled and flew up into the sky.

My cousin Luke had a big sleepover for his birthday. He is my aunt’s nephew, but he is like my brother. We were climbing the big tree in his backyard. It was a beautiful day but then something bad happened. Luke started coughing a lot and his face got red.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"I can’t breathe good," Luke said.

My mom ran over and she looked really scared. She said maybe it was pneumonia or asthma. She took him inside fast. It felt impossible to have fun after that. Our neighbor Mr. Jones came over to help too. He is stronger than my dad. They took Luke to the doctor right away. Later my mom called and said Luke was okay. He just needed medicine.

"That was scary," I told my dad. I hope he gets better soon.

Yesterday at recess I climbed the big blue slide. I reached the top and looked for my friend Sam. Unfortunately he was not there so I played alone. I love climbing especially when the sun is super hot. Then the bell rang and we moved back inside.

My teacher Mrs. Green was coaching us on math problems. She said, "Who has their homework ready for me?"

I looked in my bag to search for it. I understood the math but I lost the paper! I felt bad because I like earning gold stars. I told her, "I left it on my toasted bagel!"

She laughed and crossed her arms but she was nice. I did not complain and just did it again. It was just plain paper anyway. Next time I will bungee cord it to my bag!

I love playing Mario Kart with my big brother. He always picks Yoshi, and I pick Toad because he is fast. We were racing on Rainbow Road, and I was steering really carefully. I feared falling off the edge because it takes forever to come back.

My brother hit a banana, and I heard him yell. "Hey, that is not fair at all!" he shouted.

I zoomed past him, seeing the finish line ahead. My dad was watching and started coaching me. "Turn left now, buddy!" he said.

I won the race for a certain reason. I practiced all day yesterday while my brother was at school. He tried to complain, but I just smiled. I am the best racer in the house now.

Me and my neighbor Sam went to search the old barn. We walked through the tall grass and reached the big red door. I was fourteen but I still feared the dark inside.

"Do not make a sound," Sam whispered to me.

We jumped over a crushed box and saw a big spider. Sam almost started speaking but I covered his mouth. We treated the spider like a sleeping dragon.

Suddenly I felt a sneeze coming and I could not stop.

"Achoo!" I sneezed very loud.

We heard a thump so we ran out fast. We did not receive any treasure that day. I will write about it in my diary though. We often go there but next time we will bring a flashlight.

My nephew Ben loves video games so much. He often asks me to play racing games with him. We turned on the TV and the game started loading. I grasped the controller hard because I wanted to win. The first level was simply a boating race on water. I saw a shortcut and went very fast!

"You are going to lose!" Ben yelled loudly.

"No way, I am winning this time!" I shouted back.

I opened a big lead and my speed kept growing. I sent my boat over a huge jump. I did not even need to use my special comb item. I crossed the finish line to complete the race first. Ben was sad but I was super happy.

I was playing a weird new game on my tablet. It was about aliens who reign over a big castle. The aliens looked foreign and had three green eyes. I walked my player to the gate and jumped. But I landed wrong and twisted my ankle in the game. My player crawled slowly on the ground and it was bad.

"Why is he moving so slow?" asked my brother.

"I don't understand the controls yet," I said.

Then the alien king came out and zapped me. The screen went black and said game over. I will try to beat the level tomorrow.

I ate my breakfast fast because I was late. I ran to school but I forgot my homework. Mrs. Green was talking about a brave knight. I didn't listen though because I was worried.

At recess, we played kickball on the grass. I was the captain of the blue team. My friend Sam kicked the ball really far. It hit a leather bag on the bench.

"Is that bag strong enough?" Sam asked me.

"I hope so," I said.

Later we had art class and did painting. I painted a big red dragon for the knight. It was a good day even without my homework. Mrs. Green said I can bring it tomorrow.

One day me and Max went to the spooky island. We wanted to find treasure but it was scary. The trees were black and scorched from a fire. We climbed up a big hill to a castle. It was a huge height and I felt dizzy.

"Look out!" called Max.

We saw a white ghost on the balcony. We ran through the door but we got trapped inside. The ghost spread its arms and tried to grab us.

"We have to jump!" I yelled to Max.

We escaped out the window and ran to the boat. The captain was waiting for us. We obtained a gold coin but it was haunted. We threw it in the water. We learned to listen when people say places are dangerous. It was a very different adventure than usual.

One day my friends and I found a huge old castle. We walked through the big door and saw a dark hallway. Suddenly a bat flew out and I screamed really loud! Then we realized there was a shiny box on the floor.

"I bet it's filled with gold!" said my friend Sam.

I reached for the box and felt its heavy weight. We counted to three and opened the lid together. But inside there was just one tiny blue feather. We were not thrilled at all.

"This meant nothing," I said with my thumb down.

Then the floor started shaking like an earthquake! We ran outside fast before we got a grounding from our moms. We paid no money but it was still a scary adventure.

I was training for the big race at school. My friend Sam was my company and he ran with me. We ran very fast around the big playground. Suddenly I fell down hard on the grass. It hurt a lot but I did not cry. Sam looked at me and he looked worried.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked me loudly.

"Yes, failure is impossible for me today!" I said back.

We discovered a big hill and we had to climb it. It looked like danger but we kept running anyway. I started singing a fast song to help me run. I read a book about running fast so I knew what to do. I won the race and now I will write about it.

The alien ship landed straight on our playground. It was big and green and made a ringing sound. A strange breeze blew my hair. I was scared but my friend Tim walked up to it.

"Hello there!" Tim shouted at the ship.

A door opened and a robot dog came out. It had eight legs and was groaning. It looked foreign and weird.

"I think it is bringing us a present," I said.

The robot reached out a metal paw. It was keeping a shiny blue rock. My teacher Mrs. Lee was screaming. She did not like aliens.

"Stop that screaming," the robot grumbled.

The robot gave the rock to the teacher’s daughter. It was a pleasant surprise. Then the robot started coaching us on how to fly. We all floated up in the air!

My brother Sam turned fourteen last Wednesday. We had a party on an island near our house. The breeze was nice and cool that day. Mom made a big chocolate cake for him. Sam blew out the candles and made a wish. But then he accidentally dropped his cake on his shirt!

"Oh no, look at that giant stain!" I yelled.

Sam just laughed and said, "Gravity works really fast."

Suddenly, my aunt from a foreign country arrived with a gift. She taught us a funny dance after we ate. It was so hot that I almost fainted. I chose a spot under a tree to rest. I saw a sign that said "No Swimming." Sam is growing so fast now. I hope he doesn't catch pneumonia from being sweaty. It was the best birthday ever.

Yesterday was incredible because we had a big race at recess. We stood on the playground ground near the water fountain. My friend Sam wanted to be the champion of the school.

"I can run faster than a cheetah!" Sam yelled loudly.

"We will see about that," I said back to him.

The teacher blew her whistle and we all started running. It was hot and the sun scorched our backs. I ran fast but Sam was super speedy. He gradually got far ahead of everyone else. He crossed the finish line first and everyone was cheering. It felt like an hour but it was only a minute. Sam’s face grew very red and he needed water. He drank from the fountain and cooled down his brain. He is ready for our camping trip now!

The bell screeched really loud and everyone covered their ears. It was time for science class and I didn't do my homework. My stomach turned upside down. Mrs. Baker walked in and she looked like a scary knight in armor.

"Okay class, please take out your papers," she said.

The whole class started groaning and moaning. I knew I was in big trouble. I tried to listen but I was too scared. My friend Tim looked at me.

"Did you do the work?" Tim whispered.

"No, I forgot!" I whispered back.

Suddenly Mrs. Baker smiled. She said we had enough work yesterday so today was a free day! I never understood psychology but I think she tricked us. I was so happy I almost fell out of my chair.

My birthday was last Wednesday and it was incredible. I wanted a new bike but earning money is hard. I saved my allowance for eight weeks straight. Unfortunately I did not have enough money yet. My dad saw me counting my coins. 

"Don't worry about the money," said Dad.

He took me to the garage and showed me something. It was a bright red bike! My heart started pumping fast. 

"Is this impossible?" I asked him. 

It wasn't impossible because he bought it for me. I hugged him and we pumped up the tires. We rode down the street as it neared dinnertime. It was the best birthday ever.

I was playing my favorite video game about racing cars. I had to design my own car first. I picked red flames and a weird blue skull. It looked super cool on the screen. The race started and my engine made a loud singing noise. I sped past the other cars really fast.

My brother walked in and grumbled, "It is my turn to play now."

"No way, I am winning this huge race!" I screamed back.

I turned a corner and scorched the tires on the track. I saw the finish line ahead. I crushed the buttons on my controller. The bell was ringing because I won first place. I was so grateful that I won the gold cup.

"Okay, now you can have the controller," I said happily.

He took it and dropped a crumb on the floor. I just smiled though because I am the champion.

I was waiting for lunchtime because I was starving. My stomach kept groaning so loud that Mrs. Miller looked at me. Finally the bell rang and I grabbed my blue lunchbox. I ran to the cafeteria and sat with my friend Leo.

"Look at this," Leo told me and opened his container.

It smelled really bad, like old socks or wet dogs. It was green stewed spinach with chunky bits in it. Leo pretended he was boating his spoon through the green soup. Then he felt a sneeze growing in his nose.

"A-choo!" he sneezed super hard right into the bowl.

Green stuff flew everywhere and landed on my sandwich. He threw his napkin at the mess but it was too late. I was so mad but then we just started laughing.

"Do you have an extra apple?" I asked him.

One time I went camping with my family. It was freezing cold outside at night. Suddenly the wind blew hard and shook the tent. I was really scared and I heard a loud noise. Something was running and stamping its feet near our campfire. I looked out and discovered a big raccoon. It was trying to steal our marshmallows.

"Hey! Get away from our food!" I yelled loudly.

My dad woke up and threw a shoe straight at it. The raccoon ran away fast up a tree. It was clinging to a branch way up high. I counted thirteen stars while looking at it. Then my mom almost fainted because she saw a spider. Everyone laughed because it was incredible fun.

My cat Fluffy loves to go outside on the balcony. It is very high up and the height scares me. One day, a big breeze blew very hard. I looked out and saw a bird approaching our spot. It looked like a foreign bird from a jungle island.

"Look at that!" I yelled to my mom.

"It is so pretty," she said back to me.

The bird tried to squeeze through the railing. It wanted to see Fluffy. It was a funny scene to watch them. Fluffy meowed and tried to touch it. I will always remember that day. I wish we were boating so we could follow the bird. It flew away fast into the blue sky.

My dog Buster is the best dog in the league. We went to the park and I threw his red ball. It flew high into the air. Buster ran very fast and neared the big oak tree.

"Go get it, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He came back bumping into my legs with the ball. I was grateful he didn't run away. My mom sat on the bench and watched us. She had a hot tea she brewed at home.

"Be careful or you will get pneumonia!" she said.

It was getting cold but I was not afraid. Then we saw a small creature in the grass. It was a squirrel and it looked certain to climb the tree. Buster barked but he was already tired like a champion. We walked home happy.

My neighbor Tim came over for a sleepover last Saturday. He is younger than me but he has a huge imagination. We played pirates in my room and pretended my bed was a ship. I was steering the ship and Tim was looking for sharks.

"Watch out for the stinging jellyfish!" Tim yelled loudly.

"I am approaching the island now!" I shouted back.

We pretended we were boating on a dangerous ocean. It felt very different than just sitting in my room. My mom came in and told us to be quiet. She said sleeping is important for our psychology or something. We didn't listen very well because we were having fun. Eventually we got tired and fell asleep on the floor. It was the best sleepover ever.

It was freezing outside because it was my birthday party. My mom put a sign on the door that said "Party Here!" My neighbor Billy came over first. We sat on the couch and waited for everyone.

When my friends came, we played a game with balloons. We tried to keep the blue balloon floating in the air. "Don't let it touch the floor!" yelled my friend Sam.

Then we ate pizza, but my stomach started groaning. I ate too much cheese. I didn't want cake either. My dad taught us a magic trick with his thumb. Everyone started cheering when he made it disappear. Then I closed my eyes to make a wish. It was the best day ever.

Me and my brother Tom went boating on the lake. The scenery was nice but then the boat hit a big rock.

"Oh no!" I said. "We are stuck on the ground."

Tom looked scared and ran to the back. The water twisted around the boat very fast. We needed an important plan. I saw a rope and caught it quickly.

"Hold on tight!" yelled Tom.

I threw the rope and it crossed to a tree. We pulled hard and jumped off the boat. We were stamping our feet to dry off. Gravity helped us sit down. I found an old wet newspaper nearby. Someone wrote a note on it. It said, "Beware of the monster."

I drew a map in the dirt. I can guarantee we will be safe now. Then we went home screaming because we saw a bug.

One day me and my dog Buster went to the park. It was a very pleasant day and the sun was hot. We played catch for a whole hour. Buster ran fast but he crushed the ball with his teeth. I saw a crumb on his nose and laughed.

Suddenly Buster started digging near a big tree. He struggled to pull something out. It was an old science book! Some pages were tearing and the cover looked scorched like fire hit it.

"Look what I found, Buster!" I shouted.

"Woof woof!" Buster barked back at me.

I tried reading it but I didn't know the meaning. My mom says swearing is bad so I hope there are no bad words inside. We took the book home to read it later. Exploring is the best thing ever.

My nephew Ben and I found a secret door. It was hidden behind a big pile of old newspapers. We pushed it open and saw a dark room. Ben was scared but I held his hand tight.

Inside there was a weird computer making loud beeping noises. It looked like foreign science stuff from a movie. Suddenly the door slammed shut and we were trapped!

"We have to maintain calm!" I shouted at Ben.

Ben started pumping his arms because he was panicking. I typed thirteen on the keyboard and the screen flashed. The door opened again and we ran out fast. We had a meeting in the treehouse to plan our reign as explorers.

It was finally my birthday and I was jumping on my bed. My mom called me downstairs because breakfast was ready. I put on my favorite red sweater and ran to the kitchen. My dad was making pancakes but he grumbled about the broken stove.

"I think I burned the first one," my dad said.

"It’s okay, I like crunchy food!" I told him.

My best friend Sam appeared at the door with a big present. He threw it on the couch and we ran outside. We played tag until a bee was stinging my arm. I was groaning because it hurt a lot. My mom put ice on it and the pain gradually stopped. Later we ate stewed apples and cake. I knew it was the best birthday ever. I wrote a thank you card to Sam before I went to sleep.

My heart was thumping hard like a drum. We were playing the biggest kickball game ever at recess. The sun scorched the playground and it was super hot. A tiny breeze blew but it didn't help much.

"Watch out, here it comes!" screamed Tommy from the mound.

The red ball came fast and looked impossible to hit. I twisted my body and kicked with every single muscle. The ball rose high into the air like a rocket. It went way past the slide and the swings. I ran fast around the bases. I felt a sharp pain like a needle in my side but I kept running.

"Go! Go! Go!" my friends screamed loudly.

I slid into home plate right before the tag. We won the game and everyone was thrilled. It was better than boating or video games. I broke the kickball record today!

Last Wednesday, my friend Sam and I went exploring. We were in the jungle behind my house. We walked straight until we saw a big cave. I was seeing something big and gray inside.

"Look out, it's an elephant!" Sam shouted loudly.

It wasn't an elephant though. It was a giant monster roaming around. We ran away fast but there was a cliff. Sam loves jumping, so he had an idea. He tied a vine to his leg like a bungee cord.

"Hold on tight!" he yelled at me.

We jumped down together. It felt different than a swing. We landed safe but we were in trouble. The monster was looking down at us. My dad was coaching soccer nearby and heard us scream. He saved us!

My dog Buster is not very well trained. We went boating on the lake last weekend. Dad put Buster on a single chain so he would stay safe. But Buster saw a duck and jumped right in!

The boat started tipping over and Dad started groaning.

"Oh no, he caught the fishing line!" I yelled.

Buster struggled in the water because of his heavy weight. He was tangled in the line. Dad pulled him back up. Buster shook water on us like a fountain.

"Bad dog!" said Dad. "You are all wet."

Buster just barked and wagged his tail. We didn't catch any fish that day.

It was raining straight down on my big dog Max. He was running fast because he saw a squirrel on the fence. I grinned when he barked loud, but then I feared he would slip.

"Max, stop running now!" I yelled at him.

He didn't listen and he crushed a growing flower with his big paw. My mom says Max needs to get trained better. Sometimes my dad is swearing when Max is bad, but just quietly. Max came back and looked very hungry for his dinner. His tail was beating against my leg like a hammer.

"You are a good boy," I said and I gave him a treat.

I don't think dogs need caffeine to be crazy. They just have lots of energy inside them. Max pulled a thread on my shirt but I still love him. I hope I receive a new puppy for my birthday soon.

I woke up early because we were going camping later. I ate my breakfast very fast and grabbed my backpack. At school, my teacher gave us a math test. I looked at the paper and I felt certain I knew the answers. But then I got one wrong and I felt bad.

At recess, everyone was jumping and swinging on the monkey bars. My friend Sam looked sad.

"I hate math tests," Sam grumbled loudly.

"Me too, but at least it is lunch time," I said.

We sat down and spread out our food on the table. We tried to maintain a straight face but started laughing. I was groaning because I ate too much. It was a good day even with the test.

I sprinted to the cafeteria because I was so hungry. The scenery in the lunchroom was loud and messy. Kids were surrounding the tables and threw food everywhere. My friend Sam was approaching me with a big smile.

"I have a surprise in my lunchbox," Sam said.

I opened my bag and discovered a gross soggy sandwich. My dog chewed on the corner of the bag last night. I touched the bread and it felt super sticky. I started groaning because it looked like wet newspaper.

"You can have half of my pizza," Sam told me.

I crossed my fingers that it was pepperoni. It was! I guarantee it was the best lunch ever. We ate quickly and then ran through the doors for recess. We tried to maintain our speed to the swings. It was a great day even with a bad sandwich.

My robot named Zorg crashed into my apartment wall yesterday. He was trying to test his new super strength. It made a really big hole and my mom yelled.

"Zorg, you have to be careful inside!" I said.

Zorg looked sad and his metal eyes turned blue. "I am sorry, my sensors malfunctioned," he beeped.

We swept up the mess before my nephew came over. Zorg flew out the window to go buy some glue. He bought the strongest glue from the science store downtown. We fixed the wall but the glue added too much weight. The wall fell down again so we have to fix it tomorrow. I hope my mom doesn't see it.

It was my birthday in February and I was so excited. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We were making decorations with paper and big scissors.

"Be careful or you will get in trouble," Sam said.

I was trembling a little bit because I was so happy. I twisted the paper around my finger to make a curl. Then we threw the extra paper in the air like snow. It was such a pleasure having my best friend there.

My dad came in and saw the mess on the floor. "That is enough paper for a single lifetime!" he laughed.

He wasn't mad though and started teaching us a card game. Sam won the first game but I was just happy. Later we were sleeping in my fort and it was the best night ever.

I live in a big apartment with my dog Max. Max is a champion runner and he loves going outside. One day we went boating at the lake near the woods. Max jumped off the boat like he was bungee jumping!

"Come back here right now, Max!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and swam to the shore very fast. I knew he was feeling excited about the smells. I paddled the boat steady to catch him. When I got there, I discovered him digging in the mud. He was dumping dirt everywhere and barking at a turtle.

"You are not the captain of this boat," I said.

Max wagged his tail and we toasted marshmallows later. It was the beginning of a great summer, but he never escaped again. I drew a picture of him to remember the funny day.

One sunny morning I walked through the woods behind my house. The leaves crunched under my boots and it was a pleasant sound. I was bringing some nuts for the squirrels. Suddenly a small creature appeared near a big oak tree. It was a chipmunk with a single stripe on its back! I spread some peanuts on a flat rock for him. Then I saw a piece of paper on the ground. It was an old grocery receipt that someone dropped. I picked it up and crushed it into a ball for the trash.

"Here you go, little guy," I whispered to the chipmunk.

The chipmunk grabbed a nut and his eyes closed for a second.

"You are welcome," I said and walked back home happy.

I was walking to school when something funny happened. My backpack bounced on my back and hit the ground. A squirrel jumped out and simply ran away fast! I believed it was hiding in there all night.

When I got to class, my teacher greeted me. She said, "Why is there fur on your homework?"

"I think a squirrel tried to eat it," I said.

My friend Sam followed me to the water fountain later. He told me his nephew is coming over for camping. We talked about tents until the bell rang loud. It struck twelve o'clock so we went to lunch. The cafeteria smelled like brewed soup and burnt toast. I looked at the ceiling and saw a balloon stuck there. It was a really weird day at school but fun too.

Me and my friend Sam went to the big meadow. We were playing pirates and looking for treasure. Sam pretended to be a sailor on a ship. Suddenly we saw a dark cave approaching. It looked scary but the weather was pleasant.

"Let's go inside the cave!" Sam called loudly.

"That is impossible and dangerous," I said back.

We jumped inside anyway. It was dark but neither of us was scared. Seeing a shiny thing on the ground, I picked it up. It was just a needle but we pretended it was gold. I tried to explain that grown-ups drink caffeine but we found treasure instead. It was the best adventure ever.

My sister Sarah was having a sleepover for her birthday. Mom was bringing snacks to the basement but she tripped. She was carrying a tray of soda with lots of caffeine.

"Oh no, look at the rug!" Sarah yelled loudly.

The soda spilled everywhere and made a big brown puddle. Mom cleared the mess up fast with some paper towels. Then Sarah’s friend grabbed a game from her backpack.

"Let’s play this weird game about bungee jumping," she said.

The game had a little plastic guy wearing a helmet. You had to pull a chain to make him jump. We played until we were tired and growing sleepy. It was the best birthday ever even with the spill.

My brother Tim and I were loading the spaceship. We were bringing snacks for our big trip to Mars. Tim had a red juice stain on his shirt. He was clinging to his teddy bear because he was scared.

We blasted off and went super fast into space! Suddenly the ship stopped moving and we started floating.

"Wow, there is zero gravity here!" I shouted loudly.

Tim looked out the window and almost fainted. We landed on a red planet and walked outside. I grasped a cool red rock in my hand. We discovered a weird cave that smelled like roasted marshmallows.

"This is for science!" Tim said bravely.

Then we saw a green alien waving at us. We ran back to the ship very fast. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is very funny and always hungry. One day he ran through the bushes in the backyard. He saw a squirrel on the fence and scrambled up. But then he twisted his paw and fell down hard.

"Are you okay, Buster?" I asked him.

He just thumping his tail and looked at me. My neighbor Mrs. Green was reading her newspaper outside. She saw Buster and she grinned at us.

"That dog has too much energy!" she said.

I threw a ball for him to chase later. He didn't want the ball, he wanted my sandwich. Mom says meat has protein and makes dogs strong enough. Buster grumbled when I didn't give him any. He thinks the backyard is his own little island. Our day was complete when he finally went to sleep.

We went camping in the big dark woods last weekend. My brother Tom and I wanted to be explorers. We walked deep into the trees and found a cave. A giant black beetle was guarding the entrance.

"Watch out, that beetle looks really strong!" Tom yelled.

I carefully picked up a stick and poked the ground. The beetle moved away and the cave opened up. Inside we saw a shiny gold cup on a rock. We felt like champions because we found treasure. I used all my strength to lift the heavy cup.

"We need to be keeping this safe," I said.

We marched back to the tent with a happy rhythm. Everyone was surprised we found the secret treasure. It was the best adventure ever.

I was sitting at my desk and I felt tired. It was eight o'clock and time for school to start. My teacher walked in holding a big newspaper. She said, "Today we are learning about earning money."

I thought that sounded boring but then she smiled. She told us we could help sell cookies at recess. I used all my strength to carry the heavy box. My friend Sam appeared next to me in the hall.

"Can I help you carry that?" Sam asked me.

"Yes, please seize the other handle," I said happily.

We walked through the big doors to the playground. My little nephew goes to this school too. He bought a cookie and said it was yummy. It was a good day and I felt proud.

We went to search for the hidden treasure. Me and my brother Tom drove our bikes to the big scary cave. The cave looked dark and everyone was scared. We heard something groaning inside.

"I think it's a monster," I whispered to Tom.

"Don't be a baby," Tom said, but he was shaking.

Suddenly a big bat flew out at us! I threw a rock at it and it went away. We walked deeper and saw a dragon sleeping. Its fire breath scorched the walls. We saw gold coins everywhere!

We grabbed everything we could hold. Then the dragon woke up screaming. We ran fast and our heavy breathing was loud. We got home safe and toasted marshmallows to celebrate. We sang happy songs because we were rich!

My brother turned fourteen last week and we had a party. We went to a big park with a meadow. Mom blew up lots of balloons throughout the whole picnic area. My brother got a cool present wrapped in blue thread.

"I bet it is a video game," said my friend Sam.

My brother opened it and it was a bungee cord kit! He loves jumping off things and testing gravity. After lunch we went boating on the little lake. We saw a dog roaming near the water fountain. It looked like he stole a sandwich.

"That dog is so fast he is almost invisible!" I yelled.

We played all day until it grew dark outside. I understand why my brother likes birthdays because the cake was growing smaller very fast. We ate it all up.

Me and my dog Max went roaming in the woods. We saw a single path that grew dark and scary. The weather was cold so I zipped up my coat. Max started barking at a big cave.

"Don't go in there Max!" I yelled loudly.

But he ran inside and I had to follow him. It smelled like old toasted bread in there. Suddenly my heart started beating very fast. A giant bear was sleeping on some crushed leaves! It looked hungry. I stepped on a stick and it snapped. The bear opened one eye and struck the ground.

"Run away now!" I screamed at Max.

We ran fast and we didn't stop. We got home safe and I read the newspaper to relax.

I went to my friend Tim’s house for a sleepover. We decided to build a huge fort in the living room. We used blankets and chairs to make a castle. It looked really cool but it was dark inside.

"I think someone is following us," Tim whispered to me.

I looked around but the door was closed tight. Then we heard a loud knock on the wall. We both jumped up and started to run away. Suddenly my big sister jumped out and caught us!

"You guys are so scared!" she laughed at us.

We thought she was an invisible ghost but it was just her. Then we went back inside the fort to read comic books. It was the best sleepover ever.

My big brother Jake bought a new racing game today. I sat on the ground and watched the loading screen. It took forever! Jake was coaching me on how to play.

"You have to press the blue button to go fast," he said.

"I can learn it by myself," I told him.

I grabbed the controller early, even though the race hadn't started. The first scene was a cool city with lots of cars. I crashed into a wall right away. Jake laughed, but I kept going. I was getting better at steering. I can guarantee I will beat him next time. He is teaching me the secret shortcuts now. We played until dinner was already ready.

The giant robot beetle was huge and scary. It had red eyes and shiny metal legs. I sprinted away as fast as I could. The beetle chased me and brewed green slime from its mouth. I was so afraid but I kept running.

"Help me! It’s going to eat me!" I screamed.

My friend Max flew down from the sky. He has superpowers and he is very strong. He pushed the robot over with one hand.

"Are you okay?" Max asked me.

"Yes, thank you for keeping me safe," I said.

The robot tried to get up again. I knew we had to go now. We escaped just in time before it grabbed us. Next time I will not go near the evil robot factory.

I sat at my desk and looked at the clock. It was time for math and I felt afraid. Mr. Green wrote a big problem on the board. It was fourteen plus twenty. I searched for my pencil but it was gone.

"Who took my pencil?" I shouted.

Tommy touched my arm and gave it back. I chose the wrong answer first but then fixed it. Finally the bell rang for recess. We ran outside and played pirates on the playground. I was the captain and Tommy was a sailor. We landed on the slide and pretended it was an island.

"Seize the treasure!" Tommy yelled loud.

We tried to squeeze into the tunnel but we got stuck. We laughed often because it was funny. School is okay when you have a best friend.

I woke up early because my bed was shaking. A tiny green alien stood on my pillow holding a silver needle.

"I am swearing that I will zap you!" he shouted.

I tried to grab him but he bit my thumb. It hurt a lot so I jumped up. The alien pointed his needle and suddenly I was floating! We flew out the window towards a giant castle in the clouds.

"Please explain what is happening right now," I said.

"We are going boating in the sky," the alien told me.

The castle had a moat but the water was freezing cold. My robot dog was there too but he broke his leg. Then a dragon flew out and roared loudly. I got so scared that I fainted right away.

My dog Rex is usually a good boy, but not today. We were loading the car for camping, but Rex ran away. I saw him approaching the big woods behind our house. My mom said those woods are dangerous for little dogs.

"Rex, come back!" I yelled, but he did not listen.

I ran after him and found him sniffing a tiny lamb. The lamb looked like it was from heaven because it was so white. It made a funny noise that sounded foreign to me. I did not understand why a lamb was alone.

"We have to maintain our distance," my dad said behind me.

Just then, a farmer greeted us and picked up the lamb. Rex grumbled because he wanted to play more. We finally got back to the car to receive a treat. We were already late for our trip!

The sun was bright and a cool breeze hit my face. It was finally time for recess and I was so happy. I ran outside to the playground with my friend Sam.

"I bet I can swing higher than you!" Sam shouted.

"No way, I am the champion of swinging," I said back.

We ran to the swings and started pumping our legs fast. I looked up at the blue sky like a giant ceiling. I went higher and higher and the wind felt great. Suddenly the whistle blew loudly, sounding like a train horn. It was ringing in my ears but I didn't care.

"I won!" I yelled as I jumped off into the sand.

There was no reason to argue because I was definitely higher. We walked back to class for our meeting on the rug. I feared math class but recess made it better.

My dog Barnaby is very lazy and huge. He has a lot of weight, but he is happy. Yesterday, I tried to get him to do a trick. I had trained him before, but he forgot. I held a treat, but he simply sat down.

"Come on, Barnaby! Jump up!" I shouted loudly.

He didn't move, and neither did his tail. Then a great idea struck me. My mom had just made stewed beef for dinner. It smelled so good. I grabbed a piece and wrapped it in a newspaper.

"Look at this yummy meat!" I said to him.

Barnaby jumped up so fast to complete the trick! He ate the meat in one bite. He is smart when he is hungry.

My heart was pumping fast at the big basketball game. The noise surrounding the court was super loud. It was sounding like a huge roar from a lion. I had the ball and the other team’s guard was huge. He looked like a giant from a foreign land.

"Pass me the ball!" my friend Tim yelled loudly.

I was steering around the big guy but I tripped. It felt like I was bungee jumping without a rope. I fell but I threw the ball up high. It went right in the hoop!

"You made it!" the coach’s daughter screamed from the bench.

Neither team could believe I made that crazy shot. It was like dumping a bucket of water on them. We won the game and we all cheered.

I was playing a really cool video game about a castle. It was the hardest level and I thought winning was impossible. My brother came in and he wanted to play too.

"It is my turn now," he said and grabbed the controller.

"Wait until I see the game over sign!" I yelled back.

He pulled a loose thread on my shirt to annoy me. I tried to use psychology on him by ignoring it. Then I found a secret leather chest in the game. It had a special receipt inside that gave me extra life! I finally beat the boss and everyone cheered. I felt like the best gamer in the whole world.

My brother and I went camping in the big meadow. We had to set up the tent on the hard earth. It took fourteen minutes to get it ready. I was wearing my blue jacket because it was chilly.

Suddenly, a squirrel approached our fire. It looked hungry and cute.

"Do you think he wants a marshmallow?" I asked.

"Maybe he wants it toasted," my brother said.

I reached for a marshmallow, but the squirrel ran. He disappeared behind a big green bush. I walked over and touched the leaves gently. For some reason, he was gone. But I had a happy feeling anyway. Our camping trip was complete now.

I was sitting at my desk doing math homework. It was so boring and I wanted to go outside. Suddenly I saw a little black bug on my paper. It was a beetle and it crawled very slowly.

"Hey, look at this cool bug!" I whispered to Sam.

Sam looked over and said, "Is that a gnat?"

"No, it's way too big," I told him immediately.

The beetle started following the line of my pencil. I put a tiny crumb from my snack near it. The bug struck the crumb and started eating it. Then my teacher walked by and was bumping into desks. I hid the bug under my hand fast. We are going camping this weekend so I will find more bugs.

My brother Tom and I had an important schedule today. We wanted to beat the last level on the computer. I grabbed the controller and my hands felt sweaty. The game was loading and the screen turned blue.

"You have to be careful with the lava!" Tom yelled.

I gripped the buttons hard and started running my character. He was jumping over fire pits and especially the spikes. We had to climb the tall castle wall. It was taking longer than last time. Suddenly my guy fell off the edge!

"Oh no! Start over!" I was screaming at the screen.

Tom toasted some bread while I tried again. I finally made it to the top. We won the game and felt really happy.

Me and my brother Max went camping last summer. We walked into the woods and it grew very dark. We saw a weird cave that was fourteen feet high.

"Let's go inside," said Max.

I was scared but I climbed up the rocks anyway. Inside the cave, something weird happened. We heard a loud noise like a truck dumping rocks.

"Run away fast!" I yelled.

We ran out and drew a map so we wouldn't forget. We ran back to our meeting spot near the tent. The height of the mountain was scary but we were safe. We ate hot dogs and never went back to that cave again.

I carefully crossed the playground to talk to my neighbor. His name is Sam and he had a cool new toy. It looked like a bungee cord but smaller.

"Is that for homework?" I asked him.

"No, I found it on the ground," Sam grumbled.

We looked at the surrounding area for a sign. Maybe someone lost it during our class meeting. I held it and felt the weight in my hand. It was heavy and looked like a foreign object.

"Maybe an alien trained with it," Sam said.

We counted to three and threw it. It landed near the slide. Then the bell rang for lunch. We ran inside fast.

I ate my breakfast fast so I would not be late. Today was a wonderful day because I was the kickball captain. I walked to school and saw my neighbor, Billy. He was roaming around the sidewalk near the big tree.

"Are you ready to lose today?" I asked him.

"I guarantee my team will win!" Billy yelled back.

We neared the playground and I gripped my lucky red ball. I saw a trail of ants on the ground. We played kickball and my team was winning by a lot. But then the lunch bell rang and cleared the field. I was sad about leaving the game. I saw a balloon floating away in the sky. I understand why people love recess so much. It is the best part of school.

Me and my best friend Tom wanted to climb the big mountain. We heard a scary noise sounding like a monster. Tom was thrilled but I was scared. We walked through the dark woods and the path gradually got steep.

Suddenly a big bird screeched loudly above us.
"Watch out for gravity!" Tom screamed as he slipped on a rock.
"Grab my hand!" I shouted back.

He almost fell but I pulled him up. We cleared the path and found a cave. Inside, a witch brewed a green potion. It stewed in a big pot and smelled bad. We ran away fast so we wouldn't get pneumonia from the cold cave. I almost fainted because I ran so hard. We needed a guide next time. Exploring is very dangerous work.

One day my nephew Sam and I went outside. We wanted to find bugs in the big green yard. Suddenly, we discovered a huge brown dog behind a tree. I was a little afraid because he looked scary. But then the dog started jumping up and down happily.

"He wants to play with us!" Sam yelled loudly.

I grabbed a stick and threw it very far away. The dog ran fast and grasped the stick tightly. He chewed on it and brought it back to me. His paws made a mud stain on my new shoes. I remembered I had some treats in my pocket. I treated him to a biscuit and he was very pleased.

"Let's name him Buster," I said to Sam.

We played until it got dark and we were tired.

My friends and I went boating down the big river. We were following an old map to find a jewel. The wind blew hard and pushed our boat fast. Suddenly we saw a dark cave and we went in.

Inside it was scary and we heard something roaming around.

"I think a dragon is sleeping in here!" said Tim.

We walked through the dark and saw a glowing light. It was the jewel but a big bear was guarding it! We crossed the cave quietly without waking him up. I gave a thumbs up to my friends. We grabbed the jewel and ran out fast.

"We made it!" I yelled and we were so thrilled.

We were honest and gave the jewel to the museum. We had good company and fun throughout the whole day.

I was walking through the park near my apartment. Suddenly a green robot crashed right in front of me! It looked like a dumping truck but twisted into a man shape. Smoke came out of its ears and disappeared into the sky. The robot looked sad because it was trapped on Earth.

"Help me fix my ship," said the robot loudly.

"That is impossible because I am just a kid," I said.

The robot closed its big yellow eyes and started beeping. Neither of us knew what to do. Then I used my superpower. I shot lasers from my eyes! The ship was fixed and the robot flew away to reign over Mars. I will always remember earning a robot friend that day.

I was exploring the woods with my dog, Buster. Buster is big like an elephant and he loves chasing squirrels. Suddenly, a bright red ball bounced across the path. Buster grabbed it and looked very thrilled.

"Drop it, Buster!" I shouted.

He didn't listen and he ran into the bushes. I climbed over a big log and followed him. A stinging nettle struck my leg but I kept going. Buster disappeared behind a big tree. I found him clinging to a toy bear.

"Good boy, you found a treasure!" I said.

I was earning his trust with a treat. That was enough exploring for today, so I let Buster guide us home.

Me and my friend Sam went to the woods. We walked for an hour and saw a big cave. It looked scary but we were brave. Sam gripped his flashlight tight and we went inside.

"Look at that shiny rock!" Sam yelled loudly.

I knew we found treasure. But then a big bear growled at us. It sounded like thunder. We ran fast and hid behind a tree. The bear went away and we were safe.

"That was not pleasant at all," I said.

We grinned because we still had the gold rock. We felt like kings who could reign over the forest. We grew tired so we went home to measure our treasure. It was the best day ever.

I went outside to play in the jungle behind my apartment. My dog Sparky ran with me and we found a big stick. I grasped the stick tight because it was a sword.

"I am the king of this island!" I yelled loud.

Sparky barked at a squirrel and turned in circles. The squirrel ran up a tree and disappeared fast. I felt gravity pull me down when I jumped off a rock. I pretended to reign over the bugs and the dirt.

"We will come back tomorrow," I told Sparky.

Suddenly a big cloud came and it looked like rain. My mom called us for dinner so we ran home. I felt anger because I wanted to play more. Being a king is hard work.

We were camping near a big mountain for the weekend. I brought my basketball because there was a hoop. My heart was thumping hard because I wanted to win. My brother grasped the ball and bounced it fast. I gripped my sneakers on the concrete and blocked him. Then I scratched my knee but I kept playing.

"You can't beat me today!" I yelled at him.

He laughed and tried to shoot over my head. The ball hit the rim and rolled off. I grabbed it like it was a shiny jewel. I brewed up a plan to trick him. I ran to the fountain and then turned around fast. I shot the ball and everyone cheered for me.

"That was a certain lucky shot," he said sadly.

I felt like a king on a high balcony. I won the game!

Me and my best friend Sam walked into the dark forest. We were on a secret quest for pirate gold. I knew it was dangerous though. Sam held the map and I held the flashlight. We saw a sign that said "Danger!"

Suddenly, a big monster jumped out! It scratched the tree and made a groaning sound.

"Run!" I yelled at Sam.

We ran fast and the monster disappeared into the fog. We found a cave and a science lab was inside. A weird potion brewed in a pot.

"I guarantee there is treasure here," Sam whispered.

A big guard dog was sleeping by a chest. We counted to three and closed our eyes. We grabbed the gold without earning it. We ran home safely. My mom was coaching soccer so she didn't see us.

I was thrilled because it was finally lunchtime at school. My neighbor sat next to me and opened his box. He had a sandwich that looked like a huge mountain. I greeted him and then I looked at my own lunch. My mom packed me a weird foreign cheese again.

"Do you want to trade lunches?" I asked him.

He looked at my cheese and started groaning loudly. "No way, I am already eating my pizza," he said.

I was crushed but I started to gnaw on my cheese. It tasted okay but I really wanted pizza. Then the bell rang for recess and I ran outside for soccer training. I tried to design a cool play but I fell down. It was still a good day because I scored a goal later.

My nephew Ben and I went camping in the woods. We were loading the big green tent into the car. I gripped the bag and Ben grasped the poles. It was heavy and I was groaning under the weight.

"Keep it steady!" I yelled at Ben.

We walked into the forest and found a flat spot. We stood there and looked at the tall trees. Suddenly, we heard a bumping sound behind a bush. A little raccoon popped out and met our eyes. It looked like the king of the forest in his reign.

"He wants our food," Ben whispered to me.

We brewed some hot chocolate on the fire later. I tried to measure the water but I spilled it. Camping is really fun even when you make a mess.

My dog Buster loves digging in the soft earth. One day we went to the big park behind my house. Buster started digging fast and dirt went everywhere. Suddenly something shiny appeared in the deep hole. It was a weird metal box and it was ringing!

"What is that noise?" asked my neighbor Mrs. Lee. She was walking her cat.

"I think it's treasure!" I grinned at her.

Buster made a funny groaning sound and pulled the box out. It wasn't treasure. It was just an old toy phone. It started singing a silly song.

"I can explain," said a boy wearing a pirate hat. "I am Captain Jack and that is my phone!"

We all laughed and Buster barked happily. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods yesterday. We ran through the tall grass and jumped over logs. Max stopped and sniffed a big rock with a weird design.

"Look at that!" I yelled to Max.

He wagged his tail and barked. Suddenly, something bright blew past my face. It was a blue feather that looked like a shiny jewel. I picked it up with my thumb and finger. I wanted to measure it, but I didn't have a ruler.

Then we saw a squirrel on a branch. Max ran fast and crashed into a bush.

"Silly dog, you can't catch him," I said.

We walked home and I counted three bugs on my shirt. I read a book about birds later. It was the best day ever.

My brother Tom and I played a new video game. It was a big adventure in a dark, scary castle. We had to find a hidden jewel to win.

"Use your imagination!" Tom yelled at me loudly.

I scrambled up a wall and jumped over a hole. The dragon scorched the ground with hot fire. I blew up a wall with a bomb. We found a secret room with a science lab inside.

"Look at that gold chain!" I shouted at the screen.

The monster was moaning and bearing its sharp teeth. It was really scary but I did not stop running. I had to contain my excitement when I saw the jewel. It was sitting on a crumpled receipt on the floor.

"We did it without swearing!" Tom laughed.

We won the level and gave each other a high-five.

We were boating on the river near the big mountain. My friend Sam and I wanted to find the hidden cave. The water was bumping against our little blue boat.

"Look over there!" yelled Sam. He pointed at a dark hole in the rocks.

We pulled the boat onto the sandy shore. We counted to three and ran inside the cave. It was very dark but we had flashlights. Suddenly, we heard a loud growl approaching us. It sounded impossible but it was a bear! We ran out fast.

"That was scary but wonderful," I said.

We found a beautiful shiny rock outside instead. It was a good adventure.

My dog Buster is a huge champion swimmer. One day we went to the big lake outside. The grass was growing really tall and green there. Buster saw a duck and he ran very fast.

"Come back here Buster!" I screamed loudly.

He didn't listen and he jumped in the water. He swam far away and I followed him on the shore. I thought he was going to catch the duck. Suddenly he gripped a big stick in his mouth instead. It was a funny scene.

"You are silly," I said to my wet dog.

My mom said it was cold enough for pneumonia. She sent us back to the warm car. Buster shook water everywhere and messed up the seats.

My friends and I were playing a new game. We were boating on the grass at recess time. The wind was a nice breeze on my face.

"Watch out for the sharks!" yelled Tommy loudly.

We moved our arms like oars and went fast. Suddenly, the school bell rang for lunchtime. The big doors were closed, but then they opened. We all kept running to the cafeteria together. I was so hungry for my sandwich.

"I caught you!" said Sarah when she tagged me.

We sat at table fourteen and opened our lunchboxes. My mom packed me an apple and chips. It was just the beginning of lunch, but I ate fast. My stomach felt like it was loading up with food. It was the best day ever.

I live in a big apartment with my family. My younger brother loves sleeping all the time, but I like school. Today we had science class and it was super fun. We learned about bugs and looked at them with big magnifying glasses.

Then it was recess and we ran outside really fast. Me and my friend Sam went straight to the climbing bars. We raced to the top and counted how fast we went.

"I did it in fourteen seconds!" Sam yelled.

"I can do it faster!" I shouted back.

Suddenly, everyone started screaming because a dog ran onto the playground. We laughed together because the dog just wanted to play tag. The teacher chased him throughout the whole yard until lunch started. It was the best day ever.

I was playing Super Mario on my big brother’s TV. The scenery in the game was full of green pipes. Mario moved very fast and I was jumping over lava. My hands were trembling because I was on the last level.

"You can do it, Leo!" my friend Sam yelled.

I discovered a secret block and got a mushroom. But then a giant turtle boss came out. It looked impossible to beat him. My controller cord got twisted up in my legs. I knew I had to focus.

"Jump on his head now!" Sam screamed at me.

I climbed up the bricks and stomped on the turtle. I remember feeling so happy when I won the game. Trouble brewed when my brother came home, but I didn't care. I was the champion.

I was walking by the river and I saw a tiny island. Something strange appeared near the water. It was a little duck and it was trembling. I neared the edge but it flew away fast. Then I saw a floating log with a squirrel on it.

"Hey little guy!" I shouted at him.

The squirrel looked at me and blinked.

"Do you want a crumb of my sandwich?" I asked.

He jumped off the log and ran up a tree. It was like he was trained to be a ninja. My dad says squirrels have too much caffeine. I went home and my mom was making stewed carrots. The steam was loading up near the ceiling. It smelled good but I missed my squirrel friend.

One day me and my friend Sam went to the dark forest. We heard a loud noise deep in the woods. It sounded like a giant ringing bell. Sam was scared but I grabbed his hand. We walked longer until we saw a big cave. Inside the cave was a shiny blue jewel on a rock.

"Look at that!" I yelled.

"It is the greatest treasure ever," Sam said.

Suddenly a big dragon jumped out and sang a loud roar. I grasped the jewel and ran very fast. We knew we had to escape. We ran home and hid the jewel under my bed. It was the best adventure.

We were playing Mario Kart on Saturday. My brother Jake picked Yoshi and I picked Toad. The race started and we went straight for the big ramp. I jumped over the banana peel but Jake hit it.

"Oh man! I am going to lose!" Jake yelled loudly.

I grabbed the controller tight and kept steering left. I stuck my tongue out because I was concentrating hard. I wanted to win because I am only nine. Jake is thirteen so he usually wins everything. 

"Not this time!" I shouted back at him.

I used a mushroom boost and zoomed past the finish line. It was plain to see that I was the winner. I don't know about psychology, but winning felt really good.

I really wanted to win the big race at recess. My friend Leo is super fast, though. I feared he would beat me again. The whistle blew and we both pushed off hard. My sneakers screeched on the blacktop as I ran. I used all my strength to go faster.

"I’m going to win!" shouted Leo from behind me.

I didn't look back. I just ran. I almost dropped my water bottle but I kept going. We fought for first place near the slide. Suddenly, Leo fell down. I stopped running to help him up.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

He nodded and smiled. We didn't care about the schedule or winning anymore. I slept really good that night because I knew I did the right thing.

My friend Leo came over for my birthday sleepover. We decided to build a huge fort in the living room. We used all the blankets and pillows we could find. It looked like a beautiful castle for a king.

"This is the best fort ever!" Leo yelled loudly.

"I know, right? It is huge!" I said back.

We were jumping inside when suddenly the roof crashed down. It almost crushed my baby sister’s doll house. We laughed so hard even though it was a mess. Then we pretended we were invisible spies hiding in the ruins. Later we went outside to the park. We saw the big water fountain spraying high up. It was the best birthday ever.

I was playing my new knight video game on Saturday. I picked the strongest character with big armor. The loading bar took forever but then the match started. My heart was thumping really fast.

"I bet I can beat you this time!" my brother yelled.

"No way, I have more strength points," I said back.

We ran through a dark forest in the game. It looked like the place we go camping in the summer. Suddenly a giant bear came out of the earth. He was bearing a huge sword. I jumped and hit the button hard. My knight swung his sword and won the fight! Now I am the best player in our little league.

I wanted to beat the last level on my computer. I picked the knight because he looked stronger than the wizard. The game was hard and my hands were shaking. My mom walked in and I paused the game quickly.

"Are you hungry?" she asked me while holding an apple.

"Not right now mom, I am busy winning," I said.

She understood and left the room so I could finish. I started steering my character past the big green monster. I used a bungee rope to swing over the lava pit. The music was sounding very loud and scary now. I found the hidden treasure box and opened it up. It had a gold key inside to complete the level. I felt like a huge weight was lifted off me. I finally won the game and felt so happy!

It was my birthday and I was turning eight. All my friends came over for a big sleepover. We decided to make a huge fort in the living room. We brought all the blankets and pillows from my room.

"Make sure it touches the ceiling!" my friend Sam yelled.

We stacked chairs and built the walls really high. It was like building a real castle. Suddenly my cat Mittens ran inside and screeched loudly. We were scared but then we saw she was just playing.

"She touched the top part!" I shouted.

The whole thing fell down on our heads. We counted to three and then we laughed a lot. My mom came in approaching us with a big cake. It was the most important day ever.

My friends and I went deep into the spooky woods. We were yearning for a big adventure that day. Tim brought his science kit to measure strange footprints. 

"Look at that giant hole!" shouted Tim loudly. 

We saw a big cave that looked super dark. I had a thought that maybe a bear lived there. We walked closer and I cleared away some big branches. Suddenly a huge raccoon escaped from the black cave!

"We are in big trouble now!" I yelled.

But the raccoon just ran away very fast. I guess he already knew we were coming. We did not need psychology to know he was scared. We ran home before it got too dark outside.

One day I was earning my allowance by cleaning my room. Suddenly I heard a loud knock on my window. It was a green creature with three eyes and robot arms! I screamed because I was scared. The alien held up a pair of scissors and started approaching me.

"Do not complain," the alien said in a robot voice. "I just need a haircut."

I did not want to explain that I am not a barber. I simply took the scissors and cut his weird purple hair. He looked at his new design in the mirror.

"This is very important," he said and gave me a space rock.

Then he disappeared in a flash of blue light. I stopped screaming and put the rock in my pocket. That was the weirdest Saturday ever.

Yesterday I rode my bike to school. I gripped the handlebars really tight because I was nervous. My backpack was full of heavy books. The weight made me wobble a lot.

"Watch out!" my friend Sam yelled at me.

I almost crashed into a bush. Gravity pulled me down hard. I struggled to keep the bike straight.

At recess, we played kickball. I love kickball, especially when I'm pitching. I kicked the ball and it flew high up.

"Run! Run fast!" everyone was screaming.

I ran to first base and I was thrilled. But then I tripped on my shoelace. I made a huge scene and everyone looked. I was groaning because my knee hurt.

After school, I went back to my apartment. I discovered I forgot my homework at school. My mom is good at coaching me, but she can't help if I don't have the paper!

I brought my new hamster to school today for show and tell. His name is Fluffy, but he is stronger than he looks. I put his cage on my desk and told everyone to be quiet.

"Don't touch the cage," I said.

My friend Billy scratched his head and leaned closer. "Can he do tricks?" Billy asked.

Suddenly, Fluffy started to gnaw on the metal bars. He chewed and chewed until a single bar broke! Fluffy squeezed out and ran across the floor. He ran past the scenery we drew for the school play.

The teacher threw a towel over him and caught him fast. We put him back and taped the cage. It was the best show and tell ever.

Yesterday was the worst day ever at school. I had fourteen math problems to complete before lunch. My hand was trembling because I was so hungry. Finally the bell rang and I ran to the cafeteria.

"Hey, watch out!" my friend Billy yelled at me.

I tripped and pushed my tray right off the table. My toasted cheese sandwich went flying through the air. It landed right on Billy’s head. Everyone started laughing and pointing. I felt like groaning but I just stood there.

"You are dumping lunch on me!" Billy shouted.

I saw a piece of cheese clinging to his hair. Then the whistle blew for recess. We jumped up and ran outside for an hour. We played in our kickball league and I was steering the ball. I forgot about the cheese until later. It was sticky but funny.

We went to the spooky cave near my house. My friend Ben brought his new leather backpack. He bought it yesterday for our big trip. We walked inside and it was super dark.

"Watch out!" shouted Ben. I was bumping into the walls.

Suddenly we saw a huge shadow move. We knew it was a bear! I screamed really loud. Ben reached into his bag. He was dumping all his stuff out. He threw his sandwich at the bear. The bear ate it and looked happy. It happened so fast.

"Run away now!" I yelled.

We ran outside and we were thrilled to be safe. We drew a map of the cave later. We felt like real explorers throughout the whole day.

I sat at my desk and my brain felt tired. Mrs. Miller said the math test was very important today. I tried to explain the answers but I forgot them.

"Does anyone have scissors for the art project?" asked Tommy.

I looked in my bag and immediately found my red pair. I grinned and gave them to him. Then the lunch bell rang and we started running.

Outside, we played a game of tag near the swings. I was the guard of the slide but then I crashed. I fell down and my knee felt scorched on the hot ground.

"Are you okay?" Tommy asked while groaning about the heat.

I stood up and brushed off the dirt. It was just a scratch so I greeted my friends again. We finished playing and went back inside for reading time.

One day my friends and I went to the old castle. It was dark and cold inside the stone walls. We wanted to find the king’s lost treasure. Tim looked up at the high ceiling and saw bats. Suddenly a big green monster appeared in the doorway! It screeched very loud and started tearing at the door.

"Run away fast!" yelled Sarah as she grabbed my arm.

We ran down the hall and escaped through a window. The monster could not catch us. We were safe outside in the bright sun.

"That was the greatest adventure ever," I said.

Tim grinned at me and we walked home. The monster can keep his reign over the dark castle.

I really wanted to win the big soccer game today. My dad paid for extra coaching so I could get better. I put on my cleats and felt like I was floating. The game started and I ran very fast down the field. I saw the ball and I thought about kicking it hard.

"Pass it to me!" yelled my friend Sam.

I did not pass it and neither did the other team. The ball felt heavy like a big weight. I kicked it but the goalie found it and grabbed it. It was sad but I remember what my dad said.

"Having fun is the most important thing," he told me.

So I smiled and ran back to play some more.

I had a huge mountain of homework to do. My teacher said it should be a breeze, but she was wrong. I kept trying to fix my math, but I realized I made a mistake.

"This is taking too long!" I yelled at my paper.

My mom came in holding her old guitar. She saw my face and sat down.

"Did you see the beetle roaming outside?" she asked.

I jumped up and ran to the window. A big black bug was loading a piece of leaf on its back. It was a good sign. If he could do hard work, I could too.

I sat back down and my heart sank a little, but I picked up my pencil. I had enough energy to remain in my chair and finish.

My friend Sam and I were playing a new video game. It was about aliens roaming in space. We knew we had to win or the aliens would spread everywhere. Suddenly my screen froze and it was freezing in the game too.

"Oh no! My character is trapped in the ice!" I yelled.

Sam treated me to a power-up potion and I grew bigger. We followed the alien boss into a dark science lab.

"Watch out for the sleeping guards," Sam whispered loudly.

I remembered the secret code and we unlocked the big door. The surrounding walls started shaking and groaning like a monster. We ran out fast, leaving the bad guys behind. We high-fived because we saved the whole galaxy. Then my neighbor knocked on the door to play soccer outside.

Yesterday at recess we played a fun game. Tim chose to be the knight. I was the guard leading everyone to the big slide. The slide was actually a hidden castle.

"Halt right there!" I yelled at Tim. He stopped and looked at the scenery.

"I am here for the lost jewel," Tim said back.

Then the wind blew really hard and my hat flew off. I ran after it but I tripped and fell. My heart sank because everyone laughed. But then Tim helped me up. We found a shiny rock in the sand.

"Look, it is the treasure!" he screeched.

We put the rock in our pocket and ran inside. It was the best recess ever.

Me and my friend Sam went exploring in the woods. We found a weird cave behind some bushes. It was dark but we walked through it. Suddenly a big rock fell down with a loud groaning sound!

"Run!" I shouted and I grabbed Sam’s arm.

We ran fast but then a monster appeared. It looked scary and had green skin. It blocked the way to a magic fountain. We threw stones at it but they did not help. The monster was huge and had a lot of weight.

"We have to remain brave," Sam whispered to me.

I found a torch on the wall. The fire roasted the monster’s tail and it ran away. We were safe! We didn't learn much but we toasted marshmallows later to celebrate. It was the best adventure ever.

It was raining very hard outside my house. My friend Max stood by the window and looked sad.

"I am afraid of the storm," Max said quietly.

"Don't worry, we can have an adventure inside," I told him.

We pretended the floor was a big blue ocean. We swam across the rug to get to the kitchen. Then we brewed a magic potion with orange juice and milk. It tasted funny but we drank it all. Suddenly, a monster appeared! It was just my dog, Buster. He grumbled at us because he wanted a treat. Max grasped my hand tight. We drew a map to find the hidden treasure box. Inside was a beautiful shiny rock I found at the park. We played until we got tired. Nobody had to go to the hospital today. It was the best quest ever.

Recess is usually my favorite part of the day. But today it was a big adventure. I was swinging on the chain swing and feeling very happy. It was a pleasant day and the sun was hot. Then I felt a giant sneeze coming.

"Ah-choo!" I screeched really loud.

My sandwich flew out of my hand and scattered everywhere. The bread went near the water fountain. The cheese landed on my shoe. I was sad about the meaning of this mess. It meant no lunch for me!

"Do you want half of my cookie?" my friend Leo asked.

I smiled and took the cookie. It was the best cookie ever.

My friends and I went into the woods for a meeting. We had a really important mission to find the lost treasure. Sam brought scissors to cut the vines and I brought rope. We walked for a long time and my backpack had too much weight.

Suddenly we heard a loud screaming noise behind a big tree. It was a giant squirrel guarding a shiny box!

"I guarantee that squirrel wants to eat us for protein!" yelled Sam.

I was scared but I grabbed a pine needle like a sword. The squirrel looked at us and then ran away fast. We opened the box and found gold coins inside. We were the best company of explorers ever.

One day I was walking in the woods. I saw a huge metal beetle on the ground. It was shiny like a green jewel. I picked it up but it got hot. Suddenly, the beetle stood up on tiny legs!

"Put me down right now!" the beetle yelled.

I was so scared I dropped it. It grew bigger and bigger. It was incredible and scary. It grew fourteen feet tall.

"I am a robot king," it said with a speaking voice.

I knew I had to be brave. I kept my legs steady. We fought with laser beams from my eyes. I have superpowers too! I won and he turned back into a toy. I put him in my pocket.

I was playing my favorite video game about racing cars. I moved my blue car super fast around the track. I had to watch the speed needle go way up. My friend Sam was playing too and he was winning.

"You can't beat me today!" Sam yelled at me.

I remembered a secret shortcut I saw on YouTube yesterday. I drove off the road and jumped over a hill. Suddenly I was in first place and earning lots of points. I had fourteen big coins and Sam had zero.

"Wait, what is the meaning of this?" Sam asked loudly.

It was a total pleasure to see him so surprised. Then I heard the finish line music play for me. I won the race and it was awesome.

We woke up early because we had a big plan. My brother Tim and I walked to the old cave. We heard a loud noise inside and I felt scared. Tim said, "Maybe it is a ghost or a monster." 

We squeezed through the tiny hole in the rocks. It was dark but I had my flashlight ready. Suddenly something scratched my leg and I screamed very loud! 

"Don't worry, it's just a cat," Tim told me.

We saw an old sailor hat on the ground. We were pleased because it looked like real treasure. We feared the cave but we were brave explorers. It was thirteen minutes past noon on my watch. We ran home because we had a schedule to keep. Mom was waiting with lunch and we were hungry.

My neighbor Tom came over to play video games. We picked the boating game because I am the captain. The game was still loading, so we played rock paper scissors. I won because rock crushes scissors every time.

"You can't beat me," I said with a big smile.

"Just wait until the boat race starts!" Tom yelled.

The game started and we went straight through the big fountain. I was dumping water on his boat to slow him down. It was simply the best trick ever. I counted to three and then I zoomed past him. I scratched my nose because it was itchy, but I didn't stop. I didn't lose either because I am the fastest racer. Tom was mad but he still ate my snacks.

Yesterday my friend Sam came over to play video games. We played a racing game called Super Speed Cars. I was steering my red car really fast around the track. Sam picked a big green truck that looked like a tank.

"I am going to win this time!" yelled Sam.

"No way, my car is incredible!" I shouted back.

My heart was thumping hard because we were tied. Suddenly Sam hit a bump and went flying off the earth. His truck was dumping smoke everywhere on the screen. I crossed the finish line first and I felt great.

"I guess I need to learn how to drive better," said Sam.

"Maybe you need some psychology to be calm," I joked.

After that we played a game about a soldier named Colonel Zoom. But then my dad said to stop because my baby sister was sleeping.

I was dreaming about winning the big race all night. My dad pulled me out of bed early. "Get up, champ!" he yelled loudly. I was so tired I needed caffeine, but I am too young. We drove to the track and saw the sign. My dog tried to gnaw on my shoe. He chewed the laces, but I tied them anyway.

The race started and I flew down the track. I was tearing up the dirt. A boy from a foreign country was next to me. I dropped my water bottle, but I kept running fast. I had to learn to be faster. I crossed the line first! "You did it!" my dad screamed. I was so happy I almost cried.

My friends and I built a secret fort in the woods. We were teaching my dog Max how to explore. Suddenly we heard a loud noise near the old river.

"What was that sound?" asked my friend Sam.

We ran fast and saw a big, twisted tree. It had crashed down on the path. But then we saw something scary behind it. A strange creature was stuck in the branches! It looked like a big raccoon but blue. It was caught in a vine like a bungee cord.

"It is in danger!" I yelled.

I climbed the tree carefully and pulled the vine. The creature jumped down and ran away fast. We saved the day and felt like heroes.

I was running in the hall at school. My teacher said no running but I did it anyway. I jumped over a big pile of books. Then I crashed right into my friend Billy. He had his scissors and they flew everywhere. We fell on the floor and laughed really loud.

Then it was lunchtime and we went to the cafeteria. The lunch lady made stewed carrots and they smelled bad. I touched the carrots but I did not eat them. Billy blew bubbles in his milk. He said, "I am Colonel Milk Mustache!"

I said, "That is gross Billy, stop it!"

After lunch we went outside to play tag. I ran through the grass and I was very fast. It was like I was on a bungee cord. It was the best day ever.

We were at my grandpa’s cabin for a sleepover. My cousin Leo wanted to go boating on the lake. We jumped in the boat and my dad helped us. Leo tried to climb onto the front but it was slippery.

"Sit down and be steady!" my dad yelled at him.

We rowed to the small island in the middle. We pretended we were doing science and looked for bugs. Then we heard a weird moaning sound from the trees.

"Is that a ghost?" I screamed very loud.

We searched the bushes and discovered a tiny puppy. It was breathing fast and looked scared.

"It's just a lost dog!" Leo said happily.

We took the puppy back to the cabin. It was the best sleepover ever because we saved a dog.

Me and my dog Rex went exploring outside. We walked through the big woods behind my house. Rex was following a squirrel and barking loud. Suddenly he got his paw trapped in a hole.

"Oh no!" I shouted. "Are you okay Rex?"

He cried a little bit and looked sad. I feared he needed a hospital or a doctor. But instead I just pulled his leg gently. It popped out and he was complete again. He started stamping his feet and wagging his tail.

"Good boy!" I said while coaching him to sit.

We counted three birds and then went home. I was wearing my blue boots. Rex almost fainted from running so much. Maybe next time we will go boating on the lake. Exploring is fun but earning a nap is better.

My robot Zog was acting super weird today. He kept bumping into the walls and making loud noises. I knew something was wrong with his battery.

"Zog, stop spinning around like that!" I yelled.

He didn't listen and his metal arms kept pumping up and down. It was raining outside, so we couldn't go play. Zog brewed some hot cocoa, but he spilled it on the ground.

"Sorry, my circuits are buzzing," Zog grumbled quietly.

It seemed impossible to fix him without my tools. I have to learn how to maintain him better. Mom says swearing at robots doesn't help, though. I guess I will fix him tomorrow when I have enough time.

We were playing tag at recess and it was incredible. I was running super fast through the playground. Timmy called my name but I didn't stop. I had to climb up the big blue slide. It felt like a jungle gym meeting the sky. Suddenly I slipped and got mud on my pants. It was a huge brown stain right on my knee.

"Oh no, my mom will be mad!" I screamed.

Timmy ran over and looked at the stain. "Use your imagination," he said. "Maybe it is a cool battle scar."

I liked that idea even though it was just dirt. We kept playing until the bell rang for class. Now I have to write a story about my day. I hope seeing the mud doesn't make my teacher frown.

Me and my best friend Sam wanted a big adventure. We went into the old house on the hill. It was scary but we were brave. We climbed up to the dusty balcony.

"Listen to that noise!" Sam whispered.

It sounded like heavy breathing. I pointed my finger at a dark corner. A tiny gnat flew by my ear and made a buzzing sound. Then I saw a blue vein on my hand was shaking. Something jumped out! It was just a cat, but it felt like a stinging bee scaring us.

"We should be leaving now," I said quickly.

We ran outside fast. My dad was coaching soccer nearby. We felt foreign and strange after the scare. It was the best day ever.
