Me and my dog Max went to the spooky forest. Max is trained to find treasure, but he just barked at a squirrel. The wind blew very hard and it was freezing cold outside. We saw a big metal chain on an old gate. 

"Don't go inside, Max!" I yelled, but he ran in anyway. 

I chased him and I almost crashed into a tree. Then I saw a big red stain on a rock. It looked scary like monster blood but it was just old paint. Suddenly, Max bounced over a log and found a box! Inside was an old newspaper from a long time ago. We were not in trouble after all. We took the box home to show my mom.

I woke up late and scrambled out of bed really fast. My mom made me a toasted bagel but I couldn't eat it. The bus was already waiting outside my house. I jumped on the bus and sat next to my friend Leo.

"Did you finish the math homework?" Leo asked me.

"No, I forgot all about it!" I said back.

We looked out the window at the passing scenery. The bus stopped at school and we ran to class. My teacher Mrs. Green appeared at the door smiling. I crossed my finger behind my back for good luck. Just then the bell started ringing for lunch. I was so hungry. I felt like my brain was still loading. It was a crazy morning!

Me and my best friend Tim were explorers. We found a big map in my attic yesterday. It showed a secret path to a magic jungle. 

"We have to go tomorrow!" Tim yelled loud.

We packed our bags with snacks and flashlights. We walked for a long time until we saw a giant grey elephant. It was drinking from a sparkly blue fountain. Suddenly, a weird flying ship crashed right next to us! A funny sailor climbed out and looked dizzy.

"Is this heaven?" he asked us and rubbed his head.

"No, it's just the jungle," I said.

The sailor fainted and fell on the soft grass. We pulled him up and counted to three. He woke up and gave us a gold coin. It was very important to help him. Our mission was complete!

I loved playing basketball in my driveway. My neighbor Tim came over to play a game. I feared he would win because he is very tall. We started jumping and running very fast.

Suddenly, a giant black beetle flew right at my face!

"Get it away!" I screamed loudly.

I was so scared that I threw the ball hard. It bounced off Tim's head and broke the garage window. My mom shouted from inside the house.

"What was that noise?" she asked.

We ran inside to hide. It will be impossible to fix it before dad gets home. I hope I don't have to go to the hospital. I need to learn how to squeeze the ball better. Tim just bought me ice cream because he felt bad. His reign as the best player is over now.

My robot named Beep got really sick last week. He got a computer virus that was like robot pneumonia. He kept coughing sparks and feeling very hot. I tried to help him but I didn’t understand the problem. So I took him to a meeting with the alien doctor. The alien greeted us and used a magic wand on Beep. Beep’s screen turned green and he stopped coughing sparks.

"I am so grateful for your help," Beep said happily.

"You are welcome, little robot," the alien said.

Now Beep is better and he can be my guide again. We are going camping on Mars tomorrow!

Yesterday me and my friend Sam went to the dark forest. We wanted to find a wonderful treasure but we got lost. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound behind a big rock.

"Listen to that scary noise!" Sam whispered.

I was shaking and very scared but I looked anyway. It was a giant green creature hanging from a tree! It was stuck on a bungee cord. The monster was crying instead of screaming.

"Please help me down!" the creature yelled.

We cut the rope and he fell down with a thump. He was so grateful he gave us a giant cookie crumb. We ran home cheering because we made a monster friend. It was the best adventure ever.

One day I went exploring outside in the woods. I saw a huge tree that looked perfect for climbing. I grasped a low branch and pulled myself up. It felt like gravity was pulling me down hard. I found a shiny green beetle on the bark.

"Look at that cool bug!" I shouted to my dog.

My dog barked back and wagged his tail fast. I caught the beetle gently in my hand. It was important not to squash it. I brought it down to the ground. Instead of keeping it, I treated it nicely and let it go. It walked straight into the grass.

"Be careful, little beetle," I said quietly.

Exploring is fun but sometimes it can be dangerous. I didn't see the spider web and almost walked into it! Being outside is the best thing ever.

We had a big test today and I was scared. I woke up super early because I thought I would fail. My tummy felt like a volcano or a big mountain. At school, my friend Tim was bearing a huge bag of chips.

"Do you want some?" Tim asked me at recess.

"No thanks, I might sneeze," I said.

Then something weird happened on the playground. A bee was following us and it looked very dangerous! Tim started running and his vein popped out on his forehead. He ran into the closed gym doors. Everyone started cheering because he didn't get stung. It was funny but also scary. I was glad when the bell rang for lunch.

One day me and my friend Tom went exploring. We saw a big scary castle on a dark hill. The castle looked strange and almost foreign to us.

"Let's go inside," I said to Tom bravely.

"I am scared but okay," Tom whispered back.

We walked in and suddenly the gravity felt weird. We started floating up towards the high ceiling! The air surrounding us grew very cold and foggy. I grasped Tom’s hand so he wouldn't fly away. We knew we had to find the magic button. I reached out and pushed a red button on the wall. We fell down but landed on soft pillows. Thirteen little elves were cheering for us loudly.

"You were brave enough to save us!" they yelled.

We were happy and we went home for lunch.

My robot friend Zip woke me up very early. He was beeping loudly and speaking fast. Zip loves teaching me space tricks especially on Saturdays. I jumped out of bed and followed him outside. The sky was bright green today!

"Look at the spaceship!" yelled Zip.

A big silver ship landed on the grass. Everyone in my house ran out to see it. A green alien walked out and waved his hand. The smoke cleared away from the ship slowly.

"Do you want to fly?" asked the alien.

I nodded my head yes very fast. We went to space and saw purple stars. It was the best day ever.

Me and my neighbor Sam went to the dark forest. We were bringing my dog Max on a super secret quest. We heard a loud groaning sound behind a big tree.

"What was that scary noise?" asked Sam quietly.

"I think it is a zombie," I whispered back.

We started running fast but Max stopped to smell something. He held a giant bone in his mouth. Then a man walked out and blew a whistle. It was just the mailman eating a protein bar! He laughed and gave us a toasted bagel.

"You kids almost stole my lunch," he joked.

We ate the bagel and walked home safely.

Yesterday me and my friend Sam played soccer at the park. We were on different teams and everyone wanted to win. Sam is really fast and he stole the ball from me. I searched for an open spot and ran down the field. I knew I needed all my strength to kick it far.

"Pass it here!" yelled my teammate loud and clear.

I crossed the ball to him and he kicked it high. The ball landed right near the water fountain by the goal. The goalie scrambled to grab it but he was too slow. We scored a goal and I felt so happy.

"Good game," Sam said but he looked a little sad.

We played throughout the afternoon until it got dark. I was scared we lost, but we won by one point. My pants had a tearing sound, but I didn't care. It was the best game ever.

One day me and Tim went into the dark woods. We were looking for a secret cave. The trees grew very tall and blocked the sun.

"I think we are lost," I said.

Tim grumbled because he was tired and hungry. Suddenly a weird bug flew right at my face. It was a giant gnat! I tried to swat it but it was too fast.

"Did you hear that whistle?" asked Tim.

We stopped walking and the air cleared up. We saw a hole in the earth. It was glowing green and looked scary. I needed energy like my mom's caffeine. We jumped in the hole and started falling down. The hole was growing bigger and bigger. We landed on soft grass and saw a dragon sleeping there. We ran away fast!

Yesterday I had a super big math test at school. I was scared because math is hard to learn. My stomach felt like it was bumping around inside. I reached into my backpack for my lucky pencil. I searched everywhere but it was gone! I knew this was going to be a total failure.

My friend Sam saw me looking sad. "Do you need a pencil?" Sam asked me.

"Yes please, I can't find my lucky one," I said.

He gave me a yellow pencil with a blue feather on top. The test was just beginning so I started writing fast. I did my best and remained calm. When recess came, we played camping near the slide. My worry grew smaller and smaller. I hope I got a good grade!

One sunny day, Max and I went to the forest. We wanted to find the old hidden cave. A cool breeze blew through the trees. We walked for a long time on the rocky ground.

Suddenly, we saw a big hole in a hill. It was the cave! We went inside and it was very dark. I was scared but Max was brave.

"Do you have the flashlight?" asked Max.

"Yes, I know it is in my bag," I said.

I turned it on and we saw a shiny thing. It was a silver comb on a rock. We grabbed it and ran out fast. We were grateful to be safe outside. The scene was beautiful and sunny again. We had enough adventure for one day.

Sam and I walked straight into the dark forest. We were looking for the lost jewel of King Arthur. I grasped my flashlight tight and Sam held the map.

"Did you hear that noise?" whispered Sam.

I heard a thumping rhythm on the ground. Maybe it was a monster roaming around. We hid behind a big rock and waited.

"I am scared," I said.

Then a plain brown dog jumped out. It had a newspaper in its mouth! We laughed and grinned at the dog. We sat down and ate toasted sandwiches for lunch. I used my scissors to open a bag of chips. We didn't find the jewel but it was a fun day.

My class went outside for recess and it was awesome. We played kickball on the big field behind the school. Tommy is the greatest kicker but I have lots of strength. I kicked the red ball really hard and everyone started cheering.

I ran fast and crossed home plate before the ball came back. Then my friend Sarah fell down and got a cut. It looked like a tiny red vein on her knee.

"Are you okay?" I asked her.

"It hurts like a needle poked me," Sarah said.

We helped her up and walked to the nurse. The cut stopped growing bigger and she got a cool bandage. We learned a foreign word for bandage in Spanish class later. It was a pretty good day.

I was dreaming about winning the big swimming race. I rode my bike to the pool for the meeting. My coach was speaking to us about being fast. He was coaching us to kick hard. The water felt cold and I saw a bug floating. I jumped in and swam as fast as a shark. My eyes were stinging from the water but I didn't stop.

"You are bringing home the trophy!" my dad yelled.

I touched the wall first and I was so happy.

"To be honest, I was scared," I told my friend.

After the race, I was so tired I felt like sleeping forever. I cut my celebratory cake with a plastic knife. It was the best day ever.

It was my birthday and I wanted to go to the park. My dad said it was impossible because of the rain. I grumbled and sat on the floor with my dog. I thought my party was ruined but then the doorbell rang. It was my friends and they were singing loudly.

"Surprise!" they screeched when I opened the door.

We played inside instead and pretended the couch was an island. We grasped pillows and started jumping over the lava floor. My uncle acted like a strict army colonel.

"Climb that mountain right now!" he yelled at us.

We flew across the room and counted to ten. The scenery outside grew dark but we had fun anyway. I did not need psychology to know I was happy.

Last Wednesday I went to my friend Sam's apartment. We love playing video games and we picked a racing game. It was the greatest game ever but the track was super hard.

"You are going down!" I yelled at Sam.

He just laughed and shook his head at me. The race started and my car screeched around the corners. The road twisted like a snake and it felt impossible to win. Suddenly my controller broke and fell on the floor. I picked it up but Sam was winning.

"I won!" Sam shouted and jumped up.

I was not thrilled but we played rock paper scissors next. I used scissors and I beat his paper. Even though I lost the race, I won the real game. Science says you can't win them all!

I was playing my favorite video game with my friend Sam. We were roaming a big green forest looking for treasure. Sam is very good, so he was my guide. Suddenly a giant monster jumped out!

"Watch out!" I yelled and grasped my controller tight.

"I can handle it," Sam said, but he looked worried.

My heart was beating so fast in every vein. I felt a heavy weight on my shoulders. I used a special psychology trick to trick the monster. It ran away and we won! I was so grateful we didn't lose.

"How did you do that?" Sam asked me.

"I can explain later," I said, "let's eat toasted bread!" We were happy because we were safe.

We were following a secret map to Monster Island. My backpack had a heavy weight because of all the snacks. We needed protein bars for energy.

Suddenly, a giant storm struck our boat! We crawled onto the sand and saw a dark cave. Inside, a weird smell was brewing like old soup.

"I don't understand where we are," whispered my friend Leo.

"Look at that thing in the corner!" I yelled.

A mummy started to wrap itself in old newspaper. It looked scary but kind of funny. We ran away fast back to the boat. Next time we will just play video games at home.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old park. It was February so the ground was hard and cold. We wanted to find the secret fort in the woods. People said it was impossible to find. We walked for a long time bumping into trees. Suddenly I saw a big metal chain hanging from a branch.

"Look at that weird chain!" I shouted.

Sam looked scared but I was thrilled. We crossed a small stream by jumping on rocks. I almost fell but Sam caught my arm. We found a wooden door behind some bushes. It was locked tight.

"This feels like a failure," Sam said sadly.

But then I saw a key under a rock. We opened the door and saw a treasure box inside. We were so happy!

I had a sleepover with my best friend Sam. We wanted to build a fort in the living room. We were keeping it a secret from my mom. Throughout the night we used blankets and pillows everywhere.

"This is the best fort ever!" Sam shouted happily.

We feared the dark so we brought a flashlight inside. Suddenly, we heard a weird noise like a ghost moaning. I thought we were in danger and got scared. It happened again and it was even louder this time.

"What was that scary sound?" I asked Sam quietly.

Then Sam let out a giant sneeze. It wasn't a ghost at all! We discovered my dog was sleeping under the leather chair. He just wanted some of our roasted marshmallows. We played longer and ate snacks until we fell asleep.

My neighbor has a big cat named Tiger who loves roaming outside. Yesterday I saw him near the big tree in my yard. I crawled through the grass to see what he was doing. Tiger struck at something with his paw and I screamed really loud!

"Don't do that, Tiger!" I yelled at him.

He looked at me and then a tiny feather came floating down. It landed right on his nose. I think he just wanted to play.

"You have to learn to be nice," I said.

I counted three more feathers on the ground. Tiger cleared his throat and ran away fast. I looked up and saw a bird on the roof. It looked okay so I didn't worry. I went inside and looked at the ceiling because I felt tired. Maybe I almost fainted from running. I have to maintain a watch on Tiger next time.

I was eating breakfast and looking at the clock. I felt afraid because I was waiting for the bus. My mom was using a knife to cut my apple. She saw my face and asked me a question.

"What is the reason you look so sad?" she said.

I told her I was trapped in a big problem. I forgot to do my big math homework last night. I felt like I was in danger of getting a zero. My stomach was hurting and I was yearning to stay home.

Suddenly, I saw the big yellow bus outside. I grabbed my bag and ran out the door. Then I saw a sign on the school door. It said school was closed for a snow day! I was thrilled and started tearing up my homework sheet.

"Yes! No school today!" I yelled.

I brought my new toy beetle to school today. It is shiny and green and looks very real. I wanted to show my best friend Sam at recess. But first we had to learn math. I was almost sleeping because math is boring.

Then it was lunchtime and I opened my lunchbox. Sam looked at my sandwich.

"Did you bring peanut butter?" Sam asked me.

"No, my mom made cheese spread," I said.

Suddenly a big kid ran by and stole my beetle! He didn't mean to, but he stepped on it. My beetle was crushed on the ground. The big kid said a bad word like swearing. I was really sad especially because I was building a house for it. Sam gave me his cookie to make me feel better.

I was dreaming about winning the big game all night. The next day, I opened my eyes and ran outside. The weather was perfect for camping, but I had soccer. I trained hard for weeks to beat the other team. We spread out on the grass and the whistle blew. I ran fast and my brain told my feet to kick.

"Pass the ball to me!" shouted my friend Sam.

I kicked it to him and he ran like a sailor on a ship. Then he passed it back. I climbed over the goalie and scored a goal! It felt like I swam in a pool of happiness. After the game, I went home and played on my computer.

"You played great today," said my mom.

I was so tired but so happy I won.

My friend Sam and I found a map in the basement. It had a big red X on it. We made a schedule to leave right after lunch. We packed scissors to cut through vines and some snacks.

We walked into the dark forest behind my house. The wind blew hard and it was scary. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning noise.

"What was that?" Sam asked.

"I think it is a monster," I said.

We ran fast and saw a cave that was lit up. Inside there was a ghost floating in the air! He had a long chain on his leg. He fought us but we were brave. We grabbed a blue jewel from a rock. It left a blue stain on my hand. We ran home safe.

Max and I were exploring the creepy old attic. We wanted to find the lost treasure map. Suddenly, my foot caught on a rug and I fell. I grasped a loose floorboard and saw a box underneath!

"Look at this!" I shouted to Max.

We opened the box and saw an old computer disk inside. It was very dusty. Max counted three gold coins in there too. There was also a crumpled paper receipt from a pizza place.

"We simply have to check the computer disk," Max said.

We were so grateful we found the box. The adventure was just starting!

I was waiting for recess all morning long. My teacher spoke about math but I looked outside. We were learning about how high a mountain is. She said the height was very big. Then the bell finally rang and everyone ran out.

We played a game called boating on the grass. The grass was plain and flat like water. Tim touched me and said, "You are it now!" I had to seize him before he got to base.

Suddenly a big wind rose up through the trees. Mrs. Green was coaching us on how to line up. We had to go inside because it started raining hard. I was sad but then it was lunchtime.

I was swinging on the swings at recess today. My friend Tommy ran over and he looked mad. His face was red and a vein popped out on his neck.

"What is wrong?" I asked him.

"Mrs. Lee gave me extra homework already!" Tommy yelled.

He kicked the dirt and a small rock flew up. I jumped off the swing and my feet hit the ground hard. It felt like a heavy weight landed. I picked up my red ball and bounced it. It was made of old leather.

"Do you want to play?" I asked.

Tommy nodded and smiled a little bit. The wind blew his hair all crazy. We played catch until the bell rang for grounding us back inside. It was better than doing math.

My brother Tim and I woke up super early today. We wanted to be the greatest gamers ever. We ran downstairs and turned on the big TV. The game was loading very slow so I got mad.

"Hurry up you stupid game!" I grumbled loudly.

Tim laughed at me and started running in circles. Finally the screen flashed and we picked our characters. I picked the dragon and Tim picked the robot. We walked into the danger zone to search for treasure. Suddenly a huge monster jumped out and roasted my dragon with fire!

"Oh no! What just happened?" I yelled at the screen.

Tim won the game and did a silly dance. I hit him with a rolled up newspaper but it didn't hurt. We played all day until mom called us for lunch.

I feared math class today because I lost my homework. My teacher is nice but I felt like a failure. I started a big search inside my messy desk. I looked under my pencil case and behind a book. Then I saw something black and shiny moving. It was a huge beetle crawling on my math sheet!

"Eww, get it off!" I yelled really loud.

My friend Sam counted the beetle's legs and laughed. "It just wants to learn numbers too," Sam said.

I tried to hold in a sneeze but it came out. The sneeze scared the beetle away. It ran over a mountain of papers. I grabbed my homework just in time. I was certain my teacher would not believe the beetle story.

My teacher Mrs. Brown loves science a lot. Today she talked about gravity and dropping apples. I tried listening although my stomach was growling loudly. It was almost lunchtime and I was hungry.

"Who knows what pulls things down?" asked Mrs. Brown.

"It is gravity!" shouted my friend Leo.

I grasped my pencil tight because I wanted pizza. Finally the bell rang and we ran outside. The playground is big like a green meadow. We played tag and I was keeping the base safe. Leo treated us to cookies after we ate lunch. Suddenly I felt a giant sneeze coming.

"Achoo!" I sneezed right on his psychology book.

"Eww, that is gross!" Leo yelled at me.

I said sorry but we still laughed about it. School is fun but science makes me very hungry.

I really wanted to win the big kickball game. My friend Sam was the pitcher and he rolled the ball fast. I grabbed the bat and got ready to kick hard. The red ball bounced right to my foot.

"You can do it, Mike!" yelled my team.

I kicked it super high and it almost disappeared in the sky. I ran to first base but then I tripped. I fell down in the dirt and I was stewed. I got up stamping my feet because I missed the base. I feared I was out, but the ref said safe!

"That was close enough!" Sam shouted at me.

We didn't win but we drew a tie game. Next time I won't go camping before the game so I won't be tired.

My brother Tom and I went up the big mountain. We were looking for the secret cave. A cool breeze was blowing on my face. Suddenly we heard a loud noise. Something was roaming in the bushes!

"Look out!" I shouted at Tom.

A big bear jumped out and crashed through the trees. I was trembling so hard. Tom grabbed my arm and we ran fast. We ran down the rocky trail. We were bumping into trees and swinging our arms. We didn't stop until we got to our tent.

"That was scary," Tom said.

We made a fire and roasted thirteen marshmallows. We were safe now. But we were never going back up there.

It was my birthday and I feared nobody came. I sat on my bed and stewed about it. My younger brother rode his bike outside alone.

"Where is everyone?" I grumbled to my mom.

"Just wait a minute," she said with a smile.

Suddenly the door opened and five friends ran inside! They threw balloons at me and I laughed hard. We played a jungle game in the backyard. We had to move carefully through the tall grass. My friend Sam found the hidden treasure first. It was the greatest day ever. Later, my mom made us squeeze onto the couch for cake. I love cake especially when it is chocolate. The reason nobody came early was because it was a surprise!

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. It was freezing outside but we had big coats on. We walked for a long time until we neared a big old tree. Suddenly a tiny gnat flew right into my nose!

"Get out!" I yelled and swatted at my face.

Buster started barking and running around in circles. He looked like he was cheering for me to win. My heart was pumping fast. Then a squirrel appeared on a branch. It looked down at us like a brave knight in a castle.

"Let’s go home, Buster," I said to him.

It was simply too cold to maintain our adventure. The woods were plain and gray anyway. We ran back to the house for hot cocoa.

My best friend Ben came over for a sleepover last night. We made a huge fort in the living room with pillows. We pretended we were roaming in a deep dark jungle.

Then my neighbor Mrs. Lee knocked on the door really loud.
"Did you boys hear a weird noise?" she asked us.

We shook our heads but then we heard a crash. It came from the kitchen and we started jumping up. My cat Fluffy knocked over my science project on the floor! It was a volcano and now it looked like scrambled eggs.

"It is impossible to fix this," Ben said sadly.

My mom came in and she cleared up the big mess. She gave us toasted bread with jelly for a snack. We found a shiny marble that looked like a blue jewel. It looked like a vein of gold was inside it.

I was walking in the woods with my dog Rex. We saw a squirrel swinging on a branch. Rex started barking and pulled on his leash. The squirrel ran up a tree and I let go. Rex chased it into the surrounding bushes.

Then I heard him whining. He was trapped in some sticker bushes!

"Oh no, you are in big trouble," I said.

I pretended to be a brave knight saving him. I carefully moved the branches and grabbed his collar. I pulled him out. He licked my face.

"I can explain everything to Mom," I screamed happily.

We walked home and looked at the pretty scenery. The birds were singing and the sun was spread out everywhere. Rex was happy he wasn't waiting in the bushes anymore. We had a good adventure.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old cave. We walked inside and it was very dark. Sam turned on his flashlight and we saw something scary. There were bones scattered all over the rocky floor!

Suddenly we heard a loud thumping noise. Something big was coming towards us.

"Run away right now!" screamed Sam.

We ran fast but I saw a big black stain on the wall. It looked like fire had scorched the rock. We discovered a giant dragon sleeping there. He was stamping his feet in his sleep. I tried to contain my fear but I was shaking. We ran outside and never went back.

I was scared to go to school today. I feared my teacher because I forgot my homework. She is usually nice but homework is very important. I walked into class and saw Mrs. Green. She was approaching my desk with a big smile.

"Did you go camping this weekend?" she asked me.

"Yes, we swam in the lake," I said quietly.

I was shaking but then I remembered something. I opened my bag and saw a floating paper. It was my homework! I wrote it on Sunday for a good reason. I was jumping up and down because I was so happy. I gave it to Mrs. Green and she put a gold star on it. School is actually really fun when you do your work.

My friend Ben and I played soccer in the freezing rain. My mom said I would catch pneumonia, but I kept playing. The mud on the earth was super slippery and wet. I scrambled for the ball and scratched my knee on a rock. It hurt a lot but I knew I had to win.

Suddenly, Ben appeared right in front of me like a ghost. He tried to take the ball, but I pushed my weight forward.

"You can't stop me!" I yelled really loud.

"Watch this!" Ben shouted back and kicked the ball hard.

The ball flew past me, but I didn't care. We went inside and ate some warm stewed carrots. I had to comb the mud out of my hair later. Keeping score is fun, but getting warm was better.

I was playing my new video game after breakfast. The screen said loading for a long time. Finally, my character reached the jungle level. It was full of danger and scary monkeys. I had to climb a big metal chain to win. My fingers were hurting, but I kept pushing buttons.

"Watch out for the green snake!" yelled my brother.

"I know, I’m not afraid!" I shouted back.

I was groaning because the snake bit me. My health bar was growing smaller. But then I found a magic potion. I was so grateful. I jumped over the pit and won the game!

Yesterday at school was the craziest day on earth. We had to give speeches in front of the whole company of kids. I was so scared that my knees shook. I walked to the front as the time neared for my turn. I looked at the scenery out the window to stay calm. It looked very pleasant outside with the sun shining.

"Please start talking now," said Mrs. Green.

I opened my mouth but nothing came out. I felt like a big failure. Then I looked at the computer on her desk and got dizzy. I almost fainted right there on the rug!

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Billy.

I nodded my head and took a big breath. Then I finally started talking about my pet turtle. I did not faint and everyone clapped.

Yesterday I found a weird glowing rock in my backyard. Suddenly my arm felt really hot and my veins turned blue. I picked up a huge rock and threw it high. I had super strength! I was so thrilled that I flew into the air.

I saw a robot attacking my school with big metal scissors. He was the same height as the gym. I felt anger inside me.

"Hey you big toaster!" I yelled at him.

"You are in big trouble," the robot beeped back.

I punched his leg and he fell down with a crash. I counted to three and then the robot grew tiny. He was just a toy now. I put the single toy in my pocket. I saved the day!

Me and my friend Sam found a map in my attic. We ran to the spooky woods behind my house. The map said to go one league past the big oak tree. Sam was steering us with his compass but he tripped on a root. We fell into a giant hole and it was very dark.

"I am scared of the dark!" Sam screamed loud.

I turned on my flashlight and saw a monster. It had a long purple tongue and looked really hungry. We ran away fast and climbed out of the hole. We escaped just in time before it grabbed us.

"That was too close," I said to Sam.

We went home and my mom made us stewed tomatoes for dinner. We never went back to the woods again.

My dog Barnaby ran fast into the big green meadow. I ran after him and it felt like heaven. We pretended the tall grass was a scary jungle. Suddenly Barnaby stopped and barked at a big rock.

"What is it boy?" I asked him quietly.

I saw a tiny squirrel stuck in a hole. It looked scared and hung onto a root. I grabbed Barnaby’s collar so he wouldn't scare it. The squirrel tried to squeeze out but it was stuck tight.

"Don't worry, I will help you," I said.

I moved a heavy stone and the squirrel popped out! It ran away fast to its little island of trees. I was grateful it was safe. Later we went home and ate toasted bread. We met fourteen other squirrels but none were stuck like that one.

My nephew Tim and I found a secret map. It drew a path through the dark woods behind school. We brought scissors to cut vines because it was a dangerous place. Suddenly we saw a glowing fountain that was lit up green.

"Look out for the stinging bees!" Tim screamed loudly.

We ran fast and saw a monkey swinging on a vine. Then we swam across a small river to get away. My dad was coaching us from far away but we couldn't hear. We found a cave and made a fire and roasted marshmallows.

"This is the best scene ever," I said to Tim.

Then we put on magic cloaks and became invisible. We walked home safely and nobody saw us.

Yesterday I played a new video game about a knight. The knight had to save a little white lamb. I told my friend Sam to come over immediately. We started the game and the scenery was really cool.

"Look out for that dragon!" Sam screeched loudly.

I jumped left and hit the big red button. The dragon missed me but I had to sneeze. I paused the game because my cat was sleeping on the controller. When we started again, I won the whole level.

"You are the best player ever," Sam said.

We played until dinner and it was the best day.

It was raining very hard outside today at school. I was wearing my blue raincoat and my boots. Recess was inside because of the rain. We played a game called Reign of the Kings. My friend Sam reached for the ball and fell over.

"Ouch, my leg hurts!" screamed Sam loudly.

I heard him moaning on the floor. The teacher came over to listen to him. She helped him up and he was okay.

"I know you are brave," said Mrs. Green.

Lunch was just a plain sandwich and an apple. My backpack felt heavy like a big weight. I was loading my books inside to go home. It was a long day but it was fun.

One day I found a robot sleeping in my yard. It looked like a trash can but it was shiny silver. I reached out and touched its cold metal head. Suddenly its eyes turned bright red and it stood up straight.

"Who called me?" the robot asked with a beep.

I was scared so I hid behind my mom’s flowers. A cool breeze blew my hair and the robot looked around. It scratched its head with a hand that looked like scissors.

"I just wanted a friend," I said quietly to it.

The robot smiled and handed me a glowing blue rock. I didn't know the meaning of the rock but it was cool. That is what happened when I met my best friend Robo.

I walked to school today and it was sunny. My teacher Mrs. Miller spoke to the class about math.

"We have an important test today," she said loudly.

I felt scared but I grabbed my pencil tight. I tried to simply measure the shapes on the paper. Then the bell rang for recess and we jumped up.

Outside was wonderful because we played tag on the grass. My friend Sam grasped the ball and threw it high.

"Let's go search for bugs!" Sam yelled to me.

After school I went back to my apartment. I had to do cleaning in my room first. I found my lost comb under the bed. My mom lit a candle and it smelled good. It was a long day but now I am tired.

Me and my best friend Tom went to the spooky castle. We needed the magic scissors to cut the twisted vines. The vines caught a tiny gnat and wouldn't let go. Tom used all his strength to pull the heavy doors open. We walked together on the cold ground until we saw a fountain.

"Look, the water is gradually turning green!" yelled Tom.

"We have to hurry or we will need a hospital," I said.

A bright light became our guide in the dark hall. We found the silver scissors sitting on a rock. I obtained them quickly. Just then, a monster started grounding us with magic spells. But we ran fast enough to escape! We were safe outside on the grass.

My robot friend named Beep was acting very weird today. He was sitting on the balcony and holding some big scissors.

"Beep, are you okay?" I asked him very quietly.

Beep looked at me with his glowing blue eyes. "I am scared of the ghost in the machine," he said.

I saw a rusty chain hanging from his metal arm. He tried to cut it with a knife but it was dull. Everyone at school said Beep was a failure because he was old. But I knew he was special and just needed help. I took the scissors and I cut the heavy chain off.

"Thank you!" Beep beeped and he flew up high. He wasn't scared anymore and he used his lasers to protect me.

I was reading my favorite comic book in my room. It was about aliens who eat metal. Suddenly I heard a loud crunching noise. I looked at my robot dog named Sparky. He was trying to gnaw on my bedpost!

"Stop that Sparky!" I yelled at him.

Sparky’s eyes turned red and he made a beep sound. "I am hungry for wood now," said Sparky.

I realized he was not my robot dog anymore. An alien had taken over his brain! I grabbed my super blaster gun. The hour was late and the sun neared the hills. I shot a green laser at Sparky. He disappeared into a cloud of smoke. My toys were scattered everywhere. I believed he was gone, but then I heard a laugh. The alien was already hiding under my rug!

Me and my friend Tom went deep into the scary jungle. We were looking for a secret treasure map hidden throughout the trees. Suddenly we saw a big plane that had crashed a long time ago.

"Look at that cool design on the wing!" I yelled.

Tom climbed up the side and bounced on the metal. But then we heard a loud roar and got really scared. A tiger jumped out and we sprinted away fast! My backpack opened and my snacks scattered everywhere.

"Listen! Is it still chasing us?" Tom whispered loudly.

We were yearning to go home but we kept running. We discovered a cave and hid inside until the tiger left. We didn't find the treasure but climbing trees was fun anyway. Even though Tom felt like swearing, he didn't.

I was painting a big picture of a mountain in art class. I used lots of blue and green paint. Suddenly, my friend Tim crashed into my desk. My water cup fell over and made a huge mess.

"Oh no! I am so sorry!" Tim yelled very loudly.

Our teacher Mrs. Green appeared and she looked at the spill. She was bearing a giant roll of paper towels. It looked like a tower reaching up to heaven.

"Let’s measure how big this puddle is," she said.

We cleaned it up fast and the floor cleared up. Then the bell rang for lunch and we ran outside. I was hungry for pizza.

My math homework was impossible today. I looked at the page and started moaning very loudly. My teacher Mr. Brown walked over to my desk.

"You need to listen closely," he said nicely.

I gripped my pencil harder and I was feeling frustrated. I wanted to be outside climbing the jungle gym instead. Recess is the greatest part of the day!

Finally, the bell rang and I cleared my desk fast. I ran outside and reached the big blue slide. I was steering my body down the slide super fast.

"Watch out!" my friend Sam yelled at me.

I almost crashed but I am getting stronger every day. I love earning extra time at recess for being good. It makes me feel happy.

I was playing a video game against my big brother. It was a racing game and I wanted to win. The cars zoomed past trees and big rocks. I discovered a secret shortcut through a dark cave.

"You can't beat me!" shouted my brother loudly.

"I guarantee I will win this time," I said back.

My car crawled up a steep hill very slowly. Unfortunately, I hit a giant beetle on the track. My car spun out and gold coins scattered everywhere. I was keeping my eyes on the finish line though. Suddenly, a tiny gnat flew right into my brother's eye! He blinked and crashed his car into a wall. I zoomed past him and I won the race! It was incredible and I was so thrilled. My reign as the champion finally started today. I caught the trophy and did a victory dance.

I was sitting at my desk waiting for lunch. My stomach made a weird noise and my face felt hot. I looked at the blue vein on my wrist. It was pulsing because I was so hungry. Finally the bell rang and we all ran outside.

"I have a sandwich with a huge stain on the bag," said Billy. 

I grinned and opened my lunchbox. I had an apple and I used all my strength to squeeze it. Juice came out!

"You look like a knight crushing a dragon egg," Billy laughed.

Then we played tag and I ran fast. I felt like I was growing taller every time I jumped. We pretended we were in a foreign land fighting a colonel. Then the teacher crossed her arms and looked at us. Recess was over so we walked back inside.

I woke up on my spaceship and looked outside. The scenery was strange because the stars were purple. I walked to the main computer to check the map. Suddenly, a big robot captain greeted me with a loud beep.

"We are lost in space!" the robot shouted loudly.

I drew my laser sword and I felt brave. Just then, a green alien got caught in our net. He was moaning because he was stuck.

"Please help me complete my mission," the alien said.

Scattered around him were glowing red jewels. I cut the net and the alien gave me a jewel. Gradually, the scene changed back to normal space. We remain best friends now and fly together forever.

My friend Sam and I played in the backyard. We used our imagination to travel to a foreign land. I was a brave sailor and Sam was my guide. We were following a map to find hidden gold.

Suddenly, we saw a big monster approaching us fast! It was actually my dog, Buster.

"Quick! Seize the sword!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam grabbed a stick from the soft earth. He pretended to fight the guard dog. It was a great pleasure to win the battle.

After the fight, we sat down and ate toasted marshmallows. We did not learn anything, but playing is better than reading. We were safe.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old forest. It looked weird because the trees were purple. We walked fast and our backpacks were bumping on our backs.

"Look at that big hole!" shouted Sam.

I was scared but I went closer. Suddenly a huge rabbit came jumping out! It was steering a tiny red car. I didn't believe it either. The rabbit stopped and spread a map on the ground.

"Can you help me find my carrots?" asked the rabbit.

We looked at the map. A needle pointed north. We followed it gradually until we found a golden box. The rabbit was so grateful. We ran home before it got dark.

My dog Buster is a wonderful pet. We went to the park on a beautiful day. I was swinging high on the swings. My dad was coaching my little sister on the slide.

Suddenly, a squirrel jumped out of a big tree! Buster saw it and ran fast through the grass.

"Come back, Buster!" I yelled very loud.

Buster did not listen and he chased the squirrel. The squirrel landed on a picnic table. It grabbed a single roasted peanut and ran away.

"That squirrel is fast," my dad’s daughter said. That is me!

We finally caught Buster. We went home and had snacks. It was a fun day outside.

One day I found a glowing rock in my backyard. It was green and shiny like a big jewel. Suddenly a spaceship landed right on my mom's flowers! An alien walked out and he looked like a lizard. He had a robot guard with him too.

"That is my power rock," the alien said to me.

I held the rock tight and I felt a strong rhythm. The rock started glowing brighter and shooting sparks everywhere. Unfortunately, the robot tried to grab it from my hand.

"Stop right there!" I yelled and used my laser eyes.

My eyes shot red beams and melt the robot’s arm. The alien got scared and ran back to his ship. He flew away very fast into the sky. Everyone in the neighborhood came outside to see what happened. My dad was bringing in the newspaper and he dropped it. I am a superhero now and I guard the jungle in my backyard.

I was sitting at my desk and looking at the ceiling. Mrs. Baker was talking about history and the reign of old kings. I opened my notebook but I didn't write anything. I was thinking about recess and the incredible kickball game. Suddenly Mrs. Baker stopped talking and everything got quiet.

"Billy, are you listening to me?" she asked loudly.

I felt my face get hot and I cleared my throat. The kids surrounding me were all staring and sounding like giggling mice.

"I caught a cold," I lied to her quickly. "I might get pneumonia."

Mrs. Baker looked at me with bearing eyes but she smiled. The bell rang and I ran outside fast. School is hard but at least lunch is pizza today.

It was recess time and everyone ran outside fast. I wore my new blue sweater because it was cold. My friend Sam was climbing on the jungle gym. He grasped the metal bars tightly and swung his legs.

"Hey, look at my height!" Sam yelled down to me.

Suddenly, he slipped and struck his knee on the bar. He started groaning really loud and holding his leg. I ran over after seeing him fall.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

A teacher came over and treated his knee with a bandage. Later, we went inside and drew pictures on old newspaper. I looked at the schedule on the wall. It was almost time to go home. I looked up at the ceiling and smiled. It was a pretty good day even with the scraped knee.

My dog Buster greeted me at the door. He was groaning because he wanted to go outside. It was freezing cold but I put on my coat. We walked to the park and searched for sticks.

"Look at that squirrel!" I yelled to Buster.

He tried to squeeze under the fence but he got stuck. He struggled to get out and I pulled his tail. Finally he popped out and ran fast. The sun scorched my face a little bit. We saw my nephew walking with his mom. They were approaching us slowly on the path.

"Do you have a newspaper?" my nephew asked me.

I thought that was a weird question. I did not have one so we just followed them home. I understood that we were late for our schedule. Buster was happy and tired.

It was my best friend Max’s sleepover party. We ate pizza and threw pillows everywhere. Max’s big sister yelled at us to stop. We crawled under the bed to hide from her. It was dark and dusty down there. I saw something shiny like a jewel.

"Look at this!" I whispered to Max.

Max grabbed it and said, "That is my mom’s ring!"

We crawled out gradually and ran downstairs. We landed on the soft rug in the living room. Max’s mom was groaning because she lost her ring. We gave it to her and she smiled big. But then I saw a red stain on my shirt. I remembered the pizza sauce and felt trapped.

"Oh no, that stain will remain forever," Max laughed.

I was messy but at least we found the ring.

It was a cold day in February. My dog Max and I went outside to play in the snow. It was freezing but we had big coats on. We walked to the park and saw a fountain. It was frozen like ice! Max started barking at something near the bushes.

"What is it boy?" I asked him.

A tiny squirrel appeared and looked scared. It crawled under the fence. I tried to squeeze through the gap but I was too big. Max was yearning to chase it.

"Come back here Max!" I yelled loudly.

We ran throughout the whole park. Then we spread our arms and crashed into a snowbank. The snow felt soft like heaven. A big storm was approaching so we went home for hot cocoa. It was the best day ever.

I was feeling super nervous about the big soccer game. My jersey had a huge number fourteen on the back. I walked onto the field and looked at the scenery. There were trees and lots of green grass everywhere. My mom was waiting on the sidelines and she waved at me.

Suddenly the ball appeared right in front of my feet. I drew back my leg and kicked it super hard. The ball flew through the air like a rocket. The goalie was hanging from the top bar but missed it.

"Goal!" everyone started screaming really loud.

My coach ran over and gave me a high five. "Great job maintaining your speed!" he yelled happily.

I felt like singing a happy song because we won. We got pizza after the game and it was awesome.

My big sister Lisa is always coaching me on singing. She thinks she knows everything about psychology and feelings too. It was my birthday, and we were dumping water on Dad. He was asleep in the yard, and it was so funny!

"Stop it right now!" Dad yelled, but his tongue was blue. He ate a blue popsicle before his nap.

Mom was inside keeping the roasted chicken warm for dinner. She heard us thumping around outside.

"Are you two looking for a grounding?" Mom asked.

Lisa stopped laughing and looked scared. "No way," she whispered.

We ran away before Mom found a needle and thread. She wanted to fix my ripped pants, but I wanted to play longer. Birthdays are the best days ever.

One day I was walking outside in the big woods. I moved quietly through the tall green grass. Suddenly a weird bunny appeared right in front of me. He looked very important and was wearing a tiny red hat. I thought he was just a normal bunny rabbit. Then he started speaking to me!

"Please help me find my magic thread," the bunny told me.

"Okay I will help you look," I said back.

We looked everywhere and discovered the thread under a rock. But then a blue bird screeched loudly and stole it! The bunny started jumping up and down very fast. He picked up a stick and threw it at the bird. The bird dropped the thread and flew away. The bunny chewed on a carrot because he was happy. I never saw a talking bunny again.

The captain of the spaceship was cleaning his robot. His name was Bob and he had fourteen arms. Bob flew the ship very fast. Suddenly a weird alien jumped on the window. It was green and singing a loud song. Bob got scared and dropped a heavy weight.

"Stop singing right now!" yelled Captain Bob.

The alien looked at him with a single eye. "I just want a meeting," said the alien.

Bob knew that aliens liked science. He opened the door and they walked to a meadow. The meadow was purple and soft. They became best friends and ate space pizza. It was a good day.

It was my birthday party and we had a piñata. My dad tied the rope to the ceiling fan. It looked like a colorful donkey but with a lamb head.

"Hit it with all your strength!" shouted my friend Tim.

I swung the stick and missed, and everyone laughed. I tried again and hit it hard, but it did not break. The weight of the candy was heavy inside. I pushed my hair back and wiped my sweat with my sweater.

"You are doing it wrong," said my sister. "Use your brain!"

She stepped up and she blew a bubble with her gum. Then she whacked it and candy appeared everywhere. Neither of us got the most candy though. Tim is in a baseball league and he is fast. He grabbed it all. I drew a sad face on a napkin but then we ate cake.

My nephew Ben and I went exploring near the mountain. We wanted to find a secret cave. We walked for a long time and saw a big rock. "Look at the height of that!" Ben yelled. We climbed up and discovered a small hole. Suddenly, a lizard escaped from under a bush. I tried to seize it but it was too fast. It disappeared into the dark hole. We sat down because the sun scorched our necks. We were yearning for some water. "I have enough water for us," I said. We roasted marshmallows on a stick later. Then we went boating on the lake before it grew dark. It was the best day ever.

Me and my neighbor Sam were playing video games. We played a game about boating on a big lake. It was super fun but I kept losing. Sam is really good at gaming.

"You are going to get toasted!" Sam yelled at me.

"No way, I am going to win this time," I said back.

I tried to turn my boat but I hit a rock instead. My boat sank really fast. Although I tried hard, everyone knows Sam is the champion. Then my mom came in with a snack. She had a needle and thread in her hand.

"Time for a break, guys," she said.

We stopped playing and ate cookies. I pretended Sam had to go to the hospital because he ate too many. It was a funny joke. Next time I will beat him for sure.

My big brother Max was teaching me how to play basketball. He had a cool new ball made of real leather. I tried to dribble it with my left hand. Max is tall so he is a good guard. I ran past him and he almost stole the ball. I jumped up high and threw the ball at the hoop.

"You missed!" Max yelled at me and laughed really loud.

The ball bounced away and disappeared into the bushes. We looked for a long time but we could not complete the game. Then it started raining hard so we ran inside to play on the computer. Mom said to stay dry or we might catch pneumonia.

"I bet I can beat you at racing cars," I said.

Max smiled and picked up the controller. We played games all day until dinner was ready.

One day I found a strange green rock in my backyard. It was glowing and humming like a sleeping cat. I gripped it tight and suddenly I could fly! I zoomed up to the roof and met an alien. The alien had three eyes and was keeping a secret.

"Do not drop the rock," said the alien. "It is the greatest power in the universe."

I accidentally crossed my fingers and the rock crushed into dust. I fell down but the alien caught me. We are best friends now. He gave me a robot dog instead.

My dog Sparky is a very good boy. One day we were playing in the backyard. I threw a red ball and it bounced on the ground. Sparky ran through the bushes to get it. He gripped it with his teeth and ran back.

"Good job Sparky!" I yelled at him.

Suddenly a squirrel appeared on the fence. It was holding a nut with its thumb. Sparky dropped the ball and barked loud. It was impossible to stop him.

"Be quiet, you will wake the ghost!" my brother said. He was reading a newspaper on the porch.

Sparky didn't care. He was dumping his water bowl over. He was not sleeping today. I opened the back door and we went inside for a snack. It was a fun meeting with the squirrel.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were making forts. We were keeping all the pillows in the living room. My brother Tom wanted to play but I said no.

"You have to be quiet," I said to him.

Tom grumbled and walked away stamping his feet. We scrambled through the blankets and made a big tent. Then my mom came in. She was cleaning up our mess.

"Listen to me, girls," she said. "Please be honest."

I grasped a loose thread on the blanket. It was scorched from the lamp.

"Who did this?" Mom asked.

I struggled to speak but my heart was pumping fast.

"It was an accident," I told her.

Mom wasn't mad. We fixed the fort and had cake after. It was the best meeting ever.

I was walking my dog named Buster through the woods. We saw nice scenery like big trees and green bushes. Buster pulled hard on his chain because he saw a squirrel.

"Stop it, Buster!" I yelled, but he kept pulling.

Suddenly he jumped over a log and I fell down. I felt a sharp poke like a needle on my leg. It was just a prickly plant. Then I realized Buster was gone! I started screaming his name really loud.

"Woof!" he barked from behind a big rock.

He was acting like the captain of the forest. He looked like he was about to bungee jump off the rock. Then he let out a huge sneeze.

"Bless you, silly dog," I said and gave him a hug.

We walked home and I needed grounding for losing him. But I was just happy he was safe.

One day my dog Max and I went on an adventure. We walked into the woods behind my big house. The trees were tall and the leaves turned yellow. Max started sniffing the ground with a funny rhythm. He ran fast and I ran after him.

"Max, wait for me!" I yelled really loud.

He stopped at a big hole near a rock. I looked inside and saw a tiny bunny. It was stuck and couldn't get out because of gravity. I gradually reached my hand down to guide it up.

"Don't be scared little bunny," I said softly.

I realized it was shaking so I held it close. We put the bunny back on the soft grass. Max licked its ear and the bunny hopped away. We walked home happy and we will go back tomorrow.

It was raining very hard outside my house. My friend Sam and I were bored. We decided to go exploring in the woods. We were wearing our big rain boots. We saw a dark cave and walked inside. It was spooky and we heard a loud roar.

"I think a bear is roaming in here!" Sam yelled.

We started climbing up a big rock to hide. My finger slipped and I almost fell down. Sam grabbed my arm and pulled me up. We were safe but Sam looked very scared. He almost fainted because the roar was so loud.

"We need to learn to be more careful," I said.

We thought we were in big trouble. But then a science teacher walked out. He was just coaching a loud robot he made. We laughed and then swept the mud off our boots.

It was a hot day at school today. I was feeling very tired during art class. My friend Ben took the big scissors. He tried to cut a red paper heart.

"Be careful!" I shouted to Ben across the table.

He twisted the paper too fast and it ripped. He screamed because he got a little cut. The teacher heard him and ran over fast.

"Are you okay?" she asked him nicely.

Ben scratched his arm and said he was fine. Then the bell rang for recess time. We all ran through the big doors outside. I dug in the earth near the swings. I found thirteen shiny rocks in the dirt. Suddenly my best rock disappeared in the grass. I spread the grass but I never found it.

My brother Tim and I went boating on the lake. We saw a dark cave and decided to go inside. It was spooky and we heard someone moaning very loudly. I grabbed my whistle and blew it hard to scare them. Suddenly, a giant bear jumped out from the shadows! He was sleeping but now he looked very angry.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Tim.

"I can't remember the way out!" Tim cried.

The bear chewed on a stick and looked at us. We crashed the boat into a rock and got stuck. Unfortunately, there were fourteen bats flying around our heads. I drew my lucky sword and tried to be brave. But then the bear started to comb his hair with a claw. He wasn't mean at all! We laughed and then we went home for dinner.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. We crawled on the ground under a big log. It was very dirty and muddy down there.

"I hate bugs," grumbled Sam as he slapped his arm.

"Be quiet or the ghost will hear us," I said.

Suddenly we heard a loud roar behind a bush. We were trembling and my heart was pumping fast. A huge bear jumped out at us! We screamed and ran away very fast. We scrambled up a tall tree to get safe. Sam grabbed a branch but he almost slipped. We stayed in the tree for a long time. The bear simply walked away after a while. We climbed down and ran home screaming all the way. We did not find the gold but we were safe.

Yesterday my dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. We were looking for cool rocks for my science project. Buster started barking loudly because he saw a squirrel.

"Quiet Buster!" I screamed, but he just ran away fast.

He ran towards a big bush and started digging. I heard a weird groaning sound coming from the dirt. It was scary so I grabbed a stick to guard myself. Something flew out of the bush and hit my face! It was just a bird but I fell down. Gravity pulls you down hard when you are scared.

Buster brought me a dirty old shoe he found. It looked like a roasted potato.

"Good boy," I said and I patted his head.

We saw a storm approaching so we ran home. I used scissors to cut the laces off the shoe later.

My friends came over for a big sleepover. The weather was bad so we stayed inside. Everyone put their sleeping bags on the floor together. We were meant to watch a scary movie. But instead we just ate lots of popcorn.

"Hey, who stole the big bowl?" asked Sam.

"It wasn't me!" shouted my little brother Timmy.

Timmy was hiding under a blanket dumping popcorn everywhere. We laughed throughout the whole night and told jokes. I was feeling very happy to have company. We didn't get enough sleep but it was fun. My mom made pancakes for everyone in the morning. It was the best sleepover ever!

Yesterday at recess we played a fun game. We pretended the playground was a huge castle. My friend Ben was the king and I was a knight.

"Watch out for the dragon!" Ben yelled loudly.

I saw something big coming and moved fast. It was just a red ball that bounced by. We ran throughout the whole yard screaming and laughing. Suddenly, a tiny white lamb appeared near the fence. It must have escaped a farm. We scratched its soft head gently.

"It looks hungry," I said to Ben.

Our teacher Mrs. Green grew worried and came over. She realized it was lost. We didn't learn much math that day. But we met a real lamb! It was the best recess ever.

I went outside to play with my dog Rex. The cool breeze blew through the tall green trees. Rex ran fast and he was tearing up the grass. He barked loud at a squirrel in the oak tree.

"Come back here Rex!" I shouted at him.

He did not listen and he ran to the left. I had to run fast and finally grasped his collar. My mom says dogs can get sick with pneumonia outside. I had to squeeze him tight so he stayed warm. We went inside and I gave him a treat.

"You need to learn to listen," I told him.

My dad calls Rex the colonel because he is bossy. But we never sold him because we love him. He grumbled a little bit but he ate his treat. Rex grew tired and went to sleep on his rug.

My nephew Ben and I went camping in the woods. We wanted to see the old castle on the hill. It was a long walk and the trees grew tall. Suddenly, a tiny gnat flew into Ben’s nose! He sneezed so loud that he screeched.

"Are you okay?" I asked him quickly.

"I think I’m in trouble," Ben said and he fainted.

I counted to ten and checked his breathing. He woke up and we walked instead of running. We finally saw the castle where a king used to reign. We did not receive a prize, but it was important. I tried to explain the science of the old walls to Ben. It was a super cool adventure!

My birthday party was almost ruined by my dog Buster. I feared he would eat the cake on the counter. Buster chewed on a plastic chain and made a mess. Toys were scattered all over the living room floor.

Mom was cooking and the beef stewed in a pot. I searched for the scissors to open my new gift. It was a cool new computer game about space! Then Buster followed me and jumped on the table.

"Get down right now Buster!" I yelled really loud.

My friend Sam laughed and said, "He wants to play too."

We ate cake and then we had to complete the game. It was like climbing a mountain but we won the level. It was the best birthday ever even with a crazy dog.

It was February and very cold outside. My dog Buster started moaning at the door because he wanted to go out. I scratched his ears and put on my big coat. My mom said, "Make sure you stay on schedule for dinner!"

We walked to the park and greeted a squirrel near a tree. Suddenly, Buster crashed into a bush chasing a ball. He ran fast like he had too much caffeine. I was scared he would get sick with pneumonia because of the snow.

"Come here, Buster!" I yelled loudly. He grumbled but came back. Mom says dogs need protein to be strong, so I gave him a treat. I will write about our fun day in my journal later. We ran home before the dark clouds were approaching.

I was running fast to escape the angry robot. It had eight red eyes and long metal arms. I did not know where to go, so I ran straight ahead. Suddenly I was trapped in a dark cave.

"We are lost!" shouted my little sister Amy.

"No, look at that light," I said and pointed a finger.

A blue jewel was glowing on the wall. I pushed it and a secret door opened wide. Inside was a friendly alien with green skin. He said he would guide us home. He spread his wings and we had to climb on his back. Then he threw a smoke bomb at the robot. We flew away and nothing bad happened to us either. It was the best day ever.

My birthday party was finally here and I was super excited. Mom was in the kitchen loading the dishwasher. She told me to wait for my friends outside. I saw a car approaching our house slowly. It was my best friend Sam and he had a big box! I ran to him and grabbed his arm.

"Happy birthday!" Sam yelled and he handed me the box.

"Thanks Sam!" I said and I gripped the heavy box tight.

But then my dog Buster ran out and jumped on me. I fell down and the box got crushed under me. I was trembling because I was scared I broke it. I opened it up fast. It was just a soft teddy bear inside! We kept laughing because the bear was fine. We ate cake and played games all night.

I was running super fast in the big race today. My friend Tim was right next to me. I reached out my hand to tag the wall first. My heart was beating like a tiny beetle inside my chest.

"I am going to win!" Tim yelled at me.

"No way, just watch this!" I shouted back.

Suddenly, I tripped on my shoelace and fell down hard. A big blue vein popped out on my leg. I looked up at the gym ceiling. I felt a lot of anger but I didn't cry. My coach treated my scraped knee with a band-aid.

Tim won the race but he grinned at me nicely. He greeted me with a high-five after it happened. Later I had to write about it for homework. Next time I will make sure my shoes are tied tight!

One day I was eating my breakfast and I saw a big light. It crashed right into my backyard near the big oak tree. I ran outside in my red sweater and saw a weird green alien. He had eight eyes and he looked very lost.

"Do you want some toast?" I asked him.

The alien made a funny beep noise and pointed at his tummy. I think that meant yes in his foreign language. We ate toast and he got a big purple stain on my rug. My mom was mad but then the alien fixed it with a laser.

"Thank you, space friend," I said.

He waved his hand and flew up into the sky again. I hope he comes back next week because he was cool.

It was my birthday and I was turning nine. All my friends came over for a big pool party. I greeted them at the door with a huge smile. We ran outside and started jumping into the water. The water was cold at first but it gradually got warmer.

"Watch this cannonball!" shouted my friend Leo.

He bounced on the diving board and threw himself in. Splash! Water touched everyone standing near the edge of the pool. It seemed impossible to stay dry. We swam for hours and played marco polo. Later, my dad brought out pizza for thirteen hungry kids. It was hard keeping everyone from eating it too fast. It was the best birthday ever.

I went outside to play with my dog Sparky. He is simply the greatest dog in the whole world. We walked to the park and saw a squirrel. It was bearing a big nut in its mouth!

"Look at that squirrel, Sparky!" I yelled loudly.

Sparky barked and ran fast but the squirrel climbed a tree. We sat under the tree and I played my toy guitar. I had a cookie in my pocket but Sparky stole it! He ate every crumb and licked my hand. Then he slept in the grass for a long time.

"Wake up, you lazy dog," I said and poked him.

I grasped his leash and we walked home. I found an old receipt on the ground but I did not keep it. Then I heard a knock on the door. It was time to go inside and learn my math homework.

My dog Buster was roaming in the woods today. He loves sniffing trees and chasing squirrels. I heard him groaning near a big bush. I was bringing him a treat, so I ran over. Buster was stuck in some vines and looked sad.

"Stop moaning, Buster, I will help you," I said.

I tried to pull the vines but they were tough. Suddenly I saw something white sleeping under the leaves. It was a tiny lamb! The lamb had eight spots on its back.

"Is that dangerous?" my friend Sam asked from behind me.

"No, it's just a baby," I told him.

We worked together to get Buster free. He started jumping around because he was happy. We walked through the tall grass to find the farmer. We had enough adventures for one day. Gravity made my legs feel heavy walking home.

Me and my friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost golden coin. It was a secret quest. We walked for a long time. Suddenly we heard a loud noise.

"Watch out for danger!" Sam yelled at me.

We saw a big bear stamping its feet. It looked very hungry. I had a protein bar in my pocket. I threw it on the ground. The bear started eating it fast. We ran away while it was busy.

We found a cave and saw something shiny inside. It was the coin! But someone was already there. It was a monster cleaning the coin.

"We cannot receive the coin today," I whispered.

We saw the monster dumping trash on the floor. We grabbed a single rock and threw it. Then we ran all the way home. We were safe.

I was playing my favorite video game really early this morning. I wanted to beat level thirteen before school started. My character sprinted fast and jumped over the big lava pits. I was earning lots of points and feeling super happy. Then my dad came in and looked at the TV.

"You need to eat breakfast now," he said loudly.

I started to complain because I was almost winning. I tried to explain that I only needed one minute. But then my character crashed into a wall and died.

"Oh no, I lost all my coins!" I yelled.

I wrote my high score down on a paper anyway. I found my backpack and went to eat some toast. I will try to win tomorrow instead.

One day I was cleaning my messy room. I looked out the window and I saw something different. A big map flew right into my backyard! I ran outside and felt a cool breeze. My neighbor Timmy was already there looking at it.

"Look at this big red X on the mountain," Timmy said.

We thought it was a treasure map for a lost jewel. We walked to the big hill behind my house. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound coming from a cave. It was scary but we went inside anyway. We were seeing lots of bats and rocks. We found a shiny box on a little island in a puddle.

"Open it fast!" I yelled.

Inside was a giant blue jewel! We ran home super fast. It was the best adventure ever.

I found a shiny metal beetle in my backyard. It was glowing green and it looked very important. I grabbed it and suddenly I had superpowers! I could fly and shoot lasers from my eyes. I neared the big oak tree and saw a bad robot. It was trying to steal my bike.

"Hey! Put that down right now!" I yelled.

The robot looked at me and beeped loudly. I sprinted at him and gripped his metal arm. He was strong but I was stronger. I remembered my laser eyes and blasted his foot. The robot disappeared in a puff of smoke. My mom came outside and started cheering for me.

"You did it! The mission is complete," she said.

I was thrilled so I grasped my cape and flew away.

I was playing soccer at recess and I was scared. My team needed one more goal to win the big game. My heart was pumping so fast in my chest. I ran down the field and kicked the ball hard.

"Pass it to me!" my friend Billy was screaming loudly.

But I kept running because I touched the ball perfectly. The goalie looked afraid and he tried to jump high. I kicked it right past his hands into the net! Everyone started dumping their water bottles on me like a fountain.

"I can’t understand how you did that!" Billy said.

I counted all my teammates giving me high fives. I felt especially happy because we finally won the recess cup.

I was sitting at my desk and I felt hungry. It was almost lunchtime and I believed my stomach was growling loudly. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about an important meeting she had. She closed the door and we had to be very quiet. I looked inside my desk and discovered my lunchbox. I opened it and screamed inside my head because it looked gross. My mom packed stewed tomatoes and some roasted chicken for protein.

"Do you want to trade?" my friend Sam whispered to me.

"Yes please!" I said and simply pushed the box to him.

He gave me a bag of chips and a crushed cookie. We ate fast while Mrs. Miller looked through a newspaper. I felt like the king of the class and it was a good reign. I love keeping secrets about snacks.

It was February and my friend Max came over. We wanted to make a secret island in my backyard. My neighbor Ben saw us and wanted to play too. We pushed some big boxes together to make a fort.

"Do you have the scissors?" Max screamed from inside.

I said, "I don't know where they are!"

We used tape instead and the fort got stronger. We were following a schedule to finish before dinner. Suddenly the sun felt hot and scorched our backs. We ate eight cookies for a snack. Later we were swinging on the swings and laughing. It was the best day ever.

My brother Tom was turning eight today. Mom brewed some hot chocolate for everyone at the party. It was the greatest day because we had pizza. Tom chewed his pizza very fast and it looked funny.

"Don't eat like a monster!" I yelled at him.

"I need protein to get big!" Tom grumbled back.

Then he started tearing open his presents really fast. I feared he would rip the cool toys inside. One box was huge and looked dangerous to open. It did not contain a toy though. It was just a big fluffy pillow! Tom threw it at me and laughed. We played tag and ran around until we were tired. I want to have a birthday party again soon.

I have a robot named Sparky and he is my best friend. One day, we went on a big adventure to Mars. We had a schedule but Sparky dropped it in the mud. Then a big green alien grabbed Sparky’s arm!

"Hey, let him go!" I yelled at the green alien.

The alien threw a rock but I moved fast. I used my laser boots and crushed the rock into dust. The alien looked scared and he ran away fast. We escaped the trap and kept running to the spaceship.

"We won the battle!" Sparky grinned and beeped at me.

We ate space stewed apples for dinner. It was the most important day ever. We were safe and happy.

My adventure was just beginning. Me and my friend Sam found a big hole in the ground. It looked scary though. We jumped in and it felt like a bungee jump but without the rope! Gravity pulled us down fast.

"Grab the steering wheel!" yelled Sam.

I didn't see a wheel, but I saw a button. I struck it hard. Suddenly we stopped falling and just floated. We looked at the scene surrounding us. There were green aliens everywhere. We fought them with laser tag guns. I froze one alien with my blue laser.

"I guarantee we win this," I said.

We spread out and ran back to the top. It was the best day ever.

My neighbor Tom came over to play video games. We played a game about a secret island. The sun scorched the sand and it looked hot. I chose the red player and he was blue. We were running fast to escape the bad guys.

"You are going the wrong way!" Tom yelled loudly.

"I knew that," I said, but I really didn't.

My hands shook because I was scared to lose. Suddenly, a giant monster tried to gnaw on my leg. I simply jumped over him and escaped. Then I drew my sword and the monster fell down.

Bells started ringing because I won the game! It took eight minutes to complete the whole level. Tom was mad but we played again anyway.

It was my brother Tim’s birthday and he wanted a knight party. Mom made a cake that looked like a castle. I climbed on a chair to help put the candles on it. Tim was wearing his costume and earning lots of presents. He believed he was a real hero bearing a sword.

"This is the best party ever!" shouted Tim happily.

Then my dad started groaning because the game was still loading. We played a game where we used scissors to cut paper shields. I scratched my arm a little bit but I didn't cry. We ate cake and there was not even a crumb left. After that we sang happy birthday very loud. My uncle said he once did a bungee jump but I don't believe him. That night we slept in a tent in the living room.

"Goodnight Sir Tim," I whispered to him in the dark.

We were boating on the big lake near my house. My friend Tim looked at the dark water and frowned. Suddenly the boat hit something hard and stopped moving. We heard a loud groaning noise under the boat.

"What was that scary sound?" asked Tim.

"Maybe it is a monster," I said quietly.

The sky grew dark and the sun disappeared behind clouds. We struggled to paddle back to the shore. A huge shape was growing bigger in the water. We jumped out onto the earth and sprinted away fast. Gradually the monster went back down deep.

"I wish we sold that boat," Tim yelled.

We ate a crumb of a cookie and went home. The monster’s reign over the lake was scary. We never went back there again.

My younger brother Max thinks he is good at everything. We were bumping into each other playing a video game. It was a racing game and I was winning. I had a big lead and my car was fast. Max got mad and threw his controller on the floor.

"You cheated!" Max yelled at me really loud.

"No I didn't, I am just faster," I told him.

He put on his sweater and went outside. I opened the door and saw him swinging a bat. He wanted to have a baseball contest now. We lit the porch light because it was getting dark. I wrapped my hands around the bat. It was a pleasure to beat him again. He was roasted by my fastball three times. Then my mom called us for dinner. We had company coming over so we had to stop.

One day I went outside to explore my big backyard. The sun was warm and it was a very pleasant day. I looked under a rock and saw a big black beetle. It was sleeping in the dirt and looked very shiny.

"Look at this cool bug!" I yelled to my younger brother.

He ran over fast but he was scared of it. I held the beetle gently in my hand so he could see. I treated it nicely because bugs are small and fragile. We watched it crawl for a little longer and then I put it back.

"Bye bye Mr. Beetle," my brother said.

My mom sent us inside for lunch, but I want to find more bugs tomorrow.

My dog Buster is usually very good at keeping a schedule. Every day at three o'clock he waits by the door. But yesterday he sprinted outside very fast! I was following him into the woods behind my house. He stopped near a big tree and started digging the ground.

"What did you find, Buster?" I asked him.

He barked and pulled out an old, dirty bone. It looked like a dinosaur bone! I grinned big. Then my neighbor Mrs. Lee came out. She was holding a plastic knife with peanut butter spread on it.

"Is Buster hungry?" she asked.

Buster started jumping to the rhythm of her voice. I was cheering for him because he was so happy. To be honest, I thought he might need a hospital for eating dirt, but he was fine. Then we went inside screaming because we saw a huge spider.

I was dreaming about my big birthday party all week. Mom said I could invite my best friend Sam. We waited by the window for him to come over.

"I guarantee he will be here soon," Mom said.

Finally Sam’s dad’s car pulled up and stopped. Sam stood by the door with a huge blue box. It looked very heavy and full of cool stuff. I could not wait to see what was inside.

"Careful, that has a lot of weight!" Sam yelled.

We opened it and it was a giant robot toy. It was the Colonel Crusher robot from TV! I read the box and it looked so awesome. We set him up on the steady table to play. We didn't want him to fall over either. It was the best birthday ever.

My dog Buster is a champion at digging holes. Yesterday we went to the park and he started stamping his paws. He was waiting for a squirrel to come down. I sat on the grass for an hour.

"Come on Buster, let's go home!" I screamed.

He didn't listen and seized a stick instead. He chewed on it and got mud everywhere. Suddenly I saw a huge castle made of dirt. Buster made it! I wasn't afraid to look inside. Gradually I walked closer and saw a bug. The park closed soon so we had to leave. I hope to receive a prize for Buster's big castle one day. My mom brewed some hot cocoa when we got back. It was the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam went to the scary old apartment. It was tall and gray and the wind blew hard. We wanted to find the lost cat named Fluffy.

"We have to be honest, this looks scary," Sam spoke quietly.

We walked straight to the big door. It was locked but I simply pushed it. It opened! It was dark inside. We struggled to see anything. Suddenly, a big shadow grew on the wall. It looked like a monster! I felt like running was impossible.

"Is that a ghost?" I asked.

But then a tiny meow came from the corner. It was Fluffy! She was stuck under a box. I used all my strength to lift it. We were not wrong to come here. We grabbed the cat and ran home fast especially since it was dinner time.
