I was wearing my super suit and waiting for the alien. My mom was coaching my little brother at soccer, so I was alone. Suddenly, I heard a loud crash in the kitchen. A green alien was eating my leftover stewed carrots! He chewed really loud and kept groaning.

"Hey! You stole my lunch!" I yelled at him.

The alien looked at me and cleared his throat. "I study human science," he said. "Do you have an elephant?"

I told him no, and he started following me around. I did not receive any powers from him, but he did write his name on my wall. His name was Bob and he liked psychology. I hope he doesn't reign over Earth.

I was camping in my backyard with my dog. It was very dark and the stars looked weird. Suddenly a giant metal spaceship crashed into the grass! It landed right next to my mom's garden.

A green door opened and a robot walked out. He had fourteen blue eyes and huge metal feet.

"Do you receive my signal?" the robot asked loudly.

I was scared but I stood up tall. "Yes I hear you Mr. Robot," I said.

Then five tiny aliens ran out behind him cheering. They looked impossible because they were floating in the air. I realized I trained for this in my video games. We played tag all night until the sun came up. It was the best night ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were running fast because we saw a giant castle. It was very big and had vines surrounding the walls.

"This must be where the King used to reign!" I shouted.

We walked inside and saw a shiny sword hanging on the wall. I knew it was important. Suddenly a huge wind blew through the room. Sam got scared because his shirt got caught on a nail.

"Help me! A giant gnat is attacking me!" Sam yelled.

It wasn't a gnat, it was just a moth. I counted to three and pulled him free. We read a map on the floor to complete our quest. We found the treasure chest and ran home for dinner.

It was raining on my birthday so we stayed inside. I felt anger because I wanted to play outside. My mom made a plain cake but it smelled good. My friend Sam came over early and grinned at me.

"Do not be sad!" Sam said loudly.

I crossed my arms and sat on the floor. Then Sam scrambled into his bag and pulled out a game. It was a new board game about space.

"Let's learn how to play this now," he said.

We set up the board and started moving pieces. Suddenly an idea struck me and I felt happy again. Playing inside was actually really fun. I looked at the schedule on the wall. We had lots of time before dinner. I felt grateful for my good friend.

I was playing a new game on my computer. It was a racing game with fast cars. I wanted to make my car look cool. I clicked on the design button to change the color. The game had a special tool for painting the car. I made my car bright red with yellow stripes.

"Do you know how to drive that thing?" asked my brother.

"I can drive simply by using the arrows," I said.

The track had nice scenery with big green trees. I discovered a secret shortcut behind a rock. The box at the finish line did not contain a prize. I still won the race and beat my brother. He was mad but I was happy.

My brother Timmy and I played soccer in the backyard. I was yearning to win, but Timmy is very fast. The earth was muddy because it rained all night long. I kicked the ball hard, but Timmy caught it.

"You can't score on me!" Timmy yelled loudly.

I felt trapped near the fence, but I kept pumping my legs. I saw an opening and I crossed the ball fast. Timmy was seeing the ball go past his hands. He started stamping his feet because he was mad.

"That's not fair!" he shouted at me.

Neither of us saw the sign about wet grass. We both slipped and fell into the mud. It was a funny scene. I was feeling happy even though I was dirty. We didn't listen to Mom, so we got in trouble later.

We went to the island on a big white boat. My dog Buster was waiting for us on the beach. He barked loud because he saw a crab. I climbed on a rock to see better. My dad was loading our bags onto the sand.

"Look out Buster!" I yelled. "That crab has big claws!"

Buster did not listen, although he looked scared. He fought the crab but neither of them won. Then we heard a noise in the bushes. It was a goat with a shiny chain.

"Can we keep him?" I asked my dad.

"No way," Dad said. "He belongs to someone else."

We drove back to our tent in the little cart. I feared the goat was sad, but then his owner came. She was coaching him to jump over a log. Buster watched them happy to receive a treat.

Me and my dog Max went into the dark woods. We were looking for a secret cave. The scenery was spooky with big trees. I was certain we were lost, but I kept walking. Suddenly, a big bird flew right over my head!

"Watch out Max!" I told him loudly.

We ran fast and fell into a big hole. We were trapped inside the deep hole. My leg got scratched on a rock. I was trembling because it was cold.

"We need to climb out now," I said.

Max used his training and dug at the dirt. I climbed on his back instead of crying. It was a pleasure to see the sun again. We ran home very fast.

Yesterday I went boating on the lake with my dog. It was early in the morning so I wore a warm sweater. My dog is named Rover and he likes science. Okay he doesn't really understand science but he likes looking at bugs.

Suddenly a big green frog appeared on a lily pad. Rover barked very loud because he saw the frog floating there.

"Stop that, Rover!" I yelled with a little bit of anger.

But Rover jumped into the water and the frog escaped quickly. Rover swam back and I pulled him onto the boat. He shook his wet fur all over me. I paid five dollars for this boat rental!

"You are a silly dog," I said while pointing my finger.

Although he was wet, Rover wagged his tail at me. He understood the meaning of my words and gave me a lick.

Yesterday me and my friend Sam went to the dark forest. We wanted to find the secret cave. We walked for a long time and crossed a big river.

"Look at that big hole!" Sam shouted loudly.

It was the cave but it looked scary. Unfortunately we heard a loud roar inside. A dragon came out and struck the ground with his tail. The grass was scorched black from fire. Neither of us wanted to fight a dragon.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Sam.

We ran back home very quickly. My leg got scratched by a bush. My mom gave me a soda with caffeine. It was the best adventure ever.

My brother Tom was in big trouble last week. He tried to hide a weird black spider in his room. Mom found it when she was seeing if his room was clean. She screamed really loud and looked super scared.

"Get that thing out of here right now!" Mom yelled.

Tom grinned and picked up the spider gently. "But Mom, he is still growing!"

My dad came in with a knitting needle to poke it. He chased Tom outside into the rain. Tom dropped the spider in the bushes. He was sad but the spider’s reign of terror was over. Now Tom is serving a grounding for a whole week. I think that is fair.

My friend Tom and I walked to the creepy forest. We wanted to find the lost treasure box. Tom held a map made from old newspaper. It was muddy on the earth but we saw the X.

"Look out for traps!" I shouted at Tom.

We walked for a long time and my legs hurt. Suddenly Tom caught his foot on a big root. He fell down hard but he was okay.

"I think we reached the spot," Tom said happily.

We dug in the dirt and found a heavy box. The weight was huge so we pulled together. Inside was just stewed tomatoes in cans! My dad was swearing because we were late for dinner. We did not find gold but it was fun.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old cave. It was dark but we had big flashlights. I was wearing my lucky red sweater because it was cold. We walked far inside and the ceiling was super low.

Suddenly we saw a huge rock blocking the way. We pushed it but the weight was too heavy.

"I am yearning for some pizza right now," Sam said.

"Stop thinking about food and help me push!" I yelled.

We pushed harder and finally threw the rock over. Behind it was a shiny gold box! I knew we would find treasure today. We opened it but it was just old rocks. We laughed for no reason and ran home for dinner.

I found a robot behind my neighbor's big red barn. He looked sad and was sounding like a broken truck. I wanted to guide him home but he was heavy. He had a yearning for oil and maybe some batteries.

"I can help you walk up the mountain," I said.

The robot made a beep and said, "I guarantee I will try."

We walked for a long time bearing heavy bags of tools. We saw a magic fountain that glowed bright green. The robot drank the green water and suddenly felt strong. He didn't even need his protein shake anymore! Now I know that robots really like magic water.

It was my sister’s big birthday party. Mom was busy coaching us on how to behave for company. Dad was in the kitchen toasted buns for the hot dogs. I was painting a sign that said Happy Birthday.

Suddenly my sister yelled, “Where is my new puppy?”

We all started a big search for the little dog. I looked under the couch and behind the door. Mom called the dog’s name loudly.

“Look outside!” I shouted.

We saw the puppy dumping over the trash can. It was a huge mess but he looked so happy. He thought he was in doggy heaven. Mom said we had to remain calm and clean it up. I ended up earning five dollars for helping. After that we sat down for cake and reading cards. It was a crazy day.

I was so excited because today was the big race. I put on my lucky red sweater and tied my shoes. My dad greeted me at the door with a big smile. He said, "You did lots of training so you are ready."

We drove to the park and I saw my friend Ben. He was groaning because his stomach hurt from eating too much candy. I grinned at him and started to stretch my legs. The race started and I jumped out fast. Following me was Ben but he was moaning and looked tired.

I ran past a plain tree and saw the finish line. I felt incredible when I crossed the line first! My dad yelled, "Great job winning the race!" I was the champion and it was time to reign. Then my dog tried to gnaw on my gold medal.

We went on a quest to the big mountain. My friend Sam followed me and we walked for a long time. The path was twisted like a pretzel. Suddenly we heard a scary groaning sound!

"What is that noise?" asked Sam. He looked very scared.

"I think a monster is approaching," I said.

We realized it was just a big bear sleeping. We crossed the river quietly so we did not wake him up. The reason we came here was to find the golden needle. It was stuck in a rock at the top. We had to maintain our balance on the slippery stones. Finally, we grabbed it! Everyone in our town was cheering when we got back. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my friend Sam found a map hanging on a tree. It looked old and scary but we wanted to explore. We walked for an hour into the deep woods. The wind blew very hard and leaves swept everywhere.

"Do you know where we are?" I asked Sam.

Sam looked at the map and spoke quietly. "I think the treasure is near that cave."

We ran to the cave and opened the big rock door. Inside, we saw shiny coins scattered on the floor! Suddenly, a bat started jumping around us. We got scared and ran out fast. A newspaper flew by and hit my face. We followed the path back home just in time for dinner. We did not keep the schedule, but it was the best day ever.

My dog Rex is very funny and different. We live in a small apartment but he likes to run. One day we went to the big park for a walk. I wanted to stick to the schedule, but Rex saw a squirrel.

"Come back here, Rex!" I was screaming loudly.

He ran longer and faster into the deep woods. I ran after him and my leg felt a stinging pain. I fell down into some mud and shook my head. Then Rex came back and licked my face with pleasure. I tried to measure how dirty he was.

"You are a bad dog," I said, but I smiled. We walked home and took a big bubble bath together.

One day I built a huge robot in my backyard. It was made of metal and old cans. I was thrilled when it started singing a weird song. Suddenly a green alien climbed out of the robot’s head. He had three eyes and was swinging a laser sword.

"I need help," said the alien. "My ship disappeared."

I was trembling a little bit but I gave him a thumbs up. We looked at the surrounding trees and found his ship. He fell down because he was so happy. Even though it seemed impossible, the ship started glowing.

"Thank you, friend!" he yelled and flew away fast.

I hurt my thumb helping him but I didn’t go to the hospital. I just know nobody will believe me.

It was the middle of February and school was boring. I was feeling tired because I didn't sleep good. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about a science lesson. She drew a big heart with a blue vein on the board.

"Who knows what this is called?" she asked us.

My friend Tommy was groaning because he hates science. He whispered to me, "I wish I was floating in a pool."

I nodded but then the bell rang for lunch. We ran to the cafeteria and the line was super long. It felt like the food was loading forever. Finally I got my tray and went to our meeting spot. We talked about a kid who got pneumonia last year. It was scary but he is okay now. After lunch I did not receive any homework and that was the best part of the growing day.

One cold day in February, my friend Max came over. We wanted to play a space game on my computer. But then we realized something weird. The room started shaking and gravity went away! We floated up to the ceiling.

"Listen!" Max yelled. "I hear a strange beeping sound."

We swam through the air to the closet. It was actually a spaceship door. We opened it and saw glowing buttons. It was just the beginning of our trip. We flew to Mars and landed on red rocks. We had to use our imagination to fight aliens. We did not have enough lasers to win. Then the game said COMPLETE on the screen.

"That was close," I said. "Let's go write about this."

Gradually, we floated down. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my brother Max went into the dark woods. We wanted to find the magic fountain. It was a long walk and it took an hour. Suddenly we saw a giant wolf and we were in trouble. The wolf growled at us and showed his sharp teeth.

"Run away fast!" yelled Max.

I grabbed a big stick and I fought the wolf. Then a little white lamb jumped out. The wolf looked at the lamb and ran away. We understood that the lamb was magic. It was fourteen years old.

"Thank you, little lamb," I said.

We were freezing but we felt very grateful. We drank the water and then we went home.

My dad drove us to my neighbor's house for my birthday. I just turned thirteen and we had a huge party. My nephew came too and he brought his toy lamb.

We spread a big blanket on the grass to eat cake. My mom taught me how to cut the pieces evenly. Then my friend started to sneeze really loud.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"I think the grass makes my nose tickle," he said.

We played a game where you have to comb a doll's hair. I struggled a little bit but I still won. I thought I was the king and this was my reign! But then I grew tired and wanted to sleep. My dad said no grounding today because it was my special day.

One day I was walking my robot dog Sparky. Suddenly a big green alien ship landed in the park with a loud thumping noise. I was scared but Sparky started barking at the door.

"Don't go near it Sparky!" I screamed.

But Sparky kept jumping up and down. Then a blue alien came out. He looked like jelly. He pointed a ray gun at us and it was freezing cold. I thought escaping was impossible. But then Sparky used his laser eyes! The alien dropped his gun and ran back inside.

"Good boy Sparky," I said and patted his metal head.

We searched the ground and found a paper. It looked like a receipt for space pizza. I think the alien just wanted a snack. We ran home fast because of the danger. My mom says I have a big imagination but I know it was real.

I grumbled when my mom woke me up. I wanted to stay asleep because my bed was cozy. But today was science class and we were making slime. The weather was super hot and the sun scorched the sidewalk. I walked to school and saw my friend Sam.

"Did you finish the math homework?" Sam asked me.

"No, I forgot my book at school," I said.

We looked at the schedule on the wall. Lunch was pizza but the line was leading outside. We ate fast and then ran to play kickball. I am in a kickball league with my friends. We played until the bell rang very loud. My leg hurt a little so I walked gradually to class. Maybe I need a hospital for my leg! Just kidding. I can't wait to play on my balcony later.

I was playing tag at recess today with Mike. It was super hot and the sun scorched my face. Mike is very fast because he trained all summer. I scrambled away from him near the monkey bars. I gripped the cold metal tightly and climbed up high. Then I heard the bell ringing loudly for lunchtime. 

I jumped down but I slipped and bit my tongue. It was stinging really bad but I didn't cry. Mike ran over and asked, "Are you okay?" 

I grasped my mouth and nodded my head yes. We walked to the cafeteria and I got pizza. It appeared cheesy enough but I struggled to eat it. My tongue still hurt even though I was hungry. Next time I will just run instead of climbing.

I went to the jungle with my friend Sam. We wanted to be the champion explorers of the world. We neared a big cave that looked very scary. Sam said, "I think a monster lives in there."

Suddenly my backpack disappeared into the dark. I felt anger because my lunch was inside. It had a protein bar and my favorite sandwich. We walked in and discovered a monkey holding my bag!

The monkey ran away but the path was closed by rocks. I used my scissors to cut some vines. We climbed over and saw a strange foreign city.

"What happened to this place?" I asked Sam.

We did not complete our quest to find gold. But we found a cool monkey city instead.

Me and my younger brother crawled through the tall grass. We were explorers looking for the greatest treasure ever. I grasped my map tight and my heart was pumping fast. We saw a huge rock that looked like a monster.

"We have to climb it!" I shouted to Sam.

"It looks too slippery," Sam said, looking scared.

But we were brave so we started to go up. I scratched my knee on a sharp stone. It hurt but I simply kept going. Finally we got to the top. There was a weird box with a science design on it. We opened it and found shiny gold rocks inside! We were so thrilled. We started singing and cheering very loud. We ran home to show Mom our amazing discovery.

I was already breathing hard when I ran to class. I thought I was late for math again. My teacher Mrs. Lee looked at me and she opened the door. I walked straight to my desk and sat down fast.

"Did you do your homework?" asked my friend Sam.

I stuck out my tongue because I forgot it at home. If I got caught, my mom would give me a grounding. Just then Mrs. Lee called my name.

"Do you know the answer to number five?" she asked.

I looked at the paper and felt like a scared lamb. I guessed the answer was ten.

"That is right!" said Mrs. Lee.

I was so happy I didn't get in trouble. Next time I will put my homework in my bag first.

Yesterday was the most impossible day at school. We had a super hard math test. I gripped my pencil tight and tried my best. But then the bell rang for recess! I was so thrilled.

We all ran outside to the playground. My friend Sam found something shiny on the ground.

"Look at this!" Sam yelled. "I think it is a jewel."

"No way," I said. "It looks like a plastic bead."

Suddenly, a big kid crashed into Sam. He dropped the shiny thing in the grass. We looked everywhere but the grass grew too tall there. We were sad but then the teacher called us inside. It was important to get back to class. Lunch was pizza day anyway so we felt better.

Yesterday, I found a robot in the woods. He was rusty and making a loud groaning noise. I touched his arm and suddenly everything turned purple!

"Do not eat that crumb!" the robot yelled at me.

I looked down and saw a tiny blue crumb on my shoe. It was glowing.

"Why?" I asked him. "Is it magic food?"

The robot started steering me away from the crumb. He pointed at a huge silver castle in the sky.

"That crumb is actually a baby alien ship," he said.

We went boating on the river to get away fast. I looked back and heard a boom. Seeing the castle land was super cool.

For my birthday, my dad took me to the big park. We walked to the green meadow behind the swings. I saw a shiny blue rock that looked like a jewel. I picked it up carefully and showed my dad. It had a white line like a vein inside it.

"That is a cool rock," said Dad.

"I want to keep everything I find today," I said.

Then we went to the bouncy place. I jumped on the bungee trampoline. I went so high up in the air! It was a pleasure to fly like a bird. I felt like I was thirteen instead of eight. My smile grew really big. We stayed until no kids were left at the park. It was the best day ever.

I was roaming around the playground at recess. My friend Sam was eating a sandwich with ham. I touched his arm and he jumped.

"Hey, want to play tag?" I asked him loudly.

Sam grumbled and wiped some mustard off his thumb. "No, I failed my math test again."

He looked sad like a lost lamb. I felt bad because failure feels really awful. My mom is good at coaching me with numbers.

"I can help you study later!" I said.

Sam smiled and looked very grateful. Then the bell rang for grounding us back inside. I hope we don't have homework tonight.

I was playing a new video game with my friend Sam. We were camping in the game and fighting big monsters. It was the beginning of the hardest level ever. We struggled to beat the boss because he kept swinging a huge hammer. He was so tall he almost hit the ceiling.

"This is impossible!" Sam yelled at the TV screen.

I was speaking quietly and trying to guide him. "Just attack together and don't stop!"

We tried one longer time and used our science weapons. The boss fell down and we finally crushed him! It felt weird to win because he was so strong.

"We did it!" I shouted.

I love playing games, even when they are hard. teaching Sam how to play was really fun.

One day me and my best friend Sam went exploring. We were climbing the big mountain behind my house. I was wearing my lucky red cape. We wanted to find the secret cave. Suddenly, Sam let out a huge sneeze!

"Shhh! You will wake up the monster!" I whispered.

Then we heard a loud growl and we got scared. A big shadow disappeared behind a rock. We grabbed our sticks and walked closer. We saw shiny gold coins scattered on the ground. We were earning treasure for being brave!

"Look at all this gold!" shouted Sam.

But then a meeting of angry bats flew out. We ran all the way home, even though we wanted the gold. It was the best adventure ever.

Yesterday I went outside because there was a nice cool breeze. I wanted to see if my dog Sparky needed more training. I threw a stick very far for him but he didn't run. He was staring at a big tree near the fence.

I walked over and saw a huge green beetle clinging to the bark. I thought Sparky was afraid of it.

"Go get the stick, Sparky!" I yelled loudly.

Sparky just looked at me and then he looked back at the bug. He understood that the beetle was special. Then a squirrel ran down to gnaw on an acorn nearby. Sparky barked and tried to climb the tree but he fell down. Throughout the whole afternoon we just watched the beetle move one finger length up the tree. It was the best day ever.

It was Wednesday and my robot Zorg was acting weird. He was trembling and making loud beeping noises in the kitchen. I reached for his off switch but he jumped away. My dad was reading the newspaper and he didn't even look up.

"Zorg is broken!" I screamed at my dad.

"Maybe he needs a new battery," said Dad calmly.

But I knew it wasn't a battery problem at all. Zorg’s eyes turned bright red and smoke came out. He started pumping green slime all over the floor. It was gross. My dad finally looked and dropped his coffee. We called the robot company to fix him fast. I think Zorg needs robot psychology or something. Being a robot owner is really hard work.

My birthday was today and I was so excited. My mom stood in the kitchen and made a big cake. She asked me to help measure the sugar. We were dumping flour in a bowl when my brother ran in. He was bumping into everything and making a huge mess.

"Watch out!" I yelled at him very loudly.

"I just wanted a cookie," he spoke quietly.

He pushed a chair and then he moved it back. My mom said we had to wait one hour. We played with my new trucks until the timer rang. The cake smelled good but we were leaving soon for pizza. I ate a huge slice of cake before we left. It was the best birthday ever.

The alien ship landed on the playground with a boom. It looked like a giant silver egg. I was running to see it, but my robot dog Sparky stopped. He started barking at the metal door.

The door twisted open and green smoke came out. A small alien crawled onto the ground. He was holding a glowing blue rock.

"My spaceship is broken," the alien grumbled sadly. "I am stuck here."

I looked at Sparky and had an idea. Sparky started bringing me his spare batteries.

"Here," I said. "Maybe these will fix your engine."

The alien put the batteries in the rock. Suddenly the ship started floating up high. The alien waved goodbye and zoomed away. It was the best recess ever.

My friends and I went to a scary island. We were looking for a science lab in the jungle. It was meant to be secret. Suddenly a huge wind blew very hard. A tree fell right in front of us!

"Watch out!" I screamed loudly to my friend Sam.

Sam threw a rock at a bush because he was scared. Then we saw something impossible. A shiny door was keeping the lab safe. We opened it and saw a weird scene. A potion made things invisible!

"This is important," Sam said. "We need to take it home."

But it was getting late so we ran back fast. We will go back tomorrow to get the magic potion.

I was sitting in class and my backpack felt heavy. The weight of my math book was too much. I was yearning for recess time to start. Finally the bell rang loud and we all ran outside. I saw my friend Tommy swinging on the bars. I started running to him but I tripped on a rock.

"Are you okay?" Tommy spoke to me nicely.

"Yeah, I am fine," I said and got up fast.

We played tag throughout the whole playground. I was earning points by tagging everyone. But then the teacher blew the whistle. It was not enough time to play. Someone stole my ball too, but I didn't care. The teacher had to guide us back inside for lunch. It was a good day but I was tired.

One day my best friend Jake and I wanted an adventure. We went boating on the lake near the old castle building. My heart was pumping fast because people said a ghost knight was roaming there.

"Look out for the rocks!" Jake screamed.

Our boat hit a big rock and we landed in the mud. We were in big trouble. Suddenly, a huge dog ran up to us with its tongue out. It was just looking for company. We laughed and started walking home.

"That wasn't scary at all," I said.

My mom was waiting on the porch. She said our grounding was starting now because we were late for dinner.

Me and my friend Sam went boating on the river. It was incredible and sunny outside. We were wearing our life jackets. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping sound near the shore. My heart was beating fast and my blood was pumping.

"What is that big noise?" asked Sam.

"I think it is something dangerous," I said.

We paddled the boat to the steady ground. We saw a huge beetle crawling on a log. It was loading leaves onto its back. Then a man in a green hat walked out. He looked like a colonel from a movie. He was meeting the beetle! It was weird psychology, but he was talking to the bug. We ran away fast.

My dog Max is usually good, but today was different. He ran into the woods and I had to chase him. I found him dumping dirt everywhere near a big tree. He was digging a huge hole for a bone!

"Max, stop that right now!" I yelled at him.

He looked at me and shook his head, ears flapping. I tried coaching him to come back, but he wouldn't. Then I saw what he found. It wasn't a bone. It was a roasted chicken leg from a picnic!

"You simply cannot eat that," I said.

He looked sad, so I gave him a wonderful treat instead. I meant to be mad, but I wasn't. We walked home and I was pleased he was safe. We can measure the hole later.

I was so hungry after school, but I had soccer practice. I ate a granola bar and went to the big green field. My team struggled in the first half because the other team was fast.

"Pass the ball to me!" my friend Sammy was screaming.

I kicked the ball through the grass, and Sammy got it. He ran longer than anyone else and scored a goal! We were so happy. After the game, the coach gave us a schedule for next week.

"Make sure you sign this," he told us.

I had to write my name on the paper so I could play again. I love soccer, even when we are tired.

Last Wednesday was the worst day ever. I left my lunchbox on the bus and felt hungry. My stomach made loud noises during our meeting.

"What is that sound?" asked Mrs. Miller.

"It is my tummy," I said sadly.

At recess, we played tag and I sprinted fast. I grabbed the swing but kept bumping into Tommy. He is really big and has lots of strength. I hung on tight but fell off anyway.

I had a bad feeling about the rest of the day. Then I realized I did the wrong math homework. It was like a heavy weight on my shoulders. I cannot guarantee I will pass the test either. I hope we go camping soon so I can forget school. The day gradually got better when mom brought pizza.

I was wearing my new sneakers at recess today. They are red and super fast. Billy looked at me and said, "I bet I can jump higher." I knew he was lying because he is short. We went to the big slide for jumping. Billy tried to do a bungee jump with his shoelaces. It was a bad idea. He crashed into the sand really hard.

Then Mrs. Miller came over and she was reading a newspaper. She heard Billy make a bad sound, almost like swearing. "Billy! That is not okay!" she yelled loudly. Neither of us got to play anymore. Lunch was already over and recess was done. It was a weird day because Billy started speaking a foreign language after he hit his head. I think he was just faking it.

I woke up early because today was the big race. My bike is plain blue but it goes super fast. I scratched my knee yesterday but I didn't care. The race was through the park and up the big hill.

My friend Leo looked at the height of the hill. "That looks impossible to climb!" he said.

"We just have to pedal hard," I told him.

The whistle started sounding loud and we all took off. I was tearing down the path. Then I discovered a shortcut near the trees! I pedaled harder to seize the lead. I crossed the line first and felt amazing. I am the bike champion of the neighborhood!

I was sitting in class and looking at the clock. It was almost time for recess and I could not wait. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about a big mountain on the other side of the earth.

“Does anyone know how tall it is?” she asked us.

I raised my hand high but then I felt a sneeze coming. I tried to stop it though it was very hard. Suddenly a loud sneeze escaped my nose and everyone laughed.

“Bless you!” said my friend Tommy from the next desk.

Just then the bell rang and we all started running. We went outside to play on the playground island. We discovered a bug bearing a tiny leaf on its back. There were thirteen ants following it in a line. I guarantee it was the best recess ever although it was short. Then Mrs. Miller appeared at the door and waved.

My teacher Mrs. Jenkins put a big newspaper on her desk. She said we had to make art with it today. I was thrilled because I love art class. I grabbed my scissors and cut out a big bear. My friend Sam made a weird shape that looked like roasted chicken.

"What is that bearing?" I asked him.

"It is a superhero jumping over a building," Sam said.

We glued everything down, but neither of us had enough glue. The paper blew off the table when the door opened. Everyone started groaning because it was a huge mess. Mrs. Jenkins crossed her arms and simply pointed at the floor. We picked it up quickly because we were yearning for recess. I am in the kickball league and I want to win. The height of the fence is tall but I can kick it over!

I went to my friend Tom's house for a sleepover. We hung up some cool posters for his birthday party. The scenery outside his window was really nice and green. Tom showed me his new kite and we ran outside.

The kite flew high up in the blue sky. The wind blew very hard and sounding like a whistle. We crossed the big field and ran through the grass.

"Look at it go!" shouted Tom very loudly.

My dad taught me how to fly kites last summer. We ran back inside to do a fun science experiment. It was a really great day with my best friend.

Yesterday at recess I had a very bad feeling. I was playing tag with my best friend Sam. We were jumping over the big grey rocks. Suddenly I fell down and scratched my knee hard. It hurt so much that I screamed loudly.

Sam stopped running and grabbed my arm to help.
"Are you okay?" Sam asked with a worried face.
"No! My knee is bleeding!" I screeched back.

The teacher came over and saw the red blood. She took me to the nurse for company. The nurse cleaned it but it felt like a needle. I hung my head down because I was crying. Then she put a big bandage on it. I finally understood that I needed to be careful. Everyone was screaming and playing outside but I just sat down.

My robot Rex was acting weird yesterday. He usually just cleans my room, but he started floating. He went right through the wall and into the yard. I ran after him fast. Rex stopped near the big oak tree. There was a glowing green alien sleeping there. It woke up and made a loud moaning sound. It stuck out a long purple tongue at me.

"Rex, what is that thing?" I asked.

"I am meeting my new friend," Rex beeped loudly.

We crossed the yard together and the alien smiled. I trained Rex to shake hands, so he shook the alien’s hand. They are best friends now. I hope my mom doesn't find out about the alien.

One day my friend Billy and I went to the jungle. We wanted to find the lost golden elephant statue. It was very hot but then it got freezing cold.

"Look out for that big hole!" yelled Billy loudly.

I jumped over the hole and saw a scary snake. That was big danger so we ran fast. We ran for a long time. Suddenly we saw a weird sailor man in a tree. He had a map but he was invisible almost.

"You should go left instead of right," said the sailor.

We walked longer and used a stick to measure the mud. Finally we found the golden elephant behind a big rock. Everyone was cheering when we got home. We are famous explorers now.

One day me and my dog Max went on an adventure. We walked to the big woods behind my house. Max started sounding funny and ran to a big tree. I looked up and saw a cat hanging on a branch. It looked trapped and scared.

"Max, be quiet!" I shouted loudly.

The cat stuck its pink tongue out. It was my neighbor's cat named Princess. She acted like she had the reign of the forest. I started climbing up the rough bark. It seemed impossible to reach her. I crawled slowly on the branch to seize her collar.

"I got you!" I yelled down to Max.

I threw her gently to the soft grass below. My neighbor’s daughter ran over and hugged the cat. She was happy her pet was safe. We walked home feeling like heroes.

I was playing my favorite game called Ghost Runners. It is a racing game and I am very good. My mom said I had to do homework or I would get a grounding. But I wanted to be the champion of the level. I was earning lots of points and bumping into cars.

I dropped my controller because my hands were sweaty. Then my sister walked in and turned off the TV!

"Hey! I was winning!" I yelled at her really loud.

She counted to three and said, "Mom told you to write your essay."

I was so mad but I knew I had to learn my lesson. Maybe I was just dreaming about winning. Next time I will finish my homework first.

I was sitting at my desk doing math homework. It was really hard and my pencil broke. I looked for the scissors to sharpen it. My friend Billy walked by and he laughed at me.

"Why are you doing homework now?" Billy asked.

"I forgot to do it last night," I said.

The teacher Mrs. Green was walking through the rows. She saw Billy surrounding my desk. She thought he was bothering me.

"Go sit down right now, Billy," Mrs. Green said.

Billy sat down and he looked really mad. Then lunch happened and I paid for a pizza slice. I stole a cookie from my own lunchbox later. It felt like a huge weight was off my shoulders. I don't drink caffeine but I felt super awake!

Me and my best friend Sam went boating down the river. We wanted to see the big green jungle. Sam trained his dog Spot to sit in the boat. Suddenly we got lost because the map was bad design.

"We cannot remain here any longer!" Sam spoke loudly.

We saw a scary scene with tall grass and bugs. We crawled under a big log to hide. I tried to write a note for help. But then Spot barked at a bush. It did not contain a tiger. It was just a tiny monkey!

"That monkey knows psychology," I said. "He tricked us."

We laughed and found the way back home. It was the best day ever.

I was playing my new video game on Saturday morning. It is about a knight who lives in a big castle. The knight was jumping over fire and rocks. I kept dying and the screen said loading. It was so hard to guide him through the dark caves!

My big brother came in and saw me looking sad. He put on his warm green sweater and sat down.

"Do you need help with that level?" he asked.

I nodded my head and gave him the controller. He is good at teaching me how to play. He started to explain the buttons and I watched him.

"You have to wrap the rope around the tree," he said.

He showed me how to swing across the hole. It was important to jump at the right time. I tried again and I finally won! My brother was moaning because he wanted a turn too.

One day a green alien was jumping on my trampoline. He bounced super high, almost up to heaven! I ran outside screaming because I was scared. The alien had three eyes and was holding giant scissors.

"Why do you have scissors?" I asked him loudly.

"I need to cut the gravity," he said with a weird sounding voice.

He was steering a tiny spaceship with his other hand. Suddenly, my robot dog Sparky ran out to guard me. Sparky was pumping his metal legs fast on the ground. The alien got scared and did a bungee jump back to his ship. He flew away fast. I was so grateful that Sparky was steady and brave. I thought aliens were nice, but this one was trouble.

We were walking in the dark jungle. My dog Rex ran ahead and I followed him. Suddenly we saw a giant bug flying at us. It looked like a stinging bee but way bigger. I threw a rock at it but I missed.

"Run away fast!" I yelled to Rex.

We ran and kept bumping into big green trees. Then we crashed into a hidden cave. It was dark but I saw something shiny. It was a golden feather on a rock. I feared it was a trap. But Rex is trained to help me. He caught the feather in his mouth. Then I started to sneeze because of the dust.

"Good boy Rex," I said and patted his head.

We had to complete our mission to find treasure. We did not receive any bites either. The adventure was scary but fun.

My brother Tim was coaching me on my new video game. It was a racing game with cars and animals. I gripped the controller really tight because I was winning. My character was a blue elephant driving a fast red truck.

"Turn left now!" Tim yelled at the screen.

I turned and almost hit a floating banana peel. I grinned because I missed it. Then a big green creature tried to bump me off the road. I pushed the turbo button and zoomed past him. I reached the finish line first and saw fireworks on the TV.

"You did it!" Tim shouted and gave me a high five.

I was so thrilled that I won the gold cup. Then mom called us from the balcony for dinner. I love beating my big brother at games.

We went deep into the dark woods behind my house. My friend Leo brought a long red thread so we would not get lost. Suddenly we heard a loud moaning sound near a big rock.

"What is that?" asked Leo. His face looked scared.

I said, "Maybe it is a monster roaming around."

We walked longer and saw a hairy creature jumping up and down. It was stuck under a heavy branch. We lifted the weight off its leg together. The creature ran away fast.

"My dad says helping animals is good psychology," I told Leo.

We followed the thread back home and ate ice cream. It was the best adventure ever.

It was my birthday and I was so excited. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We ate pizza and then it was time for presents. My mom gave me a big box and I could not contain my happiness. I used my finger to rip the paper.

"What is inside?" asked Sam.

"I hope it is a toy lamb," I said.

I tore the wrap off and looked inside. Suddenly, a bright green frog jumped straight out! It disappeared under the couch. We laughed really hard. The box also had a bungee cord toy.

Then my dad walked in with cake as bedtime neared. It was chocolate and it tasted wonderful.

"Best birthday ever!" I yelled.

My dad was steering the car into the school line. I was feeling weird because I forgot my lunch. I touched my backpack and it felt too light. 

"Did you bring your sandwich?" my dad asked me.

"Oh no, it is still on the table!" I yelled.

Dad sighed and he kept loading my bags. He handed me money for the cafeteria instead.

At recess, I ran to the water fountain. My friend Sam was there too. He was drinking a soda.

"Does that have caffeine?" I asked him. 

"Maybe, but it tastes like floating clouds," Sam said.

School is okay but forgetting lunch is the worst. I hope they have pizza today.

My friends and I found a secret map yesterday. It showed a scary path through the thick jungle. We walked for fourteen minutes and saw a cave. The ground was shaking and making a groaning sound.

"Watch out for the danger!" yelled my friend Sam.

We crawled inside the dark cave very slowly. My heart was beating super fast in my chest. Suddenly, a big bear woke up and roared! We sprinted away as fast as we could. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole to escape.

"That was already too scary," I said to Sam.

We ran all the way home without stopping. I hope my mom doesn't give me a grounding. We looked for treasure throughout the day but found nothing.

My dog Buster is very funny but he is naughty. We went to the big meadow behind my house yesterday. Buster started jumping around like a crazy bunny rabbit. He saw a blue bird and he flew after it fast.

"Come back here right now Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He did not listen and he ran into the mud. He stood there looking silly with mud on his nose. Then he found an old shoe in the dirt. It was made of brown leather and it smelled bad. He chewed on it and he was bringing it to me.

"Yuck, drop that gross thing!" I said to him.

He was groaning because he did not want to drop it. My dad taught him to drop things but he forgets often. Gravity pulled the heavy shoe down when he opened his mouth. We have to learn to bring treats next time for him.

My birthday party was going to be awesome. We were doing spy training in my backyard. My dad was coaching us on how to be sneaky. First we crawled under a net on the grass. Then we ran fast with our arms pumping.

"Go faster!" yelled my friend Leo.

I pushed him a little bit but he laughed. We followed the path to the big slide. It was like loading a spaceship. Suddenly disaster struck when my shoe got stuck. It got caught on the chain of the swing.

"Are you okay?" asked my dad.

I nodded and pulled my foot out. Then we ate huge slices of cake and opened presents. It was the best day ever.

I woke up early because today was the big quest. My best friend Sam came over and we went into the woods. We walked for a while and the path cleared up. Suddenly we saw a giant cave with a monster inside! It had a sharp tooth like a needle.

"We have to run!" I yelled loudly.

Sam tried to run but he tripped on a rock. He fell and his glasses almost broke. The monster looked at us immediately. It opened its mouth but then it let out a huge sneeze. It was just a bear with a cold, not a monster! My imagination is crazy sometimes. We didn't stay any longer. Not a single person believed us later.

My dog Max and I went to the park yesterday. We pretended the big rock was a castle on an island. Max was thrilled because I brought his blue ball. I threw the ball really far across the grass. Max sprinted fast and his tongue hung out. But then he stopped and barked at a bush.

"What is wrong, Max?" I asked him.

He was afraid of something green in the leaves. It was just a little frog sitting steady on a log.

"It's okay, boy," I said. "He is nice."

Max sniffed the frog and wagged his tail. I was very pleased he didn't bite it. We played until I almost fainted from running so much. Then mom bought us ice cream on the way home.

I went outside to my backyard with my dog Max. Max is a wonderful dog and he likes to sniff everything. We walked carefully near the big bushes by the fence. Suddenly I saw something shiny on a green leaf. It looked like a tiny jewel but it was moving.

"Look at that strange creature, Max!" I said loudly.

Max sniffed it and then he grinned at me. It was a beetle with a bright blue shell. I knew it was special. I tried to pick it up but gravity pulled it down. It fell into the grass and hid.

"It was a pleasure to meet you, bug," I whispered.

Then we went inside so I could read my book about bugs.

One day my dog Spot and I went on an adventure. We walked straight into the woods behind my house. It felt like we were explorers on a science trip. Suddenly, Spot barked and ran behind a big tree.

"Come back here, Spot!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and he disappeared into the bushes. I gripped my stick and followed him. I saw something huge and grey. It looked like a small elephant, but it was just a big rock. Spot was sniffing a weird bird that screeched at him.

"Leave it alone, Spot," I said and grasped his collar.

The wind blew hard and a piece of old newspaper dropped near us. It had a picture of a zoo guide on it. We ran home fast. My mom was meeting us at the door. We were cheering because we were safe. Exploring is fun but scary too.

My brother Tom was turning eight today. We hung balloons all over the living room. Mom spread blue icing on his big cake. I was steering my toy car on the ground. Suddenly, our dog Buster appeared and he looked hungry. Buster started roaming around the table and sniffing.

"Get down, Buster!" I yelled really loud.

But Buster gripped the tablecloth with his teeth. He swept the whole cake onto the floor! My heart was beating super fast. Tom started crying when he was seeing the mess. My dad came in but he wasn't swearing. He just sighed.

We ate pizza instead and it was actually great.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for the secret cave. Suddenly we heard a loud stamping noise. It was a giant bear!

We sprinted away very fast. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. We saw a wooden sign that pointed left. We turned and jumped over a big log.

"I have a feeling we are lost," said Sam.

Then I gave him a thumbs up because I saw the cave. We ran inside and we were safe. We landed on the soft dirt floor. It took all our strength to get there. The quest was finally complete.

I met a green alien named Zog in my backyard. He was floating above the grass and he looked very funny. I was hanging upside down on my monkey bars when he appeared.

"Hello earth boy," spoke Zog with a weird robot voice.

I was scared but then he started jumping around happily. He pulled out a bag of space marshmallows. We roasted them with his laser finger and they tasted incredible.

I nodded and ate five of them really fast. Suddenly I started floating too and gradually went up into the sky! It was the best day ever.

We went to the big woods behind my house. My dog Max walked with us and smelled everything. We were looking for a secret fort. Suddenly, Max started barking very loud at a bush.

Then something big jumped out and ran fast. I screamed because I was scared. My leg got twisted on a root and I fell. I was trembling on the ground. It was just a big fat raccoon!

"Did you see that huge monster?" my friend Sam asked.

We laughed and realized it was funny. Max wanted to chase it again but I grabbed him. We didn't complain and walked home happy.

I woke up because my bed was shaking hard. My robot dog Sparky was jumping on my legs again. He had a metal tail that was thumping loudly.

"Stop it Sparky!" I yelled and he barked a beep.

I looked outside and saw something super weird. It was raining green slime from the sky today. My dad said that was impossible but it was happening. I gripped my laser sword and ran to the door.

A giant purple alien was standing on our grass. He was breathing heavy smoke out of his big nose.

"Give me the treasure or I will slime you," he growled.

I grinned and turned on my glowing blue sword.

"You can try to take it!" I shouted back.

I wrote a note to Mom later that said I saved Earth.

My friend Sam and I built a rocket ship. It was made of cardboard boxes and old blankets. We climbed inside the dark fort and Sam started steering.

"Watch out for the alien planet!" I screamed loudly.

Sam started pushing buttons on his old toy computer. The rocket flew fast through the stars in our imagination. Suddenly we heard a weird noise outside the box.

"Something is approaching us," Sam whispered and looked scared.

I heard a scratching sound on the cardboard wall. It grew louder like a giant monster was hungry. My heart was pumping so fast in my chest. We jumped out and saw a tiny black beetle. It was just crawling on the floor and groaning. We laughed because we thought it was a space monster. The beetle scratched its leg and flew away.

I was wearing my spy gear and looking for treasure. My best friend Sam was with me in the spooky woods. We saw a weird sign on an old tree. It pointed to a dark cave that looked scary.

"We have to go in," Sam said bravely.

"It looks impossible to climb that rock," I said back.

We tried anyway and I bounced off the wall once. My brain hurt from thinking so hard about the path. Inside the cave, we found a big box with a juice stain. It was the most important thing we ever found! We opened it and saw everything we wanted inside. We didn't learn a lesson but it was super fun. We stayed for an hour until it got dark.

I was sitting in math class and I looked at the clock. It was almost lunchtime and my stomach was moaning loudly. Finally the bell rang and I jumped up fast. I ran to the cafeteria with my friend Sam. We got our trays and the lunch lady gave us stewed tomatoes.

"Yuck, this looks like a red stain," Sam said.

I touched it with my fork and it looked gross. Suddenly I had a great idea. I pretended my fork was a brave knight approaching a castle. The tomatoes were a scary mountain of lava. My knight flew over the lava and saved the kingdom!

"Stop playing with your food!" my teacher yelled.

Everyone started cheering for me but I felt like a failure. I ate fourteen bites of the tomatoes anyway. They were actually pretty good.

My friends and I went into the dark woods today. We knew there was a secret castle hidden deep inside. Max drew a map on a piece of old paper. We walked for a long time and the sun went down.

"Look at that light!" shouted Sam.

We saw a glowing blue rock floating in the air. It looked impossible but it was real. We gradually got closer to the magic stone. Suddenly a big owl flew right at our heads! We ducked and ran fast to the castle door.

"We did it," I said and grinned at Max.

The door was opening and it felt like a game loading. Our mission was finally complete so we sent a signal. It was the best adventure ever.

One day my nephew Timmy and I woke up early. We wanted to climb the big hill behind my house. It looked like a giant mountain to us. We packed snacks and walked outside. Suddenly, a weird cat bounced out of the bushes. It looked foreign and strange.

"Is that a ghost cat?" Timmy screamed.

"I don't know," I said. "Neither do I," said Timmy.

The cat sat on a rock and stared at us. It looked like it escaped from a zoo. We were scared but we kept walking. We found a small cave near the top. It smelled like someone brewed old tea in there. We saw a sign bearing a scary face. We ran all the way home fast. We never saw the ghost cat again.

I was walking home and I heard a thumping sound. It was coming from the woods so I ran over there. I saw a huge metal robot sitting on a stump. He looked sad and he was groaning a lot.

"What is wrong with you?" I yelled at him.

The robot looked at me and cleared his throat loudly. "I am freezing cold and I lost my spaceship," he said.

I realized he was lost and yearning for his home. I gave him my coat but the weight was heavy. We started walking and we found his ship in a field. He was the champion of hide and seek! We had a quick meeting before he left.

Then he flew away into the stars.

One day me and my best friend Sam went exploring. We wanted to see the cool scenery in the woods. Sam likes science and he brought his notebook to write stuff down. We walked for a long time and saw a big cave.

It was dark and scary and neither of us saw the bat. Suddenly a bat flew right at my head! I screamed loud. We ran out fast and saw a bear approaching us. We climbed a tree and waited until he left. We were super hungry so we went home. My mom made roasted chicken and stewed carrots for dinner. We didn't want to go back there either.

My brother and I started playing the racing game on Saturday. I picked the blue car and he picked the red one. The race was longer than I thought it would be. I grasped the controller really hard because I wanted to win.

I won the race and did a happy dance. My grounding was finally over so playing games felt super good.

My dog Max and I went on a wonderful adventure today. We walked straight to the park near the big lake. Max started running around and barking at a squirrel. He climbed up a hill and I ran after him.

We found a tiny island in the middle of a puddle. Max jumped right onto it and got very muddy. I was groaning because now he needed a bath.

We made fourteen big cookies and put them in the oven. The smell grew stronger and smelled so good. We toasted marshmallows too while we waited. When the timer rang, my mom gave me a big squeeze. We ate them all before bedtime approaching fast.

I sat on the couch with my big brother Sam. We were playing a really cool racing game. My car was red and his car was green. I drove carefully around the corners but he drove too fast.

Sam laughed and chewed his gum really loud. Then his car flew off the track and exploded. I was winning and my heart was jumping fast. I crossed the finish line and I won the race!

I was very pleased with myself. It was different because usually Sam wins every time. He is teaching me how to play better. Next time we play, I am going to win again.

One day my friend Tim and I found an old boat. It looked like a pirate ship with a cool design. We jumped inside and I started steering the wheel.

Suddenly a big breeze pushed us away from the shore. We were going too fast and I was afraid. The water was dumping into the boat very quickly.

We touched the cold water and swam hard. It was scary but we were strong enough. We made it to the sand and found a shell like a comb. Next time we will stay on the dry land.

My dog Spot ran outside and was bumping into everything. He ran to the fountain in the park and drank lots of water. The sun was hot and it scorched the grass. My mom told me to bring him back inside. She is bringing his special leather leash to catch him.

It was a boring Wednesday at school. Mrs. Miller gave us math homework and I grumbled. I hate math because numbers are tricky. But then the bell rang for recess and we ran outside.

I looked up at the ceiling and heard a strange whistle. A big robot crashed right through the roof! It was February, so the air felt super cold. The robot had green lights pumping on its chest.

I was scared and almost fainted right there. My cat Fluffy hissed but neither of us moved. It seemed impossible, but then the robot started to float.

I crossed my fingers behind my back and made a wish. Suddenly, my hands started glowing bright blue with magic power! I blasted the robot and it flew back into space. Being a superhero is awesome.

I was playing my new racing game called "Danger Drive." My heart was pumping fast because I was in first place. My friend Sam was sitting next to me and he looked mad. He built a super fast car, but I was winning.

I went outside to play with my dog Rex. We live in a big apartment building with a small park. Rex is a very fast runner and likes to chase balls. I threw the ball and he ran like a champion. He ran into the bushes and started stamping his feet.

I pushed open the big blue door to Mrs. Miller's classroom. Everyone was already sitting down and taking out their yellow notebooks. I pulled my chair out carefully and sat next to my friend Jake.

At the water fountain, a girl named Sarah sang a funny song. Then I saw a beautiful red rose growing by the fence. It was a good day because I didn't have any homework.

It was my birthday sleepover and it was freezing outside. My friends and I wanted to make a scary scene in the backyard. We put up a big sign that said BEWARE OF THE DOG. My dad helped us with the heavy weight of the wood.

My friends came over for a big sleepover. We played video games for an hour. Then we went to the kitchen for snacks. My mom toasted some bread and it smelled like heaven.

We ran away groaning because the bug touched our snacks. We pretended we were invisible science spies in foreign lands. It was a beautiful night. Then we heard a noise.

We went to sleep but we were still hungry.

My friend Sam and I found a map leading to a castle. It looked scary though. We chose to go inside anyway. We walked for a long time. My heart was pumping fast.

My younger brother Sam and I found a cave. It looked like a foreign land inside. Bats were roaming on the high ceiling.

I woke up early because I heard a loud moaning sound. It was coming from my closet so I grabbed my bat. A green alien was floating in the air. He had a big brain and he looked lost.

He chewed on my math homework and then he spit it out. He threw a ball of slime and it crushed my lamp. I thought he was mean but he was just hungry.

He wrote a magic symbol in the air. Suddenly my lamp was fixed. I am earning a new friend today!

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We decided to build a huge jungle fort in the living room. We brought all the pillows from my mom's bed.

We spread the blankets over two chairs and the couch. Then Sam accidentally crushed my favorite box of crackers.

We talked a little longer and I felt happy in my vein. Sam is my best friend.

It was my birthday and I had a big sleepover. My friends came over and we ate lots of pizza. We climbed up the stairs to my room and played games. Then my dad came in sounding very scary like a ghost. He touched my shoulder and I screamed really loud!

"It is just me!" he said and laughed.

My mom came in too and she was holding a cake.

We blew out the candles and everyone started cheering. I guarantee it was the best party ever. Later we were all sleeping in our sleeping bags on the floor. It was super fun.

I was sitting in math class and feeling weird. My nose tickled a lot and I feared a sneeze was coming. Mrs. Jones was writing numbers on the board.

"What is five plus ten?" she asked the class.

I raised my hand but then trouble brewed. I let out a huge sneeze and it sounded like a screeched tire! Everyone looked at me and my face grew red like a scorched tomato. I thought I was going to cry.

"Bless you, Timmy," said my friend Sarah.

I didn't have a tissue either so I used my sleeve. The germs probably spread everywhere. I crossed my fingers that nobody saw the snot. Recess was next and I just wanted to run away fast.

I was playing my new video game for an hour. It is a game where you design a cool castle. I taught my little brother how to play it too. He followed me around the map and we fought big monsters.

Suddenly I heard a loud beep sound from the TV. The screen turned black and I was scared.

"What happened to the game?" my brother asked me.

"Maybe the aliens on earth broke it," I said.

We looked outside but it was just the power. My dad fixed it fast and we played again. We built the biggest castle ever. We were the best team.

One day I went exploring in my backyard. It was a beautiful sunny day for seeing nature. I chose to go near the big oak tree. Suddenly, a blue bird appeared and flew very fast. It landed on a branch and looked at me. It was guarding a small nest. Then my dog Sparky ran over barking.

"Be quiet Sparky!" I yelled loudly. "You are scaring the bird."

The bird flew away because it was scared. I saw a squirrel sleeping on the grass nearby. Sparky stole a stick and ran around fast. He threw the stick in the air with his mouth. His tongue was hanging out and he looked funny. I wanted to maintain a secret spot. I pretended I was invisible so the animals stayed close. It was certain to be the best day ever.

My friend Max and I wanted a big adventure. We trained for weeks in my backyard. We packed snacks and flashlights. Max grinned and said, "We are ready for anything!"

We walked a league into the dark woods. Suddenly, we heard a loud noise. Something crashed in the bushes nearby! It sounded like a foreign monster. My eyes closed tight because I was scared. Max was brave enough to look.

A small alien greeted us with a beep. It was not scary at all! Max looked at me and laughed. "It is impossible that aliens are real!" he shouted. We did not know what to do next. We decided to take him home for dinner.

It was almost my birthday in February. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover adventure. We jumped on my bed and scratched my dog’s ears. Suddenly my mom came in and she looked mad. 

"Who moved my favorite comb?" she asked us.

"We didn't touch it!" Sam shouted while keeping his fingers crossed. 

We neared the kitchen and I smelled something bad. It smelled like scorched popcorn! My dad was swearing because he burned our snack. 

"I think I’m getting pneumonia from this smoke," I joked.

Then my mom found her comb under the couch. We started cheering because we were not in trouble. We ate the burnt popcorn anyway and stayed up super late. It was the best night ever.

It was my birthday last Wednesday and I turned eight. My mom made a big chocolate cake for everyone to eat. We had the party in the backyard with my friends. We played tag and then we wanted to eat the cake. But when we went to the table, the cake was gone!

"Where did the cake go?" asked my friend Sam.

We searched under the table and behind the chairs. Then I realized my dog Buster had chocolate on his nose. He was supposed to guard the cake but he ate it! It was impossible to be mad at him because he looked funny.

"Bad dog, Buster!" I said, but I laughed anyway.

My dad went to the store and got ice cream instead. We seized the spoons and ate it all very fast. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my neighbor Sam went exploring in the woods. We saw a big tree and Sam started jumping up. He grabbed a branch and was clinging on tight. Suddenly the branch shook and cracked!

"Help! I can't hold my own weight!" Sam called loudly.

I sprinted over and used all my strength to grab him. I pushed him up before he fell. It was really dangerous because the ground had sharp rocks.

"Thanks for saving me," Sam said. "I don't want pneumonia from lying on the cold ground."

We met a squirrel on the way home. It looked like it was dancing on the green ceiling of leaves. We decided to go back tomorrow but stay on the ground.

I was climbing the big oak tree in my backyard. I reached a high branch and looked at the ground. It looked so far away! Suddenly, I saw a squirrel sitting there. He chewed on a tiny crumb of bread.

"Hello little squirrel," I whispered to him.

He looked at me and didn't run away. This was incredible! I slowly broke off a piece of my sandwich. I held it out with my thumb and finger. The squirrel came closer gradually. He took the food and looked very pleased. I felt like I was bungee jumping inside because I was so excited.

"You are my best friend now," I said.

I especially liked his fluffy tail. We sat there until a storm brewed in the sky. Then I climbed down fast. It was the best day ever.

Me and my brother Max went camping in the big woods. We wanted to find treasure in the green meadow. Max was jumping over logs and I ran fast. Suddenly, we found a big rock that looked scorched by fire.

"Look at that scary black rock!" I screamed.

Max turned around and looked at the ground. There was a big snake near the rock.

"Watch out for danger!" Max screamed.

We ran back to our tent very fast. We hung our wet coats on a tree. It was important to be safe. We didn't find treasure, but we saw a cool snake. Next time we will bring a stick. Exploring is fun but sometimes scary.

We were playing the biggest kickball game ever at recess. My team had eight points and the other team had seven. It was my turn to kick and I was super nervous.

"You can do it, Tommy!" my friend Sam shouted loudly.

The pitcher neared the mound and looked very mean. He threw the red ball fast and it bounced high. I jumped up and kicked it with all my might. The ball went over the fence near the nature trail!

"Run, run, run!" everyone yelled at me.

I ran past first base and stuck my tongue out. I closed my eyes and ran to home plate. We won the game and everyone shook my hand. I felt like I climbed a giant mountain. I put the winning ball in my pocket like a receipt.

I was so thrilled about my new pet beetle. His name is Bob and he is very shiny. I brought him to school in a glass jar. I knew it was risky but I wanted to show Tim. At recess, I took Bob out on the grass. He crawled fast.

"Look at him go!" Tim yelled.

Suddenly, a big dog ran onto the playground. It was not trained very well. The dog sniffed Bob and then gave a huge sneeze. Bob flew into the air! I was scared the dog would eat him.

"Oh no!" I shouted. "Grab him, Tim!"

The dog chewed on a stick instead. We found Bob near the slide. My teacher came over early and looked mad. She heard someone swearing near the swings, but it wasn't us. We put Bob back in the jar safe and sound.

Me and my neighbor Tim went to the jungle behind my house. We were looking for the lost magic jewel. It was very important. Suddenly we saw a big snake in a tree. It looked like danger! I was so scared. The snake started jumping down at us.

"Run away fast!" yelled Tim.

We ran but the snake was fast. I threw a rock at it. The rock hit the tree and made a loud noise. It was a crazy scene. We found a cave and hid inside.

"Listen, do you hear that?" I asked Tim.

We heard hissing outside. We used a big leaf to wrap up our snacks. Then we escaped out the back. We ran home and told Tim’s daughter about our adventure. It was past eight o'clock so we had to sleep.

I went to the fair with my best friend Sam. We ran through the gate and saw all the rides. The big roller coaster was scary but we wanted to go. We were approaching the line and it was super long.

"Are you scared?" Sam asked me while we waited.

"No way, I love gravity!" I said back to him.

We were loading into the car and the bar came down. The car went up gradually and the scenery looked tiny. Then we dropped down fast and everyone was screaming! The wind struck my face and we were swinging around corners. It felt like we were flying but much faster. We got off and my legs were shaking a little. I want to go on it for longer next time!

It was freezing outside but we didn't care. My soccer team ran straight onto the field. We played against the Tigers and they looked tough. Their uniforms were blue like a shiny jewel.

"Pass the ball to me!" my friend Sam yelled.

I kicked it but the goalie stopped it. It seemed impossible to score. Gradually we got closer to the goal though. I saw a beautiful opening. I used my brain and kicked it hard. The ball went past the goalie and hit the net!

"We won the game!" everyone shouted while cheering.

Our coach greeted us with snacks near the water fountain. It was a complete victory. We drew pictures of the game later. It was the best day ever.

It was a pleasant Tuesday and school was okay. I had eight problems to do for math homework. My friend Tommy was roaming around the room. He grabbed a piece of red thread from the art bin.

"Look at this," Tommy said and held it up. "It looks like a long worm."

I laughed because Tommy is always weird. The teacher said to sit down so we did. Then it was time for recess outside. We played tag and I was the greatest runner. I knew I was fast. Then I saw something shiny in the grass. It was a fake jewel from a plastic crown.

"Can I keep it?" asked Sarah.

I gave it to her and we ran back inside. It was a good day.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We walked for an hour and then we saw a big cave. It looked scary but we moved closer to peek inside.

Suddenly we heard a loud moaning sound coming from the dark.

"I think we should run away now!" yelled Sam loudly.

"No, we have to seize the treasure first," I said back.

We remembered the map and looked at the compass needle. It pointed straight so we kept walking for eight more steps. We saw a glowing box keeping guard by a sleeping dragon! The dragon had a long tongue hanging out. We were quiet like our teacher was coaching us. We grabbed the box and ran fast to our treehouse. We often go on adventures but this was the best one in the whole league!

Max and I went into the dark woods to search for treasure. We had a map but the rain almost crushed it.

"We have to complete the quest!" shouted Max loudly.

We pushed through the big bushes and saw a huge cave. It looked impossible to climb but we tried anyway. I remembered my dad said to be brave. We climbed up the rocks and found a gold box waiting there.

Suddenly a bear roared and we got scared. We sprinted back home very fast.

"We can try again tomorrow," I said to Max.

We are earning money for a new bike. It was the best adventure ever.

One day me and my friend Sam went boating. We were looking for pirate gold on the island. I was steering the boat and Sam was looking. Suddenly we hit the rocky ground hard.

"Oh no, the boat is broken!" shouted Sam.

We jumped out and started running fast. We were hungry though so we ate some apples. We kept walking and gradually got closer to a cave. It was dark inside and we heard a sounding noise.

"Is that a bear approaching?" I asked scared.

It was just a tiny bat meeting its friends. We found the gold and ran back home. Everyone was happy we were safe and not in the hospital.

My birthday started weird from the very beginning. I thought my mom brewed hot chocolate, but it was just coffee. I hate coffee! Then my dog Buster tried to gnaw on my new shoe.

"Stop it, Buster!" I yelled at him.

He dropped the shoe and wagged his tail fast. My best friend Sam came over later for a sleepover. We drew pictures of monsters and ate pizza.

"Let's seize the castle!" Sam shouted and jumped on my bed.

We played until we were super tired. To be honest, it was the best day ever. I can't wait for tomorrow because we are going to the park. I am glad this happened.

My friends and I went into the spooky old house. We saw a big painting of a sailor on the wall. The sailor looked sad and he was holding a map. Suddenly, we heard a loud noise upstairs.

"Did you hear that?" shouted Ben.

"I think it is a ghost!" I whispered back.

We walked up the stairs slowly and kept following the noise. We went into a room and a vase crashed down. A cat jumped out and landed on my foot! It wasn't a ghost though. We found an old box that belonged to a colonel.

"Look at this wonderful treasure," Ben said.

We opened it and saw gold coins inside. Gradually we realized the meaning of the map. It was teaching us where to find the secret league of pirates. We used a blanket to wrap up the gold and ran home fast.

I sat at my desk and looked at the schedule. It was time for lunch and I was so hungry. I grabbed my bag and flew down the hall. I sat next to my best friend Sam. He had a weird stain on his shirt.

"What is that orange spot?" I asked him.

"I dropped my juice box," Sam said sadly.

I opened my lunchbox but my sandwich was gone. I knew I packed it this morning. I started to search through my bag. My chips were scattered everywhere. Then I saw a giant beetle near my apple! I screamed and jumped up to my full height. The beetle crawled away fast. I thought someone took my food, but it was just hidden. I am keeping my lunchbox closed tight tomorrow.

It was a beautiful day for recess and everyone ran outside. The weather was hot but we didn't care. I was the captain of the tag team. We had thirteen kids playing and it was super fun. Then Tommy started climbing the big red slide the wrong way.

"Hey, get down from there!" I yelled at him.

Tommy didn't listen and he looked a little scared. He scratched his arm on the metal part. Then the bell rang for science class. We learned about a baby lamb and it was cute. I didn't know enough answers on the quiz though. After school, I watched a video about bungee jumping. I am certain that I want to try it when I turn fourteen.

My birthday party was on Saturday and everyone came over. I wanted to receive a cool video game for my present. My grandma handed me a big box and I smiled. I opened it fast but I was wearing a frown. It was a brown leather jacket and it looked very old.

"Do you like it?" Grandma asked me with a smile.

"I love it!" I lied because I did not want anger.

I pulled it on but neither arm fit in the sleeves. Suddenly my brother screamed because he saw a bug on it. I feared it was a spider but it was just fuzz. My mom got a knife to cut the tag off. I wished for a game but got clothes instead. It is stronger than my old coat so I wear it often.

I was dreaming about a magic forest. But my dog Rex licked my thumb and I woke up. It was a sunny Saturday morning.

"Come on Rex, let's go outside," I said.

We ran to the park and I saw a big tree. It looked like a castle made of leaves. Rex sprinted to the tree and barked. I reached up and grabbed a low branch.

"Look, a squirrel is hiding there!" I shouted.

The squirrel jumped away instead of staying. We played tag in the grass until I was tired. It was a wonderful day. We walked home and I closed my eyes. This was just the beginning of our fun weekend.

My schedule said it was time for recess. I started running to the playground leading the whole class. We wanted to search for the best swing. As we neared the swings, I heard loud thumping. It was big Jake running fast behind us!

"Hey, save a swing for me!" Jake shouted.

I screamed because he was getting really close. We were bumping into each other and scrambled to the seats. I got there first and sat down fast. The bell rang way too soon. We were leaving the playground sad but I won the race.

"Next time I will be faster," Jake said.

School is fun but recess is too short.

It was my birthday and I was yearning for a puppy. We live in a small apartment so my mom said no dogs allowed. I felt sad but then my neighbor knocked on the door. He was stamping his feet because it was cold outside. "Happy birthday!" he shouted and was cheering loudly. My mom opened the door and a cool breeze came in. He was holding a leash with a chain on it. I got scared but then I saw the scenery behind him. A tiny dog was bumping into his leg. "This is Captain," my neighbor said. "He needs a friend." I wanted to seize the leash right away. I am the happiest boy on earth.

I was in my room doing a science experiment. I wanted to build a robot but it went wrong. My robot had scissors for hands and a chain for a tail. I brewed a green potion and poured it on him. Suddenly the robot blew smoke out of his ears! He stood up and looked very scary. I was scared but then he started to dance.

"Do you want to play?" asked the robot.

"Yes please!" I yelled and we danced together.

My mom came in and she thought it was a costume.

"What a cool knight suit," she said.

The robot beeped happy sounds and we were best friends forever.

It was my birthday and I was so happy. I walked into the kitchen and saw my friends. They greeted me with a big loud shout. My mom had balloons surrounding the whole table.

"Happy Birthday, Tim!" screamed my best friend Max.

We ate pizza and then my dog started roaming around. He grabbed a slice and chewed it fast. Mom was moaning about the mess but she laughed too. Then it was time for the cake. I blew out the candles and made a wish.

"Can I cut the cake?" asked my sister.

She used the scissors by mistake but we stopped her. A piece of cake landed on my new blue sweater. I was pleased anyway because it tasted really good. We played games throughout the whole afternoon.

My brother Tom and I found a secret cave. We walked inside and it grew very dark. Tom grabbed his flashlight and I followed him deep down. Suddenly a big wind blew my hat off!

"It is impossible to see in here!" I yelled.

We saw a giant metal door with a weird computer on it. Tom started coaching me on how to open it. I typed in fourteen numbers and the door opened. Inside was a huge dragon that looked angry! It roared and fire struck the wall near us. We smelled roasted marshmallows but we were scared.

"Start running or we will be eaten!" Tom screamed.

We ran back to the steering wheel of our go-kart. We crossed the bridge and escaped the dragon's reign forever. We were not screaming anymore, but we were safe. We didn't want to go back there either.

I was playing my favorite computer game on Saturday. It was the biggest game of the whole league. My best friend Sam was on my team. We were surrounding the bad guys base. Suddenly my screen froze and I got scared. 

"Oh no, my game is broken!" I screeched loudly. 

Sam yelled back, "Don't quit now, we need you!"

I hit the side of the computer and it worked. I sent my character running fast toward the goal. I felt a huge weight off my shoulders. I crashed right into the enemy king. We won the game and I was so thrilled throughout the day. I even scratched my head because I was so surprised. It was the most important win ever.

It was raining outside so we had indoor recess. I looked at my sandwich and saw a big jelly stain. I simply ate the crust instead. My friend Sarah bounced a ball near my desk.

"Hey, watch out for my project!" I yelled.

"Sorry, I thought you were done," Sarah said.
