I was building a huge castle with blocks. It was growing very tall. I believed it was the best castle ever. Then our teacher Mrs. Green started coaching us on math. We had to complete a worksheet. She treated us to stickers when we finished. I grinned because I got a sticker with a fluffy lamb on it. School is fun but I like recess better.

My family went boating to a small island for my birthday. I wore my favorite blue sweater because it was cold. My dad told me to help set up the tent. We spread out the sleeping bags and looked for firewood.

"Can we roast the marshmallows now?" I asked my mom.

"First we need to find some dry sticks," she said.

We went on a search for sticks near the water. I saw something floating and I crawled over to see it. It was just an old piece of leather. Later, my dad taught me how to cook a lamb chop on the fire. I scorched it a little bit but it still tasted good. Then my sister used scissors to open the marshmallow bag. We ate them all night under the stars. It was the best birthday ever!

My family went on a holiday to a big park. We saw a huge mountain covered in white snow. My dad said we needed training to climb it.

"I bet I can climb that mountain!" I shouted.

"We don't have enough rope," said my mom.

The weather was sunny but the wind was stinging my face. We walked on a trail and looked at the scenery. Suddenly my brother threw a snowball right at my back! I chased him and I almost won the race. We saw a place where people did bungee jumping. I feared looking down but it looked fun too. We ate sandwiches and then we drove home tired.

Me and my nephew Jack went to the spooky forest today. We were looking for pirate gold. I had an old leather map, and Jack had a flashlight.

"This is scary," Jack grumbled.

"Don't worry, Colonel Jack," I said. "We are brave."

We walked straight for a long time. Suddenly, I discovered a big hole. It was lit by glowing mushrooms. We dropped a stone in, but we heard nothing. Then a giant rat chewed on my shoe!

"Run!" I yelled.

I was steering us away, but I tripped on a root. A sharp needle from a pine tree poked me. We ran home fast. We understood the reason pirates hide gold there. It is too dangerous!

It was raining outside so we rode our bikes to the arcade. My best friend Sam wanted to win a special jewel in the claw game. I was certain he would lose because claw games are hard. He put his quarter in carefully and we started breathing fast.

"Move it left!" I yelled. "Just squeeze the button now!"

Sam pushed the button and the claw dropped down. It was trembling as it grabbed the prize. We watched the claw pull up the blue jewel. Then it moved over the hole and started dumping the prize out. We were thrilled when we found it in the slot! We simply couldn't believe it.

"I am going to call the newspaper!" Sam said.

We walked home happy. It was like pulling a thread and winning the whole shirt.

My friends and I built a secret fort in the woods. It was dark and we heard a scary moaning sound.

"What is that noise?" asked my friend Billy.

I was not certain but I was very brave. We followed the sound past the old colonel’s house. Suddenly something came swinging out of the trees! It was a stinging bee and it chased us. My tongue felt dry and my legs grew tired.

"Run back to the fort!" yelled Sarah loudly.

We ran fast and closed the door tight. We ate toasted bread and looked at a painting on the wall. Billy said he needed caffeine but he just drank juice. We were safe inside our fort.

I was sitting in class and it was boring. Mrs. Miller was speaking about math but I didn't listen. I drew a picture of a sailor on my paper. Suddenly my pencil disappeared under my desk! I was afraid to look but I did.

"Hey, give that back!" I said.

My friend Tommy grabbed it and laughed. We fought over the pencil until Mrs. Miller saw us. She froze and looked very mad.

"Who is making that screaming noise?" she asked us.

It wasn't pleasant. I did not receive a gold star that day. Then lunch happened and gravity made my milk spill everywhere. I didn't use scissors for art either. It was a bad day. Next time I will just do my work.

It was the greatest Wednesday ever because we had gym. We played rock paper scissors but it was a race. My heart was pumping super fast when it was my turn. I ran to the middle and met Tommy there.

"Rock paper scissors shoot!" I yelled really loud.

I picked rock and Tommy picked scissors so I won. I was jumping up and down because I was so happy. Then I ran to the next hoop and crossed the line. But then I tripped and crawled to the finish. I grabbed the beanbag first so my team won the game. After school I went home and ate some roasted chicken. It was the best day.

My brother Tim turned eight today. It was raining outside, but we didn't care. We played pirate ship in the living room. Tim was the captain and I was the sailor. We crashed our ship into the sofa island.

"Be careful or you will get in trouble!" Mom yelled.

We stopped jumping, but we were already having fun. Mom made a cake that tasted like heaven. It had blue frosting like a giant vein of sugar.

"This is the most important day ever," Tim said.

Even though we couldn't go outside, it was a great party. We reached for more cake and watched a movie. I know Tim liked his present especially because it was a new bike. I hope the rain stops so he can ride it tomorrow.

My dog Max and I went exploring in the woods today. We heard something moving in the bushes.

"What is that?" I whispered to Max.

Max started stamping his feet and twisted his head sideways. A squirrel ran up a tree with a nut. It looked like a shiny brown jewel.

"Let's catch it!" I yelled and we ran fast.

We found a big rock with a blue line like a vein. It looked like a map so I drew on it. We pretended we were in a foreign land. Suddenly we heard footsteps approaching us. It was just my dad greeting us.

"Are you yearning for dinner?" Dad asked.

We smelled roasted chicken and our stomachs growled. We ran home feeling our strength growing. I like exploring but I like eating more.

It was my birthday and I woke up super early. The sun was coming through my window and it was bright. I ran downstairs and saw my mom in the kitchen. She cleared the table and put down a big box.

"Is this for me?" I asked with a happy feeling.

"Open it and see," she said with a smile.

I ripped the paper and touched something soft inside. It was a new puppy! He was small but he had a lot of strength. He jumped right out and ran outside into the breeze. I thought he was running away! But he just wanted to play tag. We played all day until I was tired. Best birthday ever.

I went to the jungle with my friend Sam. We called it the Green Zone. We walked through big trees and tall grass. Suddenly we saw a monkey jumping high.

"Look at him swinging!" yelled Sam.

The monkey grabbed a thin thread from a spider. I feared it would break. Then a big tiger jumped out. I pulled out my plastic knife toy. The tiger crashed into a bush and ran away. We were safe.

"That was scary but cool," I said.

We found a treasure chest behind a rock. It looked like an old computer box. To be honest, it was just empty. But we still felt like we won the game.

We were walking in the dark forest for a long time. My friend Sam had a map but the weather was bad. It was raining hard and the map got wet.

"Which way do we go now?" asked Sam.

I looked at the scary trees surrounding us. We chose the path on the right. Suddenly a giant bear jumped out! I screamed very loud and Sam threw a rock. The bear tried to gnaw on my shoe but I pulled it away. I drew my wooden sword quickly because I trained for this. The bear crushed a bush and ran at us.

"Run away fast!" I yelled to Sam.

We escaped into a small cave and the bear disappeared. We ate a crumb of bread and felt safe. We won the fight and we will learn to be more careful next time.

I woke up early because I was so afraid of school today. We had a big test about a special island and I did not study enough. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. I ate my toast and chewed really fast. Then I walked straight to the bus stop.

When the bus neared the school, I saw my friend Sam. He was holding a crumpled newspaper for show-and-tell.

"Did you study for the test?" I asked him.

"No way, I was playing video games all night," Sam said.

We walked past the crossing guard and into the class. I was pumping my legs fast to get to my desk. The teacher looked at us and smiled. She said the test was next week! I was so happy. Now I can just play at recess.

I was hanging upside down on the monkey bars at recess. The sun was hot and I felt like a piece of toasted bread. My friend Billy ran over to me and he looked scared. He was trembling a little bit.

"You need to come down right now," Billy said fast.

"Why is it dangerous?" I asked him.

Billy pointed to the school door. Mrs. Green was standing there with a red face. I felt a little bit of anger coming from her. I knew I was caught. I didn't finish my math homework and she looked mad.

"Oh no," I said, groaning loudly.

I jumped down and we walked to the door. It was no pleasure to see the teacher. She spoke to me with a serious voice.

"I don't understand where your homework is," she said.

It struck me that I left it on the bus. I met her eyes and said sorry. It was a bad day.

One day I was walking in the big woods. My dog Buster was with me and he loves sniffing. Suddenly a big buzzing sound appeared near a bush. Buster ran over to see but I felt scared.

"Stop Buster!" I yelled really loud. "There is danger!"

It was a giant hive of bees and they looked mad. Buster barked at them and I knew this was important. I reached for his collar and pulled him back fast. We ran away before any stinging happened. We escaped just in time and ran all the way home.

"That was incredible," I said to Buster.

He just wagged his tail and licked my face. We are safe now but we won't go back there.

Yesterday my dad drove me to school late. We were waiting in the car line forever. My heart was thumping hard because I forgot my homework. I chewed on my pencil and felt weird.

I walked into class and Mrs. Green was reading a newspaper. She said, "Where is your math, Jimmy?"

I tried to squeeze my eyes shut. "I didn't write it," I said quietly.

Then my nose tickled and I let out a giant sneeze! Mrs. Green laughed and gave me a tissue. She told me to write it at recess. It was okay though because I played on the swings after. I held the rusty chain and went super high. Next week we are going camping so I need to know my math fast.

My dog Buster chased a squirrel up the big oak tree. He barked and barked but the squirrel was too fast. Then Buster saw something shiny in the bushes. It was a giant green beetle with long legs.

"Look out Buster!" I yelled.

Buster tried to catch it but he crashed into the fence. The beetle flew away and escaped into the tall grass. Buster started stamping his feet because he was mad. It was impossible to catch that bug.

Suddenly, my cat Fluffy jumped out and trapped the beetle. She screeched happily and I started cheering for her.

"Good job Fluffy," I said.

We played outside until the sun went down. It was the best day ever.

One day I was walking near a big mountain. Suddenly the ground started shaking and sounding like thunder. I saw a giant robot stamping his metal feet. He was bringing a huge bag of space rocks. It was an incredible sight to see.

"Hello robot!" I yelled loudly at him.

The robot stopped and looked down at me. "I am very hungry for oil," he beeped.

I gave him my oil can from my bike. He drank everything inside and started bumping around happily. He was gradually turning a pleasant shade of blue.

"Thank you for understanding the meaning of friendship," he said.

Then he flew away without seeing where he was going. I hope he comes back soon.

We were yearning for an adventure. My friend Leo and I started loading our backpacks with snacks. We walked to the big mountain behind my house. It was scary but we bounced with excitement. We saw a dark cave approaching fast.

"Should we go in?" asked Leo.

"Yes, maybe there is gold!" I said.

Inside it was cold. We touched the wet walls. Suddenly we saw a rusty chain on the ground. It looked very old. We pulled the chain and a secret door opened! We found a shiny rock inside. It felt like earning a big prize. We ran home fast to show my mom.

Yesterday at school was super fun but also a little weird. We had a contest to see who could jump the highest height. I wanted to win, but unfortunately, my legs felt like heavy weights. 

My friend Sam grinned at me and said, "You can do it!"

I tried really hard, and gradually I jumped a little bit longer. I didn't win, but I still felt happy. Later at lunch, I found a single cookie in my box. I had to wrap it up fast before Sam saw it.

"Is that a chocolate chip cookie?" Sam asked me loudly.

I nodded and shared half with him like we were on a desert island. It was the best lunch ever.

My younger brother Sam was in big trouble. We looked inside the scary cave and heard a noise. I told him to remain quiet but he never listens. Suddenly, a giant bear walked out and it looked angry! It roared loudly and Sam tried to explain.

"We just want our ball back, Mr. Bear!" he shouted.

The bear did not like speaking so it roared again with anger. I grabbed Sam's arm and we ran fast instead. We were the greatest runners in the world that day. We didn't get the ball, but at least we got away safely!

My dog Buster is usually brave, but today he was trembling. We were walking in the woods and heard a loud crash.

"What was that?" I screamed. Buster hid behind my legs.

We saw a big raccoon loading acorns into a tree. The raccoon looked like a funny foreign animal because it was so fat. It put too much weight on the branch. Suddenly, the branch crashed down!

Buster ran over and gave the raccoon a big lick with his tongue.

"Stop it, Buster!" I said. "You aren't coaching him on how to climb."

I gave Buster a thumbs up for being nice. We walked home fast because my mom needed her morning caffeine. It was a crazy adventure.

It was recess time and the wind blew really hard. I put on my red sweater because I was cold. My friend Tommy looked at me and yelled, "Let's play tag!"

I started running but then I dropped my hat. The wind was getting stronger and it flew away across the playground. It went high up like it was going to heaven. I felt anger inside me because that was my favorite hat. 

I crawled under the slide to catch it but I missed. Then the bell rang for lunch.

"Did you get it?" Tommy asked me by the door.

"No, it is gone forever," I said sadly. Then I saw my teacher holding my blue hat. I was so happy!

My robot friend Zap scratched his metal head. He was making a weird sounding noise like a broken car. We were in my backyard doing science experiments. Zap pulled a shiny blue jewel from his chest pocket.

"Is this the magic rock?" I asked him.

Zap nodded his head and his eyes glowed green. "Yes, I knew it was here!" he said.

Suddenly, a portal opened right through the air. It looked like a dreaming cloud. I was a little scared but also excited. We stepped into the scene and saw purple aliens. They were having a meeting. One alien looked at me and let out a huge sneeze. It was so loud! I couldn't measure how big the alien ship was. Zap grabbed my hand and we ran back home fast.

My robot nephew was acting weird today. He kept roaming around the kitchen and making loud noises. He chewed on a metal spoon and then he disappeared. I thought he was gone forever but then I saw him. He was invisible but I could see his glowing eyes.

"Why are you invisible?" I asked him immediately.

"I am trapped in a time loop," he grumbled.

He was stuck between yesterday and tomorrow. He started groaning because his battery was low. I struck him with my magic wand to help. It made a loud zap sound like thunder on a mountain. He turned visible again and was happy. I am earning a gold star for fixing him.

My dad took me and my best friend Sam boating for my birthday. We looked at the pretty scenery and the water was very blue. Suddenly my hat dropped into the water and started sinking.

"Oh no, my favorite hat is gone!" I shouted.

Sam was tearing up because he felt bad for me. My dad stopped the boat and used a net. He touched the hat with the net and pulled it out. It was wet but I grinned anyway.

"We saved it just in time," Dad said happily.

Later we went home and I opened a single present. I used scissors to open the box really fast. It was a new video game I was earning money for! We spent the rest of the day jumping on my bed and playing the game. It was the best birthday ever.

One day me and my friend Sam walked into the woods. We saw a big dark cave that looked weird. I thought we should go in but Sam was scared.

"I don't want to go in there," said Sam.

"It will be okay and we can find treasure," I said.

We went inside and it smelled like old cleaning stuff. Suddenly a bat flew out and got caught in my hair! I pulled it out fast and we ran deeper. We found a shiny box in the dirt. We cleared the dirt off and opened it up. It was empty! We didn't find gold either.

"This isn't fun anymore," Sam yelled.

We ran home fast. My mom was teaching my sister math. We didn't tell them about the scary cave.

My team needed to win the big kickball game today. I was the captain, so I felt a lot of weight. The score was tied and the other team was tough. I stood on the base and my legs were trembling. 

"Don't mess this up!" my friend Billy yelled at me.

The pitcher rolled the red ball toward me very fast. I kicked it hard and it flew towards the ceiling! Wait, we were outside, so it just went super high up. The other team ran but nobody caught it. I ran fast and obtained second base easily. 

"Run home! Run home!" I heard everyone scream loudly.

But then I got trapped between second and third base. The other team tagged me out and I fell down. I grumbled because now I was afraid of a grounding from my dad for getting my new pants dirty. We lost, but at least we got water from the fountain after.

I was playing a video game about a magic island. My character was training to fight a big boss. I had to jump up to the ceiling to get points. It was super hard because of the jump height.

"Stop moaning and just win!" yelled my brother Sam.

"I am trying but my hands are trembling!" I said back.

My brain felt tired from playing for so long. I put on my lucky green sweater for power. The boss was approaching me fast. I did a single jump and hit him. I won the game and ended his reign! Then mom called us for cleaning time. That part was not fun at all.

My brother and I went camping in the deep woods. We wanted to find the lost king’s gold crown. Our dad was our guide, and he walked very fast.

We climbed a huge hill with heavy backpacks. The weight was really hard to carry up there. Suddenly, we saw a dark cave.

"I guarantee the gold is inside," said my brother.

We went in, and it was incredible and scary. Then we heard a loud dumping sound of rocks falling! We ran out fast.

"That was too close!" I yelled loudly.

We didn't find the crown from the king's reign. But exploring the cave was especially fun anyway.

My younger brother Sam wanted to play my new video game. It was a racing game about driving super fast cars. I told him it was too dangerous for him. He grumbled and crossed his arms tight.

"I am growing up fast!" Sam yelled at me. "I bet I can beat you."

My neighbor Billy came over to watch us play. Sam picked a red car, and neither of us blinked. The race started and my car rose into the air. Suddenly, I crashed into an invisible wall! Sam zoomed past me clinging to the steering wheel.

"I won!" he screamed. "I sold you out!"

I guess he is not too little after all. Next time I will pick the blue car.

My robot friend Zip was from a foreign planet. We climbed the big mountain behind my house. Zip struggled because his metal feet were heavy. He was groaning with weird beeps and boops.

"Come on Zip, we are almost there!" I yelled.

"It is a pleasure to walk with you," Zip said.

We found a glowing rock at the top. I was thrilled because it looked like magic. Zip started earning points on his screen. The rock was coaching him to fly! He flew throughout the sky like a bird. I did not receive any powers though.

"Look at me go!" Zip shouted down.

He was already way up in the clouds.

My family went boating on a big lake last summer. My dad was the captain and drove the boat fast. We were loading our snacks when I saw something weird. It looked like a white ghost near the trees.

"Did you see that ghost?" I asked my sister.

She laughed and said, "You need to be honest now."

I crossed my arms and looked at the pretty scenery. Suddenly, my dog jumped into the water with a splash! We followed him to the shore, but I was trembling. It was just a white sheet from a science project stuck in a tree. My dad had to maintain the boat while we got the dog. We ate sandwiches and it was the best day ever.

My brother Tom taught me how to find the secret cave. We walked for an hour in the woods. I was bringing the snacks and Tom had the map.

"Are we there yet?" I grumbled because my legs hurt.

"Almost," Tom called back. "It's past the big rock."

Suddenly, we saw a huge hole in the ground. It looked scary and deep. Tom threw a stone down and we waited. We never heard it hit the bottom! It felt like gravity pulled us closer.

"We need a bungee cord to go down there!" I screamed.

Something big flew out of the dark hole. It meant we had to run fast. I will write about this in my diary later. We ran all the way home and were safe.

We were playing kickball at recess and it was my turn. The field was just plain grass but it looked beautiful today. I knew I had to kick it super far. The pitcher threw the red ball right at me. I swung my leg and my foot landed perfectly on the ball.

"Run fast!" yelled my friend Sam from the side.

I ran to first base and then I spread my arms out. I felt like I was flying or maybe boating on water. But then the ball got trapped under a bench. The other team started groaning because they couldn't reach it.

"That counted as a home run!" I shouted happily.

I thought we were going to lose but things were different now. It was like painting a perfect picture. My team cheered when I opened my snack later because we won.

Max and I walked deep into the dark woods. We were looking for a secret cave. A cool breeze blew and the leaves moved. We heard a loud groaning sound from a hole. I was afraid but Max turned on his flashlight. We jumped down like we were doing a bungee jump!

Suddenly we saw a ghost floating in the air. He was blue and he greeted us nicely.

"Do not be scared," the ghost said softly.

"We just want to learn about the cave," I said.

The ghost smiled and gradually disappeared into the earth. We found a gold coin where he had been. We decided to remain friends forever. It was the best adventure ever!

My neighbor Tim came over to play basketball yesterday. We were in the driveway and the heat was surrounding us. I dribbled the ball straight to the hoop. Tim tried to block me but I was too fast.

"You can't stop me!" I yelled loud.

He started stamping his feet and made a thumping sound. Then he stole the ball right from my hands! He is bigger than me and lifts weights. He says he drinks protein shakes every single morning.

"I win again!" Tim shouted and threw the ball.

It went way over the fence into the left yard. We saw a big dog roaming around over there. We ran up to my balcony to hide. Maybe we will go boating tomorrow instead.

My dad is a brave sailor and he loves adventures. One day we went on a big boat to find treasure. The ocean breeze felt nice but I was a little afraid. Dad drank his coffee for the caffeine and grabbed the steering wheel.

"Look at that big island!" he spoke loudly.

We landed on the sand and saw a giant grey elephant. It was huge although it looked very friendly. Dad tried to seize the map but the wind blew it away. It seemed impossible to find the gold without a guide. Then the elephant rose up and pointed his trunk at a cave.

"Thank you Mr. Elephant!" I shouted.

We ran inside and found a big box of gold coins. It was the best day ever.

It was my birthday party and I invited my friends. We walked to the bounce house in the backyard. It was a huge castle and everyone started jumping. I bounced really high but unfortunately I fell down hard. My knee hit the plastic and it was stinging bad. 

My friend Sam shouted, "Are you okay in there?"

I tried to get up but my foot was trapped. I pulled and pulled but it didn’t move. I was stuck for a little bit longer. Then Sam crashed into me by accident. It actually helped me get my foot out!

"Thanks for crashing into me!" I said.

We were wearing different socks so we looked funny. My mom called us for cake and we ran inside. I like earning presents but playing with friends is the best part.

We had science class today and it was super hot outside. The sun scorched the playground so we stayed inside for recess. Everyone grumbled about it but then Mrs. Miller told us a surprise.

"We are going to make paper airplanes!" she said.

The whole class started cheering and clapping really loud. I drew a cool beetle on my plane’s wings. My friend Sam simply folded his straight down the middle.

"I bet mine flew better than yours," Sam said.

We threw them and mine rose up high near the ceiling. It hit the door with a loud knock. Then the principal walked in and looked like a strict colonel. He saw us and started groaning about the mess. But then he saw my plane and smiled. I was happy he didn't gnaw on us for being loud. It was the best day ever.

I went outside early in the morning to play. The wind blew the leaves around my yard. My neighbor Mr. Smith was groaning because he was raking. I saw a little bird sitting on the fence. It looked hungry though.

I ran inside and got some bread. My mom toasted it and spread peanut butter on it. I took it outside gradually so I didn't scare the bird.

"Here little bird," I said quietly. "Do you want to receive a snack?"

The bird flew down and ate the crumbs. It was a pleasant morning with the sun surrounding us. I drew a picture of the bird later. I was yearning for a pet of my own. Maybe I could keep the bird, but my mom said wild animals need to be free. The growing flowers looked nice in the garden. I sold some lemonade later too.

It was my birthday and I was turning nine. I sat on the big chair and felt excited. My dad was reading a newspaper, though he peeked over it.

"Is it time for cake?" I asked him loudly.

"Not yet, we have to wait for Grandma," he said.

I had a really happy feeling in my tummy. Finally the doorbell rang and I ran through the hall. I opened the door and Grandma was standing there. She held a red rose from her garden for me.

Then everyone came into the kitchen and sang. My brother pushed the cake close to me. I knew what to wish for when I blew. I saw fourteen candles even though I am only nine! We ate cake and it was the best day ever.

We walked into the dark forest behind my house. My friend Sam held the map he drew yesterday.

"I guarantee there is treasure here," Sam said loudly.

The trees started to look really big and different. Suddenly we saw a huge hole in the ground. It looked like a foreign land down there. I threw a rock inside and we listened.

"Should we bungee jump down?" I asked him.

Sam shook his head and we walked around it. Gradually the sun went down and we heard singing. It was just some birds hanging in a tree. We found a shiny box and started cheering. We ran home to write about our adventure. We can open the box tomorrow!

My brother Tim is getting stronger at basketball. We went to the park and greeted our friends. Everyone started running around on the court. I held the ball tight and dribbled fast. 

Tim tried to steal it but I was too quick. I jumped high off the ground and threw the ball. It hit the metal chain net with a loud sound. 

"That was a lucky shot!" Tim yelled at me.

"No way, that was pure strength!" I shouted back.

Then Tim got the ball and crashed into me. I fell down but I didn't cry. I got up and tried to contain him near the hoop. He missed his shot and we won the game! It was the best day ever.

One day I bought a map from a weird store. It had invisible ink but I was reading it with a flashlight. My friend Sam and I went to the forest. We often go there to explore caves. We saw a big sleeping bear near a fountain.

"Don't knock over that rock!" I spoke quietly to Sam.
Sam whispered, "I have a bad feeling about this."

Suddenly the bear disappeared into the earth! We did not understand where it went. We thought it was magic. We tried to measure the hole but it was too deep. The hole did not contain anything at all. We ran home fast. Next time we will bring more snacks.

My dog Max and I went exploring in the woods today. We reached the big creek and saw something moving. It looked like a stick floating in the water.

"Is that a snake?" I asked Max quietly.

Max barked loudly at the dark water. The thing started approaching the muddy bank very fast. It was definitely dangerous so we backed away. We searched for a safe place to stand.

"Let's go home now, Max," I said.

We ran back up the hill. I saw a blue vein pop out on my hand because I was scared. Neither of us wanted to stay there anymore. We told everyone about the monster snake later. Max is a brave dog but he likes the couch better.

We had science class today and it was really fun. We grew little bean plants in cups by the window. My plant got so big it looked like a mountain.

Then we went to art class for painting pictures. I made a painting of a scary green creature. But then I caught my shirt on the table. A long thread came out of my favorite blue shirt!

At lunch, the cafeteria smelled like stewed tomatoes and cheese. My friend Sam looked at my tray and asked, "Are you gonna eat that?"

I said, "No way, it looks too gross for me."

We played tag at recess until the bell rang loud. It was a good day but I am tired now.

It was a sunny Wednesday and me and my friend Sam went exploring. We were following a map we found near the old hospital. The map led us to the spooky woods behind the park. We walked for a long time and the shadows grew really big.

Suddenly we saw a huge monkey swinging on a metal chain! The monkey looked angry and he was singing a loud song.

"Run away fast!" Sam yelled at me.

"I can’t move my feet!" I shouted back.

Although I was scared, I gave the monkey my lunch. It was stewed carrots from my mom. He ate it all and smiled. He wanted to explain something but he is a monkey. We ran home safely.

My dog Buster is huge and has lots of strength. One day he saw a squirrel and pulled the leash hard. I held on tight but I struggled to stop him. He ran right into my neighbor Mrs. Lee’s garden!

Mrs. Lee was drinking her morning caffeine on the porch. Buster jumped and knocked over her flower pot.

"Oh no, Buster!" I yelled. "That is wrong!"

Mrs. Lee just laughed and blew a silver whistle. Buster stopped and sat down fast.

"He likes that sound," she sang happily.

I ran over and grabbed his collar. I told her I was sorry about the mess. Then I went home to play on my computer. Next time I will walk him in the park instead.

One day my dog Max ran into the woods. He saw a squirrel and chased it very fast. I ran after him but he was gone. I heard a loud groaning sound near the creek. Max was stuck in a hole! His paw was trapped under a big rock.

"Don't worry Max, I am here!" I yelled.

I needed strength to move the heavy rock. I grasped the cold stone with both my hands. I pulled hard and my face got red. Suddenly the rock moved and Max jumped out. He licked my face because he was happy.

"You are in big trouble," I told him.

We walked home and looked at the surrounding trees. I remembered that mom was making roasted chicken for dinner. I believed it was going to be the best dinner ever.

I brought my lunch to school in a big red bag. My mom packed a turkey sandwich with lots of protein. I sat with my best friend Sam instead of my brother. We talked about a video game on my computer. Suddenly, a kid named Leo crashed into our table! He spilled his juice all over my sandwich.

"I am so sorry!" Leo yelled very loudly.

"It's okay, but now my lunch is wet," I said.

Then the principal came over to explain the rules again. She likes teaching us how to maintain good behavior. I realized I was still hungry, but I had no food. Leo gave me his apple for company. It felt like a foreign country without my sandwich. Next time I will eat fast before anyone crashes.

Me and Sam were playing the coolest racing game ever. We were on the last level and my car was red. Sam had a blue truck with giant wheels.

"I am going to win this time!" Sam yelled loudly.

"No way, I am faster than you!" I shouted back.

We zoomed past a guard who was sleeping by the road. Suddenly, a weird green creature jumped onto the track. It scratched my car but I kept driving really fast. I discovered a secret trail behind a big rock. I crossed the finish line first and I was so happy.

"You crushed me," Sam said and looked at his controller.

My dad came in and gave me a paper receipt. He said, "Let’s measure how loud you scream when you win." We laughed and went out to play on the balcony.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I pretended I was a brave knight on an island. Suddenly I heard a loud noise in the bushes. Something crashed through the leaves and sounded scary. I froze for a second but then I looked closer. It was just a squirrel roaming around looking for nuts. He found a big acorn and started to gnaw on it.

"Hey little guy," I said to the squirrel.

He looked at me and scratched his ear. Then he ran away and crossed the creek. The water looked like a shiny fountain in the sun. I walked for an hour and found some cool rocks scattered everywhere. The sun rose higher so I went home for lunch. My mom made roasted chicken and it smelled really good.

I was so excited about my big sleepover. I heard the doorbell ringing and I ran fast to open it. My best friend Sam was there with his sleeping bag.

"I brought my new games!" Sam yelled.

We went to the backyard for a meeting about what to play first. We chose the tire swing. We took turns swinging really high. It felt like bungee jumping. Then we went inside to draw pictures. I drew a giant monster and Sam drew a cool car.

Later, my dad was reading the newspaper on the couch.

"Do you know where the pizza is?" I asked him.

He laughed and said it was on the way. Before bed, I had to comb my hair because it was messy. It was the best night ever.

My neighbor Mr. Smith has a very big dog. Yesterday I sat on my porch and watched them training. Mr. Smith threw a ball and the dog caught it. It was suddenly very windy outside but they kept playing.

"That is impossible to catch!" I yelled at them.

Mr. Smith laughed and said, "Nothing is impossible for Rex!"

Then my mom called me inside for an important snack. She gave me milk because kids cannot have caffeine. I ate a cookie shaped like a gray elephant. I obtained another cookie when she wasn't looking. Then I grew tired so I cleared my plate. It was a good day bearing good snacks. Maybe I will study psychology when I grow up like my mom.

One day I went to the zoo with my dad. We woke up very early to see the animals. The wind blew my hat off but I caught it. I was wearing my favorite blue shirt. We saw a big grey elephant eating peanuts. He looked very happy and he grew bigger when he stretched.

"Look at his long trunk!" I shouted to my dad.

"He is smiling at you," said my dad.

Suddenly the elephant sprayed water on everyone! It was cold water but we were laughing. Everyone started cheering for the funny elephant. I was feeling very wet but it was the best day ever. We bought ice cream after.

I was sitting in class dreaming about recess. My teacher was teaching us about big numbers like fourteen. I wasn't listening because I thought about the swings. Finally the bell rang and everyone scattered outside. I ran to the playground and saw Billy swinging high.

"Watch this!" Billy yelled and jumped off the swing.

Everyone was cheering for him but I felt scared. He landed in the dirt and touched his knee. He looked okay but he was clinging to his leg. I reached out my hand to help him up.

"Are you okay?" I asked him quietly.

He smiled and discovered a cool rock on the ground. We played tag until the bell rang again. It was the best recess ever.

My brother Tom and I walked straight into the dark forest. We wanted to find the secret fort. We saw a big metal fence with a sign.

"Be quiet," Tom whispered. "There is a guard over there."

The guard was actually a rusty robot. It was moaning like a ghost. We kept walking past it very slowly. We found a small door and went inside. It looked like an old computer company. There were fourteen broken screens on the wall. Suddenly, we smelled something yummy.

"Is that roasted chicken?" I asked.

A giant rat was steering a toy car. He had chicken! We ran away fast and we laughed all the way home.

Max the sailor loved adventure. One day, he grasped his map and sailed to a spooky island. He feared nothing, but the jungle was dark. He saw a giant vine growing from the ground to the ceiling of the cave.

"I will climb it!" yelled Max with pleasure.

He threw his rope and started to climb high. Suddenly, he saw a monkey eating a nut.

"That nut has good protein," said the monkey.

Max laughed and kept going up. He finally obtained the treasure at the top. He had to learn the meaning of the map to find it. His courage grew big that day. It was the best quest ever.

My big brother Leo and I went camping in the woods. We found a dark cave and walked inside. It was very cold and kind of scary. 

"Look at the bats on the ceiling!" Leo whispered.

I looked up and I got scared. We walked deeper and the walls got very tight. I had to squeeze through a small hole. I scratched my arm on a sharp rock. It hurt a little but I was brave.

"We need to find the treasure," I said to Leo.

We found a shiny box keeping safe in the dirt. I thought it would be crushed but it wasn't. It was important because we trained all summer for this. We didn't find gold either but we found cool rocks. It was the best adventure ever.

I had an incredible sandwich for lunch today. It was toasted cheese and it smelled so good. My friend Sam sat next to me for company. He looked at my lunchbox and his eyes got wide.

"Is that extra cheese?" Sam asked me quietly.

"Yes, my mom made it special," I said.

Then the bell started sounding for recess and we ran. We were jumping over the cracks on the playground. I gripped the monkey bars tight with my finger. The weight of my body felt heavy but I didn't fall. Suddenly, a ball struck me right on the arm!

It didn't hurt much but my heart was thumping hard. I grasped the ball and threw it back through the hoop.

"Good shot!" yelled Sam from the slide.

Tomorrow I hope we can play kickball instead. School is fun when you have good snacks.

It was lunchtime and I was so hungry. I bought a juice box and a sandwich. I stood in line but then Timmy bumped me. Juice went everywhere and made a huge red stain!

"Oh no, look at my shirt!" I screamed loudly.

Timmy said, "Sorry, I was just reaching for an apple."

I walked straight to the bathroom to clean it. The water was dumping out of the tap fast. It didn't work though and it looked like a trail of blood. I went back to class feeling sad. But then the teacher put on a movie about an elephant stamping through the jungle. Everyone was cheering and I forgot about my spot. It was a good day although I was sticky.

I was dreaming about a huge cake floating in space. But then my mom woke me up sounding really loud. It was my birthday! I ran downstairs and saw my brother eating cereal. He didn't say happy birthday either. I was stewed mad. But then he drew a funny picture of me on the box.

"Do you like it?" he asked with a big smile.

"It looks like an alien from earth," I said laughing.

Mom made pancakes instead of boring toast. My dad was groaning because he needed his caffeine. We fought over the syrup but it was just for fun. I didn't get into trouble today. I wish I could learn to fly like in my dream. It was the best day.

We were playing soccer at the park on Saturday. My team is called the Tigers and we have a strict schedule. I put on my cleats and walked onto the grass. The other team looked big and scary but I wasn't scared. 

"Pass the ball to me!" shouted my friend Sam.

I kicked it hard but it went the wrong way. The other team stole the ball and ran fast. My heart was beating hard and my breathing was heavy. I scrambled back to help our goalie. Then Sam moved in front of the big kid. He stopped the ball with his foot just in time!

"Nice save, Sam!" I yelled really loud.

We didn't win the game but we had pizza after. The pizza tasted like roasted cheese and it was so good. I understood that having fun is better than winning. Next time we will measure the goal better.

My brother and I went exploring near the old building. It was a cold day in February, so we wore coats. We walked until we met a huge dog behind a tree. He looked like a baby elephant because he was gray and big! I held out my finger to say hello to him. The dog licked me with his huge pink tongue. It felt very slimy and wet on my hand.

"Ew, that is so gross!" I yelled really loud.

My brother laughed and said, "He likes you a lot."

Then we saw a sign that we forgot to read. It said 'Beware of Dog' but the dog was nice. We neared the fence and petted him some more. My brother started swearing because he stepped in mud. We ran home before mom got mad at us.

My robot named Zork had a big problem. He lost his favorite blue comb. Zork looked under the bed and found a ghost. The ghost was nice and held a newspaper.

"Have you seen my comb?" asked Zork.

The ghost shook his head and blew a bubble. "No, but check the spaceship."

Zork ran to the spaceship and looked inside. He feared it was gone forever. Then he saw something shiny near the buttons. It was the comb! Zork understood that he had left it there. It was a pleasure to have it back. He combed his metal head and beeped happily.

I was training for the big race at my apartment. My friend Sam came over and we practiced running together. The breeze felt nice outside but then it started raining hard. We ran inside fast and almost crashed into the door.

"We need a good reason to stop!" I shouted.

"I am hungry and need some protein!" Sam screamed back.

We ate snacks and then played a video game instead. The monsters were surrounding us on the screen. I tried to seize the controller but I missed it. Then my mom walked in and saw us screaming.

"Stop all that noise and try reading quietly," she said.

We followed her rules but we still wanted to race later.

Recess was finally here and everyone was running outside. I was already at the playground and felt the cool breeze. My friend Jake was swinging high on the swings. I ran over to the monkey bars and gripped the metal tightly. It felt impossible to get across but I tried anyway.

Suddenly, Jake jumped off his swing and landed in the dirt. He was groaning loudly so I ran to help him.

"My leg hurts really bad!" Jake yelled while holding his knee.

Mrs. Miller appeared quickly and looked at his leg. She turned to me and said, "Go get the nurse, please."

I ran inside fast. Later at lunch, they served stewed tomatoes which looked gross. I simply threw my lunch away and waited for Jake to come back. He came back later with a big bandage and he was speaking about his cool scar.

It was Wednesday and I was playing my favorite game. My friend Sam and I played together online. We landed on a small island in the game. I gripped my controller really tight because I was nervous.

"Look out behind that tree!" Sam yelled loudly.

I froze for a second but then I pulled the trigger. We beat the bad guys and reached the next level. My hands were sweating. I was yearning to win the big trophy. Then my mom called me for dinner.

"Pause the game right now!" she said from the kitchen.

I grumbled a little bit but I stopped. We had roasted chicken and toasted bread. I heard Sam tearing open a bag of chips over the headset. We almost won, but now I had to eat.

My robot friend Zip had a busy schedule today. We flew to a magic island in space. The scenery was full of purple trees and blue rocks. Zip wanted to climb the highest mountain, but he struggled. His metal legs were trembling because it was so steep.

"I can't do it!" Zip beeped sadly.

"Yes you can, just use your jets!" I yelled.

He turned on his rockets and flew up fast. He hit the ceiling of the sky! Then he did a bungee jump back down. My heart was pumping hard but everyone started cheering. We did not receive a prize, but it was super fun.

I wanted to write a story about my dog Rex. He is big like an elephant and has messy fur. One day Rex and I went exploring in the woods. We walked for a long time and the trees got tall.

"Come here, Rex!" I called loudly.

He didn't listen and he ran into a bush. I followed him and unfortunately I got stuck on a branch. It was tearing my shirt a little bit. Then I saw something weird. Rex was trying to gnaw on a giant bone.

"That is way too big for you," I said laughing.

Rex made a groaning sound because he was tired. We gradually walked home and neared our house. I measured his height against the door. He is definitely growing too fast!

My family went to the lake for a holiday. We rented a big cabin with lights hanging outside. My dad said we should go boating early. I was hungry but I ate a banana fast. We got in the boat and the sun rose up. It was so pretty on the water.

Suddenly my little brother started moaning. "I feel sick," he said.

He gripped the side of the boat really hard. My mom said, "Oh no, we have to go back."

We turned around and left the deep water. My brother is growing up but he still gets sick. We watched movies in the cabin instead. It was still a good day.

We went to the woods early in February. The wind was tearing at our coats though. My friend Sam held the map in his hands. We walked for a long time and sang songs. Suddenly we saw a big rusty chain on a gate.

"I am certain there is treasure inside," Sam said.

We climbed over but then we heard a loud growl. A big dog ran at us and looked mean. We ran fast because we didn't want any trouble.

"That was scary but fun!" I yelled to Sam.

Sam grinned at me and we ran all the way home. We were cold but we did not get pneumonia. It was the best adventure ever.

My friends and I searched for the lost cave yesterday. We ran through the big woods behind my house. A bear was roaming there so we were trembling. We dropped our heavy bags because of the weight.

Suddenly, a giant branch crashed down in front of us!

"Look out!" yelled my friend Sam.

We saw a dark hole that the branch cleared. It was the cave. A scary bat hung from the ceiling inside. We drew a map so we wouldn't get lost.

"I am hungry," I said to Sam's daughter, Lily.

We sat down and ate sandwiches that we chewed fast. We also ate toasted marshmallows. It was the best adventure ever.

One day me and my friend Sam went boating. We wanted to find the lost pirate jewel. We were loading the boat with snacks and maps. The wind grew very strong and pushed us fast. Suddenly we crashed onto a small island.

"Oh no, our boat sank!" I yelled loudly.

Sam looked scared though he tried to be brave. We saw a shiny box in the sand. I touched the box and it opened up. Inside was the big red jewel!

"We are rich now!" Sam said.

We sprinted back to the water and saw a rescue boat. We paid the man with a gold coin. I will write a book about this someday. We know where the treasure is now.

I was sitting in class feeling very hungry for lunch. My stomach made a loud noise sounding like a monster. Then my teacher shouted, "Okay class, it is time for lunch!" I flew out of my chair and ran to the cafeteria.

Today the lunch lady roasted a big chicken for us. It smelled good but then I discovered something bad. A tiny fly crawled on my tray and appeared on my food.

"Eww, get away!" I yelled at the bug.

My friend Sam laughed and said, "Maybe he wants some stewed carrots."

I realized I was not hungry anymore so we went outside. We played a game about boating on the ocean. I was steering the ship through the big waves. We had to search for pirate gold. It was the best recess ever.

One day I went hiking up a big green mountain. My dog Buster came with me and he smelled everything. We saw a dark cave with rocks surrounding the entrance. Buster barked loudly at the scary dark hole.

"Be quiet Buster!" I yelled but he didn't listen.

Suddenly a weird creature came out of the shadows. It looked like a ghost but made of old leather. I didn't know what it was at all. Buster fought it with all his doggy strength. The creature tried to grab him but I threw a rock. The rock crushed its foot and it ran away crying.

"Good boy Buster," I said and gave him a treat.

We ran home fast and I used scissors to cut burrs off his fur. It was a crazy scene but we were safe.

I went to the spooky cave with my friend Sam. We stood at the big dark entrance and felt scared. It was freezing cold but we had our warm coats on.

"Do you see the treasure?" asked Sam quietly.

"I think a bear is sleeping in there," I whispered.

We crawled inside on our hands and knees very slowly. Suddenly, my foot got stuck on a big rock. I struggled to get free and made a loud noise. We heard a growl and we knew we had to run fast! We ran outside into the sun and breathed hard. Sam grinned at me and gave me a high five. It was the greatest adventure ever, but we didn't find any gold.

I had a really big test in reading class today. My teacher said to write our names on the paper. I sat up straight and looked at the scenery outside. A bird flew by and I wished I was outside too.

"Please be quiet and start now," Mrs. Miller said.

I looked at the first question but I felt nervous. It felt like a heavy weight was on my chest. I could feel the blood in my vein moving fast. I knew the answer though! It meant I had to explain why the bear was sad.

Suddenly the lunch bell screamed really loud and everyone jumped.

"Put your pencils down right now!" shouted Mrs. Miller.

I was hungry and ready to use my fork and knife. I think I won the test because I finished everything.

My younger brother Sam and I went exploring in the woods. We were looking for treasure but we only found bugs. I got a stinging cut when I scratched my arm on a bush. It was a weird feeling. Suddenly Sam dropped his stick and pointed at the ground.

"Look at that shiny thing!" Sam yelled loudly.

It was just a crumpled receipt that someone scattered there. But then I saw something else near a sleeping cat. It was a long blue thread. We followed the thread until it disappeared into a hole.

"Maybe a guitar pick is inside," I said.

We dug a little bit but it was getting dark. We didn't find treasure, but exploring is still fun.

My birthday party was almost ruined because of my dog. Mom put the big chocolate cake on the table. But then Buster jumped up and took a huge bite!

I felt so much anger when I saw his messy face.

"Bad dog, Buster!" I yelled and gripped his collar tight.

"He was just yearning for a treat," my friend Sam said.

My mom grumbled and took the cake away to fix it. We went outside to play jungle explorer in the backyard. We fought imaginary tigers and searched for lost treasure under the slide. Then Mom called us back inside for cake. She cut off the bad part.

"I counted seven candles, that is enough," Mom laughed.

It was still the best birthday ever, even with dog spit.

Me and my friend Sam went into the spooky woods. We were following a map to find hidden treasure. The trees looked different here and the air felt cold. We neared a big cave and heard a noise.

"I think there is danger in there," Sam said.

"My brain says we should run away," I whispered back.

Suddenly a big bear came out and he looked hungry! He grumbled loudly and we felt scared. We struggled to run but my foot got caught. Sam helped me and we cleared the path fast. We ran until we struck a big rock. My heart beat in a fast rhythm.

"I can’t explain how scared I was," Sam panted.

We didn't find gold but we made it home safe. Next time we will play inside.

My birthday is in February, so it is always cold. My mom planned a big sleepover with my best friends. I knew it would be the best party ever. Everyone brought their sleeping bags and we ate pizza.

But then my little brother started groaning very loudly. He was moaning because he wanted to play with us.

"Go away, Leo!" I yelled at him.

"But I am the video game champion!" Leo shouted back.

My mom said we had to let him play once. Although he is small, he actually beat us at everything. He won the racing game simply by holding one button. After that, we let him stay for cake. It was a fun night even with my brother there.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark forest. We wanted to find the lost golden coin. It was hidden deep in a scary cave. We walked for a long time and the earth was muddy. Suddenly we saw a big bear sleeping near a tree!

"Be quiet or he will wake up!" whispered Sam.

I nodded and we tiptoed past the big bear. Then we saw a huge cliff. We had a rope for hanging on tight.

"I will go first like a bungee jumper," I said.

I jumped down and greeted the darkness. I saw something shiny and started singing. It was the coin! We learned that we were brave enough today. Then we ran home sounding happy.

We woke up early to find the hidden gold. My brother gripped the map and I held the flashlight. We walked into the dark woods surrounding our house. The trees were growing very tall and blocked the sun.

"Are you scared?" I asked him quietly.

"To be honest, yes," he whispered back.

Suddenly, the earth shook under our feet. A single red eye opened in a bush. We ran throughout the forest and didn't stop. A monster tried to gnaw on my shoe but I escaped! We ran until we could no longer see the trees. We didn't find the treasure, but we were safe at home. Next time we will bring a bigger flashlight.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover at his apartment. We ate pizza and then we played a video game. I won the first round but Sam pushed me off the couch. He yelled, "That is not fair at all!" I laughed because he was just kidding. Later we made a huge fort with blankets for sleeping. Sam’s little sister came in and she accidentally crushed the side of our fort. I didn't understand why she did it but then she let out a huge sneeze. She struck the pillows when she sneezed and they fell down. We fixed the fort and told spooky stories until midnight. It was the best night ever.

My friends and I climbed up the big tree today. We pretended we were soldiers in a new company. Max said he was the colonel and he looked serious. We saw a squirrel jumping and it looked scary.

"We have to catch that spy!" Max shouted loudly.

We ran across the branch and almost fell off. It felt impossible to catch him because he was fast. Then the squirrel landed on Mrs. Smith’s balcony. We hung from the branch and swung like monkeys.

"Don't fall or we are in trouble," I said.

My mom treated us to ice cream after our mission. I was dreaming about catching that squirrel all night long. The rhythm of the rain helped me sleep very well.

I was playing my new video game about a floating elephant. You had to use your imagination to help him fly. My room was messy and needed cleaning, but I didn't care. I grabbed the controller tight and started to squeeze the buttons.

"You better be cleaning up there!" my mom yelled.
"I am almost done!" I shouted back, but I was lying.

Suddenly, the elephant let out a giant sneeze on the screen. He flew way up high past the surrounding clouds. I reached for my soda and realized it was empty. I searched for more chips but heard footsteps. My mom opened the door and started moaning about the mess. Now I am getting a grounding for a week. No more video games for me.

My brother bought a new basketball game last week. I really wanted to play it, but he always chose the best team. That was the reason he always won. I thought it was not fair at all!

"Let me pick the Lakers this time," I said.

He looked at me and laughed. "Only if you can score first."

I grabbed the controller and had to squeeze the buttons hard. It was like putting a thread through a tiny needle. It was so tricky! I feared I would lose again. But then my player jumped high. He dunked the ball right in the hoop!

"Yes! I did it!" I yelled loudly.

My brother was grounding me from the game, but I won anyway.

It was the greatest day at school ever. We built a huge fort out of boxes at recess. Timmy brought a lot of newspaper to crumple up. We threw the paper balls straight at the girls. Sarah screamed and ran away fast. Then Mrs. Baker blew her whistle very loud.

"You are in big trouble now!" she told us.

My face got red with anger because it wasn't fair. Timmy grasped my arm and pulled me back. I almost scratched my knee on the ground. We didn't have enough time to play anyway. We went inside and I saw my coat hanging there. I was sad but then lunch was pizza. I love pizza so I stopped screaming inside my head. It was still a good day.

Me and my friend Sam found an old map. We grabbed our backpacks and ran to the woods. The scenery was green and the trees were growing tall. We wanted to find the lost pirate island. 

"Look at that big rock!" shouted Sam.

We saw a dark cave behind the bushes. It smelled like something scorched inside. Suddenly we heard a loud ringing sound. A ghost captain floated out and he looked scary. He was keeping a gold ring on his finger.

"Why are you sleeping here?" I asked him.

He tried to explain but he just wrote in the dirt. He said he sold his ship long ago. His reign was over now. We ran home fast!

Yesterday we had a big race at recess. My friend Sam said he knew he was faster than me. I said, "No way, I am the fastest in the class."

We lined up near the slide. The teacher yelled go and we ran down the trail. I ran super fast but my backpack felt like a heavy weight. I froze when I saw a big rock but I jumped over it. Sam tripped a little bit. I grew tired but I did not stop running.

I crossed the line first and I won the race! Sam was mad but he smiled later. He said, "You are fast but next time I will win either way." We ate lunch and felt happy.

I was walking in the woods with my dog named Spot. We were seeing lots of big green trees and some bugs. Suddenly a blue bird landed right on a low branch. Spot barked really loud and scared the little bird away.

"Why did you do that, Spot?" I asked him angrily.

Spot wagged his tail like nothing happened. I was feeling sad because I wanted to see the bird. I had a yearning to catch it and keep it. But I also feared Spot might bite it by accident.

Then we saw a giant butterfly on a yellow flower. I was afraid to move too fast this time.

"Sit down and be quiet," I whispered to Spot.

It was a pleasure to watch the butterfly fly away safely. We tried to measure how high it went into the sky.

My friend Sam and I went to the spooky woods. We were wearing our superhero capes for bravery. Sam thought he saw a ghost, but it was a cat. We walked deeper and the path turned very dark.

"Do not be scared," I said to Sam.

"I am brave," Sam bounced up and down.

Suddenly we saw an incredible glowing cave. We followed the light inside and found a chest. It looked very different from a normal box. We opened it and found shiny gold coins! We did learn that scary places have cool treasure. We ran home fast to tell my mom.

The forest was dark and scary but we kept walking. My brother Tom had a big leather bag for our stuff. He was keeping the map safe in his pocket. We were looking for the hidden cave. Suddenly we heard a loud noise in the bushes.

"Did you hear that?" I shouted.

"It was just a squirrel," said Tom.

But then a big bear crashed through the trees! We ran very fast. My leg felt like a needle poked it. I thought we were going to be eaten. We reached the river and jumped in. The bear did not like the water.

"That was too close," Tom said.

We were wet but we were safe. Next time I am teaching him how to run faster.

My nephew Ben and I went exploring in the woods. We saw a big pine tree with a sharp needle. Ben crawled on the ground to look for bugs. Suddenly he ran away very fast!

"I am in big trouble!" Ben yelled loudly.

He stepped on a bee and twisted his ankle. I thought he was crying, but he just chewed his lip. I had to be his guide back home. A squirrel greeted us on the path and chattered.

"We make a good league of explorers," I said.

A bird sang a happy song in the sky. Next time we will watch where we step.

My friend Sam believed a ghost lived in the old barn. The scenery surrounding the barn was not very pleasant. It was dark and spooky, but everyone called us brave explorers. We walked through the tall grass to the big door.

"Is this wrong?" Sam asked, and his voice shook a little.

"No, we have to finish the quest," I said.

We heard a loud stamping noise inside the barn. Something scratched the wood wall, and we got scared. A path led us to a corner where someone built a nest. It was just a big raccoon! We laughed because we were just beginning to worry. The adventure was complete, so we ran home fast.

My brother Sam and I were hiking on our big holiday trip. The scenery was really pretty with big green trees. We were jumping over rocks and looking for bugs. Suddenly Sam ran ahead on the trail and went behind a bush.

"Wait for me!" I yelled but he was gone.

He disappeared completely! I reached the bush but he wasn't there. It felt impossible because he is so slow. Then I heard loud screaming coming from a hole. I looked down and saw Sam tearing his pants on a branch.

"Help me up!" he cried and held out his hand.

I tried to maintain my balance and pulled him up hard. We walked back to mom and dad very slowly. Sam was sad about his pants but I was just happy he was okay.

It was my birthday last Saturday and I felt very grateful. My friends came over for a big jungle sleepover party. We had green streamers hanging from the ceiling like vines.

"Look out for the tigers!" shouted my best friend Sam.

We crawled under the table and pretended to be explorers. My dad greeted us with pizza and snacks for the company. He is good at teaching us new games. We bounced on my bed until my mom said stop.

Later, Sam accidentally sat on my cake and it got crushed.

"Oh no! I am simply so sorry!" he cried loudly.

I laughed and said, "It is okay, it still tastes good."

We were speaking and giggling throughout the whole night. It was the best birthday ever.

One day I was walking in the woods in February. I saw a weird glowing rock and I picked it up. Suddenly a robot knight appeared out of nowhere! He looked rusty and scratched.

"Do not touch that stone!" the robot shouted loudly.

I was scared so I scrambled up a tree. The robot started stamping his feet on the ground. He had a needle on his arm instead of a sword. It was growing bigger and bigger.

"It is very important for my power," he beeped.

Unfortunately I dropped the rock and it broke everything. The robot gradually stopped moving and fell over. I felt like I had too much caffeine because I was shaking. Then I did a bungee jump out of the tree and ran home fast. It was the craziest day ever.

I was wearing my heavy backpack and it felt like a giant rock. My shoulders sank under all the weight. I walked into science class and crashed into my desk. My friend Billy was stamping his feet because he was excited.

"Did you finish the project?" Billy asked me loudly.

"No, my dog ate the paper!" I yelled back.

Everyone laughed but the teacher looked mad. She pushed a new paper onto my desk. I started groaning because it was so much work. I gripped my pencil tight and started to search for the answers in my book. Then the bell rang for lunch and I threw my stuff in my bag. Lunch is way better company than science class.

My friends and I went into the spooky woods. We heard a loud noise near the big rock.

"What was that?" asked Tim.

We walked fast and felt a cold breeze. We saw a magic fountain with blue water. Suddenly a giant bear jumped out at us! We started running and bumping into trees. Tim was dumping his snacks to run faster. We led the bear to a big cliff. There was a bungee rope there.

"Grab the rope!" I called.

We grabbed the rope and jumped down safe. We learned that the woods are very scary. We touched the ground and felt grateful to be alive. Earning a badge for bravery was the best part.

My friends and I went to the spooky old castle. We brought flashlights and a map made of newspaper. The big door was heavy but we pushed hard.

"Look at that shiny knight!" yelled Billy loudly.

Suddenly the door slammed and we were trapped inside. It was very dark and we were scared. We walked down a hall bumping into walls. I counted thirteen steps and then I stopped.

"This is impossible!" I cried out.

A giant spider came down sticking out its tongue. Billy struck it with his backpack and it ran away. We found a small window and climbed out fast. We ran home just in time for stewed carrots. It was the best adventure in a single day.

Me and my neighbor Tom played in the woods. We pretended to be brave knights on a big quest. We found a dark cave and I heard something moaning.

"I think there is a monster in there," said Tom.

I gripped my wooden sword and walked inside slowly. It was dark and I could hear heavy breathing. Suddenly something dropped from the ceiling! I started screaming and swinging my sword everywhere. It was just a bat hanging upside down.

"That was the greatest scare ever!" I laughed loudly.

We ran out and I closed my eyes tight. It was a pleasure to be safe in the sun. We did not receive any gold but we had fun. Maybe next time we will use science to find treasures.

I sat at my desk and chewed on my pencil. Math class was so boring today. My friend Billy kept bumping my arm and giggling. The teacher looked at us and we sat up straight.

"Do you know the answer, Sam?" Mrs. Green asked me.

"Is it forty-two?" I asked back.

She smiled and nodded yes. Then the lunch bell rang loudly. I was so hungry for pizza day. But the lunch lady gave us stewed tomatoes instead. They looked gross. I simply could not eat them.

"I think I have pneumonia," I told Billy. "I can't eat this."

"To be honest, it smells bad," Billy said.

We ate our apples and then ran outside for recess. It was a good day even with the bad lunch.

One day I found an old map in my attic. It looked very important and had a big red X. I grabbed my flashlight and ran to the forest immediately. The trees were growing very tall and dark there. I held the map tight so I wouldn't lose it. Suddenly I heard a loud breathing sound behind a bush.

"Who is there?" I yelled very bravely.

"It is just me, a dragon!" said a small green dragon.

I was grateful he was friendly and not mean. We walked together to complete my quest for treasure. We found a golden box and I opened it. Inside was a note that someone wrote a long time ago. I started reading it out loud. It said the real treasure was just using your imagination!

One day my dog Rex ran into the woods. He loves climbing over logs and sniffing the dirt. I had to follow him because it was freezing outside. My mom said, "Don’t get pneumonia out there!" but I ran anyway.

I found Rex swinging his tail near a big bush. Suddenly a tiny squirrel appeared on a branch. It looked like it was the king of the forest beginning its reign.

"Come here, Rex!" I yelled loudly.

Rex didn’t listen because he was busy greeting the squirrel. We have a schedule for his walks, but he ignored it. Earning a treat is usually his favorite thing, but he wanted to play science explorer instead. I grabbed his collar and we walked home. He is growing so big and keeping him safe is hard work. I don't want to be in the bad dog league either.

One day I was playing near the old fountain. My friend Sam jumped in the water and found a secret tunnel. We crawled inside and saw a big blue ocean. There was a pirate ship floating there but it had no sailor.

"We should go on it!" Sam yelled.

We climbed up and I started steering the wheel. A cool breeze hit my face. Suddenly we heard a scary moaning sound from below.

"I am scared," I said. "Are you scared?"

"Neither of us should be scared," Sam said bravely.

Then I remembered I had a map in my pocket. It had foreign writing on it. We followed the map to an island and found a treasure chest. We were rich! We bought a million pizzas and went home.

It was my birthday sleepover and my friends were excited. We decided to make a blanket fort in the living room. Dad was in the kitchen and he made us snacks. We smelled toasted bread and hot cocoa. Then I heard a loud whistle from the kitchen.

"Who wants to help me wrap up these sandwiches?" Dad asked.

My friend Leo ran in but he started tearing the paper. He tried to fix it but then he let out a huge sneeze! We all laughed really hard. Later, we pretended to be pirates guarding a hidden jewel. Dad was coaching us on how to talk like pirates.

"Arrr, hand over the stewed apples!" I yelled loudly.

It was the best night ever. We stayed up late and told spooky stories. Then we fell asleep in our big fort.

I was sitting in class and looking at the clock. Mr. Smith was coaching us on math but I wasn't listening. I heard my tummy grumble really loud. Finally the bell rang and I grabbed my lunch box.

I ran outside to the playground with my friend Sam. We climbed to the very top height of the monkey bars. I looked down and felt like a king beginning his reign.

"I bet you can't jump from there," Sam grinned.

"Watch this!" I yelled and jumped into the sand.

I didn't get hurt but I lost my sandwich. It fell out of my pocket while I was loading up my jump. I was sad but Sam shared his cookies. Earning a cookie is better than eating a sandy sandwich anyway. Then we went inside and read books until the bus came.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. It was the beginning of our big adventure. We wanted to find the old spooky cave. Sam thought he saw a white shape moving fast.

"Is that a ghost?" Sam whispered to me.

"No, it looks like a little lamb!" I said.

We walked closer and my heart was beating really fast. Suddenly a huge grey shape stomped out from the trees. It was big like an elephant but very scary. We counted eight yellow eyes on its face! It was the monster that liked to reign over the forest. We heard its loud breathing and we ran home super fast. We were safe but we never went back there.

Me and my best friend Leo went into the dark forest. We feared the old witch who lived there. Leo brought his lucky scissors for protection. Suddenly, a bush shook loudly and I jumped back.

"Did you hear that noise?" whispered Leo.

"Yes, we should run immediately!" I yelled.

But then a big black cat jumped out. It scratched my leg but it was just playing. We were leaving when we saw a glowing cave. Inside, a pot brewed with green slime. I threw a rock at it and everything exploded! We ran home fast and never went back.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring in the woods. We were looking for the secret magic fountain. The path was very dangerous and full of big rocks. Suddenly, we heard a loud groaning sound near a cave.

"Did you hear that?" I whispered, and my hands were trembling.

"Maybe it is a dragon sleeping inside," said Leo.

We counted to three and started jumping over the logs. Leo tripped and almost got crushed by a falling branch! He hurt his leg and it looked bad. I knew we were in big trouble now. I helped him up and we walked slow. We needed to remain calm.

"I think I need a hospital," Leo cried.

We didn't find the fountain, but at least we had each other for company. I was steering us back home safe.

It was raining so we had inside recess today. I sat at the computer and my friend Sam sat next to me. We wanted to play the monkey game but the internet was slow.

"This is taking a million years," Sam spoke loudly.

Suddenly I discovered a hole in my backpack. My heavy math book was too much weight and it ripped. My favorite red pencil escaped out of the hole and fell. I picked it up with my finger and put it on the desk.

"Maybe we should just do our homework," I said.

Our teacher Mrs. Green taught us how to do subtraction yesterday. I tried to complete the worksheet but it was hard. I was swinging my legs under the chair. Then the bell rang and we ran to the water fountain. Being inside is boring but at least we didn't get wet.

I woke up late and ran to the bus stop. My neighbor Tim was there and he looked sleepy too. We got to school just as the bell rang loudly.

In art class, I drew a giant monster with green eyes. The monster appeared very scary because of his great height.

"That looks awesome," Tim said to me.

"Thanks, I am earning a gold star today," I said.

At lunch, they sold pizza and chocolate milk. I followed the long line and my tummy rumbled. I was yearning for that pizza so much. Trouble brewed when Tim spilled his milk on the floor. It made a huge puddle but the janitor was nice. It was a good day even with the spill.

My brother Timmy got superpowers from a glowing rock. He found it on the ground in our backyard. He blew on the rock and he started floating! He went all the way up to the ceiling.

"Get me down!" Timmy yelled. He looked scared.

I grinned and said, "Not until you do my chores."

He scrambled in the air like he was swimming. It looked really funny. Then he caught a newspaper that was flying by. He put the newspaper on his head for extra weight. It didn't work.

"Fine! I will do the loading of the dishwasher!" he shouted.

I counted to three and grabbed his foot. I pulled him down. Mom walked in and looked at the schedule on the wall. She didn't see Timmy floating. We would be in big trouble if she knew.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for the greatest hidden treasure. The scenery was full of big green trees. Sam thought he saw a shiny gold vein in a rock. We climbed up high although it was slippery.

Suddenly, a giant bear came out of a dark cave! We were in big trouble. The bear was screaming loud and growing angry.

"Run fast!" I yelled at Sam.
"I am running!" Sam shouted back.

I threw a big stick at the bear to stop him. Neither of us looked back. We ran all the way home. My mom brewed hot cocoa for us. We were safe, but we never found the gold.

My dad drove us to the big green forest. We had an important mission to find the lost treasure. My friend Sam brought his bungee cord and a map. We walked for a long time and saw a cave.

"Look out for the stinging bees!" I yelled loudly.

Sam ran fast and grasped the shiny gold box. He felt like a real champion. Then a big bear came out and greeted us with a roar.

"Run back to the car!" Sam screamed.

We ran very fast and got away safely. My mom sent us snacks later because we were brave. It was the best adventure ever.

My brother Tom and I went to the old cave. We wanted to find the gold vein inside the rock. I grasped my flashlight tight and we walked in. It was very dark and scary in there.

"Do you know where we are going?" I asked.

Tom nodded and moved ahead of me on the dirt. We climbed over big rocks on the ground. Suddenly I heard a noise like a tiny gnat buzzing. Then a big bat flew right at my head!

"Watch out!" yelled Tom.

I ducked down fast and put my weight on my hands. The bat flew away into the dark hole. We were safe but we ran home very fast.

My friends and I went into the woods behind my house. We were looking for the secret magic fountain. I held the old map that I obtained from a newspaper. The path was leading us deep into the dark trees. Suddenly we heard loud breathing coming from a big bush.

"What is that scary noise?" asked my friend Sam.

I grabbed a stick and I struck the bush hard. A little white lamb jumped out and ran away fast. We knew it was just a baby animal. We kept walking and we found the stone fountain. The water spread out over the ground. I took out my lucky comb and dipped it in.

"We did it!" shouted Sam happily.

It was the best adventure ever.

My brother Tom turned thirteen today and we had a big party. Mom was loading the cake onto a plate and grabbed a big knife. Suddenly a huge black beetle crawled out from under the table! It looked very scary and my sister started moaning loudly.

"Get it away from me!" she yelled and jumped on a chair.

My dad struck the table with a newspaper but the bug escaped. It struggled to climb the wall and everyone was scared. I wanted to write a story about it for school later. Then Tom caught the beetle in a cup and put it outside.

"That was the best present ever," Tom laughed.

We finally ate the cake but I checked my slice first.

Me and my best friend Ben went exploring. We are eight years old and we are very brave. We walked into the dark woods behind my house. It was getting darker gradually and I felt scared.

Suddenly we saw a huge bear eating berries! Ben whispered, "That is the greatest bear ever."

I said, "Shh! We need keeping quiet right now."

We ran away fast and hid behind a tree. Then we smelled something weird like roasted marshmallows. It was actually my dad making a fire nearby. He gave us toasted bread and hot chocolate. My mom says chocolate has caffeine so I felt awake. It was thirteen minutes past bedtime but we didn't care. I love adventure but psychology is too hard to spell.

Max and I were playing outside in the hot weather. We saw a cave and decided to explore it. It was dark but I had a flashlight. Suddenly we heard a moaning sound.

"What is that noise?" asked Max.

I froze and treated the flashlight like a sword. We saw a big dragon sleeping on a rock! It had smoke coming from its nose. The dragon woke up and flew at us. It scorched my shoe with fire. We ran very fast.

"Run faster or we will be roasted!" I yelled.

We ran all the way home and told my mom. She was reading a newspaper. She said dragons are just science fiction. But then she saw my shoe. The dragon disappeared back into the cave. We never went back there again. It was bearing a grudge against us.

I was playing my new video game about racing cars. My car was red and it looked beautiful on the screen. I was winning the race but my brother grabbed the controller.

"Hey! Give it back!" I was screaming at him really loud.

He just laughed and crashed my car into a big mountain. Then he dropped the controller and ran away to his room. I felt mad but I found another controller under the sofa. I started the race again and I was feeling happy. I drove past a giant elephant and a tiny beetle on the track. Gradually I got faster and went past a water fountain.

"I am the winner!" I yelled when I crossed the line.
