My brother grumbled in the hallway because I beat his high score. I slept very good that night because I am the best racer ever.

My dog Buster is very funny and loves jumping on everything. One day I was playing on my computer and Buster ran outside. I went to the backyard and it was beautiful and sunny. Suddenly I saw a big black beetle on the grass. Buster saw it too and he landed right on it!

"Oh no Buster, get off!" I yelled very loud.

Buster looked at me and he gradually moved away. He chewed on an old newspaper instead. I was grateful he didn't eat the bug. Then I remembered something scary. My friend said bugs have germs and give you pneumonia. I checked Buster's weight on the scale later but he was fine. He acted like he was doing a bungee jump off the couch.

"You are a crazy dog," I said to him.

It was my birthday party and it was freezing outside. My friends came over for a sleepover and we wanted cake. My mom said we had to earn it by being good. We played hide and seek and I was scared in the dark closet. Then we did a treasure search in the living room.

Finally, it was time for the big chocolate cake. My mom brought it out and everyone started cheering loudly. But then my dog Buster jumped up and hit the table! My heart sank when the cake fell on the floor. Buster ate every single crumb. I was honest and told mom I didn’t push him. She laughed and paid the pizza man for extra pizza instead. I like earning pizza more than cake anyway.

I was boating in space when I saw a weird planet. It was green and smelled like toasted bread. I landed my rocket and climbed out. A big robot walked up to me. It had a giant comb on its head.

"Hello human," said the robot. "Do you have any caffeine?"

"Unfortunately, no," I said. "I only have juice."

The robot crossed its arms and looked sad. I remembered I had a single chocolate bar in my pocket. I gave it to him. He ate it with his thumb. Suddenly he got super strength! He picked up my rocket with his imagination. He was bringing it to his castle for a party. It was the best day ever!

One day I was walking in a beautiful meadow. Suddenly a big purple creature flew down from the sky. It looked like a robot bird with shiny wings. I was certain it was an alien! It landed near me and started jumping around.

"Are you in danger?" I asked the robot bird.

It screeched loud and looked scared. Then a bad alien threw a net at it! I used my super imagination power. I imagined a giant shield and the net bounced off. It was raining lasers now!

"Watch out!" I was screaming.

I took my pocket knife and cut the bad alien's ship. He flew away fast. The robot bird was safe. To be honest, it was the best day ever.

I was running late for school today. I threw my bag on my back and zoomed out. My teacher Mr. Jones was groaning when I came in. He had to explain the math problem again. It was very boring and plain.

At lunch, the cafeteria smelled like stewed tomatoes. I saw a weird thing floating in my soup.

"Ew, is that a bug?" asked my friend Sam.

"No, it looks like a bungee cord," I said.

We started tearing up our napkins for fun. Then the bell rang for recess. We ran outside to play tag. It was a good day even with the weird soup.

I was so excited for my birthday adventure. My big brother Tom walked me to the park. He is fourteen and thinks he is cool.

"I guarantee this will be the greatest day," Tom said.

We saw a big bouncy castle on the ground. It looked like a danger zone but super fun. I ran to the guard at the front. He said I could go in but no shoes.

Inside, I saw my friend Sam and I pushed him gently. We started jumping like we were doing a bungee jump. Then I fell down hard on my arm. It was stinging really bad so Tom called mom.

"We have to go to the hospital," mom said sadly.

My arm was broken but I got a blue cast. It was still a pretty good birthday.

My birthday party was last Saturday and I turned nine. I was so thrilled because my friends came over for cake. My mom made burgers because they have lots of protein. Then we opened presents and I hoped to receive a drone.

I ripped the paper off the big box really fast. It was a red drone and I started screaming loudly! My dad put batteries in it and we went outside. The drone flew up high and it went through the trees.

Suddenly it hit a branch and sank into the pool. My sister who is thirteen laughed at me but I screamed. My dad jumped in and saved it just in time. We dried it off and it still worked perfectly. Best birthday ever!

One sunny day, my dog Spot and I went outside. Spot found a hole near the big oak tree. He started digging fast and dirt went everywhere. Suddenly, I heard a weird noise coming from the hole. It sounded like a tiny guitar playing music. I was trembling a little bit but I looked inside.

"What is down there, Spot?" I asked him.

Spot barked and gripped a root with his teeth. He struggled to pull it out. Then gravity made him fall backward into the grass. I looked again and saw a little beetle. The beetle was just beginning to climb up.

"It's just a bug!" I yelled and laughed.

I decided to guide the beetle to a safe rock. Then Spot led me back home for a snack.

My birthday party was simply wonderful. My friends came over and we played in the backyard jungle gym. The breeze felt nice on my face while I was clinging to the bars. Then we went inside for cake and it tasted incredible. My best friend Sam crawled under the table to hide.

"Come out right now!" I yelled at him.

Sam laughed and said, "It is impossible to find me!"

We discovered a big box on the table. I started to wrap my arms around it. My hands were trembling because I was so excited. I opened it and saw a science kit! Everyone started cheering for me. I can’t wait to write a thank you note to my grandma.

We walked through the dark woods and felt scared. My dog Rex followed me closely, bumping my leg. Suddenly, a big dragon flew down and scorched the ground! We ran fast and escaped behind a big rock.

"This is big trouble," I whispered to Rex.

Rex barked and looked at a shiny sword nearby. I grabbed it and walked out like a brave champion. The dragon looked at me and roared loud. I knew something was wrong with its wing. I helped fix it gradually. The dragon was grateful and licked my face.

"You are my friend now," I said happily.

Everything was okay, so we went home for dinner.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. We walked through the tall grass and saw a big lake. It looked like a fun place for boating. Max ran ahead and started barking at a funny squirrel.

"Max, stop shouting!" I yelled at him.

The squirrel grasped a nut and ran up a tree. It was a funny scene. Then we smelled something weird like roasted coffee beans. My dad drinks caffeine every morning so I know the smell. We crossed a little bridge and saw a man camping. He brewed some hot tea on a fire.

"That smells strong," I said to the man.

"It gives me strength for hiking," he told us.

Max was tired so he started sleeping on the leaves. The wind blew hard and it got cold. We walked home seeing lots of bugs. It was the best adventure in our league of explorers.

I was walking to school and my heart was thumping. I realized I left my homework on the kitchen table. It was impossible to go back home now. My teacher Mrs. Green would be very mad at me. I saw my friend Sarah by the playground meadow.

"Did you do the math sheet?" Sarah asked me.

"I did but it disappeared!" I said very sadly.

We went inside and sat at our desks. Mrs. Green asked for our papers and I looked down. Then the principal walked in bearing a piece of paper. It was my homework receipt from my mom! She drove to school just to bring it.

"Here is what you need," the principal said.

I was so happy and now I know I can maintain my good grades.

It was my brother Tim's birthday and he was turning eight. We had a party in the backyard even though it looked like raining. My dad was pumping air into the bouncy castle. He worked hard but he was afraid it wasn't enough.

"Is it ready yet?" Tim asked loudly.

"Just wait a minute," Dad said while wiping his face.

Our dog Buster chewed up the newspaper and ran outside. He thought the castle was a big toy. It was dangerous because his teeth are like a needle! My mom grabbed Buster by his collar and was steering him inside. Neither Tim nor I wanted the bouncy castle to pop. Finally, the castle was complete and looked wonderful. We jumped for hours until we were tired. It was the best day ever.

For my birthday sleepover, my friends and I played pirates. We ran outside and started stamping our feet on the grass.

"We are following the map to the treasure!" shouted Leo.

We dug near the big tree and found a box. Inside was a shiny red jewel made of plastic. It looked real.

"Is it dangerous to touch?" asked Sarah.

"No, simply grab it!" I said.

Suddenly the wind grew very strong and cold. We got scared and threw the jewel back in the box. We ran inside for cake instead. My mom was keeping the pizza warm. It was fun but playing pirates is scary sometimes. We used a needle and thread to fix my pirate hat later.

I was climbing a big mountain on the planet Zog. My robot dog Sparky ran through the red rocks fast. We were looking for the green aliens that hide there. I used my thumb to push the button on my laser.

"Listen to that noise," I said to Sparky quickly. It sounded like a giant buzzing bee.

Suddenly a green alien jumped into the scene! He had three eyes and he looked very tired. He was holding a cup of hot coffee.

"I need caffeine or I can't fly my ship!" the alien yelled.

I did not have any coffee but I had a juice box. I gave it to him and that was enough. He flew away but Sparky didn't want to leave either. We watched his ship zoom into the stars.

Yesterday I went exploring in the woods with my dog. His name is Buster and he likes to guard me. We walked through some big bushes and I got scratched. It felt like a sharp needle poked my leg. I was groaning but Buster licked my knee to help.

Suddenly we saw a shiny blue bug on a rock. It looked like a bright jewel in the sun.

"Look at that cool bug, Buster!" I said loudly.

Buster barked at it but he knew not to eat it. My mom says bugs are just protein but that is gross. Then we caught a frog near the river. I had to do some coaching to get Buster to leave it alone. We did not want to get in trouble so we let it go. I will remember that adventure forever.

One day me and my nephew went boating on the lake. We saw a big green frog jumping on the ground near the water. It was super muddy there. Suddenly the frog disappeared into the tall grass!

"Where did he go?" asked my nephew.

I looked around but I feared he was gone forever. Then we heard a loud splash. The frog was swimming near our boat!

"Look out, he is approaching us!" I yelled.

We greeted the frog but he did not say anything back. We played for a long time. It was enough fun for one day. Then my mom called us for dinner. She was grounding us if we were late. We ran home fast.

It was a weird Wednesday at school. We had a huge math test and I was trembling in my seat. I could not remember the answers at all. The clock struck twelve and it was finally lunchtime.

I grabbed my box and went running outside immediately. My friend Sam was clinging to the monkey bars. He looked like he was climbing a mountain.

"Do you want to play tag?" Sam asked me.

"Neither of us is 'it' yet!" I yelled back.

We ran around for an hour. I often get tired but today I had good rhythm. Suddenly the bell rang loud. I was afraid we would be late. We ran back inside fast. It was a fun day.

I thought my math homework was going to be easy. But then I saw the sheet and started groaning loudly. It looked like a foreign language or something. My heart was pumping fast because I wanted to play outside.

"This is impossible!" I yelled to my mom in the kitchen.

"Just try your best, honey," she said and kept cooking.

I looked at the paper again and my hand was trembling. I wished I was invisible so I could sneak away. Then my dog Buster came in for some company. He jumped up and put his paws on my beautiful desk. He obtained a pencil with his mouth and ran away fast! I had to chase him through the whole house. I did not complain because running was way better than math.

I feared the spooky old cave near my house. My big brother Tom pulled me inside with his strong hands. We walked on the rocky ground and it was very dark.

"I hate this," I grumbled loudly to Tom.

Suddenly, a giant bat crashed into the wall above us! Tom tried to seize my arm but I ran fast. My heart was simply pumping so hard.

"Use your strength!" Tom yelled at me.

I remembered I had a flashlight in my pocket. I turned it on and the bat flew away. We treated ourselves to ice cream later because we were brave. I will write about this in my diary tonight.

My dog Buster and I went climbing up the big hill. The sun was hot and it scorched my neck. We saw lots of nice scenery like green trees. Suddenly a tiny gnat flew in Buster's nose. He sneezed hard and pulled on the leash.

"Stop it Buster!" I called to him loudly.

But he ran fast and crossed the old wooden bridge. Then a big wind blew and a branch broke off. It crashed right onto the path near us. It was real danger! I threw a stick to make Buster come back.

"Let's go home now," I said.

We ran down the hill leaving the scary woods. I will write about our big adventure in my diary. The moon rose up as we got safe inside.

I was eating breakfast when a green alien walked in. He had three eyes and he looked very hungry. He spread purple jelly on my toast and smiled. I thought he was nice until he shouted loudly.

"Give me the remote control now!" he yelled.

I ran through the kitchen door and into the meadow. My robot dog Sparky was waiting there for me. Sparky started groaning and shot lasers from his eyes. The alien got scared and gradually turned invisible. He ran left towards the big blue spaceship. I never paid attention to aliens before today.

"Good boy Sparky!" I said and patted his metal head. We went back inside to finish eating my toast.

I was playing Mario Kart with my big brother. He is thirteen and thinks he is the best player ever. I picked Yoshi because he is green and super fast. My brother picked Bowser because he likes being mean. We were racing on the rainbow track.

"I am going to win this time!" I screamed loudly.

"No way, you are too slow," he said back.

I was approaching the finish line really fast. I threw a red shell at him. It hit him and he started moaning about it. Then I used a shortcut by jumping over the gap. I ended up seeing the checkered flag first! It was like squashing a tiny gnat.

"That wasn't fair!" he yelled.

"I won fair and square, be honest," I told him.

He was mad but I felt happy like I won rock paper scissors.

Yesterday me and my best friend Sam went exploring. We walked to the plain field behind my house. It looked weird because the grass was super tall.

"I think a dragon lives here," Sam shouted loud.

We used our imagination and pretended to be knights. Sam was the guide and I was the guard. Suddenly we heard a scary noise sounding like a growl. My heart started pumping really fast inside my chest.

We saw eight shiny rocks waiting in a pile.

"Look out! It's dragon eggs!" I yelled at him.

We ran away fast but we felt very brave. It was the best adventure ever. Next time we will bring swords.

My neighbor Tom challenged me to a race yesterday. The park scenery was so plain and brown. I felt scared because Tom is really fast. He said, “I guarantee I will beat you today!”

I just nodded and looked at the surrounding trees. We neared the big oak tree start line. My heart was sounding like a drum inside.

“Ready, set, go!” yelled my sister loudly.

I ran fast and fought gravity with my legs. I felt like a ghost flying past him. I won the race and ended his reign! It was certain that I was the winner now. I felt grateful for my new fast shoes. Science class says gravity pulls you down, but not me.

“Wow, you are super fast,” Tom said sadly.

I feared I would lose, but I won!

I trained for the big race for two weeks. My brother said I was too slow, but I kept running. There were thirteen kids at the park for the race. My legs were trembling a little bit because I was nervous.

"Ready, set, go!" my dad screamed very loud.

We all took off and my feet flew fast. I was keeping up with the big kids. Then a boy named Sam stole the lead from me. I ran harder and reached for the finish line. I passed him right at the end! It was a pleasure to win the shiny gold medal.

"Wow, you are actually fast," my brother said without speaking meanly.

I was so happy that I jumped up and down.

I live in a big apartment with my best friend Sam. One day we saw a giant hole in the ground outside. We knew it was a secret tunnel so we jumped in. It was dark and scary but we were brave explorers. Suddenly a huge green beetle crawled out and looked at us. It grew bigger and started to make a loud noise.

"Run away fast!" shouted Sam and he looked really scared.

"I understand him!" I yelled back at Sam. "He is friendly."

I believed the beetle was nice so I grabbed a cookie. I gave it to him and he ate it all up. We counted fourteen more beetles in the tunnel. It was the best adventure ever.

I was playing my favorite video game on Saturday. My character was a brave knight on a big island. The bad guys were surrounding me, and I was scared. My dad sat down and started teaching me a trick. He drove his car on the screen very fast through the mud.

"You have to jump now!" my dad yelled loudly.

"It is impossible to win this level!" I shouted back.

Suddenly, I found a secret glowing sword in a cave. I fought the boss and I actually won the game! I felt like I was dreaming because I was so happy. We ate pizza to celebrate my big win that night.

I had a really big problem at school today. My homework got messed up in my backpack. It was simply the worst day ever. I took out my math paper and saw a huge purple stain. It looked like a big blob of jelly.

"What happened to your homework?" asked my friend Sam.

"My juice box exploded on it!" I yelled.

I felt like my brain was going to pop. I walked to the water fountain to clean it. The water made it soggy and gross. It looked like my dog chewed it up.

Then I went to the computer lab. I saw a shiny jewel sticker on the floor. I put it over the purple stain on my paper.

"That looks cool," Sam said.

My teacher laughed but she still gave me a star. The sounding bell rang and we ran to recess.

I was in big trouble at school today. It happened at recess when we were playing tag. Timmy was steering the game and he ran too fast. He reached out to tag me but he missed.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled and kept running.

I was jumping over a big rock by the swings. I didn't measure the height of the rock right. My finger hit the top and it hurt a lot. I shook my hand hard because it stung.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Sarah.

I looked at the clock and it was almost eight minutes left. That was enough time to play more tag. I had a meeting with the nurse later anyway. I just kept running and had fun.

My neighbor Tim came over on Wednesday to play video games. We played a game about dangerous bungee jumping. It was hard and I struggled to win. Tim is younger than me but he is very fast. His thumb moved so quick on the controller!

"You are going to lose!" Tim yelled at me.

I tried to focus but I was hungry for a snack. I paused the game and spread peanut butter on bread.

"This has lots of protein," my mom said to us.

After the snack, I finally caught up to Tim's score. The game looked beautiful on the big TV screen. Then I won the last level and Tim got mad.

"I want a rematch right now," he said.

We played until dinner and it was the best day ever.

I rode my bike to school this morning. It was freezing outside and my hands were so cold. I forgot my gloves at home on my bed. When I got to school, everyone was surrounding the big heater.

"Did you eat breakfast?" my friend Sam asked me.

"No, I was sleeping too late," I said back.

We had math class for an hour and it was boring. The teacher talked about a mountain of numbers. Then it was finally time for recess. We played tag and I ran very fast. I knocked on the door when recess was over. It was a pleasure to go inside because I was hungry. I left my lunchbox in the hall but I found it. I ate my sandwich and felt much better.

I was stuck inside for recess today because of the rain. It was super boring so I started roaming around the classroom. I looked at the art on the wall. My friend Sam was groaning loudly at his desk.

"What is wrong with you?" I asked him.

"I have to explain this math problem but I can't," Sam said.

He showed me his paper and neither of us knew the answer. It was too hard. Just then our teacher Mrs. Green jumped up. She was drinking her coffee for the caffeine.

"Okay class, stop working and start painting!" she yelled happily.

We all cheered. I drew a big green dragon. At lunch we ate stewed tomatoes and it was gross, but painting was the best part of the day.

My friend Sam and I went to the old forest. We were swinging sticks like swords because we trained for this. Suddenly, we heard a loud roar sounding like a monster! I was scared but Sam kept jumping over the logs.

"Look out!" yelled Sam. "Something big is coming!"

A huge bear came tearing through the bushes. It touched the ground with big paws. I almost started swearing but my mom says that is bad. We ran fast and greeted a tall tree. We climbed up high. The bear crushed a small bush below us. We stayed up there until the bear left. It was the scariest day ever!

My brother Tom and I went camping in the deep jungle. Tom is younger than me but he is very brave. We walked for a long time and the path cleared up. Suddenly we stood still because we heard a loud growl.

"Did you hear that noise?" I asked my brother.

"Maybe it is a tiger or a bear," Tom whispered.

We were scared but we had each other for company. My dad taught us how to be quiet in the woods. We pretended to be invisible behind a big green bush. It was just the beginning of our big adventure today. We waited there and saw a small monkey jump out.

"It was just a monkey!" I laughed loudly.

We did learn that the jungle is a spooky place.

I was bringing my lunch to the cafeteria table. It was pizza day so everyone was happy. I sat next to Tommy and he had a huge apple.

"Is that apple full of protein?" I asked him.

Tommy laughed and said, "No, it is just a fruit."

I used a plastic knife to cut my pizza. Suddenly a cool breeze came through the open window. It blew a gray feather onto my tray. I poked it with my finger.

"We need to learn about birds now," Tommy joked.

We ate fast because we were leaving for recess soon. We met our friends outside at exactly eight o'clock. We played a game about boating on a lake. I pretended I was bungee jumping off the swings. Then my mom drove me home after school. It was a good day.

One day I found a secret island in space. It had green robots roaming around everywhere. I was scared but I had a laser knife. My heart was beating super fast. A big robot walked up to me and made a groaning sound.

"What is the reason you are here?" asked the robot guard.

"I am just looking around," I said.

The robot looked at my brain design on his screen. He was keeping me safe though. A cool breeze went throughout the ship. The robot helped me contain the bad aliens in a box. We became friends and ate space pizza.

I love playing the new racing game on my computer. I did lots of training after school yesterday. My brother Max wanted to play too. We picked our cars and the race started fast.

"You are going too slow!" Max screamed at me.

I was behind him and we were bumping cars. Suddenly I saw a shortcut through a science lab. I turned my wheel and sprinted past him. Then Max got stuck behind a big rock. He was totally trapped!

"Hey, that is not fair!" he yelled loudly.

I laughed and crossed the finish line first. I told him he needs to remain calm next time. It was the best win ever.

It was Wednesday and I had a big math test. I gripped my pencil very tight because I was nervous. The problems were growing harder and harder on the page. My friend Sam looked at me and whispered, "Do you have an eraser?"

I shook my head and kept working on the numbers. Suddenly a cool breeze came through the open window. A piece of paper started floating off my desk! It was my homework from yesterday. It disappeared under the teacher's big desk.

"Oh no, my homework is gone!" I said loudly.

The teacher was reading a newspaper and looked up. She walked over and found the paper crushed in the corner. She spread it out flat on my desk. I stuck out my tongue because I was so happy. Then the bell rang for recess and we ran outside.

For my birthday my friends came over for a sleepover. We decided to pretend we were boating in the living room. My brother wanted to play too but he was annoying. He dressed up like a knight and waved a plastic sword.

"Go away, we are playing a game!" I screamed.

"But I want to protect the boat!" he said.

I tried to maintain my calm but it was hard. Although he was loud, we let him stay. We roasted marshmallows in the microwave later. I touched one and it was super hot. It was enough sugar for everyone. My mom asked what happened to the kitchen. I tried to explain but she just laughed. Then we followed her to the TV room for a movie.

I got up early because I wanted to go camping. My dad bought a big tent and we went to the woods. We walked a long way and my backpack had a lot of weight.

"Are we there yet?" I asked my dad.

"Just a little more walking to do," he said.

We found a good spot and set up the tent. The height of the tent was very tall. Then we roasted marshmallows on the fire. Suddenly I heard a noise in the bushes. It sounded like groaning. I was scared but it was simply a raccoon! He wanted our food but he fell over a log. It was funny. We went to sleep happy.

It was freezing in the dark cave. Me and Sam crawled on the cold rocks. We were looking for the pirate treasure. We ate a big breakfast so we were strong.

Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound. Something big was approaching us fast.

"What is the meaning of that noise?" Sam asked.

I gripped my flashlight tight and looked up. Giant bats were hanging from the ceiling! I grasped Sam's arm and we ran. We crossed a small river and saw a gold box.

"Seize the treasure!" I yelled.

We grabbed the box and ran outside. It was the best adventure ever.

I walked into school wearing my new blue shoes. It was time for lunch and I was so hungry. I opened my lunchbox and saw a wonderful sandwich. It was toasted cheese and it smelled really good.

"Hey, can I trade you for that?" asked Tommy.

"No way, this is my favorite," I said.

Tommy frowned but then he started eating his apple. He tried to gnaw on it like a beaver building a dam. Suddenly, my sandwich started floating in the air! It went up to the ceiling like a ghost. Everyone screamed and pointed at the flying cheese.

"Seize that sandwich!" yelled the teacher Mr. Brown.

But no one could reach it with a knife or fork either. It just floated there all afternoon though. It was the weirdest day ever.

My brother Tim always beats me at racing games. We were playing Speed City on the couch yesterday. The loading screen took forever, but suddenly the race started. My car was red and looked like a roasted hot dog.

Tim’s car was blue and it flew down the track. I tried to listen to the engine sounds to shift gears right.

"You are going to eat my dust!" Tim yelled loudly.

"No way, I am winning this time!" I shouted back.

My tires blew out near the big brick building. My dog came over to gnaw on the controller cord. I crashed into a wall and lost the race again. Next time I will pick the monster truck instead.

We went camping at the big lake last weekend. My dog Buster was jumping around because he smelled squirrels. We put everything in the tent and made a fire. Dad said, "Let's go boating before it gets dark."

We got in the boat and saw a beaver swimming. Suddenly, something bumped us! It was a big log bumping the boat. Buster got scared and scrambled to the back. We went back to shore and roasted marshmallows.

I dropped a crumb on the ground for an ant. I was grateful for the fire because I was cold. Then we heard a knock on a tree. "What happened?" asked my sister.

Dad shined his light and saw an owl. It was a wonderful trip. I felt stronger after hiking all day. Nature is way better than science class.

My friends and I wanted to explore the spooky forest. We walked for a long time and got very lost. Suddenly a big green monster appeared behind a tree.

"Run fast!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

We dropped our backpacks and ran down the hill. We found a small cave and hid inside. It was cold so we made a fire and toasted marshmallows. We had to maintain the fire all night.

In the morning, a nice lady was walking her dog. She was coaching a soccer team nearby.

"Are you kids okay?" she asked us nicely.

We were so grateful she found us. She drove us home again. My mom was so happy she almost sold my bike. It was a scary adventure but we were safe.

My dog Buster is huge and he loves playing outside. One day we walked through the woods behind my house. It was freezing cold but Buster didn't care. Suddenly a big rabbit appeared near a bush.

"Get the bunny, Buster!" I yelled.

Buster twisted his body and started running fast. He was thumping his big paws on the hard ground. The rabbit was fast but Buster was faster. But then Buster tripped on a growing root. He fell down with a loud crash.

"Oh no, my leg hurts," Buster probably grumbled in dog language.

I ran over and he was groaning a little bit. We went inside to warm up by my computer. I gave him a treat and he started wagging his tail. It was like he was cheering for himself. We were done exploring for the day.

I was playing my favorite video game about a brave knight. The loading screen took forever, but I was thrilled to start. My knight had to climb a huge mountain to find a dragon. I grasped my controller tight with all my strength.

"Get ready to be roasted!" I yelled at the TV.

The dragon was scary and made a loud sounding roar. I used my sword and my imagination to fight him. I didn't wait a single second longer to attack. Finally, I beat him and saw the "You Win" message.

"Did you receive the gold trophy?" my brother asked me.

I grinned and said, "Yes, now I have to wrap up the game." Following the rules, I turned it off for dinner.

Yesterday was my birthday and it was raining really hard. I wanted to go to the park but we couldn't go. My mom made a huge cake that looked like a mountain. It had green frosting and little candy rocks all over it. Everyone came over to my house for a sleepover instead.

My friend Sam accidentally knocked the cake off the table. He looked scared and said, "I am so sorry!"

My mom laughed and said, "Don't worry, it still tastes good!"

We ate the smashed cake with spoons and watched movies. I realized it was the best birthday ever even with the mess. We stayed up late and told spooky stories in the dark. I remembered that having fun is better than a perfect cake. We didn't get in trouble and we slept on the floor. I tried to explain the movie to Sam but he fell asleep.

My dog Rusty is very funny but very bad. One day my mom made stewed carrots for dinner. Rusty hates carrots but he loves meat.

"Don't eat that!" I screamed at Rusty. He was jumping on the table.

He grabbed a big piece of lamb with his mouth. It was an important dinner because Grandma was coming over. Rusty ran outside fast and the door closed behind him. I looked out the window. He started to gnaw on the bone. He chewed it for a long time in the grass.

My mom came in and looked at the empty plate.

"Where is the meat?" she asked me.

I pointed outside at Rusty. He looked very happy with his snack.

I was so hungry at lunch today. My tummy felt empty like a big mountain cave. I opened my lunchbox and saw a shiny red apple. It looked like a hidden treasure inside.

"Hey, can I have a bite?" asked my friend Sam.

"No way, I am earning my dessert," I said.

Then the wind blew really hard through the playground. It was cold enough to give someone pneumonia! We ran inside and our teacher greeted us warmly. She was reading a newspaper at her big desk. I felt stronger after eating my apple. I was grateful for recess being over already. We did math next and I stopped myself from swearing because it was hard. But I got through it.

I was loading my backpack because the bus was coming. My schedule was busy today. We had art class and I made a cool design. It was a picture of a floating castle where a king would reign. Then we went to recess and played tag. I ran fast but then I struck my knee on the slide. My friend Billy yelled, "Are you okay?" I said, "Yeah, I just need a band-aid." After lunch I felt tired. My dad drinks caffeine but I am not allowed to have any. Then my teacher heard a knock on the door. It was her nephew visiting our class! He grew so tall since last year. We all scrambled to say hi to him. It was a good day at school.

I was waiting on the secret island for the alien ship. My robot dog Sparky bounced around me with pleasure. He is a good robot and he never gets scared. Suddenly a big green light came down from the sky. It was the aliens and they wanted to reign over Earth!

"Put on your super sweater," Sparky barked at me loudly.

I scrambled to put it on because it gives me powers. I guarantee that I can fly when I wear it. I counted to three and then I flew up fast. I caught the alien ship with my super strong hands.

"Please let us go!" the alien shouted from the window.

I let them go because I finished my hero training yesterday.

Last Saturday was my birthday and it was wonderful. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We rode our bikes to the park first. Then we came home and ate pizza.

"Can we open presents now?" Sam asked me.

"Yes let's do it!" I yelled.

I scrambled to the table and grabbed a big box. I ripped the paper and dropped it on the floor. It was a new Lego set! The pieces scattered everywhere but I didn't care.

Later we drew pictures of space aliens with different colors. Then my mom brought out a cake with nine candles. I closed my eyes and blew them all out. We ate cake and then we slept in my fort. It was the best day ever.

I heard a loud boom outside my window. It was raining green slime and everyone was screaming. A robot landed in my yard and he looked lost. I ran outside to help him with my science kit.

"I need some caffeine!" the robot yelled very loudly.

"I don't have caffeine but I have juice," I said.

The robot drank everything in the box and burped. He told me he was the captain of space. He checked his schedule and said he was late. Then he flew away to search for his planet. It was the best Tuesday ever.

Me and my best friend Sam wanted an adventure. We knew there was a secret cave in the woods. Sam wore his old leather boots and I grabbed a flashlight. The path led us deep into the dark trees.

Suddenly, a huge wind blew and we both froze. It was scary but we grasped hands tight.

"Is that a bear?" Sam whispered loudly.

"I think it's just the wind," I said back.

We kept walking and found a big metal box. It was the greatest treasure ever! We opened it but it was simply empty soda cans. There was no gold and neither of us was happy.

"Maybe the bear drank the caffeine," Sam said.

It was not important though. We were just dreaming of being heroes. We ran home fast before dinner.

We got up early to find the haunted castle. My big brother Max drew a map on paper. We walked for a long time and saw a huge gate. It was swinging in the wind and made a scary noise.

"I am not scared," I said, but I feared the dark inside.

Max grasped my hand and pulled me through the gate. Suddenly we heard a loud moaning sound. It was getting stronger and stronger! A white ghost rose up from the floor.

"Run away fast!" Max yelled at me.

I threw a rock at the ghost and we ran. Gradually the sun came out and the ghost disappeared. We were safe but my legs were shaking. Next time I am coaching Max on how to run faster!

My dog Buddy loves exploring outside in the big woods. We walked on the path leading to the secret creek. The earth felt squishy under my new boots. Suddenly Buddy saw a squirrel and started breathing really fast.

"Get it, Buddy!" I yelled loudly.

He ran through the bushes and disappeared behind a tree. I was thrilled because he was so fast. He rose up on his back legs. He was sounding like a big wolf.

"Come back here!" I shouted.

Buddy came back with mud spread all over his face. He looked silly but happy. We walked home and he needed a bath.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to build a huge fort in the living room. I got all the blankets and Sam got the pillows. We built a giant castle that looked like an island.

"You guard the door!" I yelled to Sam.

"Okay, I will stop the monsters!" he shouted back.

We pretended the floor was water and we were boating across. Suddenly my dad walked in and he caught us jumping on the couch. He was groaning because the room was a big mess.

I feared he would be mad, but he just laughed. He helped us make a flag for our fort. We often play this game but this time was the best. We stayed up late and told spooky stories about the earth. It was so much fun.

We were roaming in the woods behind my house. My friend Max said there was a dragon nearby. We saw a big grey castle on the hill.

"Look at that scary place!" I called to Max.

We walked carefully up the path surrounding the castle. My heart was beating super fast. We counted three big steps and opened the door. It was dark but we saw something shiny. A goblin stole a golden cup and was cleaning it!

Max gave me a thumbs up with his thumb. We ran in and grabbed the cup. The goblin woke up and toasted us with fire! We ran away fast. We slept in my treehouse that night. Nothing bad happened and we didn't go to the hospital. It was good training for next time.

We went to the spooky forest because a goblin stole my ball. The scenery was dark and green. I feared the goblin but my friend Tom was brave. We moved slowly past a big stone fountain. Suddenly, a ringing sound came from the bushes.

"Look out!" I yelled and pointed my thumb at the tree.

A small goblin appeared and it was jumping up and down. It screeched loud and bounced on the grass. We neared the goblin and saw my red ball.

"Give it back please," Tom said nicely.

The goblin met my eyes and smiled. He threw the ball and then he ran away fast. We grabbed the ball and ran home happy.

I was sitting at my desk and the clock neared twelve. My stomach growled really loud and my friend Tommy laughed. Finally the bell rang and I grabbed my blue lunchbox. I ran outside and reached the big slide first.

"Hey, wait for me!" Tommy yelled from behind the swings.

"You have to be faster than that," I said back.

We sat on the grass and I brought a turkey sandwich. Tommy shook his head because he forgot his juice box again. I shared my apple slices with him for being nice.

Our teacher Mrs. Clark walked by and she was speaking softly. She gave us a gold star sticker for sharing our food. I like earning stickers because they are shiny and cool. Then recess ended and we walked back to class slowly.

Yesterday after school I walked home to my apartment. I had to write a big story for homework. I sat on the balcony because it was sunny outside. I took out my paper and my blue scissors. I wanted to cut out pictures for the scene. My mom came outside and she looked very happy.

"Did you listen to the teacher today?" she called.

I nodded my head and showed her my work. I was earning a gold star if I finished fast. Suddenly my paper flew away and disappeared in the wind! I felt a heavy weight in my tummy. My mom ran down the stairs to receive it. She brought it back and I was so happy.

"Next time hold it tight!" she said.

I walked through the woods and saw a strange castle. It was made of blue metal and looked very shiny. I neared the big door and pushed it carefully. Inside, a robot beetle was cleaning the floor with a tiny mop. The beetle was smaller than my thumb!

"Hello," I said to the robot.

"Welcome to Earth," it beeped back at me.

Suddenly, a wonderful breeze blew through the room. I felt stronger than before. I picked up a heavy rock with a single finger. It was simply magic! The robot clapped its metal hands. My adventure was complete.

"What happened to me?" I asked.

"You have super strength now," said the beetle.

I was sitting in class and my stomach made a loud noise. It sounded like a bear roaring throughout the whole room. My teacher Mrs. Miller looked at me and everyone laughed.

"Is there a monster in your tummy?" she asked.

"No, I just really want lunch," I said.

Finally the bell rang and we all ran to the cafeteria. I had a ham sandwich but I forgot to squeeze the mustard. My friend Tom had roasted chicken legs. We bounced our apples on the table to see if they would break. Suddenly Tom stood up and started tearing open a bag of chips. He tripped on his shoelace and crashed into me. My juice box went flying like it was floating in space. It hit the floor and spilled on fourteen kids. It was a huge mess but at least we got to go to recess.

I was sitting in class and it was boring. My teacher Mrs. Miller called my name but I didn't listen. I was looking at the huge mountain of homework on her desk. It looked scary like a ghost.

"Sam, do you have your scissors?" asked Mrs. Miller.

"I think they disappeared," I said and scratched my head.

I reached into my desk and touched something weird. It felt cold. I pulled it out and it was my twisted ruler. It was bent like a bungee cord. I crossed my fingers that she wouldn't see it. The weight of my backpack was heavy too. I didn't have a pencil either. Then the bell rang for lunch and I ran outside fast.

We were earning money for our big adventure. Tommy chewed on his pencil and looked at the map.

"We need to find the secret island today," he said.

I gripped my flashlight tight. We sprinted to the old treehouse in the woods. It looked spooky in the dark. Suddenly, we heard a groaning sound.

"Maybe it's a monster!" I yelled.

We crossed the creek by jumping on big rocks. Tommy almost fell, but he was clinging to a branch. Then we saw it. It wasn't a monster. It was just a bungee cord hitting a tree. We found an old newspaper there with a crumb on it. We didn't find the island, but we did learn to be brave. It was the best day ever.

My big sister Sarah turned fourteen yesterday. We had a wonderful party at our house. It was freezing outside so we stayed in the living room. My younger brother Sam crawled under the table to hide. He wanted to scare Sarah when she walked through the door.

"Is she coming yet?" Sam whispered very loudly.

"Be quiet or you will ruin it!" I said.

Sarah walked in and Sam jumped out fast. To be honest, she didn't look scared at all. She was thrilled anyway because she saw her big cake. Then a tiny gnat flew right into the frosting! We laughed hard enough to hurt our tummies. Nobody had to go to the hospital, but it was super funny. We ate the cake around the bug. It was the best birthday ever.

We were playing Treasure Hunters in my backyard. The grass was the ocean and the porch was an island. My brother Tim was the bad guy.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled.

I sprinted across the ground very fast. I jumped over my dog like he was a little lamb. Then I ran up the hill. It felt like climbing a huge mountain. Tim chased me but he slipped on a toy truck. He crashed into the fence instead of grabbing me.

I counted to ten and touched the big tree.

"I win the game!" I shouted loud.

We found the treasure box under the slide. It was full of candy. We ate it all before dinner.

My friend Sam and I went to the old woods. We counted three big steps and jumped over the fence. My neighbor said a monster lived there, but that sounded impossible. We walked for a long time and reached a dark cave.

"Do not go in there," Sam whispered to me.

I was brave so I walked inside the cold cave. Suddenly, I saw a big, green creature with four eyes! It looked like something from a foreign planet. I touched a slimy rock and the creature roared loudly.

"Run away fast!" I yelled and grabbed Sam’s arm.

We ran back home and we realized we were safe. We never went back to those scary woods again.

Me and my best friend Sam climbed the big mountain. The wind was a cold breeze on our faces. We looked down and saw huge rocks below us.

"Watch out for that hole!" Sam yelled at me.

We kept walking and saw a bridge hanging over water. The bridge was made of old wood and looked scary. It started groaning when I stepped on it. I ran fast and bounced to the other side safely.

Suddenly a big rock came rolling through the trees! It almost crushed Sam but he jumped away fast. That was real danger. We kept growing more brave and kept walking. Finally we saw the treasure chest behind a bush.

"We did it!" I shouted. We were the best explorers ever.

It was a cold day in February. My friend Ben came over to keep me company. We wanted to play the new racing game. The screen was loading for a long time. Finally, the race started and we picked our cars.

"I am going to win this time," Ben said.

I shook my head and picked the red car. Although Ben is fast, I am way better at driving. We zoomed past a bridge and did a bungee jump off a ramp. The cool breeze from the window made me shiver.

"You caught up to me!" I yelled loudly.

My dad was coaching me from the door. I drove super fast to complete the last lap. I won the race and Ben was sad but we played again.

I was playing my favorite video game with my friend Sam. We were racing fast cars on a big track. I was steering my red car around a sharp corner. Sam's blue car was right behind me.

"I am going to win this race!" yelled Sam.

"No way, I am faster than a knight on a horse!" I said.

Suddenly, my car hit a wall and flipped over. It looked like it was going to hit the ceiling! I grabbed my controller tight and tried to fix it. My car landed on its wheels and I drove fast. I left Sam behind in the dust. I stood up and cheered when I crossed the line.

"That was a crazy race," Sam said.

We had a meeting about who would pick the next game. We decided to climb a mountain in a foreign land in the next level.

I was playing the greatest racing video game with my friend Sam. We were racing fast cars and bumping into each other a lot. Suddenly my car crashed into a wall and I started groaning.

"You are going the wrong way!" Sam yelled at me.

"No I'm not, I'm taking a shortcut," I said back.

My dad came in and started coaching me on how to drive better. We played together for a long time until my car crossed the finish line first. It felt like I was floating on air because I won. To be honest, I got lucky that Sam's car escaped off the road.

"Do you want to play again tomorrow?" Sam asked me.

"Yes, but now my mom says we need company for dinner," I said. It was super fun.

I ate my breakfast fast because we had a big mission. My sister and I were going to the spooky attic. Mom was cleaning downstairs so she didn't see us. The door was heavy, and its weight was hard to move. 

"Don't be afraid!" I yelled to my sister. 

We pushed the door open and climbed the dark stairs. It was dusty and I saw a box. I needed scissors to open the tape on it. My sister was my guide and held the flashlight. We obtained the treasure inside the box. It was Dad's old baseball cards!

"This is important!" my sister said.

The light was gradually growing dim. We finished the quest and ran down to be safe. We felt very brave and complete. We didn't even need caffeine to be awake!

I was walking to the park on Tuesday. Suddenly a big metal robot landed on the grass. It was huge and gray and wearing a red cape. The robot had scissors for hands! It looked scary but I had a good feeling. The breeze blew the robot's cape around.

"Hello human," said the robot with a loud beep. "I am lost."

I looked at his map scattered on the ground. It was twisted and old.

"I can help you find your building," I said.

He spread his metal wings out wide. We flew up high and saw everything below us. He was actually bearing a gift for the alien king. We found the castle and landed safely. The robot gave me a high five with his elbow. It was the best day ever.

I was looking off my balcony one hot day. My neighbor Timmy was wearing a big green hat. He was yelling at his dog. The dog was stuck in a mud puddle. Timmy struggled to pull him out.

"Come on, Buster!" Timmy shouted very loud.

I ran down to help him pull. We pulled and pulled until we were breathing hard. Finally, Buster popped out like a cork!

"Thanks for coaching me," Timmy said with a smile.

We pretended the puddle was a big ocean. We were boating to a secret island nearby. Suddenly, an imaginary elephant struck the water with its trunk! We ran away laughing. It was enough fun for one day. We were leaving the mud behind us now. But I was yearning to go back and play again.

One day me and my best friend Sam went exploring. We found a scary old house on the hill. Sam said, "I am certain a ghost lives inside there." We walked in and heard a loud moaning sound. It was spooky so we wanted to run away fast. But then we saw a shiny red jewel on the floor. I tried to seize it but a rat tried to gnaw my shoe! Sam threw his toasted cheese sandwich at the big rat. The rat started eating the sandwich and ignored us. We ran outside and didn't remain in that scary company. Sam was dumping his backpack out looking for snacks. He said, "I need some caffeine to stay awake now!" We went home safe.

Me and my neighbor Tim went camping in the scary woods. We pushed through big bushes and kept bumping into trees. Tim had a newspaper to help start our fire later. We wanted to learn the meaning of the spooky cave drawings.

"Look at that shiny thread!" shouted Tim.

He pointed at a web but neither of us touched it. Suddenly a bat flew right out of the cave! I opened my backpack and grabbed my flashlight fast.

"I am coaching you on how to be brave," I said.

We ran back to the tent and roasted marshmallows instead. The cave was too scary for us today.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for a secret cave with old pirate gold. The scenery was full of big green trees and bushes. A cool breeze was blowing, and the birds were singing. We walked through the dark forest for a long time. Suddenly, I heard a loud ringing sound in my ears.

"Did you hear that weird noise?" asked Sam.

"Yes, I have a bad feeling about this," I said.

We saw a foreign coin on the ground and I counted three more. Then lightning struck a tree near us! We got scared and ran back home fast. We did not find the treasure throughout the whole woods. Maybe next time we will find where the pirates reign.

Me and my best friend Tom went on a big adventure. We wanted to find the lost cave in the woods. We walked for a long time and we reached the big hill. Suddenly lightning struck a tree and it fell down!

"Watch out!" Tom screamed.

We were in big trouble. The tree almost crushed us but we jumped away fast. I was scared and I feared the storm.

"What happened?" I asked Tom.

He pointed to a dark hole under the fallen tree. It was the cave! We crawled inside to stay dry throughout the storm. I will always remember that day. We found the cave and we were safe.

I went camping in my backyard with my dog Buster. It was weird sleeping outside instead of in my bed. We were hanging out by the old stone fountain. I was training Buster to sit, but he kept jumping.

"Sit down right now!" I shouted at him loudly.

Buster did not learn very fast, although he tried. Suddenly he saw a big green frog jumping away. He caught the frog and started bringing it to me.

"Drop it, Buster! That is gross!" I yelled.

He dropped the frog and started cleaning his paws. I felt like a king and this was my reign. Then we went inside for painting pictures of the frog. It was a really fun night with my best friend.

One morning I ate my breakfast and thought about treasure. I wanted to be a brave knight so I went outside. My friend Tim came over and he shouted, "Let's go!"

We walked to the big woods and it got dark. Suddenly a ghost came floating by us. It was freezing cold and I was scared. The ghost sang a scary song but we did not run. Tim read a map and found a cave. Inside there was a big dragon sleeping on gold.

The dragon woke up and roared with a fire tongue. We roasted marshmallows on his fire and he was nice. We grew happy and everyone started cheering for us. We found the meaning of being brave that day.

I have a cat named Colonel Fluff. He is very fat and lazy. Yesterday we went outside to play in the tall grass. I pretended we were in a foreign land. Colonel Fluff saw a big bug crawl through the dirt.

"Look at that monster!" I yelled at my cat.

Colonel Fluff just meowed and laid down on his tummy. To be honest, he does not like hunting bugs. I counted three ants on his paw. He didn't care about them either. I promise and guarantee he is the laziest cat ever. I will write a book about him one day.

"Time for dinner, Colonel!" I said.

He ran inside fast for his food.

My best friend Sam and I went walking through the dark woods. We were looking for the greatest treasure ever. It was a shiny jewel hidden in a cave. We walked for a long time. The trees grew very tall.

"Do we have enough food?" Sam asked me sounding scared.

"Yes, we have apples," I said.

We neared the big cave. We heard a loud growl. It was a bear! We ran fast without looking back. Leaving was the best idea. Seeing the bear was scary but meeting it would be worse. We did not complete our quest. But we had the pleasure of each other's company. Maybe we will go back when we are growing bigger.

I reached into my backpack and pulled out my lunchbox. It was finally time to eat because my brain was tired. We had math all morning and it was so hard. I opened the plastic lid and saw my sandwich inside.

"Oh no," I said loudly to my friend Max.

Max looked over and asked, "What is wrong with your lunch?"

"My mom made me plain bread again," I said, groaning.

I wanted a toasted cheese sandwich but I just got bread. I was so hungry that I ate it anyway. Then I read my book until the bell rang for recess. We ran outside and threw the red ball back and forth. Next time I will make my own lunch.

Me and my friend Sam went on a big adventure. We pretended to be brave knights in the backyard. We had plastic swords and a map.

"Look at that big dragon!" Sam yelled loudly.

It was actually just my dog Buster. We ran past him to the old tree house. It was very high up and scary. I was clinging to the ladder. We needed to find the hidden treasure box. It was super important. We opened the box with some scissors.

"It’s full of gold!" I shouted happy.

But it was actually just chocolate coins instead. We didn't play any longer because we got hungry. We ate the treasure and it tasted great.

My younger brother Max and I went to the forest. We feared the big cave but we wanted the treasure. It was a golden cup from a king's reign.

"Look at that dark hole!" called Max.

I grabbed my flashlight and my heart was pumping fast. We walked inside and saw a shiny thing. A spider grew big in the shadows. I had to squeeze past a rock to get it. I tried to seize the cup with a single hand. Suddenly a bat brewed up a storm of dust.

"Run away!" I shouted.

We ran out fast and we felt complete. Everyone was cheering for us when we got home. We did learn that caves are very scary places.

Tomorrow is my big birthday party and I am so excited. I drew a picture of the cake I want. It will be blue and beautiful with lots of sprinkles. I heard my mom talking on the phone to Grandma.

"Can you bring the balloons?" Mom asked.

"Yes, I will bring the big red ones!" Grandma said.

I feared that nobody would come to my party. I sat on my bed feeling a little bit sad. My dog Buster came in and chewed on his toy. He looked happy so I felt better. Then my friends came over and everyone was cheering for me. We played tag and ate pizza until my tummy hurt. It was the best day ever.

It was my birthday party and I was growing really excited. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We ate pizza and I struggled to cut it with a plastic knife. Then it was time for presents! I grabbed the biggest box first. I opened it fast and saw a cool costume inside.

"Wow, look at this!" I yelled. "It is a silver knight suit!"

"That is so cool," said Sam. "Put it on right now!"

I put on the helmet but I realized it was stuck. I pulled hard but it stayed on my head. I trained like a real soldier to get it off. Finally my dad helped me. We laughed a lot and then we ate chocolate cake. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my dog Rover were running in the woods. Rover is trained to follow me, but he saw a squirrel. He dropped his ball and chased it fast. I ran after him past a big plain field. Suddenly, I discovered a dark cave with a scary sign. The sign said "Keep Out" but Rover ran inside.

"Rover! Come back!" I yelled loudly.

I heard a loud whistle sound from deep inside. I walked in and my foot hit a metal chain. Then the ground shook and rocks crashed down. My heart sank because it was so dark.

"Is anyone there?" I whispered.

Rover barked and licked my hand. We ran out fast and everyone was cheering for us when we got home. I woke up and it was just a dream.

Yesterday at school was incredible because we had art class. We were painting huge pictures of dragons and knights. I blew on my paper to dry the paint.

"Look at my green dragon!" shouted my friend Tim.

"It looks like a pickle instead," I grinned back.

Suddenly, Tim dropped his brush on the ground. Splat! Green paint went everywhere on the floor. The teacher heard the noise and walked over fast. She looked certain that we made a mess on purpose.

"You two are already in trouble," she said loudly.

She sent us to the office to sit and wait. We stewed in the chairs for a long time. It was scary but we laughed about the pickle dragon.

One day my dog Buster got loose from his chain. He ran into the woods and I shouted for him. I was scared because he never cleared the fence before. I ran fast and my face felt hot like a rose. A big blue vein popped out on my neck from screaming.

"Buster come back right now!" I screamed loudly.

I found him waiting by a big muddy puddle. He was bouncing around and dumping mud everywhere. He looked at me with yearning eyes.

"You are a bad dog Buster!" I said.

He barked and bounced again for no good reason. I wasn't going to sell him or anything though. We walked home and I wasn't mad either. I gave him a treat because I was just glad he was safe.

One day my brother Sam and I went boating. We rowed our boat to a tiny island. The water was very steady and quiet. Suddenly Sam saw something moving in the grass.

"Look at that giant frog!" he yelled.

The frog jumped high and landed on a rock. I reached out my hand very slowly. I knew I had to be fast. I caught the slimy frog with my net.

"We should eat it," Sam said. "Like roasted or stewed frog legs."

"No way!" I said. "We can't eat him."

We pulled the boat onto the sand. We looked for bugs throughout the whole island. We found beetles but we never sold the frog. We let him go back to his family. It was the best day ever.

I was so pleased because recess was finally here. I knew exactly what I meant to do today. My friend Sam and I ran to the swings immediately. We moved fast because only two swings were left.

"I bet I can go higher than you!" I shouted.

"No way, I am way better at swinging," Sam grumbled.

We pumped our legs hard and grew taller in the air. Gravity pulled me down, but I went back up. I was leading for a bit, but then the bell rang.

"Aww man, recess is over already?" Sam asked sadly.

"Unfortunately, yes," I said.

We jumped off and landed in the sand. Eight minutes was not longer enough for recess. We walked back to class hanging our heads down. Next time I will get the swings even faster.

My dog is named Buster and he loves paper. Yesterday I had to do my math homework. It was really hard and almost felt impossible. I put my worksheet on the table and went outside. I saw my dad coaching my brother in soccer. They were running around and having fun. Then I went back inside for a snack. But my homework had disappeared! I looked everywhere.

Suddenly Buster appeared with white stuff on his nose. He chewed up the whole paper! 

"Oh no, Buster!" I yelled. "You are a bad dog."

My mom said, "Now you have to explain this."

So I drew a picture of Buster eating it. My teacher laughed and said I was the champion of funny excuses. I promised to go boating with my homework next time so he can't reach it.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house today. The sun was hot and it scorched the grass. My dog Buster ran ahead on the trail and barked at a squirrel. The squirrel fought with a nut and then ran up a tree.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled really loud.

Buster stopped and looked at me with his tongue out. He was waiting for a treat. I reached into my pocket and chose a piece of beef jerky. My mom says jerky has lots of protein. I threw it and it scattered into pieces on the ground. Buster ate it all up fast.

"You are a good boy," I told him.

We climbed up a big hill to see the height of the trees. It was a fun day outside.

I was so hungry when the bell rang for lunch. Today was special because we were pretending to be camping. My teacher Mrs. Lee lit a fake fire in the middle of the room. We roasted marshmallows on pencils and sat on the floor.

"Look at me, I am a sailor!" shouted Tommy. He was climbing on a chair like it was a boat.

"Get down straight away, Tommy," said Mrs. Lee.

Then we went outside for recess and started running. I kept bumping into my friends because we were playing tag. We pretended an elephant was roaming around the playground. I ran super fast and I won the game. It was just the beginning of the best day ever. I love it when we learn new things at school.

It was my birthday and I turned thirteen today. My neighbor Sam came over for a sleepover and we were so excited. We knew it would be a fun night. We grabbed some marshmallows and went to the backyard. My dad roasted them on the fire and they tasted great. Then Sam saw something shiny in the grass. He looked down and it was a blue jewel.

"Look at this!" Sam shouted and held it up.

"Wow, is it magic?" I asked him quietly.

Suddenly a big dog came approaching us through the bushes. We froze because we were scared. Then my dad struck a funny pose with his guitar. He played a loud song and the dog ran away fast. Later we wrote a song about the magic jewel. It was the best birthday ever.

My friends and I went to the spooky island yesterday. We wanted to find the secret pirate gold. We walked on a muddy trail into the dark woods. Suddenly a big red bird flew right over our heads. It sang a loud song and dropped a shiny key.

"Look at that gold key!" shouted my friend Sam.

I picked it up and sticking out my tongue. It tasted like old metal and dirt. My brain told me to run away fast. But we kept walking and earning our bravery points. We found a small box under a tree with sharp needles.

"Open it with the key!" yelled my sister.

I looked inside and saw chocolate coins. We were keeping the treasure forever.

I was so excited because today was the big soccer game. The breeze felt nice on my face and I ran fast. Our team worked together and we passed the ball a lot. The other team was tough but we kept trying hard.

Suddenly the ball escaped from the goalie and rolled near me. I kicked it super hard and it went right into the net!

"Goal!" I shouted really loud and jumped up high.

My coach looked at his schedule and blew the whistle. It was finally time for the game to be over. We won the game and everyone was cheering for us.

"We did it!" said my friend Sam with a big smile.

We played just enough to win the shiny gold trophy. Keeping the trophy is going to be the best part ever.

My neighbor Tom challenged me to a climbing race. He said he was the greatest climber ever. We ran to the big oak tree in my backyard. I gripped the first branch and pulled myself up. My heart was thumping really fast in my chest. Tom was groaning because he struggled to lift his leg.

"You are too slow!" I shouted down at him.

"This is impossible!" Tom yelled back.

I was hanging from a high branch like a monkey. I trained for this all summer with my dad coaching me. I discovered a secret way up near the top. I used my legs like scissors to hold on tight. I touched the highest leaf first and I won! It was the best day ever.

I was walking through the woods behind my house. I often go there to look for cool bugs. I heard a loud noise and then something crashed. I feared it was a big bear or a monster. I neared the big oak tree and looked around. It was just my neighbor Tommy! He was wearing a superhero cape and reading a comic. He looked like he was in a special league.

"What are you doing here?" I yelled at him.

"I tried to climb the tree but fell," Tommy said.

I met his dog Sparky there too. Sparky had his eyes closed and was sleeping in the leaves. We played tag until it got dark outside.

One day in February I was walking to school. I discovered a glowing green rock in the grass. Suddenly a small alien jumped out from behind a tree. He had three eyes and was stamping his feet.

"Give me my power rock!" the alien called loudly.

I knew he was angry so I scrambled away fast. The alien started groaning and gradually turned purple. I threw the rock back to him quickly. He caught it and started jumping up and down happily.

"I guarantee I will not zap you now," he said.

Then he flew away into the clouds. It was the weirdest day ever.

I was walking to lunch with my friend Sam. We were so hungry and my stomach was groaning loudly. I opened my lunchbox and discovered a giant beetle on my sandwich!

"Eww, get it off!" I screamed and dropped the box.

Sam grabbed a napkin and he looked very certain. He is never scared of bugs or creepy things. He picked up the beetle and it was wiggling its legs.

"I am simply moving him to the grass," Sam said.

Gravity made my sandwich fall face down on the floor. Now there was a big purple stain from the jelly. My teacher was approaching us and she looked mad. I was not speaking because I was too sad about my lunch. I wish I was still sleeping in my bed.

Me and my best friend Leo went into the woods. We wanted to search for the hidden cave. Everyone said it was impossible to find. We walked through the tall grass for a long time. Suddenly, a big thumping sound came from behind a bush.

"What was that?" Leo asked and looked scared.

"Maybe it is a bear," I whispered back.

A small puppy appeared and bounced over to us! It had a broken chain on its neck. The puppy tried to squeeze between two big rocks. It struggled to get free. We counted to eight and pulled the rocks apart. The puppy was happy and started cheering in dog barks.

"I don't understand where it came from," Leo said.

I could not explain it either. We took the puppy home and named him Rocky. It was the best adventure ever.

I trained all week for the big soccer game. The other team was huge like a mountain and scary. My legs were trembling when the whistle blew.

"Pass it here!" my friend Leo yelled loudly.

I ran fast and kicked the ball hard. The goalie jumped but he missed it. It touched the net and we scored a goal! I felt so happy inside. Then the game grew harder and we got tired. Leo threw the ball in, but they stole it.

"Oh man, that's not fair," I grumbled.

But then I stole it back and sent it flying. The ball gradually rolled past the line for another goal! We won the game and got ice cream after. It was the best day ever.

Tim and I walked deep into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. My tummy was hungry, but I ignored it. Suddenly, the ground broke under Tim’s feet! He fell into a deep hole and started groaning.

"Are you okay down there?" I yelled loudly.

"My leg hurts, but I see something shiny!" Tim shouted back.

I was trembling, but I had to be stronger. I reached down with a long, thick branch. Tim grabbed it and I pulled him up. We looked at the gold coin he found. We felt like champions. We were thrilled to complete our mission. We sang all the way home because we were rich.

I was training for my big mission on the computer. My friend Sam greeted me at the secret base. We had to find the lost diamond. We walked carefully into the dark cave. Suddenly we saw a big hole in the ground.

"We need the bungee cord!" I shouted loudly.

Sam grabbed the rope from his bag quickly. We jumped down and it was very scary. We saw a dragon keeping the diamond safe. I was certain we could trick him.

"Throw the sleeping powder now!" Sam yelled.

The dragon fell asleep and I took the shiny gem. We climbed out and ran home fast. Tomorrow we will go on another adventure.

We were boating down the river on a hot day. The scenery was green and very pretty. Suddenly, we saw a dark cave approaching fast. My friend Max looked scared, but I was thrilled.

"Do we have to go inside?" asked Max.

"Yes, there might be treasure!" I shouted back.

We crossed into the dark and rocks were scattered everywhere. It felt like a foreign land. Then we heard a growl. I pulled out my plastic knife just in case. A big bear was sleeping on a pile of gold! We grabbed one coin and ran away fast. We were safe, and now we are rich!

One day my dog Spot and I went exploring. We ran through the woods behind my house. Spot started jumping and barking at a big tree. I looked up and saw a squirrel on a branch.

"Come down here!" I shouted at the squirrel.

The squirrel just screeched and threw a nut at me. It felt like he was the king and this was his reign. Spot was groaning because he wanted to catch it. I grasped Spot’s collar so he wouldn't run away. Then I used my imagination. I drew a map in the dirt with a stick.

"We are loading up and leaving, Spot," I said.

We walked home dumping dirt out of our shoes. To be honest, I think the squirrel won. Next time I will watch him from my balcony.

My neighbor Tom believed a monster lived in the woods. We started our quest when a cool breeze blew. I felt a heavy weight in my backpack. I brought snacks and Tom brought a big stick. The path led us deep into the dark trees. Leaves were scattered everywhere on the ground.

"I have a bad feeling," Tom whispered loudly. 

Suddenly we heard a loud crunching sound nearby. Something chewed on a bone behind a big bush. I was so scared I could not move.

"Run back home!" I yelled at Tom.

We ran fast and my legs felt like jelly. We got home safely and stewed about the monster. We never went back to those woods again.

Me and my best friend Sam went to a spooky island. We wanted to find the lost gold of a pirate champion. We walked for a long time in the hot sun. Suddenly a big scary monster appeared behind a green bush. It was wearing a funny red hat and stamping its feet.

"Do you have a sharp knife?" Sam asked me quietly.

"No, I brought a ham sandwich instead," I said.

The monster laughed with pleasure and ate the sandwich quickly. He was actually nice and showed us the gold. We took some gold coins home and bought ice cream. It was the best adventure ever.

I was steering my bike to school and I was hungry. My tummy was making loud noises like a lion. At recess, I opened my lunchbox and I discovered something bad. My banana was squished and simply spread all over my sandwich.

"Oh no, my lunch is ruined!" I yelled loudly.

My friend Sam looked at the mess and laughed. "That looks like yellow slime," Sam said.

Then a bee came flying around my head. It was looking for something sweet and stinging. I started stamping my feet to scare it away. The bee got trapped under my hat! I ran very fast. Finally, the bee flew away and I was safe. I was so tired I felt like sleeping in class. It was a very crazy day.

One Saturday morning I woke up really early. I wanted to climb the big dirt hill. We call it the mountain. My dog Buster was greeting me at the door. I grabbed my backpack and we went outside.

We walked to the hill and saw a shiny green beetle. "Look at that bug, Buster!" I said. Buster sniffed it and sneezed. Then we started steering our way up the path. It was steep and I kept bearing left.

Suddenly, I tripped on a rock and crashed down. "Ouch, my thumb!" I yelled. I was groaning but I wasn't in big trouble. I pretended I was a brave knight. We crossed the top of the hill. Later we went home and ate toasted bread. Exploring is hard work.

It was a hot Wednesday and me and Tim were exploring. We found a cave behind the old park. It was dark inside and we heard a loud groaning noise. Tim grabbed my arm and he squeezed it hard.

"Did you hear that scary sound?" Tim whispered to me.

I nodded and we saw something floating in the air. It was just a white plastic bag. We laughed but then the ground started to shake. We scrambled over some rocks to get away fast. I had my lucky scissors in my pocket. I used them to cut some vines blocking the way. Then I let out a huge sneeze. A piece of paper fell out of the bag. It was just an old receipt from the grocery store.

"Let’s get out of here!" I yelled loudly.

We ran home and ate ice cream.

One sunny morning, Tim and I climbed the big mountain behind my house. We wanted to find treasure like a real pirate sailor. The grass was tall and I pushed through the bushes. Suddenly, we discovered a dark cave with a huge rock inside.

"I bet a dragon is sleeping in there," I whispered quietly.

Tim looked scared and grumbled, "I don't like dragons."

We tiptoed inside, but then I felt a tickle in my nose. I tried keeping it in, but I let out a giant sneeze! A bat flew out and scared us. We ran all the way home fast.

Tim grinned and said, "That was the best adventure ever!"

It was the big soccer game on Saturday. I checked the schedule and grabbed my cleats from the closet. My leg scratched against the door but it didn't hurt much.

When we got to the field, the grass was wet. I ran fast and felt a vein pop in my neck. My friend Sam kicked the ball hard across the ground.

"Pass it to me now!" I yelled really loud.

Sam kicked it and I swept my leg to stop it. Neither of the other team's players saw me go by. I ran past the goalie and scored the winning goal!

"You are the best player ever," Sam said to me.

I felt like I swam through the air because I was so happy. We won the big trophy and everyone cheered.

My cousin and his nephew came over for video games. We played a racing game with fast cars. I was steering my blue car really well. But then a tiny gnat flew right in my face!

"Go away bug!" I screamed at the TV.

I tried to swat it but I turned my wheel. My car crashed into a wall and exploded. My cousin laughed at me and ate a cookie. A crumb fell on his shirt but he didn't care.

"You need more protein for energy," he told me.

I knew I was going to lose the race now. I wasn't sleeping either because I was so mad. Next time I will win the big trophy.

My friends and I climbed the big mountain. We wanted to find the magic red jewel. Max was jumping over rocks and I was stamping my feet. Suddenly a big wind blew very hard. We saw a cave and went inside it. There was a weird creature sleeping by a fountain.

"Don't wake him up!" whispered Max loudly.

"I see the jewel!" I said back.

I grasped the shiny rock and grabbed Max’s arm. The creature woke up and roared. We ran very fast down the hill. We were scared but happy because we won.

My cat Fluffy loves to climb way too high. One day she climbed the big oak tree outside. She went up to a scary height and got stuck. I heard her meowing loudly but I did not understand her. It sounded like she was speaking a foreign language!

"Come down right now, Fluffy!" I yelled at her.

She just screeched back at me and kept clinging tight. Her claws were like needles digging into the bark. I saw a vine with stinging nettles near her tail though. I ran inside and got the big garden scissors carefully. My dad came out and helped me cut the vine away. Fluffy finally jumped down into my arms. We were cheering because she was safe. She looked at the tree with yearning but she stayed on the ground.

I gripped the controller super hard and my thumb hurt. My big brother Tom was crushing me in the race. He was seeing the finish line already. I twisted my hands but my car still crashed.

"You're never going to win!" Tom laughed at me.

"Just wait, my reign is approaching!" I yelled back.

I was keeping my eyes on the screen. Suddenly Tom scratched his nose and looked away. That was my chance! I zoomed past him on the foreign track. Neither of us blinked for a second. I crossed the line first and he was crushed.

"Good game," Tom said, coaching me a little bit.

I was grateful I finally beat him. Winning felt awesome.

My robot named Zork had a shiny blue jewel. It was the reason he was stronger than other robots. But one day a green alien ship crashed in my backyard! The alien was roaming around and he looked mad.

"Give me that jewel right now!" the alien yelled.

Zork stood straight and did not move. He knew the alien wanted to reign over Earth. The alien shot a laser but Zork was clinging to the ground. Zork used his heavy weight to stay safe. Then Zork toasted the alien with his fire arm. The alien ran away fast. My mom was inside brewing tea and she didn't know anything. I was cheering for Zork. Now the alien is probably sleeping in space.

Me and my best friend Tim went into the woods. We were pretending to be a brave knight and a wizard. Tim shouted, "Look out for the dragon!" We saw a dark cave and heard a moaning sound. It was scary but we had to be brave together.

We walked inside and saw a dog roaming around. He looked sad and chewed on an old stick. The dog was in big trouble because his leg hurt. Tim said, "We have to help him, it is important." I used my brain and gave him my sandwich to gnaw on. The dog did not complain and ate it fast. We grew happy because we saved him. We named him Dragon and walked home.

I was sitting at my desk and my tummy growled loud. It was almost lunchtime and I was so hungry. My neighbor Tim looked at me and laughed.

"Is there a monster in your belly?" he asked.

"No, I just want my sandwich," I said.

Finally the bell rang and we ran outside to the playground. I sat on the big rock like it was an island. The sun was hot and I felt like a roasted turkey. I opened my lunchbox and saw my sandwich. The bread was toasted just right. Then I saw a bag of chips but I couldn't open it. I wished I had my scissors. I scratched my head and pulled hard. The bag exploded everywhere! It looked like a mountain of chips on the ground.

"Oh no, now the ants will eat lunch," I said sadly.
