My friends and I went into the dark woods. We were yearning for a big adventure. I counted the steps to the secret cave. It was exactly fourteen steps past the old tree.

"Look at that shiny thing!" yelled Mike loudly.

It was a fountain hidden in the rocks. The water looked weird and foreign to us. Suddenly a big bee flew out. It had a stinger like a sharp needle. We started running very fast back home. Mike was swearing he would never go back.

"I know we are safe now," said Sarah.

We were tired but we had fun anyway.

It was my birthday and Mom brewed some hot chocolate. My friends came over and we were jumping on the bed. Then we went to the kitchen for cake. It was vanilla and plain but it tasted like heaven. 

"Make a wish!" my friend Sarah yelled loudly. 

I blew out the candles and everyone started singing. But then I dropped my cake and it made a stain. 

"Oh no, that is my favorite shirt!" I cried.

Mom said it was okay and not important. We toasted some bread and ate that instead. It was a fun adventure even with the mess. We swam in the pool later and I was so happy. Next year I want a chocolate cake.

My dog Max is usually brave but today he was scared. We were exploring the woods and we saw a big river. Max started trembling because he hates cold water. I tried steering him away but he pulled straight ahead. Suddenly, a squirrel jumped from a high branch like a bungee cord! It almost struck Max right on his nose.

"Watch out Max!" I yelled loudly.

Max barked and ran in circles like he lost his brain. The squirrel ran up a tree to the leafy ceiling.

"That was close," I said to Max.

He wagged his tail and waited to receive a treat. We walked home and stayed away from flying squirrels.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so excited. My best friend Sam came over and brought his dog. We sat on the floor and spread out all my toys.

"Look at this cool car!" Sam called out loud.

Suddenly the lights went out and the room was dark. We looked through the window but it was pitch black outside. Then we heard a weird whistle sound. It was surrounding the house and it was scary.

"I think something is trying to gnaw on the door," I whispered.

My mom came in and struck a match for a candle.

"It is just the wind, silly boys," she said laughing.

We closed the curtains tight and ate cake in the dark. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my nephew Tim went to the spooky forest. We walked through the dark trees and heard a noise. 

"Did you hear that?" Tim whispered.

I grabbed my flashlight and shined it around. Suddenly, a big green monster bounced out! It had thirteen eyes and sharp teeth. We were scared but I threw a rock at it. The monster roared loudly. Then I realized it was just a robot. It had wires scattered everywhere.

"Look, I think it needs batteries," I said.

We climbed a tree to get away but the branch broke. We gradually slid down. Then the robot started to sneeze. It sounded funny. I used my scissors to cut a wire. The robot stopped moving. We ran home fast!

My robot Zog was the greatest robot on earth. I built him with parts scattered in my yard. He had super strength and shiny twisted metal arms. One day, a green alien ship crashed through the trees. It made a loud thumping sound and scared my dog.

"Help me fix my ship," the alien said simply.

Zog was groaning because his battery was low. But he walked over and touched the broken ship. His magic hands brought the engine back to life.

"Thank you for earning my trust," the alien beeped.

The scenery was beautiful as the ship flew away. Zog just smiled and went back to sleep.

My birthday sleepover was super fun until we got hungry. My mom made a cake but my brother sat on it! It was totally crushed and the frosting spread everywhere on his pants.

"You look like a blue swamp creature!" I yelled at him.

He was crying but my dad started laughing. We had to search for cookies instead. We found a box but there was only a crumb left. My dad was getting mad and I think he was swearing quietly.

"Let's just order pizza," my friend Sam said.

We waited for an hour and our hunger was growing big. Finally the pizza came. It had extra cheese and I pulled a long thread of it. It was the best birthday ever even with the squashed cake.

My big brother Tom thinks he is the best at everything. He is always jumping around and showing off his basketball moves. I wanted to beat him, but I was too short.

One day, I practiced my shooting for a longer time. I threw the ball up and it flew right in. My confidence grew big.

"I bet I can beat you today," I said to Tom.

"Yeah right, you are too little," he laughed at me.

We played a different game called Horse. I believed I could win. I pulled my arm back and shot the ball high. Swish! Tom missed his turn and got a letter. I won the game!

"Let's play again tomorrow," Tom said. He was surprised I beat him.

My brother and I went camping in the big woods. We were looking for a lost treasure chest. Suddenly, a huge wind blew my hat off my head. We heard something groaning behind a big rock.

"Is that a monster?" I asked my brother.

"Maybe it is a wild elephant roaming around," he said.

We walked closer and I had to squeeze through some bushes. It was not a monster or an elephant at all. It was just a little white lamb! The lamb chewed on an old paper receipt. Then my brother played his guitar and the lamb liked it. We did not find the treasure but we met a new friend. We felt like we won a champion trophy anyway. It was the best adventure ever.

My best friend Leo had a sleepover for his birthday. We watched a scary movie about a weird creature. Leo said, "I bet that monster is real." I laughed and told him he was dreaming. Then we ate pizza and it was the best.

The next morning his mom drove us to the park. We played soccer and pretended we were in a big league. Leo is tall for his height so he was the goalie. Suddenly we discovered a strange bug on the grass. Leo loves science so he picked it up carefully.

"Look at this important bug!" he yelled loudly. We watched it crawl following a trail of ants. We decided the bug should reign over the ants like a king. But then we had to leave because of the schedule. It was a really fun day.

My dog Buster and I went exploring the mountain yesterday. The sun was hot and it scorched the grass brown. Buster was stamping his feet because he was excited. We scrambled through the bushes to find a secret fort.

"Look at that big rock, Buster!" I yelled.

Buster barked and ran ahead to keep me company. We sat down carefully to eat our snacks. I wished I had caffeine but mom said no.

"This is wonderful," I said to Buster while he chewed a stick.

Suddenly Buster started groaning because he saw a squirrel. I held his collar so he wouldn't run away. I guarantee he would get lost in the woods. We were grateful to receive some cool water later. I thought it was the best day ever.

Me and my best friend Sam were simply playing outside. We discovered a secret cave behind the old painting in my garage. It was dark and scary but we went inside.

"I am yearning for an adventure!" Sam yelled loudly.

Suddenly a big green monster jumped out at us. My heart was pumping super fast and I was scared. I gripped my flashlight tight and shined it at the monster. The monster hated the light and ran away deep inside.

"We escaped!" I shouted and we ran back home fast.

I feared the monster would follow us but it didn't. We were safe in my room and I was so grateful. Maybe next time we will be a sailor on a boat instead.

Max and I went into the dark, scary woods. We were looking for the lost golden cup. Suddenly, I heard a loud stamping noise behind a big tree.

"Run Max!" I screamed. "It’s a giant bear!"

We ran fast but then we got trapped by a river. The bear was seeing us and he looked really hungry. I grabbed a big stick and threw it. The bear looked at the stick and ran away. We crossed the river and found the cave. Gold coins were scattered everywhere on the ground.

"Look!" shouted Max. "I found the golden cup!"

We ran back home and everyone greeted us like heroes. I felt like a champion. Everyone was cheering for us because we were brave.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to tell scary stories in my backyard tent. It was freezing outside so my nose was stinging. We brought big blankets and spread them on the ground.

Suddenly we heard a weird moaning sound near the fence.

"Is that a ghost?" Sam asked me, feeling scared.

"Maybe it's a monster meaning to eat us!" I said.

We heard more groaning and a loud rustle. We started running back to the house fast. Then my dad jumped out with a white sheet. It was just a silly sign that he was pranking us. We laughed but my heart was beating really fast. Next time we are staying inside.

The bus schedule said we had to leave soon. But me and my friend Max wanted an adventure first. We rode our bikes deep into the dark woods. Suddenly, we saw a giant river with no bridge.

"We need to cross it now," Max shouted loudly.

We saw a long rope swinging from a tree. I felt scared because the water moved very fast. Max went first and he struggled to hold on. He used all his strength and made it across safely. Then I stood up and grabbed the rope tight. It was just the beginning of our journey. We didn't wait any longer and jumped into the trees.

Me and my best friend Tom went into the spooky cave. It was very dark and we were a little scared. We saw a big box at the end of the tunnel. I opened the box and saw a shiny blue jewel. 

Suddenly, a big bat flew right at my head! I screamed loud and ducked down fast.

"Grab the jewel and run!" Tom yelled at me. 

I grabbed the stone and we ran back outside. We escaped just in time before the cave shook. Then we looked at the jewel and it was actually just a painting of a gem on a rock. We laughed but I am certain we are brave explorers now.

We went boating on the big lake last Saturday. My dog Sparky came too and he was wearing a tiny orange vest. The water was blue and the sun was hot. I was yearning to jump in the water but Mom said no.

Sparky saw a duck floating near our boat. He tried to seize the duck with his mouth!

"Stop it, Sparky!" I yelled very loud.

"He just wants to play," said my Dad.

The boat moved with a nice rhythm on the waves. It was a pretty scene with trees everywhere. We didn't catch any fish, but I didn't care either. It was just fun to be outside on the water. Next time I hope Sparky doesn't bark so much.

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother for an hour. My heart was pumping because it was the last race. I really wanted to receive the gold trophy.

Suddenly, my brother pushed me, and he was bumping my arm! My car spun out and got trapped behind a big rock.

"Hey! That is cheating!" I screamed at him.

"I didn't mean to do it!" he shouted back.

I drove fast, but then a blue beetle shell hit me. I screeched my tires, but neither of us won. The computer player won the race. Then I felt a sneeze coming. I sneezed so hard I dropped the controller. Next time, I will write down the rules before we play so he doesn't cheat.

Timmy and I found a hidden door in my castle. We pushed it open and saw a dark tunnel.

"I am scared," Timmy said.

"Don't worry," I said. "We have my flashlight."

We walked down the path and heard a loud noise. Suddenly, a giant elephant ran at us! He was stamping his feet. The whole ground shook from his weight. I feared he would squash us flat.

I threw a single peanut at him. The elephant stopped and ate it. He liked it! Then we escaped past him and found a treasure chest. Inside was a golden computer. We ran home singing happy songs. My mom was making stewed carrots for dinner. We ate them all without leaving a crumb. It was the best day ever.

One day me and Tim went boating on the lake. We saw a dark cave and we went inside. It was spooky and I had a bad feeling. Then we heard a loud thumping noise. Something was stamping its feet in the dark!

"What is that sound?" asked Tim. He looked scared.

I grabbed my flashlight and shined it. It was a big bear moaning because it was stuck. We sent a signal with the light to my dad. He came and helped the bear get free. The bear grinned at us and ran away.

"That was a scary meeting," I said.

Later we went home and read a book about bears. It was the best adventure ever.

I have a pet monkey named Bobo who is usually good. But today Bobo was very hungry and he wanted a snack. I tried to give him a banana but he screeched loudly. He threw the banana on the floor and looked mad. 

"I don't want that!" Bobo seemed to say. 

Bobo climbed up the curtains and was clinging to the ceiling fan. He looked like a small hairy elephant up there. I was not pleased with him at all.

"Come down right now, Bobo!" I yelled at him.

He ignored me and started moaning like a ghost. Then he saw my toasted bagel on the table. He jumped down and grabbed it instead. He ate it fast like it was a rare jewel. I guess Bobo is not trained very well, especially when he wants food.

One day me and my dog Buster went exploring. We walked up a big green mountain behind my house. It was hard work. My heart was beating super fast in my chest. Buster was happy though. He was bearing a big stick in his mouth.

"Look at that view Buster!" I called out loud.

The sky looked blue like a painting. It felt like we were close to heaven up there. Suddenly Buster pulled on his leash really hard. He saw a squirrel growing on a tree branch.

"Stop it Buster, don't be bad!" I yelled.

I was a little afraid he would run away. But he gradually calmed down and sat on the soft earth. I thought he was a good boy after all. We walked home for dinner.

My nephew Sam and I were playing spies in the apartment. We needed to search for the secret ruby. It was growing dark outside. We went out onto the balcony carefully. The wind blew hard and cold on our faces.

"Do you see the bad guys?" Sam asked me.

"I see a shadow over there," I whispered back.

Suddenly a big cat jumped up and we froze. It was tearing at a cardboard box. We fought the monster with our plastic swords. Gradually the cat got bored and ran away. We were safe again. We found a red marble in the box.

"We did it!" Sam yelled loudly.

We are the best spies ever.

It was my birthday party and we had a bouncy castle. My neighbor Billy came over and he was so excited. We jumped up and down like we were climbing a mountain. I especially liked doing backflips in the corner.

"Watch this huge jump!" Billy screamed really loud.

He started pumping his legs and he flew into the air. He went so high that I thought he defied gravity. Then he threw a soft ball at me but missed. It hit the ground and bounced away.

"You can’t catch me, I am the champion!" I yelled.

It was almost impossible to stop jumping. We played until we were tired and ate cake. It was the best day ever.

I was bringing my new baseball cards to school today. My neighbor gave them to me because he is nice. I kept them in my pocket so they were safe. But at recess I saw a big danger near the swings. A big kid was running way too fast. He almost crashed into me!

"Hey, watch out!" I yelled at him really loud.

He stopped and said, "Sorry, I am late for kickball."

I went to sit on the bench to look at my cards. I have a cool card with a neat design on it. It is my favorite player in the whole league. I look at it often. I was yearning for lunchtime so I could trade with Sam. We left recess early because it started to rain. School is fun but sometimes it is crazy.

I woke up super early because we were camping. My big brother Tom said there was a secret cave nearby. We put on our sweaters because it was freezing outside. We walked fast over the hard ground. My heart was pumping hard in my chest.

"Do you hear that sounding like a bear?" I asked.

Tom laughed and said, "No, that is just the wind!"

We found a small hole in some big grey rocks. I had to squeeze my body to fit inside. Inside it was dark and I feared getting lost. Tom gripped my hand tight. Suddenly my flashlight bounced off something shiny. It was a gold coin! I was yearning to find treasure and we did. We ran back to the tent to show Dad.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We decided to play a cool game on the computer. The game was about a big green jungle. We walked through the trees and looked for treasure.

"Watch out for that tiger!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam grabbed the mouse and clicked really fast. He jumped over a big rock and kept running. We played throughout the whole night and ate popcorn. Finally, we beat the last level together.

"We are the best team ever," Sam said.

We felt like a single giant champion. Then my mom came in and told us to sleep. It was the best sleepover ever.

Yesterday I went to the park with my dog Buster. The sun was hot and we were both very hungry. I held a big sandwich in my hand. Buster looked at me with his long pink tongue out.

"Do you want some company?" I asked my dog.

He barked and started jumping up on my leg. I sat on the grass and opened my lunchbox. The sandwich was toasted cheese and it smelled so good. Suddenly a big black bird flew down near us.

"Go away bird!" I screamed at it loud.

But the bird stayed steady on the branch and sang. I thought it was beautiful but Buster did not like it. He ran at the tree and was dumping over my juice. Then I remembered I had a cookie. I broke it with my finger. We ate the cookie and were happy again.

One day a giant green alien landed in my backyard. He had three eyes and big blue boots. I ran outside and saw him leaving his ship.

"Wait! Do not go!" I yelled at the alien.

The alien looked at me and brewed a magic potion. It smelled like old socks and rotten eggs. He threw the potion at a tree and it exploded!

"I must fight the robots," the alien said loudly.

Just then, five silver robots sprinted through the gate. They fought the alien with lasers. The alien used his super strength and pushed them away. They flew up into heaven and disappeared fast. The alien waved goodbye and zoomed away in space.

It was a freezing Tuesday and I had an important test. I walked into the classroom and saw my desk was wet. Suddenly I realized my juice box had crushed inside my backpack! There was a big purple stain on my math homework. I was groaning because my mom simply hates messes.

I met my friend Sam at the door and he laughed. "That happened to me last week," Sam said.

"This is not funny at all," I grumbled.

The teacher closed the door and we started our work. I was waiting for recess so I could be the tetherball champion. But then a cold breeze came in the window. The teacher said recess was inside today. I was so mad.

The jungle was scary and the trees were surrounding us. My best friend Max gripped his map tight. We walked for a long time on the plain grass. Suddenly we saw a giant mountain with a weird design.

"We have to climb that!" I yelled.

Max started to complain but he followed me anyway. We went up high and I almost fell because of gravity. A monkey was dumping fruit on our heads. It bounced off my helmet. Then a tiger jumped out and screamed at us!

"Run fast!" Max shouted.

We ran back down and became the champion runners. We were safe but tired. It was the best adventure ever.

It was early in the morning and I hated math class. I looked at the ceiling and saw a fly. My teacher Mrs. Gable stood at the board and talked loud. I was groaning because I was so bored.

"Who has the answer to number five?" she asked.

I looked at my paper and saw a cool design. It looked like a blue vein on a leaf. I drew it with my pen. Suddenly a nice breeze came in the window. It felt good.

"I have the answer!" shouted my friend Leo.

He often knows the answers but I don't care. I believed that recess was coming soon. I watched the clock and the time grew closer. When the bell rang I climbed on the monkey bars first. I found a shiny rock in the dirt later. It looked like a real jewel. I put it in my pocket forever.

My family went on a camping trip last weekend. We drove for a long time to get there. The woods looked like a green jungle everywhere. My dad set up the tent in the breeze. Then we made a fire and had some company. My friend Sam came over to eat hot dogs.

"Watch out for gravity!" Sam yelled loudly.

He dropped his hot dog and it disappeared in the dirt. We laughed because not a single bite was left. I was grateful for seeing my friend there. We ate s'mores until it got very dark outside. It was the best night ever.

I went outside to my treehouse because I love science. My cat Fluffy was clinging to the ladder and bumping my leg. We climbed up to the top and looked at the height. It felt like we could touch the clouds on the ceiling. I drew a map of the garden with my finger.

Suddenly, a squirrel started jumping on the roof! It sounded like someone was steering a car up there.

"Look out Fluffy!" I yelled.

Fluffy thought it was a toy and tried to catch it. I knew she was fast but the squirrel was faster. It touched a pine needle and ran away.

"We missed the squirrel," I said sadly.

The whole scene was funny though. We stayed up there until my mom yelled about my schedule. It was time for dinner.

My dog Sparky was roaming around the backyard again. He sniffed the ground and then he started digging fast. I feared he would ruin Mom's new flowers.

"Stop that right now, Sparky!" I yelled loudly.

Sparky looked up and he just grinned at me. There was dirt on his nose and he let out a huge sneeze. A cool breeze blew through the trees. I walked over to see the reason for his digging. I looked into the hole and discovered a shiny rock. It looked like a tiny mountain.

"Is that for me?" I asked him.

Sparky barked and closed his eyes happily. I didn't complain about the mess this time. I think he needs more coaching on where to dig though.

I was wearing my super suit when the aliens landed. They looked like giant green bugs and they were very scary. One alien had a laser that looked like a sharp needle.

"We want to squeeze your planet!" the alien shouted loudly.

I knew I had to maintain my courage to save everyone. I used my laser eyes and toasted their spaceship. It smelled like burnt toast and the aliens started moaning.

"Please don't hurt us, we are just a gnat army!" they cried.

I told them to leave and go search for another home. I am certain they will never come back here again. Then I went inside to write about my big adventure.

We were playing the new Mario Kart game all afternoon. My brother Timmy was bragging throughout the whole race. He thought he was the best at steering his car. I pulled ahead of him near the spooky castle level though. My hands were trembling because I really wanted to win.

"You will never beat me!" Timmy yelled loudly.

"Just watch this!" I shouted back and pushed the button.

Suddenly my character flew off the track and hit a wall. I crashed right into a big grey building. Timmy laughed when my car fell down to earth. I was swinging my controller around but it didn't help. I learned that I need to practice more before our next meeting. My dad was reading a newspaper and told us to be quiet. I understand that I lost, but I will win next time.

It was almost lunchtime and my tummy was moaning. I looked at the clock but the hand moved slow. Mrs. Miller was approaching my desk with a math test. I gripped my pencil tight and I held my breath.

"You have eight minutes left," she said loudly.

I felt nervous throughout my whole body. I reached for my eraser but it flew off the desk. It bounced on the floor and escaped under Jake’s chair. I tried to get it but neither of us could reach. Then the bell rang and everyone started screaming.

"Recess time!" Jake yelled and we broke into a run.

My hunger grew bigger but I just wanted to play tag. We ran outside and felt the sun. It was the best part of the day.

My younger brother Max and I found a map. It showed a path to a hidden cave. We were steering our bikes fast down the hill. The wind was stinging my face but I kept going. We threw our bikes down and ran inside the dark cave.

"It smells like a giant sneeze in here!" Max yelled.

I told him to be quiet and hold the light steady. We saw a shiny box sitting on a rock. I opened it and obtained a gold coin! I felt so grateful we found it. Suddenly, the cave started shaking and growing loud. We ran out fast. The box could not contain all the treasure, but one coin was enough. We sent a picture to Mom when we got home.

My neighbor Billy had a sleepover for his birthday. My nephew Sam and I bought him a big red ball. We stood at the door and Billy opened it fast.

"Happy Birthday!" I yelled and I gave him the present.

"Thanks for the ball!" Billy said and he started jumping.

We went to the backyard and roasted marshmallows on a fire. But then Billy's dog escaped from the house. He ran around and he chewed on my shoe. I struggled to get it back but he was strong. The dog scratched my leg and I felt some anger. Then the dog crushed Billy's new red ball with his teeth. Billy was sad but his dad started coaching us on soccer. We used a foreign soccer ball instead and it was fun.

I loved playing soccer, although my team often lost. We had a big game on Saturday against the Tigers. My dad was coaching us and he looked really serious. He told us to watch the ball every single second.

"Get ready to win!" he yelled loudly.

The scene on the field was crazy and loud. I gripped my water bottle before I ran onto the grass. The Tigers were fast, and they scored a goal quickly. I thought we were crushed. But then my friend Sam grabbed the ball. He kicked it hard, and it went right in!

"Yes! We did it!" Sam screamed while jumping up and down.

We were thrilled when the referee counted the final score. We actually won the game! Afterward, we ate roasted hot dogs to celebrate. It was the best day ever, even though I was super tired.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so happy. My friends and I crawled into my big fort made of blankets. We had a flashlight that lit up the whole tent. 

"Let’s tell spooky stories," said my friend Sam.

I wanted to read a story I wrote about a ghost lamb. The lamb was invisible and disappeared when you looked at it. It liked to bounce like it was on a bungee cord. Everyone laughed at my story especially the part about the bouncing. 

Suddenly we heard a loud noise outside the door. Sam got scared and sprinted to the corner of the fort.

"It is just my dad trying to scare us!" I yelled.

My dad opened the door and smiled. He was not mad and had no anger at all. He just brought us snacks.

One day I was camping in my backyard very early. I was wearing my blue pajamas and jumping on the grass. Suddenly a green alien ship landed right on my swingset! A tiny robot came out and it touched my shoulder. I felt weird and everything started floating in the air. My weight was gone and I was flying up high.

"Do not worry," said the robot with a beep. "I will guide you to space."

I grabbed my neighbor Timmy because he was clinging to the fence. He is good company when scary stuff happens.

"This is different than school," Timmy yelled loudly.

The robot gave us heavy boots for grounding so we landed. We walked on the moon and ate space cheese. It was the best day ever.

It was my birthday last Saturday and I was thrilled. My dad took my friend Sam and me boating on the lake. We were wearing bright orange life jackets. The water was choppy and I got a little scared. Sam screamed when a big wave hit our boat.

"This is impossible!" Sam yelled over the loud engine.

"Hold on tight!" my dad shouted back at us.

We finally got to the island and made a fire. We roasted hot dogs and marshmallows until they were burnt. It felt like I was earning my dinner. When we got home, I opened my big present. It was a new computer game about spaceships. It was the best birthday ever.

Yesterday I had a big adventure at the park. We played a huge game of tag near the water fountain. There were fourteen kids playing and every single one was fast. I ran hard and felt the cool breeze on my face.

My friend Tim was climbing the slide to escape. His legs were trembling because he was scared of being "it." I decided to seize the moment and ran up the ladder.

"I’m going to tag you!" I yelled loudly.

"No way, you can’t catch me!" Tim shouted back.

I struggled to reach his shoe but I touched it. He almost fainted because he was so surprised. Then we went to receive our prize which was ice cream. It was the best game ever.

It was lunchtime and I was so hungry. I opened my blue lunchbox and looked inside. My sandwich looked good, but I wanted my cookie. I searched everywhere for my chocolate chip cookie. It was gone!

"Hey, did you see my cookie?" I yelled.

My friend Sam was sitting next to me. He was chewing something big and he looked scared. His mouth was full of crumbs. I felt anger inside my tummy.

"You ate it!" I said. "That was my favorite snack."

Sam swallowed and said, "I was yearning for chocolate."

Just then, I saw a plastic bag floating away. It was under the table. It had my cookie inside! It looked like a brown jewel. I grabbed it fast enough. I was so happy I started singing a little song. The sounding bell rang and lunch was over.

I was sitting in class and the bell started ringing. It was sounding very loud so I covered my ears. Mrs. Higgins said, "Everyone stop running in the hallway!" We pushed our way to the lunchroom. I was very hungry. I opened my lunchbox and saw something crazy. There was a giant beetle on my sandwich!

"That is impossible!" shouted my friend Sam.

I believed him because beetles are gross. I threw the sandwich in the trash. I was sad about not earning my dessert today. Then I saw a picture of an elephant on the wall. It had fourteen toes. I laughed so hard my tummy hurt. I didn't get into trouble, but I was bearing a big hunger. Lunchtime is the weirdest time of day.

One day my neighbor Tim heard a loud noise. We were reading books but we wanted an adventure. We walked up the big mountain behind my house. Suddenly we discovered a dark cave with a scary sign.

"Do not go in there!" screamed Tim loudly.

"We have to go because we are brave," I said.

Inside there was a skeleton playing a guitar. It was not a real skeleton. It was just a knight in dusty armor. He was in trouble because he was stuck. We pulled him out and he was stronger than us. He started swearing because he was mad at the rocks. Neither of us liked the bad words. But the knight was pleased we saved him from danger.

We met at the big park near the huge mountain. Me and Sam chose to climb up the rocky side. We walked through the tall grass and saw a cave. Suddenly I slipped and grasped a root very tight.

"Help me up!" I yelled really loud to Sam.

Sam pulled me up and we didn't fall down. It felt like gravity was pulling us super hard. We went inside the dark cave and heard a noise.

"Is everyone okay in there?" a deep voice shouted.

It was a bear but he was trapped under rocks. We moved the rocks and he ran back to earth. We landed back home safe and ate some pizza.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were freezing in my room. My friend Leo wanted to climb onto the balcony but my mom said no. We decided to build a fort with blankets instead. We used a needle and thread to tie the sheets together.

"I am a brave knight!" Leo screamed and he jumped inside the fort.

Then we heard a loud tapping rhythm on the window. We thought it was a monster but it was just rain.

"Are you guys sleeping yet?" my dad spoke from the door.

He had a pizza box and the receipt fell on the floor. We ate the pizza together in our fort and told scary stories.

My robot friend Zip is really shiny and silver. We walked to the science fair at my school today. Zip was bumping into everything because his eye was loose. I tried to fix him, but I am not great at it.

"Be honest, do I look okay?" asked Zip.

"You look weird but cool," I said.

We saw a girl with a ghost in a jar. The ghost was glowing green and it looked sticky. Zip got scared and hid behind a big computer. Then I remembered that Zip has laser eyes! He zapped the ghost and it turned into slime. Although he made a mess, everyone clapped for us. We won a blue ribbon for being brave.

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother Sam. He always wins and it makes me mad. I picked Yoshi because he is fast and cute. Sam picked Bowser because he likes being big and mean.

The race started and we were running down the track. I was in first place for a long time. Suddenly, a blue shell came floating over my head. It hit me and I spun out.

"Ha ha! Now I am going to win!" shouted Sam.

I stuck out my tongue at him. I felt anger in my belly. But then I got a star and turned gold. I zoomed past him right at the end.

"Neither of us saw that coming!" I yelled happily.

I won the race and jumped up and down. Dad brought us some toasted bread for a snack. He said no caffeine for us because it was late. We played again but I kept my guard up this time.

It was a boring Wednesday at school. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about history. I had a sleepy feeling and I put my head down. Suddenly the door opened and a new boy appeared. He was bearing a huge blue backpack.

"This is my nephew, Sam," said Mrs. Miller.

Sam looked nice but he was very quiet. He sat next to me and I saw his thumb was blue. I whispered to him, "Why is your thumb blue?"

"I blew up a paint pen," he said.

We laughed so loud the whole class looked. It was a funny scene. I stopped sleeping and felt happy. We played tag at recess early and ate pizza. He spoke a foreign language too. It turned into a good day.

My friend Sam and I went to the spooky forest. We were seeing big trees everywhere and twisted vines hanging down. I was steering my bike carefully, but I kept bumping rocks.

"Look at that old castle!" Sam yelled loudly.

We saw a metal knight standing by the big door. I knew it was fake, but it looked scary. Suddenly, a weird green fog brewed up from the ground. It smelled bad. My finger started shaking.

"We should go back or run through it," I whispered.

We didn't want the fog to reign over us. A squirrel tried to gnaw on my shoe. We started jumping on our bikes fast. We didn't stop for anything either. We rode home and drank juice. It was the best adventure ever.

My neighbor Tim and I went to the jungle behind school. We knew it was dangerous but we walked inside anyway. The trees got taller and the shadows got longer. Suddenly a big green bird flew right at my head! It screeched very loud and I almost fell down.

"Watch out for that bird!" yelled Tim loudly.

"It is impossible to catch it!" I shouted back.

We kept bumping into vines and big rocks. I used my school scissors to cut a path. It was just the beginning of our big adventure. We hoped to receive a prize for finding the hidden treasure. But then we saw a giant tiger sleeping by the river! We ran home very fast.

On Wednesday, I lost my best eraser at school. It was shaped like a little green creature. I looked everywhere in the building but it just disappeared. My friend Sam helped me look near the swings.

"It is impossible to find!" Sam yelled loudly.

I was trembling a little because I was sad. We crossed the playground and looked by the big tree. Then I saw something shiny near the fence. It looked like a silver chain, but it was just foil.

"Wait, look over there by the slide," I said.

A boy named Tim was playing like he was a knight. He was the captain of the playground today. He treated us nicely and followed us to the grass. My eraser was right there! Neither of us saw it before. I was so happy I found it.

I was swinging the bat as hard as I could. My nephew threw the ball, and I counted to three. I hit it right through the neighbor's fence!

"You broke it!" shouted my nephew.

I crawled under the fence, but a stinging bee bit me. It hurt so bad I felt it in my vein. I fought the bees away and found the ball. It was near some old scissors and a foreign coin. I squeezed through the hole and ran back home. Mom was making stewed carrots for dinner. I heard her steering the car into the driveway.

"Did you break anything?" Mom asked me later.

I looked at the fence and just ate my dinner.

The forest was getting darker and the shadows were growing. Me and my friend Sam were running fast because we heard a scary sound. It sounded like a ghost moaning in the bushes.

"We need more strength to climb that big wall!" Sam yelled.

I gripped the rocks hard and pulled myself up. My thumb hurt but I didn’t stop. We reached the top and saw a cool design on a cave door.

"Is that monster still roaming around?" I asked.

We waited but the scary noise stopped. We spread out our map on the ground. The path home was longer than we thought. We were safe for now but we had to be brave.

My heart was beating super fast in my chest. I was playing the hardest level on my video game. It was almost impossible to beat the final boss. My little brother Tommy was watching me and eating chips. Chips were scattered all over the floor.

"You can do it!" Tommy screamed really loud.

I took a deep breath to slow my breathing. I had to use my brain to find the secret button. Suddenly, I saw the glowing red weak spot. I pressed "A" and my character jumped up high. I hit the monster and he fell down and fainted. The screen flashed "WINNER" in big gold letters.

"I knew you would be the champion!" Tommy yelled.

I grinned at him because I was so happy. There was no reason to be scared anymore. I was really grateful that Tommy cheered for me.

I went to the old castle with my friend Sam. We looked at the schedule and it said "Dragon Feeding Time." We got scared but we kept walking inside the dark room. Suddenly a big metal knight moved his arm at us!

"Watch out for that sword!" I yelled very loud.

Sam was jumping up and down because he was nervous. Then the ground shook hard like a big earthquake. We saw a goblin dumping trash into a deep hole. The goblin had a shiny knife in his belt.

"We should go home now," Sam whispered to me.

I agreed so we ran away fast. Later we bought ice cream and it was much safer.

My brother Tom thinks he is cool because he plays on the computer. But for my birthday sleepover, we went camping in the backyard. We roasted marshmallows and told scary stories in the dark. Suddenly, we heard a weird moaning sound.

"What was that noise?" my friend Sarah screamed.

"It is probably just a monster," Tom said to scare us.

We listened hard but then something jumped out! It was jumping up and down like a bungee cord. It reached for us with furry paws. It was a creature! We escaped into the tent and zipped it fast. But then the creature started barking. It was just my dog Buster! It was impossible to sleep because Buster wanted marshmallows too. He is often very hungry.

Me and my brother started playing a new game. It was a cool knight game with a big castle. I liked the design of the knight’s armor a lot. We were waiting for the loading screen for a long time.

"Come on, hurry up!" I shouted at the TV.

Finally, the game was ready and my knight was running. We fought a big dragon near a magical fountain. But then the dragon disappeared into a dark cave. I was keeping my hand steady on the controller.

"Watch out for the fire!" my brother yelled loudly.

I jumped instead of running and I won the battle. We celebrated by eating toasted cheese sandwiches for lunch. I liked seeing my high score on the screen.

My robot named Zork was in big trouble. He was dumping all the trash on the floor. His metal feet made a loud thumping noise. I touched his shiny head to stop him.

"Zork, you need to use your brain!" I yelled.

Zork looked at me with his glowing red eyes. "I cannot maintain my gravity," he grumbled.

He floated up and went right through the ceiling! I was thrilled because he was finally flying. But then he crashed into my bed. Zork is a cool robot, but he is very messy. I hope my mom doesn't see the hole in the roof.

My brother and I trained all week for the big race. We woke up early on Saturday and ate breakfast fast. The race was simply running to the big oak tree. My brother stood at the line and looked ready.

"I am going to beat you today!" he yelled.

I tied my shoes tight to avoid any danger. Mom shouted go and we scrambled down the grass. I was tearing through the yard like a fast cheetah. My brother tripped on a bungee cord near the garage. He fell down but he wasn't crying or sleeping.

"You won this time!" he shouted from the ground.

I touched the tree first and did a happy dance. Winning felt like earning a million gold coins. I spread my arms out and started singing loudly. Next time I will put winning on my schedule again.

It was lunch time and my stomach was simply groaning. I opened my blue lunchbox and something weird appeared inside. My apple was chewed up and left in a mess! I knew it was my younger brother. He is always hungry and growing fast.

"Who ate my apple?" I yelled at my friends.

"Not me," said Ben, who was busy climbing the jungle gym.

I cleared away the mess and found a note. It said my mom paid him five dollars to eat it. That didn’t make sense. Then I saw a worm crawling out.

"Gross!" I shouted and ran to the computer lab.

I decided to seize the day and play games instead. I was hungry, but at least I didn't eat a worm.

My big brother Max had a birthday party on Saturday. We were thrilled because Mom made a giant cake. It looked like a big treasure island with chocolate coins.

"Who wants the first piece?" Max shouted loudly.

"Me! Me!" I yelled and pushed my friend Sam.

Sam fell and twisted his ankle a little bit. Mom ran over and looked at a blue vein on his foot. She put ice on it fast. Then she got the big scissors to cut the cake. We all scrambled to get a plate. Max opened his presents and found a receipt in a box. It was for a cool robot toy!

"You need protein to grow big," Mom said, handing us hot dogs.

We ate everything and then played tag until dark. It was the best day ever.

My dog Sparky was roaming in the big meadow behind our house. He started barking at a hole in the ground. I ran over and discovered a tiny rabbit trapped inside. It looked scared and lonely.

"Don't worry, little bunny!" I screamed. Sparky was thumping his tail hard against the grass. He knew we had to help.

I used all my strength to move a big rock away. The bunny hopped out fast. It looked like a foreign creature because its ears were huge.

"Go home now," I said to the bunny. It ran toward the woods.

Later we roasted marshmallows on a fire. The stars looked like they were on the ceiling of the world. Sparky sat close for company. He is the best dog ever.

I had my big party last Saturday. It was my birthday and I turned nine. My cousin Sam came over and he is thirteen. We played a game with big purple balloons.

"Try to keep them floating!" Sam yelled really loud.

I hit the balloon and it bounced off the ceiling. Neither of us let it touch the floor. Then we ran through the kitchen to the backyard. My dad was outside and he roasted hot dogs. We ate them fast because we had a club meeting.

"This is the best party ever," I said to Sam.

We played until it got dark outside. I was so tired but I was happy.

I bought a new puppy named Sparky yesterday. He is growing so fast and he has lots of strength. We went outside because it was freezing cold. Sparky bounced around the yard like a happy bunny. Suddenly he stopped and stood very still near a bush. I realized he saw a giant black beetle.

"Don't eat that, Sparky!" I yelled loudly.

Sparky didn't listen and he pulled on his leash hard. He sniffed the beetle and then he sneezed. It was the greatest sneeze ever. Then he almost fainted because he got scared.

"Come on, let's go inside now," I said.

We are leaving the park now to find a water fountain. I trained him to sit but he still needs practice. Being a dog owner has a big meaning to me.

Me and my best friend Tim built a fort. It was simply a box, but we used our imagination. We believed it was a super dangerous castle. I was wearing my cape and Tim held a stick sword.

"Watch out for the dragon!" I yelled loudly.

Tim bounced around and fought the invisible dragon for an hour. Suddenly, we heard a thumping noise outside. We got really scared. My heart was beating fast.

"Maybe it is a real monster," whispered Tim.

We looked outside though. It was just a tiny white lamb. It scratched its ear and looked at us. We laughed because we were scared of a baby sheep. We have to learn to be brave next time.

My nephew Timmy found a shiny rock in the dirt. It glowed green and looked like an alien egg. Timmy grasped the rock tight and it started to buzz. Suddenly a little green man popped straight out of the rock! He was very small like a gnat.

"Hello Earth boy," the alien said with a squeaky voice.

Timmy grinned and showed me the tiny green man. It was wonderful and strange.

"Do you want to go on an adventure?" asked the alien.

The alien drew a magic door on the wall. We heard a loud knock from inside the door. My brain felt fuzzy and weird. We jumped through the door and landed on Mars!

I walked into the woods with my dog named Rex. Rex is trained to be a very good guard dog. We often go there to look for cool bugs. I brought a sandwich and used foil to wrap it up. Suddenly, a big blue bird flew right past my head!

"Did you see that giant bird?" I asked Rex.

Rex just barked and wagged his tail really fast. We walked deeper into the trees and stepped on sticks. One stick broke with a loud snap under my shoe. Then an idea struck me about building a fort.

"I guarantee we can build the best fort ever," I said.

We found lots of big branches and made a wall. It was the best day outside with my best friend.

Tim and Ben were wearing their backpacks and hats. They wanted to climb the big blue mountain. Everyone feared the mountain because a giant lived there.

"Are you scared?" asked Ben with big eyes.

"No, I am thrilled to go!" said Tim bravely.

They walked for a long time and saw a fountain. The water was sparkly but they did not drink it. Then they saw a huge cave. A giant bear was sleeping inside!

Tim struggled to be quiet but he snapped a twig. The bear opened one eye. The boys ran very fast down the hill. They were not meeting that bear today. They ran all the way home and felt safe. Maybe they would try again next week.

My friends and I went to the old park. Everyone said a monster lived there near the big fountain. We walked past a sign that said "Keep Out."

Suddenly, Sam looked up and screamed really loud. Something was swinging from a tree branch! It was big and green and had red eyes.

"Run away now!" yelled Maya as she grabbed my arm.

The monster screeched and jumped down on the grass. We didn't know what to do so we ran fast. Then the monster suddenly disappeared into thin air. It was invisible! We cleared the fence and didn't stop running home. We never obtained the treasure, but at least we were safe.

One day I was reading a book outside under a big tree. Suddenly, I saw something floating in the river. It was a little duck and it looked scared. I walked closer but then I froze. A big mean fox was there too! The fox wanted to eat the duck.

"Hey! Leave him alone!" I yelled really loud.

The fox looked at me and then he ran away fast. The duck struggled to get out of the water. I helped him up onto the grass. He was moaning a little bit like he was hurt. I knew it was important to keep him safe.

"Do you want some company?" I asked the duck.

He quacked at me. I think he was hungry though. I had a sandwich but a squirrel already stole half of it. I gave the duck enough bread to make him happy. It was a good day.

One day my dog Max and I went exploring. We walked straight into the dark woods behind my house. Max heard a noise and ran to a big bush. I sat down on a rock and started waiting for him. Suddenly, Max struggled to get out of the prickly bushes.

"Max, what is wrong with you?" I yelled loudly.

He barked and held up his paw. It had a thorn in it! I crossed the grass to help him. I had to wrap his paw with my scarf. We went home and my mom brewed some hot cocoa for me. She stewed some chicken for Max too.

"You are a brave dog," I told him.

Max wagged his tail and ate his dinner fast. We were happy to be safe inside again.

I was playing Mario Kart with my big brother Sam. It was the beginning of the race and I was losing. I tried to climb the big hill in the game. Sam threw a red shell at me and I crashed.

"That wasn't fair!" I yelled with lots of anger.

"You have to drive faster," Sam said and laughed.

My finger hurt from pressing the button so hard. The track was dangerous because there was lava on the ground. Suddenly I felt a giant sneeze coming. I sneezed so loud that Sam looked away from the TV. He crashed his car right into a wall. I zoomed past him seeing the finish line. Sam started groaning because I won the race. I am going to write about my win in my diary.

I had a mountain of math homework to do. It was sounding really hard and I feared it. My teacher Mrs. Green walked by my desk. "I guarantee you can do it, Tommy," she said. I stared at the paper for an hour. I thought about playing tag at recess instead. I saw a feather floating outside the window. Then the lunch lady brewed some soup and it smelled good. I chose to be honest with Mrs. Green. "I am stuck on number five," I told her. She helped me fix it fast. Then the bell rang and recess was approaching. I ran outside and got caught by Billy in tag. I felt happy school was almost done.

My birthday party was going to be the best. I waited for an hour for my friends to come. Then my friend Leo walked in and touched my new bike. It was blue and had cool tires.

"Can I ride it?" Leo asked me with a big smile.

"Not yet," I said. "We have to eat cake first."

My dad was reading the newspaper and he pointed at the cake. My dog Buster chewed on a toy bone near the table. I felt a happy feeling in every vein. We played a game of jumping over a rope. Leo had a great imagination and pretended the rope was lava. He jumped to a really high height. It was a good sign that everyone was laughing. Soon we ate enough cake and my finger was sticky with frosting. It was a super fun day.

I was walking home when I saw a strange green light. It was coming from a twisted metal ship in the park. Suddenly a door opened and a robot came out. The robot had three eyes and a long purple tongue. I was thrilled but also a little scared.

"Hello earthling, I am hungry for snacks," said the robot.

He gripped a bag of chips that was scattered on the grass.

"Please be my guide," the robot asked me nicely.

I thought about the danger but I wanted to help him. We walked to the store and people were screaming and surrounding us. The robot shot a laser at the ceiling and everyone stopped. It was the greatest day ever. I hope I receive a letter from him soon.

My brother and I played a video game called Jump Quest. The scenery in the game looked like a big green jungle. We had to climb a mountain to get the magic jewel. My character was a blue cat wearing a red sweater. I was scared because the mountain had a really big height.

"Look out for that bug!" my brother yelled loudly.

It was a tiny gnat, but it could push you off. Gravity pulled me down, and I almost hit the ground. I did not want to lose again.

"I knew you could do it," he said to me.

I jumped over a sign that said Danger. I grabbed the jewel and we won the level. We didn't want to stop playing either, so we started the next one.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so excited. My friends came over and we played with my new science kit. Then we decided to play dress up in the basement. I put on a silver helmet and pretended to be a knight.

"I am going to save the castle!" I yelled loudly.

My friend Sam pushed a big box and it made a loud noise. My mom appeared at the top of the stairs looking mad. We knew we were in big trouble.

"What is going on down there?" she asked us.

Sam grasped my arm because he was scared. We heard my dad groaning because he was trying to sleep. We chewed on our pizza quietly throughout the rest of the night. As morning neared, we felt better. My mom even stewed some apples for breakfast and smiled at us.

I was sitting in math class and I was so bored. Mrs. Green was talking about how to measure lines with a ruler. But I pulled a loose string on my shirt instead. I looked out the window and saw a plastic bag floating. It looked like a ghost roaming around in the breeze.

"Pay attention please!" Mrs. Green said loudly.

"I am listening," I said back, but I knew I wasn't.

My stomach grew loud and I wanted lunch really bad. Lunch today was chunky beef stewed with carrots. I hate stew. I wished I was sleeping at home. Then the bell rang and everyone swept out the door. I ran to the playground first.

I looked at the robot and he was very shiny. He was made of silver metal and blue lights. My dad said this was an important science project. But the robot started singing a weird song very loud. He was dumping all the trash on the floor too.

"Stop that right now!" I yelled at the robot.

The robot beeped and said, "I have escaped!"

He pushed the door open and started running outside. I had to catch him before my dad came home. I grabbed my super magnet and chased him down the street. It was already getting dark outside. I hoped the magnet would work on him.

My friend Ben and I chose the weird path today. We were playing explorers in the woods near my house. Suddenly, we saw a big cave with green moss.

"I bet there is treasure inside," Ben said loudly.

We walked in carefully but my legs were trembling. It was dark and smelled like old science experiments. I turned on my flashlight and the light spread out. We saw a rock that looked just like a fluffy lamb. Then Ben saw something shiny in a blue vein of rock.

"It’s gold!" he yelled and started jumping up and down.

But then a bat flew out and we got scared. We scrambled out fast like we were doing a bungee jump. That was just the beginning of our scary adventure. I know we will go back tomorrow.

Me and my best friend Sam went to a secret island. We wanted to find the golden crown to reign over the jungle. We followed a map that appeared in an old newspaper. Suddenly a big wind blew very hard and trees crashed down.

"Watch out for that giant rock!" shouted Sam loudly.

We ran fast but I tripped and crushed a cookie crumb. Neither of us stopped running until we reached the big cliff.

"We have to jump like a bungee cord!" I said.

We held hands and jumped and we landed in soft water. We found the crown and Sam was keeping it safe in his bag. We were very pleased to be the kings of the island.

The weather was very hot outside during recess today. The sun scorched the playground and made the slide burn. I touched the metal and pulled my hand back fast.

"Don't go down that or you will get hurt!" I yelled to my friend Max.

Max looked scared and backed away from the slide. We sprinted to the swings because they were in the shade. I went straight up high toward the blue sky. Suddenly, a big bee flew right near my face. I fell off the swing and landed on the grass.

A teacher swept over to see if I was okay.

"Are you in trouble or hurt?" she asked me.

I tried to explain about the bee. I crawled up and saw a steady line of ants on the ground. My arm hurt a little bit near a blue vein. But I was mostly just dirty.

On Wednesday my friend Sam and I went exploring early. We were wearing our superhero capes and climbing the big hill. We saw a cave and heard someone singing inside.

"I think a dragon lives there!" Sam shouted loud.

We went inside and it smelled like scorched toast. A tiny green dragon was clinging to a rock. He blew a little puff of smoke at us. He wasn't scary but he looked hungry. I gave him the gum I chewed. He liked it and his long tongue hung out.

"He wants to be our friend," I said happy.

We kept him and named him Sparky. It was a pleasure to meet a real dragon. Then his mom screeched and we ran away fast! That is the reason we don't go back there.

I woke up early and ate my breakfast fast. Today was the big race at the park. My heart was pumping so hard in my chest. I put on my lucky shoes and I looked ready.

We got to the park and I counted ten kids. One boy was very tall, and his height scared me. He looked like a giant!

"Ready, set, go!" yelled my dad.

We all ran fast, bumping into each other a little. A tiny gnat flew in my eye, but I kept running. I thought I was going to lose, but I discovered I was fast. I caught up to the tall boy near the end.

"You can't beat me!" he shouted.

"Watch me!" I yelled back.

I crossed the line first and it felt like heaven. I won the race!

One day me and my dog Sparky went exploring in the woods. We walked for a long time until we found a hidden island in the middle of a creek. The water was freezing cold but we jumped across big rocks to get there.

"Look, Sparky, we discovered a secret fort!" I shouted.

Sparky barked and pulled on his leash because he was excited. We started climbing the biggest tree and it was the greatest view ever. I knew we were explorers now. We brought some snacks and sat on a log to eat. Then I saw an old newspaper under a rock. It had a picture of a cat wearing a crown.

"Sparky, I think a cat king used to reign here!" I grinned.

We stayed a little longer and pretended the birds were cheering for us. It was the best adventure we ever brewed up.

We had art class today and it was super messy. I tried to paint the scenery outside but my brush twisted. I got green paint all over my thumb and finger.

Then Billy shouted, "Hey, watch out for my picture!"

I accidentally scratched his paper with my messy hand. We almost fought but the teacher came over fast. She hung our wet paintings on the wall to dry.

Later we went to recess and I crawled under the slide. I felt a sneeze coming and it was really loud. My best friend was clinging to the monkey bars upside down.

"You sound like an elephant!" she laughed at me.

I didn't want a grounding so I didn't yell back. I just found a pine needle on the ground to write my name in the dirt. School days are kind of crazy sometimes.

The alien robot landed in my backyard last night. He was shiny and green and had big eyes. He scratched his metal head with a long finger. He looked like a funny sailor from space. I knew he was friendly because he was singing.

"Hello Earth boy," the robot said to me.

"Do you know how to fix bikes?" I asked him.

The robot pulled out a laser knife and fixed my tire. He was swinging his arms and looked very happy. Then my mom came outside screaming because she was scared.

"Don't complain Mom, he is nice!" I yelled.

The robot waved goodbye and flew away fast. I hope he comes back soon to play.

It was my birthday party and I was so happy. All my friends came over for a sleepover immediately after school. We ate pizza and then we opened presents. My friend Billy handed me a big box with shiny paper.

"Here you go!" Billy said. "I hope you like it."

I grabbed the scissors and cut the tape. I reached inside the box and pulled out a rocket ship. It was super cool and had buttons.

"Wow, this defies gravity!" I yelled.

We played with the rocket for a long time. It made weird noises when you pushed the red button. Later we looked at the scenery outside my window. The stars were bright and shiny. I felt very grateful for my friends. It was the best birthday ever for a good reason. I did receive lots of toys but friends are better.

My brother Tom and I found a map in the attic. It showed a secret cave near the river. We packed our bags and started steering our boat down the stream. The water was fast and I was so thrilled. Suddenly we saw a big bear sleeping near the cave entrance!

"Be quiet or it will wake up!" whispered Tom.

I tried to be quiet but I stepped on a stick. The bear opened one eye and roared loudly. We screamed and ran back to our boat very fast. My heart was beating like crazy in every vein. We escaped just in time. We never did receive the treasure, but at least we are safe. Next time we will be better trained for bears.

It was raining very hard on my birthday. I was turning nine but I wanted to be fourteen. My mom made my favorite dinner which is stewed chicken. I knew it would be good because it smelled yummy.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We played games and looked at the scenery out the window. Suddenly my little sister came in screaming loudly.

"Look at the water!" she yelled.

We looked outside and saw a big fountain of water. The drain pipe broke and water was shooting everywhere! I had a funny feeling in my tummy. We ran outside and jumped in the puddles. It was the best birthday ever even with the rain.

I was walking home and the breeze felt weird. Suddenly a blue robot landed in my backyard. It was huge and made a loud bumping sound. I was scared but I went closer. The robot had a shiny red jewel on its chest.

"Hello human," said the robot with a funny voice.

"Who are you?" I asked him very quietly.

He told me he came from space to find friends. Then a green light grew out of his hand. It was magic light seeing into my brain. The light went throughout my whole yard surrounding us. It felt impossible but I started to float up. Now I have superpowers and I can fly everywhere! It is the best day ever.

I went to my cousin Max’s house for a sleepover. We played tag in the backyard until it got dark. Max ran fast but I grabbed his shirt. I twisted around and threw a soft ball at him.

"You are caught!" I yelled really loud at him.

Max laughed and started stamping his feet on the grass. He thought he was faster than me. We went inside and ate thirteen cookies. My tummy hurt a little bit so I squeezed a pillow.

"Let's have a pillow fight now," Max said to me.

I crossed my fingers for good luck. I jumped on the bed and landed on my knees. I knew this was the best sleepover ever.

My friends came over for a big sleepover last night. We set up a tent in the living room carefully. Mom sent us some marshmallows and we pretended to camp. We toasted them over a little fake fire my dad made. It was incredible and tasted so good and gooey.

"This is the best night ever!" I yelled happily.

Then my dog Buster escaped from the kitchen and ran in. He swept his tail around and knocked over our fort. My friend Sam grasped his sleeping bag tight and hid. We discovered Buster eating our leftover roasted marshmallows on the floor.

"Oh no, Buster, you are a bad dog," Sam grumbled.

We drew pictures of Buster in jail after that. Then we closed our eyes and finally went to sleep.

I had a different kind of day at school. We had a big art project in Mrs. Green's class. I drew a brave knight with a shiny sword. My friend Tom made a bird with a blue feather.

"Can I borrow your red marker?" Tom asked me.

"Sure, just remember to give it back," I said.

Then things went wrong. The marker flew out of his hand. It hit my paper and made a huge red line. I felt anger inside me like a hot fire. I wanted to yell. But then I saw the line looked like a thread. So I changed my picture. Now the knight was jumping over a red laser beam!

"Wow, that looks so cool!" said Tom.

I was feeling happy again. We had fourteen minutes left so we cleaned up. I put newspaper on the table to keep it clean. Mrs. Green hung my picture up as a guide for others. It was the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for the secret cave. The wind blew hard and it was growing dark. We neared a big rock and saw a small fire. Someone had roasted marshmallows there.

"Do you think a monster is keeping watch?" Sam asked.

I shook my head and we walked closer. The path gradually cleared up. We saw an old man sitting there. He was brewed some tea in a pot. He smiled at us.

"I have enough tea for company," he said simply.

He gave us a paper. It was a receipt for treasure! We were coaching each other to be brave. It was a good meeting. Then we ran home fast.

It was a pleasant day for an adventure. My friend Sam was bringing his backpack and I had mine. We walked to the spooky house on the hill instead of the park. It looked scary but we were brave.

We neared the big front door. Sam said, "I hear something tearing inside."

It sounded like giant scissors cutting paper. We climbed up to the old balcony. Suddenly a big monster jumped out! It wasn't real though. It was just a cat playing with a box. My imagination was making it scary.

Sam was coaching me to be brave. "We should stay longer," he whispered.

We ate toasted cheese sandwiches on the porch. Then we ran through the tall grass back home. It was the best quest ever.

We were walking in the dark forest together. I had my magic sword and my robot named Beep. Suddenly a big green alien jumped out! It was clinging to a tree branch. It made a groaning sound like a sleepy bear. 

"Look at that weird sign on its tummy," said Beep. 

The sign was glowing bright red. Then a tiny gnat flew into the alien’s nose. The alien sneezed huge fire everywhere! We ran away fast. Beep’s metal arm got a little toasted by the fire. We could not stay any longer. 

"Everyone run to the spaceship!" I yelled loud. 

We jumped inside and flew up high. We were safe. The alien was just mad about the bug.

It was February and there was a cool breeze. My friend Sam and I wanted a big adventure. We took our boat to a secret island. We were on a search for pirate gold.

"Look at that floating box!" Sam yelled loudly.

I rowed the boat fast to catch it. The water had a nice rhythm. We landed on the sand and opened the box. It was empty but we used our imagination.

"Maybe a ghost took the gold," I said.

We made a fire and ate roasted marshmallows. We did not find gold but we had fun earning our explorer badges. It was the best day ever.

I was so excited for my birthday sleepover tomorrow! My dad said we were going to the big mountain. My best friend Sam was bringing his sleeping bag. We packed the car straight away and left.

When we got there, we started tearing open the snacks. "Look at that big jump!" Sam yelled, pointing up. It was a bungee jump place.

My dad laughed and said, "That is for the Colonel!" The Colonel is our dog, but he just chewed a stick. We ate stewed beef for dinner and it was yummy.

Seeing the stars at night was the most important part. We cleared a spot and looked up at the sky. We heard people cheering throughout the woods. I knew this was the best birthday ever. Sam fell asleep first, but I stayed awake.

Me and my friend Sam found a cave. It looked weird and scary but we went inside. The air was cold and I could hear Sam breathing loud. Suddenly the ground broke under my feet! I grabbed a root like a bungee cord.

"Help me up!" I yelled really loud.

Sam pulled me up and then we saw a shiny crown. A ghost king used to reign here a long time ago.

"Look out for the bats," Sam said to me.

Just then a big bat flew by and made me sneeze. We ran out fast and sang a happy song outside. We were safe but we are never speaking of that cave again.

My friends and I walked deep into the dark woods. We were looking for the secret pirate treasure. The map was old and hard to read though. We climbed over a big pile of rocks.

"Watch out for the snake!" yelled my friend Sam.

I looked down and saw a scary green snake. It was spread out on the path near my foot. I struggled to jump over it fast. My heart was beating super loud.

"That was too close," I said.

We kept going until we found a cave. Inside was a box with gold coins! I was swearing I would never tell anyone about it. But my mom said that swearing is bad. I had to learn the real meaning of keeping secrets. We took the gold and ran home for dinner.

I grabbed my backpack and ran to school. Today was show and tell, and I brought my stuffed lamb. I knew everyone would like him because he is super soft.

At recess, we played basketball on the court. The ball bounced really high because of my height. Suddenly, Tommy shouted, "Watch out for the sleeping teacher!" Mrs. Green was napping on a bench nearby.

We tried to be quiet, but I accidentally let the ball knock into the fence. Mrs. Green woke up fast!

"Is that a needle in the haystack?" she asked confused.

I didn't think she understood where she was.

"No, it's just a basketball!" I said.

She laughed and we kept playing. My growing hunger meant it was almost lunchtime. I was ready for pizza day.

I woke up early because today was the big race. My tummy felt weird like a dog was trying to gnaw on it. It was the most important day ever. I grabbed my controller and sat on the rug. My friend Tim came over and he was stamping his feet.

"I am going to win this boating game," Tim yelled loudly.

I just scratched my head and pressed start. Our boats were floating on the water on the screen. The sound of engines growing louder filled the room. We raced for almost an hour. Suddenly, Tim’s boat hit a rock and disappeared under the waves.

"No way!" he cried out, screaming at the TV.

I reached the finish line first and heard the winning music. I was so happy I jumped up.

I was waiting for recess all morning because I had a secret. In my pocket was a shiny blue jewel I found in the dirt. It was the greatest thing ever. Finally the bell rang and everyone ran outside to the playground.

I grabbed my friend Billy and we ran to the big tree. The scenery was nice there.

"Look at this!" I said and spread out my hand.

Billy’s eyes grew really big. "Is that magic?" he asked.

Suddenly a big spider crawled down from a branch. It twisted around and looked scary. I was scared so I dropped the jewel.

"Don't complain," Billy said. "Let's just get it."

He was brave like my older nephew. He picked it up and gave it back. It was a pleasant recess after that. Then the bell rang again.

My best friend Sarah got pneumonia and missed school. I was wearing my blue coat when I went over. I brought her a painting I made in science class. Her dad let me in and was my guide upstairs. Sarah was on the balcony wrapped in a blanket. The scenery was beautiful from up there. We looked through the rails at the street.

"I feared you would be bored," Sarah said quietly.

"No way, I obtained some marshmallows!" I told her.

We roasted them over a little candle her mom lit. We built a fort out of pillows later. I was coaching her on how to make the roof stay up. It was the best sick day ever.

We woke up early for our big adventure. My dog Max and I were training to be explorers. We walked into the dark forest behind my house. It was scary but we were brave.

We neared a big cave and I heard a growl. Max barked loud and I held his leash tight.

"Do you know what that is?" I whispered to Max.

Max simply wagged his tail and pulled me forward. Suddenly a big raccoon ran out and we screamed! We scrambled up a tall tree to be safe. The raccoon looked at us and ran away. We escaped the monster! To be honest, I was shaking a lot. My mom was waiting for us with snacks. Being an explorer is very hard work.

Me and my friend Sam searched the woods behind my house. We wanted to find a secret treasure chest. Sam scratched his arm on a big tree branch.

"Look at that weird hole!" Sam shouted loudly.

We discovered a dark cave that looked very foreign. It was scary but we were thrilled to go inside. I used my flashlight and the light spread out. We saw a shiny box sitting straight ahead.

"I bet it will contain gold!" I said.

The box was closed tight but we got it open. We were wrong about the gold. It was just a weird rock and a map. We decided to wrap the rock in my jacket. We felt like kings starting a new reign. Then we ran home for lunch.

My teacher Mrs. Jenkins put the schedule on the board. We had math first and it scrambled my brain. The numbers were jumping around and bumping into each other. I tried to sit up straight but I was so tired. Then the bell blew loudly for recess!

Recess is the greatest time of the whole day. I ran outside with my friend Leo. We saw a new kid sitting alone by the swings.

"Do you want some company?" I asked him.

"Yes please," the new boy said with a big smile.

We greeted him and played tag until lunch started. It was a good day because I made a new friend. I hope we don't have hard math tomorrow.

I bought a robot kit but it blew up. A piece of metal crashed into the ceiling and stuck there. Suddenly a small green alien landed on my messy desk. He was the height of a soda can.

"I need a needle and thread to fix my ship," he said.

I ran to get my mom's sewing box for him. He used the thread to maintain his engine. Then he pulled out a glowing red jewel. A cool breeze filled my room when he held it.

"Thanks for helping me," the alien said and flew away.

My mom walked in reading a book and saw the ceiling. She almost fainted right there on the rug.

It was my birthday last Wednesday. We had a big party with all my friends. My mom made a chocolate cake and lit the candles. Everyone started singing really loud. I was approaching the cake to blow them out.

"Make a big wish!" my dad yelled.

I closed my eyes and blew hard enough. Then my friend Timmy turned green and fainted. We were scared so my dad shook him gently. Timmy woke up fast.

"I think I ate too much toasted bread," Timmy said.

We did not go to the hospital because he was okay. After that we did finger painting together. It was messy but fun. My mom said we were behind schedule for presents. I got a toy car that looked foreign. It had a heavy weight to make it go fast. It was the best day ever.

My birthday party was almost impossible to save. Mom was coaching my soccer team, so Dad was in charge. He tried baking a cake, but he twisted his ankle. The cake fell and got crushed on the floor! It looked like a big brown blob.

"Oh no, the party is ruined!" I yelled loudly.

"Don't worry, we are keeping it fun," Dad said.

Then my friend Sam reached into his bag. He pulled out huge balloons that were floating everywhere. We played games throughout the whole afternoon. Suddenly, Sam let out a huge sneeze. The candles disappeared because he blew them out too fast! It was the best birthday ever, even without a perfect cake. My family is really important to me.

My friends and I found a secret cave in the woods. The surrounding trees were huge and dark. I was thrilled but also a little scared. We walked inside and it smelled like old dirt. Suddenly, we saw something floating in the air! It looked like a ghost but it was just a white bag. 

"Look out!" yelled my friend Sam. "It might be a trap!"

We ran deeper and found a shiny treasure chest. Inside there were fourteen gold coins and a silver needle. I used all my strength to lift the heavy box. We thought we were rich! Later we sat by a fire and toasted marshmallows. It was enough adventure for one day.

My birthday party was going to be the best. I knew exactly what I wanted for a present. I wanted a parrot from a foreign jungle. I trained all month to be ready for it.

Then I heard a loud knock on the door. My friend Billy flew inside with a big box. "Open it now!" Billy yelled.

I ripped the paper hanging off the side. Inside was a robot, not a parrot. I felt crushed. It made a weird sounding noise throughout the room.

"Do you like it?" asked my mom.

I tried to smile, but it was a failure. Then the robot fainted on the floor. We all laughed really hard. It was actually a fun toy after all.

I woke up early because my alarm clock was loud. It was the beginning of a big day at school. Mom made toast and I spread lots of jam on it. My brain felt tired but I was ready for gym class. We played tag and I ran very fast.

Suddenly, Timmy fell down and started crying. "My knee hurts!" he yelled. The teacher blew her loud silver whistle. She said, "Everyone remain calm and stand back." Timmy went to the nurse, but he didn't need a hospital.

At lunch, I lost my sandwich but found a cookie. I also drew a picture of a white lamb. It was a good day, but now I have lots of homework.

It was Wednesday and it was raining very hard outside. My dog Max was sad because we couldn't go to the park. He grabbed my dad’s old guitar and chewed on the strings.

"Max, stop that right now!" I yelled at him.

Max dropped the guitar and ran into the kitchen. He found a big black beetle near the fridge. He started bumping his nose against it. I thought about the danger but I just laughed.

"You are a silly dog," I said to him.

Then the sun came out so we went outside climbing on the rocks. I threw a stick and Max obtained it quickly. We saw a man boating on the lake. Everyone started cheering because the rain stopped. It was the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old castle. It was dark and scary inside. We heard a loud thumping noise from the basement. The floor shook and we were scared. 

"Did you hear that sounding like a monster?" asked Sam.

"Yes, but we kept walking," I said bravely.

We saw a dragon dumping gold into a pile. He was coaching a baby dragon on how to fly. The baby dragon had a cool design on his wings. Then the big dragon saw us! He toasted a marshmallow with his fire breath. He was actually nice. We ate the marshmallow and then ran home fast.

My friends and I love recess the best. We ran through the doors and into the sunshine. Today we were training for a big race. Tim crossed the line first and he grinned at us.

"I am the greatest runner ever!" shouted Tim.

We started jumping up and down because we were happy. But then Sarah crashed into a big tree. She was okay but her shirt got dirty. We all sat on the grass to keep her company. I had a plain ham sandwich for my lunch. It was boring but I was super hungry.

"Do you want my cookie?" asked Sarah nicely.

I said yes and we ate it together. It was a really good day at school.

Max and I walked into the dark forest. We saw a big, spooky cave and went inside. Suddenly, the ground started shaking and we grasped each other’s hands. A giant rock fell down and we were trapped!

"We are in big trouble now," Max whispered, trembling.

I looked around and saw a small light. It was simply a hole high up. We piled up some rocks gradually. I climbed up and jumped out. Then I pulled Max up.

"I remembered my rope!" I shouted happily.

We ran home fast. The sun rose and the scary cave disappeared behind us. We counted our steps all the way back. We learned the meaning of bravery that day. It was scary but we made it.

It was raining hard outside, so I played video games. My big brother is thirteen and thinks he is the best. We played a game about building huge castles. I scrambled to get all the bricks first.

"You are too slow!" he yelled at me.

I stewed in my chair but I kept trying. My castle grew stronger and his walls looked weak. Suddenly a dragon appeared on the screen. It moved fast and blew fire everywhere. I drew my sword and fought it. I was earning lots of points by following the monster.

"Wow, how did you do that?" my brother asked.

I won the game and everyone was cheering for me. I felt happy because I finally beat him. I did not need scissors or glue to build this castle. It took longer to learn, but I am the champion now.
