I sat at my desk and I felt trapped. We were learning math but I was sleeping inside. My teacher Mr. Jones started teaching about numbers and I just looked outside. A nice breeze blew the leaves and I saw a bird.

"Hey, pay attention!" shouted Mr. Jones loudly.

I jumped up and my pencil fell down. I struggled to pick it up because it rolled away. I wanted to be a sailor on a boat instead.

"Can you explain the answer?" he asked me.

I didn't know the answer so I just guessed. Throughout the whole class I thought about lunch. I believed that recess was the best part of school. Earning a gold star is hard work. I pulled a loose thread on my shirt. Finally the bell rang and we all ran outside.

I woke up early because my dog jumped on me. He licked my face and I started groaning. I put on my favorite shirt but it had a big stain. Mom saw it and shouted, "Change your shirt right now!" I grasped my blue shirt and ran to the bus.

At school, we played kickball and I hurt my thumb. It turned purple but I didn't cry. My friend Tim said, "Does it hurt a lot?" I said, "No, I am tough." I got an A on my math test and felt happy. I am earning points for a pizza party. I obtained five gold stars today! I hope I don't get a grounding for my dirty shirt. It was a pretty good day.

I was so excited for my birthday party. My dad brought a big box into the kitchen. I turned around and opened it super fast. It was a new pair of boxing gloves made of leather! I put them on and they fit good.

"You look like a champion," said my mom.

I felt certain that I could win any fight now. It seemed impossible before but now I felt strong. My heart was beating really fast.

"I need to start training right now," I told my dad.

He laughed and we went outside to play. I grew tired after a while but it was fun. It was the best birthday ever.

Once upon a time on a Wednesday I was boating. My robot dog Sparky was with me and he bounced around. Suddenly a big green spaceship flew down from the sky. It made a weird sounding noise like beep beep.

A knight walked out of the ship holding a sword. He looked foreign and I was very scared of him.

"I am here to seize the magic jewel!" he yelled.

"To be honest, I don't have it," I said.

Then thirteen tiny aliens ran out and scattered everywhere. Sparky barked and fourteen lasers shot out of his eyes. The knight ran away fast but didn't receive the jewel. We went home and had pizza for dinner.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were playing outside. My friend Billy was climbing the big oak tree. He yelled, "Look at me I am so high up!" But then he struck a branch and fell down hard. He started moaning because his knee was stinging really bad. There was a big green grass stain on his new pants. We all crawled over to see if he was okay.

My mom came out and saw us sitting in the dirt. "You boys need to remain calm," she said. She helped Billy up and started loading us into the car. We were keeping very quiet on the ride home. Billy got a band-aid and some ice cream later. It was still a good birthday even with the fall.

One day me and my friend Sam went on an adventure. We wanted to find the greatest treasure on the big mountain. I brought a map and Sam brought snacks.

We ran through the dark woods and looked for clues. Suddenly a giant bear jumped out! It was scary but I knew what happened next. I threw a shiny rock to trick him.

"Quick, run away!" yelled Sam.

We ran fast and the bear grew tired. We found a cave with a cool design on the wall. Inside was a box of gold coins! We were earning our prize. I was grateful we were safe.

"I am yearning for a snack," said Sam.

He ate a cookie and left not even one crumb. We went home happy.

My dog Buster is not very honest. He often steals food when nobody is looking. One day we went exploring near the big mountain behind my house. I wanted to see the birds but Buster just wanted snacks.

We walked for a long time and discovered a big tree. Something was hanging from a branch. It was a bird feeder!

Buster jumped up and stole a giant bite of seeds. A blue bird flew down and screeched at him.

"Stop eating my dinner!" I told Buster.

He looked at me with sad eyes. He needs more training. We walked home and Buster was still hungry so I gave him a real treat.

I was playing baseball at the park with my friends. The sun was hot and my heart was thumping hard. It was the bottom of the ninth inning. My team was losing, but I felt the weight of the bat.

"You can do it, Timmy!" my friend shouted loudly.

I chewed my gum fast and got ready to hit. The pitcher threw the ball super fast at me. I swung the bat with all my might. It sounded like thunder when I hit it. The ball flew high up like a rocket. It landed way past the fence on the earth.

"That ball is gone forever!" the pitcher yelled.

I ran around the bases and felt like a king. My reign as the best hitter had just started. Everyone cheered for me and it was the best scene ever.

Me and my neighbor Sam went to the spooky forest. We walked on a muddy trail and we saw a weird cave. Sam heard a scary moaning sound coming from inside.

"I am bearing a flashlight," Sam said bravely.

We went inside and something touched my arm! I screamed but it was just a wet leaf. We kept walking and saw a fountain with green water. A ghost was groaning by the water.

"Is that ghost honest or mean?" I asked Sam.

Sam did a loud whistle and the ghost disappeared fast. He stuck out his tongue at the empty air. We laughed and ran home because we did not want either of us getting scared again. We need more ghost training before we go back.

My brother Tom was coaching me for the big sleepover. We were playing a game in our fort under the balcony. He was the knight and I was the dragon.

"You have to roar louder!" Tom shouted at me.

I crawled out and grabbed the scissors to cut paper. We were making masks out of old newspaper. I dropped the glue but it didn’t break. I knew this was going to be fun.

My friend Sam followed me inside. "Is the game loading yet?" he asked.

We trained all night for the video game tournament. We didn't sleep at all. My mom said we were crazy. I know she was right but it was the best birthday ever.

I put on my shiny helmet and grabbed my plastic sword. Today I was a brave knight and I was on a quest. My brother Timmy was afraid but he came too. We walked through the dark woods behind our house. The trees were twisted and looked scary like a monster.

"I guarantee there is dragon gold here," I said.

Timmy shook his head and looked at the ground. "I think we went the wrong way," he whispered.

We kept walking until we saw an old shed. It was bearing a strange symbol like a painting. We went inside to search for the treasure. It wasn't gold but it was cool enough for us. It was a box of old comic books! We were happy explorers.

My cat Fluffy is really weird sometimes. Yesterday she saw a big squirrel in the yard. It was sitting on the fence and eating a nut. Fluffy’s tail started thumping on the floor really hard. She wanted to seize the squirrel, but the door was closed.

"You can't catch him," I told her. "It is impossible."

Fluffy didn't listen and she jumped at the glass door. Bonk! It was a big failure and looked funny. She tried to maintain her balance, but she fell over. I remember laughing a lot at her silly face.

"That was not very smart, Fluffy," my mom said.

Fluffy just walked away like nothing happened. She caught a toy mouse later instead. It is important to practice hunting even if you miss the squirrel.

Everyone on the soccer field was wearing blue jerseys. It was the big game and the weather was super hot. My coach shouted at us to spread out more.

"Pass the ball to me!" I yelled really loud.

My friend Sam kicked it and it struck my foot hard. I ran fast because I ate a protein bar for breakfast. I saw the goal and I counted to three in my head. Then I kicked the ball with all my might. It went right past the goalie and hit the net!

"We won!" everyone shouted together.

It felt like my reign as the soccer king had started. I was so tired but happy because we already won the trophy. I heard my mom cheering for us. Tomorrow we are going to have a pizza party to celebrate.

I was waiting for lunch for a whole hour. My stomach made loud noises in math class. Finally the bell rang and everyone ran. I opened my lunchbox carefully. It did not contain my sandwich. It had a weird painting my little nephew made!

"Oh no, I grabbed the wrong bag!" I shouted.

My friend Sam looked at the messy art. "Maybe you can eat the paper?" Sam laughed.

I was so hungry I thought about it. Suddenly, a bird flew down and screeched loudly. It grabbed Sam's roasted chicken leg. The chicken scattered everywhere on the grass. Sam was mad but then he started laughing. We shared my apple. I will check my bag for real food tomorrow.

My friends and I went into the scary woods yesterday. We were looking for the lost treasure box. Sam saw a big hill and we started to climb. Suddenly we heard a noise. A big monster was roaming around the trees!

"Run fast!" I yelled to Sam and Jenny.

The monster screeched loud and it crashed through the bushes. We ran super fast but Jenny tripped on a rock. I grabbed her arm and pulled her up. We did not have any caffeine but we had lots of energy! We escaped and hid behind a big log.

"I hurt my thumb," Jenny whispered quietly.

We didn't find the treasure either. But we are loading our backpacks to go back tomorrow.

I was playing my favorite video game with my brother. It was a racing game and I wanted to win. We picked our cars and the race started fast. I zoomed past him, but then he passed me back.

"You are going down!" my brother yelled loudly at me.

I gripped the controller hard and my thumbs grew tired. I pulled ahead right at the last big turn. My brother got mad and stewed in his chair. Then I crossed the finish line to complete the race. A big sign on the screen said "Winner!"

"That was not pleasant at all," he said sadly.

I opened a bag of chips and spread them out. He started stamping his feet but then he grabbed a chip. We laughed and started a new game.

Yesterday, I went outside to climb my favorite tree. My dog Spot came too and he sniffed the ground. The sun was hot and it almost scorched my back.

I saw a bird on a branch and it looked funny. Suddenly it screeched very loud at us! Spot barked back and the bird flew away gradually.

"Be quiet, Spot," I spoke to him.

"Woof!" he said and wagged his tail fast.

I knew he wanted a treat but I had neither. My mom says dogs cannot have chocolate or caffeine anyway. We sat in the shade and I felt sleepy. The wind started to wrap around us and it got cold. We went inside because tomorrow is a school day. My mom was moaning about the mud on my shoes.

I was running in the woods behind my house. I wanted to learn about nature for my science class. I saw a big hole through the bushes. It looked like a secret cave.

"I am the captain of this forest!" I yelled.

Suddenly, a tiny bunny disappeared into the hole. I was scared but I wanted to see it. I touched the dirt near the hole. It felt cold.

"Please remain calm," said my friend Billy.

He had a stick that looked like a knife. We made a schedule to watch the hole every day. We wanted to design a trap but we didn't. The bunny was stronger than us and very fast. It was important to let him be free. I put a receipt in the hole for him. It was a funny gift.

It was my birthday and I had a bouncy castle. All my friends came over to my house to play. We bounced really high and almost hit the sky.

Then my friend Sam looked at the door and shouted. "The door is stuck and we are trapped inside!"

We all got scared and started bumping into the walls. I shook the zipper but it did not open up.

"Help us get out!" I told my dad loudly.

He laughed and opened the zipper really fast for us. We were just pretending to be stuck in a jail. Then we went inside for cake and mom spread icing on it. We were stamping our feet because the cake was so good.

I sat in my chair and looked at the clock. It was already almost time for lunch. I was so hungry because I skipped breakfast. My stomach made a loud growling noise.

"Be quiet stomach," I whispered to myself.

Then Mrs. Miller told us to take out our math. I feared math class the most. We had to do page fourteen today. I looked through the book but it was hard. I held my pencil tight and I almost crushed it.

"Do we have enough time to finish?" asked Billy.

"Yes, just do your best," said Mrs. Miller.

Finally the bell rang and I ran outside. I jumped on the swings and touched the sky. It was like I was steering a spaceship. School is okay but recess is the best part.

My best friend Sam and I played the greatest video game. It was about space beetles fighting bad guys on Earth. I gripped my controller super tight. I was leading the team and my score was huge.

"Look out for that big green beetle!" Sam shouted loudly.

I saw the monster and I grabbed a power-up fast. My health needle went all the way up. We ran through a pretty meadow in the game. Then we reached the final boss near a big blue fountain.

"We have to complete the mission now," I said to Sam.

We blasted the boss and the computer made a happy noise. We won the game and ended up earning the gold trophy! It was the best day ever.

Yesterday at lunch something really bad happened. I sat down with my tray and opened my milk. My younger brother Billy ran over to my table. He looked mad and his face was red with anger.

"You stole my giant cookie!" Billy yelled loudly.

"I did not take your cookie," I said back.

He grabbed my sandwich and threw it on the floor. Everyone laughed at me and I felt like I was on an island alone. Then I found the cookie in his own pocket! He grinned and said sorry but it was too late. I thought about telling the teacher. But then he would get a grounding at home. Gradually I stopped being mad and ate my apple instead.

I was jumping up and down because it was game day. We played the Tigers and they are the greatest team ever. My coach called us over and he looked like a colonel.

"Be honest and play hard!" he yelled at us.

I had a nervous feeling in my stomach like a needle poking me. The ball hit the ground and I grabbed it fast. I felt a heavy weight on my back but kept running. It was a huge player dumping me on the grass!

"I know you can do it!" my mom shouted.

I got up and threw the ball really far. We won the game and got free pizza after. It was the best day of my life.

My friends and I played knight in the woods. Max had a sword and I had a shield. The trees were surrounding us and blocking the sun. We felt a cold breeze on our necks.

"Look at that big cave over there!" Max shouted.

We ran to the cave but it looked scary. I grabbed Max's arm because I was scared. A bat flew out and screeched loudly. It dropped a shiny rock on the grounding.

"Wow, it looks like a gold vein!" I said.

We tried to squeeze inside the dark cave hole. The weight of my backpack made me stuck. Max pulled me out and we ran away fast. We did not want to see that scary scene again.

One day my dog Spot was roaming in the big woods. He likes sniffing the ground and chasing squirrels. Suddenly I heard a loud moaning sound. It sounded scary but I was certain it was just Spot. I walked past a tree and Spot appeared. He was bearing a huge stick in his mouth.

"Drop it, Spot!" I yelled at him.

Spot just wagged his tail and his pink tongue hung out. He dropped the stick and gravity made it fall fast. It landed on an old wet newspaper.

"You are a silly dog," I said.

We left the woods and walked home. My mom was waiting for us on the porch. I guarantee she will not like the mud on Spot. He drew a muddy paw print on the clean floor. We had to give him a bath.

One day I was exploring in the woods behind my house. I walked slowly because the mud was very slippery. My dog Max was with me and he sniffed everything. Suddenly I saw a huge black beetle on a rock. It looked scary but I held my hand steady.

"Look at that bug Max," I whispered to him.

Max barked at the beetle and wagged his tail fast. I thought it was dangerous but it just sat there. Then everyone from my house started calling my name for dinner. It was getting late so we had to go back.

"Come on Max, we are leaving now," I yelled.

We ran home fast because I was hungry. I opened the door and saw my mom. It was only thirteen minutes past five so we were early. I didn't get a grounding for being late this time!

Me and my best friend Sam stood at the edge of the dark woods. We wanted to find the old tree house. It looked weird and spooky, but we walked in anyway. The scenery changed fast and it got super dark.

Suddenly something big happened! A monkey was swinging on a vine above us. He dropped a long silver thread down. I was screaming because I feared it was a snake.

"Grab it!" yelled Sam. "It is just a rope!"

I grabbed the thread and started climbing. I was clinging tight. Neither of us looked down. Sam climbed up next to me. My dad taught me how to be brave, so I didn't cry. We found the tree house and ate our snacks inside. It was the best adventure ever!

It was freezing outside at recess today. My neighbor Sam and I were stamping our feet on the ground. We pretended to be lost at sea like a brave sailor.

"We need water!" Sam yelled loudly.

We ran to the drinking fountain near the slide. A big black beetle was sitting right on the spout. It looked scary. Getting a drink seemed impossible.

"I am neither scared nor thirsty," I said.

We neared the swings instead. Sam found a stick and said it was our bearing. We grinned because play time was not enough. The bell rang too soon. We ran back to class before the teacher got mad.

I was playing Mario Kart with my younger brother Timmy. He is only six but he is actually pretty good. We raced through the spooky castle level really fast. Suddenly Timmy let out a giant, loud sneeze!

"Bless you!" I yelled while I kept looking at the screen.

He wiped his nose and grabbed the controller again. But I was already way ahead of him. I gradually got faster and faster on the last lap. Not a single car could catch me now. I crossed the finish line and I felt great.

"I win again!" I said. "I am the champion!"

I have won thirteen races in a row simply because I practice every day. A big smile spread across my face. Next time I will let him win one so he doesn't cry.

I was walking home and saw a huge silver robot. It was waiting by my front door and holding a chain. The robot had big red eyes and shiny metal skin. I was trembling because I was scared.

"Do you want to play?" asked the robot.

I crossed my arms and looked at his big hands. He held out a piece of old leather for me.

"Is that a toy?" I asked him.

"It is for my dog," said the robot.

Suddenly a green alien dog jumped out. It started to gnaw on the leather happily. I counted three eyes on the dog. I guess robots can have pets too. I had seen enough already so I ran inside. I hope they don't reign over my house forever.

I was bumping into everyone in the hallway today. My heavy backpack was hanging off one shoulder, and I was steering myself toward the gym. I really struggled to open the big metal doors. Inside, Mrs. Green had set up a huge obstacle course.

"Okay class, time for the rope swing!" she yelled.

I grabbed the rope like I was holding a bungee cord. I jumped and spread my arms out wide. But I let go too soon and fell onto the mat.

"Try again, Jimmy!" my friend Sam shouted.

After gym, I was so thirsty at the water fountain. Then at lunch, I tripped and started dumping my tray everywhere. My spaghetti went flying! I spent the rest of lunch singing a sad song to my empty plate. It was a messy day.

Yesterday me and my brother Max went boating on the river. Our dad was coaching us on how to paddle straight.

Suddenly we saw a huge jungle island. We landed our boat and walked into the trees. The path was very twisted and dark.

"Look at that big hole!" shouted Max.

"Don't go near it!" I yelled back.

Unfortunately Max slipped on mud and disappeared. I looked down and my heart sank. But he landed on a pile of soft leaves! He found an old fort someone built long ago.

Then we heard a loud ringing sound. It was our dad calling us back. He was our guide so we ran back fast. It was scary but we were safe.

My birthday happened in February and I was so excited. I woke up very early because I was yearning for cake. I ran through the hall and pushed my brother’s door open. He was still sleeping and he started groaning loudly.

"Get up right now because it is my birthday!" I yelled.

He sat up and looked at me and grinned. Then he let out a huge sneeze right on his pillow. It was gross but I laughed anyway. We ran downstairs to see if Mom was keeping presents for me. There was a big blue box on the table.

"Open it fast before breakfast," my brother said.

I tore the paper and saw a new video game inside. It was the best birthday ever.

My nephew Ben and I went exploring in the woods. We saw a monkey hanging from a big tree. It was very weird because monkeys are foreign animals here.

"Look at him go!" shouted Ben loudly.

I thought he was going to jump like a bungee cord. Suddenly a tiny gnat flew right into my eye. I started groaning because it hurt a lot. Then the monkey started stamping his feet on the branch.

"I guarantee he is hungry," I said to Ben.

We ran home and got some toasted bread. The monkey caught the bread and ate it fast. It tasted better than stewed carrots. We grew tired so we went inside to sleep.

I was playing basketball with my big brother in the driveway. The ball was orange and bumpy, and I felt lots of strength in my arms. A tiny gnat kept flying around my face, but I ignored it. I started jumping up and down to get ready.

"You can't beat me today!" I yelled at him.

He just laughed and said, "We will see about that."

I dribbled the ball fast and ran right through his legs. My heart was pumping hard as I took the shot. The ball went in the hoop! I spread my arms out wide like an airplane. My brother gave me a high five. Then he pulled a crumpled paper from his pocket. It was a receipt for ice cream.

"I know you won," he said. "So let's go get a treat."

My friends and I went boating on a weird lake. We saw a dark island, so we started jumping out. My friend Sam was moaning because he was scared.

"I want to go home now," Sam said.

"Don't be a baby, Sam," I told him.

We climbed up a big rock to a great height. It took us almost an hour to get there. At the top, we found an old cave with a computer inside! It was glowing green. A robot king used to reign here long ago. Suddenly the ground shook, and we ran back to the boat fast. We were safe, but we never went back to that island. It was the best adventure ever.

Last week my dad drove me to Tim’s sleepover. I was a little scared because I thought nobody liked me. But Tim simply shouted, "You’re finally here!" when I landed on his porch. We played a cool game on his computer about roaming space zombies. I used all my strength to win but Tim grew very strong too. Then his mom made stewed beef for dinner. It was okay but Tim was moaning that he wanted pizza.

Later we ran outside in the dark. I closed my eyes and pretended we were scientists doing science. "Watch out for the monsters!" I yelled. We stayed up super late and told ghost stories. It was the best sleepover ever.

Yesterday, my friend Ben and I went exploring. We walked deep into the dark woods behind my house. The path was twisted and hard to see. We crossed a small river and got our shoes wet. Suddenly, we saw a big cave with scorched black rocks.

"Do not go in there!" Ben shouted loudly.

I didn't listen and started walking inside. It smelled weird and scratched my nose. We saw strange writing that looked foreign on the wall. Then we heard a low growl from the darkness. We realized we were in big trouble. We didn't want to get eaten by a monster.

"Run fast!" I yelled, and we ran away.

We didn't look back either. We were safe, but we were scared. Next time we are following the map.

I walked to school and ate my breakfast toast. I believed today was going to be really good. My teacher Mrs. Gable greeted us at the door. We did math and then the bell rang loudly.

At recess, my friends and I were roaming around the playground. We saw a big dog approaching the fence. It put its pink tongue through the metal wire. I touched its soft nose and it felt wet.

"He looks hungry," said my friend Sam.
"Maybe he wants my sandwich," I told him.

The teacher came over leading us away from the dog. I was grateful she didn't yell at us. I thought about the dog all day long. It was the best part of school.

My cousin Leo is my favorite nephew, even though we are the same age. He came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We made a schedule for the whole night. First, we played outside on the trail behind my house. It was a beautiful day but the sun scorched our necks. We pretended we were foreign spies.

"I will remain here and watch for bad guys," said Leo.

"Okay, I will be the champion of sneaking," I said.

We ran around for an hour until my mom called us for dinner. We were stamping our feet to get the mud off. Later, we trained my dog to sit for a treat. He is a good dog. I will always remember that fun day. Then the clock struck ten and we fell asleep.

I was walking straight to class when I saw it. There was a big black beetle near the door. It was crawling fast.

"Look out!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked down and jumped away. He almost stepped on it. We watched the beetle go under the door.

In class, Mrs. Green was talking about history. She said George Washington was a captain. I chewed on my pencil and looked outside. I was steering my own ship in my head. I was boating on a big blue ocean.

Suddenly I heard a loud thumping noise. It was my heart because Mrs. Green called my name.

"Are you listening?" she asked me.

I knew I was in trouble. Everyone was moaning because now we had extra homework. I just wanted to go to recess.

I rode my bike to school today because I was late. My mom bought me a new blue bike for my birthday. It is very fast and I felt stronger when I pedaled. I got to school just before the bell started ringing. It was sounding really loud in the hallway.

At recess, we played basketball on the court. The ball bounced high because of my height. But then the ball got trapped under the fence again.

"You need more strength to pull it out!" yelled my friend Sam.

I pulled hard and got the ball back. I felt like I had lots of energy, like I drank caffeine or something. I am training to be the best player in third grade.

My neighbor Tim and I went to the woods. We wanted to find a secret cave for science class. Tim wore his old leather boots because it was muddy. We walked for a long time and got tired.

"Look at that big hole!" shouted Tim loudly.

We ran over and looked inside the dark hole. It was very scary and we heard heavy breathing. I pulled Tim back and we hid behind a tree. A big bear came out and looked around. We kept very still and didn't make a sound. My heart sank because I was so scared. Then the bear walked away and we discovered a map on the ground!

"Let's go home now," I whispered to Tim.

We ran all the way back to my house.

My friends and I went exploring in the woods yesterday. We wanted to see everything in the old fort. My dog Spot came for company and he was running fast. The big metal gate was closed tight. We climbed over the wall and saw a scary rope hanging down.

Suddenly, Spot started barking at a dark hole.

"Don't go in there!" shouted my friend Sam.

"I am brave like a champion," I said back.

We walked inside and it was very cold and dark. My dad taught me to bring a flashlight. I turned it on and saw a huge spider! We got scared and ran all the way home. My mom sent us inside to wash our hands. It was the best adventure ever.

I feared math class today because I didn't do my homework. My teacher Mrs. Miller is nice but she likes stamping our papers. I walked to the water fountain and took a long drink. The water was cold especially on my teeth.

Then the bell rang and everyone started bumping into each other. It was finally recess time! We ran to the swings with the metal chain seats. My friend Jake shouted, "Watch me jump off and hit the earth!" He jumped and landed in the dirt surrounding the slide. He pretended to hurt his leg but it was just his imagination. I treated him like a doctor and said, "You need a bandage."

We played tag throughout the whole playground until lunch. I sat on the old leather couch in the library later. It was a good day even without my homework.

One night I was sleeping in my bed. I woke up because I heard a loud breathing sound. It was coming from the closet. I felt trembling in my knees but I got up. I pulled the door open slowly.

A tiny green alien was sitting there squeezing a toy robot.

"Please do not hurt me," the alien said.

I knew he was nice because he had a pleasant face. He simply wanted a friend.

"I won't hurt you," I said. "My name is Tim."

He told me he was roaming space and got lost. I believed him. I let him sleep under my bed. I have to explain him to my mom soon. My brain hurts thinking about it! We spread blankets on the floor and played. It was the best night ever.

My friends and I found a dark cave behind the school. It looked scary but we wanted to explore. We walked straight inside and it smelled like old dirt. Suddenly, we saw a giant spider with twisted legs!

"Run!" I screamed very loud.

We sprinted away but the spider was fast. I remembered I had a roasted crumb of cookie in my pocket. I threw the single crumb at the spider. The spider stopped running and started eating it. We escaped and ran home.

"That was close," said my friend Sam.

I reached into my pocket again. I found a blue feather and a piece of thread. Maybe next time we can catch the spider. I saw a dust ball floating in the air. We are never going back there again.

I had a weird feeling when I saw the green light. My robot dog Sparky started barking at the sky. We were boating on the lake near my house. Suddenly a big spaceship landed on the trail by the water.

An alien with three eyes walked out. He looked like a toasted marshmallow but purple. I knew he escaped from space jail because he had handcuffs.

"Do you have any caffeine?" the alien asked me.

"No, but I have a newspaper," I said.

He grabbed the paper and ate it in one bite. Then he jumped back in his ship. I was certain he was magic because the ship vanished. It disappeared like a needle in a haystack. Sparky and I went home fast.

My big brother Max challenged me to a race last Wednesday. We went to the meadow behind the school playground. It was freezing outside but I wore my lucky sneakers. I felt like a brave knight ready for a big battle.

"I bet you are afraid to lose," Max grumbled loudly.

"No way, I am faster than a ghost!" I yelled back.

We started running fast up the small dirt mountain. My legs felt heavy and my chest was groaning. Max chewed on his lip because he was trying so hard. I ran past him and touched the old leather fence first. I won the race and sang a happy song! Max was tired and looked like he was sleeping standing up. We went home and mom brewed us some hot chocolate.

Me and my friend Sam were running to the park. We were going to play basketball together. Sam is very tall for his height. I had to jump really high.

"Pass me the ball!" I screamed.

Sam threw the ball, but I missed it. The ball hit my knee and it was stinging bad. I scratched my leg a little bit. We kept playing anyway. We were bumping into each other a lot. It was a close game. The score was eight to eight.

"I am going to win!" Sam yelled at me.

I dribbled fast and shot the ball. It went right in the hoop! We were stamping our feet because we were happy. I obtained the win this time. We sat down on the bench waiting for my mom. It was a good game.

I was sitting on the couch and holding my controller. The screen was loading my favorite fighting game. My brother walked in and he was moaning about losing.

"I bet I can beat you this time," he said.

"No way, I practiced all week," I told him.

The match started and my heart was pumping fast. I saw the danger sign over my character’s head. He hit me hard but I did not give up. I blocked his punch and I was grateful for my shield. Then I did a super move and he didn't receive any warning.

I won the match without losing a single life! My brother frowned and started to gnaw on his thumb.

"That was just luck," he mumbled sadly.

I greeted him with a high five anyway. It was enough for me to just win once. Eight wins in a row is surrounding me with happiness.

On Wednesday, I walked to school with my big bag. The weather was hot, and I was sweating a lot. I greeted my teacher, Mrs. Green, at the door.

"Did you complete your homework?" she asked me loudly.

I nodded my head yes and smiled at her. I was earning a gold star for my chart today. If I get ten stars, we go camping outside!

At recess, we played a game about a lost sailor. We ran around and pretended the grass was water. I reached for the ball, but gravity pulled me down. I fell and ripped my pants on the scene.

"Oh no, you are tearing your clothes!" yelled Billy.

I was sad, but Mom fixed them up later. I hope I don't get a grounding for messing up again.

I found a robot sleeping in the woods behind my house. He was rusty and covered in moss. I poked him with a stick and his eyes turned blue.

"Hello," he said with a weird metal voice. "I am Unit 4."

"I am Ben," I said back. "Do you want to play?"

He stood up and started swinging his arms like a windmill. We played tag but he was very slow. He told me he was a guard for a spaceship. He was yearning to go back to the stars. I tried to teach him a song but he had no rhythm. He made beeping sounds instead of singing. Then we tried to climb a tree but he was too heavy.

"I must go now," Unit 4 said sadly. "I am keeping my friends waiting."

He flew up into the sky and I waved goodbye.

The giant robot landed on Earth with a big crash. It was huge and green and looked really mad. People were running away because they feared the robot. It started tearing the top off a tall building!

I jumped into my super suit and flew up fast. I am Super Sam and I am very strong.

"Stop hurting my city!" I yelled at the robot.

The robot roared and bounced a car off a wall. "I want all your pizza!" the robot said.

He was clinging to the side of the hospital now. I flew over and punched his metal leg hard. He fell down and made a hole in the street. The doctors treated the people inside but they were okay. I searched for a rope and tied him up tight. I threw him over the mountain and he never came back.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the incredible jungle. The weather was super hot, though we didn’t care. We saw a big fountain in the middle of the trees. Suddenly, I heard a loud groaning sound nearby. It was a monkey stuck in a vine, tearing at the leaves.

"We have to help him!" I shouted loudly.

Sam nodded and said, "I have a bungee cord in my backpack."

We treated the monkey nicely and cleared away the vines. The monkey started floating down safely. He was so happy, especially when we gave him a banana. Everyone started cheering for us. It was the best day ever.

One day me and my brother Sam went boating. We were dreaming about finding secret treasure on the island. We saw the dark island approaching fast.

"This is an important mission," I told Sam.

Sam grumbled because he was tired of pumping up the raft. We jumped out and ran into the woods. It was scary but we were brave. We found a big box under a tree! I used my shirt to wrap the box so it was safe.

"It’s just old rocks," Sam said sadly.

"No, these are magic rocks," I shouted.

We play with the rocks often now. Mom made us start cleaning our shoes before we came inside though. It was the best adventure ever.

One day my dad and I went boating on the big lake. The water was blue and the trees looked beautiful. Suddenly I heard a loud moaning sound near the shore.

"What is that noise?" I asked my dad.

He stopped the boat and we looked around carefully. We saw a baby duck stuck in some thick weeds. It was feeling very scared and was crying for its mom.

"We have to save him!" I called out loudly.

My dad paddled close and I grabbed the little duck. He was safe! Then we saw thirteen other ducks swimming over to us. I realized it was his family. It was an incredible sight to see them all together. The mama duck quacked like she was grateful. It was the greatest day ever.

I was climbing the big hill in my backyard. Suddenly I saw a shiny green jewel in the grass. I touched it and then everything felt weird. My feet started floating up into the sky!

"Oh no, gravity is broken!" I yelled.

I was flying higher and higher like a bird. I saw my younger nephew sleeping in his stroller. He looked very small from way up there.

"Get down here!" my mom grumbled from the porch.

I tried to swim in the air but it was hard. I thought I might float to space. Then I remembered the jewel in my pocket. I threw it down hard. I stopped floating and landed softly in the grass. It felt like a bungee jump. The jewel turned invisible and disappeared forever.

The woods behind my house are scary at night. My neighbor said a monster lived there, but I believed I was brave. I put on my red sweater and walked through the tall grass. It was raining hard and the wind was surrounding me. Suddenly, I heard a loud noise near the old oak tree.

"Who is there?" I screamed into the dark.

Something crashed down and it sounded like tearing metal. I saw a scorched spaceship twisted on the ground! An alien was trapped under a heavy branch. He looked sad.

"I am waiting for help," the alien said quietly.

I lifted the branch and he was free. He smiled at me. I was teaching him how to high-five when his mom came down. She took him home, but I will never forget my space friend.

My friend Leo came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We wanted to build a huge mountain out of blankets. I grabbed the big blue sheet and Leo got the pillows.

"Stop moaning and help me lift this!" I yelled.

We worked for an hour and the fort grew really big. It looked like a castle floating in my messy room. We brought snacks inside but I dropped a crumb on Leo.

"Hey, you crushed my chip!" Leo said.

We heard the phone ringing downstairs so we stayed quiet. My dog Buster scratched at the door and wanted to come in. He is not trained very well. He ran inside and jumped on the fort. It fell down fast. We were sad but my mom was bringing us pizza. We cut the pizza with scissors because we couldn't find the cutter. It was the best night ever.

My brother Tom wanted a big mountain bike for his birthday. He knew it was expensive so he saved his money. He didn't want toys or games either. He just wanted to ride fast. But when his birthday came, Mom made a big breakfast instead. We had eggs and toasted bread.

"Happy birthday!" I yelled and gave him a card.

"Thanks, but where is the bike?" Tom asked sadly.

Dad laughed and pointed to the garage door. There was a sign on it. Tom ran outside. The bike was huge! Dad paid for the rest of it. To accept the bike, Tom promised to be honest about wearing his helmet. If he didn't, he would get a grounding. We roasted marshmallows later to celebrate.

My neighbor Sammy and I went exploring in the big meadow. We were pretending it was a secret island. I had my mom’s old scissors to cut the tall grass. Sammy was coaching me on where to dig.

"Look at this spot on the ground!" Sammy shouted loudly.

I started digging fast and soon something appeared. It was an old rusty box. We were yearning to open it. I pulled hard and the box made a groaning sound.

"It must be pirate treasure!" I yelled.

Inside was just a bunch of old rocks. We laughed so hard. We often find silly things outside, but it is always fun. We left the box there for the next explorer.

I was running on the playground in February because it was cold. My friend Tommy grabbed my arm and twisted me around.

"Hey, look at that big bird hanging on the swings!" he yelled.

The bird was huge and it looked like it came from an island. Then something weird happened. The bird flew down and stole my sandwich. It spread its big wings and went up high like it was going to heaven.

"That bird is keeping my lunch!" I shouted at the sky.

I was mad because I hate cleaning up crumbs, but now I had no food. I threw a stick but I missed. The teacher blew the whistle so we went inside. I was so hungry for the rest of the day.

My stomach grew loud during math class. It sounded like a monster moaning under my desk. Finally the lunch bell rang and we ran to the cafeteria. I was so hungry but then I saw the food.

"Oh no, it is mystery meat again," said my friend Sam.

The meat was stewed in a weird brown sauce. It looked plain and gross. I walked through the line and obtained a tray anyway. The lunch lady was loading more glop onto plates. I decided to just eat my apple instead.

"I am going to the water fountain," I told Sam.

Lunch is usually fun but today it was bad. I hope we have pizza tomorrow.

My teacher Mrs. Baker said we had to design a new country. It was for science class but it felt like art. I drew a big green island with a jungle on it. My friend Sam drew a place that was freezing cold. He said, "My people live in igloos and eat fish."

I said, "My people are clinging to trees like monkeys!"

Everyone scrambled to finish before the bell rang. We had to receive a gold star to get extra recess. Mrs. Baker walked around and looked at my island. She said it looked like a foreign land with a hidden jewel. Then the bell blew loudly and everyone started cheering. We ran outside especially fast because it was pizza day. I hope I don't end up in the hospital from eating too much!

I was playing Super Space Racer on my tablet. My brother Sam sat next to me and watched. My spaceship was floating in the dark sky. I neared the finish line, but then a big alien ship blocked me.

"Watch out for the green slime!" yelled Sam.

I moved my ship fast to the left. The alien brewed a purple potion and threw it at me. I dodged it just in time. Suddenly, zero gravity made my ship spin around. I closed my eyes for a second and pushed the turbo button. I stole the lead from the alien right at the end!

"I won the gold cup!" I shouted.

Sam grinned at me and sang a funny victory song. I started a new search for the next level. It was approaching fast.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. We were looking for pirate treasure. The scenery was really pretty because the trees were green. A nice breeze swept through the leaves.

"Look at that big rock, Max!" I yelled.

Max started digging very fast. He was sounding like a little pig. We discovered a shiny blue rock in the dirt. It looked like a real jewel.

"We found it!" I said. "We are rich now."

We ran to the creek and swam for a while. The water was cold but steady. Later, we went home and toasted marshmallows. My mom stewed some apples too. It was the best day ever. I bet that jewel is worth fourteen million dollars. We are loading our backpacks to go back tomorrow.

We played soccer in the big green meadow today. My team wore red shirts and the other team was blue. I drew a picture of our plan in the dirt.

"Pass the ball to me!" I yelled loud.

My friend Sam ran fast but he struggled with the ball. He kept tripping over his own feet. It was funny. I had a yearning to win the big game. I used all my strength and kicked it hard. The goalie threw his hands up but missed it.

"Goal!" Sam shouted and we did a happy dance.

After the game, we ate snacks on the bench. I had a cookie and not one crumb was left. I need to learn to wrap my ankle better. It hurts a little bit now but winning felt great.

I was hanging out at Sam’s house for a sleepover. We wanted an adventure so we went to the basement. It was dark and I feared the weird shadows. Sam held up an old newspaper like a sword.

"Do you see that thing approaching us?" Sam whispered loudly.

I saw something white and fluffy roaming on the floor. I did not understand what it was at first. I wanted to seize Sam’s arm because I was scared.

"It is just a feather from my pillow!" I yelled.

We knew it wasn't a monster any longer. We laughed and went back upstairs to eat pizza. Sleepovers are fun but basements are scary.

I took my dog Buster for a walk in the woods. He bounced up and down because he was so happy. We crossed a small bridge and saw a big tree. The roots were twisted and looked like scary snakes.

I pretended I was a brave knight with a sword. Buster was my helper, but he just sniffed a newspaper on the ground. Suddenly, we heard a loud snap in the bushes.

"What was that noise, Buster?" I asked him.

He barked at the surrounding trees and wagged his tail. We neared the bush and saw a tiny squirrel. It looked at us and then it ran away fast.

"I think it is an invisible spy," I said.

We kept walking until it was the beginning of sunset. I chose the long way home to tell my nephew about our adventure.

I was boating in space on my rocket ship. Suddenly I saw a giant castle floating near the moon. I parked my ship and walked inside the big doors. It was dark but I saw a robot sailor cleaning the floor. He was groaning because he dropped a crumb of space cake.

"Do you need help?" I asked the sad robot.

"Yes please! My boss will be mad," he beeped.

I used my superpower to float up to the ceiling. I found a broom up there and gave it to him. He was so thrilled to receive the broom.

"Thank you! I cannot explain how happy I am," he said.

We cleaned the mess and then ate the cake together.

My dog Buster is always getting into trouble. Yesterday he ran into the garden and started digging. He was wearing his blue collar, but now it is brown with mud. Buster chewed on Mom’s flowers instead of his bone.

Mom came outside and yelled, "Buster, stop that right now!"

She spread fresh earth over the hole he made. I tried teaching him to sit, but he kept jumping. I don't think he understood what I said.

Then he ran inside and grabbed Dad's newspaper. He ripped it up until it crossed the whole floor.

"That is enough, you silly dog!" I said.

We love Buster, even when he makes a big mess.

Yesterday I discovered something cool in the woods. My dog Buster was sniffing a big rock and moving his tail fast. I thought he found a squirrel, but it was just a turtle.

I tried to pick it up, but the weight was heavy. Buster started barking super loud like a ringing bell. My mom came over to see what happened. She looked at the turtle and smiled at me.

"Don't touch it, or it might feel anger," she said.

"Is he swearing at us in turtle language?" I asked.

Mom laughed and said turtles don't do swearing. She told me it is important to learn about nature but not touch. We moved away so the turtle could be safe. Buster wanted to stay, but I had to guide him home for dinner. It was the best day ever.

My neighbor has a cool basketball hoop in his driveway. Last Wednesday, I went over there to play with his nephew. We played a huge game and we fought hard to win. He is tall, but I am super fast. I caught the ball and I threw it high up.

It missed and hit the garage door really loud. My neighbor appeared and he looked kind of mad at us. I thought I heard him swearing under his breath. He chewed on a piece of gum and stared at me.

"Be careful with that ball please," he said.

"Okay, we will stop bringing it near the door," I said.

He greeted us with a smile then and went inside. We played one single game more and I won. I was grateful that he let us play there. We had to wrap up before it got dark.

My friends came over for a big sleepover on Saturday. We wanted to do a science experiment in the kitchen. My mom brewed some tea and then she went upstairs. We mixed red juice and green soda in a bowl.

"I am certain this will explode!" said my friend Sam.

We threw in some glitter and it looked like magic treasure. Then we discovered a box of baking soda on the shelf. We put it in and it made a huge fountain!

"Do you know how to clean this up?" I asked.

Just then we heard a loud knock on the door. It was my mom coming back for her tea. It was not a pleasant surprise for her at all. We spent the whole night cleaning up the sticky mess.

My younger brother Max and I went into the woods. We were looking for pirate treasure by the old river. I brought my pocket knife and Max brought a rope. He wanted to bungee jump off a tree, but I said no.

"Stop trying to complain," I told him. "We need to keep walking."

We heard a loud ringing sound coming from a bush. Max thought it was a monster, but it was just an old phone. Someone had left it there already. We kept digging near the big rock. Suddenly, I hit something hard! It was a metal box.

"We found it!" Max yelled.

I tried to explain that we had to share. But inside the box was just old rocks. We were sad but keeping them made us happy anyway.

The wind blew hard and it was freezing cold outside. My friend Tim and I were climbing a big mountain. We were yearning for the treasure at the top. It was very high and the height was scary. We saw a sleeping bear near a cave!

"Look out for the danger!" Tim screamed loudly.

The bear woke up and screeched at us. I obtained a big rock and threw it far away. The bear ran to chase the rock. We ran to the top and found a gold crown.

"We can reign like kings now!" I said happy.

Everyone in our town clapped for us. We felt like a brave sailor on the sea. But my mom was mad because I was swearing a little bit when the bear chased us.

I drew a map on a piece of old paper. My friends and I wanted to find the lost jewel. We walked for a long time up the big mountain. The path was scary and we held hands for company. 

Suddenly we saw a giant hole and we stopped.

"We have to jump across!" yelled Tommy loudly.

"I have a bungee cord in my bag," said Sarah.

We used the rope to measure the big jump. Sarah went first and she was stamping her feet. She jumped and landed by a sparkly water fountain. We all followed her and saw the shiny jewel. Everyone started cheering because we were so pleased. We took the treasure home and hid it under my bed.

We got on our small boat and started steering it. The water was blue and there was a nice breeze. We were looking for the secret treasure on the map.

Suddenly we saw a big green island. We neared the sandy beach and jumped out fast.

"Look at that big tree!" shouted my friend Sam.

I looked up and saw a rope swinging there. It looked like a fun bungee cord. But then I saw a scary sign. It said "BEWARE OF BEARS" in red paint. We heard a loud roar bearing down on us.

"Run back to the boat!" I yelled loudly.

We ran very fast and escaped just in time. We did not get the treasure but we were safe.

I was waiting for the bell to ring for recess. My homework felt like a huge mountain on my desk. I stuck out my tongue at the math worksheet. Then the bell finally started ringing and everyone ran outside.

We played tag near the big metal chain fence. Timmy was the guard and he tried to seize me. I ran fast but I tripped and landed in the mud. I felt trapped because my shoe was stuck deep.

"Are you okay?" asked Timmy as he stopped running.

"I think my shoe is grounding me forever!" I yelled back.

We laughed and he helped me pull my foot out. I crossed my fingers that my mom wouldn't be mad. I really needed some caffeine or sugar because I was so tired. It was a crazy day.

My robot Zap was hanging from the ceiling. He was bumping into the lamp and making noise. Zap is a cool robot because he can fly.

"Get down Zap!" I yelled at him.

Zap moved his metal arms and flew down fast. He landed with a big crash on the floor. I remembered that he has a jumping button too. I pressed the red button on his chest. Zap started jumping up and down like a bunny.

"I am the jumping champion!" Zap said in his robot voice.

I knew he was going to break something. I can guarantee my mom will be mad. I turned him off quickly. Next time we will play outside in the grass.

The alien guard turned green when he saw me. He looked weird with three eyes and blue skin. I remembered what my dad taught me about aliens. You just have to be nice to them.

"Hello there!" I greeted him and bounced a ball.

The alien grabbed the ball and threw it back. It was impossible but he smiled with all his teeth. Then a robot stole my backpack and ran away! It was not my imagination either.

"Hey! Give that back!" I shouted at the robot.

The alien helped me catch the shiny metal robot. We got my bag back before I got pneumonia. My mom would give me a grounding for losing it. Being a space hero is hard work sometimes.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the big scary mountain. We heard a loud noise surrounding us. It sounded like moaning and stamping feet. I was afraid but Sam was brave. We found a cave and saw a tiny white lamb inside. It was trapped under a big rock.

"Help me!" said Sam as he pushed the rock.
"I am trying!" I yelled back.

We twisted the rock and it moved. The lamb was free! Suddenly a ghost came floating out. It brewed a magic potion and threw it at us. We ran away fast bumping into trees. We obtained the lamb and ran all the way home. I will write about this in my diary.

My neighbor Mr. Bob is a science teacher. One day I touched a green rock in his yard. It gave me a shock and it was not pleasant. Suddenly I could fly up to the ceiling! I flew around my room and I drew pictures on the roof. My mom walked in and she screamed very loud.

"Get down right now!" she yelled at me.

"It is impossible but I can fly!" I said.

I knew she would take me to the hospital. But then a robot dog came in to gnaw on my shoe. It left a trail of oil on the rug. Mr. Bob ran in and tried to explain everything. He said the robot was from a secret island. It was a pleasure to meet a robot dog.

My brother Tom and I went to the old castle today. Mom was busy reading her newspaper so we snuck out the back door. We saw a big iron gate approaching us. It had a rusty chain on it but Tom threw a rock at it.

"Watch out!" I yelled when the gate opened.

We went inside and saw a scary dog running around. It was tearing up an old flag. Tom tried coaching the dog to sit but it just barked loud. I heard a loud knock on the wall behind us. It sounded like a ghost wanting to reign over the castle.

"Let's get out of here!" Tom screamed.

We ran home fast and I did not complain one bit. I think we will learn to stay home next time.

I was playing Super Mario with my brother Sam. We were racing on the rainbow level and it was hard. My car was floating off the edge a lot. 

"Stop pushing me!" I screamed at Sam. 

"I didn't even touch you, you just stink," he laughed.

I felt like groaning because he was winning again. Then my dad walked in and stood in front of the TV. My car disappeared behind his big legs. I crashed right into a banana peel. 

"Dad, move! You are grounding my car!" I yelled.

He scratched his head and believed he was helping. 

"Sorry guys, but dinner is ready right now," Dad said.

We paused the game even though I was losing bad. I bet I can beat Sam after we eat tacos.

I woke up early and ate my breakfast fast. Today was the big soccer game on my schedule. My stomach felt weird, and my breathing was super fast. Mom drove me to the field, and I saw my friends. We started roaming around and warming up on the grass.

The other team looked scary, and they kicked the ball hard. The ball bounced high, and I ran to catch it. I discovered a spot where I could kick it into the goal.

"Pass it to me!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam threw the ball in, and I kicked it really hard. It went right past the goalie and into the net! The goalie started moaning because he missed it. We won the game, and my mom gave me a receipt for ice cream. I stayed out of trouble and played my best game ever.

My cat Fluffy was acting very weird yesterday. She was jumping everywhere and stamping her paws on the rug. I told my mom that Fluffy was growing wings.

"That is impossible!" said my mom. "Cats cannot fly."

But then Fluffy jumped super high. She almost touched the ceiling fan. It looked like gravity stopped working. Maybe it was magic or maybe it was science.

"Look out!" I screamed.

Fluffy landed on the table and knocked over the milk. Neither of us could catch the cup in time. Mom was mad but Fluffy just purred. She ran outside to chase a bug. I think she wants to be a bird.

My neighbor Alex came over to play video games. We opened my new racing game and picked our cars. He picked the red one and I reached for the blue one.

"I’m going to beat you!" Alex yelled loudly.

"No way, I practiced all day!" I said back.

We started the race and my car was super fast. Suddenly, a weird green beetle flew in the window. It landed right on my nose and I had to sneeze.

"Achoo!" I sneezed and dropped my controller on the floor.

Alex zoomed past me and cleared the finish line first. I was groaning because I lost. Then my dad came in. He said we had company for dinner and the game was over. I realized I never win when bugs are watching.

Me and my dog Buster went boating on the lake. It was sunny but the wind blew hard. We saw a big newspaper floating on the water. I wanted to grab it but Buster barked loud.

"Don't do it, Buster!" I yelled at him.

He jumped anyway and grasped the paper with his teeth. The boat tipped over and we fell in the water! It felt very cold. Buster grumbled because he hates being wet.

"That was dangerous," I said when we climbed back in.

We shivered together until the sun dried us off. Next time we will just stay on the dry grass.

It was the most important game of the season. My team the Tigers was losing by one point. The clock moved fast and we needed to score immediately. I grabbed the ball and ran down the court. A big kid tried to block me but I jumped high.

"Pass it here!" yelled my friend Sam.

I saw him near the basket so I threw it. Sam caught the ball and rose up for a shot. The other team almost stole it but he was too quick.

"Yes!" I shouted when the ball went in the hoop.

We won the game and started earning our trophies. My love for basketball is growing every day. We celebrated with pizza after the big win.

We went into the spooky forest to find pirate gold. Max grabbed the map and I held the flashlight. Suddenly a giant beetle crawled on my shoe! I screamed and threw it in the bushes.

"You are going to get us in trouble," Max grumbled.

We walked deeper and the sun gradually went down. Then we saw a big cave. Max wrote an X on a tree so we wouldn't get lost. Inside the cave, we saw a shiny box! I thought it was gold, but it was just old rocks someone sold a long time ago.

"This is the worst treasure ever!" I called out.

We were steering our way home when we heard a roar. We ran super fast all the way back to my house. It was scary but kind of fun too.

I was playing my favorite video game called Space Race. My character was a cool robot named Colonel Zap. He had to find a secret jewel to win the level. I drew a map on paper to help guide him. Suddenly, a big monster jumped out and I froze! My hands were trembling on the controller.

"Watch out for the rocks!" my brother yelled at me.

I moved the stick fast and led Colonel Zap away. But then I crashed into a blue wall.

"Oh no, you lost a life!" my brother said.

I tried again and this time I grabbed the jewel. The screen flashed bright colors and I finally won the game.

One day I built a giant robot named Zordo in my backyard. He was huge and made of shiny metal that scratched the sky. I taught him how to fly by pumping his big iron legs. We went camping on the moon because Zordo did not need air. Suddenly a green alien jumped out and tried to squeeze Zordo's foot! The alien looked like a fuzzy lamb but with three eyes.

"Stop that right now!" I yelled at the green alien.

"I just want to play steering wheel," said the alien.

Zordo let the alien climb up to his head to reign over the stars. We were best friends and ate space rocks for lunch.

I love playing soccer at the park with my friends. The weather was hot and sunny today. We played in the big green meadow near my house. I was running fast and keeping the ball close to my feet. My friend Sam was bumping into me a lot. He wanted to steal the ball but I held on tight.

"Hey, pass it over here!" yelled my teammate Jake.

I kicked it hard and Jake scored a goal. The coach blew his silver whistle very loud. It was often loud when we scored.

"We are the champions!" Jake screamed happily.

I saw a tiny black beetle crawling on the grass. It was funny to see in the middle of our game. I thought we were going to lose, but we won. It was a really cool scene when everyone cheered.

We had a sleepover for my birthday last night. My friend Sam slept over and we ate lots of pizza. Then we went outside to play on the monkey bars. I was swinging really fast but my arm twisted a little bit. It hurt but I used all my strength to hold on. 

"Wow, you are so strong!" Sam yelled loudly.

"Thanks, but my arm feels weird now," I said back.

My mom made stewed apples for dessert and they smelled good. But then my brother grew jealous of my new toys. He had so much anger in his face. Neither of us wanted to fight on my birthday. Everyone started cheering when we opened the cake box instead. We ate cake and stayed up until fourteen minutes past midnight!

Yesterday me and Sam went on a big adventure. We went into the woods behind my house. We were looking for a secret cave. Sam was wearing his red cape. I had my lucky stick.

Suddenly we saw a huge bear near a rock! It looked really scary and mean.

"Run away fast!" Sam screamed at me.

We sprinted back to the fence. I tripped and struck my knee on a log. It hurt so much I almost started swearing but I didn't. We reached the safe grass just in time. The bear did not follow us. It was super scary but fun too.

I walked to the spooky cave with my friend Sam. We wanted to find the pirate treasure. Sam said he was the captain and I was the helper. We saw a big spider and I screamed very loud.

"Don't be scared!" yelled Sam. "Use your brain!"

I looked in my backpack and found some scissors. I cut the spider web and we ran inside. It was dark but we saw something shiny on the earth. It was a gold box! We were the greatest explorers ever.

"Look at this amazing scene!" I said.

A big monster was growing in the corner but we ran away. We landed back home early for dinner. It was a good day.

Yesterday at recess was the greatest time ever. My neighbor Sam and I were playing a pretend game. We pretended the jungle gym was a secret island. 

"I am the captain now!" I yelled loudly. 

Sam laughed and scratched his head. "Okay, but we need to find the lost jewel."

We ran around the playground really fast. The wind blew my hair all over my face. We were approaching the water fountain near the swings. Suddenly, a bee started stinging Sam on his arm! He started moaning because it hurt a lot. I didn't have any scissors or medicine to help him.

"We have to go inside right now," I said.

We missed the rest of recess, but the nurse gave Sam a bandage. We didn't find the jewel either, but we still had fun.

The cave looked dark and scary, but we moved closer anyway. I had a bad feeling in my tummy about going inside. My friend Tom was jumping up and down because he was excited. He knew there was gold hidden deep in the rocks.

"This is the most important quest ever," Tom called loudly.

Suddenly, a strange green light appeared from behind a big rock. A groaning sound started echoing, and then a tiny goblin walked out! He was holding a shiny golden thread in his hand.

"You must paid a toll to pass!" the goblin shouted.

I didn't have any money, but I gave him my sandwich. He smiled and disappeared into the shadows. Seeing the path was clear, we kept loading our bags with cool rocks. I was certain we were going to be rich explorers soon.

One day me and my best friend Sam went boating. We saw a long trail in the woods and we got out. It was scary but we had lots of strength. We heard a sound like something trying to gnaw on a bone.

"Did you hear that?" Sam asked me quietly.
"Yes, let’s go look," I said back to him.

We kept walking and the trees were growing tall. Suddenly we saw a wolf roaming around. It looked hungry but then we saw a baby lamb. The wolf was just waiting there. Gradually we threw our sandwiches to the wolf. He ate them and ran away. We spread our arms out and hugged the lamb. We were heroes and we went home happy.

My dog Buster and I went to the park. The sun was hot so we sat under a big tree. Buster started digging in the dirt. He dug a huge hole in the soft earth. I watched him carefully because he gets dirty fast.

Then Buster ran to the water fountain. He was thirsty. "Stop splashing me!" I yelled at him. He barked back like he was laughing. The water sounding like a river. Then my shoe sank into a mud puddle. It was gross. I looked at the swings with yearning. I wanted to play but I was stuck. Everyone at the park looked at my muddy shoe. "Let's go home, Buster," I said sadly. We walked home slowly.

I closed my eyes and gripped my magic wand tight. A scary robot appeared on the playground and it looked mad. It stomped on the ground and blew smoke from its ears.

"Go away right now!" I yelled at the big metal monster.

The robot just laughed and pointed a laser finger at me. I was scared but I drew a circle in the air. Suddenly a bright light flashed and the scene changed fast. My younger brother ran out and gave me a thumbs up.

"You did it! You are earning a hero medal," he shouted.

The robot turned into a tiny toy and fell down. I picked it up with my thumb and put it away. I heard everyone clapping for me because I saved the day.

It was the greatest day for our big soccer game. I was running fast because my dad’s company sponsored our team. We were losing by one goal and time was running out. I gripped the ball with my feet and ran hard. The wind was stinging my face but I didn’t care.

"Pass it to me now!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball super hard into the net. We won the game and everyone screamed. We celebrated by dumping the water cooler on our coach. Then we all drank from the water fountain. It was enough fun for the whole week.

"We are the champions!" I shouted to my team.

One day I met a small robot named Zog. He flew down from the sky in a shiny ship. Zog was green and had big eyes. He looked sad and his tummy grumbled loudly.

"Are you hungry?" I asked him.

Zog nodded his metal head fast. "I need batteries for lunch," he said.

I ran inside and grasped two big batteries from my toy car. I gave them to Zog and he ate them up. Suddenly his eyes lit up bright blue. He was so happy that he started singing a beep-bop song. Then he blew a puff of smoke and zoomed away. I hope he comes back soon.

My brain was so tired from math class. We are learning how to multiply by eight. It is super hard and boring. I was just staring at the clock and waiting for the bell. Finally, it rang! We all ran outside because it was recess time.

My neighbor Sam was hanging on the monkey bars. He yelled, "Watch this cool trick!"

But then he slipped and fell in the mud. It was freezing cold outside, so the mud was icy.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"Yeah, but my pants are wet," Sam said.

He looked funny, but I didn't laugh. That would be mean. The teacher blew the whistle, and the danger was over. We walked back inside, but Sam was walking like a robot. I hope he doesn't get in trouble for being muddy. I was just happy that math was finished.

I walked to the spooky island in the middle of the river. My dog Buster came too and he is the greatest dog ever. We wanted to find a secret jewel hidden under a rock. Suddenly Buster stopped and kept his legs steady.

"What is the reason you stopped?" I asked him quietly.

Buster started groaning and then he barked at a bush. A little bird was trapped in some old fishing line. The line was going to wrap around its wing. I caught the bird gently and took off the string. Then I sat down and played my guitar for it. The bird grew happy and flew away fast.

"We are like heroes," I told Buster with a big smile.

We never found the jewel but we saved a life. Then we crashed onto the grass and looked at the clouds.

I was exploring the woods behind my house yesterday. I looked at the ground and saw something weird. It was a big red bug with spots. I believed it was a rare beetle. I grabbed a jar and tried to catch it.

"Stay still, little bug," I whispered to it.

But the bug spread its wings and flew up. I feared it was a stinging bug! It landed on a flower, so I tried again. I opened the jar and moved very slow. I didn't want to squeeze it. Just then, my dog Buster appeared. He was bringing me a stick. He barked loud and scared the bug away!

"Oh no, Buster!" I shouted. "You ruined it!"

I am keeping the jar just in case it comes back.

My dog Buster was sleeping on the balcony in the sun. The weather was very hot and nice outside. I thought Buster looked like a big fuzzy rug. Suddenly, a blue bird flew down and started jumping near him.

"Go away bird," I grumbled quietly to myself.

But the bird kept thumping its little feet. Buster woke up and started barking and stamping his paws. He started running in circles and everyone laughed at the scene. He was chasing the bird but it was too fast.

"You are too slow, Buster!" my mom yelled.

The bird looked shiny like a jewel and flew away high. Buster was sad seeing it leaving, so I gave him a treat.

I was jumping up and down because it was race day. My neighbor and his daughter came over to our yard. We drew a line on the ground with a stick. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. 

"Get ready to run fast!" I yelled to everyone.

"I will seize the win today," my friend said.

We played rock paper scissors to see who started first. I put out scissors and I won the start. I took off tearing down the grass. My finger scratched a tree branch but I kept going. I was growing tired but I saw the finish line. I fell on the earth right at the end. I did receive the first place ribbon! It was just a piece of blue paper. I was so happy I won the big race.

I was already late for school and my backpack felt heavy. My math homework was hard and I struggled with it last night. Mom said, "Hurry up or you will miss the bus!" I ran to the kitchen and grabbed my lunchbox fast.

The bus was loading kids when I finally got outside. I sat next to my friend Jake and he was groaning. He said, "I think we have a spelling test today." I felt scared because I did not study my words.

At recess I saw a shiny feather on the ground. I crawled under the slide to seize it before the bell rang. I hope I receive a good grade on the test later. It was a crazy morning but at least I found something cool.

My best friend Sarah had a sleepover for her birthday. We put up a tent in her living room like it was a secret island. We were reading scary stories about a big creature. Suddenly the lights went out and Sarah screamed. 

"Something is wrong!" she yelled. "I am afraid!"

It was dark and freezing in the house. We pretended we were climbing a huge mountain to escape. My dad came in with a flashlight and laughed at us. 

"It just struck midnight, girls," he said. "Happy birthday Sarah!"

We stopped feeling scared and started singing happy birthday. We ate cake in the tent and it tasted really good. I have trained my dog to sing too but he wasn't there. It was the best night ever.

My brother had a sleepover for his tenth birthday. Mom brought pizza and soda to the basement for us. We treated the basement like a jungle gym. We were jumping on the couch and stamping our feet loud.

"Stop making so much noise down there!" Mom yelled.

My friend Jake was hiding behind the big chair. He was pretending to be a scary creature. He wanted some protein so he ate a cheese stick.

Then the lights went out and we got scared. We couldn't find the flashlight either.

"I think we are lost in the dark," Jake whispered.

We were seeing shadows moving on the wall. It was just our cat, but we screamed anyway. Mom came down with a light and laughed at us. It was the best birthday ever.

It was a boring Wednesday and I was boating in the pond. Suddenly a big silver robot appeared on the plain grass. He was the height of my house! I started running but my legs felt heavy. The robot was approaching me very fast. His metal brain was glowing bright green.

"Do you have any protein bars?" the robot asked loudly.

I stopped and looked in my pocket. I discovered an old squished granola bar.

"Yes! Eat this!" I yelled and threw it.

The robot ate it and flew away to a magic island. He was just hungry I guess.

My dog Buster escaped from the backyard yesterday. It was freezing outside so I put on my coat. I grabbed a leash and pretended I was a captain.

"Come back here, you silly sailor!" I screamed.

Buster ran to the park and I chased him. He found a squirrel and barked at it. The squirrel was scared and ran up a big tree. Buster looked like he was loading a cannon to shoot. Then I saw my friend Sarah and her daughter doll.

"Is he being bad again?" Sarah asked me.

"Yes, he thinks he is in a racing league," I said.

We finally caught him near the swings. Sarah gave him a roasted peanut from her pocket. We had a meeting about keeping him safe. Then we walked home and gave Buster a treat.

We had a big sleepover for my birthday last Saturday. My friends and I set up a tent in the living room. Suddenly, my dad appeared with a scary mask on. We all screamed and I gripped my pillow very tight. Then my dad tripped and landed on the floor with a thump. He was groaning because he hurt his toe on the table.

"Are you okay, Dad?" I asked him.

"I think my toe is toasted!" he said funny.

We heard my mom laughing from the kitchen. We discovered she was hiding behind the door the whole time. It was a funny night. Then we ate popcorn and stayed up super late.

One day, a brave knight was walking in a big meadow. He had a shiny sword and he was looking for dragons. Suddenly, a green alien grew out of the ground! The alien had three eyes and big purple scissors for hands.

"Do not eat me!" yelled the knight.

The alien laughed and said, "I just want a haircut."

But then it started raining pink slime from the sky. The alien reached up and caught some slime and chewed it. It was so gross that the knight fainted right there. When he woke up, the alien was gone. He ran home fast.

I was boating in space on my rocket ship. My robot Zog was painting the stars purple. Suddenly we heard a loud boom. A big green alien flew by on a shiny saucer. He looked very scary and I feared him.

"Give me your space candy!" the alien yelled at us.

"No way, it is my lunch!" I shouted back.

My heart was pumping fast. Zog simply pointed his laser finger. Zap! The alien’s engine stopped working. The alien fainted right there in his seat. We were safe but we were totally lost. We flew past a sleeping moon. Seeing home was the best part. I never want to go to space again.

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother and he was winning. My brain was hurting because I wanted to win so bad. I was trembling a little bit. He had an incredible lead and I was way behind. I saw a crumb on my controller and I brushed it off.

"You are going to lose!" my brother shouted at me.

"I will not complain if I lose," I said quietly.

Suddenly I got a blue shell from a mystery box. I threw it and it zoomed through the air fast. It hit him and roasted his car. I drove past him and cleared the finish line first! Everyone cheered for me and I felt so happy.

"Next time I will wrap this game up," he said groaning.

I just smiled because my yearning to win was finally gone. The race was closed and I was the champion.

My birthday party was going to be awesome. I invited fourteen friends to come over for cake. My mom greeted everyone at the door with a smile. We played games in the backyard on the soft ground.

"Who wants to play tug of war?" I shouted loudly.

My friend Sam said, "I have the strength of a champion!"

We pulled the rope hard and my team crashed down. We got up and tried again with more power. Suddenly, my dog Buster ran out and chewed on the rope. He thought he was playing too. My mom laughed and said, "Buster wants some company!"

Later, my grandma gave me a special box with a jewel inside. It was a shiny necklace on a thin thread. I feared I might break it, but I loved it. It was the best birthday ever.

I was sitting in my backyard and a giant metal beetle neared the grass. It was a spaceship! A green alien walked out and he looked sad.

"My ship is broken and I have an important mission," the alien said.

I looked at his ship and saw a wire hanging down. I knew how to fix stuff because I love robots. I connected the red wire to the computer immediately. Then a loud ringing sound started and the engine turned on.

"You saved me and now I can go back to earth!" the captain yelled.

He was actually from Earth but lived on Mars now. It seemed impossible but it was true. I heard my mom cheering for dinner so I ran inside. It was a crazy day and I didn't even get stinging from a bee.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. The weather was dark and cloudy but we kept running. We wanted to find the secret cave. Suddenly we heard a loud growl and felt scared.

"Did you hear that?" Sam whispered to me.

"Yes, but we have to be brave," I said.

We walked carefully and then we discovered a hole. It was the greatest cave ever! Sam grabbed his flashlight and lit up the dark walls. Inside was a big bear but he was just sleeping. We were very hungry so we ate our snacks outside. It was fun teaching Sam how to explore but we ran home fast.

We were camping in the scary woods behind my house. My best friend Leo said it was impossible to find the secret cave. We walked for a long time and crossed a big river. Suddenly I heard a loud noise like a drum beating.

"Did you hear that weird rhythm?" I asked Leo.

Leo started shaking and bumping into me. "I am dreaming about monsters!" he yelled.

We kept walking and saw a dark hole in the rocks. I was seeing everything very clearly because of the moon. We went inside and I used all my strength to move a big rock. Then Leo let out a giant sneeze! A bat flew out and scared us. We ran all the way home very fast. It was the best adventure ever.

I was sitting in class and feeling very bored. Mrs. Jones was speaking about math and it took forever. I was yearning for recess because I wanted to run. My legs felt trapped under my little wooden desk. Suddenly the bell rang and broke the quiet sound.

"Finally we can go outside!" I yelled to Sam.

We ran to the door but Mrs. Jones held up her hand. She said we had to remain in our seats.

"Nobody is leaving until I see your homework," she said.
