I looked in my bag and my homework appeared right there. I did my training for soccer so I almost forgot it. I showed her the paper and then we ran outside. We played tag and it was the best recess ever.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday last Saturday. He turned eight years old and we had a big party. My mom brewed some special tea for the grown-ups. I counted the candles on the cake twice. Then my dad reached for the big knife to cut it. Everyone started singing really loud throughout the whole house. Sam stood up to his full height and smiled.

"I want the biggest piece!" Sam yelled at us.

"You have to wait your turn," I said back.

Then we realized we forgot to buy ice cream. My dad ran to the store while we kept eating cake. I was reading my book until he came back. It was a really fun day for everyone.

We stood in line for recess and my stomach chewed itself. I really wanted to play kickball but the big kids were playing.

"You can join my team," said Sam. "We need a good kicker."

I nodded and we ran to the field. I was nervous as the pitcher neared the mound. He threw the ball fast but I got into a rhythm. I kicked it super hard and it went flying. It was like I was in the major league!

"Run!" screamed Sam while jumping up and down.

I ran to first base and I felt happy. Usually kickball is impossible for me. My confidence grew and I felt like a hero. It was way better than my weekend camping trip. Then the bell rang and recess was over. We walked back inside and I was hanging my head low. But at least I got a home run.

My dog Rex thinks he is a brave knight. He scrambled through the bushes leading to the big woods. I ran after him because I was a little scared. Rex found a big pile of sticks. It looked like a messy wooden castle. Although it was just sticks, Rex barked loudly at it.

"Come back here, Rex!" I shouted.

Rex did not listen and he struggled with a branch. He chewed on the stick instead of guarding me. He is not in the league of super dogs yet.

"You are a silly boy," I told him.

We walked home and Rex wagged his tail happily.

My younger brother Tim and I went on an adventure. We live in a big apartment building. We pretended the hallway was a jungle.

"Look out for the elephant!" I yelled.

Tim ran behind a plant. He is small but he is stronger than he looks. We crossed the dark hall quietly. Suddenly a bad monster jumped out. It was just Mr. Jones's cat but it looked scary.

"Throw the magic rock!" Tim shouted at me.

I threw my bouncy ball and it struck the wall. The cat got scared and ran away fast. We were safe. We went back inside for a snack. It was a good quest.

Yesterday me and my friend Sam went to the old woods. We heard a scary groaning noise coming from a big cave. Sam was scared but I knew we had to look. We walked carefully inside the dark hole. It was very cold and wet in there.

"Do you see anything?" Sam whispered to me.

"I see a glowing red eye!" I yelled back.

It was a monster but it was actually just stuck. It had a big rock on its foot. We understood it needed help so we started loading rocks. We threw the rocks away and the monster smiled. It ran away fast. We were heroes and we walked home for dinner.

I was playing a really cool video game called Ninja Jump. My character had to climb up a big mountain. The mountain was surrounding a secret castle. I was doing really well at first.

"You can do it, Jake!" shouted my brother from the couch.

I pressed the jump button, but I pressed it wrong. My ninja missed the ledge and he fell down into the water. It was a huge splash. I felt sad because I lost my last life.

"Next time use the bungee rope!" my brother said.

I stood up and stretched my legs. We had a team meeting about how to win. We decided to try again after lunch. Next time I will get to the top!

I was playing in the big soccer league final today. The other team was huge and they looked mean. My coach yelled, "Pay attention to your surrounding!" I tried to understand his plan but I was scared. The ball dropped right in front of my feet suddenly. I thought about scoring a single goal to win. My imagination went wild and I saw myself holding the trophy. But then a big kid ran at me fast. I was in danger so I kicked the ball hard. It flew past the goalie and hit the net! "We won!" my friend Sam yelled and hugged me tight. The whole scene was crazy and everyone was jumping. We got pizza after the game and it tasted great.

My friends and I went into the spooky woods behind school. We wanted to find the lost cave. My backpack felt like a huge weight on my back. We walked for a long time. Suddenly we heard a noise.

"Did you listen to that sound?" asked Timmy.

It sounded like a baby lamb but we saw nothing. We kept walking and found a big rock. It looked impossible to move. We pushed it together. Behind it was a secret hole!

"This is important for science!" I shouted.

We did not receive any treasure inside. We just found some cool bugs. It was enough fun for one day so we ran home.

I was sitting in class and looking at the clock. It was almost recess and I was yearning to go outside. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about the earth and rocks. I knew all about rocks because I collect them. Finally the bell rang and everyone ran to the door.

Outside the wind blew very hard and messy. I saw my friend Billy by the big red slide. He chose to play tag so I ran after him.

"You can't catch me!" Billy yelled very loud.

"Yes I can!" I shouted back and ran faster.

I got thirsty so I went to the water fountain. I drank enough water and then the bell rang again. We had to remain quiet in the hall. Recess was over way too fast today.

I trained all week for the big soccer game. My dog tried to gnaw on my cleats, but I grabbed them first. We climbed into the car and drove to the field. The other team looked huge, but I knew we could win.

"Listen up everyone," the coach yelled loudly. "Just pass the ball and run fast!"

I grasped the goalie gloves tight and stood in the net. A big kid kicked the ball super hard at me. I jumped and blocked it with my chest! It kind of hurt, but I felt pleasure when everyone cheered. Then my friend Sam scored a goal. We crushed the other team five to zero!

"I knew you could do it!" my mom said.

I believed in us too. The referee blew the whistle, and the game was already over. We won the big trophy!

Me and my dog Buster went outside to play. Buster is big and brown and thinks he is a sailor. He ran to the muddy puddle near the big tree.

"No Buster!" I yelled. "That is not water for swimming!"

But unfortunately Buster jumped right in the mud. Splash! He looked like he was painting himself brown. He shook his fur and mud went everywhere. It got all over my finger and my nose.

"You are so messy," I grumbled at him.

Buster started groaning because he wanted to play more. But it was important to go inside for a bath. He looked like he went bungee jumping into a chocolate cake.

"Come on, you silly dog," I said.

We walked home and he left muddy footprints on the grass. Mom is going to be so mad at us.

One day my dog Max and I went to the big meadow. It was sunny but the wind felt freezing. We walked until we cleared the tall grass. Suddenly I heard a loud thumping sound. I was afraid because it sounded like a giant rabbit.

"What is that noise Max?" I asked him quietly.

Max barked and ran towards the trees. I feared he would get lost so I ran too. We found a deer eating some scorched grass. It looked pleased to have company. Then the deer did a huge sneeze!

"Bless you Mr. Deer," I said.

The deer looked at us like we were invisible. It was not scared of us at all. We watched it until the sun started approaching the hills. Then we went home because we were tired.

I searched my backyard for the alien ship. I was thrilled when I saw a big green light. It was coming closer and closer to my treehouse. The ship was approaching very fast!

Bright pink smoke was surrounding the ship. I was yearning to see a real alien. Suddenly, a metal door opened and steam came out.

"Hello human!" shouted a small blue creature.

The smoke cleared and I saw his three eyes. I remembered my camera was in my pocket. My hands were trembling but I took a picture.

"Are you loading your laser gun?" the alien asked.

"No, it is just a camera for meeting you!" I said.

Then the alien smiled and gave me a glowing rock. I ran inside to tell my mom.

It was my birthday and the weather was hot. My mom said I am her best daughter ever. We played outside and pretended we were sailors on a boat. My friend grasped the map to find the treasure.

"Look at this wonderful gold!" I yelled loudly.

"That is incredible!" my friend shouted back at me.

We ran around but gravity made me fall down. My dad had to guide us to the cake inside. It was hard to maintain being quiet because I was excited. We ate chocolate cake and it was so good. Being ten is going to be the best year.

I was sitting in science class and looking at the weird hamster. His name is Mr. Fluff. Suddenly, Mr. Fluff pushed the cage door open and escaped! He ran fast across the floor leading to the door.

"Oh no!" yelled Mrs. Green. "Everyone catch him!"

I grabbed my lunchbox to block him but he was too fast. He ran under my desk and I discovered a hole in the wall. He squeezed through it. I grumbled because I wanted to hold him.

"I can’t believe he fits," said my friend Leo. "He has too much weight!"

We didn't catch him either. It wasn't a pleasure to do homework after that. We just talked about the hamster all day. Maybe he is eating pizza in the cafeteria now.

My nephew and I went exploring outside today. It was raining a little bit so I wore my green sweater. We ran to the big meadow behind my house.

"Look at that bug!" my nephew shouted.

He grabbed a big black beetle from the wet grass. It looked like a tiny tank walking around. I grasped a stick and we poked the dirt. Then we saw a squirrel holding a piece of newspaper. It ran up a tree like it had an important meeting.

"Where is he going?" I asked.

"Maybe to the mountain," my nephew said.

We pretended the dirt pile was a huge mountain. We climbed it until my mom called us for dinner.

Me and my best friend Sam chose to explore the spooky cave. We crawled inside and it was very dark and cold. Suddenly, a big rock fell and we were trapped!

"Oh no, we are stuck!" yelled Sam.

I remembered what my dad taught me about science class. We looked around for a lever or a button. I saw a shiny handle and I decided to seize it. I pulled it hard and counted to three. One, two, three!

The rock moved and we ran out fast. We were late for our soccer schedule. We didn't want either of our moms to worry. We saw a truck dumping dirt nearby. We were happy to have each other's company. Being safe felt good.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for pirate gold. Sam had a map but he held it wrong. We walked for a long time and then we saw a cave. 

"Look at that dark hole!" shouted Sam. 

We ran inside but it was scary. Suddenly a big bear stood up! He was huge and he looked mad. I stepped on a bug and crushed it. The bear started stamping his feet. Sam took out his plastic knife to fight. 

"Run away fast!" I yelled to everyone.

We sprinted out of the cave. We ran all the way home without stopping. We were dumping sweat because we were scared. Next time we will go to a different park. We didn't find gold but we are safe now.

My friend Tim and I drew a map to a cave. Tim wrote a big X on a piece of paper. We grabbed our flashlights and ran to the woods. It was dark and scary inside the cave. Tim led the way and I followed him close.

"Look at that weird bug!" I yelled. It was just a tiny gnat flying near the ceiling.

Suddenly we saw a huge door with a cool design. It looked like fire had scorched the wood. I tried to seize the handle but it was stuck. Then a girl jumped out. She was the king’s daughter! She had sharp scissors in her hand.

"You can’t come in here," she said.

I scratched my head and we ran away fast. We did not find treasure but it was fun.

Yesterday was the greatest day ever because it was my birthday. My friends came over for a sleepover and we played pirates in the backyard. I was the captain and my brother was a sailor. We made a ship out of cardboard boxes.

"Look out for the giant squid!" I shouted loudly.

We sprinted across the grass but then gravity pulled me down. I crashed right into the mud and a gnat flew in my nose.

"Are you okay captain?" my friend Sam asked me.

I believed I was hurt but then my mom appeared with cake. Nothing is wrong when there is chocolate cake. I guarantee it was the best party ever. My dad helped guide us inside to eat. We stayed up super late and told ghost stories too.

My friends and I went through the dark spooky woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. Ben had a map but it was ripped.

"I think the gold is near the big rock," said Ben.

We walked slowly and then we heard a loud roar. A giant bear jumped out from the bushes! We were scared and we sprinted very fast away. We ran until we saw a small cave.

"Quick, go inside!" I yelled to everyone.

We hid in the dark and waited quietly. The bear roared again but gradually walked away. We escaped the danger. Inside the cave, gold coins were scattered everywhere on the ground.

Ben grinned at me and said, "We are rich!"

I thought we were lucky. We trained to be explorers and we found it.

We went camping in the scary woods near my house. My brother Ben held the map and he looked brave. But I really feared the big, dark cave ahead.

"Don't go in there!" I screamed loudly at him.

Ben didn't listen and he walked right inside anyway. Suddenly a big bat flew out and screeched at us. I thought it was meaning to bite my nose! We ran away fast and we fell down.

"That was so scary!" Ben yelled.

We treated our scraped knees and went back home. Ben told Mom he sold the map to a ghost. She just laughed at us dumping our gear. We are never going back there again.

My friends and I went into the dark forest today. We wanted to find the old haunted cabin. We walked for a long time and finally reached a big hill. 

"Look at that spooky light!" said my friend Sam. 

We neared the top and saw a blue ghost floating there. It looked like a big cloud with eyes. I was scared but I did not run away. I turned on my flashlight and shined it at the ghost. 

"Go away ghost!" I yelled really loud. 

The ghost did not like the light and it flew away fast. We saw the cabin but it was locked tight. We sat down and ate toasted marshmallows for a snack. We did not learn the ghost's name but it was fun. It was almost fourteen minutes past dinner so we ran home.

One day I went outside to the woods behind my house. The sun was hot and it scorched the dry grass. I saw my dog Buster running near the big oak tree. He greeted me with a loud bark and wagged his tail. We walked deeper into the trees to look for bugs.

"Look at that big spider web!" I screamed loudly.

The web had a cool design and was very shiny. I grasped a stick and poked it a little bit. Then we decided to make a campfire for lunch. We toasted some marshmallows until they were brown. Mine got roasted too much and turned black.

"This tastes like charcoal," I said to Buster.

He didn't care and ate it anyway. Then I used my fingers to comb his fur. We played until the sun went down. It was the best day ever.

I put on my green sweater because there was a cold breeze. I went to the big park with my nephew Sam. We were looking for a cool creature in the dirt. Suddenly, Sam started bumping into me and pointing at a log.

"Look at that giant shiny beetle!" Sam yelled loudly.

It was trying to lift a huge leaf, although the weight was heavy. It seemed impossible for a tiny bug. The beetle pushed longer and harder. Then a bird flew down and started singing a song.

"Stop singing or you will scare him!" I said.

The bird flew away and we ate toasted bread for a snack. I felt like I was coaching the beetle to win. My mom says swearing is bad so I just cheered. It was the best bug hunt ever.

It was Tuesday and we had science class after lunch. I was so hungry but I ate my sandwich quickly. Then we went outside for recess and played on the climbing wall. My friend Sam climbed to the top like he was doing a bungee jump.

We went inside and Mrs. Green put a big bowl of water on her desk. It was a scene because everyone wanted to see the experiment. We carefully put things in the water to see if they were floating. A feather stayed on top but a rock crashed down.

"Look at my paper boat!" shouted Sam. "It is boating across the water."

"That is very cool," said Mrs. Green.

I struggled to make my boat but Sam treated me nicely and helped me. Then I felt a sneeze coming and it was loud. Everyone laughed and then the bell rang so we left.

The baseball game was super important today. We were playing the Tigers and they are really good. I stood at second base waiting for the ball. My glove is made of brown leather and it smells nice. Suddenly the batter hit the ball very hard and high. It looked like it was flying to a desert island.

I started jumping up and down because I was scared. The ball came down fast and I caught it! Everyone cheered for me and I felt happy.

"You are the best player ever!" my friend Sam yelled.

"Thanks, I just got lucky," I said back.

After the game my mom treated us to ice cream. We didn't remain at the field long because it was hot. Winning feels great but ice cream is even better.

My neighbor has a big dog named Buster. Buster is usually nice, but sometimes he is naughty. One day, Buster escaped from his yard. He was roaming around the street. My mom was scared because Buster looked very big.

"Go inside quickly!" my mom yelled at me.

I ran to the window to watch. Buster saw a bird and ran fast. The bird flew up high and defied gravity. Unfortunately, Buster bumped into the mailman approaching our house. The mailman dropped his bag. Buster grabbed a newspaper and ran away.

"That dog needs more protein, not paper!" my dad joked.

He grinned at us. Everyone laughed, but the mailman looked mad. Then Buster’s owner came and took him home. It was an important lesson for Buster.

It was a rainy Wednesday at school and I was thrilled. I love indoor recess because we get to play games inside. My teacher greeted us and said, "You can pick any game." I ran to get the Connect Four box fast. My friend Sam twisted his face and looked mad at me.

"I wanted that game," he said in a grumpy voice.

"We can play together and I guarantee it will be fun," I said.

We played for a long time until the bell started ringing. I won the last game and felt like a champion. Then I looked down and saw a red stain on my sweater. It was from my juice box at lunch. I gripped my sweater tight but the spot simply stayed there. I hope my mom isn't mad later.

We went to a big mountain for my birthday. It was a wonderful day and the sun was hot. My dad pushed me on the big swing first. I was pumping my legs so hard and fast. The breeze felt nice on my face and hair.

"Look at me go!" I yelled to my mom.

"You are going incredible high!" she shouted back.

I reached for the sky and it was simply the best. Then we ate cake and the weight of it was heavy. I had a happy feeling inside my tummy. My brother started sounding like a monster to scare me. I tried to seize his cookie but he ran away. It was the best birthday ever.

Yesterday was a weird Tuesday in February. My best friend Sam came over. He was holding an old newspaper.

"Look at this map!" Sam yelled. "It shows a secret cave."

We ran outside and went into the woods. We walked for a long time. The path was leading us through big trees. It was scary but we were brave. We found a dark hole in the ground.

"I think a witch brewed potions here," I said.

Inside there were different colored rocks. It looked like a science lab. Suddenly we heard a loud growl. It was a angry badger! We ran home very fast. The reason we ran was because badgers bite. We are never going back there again.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were roaming around looking for a secret cave. Suddenly we saw a weird hole in the ground. It looked scary but we crawled inside anyway. It was dark and smelled like toasted marshmallows.

"What happened here?" asked Sam.

I remembered a story about a dragon. We saw a big shadow on the wall. I drew my toy sword very fast. Then a heavy weight crushed my foot. It was just a big rock falling down!

"Let's get out of this scene," I said.

We ran out together and ate stewed apples at home. We never learned dragon psychology but we were safe.

I was walking in the jungle and I saw a robot. The robot was silver and had a bright blue jewel. I gripped my laser stick tight because I was scared. The robot looked at me and beeped loudly.

"Do not be afraid of me," said the robot.

"Are you going to hurt me?" I asked him.

He shook his head and simply pointed at the sky. Suddenly the gravity turned off and we floated up high. We floated past a monkey reading a newspaper. The sun was hot and I felt like a roasted peanut. It was fun but I didn't want to float any longer. The robot pressed a button to complete the mission. We fell down and landed on soft grass. Then we ate toasted marshmallows together.

My robot dog Sparky touched a glowing green rock on Earth. Suddenly he started shaking and his metal skin turned purple! I was thrilled because he looked super cool now. But then his eyes turned red with anger. A stinging zap hit my arm like a bee sting.

"Sparky stop it right now!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't stop and he started floating up. I felt a heavy weight on my chest. It felt like when I had pneumonia last winter. I counted to three and jumped to grab his leg. I saw a glowing blue vein on his tummy. I pressed it to make him receive my command.

"Power down Sparky!" I screamed.

He fell down and went back to normal. We have to search for a way to fix him.

I was wearing my new sneakers today. They are red and super fast. At recess, I saw my friend Billy by the swings. He shouted, "Let's have a race to the big tree!"

My heart was pumping fast. We lined up at the fence. "Ready, set, go!" Billy yelled. I ran as fast as I could. The wind went through my hair. I struggled a little bit near the slide. Billy is tall and his height helps him run big steps. But I pushed hard.

I heard everyone cheering for us. I touched the tree first! It was the greatest feeling ever. Billy grinned at me.

"Wow, you are so fast," he said.

I thought I was going to lose, but I won. I will receive a high five from everyone later.

My brother Tim and I played soccer in the backyard. The sun was hot and the grass felt scorched. I was running fast with the ball. Tim tried bumping into me but I was too quick.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled loudly.

He was bearing down on me like a big truck. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. I kicked the ball past the scissors we left outside. It went right into the goal!

"That's not fair, you started early!" Tim shouted.

We played for a long time. Suddenly my stomach made a loud noise. I was so hungry. The bugs were surrounding us so we went inside. We didn't get in trouble for the scissors. It was a good game.

I was sitting at my desk doing homework on my computer. Suddenly, my little nephew appeared in my room. He is only three and he was roaming around my house. He started dumping all my toys on the floor.

"Stop that right now!" I yelled at him.

He just laughed and held up a shiny red jewel. It was fake but it looked cool. Then he made a weird noise sounding like a foreign language.

"I need to learn my spelling words," I told him.

He ran away throughout the hall and I chased him. Mom roasted a chicken for dinner later. It was almost eight o'clock and I was tired. Dealing with little kids is hard work.

My grandma came over for my big birthday party. She was bearing a huge box wrapped in red paper. I ran to the door and greeted her with a hug. The box was heavy, so I felt its weight immediately.

"Be careful with that box!" Grandma said with a smile.

We went inside and my friends appeared from the kitchen. We had to stick to the schedule because cake was next. I grasped the box and sat down on the rug. I needed scissors to open it, but I just ripped it. Inside was a sewing kit with a silver needle and thread!

"Do you like it?" Grandma asked me.

I did like it because I want to make clothes. Then I felt a sneeze coming and went *achoo* really loud! It was the best day since I turned eight.

We woke up very early for our big adventure. My big brother Tom said, "I guarantee we will find the treasure today!"

We started walking into the dark woods. A cold breeze blew through the trees. Everyone was a little scared at the beginning. We crossed a small river on a slippery log. I almost fell, but I grasped a branch just in time.

We struggled to climb the steep hill. Not a single person wanted to stop running or walking. We were growing tired but we kept going.

Suddenly, Tom drew a map from his pocket. He is thirteen and he thought he knew the way.

"Look!" I shouted. "The cave is right there!"

We found a shiny box inside. We felt like we were earning a prize for being brave. It was the best day ever.

Me and my neighbor Sam went exploring in the woods. We ran through the trees for a really long time. Suddenly we discovered a giant stone fountain covered in moss. It looked old and scary.

I threw my bag on the ground and we escaped. We ran all the way home before it got dark at eight. We brewed some hot cocoa and felt safe. No more scary fountains for us any longer!

My dog Buster is always dreaming about squirrels. He makes funny noises in his sleep and his paws start moving. Yesterday he actually escaped from the backyard because the gate was open. He started roaming around the neighborhood and sniffing everything. I was so scared about danger like cars, so I ran after him.

"Buster, come back!" I yelled really loud.

He just kept running and jumping over puddles. He chose to run into Mrs. Miller's garden. I tried coaching him to sit, but he didn't listen. Finally, he stopped to sneeze on a flower. I grabbed his collar and we walked home at a steady pace. Mom said we need a better schedule for keeping the gate locked. I am just glad he is safe now.

Me and my best friend Tom went to the old forest. We searched for the secret cave behind the waterfall. We walked for a long time and saw a big river.

"Look at that huge drop!" shouted Tom.

We struck a pose like superheroes and counted to three. We pushed off the edge and fell down fast. It felt like a bungee jump but without the rope! We landed in the deep water with a big splash. We swam to the side and saw the cave. We trained our flashlights on the dark hole. We were seeing something shiny inside. It was a gold coin! We want to go back again soon but next time we will remain dry.

My big brother Tom turned fourteen today. We had a party in the backyard. Mom roasted hot dogs on the grill. I gave Tom a present. It was a fake red jewel I found.

"Thanks, this is cool," Tom said. He knew I liked keeping shiny things.

Then my dog Buster escaped from the house. He ran right to the food table. Buster disappeared under the table with a whole steak! He is a bad dog but we love him.

Buster was moaning because his tummy hurt later. He felt the weight of all that food. I could see a little blue vein on his belly. He will learn not to steal food next time. We ate cake instead and it was yummy.

I thought today was going to be boring. We had math class and it felt very long. Then the bell rang and everyone shouted, "Recess!" I ran through the door very fast. My friend Sam was already by the swings. He was holding something strange.

It was a big white feather. He looked thrilled. Then the wind blew hard. The feather disappeared over the fence.

We watched it float away like it was boating on the air. Then the teacher blew her whistle. It was time for lunch. Today we had roasted chicken. It tasted good but I missed the feather.

One sunny day, me and my friend Sam went exploring. We were in my backyard but we pretended it was a jungle. We saw a big grey elephant behind a bush. It was actually just my dog, Buster.

"Look out! It is going to charge!" yelled Sam.

I gripped my stick like a sword. We ran fast to the treehouse. We were loading our backpacks with snacks. Then we started climbing up the ladder. I was clinging to the wood. Suddenly, I fell down but I landed in soft grass.

I sang a happy song because I was fine. Then an invisible monster greeted us. We fought every single monster and we won. My dad came out coaching us on how to be brave knights. It was the best adventure ever.

It was my birthday sleepover and my mom made breakfast. We were so hungry because we stayed up all night. My mom scrambled a lot of eggs for us.

I was playing my new video game called Mega Jump. It is about a green beetle that jumps on clouds. I meant to do my homework, but the game is so fun. My mom walked in and saw me playing.

We built a secret fort in the woods yesterday. My friend Sam and I scratched our legs on bushes. We wanted to find the lost king’s treasure.

One day I was outside in my backyard exploring. I felt a nice breeze and I looked up high. There was a big squirrel on the roof near my window. He was bearing a giant nut in his mouth. I thought he looked funny and cute. Suddenly I heard a loud noise from the big tree.

Me and my dad went boating on the big lake. The boat engine was loud and made a groaning noise. We saw a little duck clinging to a big rock.

When we hit the ground, my mom greeted us. "Did you find a new friend?" she asked.

The duck started singing a loud quack song. We let him go and he swam away happy.

It was a super hot day at school today. The sun scorched the playground and everyone was sweaty. I ran to the water fountain but the line was huge. My friend Ben was standing there too.

We looked at the scenery surrounding the school yard. The grass was brown and dry. I felt like I was invisible because the teacher didn't see me waving. She was busy teaching the other kids a game. The schedule said it was math time, but I just looked out the window. A shiny green beetle crawled on the glass. It moved very slowly.

I was yearning for lunch because I was so hungry. In science class we had to learn about sick animals. Mr. Brown said that sheep can get pneumonia just like people. That sounded really bad and everyone started moaning about the homework.

My dog Buster loves digging. We were building a fort in the woods yesterday. Buster was following me and sniffing the dirt. He found a big hole near a tree.

I was yearning to climb the big mountain. My dad was coaching me on how to pack. We were loading our bags with everything we needed. Dad put a compass with a red needle in his pocket.

My hands gripped the controller really tight. My heart was thumping so loud in my chest. The loading screen appeared and I saw the scary ghost. It was the final boss level and it seemed impossible.

A victory potion brewed on the screen. I finally won the game.

My younger brother Sam was turning eight today. He was stamping his feet because he wanted cake now. My mom was pumping up balloons and she looked tired. I grabbed a red balloon and threw it up high.

He was swearing he saw a monster in the closet. But really it was just his big teddy bear. I think he has too much gravity in his brain. 

Dad came in bearing a huge chocolate cake with candles. It looked like a chocolate fountain was on top.

Sam blew out the candles and we all cheered. I am certain he wished for a foreign car toy. He loves those fast cars the most. We ate cake until our tummies hurt.

I was playing soccer at the park for an hour. My team struggled because the other team was huge. They crushed us in the first half of the game. Then the ball flew right at my head! Yesterday me and my friend Sam went on an adventure. We live in the same big apartment building. We pretended the hallway was a spooky island. We neared the elevator and saw a dragon!

Sam jumped back and held up his shield. "We have to seize the treasure now," he said.

We ran to apartment number eight. It was actually a castle with gold inside. We were bringing cookies to Mrs. Lee. She gave us five dollars for earning it. It was the best quest ever. We bought ice cream after.

We went to the old forest behind my neighbor’s house. My friend Sam brought snacks with lots of protein. We walked for fourteen minutes and saw a dark cave. Suddenly a big bear appeared and it was stamping its feet!

I was looking in my backpack for my homework. It was gone but I found a crumpled receipt. Then I saw something weird under my desk. It looked like a tiny mountain made of dirt.

The teacher looked at us from her big desk. We stayed quiet throughout the rest of the math lesson. At recess we told everyone about the secret school plant. I think it is magic.

My dog Buster loves my birthday because he gets cake. I grasped his collar so he wouldn’t jump on grandma. Grandma sat in the big chair and brewed some tea. She brought me a cool present wrapped in old newspaper. I ripped it open and it was a rocket ship!

My birthday party started at breakfast. Mom made pancakes and we were singing happy birthday. Then my friends came over for the big surprise. We went to a trampoline park with a bungee jump!

I love playing soccer in the big league. My team is called the Rockets and I am the captain. Yesterday we played a really hard team near the tall building. I was a little scared but I ran super fast. The referee blew the whistle and the game started.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost treasure cave. The trees were twisted and scary. We walked straight for a long time. It started raining and we were freezing cold.

My dog Buster is weird and likes to eat dirt. I was playing outside and he was digging a giant hole. He looked like he was yearning for a bone in the earth. I grabbed his comb to brush him but he ran away.

I was playing my new video game in February. It was a cold Tuesday but my room was toasty. The game is about a monster island. I picked the blue creature because he is super fast.

The screen started loading and my heart was beating fast. The game opened and my guy was running through the jungle. I had to squeeze past a big rock. It was a breeze at first but then I messed up. My younger brother Sam is so annoying often. It was his birthday party and everyone was waiting. The doorbell started ringing and my friends ran inside. We played a game where you had to be a brave knight. I put a pot on my head for a helmet.

My friends and I went exploring in the big woods yesterday. We were tearing through the bushes and finding cool sticks. We walked for a long time and found a secret cave.

My robot Zog was wearing a cool hat. We landed our ship in the green jungle. Zog’s computer brain started ringing very loud.

"What is that noise?" I asked Zog.

Zog beeped and said, "I have to search for aliens."

We walked past big trees and blue flowers. Suddenly a purple monster jumped out! It was screaming and running at us. I simply pressed a red button on my belt. My superpowers made a giant net appear. The monster screeched and got stuck in the net.

"Good job!" Zog said to me.

We went back to the ship for snacks. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is always bringing weird stuff home. One day he ran into the woods and I followed him. We saw a big nest hanging from a tree. Then a bright blue bird flew out of it. It looked like a shiny jewel in the sky.

"What is that?" I asked Buster.

He just barked and wagged his tail. We walked closer and I heard a knock on the wood. A squirrel peeked out and greeted us with a squeak. I think the bird was foreign because it looked strange. Maybe it was sent from a far away place. I cannot explain how pretty it was.

"Let's go home, Buster," I said.

We ran back and Mom had bought us ice cream. I love exploring outside with my best friend.

I live in a big apartment with my cat named Tiger. One day, I saw Tiger following a bug to the door. He jumped up and threw his weight against it. The door opened!

We went outside and it felt like a hot jungle. We walked to the park and saw a water fountain. Tiger sniffed it and got his nose wet.

"Yuck! That feels cold!" I said to Tiger.

He shook his head and water flew on my finger.

"Meow," Tiger said, keeping close to my leg.

I was his guide, but then a loud dog barked. Tiger got scared and ran back home. I ran too, feeling my feet grounding on the pavement. We got inside and I closed the door fast. We are staying inside now.

My friends and I found a big map under my bed. It showed a path through the dark woods to a mountain. We packed our bags and started walking fast. Suddenly, a giant green beetle jumped out at us!

"Run away!" I yelled loudly.

We ran fast and escaped the scary bug. Unfortunately, we got lost near a prickly bush with a sharp needle. Then we saw a bear bearing a honey pot. He looked nice, but we were still scared.

"Is that treasure?" asked my friend Sam.

We saw a shiny gold coin on the ground. We were earning a reward for being brave! It was a wonderful adventure, but we went home screaming when a squirrel jumped.

One day me and my friend Sam went to the dark forest. We wanted to find the magic fountain. We walked for a long time throughout the big trees. Suddenly a huge bear jumped out!

"Run fast!" yelled Sam.

We sprinted away but I tripped on a single rock. I crashed into the dirt. The bear was getting closer and looked very mean. But then Sam came back and helped me up. He is stronger than me. We ran to a cave and hid. The bear went away.

"I am so grateful you saved me," I said.

We found the fountain inside the cave. A fairy greeted us and gave us gold coins. We were happy and walked home.

My dog Buster is incredible because he bounces everywhere. One day we went outside to the forest. I found a shiny rock in the dirt. It looked like a real jewel from the earth. I put the weight of the rock in my pocket.

"Look at this cool rock!" I yelled to Buster.

Buster barked and ran around a big tree. But then he ran into a mud puddle. He obtained a big brown stain on his fur.

We went home and I swept the floor. My mom saw Buster and looked at the ceiling.

"You are earning a bath tonight, Buster!" she said.

That was the beginning of Buster’s bath time. He shook water all over the newspaper. It was a funny day.

We went exploring in the woods behind my house today. The ground was muddy because it rained all night. I brought my pocket knife to cut sticks. My dog Rex ran ahead and he found something weird.

"Look what Rex has!" I yelled to my brother.

Rex was dumping a pile of leaves with his nose. He grasped a shiny blue feather in his mouth. We met a big bird once with feathers like that. It was impossible to reach the nest because of the height.

"That feather meant the bird was here," my brother said.

We tried to maintain our fort but it was falling down. We sat down and ate toasted sandwiches for lunch. Suddenly we heard wings beating fast above us. We looked up and saw the blue bird fly away. I wanted to wrap the feather in a napkin but I lost it.

It was my birthday and I was turning nine. I was running around the yard with my best friend Sam. The wind blew very hard and it was freezing outside. My mom shouted, "Come inside right now for cake!"

We went inside and the house smelled like stewed tomatoes. I heard a loud knock on the door. It was my uncle holding a huge box. The weight was heavy but he put it down simply. I opened it and saw a new bike!

"You are the birthday champion!" my uncle said.

I was so happy I felt like I was floating. I saw a little blue vein on my hand shaking. I sat down and started write a thank you note. My little sister was clinging to my leg. I hope my mom isn't thinking about grounding me for running in the mud. It was the best day ever.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday party last Saturday. He turned five and he was so excited. We played games and then my mom brought out the cake.

"Make a wish, Sam!" I yelled really loud.

Sam blew out the candles and spit a little bit. Then we ate cake and it was messy. Crumbs were scattered all over the floor. Suddenly, a big clown appeared at the door. He had a red nose and big shoes.

All the kids scrambled to see him do magic tricks. He pulled a rabbit out of a hat. Then he cleared the table for presents. Sam threw the paper everywhere and laughed.

"This is the best day!" Sam said with a big smile.

I will remember everything about this fun party. It was a really good day for my family.

My friends and I went into the dark woods today. We brought some snacks and a pair of scissors to cut vines. The sun was hot throughout the whole morning. Suddenly, a tiny gnat flew into my eye! It hurt but I blinked it away immediately. 

"Look at that big cave over there," shouted Timmy.

We crossed the creek and walked inside the scary cave. It smelled like smoke, as though something was scorched. A huge bear was sleeping in the corner. He started to gnaw on a bone loudly. We were scared he would wake up and chase us.

"Run back to the house!" I yelled very fast.

We ran until we struck a tree by accident. Timmy hurt his arm, but he did not need a hospital. It was the best adventure ever.

Yesterday I taught my dog Rex a new trick. I was bearing a big bag of treats in my hand. He was wearing his blue collar and looked cute. I told him to sit and listen to me.

"Sit down, Rex!" I yelled very loud.

He sat down fast and wagged his tail. Then I grew impatient because he kept barking. I opened the bag and took out a bone.

"Do you want this?" I asked him nicely.

He jumped up high and almost landed on me. My dad sat on the porch reading a newspaper. He laughed at us. Then he sent me inside to write my homework. It was boring but I finished it quickly.

My cat Fluffy is really crazy sometimes. She is straight black and has big green eyes. One day she climbed up the tall bookshelf. I heard something weird sounding in the living room. Suddenly Fluffy crashed down onto the floor! She knocked over a big bowl of popcorn.

"Oh no, Fluffy!" I yelled very loud.

My mom came in and saw the mess. Popcorn was scattered everywhere throughout the room. It spread all the way to the kitchen.

"You have to clean this up," Mom said.

I discovered Fluffy hiding under the table. She looked scared. I counted eight pieces of popcorn on her head. I looked up at the ceiling and sighed. Fluffy is not the best daughter for a cat mom. But I love her anyway.

I was hanging upside down on the monkey bars at recess. The sky was beautiful and blue, but suddenly the wind blew hard. My friend Sammy grinned at me from the ground. "I bet you can't jump off!" Sammy shouted. I shook my head because I feared I would fall. Then my teacher blew her whistle. It was time for lunch.

In the cafeteria, they served roasted chicken and mashed potatoes. I was pleased because I was super hungry. My little nephew goes to my school too. He walked over with his tray. "Look what I built!" he said. He had a tower of peas on his spoon. I started loading my fork with food. But then his peas fell on the floor. He looked sad, but I gave him my cookie. He smiled and his anger went away. It was a good day.

I was sitting at my desk and staring at the clock. The seconds hand was taking longer than usual to move. I scratched my head and looked at my math worksheet. It was full of hard problems. I started dreaming about recess. I wanted to be swinging on the monkey bars in the big meadow behind the school.

"Please stop moaning, Timmy," said Mrs. Krabappel.

"But my brain can’t contain all these numbers!" I said.

Just then, the bell finally rang for lunch. I realized I was starving. I reached into my bag and grabbed my lunchbox. We all escaped the classroom fast. I saw the cafeteria ladies loading trays with pizza. I did not complain one bit. It was going to be a good day after all.

I was trembling because I feared no one would come. It was my birthday party and it was still early. My mom was in the kitchen making stewed apples. She said, "Don't worry, your friends are coming soon."

Suddenly I heard stamping feet on the porch outside. The door swept open and my best friend Sam was there! He held a big blue box in his hands.

"Happy birthday!" Sam shouted while jumping up and down.

I was so thrilled and I wasn't scared any longer. We drew funny pictures and played tag in the yard. Later we looked at the decorations hanging on the wall. I felt so grateful for my friends and my growing pile of presents. It was the best day ever.

Yesterday me and my best friend Sam went exploring. We walked deep into the dark woods behind my house. Sam brought a big backpack with snacks and water. 

Suddenly we saw a huge cave made of gray rocks. It looked like a monster's mouth opening wide. I pointed my finger at the dark hole.

"We should go inside and look for treasure," I said.

Sam shook his head and looked really scared. "No way! There might be bears in there."

We went in anyway and it smelled like old newspaper. We saw something shiny but it was just a wrapper. We heard a loud growl and felt fear and anger. We ran out fast like we were doing a bungee jump. We ran for fourteen minutes without stopping. We ate a protein bar later but my mom says no caffeine.

My family went to my grandma’s house for Thanksgiving. It was freezing outside, but inside it smelled like turkey and pie. I grabbed a warm roll and sat by the fire. My cousin Timmy is the same height as me now. We wanted to play outside, but a cold breeze blew hard. So we played video games instead.

Later, my uncle brought in a funny sign with strange words.

"What is the meaning of this sign?" I asked him.

"It is in a foreign language," he said. "It says Happy Thanksgiving!"

We ate so much food. The lamb was good, but the turkey was better. Gradually, I got very sleepy. I fell asleep on the big rug. It was the best holiday ever.

Me and my friend Sam built a secret fort in the woods. The trees surrounding the fort grew super tall and scary. We heard a loud knock on the wood. It was a giant beaver with huge teeth!

"Run away!" I yelled at Sam really loud.

"Wait, look at his teeth," said Sam.

The beaver chewed on a stick, though he looked friendly. He taught us how to gnaw on wood too. Then we saw a magic fountain pumping purple water. It was so cool that Sam almost fainted. We drank the water and our muscles got big. Our quest was finally complete and we walked home feeling strong.

I was wearing my super suit and looking for aliens. My robot dog Sparky moved fast and sniffed every crumb. We had to complete our mission before dinner time.

Suddenly a green ship landed in the park. The door opened and a big alien walked out. He had huge muscles and lots of strength. Sparky barked loudly although he was scared.

"We come in peace," the alien said in a deep voice.

"Do you like science?" I asked him quickly.

The alien nodded his three heads and smiled. He was speaking a weird language but I understood. He struggled to find his map to search for his home. I helped him measure the stars with my telescope. Then he flew away to reign over his own planet. The mission was done and we went home.

I was camping in my backyard with my dog. Suddenly a green light appeared and scorched the grass. A big metal robot landed right there! His eyes were pumping red light everywhere. My dog caught a stick and barked at him.

"I come in peace!" the robot screamed loudly.

"Do you want a marshmallow?" I asked him.

The robot ate the marshmallow and his tummy glowed. Then a foreign ship came down and he disappeared inside. My mom came out after the smoke cleared. I told her I won a battle against an alien. She just laughed and paid me my allowance. I am a brave daughter.

We went to the big island on a boat. It took an hour to get there. We walked through the dark woods. My friend held a small knife for safety. Suddenly a huge bear appeared behind a tree. It was swinging its big paws at us.

"Run to the mountain!" I yelled loud.

We ran fast and my legs hurt. We found a cave and the door was closed. We pushed it open and went inside. We heard a loud groaning sound in the dark. It was a dragon with a small brain.

"I will eat you roasted!" the dragon spoke.

We ran out but the bear was gone. We were safe and stayed no longer.

One morning I ate my breakfast very fast. The weather was bad and it was raining hard outside. I wanted to go boating on the lake but we were trapped inside. My dog Rex was yearning to run around. He jumped through the door when it opened.

"Come back Rex!" I yelled loudly.

He disappeared behind the big shed. I put on my coat and grabbed a whistle. I ran outside and saw him digging in the mud. He found an old newspaper that was all wet. Then he started barking at a squirrel on the fence.

"Let's go inside for a snack," I said to him.

We went in and Mom roasted some marshmallows for us. It felt like we climbed a mountain but we were just in the yard. I used my imagination to make it fun.

One day I was walking and seeing a weird green feather. I picked it up and suddenly felt a heavy weight. My brain felt super fuzzy and hot. I looked at my arm and it turned purple!

"Oh no, this is big danger!" I yelled loudly.

Then a robot flew down from a great height. He had shiny metal wings spread wide. He struck the ground and made a big boom.

"Do not fear, kid," the robot said in a beep-boop voice.

He zapped the feather with a blue laser. I felt way stronger and I could even jump really high. I sang a happy song because I had superpowers now. Everyone was cheering for me. Then I flew left and went home for dinner.

It was a cold Tuesday in February and I felt tired. My teacher Mrs. Lee was talking but my mind flew away. I looked out the window and saw snow falling down. Then the bell rang and everyone bounced up for lunch. I was thrilled because today was pizza day! We ran through the hallway and I realized I forgot my money. I felt like groaning but my friend Sam saw my face.

"Do you want half my sandwich?" Sam asked nicely.

"Yes please!" I said and grinned with my tongue out.

It was a toasted cheese sandwich and it tasted like the greatest adventure ever. We kept talking about video games until the bell rang again. I will always remember that sandwich.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. It was raining hard and we were seeing shadows everywhere. We wanted to find the lost gold near the old cave. Suddenly, a big green monster was jumping at us!

"Run fast!" I yelled.

Sam tripped and started groaning because his knee hurt. A stinging bee flew by my head and I got scared. The monster was huge and scary but it was floating in the air. I grabbed Sam’s arm and we hid behind a rock. We had to remain very quiet. The monster flew away and we ran home fast. Everyone was cheering when we got back safe. We didn't find the gold but it was a cool adventure.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost magic fountain. Sam had a map and I had a flashlight. We walked through big trees and stepped on crunchy leaves. Suddenly, I dropped my flashlight on the ground! It broke and the light went out.

"Oh no! We are stuck here forever!" Sam yelled.

I grabbed his arm and said, "Don't be scared."

We saw a tiny light near a big rock. We had to squeeze through a small hole. It was like a needle because it was sharp. Inside was the beautiful fountain! The water looked shiny. I felt a heavy weight lift off my shoulders.

"We did it!" I called to Sam.

We drank the water and started our training to be wizards. It was the best scene ever. We never got lost again.

I was sitting in class doing math and my brain hurt. The clock was ticking like a tiny needle poking my ear. Finally the bell rang and everyone started cheering loudly. We ran outside for recess and the sun felt stronger today.

"Let's play tag!" shouted my friend Sam, sounding very excited.

I started following him but then I heard a thumping noise. It sounded like a giant elephant walking on the playground! It was just the big kids jumping off the swings. They landed hard and it shook the ground.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled back to Sam.

We ran up the big dirt hill like it was a mountain. Gradually I got tired and stinging sweat got in my eyes. But having company made it fun. Sam greeted me at the top with a high five. Recess is the best part of school.

My big brother Max turned thirteen last Saturday. We had a huge party in the backyard. The weather was really hot and sunny. Max twisted his ankle playing soccer, but he didn’t cry. I feared he would be mad, but he just laughed.

Mom made a cake that looked like planet earth. Everyone started cheering when she brought it out.

"Make a wish, Max!" I yelled really loud.

"I wish for a puppy," Max said with a smile.

Suddenly, our dog Buster jumped up and ate the cake! My dad started swearing under his breath, but it was funny. We trained Buster not to jump, but he forgot. It was the best birthday ever.

One day I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I wanted to find a secret fort but I discovered something better. It was a big pile of rocks that looked like a castle. My dog Buster was with me and he sniffed everything. Suddenly Buster let out a huge sneeze! It was so loud that some birds flew away fast.

"Bless you Buster!" I said to him and laughed.

We looked closer at the ground near the rocks. There were fourteen shiny acorns scattered all over the dirt. I picked them up and put them in my pocket. I felt very happy because I had obtained a treasure. I was certain that a squirrel lived inside the rock castle. It grew dark so we ran home for dinner.

"We will come back tomorrow," I promised Buster.

I was playing my new video game all day. It is about race cars and earning gold coins. The loading screen took forever and I was yearning to play. Finally, the race started and my car crashed into a wall. My brother started moaning because he wanted a turn.

"Let me play a single game!" he yelled loudly.

"No, I am going to be the champion," I said.

I tried again and I drove super fast this time. My car did an incredible jump over a big science lab. I was hungry but I couldn't stop playing. I won everything and felt like a hero. Then mom came in dumping laundry on the floor. She said I would get pneumonia if I didn't wear socks. I don't think video games contain germs but I put them on anyway.

I was reading a book about dragons and I suddenly heard a noise. My dog Max bounced up and ran to the basement door. I knew something was wrong so I grabbed my flashlight. We went down the stairs slowly. It was dark but I cleared away some old boxes.

"Look out Max!" I yelled because a shadow moved.

It looked like a giant monster. I drew my toy sword immediately. I felt like a brave knight ready to fight. Then I realized it was just a coat on a chair. I spread the coat out and saw a tiny mouse.

"It's just a mouse, Max," I said and laughed.

Max barked at it though. We were the best guard team ever. We ran back upstairs to have a snack.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. We saw a big pile of rocks like a giant mountain. Max started barking at a hole in the rocks. I looked inside but it was dark.

"It is too dangerous," I said to Max.

Max really wanted to go inside. He had a yearning for adventure. He tried to squeeze his body into the small hole. It looked impossible but he kept pushing.

"Stop it Max!" I yelled.

I grabbed his tail and pulled him back out. We crossed the creek and counted three frogs on a log. Suddenly lightning struck a tree nearby. It was a scary feeling so we ran home fast. We ate snacks together on the couch. I felt like a champion because we were safe.

Yesterday was the best day ever at school. I brought my new leather soccer ball for recess. We ran to the big meadow behind the playground. It was sunny even though a tiny gnat flew in my eye.

"Pass it to me!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball hard and made a thumping sound. Sam scored a goal and everyone cheered. Then the bell rang for lunch. I was so hungry. I ate every single crumb of my sandwich.

"Do you want to go camping this weekend?" Sam asked me.

I nodded my head yes. My teacher greeted us at the door. I felt grateful for such a fun day. We did math next but I was still thinking about soccer.

I bought a cool robot kit at the store yesterday. It was silver and had big green eyes. I built it fast but I forgot a screw. The robot tried to walk but fell over with a crash. It was a big failure.

"Are you okay, robot?" I asked him.

The robot beeped a sad rhythm and his eyes flashed red. He was heavy so I felt his weight when I lifted him. I remembered the extra screw in the box. I fixed his leg and brewed him some oil tea. Suddenly he flew up into the air! I saw him zoom around my room. Then he disappeared out the window into the clouds.

"Come back soon!" I yelled.

Me and my best friend Sam were looking for treasure. We had a map that my grandpa sold to us for a cookie. We walked through the dark woods surrounding my house. It was scary because the trees were moaning in the wind.

"I think finding the gold is impossible," Sam said.

"Use your brain, Sam, it is right here!" I yelled.

We started digging and I was tearing up the dirt. Suddenly I hit a box! We opened it but there was no gold inside. It was just a note about coaching soccer tomorrow.

"I am swearing that grandpa tricked us!" I shouted.

We were mad but at least we got paid with a snack later. It was a fun adventure for certain but next time I will measure the map better.

I was sitting at my computer and waiting for Sam. We play this super cool racing game every single day. My heart was thumping really fast because I wanted to win. Sam usually wins, but today was going to be different.

"Are you ready to lose?" Sam asked me through the headset.

"No way, I am going to be the champion!" I yelled.

The race started and our cars zoomed off the line. I drove really fast and went through a dark tunnel. I didn't listen to Sam trying to trick me. I had enough gas to make it to the end. My red car crossed the finish line first! Now my reign as the best racer begins.

I was afraid of the big slide at recess. Everyone knew it was the fastest slide ever. My friend Tim was climbing up the ladder quickly. He obtained a spot at the very top.

"Come on up!" Tim yelled down to me.

I was clinging to the metal pole at the bottom. The playground scenery was nice but I was scared. I took a deep breath and started climbing. At the top, I saw my lunch box scattered on the ground. Someone threw it!

"Who did that?" I asked Tim.

We went down the slide fast to pick it up. It was actually fun and not scary at all.

Yesterday I discovered a gross sandwich in my backpack. It was squished at the bottom and looked like leather. I think it was bearing mold because it was green.

"Eww, what is that smell?" screamed my friend Sam.

I stuck out my tongue and said, "It is my old lunch."

My teacher walked over to see the scene. She looked like a knight ready to fight a dragon. But the dragon was just my sandwich. I was trembling because I thought I was in trouble. I felt trapped in the corner.

"You need to learn to clean your bag," she said.

It was not a pleasure to clean it up. My nephew does better at cleaning than me. Next time I will eat my foreign food before it goes bad.

I was boating on a plain lake near my house. Suddenly, a bright green light appeared in the sky. It lit up the whole dark scenery. I felt scared because it looked very dangerous. The light turned into a big metal ship. A door opened and blue smoke spread everywhere.

"Hello human," a strange robot voice said loudly.

I thought I should run, but I was floating.

"Do not be feared," the robot said again. "We are nice."

Then the ship became invisible and just disappeared. It was weird but I felt pleasure that I was safe. I rowed home fast and told my mom. She just said to wash my hands for dinner.

One day my friends and I discovered a secret map. It showed a twisted path to a scary castle. We walked for a long time and got tired. Suddenly we saw a sign that said danger ahead.

"Look at that sharp rock like a needle!" said Sam.

We crossed a river and heard screaming sounds. It was actually just a lost lamb stuck in a bush. We helped the lamb get free and kept walking. The path got longer and darker near the foreign land. Then we saw the big castle doors open wide.

"We made it!" yelled Max while jumping up.

Everyone started cheering because we were brave explorers. We went inside to find the treasure box.

Me and my neighbor Sam were playing basketball outside. The ball felt like a heavy weight in my hands. I struggled to shoot it high enough. Sam laughed and threw the ball perfectly into the hoop.

"I guarantee I will beat you," Sam said loudly.

I wiped my nose because I felt a sneeze coming. The breeze was nice though. I scratched my elbow and tried again. This time the ball escaped my hands fast. It went right in!

"Nice shot!" I yelled.

Sam's mom came out with a newspaper. She is nice. I felt happy even if I didn't win. We played until it got dark.

Yesterday was a very bad day at school. I wore my new blue sweater to recess. Suddenly, a big dog escaped from the playground next door. It ran right at me and I screamed loud!

"Get away from me!" I yelled at the dog.

The dog jumped up and scratched my arm. It didn't hurt too much but I was scared. My heart sank when I saw a hole in my sweater. I fought back tears because I knew my mom would be mad.

My teacher ran over and said, "Are you okay?"

I nodded but I wasn't certain. The dog did not contain its excitement enough. I hope I don't get a grounding for ruining my clothes. Next time I will run faster.

Mrs. Lee gave us math homework and everyone started moaning. It was an important test tomorrow so we had to study.

"This is going to take an hour!" I yelled loudly.

At lunch, I grasped my sandwich but the bread was plain. I wanted it toasted but my mom forgot to do it. Then I went outside for recess and jumped on the swings. The metal chain felt cold on my hands. I pumped my legs hard like a bungee jumper. Suddenly, a bee stung my thumb and it was stinging really bad.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Sam.

I was groaning because it hurt a lot. We ran to the nurse and she put ice on it. I was already dumping my ice pack in the trash when the bell rang. School is fun but bees are scary.

My friend Max and I found a cave in the woods. The scenery outside was nice with big green trees. We wanted to explore for a good reason. Max had a map that looked like an old painting.

We went inside and it was very dark and scary. Suddenly, a tiny dragon jumped out and scorched the ground!

"Don't worry, I have a snack," said Max loudly.

He threw a crumb of his cookie at the dragon. The dragon ate it and let out a big sneeze. It sounded funny and we started cheering. The dragon was actually nice and wanted to play. We were very pleased. We tried to contain our laughter but it was hard. Max used his scarf to wrap up a shiny rock we found. It was the best adventure ever.

My nephew Sam and I were playing a new video game. The loading screen took forever, so we had a thumb war. I won because my thumb grew huge like a giant. Finally the game started and we climbed a big mountain.

"Look out for that zombie roaming around!" yelled Sam.

I used my sword to cut through a big green vine. It looked like scissors cutting paper. My hands were trembling because the boss was scary. He spread purple slime everywhere and it left a stain on my armor. We treated the slime with fire and it went away. The only reason we won was because we worked together.

"We remain the champions!" I shouted happily.

We high-fived and then we ate pizza for dinner.

It was my birthday party and I turned fourteen in dog years. I invited my best friend Sam for a sleepover. We played a game called "Sailor on the Earth" in the backyard. I was the captain and Sam was the sailor.

"Watch out for the danger!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam ran fast but he tripped on a big rock. He fell down and pretended that he fainted. I pulled his arm to help him up. He had a little cut on his finger but he was okay.

"We have to squeeze through the tunnel now," Sam said.

We crawled under the slide and it was tight. I was yearning for some cake so we went inside. My mom gave us big slices of chocolate cake. It was the best birthday ever.

One day me and my brother Sam went to the forest. We searched for a secret cave behind the old waterfall. We walked through the water and found a dark hole. It was very scary inside but we were brave. We crawled on our knees because the roof was low. Suddenly Sam stopped moving.

"Help! I am trapped!" Sam yelled really loud.

His foot was stuck under a big heavy rock. I was afraid but I pushed the rock hard. I was strong enough to move it a little bit. Sam pulled his foot out fast. We ran back to the light. We didn't receive any treasure that day. The height of the cave was too small for us. We went home to eat snacks.

I was boating on a lake and I discovered a robot. It was freezing cold but the robot was made of fire. He was groaning because he was stuck in the mud. I used my super strength to pull him out. He was stamping his feet to get the mud off.

"Thank you for helping me!" the robot said loudly.

I was pleased he was speaking to me. We walked home and I simply hid him in my room. My mom thinks I am keeping a dog. I trained him to hide under my bed.

"Do not burn my toys," I told him.

He promised to be good. Now we are best friends forever.

My nephew and I went to the park. He brought his new dog named Rex. Rex loves digging in the soft earth. Suddenly, Rex started barking at a big tree.

"Look up there!" I screamed.

A squirrel was stuck on a branch. Gravity was pulling it down. Rex grabbed a stick and threw it. The squirrel got scared and ran higher. Then Rex scratched his ear and sat down. My mom drove us home later. We were earning money for walking the dog, but it was just fun.

"Good boy, Rex," my nephew said.

We gave him a treat and he wagged his tail.

I rode the bus to school today and I forgot my lunch. My stomach was growling so loud during math class. Mrs. Jones was talking about gravity and how things fall down. Then I dropped my pencil on the floor by accident. Everyone looked at me and I felt my face get hot.

"Pick that up please," said Mrs. Jones nicely.

At lunchtime I had to eat the school hot dog. It tasted wrong and I wanted to complain but I didn't. My friend Sam saw me groaning and gave me his apple.

"Do you want to play tag?" asked Sam after we ate.

We ran outside and the wind blew my hair everywhere. I ran super fast and tagged Sam before the bell rang. I won the game and felt happy again. I remembered to wrap up my trash. It was a good day even with the bad hot dog.

My brother Tom and I played a big soccer game today. The grass was wet and slippery, but we didn’t care. Tom kicked the ball hard, and it flew across the field. I followed the ball and tried to run super fast. Suddenly, I tripped on a rock and scratched my knee badly.

"Are you okay?" yelled Tom from the other side.

"I think so, but it hurts," I said quietly.

I chewed on my lip to stop from crying. Then I got up and started pumping my legs again. The other team was stamping their feet and waiting for us. I knew I could still win this game. I kicked the ball and it scattered the dirt everywhere. It went right into the goal and we won!

I was playing my new video game on Saturday. It is a racing game with super fast cars. I was the captain of the blue team. My car was swinging left and right on the track. Suddenly, a big red truck crashed into me!

"Hey, watch out for my car!" I yelled at the TV.

My brother laughed and said, "I totally crushed you."

I remembered a secret button on my steering wheel. I pushed it and my car did a bungee jump off a ramp. I flew over the whole scene and disappeared into first place. I was so happy I almost fainted. Then I felt a sneeze coming. I sneezed so hard I dropped the controller. But I still won the race!

I woke up early today because I was certain it was Saturday. I jumped out of bed with a thumping heart. I wanted to go climbing on the jungle gym at the park. But then my mom walked in and frowned.

"Why are you awake?" she asked me with a sleepy face.

"I want to go play outside!" I yelled happily.

"It is only Tuesday so get dressed for school," she said.

I felt sad because school is not as fun as boating. Math class felt impossible and lasted for a long time. I was afraid I would fall asleep at my desk. Finally the bell rang and the room cleared out fast. I ran to recess and played tag with my friends. We pretended the swings were a boat. It was actually a good day.

I was playing my new video game for one hour. It was the best racing game ever. My brother Tom wanted to play too. He tried to grab the controller from my hands.

"Stop it, Tom!" I shouted at him very loud.

He pushed me and I fell on the floor. I was so mad I almost started swearing. Mom came in because she heard the noise. She looked like she needed some caffeine. Her hair was messy and she needed a comb.

"Both of you stop fighting right now," Mom said.

She looked up at the ceiling and sighed. She told us we got a grounding for two days. I had to search for my book instead of playing. It was not a fun day at all.

I woke up early because I had a big feeling today. It was Friday and we had science class first. Mr. Jones said we could build a castle out of boxes. I was so excited to start working.

"I want to be the knight!" yelled my friend Sam.

"Okay, but I am climbing the tower," I said back.

Suddenly a tiny gnat appeared right near my nose. It was annoying so I waved my hand fast. Then my stomach made a loud noise because I was hungry. It was almost time for lunch and I had a sandwich. I pretended I was bungee jumping off the chair when the bell rang. School is fun but eating is the best part.

I was so thrilled because my birthday was finally beginning. We had decorations hanging from the ceiling and balloons on the floor. My mom made a huge cake and spread chocolate frosting everywhere. It was going to be the best adventure ever. My friends came over and we played tag in the yard.

"I bet I can jump longer than you!" yelled Sam.

"No way, let’s measure it," said my best friend Leo.

We jumped into the sand and got really dirty. Later that night, we had a sleepover in my big tent. We stayed up late talking and dreaming about superheroes. My eyes got heavy and I fell asleep fast. It was a really good day.

Yesterday at school was super crazy. We had to do a big art project with scissors and glue. My friend Sam tried to cut a red paper rose but he messed it up.

"Hey, be careful with that!" I shouted at him.

Sam laughed and said, "I guarantee I can fix it."

But he couldn't fix it. Then it was lunchtime and I had a weird sandwich. My mom packed me foreign cheese with extra protein. It tasted funny so I gave it to the lunch guard.

At recess, we played a huge game of tag. The sun was hot and the grass felt scorched. I ran super fast like a needle through cloth. I tagged Sam right at the end and I won the game! It was the best day ever.

One day my dog Buster ran into the woods. He was sniffing a weird twisted stick on the ground. Suddenly I saw a squirrel floating on a piece of wood in the creek. The squirrel looked like a tiny sailor on an island.

"Look at that squirrel!" I yelled to Buster.

Buster barked and started running into the water. He has lots of strength so he swam fast. He grabbed the wood and started bringing it back. The squirrel was waiting and looked scared.

"Good boy, Buster!" I said when he turned around.

My dad calls Buster the colonel because he is bossy. We were loading the squirrel onto the grass. It ran away fast. It was like speaking a foreign language to Buster. He just wagged his tail and licked my finger. Then we went home for some reading time.

Sam and I went to the old green forest. We were swinging our backpacks and running fast. Sam saw a huge tree with big branches.

"I bet it is impossible to go up," Sam said.

I grinned at him and gave him a big thumbs up. We started to climb the rough bark. It was hard but we kept going up. Suddenly a squirrel started dumping acorns on our heads! They hurt a little bit.

"Watch out for the angry squirrel!" I yelled loudly.

We climbed higher until we saw a secret fort. A small flower was growing right in the middle. We sat down and ate our snacks. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is very silly and has a funny brain. One day we were loading the car to go camping. Buster kept jumping in the back seat and barking at dad. We drove far away to a big green meadow. I set up the tent and Buster scratched at the door.

"Stop it right now Buster!" I yelled at him.

Dad made a fire and we roasted marshmallows on sticks. It was a pleasure to eat them because they were gooey. In the morning we ate scrambled eggs outside. Buster was waiting for some eggs but he got dog food.

"You are a good boy," I said and patted him.

Then we went hiking and saw a big blue bird. Camping is the best fun ever.

My teacher Mrs. Green greeted us with a big smile. It was freezing outside so we had indoor recess today. I felt sad because I love running on the playground. But then Mrs. Green pulled out a new game.

"Who wants to be the champion of checkers?" she asked.

I scrambled to the rug and sat down fast. My friend Sam sat next to me. We spread out the red and black pieces. I thought about my moves carefully. It was like coaching a tiny army.

"I am going to win!" Sam said loudly.

I jumped over his piece and took it. I felt very pleased with myself. Then the bell screeched for lunch. I was hungry for my roasted turkey sandwich. Indoor recess was actually really fun.

My dad says I need to eat protein for lunch. He packed me a huge sandwich with ham and cheese. I sat down next to my friend Leo. Leo had a bag of chips and a red apple.

"Do you want to trade?" I asked Leo with a smile.

"No way, I am training to be a champion!" Leo said.

We finished eating and then ran outside for recess. We bounced a basketball on the blacktop near the fence. I saw a little bug crawled on the chain link fence. It looked like a blue vein on a leaf. I touched it gently with my finger, although I was scared. The bell rang and we ran back to the computer lab. I was thrilled because I love typing games. I stuck out my tongue when I won the game. I have a big imagination!

Yesterday was the best day at school ever. I ate my breakfast fast because I was wearing my new superhero shirt.

In art class, we started painting with bright colors. I was not afraid to make a big mess. I took the scissors and cut up an old newspaper. Then I glued it on my paper and it looked like a giant island.

"That looks awesome!" said my friend Billy.

"Thanks, I drew a monster on it too," I told him.

Suddenly, a real monster appeared in my imagination. I climbed on my chair and roared like a lion. Then the bell rang for recess. We ran outside and played tag until we were tired. I love art class.

My friends and I went into the woods behind my house. We found a small trail and followed it for a long time. Suddenly, we saw a big spaceship crashed on the ground! It was smoking and looked very scary.

"We have to help them!" I shouted loudly.

Sam started to complain because he was feeling scared.

"This is important," I told him. "Don't be a baby."

We walked closer and heard a loud knock from inside. Someone was trapped in there. I found a big rock and hit the door. It opened and a green alien came floating out. He was not scary at all. He started jumping up and down. We were all cheering because he was safe. We often go back to visit him now.

My brother Sam and I wanted to be ninjas. We trained in the backyard every single day after school. I threw my frisbee like a throwing star. Sam pretended his baseball bat was a sword. One day we discovered a big box.

"We can make shields with this!" I yelled.

Sam got the scissors and cut the cardboard. We spread the pieces on the ground to paint them. We gradually made them look like shiny silver metal. Then we had a big battle. I tried to wrap Sam in a hug attack, but I lost my balance. I fell on the grass and laughed.

"You are not a ninja yet," Sam said.

We played until it got dark outside. It was the best ninja training ever.

I was waiting for the robot to wake up. His name was Metal Mike and I drew him yesterday. My magic pencil made my painting turn real. Mike stood up and his eyes glowed green.

"Hello friend," said Metal Mike in a loud voice.

We went outside and drove my toy car around. Suddenly a big red alien was roaming in the yard. I feared the alien would eat my lunch. Mike blew a cold wind from his mouth. He fought the alien with ice powers.

"Go away bad guy!" I yelled at the alien.

The alien ran away fast. We went back to reading comic books inside. Magic is the best thing ever.

It was the day before my birthday party. My mom made a schedule for the whole day. We spent the morning cleaning the house really fast. I was roaming around the yard looking for balloons. My younger brother was running everywhere with the blue scissors.

"Stop running or you will get hurt!" I yelled.

My mom took the scissors away and looked pleased. We hung up streamers and made a big cake. I was feeling so excited for my friends.

"Is the house clean enough yet?" my dad asked.

I looked at the clock and the time was approaching fast. I wanted to jump like a bungee cord. It was going to be the best party ever.

I was dreaming about winning the big race. My go-kart game is my favorite thing to play. I feared I would lose because my brother is good. We turned on the TV and the game started fast. I zoomed through the first level and got a boost. My brother was growing mad because I was winning.

"Hey, stop blocking me!" he shouted at the screen.

I found a good rhythm and I didn't crash once. I discovered a secret shortcut near the big castle. I cleared the jump and landed right in first place. My brother started swearing a little bit under his breath.

"Good game," I greeted him when I won the cup. He was grumpy but I felt like a science genius. I am the best racer in the whole house!

It was my birthday and we had a sleepover. My best friend Sarah walked in with a huge box.

"Happy birthday!" she shouted really loud.

The box was heavy and I felt the weight. I opened it and it was a cool robot dog. It looked foreign and weird but I liked it.

"It is trained to do tricks," Sarah said.

I turned it on and it started trembling. Then it ran fast and crashed into the wall. My mom came in with a cake and candles. I blew them out even though I was laughing. Then my little sister came in. She is my mom's other daughter. She tried to comb the robot's hair.

"Don't do that!" I said to her.

We ate cake and played with the robot all night. It was the best birthday ever.
