I was running fast at recess today with my friends. We played tag and then we had a big meeting. We sat by the water fountain and talked about super heroes.

"I wish I could jump like a bungee cord," said Sam.

"I wish my finger could shoot lasers," I said back.

Then the whistle blew and we had to go inside again. It was time for art class and I was happy. I drew a picture of a giant green monster. The monster grew bigger and bigger on the paper. Then we had to read our books quietly at our desks. It was a good day but now I have math homework. I hope I finish it fast so I can play.

My friend Sam and I went on a big search. We wanted to find the lost cave of the old king. We walked for a long time over the earth. Suddenly we saw a big dark hole in the mountain.

"Is that it?" Sam spoke quietly because he was scared.

We climbed up the rocks and got closer to the hole. It was very dark and we feared a monster lived there. But then we saw something shiny on the ground. It was a gold crown from the king's reign!

"We discovered the treasure!" I yelled and started cheering.

We were so happy and thirteen bats flew out fast. We ran home and that was the meaning of adventure. We didn't see either of our moms approaching us. They were mad but we led them to the gold.

I heard a loud bell and started packing my bag. It was finally time for recess! Everyone scrambled to the door and screeched with joy. My friend Tim was wearing his new knight shirt. We ran outside and immediately started a game of tag.

"You can't catch me!" yelled Tim while jumping over a log.

"Yes I can!" I shouted back.

I ran faster and felt my legs getting stronger. Tim tried to squeeze through the slide, but he got stuck. I tagged him and laughed. Suddenly, we heard a weird rhythm. It was the teacher clapping her hands.

"Line up, class!" she said.

We had fourteen minutes left, but recess was over for some reason. We spread out in line and walked back inside sadly.

Me and my nephew Tom went on a big adventure. We went boating on the lake because the sun was hot.

"Look at that scary island!" Tom yelled loud.

We paddled fast but the wind grew very strong. It meant a storm was coming soon. We landed the boat on the sand. We were already wet and cold. I sent Tom to find dry wood. We made a fire and we roasted marshmallows.

"This is the best food ever," I said.

We slept under the stars and I was pleased. In the morning, we saw a bear but it ran away. We were brave explorers and we sailed home safe.

I went through the spooky woods with my best friend. We were on an important search for lost pirate gold. The trees scratched my arms and it hurt a little.

"Look at that big rock!" I yelled loudly.

A scary monster appeared from behind the dark trees. It had a weird design on its head. I grabbed my plastic knife and my friend grabbed scissors. We were brave so we did not run away.

"Go away monster!" my friend shouted at the beast.

The monster broke a stick and then it ran off. The surrounding woods were quiet again. We kept walking and found a plain box. Everyone was happy because the gold was inside. My brain felt super tired but I was proud.

I was stamping my feet because math class was so boring. Mrs. Green yelled at me to please listen. I stopped and crossed my arms on my desk. Then it was finally time for art class. I grabbed a red feather and some glue. It was a pleasure to make a cool bird mask. But then I dropped my glue stick on the floor. It rolled under the big computer table. I crawled under there to get it.

"Hey, what are you doing down there?" asked Timmy.

"I lost my glue!" I said.

I found a plastic knife under there too. I was grateful when the bell rang for lunch.

Me and my best friend Tim went boating on the lake. We rowed through the water and bounced over big waves. Suddenly the wind blew hard and it got scary.

"Look out for that rock!" yelled Tim.

We almost hit it but I steered away fast. Then we saw a secret island. We swam to the shore and ran into the woods. We found an old box under a tree. I used my scissors to open it. Inside was a receipt for fourteen pizzas and a map!

"I think a pirate left this here," I said.

We heard a loud groaning noise behind us. It was a bear! We struggled to run back to the boat. Tim let out a giant sneeze and the bear stopped. We jumped in the boat and escaped. I hope my mom doesn't give me a grounding for being late. We brewed some hot cocoa when we got home.

My friend Sam and I were playing in his apartment. We went out on the balcony and looked down at the ground. It looked like a giant mountain far away. We were pretending to fly a spaceship. I was steering the ship and Sam was the lookout. Suddenly, we heard a scary groaning noise.

"What was that sound?" asked Sam. He froze like a statue.

"I think it’s a space monster!" I yelled.

We threw a cookie crumb over the edge to feed it. We hoped it was enough food for the monster. We held up a thumb to check the wind. The monster stopped making noise. We were keeping the city safe from danger. Then Sam’s mom called us for lunch.

My brother Tim is often mean when we play basketball. He thinks he is the champion of the driveway. I was waiting for my turn with the orange ball.

"You can't beat me," Tim screamed loud.

I held the ball steady in my hands. It was an important shot for me. I realized he was not looking at the hoop. I threw the ball up high and straight. It went right through the net like a thread!

"That doesn't count!" he yelled at me.

Just then my dad blew his silver whistle. He was seeing everything from the porch.

"It counts and Sam wins!" Dad said.

I tried to explain that I practiced a lot. Tim was mad but I was happy. I finally won the big game.

I slept too late and almost missed the bus. I ran to school but I forgot my homework. At recess we played a big game of tag. I was the captain of the blue team. There was a huge mountain of dirt on the field. My friend Leo jumped over it and yelled, "You can't catch me!" I chased him through the muddy grass.

Later we had a meeting in the gym. The principal said we trained hard for the big race. I paid two dollars for a snack after school. It was a good day but I was very tired. Next time I will put my homework in my bag early.

My robot friend Zog landed in my backyard yesterday. He flew all the way from Mars in a red spaceship. Zog is shiny and silver, but he has one green eye.

"I am so thrilled to see you!" Zog said.

"Me too, Zog!" I yelled and gave him a high-five.

We sat on the grass and ate some pizza. Zog chewed the crust loudly because he has metal teeth. Then he grinned at me.

"I have something important for you," Zog told me.

He reached into his pocket and pulled out a glowing blue rock. It was magic! When I looked through it, everything turned upside down. Zog stayed for an hour, but then he left. He promised to bring me a moon rock next time.

My neighbor Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to make s'mores in the backyard fire pit. Dad got the fire going, and we roasted the marshmallows.

"Don't get too close or you'll get pneumonia!" Mom yelled.

I don't think you get pneumonia from fire though. I toasted my marshmallow until it was black and tearing apart. It was so gooey it got on my shirt.

"Oh no, that will leave a big stain!" Tim said.

I was in trouble, but the s'mores tasted like heaven on earth. I could feel the sugar rush in every vein. I guarantee it was the best night ever.

My robot friend named Beep was shiny and cool. He wore a little jacket made of brown leather. We went to Mars to find some green aliens. I was the guide and Beep followed me. We walked for a long time and got very hungry. Beep ate a battery and I ate a sandwich.

Unfortunately, we saw a big monster on a balcony. It was clinging to the wall and looked scary.

"I guarantee I can fight it!" yelled Beep.

"Be careful, Beep!" I shouted back at him.

The monster treated us badly and tried to grab us. Beep used his laser eyes and scared it away. We were safe and happy to go home.

My friends came over for a sleepover last night. We heard the doorbell ringing and I ran fast. It was my best friend Sam bringing his sleeping bag. We went to the kitchen and ate toasted marshmallows.

"This is the best night ever!" Sam yelled loudly.

My mom was dumping chips into a big red bowl. Then we went to my room for a secret meeting. We drew funny pictures of aliens with big heads. Sam started groaning because he felt sick from the candy.

"My brain feels like it is spinning," he said.

We jumped on the bed until gravity pulled us down. I felt my heart pumping fast when we fell off. I am certain we flew through the air like birds. We landed on the earth with a big thump. I had to squeeze my pillow to stop laughing.

I was so excited about my sleepover with Max. We grabbed our sleeping bags and ran upstairs. Max chewed on some gummy worms and I ate chips. We looked at the ceiling and talked about scary monsters. Suddenly the lights went out and I was trembling.

"Did you turn off the light?" I yelled.

"No, I think the storm did it!" Max said.

My heart was pumping fast because it was pitch black. We sprinted downstairs to find my mom and dad. My dad was steering a flashlight around the kitchen. He had company over but they left early. Mom brewed some hot cocoa for us to drink. Seeing the lights come back on made me happy. I read my comic book and fell asleep fast.

I had a wonderful idea for my science project. I wanted to make a rocket go straight to the ceiling. I used a newspaper to make the body. I put different colors on the wings. My friend Sam was waiting by the door.

"Is it going to work?" Sam asked me.

"It will be the greatest rocket ever," I spoke loudly.

We went through the hall to the playground. I put the rocket on the ground. I started counting down from ten. Suddenly, the rocket flew up fast! But then it started thumping against the wall. It was bumping into everything.

"Oh no! It is a failure," I yelled.

Neither of us could catch it. It finally crashed. It wasn't perfect, but recess was still fun.

I was boating on the lake when the weather changed. Suddenly a big silver ship landed right in the water. It made a loud groaning sound and smoke came out. I rowed straight to it because I was brave. A green alien with eight eyes appeared at the door.

"We are here to receive the treasure," the alien said.

I pointed to the magic fountain on the island. The alien grumbled because he hated getting wet. He pushed a button and a robot came out. The robot was growing bigger and bigger every second. It walked into the fountain and grabbed a glowing box. Then they flew away fast. I think they were space pirates.

I was playing the most important video game ever. My brother Sam was coaching me on the hard level. It was super cold and my hands were freezing. I tried a special jump but I crashed into a wall. It felt impossible to win this race.

"You need to use the turbo boost!" Sam yelled.

I pressed the button and my car flew up high. I twisted the controller and landed perfectly on the track. Suddenly I had to sneeze really loud. I almost dropped the controller but I held on tight. I discovered a secret shortcut near the big castle.

"I counted three seconds left!" Sam shouted at me.

I drove fast and crossed the finish line just enough. We ate toasted cheese sandwiches to celebrate my big win. Then I played my guitar because I was so happy.

My friends came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to make s’mores, but it was raining. So we roasted marshmallows in the kitchen instead. My mom toasted them over the stove for us.

"Be careful because they are hot," she spoke loudly.

I grabbed mine immediately and it fell on the floor. My dog flew across the room and chewed it up!

"Hey, that’s not protein for you!" I yelled.

We went to my room and looked at the ceiling. We tried to stay awake, but I crashed fast. It was a pleasant night until my friend sprinted to the bathroom. He ate too much candy.

I woke up really early because my dog barked. His name is Rex and we live in a big apartment. Rex scratched at the door so I let him outside. We went to the park and I saw a shiny beetle. It was green and walked on a leaf.

"Look at that bug, Rex!" I yelled loudly.

Rex did not care and he chewed on a stick instead. Then a big bird flew down and landed near us. It started sounding like a weird duck.

"That bird is huge," I thought to myself.

Rex tried to catch it but it was impossible. The bird flew away fast. Then Rex let out a big sneeze. We walked home and I want to learn more about beetles.

My dog Buster is incredible at escaping. Yesterday he escaped through the backyard gate. I grasped his leash and ran outside fast. He crossed the street without looking! It was big danger but no cars came.

"Buster, stop running right now!" I yelled loud.

He kept running until he found a cat sleeping. He sniffed the cat and let out a huge sneeze. The cat woke up and hissed. That is the beginning of the trouble. Buster got scared and ran back to me. I obtained his collar and we walked home.

"You need more training," I told him.

We discovered a growing flower on the way back. Then I heard my mom ringing the dinner bell. Buster ran inside to eat his food.

My best friend Sarah came over for a sleepover last night. We set up my tent in the living room. It was the greatest sleepover ever. We ate pizza and we drank lots of soda.

"I am dreaming of ice cream," Sarah said to me.

I gripped my pillow tight and laughed. We grew tired but we wanted to stay awake. Then my mom appeared with a big bowl of popcorn. It was enough for everyone to share. We told scary stories until it was very late.

"I remembered a spooky story about a jewel," I said.

The jewel had a secret meaning and it glowed green. Sarah got scared and hid under her sleeping bag. It was so much fun.

It was my birthday last Saturday and I was so excited. My mom brewed some hot chocolate and we waited for my friends. Then the doorbell rang and my best friend Tim came inside. He grabbed a big blue box and gave it to me.

"Happy birthday!" Tim yelled very loud.

I searched through the box and found a cool robot toy. I thought it was the best present ever. But then the robot suddenly disappeared under the couch. My dad came in bearing a huge chocolate cake with candles. I blew out the candles and made a special wish.

"Did you find your robot?" my mom asked me later.

I was not pleased because the robot was still lost. My dad lifted the couch and was sweating and almost swearing. But then he found it! I learned the meaning of growing up is sharing cake and toys.

My cat Fluffy has a busy schedule every day. She likes exploring the big tree in our backyard. One day, she climbed really high to the top. I looked up at the leaves like a green ceiling. Suddenly, a blue jay screeched at her very loud!

"Get down from there right now!" I yelled.

Fluffy lost her strength and neither of her paws held on. She slipped and crashed onto the soft ground fast. I grabbed her and treated her paw gently.

"Are you okay, Fluffy?" I asked her.

She opened her eyes and purred at me. I believed she was just speaking in cat language. She was happy to be safe with me again.

Tomorrow is my birthday party and I am so excited! My mom was loading the car with lots of balloons. We went to the park and saw my friends approaching. We played tag and I was running very fast through the grass. Suddenly my friend Sam stopped and looked scared.

"Did you see that white thing?" Sam asked me.

"Maybe it is a ghost!" I yelled loudly.

We ran back to my mom immediately because we were scared. But it was just a white plastic bag flying around. We laughed and then felt stronger and brave again. My mom said it was time to open presents. I got a cool toy and had to wrap it back up to show my dad later. It was the best birthday ever.

I was playing soccer with my friends near the camping site. The wind blew really hard through the trees surrounding us. It felt impossible to kick the ball straight. My friend Leo kept bumping into me.

"Hey, watch where you are going!" I yelled loudly.

Leo laughed and kicked the ball hard. It flew high up in the air. We had to search for it in the tall grass. I struck something hard with my foot. It was a different ball!

"That looks like a super lucky ball," Leo said.

We used the new ball and it was perfect. We played until we didn't have enough light to see. My dad had to guide us back with a flashlight. It was the best game ever.

My younger brother dropped the scissors on the rug. We were making decorations for my birthday party tomorrow. I yelled at him because he almost cut me. He started running around our apartment and I chased him.

"Give me those back!" I shouted.

He didn't listen and kept roaming around the living room. Suddenly he tripped and the scissors flew up high. They hit the light on the ceiling and broke it. My mom came in and saw the mess. She heard the crash and looked really mad.

"Who did this?" she asked in a scary voice.

I pointed at my brother but he had already escaped. The light bulb was scorched black. My mom was almost swearing but she stopped herself. She said no more running inside any longer. I had to seize the broom and clean everything up.

My dog Buster is usually a very good boy. One day we went for a walk in the woods. It was a pleasant day and the sun was hot. Buster saw a rabbit and he started running fast.

"Buster stop!" I screamed but he did not listen.

He ran into the bushes and I heard something thumping. I ran after him and my foot struck a big rock. I fell down and almost crushed a little flower. My knee felt like it was scorched by the dirt. Then I heard Buster barking and bumping into trees. I realized he was chasing a squirrel now. My heart was beating super fast.

"Come here right now!" I yelled loudly.

Buster finally came back and licked my face. He looked happy but I was just glad he was safe. We walked home very slowly.

My robot Zog has a really shiny brain. I made him from old metal and some leather. One day Zog started moaning very loud. He looked sad and I saw a big purple stain. It was right on his tummy. I thought he was broken forever.

"What is wrong Zog?" I asked him.

"I tried to eat a toasted sandwich," Zog beeped.

Robots cannot eat food so it made a mess. It was not a pleasure to clean him up. I used my mom's scissors to cut the sticky part off. We were late for our flying schedule. We flew right through the clouds anyway. Next time Zog will not eat lunch.

One day my dog Rex was roaming in the backyard. He was sniffing everything and wagging his tail. I was wearing my blue coat because it was chilly. Rex started digging a hole near the big oak tree. I believed he smelled a bone or a squirrel.

"What are you doing, Rex?" I asked him.

He just kept digging and dirt spread everywhere. Suddenly, he dropped something shiny on the grass. It looked like gold!

"Is that pirate treasure?" I yelled.

I picked it up and saw it was just a shiny rock. The sun lit it up and made it sparkle. I was yearning for real gold, but the rock was cool too. We went inside and I started loading my pockets with dog treats for him. Rex is the best treasure hunter I ever met.

One sunny morning, I ate my breakfast very fast. Today was important because we were going on a big quest. My friend Sam was waiting outside with his backpack.

"Are you ready for the adventure?" Sam asked me.

"Yes, we have to find the magic stone!" I yelled.

We ran to the woods leading to the big river. It looked impossible to cross because the water was super fast. But then I saw a vine swinging from a tree. I grabbed it and I felt stronger than a superhero. I swung across and landed on the other side. Sam followed me and everyone cheered for us. We found the stone under a bush and saved the day!

One day my friends and I found a map. It showed a secret island with a big castle. We got on a boat and sailed fast. We saw a knight guarding the door. He looked scary and big.

"You cannot pass!" the knight yelled loudly.

"We need to find the treasure," I said back.

He brewed a magic potion and it smelled bad. It made a green stain on the floor. Then a dragon flew down from the sky. It was groaning because it was hungry. We understood that it wanted food. We sold some apples to the knight for gold. Then we fed the apples to the dragon. The dragon was happy and let us pass. We did not need him to explain the rules. We learned that dragons just like snacks. Then we heard a noise and ran inside the castle.

My nephew came to school for show and tell today. He is only four and he grew a lot since last summer. He brought a big box and everyone wanted to see inside.

"Do you remember what is in the box?" I asked him.

He smiled and opened the lid very slow and steady. Suddenly a giant black beetle crawled out! It was huge and scary.

"Ahhh!" screamed Sarah and she almost fainted right there.

The beetle ran to the teacher's desk. My teacher tried to catch it but she had to sneeze. *Achoo!* The beetle fell off the desk. Then my nephew laughed and pulled a chain. It was a fake robot bug! It just needed batteries, not caffeine, to run fast. I was happy to receive a high five from my best friend. It was the best day ever.

Yesterday at recess I was playing kickball with my friends. The sun was pleasant and warm. I was wearing my new red sneakers.

"I am going to kick it so far!" I yelled.

My friend Sam laughed and said, "You are dreaming!"

I gripped the fence and waited for my turn. I felt stronger than ever. The pitcher threw the ball fast. It looked a little dangerous. I kicked it super hard and it flew over the fence!

But then I lost the ball in the tall grass. We looked everywhere.

"Oh no, I feared this would happen," Sam said.

Then the teacher blew her whistle loudly. It was time for lunch and I was very hungry. We never found the ball but I chose to be happy anyway. I am grateful for lunch. I drew a picture of the lost ball later.

My younger brother Leo and I found a map. It showed a secret path to the old castle. We walked straight into the dark woods. My heart was pumping fast. Suddenly, a giant bee flew at us! It was stinging the air.

"Run, Leo! Use all your strength!" I yelled.

We ran and ran until we saw the castle. The king's reign ended long ago, so it was empty. But then a dog came out. He looked like a colonel in an army.

"It is impossible to pass!" the dog barked.

We gave him a sandwich and he let us in. We spread our blanket and had a picnic. It was the best adventure ever.

We were playing soccer at recess and I was mad. My anger rose up because Jimmy kept stealing the ball. He swept past me and kicked it hard. It was tearing through the grass.

"Hey! That is a foul!" I yelled at him.

Jimmy laughed and said, "No it isn't, keep playing!"

I chased him and my face was red. I wanted to break his reign as the best player. I saw the ball rolling near the chain fence. I ran fast and I obtained the ball first. I kicked it with a single big swoosh. It went right into the goal! The whistle blew loud. The kids surrounding us cheered for me. Even though I was tired, I felt like a king. My imagination said I just won the World Cup!

We went camping at the big lake last summer. My dog Buster came with us and he was so happy. We went boating on the water and Buster barked at ducks. Dad said, "Sit down Buster or you will fall in!"

Later we made a fire and toasted marshmallows. I simply love s'mores because they taste so good. Suddenly a squirrel flew down from a tree. Buster sprinted fast to catch it but he missed. He chewed on a stick instead and shook his head.

"Maintain your cool, Buster," I told him.

I obtained a book to read inside the tent. Then I twisted my sleeping bag up tight. It was a good trip but bugs are gross.

One day my friend Tom and I went exploring. We found a scary cave with a huge ceiling. It was dark but we saw a weird design on the wall. Suddenly we heard a noise like screaming or singing.

"Do not go in there!" Tom yelled, trembling.

"We have to see what it is," I said.

We walked deeper and discovered a hidden room. Inside was a fountain with green water. A single bat flew by and I tried to wrap my coat tight. Then the door slammed shut and we were trapped! We ran around looking for a way out. I saw a button and pushed it hard. The door opened and we ran home fast. My mom was drinking caffeine in the kitchen. We were safe throughout the night but we never went back.

My backpack felt heavier than a giant mountain today. I had to carry all my books home for homework. My thumb hurt from holding the strap so tight. I walked slow and tried to keep my feet steady.

Then I heard a loud knock on the window. It was my friend Sam from the bus.

"Wait for me by the water fountain!" Sam yelled.

I waited but he took longer than I thought. My younger sister was already waiting there too. She likes teaching me games but she talks a lot.

"Stop being so slow, Sam!" I shouted.

I didn't want to complain, but I was hungry. We finally walked home and ate snacks.

My birthday party was the best day ever. We had it at the park near my house. My mom greeted everyone with big hugs. We sprinted to the swings and jumped off. Then we played a game called Island tag.

"You can't catch me!" yelled my friend Sam.

"I am the champion of running!" I shouted back.

Suddenly, a big wind swept through the park. It blew all the napkins away. We ran around dumping juice on accident. Then we found my cake on the table. My mom lit the candles and I made a wish. I blew them all out fast.

"Time to open presents!" said my dad.

I sat down to wrap my arms around a big box. Inside I found a cool art set. I drew a picture of us right away. Then the sun disappeared and we went home happy.

My dog Buster and I went to explore the woods. The scenery was really pretty with big green trees everywhere. Buster ran fast and I scrambled over a big log. Suddenly, Buster stopped and started trembling near a hole.

"What is it boy?" I asked him.

He barked loud and scratched at the dirt. I saw a tiny bird trapped under some sticks. I carefully threw the sticks away and picked it up.

"It's okay now," I said softly to the bird.

I dropped it gently on a branch and it flew away. We walked home and I told my mom everything. Then Buster crashed on his bed and slept on the newspaper.

It was my birthday party and we were playing tag. My friend Mike was it and he was running fast. I gripped the grass and ran up the mountain in my backyard. It is just a hill but I call it a mountain. Mike shouted, "I am going to get you!"

My heart was pumping hard and I kept running straight. I didn't see the mud puddle and I fell right in. I sat there with a big brown stain on my new pants. Mike caught me but then he started laughing.

"You look like a mud monster!" he said.

I was stamping my feet because I was mad. I thought I would cry but then I started laughing too. The stain was growing bigger but it was okay. We went inside and had cake anyway.

It was my birthday last week and I woke up happy. My mom made me eggs for protein and gave me presents. Then my neighbor Sam came over for a sleepover. We drove to the park to play a game. 

"Let's pretend this is a big green jungle!" Sam yelled.

"Okay, watch out for the tigers!" I said back.

We found a dirt trail and started running fast. I tried to jump over a log but I tripped. It was a big failure because I got mud on my pants. We laughed about it and went home for cake. It was the best day ever.

I was walking in the woods and I saw a big metal hand. It was a robot hand sticking out of the dirt. I wanted to search for the rest of it. I dug fast and discovered a huge silver head.

The robot opened its eyes and they glowed red. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. I yelled, "Are you a good robot?"

The robot stood up and the earth shook. It gripped a big rock and simply crushed it into dust. It had so much strength. Then I saw a green alien approaching us.

"Run away!" the robot said in a deep voice.

I grasped the robot’s leg and we flew up high. We were safe from the alien.

I didn't know we had a science test today. My papers were scattered all over my messy desk. I looked everywhere for my pencil but couldn't find it. Then I saw a tiny gnat flying around my head. It was annoying.

"Hey, can I borrow a pencil?" I asked my friend Sam.

Sam nodded and said, "Sure, but give it back later."

I quickly spread my notes out to study. The sun scorched my back through the window. I thought I was ready, but I was scared. I believed I could pass if I tried hard. The only reason I was worried was because I forgot to study last night. The bell rang loudly and it was time to start. Hopefully I get a good grade.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. The scenery was full of big green trees. I was steering Buster by his leash carefully. We walked on the path and neared a small creek. A cool breeze blew on my face. Suddenly a little squirrel appeared on a branch! Buster barked and scared it away.

"Be quiet Buster!" I yelled at him.

We sat down and I ate a sandwich. A tiny crumb fell on my finger. An ant came and took the crumb away. It was wonderful to watch the bugs. Then I heard a bell ringing.

"Time to go home for dinner," my mom called.

I pretended I was a king and this was my reign. Exploring is the best fun ever.

One sunny day, Max and I went to the big meadow. We were looking for a secret cave with a high ceiling. Max shouted, "Look over there!" I saw a dark hole in the rocks. We grasped our flashlights tight and walked inside. It was scary but we were brave enough. Suddenly, a giant spider happened to drop down! I thought it would bite us.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Max. He grabbed some scissors from his backpack for some reason. He cut the web and the spider disappeared. We found a golden crown from an old king's reign. The glowing light was growing brighter. We took the treasure home and ate pizza. That was the best adventure ever.

My heart was thumping really fast. It was the last level of the video game. I had to beat the big boss guard to win. I remembered the secret code from my brother. I pressed the buttons straight away and my character jumped high.

"Watch out for the fire!" yelled my friend Sam.

I moved my guy left and he dodged the hot fire. I did not want another failure. I used the map to search for the hidden sword. My character followed the glowing guide on the screen. I finally found the sword and hit the boss.

"You are earning so many points!" Sam shouted happily.

The boss fell down and the screen flashed bright colors. I won the game and we gave each other a high five.

One sunny day my dog Rex and I went on an adventure. We walked to the park near our big apartment. Rex loves running so his legs were pumping fast. Suddenly he saw a squirrel and chased it up a tree. The squirrel landed on a branch and looked down at us.

"Come back here Rex!" I screamed really loud.

Rex scratched the bark but it was impossible to climb. My mom says dogs cannot climb trees. We sat on the grass and I ate a protein bar.

"Do you want a treat?" I asked Rex nicely.

He wagged his tail so I gave him a little piece. We don't give him caffeine or chocolate because that is bad. Then we walked home and I used scissors to cut a sticker for my journal. It was the best day ever.

I brought my new soccer ball to school today for training. It was hot outside and the sun scorched the grass. My younger brother wanted to play but neither of us could find him. 

At recess, I grabbed the ball and ran to the field. I kicked it hard and it rose high in the air. Then it crashed right into the fence. 

"Watch out!" my friend Sam yelled.

My leg was stinging a little bit from the kick. I heard the bell ring so we had to go inside.

"I hate when recess is over," I said.

We had to learn about science next. We had to remain in our seats for a long time. It felt like a foreign country because the words were so hard. I just wanted to go back outside and play.

My friend Tommy and I were playing at recess. We like keeping each other company on the swings. The scenery is nice from up high. But then a big kid tried to seize our swings. I was scared but Tommy was brave.

"You have the wrong idea," Tommy said loudly. "We are the kings and we reign here!"

The big kid started stamping his feet. He looked mad. I tried to squeeze my hands tight on the chain. Then the bell rang for lunch. It was a wonderful sound.

"I know you are hungry," I said to the big kid.

He stopped stamping and smiled. We all ran inside to get pizza. I understand now that even mean kids like pizza.

My neighbor has a new pet on his balcony. It is not a dog, and it is not a cat. It is a baby lamb with fluffy white wool! The lamb looked afraid because it missed its mom. I went over to say hello to the animal. It had a small silver chain around its neck.

"Don't be scared," I said to the little lamb.

My neighbor came outside and he smiled at me. He is from a foreign country far away. He taught me how to feed the lamb milk. It was incredible to hold the bottle for him.

"We just met, but I like you," I whispered.

The lamb drank all the milk very fast. I hope he can reign over the backyard someday.

My dad drove us all the way to the big soccer field. It felt like we were camping because we brought a tent. We neared the field and I saw the other team. They looked really big and tough. I drank some juice but my dad drank coffee for the caffeine.

"You need protein for strength," my mom spoke loudly. She gave me a weird bar but I ate it anyway.

The game started and I ran super fast. The surrounding crowd cheered for us. I kicked the ball hard and it went right in! I was so thrilled. It was better than winning on my computer. Even though I was tired, we won the game!

I gripped the controller tightly because I was nervous. We were playing a new boating game on the TV. It was weird and different from my usual car games. My friend Sam chose a big red boat. I picked a fast blue one with a cool stripe.

"I am going to win this race!" Sam yelled loudly.

"To be honest, I am faster than you," I said.

The race started and we both ran our engines hard. The track was dangerous with big rocks everywhere. Suddenly my thumb twisted the wrong way and I crashed. I was groaning because I knew I lost. But then Sam hit a foreign object that looked like a knife. He sank! I drove past him and won. I was thrilled and grateful that I didn't sink too.

My best friend Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We pretended my living room was a big green jungle. Tim bounced on the couch and I yelled, "Watch out for the snake!" 

We built a fort with blankets and pushed the chairs together. I was a brave knight and Tim was the dragon. I twisted my ankle a little bit but I didn't cry. My mom came in and crossed her arms. She looked mad but she wasn't.

"Do you know what time it is?" she asked us.

We knew it was late so we stopped playing. Tim wrote a note to the dragon to say sorry. Then we went to sleep. It was the best sleepover ever.

I was playing soccer with my friend Sam. We woke up early to go to the park. It was a big game against the Blue Team. I was the goalie and I was feeling nervous. The other team was really good at kicking the ball.

Suddenly a boy kicked it super hard at me. I jumped up and caught the ball with my hands! My anger went away and I felt happy. I cleared the ball by throwing it far away.

"Great job!" yelled Sam from the other side.

I grinned at him and gave a thumbs up. Although I was tired, I kept playing hard. We were winning but my excitement was growing. We won the game and we were hanging out after. It was the best day ever.

My dog Buster ran into the woods behind my house. He was jumping over logs and tearing through the bushes. I knew I had to catch him before dinner. The woods looked like a scary jungle with big trees. I saw him bearing his teeth at a squirrel.

"Come here Buster!" I screamed really loud.

He did not listen and he ran deeper inside. He led me to a weird old fort made of sticks. It had a cool design like a castle. I pretended I was a brave knight with a sword. Then I saw something shiny on the ground. It was a pair of rusty scissors.

"Let's go home now," I told Buster.

He barked and we walked back to my house together.

I was camping in the woods with my dog Max. He is not very well trained, but he is funny. We walked on a twisted path and the wind blew hard. Max sniffed a big bush and then he started barking.

"Be quiet Max!" I grumbled at him. 

But he kept barking at something green and slimy. It looked like old stewed spinach. Suddenly a frog jumped right at my face! I almost fainted because it was so scary. Max chased the frog and felt very pleased with himself.

"You are a silly dog," I said.

Max wagged his tail like he was speaking to me. He has a small brain but a big heart. The walk was complete so we went back to the tent. I was grateful for my warm sleeping bag.

We were camping in the big woods behind my apartment. My friend Leo was scared because it was getting dark. We were yearning for a big adventure. Suddenly, a strange sound appeared from the bushes. It sounded like something scratching a tree.

"What is approaching us?" Leo whispered loudly.

"Maybe it is a bear full of caffeine!" I said.

Leo jumped up and started coaching me on how to run. We heard more noise and saw a shadow jumping. It was just my cat Fluffy! She scratched her ear and looked at us. She wanted to reign over our tent like a queen. We laughed and felt silly.

"I thought we were done for," Leo said.

We gave Fluffy a snack and went to sleep. Being brave is hard work.

I woke up early because it was raining hard. My friend Sam came over and we chose to go on a quest. We wanted to search for the hidden treasure in the woods. We walked straight into the dark forest.

"Look out for that huge hole!" Sam shouted loudly.

I almost fell but I grabbed a branch with my thumb. We saw a giant beetle jumping on a log. Then the wind swept through the trees. We found an old box under a pile of leaves. It had a sharp needle inside but not a single coin.

"We should remain here until the storm stops," I said.

We pretended to be a colonel in the army. Later I will write a story about our big adventure.

My neighbor is in my class and his name is Billy. Yesterday at recess we played tag and I caught him fast. Billy got mad and said I cheated but I didn't. Then the bell rang and we crawled under the fence. The teacher saw us and she looked very stewed and angry.

"I guarantee you are in big trouble!" she yelled loudly.

We had to sit inside for ten minutes while everyone played. I held my head down because I felt bad. Then Billy struck me on the arm and laughed.

"My nephew acts better than you!" he whispered to me.

I ignored him and just waited for lunchtime to come. It was a long day but the pizza was good.

My friend Max and I went into the scary woods. We wanted to find the old ghost house. The wind blew hard through the trees. I was very scared but Max was brave.

"Look at that creepy door!" Max screeched loudly.

We walked inside the big, dark room. It smelled like old stewed tomatoes. Suddenly, a bat flew right at my head! I ran out fast and Max followed me. We ran all the way back to my apartment.

"That was so cool!" I said when we were safe.

Everyone told us not to go there. But we were thrilled we did it. Next time we will bring flashlights.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating at the lake. The water was freezing and the wind was stinging our faces. Suddenly we saw a dark cave approaching fast.

"Watch out for the rocks!" Sam screamed loudly.

I steered the boat away but we scratched the side. We stopped the boat and climbed onto a big ledge. It was very dark and scary inside. We started walking and heard a weird noise sounding like a monster.

"I think we should go back now," I whispered.

Then we saw a fountain of water shoot up high! It wasn't a monster, it was just a leaky pipe. We laughed and pretended we were bungee jumping off the ledge back to the boat. It was the best adventure ever.

I met a green alien named Zog in my backyard. He had a shiny metal suit and three big eyes. Zog told me his spaceship broke because of gravity.

"I need a needle to fix the engine!" Zog yelled.

I ran inside and grabbed my mom's sewing kit. I gave him the needle and he started fixing it. Suddenly, Zog let out a huge sneeze. It sounded like screaming and green slime went throughout the yard.

"Sorry, I am allergic to Earth air," Zog said.

He finished the job and the ship hummed. I wrote my name on his ship with a marker. Then he flew away and I roasted marshmallows on the engine's fire. I discovered that alien fire makes marshmallows taste like blue raspberry. It was the most important day ever.

My finger hurt from pushing the buttons so hard. I was playing the new robot racing game with my friend Mike. The screen was scorched with fire because my robot exploded.

"You can't beat me!" Mike screeched loudly.

"Just wait until the next level," I said.

I grabbed the controller tight and started the race again. My robot ran fast and jumped over a fountain of blue water. I could hardly contain my excitement when I passed Mike’s robot. A loud bell started ringing to show I won the race. It was such a pleasure to finally win against him. I was really grateful that I practiced all week. Now Mike wants to play again tomorrow.

I was dreaming about finding a secret cave. The cave was at a great height on a big mountain. Me and my friend Sam bought ropes and flashlights with our earning money. We started loading our backpacks carefully.

We hiked up the mountain and saw a huge creature. It looked like a furry elephant! I was scared but Sam felt stronger than me.

"Look at it jumping over the rocks!" Sam shouted.

"We need to be quiet," I whispered back.

The creature was bearing a big stick. It stopped near a fire and roasted a marshmallow. Then I woke up in my bed. It was just a dream, but now I want a marshmallow.

The weather was stormy and dark outside the cave. My friend Tim was wearing his superhero cape. We were pretending to be a league of heroes. We dug in the wet earth with a plastic knife.

"I think I found a bone!" shouted Tim loudly.

I looked down and my breathing got really fast. It was just a white rock but we kept digging. We wanted to find a treasure chest or maybe gold. Suddenly I heard a noise deep inside the dark cave.

"That sounds like a dragon," I whispered to Tim.

We were brave like a strong knight in a book. But the noise got louder so we ran away fast. We ran far enough to be safe at my house. Maybe we will find the treasure when the sun comes out. We sold the white rock to my sister for a cookie.

My heart was pumping fast as we crawled through the cave. The ground was cold and hard on my knees. Timmy bounced ahead of me because he was excited. We were looking for the pirate treasure hidden inside.

"It’s too dark in here!" grumbled Timmy.

"Just keep bearing left," I said simply.

We saw a weird light shining near a big rock. I had a yearning to see what it was. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole. Neither of us was scared though. We found a golden thread on the floor. It was leading to a meeting spot for pirates! We followed it and found a box. It was the treasure!

I went to the old forest with my dog called Spot. We were looking for a lost treasure chest. It was very important to find it before lunch. Suddenly a white ghost appeared behind a big green tree. Spot barked loudly and ran at the ghost.

"Don't be scared, Spot!" I yelled at him.

The ghost floated closer and pointed at the mud. I saw something shiny that sank deep in the dirt. I dug it up and held it high like a champion. It was a golden pen to write secret notes!

"We found it!" I shouted.

Then my mom called us for dinner. I hope I don't get a grounding for being late.

Yesterday was the worst day at school ever. I had a huge project due about the earth and I forgot to bring it. Mrs. Brown asked everyone to put their projects on her desk.

"Oh no!" I screamed inside my head.

I was wearing my favorite blue shirt but I still felt sad. At recess I didn't even want to play on the big mountain of tires. My friend Tommy came over and he was eating an apple.

"Why are you so grumpy?" Tommy asked me.

"I didn't remember my important project," I said.

I started to write a note to my teacher. I didn't want to complain but my stomach hurt. Then the bell rang for lunch hour. I was bumping into kids in the hallway because I was looking down. I hope tomorrow is better than today.

My brother Tom and I went into the dark woods. We saw a big wooden sign that said DANGER. We ignored it simply because we are brave. Suddenly, a giant green beetle jumped from a tall tree. It was the same height as my dad! Tom screamed very loud but I held my sword tight.

"I guarantee I can beat him!" I shouted.

The bug hissed and almost crushed us with its leg. I used all my strength and fought the monster hard. Tom threw a rock and it hit a blue vein. The beetle ran away fast and we sang a victory song.

"You looked like a real knight," Tom said happily.

We walked home and played on the computer until fourteen o’clock.

I struggled with my math homework on Tuesday. The numbers looked like they were floating on the paper. I tried to focus, but my brain felt fuzzy. My pencil fell and crawled under my desk. I had to search for it in the dust. Then the bell rang for lunch and I was happy.

"Did you finish the math?" asked my friend Sam.

"No, it was too hard," I said.

We ate roasted chicken and played tag outside. A blue bird flew over the playground. Then the bird disappeared behind a big tree. After lunch, we went back to class. I drew a picture of the bird instead of math. It was a good day even with the hard numbers.

Me and my friend Sam sprinted to the old castle. It looked scary and the ceiling was super high. We held our flashlights tight and walked inside. Suddenly a big monster appeared! It looked like a giant angry lamb.

"Use your imagination!" Sam told me loudly.

I drew a magic sword in the air. Then I blew on it and it turned real. I felt like I had super strength. I ran at the monster but I didn't knock it over.

"Stop swearing at the lamb!" Sam yelled.

I wasn't swearing, I was just making loud noises. Then I remembered that lambs like grass. I gave it a sandwich. The lamb ate it and let us reign over the castle. We were kings!

I woke up really early for my big soccer game. I needed lots of strength so I ate a huge breakfast. My toast had too much jelly and it was stinging my tongue. 

When we got to the field, I saw the other team. They looked tough, especially their goalie. The game was just beginning and I ran very fast.

"Pass it to me!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

He kicked the ball and I was ready to receive it. I ran past a boy who crashed into the grass. Then I kicked the ball hard. It flew high like it would hit a ceiling. It went right into the net and rattled the chain! 

"Nice shot!" Sam shouted at me.

We won the game and I felt so happy. Now I was hungry again and ready to learn a new video game. Science class is okay but winning soccer is way better.

It was my birthday and I was so excited. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We played video games and ate lots of pizza. Then my mom started bringing out the cake.

Suddenly, Sam dropped his soda on the floor. He looked afraid because it made a huge mess. My heart was pumping fast. I thought my mom would feel anger.

"I am so sorry!" Sam yelled loudly.

"Don't be scared, it was an accident," my mom said.

She meant it and she was not mad at all. We cleaned it up and ate the cake. The best part was when I got to receive my presents. I got a cool science kit for training ants. That was the most important gift ever. We stayed up late staring at the ceiling and talking. I woke up happy the next day.

Recess was finally here and I ran outside fast. My friend Billy was the captain of our kickball team. He threw the red ball to me and I kicked it hard. It went soaring over the fence near the swinging bars.

"Wow! You are getting strong," Billy yelled at me.

"I have been eating lots of protein," I said back.

We saw a big dog roaming near the playground fence. It looked like it was training for a race. I knew we should not go near it. The teacher saw us approaching the fence and blew her whistle loud. She is honest but strict about the rules. We ran back to the blacktop. I was yearning for one more kick but the bell rang. My reign as the kickball king was over for today.

My friend Max came over for a sleepover last night. We ate pancakes for breakfast and then we played in my room. We built a huge mountain out of pillows and blankets. It touched the ceiling and it looked really cool.

"Watch out!" I screamed when Max jumped on the top.

He struggled to stay up there but then he crashed down. The whole fort fell and hit my lamp. I was scared that my mom would be mad.

"Are we in trouble?" Max asked with big eyes.

My mom came in because she was leaving for the store. She saw the mess but she just laughed at us. It was weird because usually she hates messes. We cleaned it up fast before she came back.

I was sitting in math class and I was yearning for lunch. My stomach was making loud groaning noises again. Mrs. Miller was wearing her blue dress and talking about numbers. I reached into my desk for a snack but I stopped. I could not contain my hunger but I had to wait. Finally the bell rang and everyone ran out.

I grabbed my leather lunchbox and crashed into my friend Tommy. "Watch out!" he yelled.

"Sorry, I am just so hungry!" I said.

We sat down and I opened my box. I broke my cookie in half and not even a crumb fell. We ate fast and then crawled under the slide. We do that often when we play spies. It was growing dark outside so we had to go back in. I hope lunch is longer tomorrow.

One day my friends and I went to the woods. We were looking for a secret cave in the earth. It was getting dark and scary. Suddenly we heard a weird noise. It sounded like a monster groaning.

"Run!" I yelled very loud.

We ran fast but something was following us. It felt like an invisible ghost. Then Tim tripped on a rock. He screamed because he hurt his leg. I saw something floating in the air. It was just a white plastic bag. We laughed but my heart was beating fast. I felt caffeine in my vein even though I didn't drink soda.

"Let's go home now," said Tim.

We didn't find the cave but we were safe. Next time we will bring a flashlight.

I was playing my new video game called Mega Knight. It was the most important level because I was fighting the boss. He stood in front of a big dark castle. He was huge and green like a monster from a foreign earth.

"You can't beat me!" the boss yelled at my screen.

My heart was thumping hard in my chest. I pressed the buttons fast and my character rose up high. I used my super sword immediately. The monster started groaning and fell down with a loud crash. It sounded like someone dumping rocks.

"Yes! I won the game!" I shouted to my brother.

My brain felt tired but happy. I saw the ending cutscene. My knight was tearing a gold chain off the gate. I was finally the champion of the whole kingdom.

My best friend Ben came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to have a big adventure in my backyard. We pretended to be brave soldiers in a kingdom. Ben was a shiny knight with a plastic sword. We walked until we neared the big oak tree.

"Look out for the dragon!" I yelled loudly.

It was actually just my dog Buster. We started climbing the low branches of the tree. We spread out our blankets to make a secret fort. Suddenly, my mom appeared with a plate of cookies.

"Did you boys reign over the kingdom yet?" she asked.

We ate the cookies and felt strong enough to fight again. We crossed the grass and saw a rope hanging down. We didn't get in trouble because we were quiet. It was the best sleepover ever, especially the cookies.

I was sitting at my desk doing math. It was freezing in our classroom because the window was open. Mrs. Miller said, “Please write down the answer to number five.” I looked at the paper but I didn’t know it. My heart started pumping really fast in my chest. I tried to focus on my breathing to stay calm.

Suddenly, the computer on the teacher's desk crashed and made a loud noise. Everyone jumped! Then the lunch bell rang and we all ran outside. We played tag in the big grassy meadow behind the school. I am fast because I am almost thirteen.

At lunch, I opened my box and took out my apple. I used a plastic knife to cut it into pieces. My friend Sam asked, “Can I have a slice?” I gave him one and we laughed. It was a good day after all.

It was a cold Tuesday in February. My friend Sam and I ate breakfast fast because we had a mission. We believed there was a treasure in the park behind our apartment. We ran outside and entered the jungle of tall bushes.

We walked for a long time and my legs hurt.
"This backpack has too much weight," Sam grumbled loudly.
"We are almost there," I said.

Suddenly, a stinging bee flew right at my nose! I swatted it away and we ran. We reached the big oak tree and dug in the dirt. Gradually, we saw something shiny and red.

"Look at that!" Sam yelled. "It is the lost jewel!"
I knew we were rich. We took the jewel home for lunch.

I was reading a newspaper in my treehouse. It said a king used to reign here long ago. My neighbor Tim climbed up and he looked excited. He had a map and was yearning for an adventure.

"Look at this old map I found!" shouted Tim.

We moved fast into the dark woods behind my house. We were looking for the king's lost gold bearing. Suddenly, a big bear jumped out and roared at us! We ran back home very fast. We were pleased to be safe in my yard. We told my mom what happened.

"You boys are crazy," she said with a laugh.

Me and my best friend Sam were exploring the woods. It was raining a little bit but we didn't care. We were looking for the secret cave. Suddenly we heard a weird noise. It sounded like something groaning in the dark.

"I think a dragon is sleeping inside," Sam whispered.

I shook my head. "Maybe it's a monster eating stewed rats."

We walked straight into the dark cave very slowly. I saw something floating in the air. It was a glowing blue ghost! We almost flew out of there because we were scared. But then the ghost smiled.

"I have an important message," the ghost said.

It told us about a different world. Gradually the light faded away. We ran home fast. We felt like we fought a big battle. It was the best adventure ever.

I gripped the controller tightly in my hands. It was the last level of the mountain climbing game. My annoying nephew watched me play. He knew I was going to win this time. I looked straight at the screen and did not blink.

"You are going to lose!" he shouted loudly at me.

"Be quiet or I'm telling Mom!" I yelled back.

My character jumped over a big rock on the ground. Then a giant monster started dumping huge boulders everywhere. I simply pushed the red button fast. My character threw a magic fireball and hit the monster. It fell down and I won the game! I felt happy, but my mom walked in then. She saw I didn't read my book for school yet. Now I am getting a grounding for a week.

I was bearing a big heavy box to school today. It had my science project inside, and I was thrilled. I used all my strength to carry it up the stairs.

"Do you need help?" asked my friend Leo.

"No thanks, I got it!" I said with a smile.

I really feared I would drop it before class started. But I reached the room safely and put it down. My teacher gave me a sticker because I obtained an A plus! It gave me so much pleasure to see that shiny sticker. After school, I went to soccer training and I scored a goal. It was the best day ever.

I put on my green sweater early in the morning. I wanted to go exploring in the woods behind my house. My dog Rex was sleeping on the rug, though. I woke him up and put on his chain leash. We walked outside and Rex started stamping his feet in the mud.

Suddenly a big squirrel appeared on the fence! It looked very dangerous and mean. Rex started barking loudly at the squirrel.

"Stop it right now!" I shouted at him.

Rex kept barking and it was feeling impossible to stop him. My plan was a failure. The squirrel ran away fast.

"You have too much imagination," my mom said later. She was speaking nicely but I was still mad. Next time I will leave Rex at home.

I was yearning for lunchtime because I was so hungry. My stomach made a funny noise and everyone looked at me. Mrs. Miller was talking about math and it was boring. I looked at the clock but the hands were barely moved. It felt like I was floating in space with no gravity. Finally the bell rang and I screamed inside my head. 

"Don't forget your homework is loading on the computer!" Mrs. Miller said.

I ran to the cafeteria very early to get pizza. I can guarantee that pizza day is the best day. Although the line was long, I waited for a big slice. 

"This is the most important meal," my friend Sam said.

We ate fast and then we ran outside to play tag. I was happy because school is okay when there is pizza.

It was my birthday party and we were hanging out in the backyard. My dad was steering the grill for hot dogs but the fire was too big. He scorched two hot dogs and his face turned red with anger.

"Oh no, I burned the lunch!" Dad yelled loudly.

My friend Leo saw a huge black beetle crawling on the table. He tried to catch it with my mom's kitchen scissors. Suddenly, the beetle opened its wings and flew right at my sister.

"Get it away from me!" she screamed and ran inside.

Then my mom appeared with a big chocolate cake. I felt happy because I was earning extra presents for being good. We ate the cake fast and forgot about the burnt hot dogs. It was the best day ever.

Max and I were waiting by the spooky old fountain. We wanted to search for the ghost in the castle. I was certain it was real because I read the newspaper. We walked inside and heard a loud whistle.

"Did you hear that noise?" asked Max.

Suddenly the floor opened up and we fell down. We were trapped in a dark hole! I threw a rock and it disappeared into the shadows. I thought we were stuck forever.

"I see a light over there!" I yelled.

We climbed out and ran all the way home. We are never going back to that scary castle again.

One day my dog Buster got loose in the yard. He had a long silver chain but he broke it. He was roaming around the big bushes near the fence. I saw him jumping up and down like a bunny.

"Buster stop that right now!" I yelled very loud.

He didn't listen and kept thumping his tail on the ground. He found something shiny in the dirt. It was my dad's lost scissors! Buster looked very proud that he obtained the prize.

"Good boy Buster, give it here," I said nicely.

Just then my mom came outside because the phone was ringing. We went inside and had roasted chicken for dinner. Buster got a little piece too because he found the scissors. Then he started stamping his paws for more food. He is a very silly dog.

Me and my best friend Sam were camping in the woods. We looked for sticks but discovered a huge, dark cave. Sam shouted, "Let's go inside and explore!"

We walked in and it was very plain and rocky. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound. My heart started pumping really fast. We realized a bear was waiting for us!

The bear started moaning and walking closer. We spread out and ran away fast. We escaped the cave and found a water fountain outside.

"I think we should learn to stay away from caves," I said.

Sam nodded and we ran back to our tent. We were bearing good news that we were safe.

My dog Buster sprinted through the tall grass in the backyard. It was a cold day in February but we didn't care. We pretended the bushes were a thick jungle.

"Look Buster, I see treasure!" I shouted.

Buster barked and started digging and tearing at the dirt. His paws got all muddy and he made a big stain on his fur. I touched the wet ground and felt something hard. It was just an old bone my dad bought for him last week.

"Oh no, we found it already," I said sadly.

Suddenly we heard a weird noise coming from the fence. We were trembling a little bit but we walked over. Buster led the way. It was just a squirrel bringing a nut to its family. We watched it run away and tried to maintain our secret hiding spot. Being explorers is hard work.

I was boating on a magic river in space. I saw a glowing green island floating in the stars. My robot dog Sparky barked at a trail of glitter. We landed near a big crystal fountain. Suddenly a blue alien jumped out and froze us with a ray gun!

"Give me the magic jewel now!" he shouted.

I was yearning to be brave like a superhero. I drew my laser sword and it made a loud buzzing sound. The alien looked scared and his pants started tearing. He sank into the ground and disappeared.

"We are certain to be safe now," said Sparky.

We found the jewel inside the fountain water. Now I can reign over the galaxy as the king.

One day my dog Spot woke up early. He loves roaming around the backyard. I went outside and I held his leash tight. We walked to the big park down the street. It felt like we were in a foreign land.

Spot saw a squirrel and yelled, "Woof!"

The squirrel bounced away fast like a bungee jumper. Spot turned his head and looked at me. He wanted to chase it even though he couldn't.

"You are a champion runner, Spot," I said to him.

We started walking back home for an important meeting. My mom was painting the fence blue. I felt like loading my brain with fun ideas. Exploring with Spot is the best thing ever.

It was raining so hard outside. I was breathing fast because I saw a cat in the mud. The cat struggled to walk straight. My brother Tom said, "We must help him immediately!" We ran to the cat and my feet sank in the wet dirt.

I picked up the cat and something sharp struck me. It felt like a needle but it was just his claws. I ran inside again and sent Tom to get a towel.

"I guarantee he is hungry," Tom yelled from the kitchen.

We discovered the cat had a cold because he did a big sneeze. The reason he was outside was a mystery. We gave him milk and named him Science because he looked smart. He is our best friend now.

I had a sleepover with my best friend Max. We played games and jumped on my bed until I felt dizzy. It was like there was no gravity in my room! My mom came in and brewed some hot chocolate for us.

"Please be quiet or you will wake the baby," she said.

Max whispered, "Okay, we will use our brain to be quiet."

We drank the chocolate and the warmth gradually filled our tummies. But then we heard a loud thumping sound on the stairs. It was my dog Buster running down to say hello. He grew so big last year! We laughed again and again until we were tired. The sleepover was complete when we finally fell asleep on the floor.

My tummy was hungry and yearning for lunchtime. I crawled under my desk to find my lost pencil. It was earning me a headache because math is important.

"Where are you going?" asked Mrs. Green loudly.

"Just getting my pencil," I said and reached for it.

Then the bell rang and we ran outside fast. The slide was slippery and twisted like a snake. It looked a little dangerous but I wasn't feared. I climbed up high like I was training for mountains. My friend Sam kept me company on the big balcony.

Suddenly a bee came buzzing near my ear. I didn't want a stinging mark on my face! I had to maintain my balance or I would fall. We jumped off and ran to eat our sandwiches.

We woke up really early because we saw something cool. It was a treasure map floating in the water. My friend Sam grabbed it fast.

"This must have a secret meaning!" Sam shouted loudly.

We believed it was from the scary Pirate Blackbeard. The map showed a path to a spooky island. We took our small boat and started rowing. A tiny gnat flew in my eye but I kept rowing.

We saw a big bear roaming on the beach. He was bearing a shiny gold necklace!

"Look out, he sees us!" I yelled.

We ran away very fast. We were already tired but we found the X. We dug in the sand and found a box. It was full of chocolate coins! We ate them all on the way home.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the woods. We heard a noise behind the big oak tree. It sounded like a monster but it was just the breeze. We started walking deeper into the dark forest. Suddenly I saw a hole in the earth. I pushed Sam a little bit to look closer.

"Watch out!" I yelled because he slipped.

Sam scrambled up the dirt and he looked scared. He was holding something white in his hand. It was an old receipt from the grocery store. Then we heard screaming from a bird in the sky. We got scared so we ran home fast. We almost got caught by a big dog. It was a scary adventure but we were safe.

I was in the forest following a map from my imagination. My dog Max was leading the way and keeping close. We neared a big dark cave that looked scary. Suddenly a huge bat flew out and I screamed really loud! Max barked at it and started tearing up the dirt.

"Don't go in there Max!" I yelled at him.

But he ran inside and I heard a groaning noise. I knew I had to be brave so I ran inside too. I realized the noise was just the wind floating through holes. We found a chest and dumped it out. It was just old rocks but I pretended it was gold.

"We are rich now!" I said to Max.

We ran home before the sun landed behind the hills.

We had a big science test today. I chewed my pencil because the questions were super hard. It felt impossible to finish! Then the bell rang for recess and we all ran outside. The weather was nice and sunny. 

We played kickball together on the big grass field. My friend Sam kicked the ball way too hard. It landed on the roof!

"Oh no, the ball escaped!" yelled Sam.

"Maybe I can jump and get it," I said.

I jumped but I am not a champion jumper. Then the wind blew very hard and the ball rolled down. We were so happy. After recess, we did reading time about a magic island. I wished I was invisible so I didn't have to do cleaning up later. Then I remembered I had a cookie in my lunchbox. It was a good day.

I ran to the forest behind my house again. My dog Rex was running fast and his legs were pumping. He stopped at the creek and I grasped his collar. He saw a frog on a rock. I thought he would jump in but he didn't.

"Don't eat that frog, Rex!" I yelled loudly.

Rex barked and sounded like a big wolf. He greeted the frog with a sniff. We kept walking and found a small dirt island. I started dumping rocks in the water to make a bridge. I hit my thumb with a rock and it hurt. Often we find cool bugs out here but today was just frogs. It looked like a painting with all the green trees.

"I guarantee we will find a turtle next time," I said.

We walked home for lunch.

One day me and my friend Sam went exploring. We saw a big scary castle on a hill. It looked really old and different from other houses. Sam loves adventures but he was scared.

"This looks impossible to climb," Sam said quietly.

"We have to because it is important," I yelled.

Suddenly we heard a loud knock on the door. A giant dragon was roaming in the yard. He greeted us with a roar! He chewed on a giant toy guitar. We ran away fast. My legs felt like jelly.

Sam was growing tired but we kept running. He was coughing like he had pneumonia. We finally got home safe. My dad was coaching soccer outside. We were happy to be safe.

Me and my friend Sam went to the big forest. We wanted to find the secret cave. We walked for a long time throughout the trees. Suddenly we saw a big mountain and started climbing.

"This is really high!" yelled Sam.

"Don't look down or you will get scared," I said.

My hands gripped the rocks tight. I was breathing really fast. We saw a bridge made of old ropes swinging in the wind. It looked like a bungee cord but scary. I thought something might go wrong. Then a sharp rock poked me like a needle.

"Ouch! I hate this!" I shouted, almost swearing.

We ran across the bridge and greeted a dark cave. Sam walked inside and just disappeared into the black. I was scared but I followed him. We were brave explorers.

Yesterday was the best day at school ever. We had a big contest in gym class for jumping rope. I was trembling a little bit because I was scared. My friend Tim is the champion of jumping, but I wanted to win.

The teacher yelled, "Go!" and everyone started jumping fast. I bounced up and down and counted in my head. Tim stopped because his foot got caught. I kept going until I had enough points to win!

I was so thrilled when the teacher said my name.

"You jumped to a new height!" she told me.

I grabbed my prize which was a cool blue pencil. To be honest, I thought Tim would win again. Then we went to computer class and played games. It was super fun and nobody was groaning about homework. I wish every day was like yesterday.

My friends and I went deep into the jungle. Max was leading the way and jumping over logs. Suddenly a big wind blew hard throughout the trees. It was scary but we knew we were brave enough. We saw a river and swam across it quickly. Then we saw a giant monkey speaking to us!

"Go back home!" the monkey yelled loudly.

"We are looking for gold!" I shouted back.

The monkey threw a banana and we ran away. Later I wrote about it in my diary. It was the best adventure ever.

I was sitting in math class and I hated it. We had to learn about fractions and it was so boring. Suddenly a tiny gnat flew right into my ear! I moved my head fast and hit my desk. It made a loud knock sound. Everyone looked at me and my face turned red. Then a big black beetle appeared on the floor near my foot.

"Eww, look at that bug!" yelled Sarah loudly.

My teacher Mr. Jones came over to look. He tried to squeeze past the desks but he tripped. He almost said a bad swearing word but he stopped. He threw a tissue over the beetle and picked it up.

"Okay class, time for lunch," he said.

I chewed my sandwich fast because I was hungry. Then the bell started ringing for recess and we ran outside.

I walked to the park with my younger nephew Sam. It was his birthday and he was so happy. We saw a big fountain splashing water everywhere. Sam ran right through the water and got wet.

"Oh no, you are soaked!" I shouted loudly.

Sam was just laughing and chewed on his shirt. Then he discovered a lost puppy waiting by a tree. The puppy was clinging to the rough bark. Sam grabbed the puppy and sat on the ground.

"Can we keep him please?" Sam asked me.

I was certain my mom would start groaning later. We toasted marshmallows at home and the puppy ate one. It was the best birthday ever.

I was feeling happy because it was recess time. I scrambled out the door and ran to the big oak tree. My friend Sam was already there. He was bringing a shiny box from his pocket.

"Look at this treasure I found," Sam said.

I looked inside and saw a shiny silver needle. We climbed up the tree to hide it. I struggled a little bit but I made it up. We spread out on a thick branch and counted leaves. Suddenly a squirrel appeared and scratched the bark near my hand.

"Watch out for the squirrel!" I yelled.

We jumped down and ran back through the playground. Climbing trees is fun but scary sometimes.

My friends Sam and Leo came over for a sleepover. We decided to build a giant fort in the living room. We used every blanket and pillow in the house. It looked like a castle from a foreign land.

"We need snacks for our big adventure!" Sam shouted.

We ran to the kitchen and grabbed chips and juice. We cleared a spot inside the fort for the food. Then we counted all our glow sticks. We had enough for everyone to have two.

"Do you understand the secret password?" asked Leo.

"Yes, it is 'planet earth'!" I said back.

We crawled inside and told scary stories until midnight. It was the best sleepover ever because we stayed up super late. We didn't want to go to sleep either.

I was playing Rocket League with my friend Sam. We were on different teams and he was winning. I felt like I was going to explode. He scored another goal and my car blew up. I was groaning loudly because he is so annoying when he wins.

"Ha! I toasted you again!" Sam yelled through his headset.

I leaned forward in my chair. I was wearing my lucky hat now. I drove fast and hit the ball hard. It went tearing across the field into his goal.

"No way!" he shouted.

I laughed and threw my controller on the bed. Then my mom came in from the balcony. She told me to be quiet or turn it off. I whispered, "One more game," and sat back down.

It was a cold day in February for my big sleepover. My best friend Sam came over and we started loading snacks into my fort. We made a huge fort with pillows and blankets but it felt a little trapped inside.

"Can we make it stronger?" Sam asked me.

We searched for more heavy books to hold the blanket down. We toasted some marshmallows in the microwave but they made a sticky stain on the plate. Then we crawled back in the fort and squeezed inside. It was very tight but we had enough room.

Suddenly the whole thing crashed down on us!

"Hey, I can’t get out!" I yelled.

My mom came in and saw us laughing under the blankets. My eyes were stinging from laughing so hard. We ended up just sleeping on the floor with the fort closed on top of us. We didn't complain because it was the best night ever.

Max and I found a dark cave near the river. We had flashlights but they weren't very bright. It got darker gradually as we walked deeper inside. Suddenly, we saw a giant spider web blocking the path.

"Watch out for the needle teeth!" Max yelled loudly.

The spider was huge and it was singing a scary song. I was scared but I understood we had to run. We saw a vine hanging from the ceiling like a bungee cord. I grabbed it and swung over the spider. Max followed me and we landed safely.

"I am so grateful we escaped," I said.

We lit a fire outside and ate our snacks. Next time we will bring bigger lights for the cave.

Me and my friend Sam went to the big mountain. We wanted to find the secret cave at the top. We walked for a long time across the grassy plain. Suddenly, a huge rock crashed down right in front of us!

"Watch out, Sam!" I yelled really loud.

Sam jumped back and looked scared. "That was super close," he said.

We kept walking and crossed a cold river on a log. The water was moving very fast. We were keeping our balance carefully. Then I felt a tickle in my nose. I let out a giant sneeze. The sneeze made me wobble, but Sam grabbed my arm. Everything was okay. We finally found the cave and it was dark inside.

I was sitting in class and it was boring. My teacher Mrs. Green was talking about math numbers like eight and fourteen. I didn't really understand it. Suddenly I saw something moving in my backpack. I pulled the zipper open and my hamster Fluffy popped out!

"Oh no, Fluffy escaped!" I screamed very loudly.

Fluffy ran across the floor and everyone started cheering. He looked like he was camping under the desk. Mrs. Green looked surprised but then she smiled.

"Is that your hamster?" she asked me.

It was very important to catch him before lunch. I grabbed him quickly. I discovered that bringing pets to school is actually fun. I hope I don't receive a detention tomorrow.

It was a beautiful day for recess at my school. My friend Sam and I ran outside fast. We are in a kickball league with the other classes. Sam grinned at me and grasped the red ball.

"Do you remember the rules?" I asked him loudly.

"Yes, I will reign as king today!" Sam yelled.

The teacher brewed some tea inside but we didn't care. We played hard. Sam threw the ball super far across the field. I ran to guide him to the home plate base. He ran like he had too much caffeine. We won the game and everyone cheered for us. It was the best recess ever. Then the bell rang and we had to go back.

My neighbor named Sam came over to play video games. We played a game about climbing a big green mountain. My mom gave us a snack with lots of protein. I picked the character with red hair and blue shoes. Sam picked the ninja who fights with big silver scissors.

"I bet I can beat every single level!" Sam screamed.

"No way, I am the real champion," I said back.

We played for a long time and tried to complete it. The last boss was really hard to find and search for. Suddenly, Sam's character fell off the edge of the map. I jumped over the hole and won the whole game! I felt like a king and Sam was mad. My mom’s daughter, my sister, laughed at him. It was the best day ever.

My best friend Leo came over for a sleepover. We decided to build a huge fort in the living room. We used every blanket and pillow we could find. It looked like a giant soft mountain.

"This is the best fort ever!" Leo screamed happily.

"I am certain nobody can get in," I said.

Suddenly, my big dog Buster sprinted into the room. He was running too fast and he slipped on the rug. Buster crashed right into our blanket mountain. The whole thing fell down on top of us. I feared we were trapped forever. Then my mom appeared with a plate of cookies. She looked at the mess but she wasn't mad.

"Are you boys hungry?" she asked with a smile.

We were very pleased and ate cookies in the ruins.

It was Wednesday and I forgot my homework. I met my friend Sam at his locker. He was looking for his math book.

"Did you do the worksheet?" I asked him.

"Yes, but my dog scratched it up," Sam said.

We walked to class and kept bumping into people. Everyone was loud. Mrs. Baker rose from her chair when the bell rang. I was groaning inside my head. She looked at us and smiled.

"Today we are going to the computer lab!" she yelled.

I was so happy because I escaped trouble! We played games and typed fast. But then Mrs. Baker caught me talking.

"Please focus on your typing," she said nicely.

It turned into a good day after all.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We had a map that Sam drew on old paper. We were looking for the lost jewel of the King. Suddenly, a giant bug appeared! It looked like a super big gnat with red eyes.

"Run away immediately!" yelled Sam.

We ran fast and hid behind a big rock. The bug flew away and the path cleared. We walked more and found a shiny cave. Inside sat a tiny elf holding a needle and thread.

"It is a pleasure to meet you," the elf greeted us.

He gave us the blue jewel because we were brave. Everyone was so happy when we got home. We felt very grateful. I can’t wait to write about it in my diary.

I was playing soccer with my friend Sam at the park. We were pretending to be a brave sailor team fighting pirates. I kicked the ball hard and it flew across the scenery.

"Go get it!" yelled Sam while jumping up and down.

I ran fast but then I twisted my ankle on the bumpy ground. It started stinging really bad and I fell down. I grasped my leg because it hurt so much. I tried to contain my tears but I was trembling a little bit. Sam ran over and looked at my knee. It was scratched and dirty.

"Are you okay?" he asked me.

"I think so," I said. "But now I am really hungry."

We walked home slowly. I did not receive a trophy today. But I did eat fourteen cookies.
