Yesterday at school was a really wonderful day. We had art class right after lunch time. My teacher taught us how to make paper flowers. I grabbed my blue scissors and cut the paper carefully.

"Make sure you squeeze the glue hard," my friend Leo said.

I put too much glue and it got everywhere! We made a mess but the scenery looked nice. We drew trees and the sun behind our flowers. Then the bell called us for recess and we ran outside. Leo followed me to the swings.

"Do you remember seeing my red ball?" I asked him.

We looked around until the grass grew tall by the fence. We found it hiding there. It was fun playing but then school was over. I was so tired when I got home.

It was raining on Wednesday so we had an indoor adventure. My friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We were wearing our pajamas and we built a huge fort. It looked like a castle floating in the living room.

"Use your brain!" Sam yelled when the blanket fell down.

We fixed it with a pillow and a heavy book. Mom roasted some marshmallows on the stove for us. She grinned and gave us a big bag of candy.

"I don't understand how to eat this," Sam said laughing.

Mom was teaching us how to make s'mores inside. It was fun but I was yearning to play outside. Suddenly I saw a tiny white feather on the floor. It was from the pillow fight we had earlier. Gradually we got tired and fell asleep in the fort. It was the best night ever.

Yesterday was the best day ever at school. First we had computer lab, and I played a math game. I am the champion of the multiplication game now. Then the bell screeched really loud, so we ran outside for recess.

Me and my friend Sam were tearing across the grass. We wanted to play tag by the water fountain.

"You're it!" Sam yelled at me and laughed.

I ran fast but I tripped and scratched my knee on the ground. It hurt a little bit, but I didn't cry. I feared I would have to go to the nurse. But then the teacher said I could be the line captain anyway. Being captain is super cool. I felt happy again and we walked back inside for lunch.

The robot named Zog stood on the small island. He was waiting for his spaceship to come back. Zog felt very sad and lost in the dark. His metal heart was yearning for his home planet. Suddenly, a tiny gnat flew near his shiny head. Zog moved his hand and caught the little bug.

"Do not eat me, Mr. Robot!" said the gnat.

Zog was thrilled that the bug could talk. He neared the water and let the bug go.

"My mission is complete now," Zog said happily.

Just then, his spaceship crossed the sky. His oil was pumping fast with joy. He did not complain about the long wait anymore. The weight of sadness left him as he flew away.

I had a mountain of homework on my desk. I gripped my pencil tight and stared at the paper. It was math and I kept getting the answers wrong. I felt trapped in my chair forever.

"Can I go outside?" I asked my mom loudly.

"Finish two more problems first," she said back to me.

I sighed and looked through the window at the swings. I wanted to be the king and reign over the playground. Finally, I finished the last problem and ran through the door. I jumped on my bike and rode to the park fast. The wind swept my hair back and it felt great. I was free!

I was playing my favorite game called Mountain Racer. It is a game where you jump off a big mountain with a bungee cord. I reached the last level and my heart was beating fast. I was breathing hard because the boss was super tough.

My mom yelled, "Dinners ready, pause your game!"

"I can't pause it now, Mom!" I shouted back.

If I waited any longer I would lose. I jumped off the cliff and spread my arms out. I almost crashed into a rock but I dodged it. Then I accidentally spilled my juice on my shirt. It made a huge red stain. But I won the game anyway! I might get in trouble for the shirt though.

It was a super hot Wednesday at school today. At recess, we played on the big playground equipment. It looks like a giant green mountain. My friend Billy pushed me on the swings first. I went so high and straight up into the air.

"I can see the whole jungle gym!" I yelled down.

Billy shouted back, "You look like a monkey roaming around!"

Then we moved to the sandbox. We pretended we were boating down a long river trail. The scenery was just sand and some rocks. Suddenly, I saw a big spider and got scared. I held up my thumb to squish it, but I didn't. I let it wrap itself in a leaf instead. School is fun but bugs are gross.

The lunch bell finally rang and everyone ran outside. I was so hungry because we had math all morning. We were learning about earning money but it was boring. I sat next to my friend Jake on the bench. He opened his lunchbox and started groaning really loud.

"What is wrong with your lunch?" I asked him.

"My mom packed stewed carrots again," Jake said sadly.

I had a sandwich so I felt bad for him. Then Mrs. Miller walked over and greeted us with a smile. She cleared the empty juice boxes off the table. She started coaching us on how to play kickball. The line grew long because everyone wanted to play. We pretended the ball was a boat and we were boating. It was the best recess ever.

It was a hot day at recess. The sun was stinging my neck. We were playing tag on the big hill. It felt like climbing a mountain. I ran fast and greeted my friend Sam.

"You can’t catch me!" I yelled loud.

Sam laughed and kept running. I was the captain of the tag team. Suddenly I tripped on a rock. I fell down hard but I stayed steady.

"Are you okay?" asked Sam, stopping fast.

"I am fine," I said, growing a big smile.

Later, we went back inside through the big doors. Mrs. Green was bringing out her guitar. She looked very pleased with us. We sang songs until the bell rang for lunchtime. It was the best day ever.

Me and my younger brother Sam found an old map. It showed a big red X near the spooky forest. We packed our bags and Sam brought his bungee cord.

"Are you keeping the map safe?" asked Sam nervously.

"Yes, I am reading it right now," I said.

We walked for a long time and the sky gradually got dark. Suddenly a giant bat flew right at our heads! We ducked and ran fast into a cave. Inside there was a pot that brewed green slime. Behind the pot was a shiny box of treasure! We grabbed it and ran home. Mom was so grateful we were safe. We won the best adventure ever!

The science teacher Mrs. Green walked in. Everyone was groaning because it was time for a test. I looked at the paper and I felt scared. I did not learn anything about plants last week! My friend Tim was tearing up his paper into tiny pieces.

"Please stop doing that Tim," said Mrs. Green loudly.

"I wish I was camping instead," whispered Tim to me.

I tried to focus but people kept bumping my desk. It felt like a needle poking my brain. I looked at the surrounding kids and they were writing fast. I just wrote about a bungee jump I saw on TV. I hope I don't get a grounding for this bad grade. School is hard sometimes.

My nephew Ben and I wanted to be explorers. We woke up early and packed our bags. It was freezing outside but we had big coats. We walked into the dark woods behind my house. Suddenly we heard a loud sounding roar nearby.

"Run back to the house!" I yelled at Ben.

Ben threw a stick at the noise and hid. A big dog jumped out and started barking. It was just Colonel the dog from next door.

"I guarantee he is friendly," Ben said laughing.

We were yearning for treasure but we found a dog. I was steering him back home by his collar. We didn't complete our quest to find gold today. But Ben said I was the champion of dog catching. Next time we will find the real treasure for sure.

My robot friend named Zog went camping with me. We walked straight into the green jungle behind my house. Zog was bumping into trees because he is made of metal. He is the same height as me but way stronger. We saw a weird blue light hanging in the sky.

"What is that?" I asked Zog.

"I do not know," Zog spoke in a robot voice.

Suddenly a small green alien moved out of the bushes. I thought it was scary but it looked nice. It pushed a button and we started to float! We floated throughout the whole forest. It was fun but then we left to go home. We did not receive any superpowers but it was cool enough for me.

My dog Buster thinks he is a brave knight. He likes exploring the woods behind my house. Yesterday we found a big stick. Buster used all his strength to pull it.

"I guarantee I can break this," I said to him.

Buster just grinned and chewed on the bark. We made a fire pit with stones. My dad came out and roasted marshmallows with us. The smell spread through the air gradually. It was so good. Then Buster started groaning because his tummy was empty.

"Do you want a treat?" my dad asked him.

Buster jumped up like he found a magic jewel. I like teaching him tricks, but he wasn't listening. He was just speaking in barks for food. Exploring is fun, but snacks are better.

One day I walked outside to play in my yard. My neighbor has a big dog named Rex. Rex was wearing a blue collar and looked very sad. He was waiting by his dog house on a heavy chain.

"What is wrong, Rex?" I asked him quietly.

He just barked and looked at the woods. He was yearning to run free through the trees. I wanted to help him but I had to listen to my mom. She says science class starts soon and I need to study. Suddenly a squirrel crashed into the fence loudly! Rex jumped up and barked super loud at it.

"Quiet down, boy!" yelled my neighbor from his porch.

I felt bad for Rex because he just wanted to play. Maybe tomorrow I can ask to walk him.

One day I was steering my spaceship near Mars. Suddenly a giant green alien appeared right outside. I was so scared that I almost dropped my juice. The alien had three eyes and it was bringing a laser gun!

"Don't shoot!" I yelled through the thick glass window.

The alien laughed and said, "I just want a sandwich."

I grabbed my lunchbox and I struggled to open the hatch. I feared the alien might eat me instead of the ham. My robot buddy Beep helped me push the food out. The alien took it and started running away fast. Then he let out a huge sneeze that shook the stars. I guess he was allergic to ham but he ate it anyway. I neared the planet safely and told my mom about it. She said I watch too much TV but I know it was real.

I was scared because my dog Max was trapped under the porch. He scrambled under there to get his ball, but he got stuck. My dad was coaching my brother's team, so he wasn't home. The weight of the wood looked heavy, though I tried to lift it.

"Come here, Max!" I yelled, but he just whined.

My friend Sam was approaching with a flashlight. We trained the light on Max's scared face. It was getting dark and a cold breeze was blowing.

"We have to seize the moment," Sam said like a movie hero.

We pulled some loose dirt surrounding the hole. Max wiggled free and felt like he was in heaven. My dad taught me to stay calm, but my hands were shaking. We left the porch and went inside for cookies. Max was happy again.

We walked into the dark cave and lit a torch. My friend Ben was shaking because he was scared. Suddenly, a giant bat flew right at our heads!

"Watch out!" I yelled and ducked down fast.

We saw a trail of slime on the rocky floor. We followed it deep inside until we saw a fountain. The water was glowing green and looked very spooky. Then a monster with eight eyes jumped out. It was breathing smoke and it chewed on a rock. We were trapped in the corner.

"Run for the hole!" Ben screamed.

I tried to seize the glowing treasure but I missed. We struggled to squeeze through the tiny hole. We ran outside and fell on the grass. We were safe but we didn't get the gold. Next time we will bring a net.

My dog Sparky ran into the freezing water. He loves swimming even though it is very cold. I threw a stick and it bounced on the ice. Sparky reached the stick and he looked like a sailor.

"Come back here, Sparky!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and he kept swimming fast. My heart was beating fast because I was scared. The breeze was strong and the clouds looked like they brewed a storm. Finally Sparky swam back to the fountain in the park. He was shaking water everywhere.

"Good boy for earning a treat," I said.

He was bearing a big smile on his face. We walked home and got warm.

Yesterday my dog Max was jumping all over the place. He threw his ball into the big stone fountain. Splash!

"Oh no, Max, that is a total failure," I said.

Max just looked at me and started singing a loud bark. He wanted his ball back but the water was deep. I had to use my imagination to get it. I drew a plan on the ground with a stick.

"I need some protein for energy first," I told him.

I ate a snack and then I climbed up. It was a pleasure to help him. I reached in and grabbed the wet ball. My job was complete! Max was so happy he jumped as high as the ceiling. We played catch until the sun went down. It was speaking to us that it was bedtime.

Me and my friend Sam went to the spooky forest. We walked through the tall trees and looked for treasure. Suddenly, Sam disappeared behind a big bush! I ran over and discovered a secret cave. It looked scary, but we started walking inside. It was very dark, and I could hear water dripping.

"Do you think there is gold here?" Sam asked me.

"Maybe, but we don't have enough light," I said.

We kept walking, but neither of us saw the hole. I almost fell, but Sam grabbed my arm. My weight was heavy, but he pulled me up. We found an old box, but it was just rocks. We were not earning any money today. We ran home fast because it was dinner time.

It was my birthday and everyone came over for cake. My mom gave me a big box and I had to wrap my arms around it. I used scissors to cut the tape and opened it fast. Inside was a sewing kit with lots of thread and a comb for my doll.

"Do you like it?" asked my mom.

"Yes, but I need coaching!" I said.

We sat on the floor and looked at the scenery outside. My dad was digging in the earth for his garden. My hand was not steady but I kept following the line. It took longer than I thought. My little brother ran in and there was danger because he almost tripped.

"Watch out!" yelled my dad.

We ate cake and my brother got icing in his hair. I used my new comb to get it out.

My nephew Ben and I went on a big search outside. We looked in the tall grass surrounding the old shed. We found a shiny green beetle sleeping on a leaf. Ben tried to pick it up, but it flew away fast.

"That was impossible to catch!" Ben yelled loudly.

We kept walking through the mud and wet earth. My dog Rex ran past us and sank into a puddle. He looked so funny with mud all over his face. He chewed on a stick he found in the dirt.

"Stop dumping water on me, Rex!" I shouted at him.

Rex just wagged his tail and barked. We walked home because we were tired and hungry. It was a good day but very messy.

It was my birthday last Saturday and I turned eight. My mom baked a big chocolate cake and lit the candles. We walked to the living room and everyone started singing loudly.

"Make a wish before you blow them out!" said Dad.

I closed my eyes and wished for a new puppy. Then I blew out all the candles in one breath. The smoke smelled like magic and everyone clapped for me.

My best friend Sam handed me a heavy box. The weight of the box made my arms feel tired. I opened it and saw a robot toy inside.

"I picked it out for no reason!" Sam laughed.

I understood that meant he just liked it a lot. We played with the robot and Mom treated us to ice cream. The dog followed us around hoping for some crumbs. It was the best day ever.

I hung my backpack on the hook and sighed. Today was a very important day for our kickball league. We were playing the red team at recess. I really hoped my team would win the game.

"Don't forget your math homework!" said Mrs. Green loudly.

I thought about the game and not the math. I already did my work so I felt pleased.

At recess, the ball bounced right to me. I kicked it hard and it escaped the fence!

"Wow, you kicked it to the moon!" shouted Tommy.

I gave him a thumbs up and smiled big. The scenery outside was nice and sunny today. I felt like a weight was off my shoulders. It was the best day ever, not like seeing a scary ghost.

I was loading my backpack with heavy books. We had a big test in science today and I was nervous. My friend Sam walked up to me in the hall. "Are you ready for the test?" he asked me. I shook my head and started groaning loudly. The bell blew and we all ran to class.

Mrs. Higgins was keeping a jar on her desk. Inside the jar was a huge black beetle with long legs. "Look at this bug!" she screeched happily. I knew it was going to be a weird day. We took the test and then it was finally lunchtime. I ate my sandwich and forgot all about the bug.

I went to the park with my dog Buster. We saw a big bug on a leaf. It crawled very fast and looked scary. Buster barked at it and was trembling a little bit.

"Don't be scared, Buster," I said to him.

Then a bird flew down and tried to eat the bug. The bug hid under an old paper receipt on the ground. We sat on the grass and watched them carefully.

"That bug is smart about psychology," I told Buster.

Buster meant to chase the bird, but he tripped. He looked silly. The sun was hot and I felt like a stewed carrot. We went home to get some cold water.

My best friend Ben and I went climbing up the big hill. It was freezing outside but we had our coats. We were looking for the lost cave. Ben was bringing a flashlight and I had some scissors. We heard a loud noise suddenly.

"What was that?" asked Ben, keeping his voice quiet.

"It sounds like a groaning monster," I whispered back.

We walked closer to the dark hole in the rocks. Something was screaming inside! It was just a small cat stuck in a bush. I used the scissors to cut the prickly branch. The cat was so grateful.

"We are simply the best explorers ever," said Ben.

I felt like a champion. We carried the cat home safely.

I walked into class and my teacher greeted everyone loudly. Today was an important day because we had pizza for lunch. I was already hungry and my stomach made a funny noise.

"Is it lunchtime yet?" I asked my friend Sam.

"No, we have to do math first," Sam whispered back.

Math took forever but then the bell finally rang. We ran outside and started swinging on the swings really high. It felt incredible to go so fast in the air. Then we played a game about a brave army colonel. Neither of us wanted to be the bad guy.

"I will seize the castle!" I shouted at Sam.

It was the greatest recess ever but it wasn't enough time. Then we went inside to eat the pizza. It was super cheesy and good.

I was running late for school today because I slept too much. I grabbed my backpack and pushed the door open fast. My younger brother yelled, "Wait for me!" but I kept going.

At lunch, I obtained a big chocolate milk. But then Ben bumped into me and I jumped back. The milk crushed in my hand and made a huge stain. It looked like a foreign country on my blue shirt. 

"Oh no, look at your shirt!" Ben said.

"It is okay, I have gym clothes," I told him.

I changed my shirt and then we played tag. We trained for the big race next week. I ran around the track eight times. It was a good day even with the milk mess.

One day I woke up super early. The sun rose up pink and bright. My dog Rex was still sleeping on his soft bed. He slept very late last night because he chased a raccoon. I went outside and the grass felt wet and cold. I saw a big hole in the earth near the fence.

"Rex, come look at this!" I yelled loudly.

Rex ran outside and sniffed the dirt. He chewed on a stick near the hole.

"Do you understand what made this?" I asked him.

I think a magic mole lives there. Maybe he brewed a potion and turned invisible. We waited a long time but nothing came out. Rex got bored and went back inside to eat breakfast. I put a rock over the hole to keep the magic inside.

One day a giant green alien ship landed in our backyard. It made a loud noise and everyone was scared. My little sister Amy screamed and hid under the table. I grabbed my laser sword and ran outside. 

Fourteen little purple robots walked out of the ship. They looked funny.

"We want cookies!" the robot leader said.

I didn't have cookies so I gave them my sandwich. They ate it all up together. Then they spread out and searched the yard for more food. They scattered everywhere. Suddenly lightning struck the tree and it fell down.

"Run away!" I yelled to the robots.

They crossed the yard fast and jumped back into their ship. Then they flew away into the sky. It was the craziest day ever.

I saw a foreign ship land in my backyard. It was silver and very shiny. A robot walked out and he was a scary height. He looked like a giant trash can with legs.

"Take me to your leader," the robot beeped loudly.

"My dad is at a meeting," I said to him.

The robot frowned and pulled out a green jewel. The jewel started glowing and flew into the air. Suddenly a colonel from the army ran into the yard. He looked very mad and held up a piece of paper.

"I have the receipt for this robot!" the colonel yelled.

The robot got scared and blasted off into space. It was thirteen seconds before he disappeared completely. My dad missed the whole thing.

My dog Buster is a very good boy. One day we went for a big search in the woods. I pretended I was the captain of a ship. Buster walked next to me at a steady speed. We neared a big old tree and stopped.

"Do you see anything Buster?" I asked him.

He barked really loud and sniffed the ground.

Then I heard a buzzing sound above us. A beehive hung from a branch very high up. We did not want to receive a sting today. I am being honest, I was a little scared.

"Let's run away fast!" I yelled to Buster.

We ran home and I used my comb on his fur. I did not want any bees in there either. Then we sat down and I started reading a book about bugs. Buster fell asleep on my feet.

I woke up and my stomach was making thumping noises. It was breakfast time and I smelled something wonderful. Mom was making roasted toast and eggs so I ran to the table. I ate it immediately because I was super hungry.

Then I went to school and saw my friend Billy. We played a game about boating at recess. I was steering the ship and Billy was the captain.

"Look out for the shark!" I yelled really loud.

"We are going to crash!" Billy shouted back.

It was like heaven but then the bell rang. We grumbled because recess was over. Inside we found our math books. I am the champion of math so it was easy. I heard the lunch bell and felt my stomach growing again. It was a good day.

One day I went hiking up a big mountain with my dog. It was freezing cold outside so I wore my heavy coat. We walked for a long time and saw a pretty scene. Then my dog Rex found an old leather boot in the snow.

"Look at that silly boot, Rex!" I yelled loudly.

Rex barked and wagged his tail very fast at me.

We sat down and ate our yummy breakfast on a rock. I counted thirteen birds flying in the blue sky above us. Suddenly Rex sank into a deep pile of white snow! It was important to get him out so I pulled hard. We were tired so we went home and slept. My mom said I am a good daughter for helping him. Maybe next time we won't go near the snowy holes.

My neighbor, Mr. Green, is actually an alien. I saw him yesterday in his backyard eating rocks. He cleared his throat and his eyes glowed purple. I immediately ran to get my super suit on. It was heavy, and I struggled with the weight. My suit gives me laser vision, so I crossed the fence.

"Stop tearing up the grass!" I yelled at him.

Mr. Green looked at me and blinked his three eyes. "I will not complain again," he said in a robot voice.

Then he jumped really high into a cloud. I hope he doesn't come back soon. Being a superhero is hard work.

I was playing baseball with my nephew in the backyard. My neighbor Mr. Smith was coaching us from his porch. He was screaming really loud when I missed the ball. It was sounding like a siren! The ball went floating over the fence into the woods.

"That shot was impossible to catch!" yelled my nephew.

"Go get it or I’m grounding you!" I joked back.

We ran into the woods like we were camping or something. It was spooky and quiet. Suddenly the wind blew really hard on my face. I saw the ball sleeping in a bush near a rock. I grabbed it and ran back fast. My brain felt dizzy like I fainted. Science class is easier than baseball. We didn't want to play anymore either. We went inside for juice.

I was sitting at my desk and staring at the math test. It was really hard and I struggled with number eight. My pencil broke so I had to sharpen it carefully. Then the bell rang for recess and everyone ran outside. We played a game called King of the Jungle.

"I will reign over the monkey bars!" shouted Tommy.

He climbed up high but then he slipped and crashed down. He wasn't hurt bad but he was moaning a little bit. A younger kid was clinging to the ladder because he was scared.

"Let's go on an adventure to the swings instead," I said.

We ran to the swings and went super high. School is fun but I hate math tests.

My friend Tom and I went to the old castle. We saw big green vines growing up the walls. Tom said, "I am not afraid of ghosts." We walked inside and discovered a huge room.

There was a dusty fountain in the middle. Old papers were scattered on the floor. Suddenly we heard a loud noise upstairs. We ran up to the balcony very fast. I saw something weird in the corner. It looked almost invisible but it had red eyes.

"We are in big trouble!" I yelled.

We did not remain there any longer. We ran all the way home because we were scared. Then we got very hungry so we ate pizza.

I was walking in the woods and I felt a cool breeze. Then I saw a big metal robot behind a tree. He was trembling and looked very scared. His parts were scattered all over the ground.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"I can't find my arm," the robot beeped sadly.

I wanted to help so I used my super strength. It felt impossible but I lifted a huge rock. I discovered his shiny arm right under it. He put it back on and then he did a huge sneeze! It was so loud.

"Thank you! You know everything," he said.

"Listen, I just like to help," I told him.

Then he flew away into the sky.

I was dreaming about pirates when I heard a noise. My brother Sam and I ran outside to the woods. We saw a twisted tree and a dark cave. Sam was trembling but he walked inside first.

"Look at that big stain on the wall!" I screamed. It looked like scorched fire marks.

Suddenly a skeleton jumped out and tried to seize us. I reached for a stick and hit its finger. It broke off! We ran back to the light jumping over rocks. Neither of us looked back at the scary captain. We ate roasted marshmallows later and they tasted like toasted clouds. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my brother Ben were playing a racing game. We sat on the floor and stared at the TV. My car was red and his was blue. I was winning and my car was flying fast.

"You are going to lose!" I yelled at Ben.

"No way, I am faster than you," Ben said back.

He scratched his nose and leaned forward. Suddenly his car went off the track and started floating. It looked like it was climbing into the sky.

"Why is your car flying away?" I asked him.

Ben started groaning and then he was screaming loud. My dad was reading a newspaper and drinking coffee he just brewed. He looked at us and started singing a funny song to make us stop. I won the race because Ben's car disappeared.

I was playing my new video game called Magic Mountain. My nephew Timmy watched me because he is too small to play. In the game, I had to climb a big mountain. I was afraid of the dragon at the top. The dragon had a red jewel in his hand. I needed that jewel to win the game and reign as the king.

I jumped over a rock and hit the attack button.

"You can do it!" yelled Timmy.

The dragon breathed fire, but I blocked it with my shield. It was not enough fire to hurt me. I hit the dragon one more time. The dragon fainted on the ground.

"I won the game!" I shouted.

It was hard, but I beat the foreign lands level. Now I am the champion.

I was playing my new car racing game in my apartment. It is very fun but the track is super dangerous. You have to keep steering the car away from the cliffs. My friend Sam came over for a meeting about our team.

"We need more speed to win," Sam said loudly.

I was speaking to him but keeping my eyes on the TV. "I know, but this foreign car is really fast."

We ate a protein bar for energy and played again. It was a pleasant afternoon until I crashed into a wall.

"Oh man! That was a bad crash," Sam yelled.

We laughed and just started the race over again. Next time I will definitely win the big trophy.

I was playing my favorite video game about a jungle. I had to climb a big mountain to win. My brother Timmy wanted to play too, but I said no. I needed to focus my brain on the game. Suddenly, my character fell off a cliff and got twisted up.

"Oh no! You got crushed!" Timmy yelled at me.

I felt anger inside because I lost all my points. I took a deep breath and tried again. This time I jumped high and ran fast. It was enough to beat the level!

"Wow, you are really good," Timmy said.

I let him play the next turn. We had fun together.

My birthday party was almost ruined because it started raining. I was afraid nobody would come to my house. But suddenly the doorbell rang and my friends were there! I grinned and grasped my best friend’s hand. We played games in the living room while my cat was sleeping. Then my dad brought out a huge cake with a needle sharp candle. He was pumping his arms and pretending to drop it! "Watch out!" he yelled and pretended he dropped the cake. We all screamed but he was just joking. We ate the beautiful cake and then we sprinted outside. The rain stopped and we spread out on the wet grass. It was the best day ever.

Yesterday was my nephew Sam’s birthday and we drove to his house. It was a longer trip than usual because of traffic. My mom drank lots of coffee because she needed caffeine.

When we got there, I drew a picture for Sam. It was a dog roaming in a field with a gold chain. Sam looked at it and spoke very loudly.

"This looks like a different dog!" he said.

"It is a magic dog floating in the sky," I told him.

I was certain he would like it. He did not receive many gifts, so he was happy. We played tag until it was dark outside. Then we had cake and it was the best day ever.

I believed my math teacher was secretly an alien. He was teaching us about fractions and his face turned red. He looked like he was fainted but he stood steady.

"Are you okay, Mr. Smith?" I asked him quietly.

"I just need a single glass of water," he said.

At recess, I saw him hanging upside down on the monkey bars. He was doing weird training like a space ninja. I told my friend Sam about the alien coaching. Sam just laughed and showed me a shiny jewel he found. Then the bell started sounding really loud. We ran back inside before we got a grounding. My suspicion grew bigger every day.

We went on a boating trip for my birthday. The water was cold and stinging on my legs. My dad rowed the boat and my mom held the lunch. I was very hungry for my birthday cake.

Suddenly, the boat crashed into a big rock! I gripped the side of the boat very hard.

"Watch out for the rocks!" shouted my dad.

My little brother started moaning because he was scared. Although it was scary, I believed my dad could fix it. He caught a rope and pulled us to the shore.

"This is the worst trip ever," grumbled my brother.

We walked through the woods back to the car. We ate cake in the parking lot and it tasted good.

Me and my friend Sam walked into the dark woods together. The cool breeze blew the leaves around on the ground. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure map.

"This is impossible," Sam grumbled and kicked a big rock.

"We have to keep moving," I said. "It is important."

We moved past an old building that looked scary. Suddenly, I saw something shiny sticking out of the dirt. I pulled it up fast. It was a golden coin! We started digging and found a box. We were loading our pockets with gold when a bear growled. We ran away fast but we were happy. Later we roasted marshmallows and felt rich.

I was so nervous for recess today. It was the big kickball game against Mrs. Miller’s class. I grabbed my lucky leather shoes and tied them tight. My heart was thumping like a drum in my chest.

"Do you remember the plan?" asked my friend Sam.

"Yes, we need to kick it past the slide," I said.

We ran outside and saw a huge beetle on the grass. Neither of us touched it because we had to play. I kicked the ball hard and everyone started cheering. I felt like a real champion running around the bases. I realized that my mom was right about practicing. Everything went perfect and we won the game! My teacher said we earned extra recess time tomorrow.

Me and my friend Sam went hiking up the big mountain. We wanted to find the weird cave near the top. We walked for eight hours and unfortunately forgot our schedule. Sam was jumping over rocks and singing a funny song.

Suddenly, we heard a loud noise through the trees.

"Did you hear that roar?" Sam asked me.

"I know it is a bear!" I yelled back.

We ran fast but I scratched my leg on a bush. We hid behind a giant rock and tried to remain quiet. A huge bear walked by and crushed a stick. We were scared, especially when it sniffed the air. Often bears are hungry. We waited a long time and then ran home fast.

The alien landed on my balcony with a loud thud. He was green and wearing a shiny leather jacket. I heard him groaning so I went outside to look. He was holding his tummy and making sad noises.

"My stomach hurts from eating roasted moon rocks," he said.

I didn't know aliens could get sick from rocks. I gave him some milk and he started speaking fast.

"Thank you for everything, earth boy!" he yelled.

He gave me a gold coin for helping him. I like earning money so I did not complain. Then he flew away into the dark sky. It was the coolest night ever.

One day I was walking on a floating island. It was high up near heaven. Suddenly a big silver robot landed with a crash. He looked angry and red lasers shot from his eyes. I sprinted away fast but he ran faster.

"Hey! Give me that power crystal!" the robot shouted loudly.

I held the glowing blue rock tight in my hand. I thought about dropping it but I was too scared. The robot struck the ground and made a huge hole. I already knew what to do. I used my super jump and leaped over him.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled back at him.

I caught the edge of a cloud and climbed up. The robot was stuck on the island forever. I was safe and I had the magic rock.

My big brother Jake is usually the best at Mario Kart. He wins every time, and I get mad. Today I picked Yoshi because he is fast enough.

"You are going to lose again!" Jake screamed at me.

"No way, I practiced all day," I said back.

The race started, and we were tearing down the track. I jumped over a big hole. I feared the blue shell, but it didn't come. Jake hit a banana peel and spun out. He was in trouble now!

My brain told me to focus on the road. I used the map to guide me to a shortcut. I crossed the finish line first! Jake looked like he was going to cry. Even Mom’s daughter can win sometimes. I want to race him again tomorrow.

I was scared because I forgot my homework today. My teacher Mrs. Miller was stamping papers at her desk. She is usually nice but hates when we forget things. I looked at the schedule on the wall and sighed.

"Where is your math sheet?" Mrs. Miller asked me.

"Unfortunately, my dog blew it away," I lied quickly.

She looked at me like I was being silly. Just then, a fly landed right on her nose! The whole class laughed and she swatted it away.

"Okay, just bring it tomorrow," she said with a smile.

At recess, I climbed the big slide with my friend. We found a shiny rock that looked like a jewel. My dad is coaching my soccer team later so today is good. I put the rock in my pocket for company.

My dog Buster is weird and likes digging holes. Yesterday we went exploring in the woods behind my house. My younger brother Sam came too but he is slow.

Suddenly Buster started barking at a big hollow log. Something was trapped inside it and made a scratching noise.

"Be careful Buster, it might be dangerous!" I screamed.

Buster did not listen and he chewed on the wood. He used all his strength to pull something out. It was a bird with a bright blue wing. It looked like a shiny jewel but it was hurt.

"Is it going to heaven?" Sam asked me sadly.

"No, we can save it," I said.

We put the bird in a box and closed the lid gently. Then we heard a ringing sound from my pocket. It was mom calling us for dinner. We ran home fast to help the bird.

It was a hot Wednesday and school was out. My friend Max and I were roaming the woods behind his house. The scenery was mostly big green trees and bushes. We heard a loud noise coming from a cave.

"I think a creature is in there," Max whispered.

We scrambled up the rocks, climbing higher and higher. It sounded like something was groaning in pain. We were feared but we kept going. I saw a piece of brown leather on the ground. We ran through the dark tunnel. Suddenly, we saw a small dog stuck on a stone balcony.

"It’s just a puppy!" I yelled, cheering loudly.

We grabbed the puppy and started running back home. We were meeting Max’s mom for lunch soon. It was the best adventure ever.

I was playing kickball at recess with my friends. The red ball bounced on the hard ground. It was my turn to kick and I had a nervous feeling. My team had fourteen points and the other team had thirteen.

I grabbed the ball and set it down. Then I kicked it really hard! It went way over the fence into the bushes.

"Go get it, Sam!" yelled my friend Leo.
"I searched everywhere but I can't find it," I said back.

I feared the ball was gone forever. Then I touched something round. I pulled it out but my shirt was tearing on a branch. I sat down and realized it was just an old basketball. We lost the game because we lost the ball.

One day I went outside to explore the big woods. My dog Sparky came with me for company. We walked straight to the big oak tree. Suddenly I saw a hole in the ground.

"Look at that big hole Sparky!" I yelled.

Sparky barked and started digging fast. He was dumping dirt everywhere. I thought maybe he found a treasure. Then he opened his mouth and pulled on a stick. It was just an old dirty branch.

"You are the greatest dog ever," I said.

We played with the stick all day long. It was the best day outside. Sparky was tired so we went home for lunch.

One cold day in February, my friend Max and I went exploring. We found a scary cave near the big hill. The wind made a loud moaning sound inside.

"Do you hear that?" Max asked me quietly.

"Yes, but we are trained explorers!" I said back.

We crawled inside and moved slowly in the dark. Suddenly, my flashlight disappeared from my hand! Something grabbed it. The scene was very scary. We heard a sharp whistle and then a knock on the wall. Max tried to seize my arm. A heavy weight fell on my foot. We were simply too scared. We ran outside fast and were loading our bikes to leave. The important thing is that we got away safely.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating on the dark river. We had a schedule to find the greatest treasure ever. The map was leading us to a spooky cave. "Look out for that rock!" yelled Sam. I grasped the paddle tight and kept the boat steady. We heard a loud knock coming from inside the cave. Something was approaching us very fast. It was a big beaver trying to gnaw on our boat! "Go away beaver!" I shouted. We paddled super fast and got away just in time. We found the treasure chest on the sand and opened it up. It was full of shiny gold coins.

I was sitting in class and it was raining outside. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about a big mountain. I was so bored and almost sleeping on my desk. Suddenly Mrs. Miller lit a candle on her desk.

"Today we are learning about camping," she said loudly.

Everyone was grateful because math class is super boring. She started to explain how to go boating safely. She showed us a picture of a man steering a boat. Then she started singing a funny song about loading gear.

"This is the greatest day ever!" my friend Sam whispered.

We didn't do a single page of math work today. It was enough fun to last for a whole week. I love school when we don't have homework.

Yesterday was the craziest day ever at school. My teacher called my name but I didn't hear her. I was looking through the window at a dog roaming outside.

"Timmy, pay attention!" she yelled loudly.

I was trembling a little bit because everyone looked at me. Then the fire alarm blew really loud. We all sprinted to the door but the teacher said stop. We had to walk.

Outside on the playground, I saw my nephew. He is only five and he goes to kindergarten.

"What happened?" he asked me.

"I think someone caught a fire in the kitchen," I said.

It was just burnt toast though. Nobody went to the hospital. But the cook got a grounding from the principal. I will remember that burnt toast smell forever. It smelled like bad boating gas.

One day I was walking in the woods. I saw a shiny blue jewel on the ground. I picked it up and suddenly a robot appeared! He was big and silver and had green eyes.

"Do not be afraid," the robot said in a funny voice.

I was surprised but I stood up straight. "Who are you?" I asked him.

"I am Zog and I lost my power jewel," he said.

He looked sad so I gave him the jewel back. He put it in his chest and his eyes glowed bright. Then he started steering his spaceship down from the sky. It blew lots of wind everywhere. I thought he was leaving but he waved at me. He flew away throughout the clouds while everyone else was sleeping. It was the best night ever!

It was Tuesday and we had a science test. I counted the questions and there were ten of them. My teacher Mrs. Miller said we needed to guarantee good grades. I was scared of failure because I didn't study enough.

Suddenly a weird noise appeared in the room. It sounded like a foreign alien spaceship landing.

"What is that ringing sound?" asked my friend Leo.

"I think it has a strange rhythm," I whispered back.

Mrs. Miller walked throughout the room and discovered the noise. It was just Leo’s lunchbox shaking! He had a protein shake in there and it exploded. He tried to maintain a straight face but he laughed. The test was paused so we all cleaned up the mess. It was the best Tuesday ever.

My dog Max and I were exploring the woods surrounding my house. It was a hot day and the sun roasted our backs. Max started groaning because he was tired.

"Don't complain, Max, we are almost there," I said.

We walked through the tall grass and kept going. My legs were pumping hard and I grasped a stick. Suddenly, we heard a weird ringing sound. A bee was approaching a single blue flower.

"Look at that bee!" I shouted to Max.

Max barked at it and started steering us away. It felt impossible to catch the bee. But then I obtained a cool rock from the ground instead. We ran home fast.

I was playing my favorite computer game about a brave knight. The knight was jumping over a big hole in the earth. It was freezing in the game because of the snow level. I was yearning to win because I lost last time. 

My brother Sam walked in and started moaning loudly. "Let me play!" he yelled.

I said, "Wait, I am beginning the boss fight!"

I reached the boss, who looked like a scary pirate sailor. He had a big sword, but I found his rhythm. I hit him again and again until he fell down. I roasted him with a fire spell! I remember seeing the gold coins pop up everywhere. 

"Okay, you win," Sam said. "You are good."

I felt happy because I finally beat the sailor boss.

Last Wednesday was the worst day of school ever. I had fourteen math problems and they were super hard. My friend Sarah crawled under her desk because she was scared.

"I can't do number eight!" she yelled loudly.

"Just look at the board," I said to her.

Then we went outside for recess on the big ground. The scenery was nice although it was very windy. We fought over who got the red swing. I pushed off the ground and went super high. The height made my tummy feel funny. Suddenly I heard screaming near the slide. Sarah fell and crushed her lunch box. She was crying but gradually she stopped. Then the teacher sold us ice cream tickets for thirteen cents. It made everything better.

Me and my best friend Leo found a boat. It was hidden in the tall grass by the river. We jumped in and I started steering it. The water was freezing but we didn't care.

"This is the greatest adventure ever!" I yelled.

Suddenly the boat crashed into a big grey rock. Water came inside and soaked my shoes. Leo screamed really loud because he hates getting wet. He looked funny.

"Grab the bucket and scoop!" Leo shouted at me.

We scooped out the water fast. Then we ate our lunch. It was stewed carrots wrapped in an old newspaper. We grinned because we were safe. We are brave explorers.

I was playing a racing game on my tablet. My car was red and very fast. I was following my brother's blue car up a big mountain. The road was bumpy and scary. My hands were trembling because I wanted to win.

"You can’t catch me!" shouted my brother.

"Yes I can!" I yelled back.

Suddenly, his car crashed into a rock and flipped over. I zoomed past him and crossed the finish line. I felt like I was on a real adventure. My dad was coaching me from the couch. He said I did a great job. We ate roasted peanuts to celebrate. I will remain the champion forever.

My neighbor Mr. Brown was coaching us on boating safety. We were sitting in a blue canoe on the lake. The water was very calm and we were simply floating. Suddenly, a big green frog jumped right onto my knee!

"Eww, get it off me!" I yelled really loud.

Mr. Brown laughed and said, "He just wants a ride."

My dog Buster scrambled to the front of the boat. He started bumping into the sides and breathing heavy. The boat rocked back and forth and our snacks scattered everywhere. My sandwich was hanging off the edge. Neither me or Buster reached for it because we were scared. We paddled back to the shore very fast. Next time we will leave Buster at home.

One day I was eating lunch at my big school. I opened my blue lunchbox to search for my sandwich. I saw my juice box floating inside the water bottle spill. It touched my cookie and made it all soggy.

"Oh no, my lunch is ruined!" I yelled loudly.

My friend Tommy heard me and looked at my mess. "You can have my apple if you want," he said.

Just then, Mrs. Green came approaching our table very fast. She screeched her shoes on the floor when she stopped. She said adults need caffeine but kids need good food. I had to squeeze the water out of my napkin. My chips were scattered all through the bag too. It was a bad meeting with my lunch today. I hope I receive a better lunch tomorrow.

My stomach was growling in math class because I was hungry. I really wanted my lunch but the clock moved slow. Finally the bell rang and everyone ran to the cafeteria. I sat with my friends and opened my lunchbox.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "My juice box exploded everywhere!"

My sandwich was floating in purple juice and it looked gross. There was a huge stain on my new shirt too. I froze because I didn't know what to do. My friend Sam saw me looking sad.

"Do you want half of my toasted cheese?" Sam asked.

"Yes please," I said. "You are good company to have."

I ate the cheese sandwich and it tasted really good. Then we went outside and swam in the air like birds. I was certain that lunch was the best part of school.

My younger brother Sam and I went boating on the lake. It was raining a little bit but we didn't care. We wanted to explore the big mountain on the other side. We paddled hard and it felt like a workout for every vein.

Suddenly we saw a dark cave near the water. Sam grew scared but I told him it was important.

"We have to go inside," I said bravely.

"I think there is a bear!" Sam yelled back.

I drew a map on a piece of paper. We walked in and found a box with eight gold coins! Our quest was complete. We went home and toasted marshmallows to celebrate bringing the treasure back.

One day I explored the big woods behind my house. I walked to the creek and I saw a tiny island. There was a weird noise so I jumped across the rocks. I saw a baby raccoon and he was trapped in a net! The poor raccoon struggled and scratched at the ropes but he was stuck.

"Don't worry, little guy!" I screamed so he could hear me.

I gripped my pocket knife but it was too dull. Then I remembered the scissors in my backpack from school. I cut the net and he ran away fast. Then he stopped and looked back at me. I understood that he was saying thank you.

"You are welcome!" I shouted.

When I got home my dog greeted me at the door. I met a new friend today and it was awesome.

I was playing my favorite video game on the computer. It was the most important level ever. The loading screen was super slow and I got scared. My brain was thinking really fast about winning.

"Come outside right now!" my mom yelled from the balcony.

"Not yet! The boss is approaching!" I yelled back.

My toys were scattered all over the floor but I didn't care. I needed to use my science power to win. I pressed the red button and the monster fainted. I won the game and jumped up high! Then I ran outside to play soccer.

I was sitting in class and my heart was thumping. We had a big test and I knew it was danger. The teacher said, "Time is running out so please finish." I scrambled to write the answers but my pencil blew off my desk. It fell because of gravity.

Suddenly the bell rang and it sounded like heaven. We all ran outside to the playground for recess. The scenery was nice and sunny today. My friend Sam was breathing hard from running fast. He looked at the swings and smiled.

"Let's jump off like we are bungee jumping!" Sam yelled.

We swung high and gradually slowed down. It felt like camping but way more fun. I love recess more than tests.

I was playing a super cool racing game with my nephew. We picked the jungle track with the bugs roaming around. I sprinted my car fast but then I crashed.

"You can't beat me!" he greeted me with a laugh.

"My brain has a secret plan," I shouted back.

My car crawled out of the mud and followed him. I believed I could win if I used the shortcut. I drove off a cliff like a bungee jumper. My car disappeared into a tunnel under the ground. He feared I was gone forever. Suddenly I zoomed past him at the finish line! I could not contain my happiness any longer.

"I won!" I yelled.

We went to the kitchen and drank hot cocoa my mom brewed.

I was playing my new video game on the computer. It was a game about roaming around a big city. I discovered a secret building and I went inside. Suddenly my character fell down a huge hole like a bungee jump.

"Oh no, I think I died again!" I yelled loudly.

My brother walked in and he was eating a cookie. A tiny crumb fell on my keyboard and made me sneeze. I looked back at the screen and my character was scorched by fire. He fainted on the ground and was groaning.

"You have to listen to the clues," my brother said.

I started jumping up and down because I was mad. Then a monster greeted me and I started winning. It was better than boating in real life!

I woke up late because my alarm didn't go off. I moved fast and put on my blue shirt. My mom brought me toast but I couldn't eat it. I ran out of our apartment and down the stairs. The wind blew hard outside and it was super cold. 

At school, we had a huge mountain of homework. My teacher Mrs. Green looked mad. "Where is your math, Tim?" she asked me. I searched through my bag but it wasn't there. I thought I left it in the building lobby! 

"I will seize it!" I yelled and ran to the door. But then I saw a blue vein on my hand. It was just pen ink. I threw my hands up. My homework was in my other folder! I often lose things but today was lucky. "Here it is!" I said. Mrs. Green just smiled.

My brother Max is thirteen and thinks he is the best. We were playing Space Racers on his big TV. I picked the green car because it has gravity boots. Max picked the red one.

"You can't beat me," Max said. "It is impossible."

The race started and I held the controller tight. My car screeched around the corner. I kept pushing the button very fast. Suddenly my car flew off the ground! I was winning!

"No way!" Max screamed loudly.

I crossed the finish line first. Mom was in the kitchen painting but she heard us. I started stamping my feet and cheering. I read the screen and it said I was the winner. I am certain I am the best racer now.

My dog Buster is very funny. One day in February we went outside to the big meadow. Buster loves roaming around in the tall grass. I climbed a big rock and looked down. Buster was approaching a squirrel. The squirrel bounced away very fast! Buster tried to jump but gravity pulled him down.

"That squirrel is too fast for you," I said.

Buster barked loudly at the tree. "Woof woof!"

He looked sad. I thought about dog psychology. Maybe he just wanted a friend.

"Don't worry Buster, we can play instead," I told him.

But Buster just grumbled and sat down. He was already tired from running. Nothing bad happened though. We walked home and Buster got a treat. Exploring is fun but Buster is a lazy dog sometimes.

It was my birthday and we went camping. My dad made a fire and we toasted marshmallows. They got black and sticky but they tasted good. We walked down a long trail near the river. My little brother was groaning because his legs hurt.

"Look at that big dog!" I yelled loudly.

It had a silver chain and a loud bark. The owner gripped the leash tight to guard us. Then we saw a red balloon floating in the air. I tried to seize it but the wind blew it away. Although I missed it, I still had fun.

"Do you want cake or ice cream?" Mom asked.

"I don't want either, I want both!" I said.

Then I drew a picture of the balloon in the dirt. It was the best birthday ever.

I got to school early today because my mom made me. The scenery outside the window was just boring gray clouds. I feared that recess would be inside, but then the sun came out! We played kickball for an hour and it was awesome.

"Pass the ball to me!" I yelled really loud.

My friend Sam kicked it hard and it went floating over the fence. Everyone started cheering and sounding happy. But then the teacher blew her whistle.

"Time for lunch, everyone line up!" she said.

My sandwich was toasted and tasted good, though I scratched my arm on the table. We only had thirteen minutes to eat. I wish I could remain at lunch forever. My brain is tired of math. I found a shiny rock that looked like a jewel on the way back inside.

One day I found a map to a magic island. I took my robot dog named Sparky with me. We flew in my spaceship far away from earth. When we landed, a big green alien greeted us. He had three eyes and was very nice.

"Do you want this red jewel?" asked the alien.

"Yes please! I am earning points for my team," I said.

Then we heard a loud noise. It was a witch! She brewed a smelly potion in a pot. She tried to cut my map with big scissors. But Sparky barked and scared her away. I read the map again and we found the treasure. It was a box of gold cookies! We ate them all up.

My robot was plain silver and looked like a toaster. He needed to learn how to fly but he couldn't. I heard a loud beep and saw smoke. His wings grew big but they were too heavy.

"Oh no, you are a total failure!" I screamed.

He looked sad so I gave him a hug. Then fourteen tiny rockets popped out of his feet. He was seeing the sky and went up fast. He was steady in the air and felt no weight.

"Look at me go!" he beeped loudly.

Neither of us knew he had hidden rockets inside. I almost sold him but now he is awesome.

For my birthday, I wanted a new computer game. My mom said I play too much computer, but I kept yearning for it. I promised to eat more healthy food for protein if I got it.

"We have company coming over soon," Mom yelled. "Start running around and clean up your messy room!"

I cleaned up fast because I heard the doorbell ring. It was my best friend Sam and he had a big gift. I ripped the wrap off the box quickly. It was a stuffed lamb, not the game!

"Do you like it?" Sam asked with a big smile.

I hugged the lamb and pretended it was the king of my bed. Let the reign of Fluffy begin! My friendship with Sam is stronger than any video game. We played with the lamb all day.

It was raining outside so I turned on my video game. I was playing the Super Ninja game again. My ninja crawled into a dark cave and saw a monster. The monster was chewing on a bone and looked scary.

"I am trapped!" I yelled at the TV screen.

My sister came in and she was speaking really loud. "Are you winning or losing?" she asked me.

"Be quiet, I am seeing a giant jewel!" I said.

My ninja touched the shiny jewel and the door opened up. The monster spread its wings but I was too fast. I kept jumping and sounding the alarm to escape. I won the level and it felt great. I love keeping my high score at the top.

Yesterday me and my dog Buster went to the woods. It looked like a big green jungle. We saw a squirrel swinging on a branch. Buster started barking and pulling on the leash. "Stop it Buster!" I yelled. He wanted to squeeze under a fence to chase it.

Then we found a river with leaves floating on top. We sat down to eat our snack. I had a toasted cheese sandwich. Suddenly Buster let out a giant sneeze. He scared a bird and it flew away screaming. The sun was super hot and I felt scorched. "Let's go home now," I said to Buster. He wagged his tail and we walked back fast. Exploring is fun but tiring.

It was a cold day in February. My friend Sam and I wanted an adventure. We walked to the big hill behind the school. It took almost an hour to get there. We started to climb up the steep rocks. My boots were stamping loud on the ground.

"Look out for the slippery mud!" I yelled to Sam.

"I can do it, I like the challenge," said Sam.

We kept going up and up. I had a scared feeling in my stomach. But having Sam for company made me brave. We found a secret cave near the top. We heard a dripping rhythm inside. It sounded like water floating in a dark pool. We pretended we were meeting a dragon. We did some coaching to help each other be brave. It was the best day ever.

I have a dog named Max and he is funny. One day we went to the park to look for bugs. I saw a big sign that said "Do Not Enter" but I went in. My mom drank her coffee for the caffeine and did not see me. I thought I saw a shiny beetle on a tree. It looked like a tiny knight in armor.

"Look at that bug!" I yelled to Max.
"Woof!" said Max and he tried to jump on it.

The bug crawled up gradually and I counted its legs. It had six legs and neither of us could reach it. We were grateful when it flew down. Max slept all the way home because he was tired. I already want to go back tomorrow. The only reason we left is because I got hungry. I hung my coat up and went to eat a snack.

We went to the big green jungle for an adventure. My younger brother Sam had a map but we got lost. We walked for a long time and found a huge cave.

Suddenly we heard heavy breathing inside the dark cave.

"I am scared," Sam whispered and held my hand tight.

We saw a giant grey elephant stuck in some vines. It looked sad and it needed help immediately. I pulled out my shiny scissors from my backpack. I cut the vines and the elephant was free.

"Thank you!" the elephant trumpeted loudly at us.

We discovered a secret treasure chest under the elephant’s foot. Inside was a gold bar that looked like a protein bar. We did not measure it but it was very heavy. We were happy to receive such a cool prize. We ran home fast before it got dark.

We were climbing the big grey mountain. My legs were pumping fast because I wanted to see the top. My friend Leo was behind me and he looked scared. Suddenly we saw a dark cave and heard a loud roar.

"What is that?" screamed Leo. He was jumping up and down.

I thought it was a bear or a monster. A huge furry creature walked out of the dark. It had big green eyes and sharp teeth.

"Run away now!" I yelled at Leo.

We ran back down the path very fast. We reached the bottom and stopped to breathe. We were safe but we never went back there.

My friend Sam and I went to the old forest. We were reading a map about a secret cave. Suddenly we heard a loud noise. A big rock crashed down and hit the ground hard! It almost crushed my foot but I jumped away.

"Watch out for the rocks!" Sam yelled loudly.

We saw a shiny key hanging on a branch. I pointed my finger at it. We worked together to climb the tree. I grabbed the branch and obtained the golden key.

"We did it!" I said. "We have everything now."

The sun was gradually going down. It was already getting dark outside. We ran home fast before the scary bears woke up.

I was playing Super Mario on my big brother’s TV. I reached the lava level and my hands got sweaty. Mario was jumping over fireballs but then he fell in. I simply could not beat the big boss at the end. I tried again and again but got trapped in a corner.

My brother walked in and saw me lose a life. He started swearing like a sailor because it was his save file.

"Hey! You messed up my game!" he yelled loudly.

"I didn't know it was important," I said.

He started to complain to Mom but she just laughed. I struggled to hold the controller because I feared he was mad. Next time I will just play Minecraft instead.

My nephew Ben and I went on a big adventure. We wanted to find the secret magic fountain in the woods. We walked throughout the forest for a long time. Suddenly, we heard a loud thumping noise behind a tree.

"Run fast!" I told Ben, and we hid behind a rock.

A huge bird flew out and landed near us. It looked lost and scared. We gave it some crackers to eat. Then it was time to complete our quest. We walked more and found the shiny water.

"Look, there is the fountain!" Ben yelled happily.

We drank the water and it tasted like sweet juice. We were safe and went home before dinner.

My cousin Sam turned thirteen last week. We had a big party for him. I helped my mom make a schedule for the day. We scrambled eggs for breakfast because they are Sam's favorite.

"Don't forget to put the candles on," my mom spoke.

I put the candles on the cake with my thumb. Then we played tag outside. Sam has a lot of strength and runs fast. I tried to seize his arm but I missed. I crashed into the bushes and got a scratch.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked me.

I nodded but then I felt a big sneeze coming. I sneezed so hard I almost fell over! Later we broke a piñata and candy went everywhere. We often have fun parties like this. I love my family.

I was so hungry before lunch. I didn't eat any breakfast because I was late. Finally the bell rang for recess and we ran outside.

"Let's play island!" I screamed to my friend Sam.

We jumped on the wood chips like we were floating in water. The big slide was the island. Sam grasped my finger to pull me up.

"Watch out, a shark is approaching!" Sam yelled loudly.

We climbed up fast to escape the shark. I spread my arms out to balance. It felt like there was zero gravity on the slide. Then the bell rang again. Everyone started screaming because recess was over. We walked back inside for the math league test. I hope I pass.

Me and my younger brother Tim went to the woods. We wanted to explore a foreign land. We saw a huge cave. It looked scary and full of danger. Tim held my hand tight.

"Do you remember the map?" Tim asked me.

"Yes, it says the dragon is here," I said.

We walked inside the dark cave. The ceiling was a great height. Suddenly we heard a noise. A big green dragon brewed some fire in its mouth. Unfortunately, we did not have any swords. We ran away fast to the river. We jumped in and swam across. The dragon could not swim. Our reign as heroes was over for today. I will write about it in our club newspaper.

It was Wednesday and it was freezing outside. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We wanted to build a huge fort in the living room. I got the scissors and cut some tape. Sam was dumping all the blankets on the floor.

"This is going to be incredible!" Sam yelled loudly.

We used a needle and thread to fix a hole in the sheet. My mom helped us because needles are sharp. We pretended to be knights in a castle. I was the champion of the fort.

"Watch out for the dragon!" I shouted at Sam.

We ate pizza inside the fort. It tasted really good, especially the pepperoni. We stayed up late and told scary stories in the dark.

It was my birthday party and I was yearning for cake. My dog Buster greeted everyone at the door with a bark. We played tag in the yard and I ran straight ahead. I flew past the tree but then I tripped on a root. I scratched my knee but I didn't cry. My friend Sam grasped my hand and pulled me up.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked me.

"I think so, but look at my knee!" I said.

Then Buster chewed on my new soccer ball. He knew he was being bad. He disappeared behind the shed because he sensed danger. My mom screeched when she saw the ball was a failure. But then we had cake and I won the biggest slice. It was the best day ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating on the lake. It was a wonderful sunny day and we were so happy. Suddenly, we saw a dark cave near the rocky shore.

"Let's go inside and explore!" Sam yelled excitedly.

We paddled inside the cave and it got very dark. We saw a glowing blue rock, but then we got trapped. A big spider web was blocking the way out! I was yearning for my flashlight.

"This is not good," I whispered to Sam.

Sam was brave and he threw his apple at the web. The spider ran away and we sprinted back to the boat. We were pleased to be safe again. Later, we sat by a fire and toasted marshmallows. We learned that caves are scary but adventures are fun. It was the best day ever.

My brother and I played a new video game yesterday. We had to save a princess in a giant castle. It was freezing in the game because there was snow everywhere. My brother kept jumping over the scary monsters.

"Watch out for that trap!" I yelled at the TV.

He didn't listen and fell into a deep pit. I thought the level was impossible to beat. Then I discovered a secret door behind a rock. I used a silver knife to open the lock. The door opened and we saw the treasure room. We counted all the gold coins we found inside.

"We finally won the game!" my brother shouted happily.

We were keeping the score, and I won by ten points. We turned off the TV and closed our eyes to sleep.

I woke up early because today was the big field trip. We were going on a bus to a real mountain. My little brother wanted to come but he is younger. I packed my lunch and put in a special treat. My backpack felt heavy like I was carrying treasure.

At school, my friend Sam was already waiting by the bus. He looked stronger than usual in his hiking boots.

"Did you bring the map?" I asked him.

"No, I thought you had it!" Sam said, sounding worried.

We both laughed because neither of us had it. The bus ride was bumpy and loud with company. Then we heard a ripping noise. Sam was tearing his sandwich bag open too fast. We caught bugs and pretended we were camping in a foreign land. It was the best day ever.

One day I discovered a weird shiny door in my backyard. I opened it and walked straight into a new world. It was a giant purple island floating in space. A robot with three heads walked up to me. He had a metal comb in his hand.

"Listen to me!" the robot shouted very loudly. "My daughter disappeared yesterday."

I felt bad so I said, "I will help you find her."

We went on a big adventure to the dark caves. The path was very twisted and scary. We found the robot girl trapped in a cage made of lasers. I used my imagination to make a key appear. The cage opened and she was free! The robot gave me the comb as a prize. Then I went home for dinner.

I was playing basketball in the driveway with my big brother. He was wearing his lucky red jersey. The score was tied and the end of the game neared. My heart was thumping so loud in my chest.

"You can't stop me!" my brother yelled and dribbled fast.

"Watch me!" I shouted back and waved my arms.

He was approaching the hoop and jumped really high. I jumped too and we were bumping into each other. The ball hit the rim and bounced up toward the sky like it hit a ceiling. It didn't go in! It was my turn now. I wasn't listening to my dad coaching from the porch. I just ran and threw the ball. It went right in! I didn't think I could win, but I did. I didn't think he could lose either, but he missed.

My robot friend Zonk flew his spaceship into my yard. He was bringing me a cool new electric guitar. It was super heavy, but Zonk lifted the weight easily. We jumped in the ship and I grabbed the steering wheel.

"Let's go to Mars!" I shouted at Zonk.

"That is impossible," Zonk said with a thumping noise.

He was wrong because we zoomed up fast. The wind blew my hair everywhere. Suddenly, a space monster tried to seize our ship! I had an idea and grabbed a bungee cord. I tied a giant cookie crumb to it. The monster ate the crumb and let us go. We didn't want to fight either. I can't wait to write about this in school.

One day my nephew Tim and I went exploring. We rode our bikes through the woods to find treasure. Suddenly we saw a floating light near a big fountain. It was ghost! We scrambled behind a bush and held our breath. A scary zombie was roaming around too. It was groaning very loud and sounded angry.

"Do you have the magic scissors?" Tim whispered.

"Yes, I learned how to use them in training," I said.

I jumped out and cut the zombie's belt. His pants fell to the ground and he tripped. He was swearing but I couldn't understand him. Then he fainted right there. We ran away fast before he woke up. We were safe!

Yesterday was my birthday and we went boating. My dad was loading the heavy cooler onto the boat. It had so much weight because of the sodas. We neared the middle of the lake and it was fun.

Then my brother yelled, "Look out for that big log!"

We were bumping up and down on the waves. It felt a little dangerous. My dad tried to turn but we crashed into it. We were trapped on the log for ten minutes. My mom was hanging onto the side and looked scared.

"I am the champion of bad driving," my dad said.

We weren't in real danger though. We laughed about it later. I didn't get wet and my brother didn't either. But I think I heard my dad swearing a little bit. It was still the best birthday ever.

My best friend Tim came over for a sleepover. We started eating pizza on the floor in my room. Suddenly, a big piece of pepperoni dropped on my new sweater. It made a huge red stain right in the middle!

"Oh no, your mom is going to be mad," Tim said.

I scrambled to find a towel to clean it up. I rubbed it hard, but it looked really bad. I felt like my brain was going to explode.

"Maybe we can say the dog did it?" Tim asked.

"No, I have to be honest," I said sadly.

Just then, my hamster escaped from his cage! He ran across the pizza box and crushed a chip. We laughed so hard that I forgot about the mess. My mom wasn't even mad, though. It was enough fun just chasing the hamster before he was leaving the room.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the woods. We wanted to find the old haunted cabin. The wind brewed a big storm and the trees shook.

"Look over there!" yelled Sam.

We discovered a dark cave behind some bushes. We went inside for company because we were scared. Suddenly a bat swept down and crashed into the wall. My heart was pumping so fast.

"What happened to it?" I asked.

Something big chewed on a bone in the corner. A bear lived there! We trained for this in scouts so we ran fast. We spoke about it later and laughed. We were safe at home.

My neighbor has a dog named Spot. Spot is trained to catch a ball, but sometimes he forgets. We went camping in the woods last week. We walked on a long trail. The earth smelled wet and muddy.

Suddenly, I saw a squirrel jumping on a tree. Spot saw it too and started trembling. He grasped his leash tight in his mouth.

"Do not run away, Spot!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and he ran fast. I reached for him, but my arms were not longer enough. I realized he was gone. But then he came back again. He wanted a treat.

"You have to learn to stay," I told him.

He sat down to complete his trick and receive a cookie. Being a dog is hard work.

My dog Buster is very silly and loud. One day we went to the park and sat on the grass. Buster saw a squirrel and started jumping up and down.

"Stop it, Buster!" I yelled, but he didn't listen.

Suddenly, a big bee appeared right on Buster's nose. He looked funny with his pink tongue hanging out. He tried to sniff the bee, but then he let out a huge sneeze! The bee flew away fast. Buster thought it was a game. He was earning treats for being brave in danger.

"Good boy!" I said, cheering for him.

Later, he woke up from a nap and wanted to play again. I love my silly dog.

My best friend Sam and I found a treasure map. It was hidden in a hollow tree in my backyard. We packed some snacks and walked to the woods. The map showed a big X on a secret island.

"Look out for the twisted vines!" I screamed loudly.

We jumped over the vines like we were trained ninjas. Suddenly, we saw a deep pit with water at the bottom. It looked like huge danger. We had to use a bungee cord to jump across. We swung over the hole and landed safely.

"To be honest, that was scary," said Sam.

We found a chest and opened it fast. Inside was just some old stewed tomatoes. We called my mom to pick us up. It was a fun adventure anyway.

It was February and it was freezing outside. My mom drove me to school, but I didn't want to go. We pulled up to the curb and I saw my friends. They were dumping their backpacks by the door.

"You have to go inside now," Mom said.

I looked at the big red door and felt scared. Mr. Jacobs was standing there and he looked grumpy. It seemed impossible to walk past him without trouble.

"But I forgot my math homework!" I said.

Mom just smiled and led me to the sidewalk. I walked slow and saw a big truck approaching. It was loading food for lunch. I heard kids screaming on the playground. I wanted to remain in the car. But I walked in because I was certain lunch was pizza today.

It was a dark and spooky Wednesday night. My best friend Sam and I moved slowly into the woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure map. Sam had a flashlight and kept it steady in his hand. Suddenly we heard a loud stamping sound near the big rock.

"Did you hear that noise?" whispered Sam.

"Yes, but finding the gold is not impossible," I said.

We pushed through the bushes and saw a big hole. Inside the hole was a dirty box with strange writing. The meaning of the writing was hard to understand. We opened it and did not receive gold. It was just cans of coffee with lots of caffeine! We ran home fast because it was scary.

I drew a map on old paper yesterday. My friend Sam and I were following the red line. We walked deep into the dark woods behind my house. Everything was quiet and kind of scary. The wind blew hard and the leaves spread everywhere.

"Listen to that weird noise!" Sam whispered loudly.

I was trembling a little bit but I didn't say it. We saw a big hole in the ground. It looked like a giant bungee jump for a squirrel. Gradually, we walked closer to the edge. I looked down and saw something shiny.

"I am bringing it up!" I yelled.

I used a rope and hooked the shiny box. I gave Sam a big thumbs up. He grinned at me. We opened the box and found huge chocolate bars!

One day I discovered a small robot in my backyard. He was silver and shiny but he had dirt on him. His parts were scattered all over the grass near the tree. I took him inside and kept him in my room.

"Please fix me," the robot beeped very quietly.

I heard him and I got my dad’s tools. I used a screwdriver and tape to put him back together. Suddenly his eyes grew bright blue and he started flying!

"Thank you for being honest and nice," he said.

We flew to Mars for dinner and ate stewed moon rocks. We stayed until it was late enough to sleep. I never got in trouble because he had a time machine. But my mom never learned to listen to robots.

Me and my brother went camping in our backyard jungle. It was dark but I held my flashlight tight. We pretended to be knights on a big quest. Suddenly we heard a weird noise near the bushes.

"Did you hear that?" I asked my brother.

He nodded and gripped my arm really hard. We saw a shadow moving and swinging around. I grabbed a stick and we sprinted toward it. We discovered it was just our dog, Spot! He was twisted in the tent ropes. He was dumping over our snacks and looked silly.

"You aren't a monster!" my brother told him.

We opened the tent and a tiny gnat flew out. Then we all went to sleep safe and sound.

I was playing soccer on Saturday and it was so hot. The sun scorched the grass and I was sweating a lot. A tiny gnat flew in my eye and it really hurt. I rubbed my eye but the coach blew his whistle loudly.

"Get in the game, Timmy!" he yelled at me.

I ran fast but then I tripped on my shoelace. I chewed on my lip because I was mad at myself. The other team got the ball and they scored a goal. I thought I was in trouble but my mom just smiled.

"Don't worry, just check the schedule for next week," she said.

I looked at the sign by the field. We play again on Tuesday. I looked at the trees surrounding the field and felt better. Next time I will tie my shoes tight and win.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for the lost golden champion trophy. We walked for a long time and saw a dark cave.

"I am scared of the dark," said Sam quietly.

"Don't worry, I have a flashlight," I told him.

Suddenly a big bat flew out and screeched loudly! We both jumped back and I dropped the light. I felt something sharp like a needle poke my arm. I started screaming and running away fast. Sam followed me but he was slower. We heard a loud noise bearing down on us.

"Keep jumping over the logs!" I yelled back.

We ran all the way home without seeing the trophy. My dad was swearing because we were late for dinner. We didn't find the gold but we were safe. Next time we will bring a bigger light.

It was a super hot day at school today. The sun scorched the playground and everyone was sweating. At recess, we all ran to the water fountain. There was a huge line with like thirteen kids waiting.

"Hey, no cutting!" yelled my friend Billy.

"I’m dying of thirst!" said Sarah, who was jumping up and down.

We finally got water and then we played tag. My papers fell out of my pocket and scattered everywhere. It was dumping papers all over the grass. I had to pick them up throughout the whole recess. I felt like a slow creature crawling around.
