Later in math class, we had to measure our desks. Mine was fourteen inches wide. I hope tomorrow is cooler because today was way too hot.

My nephew Ben goes to my school now. At recess, we sprinted to the big field. It looked like a meadow with no grass. We saw a big stick on the ground.

"Let's measure how far we can throw it!" I yelled.

Ben twisted his body and threw the stick hard. It flew high and scattered some dirt. We ran to find it.

"I think that was the greatest throw ever," Ben said.

We looked around but we couldn't see the stick. We found it roaming near the fence. Suddenly the bell rang loudly. It was loud enough to hurt my ears. We grew tired but we ran back inside. Lunch was next and we had roasted chicken. It was a really good day.

Yesterday was the worst day ever at school. I was feeling great because I am the handball champion. Nobody beats me at recess! I reign over the playground like a king.

At lunch, I chewed my sandwich and drank my juice. Then I discovered a big red stain on my shirt. I tried to squeeze water on it, but it got bigger.

"Oh no!" I screamed in the bathroom.

My friend Leo walked in and said, "That looks like tomato soup."

I realized he was right. I stewed about it all day. I feared my mom would be mad. When I got to my apartment, I hid on the balcony. She found me and laughed. She said she needed some caffeine anyway. I went on the computer and played games until dinner. It was okay in the end.

One day my cat Fluffy was roaming around the backyard. She likes bringing bugs inside but today was different. She held something big in her mouth and looked proud.

"What do you have, Fluffy?" I yelled loudly.

She dropped a giant black beetle on the newspaper. The beetle was huge and looked very impossible. It started singing a weird buzzing song. My mom walked in and saw the bug.

"That looks dangerous!" she said and jumped back.

I knew I had to save the beetle. I scooped it up and ran outside. I left it on a tree. Then I went inside and ate a toasted bagel. I am keeping Fluffy inside now because nature is scary. That is exactly what happened.

One day my dog Buster was roaming in the garden. He loves sniffing different smells on the ground. Suddenly he threw his toy ball into a big bush. I ran after him and we heard a weird noise. It sounded like something was groaning behind the leaves.

"What is that sound, Buster?" I asked him quietly.

Buster barked and then crashed right into the bush.

I looked inside and discovered a tiny kitten hiding there. It was gray and looked almost invisible in the shadows. It was waiting for its mom. I picked it up gradually so it wouldn't be scared.

"Let's take it inside," I told Buster happily.

We put the kitten on some newspaper in the kitchen. Later I was painting a picture of my new pet. It was the best day ever.

We woke up really early because today was the big adventure. My friend Sam had a map and I had the scissors to cut vines. We walked into the dark woods behind my house. Suddenly a big mean dog appeared and blocked the path! It looked like it chewed on rocks all day.

"Watch out for that beast!" yelled Sam loudly.

I was scared but I knew we had to be brave. The dog barked but then a man in a green hat came out. He looked like an army colonel.

"Don't worry, he just has a bad cough, like pneumonia," the man said.

The dog sniffed my shoe and wagged his tail. We walked past him and found the secret cave. The ground was black and scorched from a fire. We found a shiny gold coin inside and ran home fast.

My neighbor Tim and I had a big science project to complete. We needed to find a rare blue bug in the forest. We looked at our schedule and saw we were leaving soon.

"I have a yearning to find that bug!" Tim yelled.

We sprinted into the dark woods behind my house. It was scary but we felt important. Suddenly, Tim stepped on a stick and it crushed loudly. A big bear came out from behind a tree!

"Run for your life!" I screamed.

We ran fast back to the house. We ate a protein bar for energy. It was a pleasure to be safe inside. We did not get the bug, but at least we didn't get eaten.

We had a sleepover for my birthday in the backyard. My dad built a big fire on the ground. We roasted marshmallows and ate chocolate and Graham crackers. Then my dog Spot sprinted through the yard and he barked loud. My friend Tom laughed and he moved his chair back.

"Spot thinks he is a guard dog," Tom said.

We went inside for presents and I needed big scissors. I opened a cool truck that was loading rocks. I believed it was the best toy ever sold. Then my mom spoke to us and she was leading us to the kitchen. She reached for the cake and we sang happy birthday. It was the best night.

It was my birthday last Wednesday and it was raining. I wanted to play outside but my mom said no. We stayed inside and my dad brewed some hot cocoa. Then my best friend Tim came over for a sleepover.

"Let's play hide and seek!" Tim yelled loudly.

We ran upstairs and I hid under my bed. Tim looked everywhere but he could not find me. He looked in the closet and behind the curtains. Finally, his dog led him right to my spot.

"I caught you!" Tim laughed and pulled my arm.

We went downstairs and my dad was reading the newspaper. He tried to explain a boring story but we ran away. We wanted to seize the day and eat cake. I guarantee it was the best birthday ever. We didn't care about the rain either.

I love playing the video game called Space Racers. One day I sat on the couch with my friend Mike. We were racing on the moon level and it was super fast. My car flew past a big crater on the earth map. I was winning but then Mike passed me.

"You are going down!" Mike yelled at me.

I pushed the turbo button and my car grew bigger. I zoomed past him and I almost hit a space rock. We heard a loud beep and the race was over. I won by a single second!

"I am the champion of the galaxy!" I shouted loudly.

Mike was mad but we just started a new game. We played until my mom brewed some hot cocoa for us. It was better than camping or even when we swam at the pool. We were just hanging out and having fun.

I was playing Super Smash Bros with my brother. We picked the dangerous island level and it was scary. My heart was thumping really fast because I wanted to win. I picked Bowser because he has a lot of weight. My brother picked Mario and he started jumping around everywhere. I threw a big fireball at him and he missed.

"You are playing it wrong!" my brother yelled loudly.

"To be honest, I am just better," I said back.

Then he fell off the edge and started groaning. I won the game and my reign began. We met in the kitchen and ate toasted bread for a snack. It was the best day ever.

I went outside with my dog Max. It was freezing cold but we ran fast. Max barked at a big squirrel in the tree. The squirrel looked afraid and climbed up high. Then it started to snow hard.

"Come on Max, let's go!" I yelled.

We heard a loud noise behind the shed. Something crashed into the old fence. A tiny cat appeared from the bushes. It looked trapped in the deep snow. I grew worried for the little cat.

"Don't be scared," I said to the cat.

I grabbed the cat and put it in my coat. We ran inside and I drew a picture of us. It was like a painting of our adventure. Max licked the cat and they became friends.

My friends came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We made a huge fort instead of sleeping in beds. We used blankets and twisted them around the chairs.

"This building is trapped!" shouted my friend Leo.

"We need a jewel to save us," said Sam.

We pretended the weather was bad outside the fort. Suddenly, the lights disappeared and everything went dark. It happened because my dad turned them off. It was not on our schedule to sleep yet!

Then my cat flew into the fort and scared us. We looked at the scenery of pillows and laughed. It was a very important meeting in our fort. We talked until we fell asleep.

It was my birthday and I was feeling super excited. My friends came over for a big sleepover party. We played tag in the backyard until it got dark. Then my dad started dumping water balloons on us from the deck!

"Hey, no fair!" I yelled at him.

He just laughed and threw another big balloon at me. I caught it before it popped. Then I threw it right back at his head. Splat! He was soaking wet and looked funny.

Later we were steering our sleeping bags into a fort. I knew this was the best birthday ever. We simply could not stop giggling all night long.

We went on a boat to the spooky island. My friend Tom had a map but it had a red stain on it. We searched for the hidden cave for a long time. It was getting dark and I feared the ghosts.

"Look over there!" shouted Tom. He pointed at a big rock that looked like a brain.

We ran to the rock and saw a closed door. I pushed it open and it was very cold inside. It was so cold I thought I would get pneumonia. We found a gold box inside the cave.

"We need to learn how to open it," I said.

We smashed the lock and found chocolate coins inside! We ate them all on the way home.

My nephew Billy and I went on a big search. We wanted to find the lost cave in the woods. We walked on a dirt trail for a long time. Suddenly, we heard a loud tearing sound in the trees.

"Look out for that big rock!" yelled Billy.

I was steering our wagon, but we crashed into it. We were trapped in a dark hole under the ground. The ceiling was very high up and covered in moss.

"I wish I had some caffeine to stay awake," I said.

Instead, we found a magic glowing feather on the floor. It grew bigger and bigger until it was huge. We climbed on it and flew out fast. We went home and ate toasted marshmallows for dinner. We did a good job keeping our secret safe.

Yesterday was my birthday party at my apartment. My friends came over and we were loading up the car. We drove to the park because the breeze was nice. I saw a big bounce house approaching on a truck.

"Is that for us?" asked my friend Sam.

"Yes it is!" I yelled and ran fast.

It was not a bungee jump but it was still fun. We jumped for a long time until it got dark. Then my mom lit the candles on my cake. The cake had a blue jewel on top made of candy. After cake, I drew a picture of everyone. It was the best day ever.

I was running in the woods behind my house. My dog Max was with me and he loves to run. We found a big pile of old logs. I heard a small noise coming from inside the pile.

"Max, stop barking," I said. "I hear something."

We neared the logs and looked deep inside. I saw a baby bunny trapped under a big stick! It looked scared. I carefully put my finger through a hole in the wood. I moved the stick to the left. The bunny hopped out fast.

"Look, Max, we saved him!" I yelled.

The bunny looked back at us. I think he was grateful. Then he ran away into the bushes. I hope he will learn not to hide in log piles again.

I woke up really early because my dog Spot was barking. We went to the park and I threw a stick for him. It was a nice day but then a squirrel appeared. Spot ran so fast and his leash got tangled on a bench.

"Stop right there, Spot!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't stop and he ran near the water fountain. I had to use my mom’s scissors to cut the string. It was stuck in a vine that looked like a blue vein. My mom says coffee has caffeine but I just had juice.

"I guarantee you won't catch that squirrel," I told him.

We walked home and did some grounding in the grass. It felt cold on my feet and Spot liked it too.

I opened my lunchbox and saw a gross sandwich. My mom packed roasted turkey but it looked green. I grumbled because I was super hungry. My neighbor Tim had a giant cookie.

"Do you want to trade?" I asked him.

Tim shook his head and grabbed his cookie tight. "No way, this is my favorite," he said.

I crossed my arms and felt sad. Suddenly, a juice box came floating through the air! It crashed right onto my tray. It was grape juice.

"Sorry!" yelled Sarah from the other table. She threw it too hard.

I was grateful anyway because I was thirsty. I drank the juice and ate my green sandwich. It actually tasted okay. The bell rang and we all ran outside. Recess is the best part of the day.

My friend Tommy has a really cool watch. He brought it to school today and showed everyone. It is blue and counts your steps when you run. At recess, we all ran around the playground super fast. Tommy pushed the button on his side to check his speed.

"Look how fast I am going!" Tommy yelled loudly.

But then he tripped on a big rock near the slide. He fell down hard and we heard a crunch. The watch broke into two pieces on the grass. Tommy looked like he was going to cry.

"My mom is going to be so mad," he said.

I picked up the pieces carefully and gave them back. He was sad throughout the rest of the day. He didn't even eat his cookie at lunch, though I did.

My friends and I went to the old scary forest. We wanted to find the secret hidden treasure chest. I counted three big trees and we turned left. The ground was muddy and we got very dirty. Suddenly a giant green beetle crawled on my shoe!

"Eww get it off me!" shouted my friend Sam.

I flicked it away with my finger and laughed. We kept walking until we met a huge dark cave. We were hungry but we wanted to see inside.

"I think the gold is in there," I whispered.

We walked in and saw a shiny box. I opened the lid and we all grinned. But then I felt a tickle in my nose. I let out a huge loud sneeze! A bear woke up and looked at us. We realized it was time to run home fast! We were thrilled we escaped the bear.

It was my brother Sam’s birthday and we planned a surprise. I made a special design for his cake with blue frosting. Mom was hanging the balloons and Dad trained the dog to sit. I had the scissors to cut the wrapping paper.

Suddenly, our dog Buster crashed into the table! The cake fell down and my mom screamed very loud. Buster scratched his ear and then he licked the blue frosting.

"Oh no, that was the greatest cake ever!" I yelled.

My dad grinned and said, "Now Buster is sweeter and stronger."

Sam walked in and saw us moaning about the mess. He didn't care about the meaning of the mess. He just laughed. I got a comb to fix Buster’s messy fur. It was the best birthday even with a dog cake.

One day my cat Fluffy looked up at the big tree. He was yearning to climb to the very top branches. The height was really scary but he jumped up anyway. I yelled, "Fluffy come down right now or else!"

But he didn't listen and he disappeared into the green leaves. Suddenly a loud noise struck the air and a branch broke. Fluffy fell and crashed through the leaves like a rock. I was so scared because of the danger.

He hit the ground but he landed on his feet. I pushed through the bushes and grabbed him tight. I ran inside bringing him to my room. He jumped on my bed and looked at the ceiling. Then he crashed into my pillows and went to sleep. He is a crazy cat.

I hate homework but I love recess. Today we played kickball and I was the champion. My team cheered for me and we were jumping up and down.

Then the bell screeched and we had to go inside.

"I don't want to do math!" I screamed.

"Please sit down and open your books," said Mrs. Green.

I started to complain because math takes an hour. It is so boring. I looked at the clock and I was waiting for lunchtime. My younger brother loves school but I think he is silly. To be honest I just want to play on the computer. Finally school was over and I ran home fast.

My friend Sam and I gripped our controllers tightly. We were playing a new game about finding treasure. The last level was super hard and confusing.

"I do not understand where to go!" Sam yelled.

I looked at the map and saw a big balcony. A scary soldier called the Colonel was standing there. He was leading a bunch of bad guys.

"We have to jump over him, I guarantee it!" I shouted.

Sam tried to jump but his character fell down. Neither of us could beat the level. My anger was growing fast. It felt like a foreign language we couldn't speak. I could barely contain my scream when the screen went black.

"Let's just play soccer outside instead," Sam said.

We ran out the door to play a real game.

One day me and my dog Max went exploring. We found a small trail in the woods behind my house. Max was thumping his tail because he was happy. We walked until we saw a big rock like an island.

"Look Max, I am a knight!" I yelled loudly.

I jumped on the rock and pretended I had a sword. But my foot twisted on a root and I fell down. My leg hurt and I struggled to get up. Max barked at me and licked my face.

"You are stronger than me today," I told him.

I thought we were in big trouble. But then I saw my dad swinging through the trees. He helped me up and we walked home to complete our adventure. The sun scorched my neck but I was safe.

I was playing a racing game with my brother on Saturday. It was the hardest level called Mountain Pass and it felt impossible. My car crashed into a wall and his car kept going.

"You are going to lose!" my brother yelled at me.

"I can still win even though I crashed," I said back.

My car scattered parts everywhere but I found a secret shortcut. I drove through a meadow and jumped over a big rock. My brother feared I was catching up so he drove too fast. He hit a tree and his car got crushed. I caught up and crossed the finish line first. Winning meant I got the gold cup on the screen. It was better than camping or playing guitar. I felt like a winner.

My neighbor Tim and I went on a quest. We wanted to find the greatest treasure in the woods. Tim brought his science kit and a map.

"I have a bad feeling about this," Tim said.

We walked far and saw a weird beetle on a rock. Suddenly a loud noise screeched in the trees! We scrambled behind a big bush fast. Something was breathing loudly near us. It sounded like a groaning monster.

"Maybe it wants a protein bar?" I whispered.

We threw a bar and ran away fast. We woke up a sleeping dog. The dog was our guide back home. We paid him with a treat. I was very pleased to be safe. It was like a foreign land out there.

Me and my friend Sam went to the scary cave. It was dark inside and we heard a loud growl. Suddenly a big dragon jumped out at us! We were trapped in the corner. The dragon breathed fire and scorched my shoe.

"Run fast!" yelled Sam.

I grabbed a rock and threw it hard. The dragon moved back and roared. We struggled to get past its tail. Then I saw a shiny sword on the ground. I was jumping over rocks to get it. I swung the sword and scared the dragon away.

"We won the fight!" I shouted.

We were happy to have each other's company. We ran home before it got dark.

I was so thrilled about my birthday sleepover. My best friend Sam came over and we were running around the yard. We played tag and Sam was screaming because he was bumping into things. Then we climbed up the big tree in the back. I sat on a branch and grasped the rough bark tight.

"Look out below!" Sam yelled and jumped to the ground.

We went inside and my mom had balloons scattered everywhere. We ate pizza and then we sank into the soft couch. I opened my presents and I could not have believed my eyes. It was a new video game!

"Can we play it now?" asked Sam while jumping up.

"Yes we can!" I said. We played all night long through the dark.

I was camping on a big mountain with my nephew. His name is Ben and he is a robot. Ben can run very fast and jump over trees. Suddenly we heard a loud whistle sounding from the sky.

"What is that noise?" asked Ben.

I looked up and saw a spaceship. It hung in the air right above our tent! A green alien came out and drew a laser sword.

"I am the champion of space!" yelled the alien.

Something felt wrong so I grabbed my magic rock. I threw it and it turned into a giant shield. The alien got scared and ran away fast. Ben and I high-fived because we saved the day. Then we ate s'mores.

The green alien landed his ship in my backyard. It crashed right into my mom's favorite rose bush. I knew I was in big trouble. The alien walked out and he had three eyes. He looked at the scenery and then he grinned.

"Take me to your leader," he said with a weird voice.

I held up my thumb. "I am the leader here," I told him.

Suddenly, a giant robot came running down the street. It was screaming loud metal noises. My ears were ringing so bad. The robot grew taller and taller. I counted to three and used my laser eyes. The robot melted gradually into a puddle of gray slime. That was enough excitement for one day. I put a sign on the slime that said DO NOT TOUCH.

I was sitting in science class and looking out the window. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about rocks and dirt. Suddenly I heard a loud squeak from the back of the room. The class hamster named Fluffy had escaped his cage!

"Oh no! Fluffy is running away!" yelled my friend Ben.

Fluffy ran through the legs of the desks very fast. Papers were scattered all over the floor when kids tried to help. It looked like a mountain of homework on the ground. Mrs. Miller almost fainted when she saw the big mess.

"Quick, someone seize that hamster!" Mrs. Miller shouted loudly.

I ran to the water fountain but he wasn't there. Then I saw him hiding near the trash can. I picked him up carefully so I wouldn't get in trouble. Mrs. Miller drank some caffeine from her mug and smiled. Fluffy was safe again.

One day me and my neighbor Tim went to the woods. We wanted to find the lost treasure box. We climbed a big tree and saw a cave. Tim jumped down and ran fast to the dark hole.

"Wait for me!" I yelled and ran after him.

Inside it was dark and we were bumping into rocks. Suddenly a bat scratched my arm and I was scared. But I knew we had to complete the mission. We saw a big box in the water. It looked like an old sailor chest. But the heavy box sank deep into the mud. We tried to open it with my safety scissors.

"Oh no, it is a failure," said Tim sadly.

But then the box popped open! Inside was just old rocks. We laughed and went home for lunch.

I woke up late and ran to the bus stop. My backpack felt heavy on my shoulders. At school, Mrs. Miller asked for our math homework. I looked inside my bag but it disappeared! I scratched my head because something was wrong.

"Where is it?" asked my friend Leo.

"I don't know!" I said, feeling scared.

Just then, I saw my dog's toy inside. It was a rubber bone with bite marks. My dog likes to gnaw on everything. I must have grabbed the wrong paper at home. Mrs. Miller hung up my empty folder on the wall. I was not earning a gold star today. Later at recess, everyone was screaming and playing tag. I felt sad but then I found a cool rock. Tomorrow I will check my bag two times.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house today. My dog Rex came with me to keep me company. We pretended the tall grass was a wild jungle. Rex was the captain and he walked in front to guide me.

Suddenly, a squirrel sprinted up a big oak tree! Rex barked at it and started roaming around the roots.

"Come back here, Rex!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen because he was too busy sniffing. We found a little fountain of water dumping into a puddle. The birds were singing a happy song with a nice rhythm. We saw some berries growing on a bush, but they looked crushed. I pretended we roasted them for dinner, but really we just went home. My mom greeted us at the door with snacks.

My neighbor Tim likes science a lot. One day we discovered a secret button in his garage. We pushed it and suddenly we swept away into space! We landed on a weird purple island floating in the sky.

"Look at that thing!" Tim yelled loudly.

It was a robot elephant with eight shiny metal legs. The creature was super heavy because of its weight. It was clinging to a big blue rock. We rode on its back and it was scary but fun.

"I will always remember this," I told Tim.

Then the elephant started reading a map and flew us home. It was the best day ever.

My friends and I went on a big adventure. We wanted to find the magic fountain on the mountain. My mom sent us with snacks and our coats because the weather was bad. We walked for a long time and we reached a dark cave.

"Watch out for the dragon!" yelled Timmy.

We saw a big metal chain on the ground. Then we saw the dragon. It scorched the ground with fire! We ran fast and I used my science kit. I threw a smoke bomb and we obtained the treasure.

"We bought enough candy for everyone!" I shouted happily. We were safe and happy.

My dog Buster chewed my mom's favorite shoes again. He is a very naughty creature sometimes. I saw the shoes and they looked scorched and ruined. Mom was wearing her blue dress and she was mad.

"Buster! You are going to get a grounding!" I yelled.

Buster was afraid and hid under the fountain outside. I found a big green beetle there. It was sleeping on a rock. I drew a picture of it with my crayons.

Then Mom came outside with scissors for the garden. She saw Buster and her face turned red with anger.

"Oh no, not those shoes!" she said loudly.

I felt like swearing but I didn't. Buster is stronger than me so I couldn't pull him. We just played with the beetle until Mom was happy again.

My backpack was super heavy today. I walked to school with my greatest friend Sam. We talked about how we are growing really tall. Sam said, "I bet I have more strength than a bear!" I laughed and then we went inside.

At recess we played tag and I ran very fast. But then Sam crashed into me by accident. I fell down and my leg got trapped under him. It hurt a little bit but I didn't cry. 

Later my teacher brewed some hot tea for herself. She read a newspaper while we did our math test. "Is everyone almost done?" she asked the class. I finished first and felt really happy. School is fun but homework is boring.

My best friend Tim came over for a sleepover on Saturday. We wanted to dig a giant hole in the back yard. We used big shovels to break the hard ground.

"This is really hard work," Tim grumbled.

Suddenly my shovel hit something loud and shiny. We discovered a metal box deep in the earth! I was so excited I almost fainted right there. We opened the box and saw an old piece of paper. It was a schedule for feeding a dog named Rex.

My dad came outside and saw the dirt everywhere. He turned very red and looked mad.

"You guys better clean this mess up fast!" he yelled.

I promised I would maintain the yard better next time. We were swearing to never dig again, but it was still fun.

I went to my neighbor Sam’s house for a sleepover. We wanted to build a huge fort in his room. Sam got some blankets and I got the scissors for tape.

"This fort needs to be stronger," Sam said loudly.

I knew he was right because the roof fell down. We piled up more pillows until the wall grew very high. It was a certain danger to climb on top of it. Sam's mom came in and brewed some hot chocolate for us.

"Be careful up there or you will fall!" she yelled.

We drank the hot chocolate inside the dark fort. It was the best sleepover ever because we stayed up late. Next time we will make the fort even bigger.

I gripped my controller tight and the game started. We were playing racing karts in space and I was winning. My friend Tom was approaching me fast in his red car.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled and pushed the button.

"Yes I can, just watch this trick," Tom grinned.

Suddenly his car was floating over a big gap. It looked like he had a bungee cord attached. He landed straight ahead of me and I was mad. The scenery was cool with stars and planets everywhere. I tried to catch up but I crashed into a wall.

"I win! I reign supreme!" Tom shouted happily.

I scratched my head and sighed but then I smiled.

"Next time I'm teaching you a lesson," I said.

We laughed and started a new game right away. The weather outside was rainy so we played all day.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old park. We saw a weird building behind the big swings. The ground was all scorched and black near the door. Rocks were scattered everywhere so we had to be careful walking.

"Do you understand what that noise is?" Sam asked me.

I heard a loud stamping sound coming from inside. We walked closer and I counted to three. Suddenly a big robot dog ran out! It was bumping into trees and surrounding us. We were scared but it just wanted to play.

"Here boy!" I yelled and threw a stick.

The robot was happy and started cheering with beeps. We were so grateful it was nice. We didn't receive any treasure but we made a new friend.

One day my younger brother Sam and I went outside. We were walking through the tall grass near the river. I saw something moving near a big rock. It was a tiny frog and it looked scared. "Look, I caught it!" I yelled to Sam. He ran over and grinned at the green frog. 

The frog looked very hungry so we found a bug. But then Sam tripped and fell on the dirt. He almost crushed the poor frog with his hand. "Be careful or gravity will hurt him," I said. Sam got up and started dumping dirt off his pants. Although he was dirty, he was happy we had company. We put the frog back in the water. It swam away very fast. We waved goodbye and went home for lunch.

My friend Sam and I wanted to explore the old apartment. It was big and scary, but we wanted to find treasure. We neared the basement door and I pulled it open. It was very dark and it smelled funny inside.

"Do you have the flashlight?" Sam asked me quietly.

"Yes, but the batteries are bad," I said.

Unfortunately, the light went out and it was pitch black. Suddenly, a ghost appeared in the corner! He looked like an old sailor with a blue hat. He started swearing because he stubbed his toe on a box. It was not a pleasant sound. We ran away fast and we did not want his company.

"I am never going back there again!" I yelled.

Sam agreed that staying safe was more important than gold.

We were certain the treasure was near the old fountain. My brother Max was steering the map and I was looking. We started walking through the thick, green bushes. Suddenly a tiny gnat flew into my eye and I screamed!

"Be quiet or you will wake the sleeping dragon!" Max whispered.

We kept going until we saw a huge cave. We were thrilled but also scared enough to run away. Then we heard a loud dumping sound inside. A big rock landed right near my foot! It almost crushed my favorite blue sneakers.

"Run! It’s waking up!" I yelled, leaving my backpack behind.

We ran fast and often looked back. We were safe but I almost fainted. We didn't find gold, but it was a scary adventure.

My robot named Zork lived on a floating island. Zork was the greatest robot ever because he had superpowers. He was teaching me how to fly over a giant fountain.

"Don't fall into the water!" Zork yelled loudly.

I tried to maintain my balance in the air. Suddenly, a plain green alien landed on our island. He looked hungry and chewed on a rock.

"I have some stewed carrots," I said to the alien.

The alien greeted us and ate the carrots fast. He treated us nicely and gave me magic scissors. Then my mom called me because she was coaching my soccer team. I missed my grounding but the alien was cool.

Yesterday at recess I scrambled across the playground with Mike. We were looking for my bouncy ball. We searched through the tall grass near the fence. Suddenly I touched something hard and cold on the earth.

"Look what I discovered!" I yelled to Mike.

It was a shiny silver coin bearing a weird face.

"Is it important?" asked Mike.

I nodded because it looked very old. The dirt surrounding it was wet and muddy. Just then the bell rang for the beginning of math class. We ran back inside but I kept the coin safe. I felt like a real spy trained to find treasure. I can't wait to show my teacher what I found.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the big green jungle. We were looking for the lost golden cup. We walked for a long time and saw a tall tree.

"Look at the height of that tree!" shouted Sam.

We started climbing up the branches very fast. Suddenly a monkey jumped out and grabbed my hat. I tried to get it back but I felt a sneeze coming. 

"Achoo!" I sneezed loudly and almost fell down.

Sam caught my arm and held me tight. The monkey dropped the hat because the noise scared him. We found the golden cup at the top. It had a heavy weight. We climbed down and everyone was cheering for us like a champion. We were so grateful to be safe. We used scissors to cut some vines and went home for dinner.

I was jumping on my bed when the spaceship landed. A big robot walked out and he looked super scary. He was dumping green slime everywhere on the grass. My heart was beating so fast like a drum.

"Stop right there!" I yelled at the big metal man.

"I am the champion of Mars," the robot said back.

He shot a laser but I crossed my arms quickly. I have superpowers so the laser didn't hurt me either. I picked him up and felt his heavy weight. I threw him back into his ship. He was trapped inside now. The danger was gone and my hands were steady. It was a cool scene but then my mom called me for dinner.

My birthday breakfast was pancakes and they smelled so good. I looked at the big present on the table. My heart was thumping hard because I was yearning for it.

"Open it now!" my mom said with a smile.

I ripped the paper and saw a shiny red guitar. It was like finding buried treasure in my kitchen. The weight of it was heavy but I held it tight. I moved my fingers on the strings and stuck out my tongue. I felt like a champion on a big stage. A little blue vein popped out on my hand because I squeezed hard.

"Play us a song," my dad said.

I strummed it loud as my dog neared me. This was the best birthday ever.

My friend Leo and I wanted to find the old castle. We packed our bags and walked into the dark woods. We followed a muddy path until it stopped at a huge wall.

"This looks impossible to climb," Leo said quietly.

I looked up and saw a bumpy rock. I used all my strength and pulled myself up. Leo climbed up next to me. We turned the corner and saw the big stone castle. It was very tall and scary.

Suddenly, a big green frog came jumping at us! We screamed and ran fast, but then the frog stopped. It looked at us and croaked loudly.

"I think he just greeted us," I laughed.

We trained our flashlights on the ground and found a secret door. We were ready for the next adventure.

My cat Fluffy thinks he is the greatest climber ever. One day we went outside to the big tree. Fluffy started climbing up very fast. He looked like a plain orange blur going up the bark.

"Come down right now, Fluffy!" I yelled loudly.

He did not listen and went higher. Suddenly the wind blew hard and shook the branches. Fluffy was hanging on with just his front paws! Then gravity pulled him down. He landed on his feet in the grass.

"I guess you still have to learn how to climb," I said.

Fluffy just meowed like a little captain giving orders. He grew tired and fell asleep in the sun. Being outside is fun but scary sometimes.

The captain of the space ship was a blue alien. His name was Zorg and he had big green eyes. I was the pilot and my superpower was flying. We landed on a tall purple mountain on Mars.

"Look at that robot!" I shouted to Zorg.

The robot looked sad and it held a tiny feather. The robot greeted us with a beep. It wanted to bungee jump off the cliff. That was the reason it was sad. It had no rope.

"I can help you," Zorg said nicely.

He grabbed a long space rope with his thumb. The robot jumped and felt happy again. Zorg was the best leader to reign over Mars. We flew away to find more space friends.

Me and my friend Sam woke up very early. We had a yearning for a big adventure. We grabbed our backpacks and bounced down the stairs. Sam wanted to be a brave sailor on the lake.

"Look at that big island over there!" Sam shouted.

We got in our small boat and paddled hard. The water splashed throughout the boat and got us wet. Suddenly a giant duck swam right at us!

"Use your brain and paddle faster!" I yelled back.

We got away and landed on the sandy beach. It was a pleasure to find a secret cave there. We treated ourselves to juice boxes and pretended we found gold. It was the best day ever.

On Wednesday, I forgot my homework in my backpack. My teacher Mrs. Lee asked for it, and I grumbled quietly. Then it was time for recess, so I grabbed my coat.

Outside, the jungle gym was crowded with loud kids. Everyone was cheering because Tommy climbed to the very top. I saw a shiny beetle clinging to the metal pole. I touched its hard shell, and it fell down fast.

"Look at that bug!" said my friend Sarah.

"It has eight legs, I think," I told her.

Then the bell rang, and it ruined our rhythm. We had to go inside for math class. I used my imagination to pretend I was still outside. But Mrs. Lee saw me staring at the window. I hope I don't get a grounding when I get home.

My robot named Zork had a big problem. He was growing too fast and his metal legs were hanging off his bed. I treated him like a real person, but he was messy.

"I need bigger legs!" Zork shouted loudly.

I walked to the garage and searched for my dad's tools. I found some scissors and a hammer. Then I sprinted back to my room.

"Stay still, Zork," I said. "I am teaching you to be patient."

Zork was climbing the wall because he was bored. Gradually, I fixed his legs with new metal parts. He looked funny, but he was happy. I trained him to sit down nicely. I don't know about robot psychology, but Zork is my best friend.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were so excited. We wanted to make bracelets but I dropped the box of beads.

"Oh no, you are dumping them everywhere!" said my friend Sam.

We started picking them up but some rolled under the bed. I was afraid to look because it was dark down there. Sam acted like a guard and held the flashlight for me. I saw a shiny silver chain and pulled it out.

"This looks wonderful," I said.

Then we found the beads and put them on a thread. We had to measure our wrists to make them fit right. It felt like an invisible guide helped us finish them. Suddenly my mom came in stamping her feet.

"Who is making all that noise?" she grumbled.

We showed her the bracelets and she smiled gradually. We went to sleep happy.

My younger sister had a bad day at school. She scratched her knee on the playground at recess. Then she stole my favorite blue marker for drawing. I was mad but Mom said simply let it go.

At lunch I discovered something gross in my sandwich. It looked like green slime but it was just lettuce. I ate the protein bar instead and bounced my ball. My friend Tim bought a huge cookie and shared it.

"This is the best cookie ever," I said happily.

Tim laughed and said, "My mom made eight of them!"

After school we went roaming in the woods nearby. We pretended we were boating on a big ocean. But then it started dumping rain and got cold. We ran home fast so we wouldn't catch pneumonia. It was a crazy day surrounding my house.

I was scared about art class today. We were making masks and I am bad at cutting with scissors. Mrs. Green was approaching my desk and I started sweating. I was holding the scissors wrong and the paper was ripping. It looked like a monster but not a good one.

"That looks nice, Timmy," said Mrs. Green.

"I think it looks ugly," I said.

Then the bell rang for lunch and I started running. I was so hungry. My mom packed a toasted cheese sandwich. I pretended the cheese was a bungee cord. It stretched really far. I had a happy feeling in my tummy. Then I saw a needle on the floor. It was just a pine needle from outside. School is weird sometimes.

My dog Buster loves jumping in big piles of leaves. Yesterday we went outside to search for the biggest pile. We walked for a long time in the woods. 

"Look at that giant pile!" I shouted loudly. 

Buster barked and ran fast towards the huge red leaves. But suddenly he stopped because a squirrel was steering him away. The squirrel ran up a tree and Buster sat down.

"It is impossible to catch him," I told Buster.

Buster looked sad and had a yearning look on his face. He led me deeper into the woods for fourteen minutes. We found a fort that someone built with sticks. We played inside for a while but couldn't stay longer. It was getting dark so we ran all the way home.

My robot named Zork had a very strange feeling. He said he was reading a map about treasure. "I am the champion of treasure!" Zork yelled loudly. We had to climb a big mountain on an island. Suddenly, we saw an invisible spaceship appear in the sky. It was hard for me, and I was breathing fast. It was important to keep going, even with the heavy bearing. Zork used a tiny needle to point the way. Then the clouds cleared up and we saw the alien captain. "Are you certain we can win?" asked Zork scaredly. "It is not impossible!" I shouted back at him. We ran fast and grabbed the gold box first.

I sat at my desk and looked at the paper. It was a very important test about geography. I had to label every single island on the map. I scratched my head and thought very hard. My teacher Mrs. Miller walked by my desk slowly.

"Please write carefully and complete every question," she said.

I tried to remember where the big island was. Then the bell rang and screeched loudly in the hall. It was time for lunch and I was so hungry.

"I will receive a good grade," I told my friend Sam.

We ate pizza and talked about a big grey elephant. We pretended to reign over a kingdom of monkeys. Recess was fun but we were waiting for class again. School is long but playing games is the best part.

Max and I climbed up to the spooky balcony. We knew there was big trouble inside the old house. I thought I heard a loud thumping sound.

"Do you remember the map?" I asked Max.

"Yes, it is in my pocket," Max said.

We needed to maintain our balance on the wood. Suddenly a weird foreign coin fell out of the wall. It looked like a prize for a champion. Max threw a rock at a dark shadow. We were training to be spies all summer. We were earning our badges today!

"I hope we receive a reward," I whispered.

Then a bat flew out and started swearing at us! It was just squeaking really loud. We ran away fast. It was the best adventure ever.

It was my birthday in February and I turned eight. My mom drove me to the store to get a present. I wanted a new toy dog that could gnaw on a bone. We bought the dog and then we went home. My big sister was studying psychology at the table. She looked at my toy and started groaning loudly.

"That toy is for babies," she said to me.

I knew she was just jealous of my cool dog. The dog had a design with blue spots on it. Suddenly, my friend Tim came over with fourteen balloons. One balloon flew away but we caught it fast. We played until we found a sharp needle on the floor.

"Watch out for the balloons!" Tim yelled.

We had cake and it was the best day ever.

My birthday was last Saturday and it was awesome. Mom drove me and my friends straight to the Science Center. We ran inside and saw a huge rocket on the ceiling. I pretended I was the captain of the spaceship.

"Look at that big dinosaur!" shouted my friend Leo.

"I bet he is hungry for cake," I said.

We played games throughout the whole afternoon. Then we went into a room with mirrors and bounced lasers around. Suddenly a loud noise screeched from the speakers. It was time for the show! We swept into the theater seats fast. The science lady made it rain inside.

"I will reign over this kingdom!" Leo yelled.

It was the best day ever.

Tomorrow is my greatest birthday ever because I am turning nine. I ran to the kitchen to see my mom. She was making a big cake with chocolate frosting.

"Can I lick the spoon?" I asked my mom.

"Yes, but hold it carefully so it doesn't drip," she said.

I saw a present on the table bearing my name. I thought it was a new video game. I wanted to seize it and open it right now! My dog Sparky sniffed the ground near the box. He likes the smell of protein bars, though I don't think any are in there. I will search the whole house for more presents later. I am so excited for my party with my best friends.

My friends and I went to a big island. We wanted to find treasure so we walked far. We discovered a dark cave and we crawled inside.

Suddenly, the ground shook and rocks fell down.

"We are in big trouble!" I screamed loudly.

A huge spider grew big in the shadows. We struggled to run but my foot got stuck. My friend Ben held my hand and pulled hard. We bounced over the rocks and ran fast. We cleared the cave just in time. The spider disappeared into the dark and we were safe.

"I knew we shouldn't go in there," Ben said.

We went home and ate pizza instead of finding gold.

We climbed up the big hill behind my house. My friend Sam wanted to be the captain today. He walked straight into the dark woods and I followed. Suddenly a big noise greeted us from the bushes. It sounded like something tearing through the leaves.

"Run!" screamed Sam and he ran very fast.

We ran until the scary noise gradually disappeared. Then we saw an old man in a green hat. He looked like a colonel from a movie.

"Are you boys lost?" he asked us nicely.

We shook our heads and walked home. It was almost a failure but we made it back safe. Next time we will bring a map.

My robot Max and I flew to Mars on Tuesday. We had to climb a big red mountain there. It was super hard because the air was thin. Max is made of metal, so he has a lot of weight.

"I am getting hungry," I said to Max.

Max made a weird beep noise. "Eat your protein bar," he said back.

We kept climbing and finally reached the top. A green alien was there playing a guitar. He had a long purple tongue. We fought him for the special rock. I used my laser and I was the champion! We obtained the rock and our mission was complete. Then we ate pizza on the spaceship leading home.

My dog Buster is huge and has a lot of weight. He is brown and likes to run in the park. One day we went exploring near the old creek. A nice breeze was blowing on my face.

"Look at that big stick, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

Buster saw a squirrel and ran very fast. He crossed the water and splashed everywhere. I counted fourteen rocks in the water. Suddenly Buster slipped and crashed into a bush!

"Oh no, are you okay?" I asked him.

He was fine and wagging his tail. He thought it was a fun game. I grabbed his collar for some grounding. I pretended to reign over the forest with my dog. It was the best day ever.

It was my birthday last Saturday and I was so excited. My mom stewed some meat for dinner and it smelled yummy. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We played on my computer for a long time. Then we went outside and started jumping on the trampoline.

"Watch my strength!" Sam yelled and jumped super high.

"That was cool," I said and I clapped my hands.

Later we went inside and drew funny pictures of dogs. I lost my blue comb but we found it later. It fell through a crack in the floor. My mom asked if we ate all the cake. I had to be honest and say yes. It was the best birthday ever.

My brother Max is thirteen, and he always beats me. We were playing a new video game about boating and camping. Max stole my best boat and I started groaning. I felt like dumping the game in the trash. 

"You can't catch me!" Max yelled at me.

Then a big monster appeared on his screen. It had a big metal chain. Max tried to run but his character did a sneeze. My character was busy painting a trap for him.

"Got you now!" I shouted when he fell in.

I finally won the game and stopped yearning to win. I heard him sigh, but I was so happy. It was the best day ever.

Yesterday at recess I brought my big red ball. I bounced it high near the water fountain. My friend Tim was there and he looked sad.

"Why are you moaning?" I asked him loudly.

"I have a scary meeting with the principal," he spoke.

Just then the gym teacher blew his shiny whistle. It was so loud it made me sneeze. We ran down the trail to the field. Tim loves coaching our kickball league. He forgot about the principal and we played hard. Then we sang silly songs at lunch. I used a plastic knife to cut my apple.

"Let's play again tomorrow!" Tim yelled.

Recess is way better than reading my dad's big psychology book.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We were waiting for pizza in the living room. Sam said, "I bet I can do a bungee jump off the sofa!" He pushed the cushions onto the floor and jumped. He caught his foot on the rug and fell. It sounded like a giant elephant dropped from the sky! My mom heard the noise and ran in. "What is going on in here?" she asked loudly. Sam looked scared and tried to be invisible. I laughed so hard I had to sneeze. My mom cleared the mess and taught us a lesson about safety. The pizza box did contain pepperoni, so we were happy again.

My friend Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to search for a ghost in my backyard. Tim grabbed a big flashlight and I took a chain. We walked on the ground very quietly like a sneaky sailor.

"Do you hear that rhythm?" Tim asked me scared.

It was just my neighbor playing loud music. We sat down and felt the weight of our blankets. We pretended we were in a foreign land far away. Then my mom came outside bearing a tray of cookies.

"No caffeine for you two," she said with a smile.

We ate the cookies and forgot about the scary ghost. It was the best sleepover ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the spooky forest. We were looking for the dragon's cave. My dad taught us about dragons, so we were brave. We walked for a long time and saw a big hole.

"Look at that smoke!" Sam yelled loudly.

We scrambled up the rocks and peeked inside the dark cave. Suddenly, a huge fire shot out and scorched a bush! It was very hot and scary. I almost fainted from the heat. The dragon opened its yellow eye and looked at us.

"Run away fast!" I screamed at Sam.

We ran back home and slammed the door closed. That training didn't help us at all. We sent a letter to the king about it later. I am never going back there again because that was too dangerous.

It was a boring Wednesday until the spaceship landed in my backyard. A green alien walked out and his name was Zork. He had three eyes and they were looking at my dog.

"Do not eat him!" I screamed at the green guy.

Zork said, "I do not understand. I just want pizza."

We walked through the kitchen door and my mom was keeping snacks there. We ate pizza and chips until crumbs were scattered everywhere. Suddenly, Zork used magic to make us fly to a floating island. We crossed the sky very fast. It felt impossible but it was real. Everyone on the ground was looking up and cheering for us. It was the best day ever.

I was wearing my favorite blue shirt for lunch today. I opened my lunchbox and saw a cheese sandwich. I wanted a toasted cheese sandwich instead, but it was cold. My friend Sam sat down next to me.

"Do you want to trade for my apple?" Sam asked.

"No thanks, I really like cheese," I said.

I knew I had to finish eating quickly for recess. We ran outside and played tag on the grass. I grasped the metal pole at base so I was safe. Suddenly I saw a tiny white feather floating down. It looked like a needle in the grass. Then the bell rang loudly, leaving us no more time. We gradually walked back to class. There were thirteen math problems on the board. I cleared my desk and got ready to work.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the big meadow. We were looking for a secret cave. The breeze was nice and cool that day. We saw a big rock and scrambled up it fast.

"Watch out for the bugs!" yelled Sam loudly.

I was clinging to a branch on a tree nearby. Suddenly, I saw something dark inside the rocks. It was a giant bat swinging from the ceiling! It screeched at us and we got scared.

"Run away now!" I shouted back at Sam.

We ran all the way home without seeing the cave. My dad was teaching me how to run fast anyway. It was scary but really fun too.

My birthday party was beginning and it was super exciting. All my friends appeared at the front door with presents. We played tag on the ground in the backyard. Then my friend Tommy saw something small and black.

"Look, it's a giant beetle!" Tommy yelled loudly.

We all ran over and the beetle disappeared under a leaf. It was freezing outside so we went into the warm kitchen. My mom brought out a huge cake with ten candles. I felt the weight of the crown on my head. It was my time to reign as the birthday king! Everyone sang happy birthday to me and I blew out the candles. Gradually, the room got quiet while we ate the yummy cake. Following the cake, we opened presents and played video games all night.

My big brother Max was teaching me his favorite video game. It was about knights and a dragon who lived near a fountain. The scenery in the game looked really cool and bright.

"You have to dodge the fire or you get roasted!" Max yelled.

I looked at the schedule on the wall and sighed. My mom said we had to stop playing at five o'clock. I kept groaning because the dragon was super hard to beat. It felt impossible to win.

"Just be honest, are you letting me win?" I asked him.

Max laughed and shook his head no. Suddenly, I hit the right button and the dragon fell down! I jumped up and almost hit the ceiling.

"I won everything!" I shouted.

It was like a dream, and now my reign as champion begins.

I had a weird day at school today. It started when Mrs. Green was stamping our homework papers. She looked at mine and her face turned red. A big blue vein popped out on her forehead!

"This is not enough work," she said loudly.

I felt sad but then the bell rang for lunch. I was so hungry for my toasted cheese sandwich. We ran through the hall to the cafeteria. I saw my friend Billy jumping up and down.

"Look who is approaching!" Billy yelled at me.

It was Mrs. Green but she was smiling now. She gave me a cookie and said sorry for yelling. It was the best lunch ever.

Tim told me we had to wake up early. We had a schedule for our big adventure today. We crawled under the fence and saw the old forest. It was scary because we heard a loud moaning sound.

"Did you hear that noise?" Tim whispered to me.

I nodded and we kept walking past a broken fountain. We counted ten big steps until we neared the dark cave. Something was roaming inside and the shadows grew very long. We struggled to open the heavy door but we did it.

"Run fast!" I yelled when I saw the green eyes.

We ran all the way home and felt safe again. It was the best adventure ever.

We were eating breakfast when my brother Max grabbed his map. He said we needed to go on a science mission. We packed our bags with juice and every single crumb of toast. Then we ran to the spooky woods behind our house.

There was a big tree and we climbed it very fast. I saw something shiny in a hole. It was a silver whistle! I blew it and it made a loud noise. Suddenly a squirrel looked at us.

"Run away!" yelled Max. "It is a monster squirrel!"

We jumped down and ran all the way home.

"I guarantee we are safe now," I said.

We were tired but we started reading a book about squirrels. It was the best adventure ever.

My friends and I love playing video games together. Yesterday we played a new game about knights in a castle. We had to search for a hidden treasure chest. The game was loading really slow and it was weird. I drew a map to help us find the gold.

Then my dog ran in and chewed up my map! He was tearing it into tiny pieces on the floor.

"Oh no, stop that right now!" I yelled loudly.

My friend Sam laughed and said, "He thinks he is boating!"

We finally beat the level and did not need the map. I was grateful when I saw the screen say YOU WIN. It was the greatest feeling ever to receive the big trophy. I am going to write about it in my diary.

I was playing my favorite video game about space pirates. My character swept through the level and jumped over lava pits. I knew the big boss was coming up soon. The boss was a giant robot that liked singing loudly.

"You can’t beat me!" shouted the robot on the screen.

I squeezed the controller and thought of a good plan. The robot shot lasers but I dodged them fast. It was raining fireballs now so I hid behind a rock. I understood the pattern and drew my laser sword. I ran forward and hit the big red button.

"Game over! You win!" said the announcer voice.

My mom yelled from downstairs, "Dinner is ready!"

I paused the game just in time. I escaped the danger but now I was really hungry. The box didn't contain any more enemies anyway.

Me and my friend Sam were playing Mario Kart. We were racing on the boating level with the water. The breeze from the fan felt good because I was sweating. Suddenly, a blue shell hit me and I fell off the track!

"Oh no, I am roasted!" I yelled at the TV.

Sam grasped his controller tight and sprinted to the finish line. He was winning gradually. I found a mushroom and went super fast. It was a crazy adventure.

"I am going to beat you at this meeting!" Sam shouted.

But then he hit a banana peel. I zoomed past him and crossed the line first. I won the big race!

Me and my best friend Leo were playing outside. We found a map in the dirt and discovered a big red X.

"We have to go straight to the old tree!" Leo shouted.

We ran fast and bounced over a log. Suddenly we saw a deep hole sounding like a monster was inside. It was scary but we are brave. I jumped over the hole and landed on the grass. Leo jumped too because he is a champion jumper. We found a shiny box in the grass.

"We did it!" I yelled. "Our training worked."

The mission was complete and we opened the box. It was full of gold chocolate coins. We ate them all before dinner.

My math homework was hard and my brain felt tired. I chewed on my pencil and looked at the clock. Lunchtime was neared and I was so hungry. Finally the bell rang and everyone started running. I grabbed my lunchbox and saw my friend Billy approaching. He was bringing a huge bag of chips for lunch.

"Do you want some chips?" Billy asked me loudly.

"Yes please!" I said and took a big handful.

We sat down and I told him about my homework. He tried coaching me on the math problems. He tried to explain how to add big numbers. We had to search for the answers together. But then recess started and a storm brewed outside. We had to stay inside and play board games instead. It was still a fun day at school.

My robot Zog was acting very weird today. He usually helps me with my homework on the computer. But this morning he was making a strange sounding noise. Zog scratched his metal head and looked confused.

"My circuits are toasted!" Zog grumbled loudly.

My neighbor Mrs. Green was coaching her cat outside. She saw Zog spinning around in the yard. His parts were scattered everywhere on the grass. It was a very messy scene.

"Is that robot growing bigger?" Mrs. Green asked me.

Suddenly Zog turned purple and started floating. He said he had an important mission on Mars. Then he zoomed away into the sky. I guess I have to do my own math now.

It was the final level of Super Alien Jumpers. I pushed the buttons really hard and my hands were sweaty. My big brother Tom was leading by five points. He always wins but I had a guarantee to beat him today.

"You are going to get roasted!" Tom yelled at me.

I moved my character past the floating rocks and jumping aliens. I caught a power-up star and zoomed ahead. I feared the big boss monster at the end. It was sounding scary with loud roars.

"No way! How did you do that?" Tom asked.

I kept going throughout the whole level without dying once. I ate the last power crumb and beat the boss. It was a wrap for Tom. I finally won!

I drew a map on my old computer. It showed a secret cave where everything was hidden. My friend Sam and I grabbed our bags and left quickly. The weather was hot and sunny that day. We ran past the school and into the big woods.

"Listen! Do you hear that loud noise?" asked Sam.

I stopped and looked up at the blue heaven. A huge grey elephant was floating in the sky! It looked like a balloon pumping with air.

"I knew this was a magic forest!" I yelled.

We used my map as a guide to the cave. Inside, I found golden scissors on a rock. We took them and ran home fast. It was the best adventure ever.

I had so much homework last night. My mom made me sit at the table. I had to read a book about a brave knight. The knight had a shiny sword and a leather belt. He lived in a castle built of gray stone.

After I finished reading, I heard my brother in his room. He was playing his new red guitar very loudly. My dad was roaming the halls and looked annoyed.

"Turn that down right now!" my dad yelled.

My brother started groaning but he stopped playing. Then I saw a loose thread on my shirt. I pulled it and my button fell off!

"Oh no, now I have more work," I said.

I was tired but I finally went to sleep.

I had a really big math test today. It felt impossible because I forgot to study last night. My neighbor Billy was groaning loudly at his desk. He looked up at the ceiling and sighed. I tried to focus, but my stomach made a funny noise.

"Be quiet, please," said Mrs. Green in her strict voice.

"Sorry," I whispered back and then I drew a little cat on my paper.

Finally, the bell rang and we ran outside for recess. The wind blew hard and messed up my hair. I ate my snack until every crumb was gone. Then we played tag and I was roaming around the playground fast. I tagged Billy and shouted, "I am the champion!" My reign lasted until lunch when I dropped my sandwich. It was a good day anyway.

Max and I went into the dark woods. We were on a big search for the lost treasure. My heart was pumping so fast because it was scary. We kept walking and I saw a tiny gnat flying around. Suddenly a big hole appeared in the ground!

"Watch out!" yelled Max.

I stopped just in time but I was scared. We looked down and saw something white. It was not treasure. It was a lost baby lamb stuck in the mud. Getting it out looked impossible.

"We have to help it," I said.

Max grabbed a stick and I did too. We were jumping down carefully. We pulled the lamb up and it was safe. Following the map was fun but saving the lamb was better.

My class went outside for recess and the breeze felt nice. We wanted to play tag but Billy had a ball. He was wearing his new red shoes.

"Let's play kickball instead!" Billy yelled.

Everyone grinned and we made two teams. My team had eight kids and the other team had seven. I grabbed the big red ball to pitch. Unfortunately, I kicked it too hard and it went over the fence.

"What happened?" asked Sarah.

"I think we lost it," I said.

We started to search but we couldn't find a sign of it. Then the teacher blew her whistle. My team was beating the other team anyway. We heard cheering from the other playground because they found our ball. We spread out and ran back inside to listen to a story. It was a fun day.

One sunny morning, Tim and I walked into the dark forest. We were pretending to be a brave knight and his helper. Suddenly, we heard a weird groaning noise behind a big rock. I grasped my stick sword tight and we looked around carefully.

"Maybe it is a dragon," whispered Tim very quietly.

"Or maybe it's just a lost lamb," I said back.

We found a secret cave with a stone fountain inside. The water looked cool and pleasant, so we drank some. It gave me lots of energy like Dad's morning caffeine. We had to maintain our courage to receive the treasure. It was a pleasure to find a gold coin there! We ran home fast to tell Mom about our big adventure.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old hospital. We heard a scary noise coming from the basement door. Sam looked at his computer watch and it was blinking red.

"Something is wrong down there," Sam said quietly.

We walked through the dark hall and saw a big bug. It looked like a giant gnat but way bigger. I feared it would bite us, but it just sat there. I almost crushed it with my boot. Then the gnat started speaking in a tiny voice!

"Please complete the quest," the bug said to us.

We had to learn the meaning of the secret code. It was very important to help the bug get home. We pressed buttons and opened the magic door. We did it!

I got to school early today because my mom had work. The playground was empty and I was roaming around by myself. I saw my friend Sam approaching the swings.

"Do you want some company?" I asked him.

"Yes! Let's swing really high," Sam yelled.

We were pumping our legs hard and earning a good view. Later it was lunchtime and I was so hungry. My sandwich tasted weird and chewed like rubber.

"What is that smell?" Sam asked me.

"It smells like stewed carrots," I said.

I drew a cool design on my napkin instead of eating. School is often fun but sometimes the food is gross. I can't wait to go home.

I was dreaming about climbing the big red slide. Mrs. Miller was talking, but I was looking through the window. It was sunny outside, and I was yearning for recess. I had a loose thread on my shirt. I pulled it, but it kept hanging there.

"Please pay attention, class," Mrs. Miller said loudly.

I got scared and sat up straight. I paid attention then because I wanted a gold star. Earning a star meant no homework tonight. The bell started sounding, and everyone jumped up.

"Race you to the swings!" my friend Leo yelled.

We ran outside, jumping over cracks in the sidewalk. I scratched my knee, but I didn't care. I understood math, but recess was way better. I ran fast and felt happy.

I was playing baseball with my neighbor, Sam. It was super hot like a jungle outside. We were swinging the bat really hard. Sam hit the ball and it drove right into the bushes.

"Oh no! It’s trapped in there," Sam yelled.

I ran over but I froze near the green leaves. I feared there were spiders keeping guard inside. I was yearning to just go inside and eat a toasted bagel. But I reached in carefully. My arm got twisted on a branch.

"Stop moaning and grab it!" Sam shouted at me.

I felt a tickle in my nose and let out a big sneeze. I thought I saw a bug, but I grabbed the ball. We won the game!

We were walking in the forest and we found a cave. It was dark and I heard a groaning sound inside.

"I think a monster is in there," said Timmy.

We saw a knight standing there with his shiny sword. The knight greeted us and told us to be careful. We walked deeper and suddenly saw a stinging bee flying around. I was trembling because I am scared of bees. We ran fast and crossed a wooden bridge over water. The water was fast and a log was floating by.

"Look out for the hole!" yelled the knight loudly.

We jumped over it and we were clinging to a rope. We finally found the gold box. It was the greatest treasure in the world. Fourteen people were cheering for us when we got home. Colonel Smith gave us medals for being brave.

I woke up early because my dog jumped on me. He barked loud and licked my face. I got dressed fast and ran downstairs for breakfast. My dad was reading the newspaper and drinking coffee.

"Hurry up or you will miss the bus," he spoke.

I ate my toast and grabbed my big red backpack. At school, we had a really hard math test. Everyone was moaning because the problems were so tricky. But then it was finally recess time!

We played kickball and the ball bounced over the fence. The wind blew hard and my hat went floating away. I ran to catch it and I was earning points for being fast.

"You are the fastest runner ever!" my friend Sam yelled.

It was a good day even with the hard math.

I thought today was going to be a total failure. I forgot my lunch box on the kitchen counter. My stomach growled like a monster during math class. I counted the minutes until the lunch bell finally rang. I walked to the cafeteria with a heavy weight in my chest. 

Then my best friend Sam opened his big lunch bag. He grabbed a huge bag of chips and smiled.

"You can have half my sandwich," Sam said nicely.

I was so grateful and thrilled to see that sandwich. It was peanut butter and jelly, which is my favorite. We obtained some juice boxes from the cafeteria lady too. I felt stronger after I ate the yummy food.

"Thanks for bringing extra food today," I told him.

Then we ran outside and bounced the red ball. We struck the wall with the ball and laughed. I remembered that having good friends is the best thing ever.

My cat Fluffy was sleeping on the very high shelf. He looked like a white cloud near the ceiling. I put on my red sweater because it was cold. I wanted to get him down carefully.

"Come down, Fluffy!" I yelled loudly.

He did not move at all. He is a heavy cat with lots of weight. I had to explain my plan to my mom. I stood on a plain wooden chair. I reached up high. Fluffy jumped right into my arms!

"Yay, you caught him!" my mom said.

Everyone was cheering for me. Then Fluffy ran away to sleep under the bed. Cats are so silly.

Me and my nephew Tim went to the big mountain. We were looking for a magic fountain. The path was steep and scary. We heard a loud groaning sound nearby.

"Run fast!" I shouted to Tim.

We ran until the trees cleared. A big bird flew over our heads. It was bearing a shiny gold key. We kept running and turned left. Neither of us stopped for a break. The groaning noise was growing louder.

"Look there!" Tim said.

We saw the magic fountain glowing blue. We did not see the monster either. We were safe and drank the water.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house. The weather was nice and there was a cool breeze. My dog Max was running fast and smelling everything. Suddenly I heard a loud thumping noise by a big tree.

"Max, come here!" I shouted.

Max ran over to me with his tail wagging. We looked down and saw a rabbit. Its leg was twisted in a vine. It looked scared and its heart was beating fast. It was trapped and could not move.

"Don't worry bunny," I said softly.

I pulled the vine and the rabbit jumped away. It was happy. Max barked and we walked home. Later I saw Max sleeping on the rug. He was tired from our big adventure.

I was playing my new video game called Space Racers. My dad bought it for me yesterday because I did my chores. In the game, you race fast cars on a foreign planet. The ground looked like the earth but it was purple. I had to climb a big mountain with my car.

My friend Leo was watching me play. "You are going too slow!" Leo shouted at the screen.

"I knew that already, stop coaching me!" I yelled back.

Suddenly my car disappeared off the edge of the track. I crashed and the game made a loud noise. Leo started moaning because he wanted a turn. I pressed the restart button really fast. I was going to win this time for sure.

My birthday was the best day ever. We went to a small island on a boat. The water was blue and I saw a fish floating. My dad caught the fish with his big net. I was afraid it would bite me but it didn't. We made a fire and my mom stewed some yummy soup. 

Then my friend Sam started jumping around like a crazy frog. "Look out, a monster is approaching!" Sam yelled loudly. 

"Don't complain, it's just a bug," I said to him. 

We played on my new computer later that night. We played a game where a pirate stole all the gold. It grew dark outside but we had enough light inside. I was so tired I fell asleep on the floor. It was a really super fun birthday.

I was steering my bike down the bumpy hill. My dog Max was running with me for company. We were going to the big oak tree. It has a huge root like a vein in the ground. I bumped over it and almost fell off!

"Watch out for the bumps!" I yelled at Max.

He just wagged his tail and greeted a squirrel. The squirrel ran up the tree really fast. We sat down to eat our snack. I had a toasted cheese sandwich to wrap up my lunch.

"This is the best spot for a meeting," I said.

Max barked at me like he was coaching me. We stayed there until it was eight o'clock. The grass was growing tall around us. We go there often because it is our secret place.

We were going camping for my big brother’s birthday. Dad was loading the sleeping bags into the van. Mom was dumping lots of snacks in a bag. 

"Did you pack everything?" Dad asked.

"I think so," I said. 

We drove for a long time to the woods. We set up the tent and then made a fire. Dad roasted marshmallows for us. I spread chocolate on a cracker. It was so sticky and yummy. 

Suddenly we heard a loud noise in the bushes. I thought it was a scary ghost! I started running to the tent. 

"Wait, it's just a bunny," my brother laughed.

He was right. A small bunny was following us. We made a cool design with stones around the fire. Then smoke got in my eyes and it was stinging. We slept outside and had the best time leaving the city.

One day I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I was looking for bugs because I wanted to be a champion bug catcher. The leaves were scattered everywhere on the ground. Suddenly I saw something huge and green jumping near a log. It was the biggest frog ever! I walked carefully so I wouldn’t scare it.

"I am going to seize you, Mr. Frog!" I whispered.

My friend Leo came running over and he was very loud. The frog got scared and jumped into the floating green stuff in the pond.

"You messed it up, Leo!" I told him.

Leo said, "Sorry, but look at this cool stick I found. It looks like a sword for a knight."

We forgot about the frog and started playing knights. Mom called us for dinner because we need protein to grow big and strong, especially after exploring.

I was playing my new video game about climbing a big mountain. It is very dangerous because you have to jump over rocks. My character grasped the rope tight. I needed to search for the golden key to win.

"Look out for the lava!" shouted my brother.

"I know!" I yelled back.

My hands were shaking a little bit. I thought I was going to lose. Then the screen lit up bright green. I found the key! My character hung onto the ledge and climbed up. Neither of us blinked. Gradually the boss monster came out. I drank my soda for fake caffeine power.

"You have to remain calm," my brother said.

I hit the buttons fast. I won the game! It felt better than painting a picture. We jumped up and down.

I sat at my desk and looked at the ceiling. It was the middle of February and school was boring. Mrs. Jones told us to listen to her story. But I thought about recess instead. I drew a picture of a monster with a huge thumb. My friend Sam looked at my paper and laughed.

"That monster is so ugly!" Sam whispered to me.

"Be quiet or we will get in trouble," I said.

The bell rang and everyone scrambled to the door. We ran outside to check out the snowy scenery. Neither of us wanted to go back inside. We counted the minutes until lunchtime. I was certain that today was the longest day ever. We grew very hungry waiting for pizza day. I tried to maintain a straight face but I giggled.

My dad drove us to the dark woods for camping. I was a little afraid because the trees were huge. We set up the tent immediately. Suddenly we heard a loud roar sounding like a monster. 

"Did you hear that?" I shouted.

"It is impossible for monsters to be here," said Dad.

But then a big shadow struggled to get through the bushes. It was a bear! We ran to the car very fast. The bear sang a low growl at us. My dad could not contain his fear. We drove away and we were thrilled to be safe. It was a crazy adventure.

I went exploring in the woods with my dog Max. We walked for a long time and saw a fountain. The water was sparkly like a big blue jewel. Max barked at it and then he started digging. Suddenly a tiny squirrel appeared from a hole. Max tried to chase it but he was too slow.

"Come back here Max!" I yelled very loud.

We sat down and ate lunch on the grass. I had a sandwich and Max had some roasted chicken. It was especially good because we were so hungry. We saw fourteen ants marching on a newspaper. Then we decided to go boating on the little pond.

"Don't fall in the water," I told Max.

He was good at everything except sleeping in the boat. We had fun and I want to learn to row better.

I was running late for school again today. My mom screamed that we did not have enough time. I grabbed my bag and we drove very fast past the scenery. When we got to school, I remembered my lunch was on the table! It was too late to go back home to get it.

At recess, my friend Billy bounced a big red ball to me. He saw I was sad and asked me what was wrong.

"I forgot my lunch and now I am super hungry," I said.

Billy smiled and stuck out his tongue at me. Then he opened his bag and appeared with a big apple.

"You can receive half of my sandwich or this apple," Billy said.

I took the apple and we played longer than usual. I was happy I didn't have to choose either being hungry or eating yucky cafeteria food.

Me and my friend Sam went boating on the lake. We saw a huge mountain with a spooky castle on top. The sun was hot and my skin felt scorched.

"I am tired of rowing!" Sam grumbled loudly.

"Stop trying to complain," I said. "We are almost there."

We climbed up the rocks and heard a loud whistle. A colonel in a green uniform ran out screaming at us. He was coaching a big dragon. The dragon was growing bigger and breathed fire. It made a black stain on my shirt!

"Run away!" I yelled.

We ran back to the boat fast. The weight of the oars felt heavy but we rowed hard. We had enough adventure for one day.

The old house looked scary and dark. My friend Leo grinned and pulled out his pocket knife. It wasn't sharp, but he felt brave. We crawled under the fence surrounding the yard. I counted to three and we ran to the door.

"Is anyone waiting inside?" asked Leo quietly.

"It is impossible to know," I whispered back.

Suddenly we heard a loud whistle from upstairs. We jumped and started bumping into each other. Then something crashed in the hallway! We saw a weird painting on the wall. It was moving. We screamed and ran outside fast. We crashed into the grass and laughed. It was too scary for us today.

On Wednesday, I had a big soccer game. I was the captain of my team. We played the Tigers and they were very fast. The ball escaped from my foot and rolled away. I searched for it but I couldn't find it.

"Pass it to me!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball hard and it went through the goal. I was thrilled because we were winning now. Then I grasped my water bottle and drank a lot.

Suddenly, a dog crawled onto the field! He looked like a sailor because he had a blue hat.

"Get that dog off the grass," the coach grumbled.

I realized the dog just wanted to play too. Seeing him run was funny, but we had to finish. We won the game and had a team meeting after. It was better than science class!

My brother and I were playing the new soccer video game. It was the final match and I needed to win the jewel cup. I picked the team with the most strength and speed. My brother picked the team with the blue jerseys.

"You are going to lose this time!" I yelled loudly.

"Neither of us has won yet," he said back to me.

The game started and my player grabbed the ball fast. I ran down the field and jumped over a defender. Unfortunately, the goalie caught the ball in his big hands. I was trembling because the clock was ticking down. I drank some water like it was a magic fountain. I needed energy and maybe some protein too. I remember pressing the red button really hard.
