My player kicked it with all his weight. It went right into the goal! I won the game without any trouble.

My brother and I were playing a new video game. It was about camping in the jungle. The loading screen took forever, so we waited.

"I bet I will win this time," my brother said.

"No way, I practiced all day yesterday," I told him.

The game started and my character ran fast. I saw a big elephant near the river. I grasped the controller tight because I was nervous. My score grew higher and higher. It was a wonderful feeling to be winning. Suddenly, my brother let out a huge sneeze! He threw his controller on the floor by accident. My character jumped into a boating race and won the gold medal. I grinned at him because I finally beat him.

My neighbor Jake and I climbed on the big slide. It was recess and everyone was cheering for the kickball game. I wanted to play but Jake wanted to pretend.

"I am a brave knight!" Jake yelled at me.

"I am the captain of the castle!" I yelled back.

We reached the top and looked down at the playground. Suddenly, I saw a dog run onto the field. He started to gnaw on the red kickball.

The gym teacher almost fainted when he saw it.

"That dog has fourteen spots," Jake said.

We didn't know whose dog it was either. The dog ran away fast. We slid down the slide and laughed. Recess is the best part of school.

We went to the beach for my big birthday trip. I stood on the sand and looked at the water. My dad pretended he was a brave sailor on a boat. Although it was sunny, my little sister grumbled about the heat. We hung our towels on a big rock to dry.

A seagull flew over us and tried to steal my sandwich! My mom brewed some ice tea and we ate lunch. I had a yearning to find a secret treasure island.

"Let's go look for gold!" I yelled to my dad.

"Okay, but don't go too far," he said back.

We searched near a big sand mountain and climbed up it. Then I heard a funny noise. It was just a crab. We didn't find gold but it was the best day.

My birthday party was going to be the greatest. I invited my best friends over for a sleepover. We ate pizza and then we played hide and seek. I searched under the bed and in the closet. I found Sam behind the blue curtain.

"You found me!" Sam yelled and laughed.

Then we decided to play a video game. I gripped the controller very tight. I wanted to be the champion. I pushed the buttons fast and my character jumped high. I won the level and it said complete on the screen.

"Wow, you are so good at this game," my friend Tim said.

My mom came in with a big cake. She paid for it at the store. Everyone sang happy birthday to me. I have a lot to learn but I love birthdays. It was the best day ever.

My robot named Zork crashed his spaceship on a weird island. He was not very good at science. He twisted his metal leg when he fell out. I ran over and touched his shiny arm to help.

"Are you okay, Zork?" I asked him loudly.

Zork looked at me and grinned with his metal mouth. "My gravity boots are broken again," he said.

I had to be honest with him. He needed more coaching on how to fly. We scrambled up a hill to find food. We roasted some blue alien apples over a fire. We ate eight of them! We didn't leave either of the cores behind. I tried to explain how to fix his ship. Next time I will drive instead.

My family went on a big holiday to the lake. We stayed in a tall house with a giant balcony. On the first day we went boating on the water. I discovered a cool spot where the ducks were floating. My brother grumbled because he was hungry and wanted lunch.

"This is the best spot ever!" I screamed happily.

"I just want a sandwich," my brother said.

Later we saw people doing a bungee jump off a bridge. It looked so scary because of the weight on the rope. I was breathing super fast just watching them! At eight o'clock we had a family meeting about dinner. We greeted my cousins who came to visit us too. It was a really different and fun day.

My dog Barnaby is very silly but he is nice. Yesterday he ran outside and it was freezing cold. He saw a squirrel near the big fountain. Barnaby barked and the squirrel screeched loudly. It was scared of him.

"Come back here right now!" I yelled at him.

Barnaby didn't listen and he chewed on a stick. My mom says Barnaby needs to learn better manners. She was reading the newspaper on the porch.

"He doesn't understand danger," Mom said to me.

I think Barnaby has a yearning for adventure. He finally came back inside and jumped on me. I caught him and hugged him tight. Now he is sleeping on my bed. I think I need to study dog psychology to help him. He keeps bringing mud into the house.

My friends and I went boating down the big river. We saw a huge green jungle and a tall mountain. Suddenly we saw a shiny box hanging from a tree.

"Look at that treasure!" I screamed to my friend Sam.

We stopped the boat and climbed up the muddy bank. A monkey jumped out and tried to grab the box. We ran fast but the monkey was very quick. Sam threw a roasted peanut and the monkey stopped to eat.

I opened the box and saw lots of gold coins.

"We are going to be rich!" Sam said loudly.

But then we heard a loud roar behind us. A tiger was watching us and looking for trouble. We ran back to the boat and kept it steady. We got away just in time with the gold.

I was walking to the water fountain after recess. I was very thirsty because it was hot outside. I pulled my water bottle out of my bag. Suddenly I saw something weird on the floor. It was Mrs. Miller’s favorite red marker! I scratched my head. Mrs. Miller feared losing that marker. It disappeared yesterday and she was sad.

I picked it up and ran to class early. A tiny gnat flew in my face but I kept running. I opened the door and screeched, "Mrs. Miller! I found it!"

She looked up and smiled big. "Oh thank you! I can wrap my gift now."

She was making a card for Mr. Miller. Neither of us knew it was just under the fountain. I felt happy to help my teacher.

The weather was bad and a storm brewed outside. My friend Tim and I were yearning for adventure. We escaped my house and ran to the spooky woods. We were jumping over logs and thumping on the ground. Suddenly we discovered a dark cave near the big river.

"Let's go inside," said Tim with a scared face.

"Okay but be careful," I said back to him.

We went in and saw a giant bear sleeping. He looked like he stewed in anger even while sleeping. Then he woke up and roared loudly at us. We ran away fast without dumping our backpacks. We disappeared into the trees before the bear caught us. We were safe but we never went back there again.

I woke up at eight o'clock and I was late. I ran to school and I almost forgot my backpack. My teacher Mrs. Green was standing at the door. She looked mad but she smiled a little bit.

"You are late again, Tommy," she said to me.

I went to my desk and saw a big box. It was a present and it was bearing my name. I opened it and saw an incredible red car inside. It meant everything to me because I love cars. Then I heard the bell ring for recess.

"Can I take it outside?" I asked Mrs. Green.

She nodded and I ran out the door fast. I left my homework on my desk but I didn't care. It was the best day ever to receive a toy at school.

I was playing a video game against my big brother. The game was about running through a spooky forest. The scenery was dark green and scary. I tried to use psychology to win. I told him there was a spider on his finger. He looked down and I zoomed past him!

"Hey, that's not fair!" he yelled at me.

"I realized I had to trick you!" I said back.

My lead grew bigger and bigger. Suddenly my character pulled out a cool electric guitar. I crossed the finish line and the crowd cheered. My reign as the champion started today. Even though I like science class, winning games is way better. I drew a picture of my trophy later.

My dog Buster is fat because he eats too much. We went exploring through the woods behind my house today. Buster was moaning because he hates walking fast. I told him we had to keep to the schedule. Suddenly we saw a squirrel climb up a big tree. Buster crashed into the bushes to chase it. He jumped and almost hit his head on a branch ceiling.

"Come back here Buster!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and he tripped on an invisible root. He fell down carefully but he looked sad. The squirrel was gone. I gave Buster a roasted treat to make him happy.

"You are a good boy," I said to him.

He was grateful for the snack and wagged his tail. We walked home and I felt the weight of my backpack. I like nature science but Buster just likes food.

One sunny morning, me and my dog Buster went outside. We were playing in the woods behind my house. Buster loves company and wagged his tail fast. We saw a big tree perfect for climbing.

"Let’s go up there, Buster!" I said loudly.

I grabbed a branch but it scratched my arm. I ignored the stinging feeling and pulled myself up. Buster barked because gravity kept him on the ground. I saw a squirrel steering its tail like a rudder.

"You can't catch him!" I yelled down to Buster.

I grinned at my silly dog. I chose to sit on a big branch instead of climbing higher. I pulled a leather book from my pocket to read. It was nice seeing the birds complete their nests. We stayed until my mom called us for dinner. It was way better than following a schedule inside.

I was playing my new video game on Saturday. My character was running up a big mountain. It felt impossible to beat the boss at the top. I chewed my lip because I was nervous. My big brother watched me play and laughed.

"You will never win," he said meanly.

I knew I could do it if I focused. I dodged a single rock and jumped over fire. Suddenly, my character escaped the monster! It felt like a cool breeze hit my face. I touched the glowing treasure chest and won.

"I can't explain how you did that!" my brother yelled.

I felt grateful that I finally won level thirteen. It was not simply luck. I practiced a lot and gradually got better. I wasn't scared anymore.

My friends and I were roaming in the spooky woods. We were following a map my brother made. Suddenly, we heard a loud moaning sound behind a big tree. My heart started pumping super fast!

"It sounds like a zombie," whispered Max.

"Maybe it is just the wind," I said, but my finger shook.

We walked closer and the ground felt like it was moving. It was scary but we had to be brave. Being brave is important for our explorer league. Then a big brown dog jumped out! It wasn't a monster at all.

"That taught me a lesson," said Max with a smile.

We felt stronger and kept walking deeper into the forest. We thought we were the bravest kids in the world.

I had a math test today and it was super hard. My brain felt like it was floating away in space. I searched for the answers in my head but it was impossible. I looked at the clock and the time got longer and longer. I thought I was going to fail so I felt sad. Then I remembered something important about adding big numbers.

"Do you need help?" my teacher asked me quietly.

"No thanks, I think I got it now," I whispered back.

At recess, I built a huge castle in the sandbox with my friends. We were roaming around pretending to be knights. My anger about the test went away fast. Having good company makes everything better, even hard math tests. We ended the day painting pictures of our cool castle.

It was a super hot day at school. The sun scorched the playground and made the slide burn. I sprinted to the swings but they were twisted up high. My friend Tim was there and he looked sad.

"What happened to your lunch?" I asked him.

"I left my sandwich outside and it got toasted," he said.

We searched for a shady spot under the big tree. We discovered a cool rock that looked like a knight. It was about the height of my water bottle. We played a game with the rock for eight minutes. Then the bell rang and everyone started groaning. We had to go back to class for math. It felt like a foreign country in there because I didn't understand anything!

It was a cold day in February and I was wearing my thick blue sweater. My best friend Sam and I were boating on the lake. Suddenly, a giant silver robot started approaching us from the water! I was really afraid but Sam just grabbed his magic painting brush.

"Stop right there, robot!" Sam yelled loudly at it.

The robot made a buzzing sound and kept coming. It was leading a whole army of tiny green aliens.

"I am not scared of you!" I shouted back.

Sam started painting a giant wall right in the air. The robot crashed through it and fell backwards into the water. It made a funny noise like it was swearing in robot language. We rowed away fast before they could catch us.

I was walking in the woods and saw a light. It was a green alien sitting near a big rock. He was cooking something in a pot that smelled funny.

"Hello," said the alien with a strange voice. "I am making stewed moon rocks for my lunch."

I reached into my pocket and found a shiny jewel. I gave it to him because he looked hungry. The alien smiled and his eyes started glowing bright.

"This is growing very hot!" he yelled happily.

He ate the jewel and then he drove away in a spaceship. He paid me with a magic coin that makes me fly. I was grateful because now I can fly to school fast. It was enough magic for one day.

One day I was camping on a secret island with my robot dog. His name is Sparky and he is made of shiny metal. We started a fire and roasted marshmallows until they were toasted brown. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping sound in the bushes.

"What was that?" asked Sparky with his speaking voice.

I was scared but I grabbed my stick like a brave knight. A big green alien walked out and looked at us. He didn't look mean though.

"Hello sailor," the alien said to me.

He tried to explain that his spaceship broke. I decided to help him climb a tall tree to fix his antenna. We fixed it and he flew away fast. That is what happened on my vacation.

My brother Tim was having a big birthday party. Mom cleared the living room so we could play games. We scattered balloons everywhere and put up a sign. I was bearing the giant chocolate cake to the table. Suddenly, my foot struck a toy truck on the floor. I was afraid I would drop the whole thing! I scrambled to maintain my balance and almost fell over. Tim crossed his fingers and looked very scared. But I caught myself just in time.

"Phew, that was really close!" I shouted loudly.

Everyone started cheering for me because I saved the cake.

"Let’s eat before you drop it again," Tim said.

We ate the cake and it tasted super good.

My friend Leo and I went to the woods today. We wanted to find the greatest treasure ever. We walked for a long time on the rough ground. Leo pointed at a big dark cave.

"I bet the treasure is in there," Leo said.

We scrambled over big rocks and went inside. It was dark and scary but we felt stronger together. Suddenly, a bat started jumping around our heads! I scratched my arm on a wall. We ran out fast and disappeared into the trees. We realized there was no gold inside the cave.

"At least we are safe," I told Leo.

We looked up at the blue heaven above us. We were pleased just to be outside again.

It was my best friend Sam's birthday party. We were having a sleepover in his backyard tent. The weather was bad and it started raining hard. We zipped up the tent so we wouldn't get wet. Sam opened his presents and he got a cool toy car. 

Suddenly a giant black beetle crawled on Sam's sleeping bag! He screamed very loud and almost fainted.

"Get it away!" Sam yelled. 

I grabbed a cup and I caught the beetle. I put it outside in the grass. 

"It's okay, bugs have lots of protein," I joked.

Sam laughed and said, "I am not eating that either!"

Then my brother crashed into the tent wearing his pajamas. He was thirteen and wanted to scare us. We realized it was him and tackled him. It was a pleasure to beat him up with pillows. We stayed up late and told spooky stories.

Me and my friend Leo found a secret door. It was in the basement behind a big box. We went inside and it was very dark. The ceiling was low and we had to crawl. I felt something fuzzy and I got really scared.

"What is that?" Leo asked me with a shaky voice.

"I don't know but something is wrong," I said.

Suddenly we heard loud stamping noises coming closer. We started screaming and ran back to the door fast. Everything was dark but we saw a light. It was just my dad looking for us. Everyone was safe but we never went back. The quest was complete and now we play outside only.

Yesterday was my birthday and I had a huge party. I was wearing my new superhero shirt and feeling great. My friends came over and we played lots of games. We threw a ball around and then we played hide and search. It was hard to contain my excitement because of the cake.

"Listen to me!" my mom yelled over the noise. "We are going to cut the cake now."

Everyone started cheering loudly and ran to the table. My dad lit the candles and sparks flew everywhere. I counted to three in my head and blew them out.

"Did you make a wish?" asked my best friend Sam.

I nodded but I didn't explain what it was. We ate cake throughout the afternoon until my stomach hurt. I often wish my birthday was every day.

My hamster Fluffy escaped from his cage yesterday. My heart was pumping fast because the cat was looking at him. Fluffy ran behind the big blue couch. I was scared he would get hurt.

"Come here right now, Fluffy!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen to me and he kept running. I have a big imagination so I thought he was on a dangerous mission. Maybe he was yearning for a wild adventure outside.

My brother said, "He looks like he is bungee jumping off the rug!"

We finally caught him after thirteen minutes. I put him back in his cage. I am earning five dollars for cleaning his cage next week. I will buy him a new wheel instead of playing on the computer.

My dog Max is trained to be a spy dog. One day we ran through the woods behind my house. We were looking for a secret cave. Suddenly, Max stood very still and stuck out his tongue.

"What is it, Max?" I asked him.

He barked and pointed at a big bush. We pushed through the leaves and crashed into a hidden hole! It was dark and scary inside. We found a map on the floor, but we had to leave fast.

"We have to go home now," I said. "We are behind schedule for dinner!"

We escaped just in time. I tried to explain everything to Mom, but she just laughed. She didn't believe we were heroes.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were so excited. My mom toasted marshmallows for us in the backyard. We made s'mores and they were sticky on my thumb. Then we went inside to my room.

"Let's play spooky mountain!" my friend Sam screamed loudly.

We built a huge pillow fort that looked like a mountain. I drew a scary face on a piece of paper. We turned off the lights and I felt afraid. Suddenly we heard a weird moaning sound outside the door.

"What is that noise?" I whispered to Sam.

Sam followed me to the door and we opened it. It was just my dog Buster! He blew air out of his nose. He wanted a crumb of our snacks. We let him reign over the pillow fort like a king. I did receive the best present ever that night.

My younger brother Sam and I were playing a video game. It was a racing game with fast cars. We neared the finish line and I was winning. Suddenly, a weird dragon flew down onto the track. It breathed fire and scorched my red car.

"Hey! That is not fair!" I yelled at the TV.

Sam just laughed and kept running his car past me. My car froze on the screen. Then I found a secret tunnel behind a rock. Inside the tunnel there was a shiny blue jewel. The jewel gave my car super speed. It felt like electricity was in my vein.

"Watch out, here I come!" I shouted.

I zoomed past the dragon and won the race. Sam looked a little scared because I was so fast.

We were climbing up the rocky mountain. My friend Sam was beginning to get tired. He grumbled, "I am so hungry right now." I told him to keep going. We knew the secret cave was close. Suddenly we saw a big hole. We went inside carefully.

Water bounced off the walls from a fountain. It was dark but something shiny was there. It was the magic jewel! I grabbed it quickly. Then the ceiling started shaking. A big rock crashed down near us. We froze in fear.

"We have to leave!" I yelled.

We ran fast and went left. We escaped just in time. We did not seize the treasure, but we were safe. Next time I will bring a snack.

Yesterday was the best day at recess ever. The wind blew hard and shook all the trees. My friend Sam sprinted to the big slide first.

"I bet I can beat you there!" Sam yelled loudly.

I ran fast but then I tripped on a rock. My knee was stinging but I didn't cry. I got up and kept running to the monkey bars. I am really good at climbing them now. Then the wind swept a big piece of newspaper across the yard. Sam carefully picked it up and made a ball. We played catch until the bell rang.

"Oh no, I forgot my lunch," I said sadly.

But then I found a bag of chips. They were a little crushed but they still tasted great.

Yesterday me and my best friend Sam went exploring. We were seeing if the old woods were scary. We walked for a long time following a muddy path. The weather was hot and sticky. We found a giant stone wall with ivy growing on it.

"Look at that big fountain!" shouted Sam.

It was broken and dry but looked really cool. Suddenly I saw something shiny near the water. It was an old leather boot with holes. Then we heard a loud growl.

"Run away fast!" I yelled.

We ran back home super fast. My mom greeted us at the door. I told her we saw a bear but she laughed. She said seeing bears means grounding for a week. We ate fourteen cookies and felt safe again.

Me and my friend Sam went to the dark forest. We feared the big monster that lived there. It was a very hot day and the sun scorched our backs. We walked for a long time but Sam did not complain.

"Look at that big cave!" shouted Sam.

We saw a single red eye glowing inside. It was scary. We heard a loud swinging noise like a tail hitting rocks. We ran away very fast to maintain our speed. I scratched my leg on a bush but it didn’t hurt much.

"That was not pleasant at all," I said.

We made it home safe and ate ice cream. We are never going back there again.

My cat Fluffy is usually lazy, but today she moved fast. She saw a squirrel on the big oak tree and wanted to catch it. Fluffy climbed up the rough bark very high. I thought she looked like a brave knight fighting a dragon. But then she got stuck near the top branch.

"Come down, Fluffy!" I yelled loudly at her.

"Meow!" she cried back because she was in trouble.

My dad came outside seeing us looking up. He got the tall ladder and caught her gently.

"You have used up fourteen of your nine lives," Dad joked.

Fluffy just purred and ran inside to sleep again.

I was boating in space on my rocket ship. Suddenly, a big green alien ship started approaching me fast. I pushed a big red button and my lasers blew up an asteroid.

"Stop right there!" shouted the alien captain.

I drew my laser sword and greeted him. We had a sword fight throughout the whole ship. My heart was beating really fast. I used my superpowers and pushed him back. I was teaching him a lesson about messing with Earth. Finally, I won and became the galaxy champion.

"You are strong," the alien said. "I am grateful you didn't hurt me."

We became friends and flew away together.

I grabbed my controller and stared at the loading screen. My friend Tom greeted me on his headset. We were playing the new pirate game and it looked hard.

"We need to find the treasure on the island!" Tom screamed.

I gripped my controller tight and my hands were sweaty. We ran through the jungle but a monster bounced out. It made a scary sounding noise and I started moaning. It seemed impossible to beat him because he was huge.

"Use the magic sword!" I yelled back at Tom.

We fought the monster and it was really important. Although we were scared, we kept hitting him. Suddenly the monster fell down and we saw the gold. We won the game and it felt like real camping. It was a different kind of fun but very cool.

We went through the dark woods to find the lost treasure. My dog Buster walked next to me and he carried a heavy weight. We saw a big cave and heard something loud inside.

"Something is approaching us!" I yelled to Buster.

A big monkey screeched and jumped out at us. It looked very foreign and scary. I was trained to fight monsters so I was brave. I used my special sword with a dragon design on it.

"Run away now!" I shouted at the monkey.

The monkey was scared and it escaped into the trees. We went inside and found a box bearing gold coins. We were so hungry later so we toasted marshmallows by a fire. I learned that Buster is a very brave dog.

My neighbor Tim and I went climbing up the big hill. We wanted to see the science lab at the very top. Tim was my guide because he is older.

"I am freezing!" I said because the breeze was cold.

"Keep going!" Tim yelled. "My heart is beating fast too."

We jumped over a big rock and landed in mud. The scenery was mostly trees and gray rocks. I feared we were lost, but then we saw it. A dog ran out and started barking loud.

"Is that dog swearing at us?" I asked Tim.

Tim laughed and said, "No, he just had too much caffeine!"

We ran away fast. We didn't find the lab, but it was fun.

I ate my breakfast fast because today was the big adventure. My friend Sam and I went to the spooky forest. The scenery was green and dark and scary. We walked for a long time without seeing a single person. Suddenly we heard a loud noise like singing but bad. 

"Did you hear that weird sound?" asked Sam.

I was thrilled but also scared. Then a big monster jumped out! It was screaming loudly and running right at us. I picked up a rock and threw it hard. It struck the monster on the toe.

"Run away fast!" I yelled to Sam.

We ran until we reached the safe playground. We were safe but we never went back there.

I was sitting in my apartment and drinking hot chocolate. Suddenly my robot dog Sparky jumped up and hit the ceiling. He bounced off the wall and started steering himself around.

"Hey! Get down from there Sparky!" I yelled loudly.

Sparky just barked and his metal tongue stuck out funny. He drank my dad's coffee earlier and had too much caffeine. Gradually he stopped flying and landed on the floor. Then he disappeared because he turned on his invisible mode.

"Where did you go?" I asked the empty air surrounding me.

He licked my hand and I was grateful he was safe. I closed my eyes and heard my neighbors cheering outside. We often play games together with my super robot dog.

My younger brother Sam and I explored the dark cave. We walked for thirteen minutes and then we saw it. A big twisted root blocked the small tunnel. I pushed the root but it trapped my foot.

"Help me!" I yelled and I was feeling scared.

Sam moved closer and he pulled on the old leather boot. He pulled really hard and suddenly my foot was free. We kept walking and reached a big stone room. Something was approaching us from the shadows. It was just a tiny bat swinging from the ceiling.

"I thought it was a monster," Sam said quietly.

We found eight shiny rocks and felt like we won. We followed the path back home to receive snacks.

My dog Buster is very fast at running. Yesterday we went to a big green meadow. The scenery was so pretty with lots of flowers. I grasped his leash tight but he is getting stronger. Suddenly he saw a squirrel and pulled really hard! Unfortunately, the leash slipped out of my hand. Buster escaped and ran through the tall grass.

"Come back right now, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and he just kept chasing the squirrel. I had to run fast to catch him. Finally he stopped to smell a bush. I grabbed him.

"You are a bad dog," I grumbled at him.

We walked home and he was very tired. Tonight he is dreaming about squirrels. We will try again tomorrow.

We were roaming in the big woods behind my house. My dog Max was already sniffing a weird hole.

"Get back here, Max!" I shouted loudly.

But Max kept digging and I heard a strange noise. It was sounding like a angry bear or a monster. Suddenly a tiny bug flew right into my eye. It was just a little gnat but it hurt. Then the ground started trembling under my feet.

"Do you know the meaning of danger?" asked my friend Sam.

I looked up and saw a huge shadow approaching us. It looked stronger than ten men. I was trained to run fast so I grabbed Max. We ran throughout the forest and didn't stop. The monster was singing a scary song but we escaped. The monster’s reign of terror was over for today.

The jungle was very hot and full of bugs. My friend Tim and I were boating down the river. We were looking for the lost jewel of the monkey king.

Suddenly, we saw a big rock floating in the water.

"Look out! That is an alligator!" shouted Tim.

We paddled fast but the alligator swam fast too. I was scared. The alligator scratched the side of our boat. It made a loud sounding noise. We rowed for fourteen minutes until my arms hurt.

Then a big bird flew down and distracted the alligator. We got away! But then Tim felt something tickle his nose.

"I have to sneeze," he said.

"Don't do it or the alligator will come back!" I yelled.

We were safe for a little longer, but then we saw a cave. The adventure was not over yet.

I gripped the remote so hard my hands hurt. It was the greatest Mario Kart race ever. My brother Tom was winning but not by enough. Neither of us wanted to lose this race.

"I am going to seize the win!" I yelled.

Tom just laughed and threw a green shell at me. It bounced off the wall and hit him instead! I flew past him on the rainbow trail. My tires scorched the road because I was going so fast. I feared a blue shell was coming, but it didn't. I crossed the finish line screaming with joy.

"You got lucky," Tom said.

I could not contain my happiness. I finally beat him!

Me and my best friend Sam went to the woods. We were looking for pirate gold. I held the map and Sam held a big stick.

We walked straight for a long time. Suddenly a big dark cave appeared in front of us. The ground was all scorched and black.

"Do not go inside!" Sam yelled very loud.

"I am not scared," I said back to him.

We went in and saw shiny things scattered everywhere. It was real gold coins! We realized it was the treasure. But then a huge bear came out. It looked mad. We ran very fast back home. We treated ourselves to ice cream after that. We sent the map away in the trash can. It was too scary for us.

I was running away from the robot monster. He was huge and made of grey metal. He was approaching me very fast. I threw a heavy rock at him. It bounced off his head like a plain feather.

"You cannot stop me!" the robot yelled.

"Yes I can!" I shouted back at him.

I used my super strength to lift a big car. The weight was nothing for me. I tossed the car and it crashed on him. The robot was crushed flat. Unfortunately, he started beeping loudly. He was loading a laser beam. I grabbed my younger brother and we flew up high. We went way up into heaven. Everything looked small from the sky. We landed on a mountain to eat a protein bar. We were safe now.

Me and Sam went to the dark woods today. It was the beginning of our big adventure. The ground was cold and freezing. Sam gripped my arm because he was scared.

"Did you hear that sounding noise?" Sam asked.

I thought it was a bear, but I didn't know. Then I saw a huge beetle jumping on a log. It looked weird. I thought about my mom's psychology book. She says fears are just in your head.

"It is just a bug, Sam," I said brave.

We kept walking and found a dumping spot. Someone paid no attention to the rules. I found a blue comb there. We ran home fast before dark.

I was playing my favorite game with my friend Sam. We were racing to the big stone castle on the hill. It was a very important race because the winner gets a trophy. I chose the red car and Sam picked the blue one.

"I am going to beat you today!" Sam yelled loudly.

"No way, I am faster than lightning!" I shouted back.

My car flew over a big jump and spun around. I almost crashed into a tree but I turned fast. Sam was right behind me. Suddenly I heard a loud noise like a monster. It was my mom dumping toys in my room.

"Time for dinner, boys! I made beef stewed with carrots," she said.

I paused the game just in time. We grabbed our forks and a knife. The race would have to wait until after we ate.

My robot friend Zog likes to eat rocks. We climbed a big mountain on Mars yesterday. The height was scary but the gravity was low. We jumped really high off the ground!

Zog found a shiny blue rock near a fountain. "This looks yummy," Zog said.

He chewed the rock loudly like it was gum. Suddenly Zog grew very big and floated up. He lost all his weight! I had to grab his metal foot.

"Help me down!" Zog yelled.

I pulled him down, though it was hard. We went home and made a painting of the mountain. Zog promised not to eat blue rocks again.

We went boating on the big lake for science class. My friend Tim was dumping rocks in the water. We heard a loud thumping sound coming from the woods. A huge bear was approaching us very fast!

"Run back to the boat!" I yelled at Tim.

"I can’t lift the anchor’s weight!" Tim shouted back.

The bear was swinging its big paws at a tree. Not a single person knew what to do. Then the bear stopped and looked at a beehive. It just wanted honey to reign over the forest. We got in the boat and rowed away fast. It was the scariest day ever.

Me and my friend Tom went on a big search. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure on skull island. I was wearing my lucky red hat. The wind was so cold it felt like freezing ice. We walked for a long time across the plain grass. Suddenly a giant gnat flew right at Tom’s face!

"Get away from me!" yelled Tom and he swatted it.

We kept walking and saw a dark cave. It looked scary but we went inside anyway. Inside there was a big gold box that was closed tight. I remembered the key was in my pocket. I opened it and saw so much gold it looked like heaven!

"We are rich!" I shouted.

Tom was so happy that he almost fainted. I pinched him to make sure I wasn't dreaming. It was the best adventure ever.

We were camping deep in the jungle last summer. My brother Max was steering our little boat down the river. Suddenly we saw a giant cave opening in the earth. We parked the boat and started approaching the dark hole.

"Look at that shiny thing!" Max yelled loudly.

It was a glowing blue rock that hung from the ceiling. We tried to squeeze through the rocks to get it. Then my phone started ringing really loud. It was scary because we had no service.

"Maybe it is an alien computer," I whispered.

Just then the blue light disappeared and it got dark. We ran back to the boat fast. We finished loading our stuff and left. We never found out what the rock was.

Last weekend my family went boating on the big lake. My brother pushed me into the water and I sank down fast. I swam up and I was so cold.

"Hey stop it!" I yelled at him really loud.

He just laughed and started jumping off the side too. We swam for a long time and then we got hungry. My mom made sandwiches but she put too much cheese on them. I had to squeeze my sandwich to make it fit in my mouth.

After lunch we saw a man doing a bungee jump off a bridge. It looked super scary. Then we followed a duck with baby ducks. I fell asleep on the boat and woke up groaning because I was sunburned.

"Put some lotion on," my dad said to me.

It was a fun day but my back hurts now.

It was taco Tuesday and lunch was my favorite time. I sat with Tommy and we looked at the schedule. We had math next and I simply hate math. Tommy opened his lunchbox and his face turned green. His juice box had crashed and spread all over his sandwich. 

"Oh no, my juice threw up everywhere!" Tommy yelled.

"It looks like a purple monster chewed it," I said.

The lunch lady came over to help with the cleaning. She told us to hurry because recess was starting. We ran outside and my heart was thumping hard. We played tag and I escaped from the person who was "it." I was breathing fast but it felt good to run. I did not want to go back inside. I wish recess could reign forever, but the bell rang too soon. We walked back to class very slowly. I know tomorrow will be better because it is pizza day.

We were playing Knights and Dragons at recess today. Timmy was the guard near the big slide. He was bearing a stick like a sword. I was a brave knight in training. "You cannot pass this mountain!" Timmy yelled loud. He was stamping his feet on the wood chips. I ran past him bumping his arm. I discovered the water fountain was the magic castle. Everyone was yearning for a drink because it was hot. Then Sarah started screaming because she saw a bee. "Run away fast!" Sarah shouted at us. We all ran back to class together. It was enough running for one day.

The sun scorched the playground and the blacktop was hot. I sat on the bench yearning for a cold drink. My stomach was groaning because it was almost lunch time. I drew a silly face on my hand with pen. Then I counted all the kids playing tag near the swings.

"Pass the ball over here!" yelled my friend Sam.

I stood up and scratched my knee where it itched. My heart was beating fast like a drum's rhythm. I picked up the red ball and threw it high. Gravity pulled it down right into Sam's waiting hands.

"Nice throw!" he shouted back at me.

I thought about earning a gold star in math later. Mrs. Green was teaching us adding and I was getting better.

I was teaching my nephew how to play kickball at recess. He is only five but he runs super fast. We were on the big field and the sun was hot. Suddenly the ball went flying into the scary woods.

"I am not going in there!" yelled my nephew.

I sighed and walked to the trees to find it. The leaves were scattered all over the muddy ground. I looked for thirteen minutes but I saw nothing. Then I saw a shiny blue thing like a jewel. It was just an old candy wrapper.

"Did you find it?" he asked me.

"No, it is gone to kickball heaven," I said.

We went back to class when we heard the knock on the door. It was the teacher with our ball! I felt like I could bungee jump with happiness. We play there often now.

I was playing my favorite video game about boating. I was wearing my lucky hat and yearning to win. The game was loading really slow, so I grumbled. Finally, my boat was following the big red ship. I squeezed the controller super hard.

"Don't crash into the rocks!" my brother yelled at me.

"I know what I am doing!" I shouted back.

Suddenly my boat flew in the air and landed on the ground. I discovered a secret shortcut behind a big tree. I swam my boat fast to the finish line. I won the race and didn't have to go to the hospital in the game.

"Next time I am beating you," said my brother.

We had a meeting about who plays next.

I trained for the big race all week. It was at summer camping and I wanted to win. My friend Sam said it was dangerous but I wasn't scared. I sprinted fast and I ran past the big tree. Then I threw a water balloon at the target to complete the obstacle course. 

"You are going too fast!" yelled Sam.

"I am going to win!" I shouted back.

I jumped on the bungee trampoline and bounced high. I felt like a superhero flying in the air. I crossed the finish line first and everyone cheered for me. Then I was very hungry so I ate a hot dog. I read the camp newspaper later. It said I was the fastest runner ever. I can't wait to race again tomorrow.

My friend Tim and I woke up very early. It was a cold Saturday in February. We wanted to find the lost treasure in the woods. We put on our big coats and ran outside.

"Look at that big mountain!" Tim yelled loudly.

We climbed up the hill and the path cleared. Suddenly, a big dog jumped out at us. It looked like a monster but it was nice. I grasped Tim’s hand because I was scared.

"Maybe the dog is a knight guarding the gold," I said.

The dog grabbed a stick and ran away fast. We kept walking and found a shiny box. I held it tight and used my brain to open it. It was already empty! We laughed and went home for lunch.

Yesterday I played a big video game with my brother. We had to find a golden elephant in the jungle. I searched everywhere for it but it was super hard.

"Where is it?" I screamed at the TV screen.

My brother laughed and he threw a virtual rock at me. I felt anger because he was winning the game. I heard a loud noise and saw my character bumping into a tree. Then I saw something shiny under a newspaper on the ground.

"I found it!" I said and used my knife to dig.

It was not the elephant but it was a magic comb. I thought the game was broken so I turned it off. We did not complete the level but it was still fun.

I was so excited for the big soccer game today. I am the captain of my team, the Tigers. My mom was bringing my lucky red socks. But then I saw a giant purple stain on them! My dog Buster chewed them up and they looked terrible. I was so mad I stewed about it all morning.

"I can't play without my lucky socks!" I screamed.

"They are just socks, you will be fine," said Mom.

The sun scorched the grass on the field. The game was longer than usual and very hot. I kicked the ball hard and scored a goal! It was an incredible shot right into the net. We won the important game even without my socks. I guess I don't need them to be a winner.

My brother Max and I woke up very early today. We wanted to be the greatest explorers ever. We packed our bags and moved quietly outside. Max brought his toy sword because he is trained to fight monsters.

Suddenly we heard a loud noise tearing through the bushes. I was scared but Max was thrilled.

"Do you think it is a dragon?" I whispered.

Max turned around and said, "Get your rope ready to wrap it up!"

We saw a shadow growing bigger and bigger. We jumped out and yelled! But it was just a tiny white lamb. It looked lost so we took it home. It was the best adventure.

On Wednesday, me and my friend Max went on a big adventure. We found a dark cave behind the school playground. Max feared the dark, but I did not. We scrambled over some big rocks and reached the opening. Inside, shiny coins were scattered all over the floor!

"Wow, look at all this gold!" Max shouted.

Suddenly, a giant spider jumped down to guard the treasure. I threw a rock at it, and it ran away. Max grinned and tried to seize a handful of coins. Then the ground shook, and we lost gravity for a second. We floated up!

"Let’s get out of here!" I yelled.

We swept up some coins and ran back outside fast. That was just the beginning of our fun day.

My cousin and I were playing a dangerous new video game. We picked the jungle level because it looked scary. My player was roaming around looking for bad guys. Suddenly a big creature jumped out and I started trembling.

"Watch out for the green monster!" yelled my cousin.

I grabbed my controller tight and my hands were sweaty. My character threw a rock but the monster twisted away. Then the gravity got weird and I started floating up. I was clinging to a tree branch so I didn't fly away.

"You are going to get roasted by his fire!" he laughed.

But I found a special sword with a secret meaning. I hit the monster and won the level fast. My little nephew watched us play in our apartment. It was the best game ever.

My neighbor Tim and I went to the spooky mountain. It was the beginning of our big quest. We saw a cave and crawled inside carefully. The ceiling was very dark and scary.

"Look at that shiny thing on the ground!" Tim screamed.

I grinned and walked to the shiny gold rock. Suddenly a big bear jumped out. The scene was super scary.

"Run away fast or it will be a failure!" I yelled.

We ran out and escaped the bear by jumping over logs. We felt stronger and brave. The height of the mountain was huge but we were safe. We went home and had snacks.

One day I went to the zoo with my dad. We paid for tickets and walked inside. I saw a huge gray animal roaming in the grass.

"Look at that big nose!" I said.

My dad laughed and told me it was an elephant. Suddenly we heard a loud noise sounding like a trumpet. The elephant was approaching the fence fast! I thought it escaped from its cage.

"Run away!" I screamed.

But the elephant just wanted some peanuts. It was incredible to see up close. Later we saw seals and they swam in blue water. It was the best day ever.

I thought today was going to be a normal day. I ate my breakfast and ran to catch the bus. But then I saw something weird in the school yard. It looked like a lamb, but it grew really big!

It struck me that maybe I was still asleep. I froze and just stared at the animal. Then my friend Tommy reached over and poked me.

"Is that a sheep?" Tommy asked me.

"To be honest, it looks like a monster," I said.

Suddenly the animal started running toward the jungle gym. We crawled under the slide so we wouldn't get caught. I counted to ten and peeked out. The animal was gone! It was so strange. Then the bell rang and we had to go receive our homework. I hope nobody asks me about the giant lamb.

I was walking home from school and I heard a loud knock. Suddenly a big green ship appeared right on the grass. The door opened and a robot walked straight out. He was holding a glowing rock that lit up the whole street. I had a really bad feeling and I was scared.

"Take me to your leader on Earth," the robot spoke.

"I don't know who that is!" I screamed back.

Then a little alien came out steering a floating chair. He looked like a king ready to reign over us. I almost fainted right there on the sidewalk. But then my dog barked and they got scared and escaped back into the sky.

I have a robot named Sparky. He is made of shiny metal and bounced around my room. Sparky loves science and speaking about space. One day, Sparky found a big painting of a blue alien. He was afraid because the alien had three eyes.

"Don’t be scared, Sparky," I said. "It is just art."

Sparky beeped and held up a soft feather. He tickled the painting and we laughed for an hour. Then we tried to climb the bookshelf to see the stars. Sparky fell down, though. He did not break. He said he knows robot psychology, so he felt happy again fast. Being friends with a robot is the best fun ever.

One Wednesday in February, me and my friend Sam went exploring. We walked up the big mountain behind my house. It was very steep and the height was scary. We wanted to find the secret magic fountain at the top.

"Look at that cave!" Sam shouted at me.

We went inside and it was dark and cold. Suddenly we heard a loud whistle sound. It was a giant bear guarding the water! We ran fast and cleared the path to get away.

"That was too close," I said.

We didn't find the fountain but earning our safety was important. We went home to play a game on the computer instead. The game was loading slow but we didn't care. It was better than getting eaten by a bear!

I was running in the woods behind my house. The leaves were growing big and green on the trees. I saw a weird bug floating near a flower. I started to look closer at it.

"Don't touch it!" yelled my brother Sam. "It is a stinging bee!"

I pushed him away playfully. "I want to learn about it."

Sam drew a picture of the bug in the dirt. We watched the bee spread its wings. Suddenly, a big dog came approaching us fast. It crushed the dirt picture with its paw.

"Who is bearing down on us?" I asked.

The dog sniffed my shoe. It looked hungry. I had some stewed beef in my pocket from lunch. I gave it to the dog. He ate it and gravity pulled him down to sleep. We made a new friend.

My dog Barnaby loves riding in my dad's truck. He sits in the front seat like a furry person. We were driving to the park for a picnic. The breeze felt nice coming through the open window. It was a beautiful sunny day for exploring outside.

Barnaby put his paws on the wheel like he was steering. Dad laughed and said, "Look at Colonel Barnaby driving us!"

I laughed too and Barnaby barked at a squirrel. We finally got to the big green park. Mom was waiting for us by the swings with lunch. She played her guitar and everyone sang songs. Then Barnaby chased a ball and brought it back again. He is the best dog in the whole world.

We were having a huge sleepover for my birthday. All my friends came over early to play. We crawled into my fort made of blankets. It was dark inside and we felt a little scared. Then my brother jumped out and screeched loudly! We were trapped inside and he was laughing.

"Stop it, you are being mean!" I yelled.

He grinned and said, "I knew you were scared."

My mom came in bearing a tray of snacks. She taught us how to make shadow puppets together. We stayed up late and had too much caffeine. I love keeping secrets in our fort and telling jokes. I had a funny feeling in my tummy from growing too fast. It was the best birthday ever.

I brought a toasted cheese sandwich for lunch today. It is usually my favorite food to eat at school. But today I discovered something very bad inside my lunchbox. The cheese was cold and it tasted like rubber.

"Ew, this tastes gross!" I said to my friend Sam.

Sam looked at my sandwich and stuck out his tongue. "I guarantee my mom packed me something better," he said.

He had scrambled eggs in a thermos, but he chewed loudly. It was not a pleasant sound to hear while eating. I decided to eat my apple instead. After lunch, we played soccer and Mr. Jones was coaching us. It was a pleasure to score a goal finally! Then the bell rang and we ran back inside.

I was playing my favorite car racing video game. My hands gripped the controller super tight. I wanted to be the champion of the whole world. My car was blue and looked like a painting.

"Go faster!" my brother yelled at the screen.

I pressed the button and my car zoomed to the left. I swept past the red car and took the lead. I felt thrilled and started jumping up and down. But then my car crashed into a wall. It was bad.

"Oh no! You lost your speed," my brother said.

I remembered a trick and used a boost. I spread my fingers out to seize the win. I crossed the finish line first! I was so grateful. My mom said I had too much energy like I had caffeine. I tried to maintain my cool, but I was bearing a huge smile.

One day my friend Leo and I went on an adventure. We walked deep into the jungle to find a lost treasure. Suddenly, a huge wind blew and the trees started shaking. We heard a loud ringing noise near a big cave.

"What is that scary noise?" asked Leo.

We crawled inside the dark cave and saw a baby elephant! His foot was stuck under a heavy rock. I felt sorry for him so I grabbed a big stick. Leo and I pushed the rock and threw it away. The elephant was so grateful and happy. He picked us up with his trunk. We were swinging in the air and laughing.

"This is the best day ever!" I shouted.

We didn't find the gold treasure but we were thrilled anyway. We made a new friend and that was better.

I was in my treehouse doing a science project. My nephew Billy was helping me mix green slime. Suddenly a big purple ship landed in the yard. Leaves scattered everywhere and the tree was trembling. An alien came out and he looked hungry.

"Do you want some toast?" asked Billy loudly.

The alien made a weird moaning sound.

I ran to the kitchen and toasted some bread. I already brewed some hot chocolate too. We gave the food to the alien and he ate it fast. He smiled and got back in his ship. He was leaving but he waved goodbye first.

"That was cool," I said to Billy.

We went back to making slime.

We were roaming through the old woods near my apartment. My friend Leo pushed a big branch out of the way. We were looking for the haunted shed.

"Did you hear that groaning sound?" Leo asked me.

"Maybe it is just a ghost," I said bravely.

We crossed a small river and reached the creepy shed. It had a weird design on the door. I saw something roaming inside! A bat flew out and we screamed. We ran until we saw thirteen stairs. We climbed them and were safe.

"That was scary but fun," Leo said.

My dog chewed on a stick and wagged his tail. We felt like we were meeting a real monster today. It was a very different adventure than usual.

My best friend Sam came over to my apartment for a sleepover. We decided to bake cookies for my mom because she was sad. I grabbed the big bowl and scrambled some eggs inside.

"Where is the butter?" Sam asked me.

"I think it is near the scissors," I said.

We found the butter and used a dull knife to cut it. We mixed it all for an hour. The smell went throughout the whole kitchen. We put them in the oven but we forgot the timer.

Suddenly, smoke blew out of the oven! The cookies were totally scorched black. My mom ran in and saw the mess.

"Are you boys okay?" she yelled.

We nodded. She laughed and showed us the receipt for pizza. We ate pizza instead and used our imagination that the burnt cookies were moon rocks in a meadow. It was the best night ever.

I was playing a soccer game and I really wanted to win. My friend Sam was on the other team and he is fast. I ate a protein bar before the game for energy. I chewed it quickly but I got a stain on my shirt.

Suddenly the ball appeared right in front of my feet. I ran fast like a breeze and kicked it super hard. It cleared the goalie's head and went right into the net! It felt like finding a shiny jewel.

"Did you use your hands?" Sam asked me and looked mad.

"I promise to be honest, I didn't touch it," I said.

I tried to explain but he just walked away to comb his hair. I was happy because I got to seize the win!

My best friend Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to stay up late, but my mom had a schedule. We went to the basement because it was freezing down there. Tim said, "Maybe a ghost lives in your ceiling." I laughed and said, "Neither of us believes in ghosts!"

We started painting pictures of monsters and aliens on big paper. Suddenly, the lights went out and we both got scared. I thought about scary stories and almost fainted right there. Tim shined a flashlight and caught me hiding under a blanket. He counted to three and then jumped out to scare me. We laughed so hard that my throat felt scorched. Mom came down and checked us for pneumonia because we were cold. Then we went to sleep and dreamed about foreign lands.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday party yesterday. We went to a big park with giant slides. Everyone held their presents and waited for Sam to open them.

"This is the best party ever!" yelled Sam loudly.

Sam’s mom told us we could play a new game. We followed her to a big bouncy castle. It looked simply amazing and we all jumped inside. I tried to do a single flip but it was a failure. Sam pretended he was doing a bungee jump off the side.

After that, we sat down for cake and reading cards. Sam got treated like a king and felt very special.

"I hope I don't get pneumonia from sweating!" I joked.

The party was complete when we ate all the cake. I am waiting for my birthday to come soon too.

For my birthday party I invited my best friend Sam. We were turning eight on the same day which is weird. We started running in the backyard and swinging on the big swing.

"Watch me go super high!" Sam yelled at me.

We played tag together until we got really tired. Then we went inside for pizza and cake. My mom said I have to maintain my room clean. But we made a mess with all the toys again.

"I am not sleeping on the floor," said Sam.

So we put our sleeping bags on my bed. Seeing my friend happy made me happy too. It was the best birthday ever.

On Wednesday, my dog Buster and I went exploring outside. We walked to the big woods surrounding our house. Buster started sniffing and then he ran off fast. I had to run and search for him everywhere. Then I heard him screaming near the old creek.

"Buster, where are you?" I yelled really loud.

"Woof! Woof!" he barked back from a deep hole.

He had crashed into a ditch and struggled to climb out. The dirt was too slippery and wet. I tried to pull him, but I wasn't strong enough. I needed help fast. I blew my loud whistle three times. My dad came running.

"Don't worry, we are loading him up," Dad said.

We cleared away some branches with scissors. Then we pulled Buster out and left for home. He was safe!

Yesterday my friends and I went to a scary island. We took a small boat and the water was rough. Suddenly a big wave hit us and I fell out! I swam really fast to the sandy ground. I was clinging to a rock because I feared the sharks. My friend Tom grabbed my hand and pulled me up.

"Are you okay?" Tom asked with his eyes closed tight.

"Yes but I lost my backpack," I said sadly.

We walked into the jungle and heard a loud noise. It sounded like a mad elephant roaring in anger. The sound was growing louder and louder. We ran away fast but vines caught my leg. I used my scissors to cut them and we escaped. It was the best adventure ever!

Me and my best friend Sam played a cool video game together. It was called Jungle Racer and it had fast cars. We picked the level with the big green trees. It looked like a real jungle with monkeys everywhere.

"I bet I can beat you this time," Sam said.

"No way, I am the best driver," I told him.

The race started and I pushed the gas button hard. My car jumped over a huge river like we were boating. But then Sam grabbed a power-up and went super fast. It was like he had zero gravity! I tried to catch him but I couldn't contain my car. I pulled the controller back but I crashed into a rock. Sam won every single race that day. I believed I could win, but he was too good. Maybe I need some coaching from my big brother. Next time I will win everything!

I was so excited for recess today. I sprinted outside and my friend Sam was there. We wanted to play chase but first we ate our snack. My mom packed me a bar with lots of protein. It tasted okay but it was very chewy. 

"Let's go play on the big slide!" Sam yelled.

We ran over but everyone was bumping into each other. I saw a kid clinging to the ladder because he was scared. I understood why because it is very high up. 

Suddenly, I felt something in my pocket. It was my small safety scissors from art class! I forgot to put them away. I ran back to the teacher and gave them to her. She smiled at me.

"Thanks for being honest," she said.

Then I went back to play and seize the day. We pretended to bungee jump off the swings until the bell rang.

It was my birthday sleepover and everyone was so excited. We built a huge fort in the living room using blankets. But then my dog Buster ran right through the middle! 

"Oh no! We are trapped!" yelled my friend Jake. 

We simply laughed and started fixing the walls again. It was freezing outside, so we were happy to be inside. Later, we had a dance contest in our pajamas. I moved to the rhythm of the music like a champion. Unfortunately, Jake tripped on a pillow and fell down. 

"Are you okay?" I asked him, leading him to the couch. 

He was fine, but he struggled to get back up. Soon we were all sleeping in our cozy fort. We ended up leaving the mess for the morning because we were too tired. It was the best birthday ever.

I had the greatest sleepover ever last weekend. My best friend Sam came over and we met in my room. We moved my bed so we could see the ceiling better. We put glow stars all over it.

"Look, that one is falling!" Sam yelled loudly.

We caught the star before it hit the floor. Then we started loading up on snacks. My mom said no caffeine but we drank soda anyway. Later my stomach was groaning so loud.

"I think I’m growing a monster inside," I said.

Sam believed me and got scared. It was a funny scene. We stayed up all night talking. It was the best night.

I was walking in the woods and I saw a robot. He looked sad and he was searching for something. I walked carefully up to him and touched his arm. Suddenly a green light appeared and he started jumping up and down!

"Thank you for touching the button!" the robot beeped loudly.

"You are welcome, but what do you eat?" I asked him.

He said he needed a special protein bar from Mars. It seemed impossible to find one but I had a granola bar. He ate it and made a wonderful buzzing sound. He was very grateful and greeted me with a high five. Then he zoomed away into the sky. I hope he stays out of trouble in space.

My friends and I had a big sleepover last Saturday. We were wearing our matching pajamas with blue stars. We wanted to build a huge pillow fort in the living room. It looked like a giant mountain of blankets and pillows.

"Put that cushion over here," said my friend Sarah.

"Okay, but hold it steady or it will fall," I said.

I feared it would crash, but it stayed up. We bounced inside and pretended a tiny gnat was a monster. But then my brother came in and jumped on it. Everything fell down and went wrong! We were mad at him, but then mom brought pizza. We ate the pizza and built the fort again.

We went camping for my brother’s big birthday. He turned thirteen today and he was very bossy. We were climbing a big hill and my legs hurt.

"Hurry up you slow turtle!" my brother screamed.

I grumbled because he was bringing way too much stuff. His backpack was huge and heavy like gravity was pulling it. Suddenly we saw a squirrel and my sister screeched loudly. The squirrel ran up a tree very fast.

"Stop making noise or we won't see bears," Dad said.

We finally got to the top for our meeting spot. We ate cake and it was squished but tasted good. I like camping but I don't like climbing big hills. Next time I am staying in the tent.

My friends and I went climbing up the big green hill. We wanted to find a secret cave near the top. Sam said he saw a single red light there last night. We walked for a long time and my legs grew tired. Suddenly, we discovered a dark hole in the rocks.

"Do you think an alien lives inside?" asked Sam.

I wrote a note in my notebook for science class. We heard a loud noise and something screeched at us. A weird creature was approaching fast with a long blue tongue! It looked very foreign and scary.

"Run away before it eats us for protein!" I yelled.

We ran back down and then we roasted marshmallows at home. That was the scariest adventure ever.

Yesterday was the best day at school. It was freezing outside, but we still went to recess. My friend Sam had a big plan for us. We were going to build a snow mountain.

"We need more snow!" yelled Sam loudly.

I started steering a giant snowball across the playground. It got super heavy, although I kept pushing it hard. We worked throughout the whole break to make it huge.

Suddenly, the teacher blew her whistle immediately. That meant recess was over.

"We can finish it tomorrow," I said to Sam.

We are in a snow fort league now. We didn't finish the mountain, but it was still fun. I was so tired after school.

My younger sister had a birthday party on Saturday. Mom woke us up early and moved the big table outside. The breeze was nice and cool in the yard. My sister was thrilled because all her friends came over. They ran around and threw balloons at each other.

"Stop running near the cake!" Mom yelled loudly.

I brought out the presents and counted them all. There were ten big boxes sitting on the grass. Suddenly, the dog crashed through the decorations. He was bearing a muddy stick in his mouth.

"Oh no, look at the mess!" I grumbled.

We crawled under the table to catch him. My sister laughed so hard she cried. Then Mom found a needle and popped a balloon by mistake. It was the best party ever.

I was eating my breakfast when my dog Max escaped. He ran right out the door and into the woods. I felt anger because I wanted to watch cartoons. I grabbed my shoes and scrambled after him.

Max was hanging around an old building made of wood. It looked scary but I used my imagination. Maybe it was a castle for bears?

"Max! Come here right now!" I yelled loud.

He shook his fur and barked at a squirrel. He did not listen to me at all.

"If you don't come, I am leaving!" I shouted again.

Finally he ran back to me. I paid him with a treat when we got home. Next time I will lock the big door tight.

Yesterday at recess I was swinging super high on the swings. My shoe almost flew straight off my foot! I jumped off and started running to the slide. Then I saw a weird sign near the bushes. It said "Do Not Open" but the wind blew it over.

"What is in there?" asked my friend Sam.

"Maybe it is a secret treasure," I said.

We opened the big box and a hamster escaped! It ran fast like it was scorched by fire. We searched everywhere for him. We finally found him cleaning his face under a bench. We drew a map to find his cage again. The teacher used a thread to fix the cage door so he would stay inside. It was hard to contain him because he was wild. It was the best recess ever.

I was at recess playing tag near the big building. Suddenly a huge gnat appeared right in front of my face. It looked like an invisible monster but I could see it. I twisted my body to get away from the bug.

"Get away from me!" I screamed very loud.

My friend Leo ran over to guard me from the bug. He gripped his lunchbox like a shield and struck the air. The sun scorched our backs because it was super hot outside.

"Did it bite you with a stinging tail?" Leo asked.

I was jumping up and down because I was scared. The bug flew away and disappeared into the trees quickly. We did not want to make a big scene. We went back to class to wrap up our math homework.

My nephew Ben came over to help with homework. He is in high school and drinks lots of caffeine. I struggled with my math and started moaning.

"This is like climbing a huge mountain!" I yelled.

Ben laughed and scratched his head. "It's just numbers, though."

We worked for eight minutes and then I got hungry. Mom made me a sandwich and it was toasted. I discovered a pickle inside and stewed about it. I hate pickles! I threw the pickle through the air.

"Watch out for gravity!" Ben shouted.

The pickle hit the floor with a splat. It was in danger of being eaten by the dog. I started groaning because now I had to clean it up. Homework is the worst.

I was wearing my favorite blue sweater at recess. It is very soft and warm. I saw a loose thread on the sleeve. I started pulling it just a little bit. The thread grew longer and longer. Suddenly, I heard a loud rip! The hole rose up my arm fast. Oh no! I knew my mom would be mad.

My friend Sam ran over to me.
"Did you break your sweater?" he asked loudly.
"Yes, I think I ruined it," I said sadly.

I was yearning for the bell to ring. Then I could hide it in my backpack. I heard a knock on the playground door. It was time to go inside for math. I hope nobody sees the big hole.

Max and I walked to the old spooky house. We knew nobody lived there anymore. The door was closed but I gave a loud knock.

"Hello? Is anybody home?" I yelled very loud.

Nobody answered so we went inside the dark room. It smelled like someone brewed old tea. Suddenly we saw a giant rat gnaw on a chair. Max started stamping his feet and jumping around.

"Look at that scary rat!" Max screamed at me.

We ran into a room that looked like a science lab. There was a big machine with a steering wheel. A sharp needle pointed to red. We were scared so we ran back outside fast. We are never going back there again.

My neighbor Sam came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to go camping in the backyard. My dad helped us set up the big tent. It took a lot of strength to hammer the stakes. Then we played a computer game inside the tent.

"This is good training for the wild," Sam said.

We pretended the garden hose was a dangerous snake. We made a trail with glow sticks to the house. Suddenly my zipper got stuck and I was trapped!

"I can be your guide!" yelled Sam.

He used a tiny needle from a sewing kit to fix it. We stayed up late talking about school tomorrow. It was the best sleepover ever.

One day my friends and I went to the spooky forest. We heard a loud noise and we were scared. It sounded like a monster but we kept walking. Suddenly a giant bird flew down and screeched at us!

"Run away fast!" shouted my friend Timmy.

The bird had a beautiful blue feather on its head. It blew a big wind at us and we almost fell. I grabbed a stick and threw it at the bird. It broke on a tree but the bird got scared.

"That was impossible!" I screamed happily.

We feared the bird would come back so we ran home. My mom greeted us at the door. I thought we were safe but then we heard a knock. It was just the pizza man. We ate pizza and had fun.

It was February and it was freezing outside. My dog Max and I went for a walk on the trail. It started raining a little bit, but we kept walking. Max was sniffing a big pile of leaves. I thought he found a squirrel.

Suddenly, Max ran into the bushes and disappeared! I got scared because there might be danger in the woods.

"Max! Come back right now!" I yelled really loud.

I neared the bushes and my heart was pumping fast. I heard a noise like a bell ringing. It was Max's collar. He was just dumping dirt on a bone he found.

"You are a bad boy, Max," I said.

He looked happy. We walked home and he fell asleep fast. He was sleeping all night.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover last Saturday. We planned to stay up all night and guard the snacks. Sam’s mom brewed some hot cocoa for us, though it was super hot. We spread out our sleeping bags in the living room. Suddenly, we realized the bag of chips was gone!

"We have to seize the thief!" I shouted loudly.

We looked everywhere and discovered my dog Buster in the corner. He had his head inside the bag. I screamed because it was so funny. Buster believed the chips were just for him. The bag did contain a lot of crumbs now. Our plan was a total failure, but we laughed anyway.

"Bad dog!" Sam said, but he petted Buster’s head.

We grabbed a newspaper to clean up the big mess. Next time, we will keep the snacks up high.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for the lost fort. Sam was steering his bike fast and I followed him. We went through a big bush and got scratched. Then we heard a loud noise.

"Did you hear that?" I asked Sam.

"It sounded like a bear!" Sam yelled back.

We dropped our bikes in a cleared spot. We saw an old man in a green coat. It was Colonel Jenkins from down the street. He was coaching his dog to sit. They were eating roasted marshmallows by a tiny fire.

"Do you want some?" the Colonel asked us.

"Yes please!" said Sam.

We sat on pine needles. The needle poked my leg but I didn't care. We turned around and went home before dark. It was a good adventure.

One day I was running in the woods with my dog Max. He loves to chase squirrels and run fast. We climbed over a big log and touched some moss. Suddenly Max stopped running and started trembling. I saw something sharp in his paw like a needle. It was a big thorn stuck deep inside.

"It’s okay Max," I said. "I will help you."

I tried to pull it but I didn't have enough strength. I realized we had to go home. We walked back slowly bumping into bushes. My mom got the scissors and some tweezers. She told me it was important to hold him tight. I gave Max a big squeeze and she pulled it out. He barked and then licked my face. He escaped from the house and wanted to play again!

Yesterday I went on a big adventure in space. I was leading my robot dog Sparky to Mars. The scenery was all red and dusty rocks. Suddenly, a big green alien came approaching us fast! He looked very mean and had twisted horns.

"Stop right there!" the alien shouted at us.

Sparky started groaning and his metal tail was shaking. I grasped my laser blaster tight. I was certain we were in big trouble. Then the alien pointed at a scorched rock. It was actually a painting of a flower.

"I am just cleaning my art," he said nicely.

I was so grateful he wasn't going to eat us. We helped him scrub the rock until it shined. Sparky barked happy beeps and we flew home for dinner.

I was in big trouble today at recess. My friend Sam saw a shiny green beetle on the grass. He tried to pick it up but I yelled, "Stop!" I told him that beetles are trained by the army. Sam just grinned and said, "You are silly."

Then the beetle crawled onto my shoe. I shook my leg and it flew away. We played tag throughout the rest of recess. At lunch, I had a sandwich but the jelly kept leaking out. I had to squeeze it hard to eat it. My tummy grumbled because I was still hungry. I wished I had an elephant to eat my crusts. Later, I crossed my arms and waited for the bell. I hope I don't need the hospital for a tummy ache!

Me and my neighbor Tim were playing a new video game. It was about climbing a huge mountain and finding treasure. We trained our characters to be stronger and faster.

"I bet I can get to the top first," Tim said.

"No way, my brain is way smarter at puzzles," I told him.

We started jumping over rocks and running through caves. Suddenly, my character slipped and dropped his sword. I grabbed a new one quickly. Tim was keeping ahead of me, but then he got stuck. A giant bird spread its wings and blocked him! I ran past him and kept going. Seeing the top made me happy. I won the game!

It was raining very hard outside my house. My friend Max came over for a secret mission. We thought there was a treasure in the backyard. We put on our boots and ran outside fast. Max was bringing a big shovel and a map.

"Dig right here next to the big tree!" I yelled.

We dug through the mud for a long time. Suddenly my shovel hit something hard and metal. We pulled out a shiny gold box. We obtained the treasure! Unfortunately it was just a single old toy car.

"I think my dad lost this last year," Max said.

We got caught in the rain but we were happy. Maybe we can find real gold tomorrow.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark forest. We wanted to find the lost treasure chest behind the big rock. We walked for a long time and my leg got scratched by a bush.

Suddenly, a giant gray elephant jumped out! I thought elephants only lived at the zoo.

"Run away fast!" yelled Sam.

I grasped Sam’s hand and we ran behind a tree. The elephant looked scary, although he was actually very nice. He greeted us with a happy trumpet sound. Then a tiny gnat flew on his nose and he sneezed loudly. We often play in the woods, but this was the best day. We did not find gold, but we made a new big friend. We went home because my mom has a strict dinner schedule.

I was climbing a big tree in the park. My younger brother Sam was steering his toy car on the grass. Suddenly I saw a tiny bird on a branch. It looked hurt and scorched from the hot sun. I thought it needed help right away. I carefully brought it down to show Sam.

"We have to take it to the animal hospital," Sam said.

We ran home to get a box and some water. My mom got a needle and thread because the wing was torn. She used tiny scissors to cut a bandage. The bird drank some water and looked happy.

"You are the greatest helpers," Mom told us.

We felt very grateful that the bird was safe. We especially liked saving animals.

I was daydreaming in class about finding treasure. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking, but I was roaming in my head. I drew a big pirate map on my notebook. Suddenly, Mrs. Miller stopped talking and looked right at me.

"Are you listening, Tommy?" she asked very loudly.

"Yes, Mrs. Miller," I said, but my face went red.

My thumb was covered in blue marker from my drawing. At lunch, I sat with my nephew, Billy. We traded snacks because I wanted something different. I did not receive any cookies, and neither did he. We ate sandwiches and left not even a crumb. Then the bell rang for recess, and everyone started groaning. I hate when lunchtime is over so fast!

We were playing video games in my basement. It was freezing cold down there but I didn't care. I was earning lots of points in the racing game. My friend Sam was losing and he started swearing.

"Hey stop speaking like that or my mom will hear!" I yelled.

Sam just kept playing and his face turned red. A big vein popped out on his neck. He opened a new level but I was still winning. I discovered a secret shortcut near the hanging bridge. I drove my car right through a tiny thread of space.

"No fair! You touched my controller!" Sam screamed loudly.

He sounded really mad and jumped to his full height. He looked for something to throw and grabbed some scissors. I ran away longer than I ever ran before. I am never meeting him for games again.

My friends and I found a huge, scary cave today. We wanted to measure how deep it went inside.

"I will go first!" shouted my friend Leo.

We sprinted into the dark and it smelled like old dirt. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping noise coming closer. We were scared so we hid behind a big rock. A giant bear walked by and we held our breath. It was dumping berries on the ground to eat.

"We have to get out of here," I whispered.

We fought our fear and ran back to the light. We crossed a small river and climbed a tall tree. We grinned because we were safe and it felt like heaven. We didn't receive any treasure but we paid with our bravery. It was the best adventure ever.

I ate my breakfast fast because today was important. My big brother Tom said we could explore the dark caves. I feared the caves, but I wanted to be brave. We started walking and soon we neared the big mountain. The trees surrounding us were huge and spooky.

Tom was steering us toward a tiny hole. "Do not remain here alone," he said.

I nodded and pushed my way inside. It was very dark. Suddenly, I saw something shiny on the ground! I thought it was earning gold, but it was just an old wrapper.

"Is that treasure?" Tom asked.

"No, just trash," I said sadly.

We walked deeper and gradually saw a light. We found a secret exit! I was so grateful we were safe. It felt impossible, but we did it.

I sat on the edge of the fountain. It was freezing cold but I didn’t care. My robot dog Sparky was acting weird. He pulled at his leash and started barking at a big green beetle.

"Stop it, Sparky!" I yelled. "It's just a bug!"

But the beetle started glowing bright purple. Suddenly, it grew huge like a monster! I was so scared my heart was beating fast. I feared it would eat us. Sparky jumped in front of me and shot a laser from his eyes.

"Take that!" I screamed.

The laser hit the bug and left a black stain on the ground. The bug shrank back down and ran away fast.

"Good boy, Sparky," I said. "That was enough excitement for today."

We went home even though we hadn't paid for our ice cream yet.

I have a pet rabbit named Fluffy. He is white like a little lamb. Fluffy has a very busy schedule every day. He eats his breakfast and then he hops around. One day I opened his cage and he flew out fast. He ran to the garden and scattered all the dirt.

"Come back here Fluffy!" I yelled loudly.

Fluffy was thumping his foot on the grass. He was happy but I was groaning. It is important to keep him safe inside. I ran and fell down in the mud. Fluffy hopped over and greeted me with a sniff.

"You are a bad bunny," I said.
