He often runs away but he is still my best friend. Then I picked him up and we went inside.

My friends and I went deep into the woods. We were yearning for a big adventure that day. The earth felt soft and wet under our boots. Suddenly, I saw a shiny thing in the dirt. It looked like an old, rusty knife.

"Look at this cool treasure!" I yelled loudly.

Sam grabbed my arm and pointed at a dark cave. We walked through the bushes and went inside slowly. It was cold so I put on my sweater. Then a bat flew out and it really scared us!

"Run away fast!" Sam screamed at me.

We ran back home and it was a pleasure to be safe. My mom taught me to stay away from caves. I grasped my pencil to write about our scary trip.

I woke up early because it was the big day. My brother and I were playing the new jungle video game. He picked the big green creature and I picked the fast tiger.

"I am going to win!" I screamed at him.

"No way, I practiced all night," he said back.

We started the race and ran through the trees. My tiger jumped over a log and pulled ahead. Suddenly a big monster appeared and tried to gnaw on my leg! I turned quickly and ran the other way.

My brother was stuck hanging on a vine. I counted to three and crossed the finish line first. It meant I was the champion! I ran to get a comb for my messy hair. I was so happy I won the game.

My best friend Ben and I walked to the old spooky house. We were thrilled but also a little bit scared. The scene looked scary because all the windows were broken. We feared that a ghost lived inside the dusty walls.

"Let's go inside," Ben whispered and his hands shook.

We crawled under the fence and scratched our knees on rocks. Inside the house was dark and it smelled really bad. Suddenly something huge landed right next to us with a thud! I started screaming and ran fast toward the door. Ben ran too and he dropped an old receipt. We counted thirteen steps to the gate and then fourteen more.

"That was too close!" I yelled when we were safe.

We never went back to that creepy house again.

My robot nephew named Beep lives in my apartment. He is made of shiny metal and old computer parts. One day he started sounding like a loud whistle.

"Are you okay Beep?" I asked him worriedly.

"I chewed on a wire," Beep said sadly.

He was bumping into walls and looking sick. I knew I had to take him to the robot hospital. The scenery outside was nice but we rushed fast. The robot doctor treated him quickly and used tape to wrap his tummy. He checked his schedule and used a ruler to measure Beep.

"You are all fixed now," the doctor said.

Beep was happy though he promised not to eat wires again. We went home and played games all night.

Yesterday was the worst day of school ever. I had to **write** a big story for English class. My teacher Mrs. Green said we had to **listen** carefully. She gave us a **guide** paper but I lost it. I **searched** my messy desk for a long time.

"Where is your paper, Billy?" Mrs. Green asked me.

"I think my dog ate it," I lied.

My stomach felt **twisted** up in knots. I kept **sounding** out words in my head. I looked **through** my backpack again. Finally I found the paper under a banana. It was all crumpled **though**. I **crossed** out my bad words and started over. I promised myself no **swearing** if I finished on time. The clock ticked loudly. Trouble **brewed** because recess was starting soon. But I finished just as the bell rang!

I simply feared my lunch box today. My mom brewed some weird tea and put it in a thermos. It smelled scorched and bad. I opened my sandwich and there was a giant red stain on the bread. It looked like a crime scene!

My friend Billy looked at my lunch and made a face. "Is that protein?" he asked.

"Neither of us knows," I said. I gave a thumbs down with my thumb.

Then the bell screeched loudly for recess. We ran to the swings and made a chain with our arms. Although I was hungry, playing was way better than eating. We often play tag, but today we just ran around speaking about video games. I hope my dad makes dinner tonight. He reads the newspaper and cooks pizza.

It was almost time for recess and I was staring at the clock. Mrs. Miller was talking about math but I wasn't listening. I gripped my pencil tight and waited for the bell. Suddenly a loud ringing sound started screaming through the room.

"Okay class, you can go outside now," Mrs. Miller said.

I ran to the playground and saw my friend Billy. We played a game about pirates on a big ship. I was the captain and Billy was a sailor. We grasped the monkey bars like they were ropes. My hands started hurting so I had to squeeze hard.

"Watch out for the sharks floating in the water!" Billy yelled.

Then the bell rang again and we were groaning loudly. It felt like recess needed to be longer. We walked back inside and I saw a loose thread on my red sweater. I pulled it and sat back down at my desk.

Yesterday at recess, me and my nephew Sam played on the big toy. It looks like a huge mountain made of plastic. Sam climbed up the twisted slide really fast. I moved slower because I had a heavy backpack. It felt like I was loading a truck.

"Hey, watch out for the lava!" Sam yelled loudly.

We pretended the wood chips were a hot island of lava. I jumped and felt like I was floating in the air. But then I landed funny and my ankle hurt. It spread up my leg a little bit.

"Are you in trouble?" asked the recess teacher.

I said no, but I limped back to class. My teacher was having a meeting about psychology or something boring. It was hard to contain my laughter though because Sam was making funny faces through the window. It was a good day even with a sore foot.

It was Friday and I was so happy about recess. But first we had art class with Mrs. Green. She was nice but she did not like noise. Everyone was roaming around the room and talking too loud. I needed the scissors to cut my blue paper. My neighbor Jack had them on his desk.

"Can I please use those?" I asked him nicely.
"No way, I need them for my scene," Jack said.

Suddenly Mrs. Green started approaching our table. I was afraid she would be mad. Everyone stopped talking to listen. She looked at Jack and me.

"Please treat the supplies better and share," she said.

I was glad she wasn't mad. Jack let me squeeze in to get the scissors. I feared getting in trouble but everything was okay again. Then the bell rang for lunch and we ran outside.

My homework disappeared right after lunch yesterday. I looked through my scattered papers, but it was gone.

"What happened to your math sheet?" asked my friend Leo.

"I simply can't find it anywhere," I said sadly.

We heard the bell sounding for recess, so we ran outside. I was bumping into kids because I was looking everywhere. My schedule said we had math next, so I was in danger. I needed more protein for my brain to think harder.

Suddenly, Leo called out, "Look under the slide!"

My paper was there, but it looked a little wet. I was so happy to receive it back, even if it was dirty. I won't wait any longer to put it away next time.

I walked to the secret island to find the treasure. It was raining really hard and my shoes were wet. Suddenly I saw a big robot made of gold. He was groaning like his tummy hurt.

"Are you okay Mr. Robot?" I asked him loudly.

The robot froze and looked down at me. He had a giant thumb that was glowing blue. He reached out and touched a rock. The rock turned into a beautiful cake!

"My magic is broken," the robot said sadly. "I am a failure."

I gradually walked closer and hugged his metal leg. He sold me the cake for a hug. It was the best treasure ever.

Me and my brother Max went camping in the dark woods. We walked throughout the trees and looked for a secret cave. My heart was pumping fast because it was scary. Suddenly we saw a big black hole in the rock. 

"I will go in first," said Max bravely.

"Be careful of the bats!" I yelled back to him.

We walked inside carefully and it grew very cold. Then a bat flew right at my head! I screamed loud. Max grabbed my arm and we ran out. We counted three more bats chasing us. We ran back to our tent and locked the zipper chain. We were safe but we never went back there.

It was a cold Tuesday in February. My teacher Mr. Smith said we had a big test. I was scared because I didn't study enough. Then the recess bell struck and we all ran outside. Me and my friend Sam found a giant black beetle. We watched it crawling through the grass near the fence.

"Look at him go!" Sam yelled while jumping.

"He looks like a climbing champion," I said back.

We pretended the beetle was finding treasure in the dirt. Suddenly we heard loud screaming from the swings. A girl got her shoelace trapped in the swing chain. It looked like she was bungee jumping upside down! The teacher helped her and she was okay. After recess we had to measure shapes for math class. I ended up earning a gold star on my work. It was way better than camping in the rain.

One day my dog Buster got loose in the big woods. We often walk there but he ran away fast. I yelled his name, but he didn't come back.

"Buster, where are you?" I shouted really loud.

The scenery was pretty but I was scared. I ran through the leaves and swept them away. I looked for his paw prints stamping in the mud. It felt like a foreign place because I was lost. I struggled to walk up a big hill.

Suddenly I saw a tail wagging behind a tree. It was Buster! He simply sat there and waited for me.

"You chose a bad hiding spot," I told him.

We ran home fast because we were late for our schedule. I gave him a treat and he was happy.

One day my nephew Tim and I went exploring early. We walked into the dark woods behind my house. We heard a weird noise like a groaning monster. Tim was scared but I was keeping him safe.

"Look at that big cave!" shouted Tim loudly.

We went inside and saw a fluffy white lamb. It was stuck behind a heavy rock. I used my thumb to push a button on my flashlight. We were steering the rock away carefully together. The lamb was so happy and grateful.

"We saved him!" I said and gave Tim a high-five.

We ran home fast before dinner time. It was the best adventure ever.

Yesterday was the best day at school ever. I wore my favorite blue sweater because it was cold. My teacher Mrs. Gable opened the big box on her desk. It had a shiny plastic jewel inside for the winner. We had to write a story about a king's reign. I tried hard not to spell any words wrong. 

"Time is approaching the end!" Mrs. Gable yelled loud.

I finished my story just in time. It was about a bird with a magic feather. Mrs. Gable read it and started cheering for me. I felt like I was steering a rocket ship!

"You win the jewel!" she said to me.

At lunch I ate a toasted cheese sandwich. My nephew is in first grade and he saw my prize. I looked at the ceiling and smiled big. I love winning prizes.

One day I was exploring the woods behind my house. I crawled under a big bush and saw a frog. He was sitting on a wet rock near the pond. The sun rose up high and it got really hot.

"Hello Mr. Frog," I said to him very quietly.

The frog looked at me but he didn’t jump away. I wanted to catch him for my science class. I moved closer though my boots got stuck in mud. My feet sank deep into the soft earth. I used all my strength to pull my boots out.

"Ribbit!" the frog said sounding like a grumpy knight.

He jumped into the water and started swimming fast. I closed my eyes and wished I was faster. I had a yearning to be a frog too. I went home dirty but happy.

I was wearing my new sneakers to school today. They are blue and make me run super fast. At recess, my friend Sam wanted to race me. We ran all the way through the big grass field. I was thrilled because I won the race easily.

Then the bell rang and recess was over. We walked back to class and sat down. My neighbor at the next desk had a surprise. He had a small box with holes in it.

"Look inside," he whispered to me quietly.

I looked and saw a shiny green beetle. It was crawling around and trying to squeeze out.

"Don't let him out!" I said back to him.

Just then the teacher walked by singing a song. She neared our desks but she didn't see anything. School is fun but it feels longer today. I don't want to do math homework either.

My nephew Sam came over to play video games. We played a game where aliens attack the earth. I was scared of failure because Sam is really good. My hands were freezing even though it was warm inside.

"You are going down today!" Sam yelled at me.

We raced through the first level very fast. Suddenly a huge monster blew fire at my character. I stopped breathing for a second. I feared I would lose. But then I jumped from a great height. I landed right on the monster’s head!

"Wow, I can't believe I am seeing this," Sam said.

I won the game and felt so happy. We ate pancakes for breakfast after because we were hungry. My mom showed us the receipt for the new game. It was the best day ever.

I had a lot of homework to complete for tomorrow. It was especially hard because my dog scratched my paper. I turned it over and wrote on the back. My mom said I had enough time to finish it.

"Do your math before you go camping," she said.

I looked at the ceiling and sighed really loud. I wanted to play outside before the sun went down. Suddenly, my friend appeared at the window and screeched my name.

"Can you come out and play tag?" he asked.

I shook my head because I didn't want a grounding. I had to receive a good grade or no camping trip. So I finished my work and then I ran outside. It was a good day.

One day I was walking near the big mountain. I saw a glowing blue robot sleeping under a tree. He looked very tired and his battery was low. I walked carefully so I did not wake him up. Suddenly he opened his eyes and beeped loudly!

"Do not be scared," the robot said to me. "I have an important mission to save the planet."

We walked together until we neared a magic fountain. The water was bright green and smelled like candy. The robot drank the water and his lights turned on. Then a spaceship disappeared in the sky above us. It was his friends! They were cheering for us because the robot was fixed. Now we are best friends and fight aliens together.

Yesterday at recess everyone was playing kickball. It was super fun until Billy got in trouble. He was steering his bike near the swings. That is very dangerous! The teacher yelled at him to stop. Then we went inside for lunch. I was bringing my tray to the table. Suddenly, I felt a giant sneeze coming.

"Achoo!" I sneezed really loud.

My tray tipped over and started dumping food everywhere. My spaghetti touched the floor and made a huge mess. I started stamping my feet because I was mad.

"Don't worry, I will help you clean it," said my friend Sam.

We picked up the food and threw it away. The janitor was nice about it. Next time I will hold my tray tighter.

It was my birthday and I was turning thirteen. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. It was freezing outside so we stayed in my room. We heard a loud ringing sound from the kitchen.

"Is that the pizza?" Sam asked me.

"I hope so because I am starving!" I said.

My mom yelled that dinner was ready. We ran downstairs and grabbed some big slices. My uncle from a foreign country was there too. He gave me a small box with a shiny jewel inside. I almost forgot to say thank you but then I remembered. It was really pretty though. Later we drew funny pictures and tried to seize the last cookie. We neared the end of the night and got in trouble for talking too late.

My brother Tim and I love playing video games. We were approaching the final level on our favorite game. My mom said it was already time for bed. I heard Tim moaning because he didn't want to stop. There were toys scattered all over the floor. We treated the game like it was real life.

"Just five more minutes please!" I yelled loudly.

"Look at the schedule on the wall," Mom said.

I feared we would lose our progress. In the game, my character had a cool knife. Tim's character could bungee jump off cliffs. We kept seeing the "Game Over" sign flashing. Finally, we played enough to beat the boss. The game guide said it was the hardest level. We high-fived and went to sleep happy.

I chose the wrong day to forget my homework. My teacher Mrs. Gable was already moaning about the noisy class. She was stamping her foot and looked really mad. I sat there gripping my pencil until my hand hurt. I was trembling a little bit because I was scared.

"Where is your math sheet, Leo?" Mrs. Gable asked loudly.

"I left it next to my computer," I whispered.

She sighed and combed her fingers through her hair. Just then the bell rang for recess and I grinned. My face lit up because I was thrilled to escape. We ran outside and started roaming around the playground. I was yearning for the swings but they were taken. So I just ran around tearing up grass instead. It was way better than math class.

Me and my brother Tom went boating on the lake. We were exploring the big mountain in the middle. The water was freezing and my finger hurt from paddling. Tom was wearing his red life jacket.

Suddenly a big log came floating near us.

"Look out for the danger!" I yelled really loud.

Tom tried to steer but he almost fell in. He started swearing because he was scared.

"I guarantee we will crash!" Tom shouted back at me.

We hit the log and the boat tipped over. The surrounding water was so cold. We swam to the shore fast. We did not need a hospital but we were wet. I used my imagination and pretended we were pirates. We found fourteen shiny rocks on the beach. It was the best adventure ever.

My dad’s birthday was yesterday and we made a party. Mom brewed some hot coffee and I helped her start cleaning the living room. My little brother was jumping on the couch and making a mess.

"Stop thumping around or we won't have cake!" I yelled at him.

He stopped and grinned at me with his big teeth. Then I drew a nice card with markers and glitter. I reached up high to hang the blue balloons. When Dad came home, we all yelled surprise really loud. He looked so happy and gave us big hugs. I felt grateful that he liked my card the best. We ate chocolate cake and stayed up late.

Me and my dog Max went to the park. It was sunny weather and we wanted to explore. We saw a big tree and I tried to climb it. Max barked at a squirrel in the surrounding bushes. Suddenly a bird flew right over my head! It spread its wings wide and looked huge.

"Look out Max, it might be a ghost bird!" I yelled.

Max just wagged his tail because he was hungry. We sat by the water fountain to eat our snacks. I drew a picture of the bird in the dirt. Max sniffed it and sneezed. There was no danger here, just fun. Then we ran all the way home for dinner.

I was walking through the hallway after recess. I heard a loud crash near the water fountain. My friend Tim dropped his lunchbox and grumbled. 

"Oh no, my sandwich is ruined!" Tim yelled.

I looked down and saw his apple rolling away. It looked impossible to catch. But then I remembered I am fast. I ran following the apple. I felt like a brave knight saving the day. I grabbed it right before the stairs.

"Here is your apple, Tim," I said.

He smiled and stuck out his tongue at the apple. We walked back to class earning a tardy slip. It was the greatest adventure, but Mrs. Jones was mad. Next time I will listen for the bell better. We were scared, but the scenery outside was nice.

My friends and I made our own soccer league. I was the captain of the Red Team on Wednesday. We rode our bikes to the park near the walking trail. The scenery was nice because there was a cool breeze.

"We will reign as champions today!" shouted my friend Tim.

"Only if you stop cleaning your shoes," laughed Sam.

The game started and I ran really fast. I felt sharp like a needle. Suddenly I froze because I saw a big dog. The dog ran onto the field and stole the ball! We chased him but he was too fast. After the game, my mom treated us to ice cream. We have to design a new schedule for the next game. It was the best day ever.

Yesterday was the worst school day on earth. I was walking through the hall and I was bumping into everyone because my bag was huge. I heard my teacher say we had a test. I yelled, "Oh no I forgot to study!"

We went inside and sat down at our desks. I wrote my name on the paper but I didn't complete the math. Then I realized I crossed out the wrong answer. It was a mess.

At lunch, my friend's daughter came to visit our class. She is very small and cute. She said, "You look sad today."

I told her about the bad test. Then the bell rang for recess and I felt better. I ran outside and played tag until my legs hurt.

I was in big trouble. Mrs. Lee gave us a really hard math paper leading up to recess. I looked at the ceiling and groaned. The numbers looked foreign to me.

"I hate subtraction," I grumbled to my friend Sam.

Sam grinned and pushed his paper toward me. "Just borrow from the tens place," he whispered.

I tried it and spread out my fingers to count. It worked! I was thrilled. I finished just as the bell rang loudly throughout the hall. We ran through the door to the playground.

"Race you to the swings!" I yelled.

I ran fast and felt the wind on my face. Math was hard, but recess was the best part of the day.

We woke up early and I ate my breakfast fast. Today was the big soccer game against the Ghosts. Their team is scary because they always knock people over. My dad drove us past the mountain to the field. I saw a huge bird approaching the grass like a flying creature.

"Are you ready to win?" my dad asked me.

"I am going to score a goal!" I shouted back.

The schedule said we played first so we ran onto the field. The sun was hot and the grass felt scorched. I kicked the ball hard and everyone started cheering. I felt strong like a sailor on a boating trip. We won the game and went back to our apartment happy.

I was playing my new video game on Saturday. My character was wearing a blue helmet and holding a sword. Suddenly, a big green dragon appeared on the screen. I was a little afraid because the dragon breathed fire.

"Look out for the fire!" my brother yelled at me.

I pressed the jump button fast and dodged the stinging flames. The danger was real, but I used my imagination to win. I discovered a secret cave behind a waterfall. Inside the cave, a magic potion brewed in a pot. My character grew bigger and stronger after drinking it.

"You are going to win now," my brother said.

The dragon looked different now because he was scared of me. I won the level and it looked like a cool painting. It was the best game ever!

I was walking to school and saw my friend Tim. He greeted me with a big wave. We walked through the big green meadow near the playground. Suddenly, the school bell screeched very loud. We ran fast because Mrs. Miller gets mad if we are late.

"Oh no, I forgot my homework again!" Tim yelled while running.

I was groaning because I hate when he forgets it. We got to class just in time. The teacher was approaching my desk with a smile. My papers were scattered all over the floor. It was a mess.

"Please maintain a clean desk," she said nicely.

Later at recess, we played near the water fountain. I saw a plain red ball floating in a puddle. It looked like it disappeared into the earth. It was a weird day.

I was waiting for the ball in the outfield. The sun was hot and my heart was pumping fast. I saw the batter walking up and approaching the plate. He looked big like a strong sailor. I feared he would hit it over the fence.

"Move back!" yelled my coach from the dugout.

"I got it!" I shouted back at him.

The batter swung the bat hard and hit the leather ball. It went high up through the air. I was roaming backward and jumping up. I grasped the ball in my glove. The weight of it felt good in my hand. My team was surrounding me and cheering loud. Neither team scored again and we won the big game. I was so grateful we practiced catching yesterday. I tried to explain how I caught it but I just smiled.

I was playing Super Smash Bros with my best friend. He picked Mario, and I picked Kirby because Kirby is the best. We were fighting on the big ship stage.

"You are going to get toasted!" he yelled at me.

I just laughed and pressed the B button really fast. My Kirby ate his Mario and spit him out. Then I jumped up high and turned into a heavy rock. I crashed right on top of him!

"That doesn't count! You cheated!" he screamed.

I simply smiled and pulled my controller away. I swept him off the stage and he fell.

"I won again!" I said. "Do you want to play again?"

He sighed and nodded his head. He thought he could beat me, but I am too good. We played until my mom called us for dinner.

My nephew Timmy and I went to the old cave. We brought flashlights because it was super dark inside. Suddenly, we saw a shiny blue jewel on a rock. But a big bat was hanging right above it!

"Watch out for the monster!" I yelled loudly.

Timmy tried to grab the jewel but he made trouble. The bat screeched and flew at our heads. We ran fast and scattered rocks everywhere with our feet. Timmy almost fainted because he was so scared.

"I am stronger than a bat," said Timmy.

We found a box that did not contain gold. It was empty so we went home for dinner. Mom gave us a grounding for being late.

We went boating on the lake last Saturday. It was sunny and the trees surrounding us were green. My dog Buster was running around the boat and barking. He saw a duck with a blue feather.

"Sit down Buster!" I yelled at him.

Suddenly he sprinted to the back and jumped through the air. Splash! He was swimming fast with a funny rhythm. He crossed the water to chase the duck but it flew away. Buster got back in and shook his wet fur. Now there is a big water stain on my shirt.

"You are a bad dog," my dad said while laughing.

We ate toasted sandwiches because we were hungry. Then we discovered a tiny island. I guarantee we will go there again soon. It was the best day ever but Buster smelled like a wet sock.

My dog Sparky is the best runner ever. He ran around the yard eight times today. I watched him from my treehouse building. Sparky saw a big squirrel near the fence. The squirrel flew up the tall oak tree fast. Sparky started stamping his feet on the grass.

"You can't catch him, Sparky!" I yelled down.

Sparky barked at me and wagged his tail hard. My dad came outside with his coffee mug. He loves caffeine in the morning.

"Is Sparky acting crazy again?" Dad asked me.

"Yes, he thinks he is the champion of squirrels," I said.

Then Sparky tripped over a big stick and yelped. We drove him to the animal hospital just in case. He was okay, but now he has a blue bandage. He is still a good dog.

My brother Tom and I went to explore the greatest cave ever. We brought flashlights and my dad’s pocket knife. It was freezing inside and my hands were trembling. Suddenly, a big rock fell and we were trapped!

"We need to wrap my coat around the rock and pull," Tom yelled.

We pulled hard but the rock was too heavy. My heart was thumping so loud. I thought we would never get out. Then I saw a small hole near the scorched wall.

"I guarantee we can fit through there!" I grinned.

We squeezed through the hole and escaped just in time. Mom gave us hot chocolate but neither of us told her about the danger. It was an important secret. We felt brave but I really needed some caffeine to stay awake.

I was clinging to the monkey bars at recess. The ground looked like hot lava floating below me. My friend Tim was coaching me from the side.

"Just let go and jump!" Tim yelled loudly.

"Unfortunately, I am scared of danger!" I shouted back.

I scrambled across the bars and jumped onto the grass. We opened our lunch boxes together on the bench. My mom packed my greatest snack ever. But my sandwich had disappeared! I scratched my head and looked everywhere.

"Where is it?" I simply asked.

Tim pointed at a squirrel near the trash can. It was eating my camping trip granola bar.

"That is so mean," I grumbled sadly.

Then the bell rang and recess was over. We walked back to class very slowly.

My family went camping for my birthday last week. We found a big green meadow to put our tent. My dad told me to hold the pole steady.

"You have the strength of an elephant!" he said.

I felt very strong and we finished the tent fast. Then we made a fire and roasted marshmallows. They tasted so good when they were toasted brown. My mom spread a newspaper on the ground for us to sit.

"I have a yearning for chocolate," said my sister.

We made s'mores and ate them until they disappeared. It was different sleeping outside but I liked looking at the stars. It was the best birthday ever because we were all together.

My best friend Sam and I walked home together. The cool breeze hit my face and it felt nice. We walked past the park and saw kids swinging. I looked at the scenery and counted three blue cars.

"I hate homework," Sam grumbled loudly.

"Me too," I said while kicking a stone. "Especially math."

We neared my big apartment building and stopped. A huge black beetle was right on the sidewalk! Sam tried to poke it but I stopped him. My stomach was earning for a snack so we went inside. My heavy backpack was stinging my shoulders. We sat down and started groaning about our spelling words. They looked like a foreign language to me. But we did not want to get in trouble, so we finished it all. Then my dog started to gnaw on Sam's shoe! It was a crazy day.

I was cleaning my room for my sleepover. Suddenly I saw a weird creature on my bed. It was brown and had six legs. I screeched really loud and my mom ran in.

"What happened in here?" my mom asked me.

"There is a monster!" I yelled and pointed.

My mom looked and then she started laughing. It wasn't a monster at all. It was just a big crumb from my cookie. I felt silly but then my friend landed on my porch. She was wearing her pajamas and blew a whistle.

"Let's start the party!" she yelled.

We started screaming and jumping on my bed. My mom said to stop or I would get a grounding. We ate pizza and then went on a search for candy. It was the best sleepover ever.

It was February and very cold outside. My friend Sam and I went to the old cave in the woods. We crawled through a small hole in the rocks. It was dark inside but Sam had a flashlight. We saw something shiny on the ground.

"Look at this old leather bag!" I shouted.

Sam picked it up and it felt heavy. Suddenly a big bat flew over our heads and we screamed. We ran back to the hole fast. My heart bounced in my chest like a ball.

"We have to tell the King's daughter!" Sam said.

We stood outside and looked at the treasure. We didn't know the meaning of the symbols on the bag but it looked magic. We were real explorers now and it was the best day ever.

My teacher Mrs. Green gave us a big project today. We had to make a huge painting of a jungle. I started mixing the blue and yellow paint. It made a really nice green color for the leaves.

"Where is the brown paint?" my friend Sam asked.

"I don't know, let's search for it," I said.

We looked under the table but it wasn't there either. Neither of us could find it anywhere. Then I saw Timmy wearing a brown shirt. He climbed on a chair to reach the top shelf.

"Here it is!" Timmy shouted loudly.

He tried to explain that he hid it for safety. We all laughed and finished our big jungle picture. It was the best art class ever.

The bus was always on schedule, but today it disappeared. My friend Billy said we should walk to school instead. We walked past the old park and saw something wrong.

"Look at that big gate!" Billy shouted loudly.

It was not a park anymore, but a giant castle. A scary knight was standing there holding a shiny sword. We scrambled up the wall and saw a vine hanging down. We started swinging across a big hole in the ground.

"We are in the hero league now!" I yelled.

Suddenly, a clock struck twelve and the sky twisted fast. It looked like heaven but then it got dark. We were earning points for being brave explorers. We ran back home before mom got mad.

My dog Buddy is very fast and loves outside. One day I threw his blue ball way across the yard. Buddy sprinted very fast and he almost hit the fence. He drove his nose into the grass to find it.

"Did you find it, Buddy?" I yelled at him.

He barked and his tail wagged like a crazy bungee cord. He had the ball and some dirt on his nose.

My mom says Buddy has the strength of a sailor. Sometimes he acts weird like he needs dog psychology or science. But mostly he is just happy and runs around. We neared the porch and saw leaves scattered everywhere.

"Come inside now before you catch pneumonia!" Mom said.

We went in and I gave him fourteen treats for waiting.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old building. It was tall and scary and had a big height. We walked carefully so we did not make a sound. Sam chewed his gum really loud and I told him shush.

We saw a big door and we heard a knock.
"Did you hear that?" Sam asked me.
"I think a ghost is inside," I said back.

We opened the door and saw a little dog. He grew really happy when he saw us. We thought he was scary but he was nice. He did not receive any food for a long time. We had enough snacks for him in our bag. We sat down and I tried to write a note. We took the dog home and named him Spooky.

Me and my brother Max were playing Zombie Island. We had to find the treasure before the zombies got us. We ran around the island to search for clues.

"Look out behind you!" yelled Max very loud.

A big ghost zombie was hanging from a tree. I used my super scissors to cut the rope. The zombie fell down and screeched like a bird. We escaped and kept running to the bridge. We saw a bungee cord near the cliff.

"We have to go jumping off the side," I said.

Max was scared but we jumped down together. We landed on a boat and found the treasure chest. The game said "Level Complete" on the screen. We got a receipt for earning one million gold coins. It was the best game ever.

We played soccer against the scary Tigers team today. I feared them because they are really big and fast. My friend Sam paid five dollars for new shin guards. He hoped they would make him play better.

"Pass the ball to me!" Sam yelled loudly.

I ran fast and threw the ball in from the side. The ball went high like it was over a mountain. It crashed into the goalie’s hands but he dropped it. Sam kicked it hard and it flew into the net.

"We scored!" I sang out because I was so happy.

The news spread fast that we were winning the game. The whistle blew sounding really loud and the game ended. We drew a picture of our team winning for our coach. We searched for pizza after the game to celebrate.

One day I found a weird feather on my balcony. It was glowing green like a super alien vein. I grabbed it and suddenly I was flying straight up! The wind blew my hair crazy and I was climbing the air. I saw a robot eating metal scissors on a cloud.

"Hey, stop eating that!" I yelled at the robot.

The robot looked at me and made a groaning sound.

"I do not understand humans," said the robot.

He drew a laser sword that was longer than a bus. I was scared so I flew away fast leading him on a chase. But then my mom called me for dinner and I woke up in my bed. It was just a dream but I still have the green feather.

Me and my best friend Sam found a cave. It looked scary but we went inside anyway. The walls had a weird design on them. Suddenly the floor disappeared and we fell down. It felt like there was no gravity. We landed on a pile of soft hay though.

"Where are we?" asked Sam.

"I think we are in a dungeon," I said.

A big metal knight walked out from the dark. He did not have a sword. Instead he had a giant spoon. He reached out to catch us. Sam grabbed my hand and we ran through a small door. We were safe but we were lost.

My backpack felt super heavy, like a huge weight on my back. I had my math book and my spelling book inside. It felt impossible to carry! I grasped the straps tight and walked to school. My heart was thumping hard because we had a big test.

When I got to class, my friend Billy appeared at his desk. He looked happy.

"I am going to be the champion of spelling!" Billy shouted.

"I am scared about the math test," I said quietly.

Mrs. Lee started coaching us on the words one last time. We practiced eight hard words. Then the bell rang for the greatest time ever, recess! I stopped moaning about the test and ran outside. Tomorrow is Saturday, so I can finally rest.

Me and my best friend Sam started a big adventure. We searched for a treasure chest in the spooky woods. The trees were tall and scratched my arms a little bit. Sam was scared because he heard a loud groaning noise.

"I think a monster is seeing us!" Sam whispered loudly.

"Don't worry, we have each other for company," I said.

We kept walking and found a small, dark cave. I was loading my pockets with rocks just in case. We had to squeeze through the tiny hole. Inside, it was complete darkness but we saw something shiny. It was just an old tin can, not gold. We laughed and ran all the way home for dinner.

I love playing my dragon video game after school. My brother Ben thinks he is better, but he isn't. Yesterday we raced to the top of the volcano level. I climbed up the rocks really fast. The dragon scorched the ground with fire, so I jumped. I was earning lots of gold coins on the way up.

Suddenly Ben's dragon got stuck in a cave. "Help me, I'm trapped!" Ben yelled at the screen.

"Use your magic scissors to cut the vines!" I shouted back.

He did it and flew out just in time. We both landed on the finish line together. I feared he would win, often he beats me. But the game said, "Player 1 Wins!" I will write my name on the high score list today.

My neighbor Tom and I were playing a weird video game. We were climbing a giant mountain to fight a monster. I was earning lots of points, so I felt good. But then the boss monster neared us and he looked scary.

"I guarantee I will win this time," Tom said loudly.

I just laughed because I am usually the champion. I kept pressing the buttons fast to maintain my speed. Suddenly my character fainted on the screen! I was crushed because I lost all my gold coins.

"Wow, that is some bad luck," Tom said while smiling.

I crawled over to the restart button. I am not pleased about losing, but we started again. Next time I will win for sure.

I went outside to play with my dog Sparky. We walked to the big woods behind my house. Sparky ran fast and he bounced over a log.

Suddenly, I heard a loud sounding noise near the creek. Sparky barked and I ran to see what it was. We discovered a small baby bird in a hole. It was trapped and it looked scared.

"Don't worry, little bird!" I said to it.

The bird struggled to get out but it couldn't. I used a stick to help lift it up. It took about fourteen tries but it finally worked. The bird flew up to a branch.

"Look, Sparky! We saved him!" I yelled, cheering loudly.

Then we met my mom on the porch. She blew a whistle for us to come inside. I love science and nature because it is cool.

I was playing my new soccer game on the computer. My brother Sam wanted to play too, but it was my turn. I picked the team with the red jerseys.

"You are going to lose!" Sam said meanly.

The game started and my players were running fast. My heart was pumping so hard in my chest. I sprinted down the field with the ball. Suddenly, a big green beetle landed on my keyboard! I screamed and almost stopped playing.

"Get it off! Get it off!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam laughed but he flicked the bug away. I kept playing and I scored a big goal. I was so thrilled that I won the game. I feared I would lose because of the bug. Sam was swearing under his breath because he was jealous. It was the best feeling ever to win.

I rode the bus to school today and sat with Ben. We talked about Minecraft and he chewed his gum really loud. At recess we ran outside to the playground. I started climbing up the big slide but then I saw a shiny rock. It looked like a magic jewel.

"Look at this cool rock!" I yelled to Ben.

Ben ran over and he was jumping up and down. "Can I hold it?" he asked me.

Then a big kid stole the rock from my hand! He laughed and ran away to the water fountain. I was mad so I bounced my ball hard. But then the teacher saw him dumping sand on a girl. She made him give the jewel back. I put it in my pocket safe.

My robot friend Zap was acting very weird today. He usually follows his schedule, but he ran outside. I followed him down a long trail into the woods. The breeze was freezing, so I pulled my coat tight. Zap stopped near a big, glowing rock.

"This is impossible!" I shouted at him.

Zap beeped loudly and pointed at the sky. A green light grew bigger and landed on the grass. It was a tiny alien wearing a shiny silver suit.

"I told you they were real," Zap said with a beep.

We counted three aliens, and they looked friendly enough. They said they were from a science planet near a blue star. We heard a loud noise, and their ship started shaking. They had to leave fast. Zap and I watched them fly away over the island. It was the best day ever.

We walked into the spooky meadow. The grass was very tall and green. My friend Sam was wearing a big red sweater. It had a weird purple stain on the front.

Suddenly we heard a loud ringing sound. It was coming from a dark cave nearby.

"I think a dragon lives there!" shouted Sam.

"Use your brain, dragons aren't real," I said back.

We walked closer to the cave door. I counted thirteen bats swinging from the roof. Then we heard a huge, loud sneeze inside. It sounded like a bear bearing its teeth! We ran away super fast and didn't stop. That was the scariest day ever.

I woke up late and ran to school fast. My neighbor greeted me but I didn’t stop running. When I got to class, everyone was quiet. I thought I was in big trouble today.

"Where is your homework?" my teacher asked me.

I looked in my bag but seeing nothing there made me scared. I dumped my bag on the ground. Everything scattered everywhere like a messy island.

"I fought my dog for it!" I screamed loudly.

The class laughed, but then I found it. It was hiding under my lunchbox. It was eight pages long! I was happy. Thirteen kids clapped for me. It was a crazy start to the day.

My neighbor Sam came over for a sleepover on Friday. We built a huge castle out of pillows in the living room. It was growing taller and taller until it touched the couch.

"This is the best fort ever!" Sam shouted happily.

We were jumping on the cushions and acting crazy. My dad came in and he was coaching us on how to fix the walls. Then we ate pizza and it was eight o’clock.

"Do you want to write a secret message?" I asked Sam.

We pretended we were boating on a pirate ship in the dark. The castle was our ship and the carpet was the ocean. The most important rule was to not touch the floor. We stayed up super late and told spooky stories.

I went on an adventure early in the morning. My dog Buster was pleased to come with me. We walked through the woods behind my house. The ground was muddy and slippery everywhere. Buster started running and swinging his tail. He saw a squirrel twisted around a big tree. "Come back here, Buster!" I yelled loudly. He didn't listen and ran throughout the bushes. I heard him groaning a little bit later. He was stuck in a single big hole. He was breathing fast and looked scared. "Don't worry, I will save you," I said. I pulled him out and everyone was happy. I thought he was hurt, but he was fine. I felt like swearing because I was so mad. We went home to clean up all the mud.

One cold day in February, my friend Tim and I went camping. We wanted to find the lost sailor’s treasure in the woods. Tim held a big map and I had my flashlight. We walked for a long time and I had a bad feeling.

"What if we are lost?" Tim asked me.

"We have the map," I said, but I feared failure.

Suddenly a giant black beetle crawled on my shoe! I jumped and dropped the flashlight. It broke. We thought we were in big trouble. Then Tim saw a cave nearby. Inside the cave, we saw an old box. It looked like the one from the newspaper!

"This is it!" I yelled.

We opened it but it was empty. The treasure was already sold. But we knew the important reason for our trip was fun.

I was wearing my new sneakers for recess today. They make me run super fast and have extra strength. We played dodgeball and it was a very important game. Timmy threw the red ball right at my head. I ducked down low because of my short height.

"You can't hit me!" I yelled really loud.

Timmy got mad and I heard him swearing quietly. The teacher did not hear him but I did. Then I grabbed the ball to seize the moment. I threw it back and hit his leg.

"You are out!" shouted my best friend Sam.

After the game, I ate my sandwich but I chewed too fast. I wished I was invisible so nobody saw me choke. I am not trained to eat that fast. It was a good day but my throat hurt.

I woke up early because it was my eighth birthday. My mom and dad paid for a big camping trip. We crossed a small river and set up our tent. My friends Sam and Leo came with us too. We started keeping our sleeping bags in a messy pile.

"Look at that bug!" yelled Sam while jumping around.

We grabbed some sticks to design a cool fort. Suddenly, my favorite toy car disappeared in the tall grass. I felt crushed and sad about losing it. But then Leo found it under a rock.

"I know where it is!" he shouted happily.

We ate hot dogs and watched the fire growing bigger. I felt very grateful for my friends and family today. We pretended to reign over the forest like kings. It was the best birthday ever.

My brother and I went exploring in the woods today. We wanted to find bugs for my science project. The breeze was nice and cool on our faces. We looked under a big rock and saw something white.

"It looks like a ghost!" my brother yelled loudly.

I laughed and said, "Ghosts aren't real, you know."

It was just a white moth that had fainted. I caught it gently in my hands. But then my brother started screaming and ran away fast. He crushed some leaves when he ran to the left. I obtained the moth and put it in a jar. When I got home, my mom was cheering for me. She said the moth was very pretty with its wings spread out. We let it go and it flew away happy.

I was playing soccer and my leg was really stinging. I fell down hard on the grass near the goal. My friend Sam ran over and he spoke very loud.

"Are you okay? That looked bad!" he yelled.

I stood up slowly and brushed off the dirt. I was not crying but my knee hurt a lot. It felt like a bug chewed on it.

"I am fine. Let's keep playing," I said.

We had a big team meeting before the game started. The coach wrote our positions on a white board. I wanted to score a single goal today so badly. The other team was groaning because we were winning. We played until the sun went down like a bright jewel. That night I was sleeping so good because I was tired.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost jewel of the King. We walked for a long time and saw a big cave.

"I am scared to go inside," spoke Sam quietly.

"Don't worry, I have a flashlight," I said.

We went in and started climbing over big rocks. Suddenly, a giant bat flew at us and screeched loudly! I screamed and Sam screamed too. I remembered my backpack had a toy ball. I threw the ball at the bat and it flew away. Then we saw something shiny like a needle in the dirt. It was the jewel! We grabbed it and ran out jumping over logs. We read the map and went home to get cookies.

Yesterday was my birthday and I woke up so early. My mom was already singing happy birthday in the kitchen. She made me stewed apples and pancakes for breakfast. I knew it was going to be a great day.

"Do you want your present now?" asked my dad.

"Yes please!" I shouted and ran to the table.

He threw me a small box bearing a shiny bow. I opened it and saw a toy bungee jumper man. I put my thumb on his head and made him jump. Later my friends met me at the park. We played tag and we didn't listen when mom called us. Tomorrow I have school but today was the best day ever.

I rode my bike to the park for the big race. My friend Tim was there with his new mountain bike. He thought he was faster than me, but I kept practicing. We lined up at the start and waited for the whistle.

"I am going to win today!" Tim yelled loudly.

"Just you wait and see," I shouted back at him.

The whistle blew and we flew down the dirt path. I pedaled hard and spread my arms out at the end. I won the race! Tim was mad and almost started swearing, but he stopped. We went home and my mom brewed some hot cocoa for us. I tried teaching him my tricks, but he didn't listen. I went to search for cookies instead.

We went to the big mountain behind my house. My friend Max followed me and we walked for a long time. Suddenly we heard a loud roar. It sounded like a dragon! We were scared and feared danger, but we kept walking.

Then a giant rock appeared in our way. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole like a needle. It was dark inside. Max caught his shirt on a stick but he pulled it free.

"Do you see anything?" asked Max.

"Look over there!" I shouted.

We saw a baby dragon. Its tail was scorched and black. It looked sad. We gave it some water and it bounced up happily. The dragon grinned at us. It felt stronger and looked grateful. We ran home fast before its mom came back.

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother for an hour. I wanted to win so bad, I had a nervous feeling. My car went straight down the track. But then I crashed into a banana peel!

"Watch out for the shell!" my brother yelled.

I didn't listen and he hit me with a red shell. I closed my eyes because I was mad. I counted to ten and opened them again. My car was like a needle popping a balloon. I drove past a big fountain and crossed the finish line last.

"You lose!" he laughed at me.

I threw the controller. Mom came in and gave me a grounding. I can't play games for a week now.

I was playing my new video game called Mega Castle. My guy had a sword and he climbed a big wall. I was so pleased when I got to the top. But then a dragon was approaching me fast!

"Watch out for the fire!" yelled my brother Sam.

I pressed the jump button and did a bungee jump off. I landed on a cloud that looked like heaven. It was safe there. I obtained a golden key and opened the door. I believed I could win the game today. The dragon tried to get me again but I was too fast. I toasted him with my laser beam.

"You are the winner!" the game said loudly.

I felt like a king and my reign had begun. My fingers were stinging from pressing buttons but I was happy.

I was waiting for lunch all morning because I was hungry. My stomach made a loud noise during math class. Mrs. Green looked at me and she cleared her throat. Finally the bell rang and we went to the cafeteria. I sat with my best friend Sam for company.

"Look at my sandwich," Sam said sadly.

It was totally crushed inside his bag. I felt bad so I gave him half of my toasted cheese. We were happy eating and talking about video games. Suddenly I felt a big sneeze coming. I tried keeping it in but it was too strong. I sneezed right on the table! Everyone started jumping back and laughing. I wiped it up fast to maintain my cool. It was important to clean it before the teacher saw. We went outside and started roaming around the playground. I love recess more than I love to learn.

Me and my friend Sam were stuck in my apartment. We were playing pirates, but the floor was hot lava. We had to get to the kitchen for snacks.

"It looks impossible to cross," Sam said scared.

I used my big imagination and saw rocks everywhere. I started jumping on the couch pillows. The pillows held my weight easily. I tossed a pillow to Sam, but he missed. Now he was trapped on the rug island!

"I need energy!" I yelled. "I need protein!"

I crossed the lava carefully and grabbed some cheese sticks. I threw one to Sam. Neither of us fell into the lava. The whole scene was super cool. We made it safe.

My dog Rex loves to run in the woods. One day we went to the big lake. There is a tiny island in the middle. Rex jumped in the water and started swimming. I watched his tail go back and forth in a rhythm.

"Come back, Rex!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and he just kept going. I feared he would get lost. Then he disappeared behind a big rock. I waited for a long time. My mom neared me and held my hand.

"He will come back soon," she said.

Suddenly Rex popped up with a stick! I knew he was okay. We went home and mom stewed some meat for dinner. My eyes closed because I was so tired from our big adventure.

I was sitting in art class and painting a giant castle. My teacher Mr. Brown said we could pick any colors. I chose bright blue and orange for the big towers. Suddenly Billy threw his eraser across the room by accident. It hit my water cup and spilled water everywhere!

"Oh no, I did it wrong!" Billy yelled really loud.

Mr. Brown looked over and he almost fainted when he saw the mess. It looked like a bungee cord snapped and splashed water all over.

"Don't worry, we can clean it," I said to Billy.

We used paper towels but the puddle was getting longer. It took a long time but finally the reign of the water monster was over. We laughed and then the bell rang for lunch.

One day my dog Rusty was digging a big hole. He scratched at the dirt and made a mess. We were outside in the backyard near the big tree. I was tearing up old weeds for my mom. Suddenly Rusty started barking at a squirrel in the tree. The squirrel scrambled up high and looked down at us.

"Come back here!" I yelled at the squirrel.

Rusty jumped up like he didn't have any gravity. But then my dad came out and looked mad. He was approaching us very fast.

"Stop swearing at the squirrel," my dad said to Rusty.

We went inside and ate roasted chicken for dinner. It was just the beginning of summer. Tomorrow we will go to the park and find more squirrels. Rusty is a good dog but he is very loud.

I was certain we would find the treasure today. Me and my friend Sam followed the map to the old cave. It was freezing inside and my heart was thumping hard. We walked for eight minutes until a big door appeared.

"We have to push it!" Sam yelled loudly.

We pushed with our whole body weight and it shook. The door opened and we saw a shiny gold box. It was complete with jewels and coins. We felt like we just got paid a million dollars!

"We are rich!" I shouted and started cheering.

But then a big bear was waiting in the corner. We ran away fast and didn't stop running until home.

My friends and I moved the big boxes for the sleepover. We were loading all the snacks and blankets into my fort. I grasped a heavy bag of chips and pushed it inside.

"Careful, don't break the roof!" yelled my friend Sam.

We worked together to make the fort steady and strong. A tiny gnat flew near my face, and I swatted it. We neared the end when Sam started tearing open the candy.

"Wait for the movie to start," I said.

We gradually got quiet and heard a knock on the door. It was my mom roaming around with pizza. I will always remember this fun night. We ate until our bellies were full.

My dog Buster scrambled under the fence yesterday. He ran straight into the woods behind my house. I thought he was chasing a squirrel.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled really loud.

He didn't listen to me although I yelled twice. I followed him and crashed through some big bushes. Suddenly I saw a weird sign on a tree. It said "Secret Island" but there was no water. Then I heard a loud groaning sound nearby. It was Buster moaning because he stole a bee's honey. The bees were angry and they brewed a plan to sting him!

"Run away fast!" I shouted at my silly dog.

We ran home before the bees caught us. I believed we were safe inside. Buster threw himself on his bed and slept. He was not on his normal schedule at all.

My cousin Mark is thirteen and he thinks he is cool. We were playing a new video game about spaceships. Mark picked the red ship and I picked the blue one. I was afraid he would win because he plays all day.

"You are going down," Mark grumbled at me.

"No way, I am going to win," I said back.

We started flying through the stars on the screen. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. Mark shot a laser but it simply missed me. Then I blew up his ship and it hit the ground. It looked scorched and black like burnt toast. I started screaming because I was so happy. Mark looked mad but then he smiled a little bit. I thought I was the best pilot ever.

My dog Buster and I went on a big search. We looked all over the backyard for his favorite bone. Buster sniffed the soft earth and then he jumped over a log.

"Look, Buster! Are we approaching the secret spot?" I asked him.

Buster barked loudly and wagged his tail. He ran to the big oak tree and started digging fast. Gradually a white shape appeared in the dirt. Buster had obtained his lost bone! I grinned at him and he looked so happy.

"You can’t remain dirty," I said. "Let's go inside."

Buster followed me to the house for dinner. Mom made roasted chicken and it smelled really good. Buster ate his bone and then he fell asleep on the rug. It was a very good day for exploring outside.

Me and my friend Sam found a map. It showed a secret path leading to Ghost Island. We took my dad’s old boat and started the engine. It was very loud and my heart was beating fast.

"Do you think there are real ghosts?" asked Sam.

"Maybe, but we are brave explorers," I said.

We saw the island after thirteen minutes. It looked scary and dark. Suddenly the boat hit a big rock and sank a little bit. We jumped into the cold water and swam hard.

We found eight gold coins on the beach! We understood that the ghosts were just stories. We were tired so we drank soda with caffeine. It was the best adventure ever.

The alien robot landed right in my backyard. It was made of shiny metal and had a big green brain. I wasn't scared because I trained for this. I grabbed a butter knife and ran outside. The robot chewed on my mom's flowers.

"Stop eating those!" I yelled at the robot.

It looked at me with glowing eyes. I was trembling a little bit. The robot drew a laser gun, but it was just a toy.

"I am bringing you a present," the robot said.

It gave me a box with plain paper wrap. Inside was a space rock! But then my mom came outside. She saw the mess and screamed about danger. I got a grounding for a week, but I kept the rock.

My friends and I went boating on the big lake. We wanted to find the secret island, but the waves were bumping our boat hard. Suddenly, a big storm woke up the water. "We are going to crash!" my friend Sam started screaming. I was coaching everyone to remain calm, but it was scary. Our snacks got scattered all over the floor. It felt like a big failure. Then we saw a lighthouse sent a bright light. We started following the light to the shore. "Look, we made it!" I said. We were wet, but we had each other for company. It was just the beginning of our big adventure.

We went camping in the woods last weekend. My dad was loading the car for a long time. I saw a little white lamb roaming near the fence. It looked lost and sad.

"Let’s go search for its mom," I said.

My dog Sparky started running and tearing through the bushes. We found a weird foreign coin on the ground. Then we saw a big truck dumping dirt nearby. The noise scared the lamb, and it ran away fast.

"Oh no, come back!" I yelled loudly.

Sparky barked and chased it back to the barn. The farmer was happy and gave us cookies. Camping is fun but chasing animals is better.

Yesterday my friend Sam and I played inside a big box. It was our spaceship and I was the captain. We pushed lots of buttons on our paper computer.

"Oh no! An asteroid struck the ship!" yelled Sam.

We were bumping around inside the box like crazy. The ship started to shake and fall down fast. Unfortunately, we landed on a spooky green planet. We opened the door and crawled out slowly. The air was hot and sticky. We saw a cave that might contain aliens.

"Let's go look inside," I whispered to Sam.

We walked into the dark but then we heard a growl. We ran back to the ship super fast and blasted off home for dinner. It was the best adventure ever.

One day my friend Leo and I went to the forest. We were approaching a big old castle on a tall mountain. The height was very scary but we climbed up fast. We saw a ghost floating near the top window!

"Look out for the ghost!" I yelled at Leo.

He was bringing a magic rope to help us. Leo tied the rope and we did a bungee jump down. We flew through the air like super fast birds. Then I heard a loud whistle from the woods.

"I think the ghost wants his castle back," Leo said.

We ran home before the ghost could start his scary reign. My dad taught me to never mess with ghosts. We were safe but we never went back there again.

It was Wednesday and school was very pleasant today. At recess, we played kickball in the big field. I kicked the ball with all my strength. It flew high like it had no gravity!

"Wow, you should be in the big league!" yelled Sam.

"I just got lucky," I said, but I smiled.

Then the ball disappeared into the jungle gym area. I ran to get it but a bee struck my arm. It felt like a stinging thread. I held my arm and swept away the tears. My arm hurt but I didn't cry much.

Later we had to learn math, and Sam grumbled a lot. He often hates numbers. But I was happy because I got an ice cream at lunch. It was a good day.

My nephew Ben and I went into the dark woods. We were looking for a dragon's cave. The ground was wet earth and it smelled funny. We crawled under a big bush with sharp thorns. One thorn was like a needle and poked my arm. Ben was trembling because he was scared.

"Did you hear that noise?" Ben whispered loudly.

"It sounds like heavy breathing," I said back.

We saw a big shadow instead of a dragon. It was actually thirteen bats flying together! We ran home fast. My mom brewed some hot cocoa for us. Next time we will stay in the backyard.

I was playing Super Racer on my tablet. It was the last level and everything was moving fast. I grasped the tablet tight in my hands. My car was red and super cool. The bad guy was right behind me.

"Go faster!" I screamed at the screen.

Suddenly, the bad guy bumped me. I dropped the tablet on the rug. Unfortunately, my car crashed into a wall. The bad guy won the race. My reign as the champion was over.

"Oh no!" I said loudly.

I grabbed the tablet again. I remembered a secret shortcut. I looked at the ceiling and took a deep breath. I started the race again. This time I will win for sure.

I was playing the biggest soccer game of the year. My team had to maintain our lead to win the gold trophy. I ran fast down the field with the ball. Suddenly, a giant black beetle flew right into my nose! I let out a huge sneeze and the ball rolled away.

"Hey, watch where you're going!" yelled the goalie.

I tried to be honest and tell him about the bug. But my coach said I needed more energy like caffeine. I didn't drink coffee though. I got the ball back and kicked it hard. It hit the metal chain on the goal post. Clang! The referee blew the whistle and we won the game. I felt so happy to receive my medal. Later, I decided to write a story about my winning goal.

It was February and raining very hard outside. My friend Leo and I heard a noise in the attic. We looked up at the ceiling and saw a crack.

"Let's go see what is up there," said Leo.

We grabbed flashlights and went straight up the stairs. The attic was dark and neither of us wanted to go first. I cleared a path through the dusty boxes. Suddenly, we saw a monster with a huge tongue! We screamed and ran fast. But then we looked back. It was just my dog Buster licking a box.

"Buster, you scared us!" I yelled.

We laughed and gave Buster a hug. It was a scary adventure but we were safe.

I was playing my new video game called Monster Run. It is different because you race a huge, green creature. I climbed up a big mountain in the game. I was going very fast and I touched a glowing star.

"Yes! I got the power-up!" I shouted at the TV.

The star made my guy fly like a feather. But then the green monster jumped immediately right in front of me. I tried to jump, but I missed the button. My guy fell down.

"Oh no! That is so unfair!" my brother said.

The game said I was losing grounding points. I had to start over at the bottom. I will try again and win next time!

Me and my nephew went to climb the big mountain. We were bringing snacks and my lucky whistle. I pretended to be the captain of a ship. Suddenly a giant green beetle appeared on a rock! It looked scary so I pushed my nephew behind me.

"Watch out for that monster!" I yelled loudly.

"I want to go home immediately," he grumbled.

We started swinging on vines to get away fast. But then I fell and got a scratch like a needle. It hurt but I didn't need a hospital. We kept running until we saw the top. It was the greatest view ever! We ate our snacks and felt brave. Then we walked back down before dinner.

My neighbor Mr. Green was acting very weird yesterday. I saw him dumping trash in his backyard. Then a small green alien crawled out of the can. I ran over and touched the alien’s head. It felt like cold jelly and had a blue jewel.

"Help me fix my ship," said the alien.

"Okay, but we have to be fast," I said.

We searched for parts near Mr. Green's old computer. The alien’s ship had crashed right into the garden. I counted three broken pieces on the ground. We fixed it before anyone put it in the newspaper. It was just the beginning of our secret. The alien flew away and I didn't even have to go to the hospital. Now I want to learn to fly too.

I went boating on the lake with my dog Max. We were looking for frogs near the big green lily pads. The boat had a cool design with red stripes on it. Max sat at the front bearing all his weight on his paws. He was breathing hard because he was so excited.

Suddenly I saw something small floating in the water. It was a baby duck stuck in some old fishing line! I grabbed my safety scissors from my bag.

"Hold still, little duck," I said softly.

I cut the line carefully and treated the duck nicely. The duck quacked and swam away fast. I grinned at Max and he wagged his tail.

"We did a good job on our search," I told him.

I counted three more ducks nearby. The mom duck looked grateful we helped her baby. It was enough adventure for one day.

I was walking in the woods and I saw a spaceship. It was huge and silver and had fourteen lights on it. I got scared but I wanted to see inside. I neared the door and gave a big knock. A green alien opened it and scratched his head.

"Hello, are you hungry?" the alien asked me.

I said, "Yes, do you have any roasted marshmallows?"

He grasped my hand and pulled me inside. There was no gravity in there so I started floating up! I thought it was super cool. I was yearning to fly like a bird. Then I saw a robot approaching us. It looked like a metal trash can. It was running in the air, which was weird. I had to climb down the wall to get out. Seeing aliens is fun but I wanted to go home for dinner.

I was playing a really cool game called Castle Quest. My character was a knight and she had to climb a big wall. I wanted to get the magic jewel at the very top. Although it was hard, I kept jumping and running fast. I saw a dragon and it flew right at me!

"Watch out for the fire!" my sister yelled at me.

"I know, I am keeping safe!" I spoke back loudly.

I had fourteen lives left so I wasn't scared. I cleared the level and saved the king’s daughter. Then I had to read a magic scroll to learn a new spell. My mom came in sounding mad because I was shouting. I got in trouble but I still won the game and ended the dragon's reign. It was the best day ever.

We were playing tag at recess near the big oak tree. The grass in the meadow was tall and itchy. Suddenly, Timmy screamed really loud. He was trapped near the fence and looked scared.

"What is the reason you are screaming?" asked Sarah.

"There is a huge spider!" yelled Timmy, his hands trembling.

I ran over to look. It was just a small brown spider. I knew it wasn't dangerous. I counted its legs. There were eight legs. I tried to seize it, but it ran away. We often see bugs outside.

"Let's go back inside," I said. "Recess is over."

We ran back to class. My papers were scattered on my desk. It was time for math. I looked at the clock. It felt like a mountain of time until lunch.

My robot friend named Beep was climbing the big hill. He was very hungry for batteries and old metal. We saw a scary alien ship approaching us fast.

"Run away now!" I yelled at Beep very loud.

Beep did not run because he was waiting for lunch. The alien ship opened a door and started dumping trash. A long silver chain fell out and hit the ground.

"I will eat that important snack," said Beep happily.

He ate the chain and suddenly he got superpowers. He shot fire and roasted the alien ship until it left. Now Beep can reign over the hill like a king. We will receive more snacks tomorrow.

I was sitting in class waiting for the bell to ring. My teacher Mrs. Miller was coaching us on math but I was dreaming. I looked out the window at the scenery outside. A bird flew by and I wished I was outside too.

"Please pay attention!" Mrs. Miller said loudly.

I felt bad so I stopped dreaming. Finally the bell screamed and everyone started jumping up. It was time for recess and I was feeling so happy. We ran outside and started pumping our legs on the swings.

"Look what I found!" shouted my friend Timmy.

He was holding a shiny rock like it was treasure. I didn't complain about math anymore because recess is the best especially when you find cool stuff. We played until we grew tired and had to go back inside.

One day I looked outside and the weather was sunny. I wanted to be a sailor on my big boat. My boat was just a cardboard box but it was cool. I put on my hat and I grabbed my dog Spot.

"Get in the boat, Spot!" I yelled loudly.

Spot jumped in and we sailed through the tall grass. Suddenly a big wind struck our ship. Unfortunately, my map blew away into a tree. The tree grew very high so I could not reach it.

"We have to remain calm," I told Spot.

Then a squirrel ran down the tree. He stole my map and ran away! It happened so fast. I tried to seize him but he was gone. We didn't find the map, but we found a sign for ice cream. That was better anyway.

My friends and I went to the big mountain. We heard a scary sound in the meadow. It was freezing cold outside but we kept walking.

"Look at that weird sign," said Tom.

The sign had a picture of a giant needle on it. We didn't know the meaning of it. We walked past some trees and saw a cave. Inside the cave was a treasure map for a secret island! My brain was thinking very fast.

"We can go there by boat!" shouted Sarah.

We started earning money for a boat by washing cars. It was hard work but we were excited. We were going to be famous explorers soon. We packed our bags and ran to the beach. The adventure was just starting for us.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. We had a class meeting about the big art project. Mrs. Green said we had to design a castle for a king to reign over. 

"I want to draw a dragon guarding the gate!" shouted Timmy.

"You can’t do that, the dragon will eat everyone," said Sarah.

I decided to draw a huge wall going straight up. My castle had fourteen towers and a bearing for a flag. It was hard to maintain my focus because I was hungry. I could smell roasted chicken from the cafeteria. Finally, the bell rang for lunch. We started loading our trays with food. I didn't like the peas, but I didn't want carrots either. It was the best lunch on earth though because I was starving. I am certain I ate everything in five minutes!

I was playing a video game against my younger brother. It was a wonderful racing game with fast cars. Suddenly, a giant pink elephant appeared on the screen! It landed right on top of my blue car.

"Hey, that's not fair!" I yelled at the TV.

My brother just laughed and kept driving his red car. I heard him say, "I am winning this race now."

My car was stuck under the elephant for a longer time. I started moaning because I wanted to win so bad. Then my dad walked in and greeted us happily. He was holding a piece of paper like a receipt.

"What happened here?" he asked us about the elephant.

I told him the game was cheating me. He said maybe the game caught pneumonia and got sick. He started coaching me on how to get free. Finally, I escaped and crossed the finish line first!

My birthday party started great but then it got messy. My friends came over for a sleepover and we wanted cake. My little brother Tommy pushed through the door. He was running too fast and held a toy truck.

"Watch out!" I screeched at him very loud.

It was impossible to stop him. He crashed right into the table with the cake. The cake fell and the frosting scratched my leg. It was not complete anymore.

"I am sorry," Tommy said and he looked sad.

We ate the smashed cake anyway and it tasted good. Then we played games all night. My birthday was still fun even with the mess.

My incredible aunt came to my birthday party yesterday. She brought her daughter, Lily, who is my best friend. We were playing outside, and Lily was swinging high. Suddenly, my dad blew a loud whistle for lunch. Lily got scared and fell off the swing! My aunt ran over fast and caught her.

"Are you okay?" asked my dad.

"I am just hungry," Lily said.

We ate cake, but it was plain vanilla. My dog tried to gnaw on the table leg. Then my brother threw a balloon, and it popped loudly. My mom almost fainted! She says she needs to study psychology to understand us kids. It was a crazy day.

Yesterday was a super fun day at recess. My neighbor Sam and I walked out of our apartment together. He was wearing his new blue sneakers. We ran to the big field behind the school.

"I bet I can climb the mountain first!" Sam yelled.

The mountain is just a big pile of dirt, but we pretend. I counted to three and we started running. I threw my backpack down and climbed fast. It felt like I was approaching the top of the world. I cleared the last rock and stood up tall.

"I am the champion of the league!" I shouted.

Sam laughed and we sat down to eat lunch. I had a sandwich wrapped in newspaper because we ran out of bags. It was the best recess ever.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We bounced on my bed for a long time. The only reason we stopped was for pizza. After dinner, we wanted to build a fort.

We scrambled to find all the big blankets. We often make forts in the living room. Sam started to climb on the sofa.

"Watch out for the cat!" I yelled loudly.

Sam turned around fast and almost fell. My cat was clinging to the cushion. She scratched the fabric just a little bit.

"Sorry, I didn't see her there," Sam said.

We drew a sign that said "No Cats Allowed." But later that night, the cat disappeared inside anyway. I was dreaming when she jumped on my feet. We got in no trouble because my mom just laughed.

I was already late for school because I was sleeping. I ran to the bus stop and blew my nose. My mom yelled, "Do not forget your lunchbox!" I grabbed it and reached for the big yellow bus door. At school, we had art class first. I drew a picture of a giant cactus with a sharp needle. Then we went outside for recess to play tag. We had to search for my friend Tommy behind the slide. He was hiding there. Then a big kid started swearing, so the teacher made him go inside. "That is not nice words," said my teacher Mrs. Miller. I ate my sandwich and felt happy. School is fun but I like sleeping more.

My brother Tom and I went to the big mountain. We wanted to find the secret cave at the top. We walked for a long time and got very tired.

"Look at that scary height!" Tom yelled loudly.

We climbed up rocks and walked through the trees. Suddenly, I dropped my water bottle down a hole. We looked down but neither of us saw it. It was lost forever. Then we found a tiny crack in the wall. We had to squeeze inside.

"I am thrilled we fit!" I said to him.

Inside the cave, we saw fourteen shiny gold coins. A bell was ringing somewhere deep inside. We remembered the legend of the ghost pirate who slept here throughout the winter. We grabbed the gold and ran home fast.

One day I was walking in the woods. Suddenly a shiny robot jumped out from behind a tree! He looked nice and he was singing a funny song. The robot had eight metal arms and they were swinging everywhere.

"Hello friend," said the robot with a beep.

I was not scared and I said, "Do you want to play?"

We walked together and the scenery was very pretty. We saw a brave knight fighting a green alien. The knight's armor was scattered on the grass. Neither of them saw us because they were too busy. I feared the alien might win but then something happened. The robot used his laser eyes and zapped the alien! It was a pleasant day so we went home for lunch. The robot followed me all the way back to my house.

School was weird today because I saw a ghost. It happened during our morning meeting on the rug. Mrs. Miller was talking about our new schedule. Suddenly I heard a loud thumping sound. My heart was beating like a drum rhythm.

"Did you hear that noise?" I asked my friend Ben.
"No, you are wrong," Ben whispered back to me.

I looked down and saw papers scattered everywhere. It was fourteen sheets of math homework! It seemed impossible that they moved by themselves. Maybe the ghost wanted to do my math problems. I picked them up quickly before Mrs. Miller saw. It was just the wind from the window, but I still think it was a ghost. Now I have to finish my lunch and go to recess. Hopefully the ghost stays inside the classroom.

It was raining very hard outside my house. My friend Tim came over and we were bored. We decided to explore the dark basement. It was scary down there and the wind blew loudly. We saw a shadow and I was afraid.

"Do you think it is a monster?" asked Tim.

"Maybe it is a ghost making trouble," I whispered back.

We walked closer and saw something fuzzy. It was just a little lamb toy! We laughed because we were scared for nothing. Then we smelled something good. My mom had brewed hot cocoa and roasted marshmallows for us. We ran upstairs screaming with joy. It was warm and we toasted bread too.

"This is enough adventure for today!" said Tim.

We drank cocoa and heard my mom cheering for us. We weren't scared anymore.

My robot named Zork had eight shiny silver arms. We went on a big space adventure to find gold. We flew past the stars and it looked like heaven. Suddenly a green alien jumped on our ship and was clinging tight. Zork grasped the alien but he was very slippery.

"Let go of my ship!" I yelled really loud.

The alien started singing a weird song and then let go. He just wanted some of my mom’s coffee for caffeine. I gave him a cup and he was so grateful. We found the treasure box on a beautiful purple moon. It was the best day ever.
