"Zork, let's go home now," I said happily.

My dad said school is very important, so I tried hard. Today was show-and-tell and I brought my new puppy. I trained him to sit but he was so excited.

"Please sit down, Colonel," I told him nicely.

He barked and sprinted right out the classroom door! I ran after him past the big red sign. My teacher blew her whistle but we kept running.

"Come back here!" yelled my friend Sarah.

We found Colonel chewing on an old newspaper in the hall. His fur was messy so I used my pocket comb. I have a big imagination so I pretended we were spies. It took a long time to complete our mission. I hope I remember to bring his leash next time. Being a dog owner is hard work.

I was walking home when I saw a weird green light. It came from the old castle on the hill. I sprinted up the path and saw a big metal robot. It had three eyes and looked like a shiny knight.

"Do you know where Mars is?" the robot screeched loudly. It sounded like a broken radio.

I was thrilled because I love science and space. "No, but we can find it together," I said.

The robot beeped and pressed a blue button immediately. We flew up into the sky very fast. I thought we would crash, but we didn't either. It was the best day ever.

I was boating in space on my rocket ship. Suddenly I saw a green alien floating near the ceiling. He had three eyes and looked very silly. He held a shiny blue jewel in his hand.

"Give me that jewel!" I shouted at him.

"Neither of us can have it!" said the alien.

Then he did a big sneeze and the jewel disappeared. We looked everywhere but it was gone. I picked up a space newspaper to check under it. The alien neared me and looked sad. We didn't find the jewel anywhere. It wasn't enough time to find it. Then my mom called me for dinner. The end.

My dog Buster is very silly and loud. One day we drove to the big park near my house. Buster jumped out and ran fast to the trees.

"Buster, you have to listen to me!" I yelled loud.

He did not stop and he flew over a big log. I feared he would get lost in the woods. I ran after him and crossed a little creek. Buster stopped because he saw a squirrel on a rock. He barked and the squirrel ran up a tree.

"I chose the wrong way to go," I said.

Then Buster cleared the path and ran back to me. We trained him better with treats later. At home I drew a picture of us. I like to write stories about my funny dog.

My brother Timmy is swinging on the light again. He likes climbing up high because he pretends to reign like a king. Mom looked up at the ceiling and got really mad.

"Timmy, get down or you are in big trouble!" she yelled.

Timmy was sounding like a monkey and would not stop. He was hanging by one arm and eating a cookie. A tiny crumb fell right on Mom's head. That was enough for her. She grabbed him and pulled him down fast.

"I didn't know you were watching," Timmy said quietly.

Mom made him sit in the corner for a long time. Next time I hope he just plays with his toys on the floor.

My brother and I went outside to explore the woods. We walked straight to the big old oak tree. It looked plain and boring but it was special. My brother said there was a ghost inside it.

"That is impossible," I told him. He just laughed.

We crawled under the bushes near the tree. We stayed there for an hour looking for bugs. Suddenly I saw something different moving in the leaves. It was a huge beetle with big jaws!

"Look out, it might be stinging!" yelled my brother.

I jumped back fast. The beetle spread its wings and flew away. We ran home to tell Mom about the monster bug. It was the best adventure ever.

I was playing a cool video game against my brother. We were racing fast cars past pretty scenery. I threw a red shell at his car and he spun out.

"Hey! That is cheating!" my brother yelled loudly.

"No way, I am just winning," I said back.

My car escaped the crash and kept going. I drove past a big water fountain in the game. I felt like I was floating on air. Suddenly, my car hit a giant newspaper stand and flipped over! My brother drove past me and won the race. He said I was roasted. It felt like a heavy weight on my shoulders. I did not receive the gold trophy this time.

My friend Sam and I played basketball at the park. It was a beautiful day and the sun was hot. We played hard throughout the whole game. Sam is very fast but I can shoot better.

"Pass the ball over here!" I yelled to Sam. He threw it high and I caught it quickly.

Then I discovered a spot near the water fountain. It was the best spot to make a basket. I tried to maintain my balance and I jumped up. The ball swooshed right into the net! Sam screeched loudly because he was so surprised.

"You won again," Sam spoke sadly but he smiled. We decided to remain friends even though I won. Then we drank water from the fountain.

On Wednesday my dog Max ran very fast outside. He was chasing a squirrel by the big tree. Max was pumping his legs hard and stamping the grass. The squirrel ran up the tree leading Max to bark.

Then Max sank down on the ground and closed his eyes. I thought he fainted because he was so tired!

"Wake up Max!" I yelled really loud at him.
"Woof!" Max said and jumped up to lick my face.

He was just playing a trick on me. I gave him a treat because he is a good guard dog. I could not contain my happiness so I hugged him. I treated him to a belly rub and we went inside.

It was my birthday and I woke up very early. I smelled pancakes for breakfast so I ran downstairs fast. My mom greeted me with a big hug. My dad was already making a huge stack of pancakes.

"Happy birthday to the champion!" my dad yelled loudly.

Then my dog Spot escaped out the back door. He started climbing the fence to see our neighbor. I had to run and catch him quickly. My reign as the birthday boy almost ended right there.

"You can't stay outside any longer, Spot," I said.

We went inside to complete the pancake stack together. Gradually my friends came over for a fun party. We played games until it got dark outside. It was the best day ever.

I was sitting in class and feeling lots of anger. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about a big math meeting. I chewed on my pencil until it had little teeth marks. Suddenly a tiny spider crawled onto my desk. It made a silk trail right over my notebook. I didn't want to knock it off. I used all my strength to sit very still.

"Look at that spider!" whispered my friend Ben.

"He looks stronger than he is," I whispered back.

I certain that the spider wanted to wrap up my pencil. I drew a circle around him with my marker. Then the bell rang for recess and everyone started cheering. The spider ran away fast. It was the best part of my whole day.

Yesterday was a super weird day at school. It was raining hard so we couldn't go outside for recess. We had to stay inside and play in the classroom. My friend Max was pumping his legs under the desk. He was really excited about lunch because his nephew gave him candy. 

Then we went to the cafeteria and it smelled like stewed tomatoes. I cleared my tray fast so I could get a drink. I went to the water fountain and my heart was thumping hard. I saw a big spider clinging to the metal part! It looked like a bug from the jungle.

"Eww, look at that giant spider!" I yelled loudly.

Mrs. Green came over and said, "It’s just a little spider, don't worry."

I decided I wasn't earning any bravery points today. I just went back to my seat very slowly.

I was sitting in class and looking out the window. It felt like we had been there for hours. The clock was moving slow like a giant elephant. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about gravity and the ground. I just wanted to go outside to the big meadow.

Finally the bell rang and everyone started running outside. We played tag near the school building.

"You can't catch me!" yelled my friend Tommy.

"Yes I can because I am earning points!" I shouted back.

Tommy ran faster but he tripped on his laces. He almost said a swearing word but he stopped. He threw a ball instead and everyone started cheering. We played until recess was done and school felt longer than ever.

Me and my best friend Sam searched the old forest. We were looking for the lost king's treasure. Suddenly we heard a scary noise. It was a loud groaning sound coming from a cave.

"I think something is waiting for us," Sam whispered.

We walked closer and opened the big vines. A huge bear was stuck in a trap and struggled hard. It was groaning in pain. We knew it was wrong to leave him. Sam started running to get a stick. We gradually pried the trap open. The bear jumped out and looked happy.

"Maybe he knows where the treasure is!" I shouted.

The bear started jumping and ran away. We followed him to a rock with a painting on it. The painting showed a gold crown. We found the reign of the king! We were earning our adventure badge today.

I looked at the shiny green jewel in my hand. It was very hot and it hummed like a bee. My robot friend Beep beeped at me loudly. 

"I believed you said it was cold!" Beep said.

"I thought it was!" I shouted back.

Suddenly a big door opened and a weird smell spread out. An alien walked out and he looked foreign and scary. He had three eyes and crossed his arms.

"That jewel is my power source," the alien growled. 

He brewed a potion in a cup and drank it fast. He said it was just a protein shake for strength. Then he tried to grab me but Beep zapped him. We ran to our spaceship and flew away very fast. We were safe but I still had the hot jewel.

I was playing tag with my friends at the park. We had a big company of kids playing today. I was "It" and I saw Tim approaching fast. He was wearing his new blue sneakers. I sprinted after him but he was too quick.

"You can't catch me!" Tim yelled loudly.

I stopped running and looked around for someone else. Leaves were scattered all over the grass. I discovered Sarah hiding behind the big slide. She cleared the fence by jumping over a log. I chased her and almost slipped on mud.

"Got you!" I shouted and tapped her shoulder.

Now Sarah was "It" and I ran away again. We played until the sun went down. Then we roasted marshmallows on a fire. We spread chocolate on graham crackers and ate them all. Only crumbs remain on my shirt now.

My friend Sam and I went to the big forest. We neared a huge cave and it looked scary. Sam bounced up and down because he was excited. He shouted, "Let's go inside and find treasure!"

We scrambled over big rocks and crossed a small river. The company of bats flew over our heads. We saw a shiny box at a great height. It was bearing a strange symbol on the lid. We grew brave and climbed up to get it.

I thought it was gold, but we discovered old toys. Sam opened the box and spread them out. It was important to share so we each took one.

"This is the best quest ever!" I said. We were happy to receive such a cool prize.

I was swinging on the swings at recess time. My friend Tim followed me and he looked scared. He said, "There is danger approaching the playground!"

I didn't believe him because Tim always makes up stories. I just drew a picture in the dirt with my shoe. Unfortunately, a big storm brewed in the sky. It got really dark and everyone started to complain. The teacher blew her whistle loudly.

"We must remain calm and go inside!" she yelled.

We ran to the door but I didn't understand why. Then I saw huge raindrops falling fast. We got inside just in time. Tim was actually right for once. I believed him now and we ate lunch safely inside.

One day my friend Ben and I walked into the dark woods. We were looking for the secret magic fountain. The old Colonel told us it was hidden deep in the earth. We feared giant spiders but we kept going. Suddenly Ben dropped his map in a big mud puddle!

"Oh no, look at that giant brown stain!" yelled Ben.

"Don't worry, I guarantee we can still find it," I said.

We walked more and finally saw shiny blue water. A nice fairy greeted us with a smile. We drank the water and felt super strong. We were so grateful to find it. Then we ran home before dinner.

One day my robot named Beep found a magic comb. It was shiny and purple and glowing. Beep grinned at me and put the comb on his head.

"Does my metal hair look good?" Beep asked me.

"You don't have any hair, silly robot!" I shouted.

Suddenly the comb started sounding like a buzzing bee. Then a giant spaceship landed in my backyard. A green alien walked out holding a fluffy white lamb.

"We read your mind," the alien said. "Here is a pet."

I petted the lamb and it felt wonderful. Unfortunately, the lamb had laser eyes! It zapped my mom’s flowers. I quickly rode on Beep’s back to catch the lamb. We gradually slowed it down with a giant net. Now the laser lamb lives in a special cage in my room.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old jungle gym. We pretended we were exploring a big, scary jungle.

"Watch out for the tiger!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam grinned and started swinging on the monkey bars. He was really fast. Suddenly, he fell down with a loud thud. He wasn't hurt, but he looked scared.

"I think gravity caught me," Sam said.

We crawled under the slide. It was like a dark cave. We heard something loud. It sounded like a screaming elephant! We ran away fast. My mom was coaching soccer nearby. She was bringing snacks. We crossed the field and screeched to a stop.

"Did you see the monster?" Sam asked while loading chips into his mouth.

We ate our snacks together and felt brave again. Being explorers is hard work.

I woke up in my apartment and saw a robot. It had fourteen shiny arms that were all twisted together. The robot looked angry and crushed my favorite toy car. 

"Hey, stop doing that!" I yelled at the robot. 

The robot beeped loudly and said, "My reign begins now!"

Suddenly, a blue light glowed in my arm like a vein. I realized I had super powers! I shot a laser and the robot disappeared. It seemed impossible, but I saved my room. Then my mom called me for breakfast. I hoped she didn't see the mess.

Yesterday my mom drove me to school early. I had to finish my big homework project. I was making a poster about lions. My friend Tim came over to my desk.

"That lion looks really scary," Tim said.

"It is the king of the jungle," I told him.

I glued a picture from an old newspaper on it. It showed a lion surrounding a baby zebra. My nephew likes lions so I worked hard. Then the bell rang for recess and we ran outside. We played tag near the water fountain. I saw a big bug on the ground though. I was certain it was a beetle. It was a good day at school.

I was waiting for my friend Sam to come over. It was my birthday and I was turning eight. I felt certain he would bring his new game. I love playing on his computer. Finally the doorbell rang and I ran fast. My neighbor Mrs. Green was outside but Sam was behind her.

"Happy birthday!" Sam yelled and dropped his big bag.

He was wearing his cool camping hat. We went to the kitchen and ate cake. Mom cleared the table and then we played games. Later my dad called us to go outside. We played tag until it got dark. It was the best day ever.

The robot was huge and he was roaming in the forest. His name was Clank and he was bearing a big silver box. It was freezing outside but Clank didn't care. He saw a giant purple beetle on a tree. The beetle was groaning very loud.

"Are you okay?" asked Clank in his metal voice.

"I am hungry," said the beetle sadly.

Clank grinned and opened his big box. He drew out a shiny metal apple. It was a treasure for robots. He gave it to the beetle. The beetle started tearing it apart and eating it fast. They sat together on a log. It was a very pleasant day. Then Clank pulled out an old newspaper to read. He didn't understand the words, but he liked the pictures.

It was freezing outside at recess today. My teacher said we still had to go out. I put on my big coat and my hat. My finger hurt because I got a paper cut in math. Math was so hard today and the problems were impossible.

"I bet I can jump fourteen times!" shouted Billy.

He started stamping his feet in the snow. I watched him jump but he fell down. It looked like a snow creature got him. We all laughed but Billy was mad.

"I already did fifteen jumps!" I yelled back.

Just then the bell rang for lunch. We ran inside to get warm. I ate every single bite of my sandwich. I hope we don't have homework tonight.

My brother Tim and I found a hidden door. It was behind a big painting in the hallway. We pushed it open and saw dark stairs.

"This is impossible!" Tim whispered and he looked scared.

We went down the stairs very slowly. It smelled like old dirt and wet socks. Suddenly we heard a loud moaning sound.

"Maybe we should go back up again," I said.

But Tim wanted to be a brave champion today. He turned on his flashlight and we kept walking. We discovered a big wooden chest in the corner. Something scratched inside the box and I jumped back.

Tim was loading his slingshot just in case. He opened the lid and a tiny kitten jumped out! It wasn't a monster at all. We took the kitten upstairs and gave it some milk.

My dog Buster and I went exploring through the woods. It was a beautiful day but then we heard a weird noise. It sounded like thumping and bumping near the big oak tree.

"What is that noise Buster?" I asked him quietly.

Buster barked and ran over to a pile of leaves. I looked down and saw a crushed soda can. A squirrel was trying to get it but it was stuck. I picked up the can and the squirrel ran up the height of the tree.

"You are safe now little squirrel!" I yelled up.

Then we walked home and I played my guitar. We will go back tomorrow to find more animals.

I have a secret robot named Zorg in my apartment. He looks like a shiny toaster with legs. One day Zorg drank some purple juice and made a mess. There was a big purple stain on the rug.

"Oh no!" Zorg beeped loudly, sounding very scared.

"We have to clean it before Mom comes home," I said.

Zorg used his super robot strength to scrub really fast. Then we sprinted to the kitchen for a wet towel. Zorg started jumping up and down because he was nervous. I could hear his heavy metal breathing.

"Use your laser eyes!" I yelled at him.

He grinned and zap-dried the rug instantly. We worked together and saved the day. It was the greatest secret ever. We tried to contain our giggles throughout the night. Leading a double life is very important work.

One day me and Tim went into the deep jungle. We were looking for the lost magic castle. It was early in the morning so the sun was yellow. Suddenly we heard a scary groaning sound behind a big bush.

"Watch out for danger!" shouted Tim loudly.

I grabbed my plastic knife and held it up. A giant monkey jumped out and he looked really mad. He was even swearing in monkey language at us. We ran fast and found the castle door open. We ran inside and slammed the heavy door shut. We realized we were safe but we were hungry. We found some bread and toasted it on a fire.

"That was close," I said and ate the toast.

Me and my friend Sam went to a spooky island. We wanted to find a treasure chest. We walked through the dark woods and it grew very cold. Suddenly we saw a big cliff.

"Look down there!" shouted Sam.

I looked and saw the treasure hanging on a branch. But it was far down. Neither of us had a rope.

"We can bungee jump with these vines!" I said.

We tied vines to our legs and jumped. We shook with fear but we grabbed the box. When we climbed back up, we opened it. We did not receive gold. It was just old rocks! We laughed and went home for dinner.

I was in art class and it was my favorite time. We were painting pictures of animals. I made a cool design for a tiger. Suddenly, Tim screamed because he spilled red paint everywhere. It made a huge mess on the floor. 

"Oh no, look at that scene!" Tim said.

The teacher came over and she was not happy. My heart was thumping really fast. I helped Tim clean it up. Then the bell rang for recess. We ran to the swings with the rusty chain. A new kid from a foreign country came over.

"Do you want some company?" he asked us.

We played tag until the teacher caught us running. I grumbled because I was having fun. But then I started groaning because I remembered my math homework. School is fun but sometimes it is hard work.

It was a hot Wednesday and we rode our bikes to the dark jungle behind my house. I was wearing my lucky hat and bringing my flashlight. My friend Sam was trembling a little bit. We wanted to see the monster.

"Do you hear that rhythm?" Sam asked me.

"I think it is just the wind," I said brave.

We walked past eight big trees and saw a cave. Suddenly a loud noise struck the air! It was a scary roar. We looked up at the height of the cave. A huge shadow rose up. We were beginning to run fast. I was tearing my pants on a bush but I didn't stop. We did not understand what the monster was but we were safe at home.

I was playing baseball at the park with my friend Ben. It was super hot outside and the sun was bright. A tiny bug flew near my face like a gnat. I swatted it away and got ready to bat. Ben threw the ball really fast and I swung hard. I hit it way over the fence!

"You hit a home run!" Ben shouted loudly.

I ran around the bases and felt very happy. But then I started to feel dizzy. The world gradually went dark and I fell down. I almost fainted because it was so hot. My mom ran over and greeted me with cold water.

"Drink this or you can't play again," she said.

I drank it all and felt better. Later I will write a letter to my grandma about my big hit. I already sent her a picture of me holding the bat. I finally caught the ball later in the game too.

I went outside with my dog Buster today. We went to the park and I threw his favorite red ball. Buster started running fast and he looked so happy.

Suddenly, a grey squirrel moved across the grass. Buster stopped chasing the ball and chased the squirrel instead. The squirrel ran up a big oak tree. It was clinging to the bark way up high.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

"Woof! Woof!" Buster barked at the squirrel.

Catching that squirrel was impossible for a dog. It was a different kind of animal. I took a stick and drew a picture of a knight in the dirt. Then Buster finally came back to me. We walked home and Buster was tired.

I was playing my favorite computer game on Saturday. It was a race with fast cars and cool scenery. I was certain I would win the big gold cup. But then my dog jumped on my lap and barked.

"Get down, Spot!" I yelled at him.

But he hit the controller and my car fell off the road. It was a total failure because I crashed into a wall. My brother laughed and said, "That is impossible to fix!"

Then the referee blew a whistle on the TV screen. I restarted the game and held the controller tight. This time I drove past a farm with a little lamb. I escaped the bad guys and crossed the finish line first! I won the race and we had pizza for dinner.

Me and my younger brother Tim went into the dark woods. We were waiting for a monster but we only saw trees. It was cold so I put on my red sweater. We walked through the bushes and I heard a scary sound.

"I am afraid!" yelled Tim and he grabbed my arm.

"Don't be a scaredy cat," I grumbled back at him.

Suddenly we saw a huge hill and we had to climb it. We struggled up the rocks and kept bumping into each other. I feared we would fall but we simply kept going. Gradually we got to the top and looked down. There was no monster there, just a little white lamb. It looked at us with anger but it was cute. We laughed and then we went home for dinner.

My dog Buster loves to play outside. Yesterday we went running in the woods to search for sticks. Buster found a huge stick, but it was twisted around a tree root. I grabbed it and pulled hard. Suddenly I heard a loud knock on the tree.

"Did you hear that?" I asked Buster.

Buster barked and started climbing up the hill. I followed him fast. We saw a big fat squirrel sitting on a rock like a colonel in the army. It was eating a nut it had crushed.

"He looks funny," I laughed.

My mom says I need to learn about nature, but not if I get cold. She worries about pneumonia if I don't wear a jacket. She is always coaching me on how to be safe. We went home and I used a comb to get the burrs out of Buster’s fur. Exploring is the best.

One day I was running in the jungle behind my house. My nephew Timmy was with me. We were playing explorers. Suddenly we saw a big elephant eating leaves. "Look at that huge elephant!" yelled Timmy. I grabbed his hand so he wouldn't get too close. The elephant looked nice but then Timmy fell over a rock. He scraped his knee and started crying. The elephant made a loud noise like it sang a song. Then my mom called us for dinner. We smelled stewed tomatoes and ran back home. "I am so grateful we are safe," I said to Timmy. Being an explorer is hard work.

My friends and I went camping in the deep woods. We brought a big computer to play games. Suddenly, a bear crashed through the trees! It looked very hungry and angry.

"Run fast!" I yelled to my friend Sam.
"It is impossible to run with the computer!" Sam screamed.

We were in big trouble because the bear was roaring. I carefully grabbed my scissors from my bag. I cut a rope and the heavy computer fell. It made a loud ringing sound when it hit a rock. The bear got scared and ran away screaming. We thought we were safe, but bringing the computer was a bad idea. Next time we will just bring marshmallows.

Yesterday at recess we played a big game. We pretended the jungle gym was a giant castle. Tim rode on my back like a horse. I shouted, "Run fast to the hospital!"

But then I twisted my ankle on a rock. It hurt so much I almost fainted right there. The pain took all my strength away. Tim looked at my foot and frowned.

"Is something wrong with your leg?" he asked.

"I think I lost the game," I said sadly.

The teacher came over to search for the problem. She said it wasn't broken but I needed ice. I had to contain my tears because everyone was watching. Later we ate roasted chicken for lunch. I told Tim everything was okay. It was enough fun for one day.

One day me and my neighbor Leo saw a spooky forest. We built a secret fort near it with old wood. My heart was thumping really hard. I was yearning to go inside the dark trees.

"Are you scared?" I asked Leo.

"No way, I brought scissors," he said brave.

We walked in straight and it got dark gradually. Suddenly we heard a big weight drop! Something was dumping rocks from the sky. It was a giant monkey jumping on branches! Leo started swearing but I told him to stop. We ran back fast enough. My mom was mad about my muddy shoes. She is grounding me for a week but I am just hungry now.

Me and my younger brother found a map. It showed a secret cave in our neighbor's yard. We packed snacks and walked past the hanging vines. Suddenly a strange creature appeared! It looked like a foreign monster with green fur.

"Be honest, are you scared?" I asked my brother.

"No way, I am brave!" he yelled back.

We ran fast because gravity pulled us down the hill. We discovered a golden crown inside the cave. It was from the reign of a king. We treated it carefully. Then we looked at my watch.

"Oh no, look at the schedule!" I said.

We had to go home for dinner. It was the best day ever.

I was sleeping in class when the loud bell rang. It was time for recess and everyone ran outside fast. I grabbed my red ball and bounced it hard. My friend Tom wanted to play tag with me though.

"You can't catch me!" Tom yelled and ran away.

I chased him but I struggled to run fast enough. Tom disappeared behind the big slide on the playground. I crawled under the monkey bars to find him. Suddenly I felt a squeeze on my arm.

"Got you!" Tom said and poked me with a finger.

I grumbled because he was too fast for me. Then the teacher blew her whistle loudly. We walked back inside gradually. I feared looking at my math homework. I got every single answer wrong on the page. School is hard but recess is the best part.

My brother Tom and I played the new racing video game. We had company over, but I just wanted to win. I grabbed the red controller and yelled, "I am going to beat you!"

The race started and my car moved very fast. Tom’s car was following me, but he crashed into a wall. Suddenly, my dog Max jumped up and chewed on the wire! The screen went black and I almost fainted.

"That is not fair!" Tom shouted.

I was honest and said, "Okay, Max ruined my reign as champion."

We hung up the controllers and went outside instead. My dad taught us how to play basketball, and nobody had to complain. Playing outside was actually better than the game.

Me and my neighbor Tom went exploring in the woods. We were looking for a secret cave with treasure. I brought my lucky guitar for music. Tom was steering us through the tall green trees.

"We have to be quiet," Tom whispered to me.

Suddenly we heard a strange rhythm like a drum. We started running very fast because it was scary. We found a big hole in the ground though. It looked beautiful inside with shiny rocks.

"I think we will receive a reward!" I yelled.

We were keeping safe by staying near the entrance. It was different than other caves. We heard a grounding noise and saw a bear! We ran all the way home fast. Next time we will bring snacks.

I was sitting in science class and looking outside. My teacher Mrs. Green was wearing a bright yellow dress. She was approaching my desk with a big paper. It was a test about bugs and psychology. I felt a heavy weight in my tummy. Suddenly I saw something black roaming on the floor. It was a huge beetle!

"Look out!" I yelled and scrambled onto my chair.

"What is going on?" Mrs. Green asked me loudly.

The beetle was tearing across the room very fast. It was steering right for the teacher’s shoes. Everyone laughed but I was scared. Mrs. Green picked it up gently. She put it outside in the grass. Then we finished the test. I got a B plus.

My neighbor Tom came over early on Saturday. We played a racing game for fourteen minutes straight. I picked the blue car, and Tom picked the red truck. We zoomed through the first track fast. I cleared the big jump, but Tom crashed into a wall.

"I am going to win this time!" I yelled.

Tom laughed and said, "You don't understand how to drift."

Suddenly, a huge black beetle flew onto the TV screen! We both screamed and ran to the balcony. The race was still going inside, but we were scared. We decided to play basketball outside instead. It was safer than bugs.

I was the captain of our spaceship. My friend Billy was the science officer. We pushed a button and zoomed to Mars. It was impossible to see anything outside.

"Look at that red stain on the ground," Billy called.

We put on our helmets and walked outside. We discovered a huge cave. It was dark but I knew we were brave. Suddenly a green monster jumped out! It tried to grab Billy but he turned invisible.

"You can't catch me!" Billy yelled.

The monster was confused. It looked around but saw not a single person. Then it got tired and slept on a rock. We ran back to the ship fast. We were safe and happy.

I was playing my new video game with my brother. My dad bought it for us yesterday from the big store. It is a racing game with super fast cars. We had company over, so my cousin Sam was watching too. I picked the red car with the lightning bolt. My brother picked the blue one.

"I am going to win this race!" I screamed loudly.

"No way, you are going to lose," my brother said.

The race started and I was driving really fast. Suddenly, I hit a sharp needle on the road. My car spun around and scattered parts everywhere. I was stamping my feet because I was so mad. I thought I was bearing down on the finish line. Sam was seeing everything and laughing at me. I need to learn how to drive better next time.

My best friend Sam had a big sleepover on Saturday. We walked to his house and rang the doorbell. It was ringing for a long time until his mom opened it. She grinned and let me inside for the party.

We ate stewed tomatoes and toasted cheese sandwiches for dinner. Then we went outside to play near the water fountain. Sam had a huge red balloon floating in the air. The wind blew very hard and the balloon flew away!

"Oh no! My balloon is gone!" Sam yelled.

"Don't worry, we can get another one," I said.

We followed the balloon but it went way up high. We didn't want to get in trouble so we stopped. I was grateful that we still had cake to eat later. We stayed up way longer than usual that night.

My friends and I found a hidden trail in the woods. We walked on the rocky ground for a long time. Suddenly, we heard a scary noise surrounding us.

"Did you hear that?" shouted Max.

"It sounded like a monster," I whispered back.

Something screeched loudly and we froze. A big bird flew down and scratched a tree. We kept walking and the path went up gradually. We saw a cave and smelled something like roasted marshmallows. It was very strange science!

"We need to keep a steady pace," said Sarah.

We saw a silver thread on the floor. We followed it into the dark. My brain told me to run away. But we were approaching a treasure chest! We opened it and found old toys. It was the best adventure ever.

I played a video game for an hour with my friend. We wanted to be the champion of the whole world. My character was a brave colonel with a big sword. His character was a funny guide who kept getting lost. We reached level fourteen and it was super hard.

"Watch out for that big monster!" I screamed loudly.

He didn't listen and the monster hit him hard. He almost fainted in the game but I saved him. We finally beat the boss at the magic fountain. Everyone in the game was cheering for us. We sat back and felt like heroes.

"I am certain we are the best company ever," he said.

Then we heard a loud knock on my door. It was time for dinner.

My heart was pumping fast as I sprinted down the field. I was playing soccer against the red team and they were really good. The ball was clinging to my foot like glue. I looked up and saw the goalie roaming near the net.

"Pass it here!" yelled my friend Sam from the side.

"I can do it!" I shouted back.

I thought about kicking it, but then a big kid blocked me. It looked impossible to get through. I used my toe to poke the ball sideways. Then I kicked it hard. The whistle was sounding just as the ball went in.

I hurt my finger when I fell, but I didn't care. We won the game and everyone cheered for us.

My big brother is thirteen today and we went camping. Dad brewed some coffee but he said it had too much caffeine. I searched for sticks and we made a big fire. My friend Sam came too and he was stamping his feet because it was cold. We pretended to be a brave knight and a dragon.

"Look at that bug on your thumb!" Sam yelled.

I shook my hand and threw the bug away. Then Dad turned on the radio and we started cheering. We sang happy birthday and ate eight marshmallows each. Not a single one was left in the bag.

"Did you bring the cake?" asked Mom.

Dad looked sad because something was wrong. We left the cake hanging in the kitchen at home!

My friend Sam and I went to the big woods. We wanted to find the secret cave on the map. We drew the map in school last week. We had to climb a big hill with rocks. The trees were growing tall and thick everywhere. Suddenly we heard a noise like a baby lamb.

"Do you think it is scared?" I asked Sam.

Sam looked at the bushes and nodded his head. "Yes, maybe it is hiding from a bear."

We were brave so we walked to the noise. We found a little lost dog, not a lamb! He was shivering like he had pneumonia. We brewed some warm tea later and gave him water. The dog was very grateful and happy. Now he is our guide for every adventure.

Me and my friend Sam went into the spooky woods. We were looking for the old castle ruins. Sam was jumping over big rocks and logs. We walked for a long time. Suddenly we saw a weird blue light floating in the air. 

"Look at that strange light!" Sam shouted loudly.

It was leading us to a dark cave. We went inside carefully. It was a scary scene. A white sheet was hanging from the ceiling. 

"I think that is a ghost!" I whispered to Sam.

Sam laughed and pulled the sheet down. It was just an old flag roaming in the wind. We understood it wasn't real. It was a pleasure to find the castle behind the cave. We knew we were brave explorers. Although it was dark, we felt happy. I will write about our big adventure in my diary tonight.

Yesterday was the craziest day at school ever. I was sitting at my desk and my finger hurt from writing so much. Suddenly a tiny gnat flew right onto my paper.

"Get away from my homework!" I whispered to the bug.

The gnat didn't listen and kept roaming around my math sheet. I tried to flick it but I missed. Then the fire alarm started thumping really loud in the hallway. Everyone started jumping up.

"Is it a real fire?" my friend Sam asked me.

We walked outside to the playground. A squirrel was clinging to the slide. It stole a granola bar from someone's backpack! We watched it eat. It looked like it was boating on a sea of grass. I wrote about the squirrel later for my story. It was way better than doing math.

I sat on the porch and watched my dog Rex. He was coaching a squirrel up the big oak tree. The wind blew hard and the leaves shook fast.

"You can't catch him, Rex! It is impossible," I said.

Rex just stared at the squirrel like he would reign over the yard forever. He started groaning and moaning because the squirrel got away. Unfortunately, it started to rain, so we went inside.

My mom greeted us with warm bowls of stewed beef.

"This has lots of protein for big muscles," she told me.

I ate my food and thought about my science homework. It took me an hour to finish it. Then I played with Rex again. He is the best dog in the world.

Me and Sam went to the dark woods today. We found a hidden trail behind the playground. I was swinging a big stick like a sword. Sam looked like a champion explorer with his backpack. Suddenly we heard a loud noise.

"What was that?" Sam screeched and dropped his bag.

I feared it was a monster stamping on the earth. We walked slow and saw a huge fountain of water. A pipe had crashed and water was screaming out. It made a scary rhythm. We were thrilled but also wet.

"We need help bringing tools!" I yelled over the noise.

It was a crazy scene. We ran home fast to tell my dad.

My neighbor Timmy said he was the best at video games. He thought he could beat me in Super Kart Racing. I knew I was faster because I practiced every day. My mom was drinking her coffee for the caffeine. She sat on the couch and started coaching me.

"Watch out for the banana peel!" she yelled loudly.

I stuck out my tongue and chewed my gum really fast. I drove my kart up the big mountain level. Timmy crashed into a wall and his car got roasted.

"I win! I win!" I shouted and jumped up.

My mom laughed and said she was proud of her daughter. Timmy was sad but we played again later.

My brother and I love playing racing video games. We pretend we are boating on a huge blue ocean. Yesterday we had a really big race on the TV. I pushed the gas button as hard as I could. My boat was floating past his fast red boat.

"Hey, you are cheating!" my brother yelled at me.

"No I am not, just watch me win!" I shouted back.

Suddenly a giant shark appeared on the screen and ate him. I won the race and did a happy dance. I had to use my imagination to win. I will write my name on the high score list. I hope he will listen next time and drive faster. I will always remember that funny shark.

The cave was dark and smelled like old socks. Tim and Sarah walked in slowly. The heavy door closed behind them with a loud bang.

"I don't like this place very often," whispered Sarah.

Suddenly, a tiny gnat flew right into Tim's eye! He started groaning and rubbing his face. But then they saw something shiny on the ground. It was a big red jewel sitting on a rock.

"Look at that treasure!" Tim shouted with pleasure.

Just then, a small dragon landed in front of them. It breathed fire and almost roasted their shoes. The dragon looked lonely, so Sarah treated it nicely. She gave it her sandwich. The dragon ate it and smiled. They were friends now.

Max and I were roaming in the woods. We saw a weird cave and we went inside. It was dark and I felt trembling in my legs.

Suddenly, a giant bear rose up! It looked like a monster from a scary painting. I realized it wanted our lunch.

"Run away!" I screamed.

Max grabbed my arm and we scrambled over rocks. My shoe sank in the mud and I struggled to pull it out. The bear chewed on a stick and roared loud.

"Don't complain, just run!" Max yelled back.

We found a tiny door and I opened it fast. We jumped inside and slammed it. I drew a deep breath. It was safe here. We ate our eight cookies and used scissors to cut open the juice. We were safe now.

Yesterday at school was super crazy and weird. It was very hot outside and the sun scorched the playground. We were playing tag and I was running fast. Suddenly I saw a weird blue balloon floating by the swings. It looked like it escaped from a party.

"Hey look at that big thing!" shouted my friend Sam.

I walked over carefully to see it better. It had strange letters on it like a foreign language. I caught the string and was bearing it to the teacher. I thought maybe I was earning a gold star for help. But then the balloon popped loudly! Everyone started groaning because the noise was scary.

"Oh no, now it's just trash," I said sadly.

Mrs. Green said it was okay and gave me a sticker anyway. I like stickers.

I was loading my toy truck with dirt in the backyard. My dog Buster was roaming around the bushes looking for bugs. Suddenly I heard a loud thumping noise near the big tree. I ran over and saw a baby bird trapped in a hole. It had a blue feather and it looked scared.

"Don’t worry little bird, I will save you," I said.

I tried to reach it but the hole was too deep. I had a good idea. I went back to my truck and started dumping the dirt out. I filled the truck with soft leaves instead to make a bed.

My neighbor Mr. Smith looked over the fence and smiled.

"Is that a castle for a bird?" he asked.

"No, it is an ambulance!" I yelled back.

I lifted the bird out and it felt like zero weight. We took it to the vet and now it is safe.

My big brother Max and I went into the woods. We were looking for the lost cave of gold. Max is fourteen and he thinks he is brave. I was keeping up with him but my legs were tired.

"Hurry up or the trolls will get you!" Max yelled.

We found a deep hole near the big oak tree. It looked scary and dark inside. Suddenly, I slipped on some wet leaves and fell. I was clinging to a root to stop falling down.

"Grab my hand right now!" I screamed loudly.

Max pulled me up and we sat down fast. We ate some chewed gum and felt safe again. Mom was bringing stewed carrots for dinner later so we ran home. I was yearning for pizza but carrots are okay too. Max was swearing he saw a ghost but he was lying.

Tim and I walked through the big green forest. We were bearing big sticks to push the leaves away. Suddenly we saw a giant castle made of grey stone. It looked like heaven but scary. A big guard stood by the door. He was reading a newspaper and looked mean.

"We need to get inside!" I screamed very loud.

The guard looked up and he was not pleased. He started tearing up his paper and ran at us! I meant to be brave but I was scared. Tim threw a rock and it hit a metal bucket. Clang! We ran away past the pretty scenery. We never paid to get in but that was okay. We were safe and tired.

Me and my best friend Leo looked at the map. It was raining hard outside but we had a schedule to keep. We wanted to find the greatest treasure in the woods. We put on our boots and ran outside. The scenery was muddy and dark.

"Watch out for that hole!" yelled Leo.

I almost fell but I grabbed a branch. We were bumping into trees because it was slippery. The rain was dumping water on our heads. We struggled to walk up the big hill. Gradually the rain stopped and the sun came out. We saw a big box under a tree.

"We found it!" I shouted.

We opened the box and saw gold coins spread everywhere. It was hard to maintain our excitement. We were rich!

I was climbing the big slide at recess today. It felt like a giant mountain. My friend Sam was waiting at the bottom for me.

"Hurry up! Lunch is sounding really good right now!" Sam yelled loudly.

I slid down fast and almost hit a stinging nettle bush. We ran to the cafeteria because they sold pizza on Fridays. I counted my money and bought a huge slice. It was so cheesy and hot. Sam had already finished his sandwich.

"Did you see that new trail behind the gym?" I asked him.

We wanted to go look, but the bell rang. Our teacher Mrs. Green appeared and said recess was over. She was teaching us about history next. It was a fun day even without the trail.

Me and my brother Sam were playing soccer inside our apartment. We know Mom says no balls in the house. But it was raining hard outside. Sam kicked the ball way too high.

It went floating through the air like a balloon.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "Watch out for the lamp!"

The ball crashed right into Mom's beautiful lamp. The lamp fell over and dropped onto the floor. It broke into lots of little pieces. We stood there groaning.

Then we heard the front door open. My heart started pumping really fast. We were so roasted.

"What was that noise?" Mom asked from the hallway.

Sam looked at me and started jumping up and down nervously. "We are sorry!" we both shouted at the same time. We promised to fix it with glue. Mom was mad, but she helped us clean it up. Next time we will just play video games.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday and he is five. My mom taught me how to wrap his present. It was a stuffed lamb that was very soft. We went to his house and everyone was already there. Sam was jumping on the couch and bumping into people. My dad sat down to read the newspaper but Sam sat on him!

"I knew you would sit here!" yelled Sam.

My aunt said, "Sam, please let Uncle Mike sit down."

Then it was time for cake and presents. Sam tried to seize all the gifts at once. He acted like he was a king and wanted to reign over the party. My mom said he had too much caffeine. But then he opened my gift and smiled.

"This is like treasure," he whispered.

We ate cake and it was a good day.

It was my birthday party and I was so excited. My friends were approaching the house with big presents. We ate pizza and then my dad got his guitar. He started playing a funny song and we all danced. Suddenly I saw a big red balloon floating away.

"Grab it before it goes!" I shouted loudly.

My friend Leo grabbed the string and saved the balloon. We were all screaming and laughing because it was scary. But then my brother started groaning because he hates loud noises. He thinks loud noises hurt his brain. He started to complain to my mom about the noise.

"Be quiet or you are getting a grounding," mom said.

Although he was mad, he stayed steady and quiet. We ate cake and it was the best day ever.

It happened last Wednesday when me and my neighbor went exploring. We walked straight to the spooky forest behind my house. Everything was super quiet and dark in there. Suddenly the ground shook hard and we heard a loud groaning sound!

"We have to be brave," I told my friend Sam.

Sam gripped my arm tight and pointed at a cave. A glowing green light was inside the dark hole. We wanted to seize the treasure but it was scary.

"Maybe it is an alien island," Sam whispered.

I knew this was important so I took a deep breath. We walked inside but the light started to contain us. We ran back home fast and drank juice. We were safe but we never found the alien treasure.

I was playing basketball in the driveway with my big brother. He is taller than me and he thinks he is the best. I bounced the ball really hard and tried to run past him. He struck the ball away and laughed at me. I got mad and I could feel a vein popping in my neck.

"You are not strong enough to beat me!" he yelled.

I grabbed the ball and used all my strength to jump. I was tearing down the court fast. I threw the ball high up toward the hoop. It hit the rim and then went straight up like it hit a ceiling. Then it fell right through the net!

"Yes! I win!" I shouted super loud.

My mom came outside because she heard us swearing earlier. But I didn't care because I finally beat him.

My neighbor sits next to me in class. Today was weird because he kept bringing out a toy spider. He drew a picture of it eating a crumb. Then he put the spider on my desk during math. I was scared for a second because it looked so real!

"Get that thing away!" I whispered loudly to him.

"But he wants to reign over your desk," he laughed.

The teacher looked at us and we froze. She was cleaning the board and turned around fast. I was certain we would get caught. It felt like a scene from a movie leading to danger. Just then, the bell rang for lunch.

"We are having stewed tomatoes today," I said sadly.

My schedule says gym is next, so I am happy again.

It was early in the morning at my apartment. My friend Sam came over and we ate some toasted bread. We had an important mission to do in the woods today. We walked past the park and looked at the green scenery.

Suddenly we heard a loud groaning noise behind a big rock. I was scared but I grabbed a stick.

"Is that a monster?" asked Sam with a shaky voice.

"Maybe it is just a bear," I said back.

We looked and it was just a man who hurt his thumb. He was swearing a little bit because it hurt bad. We obtained a bandage from my backpack for him. He gave a happy whistle and walked away. We didn't have a failure today! It was a good adventure.

My science homework was growing bigger every minute. I threw my pencil on the desk and sighed. It was already time for recess, but I wasn't done.

"Are you coming outside?" asked my friend Max.

"No, I have to finish this stinging math problem," I said.

The numbers were scattered all over the page. I touched my head because it hurt a little. Suddenly, the bell rang for lunch! A pleasure filled my heart. I grabbed my lunchbox and ran to the water fountain. Max was waiting by the chain fence.

"Did you finish?" he asked with a smile.

"Nope, but trouble is brewing for later," I laughed. We played tag and I was clinging to the slide. The fun gradually made me forget about homework.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring in the woods. We often go there to look for cool bugs. Suddenly we saw a big sign that said "DANGER!"

"I think we should go back," Leo said.

"No way, let's keep climbing that hill," I told him.

We started climbing up the steep rocks. It was hard work. Then we heard a loud noise approaching us. A wild monkey jumped out! It screeched at us and it had a tiny guitar. It was a strange scene.

"He escaped from the zoo!" I shouted.

The monkey looked sad so I started coaching it on how to be nice. The monkey understood and stopped jumping. He grinned at us. We gave him a banana and he was very grateful. Then we ran home fast.

My nephew Tim and I went to the big jungle. We had a schedule to find the hidden gold. We walked carefully past some big green trees. Suddenly a knight appeared in shiny metal armor. He looked very hot and his cape was scorched.

"Do not go that way!" the knight yelled loudly.

I looked at a wooden sign on a tree. It said Danger Keep Out in red paint. We heard a dragon roar and saw smoke. Tim started climbing a tall rock to see better. I saw a pot of stewed carrots nearby. It smelled really bad but looked warm.

"We have to learn to be brave," I said.

Then a beautiful blue bird appeared and showed us a path. We ran fast and we were safe.

My nephew Tim and I went to the spooky old forest. We wanted to find the lost gold hanging in the trees. We walked for a long time and saw a weird bird. It flew away fast and led us to a cave.

"Should we go in?" asked Tim with a shaky voice.

"Yes, we are brave explorers!" I said loudly.

Suddenly we heard a loud knock on the cave wall. A man in a green coat walked out. He looked like an army colonel. He had anger in his eyes and spoke a foreign language. We got scared and ran away fast but got caught in vines. Tim cut the vines and we ran home safely. We never found the gold.

My dog Buster is the greatest knight in the whole world. Yesterday we went exploring through the big woods behind my house. We walked for an hour and then we saw a squirrel.

"Get him, Buster!" I yelled.

Buster screeched and ran fast but the squirrel escaped immediately. It climbed a tree and kept looking down at us. Buster was groaning because he wanted to catch it. We sat by a water fountain to rest. My mom says dogs need protein to maintain their energy. I gave him a treat for his brain.

"You are a good boy," I said to him.

It was just the beginning of our fun day. My mom sent a text to come home for dinner. We ran back inside.

My brother Jake is super good at the mountain game. You have to climb a huge rock and fight monsters. It felt impossible to beat him, but I kept trying. I was swinging my sword, and he was throwing fireballs.

"You are going to lose again!" Jake yelled loudly.

"No way, I practiced all day," I shouted back.

My heart was thumping hard in my chest. He scorched my character with fire, but I dodged it. I jumped up and bounced off a plain rock wall. Then I scrambled up to the top and won! He was so mad he looked like he swallowed a knife. Bringing home the trophy felt amazing. I had to write my name on the winner's list right away. Dad said if I beat Jake again, I would be in big trouble.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring in the woods. We wanted to find the old treehouse everyone talked about. We walked for a long time and my legs were getting tired. Suddenly we discovered a huge pile of rocks blocking the path.

"It looks impossible to climb," said Leo.

"No way, we have the strength," I told him.

We started climbing and my heart was pumping fast. I saw old toys scattered everywhere on the ground. Then we heard a loud noise and a branch crashed down! It was stinging my arm a little bit. We started stamping our feet to scare away any animals. Then we looked up and saw a rope hanging down.

"Grab it immediately!" I yelled.

We pulled ourselves up and we were safe inside the secret treehouse. It was the best adventure ever.

I was sitting in class and dreaming about recess. My legs were pumping under my desk because I had too much energy. Mrs. Green was speaking about math but I wasn't listening. I just wanted to go play on the jungle gym.

Finally the bell rang and everyone ran outside. I saw my friend Sam loading his backpack.

"Do you want to play knights?" I asked him.

"I am a trained champion!" Sam yelled back.

We ran to the swings and pretended they were horses. Neither of us wanted to stop. But then I felt a heavy weight on my shoulder. It was just my backpack. I had forgotten to take it off! I spread my arms and pretended to fly anyway. Then the bell rang again and everyone started moaning. I felt some anger but we had to go inside. Being a knight is hard work.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday party last Saturday. Everyone was scattered around the yard playing games. My dad was coaching a game of kickball. Suddenly, the big red balloon started floating away into the sky!

"Oh no! My balloon!" Sam yelled. He looked sad.

We all watched it go higher and higher. It grew very small. I grinned and had an idea. I ran to the garage and got my toy drone.

"I can save it!" I shouted to Sam.

I flew the drone up fast. It hit the balloon string and brought it down. But then my dog started to gnaw on the string!

"Stop that, Buster!" Mom said.

We saved the balloon just in time. Sam believed I was a hero. To be honest, I just got lucky. It was the best part of the beginning of the party. We counted three pieces of cake for me later.

My cat Fluffy ran outside and I chased him. He went near the old stone fountain in the park. I put on my red sweater because it was cold. Fluffy jumped on a big rock and screeched loudly. I knew he saw something scary in the bushes.

"Is it a ghost?" asked my little nephew Tim.

"No, silly, ghosts aren't real," I said to him.

We looked closer and realized it was just a frog. I started to laugh but Tim did not. He wanted to measure the frog with a stick. Then Fluffy tried to catch it but he missed. We went home to write a story about it. Tim did complain because his feet were tired. Exploring is fun but walking is hard work.

My friend Sam and I went boating near a secret island. The cool breeze felt nice, but then the boat hit a rock. We fell into the freezing water and swam to the shore. It was a scary jungle with big green trees everywhere. We saw a monkey roaming around and singing a funny song.

"Where is the treasure?" asked Sam.

"I think it is near that big cave," I said.

We searched inside the dark cave for a long time. My dad taught me how to read maps, so I drew one on a piece of old newspaper. Suddenly, a big spider started crawling on my shoe! I screamed loud, but then we saw a shiny gold box. I guarantee it was the best adventure ever!

One morning I ate my breakfast very fast. I was so thrilled because it was sunny outside. I ran into the backyard to find my cat Fluffy. I looked everywhere but I did not see her.

"Fluffy where are you?" I yelled.

I ran to my neighbor’s yard and saw something scary. Fluffy was hanging from a big tree branch! She was trembling and she looked feared.

"Help me get her down!" I shouted to my neighbor.

He brought a big ladder and climbed up high. He grabbed Fluffy and she stopped shaking. I thought she was in big trouble but she was safe. Neither of us wanted her to climb that high again. Running inside, we gave her some treats. It was a crazy adventure.

My brother and I were playing a new video game. It was about boating down a scary river. I picked the blue boat and he picked the red one. We had to work together to win.

Suddenly, a big ghost appeared on the screen! I tried to steer, but I struggled with the controls. It was like an invisible wall was blocking me.

"Watch out for the Colonel!" shouted my brother. The ghost's name was Colonel Spooky.

My boat touched a rock and I almost sank. A tiny gnat flew around my head and made trouble. I swatted it away while cleaning my glasses. Although it was hard, we crossed the finish line.

"That was close by a thread!" I said.

My dad started coaching us on how to play better next time.

I was sitting at my computer doing math homework. It was super hard and I felt a lot of anger inside. My dog Buster came in to keep me company. He started to gnaw on my favorite blue pencil.

"Stop that right now, Buster!" I yelled at him.

He dropped the pencil on the ground and wagged his tail. To be honest, I was actually grateful he distracted me. I looked outside and saw the trees moving in the breeze. I wished I was boating on the lake instead of doing fourteen math problems.

My mom walked in and saw me staring out the window. "Are you bringing your homework to school tomorrow?" she asked.

I nodded and started typing again. Buster was roaming around my room looking for socks. I finished my work and we went outside to play.

I was dreaming about boating on a big blue lake. Then my alarm shouted and I woke up. It was Monday and I felt very sleepy. I crawled out of bed and got dressed for school. I ate my toast and walked through the door.

At recess, my friend Sam was tearing around the playground. He is often very fast. We played tag and I ran hard. "You can't catch me!" Sam yelled loudly.

Later, Mrs. Green said we had to write a story. Everyone started moaning because writing is hard work. I trained my brain to think of good ideas. The day neared the end and it was pleasant outside. I was happy when the bell finally rang.

I was sitting in class and my heart was thumping. We had a big test and I was scared. I looked at the ceiling and tried to think. Then I remembered that I studied all night. I wrote down the answers fast.

Suddenly the bell rang for recess and everyone started screaming. We ran outside to play kickball on the grass. My friend Billy kicked the ball super high. It went way over the fence.

"Oh no! That was important!" Billy yelled.

"Don't worry, I will save it!" I shouted back.

I felt like a brave knight on a mission. I climbed the fence and caught the ball. Everyone was cheering for me. We played until we were tired and hungry. It was the best recess ever.

Yesterday I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I was looking for bugs under a big log. I pushed the log hard and it made a groaning sound. Underneath was a shiny black beetle. It tried to squeeze into a tiny hole and disappeared fast.

"Hey come back here!" I shouted at the hole.

Then I saw a blue feather on the ground. It was soft and felt like magic. I treated it carefully so it wouldn't break. Suddenly my dog Max ran up and barked loud.

"Max, you scared the bugs away," I told him.

He wagged his tail though and licked my face. Catching bugs with a noisy dog is impossible. I decided my collection was complete for the day. We walked home and I felt happy grounding my feet in the soft dirt.

My soccer team had a big game on Saturday. I checked the schedule and saw we were playing the Tigers. I was so nervous but also excited. When we got to the big brick building, my coach greeted everyone with a high five.

"We can win this if we pass the ball," he said.

We ran onto the field and it felt like soccer heaven. The other team was tough and kept bumping into us. Then I discovered a spot near the goal. My friend Leo kicked it to me, and I scored! I was so grateful that we practiced. After the game, the coach was dumping the water cooler on us because we won.

"Good job team!" I yelled loudly.

I can't wait to write about this in my diary. We are already champions!

I woke up early and I smelled breakfast cooking. My dog Buster jumped on my bed with his heavy weight. He got a mud stain on my white sheets!

"Get down, you silly champion!" I shouted at him.

I thought he wanted to go outside for a walk. We walked to the big park near the tall trees. Buster loves nature and he loves the company of other dogs. We saw a squirrel leaving a hole in a tree. It ran up to a high height very fast.

"Look at that squirrel go!" I said to Buster.

He barked because he was certain he could catch it. But the squirrel was too fast and Buster is slow. We went home before they sold all the donuts at the store.

My robot dog Sparky walked into the kitchen. He is made of shiny metal and has blue eyes. Suddenly a green alien appeared straight out of the wall! The alien was smaller than me and looked sad.

"Please help me fix my spaceship," the alien said.

Sparky barked and his eyes grew really bright. He used his laser tail to fix the alien's ship. The ship was on the ground outside. The alien was so grateful and he smiled.

"Thank you for helping me go home," he said.

Sparky stood guard while the ship flew away. I swam in the pool later and felt happy. I caught a ball and Sparky ran fast. Being a robot owner is the best fun ever.

Me and my neighbor Tim were playing outside. It was a pleasant day, but we wanted an adventure. We heard about a cave in the woods. "This is important training for being spies!" Tim said.

We walked until the path cleared. Inside the cave, gold coins were scattered everywhere. Suddenly, we heard a loud growl. A bear was sleeping near a painting on the wall!

"Run everyone!" I screamed as loud as I could.

We ran fast, though my legs hurt. I could feel the blood pumping in my vein. We didn't stop speaking until we got home. It was scary but we were fast enough. Next time we will bring snacks.

My robot friend named Zork was bringing me a snack. He is shiny and silver and makes funny beeping noises. Zork likes jumping over the fence into my neighbor's yard. My neighbor Mr. Smith does not like robots leaving tracks.

Zork reached into his metal tummy and pulled out an apple. We neared the big oak tree in the park. Suddenly a green alien landed right in front of us!

"Take me to your leader," the alien said loudly.

"I cannot explain where he is," beeped Zork.

Neither of them knew what to do next. We decided to learn a game called tag instead. The alien was very fast but Zork had jet boots. It was the best Tuesday ever.

I was playing my favorite racing game in the living room. My sister was cleaning the table but I didn't care. I was steering my car carefully around the big fountain. I really wanted to win the gold cup. It was the most important race ever. My car was super fast and blue.

"Turn left!" my sister shouted from the balcony.

"I know what to do!" I yelled back.

Suddenly I heard a loud noise. It was my dog breathing hard and then he did a huge sneeze. I jumped and crashed my car. I was groaning so loud. I counted to three to stop being mad. I was yearning to win but now I lost. I smelled toasted bread from the kitchen. Maybe a snack is better than winning anyway.

Me and my brother Sam went to the park. We wanted to see who was stronger and faster. First we raced down the dusty trail near the big oak tree. My hat blew off but I kept running fast.

"I am going to win!" I shouted loudly.

Sam ran past me and touched the fence first. Then we tried climbing the monkey bars. I counted to ten while Sam hung upside down. He looked like a funny bat.

"You are good at this," Sam said to me.

After that we went home and did some painting. We made a mess on the newspaper. It was a fun day even if I didn't win the race.

My brother Sam and I went boating on the lake. We neared a small island with big grey rocks. Everything was very quiet and kind of weird. Suddenly, we saw something glowing inside a dark cave.

"Do you understand what that is?" asked Sam.

"No, but we can learn if we go closer," I said.

We paddled the boat carefully into the dark water. Inside, we saw a blue light floating in the air. It wasn't a flashlight and it wasn't fire either. It was a ghost pirate’s treasure map! We grabbed it fast and paddled away. We were scared but happy because we found a real mystery.

Me and my friend Sam went exploring in the woods. We were roaming around near the old spooky house. My neighbor said a ghost lives there. We saw a big hole in the ground.

"I dare you to jump in," Sam said.

I was scared but I jumped. It felt like zero gravity! We fell down deep and landed on soft dirt. It was dark but I was seeing a light. We walked to the light and found a huge blue vein of gold in the wall.

Suddenly the ground shook hard. Rocks started falling.

"Run!" I yelled.

We ran fast and swam across a little underground river. We climbed up a rope like we were bungee jumping. We finally got out and heard a knock on a tree. It was just a squirrel. We were safe but we never went back.

My brother Max and I went on a quest. We walked through the woods behind our big school. The weather was cold, but we kept walking anyway. We looked for the secret cave from my dreaming.

"Is this the wrong way?" asked Max loudly.

"No, listen to the wind," I said to him.

We started climbing up a big, slippery rock hill. It was hard work, but I felt stronger today. Max pushed me up the last big step. We saw a small hole in the dark rocks. I had a thought that maybe we fit inside. We had to squeeze our bodies to get in there. Inside, we found a box keeping old pirate gold! It was very important treasure. We were so happy, but then it started raining. The clouds were dumping water on us, so we ran home fast.

My dog Buster is very silly and funny. Yesterday I bought him a new red collar. He was wearing it when we went to the park. Buster saw a big squirrel running up a tree. He sprinted fast but the squirrel was too quick.

"Come back here!" I yelled at him loudly.

Buster stood under the tree and barked a lot. The squirrel was clinging to a high branch. It looked like a little furry jewel up there. Then Buster found a stick and chewed it all up. He spread little pieces of wood everywhere in the grass. Suddenly we heard a loud thunder noise.

"Let’s go home now, Buster," I said.

We ran back to my house before the rain started.

One day I went roaming in the woods with my dog. His name is Rex and he likes steering me down the path. We walked for a long time and saw a big bird singing.

"Look at that blue bird, Rex!" I shouted loudly.

Rex barked immediately and started running to the big tree. I ran after him and saw something fuzzy clinging to a branch. It was a baby squirrel and he looked scared. I wanted to help him especially because he was tiny.

"Don't worry, little guy, we are nice," I said.

Just then the mama squirrel came down for a meeting. She grabbed her baby and they ran up high. After that, we went home and ate toasted marshmallows by the fire. It was the best day ever.

Me and my younger brother Sam found a secret door. It was hanging off the wall in the basement. We went inside and saw floating lights near the ceiling.

"Do you think we have enough flashlight power?" Sam asked.

"Just keep walking," I grinned at him.

Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound. A giant stone monster was blocking the way! He looked scary. He was holding a stone guitar.

"Go away!" the monster grumbled at us.

Sam started tearing up because he was scared. My heart was pumping fast. I threw a rock at a fountain. The water sprayed the monster. He hated water! He ran away very fast. We found eight gold coins on the floor.

"We are rich!" I shouted.

We ran home before mom called us for dinner.

My friends came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We wanted to build a huge fort in the living room. We grabbed every blanket we could find in the house. The scenery inside the fort looked like a dark cave.

"Watch out for the lamp!" yelled my friend Ben.

"I am bumping my head on the ceiling," said Sam.

It was hard to crawl straight through the tunnel. We discovered a secret meeting spot near the couch. It was freezing in there because of the fan. We had to complete the fort before my mom came. We used different pillows to block the dangerous dog out. We played games throughout the whole night.

"Let's seize the snacks!" I shouted at midnight.

We ate popcorn until our tummies hurt. It was the best sleepover ever.

I heard a loud crash in my backyard yesterday. A green alien crawled out of a shiny silver ship. He looked very hungry and stuck out his long purple tongue. I gave him my sandwich although I wanted it.

"Thank you human," the alien said with a funny voice. "My mission is almost complete but I need help."

He was earning points for jumping over planets. It sounded impossible but he was trained very well. The reason he crashed was because his robot dog pushed a button. I helped him fix his ship with some tape. The meaning of his visit was just to say hello. Then he flew away fast.

Yesterday was a very important day at school. I walked to class and saw my friend Sam. He looked sad because he forgot his lunch.

"Don't worry, I have an extra apple," I said.

Sam smiled and we went inside. Our teacher, Mrs. Green, brewed some hot tea at her desk. It smelled really good. We had to write a story about climbing a mountain. I wrote about a shiny jewel hidden in a cave. I made my story longer than everyone else's.

At recess, we went outside to play tag. The scenery was nice with all the big trees.

"Tag, you're it!" Sam yelled and ran away fast.

I tried to catch him, but I tripped on a rock. I will remember to tie my shoes next time. It was still a fun day.

It was my birthday and I was very excited. I wanted to write a list of gifts but I forgot. My mom was bearing a big chocolate cake with candles. The room gradually got dark when my dad cleared the table. I was a little scared of the fire on the cake. My heart was beating fast because everyone was looking at me.

"Make a wish and blow hard!" yelled my brother.

I grabbed the table and blew out the candles quickly. I almost scorched my nose but I was okay. I did not want to be a failure at blowing them out.

"Did you wish for a puppy?" asked my best friend Sam.

I was pleased because I got a new video game. I almost fainted from happiness. Later my dog tried to gnaw on the wrapping paper. It was the best day ever.

It was raining outside so we stayed in to play games. My dad drove me to the store to get a new computer game. I was trembling because I really wanted to win this time. We plugged it in and my heart was pumping fast.

"I bet I can beat you," said my brother Sam.

"No way, you are going to lose," I yelled back.

I twisted the controller in my hands and chewed my lip. The game started and I blew up his base really fast. Sam looked sad but I felt great. He paid me five dollars because he lost the bet. It was not a failure for me this time! I love winning games on rainy days.

One morning I woke up really early. The sun was hot and it scorched the grass. I went outside to find my dog, Buster. He ran away near the twisted old tree. I crossed the creek and my heart was pumping fast. Then I saw him digging near a big rock.

"Buster, stop that right now!" I screamed.

He looked at me and wagged his tail. He was stamping his paws in the mud. I looked closer and saw a shiny thing. It looked like a blue jewel in the dirt. I drew a map so I could remember the spot. I was yearning to show my mom the treasure.

"Good boy, Buster," I said and patted his head. We walked home together with the muddy treasure.

One day my dog Spot and I went outside. It was a wonderful day for an adventure. We were loading my backpack with snacks. My dad said, "Be careful near the big rock!" I understood him because I am smart. Spot is trained to stay close to me. The sun scorched the grass so it was hot. We pretended to do science by looking at bugs. I was keeping a cool beetle in my pocket. Tomorrow I want to go boating on the lake. Suddenly Spot ran too fast and fell down. He crushed a little flower but he was okay. The water in the stream was freezing cold. "Let's go home now," I said to Spot. We ran back inside for lunch.

One day it was raining very hard outside. My friend Leo and I wanted to go on a big adventure. We went into the old basement because it was spooky. There were old boxes scattered everywhere on the floor.

"I am not afraid of anything!" yelled Leo loudly.

Suddenly we heard a loud screaming noise from a corner. It sounded like a ghost was trapped in a box. We walked closer and saw a pile of newspaper moving.

"Maybe a witch brewed a potion here," I whispered.

Leo kicked the paper and a cat jumped out. It was simply a scared little kitten hiding from the storm. Our mission was complete because we saved the cat. We named him Thunder and ran upstairs for a snack.

My dad took me and my dog Buster camping last week. We went to the big woods behind our house. My dad brought his old guitar to play songs. Buster was running around and stamping his feet in the mud. He was so happy.

Suddenly, Buster ran too fast and broke his leash! He chased a squirrel into the bushes. "Buster, come back!" I yelled really loud.

He didn't listen to me speaking. He just kept running. We ran after him although it was getting dark. Finally, we found him by the lake. His paws sank into the wet sand. He looked tired.

"The reason he ran was the squirrel," said Dad.

We didn't have any dog treats either. So we gave him some protein from our beef jerky. He ate it all up. Then we walked back to our tent.

One day in February my robot Max got in big trouble. Max is made of metal and he was roaming around the kitchen. He was trying to make breakfast but he threw the bread too high. It hit the ceiling and got stuck there.

"Oh no, now the toast is burning!" I yelled loudly.

Max tried to help but his metal finger got hot. He flew up to grab the toasted bread but he was too heavy. His weight made him crash down hard.

"I think I broke a wire or a vein," Max beeped sadly.

My younger brother laughed at the mess. Then Max sprayed water like a fountain everywhere. We had to clean up the kitchen all day long.

My dog Buster is a huge champion. He loves playing in the snow outside. It was freezing cold but Buster didn't care. I put on my coat and we went to the park. The snow crunched under my boots. I was stamping my feet to stay warm.

"Look out Buster!" I yelled.

I threw a snowball and it crushed against a tree. Buster ran fast and greeted a squirrel. The squirrel grumbled and ran up the tree. Buster held a stick in his mouth with great strength. He looked so happy like he was in dog heaven. We played until it grew dark. My breathing was heavy from running.

"Let's go home now," I said.

Buster was sleeping on the rug five minutes later.

I was walking home and I saw something different on the ground. It looked like a shiny metal box with buttons. I picked it up and pushed a red button. Suddenly a little green alien popped out of the top!

"Hey, put me down!" the alien grumbled at me.

I dropped the box and it opened up wide. The alien drew a laser gun and pointed it. I held up an old receipt from my pocket.

"Don't shoot! I have paper!" I yelled.

The alien looked at the receipt and then he took a newspaper. He discovered that paper tastes like candy to him. He ate enough paper to be full and then he flew away.

My neighbor Mike is in my class at school. Today at recess he did something really crazy. We were playing tag and he ran super fast. He suddenly grabbed my lunchbox from the bench and stole it! I screamed at him to stop running away.

"Hey! Give that back right now!" I yelled loud.

Mike just laughed and kept running across the plain grass. He scattered my chips everywhere when he tripped over a rock.

"I didn't mean to drop them," Mike said sadly.

I had to explain to the teacher what happened. She made him write me a note to say sorry. Then he told me he has a bungee cord at home. I don't know why he said that. It was weird. I gradually stopped being mad at him later. We are still friends even though he owes me fourteen chips.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. We were building huge towers with blocks in the morning. My friend Tim was steering his toy car around them. Suddenly, Mrs. Green yelled at us to stop.

"Look outside!" she shouted.

There was a big grey elephant walking in the meadow behind the playground! I was trembling because it was so big. It looked like it was sleeping while it walked. My neighbor from class said it must be trained.

Then the elephant made a huge noise and Mrs. Green almost fainted. It was certain that we were not going to have recess. The sun scorched the grass outside, but we stayed inside for safety. It was not a pleasure to miss playtime, but the scenery was cool. I hope the elephant comes back tomorrow.

I was playing in the greatest video game league ever. We were in my apartment and my friend Sam was there. I gripped the controller hard because my hands were sweaty. The game was about climbing a huge building. The scenery looked really cool with lots of clouds.

"Watch out for that guard!" yelled Sam.
