I pressed the jump button and reached the next level. My character grabbed onto a ledge at a super high height. I was speaking to the screen because I was nervous. Then I got a message saying I would receive a gold trophy.

"We are never leaving this couch!" I said.

We played until dinner and it was so much fun.

Me and my brother built a castle in the woods. It was made of sticks and big rocks. We wanted to catch a frog for science class. We looked near the creek and I saw one jumping.

"Grab it before it gets away!" I yelled loudly.

My brother used a plastic knife to dig a hole. We hoped the hole would contain the slippery frog. But the frog jumped right over his head. I feared we would never catch anything cool today. We walked home bearing no frogs at all.

"Don't complain, we can try again tomorrow," he said.

I guarantee next time we will bring a net. We kept our eyes closed and pretended to be explorers. It was a fun day even without the frog.

My birthday was finally here and I woke up early. I looked for presents but I didn’t see a single one. It seemed impossible because my mom loves birthdays. I went downstairs and my heart started thumping fast.

"Where is everyone?" I shouted loudly to the empty room.

Nobody answered so I sat down and felt sad. Suddenly my dog Max chewed on my shoe. Then my dad gradually came out from behind the couch. He grinned and everyone jumped out and yelled surprise!

"We tricked you good!" my brother laughed at me.

The reason it was quiet was because they were hiding. The party neared the end and I felt happy. Nothing bad happened and I played longer than usual. It was the best day ever.

My dog Buster is the best dog in the whole league. We went exploring in the woods near my house today. We walked for a long time and the earth was muddy. Suddenly Buster started barking loudly at a big bush.

"What is it boy?" I asked him.

He was groaning and held his ground like a brave soldier. I neared the bush slowly and saw something move. It was a huge racoon eating trash! I felt like I was in danger. I grabbed Buster’s collar to seize him.

"Let’s go home right now!" I yelled.

We ran back fast and my ears were ringing. My mom was loading the car when we got back. She said I looked like I had too much caffeine. I told her the scene was scary. I am fourteen times braver now though.

My robot Max was boating on the lake with me. Suddenly, a giant purple alien ship struck the water hard. The ground shook and I gripped the side of the boat. Max’s metal arm turned into a laser gun.

"Get behind me!" called Max loudly.

The alien came out groaning and it looked very mad. It crushed a big rock with one green foot. I was scared but Max drove his laser right at it. The alien grumbled and ran back into its ship fast. We went running home to tell my mom. It was the coolest day ever.

Yesterday at recess we played a super cool game. It was like we were running through a hot jungle. My friend Sam was leading us to the secret spot. He pulled a shiny rock out of his pocket.

"Look at this magic jewel," Sam whispered to me.

Suddenly a big bug flew right at my head! I twisted away and started running fast. I saw a rope hanging from the playground gym. I tried to wrap my legs around it but I slipped.

"Watch out for the lava!" called my teacher, Mrs. Green.

She was just sitting on the bench grading papers. I had to write a story for homework later. But right then I was busy tearing across the wood chips. We didn't learn much math, but recess was the best part of the day.

My neighbor Mr. Jones was dumping weird green slime. He was bringing it straight to his backyard. I followed the slime trail. I realized it was glowing! Suddenly a spaceship crashed right there. A robot came out and it was huge. Its heart was pumping loud.

"Danger! Danger!" the robot yelled.

Mr. Jones ran out with a big shake.

"Drink this protein shake!" Mr. Jones shouted.

The robot drank it and turned into my little nephew. I knew Mr. Jones was an alien spy. We walked home fast. It was the best Tuesday ever.

One day my dog Max got off his schedule. He ran outside because he saw a big squirrel. I grabbed my bike and started steering it fast. Max ran into the woods and I got scared. The sky grew dark and a storm brewed quickly.

"Max! Come back right now!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and he kept running away. I neared the old creek and saw him. He was wearing his blue collar and barking. Suddenly he crashed into a pile of wet leaves.

"What happened to you?" I asked him.

He just wagged his tail and licked my hand. We went home before the rain started falling. Max was dirty but he was safe.

I was swinging my lightsaber in the backyard yesterday. Suddenly a green alien looked over the fence at me. He was about my height and had three eyes.

"What happened to your spaceship?" I asked him.

The alien pointed a long finger at a broken robot. The robot was groaning and smoke was coming out. Metal parts were scattered all over the grass.

"My robot is toasted," the alien said sadly.

I walked carefully to the robot and pressed a button. It made a loud sounding beep and stood up! The alien was so happy he did a flip. We ran to the park fountain to have an adventure. I tried to seize the alien's hand but it felt slimy. It was the best day ever.

I was playing a game on my computer. Suddenly the screen went dark and a ghost flew out! I screamed and ran outside but the ghost chased me. It looked scary and mad. I hid behind a big dumping truck.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled at the ghost.

"Yes I can!" the ghost shouted back.

I found some old rusty scissors on the ground. I thought I could use them. The ghost tried to gnaw on my arm. I fought back hard. I poked the ghost and it popped like a balloon! It was just a big bubble. I escaped and ran home fast. I almost got crushed by the truck but I was safe. I will never play that game again because it is big trouble.

It was raining very hard outside my house. I looked out the window at my neighbor’s yard. I saw a tiny bird trembling in the wet grass. It struggled to fly because its wings were heavy.

"Mom, look at that bird!" I yelled loudly.
Mom came over and said, "It looks cold."

We ran outside, but we were stamping in puddles. A tiny gnat flew right into my eye! It hurt, but I kept running. The bird was just sitting there, not keeping dry. I realized it couldn't fly away.

I gently picked it up, feeling its small heartbeat. We made a box for it. I wrote a note that said "Bird Hotel." I think I am good at training animals now. The rain stopped, and the sun began to reign again. We didn't see the bird’s mom either, but now the bird is safe.

On Wednesday I played my favorite video game against my brother. He always plays as the big knight with a shiny sword. I picked the fast ninja because I wanted to win. The game started and the music was like someone singing loudly. I was jumping around and he was clinging to the edge.

"I am certain I will beat you!" I yelled.

"No way, my armor is too strong," he said back.

Suddenly my ninja did a super kick and he fell off. I won the game and did a happy dance. My mom came in carrying a beautiful cake. It was hard to contain my excitement because cake is the best. I hope nobody has to go to the hospital from eating too much!

We were leaving to go to the jungle today. My friend Tim brought a big rope for swinging. We walked for a long time and I was feeling tired. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound in the bushes.

"What was that moaning?" asked Tim.

"I think it is a zombie," I said scared.

We looked behind a big tree and saw a monkey. It was bumping its head on a branch. The monkey was caught in a trap. Tim used his rope like a bungee cord. He jumped down to help the monkey get free. The monkey let out a big sneeze on Tim's face.

"Gross!" yelled Tim wiping his face.

We did not need to measure the rope because it was perfect. My dad says psychology helps you be brave, but I just ran fast.

On Wednesday, my dog Buster and I went exploring. We walked near the creek to look for frogs. Suddenly, Buster started digging by a big old tree.

"What are you doing, Buster?" I asked him.

He barked and pulled something heavy out of the dirt. It was a weird, shiny rock with funny green spots. I grasped the rock, but it felt very light. It felt like it had no gravity at all!

"This feels wrong," I said.

Then the rock started floating right out of my hand! I made a loud groaning noise because I was scared. The rock grew bigger and brighter as it went up. It drifted away until it was totally lost in the clouds. I blew my whistle to call Buster, and we ran home fast. It was the strangest day ever. I still wonder about that floating rock.

I was waiting for my robot dog Sparky to finish loading. His eyes were spinning green circles and he was making a buzzing sound. Suddenly the green circles disappeared and he barked loud. It was sounding like a real dog but louder.

"Hey Sparky, are you ready for our mission?" I asked.

Sparky nodded his metal head and opened his tummy door. I saw a shiny silver needle inside. It was very important for fixing the spaceship. We walked outside and saw the alien ship floating above the grass.

"We have to hurry before they leave!" Sparky beeped.

I grabbed the needle and ran to the ship. I realized the hole was near the engine. I pushed the needle in and heard a click. The mission was complete. We were brave enough to save the day!

My friends and I went into the spooky woods to search for treasure. We had a map from an old newspaper. "Listen!" said Billy. We heard loud stamping noises. It sounded like a giant bear or a monster. 

We walked quietly behind our guide, Sarah. She is brave and often finds cool stuff. Suddenly a big bird flew right over our heads! I closed my eyes because I was scared. 

"We have to measure ten steps from the big rock," Sarah said. 

We walked ten steps and then I dropped my shovel. It hit something hard in the dirt. We dug fast and found a box. It was locked and impossible to open. We were breathing hard. "We can learn how to open it tomorrow," I said. That was enough adventure for one day.

One day me and my best friend Sam woke up early. We wanted to find the lost treasure in the woods. We walked for a long time and met a scary dog. I didn't know what to do so I screamed loud. Sam was brave and he blew a whistle he had. The dog ran away fast and we were so grateful.

"We almost reached the cave!" Sam yelled.

We drew a map on paper so we wouldn't get lost. Gradually the sun went down and it got dark. We found a single gold coin in the dirt. It felt like we won a big prize.

"Wait, is this the wrong way?" I asked him.

But then we saw my mom bringing snacks for us. We were safe and happy.

The bell rang for lunch and everyone ran outside immediately. I reached into my bag for my sandwich, but unfortunately it was missing. I saw a receipt at the bottom of my bag instead.

"Oh no, I am a failure at packing lunch," I said sadly.

My friend Tom saw the scene and walked over to help. He had a toasted cheese sandwich and it smelled really good.

"Do not worry, you can have half of mine," Tom said.

We sat on the bench and ate the roasted cheese happily. Then we drew pictures of a pirate sailor on the pavement. We played tag until the bell rang and school started again. I did not get in trouble for forgetting my food, but I was hungry later. Next time I will check my bag all the way through before I leave.

I went outside to climb the big oak tree. My dog Rex was with me and he loves sticks. Suddenly I saw a squirrel jump like a bungee cord. It ran up high so Rex could not catch it.

"Come back down here!" I yelled at the squirrel.

Rex barked and wagged his tail very fast. I was seeing if I could climb higher than before. But then I slipped and hurt my thumb on a branch. It hurt a lot so I ran inside to Mom. She looked at it like a science doctor.

"We don't need the hospital for this," she said.

She is a good mom to her daughter. She put a band-aid on it and gave me a cookie. Then Rex and I went back outside to play again.

Yesterday I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I was looking for a beautiful shiny beetle I saw once. My dog Sparky was roaming around and jumping over logs. Suddenly Sparky started barking at a big hole in the earth.

"Come here Sparky!" I yelled, but he didn't listen.

He stuck his nose right inside the dark hole. Then he let out a huge sneeze! A tiny squirrel ran out and disappeared up a tree. It looked scared and was clinging to the branch tightly.

"You treated that squirrel bad," I told Sparky.

We walked home instead of catching the beetle. I learned that day that exploring is different when you are coaching a crazy dog. Next time I will go alone.

I was playing my new video game called Jungle Racers. It is the best game ever because you drive crazy cars. My brother Tim wanted to play but I said no. I drove my green car through the mud. Suddenly a giant beetle blocked the road! I grabbed my controller tight and my hands were sweating.

"Move out of the way!" I yelled at the screen.

I jumped my car over the beetle and landed perfectly. It was like a bungee jump but with a car. Then I saw the finish line. I was clinging to the lead but the red car was close. I was tearing up the track and going super fast. I cleared the last jump and won the race!

"You are actually pretty good," Tim said while groaning.

I was thrilled because I finally beat the hardest level.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. We walked longer than usual and found a big puddle. It looked like a swamp or a tiny island. Max bounced into the water and splashed me.

"Max, get out! That looks like danger!" I yelled.

Max scrambled out but he was trembling and wet. Then something screeched in the trees above us. It sounded like a scary ghost! Max chewed on a stick because he was nervous.

"Let's go home right now," I said.

We ran fast and the wind swept past us. When we got home, my mom brewed some hot cocoa. I wrote a story about our big adventure. Next time we won't get trapped in the scary woods.

I brought my new spy pen to school today. It has invisible ink! In math class, I drew a ghost on my hand. Nobody could see it, but I knew it was there. Then I saw a big black beetle on the floor. It was trapped under Mrs. Miller's desk.

"Look at that bug!" I whispered to Sam.

"It looks scary," Sam said back to me.

I tried steering the beetle away with my pencil. Suddenly, Mrs. Miller struck her ruler on the board. We jumped.

"Is something wrong, boys?" she asked us loudly.

I held my breath and shook my head fast. I didn't remember the answer to the math problem. I was groaning inside. Then the beetle chewed on Mrs. Miller's shoe! She screamed and ran out of the room. It was the best math class ever.

My brother turned thirteen today and he had a huge party. We were jumping on the trampoline and acting like knights. I tried to seize the castle but I fell down. My friend Ben was roaming around the yard.

"Watch out for the mud!" yelled Ben loudly.

I didn't hear him and I slipped in the dirt. My leg struck a rock and it hurt bad. I was groaning but I stood up steady. Then my mom came out and saw the mess.

"Start cleaning up right now or no cake!" she said.

We felt crushed because we wanted cake. We started dumping the trash in the bin. I let out a big sneeze because of the dust. We are not in the same league as professional cleaners. But we finished fast and got cake.

We were camping in the backyard together. I had my lucky comb and my leather boots on. Suddenly, a big green spaceship landed on the grass. The grass looked black and scorched from the heat. A robot walked out and it had three eyes. It pointed a laser at my tent!

"This is impossible!" I screamed at the robot.

The robot made a beep noise and shook its head. "Wrong house," the robot said in a robot voice.

Then the robot got back in the ship. It flew away fast and the noise was different. I ran inside to tell my mom. She did not believe me at all.

I was walking to school and felt a heavy weight. My backpack was full of really important books. Then I realized I forgot my lunch! I stopped and closed my eyes tight. I felt anger inside me but kept walking anyway.

At recess, the sun scorched the playground and it was hot. I sat on the swings and twisted the chains around. Suddenly, my friend Sam screeched, "Look out!" A ball hit the pole and I jumped.

"That was close!" I said.

Then I saw my mom by the gate. She was holding my lunch box! I felt thrilled and ran over fast. I felt stronger after eating my sandwich. It was like I was invisible before, but now I was happy.

My nephew Ben and I went exploring in the woods today. We were running fast because we wanted to find a secret fort. We reached the big old oak tree near the creek. Ben stopped and looked at a weird green puddle.

"Is that danger?" Ben asked me with wide eyes.

"No, maybe a neighbor brewed a magic potion," I said.

We poked it with a stick for fun and pleasure. It was just slime for a science project, I think. We cleared away some leaves to sit down. Then we saw a squirrel looking right at us. It was a good day outside.

My dog Buster and I went outside after breakfast. The morning breeze blew on my face and felt cold. We walked straight to the big park near my house. Buster ran fast across the ground and chased a squirrel.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled loudly at him.

He stopped running and grinned at me with his tongue out. Then a red bird flew right over his head. We walked through the tall grass and found a stick. I pretended I was a captain of a pirate ship. I opened my backpack and took out my notebook. I wrote a note about the cool red bird.

"Let's go home now," I said to Buster.

We walked back and I was cheering for us. I was tired though, so I closed my eyes later. I read my book and fell asleep.

It was time for recess and everyone scrambled outside. The cool breeze twisted my hair around my face. I saw my friend Sam and he was holding the big red kickball.

"Let's play a huge game!" Sam yelled loudly.

We started to pick teams and I led my team to the field. Sam kicked the ball high up into the sky. It felt like gravity pulled it down super fast. I ran to catch it but I tripped over my shoes. I crawled on the grass to seize the ball before it rolled away. It scattered dust everywhere.

"You got it!" everyone started cheering for me.

I was so grateful I caught it. I thought I would miss, but I remembered to keep my eye on the ball. I didn't drop it either! It was the best recess ever.

We went to the spooky cave because we needed the jewel. My heart was pumping so fast. Max held the map and I held the flashlight. We walked throughout the dark tunnels for a long time. Suddenly a big bat flew right at my head! I screamed but Max just laughed at me.

"Do we have enough food?" I asked him quietly.

"Yes, but we need to find the treasure soon," said Max.

We crossed a scary bridge over some green water. It was very important not to look down. Finally, we saw a shiny blue rock on a stand. We grabbed the jewel and ran away fast. The wind blew hard outside but we were safe. I was so thrilled we made it home.

I was wearing my new robot suit in the backyard. Suddenly a green alien ship swept down and landed. The door lit up and a small alien walked out. He looked sad and he searched the grass for something.

"What are you looking for?" I called to him.

"I lost my space key," he grumbled quietly.

I looked down and saw something shiny in the dirt. A big dog tried to gnaw on it, but I grasped it quickly. It was struck by sunlight and glowed blue.

"Here it is!" I said.

The alien was thrilled. He cleared the dirt off and there was not even a stain. He gave me a high five and zoomed away in an hour. It was the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam went climbing up the big hill. We heard a loud thumping noise from a dark cave.

"I think a monster is waiting inside," whispered Sam.

I was scared but I wanted to see the scary scenery. We scrambled over big rocks and peeked in the hole. It was dark and smelled like roasted peanuts. Suddenly a giant green beetle walked out. It was singing a funny song in a foreign language.

"Run before it tries to seize us!" I yelled loudly.

We ran fast but then Sam let out a huge sneeze. The beetle stopped singing and looked at us. It made a sad groaning sound. It just wanted some company, not a fight. We felt like a failure for running away. We went back and listened to its song.

It was my birthday and my friends came over for a sleepover. We ate pizza and then we went outside to play tag. The sun was going down and it looked like a rose.

"Let’s tell scary stories," said my friend Ben.

We sat on the grass and I started talking. I told them a story about a friendly ghost who rode a bike. Suddenly we heard a loud whistle from the street. A car was approaching our house very slowly.

"Run inside!" I yelled and we all grabbed our stuff.

We ran through the back door and hid under my bed. My dad came in and he was laughing at us. He was just coaching my little brother on how to whistle. It was the greatest birthday ever because we got so scared.

My neighbor Mr. Lee taught me the greatest game ever. It is called Capture the Flag and you need two teams. I invited fourteen friends to my birthday party on Saturday. We played throughout the whole afternoon in the cool breeze. I was the captain of the red team.

"We need to use our brain to win!" I shouted.

My friend Sam shook his head and started running. He was bumping into everyone and sounding very loud. It was simply crazy! Then he grabbed the blue flag and ran back.

"I am so grateful you are fast!" I said.

We ate cake after and it tasted like a foreign treat. It was the best birthday I ever had.

I was playing my favorite game on the computer. It is a racing game with super fast cars. I was winning but then I got trapped behind a truck. My hands were trembling on the controller. I did not know how to pass him.

"You have to maintain your speed!" yelled my brother.

"I am trying to be honest, he is blocking me!" I shouted back.

I saw a small opening near the side. I hit the gas and zoomed past a dumping truck. My car looked like a red sweater flying by. I crossed the finish line first and won a gold chain for my car. I was so happy that I won by just a thread.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so thrilled. My friends Sam and Leo came over to my house. We played outside on the swinging tire for a while. Then we went inside to read scary stories in my tent.

Suddenly Sam screeched very loud because he heard a noise.
"Listen! Is that a ghost?" Sam asked us.
"I don't hear anything either," said Leo.

But then something scratched on the tent door. We were scared but I used all my strength to open it. It was just my dog Buster! He woke up from his nap. He ran through the tent and licked our faces. We laughed throughout the whole night and stayed up way longer than usual.

It was freezing outside but we still went to recess. I looked at the ground and saw something shiny. It was a bright blue jewel stuck in the mud! I was thrilled and I picked it up fast.

My friend Sam ran over and he was trembling from cold. "What is that?" he asked me.

"It is a secret treasure," I said. I tried to squeeze it into my pocket.

Then the bell rang and we ran inside. The teacher made us complete our math newspaper. I was stamping my foot because I wanted to look at my jewel. But when I checked my pocket later, it had disappeared! I looked at the ceiling and felt sad. Maybe it is growing into a magic tree outside. I hope Sam didn't take it.

I was playing a video game on my dad's island. It was a pirate game and I was losing bad. My brother pushed me and I dropped the controller.

"Hey! That is cheating!" I shouted at him.

He just grinned and kept playing his turn. I was yearning to win just one time today. I looked at the screen and saw a sign. It said to go left but I went wrong. My character fell in the water and the game closed.

"You are so bad at this," my brother said.

I was mad but then dad came in. He had brewed some hot chocolate for us. I touched the warm mug and felt better.

"Next time I will beat you," I told him.

Dad opened his newspaper and we started a new game. I greeted the new level with a smile.

Yesterday me and my friend Sam played a cool new video game. It was about a king who had to reign over a giant castle. We greeted each other online and started the game. My character was super strong and could lift any weight. Sam’s character was fast like a breeze.

"I bet I can win everything!" I yelled into my headset.

"No way, I am going to win!" Sam shouted back.

We had to jump off a bridge like a bungee jumper. I missed the jump and fell down. I grumbled because I lost all my points. Then my stomach growled really loud because I was so hungry. We stopped playing to eat pizza. It was the best game ever.

My dog Buster is very brave, and he likes to explore. One day we went to the woods to search for bears. I thought we might find a big scary one. We walked straight down the path and saw a squirrel swinging on a branch. Buster started to bark at it very loud.

"Be quiet, Buster!" I said. "You will scare the bears away."

Buster did not listen, and he started to gnaw on a stick. Then I saw something move in the bushes. I felt a yearning to see what it was, but I also felt danger.

"Is that Colonel Bear?" I asked Buster.

It was just a fat raccoon. Buster did not complain, but I know he wanted a real bear. We went home and had ice cream instead.

My brother Tom thinks he knows everything about science. We were at the pool for my birthday party. Tom tried to explain how to float better.

"You have to maintain your breath," he said loudly.

I tried to hold my breath longer than him. I squeezed my eyes shut and went underwater immediately. My legs were pumping hard to stay up. It was impossible to stay still like that. Tom was just floating on his back easily. We were together in the deep end. I got scared and started clinging to the wall.

"You look like a scared cat," my friend Sam laughed.

I saw my mom approaching with the big cake. She doesn't know about psychology, but she knows about chocolate. We all got out and ate cake until our tummies hurt.

My brother Sam and I found a secret map yesterday. It had a big red X near the old fountain. We brought shovels and started digging in the dirt. Suddenly we heard a loud screaming noise from a hole.

"That sounds like a monster!" Sam yelled at me.

"I think it is just a racoon," I said back.

We looked inside and saw something gnaw on a bone. It was a giant rat with a missing thumb. We ran away fast enough to be safe. Sam was swearing but Mom says that is very bad. I don't understand why he was so scared of a rat. We are earning money to buy better flashlights for tomorrow. Then we will try to find the treasure again. We are in the adventure league now.

My ears were ringing because the gym was so loud. We were playing dodgeball against the red team and I was scared. The red team had a boy who threw super fast. He looked like a tough army colonel. My friend Tim screeched when a ball almost hit him.

"Watch out for your head!" I yelled at Tim.

I hid behind the water fountain for a second. It wasn't allowed though. I ran out and caught a ball. My heart was singing because I was so happy. I stuck my tongue out at the red team.

"You are out!" the gym teacher shouted at the red player.

To be honest, I got lucky. We won the game and we got extra recess time.

It was a rainy Wednesday and Max was bored. He remembered the old map under his bed. He grabbed it and ran straight to the woods. His dog Sparky followed him. The wind swept through the tall trees. Suddenly, a big shadow flew over their heads.

"What was that?" asked Max.

Sparky just barked at a twisted oak tree. A spooky sound was moaning inside the trunk. Max drew his toy sword. He was trained for this! A goblin jumped out and stole Max’s hat.

"Hey, give that back!" Max grumbled.

The goblin ran away but tripped on a growing vine. Max caught him. He felt like he was coaching a bad player. Max took his hat back and they went home for dinner.

It was Wednesday and I was so excited for soccer. I ate my toasted bagel really fast and ran outside. My friend Sam was already there jumping up and down.

"I will beat you today!" Sam said.

"No way, I am the best goalie!" I yelled back.

We started playing and Sam kicked the ball super hard. It felt like it was floating in the air forever. I jumped up to guard the net but I missed. The ball scratched my arm when it went by. Sam started screaming because he was so happy he scored.

"That was a complete accident," I told him.

It was not a pleasure to lose, but it was still fun. Next time I will stop the ball for sure.

I was swinging on the monkey bars at recess. My friend Leo grabbed the bar next to me. We pretended the playground was a big jungle.

"Watch out for the snakes!" Leo yelled loudly.

I twisted my body and grasped the cold metal tight. I crawled across the bars like a fast monkey. Suddenly, I dropped my snack bag on the ground. We searched for it in the brown woodchips.

Then the teacher blew her loud whistle. It was time to go back inside.

"I wish we could reign over the playground forever," I said.

My mom says teachers run on caffeine, but I run on juice. I was sad recess was over.

One day me and my dog Buster went exploring in the woods. We walked for a long time and saw lots of trees. Suddenly I heard a loud noise behind a big bush. Buster started barking and pulling on his leash really hard.

"What is that sound?" I asked Buster.

We cleared away some leaves and discovered a tiny baby bird. It was not growing any feathers yet and looked very scared. I screamed a little bit because it surprised me.

"We have to help it get home," I said.

We looked up and saw a nest high in the tree. My dad came and he had a ladder. It was the greatest day because we saved the bird. I felt happy seeing it safe with its mom. The baby bird grew bigger and flew away next week.

I was so excited because my brother turned fourteen today. We drove to the lake for a big party. My dad said we could go boating later. We neared the water and saw my cousins. "I bet I can swim faster than you!" yelled Sam. We raced and I won the race easily. Later we ate cake and my mom drank lots of caffeine. She loves coffee especially when she is tired.

Suddenly my brother crossed the road without looking. A car was approaching fast and neither of us saw it. We feared he would get hurt but the car stopped. It was scary so we went inside. "Don't do that again," said Mom. We were happy he didn't need a hospital. Next year he will not be fourteen, he will be fifteen.

It was my birthday and it was raining outside. I was moaning because we wanted to play in the yard. My mom said, “Look at the schedule on the wall.” It said we were having toasted sandwiches and stewed apples. I opened a single present from my neighbor. It was a cool toy fountain that cleared up the water! Then my dad appeared with a scorched cake. It was burnt but he threw some frosting on it.

“This cake has extra protein!” my dad joked loudly.

I took a bite and my mouth was stinging. We laughed anyway. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my friend Sam went into the spooky woods. We were looking for the lost King’s crown to end his reign of sadness. Suddenly we saw a weird light floating in the trees.

"I don’t want to go closer," grumbled Sam.

"We have to or we fail," I simply said.

We walked closer and neither of us saw the big hole. We fell down into a dark cave! My heart was thumping so loud. I struggled to stand up but I was okay. Then I saw something shiny on a rock. I grasped the golden crown and we sprinted back up the hill. We toasted marshmallows later to celebrate because we were brave heroes.

Yesterday was my birthday and I had a sleepover at my apartment. My mom brewed some hot chocolate for us. We squeezed onto the couch to watch a movie. 

My friend Sam grabbed a pillow and threw it at me. 

"I am certain I will win this fight!" Sam yelled.

We had a pillow fight until my mom came in. She had to explain that we were being too loud for the neighbors. Then she sent us to bed to read books. I tried to sew a hole in my sock with a needle but it was hard. Gradually we all fell asleep on the floor. It was the best birthday ever.

My big brother Max taught me how to play soccer. On Wednesday we had a huge game against the Tigers. I was nervous but my heart was pumping fast. The grass was wet and I ran through the mud.

"Pass the ball over here!" Max yelled at me.

I saw the ball and I knew I had to seize the moment. I kicked it hard but neither of us scored. The goalie threw the ball back out to the middle. I kept running and keeping my eyes on the goal. Suddenly I tripped over my own feet. It felt like I was sleeping on the ground.

"Get up, you can do it!" my coach shouted loudly.

I got up and simply kicked the ball into the net. We won the game and Max played his air guitar. I am happy that I avoided a grounding for losing.

I was so thrilled about recess today. We were training for the big monkey bar race. "Watch me go fast!" I yelled to my friend Sam. I started to climb up the metal bars quickly. It looked a little dangerous because I was swinging hard. Suddenly my shirt got twisted on a rusty bolt. I scratched my arm and fell onto the sand. My elbow felt hot and scorched from the slide.

The teacher ran over sounding very worried. "Are you okay?" she asked while breathing fast. I had to explain that I was just going too fast. I remember my arm hurt for an hour. Speaking was hard because I was trying not to cry. I did not win the race today.

Yesterday at school was the best day ever. I walked to class early because I was so thrilled. My neighbor sits next to me and he looked worried.

"I think a creature stole my homework," he whispered.

I laughed but then I remembered something important. It was freezing outside, meaning we might have indoor recess! I trapped my excitement inside. Everyone sat down and the teacher started clapping a rhythm. We clapped back but then we heard a noise. A squirrel was running around the room!

"Look out, it's fast!" shouted my friend Sam.

The teacher opened the window and the squirrel neared the exit. It jumped out and we all cheered. We found a acorn under my desk later. School is weird sometimes.

I was sitting in class and staring at the clock. It felt like the day was loading so slowly. Finally the bell rang for recess and we ran through the doors. My friend Sam gripped his lunchbox tight.

"Let's play on the big slide!" Sam shouted.

"Okay, but watch out for the beetle," I said.

We ran to the playground equipment that looks like a castle. I climbed up and pretended I was camping in a fort. Sam jumped down like he was doing a bungee jump. He is trained to land on his feet. He gave me a thumbs up and grinned. It was simply the best recess ever until the teacher blew the whistle. We had to go back inside for math.

It was my younger sister's birthday and she was so thrilled. My mom made a cake that looked like a giant mountain. We invited my friend Sam over for a sleepover. Sam is a single child so he loves big parties. We played tag and I sprinted very fast across the yard.

"Watch out for the cake!" my dad yelled loudly.

Then my sister threw a water balloon and it hit me. We laughed and my brain felt happy and dizzy. My mom acted like a tour guide for the presents.

"Open the blue one first, my daughter," she said.

My sister grew very excited sounding like a little bird. It was the best birthday ever.

My best friend Sam had a sleepover for his birthday. We were wearing our pajamas and bumping into things. We played a game about space and zero gravity. I jumped off the couch and started stamping my feet.

"Watch out!" Sam screamed when I almost hit the lamp.

We ate pizza with weird toppings that looked foreign. Then Sam opened his presents and he looked very grateful. He got a cool robot that could talk.

"I thought you would like that one," I said.

His mom cleared the messy table and brought out cake. Sam’s dad dropped a receipt on the floor. I picked it up for him. It was the best night ever to receive cake and fun.

Last Wednesday I woke up late for school. I squeezed my toothpaste but nothing came out. I ran downstairs and saw my dog sleeping on my homework. He was roaming around the kitchen looking for food.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "Get off my math paper!"

My mom was stamping her foot because we were late. I sat in the car and tried to comb my hair. We got to school just as the big doors closed. My heart was pumping fast. I believed I was in big trouble.

My teacher looked at me and smiled. "Did your dog eat your homework?" she asked.

I held up my ripped paper with a big thumb print on it. It looked like someone cut it with scissors. I started groaning but then she laughed. It was actually a good day.

I had a crazy day at school today because I lost my schedule. I looked through my backpack but it was gone. Then my friend Leo appeared and he was eating a sandwich.

"Did you see my paper?" I asked him.

"No, but maybe you left it in the computer lab," Leo said.

We walked to the lab but the door was locked. Suddenly we heard screaming from the gym. Mr. Green was blowing his whistle really loud. He was coaching kickball and the ball struck the wall with a boom. It sounded like thunder.

"Stop that moaning and run faster!" Mr. Green yelled at the team.

We ran away before he saw us. At recess we played a game about camping. I pretended I had a plastic knife to cut imaginary apples. I struggled to climb the monkey bars but I made it. Then the bell rang and the fun was over.

Me and my friend Sam found an old map. It showed a secret island with a big castle. We packed our bags and checked the schedule for the boat. The weather was sunny and hot that day. We saw a huge building made of grey stone.

"Look at that incredible tower!" yelled Sam loudly.

We ran across a green meadow to get closer. Suddenly a big dog barked at us. I was really scared but Sam was brave. He grabbed a metal chain on the ground. He gripped it tight and we climbed the wall. Inside we found a room full of foreign coins. We promised to maintain the secret forever.

My neighbor Tim said he knows a lot about psychology. He said that means he knows how my brain works. I think he is just being weird. Yesterday at recess we played four-square. "You have to get it!" Tim yelled at me.

"I am not going over there," I said back.

We struggled to see the ball in the tall grass. It looked like a little island in a green sea. We spread out to look for it. Finally, we found it. That was enough playing for one day. We went inside for lunch.

My friends and I went to the old spooky cave. We drove our bikes really fast to get there. Inside the dark cave, rocks were scattered everywhere.

"Look at that shiny thing!" shouted Billy loudly.

He pointed at a big blue jewel on a rock. But then a huge dragon flew down from the ceiling. Its fire scorched the ground near our feet. We were trapped in the corner. We crawled behind a big stone to hide. The dragon looked scary and mean.

"We have to run now!" I whispered to Billy.

We ran fast and left the cave quickly. We were safe but we didn't get the treasure. Next time we will bring a shield!

My dog Buster escaped from the backyard yesterday. I knew immediately because he was gone when I looked. My mom and I started our search for him. We walked for a league, which is really far. The sun scorched my face and I felt hot.

"Buster! Come here!" I yelled very loudly.

Suddenly, a small brown head appeared behind a bush. He shook his fur and wagged his tail fast. It had a funny rhythm like a drum.

"There he is!" my mom said with a smile.

Buster ran to us and licked my hand. He looked like he fought a big monster. He had mud on his nose and paws. It was thirteen minutes past dinner time too. We walked home and I held his leash tight. He is often very naughty but I love him.

I was sitting in class and my stomach was groaning. It was almost lunchtime and I was so hungry. The teacher was talking about something important but I wasn't listening. I just thought about the pizza slices floating in my head.

Then the bell finally rang and everyone sprinted to the door. I ran outside and my legs were pumping fast. I met my friend Sam at the swings.

"I bet I can jump higher than you," Sam said.

"No way, I trained all summer for this," I told him.

We swung for thirteen minutes until the whistle blew. Then I remembered something bad. I turned to Sam with a worried face.

"Oh no! I forgot about bringing my homework," I said.

My finger pointed to my empty backpack. I was in big trouble for the meeting with my teacher.

One day I was walking and I saw a big robot. The robot was loading heavy boxes onto a spaceship. His arms were pumping up and down really fast. I ran over to him because he looked cool. He was huge and his height was like a giant tree! But he looked sad and was making a weird noise.

"Why are you moaning Mr. Robot?" I asked him.

"The weight is too heavy for me," the robot told me.

I have superpowers so I simply lifted the box with one finger. It was easy for me.

"Wow thanks kid!" he said.

Then he flew away to Mars and I went home for dinner.

My robot was named Zork and he loved science. We landed our ship in a green jungle planet. The trees were huge and purple bugs were floating everywhere. Zork started loading rocks into his tummy for fuel.

Suddenly a big green monster jumped out of the bushes! It was taller than my house and looked mad. Zork beeped loudly because we were in big danger.

"Zork, use your laser eyes right now!" I yelled.

Zork shot a red beam and the monster ran away. We did not want to see that monster again either. The monster’s reign over the jungle was over. We got back in the ship and felt the weight lift off. We flew home safe.

My birthday was finally here and I turned nine! I was so excited that I woke up really early. Everyone in the house was still sleeping except for me. I went out on the balcony to look for my friends. My neighbor Mr. Jones was outside walking his dog.

"Happy birthday!" he shouted up at me.

"Thanks Mr. Jones!" I yelled back super loud.

Then I remembered my mom said no yelling in the morning. I was scared of getting a grounding on my birthday. Later we had an incredible party with pizza and cake. We played tag and ran throughout the whole house. My friends started cheering when I opened my presents. It was the best day ever.

One day I built a robot dog named Sparky. He was made of shiny metal and lived on an island. Sparky liked reading books about bones and lasers. He tried to gnaw on a bone but he broke his tooth! I fixed him up and he looked very pleased. Suddenly we heard a loud knock on our spaceship door.

"Who is that?" I asked Sparky.

"It is a green alien!" Sparky beeped loudly.

The alien threw a ball at us but it was just a present. The alien wanted to learn about psychology so I gave him a book. We all played tag and it was the best day ever.

It was my birthday and I was so thrilled. My mom said I could have a sleepover with my best friends. I heard the doorbell ring and I ran to open it.

"Happy birthday!" shouted Tim and he gave me a big box.

We went to the backyard and felt a cool breeze. We saw a single balloon stuck way up in a tree. It was stuck at a really high height. I thought we could not get it down. Tim tried to explain his plan to get it.

"I am hungry, let's eat cake first," I said.

After cake, my dad used a long stick to guide the balloon down. We were happy seeing it come down safe. I did not complain about the fun day. Getting that balloon meant a lot to me. I hope I receive more balloons next year.

My dog Buster is usually very good. We trained him to sit but he still jumps. One day my mom drove us to the big park. Buster was wearing his blue collar and running very fast. He neared the picnic table and smelled something good. It was my dad's roasted chicken sandwich!

Buster crashed right into the table and ate it. My dad was holding a cup of coffee with caffeine. He spilled it all over his shirt.

"Oh no, Buster!" my mom yelled loudly.

My dad was groaning and wiping his shirt. "I didn't want that coffee either," he said.

Buster grew tired after that and slept all the way home. He is a crazy dog but I love him.

Yesterday my dog Buster sprinted straight into the spooky woods. I was afraid but I ran after him fast. I neared the big swamp and heard a noise. Buster was trembling by a tree and groaning loudly. A big owl flew down and looked at us.

"Come here Buster right now!" I yelled at him.

"Woof!" said Buster and he looked very scared.

I grabbed his collar and we ran home. My dad was stewed because we were late for dinner. He was swearing a little bit under his breath. Everyone was happy we were safe though. We went boating on the lake later that night. It was the greatest day ever because I saved my dog.

Yesterday, my big brother spoke to me about video games. He said he was the greatest player ever. I told him I could beat him easily. We sat down and the ringing noise started the match. It was a dangerous level with lots of fire.

I was groaning because my character fell in a hole. But then I saw a special sword. I tried to seize it quickly. I held the button down hard. Suddenly, a storm brewed on the screen. The weather in the game turned bad. Neither of us could see anything!

I laughed and followed the guide arrow. Although it was hard, I won the game. I am teaching him how to play properly now.

Yesterday was an incredible day at school. First we had art class and I carefully used the scissors. I cut out a big blue boat for my project. My teacher Mrs. Green came over to me.

After that we ate lunch but it was stewed carrots. Neither me nor my friend Sam liked them at all.

We did not finish them. Later we learned about a colonel in history class. I hope I receive a gold star today.

I ran to the field for the big race. My younger brother Sam came too but he is slow. We were playing tag before the race started. There were fourteen kids ready to run fast.

I crossed the finish line first and I froze. It was the greatest feeling in the world. I didn't see anyone either side of me.

I was very grateful for my protein shake that morning. It helped me run super fast today.

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother Sam. He always wins, but today I had a plan. I picked the fast car and he picked the beetle car. We started the race and I found my rhythm quickly. I was trembling a little because I wanted to win bad.

Suddenly, Sam crashed into a wall and I zoomed past him. I screamed, "I'm going to win this time!"

Sam didn't say anything, but his face got really red. We crawled toward the finish line on the last lap. It could be either of us winning the big cup. Just then, I saw a blue shell coming for me. It hit me and I spun out. Sam passed me and won again.

"Good game," he said, and treated me to a juice box. I opened it and smiled, seeing that he wasn't bragging too much. I will receive that trophy next time.

I was eating my lunch outside because it was pleasant. I had a toasted cheese sandwich and an apple. Suddenly, I heard screaming from the playground. Everyone was running around and acting crazy.

"Hey, look out!" my friend Sam yelled at me.

A huge squirrel was tearing across the ground. It grabbed a bag of chips and scattered them everywhere. The squirrel didn't care about the people watching, though. It looked like it had enough food for a year. Then my teacher came over.

"Please pick up that trash," she told us nicely.

We cleaned up the mess and I found a loose thread on my shirt. It was a weird lunch but at least the squirrel was happy.

One day me and my friend Ben found a map. It showed a secret path to the magic fountain. We walked for a long time and saw a scary cave. Inside the cave a witch brewed a green potion. It smelled like stewed socks!

I grasped Ben’s hand tight because I was scared. Suddenly a giant bat flew down screaming loud. I used my imagination and threw a feather at it. The bat laughed and flew away. We ran past the witch and saw the water.

We drank the water and felt strong. A gold thread fell from the sky. We were so grateful for the adventure.

My birthday is on Wednesday and I was so excited. My mom bought a big chocolate cake and we invited my neighbor. His name is Sam and he is my best friend. We played tag in the yard together.

Sam grinned and started stamping his feet. He ran after me with loud thumping steps. Unfortunately, I tripped on a rock and fell down. My knee hurt but I did not cry. Sam helped me up.

I nodded and we went inside for cake. Everyone greeted us and started cheering. I closed my eyes and made a wish. Then the cake disappeared very fast because seeing it made us hungry. I knew it was the best birthday ever.

It was raining really hard outside today. My dog Buster wanted to go out anyway. He was jumping up and down at the door. I put on my yellow raincoat and opened the door. We ran through the wet grass together. Buster found an old soggy newspaper on the ground. He also sniffed a wet receipt from the store.

I was playing Mario Kart with my big brother. He always wins, and it makes me so mad. I was hungry for a win today. I picked Yoshi because he is fast.

I was playing basketball in the driveway with my big brother. The ball bounced on the plain concrete and made a loud noise. I tried to shoot it, but I missed the hoop completely.

I held the ball and thought about winning a big trophy. I jumped up really high and threw the ball fast. It went right through the net! I felt happy because I finally made a point.

"Good job!" he yelled. "Now let's play a real game."

We played until it got dark outside. My mom called us for dinner because we had company coming over. I was tired but I wanted to play more. I was already planning how to beat him tomorrow.

I was playing my new video game with my neighbor Sam. We had to climb a huge mountain to find a magic castle. I picked the character who looked like a strong knight. Sam picked the wizard who had a long white beard. We searched everywhere for the secret door.

"Look over there by the fountain!" Sam shouted at me.

I moved my guy and discovered a tiny silver needle. I used it to unlock the big gate. Suddenly a dragon came out and breathed fire. My hands were trembling on the controller. We spread out our snacks and got ready for level two. Science homework could wait until later.

One day my dog Rex chewed on my dad’s shoe. It was a wonderful shoe and now it had holes. Rex did not seem to know he was bad. He just wagged his tail at me.

We went outside to play in the big surrounding woods. It was freezing cold and the wind blew hard. We pretended we were on a meeting with a king. I was a brave knight and Rex was my horse.

"Let’s go find the castle," I said to Rex.

My mom says dogs have dog psychology but I just thought he was hungry. We ran home because it was especially cold. Rex ate his food and I was happy.

My neighbor Jake is a champion explorer. One day we went boating on the big river. We saw a dark cave and simply had to go inside. The cave walls had a big blue vein of shiny rocks.

We walked deeper and heard a scary growl. It was a bear! We ran out fast and jumped in the boat. We paddled hard and got home safe. Then we ate toasted marshmallows by the fire. We will never go back in that cave again.

My brother and I played a racing game on Wednesday. I picked the red car with the giant turbo boosters. He picked the green truck that looked like a monster. We started steering our cars really fast around the track.

"You are going to lose!" I yelled at him.

"No way, I am faster than you!" he shouted back.

Suddenly my car flew off a huge jump and landed perfectly. I was going thirteen miles per hour in the game! Then I saw a secret shortcut near the science lab. I drove through it and I was winning. But then my brother tried to knock me off the road. It was like a knife fight but with cars! My tires smoked and I spun around in circles. I lost the race and felt like a stewed tomato. Next time I will win for sure.

We climbed up to the spooky old balcony. My legs were trembling but I kept going. Timmy held the map and pointed at the door.

"It is impossible to open," Timmy said quietly.

I pushed the heavy door and it opened! We saw a big purple stain on the floor. Suddenly a giant spider jumped down and we screamed. I almost crushed my flashlight because I was scared.

"Run back down again!" I yelled at Timmy.

We ran fast and escaped the scary house. We had a happy feeling when we were safe. Our quest was finally complete. Everyone was cheering for us when we got home. Next time we want to find an invisible ghost.

It was my birthday and I turned eight years old today. My mom brewed some hot cocoa and we started the party. My best friend Max drew a cool picture for me. It was a design of a big castle with a guard.

"I want to reign over the kingdom!" Max shouted loudly.

I laughed and said, "Okay, but I am the king first."

We got hungry so we ate pizza with extra cheese. Then we used scissors to open my big presents. One present was a bee costume with a fake stinging tail. The night neared and we were tired but happy. It was the best birthday ever and I love being eight.

Yesterday I found a weird robot in my backyard. It was hiding behind the big tree and singing a funny song. The robot was silver and had green eyes.

"Why are you here?" I asked the robot.

"I am following a magic cat," said the robot.

My little nephew came outside and saw it too. He started running around the robot in circles. The robot tried to catch him but it was a failure. Then the robot threw a ball of light into the air. It exploded like a painting made of fire.

"Wow that is so cool!" yelled my nephew.

We played with the robot until dinner. I hope it comes back tomorrow.

My friends and I went deep into the jungle today. We were bringing snacks and flashlights for our big adventure. Suddenly, a big monkey jumped out right in front of us! It tried to wrap its tail around my leg.

"Run away fast!" shouted my best friend Sam loudly.

I grabbed my bag and threw a banana at the monkey. The monkey caught it and sat down to eat. We ran straight to the old temple door. I had to knock three times to open it.

Inside the temple, a huge stone statue greeted us. I drew a picture of it in my notebook. We were safe now, but we were very tired.

My nephew Timmy was getting his tonsils out at the hospital. I was feeling sad for him so I made a card. I drew a big green island with a pirate on it. "Are you dreaming about cake again?" she asked me.

My mom started cheering because she liked the picture. We are approaching the hospital now. Timmy was moaning a little bit in his bed. I hope he feels better tomorrow. Then we can play pirates together.

I was walking in the woods and I saw a big shiny castle. It was floating in the air and it looked like metal. I did not know what it was. Suddenly a green door opened and a robot came out. The robot had three eyes and they were glowing bright red.

I ran home fast and never went back there again.

It was Saturday and my soccer game was today. The air was freezing but I wore my jersey anyway. I believed we could win the big trophy. My dad held my hand and we walked to the field.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so excited. My best friend Sam came over with a huge brown bag. We went to my room and he started dumping everything out. It looked like a big mess on the floor.

There was a cool leather map and a flashlight. The map was our guide to the backyard. We ran outside and my brain was thinking fast. We looked under the slide and behind the big tree. Suddenly a red box appeared in the grass. It was closed tight with tape.

I opened the box and it did contain a cool toy robot! It was simply the best birthday ever.

I was walking in the space jungle with my robot dog. His name is Sparky and he has a metal thumb. Suddenly we saw a big purple alien with three eyes. I feared it was going to eat us! Sparky barked and I saw something clinging to the alien’s leg. It was a tiny bird with a blue feather.

One day, my best friend Max brought a map to school. He said it was for a hidden treasure cave. We left class at recess and ran to the woods. The woods were dark and everyone feared going inside. Max was stamping his feet because he was excited.
