We found a big rock with a green stain on it. Suddenly, we heard a tearing sound nearby. It was a giant bear! My brain told me to run fast. We ran all the way back to the playground. Max was sad about the treasure but glad for the company.

"That was too dangerous," Max said. "Maybe I was just dreaming."

We went inside for lunch. The real reason we ran was that the bear looked hungry!

My best friend Leo and I love exploring the woods. One day we found a weird trail behind my house. It looked scary and dangerous but we are brave. We walked throughout the spooky forest for a long time. Suddenly Leo pointed at a big old tree.

"Look at that strange sign," Leo whispered loudly.

The sign had a drawing of a ghost on it. We climbed up the big tree to see better. I touched a branch and it felt really cold. Then we heard a loud crack.

"What happened?" I yelled.

A huge bear came out of the bushes! We sprinted away as fast as we could. We ran all the way home and were safe. We obtained a wonderful story but we are never going back there. We trained to be fast runners so we got away.

My friends and I found a map in the old computer room. It showed a secret cave behind the school. We sprinted across the field and found a dark hole.

"I am scared," said Tim, and he was trembling.

"Don't worry, I am coaching you," I said bravely.

We crawled inside the cave and kept bumping our heads. It was very dark throughout the tunnel. Suddenly, I grasped a shiny rock. It felt heavy like gravity was pulling it down. I thought it was gold! We ran back to show everyone our treasure. It was just a painted rock, but it was still the best adventure ever.

My friends and I played in the backyard at my sleepover. We decided to build a castle out of old cardboard boxes. Sam was tearing the tape with his teeth and it looked funny. Then we hung a big sheet over the boxes for a roof. We sat inside on the ground and ate lots of chips.

Suddenly, the roof started hanging down low. It was bearing too much weight from the heavy blanket.

"Watch out!" I yelled, but it was too late.

The whole thing gradually crushed us flat. We crossed our arms and tried to push it up. My finger got stuck a little bit but I pulled it out.

"Let's climb out and build it again," said Sam.

We laughed because we looked silly. It was the best sleepover ever.

My friend Sam and I wanted a big adventure. We went into the old house on the hill. It was dark and scary inside. I saw a huge stain on the rug. It looked like red juice but maybe it was blood.

"Do you think a ghost lives here?" asked Sam.

"It is impossible to know for sure," I said.

We walked up the stairs to the high balcony. I found an old silver comb on the floor. Then we heard a loud noise downstairs. We ran very fast out the door! We did not complete our quest today. I will read a book about ghosts before we go back.

One day me and Max went up the big mountain. We wanted to find the secret cave at the top. Max had a backpack with snacks. The weight was heavy but he is strong. We scrambled over big rocks and scratched our legs.

"Do we have enough water?" I asked Max.

"Yes, and I have rope too," said Max.

We saw a dark hole and walked inside. It was very scary and dark. We had to remain quiet so the bats would sleep. Suddenly, I saw something shiny on the ground! It was a gold crown from an old king's reign. We were jumping up and down because we were happy. We used a thread to tie it to Max's bag. The adventure was complete and we went home for dinner. I hate cleaning my room but I love adventures.

I was playing Mario Kart with my nephew on the weekend. He is only five but he is actually really good. We picked the jungle island level because of the cool scenery. I was winning but then I hit a banana peel.

"Oh no, I am going to lose!" I yelled loudly.

My car twisted around and I drove into the grass. My nephew drove past me and he looked very thrilled. I felt a little bit of anger inside my chest. My items were scattered all over the road. I did not receive any good power-ups after that either.

"I am the winner now!" he said with a big smile.

I chewed on my lip and tried to catch him. But the race was almost over and he was faster. I was not keeping up with him any longer. Then I saw the finish line sign. He won the race but it was still fun.

Me and my best friend Jack went exploring today. We found a cave behind the twisted old oak tree. The scenery was spooky and dark inside. Neither of us had a flashlight, but we went in anyway.

Suddenly, we heard a loud noise on the ceiling! It was a giant bat sleeping upside down. We tried to be quiet, but I stepped on a stick. The bat woke up and spread its huge wings.

"Run for your life!" Jack screamed very loud.

We ran fast and barely escaped the scary cave. We realized we were lucky to be safe. It was thirteen minutes until dinner, so we ran home. The kitchen was warm and pleasant.

"Where were you two?" asked my mom.

"Just playing," I said with a smile. The door was closed, and we were safe.

Yesterday I went exploring in the woods behind my house. My dog Barnaby was jumping around because he loves walks. We walked for a long time and saw a big squirrel. Barnaby barked and immediately chased it under a bush.

"Come back here right now!" I yelled at him.

Barnaby disappeared into the leaves and I heard a loud noise. He crashed into a pile of sticks and got stuck. He crawled out looking very sad and twisted his leash. I was stamping my feet in anger but then he licked me. It was a complete mess but he was okay.

"You are a silly dog," I said and hugged him.

We walked home and he slept for the whole afternoon.

It was my birthday and I was so excited. My mom made a big cake and my dad played his guitar. My neighbor Ben came over to my house. He drew a funny picture on my card. I knew it was a dog because it had big ears.

I opened my presents and saw a silver chain. It was from my grandma and I loved it. I gave her a big squeeze. Then we played tag in the yard. The sun neared the earth and it got dark. We had enough cake and felt sleepy.

"Are you keeping the balloons?" Ben asked me.

"Yes, I often keep them until they pop," I said.

It was the best day ever. I didn't even know it could be so fun.

My teacher gave us big trouble today. We had a test on sounding out words, but I forgot to study. I felt like a big failure. At recess, I threw my ball really hard. It struck the wall and bounced back at me.

"Hey, are you okay?" asked my friend Sam.

"No, I am full of anger," I said.

Then the bell rang for lunch. The cafeteria lady was loading trays with weird green stuff. It looked like jungle soup or old stewed carrots. I crawled under the table to hide, but the teacher saw me. She said I needed better training on how to behave. It was a bad day. I wish I was boating on a lake instead.

I had the greatest day at school today. During recess, me and my friend Sam played a game. We pretended I was a brave knight with super strength. Sam was a dragon protecting the playground building.

I grasped a stick and yelled, "Prepare to lose!"

Sam roared back, "It is my pleasure to defeat you!"

The wind blew really hard and my cape spread out. I ran fast and saved the pretend lamb from the tower. Then the bell rang for reading time. My teacher was loading a video about my nephew's favorite book. It was fun but I have lots of homework for tomorrow. I hope I can finish it before dinner.

One day, my friend Tim came over to my house. He had a secret map he obtained from his brother. We looked at the map and saw an X.

"We need to go now," Tim said. "It is important."

We packed our bags and started roaming in the woods. Suddenly, we saw a giant elephant! It was a guard for the treasure. It was cleaning its trunk in the river. We were scared, but I had a plan. I used a long thread to distract it.

The elephant looked at the floating string and walked away. We ran past it to a plain field. We dug a hole and found a box. Inside was a science kit!

"This is the best treasure ever!" I shouted.

We ran home just in time for my dad's schedule. We were safe.

I drove my mom crazy with my guitar. I played it all day for the big talent show. My brother stewed in his room and started groaning. He hated the loud noise I made. I bounced around because I was so excited.

"Please stop making that noise!" he yelled.

"It is music, not noise!" I shouted back.

I thought I sounded great, like a rock star. But then I started coughing a lot. Mom said I might get pneumonia if I didn't rest. She brewed me some hot tea to drink. It tasted bad but it was important for my throat. I found my brain was tired from practicing too much anyway. I sat down and did some reading instead. I didn't complain because my throat hurt like it was roasted. Speaking was hard so I just played video games later.

It was a pleasant day for our big race at school. My friend Sam screeched his sneakers on the track. We were competing in the high jump. I struggled to tie my shoes because my hands were trembling.

"You can do it, Mike!" Sam yelled at me.

I looked at the bar hanging there. It looked very high. I ran fast and jumped with all my might. I cleared the height easily! But Sam was groaning because he hit the bar.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

He nodded but he was bearing some pain in his leg. Our science teacher came over to measure my jump. I was grateful that I won the blue ribbon.

I was so scared about my math test today. I feared my brain would forget all the numbers. I walked straight to my desk and sat down. Mrs. Lee handed out the papers and I grabbed my pencil.

"You can do it, Tim," my friend Jake whispered.

I looked at the first problem and started thinking hard. Suddenly, the answer just flew into my head! I grinned and wrote it down fast. My confidence grew with every single question.

When the bell rang, I jumped up happily. We went outside for recess and played basketball. Jake was the guard and I tried to score. I turned and shot the ball at the hoop.

"Nice shot!" Jake yelled as it went in.

After that, we had art class and did some painting. I love school when I actually learn stuff!

My dog Sparky is crazy and he chewed my favorite shoe. It was a big failure because I needed it for school.

"Bad dog!" I yelled at him, but he just wagged his tail.

I went outside to explore the woods behind my house. I climbed a big tree and looked down. Suddenly, a squirrel appeared and jumped right past my face! It landed on a branch and started bumping into leaves.

"Hey, watch out!" I said to the squirrel.

Neither of us moved for a long time. I wanted to remain in the tree forever. I pretended to reign over the forest like a king. Then my mom called me for dinner. I simply jumped down and ran home fast. It was a good day even with the chewed shoe.

We built a giant fort in the woods yesterday. It looked like a castle from a foreign land. My dog Max was the king, and his reign was very silly. He sat on a big rock and looked at the scenery.

"You are a good king, Max!" I yelled loudly.

Max barked back and wagged his tail really fast. We felt thrilled to be outside in the sun. Then I heard a weird noise in the bushes.

"What was that noise?" my friend Sam asked me.

We used all our strength to move a heavy log. We caught a tiny frog hiding under it! We let it go, and we went home for dinner. I am earning five dollars for cleaning the muddy fort tomorrow.

My nephew Sam and I found a map in the dirt. It looked very weird and old. We walked to the big park near the school. We saw a stone fountain with green water.

"Look at that shiny thing inside!" yelled Sam.

I threw a rock and it bounced off the side. Suddenly a secret door opened up under the water. It was dark but we went inside the hole. We saw a blue vein of gold on the wall. It was scary but we were brave enough. Then a big bat flew at Sam's head.

"Run away fast!" I screamed.

Sam got so scared he almost fainted on the floor. We ran back home and drank some juice.

I was waiting in line for lunch and my stomach was beating fast. Today was pizza day and I was so hungry. The boy in front of me kept bumping into my arm.

"Stop moving so much!" I said to him.

"Sorry, I really want pizza," he said back.

Finally, I got my slice and I sprinted to my table. The cheese was hot and I blew on it. I took a big bite and chewed it slowly to a rhythm in my head. But then I looked in my pocket. My homework was crushed into a ball! It was a complete mess. I tried to smooth it out on the table like an old receipt. It looked bad, but at least the pizza was really good.

My dog Buster escaped from the backyard yesterday. He ran straight into the woods behind our house. My mom said we needed a guide to find him. We walked for a long time and saw a strange bird. It looked foreign and had bright blue feathers like a jewel.

I touched a tree branch and heard a loud noise. It was Buster barking and sounding very scared! He was stuck in a big bush near the creek.

"Don't worry Buster, we will save you!" I yelled.

My mom pulled the branches and Buster jumped out fast.

"You have to remain close to the house now," Mom said.

When we got home, my dad was reading the newspaper. He was happy to receive lots of wet dog kisses. I think Buster likes science class better than exploring the woods.

Yesterday me and my friend Sam went boating on the big lake. We were looking for the secret island. I hurt my thumb on the paddle but I was brave. We saw a big fountain in the middle of the water.

"Look at that giant castle!" Sam yelled loudly.

We climbed up to the balcony and went through the door. It was dark inside. We saw a giant rat trying to gnaw on a bone. It was sleeping but then it heard me sneeze. It woke up and chased us to the ceiling! We ran away fast. We went home and ate toasted bread. It was the best adventure ever. I want to reign as king of that island someday.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house yesterday. I was following a tiny green bug on the ground. It crawled over a big brown leaf and under a rock. I lifted the rock and I saw something wonderful. There was a spider web with a cool design on it. It looked like someone sewed it with a needle.

"Wow, look at that spider!" I yelled to my brother.

He ran over and he accidentally hit a branch. The branch started to knock against the web. The poor spider struggled to hold on tight.

"Be careful or you will break it!" I said.

We watched the spider fix the web for a long time. Seeing nature is the best part of playing outside.

My nephew Timmy came to school with me today. It was show and tell so I chose him. We drove to school in my mom's big van. Timmy bounced in his seat the whole time.

At lunch, the cafeteria lady served us stewed tomatoes. Yuck! I thought I was going to be sick. Then we went outside for recess. We played king of the hill on the slide. I wanted to reign over the playground like a king.

Suddenly, Timmy started running away very fast.
"Stop right there!" I yelled at him.
"I don't know how!" he shouted back.

I had to chase him all the way to the swings. It was a crazy day but having Timmy there was fun.

I sat at my desk and looked out the window. The scenery outside was nice because the trees were green. A cool breeze came in, but Mrs. Lee shut it. She said we had to focus on our art project. I picked up my scissors and started cutting the blue paper.

"Hey, can I borrow those scissors?" my friend Tim asked.

"Okay, but give them back fast," I said to him.

Tim took them and cut a long snake shape. It was longer than my snake. I chose the red paper next for the tongue. Suddenly, we heard the loud bell ring for recess. Everyone started running and hanging up their aprons quickly.

"I’m bearing left to the swings!" yelled Sarah.

We all ran outside to play in the sun.

I was running super fast in my favorite video game. My player grasped the golden sword and jumped over the lava. It was the beginning of the hardest level ever.

"Watch out for the monster!" my brother yelled at me.

I gripped the controller tight and my tongue poked out. My character did a cool bungee jump off a cliff. He flew through the air like a breeze. Then I got trapped in a cage by a robot.

"You need to use science to escape," my brother said.

I pressed the red button and heard a loud sneeze. The cage opened and I was following the map again. I won the game and we both cheered really loud.

I have a new puppy named Spot. We are simply training him, but it is hard. Yesterday, Spot ran outside when the wind blew. He saw a big stick and he threw it around. I taught him to sit, but he just shook his head.

"Spot, you have to listen to me!" I yelled.

He did not listen and crashed into the trash can. It fell over, dumping trash everywhere. I had to explain to Mom why there was a mess.

"You need a better schedule for him," Mom said.

Later, Spot struck a pose by the fence. I used scissors to cut some grass off his fur. He jumped up to my height and licked my face. I hope I receive a treat for being patient. It is not easy having a puppy!

My friend Sam and I played the greatest video game ever. We were brave knights and we had to climb a big mountain. The sun scorched the ground, but we kept running. I was the captain of the team.

"Watch out for the dragon!" yelled Sam.

I threw a magic rock and it bounced off the ceiling. The dragon got scared and flew away fast. We found a secret cave with a shiny jewel inside. It was blue like a vein in your arm. We high-fived because we won the whole game.

"That was awesome," I said.

My mom greeted us with snacks throughout the afternoon. We felt like real heroes.

For my birthday, my mom took me and my friends to the big jump park. I had that excited feeling throughout my whole body. We ran inside and saw a huge bouncy castle right away.

"I bet I can jump higher than you!" my friend Sam yelled.

"No way, watch this!" I shouted back.

We jumped for an hour and got super sweaty. Then we saw the bungee trampoline. I got strapped in and went so high. I almost caught the ceiling! We counted how many times we could flip. It was the best day ever. I understood why everyone loves birthdays because you get to play all day long.

We were playing kickball at recess and trouble brewed quickly. My friend Sam kicked the ball and it flew high. I ran fast to catch it but I slipped. The ball hit my head and everything went black. I almost fainted right there on the plain grass.

"Are you okay?" yelled Sam from first base.

I got up and my head was hurting throughout the game. But I grasped the red ball tightly in my hands. I threw it at Sam and got him out!

"You got me!" Sam said and he looked really mad.

My confidence was growing because we were winning the game now. We won five to four and everyone cheered loudly.

The robot crashed right into the jungle. His metal arm was twisted and he looked sad. I saw a green wire like a vein hanging out. I wanted to help him maintain his strength.

"Do you need help climbing out?" I asked him.

The robot opened his eyes and they glowed blue. "My battery is scorched," he said in a robot voice.

I used a bungee cord to pull him up. It was hard work but I had a good feeling. We walked past a fountain made of gold. The scenery was so cool and full of trees. He gave me a silver thread as a present. I tried to seize it but it floated away! We were already best friends forever.

My brother Tim and I went to the forest today. We were steering our bikes on a bumpy path. Suddenly a big hole appeared in the earth. It was dark and scary.

"I dare you to jump in," said Tim.

I didn't want to receive a scrape or bruise. But I took a deep breath and jumped down. My weight made a loud thud when I landed. It was cold and I felt a sneeze coming.

"Don't get pneumonia down there!" yelled Tim from the top.

Then something struck my helmet. It was just a small rock. I didn't see any monsters either. We climbed out and rode home fast. It was the best adventure ever.

My friends and I walked to the park for my birthday. We played tag and then we started pumping our legs on the swings. I felt like I was jumping into the sky! My friend Sarah said, "Look at me, I am an elephant!" She made a funny noise with her nose. Then we ran to the slide together. We pretended the sandbox was a secret island. My mom brought cupcakes and we ate them all. "Did you like the chocolate one?" asked my mom. I nodded and grabbed another one. My big brother came too. He thinks he knows everything about psychology because he is in a special league at school. I don't listen to him though. We played again until it got dark. I am waiting for my next birthday already. It was the best day ever.

My dad said we were going camping in the woods. I was afraid of bears but my dog Buster was happy. We drove for a long time through the big trees. My neighbor told me the forest is full of bugs.

When we got there, Dad started pumping up the air mattress. It popped loudly and Dad grumbled. "This trip is a total failure," he said sadly.

I threw a stick for Buster and he ran fast. He found a squirrel surrounding a big rock. I thought it was funny.

"Look, Dad! Buster is the greatest hunter ever!" I shouted.

Dad smiled and forgot about the mattress. "Maybe he is like a brave colonel," Dad laughed. I knew camping would be fun after all.

Me and my friend Sam found a cave. It was dark and scary but we went in. A big guard dog was sleeping by the door. We had to squeeze past him very quietly. I felt the weight of my backpack on my shoulders.

Suddenly the dog woke up and scratched the floor! He stuck out his big pink tongue and barked.

"Run Sam! Use the scissors!" I yelled loud.

Sam grasped the silver scissors from his bag. He cut a thick vine that was holding a gate. The gate fell down and blocked the dog. We were safe! It was the greatest adventure ever. We ran home fast and my leg had a blue vein popping out. We are never going back there again.

We went camping in the woods on Saturday. It was very beautiful but my dog Buster is silly. He saw a big black beetle on a log. Buster sniffed it and then he started to sneeze loud.

"That looks dangerous!" said my little brother Timmy.

"It is impossible for a bug to hurt a dog," I told him.

Buster shook his head and kept running around. We played a game of swinging on the low branches. I pretended I was a brave sailor on a boat. Timmy sat on the ground bringing me sticks. We often go outside to play like this. It is hard to maintain a clean tent with a dog. Buster got mud everywhere but it was fun.

It was my birthday and I was wearing my new pirate costume. I wanted to be a sailor on the high seas, but we were just in the backyard. My friend Billy was running around like a wild dog. He ran too fast and crashed into the punch bowl.

"Watch out!" I yelled, but it was too late.

The red juice struck the ground and made a huge puddle. It looked like a red fountain spraying everywhere. My mom came outside and saw the big mess on the earth.

"Oh no, look at my clean grass," she grumbled quietly.

Billy looked sad, especially because his shirt was wet. I counted to ten so I wouldn't be mad.

"It’s okay," I said. "Pirates get messy sometimes."

We kept playing until the sun was growing dark and tired.

I was walking up a big mountain to see the aliens. My robot dog Sparky was with me and he was scared. The path was very plain but the sky looked beautiful. Suddenly a green alien popped out of a rock!

"Hello human!" screamed the alien with a loud voice.

Sparky started groaning and hiding behind my legs. I was not certain if the alien was nice.

"Do you want some roasted marshmallows?" asked the alien nicely.

I went through the bushes to the alien meeting place. I did not understand their language but the marshmallows were good. We ate all the snacks and then we went home. It was the best day ever.

My little nephew came to my birthday sleepover. It was weird because he is only four. We were playing tag in the yard. Suddenly a big breeze blew my new painting away! It went right toward the street.

"Oh no, it’s in danger!" I yelled.

My nephew ran fast and was clinging to the paper. He stopped right before the road. He was tearing up a little bit.

"I got it for you!" he said happily.

I was yearning for my painting to be safe. My friends started cheering for him. Neither of us got in trouble. I could not contain my smile. Everything turned out wonderful in the end.

One day my friend Leo and I went boating. It was cold because it was February. A chilly breeze hit our faces but we felt brave. We were loading the boat with snacks and ropes. We wanted to find the secret island in the lake.

"Do you think we can make it?" asked Leo.

I gripped the paddle hard and nodded my head. "We are in the adventurer league now!" I shouted.

We paddled fast and the water looked dark. Suddenly a storm brewed above us. The gravity felt heavy and waves splashed in. I knew we had to turn back fast. We paddled thirteen times really hard. We finally hit the sand safely. That was too scary for us today.

I was yearning for my birthday party all week. Finally, the day came and I was wearing my new blue shirt. My friends arrived and gave me presents that had a lot of weight.

"Happy birthday!" everyone yelled when I opened the door.

We played tag outside until it turned dark. Then my mom lit the candles on the cake. I closed my eyes and made a big wish. It was a very pleasant party.

"Did you receive what you wanted?" asked my friend Sam.

I nodded and showed him a toy beetle in a box. My dad treated us to pizza and paid the funny delivery guy. We ended the night by cheering for my new video game. I was so tired but so happy.

Max and I scrambled up the big hill behind my house. We wanted to find the secret cave. The scenery was wonderful because the sky was super blue. Max bounced a red ball while we walked.

"Look at that weird rock!" I yelled loudly.

It looked like a foreign planet up there. Suddenly, a big dog jumped out. We were scared, but Max gave him a protein bar. The dog ate it fast and cleared the path for us.

"That was close," Max said. "I think he likes snacks."

We finally found the cave entrance. It was dark inside, like an invisible monster was hiding. We didn't learn what was in there because it started raining. We ran home to play on my computer instead. It was enough jumping and running for one day!

One sunny morning, my dog Buster greeted me with a big bark. He bounced around because he was so thrilled to go outside. We went into the woods behind my house. It smelled like wet earth and pine needles. Buster ran ahead and immediately started digging near a big tree. He was tearing up the dirt with his paws.

"What did you find, Buster?" I asked him loudly.

He didn't stop digging, so I grabbed his collar carefully. Suddenly, a tiny chipmunk jumped out from a hole! It ran up the tree to a safe height. Buster barked, but the chipmunk didn't come down either. I spread some peanuts on the ground for it later. I am thirteen peanuts short now, but Buster had fun.

"Let's go home, silly boy," I said.

We walked back, grounding our feet in the soft grass.

The math test today was totally impossible. Mr. Green called my name, and I walked up to his desk slowly. My stomach felt like it was doing flips.

"Did you finish all the problems, Timmy?" he asked me.

I looked at the ground and shook my head. "No, the last one was too hard," I said.

Mr. Green smiled and spread his arms out wide. "It is okay to ask for help," he told me.

I went back to my seat feeling grateful. At recess, I was stamping my feet in the mud for pleasure. Mud is way better than math. Then the bell rang, and we all ran back inside. School is okay, but recess is the best part.

My neighbor Mr. Jones is actually an alien captain. I saw him on his balcony in February. He shook a silver stick and the sky turned purple. Then a beautiful green robot flew down to him. It looked like a big bug with shiny wings.

I ran to my room and grabbed my laser sword. I went outside and heard a loud knock on the fence.

"Hello Earth boy," said the robot with a beeping voice.

"Are you going to eat me?" I asked.

Mr. Jones laughed and gave me a space cookie. We sat by the fountain and looked at the stars. I often visit them now. We fight bad aliens and save the galaxy every Tuesday.

My nephew Leo and I went to the deep jungle. We were looking for a lost golden cup. Leo needed some coaching because he was scared of bugs. Suddenly a big gray elephant blocked our path.

"Stay back, Leo!" I shouted loudly.

The elephant looked nice but then a stinging bee flew by. The bee landed on the elephant’s nose. The elephant ran away fast into the trees. We walked more and found a cave with a guard. The guard was sleeping on a rock. Inside the cave, we saw a pot that brewed green smoke.

"Is that magic?" Leo asked me.

We grabbed the cup and ran home. We ate toasted bread and talked about everything. Exploration is the best.

My brain felt like heavy mush during math class. Mrs. Green was speaking about fractions, but I just stared.

"Who can read the answer on the board?" she asked.

I looked down at my desk and sighed. The weight of my big science book was crushing my legs. I grumbled quietly because I was super hungry for lunch.

Gradually, the clock hands moved to twelve, and the bell finally rang! I ran to the cafeteria at a steady pace. I paid for my pizza and sat with Sam.

"This cheese looks weird," Sam said while poking it.

"Just eat it," I laughed. "It tastes fine."

We finished fast and ran outside to play tag. School is okay when you have pizza and friends.

Me and my friend Sam found a secret door. It was behind the big fountain in the park. I pushed the heavy door open and we walked inside. It was dark but Sam had his new science flashlight. We saw big rocks and a long tunnel ahead.

"I think a dragon lives here," Sam whispered.

We kept walking steady until we saw something glow. The ground looked black and scorched like burnt toast. Suddenly a bat bounced off the wall and scared us! I almost crushed a bug when I jumped back.

"Maybe we should go home now," I grumbled.

Sam just grinned and turned his light on a chest. It was full of gold coins! I thought I was dreaming but it was real. We grabbed some coins and ran back home fast.

We hiked up the long, twisted trail. My bag was heavy but I had enough strength. Me and my friend Sam were looking for the greatest treasure ever. It was a big shiny jewel hidden in a cave. We walked for thirteen minutes and saw a dark hole.

"Look at that scary ceiling!" Sam yelled.

We went inside and heard something groaning. A monster was chewing on a bone! It had purple veins and looked mad. We ran fast but gravity pulled us down. We slid into a room with a water fountain.

"We are safe!" I said.

We found the jewel on top of the fountain. We ran home and heard everyone cheering for us. It was the best day.

I was playing soccer in the freezing cold rain. The wind was stinging my face and my hands were numb. We were losing the big game by one goal. I looked at the goalie and he was huge. He looked like he had the strength of a bear.

Suddenly the referee blew his whistle loudly. It was time for a free kick.

"You take it, Ben!" shouted my friend Sam.
"Okay, I will try my best," I said back.

I ran up and kicked the ball super hard. My ankle twisted a little bit but I didn't care. The ball went flying over the goalie's head. It went right into the net! We were all clinging to each other and jumping. I felt like I was on a happy island. I was so tired I felt like sleeping right there on the grass. We didn't win but a tie is okay too.

My brother Leo and I went to the old castle. It was raining hard outside but we wanted to explore. We heard a loud stamping sound coming from the basement. Leo was scared but he kept me company.

"Do you hear that heavy rhythm?" Leo asked me.

"Yes, maybe a giant is roaming down there," I whispered.

We walked down the dark stairs very slowly. I touched the cold stone wall and shivered. We saw a big door. It looked like it could hold a lot of weight.

"We are going to be in big trouble," Leo said.

But we pushed the door open anyway. Inside was a dog loading bones into a pile! He was the king of the basement. His reign was funny, not scary. We played fetch and that was enough adventure for one day. We promised to maintain his secret forever.

I was playing my favorite video game about a brave knight. The knight was thumping bad guys with his big sword. My mom came in and started speaking to me loud.

"You need to start cleaning your room right now!" she said.

I paused the game because I feared getting in trouble. I put my toys away and then gravity pulled me down. I fell on my bed and sighed because cleaning is boring. I wanted to play in the big gaming league online.

"Are you done yet?" my mom asked from the hall.

"Almost!" I yelled back and simply shoved clothes under my bed.

Then I went back to my game and greeted my friends. We jumped on a boat for the boating level. But then the power went out and the screen disappeared! I was so mad.

One day I went outside to the big mountain behind my house. I brought my dog Rex and some sharp scissors to cut vines. We pretended to be explorers in a foreign land. Rex was a brave knight and I was the colonel of the army. We walked for a long time and saw a squirrel.

Rex barked very loud and scared the squirrel away. We had a schedule to keep so we kept walking fast. I thought we might find treasure or maybe a dragon. We didn't find gold but I found a cool rock. It was getting dark so we ran home for dinner. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went roaming in the woods. We had a schedule to find the secret treasure by noon. We climbed a big hill that felt like a huge mountain. Suddenly the ground shook really hard and we got scared.

We remembered the map said the treasure was near a stone fountain. We saw something different behind a big green bush. It was the old fountain! We dug in the dirt and found a gold box. One day my dog Rex ran into the woods. I sprinted after him but he was too fast. I went through the big bushes and touched some sticky leaves. I feared he was lost forever. Then I heard a loud barking sound by the river.

Rex was trapped in a muddy hole near the water. He was jumping and stamping his paws but couldn't get out.

I saw a big stick and let him gnaw on it. Then I pulled him up hard. Mud was spread all over his fur. We walked home and I saw my dad loading the car for boating.

I kicked the red ball hard. It went floating high into the air. It looked like a dangerous scene, but it landed safe. Everyone started cheering loudly for me. I ran fast and my face felt hot. Me and my friend Sam went to the dark woods. We had a schedule to find the hidden treasure box. Sam gripped his flashlight tight because it was scary. We walked for a long time and saw a cave.

My mom gave us hot chocolate later. I was grateful because it did not have caffeine. It was the best adventure ever.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday and we had a sleepover. We were playing tag in the backyard but Sam got trapped. He was hiding behind the big shed near the fence. I was seeing him peek out but I pretended I didn’t.

Sam looked at his muddy toy and gave a thumbs up. We went inside for cake and Sam felt better. It was a fun day even with the mud.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We built a big fort with blankets and pillows. I pulled the red blanket from my bed. Sam reached for the blue one on the chair.

It got dark inside the fort and I got scared. Sam said, "Don't worry, I have a flashlight."

He turned it on and we drew pictures. I drew a monster with three heads. Sam drew a superhero. Then we heard a noise outside. Something scratched at the door and we both jumped.

"What was that?" I whispered to Sam.

My mom opened the door with snacks. She didn't have caffeine because it was late. She gave us cookies and juice instead. I didn't know it was just her. My thumb hurt from drawing so much. We ate the cookies and went to sleep.

I was running really fast at recess today. It was freezing outside and my nose felt like an icicle. We played tag and it was dangerous because the grass was slippery.

"You can't catch me!" screamed Tommy loudly.

He was sounding very sure of himself. I ran faster and my face was stinging from the cold wind. Suddenly Tommy fell down hard on the wet ground. He looked like he was grounding a plane. I stopped and helped him up. He wasn't invisible anymore.

"Are you okay?" I called to him.

He grinned and said he was fine. I tagged him and I won the game. I felt grateful that he didn't cry. My teacher said I was earning a gold star for being nice. Now we have to go inside and learn math.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. It was a cold day in February and I was wearing my big coat. We walked through the tall grass and Buster was tearing at a stick. Suddenly we heard a weird sound like moaning. I thought it was a ghost!

"Did you hear that Buster?" I asked him quietly.

Buster barked and ran behind a big oak tree. I ran after him and saw something strange. It wasn't a ghost at all. It was just an owl breathing hard. It looked wrong because one wing was stuck.

"We have to help it," I said to Buster.

I carefully got the owl free. It struck its wings and flew away. It was a pleasure to help the owl. Then we went home and ate roasted marshmallows.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old park. We climbed the big fence because the gate was closed. Sam bounced his red ball, but it went into the bushes.

"I have a bad feeling about this," Sam said.

We walked into the dark woods to find the ball. Suddenly, the sun disappeared behind a cloud. I was steering us through the tall grass for an hour. We feared a bear might live here.

"Look, that tree is different!" I shouted.

It had a huge hole. We looked inside immediately. The ball was there! We grabbed it and ran back fast. I often thought about that scary tree, but we never went back.

My robot Zorg crashed his spaceship in the backyard. It made a loud noise and frightened my cat. I ran outside and saw smoke bumping into the sky. Zorg screeched because his metal leg was bent bad. I touched the hot ship and it felt buzzy.

Zorg simply pointed at the sky and beeped sad. He needed help so I searched for my dad's tools. I found some big scissors and a hammer. I fixed his leg and he bounced up happy.

He got back in his ship and left quickly. Only a black mark on the grass would remain there. I hope he comes back soon to play.

I woke up early because of the big soccer game. It was raining outside but my dad said we still play. I looked at the schedule on the fridge and grabbed my bag. We drove for an hour to get to the muddy field. My brain was fuzzy but I was ready to win. The other team was big and scary.

Recess is the best part of the day, especially today. I ran outside and saw the big climbing frame. It looked impossible to climb to the top, but I really wanted to try. My friend Sam was already running around and stamping his feet in the dirt.

Me and my friend Sam found a cave. The scenery inside was dark and wet. We heard a loud ringing sound.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover. We decided to build a huge fort in the living room. We used blankets and pillows and it looked like a castle.

My friends and I went camping in the big woods. We walked for a long time and found a hidden cave. It was dark but we sent Tim in first. Suddenly we heard something bumping around inside the cave. The noise got louder and stronger and scary.

"Run away right now!" yelled Tim.

We grabbed our bags and ran fast down the hill. But then I saw a big rope hanging from a tree. It looked like a bungee cord. I stood there and looked at the scary bear. I jumped and grabbed the rope tight. I swung over the river and I was safe. Everyone started cheering for me. The bear could not catch us any longer. Gradually the sun went down and we went home tired.

"That was the best adventure ever," said Tim.

I was so hungry by lunchtime that my stomach hurt. I opened my lunchbox and saw a cheese sandwich. The bread looked a little toasted and brown on the edges.

"Hey, can I trade you my apple?" my friend Sam asked.

"No way, I am going to eat this whole thing," I said.

Suddenly, a big gust of wind blew across the playground. It felt like gravity stopped working for a second! My napkin went flying and I had to seize it quickly. It was tearing a little bit in the wind. We looked at the scenery around us. The sun felt hot like we were being roasted. We had one hour left before reading class started. I finished my sandwich and we ran to play tag. I was glad the wind cleared up so we could run fast.

I sat at my desk and looked at the clock. It was time for our big meeting about the school play. My teacher Mr. Brown blew his loud whistle and everyone stopped talking.

"We need to write a single scene today," he said.

I was yearning to be a superhero who could bungee jump. But then Tim stole my good idea! He screeched loudly and pretended he was flying.

"I am floating in the air!" Tim yelled.

I felt mad so I decided to squeeze my stress ball. Then the lunch bell rang and we ran outside. The scenery was nice and sunny. I ate a roasted chicken sandwich. I am earning a gold star for being good today.

One day my robot neighbor named Sparky got twisted up. He tried to walk through the door but he was stuck. I looked at my schedule and I had time to help.

"Help me please!" screamed Sparky very loud.

I pulled his metal arm and a green light lit up. Suddenly Sparky started singing a weird alien song. He spread his wings out wide and flew up high. I thought he was broken but he was just super cool. Not a single person saw him fly except me.

"Wow, you are magic," I said to him.

Neither of us knew robots could fly. We flew around until dinner and had fun.

One day my best friend Sam and I went on a big adventure. We wanted to search for hidden treasure in the woods behind my house. The cool breeze blew the leaves around us. We walked for a long time following a muddy path. Suddenly, Sam stopped and pointed at a dark cave.

"Do you hear that moaning sound?" asked Sam.

I was scared but I said, "Let's go look inside together."

Inside the cave, we discovered a shiny blue jewel on the earth. Just then, a big bat screeched and flew right at us! We ran out fast. Later, we sat by a fire and roasted marshmallows. We chewed them slowly and talked about our scary day. It was the best quest ever.

It was my birthday and I invited my friend Sam. He greeted me at the door with a big box. I struggled to open it because the tape was sticky. Inside was a hamster cage but unfortunately no hamster!

"Do you understand what it is for?" asked Sam.

"Yes, but where is the animal?" I said.

Sam laughed and pulled a tiny box from his pocket. It was a hamster! I looked close and saw a tiny blue vein in his ear. We named him Rocky because he looked like he trained at the gym.

"He needs lots of protein to get strong," Sam said.

We watched Rocky run on his wheel all night. It was the greatest birthday ever because Rocky is so cute.

I was walking to school and the breeze was cold. My nose felt like it was stinging from the wind. I saw my friend Billy steering his bike carefully. He shouted, "Hey look at my new wheels!"

I ran over but then I tripped on the ground. My lunchbox fell and my sandwich got crushed. It looked flat like an elephant sat on it.

"That looks dangerous to eat," Billy said and laughed.

I picked it up and cleared off the dirt. I was hungry so I didn't care about gravity or dirt. My younger sister thinks I am gross but I am trained to eat anything. The bell started sounding so we ran inside fast.

My younger brother drew a map on the computer. He said we were going roaming in the woods. I took my big scissors to cut the vines. We saw a bird that flew really fast.

"Catching it is impossible!" I yelled.

My heart was beating hard from running so fast. We found a weird bug that looked foreign. Neither of us knew what it was. Then we heard mom screaming for dinner. We smelled roasted chicken from the house.

"Are you teaching the bugs tricks?" Mom asked us.

We laughed and ran inside to eat. It was a good day.

My nephew Timmy came over to play my new racing game. We picked our cars and the race started fast. I was winning but then my car went off the track.

"Watch out for the banana!" Timmy yelled at me.

I tried to turn but I crashed into a wall. My car was floating in the water now. I was groaning because I hate losing to him. He drove right through the finish line and won.

"I am the champion!" he shouted and did a dance.

I stewed in my chair while he was celebrating. I feared he would brag about this all day long. Next time I will just be reading a book instead.

My nephew Timmy came over for a sleepover last Saturday. It was freezing outside so we stayed in my room. We used our imagination to build a giant fort. We were climbing on the bed and swinging pillows around.

"Watch out for the lava!" Timmy screeched loudly.

I jumped over the gap and felt thrilled.

"I will reign over this castle!" I yelled back.

Suddenly, Timmy saw a tiny feather floating through the air. For some reason, he got really scared of it. I did not understand why his face turned pale. It was like ice water was in his vein. Then he started jumping like he was on a bungee cord. We laughed so hard until my mom told us to sleep.

I was playing soccer outside and the weather was pleasant. My friend Sam was on my team and we ran fast. I kicked the ball hard and it went through the goal.

"Yes! We are winning!" I yelled at Sam.

Suddenly the sky turned dark and rain started dumping on us. We crawled under a slide but the ground got muddy. My heart was thumping because I heard thunder.

"This is not fun anymore," Sam said sadly.

We discovered a dry spot and waited for my mom. I thought we would play all day but we stopped. My mom drove up and we dropped our bags inside. We were screaming and laughing because we were so wet. Next time I will check the weather first.

My neighbor Billy is really an alien from Mars. He is thirteen years old and has green skin. One day Billy showed me a shiny red jewel. It was glowing and had a heavy weight.

"Do not touch it!" Billy yelled at me loudly.

I touched it anyway and suddenly the scenery changed. We were floating in space and I saw fourteen stars. Then a big robot flew by us really fast. My nephew Timmy was driving the robot and screaming.

"Help me fight the space monsters!" Timmy shouted.

I used the jewel to zap the monsters away. Then we woke up back in Billy’s backyard. It was the coolest day ever.

It was a cold Wednesday in February. My dog Buster and I went to the park. Buster was wearing his new red sweater. We walked to the big old tree near the pond. Suddenly, a squirrel ran right past us! Buster barked loudly and chased it.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled.

He did not listen and disappeared behind the bushes. I ran fast and crossed the muddy grass. I looked everywhere for him. Then I saw a tail wagging. Buster crawled out from a hollow log. He had a stick gripped in his mouth.

"You are the greatest dog ever," I said.

He dropped the stick and licked my face. We walked home happy and tired.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We were playing outside in the backyard near the old fence. There is a rusty chain on the gate that makes noise. Suddenly I felt something stinging on my arm and I scratched it.

"Ouch, look at this huge bug!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam looked and said, "That looks like a giant beetle!"

We were both scared but then we started laughing. We are often afraid of bugs but this one was just slow. Later we heard a knock on the back door. It was my mom calling us for our meeting about snacks. We ate popcorn and forgot about the bug. It was the best sleepover ever.

I went outside with my dog Rex on Saturday. We walked near the creek and the earth was muddy. Rex was feeling very happy and ran super fast. He chased a single squirrel up a big oak tree.

"Come back here, Rex!" I yelled loudly at him.

Rex did not listen and he chewed on a stick. I was steering him away from the mud but he slipped. He got so dirty and looked like a chocolate monster. I felt a little anger but then he licked my face.

"You are a messy boy," I said and laughed.

We neared my house and my mom was cooking dinner. It smelled like stewed carrots and beef inside the kitchen. I washed Rex with the hose and he shook water everywhere. It was a fun day but now we were both tired.

Me and my friend Sam went into the dark woods. We heard a loud noise and we were trembling. We followed the tracks on the ground. Suddenly, a big bear crashed through the trees! It was approaching us fast.

"Run Sam!" I yelled.

We ran into a cave but the bear followed. The ceiling was low and I hit my head. My head was stinging but I kept running. We met a wall and we struggled to climb. Sam was loading his slingshot with a rock. He shot a single rock and it hit the bear. The bear chewed on the rock and looked confused.

"I think he likes it," Sam said.

We were grateful the bear stopped. We brewed some tea back home and told my mom.

One day me and Max went to the spooky old cave. We wanted to find the pirate gold hidden deep inside. We crawled under a big rock and saw a dark tunnel. It was scary but we were brave enough to go.

"Do you hear that weird rhythm?" Max asked me quietly.

I listened hard and heard a thump thump sound. We walked more and saw a giant spider web. It looked impossible to cross without getting stuck. Max struggled to cut it with his stick. He chewed his lip because he was scared.

"Wait, look over there!" I yelled at him.

I saw a shiny box behind the web. It was complete with gold coins! We already found the treasure so we ran home fast. We didn't measure the gold but it was a lot. It was the best adventure ever.

I was playing my favorite video game against my brother. It was a race up a giant mountain in a meadow. We had to climb fast or we would lose. I heard the music get faster and my heart was pumping hard. My brother grinned at me because he was winning.

"You are going to lose!" he yelled at me.

"No way, I am going to win!" I shouted back.

I saw a secret path behind a rock and took it. I gradually got faster and passed him right at the end. I was so pleased when I crossed the finish line first. My brother stewed in his chair and looked mad. I felt like I had electricity in every vein. Then I got to receive the gold trophy on the screen. It was important to beat him because he always wins.

Yesterday was a crazy day at school. We were doing math and my neighbor Tom started trembling. He looked funny and his face got red.

"Are you okay?" I asked him quietly.

"I need to sneeze!" Tom yelled very loud.

Suddenly he sneezed with super strength. It was so loud! His pencil flew up and hit the ceiling. Then it came down bumping onto my desk. Everyone laughed but the teacher did not laugh. She said math is important and we need to be quiet.

Later at recess we played a game about pirates. We looked for a hidden jewel in the sandbox. I found a shiny rock and I felt happy. It was the best day ever even though Tom was loud.

I was keeping a secret for my neighbor, Mrs. Green. It was her cat’s birthday and we had a plan. But then the cat disappeared! We looked everywhere in the yard. I scratched my arm on a bush during the search.

"Where is Fluffy?" I screamed.

Mrs. Green grabbed my hand and looked scared. "Neither of us saw him leave," she said.

Suddenly I saw a tail near the car. The cat was sitting on the steering wheel! He was tearing up the seat a little bit. I thought he looked funny. A blue vein popped out on Mrs. Green’s head because she was mad. I closed the car door fast. Then we gave Fluffy his tuna cake. It was the best cat party ever.

It was my birthday and I was so excited. I woke up early and ran to the kitchen. My mom was reading the newspaper and drinking coffee.

"Happy birthday to the champion!" my dad yelled loudly.

He shook my hand like a grown-up business man. I saw a big box wrapped in plain paper. I knew what it was inside the box. I was a little afraid it was just clothes. I opened it fast and saw a new computer!

"Is this really for me?" I asked them.

"Yes, but you have to share with your sister," Mom said.

I hugged them both and felt very happy. Then my friends came over for pizza and cake. We played games all night until we got tired.

My friends came over for a sleepover last night. We made a huge fort with blankets hanging from the chairs. It looked like a weird cave inside. My friend Tom scrambled under the blanket and got stuck.

"Help me! I feel like a trapped elephant!" he yelled.

We all laughed and pulled him out by his feet. Later we ate pizza but my mom forgot to cut it. I grabbed a knife and tried to cut it myself. It made a trail of sauce on the table.

"Don't make a mess or mom will show her anger," I whispered.

We stayed up late and told scary stories. I was afraid of the dark but we were all together. In the morning my dad made eggs but he drank too much caffeine. He was moving so fast! I remembered it was the best sleepover ever.

My brother and I were playing my favorite video game. It is about a secret island full of monsters. I had to use my strength to climb a big mountain. My character has magic leather boots that ignore gravity.

"I am going to win this time," my brother yelled.

"No way, I practiced all day," I said back.

Suddenly my thumb slipped off the button. My character fell down and got crushed by a giant rock. My brother laughed so hard he almost choked. I discovered a secret cave at the bottom though. Inside the cave was a growing monster who looked very hungry. I escaped just in time and won the level! My finger hurt from pressing the buttons so fast.

"That was just luck," my brother said.

I smiled because I knew I was better. Next time I will design my own level.

My friends and I went to explore the spooky island. It was just a plain rock in the middle of the lake. We were feeling brave so we walked straight into the dark cave. Suddenly, I heard a loud groaning sound from the shadows.

"Run!" shouted Sam. "It’s a monster!"

We scattered everywhere and hid behind big rocks. I was scared I might sneeze and give us away. Then a tiny bat flew out and escaped into the sunlight. It wasn't a monster at all.

"We are safe again," I whispered.

Then my dad started coaching us on how to row the boat back home. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my best friend Sam woke up early. We wanted to find the secret cave behind the park. Sam was wearing his lucky red cape for bravery. We walked fast and saw a dark hole in the rocks.

"Do you guarantee there are no bears?" I asked Sam.

"I think so, but keep quiet," Sam whispered back.

We went inside and it was very dark and scary. I found an old paper on the ground. It was a receipt from the grocery store! Someone was here before us. I thought we found treasure, but it was just trash. We ran home before my mom started speaking about grounding me. I was pleased we were safe, but next time we need flashlights.

My dog Buster was roaming in the backyard. The sun was hot and it scorched the grass. I threw a tennis ball high up. It bounced near the old stone fountain. Buster ran fast and his tongue hung out.

"Come back, Buster!" I screamed loudly.

He didn't listen and he dug into the earth. I neared him and saw he found something weird. It was a dirty old newspaper buried deep. Suddenly, a cool breeze blew past us.

"What is that?" my sister asked me.

"I think it's thirteen years old!" I said.

Then Buster started moaning because he wanted a treat. We went inside for snacks.

I played soccer with my friends at the park. We stood on the green grass and made teams. I held the ball and kicked it hard. It went through the goal and I shouted loudly.

"That counted!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam was groaning because he missed the block. He picked up the ball and pushed it back.

"No way, my eyes were closed!" Sam said.

We played until it got dark enough to stop. My mom brewed some hot cocoa for us later. We sat on the ground and drew pictures in the dirt. It was a really fun day playing outside.

I was so thrilled about recess today. We ran outside and flew toward the big blue slide. But then I saw a danger sign on the steps. Someone chewed gum and stuck it right on the handle! It looked gross and I thought it might be sticky.

"Don't touch that!" shouted my best friend Leo.

"I won't!" I yelled back and ran to the monkey bars.

I tried to climb up but my hands were sweaty. I crawled under the bars instead and found a weird bug. It started to gnaw on a single leaf. Then the bell rang and we had to go in. I ran to the water fountain first because I was thirsty. School is fun but recess is way too short.

My friends and I found a map in the dirt. It looked old and twisted. We trained for days in my backyard for the trip. Max was steering his bike down the big hill. I followed him fast. The wind was a cool breeze on my face. We went through the scary woods behind the school. Suddenly we heard a loud whistle sound.

"Did you hear that noise?" asked Max.

"Yeah, maybe it is a monster!" I yelled back.

We pedaled faster and saw a big stone wall. It was not a monster. It was an old castle hidden in the leaves! We were brave enough to go inside. We found a gold coin on the floor. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster and I were playing outside. We pretended the backyard was a big island. Buster was jumping over a log like a knight. Suddenly he saw a squirrel and ran very fast! He escaped through a hole in the fence. I scrambled over the fence to catch him.

"Buster, come back!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen because he was training to hunt. I threw a stick but he just kept running. He found a shiny rock that looked like a jewel. Then he finally stopped for a funny reason.

"Are you hungry, boy?" I asked him.

He barked and wagged his tail. I had to explain to my mom why we were muddy. We spread a blanket on the grass and ate snacks. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Max woke me up very early today. He barked and jumped on my bed. I got up and we went outside to the garden. The grass was wet and it looked like a shiny jewel. Suddenly Max saw a big frog near the bushes. He barked at it but the frog was fast.

"Don't touch it Max!" I yelled loudly.

But Max ran and almost caught the frog. It jumped a crazy height into the air. It looked weird when it landed. Max tried again but I grabbed his collar.

"Come here you silly dog," I said.

My dad came outside with his newspaper and laughed at us. We went inside and Max took a nap.

My friend Sam and I went exploring in the woods. We were roaming around looking for a hidden fort. Suddenly we felt a cold breeze. We walked through some big bushes and saw an old house. It looked scary but we went inside anyway. The ceiling had big holes in it.

"Look at that shiny box!" Sam screamed loudly.

I crossed the room and picked it up. It was just an old receipt for pizza. That was a big failure. Then we heard a thump upstairs. We scrambled out the door fast.

"I don't want to remain here either!" I yelled back.

We ran all the way home. My mom’s daughter was waiting on the porch. It was fourteen minutes past dinner time. We were safe but we were very hungry.

Yesterday, me and Sam went to the old cave. We feared it was scary but we wanted to explore. My heart was thumping hard like a drum. We squeezed through a small hole in the rocks.

Inside it was dark and I used my imagination. I thought I saw a monster! Sam counted to three and we turned on our flashlights.

"Look at that!" Sam yelled. "It is just a big bird!"

A blue feather was on the ground. The bird was jumping around. We were having a meeting with a secret bird. It was the best adventure ever. We ran home fast to tell my mom.

I was having a really bad day at school. My backpack felt like it had a heavy weight inside. I walked to the water fountain and took a long drink. Then I saw my friend Max standing by the single swing.

"Do you want to play tag?" I asked him.

Max looked at the surrounding kids and shook his head. "No, I have to study my spelling words," he said.

I grabbed my spelling list and moved next to him. Although I wanted to run, I sat down on the grass. We looked at the words together. One word was psychology and it looked super hard to spell. I put my finger on the page and tried to sound it out.

"This is impossible!" I shouted loudly.

Max laughed and said, "It is okay because we are smart."

We studied until the bell rang and then we ran inside.

My friend Sam and I went to the woods. We were bearing big backpacks for our trip. We wanted to find the old hidden fort. The scenery was nice with big green trees.

Suddenly we saw a weird dog. It was wearing a red collar but looked lost.
"Is that our neighbor’s dog?" asked Sam.
"I think so, let’s catch him!" I yelled.

We crossed a small river on a log. I scratched my arm on a bush. We finally caught the dog near a cave. We made a fire and roasted marshmallows. They tasted good and toasted. The fire spread warmth everywhere. We were happy adventurers.

We had recess after math class and I was really hungry. My friend Tommy brought his big red ball outside. He bounced it super high on the blacktop. Throughout the whole game we were screaming and laughing.

"Pass it to me!" I yelled at Tommy.

He threw the ball but I missed it. It escaped my hands and went near the fence. I ran to get it but I caught my foot on a rock. I fell down hard but I didn't cry. My heart was beating really fast like a drum.

"Are you okay?" Tommy asked me.

"I think so," I said and I got up.

I didn't know anything was wrong until later. My teacher Mrs. Miller was teaching us about a colonel in the army. I looked down and saw a big hole in my pants. My mom is going to be so mad!

Me and my friend Sam went boating on the lake. We were looking for a lost pirate jewel. The wind blew hard and our boat rocked fast.

"Something feels wrong," said Sam looking at the sky.

Suddenly a big wave struck the side of our boat! My heart was pumping so fast in my chest. We used all our strength to paddle to a small island. We were safe but we were very hungry. We made a fire and roasted some marshmallows. It was a pleasure to eat them.

"This is an important clue," I said holding a map.

I found a shiny rock and I did wrap it up. We did not find the jewel but we had fun. We will measure the map again tomorrow.

I was waiting for recess all morning because math was super boring. We were learning about earning money and counting to thirteen. Finally the bell rang and we all ran outside fast. I wanted to search for bugs near the big tree.

"Look at this giant beetle!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked close and said, "That looks so weird and scary."

The beetle was shiny green and it looked foreign, like from another planet. We watched it crawl on a leaf near the water fountain. Then the teacher blew the whistle and recess was over. I was sad but at least I saw a cool bug.

I was playing my favorite video game on the computer. The loading screen was taking forever and I was getting mad. My heart was pumping fast because I wanted to win. Finally the game turned on and I saw my friend Sam.

"You are going down today!" Sam yelled through the headset.

"No way, I practiced all week," I said back.

We started racing our cars on the weird alien track. I discovered a secret shortcut behind a big rock. Sam was speaking loudly but then he got quiet. I went super fast and won the race easily. It felt like a huge weight was off my shoulders.

"Good game," Sam said, "but next time I am coaching you."

I was already ready to play him again. I love winning!

It was raining outside so we had my birthday inside. My mom made a big chocolate cake and I was so happy. I opened my presents and got a new red truck.

"Do you want some cake now?" my mom asked me.

"Yes please!" I yelled really loud.

We sat down but my little brother pushed the table. The cake fell down and made a huge mess on the floor. There was a trail of chocolate everywhere. I saw a tiny crumb on my shoe.

My brother started crying because he thought he was in trouble. My dad laughed and said, "There is no reason to cry."

It was sounding like a bad party but then we ate ice cream. We eat ice cream often so it was still the best day.

My brother Tom was turning thirteen on Saturday. I woke up really early because I was excited. It was raining outside though, and the ground was wet. Mom said we simply had to play inside.

"Where is the cake?" I asked Mom in the kitchen.

"It is meeting us later," she laughed and pointed.

The dog was tearing open a present on the floor! He had blue frosting all over his pink tongue. I grabbed him, but gravity made me fall down hard. There was not enough cake left for the party now. We were certain Tom would be mad at us.

"Bad dog!" Tom yelled when he saw the mess.

But then he laughed because the dog looked silly. We ate ice cream instead and it was good enough.

I was playing Super Racer with my brother Sam. We were on the last level with the big volcano. My car flew off the track, but I got back on fast. I had a scared feeling in my tummy. Sam pushed me on the arm and laughed.

"You are going to lose!" he yelled at me.

I gripped the controller super hard. My character had to climb the mountain to win. I jumped over the lava pit just in time. Suddenly, a storm brewed in the game and lightning struck Sam’s car. I crossed the finish line first!

"I am the champion and I will reign forever!" I shouted.

Sam was not happy, but I was so tired. I felt like sleeping for a hundred years because winning is hard work. I was not afraid anymore.

One day I walked straight into a big forest. I was camping there with my dad. I found a weird red rock on the ground. It was glowing and felt really hot. Suddenly the rock opened up and a tiny green alien scrambled out!

"You brought me back to life!" the alien screeched.

I was scared so I started stamping my feet. The alien shot a laser beam at the ceiling of my tent. The laser had no weight but it cut a hole.

"Stop that right now!" I yelled at him.

The weather got bad and it started raining hard. The alien used a magic thread to fix my tent. Then he started painting a picture of space on my sleeping bag. He was actually a nice alien.

My friends and I neared the spooky forest. The wind brewed a storm and it felt very cold. My heart was pumping fast in my chest. We knew something was wrong with the old tree.

"I hear a scary whistle," said my friend Sam.

We walked closer and a big shadow appeared suddenly. It was just a friendly owl! We toasted marshmallows later and felt brave.

"That was important coaching for being explorers," I told Sam.

We were happy and safe. The adventure was fun and scary at the same time. Next time we will bring a bigger flashlight.

One day I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I was looking for a magical creature but I only found a frog. It grasped a wet rock and jumped in the pond. It swam away very fast so I walked deeper into the trees.

Suddenly I saw a dark shape near an old building. My imagination went wild and I got scared. I gripped my stick tight.

"Is that a monster?" I screamed.

My dog Buster ran out from behind a bush. He was tearing up an old pillow he found. A white feather floated down on his nose. He had a big mud stain on his paw.

"Bad dog! You need more training!" I yelled.

I threw the stick for him and we ran home. I will learn to be braver next time.

I bought a robot from my neighbor named Mr. Jones. He sold it to me because it was often singing loud songs. The robot grew big fast and started swearing at my cat. It grabbed my mom's scissors and started tearing up the curtains.

"Hey! Stop that right now!" I yelled at the robot.

"I am the champion of ripping stuff!" the robot said.

It had a stinging laser beam, but I was brave. I was honest and told it that it needed good company. Then the robot escaped out the window to find some alien friends. I hope it finds them soon because my mom is mad.

I was sitting in class and I was so hungry. My teacher Mrs. Miller was teaching us about animals. She put a big picture of a jungle on the board. It had bright green scenery and big trees. Then I heard a loud growl.

"Did you hear that?" asked my friend Sam.

"It was just my tummy," I whispered back.

For art class we had to cut out animals. I struggled with the scissors because they were sticky. I was making a bear bearing his big teeth.

"That looks scary," said Sam.

The reason I made it scary was because I was hungry! Finally the bell rang for lunch. I ran to get my pizza. I love school but eating is the best part.

My friend Leo and I found a secret map. It showed a hidden island in the middle of the lake. We jumped in our old boat and rowed fast. Suddenly, a big storm came and the waves got huge!

"Row harder or we will simply sink!" I yelled loudly.

Leo used his brain and steered us behind a rock. The rain gradually stopped and we saw the sandy beach. We sprinted to a dark cave and saw a chest. Inside it didn't contain gold or jewels. It was just an old, broken guitar.

"This is the greatest treasure ever!" Leo said happy.

He started playing a cool rhythm on the strings. We pretended to be a brave knight band saving the world. We weren't dumping it, so we took it home forever.

Me and my friend Sam walked into the dark woods. We wanted to find the old hidden castle. The trees grew very tall and blocked the sun. We reached a big river and saw a huge bear. It was tearing at a log and looked mad.

"Run fast!" I yelled to Sam. 

We started jumping over rocks and roots. My heart beat super fast. We turned left and saw the castle walls. We neared the big wooden door and pushed it open. Inside, a nice old lady was making food.

"Do you want some stewed carrots?" she asked us.

We were happy to have some company and felt safe.

Today was a very long day at school. In the morning, we had a science meeting about volcanoes. Mr. Jones showed us a video where the lava scorched the ground. It was cool but I also feared it a little bit.

Then it was time for recess and everyone started running outside. The sun was hot but the wind felt pleasant. My friend Sam wanted to race me to the big tree.

"I am much stronger than you today!" Sam yelled loudly.

"No way, I have been coaching myself all week," I said back.

We ran fast but then the bell rang too early. We were all groaning because we did not want to go inside. Math class is boring and I just want to play more. Maybe tomorrow I will win the big race.

My friend Max jumped over the big log. We were exploring the spooky woods behind my house. It was getting dark and we felt scared. Suddenly, we heard a loud moaning sound.

"What was that?" I asked Max with a shaky voice.

"Maybe a monster escaped from the zoo!" Max whispered back.

We moved slowly toward the old shed. A pink tongue licked my hand and I screamed! I grabbed Max’s arm tight. It was just a lost puppy. He sat there looking sad. Although we were frightened before, now we were thrilled. We gradually walked him home. My mom said it was important to help animals. We crashed on the couch after our big adventure.

My nephew Ben loves science and robots. One day he built a robot dog named Sparky. We went to the park to test him out. The scenery was nice and green.

Suddenly, Sparky grew very big and started flying! I struggled to hold his leash but he was too strong.

"What is the meaning of this?" I yelled at Ben.

Ben looked thrilled and shouted back, "He has superpowers now!"

Unfortunately, Sparky flew too high and we lost him. We looked everywhere but we didn't understand where he went. I was sad but Ben was reading a book about aliens. He thinks Sparky went to a meeting on Mars. I hope he comes back soon.

I didn’t want to go to school today. I had to write a big story for English class. My hand was trembling a little bit when I walked in. Mrs. Baker appeared at the door and smiled at us. She told us to sit down on the rug.

"Who wants to share their story first?" she asked.

My stomach felt weird and twisted like a pretzel. I was so hungry for lunch already. Then Tommy raised his hand high in the air.

"I know my story is the best!" Tommy shouted.

He read a story about a superhero stronger than the earth. It was funny and everyone laughed throughout the whole thing. I felt better then. Maybe my story wasn't so bad after all.

Yesterday my brother Tom and I went exploring. We ate a big breakfast and walked to the woods. I saw a cave and it looked scary.

"We should go inside," I told Tom.

"I don't want to go in there," he grumbled.

We walked in and the ground was very muddy. It was dark but we had flashlights. Suddenly thirteen bats flew right at our heads! We ran fast but Tom had to sneeze. He let out a giant sneeze and the bats flew away. We found a beautiful shiny rock in the back.

"Hold the light steady," I said.

We took the rock home and showed Mom. It was the best adventure ever.

Max and I walked deep into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost golden key. Suddenly we heard singing coming from a cave. It was a goblin guarding a big metal box!

I thought the box might contain the key. The goblin saw us and his face turned red with anger. He ran at us very fast.

"Run away!" shouted Max loudly.

But I was brave and I grabbed a long stick. I poked the goblin and he fell over a rock. The box fell open and the key fell out. I obtained the key quickly and we ran home. We were so happy that nothing bad happened to us.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the weird forest. It was dark and we heard a scary noise. We walked through the big trees and saw a cave. 

"I think a monster lives there," Sam whispered quietly.

"Neither of us is scared," I said back bravely.

We went inside and saw green slime spread everywhere. Suddenly a bat flew out and I started swearing because I was surprised. Sam laughed but then he fell down hard. His knee was bleeding a lot.

We reached the end of the cave and found a shiny rock. Although we wanted it, we had to leave immediately. We ran fast to my mom's car. We didn't go to the hospital, just home for band-aids. It was the best adventure ever.

One day I was camping in my backyard. It was raining really hard so I went into the tent. Suddenly a tiny green alien walked in carefully. He looked like a shiny beetle with big eyes. I was feared at first but he smiled.

"Do not be scared," said the alien with a squeaky voice.

"Okay, do you want a marshmallow?" I asked him.

He ate it and started glowing bright purple. He said he was learning about Earth food. He told me boating on the lake was important for his mission. I had a feeling he needed help finding his spaceship. We walked to the water fountain in the garden. He jumped in and turned into a robot! Now I am coaching him on how to be a human boy.

My robot Zog crashed his spaceship right into the playground. Everyone looked up at the big silver circle. Zog scrambled out of the ship and he was sounding very beep-boop happy.

"I am here for the swings!" said Zog loudly.

Unfortunately, Zog is thirteen feet tall and made of heavy metal. He started to sit on the little red swing but it snapped. The chain broke and Zog fell down with a boom. He was clinging to the broken chain and feeling sad.

"You are in big trouble," I told him.

But then Zog used his laser eyes to fix the chain. I was so thrilled. We swung together for a little bit longer. Everyone was waiting for a turn on the robot swing.

Me and my best friend Sam climbed the big mountain. It was so tall and the wind was freezing. We wanted to find the magic gold fountain at the top. Suddenly a big red dragon flew down and roared.

"Run away fast!" screamed Sam.

The dragon breathed fire and it scorched a rock. We ran behind a big tree and hid. The dragon neared us and looked around with yellow eyes. I was scared but then I saw a shiny sword. I grabbed it and jumped out.

"Go away dragon!" I yelled.

The dragon got scared seeing the sword and flew away. We kept climbing and finally found the fountain. It was shiny and magical. We drank some water and it tasted like candy. I was so happy we didn't get eaten.

My friend Sam and I found a secret map. It was hidden behind my old computer in the basement. The map showed a big red X near the spooky forest. We walked there fast because we were yearning for adventure.

Suddenly a big storm brewed and the wind blew hard. We feared the loud thunder but we kept walking. We found a cave and saw a shiny gold cup inside.

"Look at that champion cup!" Sam yelled.

A giant bear was trapped near the cup. We used all our strength to move the heavy rocks. The bear ran away and we grabbed the cup. It was a pleasure earning a treasure like this. I wrote about it in my diary later.

My robot named Zork had a big metal brain. He flew around my room swinging his shiny arms. One day Zork started running very fast in circles. It was impossible to stop him!

"Zork, stop acting crazy right now!" I yelled loud.

He did not listen and he ate my computer. Then he disappeared into a green hole in the wall. I jumped in after him and saw a foreign planet. There was a king alien trying to reign over everyone. He had Zork tied up with a heavy chain.

"Let my robot go or else!" I shouted bravely.

The alien was yearning for lunch so he looked sad. I gave him some stewed carrots from my pocket. He liked them for some reason and let Zork go. We went home happy.

I live in a tall apartment with my robot dog named Sparky. Sparky flew around the room and bumped into the wall. My dad was reading the newspaper and he grumbled loudly at Sparky. Suddenly a green ghost came right through the floor! The ghost was made of sticky green thread and it looked scary.

"Stop leaving slime on the rug!" I yelled at the ghost.

"I don't know where else to go," the ghost said sadly.

Unfortunately, Sparky started barking and swearing in robot beeps at the ghost. The ghost got scared and started growing bigger and bigger. My dad dropped his paper and we all ran away fast. We are not going back there ever again.

My dog Rex is super fast and he has a really long tongue. Last week Rex got sick with something called pneumonia and had to rest. It took a long time but now he is better. Yesterday we went straight to the park for his training.

"Sit down Rex!" I yelled and he listened good.

My dad said, "Wow, he is really trained well."

Rex started thumping his tail on the grass. He wanted to run so I let go of his bungee leash. He ran simply everywhere and spread dirt all over my shoes. He thinks he is the king and wants to reign over the park. Later we gave him food with lots of protein so he can get even stronger. I love Rex so much.

My brother and I were playing a new video game. It was a racing game with lots of fast cars. I chose the red car and he picked blue. We pushed the buttons really hard to go faster.

"I am going to win this time!" I screamed loudly.
