My dad was sleeping on the couch but he woke up. He started coaching us from the back of the room. He told me to squeeze the controller tight. I meant to turn left but I hit the wall. My brother zoomed past me and obtained the first place trophy.

"To be honest, you got totally roasted," said my brother.

I was hanging my head down because I lost every single race. I did not complain though. We played again and I finally won one race!

One day I was exploring in the woods behind my house. I saw a huge spider web built between two big trees. It had eight sides and looked very sticky. I saw a bug floating in the air right near it.

"Watch out, little bug!" I called out loud.

But the bug flew right into the sticky thread. The spider came down fast because it wanted some protein for lunch. I felt bad for the bug, but that is just what happened.

"Nature is scary sometimes," I said to my dog.

We kept walking and found a big truck loading dirt nearby. That was the reason it was so noisy outside. We watched the truck for a while and then we went home for a snack.

It was my birthday party and I was so hungry. My friends came over and we were loading pizza onto our plates. We played a game where I was the captain of a pirate ship. I searched for treasure but it was hard to find.

"Look at that sign by the tree!" shouted my friend Tim.

I ran over and saw a red X on the grass. We followed the arrows for an hour. It felt a little bit dangerous but we kept going.

"I am certain the treasure is here," I said.

My mom wrote a clue on a piece of paper. We used scissors to open the box. It was full of candy! Then the doorbell started ringing and more friends came inside. It was the best day ever.

My friend Tim and I were playing Minecraft all day. We were building a huge castle on a floating island. It was awesome but then a zombie crawled out. My hands were trembling on the controller.

"Watch out for the zombie!" I yelled at the TV.

Tim just laughed and drew his diamond sword out. He hit the zombie and it disappeared off the edge. We jumped down to the earth below for safety. But then my mom called us for dinner. She made beef stewed with carrots, which smelled gross.

"I’m groaning because I hate stew," Tim whispered to me.

I counted five big chunks of meat in my bowl. After dinner, we pretended the floor was lava. We were safe until Tim fell off the couch. He said he needed a hospital but he was just faking.

I was playing my favorite video game with my brother. It was the last level and the scene was scary. I had to guide my character over a big hole. There was a huge rock floating in the air too.

"You are going to lose," my brother grumbled at me.

"No I won't, just watch this," I said back.

My hands felt heavy like a big weight. I had to squeeze the controller really hard to jump. Suddenly I felt a giant sneeze coming. I tried to stop it but I couldn't. I sneezed so loud and dropped the controller on the ground! My character fell into the hole.

"Oh man!" I yelled, groaning loudly.

I didn't clear the level or learn the secret code either. Next time I will win.

My younger brother Sam and I went outside to play. We crossed the big green field behind our house. The wind blew hard and messed up our hair. We saw a single red bird in a tall tree. It sang a really loud and happy song.

"Look at that bird!" Sam shouted at me.
"I wish I could fly to that height," I said.

Then my neighbor threw a blue ball over the fence. It landed right on some flowers and crushed them flat. Our dog Buster ran fast and led us to the ball. We picked it up and threw it back over. It was a fun day until it started to rain.

We went into the deep jungle to find the gold. The sun was hot and we walked through tall green grass. Suddenly, Max froze and pointed at a big snake.

"Don't move or it will bite you immediately," I whispered.

Max grasped my arm tightly and he almost fainted. The snake hissed loudly and bounced away into the bushes. We started walking again but heard a scary groaning noise. It was a monkey leaving a trap made of thread. We cut the thread and sent the monkey home. We had to maintain our path, especially now.

"I think the gold is near that big rock," said Max.

We ran fast and found a shiny box. We were happy.

I had a really hard math test today. I sat at my desk and my hands were trembling. The pencil felt like a heavy weight in my hand. I looked at the paper and I struggled with the big numbers.

"This is impossible," I grumbled to myself quietly.

My friend Sarah looked over and smiled at me. She whispered, "Just pretend you are a brave knight."

That made me laugh a little bit inside. I took a deep breath and gradually started writing. Unfortunately, the last question was super hard. It was about how much an elephant weighs. I tried to be honest and did my best work. When the bell rang for recess, I ran outside fast. I hope I got a good grade.

We woke up really early for the big soccer tournament. I was still sleeping when my mom grabbed my arm. She said, "Wake up or we will be late!" I walked to the car and ate my toast. We drove past a big green meadow with cows. The game was super important because we wanted a trophy.

The other team had fourteen players and they looked big. Their goalie disappeared behind the goal post to hide. I got the ball and ran fast down the field. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. I kicked the ball and the goalie missed it!

"Yes! That was a great goal!" my dad screamed loudly.

We won the game and the coach grinned at us. We already felt like champions. I cannot wait to maintain our winning streak next week.

Yesterday at school was crazy. We had science class and it was very important. My teacher Mrs. Green brought in a big white feather.

"Look at how it keeps floating," she said to us.

Then Billy started jumping up and down. He hit the table and the feather flew away. It spread out and disappeared under the desk.

"I don't understand where it went!" Billy yelled loudly.

Suddenly the bell started ringing for recess. We all ran outside. My friend told me about camping with his nephew. He said they saw a bear but I think he was lying. I was moaning because I had so much homework. School is fun but bearing all that work is hard.

My friends and I went exploring in the old house. We crawled under the fence and ran to the back. There was a big broken balcony up high.

"Do not go up there!" yelled my friend Sam. 

"I have to for science class," I said back.

We heard a loud thumping noise inside the house. It had a scary rhythm like a giant heart. We immediately ran to the basement door. It was dark and wet but we went in. I discovered a weird blue monster sleeping there. It snored loudly and almost crushed a box. We got scared and swam across a muddy puddle to leave.

"Our quest is complete," Sam whispered to me.

We sat on the grass outside and breathed hard. I don't know about monster psychology, but that was scary!

My friend Tom and I found a huge map. It looked like an old sailor map with burnt edges. We wanted to find the secret castle in the woods. We walked for an hour and ate some chips. 

Suddenly we saw a dark cave behind a big bush. Tom said, "This looks impossible to climb!" 

I said, "We can do it if we are brave."

Inside the cave was an incredible painting on the wall. It showed a king holding a bright blue rock. We used my science kit to look closer at it. The painting was actually a secret guide to the treasure! We felt very happy to complete our big quest. Then we ran home before it got too dark outside.

I was walking in the woods with my dog Max. He likes roaming around and sniffing big trees. We saw something weird near the creek. Someone was dumping trash there and it looked bad.

"Look at that mess, Max!" I said loudly.

Garbage was scattered all over the grass and dirt. An old plastic bag was floating in the water. We cleared some of the trash away. Suddenly, a blue bird screeched from a high branch. It sounded like it was warning us about danger.

Then we saw a tiny squirrel hiding under a log. It looked younger than the other squirrels. It simply wanted to be safe. The squirrel disappeared into a hole and we finished cleaning.

"Good job, boy," I told Max and patted his head. The woods looked much better now.

My robot named Bob loves science class. On Wednesday, he blew up a big beaker by mistake. Green slime went everywhere and hit the ceiling.

"Bob, you made a huge mess!" I yelled.

Bob beeped and threw his metal hands in the air. He tried to explain but only smoke came out. My teacher Mrs. Miller almost fainted when she saw it. Bob was clinging to the desk because he was scared.

"I will reign over this school with slime!" Bob joked.

Then he blew a loud whistle and cleaned it up. I like having a robot best friend, but he is messy.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old barn. We were exploring for treasure. The barn was plain and dusty but very big. Sam found a weird machine in the corner.

"Look at this crazy design," Sam said loudly.

I started pumping the handle up and down. Suddenly a loud whistle blew! The floor started shaking like there was no gravity. We held on tight.

"Stop loading it with air!" I yelled at Sam.

But he didn't stop. A secret door spread open on the floor. We looked straight down into a dark hole. It was the greatest thing ever. We climbed down for company. We didn't find gold but we found old tools for cleaning. It was still a super cool adventure.

I was waiting for recess all morning because we had math. Mrs. Higgins was talking about gravity but I just looked outside. It was a beautiful day and the sun was super bright. Finally the bell rang and we all ran to the playground.

"I bet I can jump higher than you!" shouted Mike.

"No way, I have special training from my big brother," I said.

We ran to the monkey bars and I grasped the cold metal. I started swinging my legs back and forth really fast. It felt wonderful to be moving and not sitting in a chair. I felt like a colonel leading an army of jumpers. I am certain that recess is the best part of school. Next we have science and maybe we will learn about psychology or brains. I hope we get pizza for lunch first though because I am hungry.

My neighbor Billy told me about a monster in the woods. We packed our bags with snacks and protein bars. We walked for a long time and saw a cave. Suddenly we heard a loud roar from inside the dark hole. Billy was scared but I grabbed a big rock.

"Look out!" yelled Billy as a bear came out.

The bear was huge and bearing big sharp teeth. I threw the rock but I missed the bear. Then I quickly drew a picture of a scary lion in the dirt. The bear looked confused and ran away fast though. We were so grateful and safe. My mom gave me a grounding for leaving but it was worth it.

"We are heroes now," I said to Billy.

My nephew Tim and I walked into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost cave of gold. The path led us deep into the trees. It grew very dark and we got a little scared. Suddenly, a big guard jumped out from behind a rock!

"Stop right there!" he yelled loudly at us.

Tim gripped my arm because he was very frightened. The guard was speaking in a mean, scary voice. He had a shiny knife on his belt.

"We are just hungry explorers," I said to him.

To be honest, I thought we were caught. My heart sank down to my toes. But then the guard smiled a pleasant smile.

"Be careful of gravity near the cliffs," he said.

We ran away fast, especially when we saw the hospital sign. We didn't find gold but we were safe.

My brother and I love playing our new computer game. We trained every single day after school for the big meeting. It is a racing game with super fast cars. I gripped the controller tight and my hands were sweaty.

"You can’t beat me this time!" yelled my brother.

"Just watch me go fast!" I shouted back.

The race started and I found a good rhythm. My car flew over the ground and didn't crash once. My brother struggled on the sharp turn and hit a wall. I had a happy feeling in my tummy. I counted the laps as I drove by. One, two, three laps were complete! I had enough speed to cross the finish line first. Bringing home the win felt awesome.

Yesterday at recess me and my friend Sam played a fun game. We were knights and the jungle gym was our big castle. Sam started climbing up the ladder really fast.

"I am approaching the tower!" Sam yelled down to me.

I was pumping my legs on the swings like I was boating. Then I jumped off and ran to the slide. We moved around the playground and pretended to fight dragons. Suddenly the teacher blew her loud whistle.

"Recess is over, please line up!" she said.

I was so hungry because I didn't eat breakfast. Lunch was next and I hoped it wasn't stewed tomatoes again. I simply wanted pizza. I found a seat next to my nephew who is in my class. He often shares his cookies with me. It was a good day.

I was yearning for recess all morning because math is hard. My teacher greeted us at the door, and then we did subtraction. I often look out the window at the swings. Finally, the bell rang and we ran outside into the cool breeze.

I saw my friend Sam by the slide. "Do you want to play tag?" I asked him.

"No, I want to see who has the best height jumping," Sam said.

We jumped off the swings, but neither of us went very high. After recess, we had science class with sticky glue and sharp scissors. I am grateful for science because it is messy and fun. I know my mom will be seeing glue on my shirt later.

One day I woke up and the weather was really different. The sky was purple and I saw a giant beetle on my balcony. I grabbed my slingshot and ran outside after breakfast. I called my friend Sam and we walked through the scary woods. We often go there to look for treasure.

Suddenly we heard something sounding like a monster. It was screaming very loud!

"Watch out for that big hole!" yelled Sam.

I almost fell but I grabbed a vine like a bungee cord. A tiny gnat flew into my eye and it hurt. Then we saw the monster but it was just a lost dog.

"Let's take him home," I said.

We were safe and we had a new friend.

I live in a big apartment building with my friend Leo. We were playing a really hard video game about a zombie island. I was coaching Leo on how to jump over the lava.

"Go straight and then jump left!" I yelled at the TV.

Leo grasped the controller tight and his face looked scorched red. He jumped, but his character fell into the fire and got roasted.

"Oh no, I keep dying!" Leo said, groaning loudly.

It felt like a heavy weight on my shoulders. We stood up and tried again. Finally, we beat the level and it felt like winning a science fair. But then my mom called us. She was painting and said it was time to visit grandma at the hospital. We paused the game and ran to the car.

I was scared because I forgot my homework at home. Mrs. Green asked for our math sheets and everyone passed them up. I felt like I was going to sneeze because I was nervous. I looked in my backpack but I only saw my library book. It was a book about knights and a big stone castle.

"Where is your homework, Timmy?" Mrs. Green asked me.

My face got hot and I wanted to hide under my desk. I thought about making up a story about a dog eating it. But my mom says keeping secrets is bad. So I decided to be honest instead.

"I left it on the kitchen table," I said quietly.

Mrs. Green smiled and said, "Bring it tomorrow, okay?"

I was so happy I almost screamed! Then I heard the bell ring for recess. I grabbed my ball and ran outside to play.

My brother Tim was roaming around the living room. He wanted to play the new racing game. I told him I was earning coins for a fast car.

"Let me try!" Tim screeched really loud.

"Okay, but I am coaching you first," I said.

I started teaching him how to drive. He crashed into a science lab in the game. Then he hit a big rock but he cleared the jump. His car was light as a feather. He actually won the race!

"I did it!" Tim yelled.

We played all day until dinner. It was super fun.

One day I went on a big adventure to space. I flew my rocket ship to the planet Zorg. I was on a search for the greatest jewel ever. It was called the Star Stone and it was shiny blue.

Suddenly a big green alien jumped out! He had three eyes and he looked very scary.

"Give me the stone!" the alien yelled at me.

"No way, it belongs in a museum!" I shouted back.

The alien grabbed my arm but I used my superpowers. I have super strength so I held him up easily. His weight was nothing to me. I brought him to his mom and she was mad. I flew home fast, tearing through the sky. My nephew will love this cool jewel especially because it glows.

My neighbor Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We played video games and I was the champion. My reign as the best player lasted for three hours. Then my mom said we had company coming over. My aunt visited us and she brought us pizza.

The next morning we woke up early for breakfast. We ate pancakes and then the sun cleared the clouds. We went outside but Tim’s shoes disappeared. We looked everywhere in my room and under the bed.

"Where did they go?" Tim asked me.

"Maybe my dog took them," I said.

We found them in the backyard and it was funny. It was a very pleasant weekend with my best friend.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old cave. We wanted to find the pirate gold hidden inside. I was steering my bike fast and Sam scrambled behind me.

"Are you scared?" Sam asked me at the meeting spot.

"I am not scared of anything!" I shouted back.

We went inside the dark cave and it was cold. Suddenly a big pile of rocks scattered everywhere. The weight of the rocks almost trapped us! We kept running until we saw a shiny box. It was the treasure! We opened it but it was empty. We didn't find gold either. But we felt like we won because we were brave. Then we went home for lunch.

We went camping in the deep woods last week. My dad was our guide but he got lost. Suddenly we discovered a huge silver ship in the trees. It had glowing green lights and looked very weird.

A blue alien walked out and he had three eyes. He spoke in a foreign tongue and waved his hands. Then suddenly the gravity turned off and we floated up!

"Put me down right now!" my dad screamed loudly.

The alien laughed and pressed a button on his belt. We fell down to the grass with a big thump. The alien gave us a map to get home fast.

"We are so grateful for your help," I said.

He flew away to reign over his own planet. It was the best trip ever.

My robot Zog crashed into the big green tree. He was hanging from a branch by one shiny leg. It looked impossible to get him down. I struggled to climb up but I am too short.

"Help me please!" Zog beeped very loudly.

"I am trying my best, Zog!" I yelled back.

Neither of us knew what to do. Then I remembered my super strength pill. It was full of magic protein. I swallowed it fast and felt strong. I grabbed the tree trunk and shook it hard. Zog fell down and I caught him safe. He was so grateful.

"Mission complete," Zog said and hugged me. We went home to eat pizza.

Me and my friend Sam woke up early today. We went boating on the big lake near my house. The water was growing darker and darker. We saw an island and started roaming around the woods. Suddenly, we found a spooky old cabin with a broken door. Inside there was a box bearing a strange symbol.

"Look at this old paper!" Sam spoke loudly.

It was a faded receipt from a hundred years ago! Then it started raining hard and getting very cold. I was scared of catching pneumonia. We ran back to the boat together. We were so grateful to be safe at home.

My cat Fluffy got lost in our big apartment building. I looked everywhere for her, but the doors were closed. I was scared she was gone forever.

My mom said, "Don't worry, we will find her tomorrow."

But I wanted to find her now. I walked down the hall and saw an open door. Fluffy was inside! She had crashed into a pile of books. She made a huge mess. The books were spread all over the floor.

"Oh no, you are a naughty cat!" I shouted.

She just purred because she liked the company. I sat down and started reading a book to her. My mission to find her was complete. We walked back home together.

My neighbor Tom came over to play video games. We played Racing Cars on my TV. My game discs were scattered all over the floor. We had to search for the right one.

"I will be the king and reign over you!" Tom yelled.

"No way, I practiced all week," I said.

The race started and I went straight down the track. I struggled at the first turn. Tom scratched his nose and laughed at me. But then I obtained a super speed boost! I went so fast.

My mom walked in and she was cleaning. "Stop screaming," she said.

I won the race and sang a happy song. I told Tom he needs to learn how to drive better. Then we sat down and started reading comic books instead.

It was my birthday and I was turning eight. My friends came over for a big sleepover party. We played a video game about a treasure island. The game was loading very slow so we waited.

Suddenly the doorbell started ringing very loud. My mom opened it and my grandma was approaching. She had a huge box in her hands.

"Happy birthday!" she shouted and gave me a hug.

I opened the box and saw a cool toy robot. But something looked wrong with its blue arm. I put my finger on it and it snapped. I looked through the clear plastic and saw a wire. It looked like a tiny blue vein inside the arm.

"Oh no, it is broken," I said sadly.

My dad fixed it with glue and it worked perfectly.

Me and my brother Tom went camping in the woods. We walked for a long time and the earth felt soft. Suddenly a big river appeared in front of us. It looked impossible to cross because the water was fast.

"We have to jump across those rocks," Tom said.

I was scared but I understood we had to go. I listened to the rhythm of the water splashing. I jumped on the first rock and almost slipped. The water swept over my shoes and they got wet. Although I was shaking, I jumped to the next one.

"Grab my hand!" shouted Tom from the other side.

I jumped and he caught me just in time. We were safe and ate our sandwiches. It was the best adventure ever.

The knight held his sword tight and looked at the dark cave. It seemed impossible to go inside because it was so small.

"We have to squeeze in," said the knight to his daughter.

"I am scared of the ghost," the daughter whispered back.

They neared the entrance and heard a loud thumping sound. It was the guard monster sleeping near the treasure. They walked quietly so they would not be discovered. Suddenly, the monster woke up and roared! They ran fast and gravity pulled them down a slide. They were lost in a new room, but they saw gold everywhere. It was the greatest treasure ever. They found a secret door and escaped, earning a big reward for their meeting with the monster.

It was a cold day in February. My friend Sam and I moved quickly through the woods. We were feeling brave. We wanted to find the old king’s lost gold. The trees were swinging in the breeze. Suddenly, I saw a big hole in the ground.

"Look down there!" I screamed.

Sam looked and started jumping up and down. We discovered a secret tunnel. It was dark but we had each other for company. We walked for a long time. Then we saw something shiny. It was a gold vein in the rock!

"We found it!" Sam said simply.

We pretended it was the king’s treasure. We let his daughter reign over the kingdom. We were rich!

We walked through the dark woods to find the hidden island. My brother Sam had a map and looked very serious. We reached the edge of the water and saw a big boat.

"Look at that giant castle on the other side!" I yelled.

Sam nodded and said, "We need to row fast before the storm."

The wind blew hard and struck our faces with rain. It felt like a foreign land because everything looked strange. We finally got to the shore and opened the big heavy doors. Inside it smelled like stewed meat and old socks. We found a kitchen and saw a giant pot of soup.

"I need some protein for my muscles," Sam said hungrily.

We were thrilled because we found the secret treasure chest too. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my best friend Sam sprinted to the old building. It was raining really hard outside. The ground was wet earth and mud. We looked at our secret spy schedule.

"We have to get inside now!" I shouted loudly.

Sam pulled the heavy door open and we ran through. It was dark and looked very dangerous in there. Suddenly a big shadow grabbed my backpack! I screamed but it was just a coat rack. I almost fainted because I was so scared.

"Let's get out of here," Sam whispered to me.

We escaped out the back door fast. We went home and ate toasted cheese sandwiches. We are earning a badge for bravery from my dad. He is coaching us on how to be better spies next time.

I was playing Super Racer in my room. I was wearing my lucky blue socks for speed. My brother Tim wanted to play, but he is bad.

"I will beat you this time!" Tim screamed loudly.

We picked our cars and the race started fast. I drove straight and did not hit any walls. Tim’s car spun around and hit a big rock. His engine smoked and looked like it brewed and stewed. Then his car scorched the ground and crashed hard. I crossed the finish line first like a champion.

"No fair! The sun got in my eyes," Tim said.

Although he lost, he was okay. I had a juice stain on my shirt. I thought I was the fastest racer on earth.

My robot Zog has superpowers but he likes to complain. We were in a green jungle looking for a magic fountain. Zog used his laser finger to cut through the big vines.

"This is impossible," said Zog with a rusty squeak.

"Keep going Zog, I am seeing something wonderful," I said.

We walked throughout the forest and saw a glowing blue light. It was the magic fountain! We had to squeeze between two rocks to get there. I trained Zog to scoop up the water. He drank it and suddenly he turned gold. It was the best day ever.

I was sitting in math class and I felt scared. My backpack did not contain my homework. I looked through my messy desk but it was gone. Then I heard a loud noise outside.

"What was that?" asked my friend Billy.

I looked out the window and saw papers floating everywhere. My homework flew out of my open bag! I ran outside and saw the wind tearing my paper. I tried to seize it but I fell on the grass. Everyone was laughing. I started groaning because I knew this was a big failure.

"Do you know where my paper went?" I yelled.

Then the teacher came over and smiled at me. I thought she would be mad but she helped me up. I did not receive a bad grade that day.

My friends came over for my birthday sleepover yesterday. We were playing tag in the basement and it was dark. Suddenly my cat escaped from the laundry room. He looked super weird because he had socks on his paws. My brother was swearing because the cat scratched him. 

"Stop running!" my mom yelled from the stairs.

We didn't listen and kept running around. Pizza boxes were scattered all over the floor. My friend neared the corner and tripped on a blanket. 

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

He was clinging to the rug but he was fine. Then my dad came down bringing the cake. I realized neither of us had washed our hands. It was the best birthday ever.

My robot friend beeped loudly and ran straight into the wall. He was in big trouble because his leg was stuck. I feared he would break.

"Help me! I am trapped!" the robot shouted.

I tried to pull him out but he was too heavy. I had to learn how to fix him fast. I read his big metal training book. It was hard to read through all the dusty pages. Finally, I understood what to do. I pushed a red button and his leg popped out.

"Thank you for saving me!" he said.

We walked home and we were happy again.

My brother Tom and I love playing racing video games. Dad bought us a new game yesterday and we played it immediately. I chose the red car and Tom picked the blue one.

"I am going to beat you today!" I yelled loudly.

"Neither of us is going to win," Tom laughed back.

The race started and our cars screeched around the first corner. I discovered a secret shortcut through a dark tunnel. I had enough speed to seize the lead from Tom. I feared crashing but I held the controller really tight. Suddenly, Mom walked in and stood right in front of the TV.

"Stop playing now or you are getting a grounding!" she said.

We had to pause the game and go search for our homework. I was sad because I almost won the big race. Next time I will read the rules first.

I was playing my new video game on Saturday. The game was loading super slowly and I was groaning. My friend Sam came over for company and to play too.

"This is taking forever to start!" I yelled loudly.

Sam laughed and said, "Just wait, it will work soon."

Finally, the start screen appeared and my heart was pumping fast. We played the racing level and it felt like heaven. I neared the finish line but then Sam stole the lead. He won the race and I thought I would cry. But then my mom brought us roasted chicken for lunch. I was so grateful for the food. It was a pleasure to eat it. After that, I was almost sleeping because I was so full. We didn't even care who won anymore.

It was a cold day in February. My soccer league had a big game against the Lions. They looked like a huge mountain. I felt small like a lamb. We played for an hour and no one scored. My legs were tired but I felt stronger.

Suddenly the ball came to me. I kicked it hard and spread my arms out.

"Run fast!" my coach screamed at me.

I ran past the goalie and crushed the ball into the net. The Lions were mad and full of anger. My team was screaming so loud though.

"We won the game!" I yelled.

It was the best day ever.

For my birthday my dad took me and Sam boating. We pretended to be a brave sailor crew on the lake. My dad brewed some hot cocoa for us to drink. 

"Look at that big rock!" yelled Sam loudly. 

"That is where the king used to reign!" I shouted back.

We remembered to bring marshmallows and we toasted them. But then Sam dropped his stick in the water. It floated away throughout the waves. We pretended the marshmallow was a lost jewel. My dad said the cooler did not contain any more snacks. We were sad but then we drove the boat home. I am going to write a story about our fun trip. I hope I don't get a grounding for muddy shoes.

Yesterday I was reading a book about birds in my backyard. I wanted to find a blue jay feather for my collection. I walked into the woods and looked on the ground. Suddenly I heard a loud noise and something screeched at me!

It was a squirrel and his tail was twisted in a bush. He looked stuck and scared. I knew it might be dangerous to touch him. I called my big brother for help.

"Use your strength to pull the branch," I said to him.

He pulled hard and the squirrel jumped out fast. We discovered a blue feather right where the squirrel was stuck! It had a little dirt stain on it. I picked it up and felt its light weight. I was happy because I helped the squirrel and found my feather.

I was so thrilled about recess today because I had a plan. My teacher Mrs. Lee was sounding very loud about math, but I did not listen. I just grasped my secret map under my desk. When the bell rang, we all crawled to the door and then ran outside. The sun scorched the playground, but I didn't care.

"Come on!" I yelled to my friend Sam. "We have to find the treasure!"

We ran to the big meadow behind the swings. Sam pretended he was a brave knight with a sword. We drove our imaginary horses very fast. Then we greeted a big rock near the fence.

"Is it here?" Sam asked me.

"Yes," I said. "We can dig together."

We used old scissors to dig in the dirt. We found a beautiful blue marble. It was the best day ever.

It was Saturday and I was waiting to play my favorite game. My mom made a schedule for screen time and I had to wait.

"This takes forever!" I grumbled to my dog.

Finally, I heard the timer go ding and I ran to the computer. I turned it on and logged into the big island level. I had to beat the boss. My heart was thumping super hard.

Suddenly, a scary ghost popped out of the bushes! It tried to scare me, but I was too fast. I used my super jump and landed on its head.

"Yes! I did it!" I shouted really loud.

My brother came in and he just grinned at me. I could not contain my excitement because I won the level.

It was my birthday party and I invited my best friend Leo. We were playing outside when we heard something loud. Leo started screaming because he saw a big dog near the cake. The dog wanted to gnaw on the table leg. My mom ran out and called the dog a bad boy. She discovered that the dog stole a piece of pizza! My heart was beating super fast.

"Hey, give that back!" I shouted at the dog.

"He ate it all!" Leo said.

My mom turned around and brought us ice cream instead. She said the dog had too much energy like he had caffeine. Then we watched the dog try to climb the fence. It was funny seeing him jump. We decided to seize the moment and play tag. It was the best birthday ever.

My dog Buster loves to go to the park. One day we went to the big pond. Buster saw a duck and he ran very fast. The duck flew away to a tiny island in the water. Buster jumped in and started to swim.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and he kept swimming. He neared the island and tried to climb up. The mud was slippery so he slid down. It was a big failure. He chewed on a stick and looked sad. Then I heard a splash. Buster swam back to me all wet.

"You are a silly dog," I said to him.

He shook his fur and got water on me. I did not complain because I love him. We knew it was time to go home for lunch.

Yesterday at recess me and Sammy played a spy game. We had to search for secret treasure near the slide. I felt very strong like a superhero with super strength. Sammy is younger than me but he runs super fast.

"Watch out for the bad guys!" I yelled loudly.

"I trained for this my whole life," Sammy said back.

We started climbing up the big jungle gym very carefully. Then the bell rang and that was wrong because it was too early. Mrs. Miller blew her whistle and sang a funny song to line up.

I was sad because we never found the treasure. I was so tired that night I slept for ten hours. I often dream about being a spy again. Next time I won’t let the bell stop us.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the twisted forest. We believed there was pirate treasure hidden deep inside. We walked for a long time and my legs were groaning. Suddenly, a huge rock crashed down right in front of us!

"That was impossible!" Sam yelled. "We almost got squished!"

"I think it’s a trap," I said to him.

We jumped over the rock and saw a dark cave. My heart started thumping really fast. Inside the cave, we saw eight glowing eyes staring at us. It was a giant spider! I used my ninja training and threw a stick. The spider ran away. We saw a gold box and tried to seize it. It was heavy but we treated it like a trophy. We were heroes!

I got up early because the sun was seeing me through my window. I ran outside to my treehouse that my dad built. It is high off the ground. I felt a nice breeze up there. Suddenly I heard a weird noise. It sounded foreign, like an alien language. I looked down and saw my dog, Buster.

"Come here, Buster!" I called.

He didn't understand gravity because he tried to fly up. He jumped really high but fell back down. Neither of us knew what to do. I decided to whistle very loud.

"Is that you making that noise?" my mom yelled from the porch.

I realized it was just my imagination. Buster ran to the door to knock with his paw. We went inside for breakfast.

Yesterday was the worst day on earth. I had so much math homework to do. My teacher Mr. Brown gave us twenty hard problems. I gripped my pencil tight and tried my best. My dog Buster sat with me for company. He is a good dog even though he barks a lot.

"I will never finish this!" I grumbled loudly.

My mom came in and looked at my paper. "You can do it if you really try," she said.

I thought about the answers for a long time. Finally I finished every single problem. The next day I got a gold star. I felt like a champion. Then we went to recess and played tag. We had to search for the ball in the bushes. It was a good day after all.

Yesterday at recess I climbed to the top of the big slide. I reached up and pretended to touch the sky. My friend Tommy yelled, "Look out below!" and he went down fast. We played kings and queens and I had a long reign over the playground.

But then the bell rang and we went inside again. Mrs. Miller gave us math homework for tomorrow. My brain felt tired from all the numbers. I looked at the ceiling and used my imagination. I saw dragons tearing up my paper.

"Are you earning your stars today?" Mrs. Miller asked me nicely.

I stopped daydreaming and finished my work. I like school but I like recess way better.

I had a super important test today at school. My stomach felt weird like a storm brewed inside. I grasped my pencil tight and tried to think. The clock moved gradually for almost an hour. Finally the bell rang for recess and everyone ran out screaming.

We went to the playground and played kickball. The red ball bounced high over the fence. Then we saw a stray dog gnaw on it!

"Hey, that's our ball!" shouted Timmy.

The dog looked at us and then ran away. It scattered dirt everywhere. We laughed and went inside for art class. We started dumping glitter on paper to make cards. My teacher put newspaper down so we didn't make a mess. It was the best day ever.

I was playing hide and seek with my brother Sam. It was impossible to find him because he is very small. I was roaming around the backyard looking for his red shoes. Then I heard a noise near the old tree. I saw something moving on the ground near the roots. I ran over there and I grabbed his arm fast.

"You got me!" Sam yelled and scrambled away from me.

"I win this time!" I shouted back and did a dance.

We went inside because Mom was making grilled cheese. The bread was perfectly toasted and it smelled so good. Sam was stamping his feet because he wanted to hide again. We played rock paper scissors to see who hides next. I won again so I ran to hide.

It was raining outside, but I still wanted to explore. My little nephew Ben gripped my hand tightly. We went out on the balcony instead of the yard.

"Look at that squirrel!" Ben yelled, sounding very loud.

The squirrel was jumping from the big oak tree. It landed on the railing and grinned at us. I knew it was hungry. I hung a bird feeder there yesterday, though. The squirrel looked plain brown and very wet.

"He wants the seeds," I said. "He is leaving now."

The squirrel ran left and jumped away fast. We watched him go. There was no anger, just fun. We went inside and had hot cocoa.

One day I was exploring the woods behind my house. I was looking for a cool creature. Suddenly I saw a big black beetle on a rock. It looked impossible to catch but I tried anyway. I was jumping around and singing a song to myself. Then I saw a sign near the big tree. It said No Dumping but someone left a box there. I looked inside the plain brown box.

"Hello there!" I screamed because something moved inside.

It was a tiny kitten with white paws. I picked it up and started walking home. It was hard steering through the bushes with a cat. I felt like a failure because I lost the beetle.

"Don't worry, you are safe now," I told the kitten.

I think the kitten is better than a bug anyway.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark woods. We wanted to find the lost treasure map. It was getting dark and shadows grew very big. Suddenly, we heard something bumping into a tree.

"Did you hear that noise?" I asked Sam.

Sam looked scared and said, "Yes, maybe it is a monster!"

A big owl appeared and flew right over our heads. We started running very fast. We found a cave and hung onto a rock. It looked impossible to climb up. But we did it anyway! Inside the cave was a gold box. Our quest was finally complete. We grabbed it and ran home. We will open it tomorrow.

We were exploring the old spooky house on the hill. My friend Sam was wearing his lucky hat. We walked into a big dark room. The ceiling was very high and had cobwebs.

Suddenly something screeched loudly in the corner!

"What was that?" I asked Sam.

Sam drew his toy sword. "I think a monster is waiting for us."

We saw a painting on the wall tearing into pieces. A cat jumped out and scratched the floor. It wasn't a monster at all! We laughed because we were scared for no reason. Sam pretended he was a champion knight. We brewed some imaginary potions in the kitchen.

"Our quest is complete," said Sam.

We ran home before it got too dark outside. The scary house wasn't actually scary. It was just an old cat's house.

One sunny day, my dog Max was sleeping in the meadow. He loves napping, but suddenly a rabbit appeared near a bush. Max woke up fast because he felt very hungry. He sprinted after the rabbit, but he was not faster. The rabbit hopped away, and Max dropped his head down sadly.

Then I heard a funny noise coming from the tall grass. It sounded like a guitar playing a strange rhythm. I walked over and saw a tiny bird trapped in a net.

"Help me!" the bird chirped loudly.

"I will get you out," I said to the bird.

I used my stronger muscles to pull the net open. The bird flew out and let out a big sneeze. I think that was his meaning for thank you. We walked home happy.

My birthday party was super fun and really cool. I turned nine, but I felt like I was fourteen! We had a knight theme because I love swords. My mom spent all morning cleaning the house for my friends.

My best friend Sam reached into his bag and smiled. He drew a picture for me as a present.

"Look, I made you fighting a dragon!" Sam said.

"That is the best drawing on earth," I told him.

Then my dad appeared with a huge chocolate cake. It wasn't plain at all. It had a little plastic dragon flying through the air. We ate cake and then did sword training in the yard. Time flew so fast. I was sad seeing everyone leave early, but it was the best day ever.

My robot named Zork loved jumping on the bed. He was not a steady jumper because his legs were rusty. One day he wanted to try bungee jumping off my roof. I told him it was a bad idea for science.

"I am the champion of jumping!" Zork beeped loudly.

"You will get scrambled like an egg," I said.

He did not listen and his oil was pumping fast. He jumped and his metal cord snapped. He fell but a space knight caught him. The knight was a sailor from Mars waiting for his ship. He cleared his throat and his breathing sounded weird.

"You must learn to be careful, robot," the knight said.

Zork was happy he didn't break. Then the knight’s daughter flew down and fixed Zork's leg with magic.

My friends and I went into the big green jungle. We were looking for a lost treasure chest. It was the beginning of a scary adventure. Suddenly, the ground started trembling and shaking hard. A loud groaning noise came from a dark cave.

"We should run away now!" yelled my friend Sam.

I was freezing with fear but I wanted the gold. We sprinted fast away from the scary cave monster. We found a safe spot and made a fire. We roasted marshmallows and ate them all up. My ears were still ringing from the monster noise. We are keeping the map safe in my pocket. Maybe we will go back tomorrow to find it.

It was the big day for our soccer league. We were playing the Tigers and they are super good. I put on my lucky jersey and felt the cool breeze. My dad was steering the car, and I was nervous.

"Don't worry, you can do it," said Dad.

"I feel like a heavy weight is on me," I said.

We got to the field and the other team was approaching. Their captain looked mean. Although they were big, I ran really fast. I kicked the ball hard and it went right past the goalie! It was like finding a rare jewel. The crowd cheered loudly. My dad said maybe I’ll get my picture in the newspaper. I didn't care about that or the trophy either. I just stopped moaning about losing and was happy we won the game!

My robot Zog was acting super weird today. He kept making a groaning sound like an old car. I opened his belly to check his computer brain. Zog grinned at me and his eyes turned red.

"My science project is a big failure," I said sadly.

Zog started shaking and looked very scared. Suddenly he let out a huge sneeze! Smoke cleared from his head and green slime went everywhere.

"I remember now!" Zog yelled happily. "I was dumping trash!"

Unfortunately, he was keeping the trash inside his head. I laughed because earning an A in science is hard. Now my robot is just a smelly trash can.

My brother and I played a soccer game on the TV. He is older and has way more height than me. I picked the team from a foreign country because they had cool shirts. The game started and I was already losing badly.

"You can't beat me!" he screamed loudly at me.

I kept bumping into his players and stealing the ball. Suddenly I ran down the field very fast. I kicked the ball simply into the corner of the net.

"Goal!" I screamed and started jumping on the couch.

He was groaning and holding his head in his hands. He was screaming that the controller was broken. It was the best game ever because I finally won.

It was last Wednesday when the green alien landed. He walked straight through my backyard fence and crushed my mom's flowers. I ran outside and saw him standing there. He had three eyes and was very slimy.

"Why did you break the fence?" I yelled at him.

The alien looked sad and he made a beep sound. "I am sorry but my ship is broken," he said.

I thought he was going to attack me but he didn't. He tried to explain about his planet but it was confusing. I helped him fix his ship by earning his trust. I gave him a hammer and he started swearing in alien language when he hit his thumb. Then he flew away into the sky.

I bought a robot dog early in the morning. It looked like a normal toy, but I knew it was special. My robot dog was jumping around my room. It was making funny beeping sounds like it was singing. Suddenly, a green alien appeared in my window!

"Give me the dog!" the alien yelled loudly.

"No way, he is mine!" I shouted back.

The alien started stamping his feet. He pulled out a shiny silver needle. He wanted to poke my robot! I pressed a red button on the dog's collar. My dog turned invisible and ran away. Keeping him safe was very important. Then I heard a knock at the door. It was my mom telling me to write my homework. The alien was gone.

Me and my best friend Tom went to the woods. We heard a moaning sound near the old cave. It was scary but we were thrilled to explore. Tom loves science and he brought his flashlight. 

We walked inside the dark cave very slowly. Suddenly something big jumped out and screamed! We started tearing down the path fast.

"Run faster, Tom!" I yelled loudly. 

"I don't understand what that was!" Tom shouted back.

We got home safe and my mom brewed some tea. We stewed about the monster for a long time. It was especially scary because it had red eyes. Next time I need coaching on how to be brave.

Yesterday we had gym class outside on the big field. Mr. Jones said we had to run around the track. I was scared because I am not very fast.

"You need strength to finish the race!" shouted Mr. Jones.

My friend Sam ran next to me as a guide. We ran gradually faster and my feet hit the ground hard. Suddenly I tripped over some scattered rocks and fell down. My knee hurt but I got up fast enough. We crossed the finish line together and I felt happy.

"Did you see the height of that jump?" asked Sam.

I didn't jump but I felt like a superhero anyway. Then the bell rang and it was time for lunch. I was so hungry I could eat a foreign food like snails!

I was roaming in the forest and I saw a robot. The robot was shiny and it had thirteen arms. It froze when I neared it because it was scared.

"Hello robot," I greeted him nicely.

"Do not hurt me please," said the robot.

He told me he obtained a magic rock early this morning. The rock gradually turned pink and then it rose into the air. Suddenly the robot let out a giant sneeze.

"Oh no, now my nose will complain," he said sadly.

I helped him fix his nose and we became best friends. We played all day until the sun went down.

My friends and I started a big kickball game at recess. I was the captain, but unfortunately my team was losing bad.

"We need to win this!" I shouted to my team.

The score was five to zero and the bell was coming. My friend Ben scrambled to the plate and grasped the red ball. He kicked it so hard it went past the weird tree.

"Run fast, Ben!" everyone yelled as he zoomed around the bases.

He cleared all the bases and our spirits rose up high. The sun lit up the field like a science experiment gone right. We didn't win, but we used our imagination and felt like champions. Next time, I am bearing the winning trophy for sure.

I walked into the dark forest with my nephew Sam. He wanted to be a brave knight today. We heard a loud moaning sound approaching us. It sounded scary and I thought it was a monster.

"Stay back, Sam!" I yelled loudly.

"I am not scared!" Sam yelled back.

We waited for an hour but nothing happened. Then a big dog came out of the bushes. It wasn't a monster either. Sam threw a stick and the dog chased it. We laughed because it was just a lost dog. It felt like a science experiment gone wrong but it was okay. We took the dog home and everyone was happy.

I was steering my bike to school and I saw a beetle. It was big and black and I put it in my pocket. At recess, I showed my friend Sam the beetle. "Look at this huge bug I discovered!" I shouted. Sam screamed and jumped back because he hates bugs. We ran to the water fountain to wash his hands. The beetle was trembling in my hand so I put it on a leaf.

Then the bell rang for lunch and we were hungry. My mom packed me a sandwich with roasted turkey. Sam was loading chips into his mouth. "I wish I had some company," said the beetle, probably. We played tag and I was stamping my feet hard. I feel like I trained for a race all day. School is fun but I am tired now.

I was wearing my lucky blue shirt for the big game. My hands gripped the controller really tight because I was nervous. The screen was loading slowly and my brother was singing loudly.

"Stop that singing or I will lose!" I grumbled at him.

He just laughed and threw a pillow at my head. The game finally started and neither of us blinked. I heard the computer making weird noises but I didn't care. My thumbs were stamping on the buttons so fast. Suddenly my character got hit by a stinging zap.

"Oh no, I don't think I can win!" I yelled.

But then I brewed a magic potion and drank it. I ran past the finish line and saw the victory sign. Either I got really lucky or I am just the best player ever.

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother Sam. He always wins but today I wanted to beat him. We picked the island track because it has cool jumps. I was steering my car really carefully around the corners. Suddenly Sam threw a red shell and it struck me!

"That's not fair!" I yelled at the TV screen.

Sam just laughed and said, "You have to drive faster!"

I squeezed the controller hard and pushed the gas button. I got a star power-up and my car scorched the road. I zoomed past him right at the finish line. The whistle blew on the game and I won! Sam was screaming because he was mad but I was happy. I finally crushed him in the race and now I am the champion.

On Wednesday me and my best friend Sam went exploring. We walked deep into the woods behind my house. We were looking for a secret hidden treasure chest. I was swinging a big stick at the bushes.

Suddenly we heard a loud thumping noise near us. Sam got scared and almost fell over a log. 

"What was that noise?" Sam asked me quietly.

"Maybe it is a bear!" I whispered back.

We were hungry so we sat down on a rock. We ate toasted sandwiches and some roasted peanuts. A tiny gnat flew right into my nose!

Then we saw a weird piece of paper on the ground. It was an old receipt from a store. Someone was dumping trash here and I meant to clean it up. We did not find treasure but we had a fun design for a fort.

My younger sister Sarah had a birthday last week. It was a very important day for our family. We went to a big park near a mountain. My mom brought a huge chocolate cake and candles.

"I am so excited for cake!" shouted Sarah loudly.

My dad laughed and said, "Wait until we start singing first."

We sat on the grass surrounding the picnic blanket. Sarah opened her presents and looked very pleased. I gave her a bracelet made of red thread. She said it was incredible and put it on. Then we ate the cake and played tag. It was the best day ever because everyone was happy.

I was playing my favorite video game against my brother. It was raining outside so we had to stay inside. My character was wearing a cool blue helmet and armor.

"I am going to win this time," I said.

My brother just shook his head and kept pressing buttons. Suddenly my screen went black and my character disappeared! I stood up and looked at the TV closely.

"Hey, you cheated!" I yelled at him loudly.

My brother laughed and was speaking but I didn't listen. Then I saw the cord was unplugged from the wall. I plugged it back in and my score came back. I obtained the high score and won the important trophy. We ate pizza for dinner instead of fighting about it.

My friends and I went into the spooky old house. Everyone was scared because it was dark and smelled funny. We saw a big hole in the ceiling. A bat flew right over my head!

"Watch out for the ghost!" yelled Timmy loudly.

"I am not scared of ghosts," I said back.

We walked carefully on the twisted wooden floor. Suddenly, lightning struck outside and lit up the room. The walls looked scorched and black from a fire. We heard a loud groaning sound from upstairs. It was especially scary because of the height of the stairs. Timmy found an old newspaper on the ground. We were not loading our backpacks anymore because we ran away fast! We were way behind schedule for dinner, but we were safe.

My robot dog Sparky ran away into the woods. I chased him and saw a big silver ship. It had crashed into a tree and smoke came out. Suddenly a green alien bounced out of the door! I was scared but the alien looked nice. He was in big trouble because his ship was broken.

"Can you help me fix my door?" asked the alien.

"Yes I have my tools right here," I said.

We fixed the door and the alien was so grateful. He gave me a special rock that glowed blue. Then he zoomed away into the sky. Sparky was sleeping under a bush nearby. I woke him up and he greeted me with a bark. It was the best meeting ever but nobody believed me later.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for the lost castle. We walked for a long time on a dirty path. The path was leading us to a big dark cave.

"I am scared of bears," said Sam quietly.

"I guarantee we will be safe," I told him.

We went inside and it was very cold and wet. Suddenly a big rat tried to gnaw on my shoe! We ran away fast and found a hidden door. I touched the handle and it opened up wide. Inside was a huge room that needed cleaning. Dust was swept into big piles everywhere. We saw a golden crown on a chair.

"I will reign as king!" I shouted loudly.

Then we heard a noise and ran home fast. My mom was mad and gave me a grounding. I dropped the receipt for my candy bar. We never found the castle but it was fun.

I was playing my favorite video game on Saturday. It was the last level and it looked totally impossible. My heart was pumping fast and my hands were sweaty. I was approaching the final boss and he was scary. He was wearing black armor and had a huge sword.

"You can do it, captain!" yelled my brother Sam.

I focused hard and cleared the first part easily. My character flew into the air and hit the monster. He fell to the ground and looked like stewed tomatoes. I won the game and felt like I was in heaven.

"You really toasted him!" Sam said with a big smile.

I was plain happy and grateful that I finally won. Leading the high score list felt so good. We ate pizza after to celebrate my big win.

Me and my friend Sam went into the dark forest. We were wearing our explorer hats and big boots. Suddenly the wind blew hard and a cave appeared. It looked scary but we went inside anyway. Inside the cave we discovered a shiny gold box.

"Don't touch it!" shouted Sam. "It might be a trap."

I didn't listen and I grabbed the box quickly. Then a giant spider came down like a bungee cord. It looked like it had a stinging tail. We ran super fast and almost got lost. The cave grew darker and we heard a scary noise. We ran outside and we sang a happy song because we were safe. We missed our meeting with the club but we had a great adventure.

I went to my friend Ben’s house for a sleepover. We were feeling very excited because we planned a big adventure. We built a giant fort out of pillows and blankets. It looked like a mountain in the living room.

"This is the best fort ever!" I yelled.

Ben said, "We need to make sure no creature gets in."

We were keeping watch for his little sister. She always tries to break our forts. Later, Ben’s dad was coaching us on how to make s’mores. We roasted marshmallows over the stove carefully. They were sticky and yummy.

Then we pretended the kitchen sink was a magic fountain. I was certain that the water gave us super powers. Ben was teaching me how to be a spy. We stayed up super late and ate too much candy. It was the best sleepover.

"Is it a monster bearing teeth?" Sam whispered.

It wasn't a monster. It was my dog Buster! He already ate his dinner but he grew hungry again. We all laughed and went back to sleep in the tent.

Yesterday me and my sister went into the big woods. We pretended we were scientists exploring a foreign planet. My dog Buster came too and he was sniffing the earth.

"Look at that bug! It is incredible!" I yelled loudly.

My sister said, "I bet it has super strength."

We found a huge stick and tested its weight. Then we saw a squirrel loading nuts into a tree. Suddenly Buster struck a pose and barked at a bush. A fat rabbit escaped and ran very fast away! It was getting late so we went home for dinner. Mom made roasted chicken because it was Wednesday.

"You smell like dirt," Mom laughed at us.

"We are space explorers," said her daughter. We love science adventures.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods behind my house. We were pretending to be explorers on a big quest. The wind was a cold breeze but we had warm coats.

"Look at that weird cave!" Sam shouted loudly.

We walked down the muddy trail and went inside. It was dark and freezing in there. Suddenly a big pile of rocks fell down behind us. We were trapped!

"I hope our ninja training works," I said.

We pushed the rocks but they were too heavy. I thought we were stuck forever. Then we saw a tiny hole of light. We crawled through it and crossed a little stream. It was just big enough to fit. We ran home fast for hot cocoa.

Max and I went to the spooky island in our small boat. We wanted to find the old pirate gold hidden inside a dark cave. The cave looked really scary throughout the whole trip.

"Do not go the wrong way," Max said to me.

We walked for a longer time than I thought we would. We heard a loud noise that sounded like a giant bear. I was scared but Max said everything was fine. We found a single red box sitting on a rock. We cleared the dirt off the top.

"This is the important treasure!" I yelled loudly.

We were in trouble because a monkey stole our map. But we had each other for company so we were okay. We ran back to the boat and took the box home. It was a very different and fun day.

I was playing a racing game on my tablet. My car was red and very fast. I drove through a big loop and defied gravity. Then I hit a rock and crashed hard. My hands were trembling because I wanted to win.

"You can do it!" my brother yelled.

I pressed the restart button and started climbing the hill again. I felt like I was on a bungee cord bouncing around. I ate a cookie crumb off my shirt and focused. Finally, I crossed the finish line first!

"Good job!" my mom greeted me with a high five.

I thought I would lose, but then the whistle blew. I won the gold cup!

I feared lunch today because my mom packed tuna. I hate tuna because it smells weird. I sat down and started tearing open the bag. My friend Billy sat next to me with pizza.

"Do you want some of my pizza?" Billy asked.

"Yes please!" I said and smiled really big.

I ate the pizza instead of the tuna. The teacher said tuna has protein, but pizza is better. Then we went outside for recess. We ran in a straight line to the swings. My heart had a fast rhythm from running so fast. I felt like I had too much caffeine! The teacher was coaching us on how to share. The bell was approaching, meaning fun time was over. Lunch is the best part of school.

For my birthday, I wanted a giant chocolate cake. It was going to be the size of a mountain! My mom said baking it was simply impossible. I grumbled because I really wanted that big cake. We tried to bake it anyway. I swept the flour off the table and mixed the eggs. The cake grew to a crazy height in the oven. But then it fell flat.

"Oh no, it looks like a pancake!" I said.

My mom started groaning and laughing at the mess. It was a big failure.

"The reign of the giant cake is over," Mom joked.

We made thirteen cupcakes instead. They were good.

I went exploring on a big mountain with my dog Rex. The sun was hot and the grass looked scorched and yellow. We walked for a long time on a rocky trail. Suddenly, Rex barked loudly at a big gray rock.

"What is that, Rex?" I asked him.

The rock moved and it wasn't a rock at all! It was huge and gray like an elephant, but it was just a funny bush. I was scared for a second. Then I counted three blue butterflies on it. They were so beautiful and bright. We sat down and drank our water.

"This is the greatest day ever," I told Rex.

I was grateful for my dog and the cool water. We walked home again before it got dark.

I was waiting for lunch for a whole hour. My tummy was making a really loud sounding noise. I looked at the clock and it was finally time. I ran to the water fountain first because I was thirsty. Then I saw my friend Billy sitting on the ground. He dropped his lunch box and he looked really sad.

"What is wrong Billy?" I asked him.

He said, "I think my sandwich got dirty."

I told him not to worry. I gave him half of my sandwich. Then we talked about sick people. Billy said his grandpa had pneumonia once but he got better. Our teacher came over to guide us back to class. It was a good day because I helped my friend.

Yesterday, my robot named Sparky acted really weird. I was doing my homework on my computer. Suddenly, Sparky flew up and hit the ceiling! He fell down with a big crash. I thought he was broken, but then he started glowing green.

"I have a superpower!" Sparky beeped loudly.

"You are just a robot," I said to him.

Then he started to sneeze bolts and screws everywhere. He tried to seize my math book with his metal claws. Everything in my room started floating around like magic. My little nephew walked in and saw us floating.

"Wow, Sparky is a champion!" he yelled.

We played space games until Sparky went back to sleeping mode. Being a robot owner is hard work.

The jungle was thick and green and scary. Max and Sam walked slowly because they were seeing giant bugs. Suddenly, they heard a loud stamping noise behind some trees.

"It sounds like a dinosaur," Sam whispered and shook with fear.

"That is impossible," Max told him bravely. "Dinosaurs are sleeping forever."

They peeked around a bush and saw a huge gorilla instead. He was eating a big bug for protein. The gorilla looked like he wanted to reign over the whole jungle.

"We should go back," Sam said quietly.

Max nodded his head fast. Teaching a gorilla to be nice was too dangerous. They ran all the way home without stopping.

Me and my brother went camping in the big woods. We pulled our tent out and set it up fast. The trees surrounding us were super tall and green.

"I am hungry!" my brother called loudly.

"Let's make s'mores," I said back to him.

We made a small fire and found some sticks. I grasped my stick tight and put a marshmallow on. I held it over the fire and it gradually turned brown. It smelled like toasted sugar and it looked so yummy. My brother roasted his until it was totally black and burned! We counted to three and ate them simply with chocolate. It was the best night ever.

My dad was coaching my soccer team today. It was a very important game because it was my birthday. We were playing the Tigers, and they were big.

I saw the ball coming and I kicked it hard. It went right past the goalie! Everyone was screaming and ringing cowbells. I felt like a giant elephant because I was so strong.

"Good job, buddy!" my dad yelled from the sideline.

I ran back but my legs were hurting. I was groaning a little bit. The game felt longer than usual.

"Do we have enough time for cake?" I asked my mom.

She smiled and said, "We always have time for cake."

I thought it was the best birthday ever. We won the game and ate chocolate cake.

I was playing my new racing video game with Sam. My car was super fast and stronger than his big truck. I was approaching the finish line, but Sam shouted at the screen.

"Hey! You cheated!" he yelled loudly.

"No way, I just drive better," I thought to myself.

Suddenly my car crashed into a big wall on the track. Sam zoomed past me and crossed the line first. The referee blew a whistle on the TV.

"That's not fair," I grumbled and ate a toasted crumb of bread. Sam was bringing his controller over to me for a rematch. Next time I will win for sure.

My cat Buster is always roaming around the backyard. One day I saw him climbing the big oak tree. He loves to climb everything he sees outside. He went way up high and felt the cool breeze. Suddenly he looked stuck and he meowed very loud.

"Mom, Buster is trapped in the tree!" I yelled.

Mom came outside and we saw Buster approaching a thin branch. He tried to squeeze through the leaves but he was scared.

"Don't worry Buster, we will get you!" Mom said.

She got a ladder and climbed up to grab him. Buster was hungry so we gave him some treats. Then I had to comb his fur because it was messy. He looked different but he was happy to be safe.

One day a robot crashed into my backyard. He was silver and had lights running down his chest. I ran outside and saw him lying on the grass. His metal parts were scattered everywhere.

"Are you okay?" I asked the robot.

He sat up fast and looked scared. "The aliens are coming!" he screamed.

My heart was pumping so fast. Suddenly a green spaceship landed next to my swing set. Three aliens started jumping out with laser guns. We fought them with water balloons. The robot was incredible and threw mud at them. The aliens scrambled back to their ship and flew away. My ears were ringing from the noise.

"We did it!" I yelled.

The robot gave me a golden thread as a present. I almost sold it but I kept it instead. I was already a hero.

My brother and I played a big video game today. We chose our players and got ready to fight. I picked the silver knight because he had a sword. My brother rode a big dragon that breathed hot fire.

"You are going down!" I yelled at the TV screen.

We started stamping our feet to the music's rhythm. My knight twisted away when the dragon flew at him. It was a very important match for the championship reign. Suddenly, a strange colonel appeared from a foreign land. He tried to help me, but I didn't need it. I jumped high and crushed the dragon with my boot.

"No way, I was supposed to win!" my brother cried.

I was so happy to receive the gold trophy. I am the best player in the whole house.

My friends and I played basketball at the park yesterday. We discovered a new way to play called Zero Gravity. It felt like playing on a foreign planet with no rules. We drew a line on the ground with chalk. Then we scattered around the court and started shooting.

I threw the ball and it reached a great height. The wind blew it right into the net! I was earning so many points for my team. My friend Sarah shouted, "You are the best player ever!"

"I just got lucky!" I yelled back to her.

Gradually the sun went down and it got dark outside. Sarah’s mom came and picked up her daughter. I thought the game was super fun. I want to learn more cool games to play tomorrow.

My brother Tom thinks he is the greatest at video games. He always beats me at race cars, but today was different. I discovered a secret shortcut in the jungle level. I twisted my controller hard when we neared the big jump.

"You can't beat me because it is impossible!" Tom yelled.

I did not listen and I kept going fast. My dog started to gnaw on Tom's shoe and he got mad. That gave me a chance to pass him. The finish line gradually got closer and I felt happy.

"I knew I could win!" I shouted when I crossed first.

Tom looked at the newspaper on the floor and sighed. He said maybe psychology helped me win, but I think it was just skill. It felt like I won a science prize. Then we heard a knock at the door for pizza.

Yesterday at recess, I was swinging on the monkey bars. I love how gravity pulls me down when I jump. But then, my favorite eraser fell out of my pocket. It had a cool design with blue stars on it. I looked down, but it was lost in the grass.

"Oh no, I think a ghost stole it!" I shouted.

My friend Leo laughed and said, "Ghosts don't need erasers."

I was afraid I would get a failure on my math homework without it. I looked everywhere, and then I saw something shiny. It was my eraser! I was so grateful. Then a bee came by, and I ran away fast because of the stinging. Recess is fun but scary sometimes.

I was trembling when I opened my backpack. My homework was gone! I looked everywhere but I wasn't seeing it. Suddenly, I had a crazy idea. Maybe an invisible monster grabbed it during breakfast.

My teacher walked over and she looked mad. "Where is your math, Timmy?" she asked.

I crawled under my desk and pretended to be cleaning. My face grew really hot. "A monster ate it!" I said.

Then I saw something under my chair. It was my homework! A huge storm brewed in my tummy because I felt silly. I gave it to her and ran to recess. Being invisible would be nice sometimes.

Today was a very hot day at school. The sun scorched the blacktop and we were all sweating. I was yearning for recess to be over soon. My friend Jake bounced a red ball near me.

"Pass it here!" I yelled to him loudly.

Jake threw the ball but it went too far. It hit the wall with a big thud. Then the bell rang for lunch and we ran inside. I heard lots of feet stamping in the hallway. Everyone was screaming because they were so hungry.

"Is that enough pizza for you?" the lunch lady asked me.

I nodded my head because eating was very important. I sat down and ate my food very fast. It was a good day but I was tired.

My robot Ralph was the greatest invention ever. I drew his design on a piece of newspaper. Ralph was eight feet in height and very shiny. We went to space to fight a giant beetle.

"Look out for that laser!" I yelled loudly.

Ralph scrambled away and grabbed his laser sword. The beetle had impossible speed and scattered rocks everywhere. We fought for an hour on the red planet. Ralph hit the beetle and became the champion.

"We are bringing home the trophy," Ralph said.

I was seeing stars because I was so happy. Being a space hero is the best job.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We wanted to play video games but the screen kept saying loading. It took forever so we sprinted outside to the backyard instead. Sam pretended he was the king and his reign was scary.

"I am the king of this jungle!" he shouted loudly.

I laughed and said, "You can’t catch me, King Sam!"

We ran straight to the big oak tree by the fence. I grabbed a branch and was hanging there like a monkey. Then my foot got caught in a net we made yesterday. I struggled to get out but Sam helped me get free. Later my dad made a fire and we toasted huge marshmallows. It was the best sleepover ever until Sam started talking in a weird foreign language. He is so funny.

My backpack was so heavy today. I was dumping everything out on my desk. Then I saw something weird. It was a shiny black beetle! It was freezing cold in our classroom too. I put on my jacket but the beetle didn't have one.

"Hey, look at this bug!" I yelled to Sam.
Sam ran over and looked at the desk. "He looks like he is sleeping," Sam said.

We discovered the beetle liked eating crumbs. We gave him part of my sandwich. Then we went outside for recess. I was jumping rope and looking at the scenery. I didn't want to go back inside either. School is boring but at least now we have a pet bug.

It was my sister’s birthday and she turned thirteen today. We had a party in the backyard with a cool breeze blowing. My dad was stamping his feet because the dog got out. Our dog Buster escaped through the open gate and ran away.

"Come back here right now!" yelled my dad loudly.

We all ran to catch him but it felt impossible. Then Buster saw the cake and stopped running. He scattered crumbs everywhere when he jumped on the table. My mom found the receipt for the cake on the ground.

"I guess we need a new cake," I said.

We laughed and ate ice cream instead.

My best friend Leo came over to my apartment to play video games. We saw a sign for a big tournament online. The game was about a rock star playing a loud guitar.

"I bet I can beat you," Leo said.

"Neither of us is growing tired so let's play," I shouted back.

We started playing and the scene on the screen was crazy. The music was so loud it almost hit the ceiling. My score kept following his score very closely. Suddenly, Leo screeched when he missed a note. I used the special scissors move to cut his power cord in the game.

"You can't contain my skills!" I yelled happily.

We decided to wrap up the game. I won but we remain best friends.

I went to my friend Sam’s sleepover for his birthday. The weather was bad outside but we didn't care. We played a game where we were invisible spies.

Suddenly I heard a loud noise from the kitchen. It sounded like a monster groaning and moaning. Sam gripped my arm because he was scared.

"What is that noise?" asked Sam.

"Maybe it's a ghost," I said.

We walked to the kitchen and saw his dad. He had chewed on a super hot pepper! His face grew really red immediately. He grabbed a glass of milk and drank every single drop.

"My mouth is on fire!" he yelled.

He was swearing a little bit but it was funny. We spread out our sleeping bags and laughed all night.

I hated my lunch today because my dad packed it. He put in a sandwich with toasted bread but it got cold. I grumbled when I saw a big crumb on my shirt. My friend Sam sat next to me and he was dumping out his chips.

"Do you want to trade?" I asked him quietly.

Sam shook his head and said, "No way, I paid my own money for these."

I looked outside and saw the big kids pumping their legs on the swings. My neighbor was there too but he looked sick like he had pneumonia or something. He wasn't playing. I ate my sandwich but I wished I was boating on a lake instead. School feels like growing a plant that takes forever. Next time I will make my own lunch with a knife and jelly.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the spooky mountain. We wanted to find the secret cave. We walked for an hour and then we saw a big hole. It was super dark inside. Suddenly, a furry creature jumped from the ceiling! It had red eyes and was growing bigger.

"Run away fast!" I screamed at Sam.

Sam threw a rock at it but he missed. The creature let out a loud whistle. Then it tried to seize my backpack. We were screaming and running down the hill. We ran all the way home and my mom was reading a newspaper. She greeted us but then she saw my ripped shirt.

"You are getting a grounding!" she yelled.

I almost fainted because I was so scared. We spread out on the floor and rested. We are never going back there again.

Max and I were waiting by the spooky cave. We had a schedule for our big adventure today. Max held a blue feather he found outside. He grinned at me and turned on his flashlight.

"Are you scared of the dark?" Max asked.

"I am not afraid of anything," I said back.

We started walking deep inside the dark tunnel. I heard something stamping its feet loudly nearby. A shadow was growing bigger on the wall. Something was approaching us very fast! We saw a shiny red jewel on the ground. Max tried to seize it, but I stopped him.

"That jewel has a bad meaning," I whispered.

Suddenly a bat flew right at us! We ran outside and jumped in our boating raft. We paddled away fast. We didn't need a computer to know that was dangerous. We weren't going back inside either.

Yesterday I went exploring in the woods behind my house. It was a wonderful day and the sun was hot. I pushed through some big bushes and found a secret spot. Suddenly a little brown rabbit appeared near a tree. It twitched its nose and looked very funny. Then the rabbit let out a loud sneeze!

"Bless you little bunny," I whispered to it.

The rabbit jumped high and ran away fast. I tried to follow it but I got my shirt caught. It got stuck on a branch that hung low. I was groaning because I couldn't get free. Finally I got loose but the rabbit was gone.

"I will come back tomorrow to find you," I said.

I grinned all the way home because I have a secret.

I sat in my room and heard a weird noise. It came from the ceiling and sounded like buzzing bees. Suddenly a green alien flew down and landed on my bed. He had three eyes and his ears were twisted funny.

"Do not be scared," the alien told me quietly.

I stared at him because this was impossible. He held out a tiny silver fountain that glowed blue.

"Receive this gift," he said and then he pushed a button.

Bright light spread everywhere and I grew very tall. I felt super strong and I could even float. The alien was dumping sparkles on the floor but I didn't care. I had to remain calm so I could learn to fly. It was the best day ever.

I was playing soccer, and it felt like heaven. My team needed a single goal to win the game. I remembered what my dad said about focusing hard. The ball rolled fast on the bumpy ground. I grasped my shirt because I was so nervous.

Suddenly, the other player pushed me with all his weight. My face got red, and a vein popped out. It was not a pleasant feeling at all! But I stood up and felt invisible power.

"Pass it to me now!" I yelled loudly.

My friend kicked it, and I jumped like a bungee. I kicked the ball right into the net. We won!

It was my birthday and we went to a big mountain. My dad drove the car straight up the hill. We were loading our bags and I grabbed my new camera. It was important because I wanted to take pictures.
