We walked to the balcony of our cabin. The sun was gradually going down and the sky looked pink. I counted three birds flying near us.

Then my brother called me. "Hey, watch out for that bee!" he yelled.

I felt a stinging pain on my finger. It hurt a lot! I thought the trip was a failure.

"Don't worry, we have cake," my mom said.

I felt better and we ate cake. The night was approaching fast. We played games until I fell asleep on the couch.

Me and my best friend Tom went exploring in the woods. We wanted to find the old treehouse for our science project. The ground was muddy and slippery from the rain. Suddenly, we heard a loud groaning sound from the bushes.

"What was that spooky noise?" whispered Tom.

"I think it is a monster!" I yelled back.

We scrambled up a big rock to be safe. It wasn't a monster though. It was just a big branch breaking. Then we saw a beehive. A bee stung Tom and it was stinging bad. We ran all the way home. My mom gave us toasted marshmallows and hot chocolate. We were so grateful to be safe inside. We decided to explore a little longer next time.

One day I went outside to my big tree. It was a sunny day and the grass was wet. I saw my cat Fluffy near the trunk. She looked like a brave knight guarding a castle. I wanted to go up high so I grasped a branch.

"Watch out Fluffy!" I yelled. "I am going up!"

I climbed very fast and my hands got dirty. Then I saw a shiny blue egg on the ground. It must have fallen out of a nest. I climbed down and opened my hands to pick it up. I knew I had to help it.

"Don't worry little egg," I said. "I will keep you safe."

My mom sent me inside for lunch but I felt happy. I put the egg in a soft box. It was a good adventure.

I was pumping my legs so fast on the swing. Then the recess bell rang and it struck my ears loudly. We ran inside and I kept bumping into my friend Sam. Our teacher Mrs. Green taught us math but I was hungry. My stomach grew very loud and everyone heard it.

At lunch, I opened my box and saw my sandwich. I spread grape jelly on it this morning. Then I saw that Sam obtained a giant cookie.

"Hey Sam, can I have a bite?" I asked him.

"No way, my mom made it," Sam said quickly.

I chewed my sandwich slowly and wished for a cookie. Then a big dog ran onto the playground and stole a ball! It was so funny to maintain a straight face. We laughed until milk came out of my nose.

It was a boring Wednesday at school. I was yearning for lunchtime because my tummy was rumbling. Mrs. Miller was teaching us math but I did not want to learn. I scratched my head and looked out the window. The scenery was just the playground and some grass. I saw my friend Billy steering his pencil like a race car.

"Stop making zoom noises," whispered Mrs. Miller.

Billy stopped but then he started tapping his finger. I thought about coaching my soccer team at recess. Finally the bell rang and everyone was seeing who could run fastest.

"I'm so hungry," said Billy, moaning loudly.

We ate our sandwiches and then we played soccer until the bell rang again.

I was playing a racing game with my brother. We had to drive straight through a big mountain. My car was red and very fast. My brother crashed into a wall and I laughed.

"Hey, that is not fair!" he yelled at me.

I just kept driving and I pressed the turbo button. My car flew in the air and landed perfectly. I found a secret shortcut behind a rock. Then I heard the finish line music play loud.

"I win again!" I shouted and jumped up.

My brother was sad but he wanted to play again. I told him he needs to learn the secret path. We counted to three and started the next race. I ran to get a snack while the game loaded. I love winning races.

My nephew Ben and I wanted to explore the old house. It looked like a castle, but people said a ghost lived there. We walked through the tall grass and neared the big door. My heart was thumping like a drum rhythm.

"This is important," Ben said. "We have to be brave."

I grasped the handle and the door blew open. It was dark inside. Suddenly, we heard a loud sound like an electric guitar! We ran away fast. We didn't have enough courage to be a champion today. Gravity pulled me down, and I fell. Ben helped me up. We ran all the way home. I think I heard the ghost swearing at us, but maybe it was just the wind. We did not wrap up the mystery today.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the spooky woods. Sam was wearing his lucky red sweater because it was cold. We were looking for the secret cave. We walked for a long time and my feet hurt.

"Are we there yet?" Sam asked me.

"No, keep walking," I said.

Suddenly we saw a big hole in the ground. It was the cave! We jumped inside and saw fourteen shiny rocks. Then we heard a loud groaning noise. It was a bear!

"Run!" I yelled.

We ran fast and the bear didn't catch us. We were cheering when we got home. My mom was already making dinner. I promised I would never go back there.

I was running late for school today because I could not find my shoes. My younger brother hid them under the couch. I ran into class just as the bell rang.

Mrs. Miller looked at me. "Do you know what time it is?" she asked.

"I am sorry," I said. I sat down at my desk and looked up at the ceiling.

Then we had a math test. I struggled with question number eight because it was hard. I thought I did okay though.

At recess, we played tag. My friend Ben has a really loud whistle. He blew it when I was running fast. I tried to stop but I slipped. I fell on my lunch bag and crushed my sandwich. Then I let out a huge sneeze. It was a messy day.

Me and my friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost golden beetle. The trees were big and the leaves were scattered everywhere. We walked for a long time and saw a beautiful cave.

"I think the beetle is in there," said Sam.

We heard a ringing sound coming from inside. It was scary but we went in anyway. Suddenly a bat screeched and flew at us! It was approaching fast. I knew we had to run away. Sam threw a rock at the wall to scare it.

"Run back to the house!" I yelled loudly.

We ran past a sleeping bear and didn't stop. My leg was stinging from a scratch but I didn't care. We got home safe and ate roasted marshmallows. We often talk about the beetle but we don't go back. I know it is still there waiting for us.

My friend Tim and I were playing a video game. It was a racing game with lots of fast cars. I picked the blue car because it looked really cool. Tim picked the red one and he was very fast. We were racing up a big mountain and climbing high.

Suddenly, Tim bumped my car and I fell off the track. I felt anger inside me and I wanted to scream.

"You cheated!" I yelled at him.

"No I didn't, I just drive better," Tim said.

We started the race again but then I had to sneeze. I closed my eyes and I crashed into a wall. It felt like a big failure. I scratched my nose and threw the controller down. Then I saw a shortcut and I drove really fast. I won the race and everyone was cheering for me! I was not scared anymore. Tim sold his car to buy a slower one.

It was my birthday and I had a sleepover with Sam. We wanted to make s'mores in the backyard. My dad built a fire and we got our sticks. I chewed on a marshmallow while I waited for the fire.

"Don't get too close!" my dad said.

I put my marshmallow in the fire but it got scorched. It was totally black but I ate it anyway. Then we went inside to open presents. Sam gave me a science kit. It was so cool. I had to wrap it up later so I wouldn't lose the pieces.

"Let's play with the slime part first," Sam said.

We made green slime and my mom blew a whistle for cake. Everyone was cheering when I blew out the candles. Then we drew pictures until we fell asleep. It was the best night ever.

I feared the big red whistle at recess today. My neighbor Billy told me a secret about gravity. He said if you jump when the whistle blows, you start floating! I grabbed my sandwich and ate every crumb quickly. I was growing excited but also a little scared.

Soon, the teacher was approaching the playground steps. She held the silver whistle to her lips.

"Get ready to jump!" Billy called to me.

I bent my knees and waited for the sound. *Tweeeeet!*

I jumped high, but my feet hit the ground hard. I didn't float away. It was no different than yesterday.

"I think you are earning a timeout for lying," I told Billy.

"Maybe it only works tomorrow," Billy said with a shrug.

I laughed and ran inside to receive my math homework.

My soccer team was in the big summer league. We played the Tigers and the grass scene was muddy. My heart was pumping super fast because the score was tied. I started running and jumping over a puddle.

"Pass me the ball right now!" I yelled loud.

My friend Sam kicked it hard across the field. I stopped the ball and I was stamping my feet. I looked at the goal and kicked it really high. The ball went climbing up into the air. It hit the earth right inside the net!

"We won the whole game!" Sam shouted.

We had to learn to play better but we won. It was the best day ever.

Me and my best friend Leo rowed our boat to the spooky island. We were looking for pirate gold. We walked for a long time and saw a big, old castle. It looked scary but we had enough strength to go inside.

Suddenly, a giant rat started to gnaw on my shoe!

"Get away!" yelled Leo, and he kicked a rock.

The rat ran away fast. We cleared the path and found a treasure chest. Inside was not gold but a funny paper.

"It is just a receipt for pizza!" I said.

We were earning nothing for all our trouble. We were bringing home zero gold. We didn't stay any longer. We ran back to the boat fast. Exploring is hard work.

My hands were trembling when I held the controller. I was playing the big racing game against my brother. He always won and I always lost, but today felt different. The cars zoomed fast and the engine noise was growing loud.

"You are going to be in big trouble!" my brother yelled.

I did not say anything and just drove my red car. We went around a sharp corner and he twisted his controller hard. Suddenly, his blue car spun out and blew a tire. I threw my car into high gear and crossed the finish line.

"I can't believe you actually beat me," he said.

I was so grateful that I finally won a race. I thought I would lose again but I was the champion.

It was a cold day in February and I was playing outside. I saw a bright green light in the meadow behind my house. I ran to see it because it looked important. A big silver robot landed right on the grass! I was so scared that I almost screamed. The robot opened a door and a small alien flew out.

"Do not be afraid!" the alien said to me.

He had a blue cape like a knight and held a sign. The sign simply said HELLO. I gave him a thumbs up with my thumb. He threw a purple ball to me and it turned into candy. It was a pleasure to meet him. Then he got back in his ship and flew away fast.

Yesterday was Wednesday and me and Tom went exploring. We saw a dark cave near the big woods. We feared it might have bears roaming inside. Tom grabbed a stick and he was our guide.

We walked in slowly and the light faded gradually. Suddenly I saw something clinging to a rock! It looked like a bat but huge.

"Look out!" yelled Tom loudly.

I pointed my finger and the thing flew away fast. We ran outside and we were breathing hard. We decided to learn more about caves later. Then we went home and ate roasted marshmallows. It was the best adventure ever.

My friends and I found a cave near the old fountain. I am fourteen but my friend Sam is very short. We scrambled over big rocks on the hard ground. Suddenly we realized something was very wrong inside the dark cave.

A giant green beetle crawled out and blocked our way! It screeched at us and tried to gnaw on Sam’s shoe.

"Run away before you get in big trouble!" I yelled loudly.

Sam looked scared and he greeted the bug with a stick. He hit the beetle and it ran back into the hole.

"That bug needs some protein to grow to that height!" Sam said.

We ran home fast to play games on my computer. I never want to see a giant bug ever again.

My dog Sparky loves going to the park. He bounced around because he was so happy. We walked on the path and heard birds singing. I was swinging a big stick I found on the ground. Suddenly Sparky stopped running and started groaning.

"What is wrong, Sparky?" I asked him.

He looked scared though nothing was there. Then I heard a weird noise coming from a bush. It sounded like something yearning for a snack. We kept walking very slowly toward the noise.

"Is it a monster?" my little brother whispered.

A tiny kitten jumped out! We are earning a treat for saving it. We take it home often to play.

My neighbor Mr. Jones has a secret robot. I saw him climbing into a big metal suit. The robot was shiny and it had a green jewel on its chest. I followed him to his backyard shed.

Mr. Jones pushed a button and the robot rose up high. It moved very fast and ran straight at me! I screamed really loud and tried to run away. The robot grabbed my shirt but only scratched my arm.

"Be careful with my robot!" Mr. Jones yelled.

"I understood, I'm sorry!" I shouted back.

He brewed some tea and gave me a bandage. Then the robot fainted because its battery died. Mr. Jones is bringing it inside now. It was the coolest thing ever.

It was raining outside but my dog Buster wanted to go. He was stamping his paws by the door. I put on my coat and we went into the wet grass. Suddenly a bird flew out of the bush and scared us! Buster started trembling a little bit because the noise was loud.

"Don’t worry, Buster, there is no danger here," I said.

We walked longer down the path to the big oak tree. Buster found a stick and chewed on it happily. He likes having company when he plays outside. Then I saw a tiny squirrel on a branch. It could not maintain its balance and almost fell.

"Look at that squirrel!" I yelled to Buster.

The squirrel spread its tail and jumped away safely. Buster barked at it but the squirrel was too fast. We ran back home because my mom was beginning to call us for dinner. We were wet but everything was fun.

It was early in the morning when I woke up. My friend Sam was waiting on my balcony for me. We wanted to find the lost golden statue. We searched the backyard near the big oak tree.

"Look at this giant footprint!" Sam yelled loudly.

It looked like an elephant had walked there. We realized the statue was in the muddy hole. Sam started dumping the mud out with his hands. I helped him spread the dirt around the grass. Suddenly my shovel struck something hard and shiny. It was impossible but we found it!

"We are earning a big reward for this," I said.

We ran inside to tell my mom about our adventure.

I was exploring the woods with my dog Max. We saw a big bird in a tall tree. It flew down fast and landed on a rock. I thought it was a hawk or maybe an eagle. I grabbed a stick and I threw it far away. Max ran after it and he barked really loud.

"Max, come back here right now!" I yelled.

He did not listen and he kept running away. I neared the big rock and saw something shiny. It was a wonderful green beetle with eight legs. Max came back and he was panting hard.

"Look at this bug, Max!" I said.

He sniffed it and tried to eat it. I know bugs have protein but that is gross. Max is earning a grounding if he eats everything. We walked home and had a good snack instead.

My big brother Ben and I played a video game. It was about a beautiful island with lots of treasure. I picked the fast ninja and Ben picked the big guard. We started fighting and my heart was thumping really hard.

"You can't beat me!" Ben yelled at the screen.

I drank the magic potion my character brewed. Suddenly I was invisible and snuck behind him. I started dumping all his gold into my bag.

"Hey, where did you go?" asked Ben loudly.

I jumped out and won the game. I felt like a hero in the newspaper. Ben was mad but we played again anyway.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday and he turned four. We went to the park and the scenery was nice. My big brother is fourteen and he loves science. He brought a big jar for catching bugs. 

Suddenly Sam started groaning because he saw a huge beetle. "Look out, it's a monster!" Sam yelled loudly.

My brother scrambled over and caught the beetle quickly. "Don't worry, I will guard you," he said.

We neared the cake and my dad dropped a plate. I think I heard him swearing but my mom said shh. We ate cake and I felt very grateful for the frosting. It was a fun day.

I was sitting in class and feeling very hungry. My stomach made a loud noise like a monster. My neighbor Tommy heard it and he laughed at me. I thought about my lunch box in my locker. My mom packed a big sandwich with lots of protein. I also had an apple to gnaw on later.

Suddenly Mr. Jones stopped playing his guitar for music time. He looked mad because someone was sleeping in the back. "Wake up right now!" he shouted loudly. Then the bell finally rang and everyone disappeared outside.

I ran to get my lunch but it was gone! A dog had chewed a hole in my bag. I was so mad I almost started swearing but I stopped. Then Tommy shared his chips and I felt like a champion. We played tag until recess was complete.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. My neighbor sat at the computer next to me. He drew a picture of a ghost on the screen. It looked scary and I feared it was real.

"Why are you stamping your feet?" the teacher asked.

"I saw a ghost on the computer!" I yelled loudly.

She looked at the ceiling and then at the earth. She did not understand the meaning of my words. Then she saw a crumb on my shirt.

"You are just hungry for lunch," she said.

I grew very red and started leaving the room. My friend has a different idea about ghosts. He thinks they eat homework. I hope he is right.

It was my sister’s birthday and we had a busy schedule. Mom said we needed to make a really big card. I got the scissors and some blue paper. My hand was steady when I cut out a big star.

"Does this look good?" I asked my brother.

"Yes, but you need more glue," he said.

We spread glue all over the back of the star. It was sticky and messy but it stuck good. Then we saw that we forgot the glitter. I feared that Mom would be mad about the mess. But she just smiled and paid for the pizza. We ate it all through the night. It was the best birthday ever.

I was playing basketball with my best friend Sam. We were in my driveway and the hoop hung on a chain. It was a really hot day in July. I jumped up high and the ball flew through the air.

"Nice shot!" Sam yelled at me.

But then I landed funny and my ankle twisted bad. It hurt a lot and a blue vein popped out. My foot grew really big and purple fast. I almost fainted because it hurt so much.

"Are you okay?" asked Sam.

My mom came out and saw my big foot. She started dumping ice on it. It was cold enough to freeze me. I had company though so I didn't cry. Later I just looked at the ceiling and played video games.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the big mountain. We wanted to find the lost treasure of the golden knight. I brought my backpack and Sam brought snacks. We had a map to guide us, but it was ripped.

"I have a bad feeling about this," said Sam.

"Don't complain or we won't find anything," I said back.

We walked into the dark woods surrounding the mountain. Suddenly a giant beetle jumped out at us! It was huge and scary. We ran very fast until we were safe. Then we realized we were lost. We didn't have any caffeine so we were tired. We ate everything in our bags. We decided to go home and try again tomorrow. We didn't find the treasure, but we didn't get eaten either.

It was February and my dog Buster was bored. He simply wanted to go outside and play. I grabbed his red leash and we ran to the park. Buster saw a squirrel and started bumping into my leg. He was jumping up and down like a kangaroo!

"Stop coaching me, Buster!" I said. "We are going!"

We walked to the big tree by the lake. It looked like a tiny island. Suddenly, a single bird flew out of the branches. Buster started groaning because he wanted to catch it. Then he found a stick and chewed on it for a long time. It was growing dark, so we had to go home.

"You reign as the king of sticks," I told him.

He wagged his tail eight times. I think that means he was happy to receive a compliment.

My friends and I went into the scary woods. We believed there was a monster, so we walked slowly. Suddenly, the wind blew hard and scattered leaves everywhere.

"Look at the height of that cave!" yelled Timmy.

We saw a big metal chain on the ground. It looked heavy and old. Timmy threw a rock inside. Then something roared loud! I almost fainted because I was so scared. We ran fast but Timmy sat down to tie his shoe.

"Run, Timmy!" I screamed.

We escaped just in time. Later we discovered it wasn't a monster. It was just a grumpy bear who drank too much caffeine soda. We laughed all the way home.

The big race was today and I felt like a nervous gnat. I had to run fast to get the gold treasure. It was a hot day but a nice breeze came. My friend Tim said, "You are going to be a total failure."

I grumbled at him and told him to listen. "I will run fast like gravity pulls things down."

The coach blew the whistle and everyone started screaming. I ran so fast I thought I was in heaven. I did not stop for the water fountain. My legs felt like roasted marshmallows but I had to complete the race.

I saw the finish line and I did a big squeeze. I crossed the line first and felt very important. Science class is boring but winning is the best.

I was boating on the lake and saw a green light. It came from the sky and struck the water hard. My boat turned over and I sank a little bit. I swam to the shore and I was scared. A robot climbed out of the water and looked at me. It was trembling and sparks flew out of its head.

"Do you know where I am?" the robot asked me.

"You are on Earth," I said.

The robot threw a rock and it turned into a gnat. I discovered the robot had magic powers! It brewed a potion in a cup. I was loading my backpack to run away. But then the robot smiled and flew back into space.

I sat on the couch with my controller. I was playing the hardest level in Super Smash Bros. My brother Kevin was moaning because he was losing badly.

"You are cheating!" Kevin screamed at the ceiling.

I stuck out my tongue and laughed at him. I discovered a secret move that roasted his character. He neared the edge of the scene and fell off.

"Game over!" the announcer said.

My thumb was stinging because I fought so hard. A blue vein popped out on my hand. I won every single round.

"I want a rematch right now," Kevin said.

I smiled and pressed the start button again. I knew I would win the next game too.

I was outside exploring for an hour with my dog. His name is Rex and he is the greatest dog ever. We walked to the old shed where the chain link fence stood. Rex started barking at a little creature in the grass. It wasn't a ghost, but it looked scary.

"What is that thing, Rex?" I asked him quietly.

Rex just bounced around and grinned at me. It was a frog! I touched its back and it felt slimy. Rex acted like a brave knight protecting me. We were hungry so we went back inside for lunch. Mom made us toasted cheese sandwiches.

"That was a pleasant walk," I told Mom.

The radio sang a song while we ate. Our adventure wasn't a failure at all. We are loading up the wagon to go back out now!

I reached into my bag and I felt something squishy. My lunch was totally crushed! The apple sauce pouch had twisted open. It was dumping goop all over my math homework. I feared Mrs. Baker would be mad.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "My sandwich looks like earth!"

My friend Tommy saw the mess and he laughed. He tried to squeeze his juice box but nothing came out.

"Maybe you need caffeine," he joked.

I cleaned it up and my heart was pumping fast. I found a shiny rock in my pocket. It looked like a jewel. I was so pleased. I decided to seize the day anyway. We played tag until recess was over. It was thirteen minutes of fun.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. The weather was hot but we walked fast. We were looking for the secret cave. Suddenly we saw a big bear approaching us! I grabbed Sam’s hand and we ran away. We hid behind a rock very carefully. The bear went away and we were grateful.

We found the cave and went inside. Sam obtained a shiny gold coin from the floor. "Look at this!" shouted Sam. "I guarantee it is pirate treasure," I said.

We went home and brewed some hot chocolate. We toasted some marshmallows too. The fire grew warm and we felt safe. I put the coin in my pocket. I don't have a receipt but it is mine. We are going back tomorrow again. We already packed our bags.

We woke up really early to go exploring in the woods. My uncle was our guide and he brought his nephew, Ben. We walked a long time and looked at the scenery.

Suddenly, the earth shook and Ben started trembling. We fell into a deep hole and got trapped! It was dark and scary down there.

"How do we get out?" asked Ben.

My uncle said, "Don't worry, I have a plan."

He brewed some tea on a little fire and we roasted marshmallows. Then we saw a rope hanging down. A bear was roaming around up top but he didn't see us. We climbed out fast. My uncle found an old receipt in his pocket and drew a map on it. We finally went home safe.

My birthday was approaching and I was so excited. I wanted a big party with my whole baseball league. My dad is the coach, and he loves coaching. We walked to the park to practice hitting the ball.

Then I saw a weird bug on the ground. It was a huge black beetle near the fence. My little sister tried to gnaw on it!

"Stop eating that bug!" I yelled really loud.

"But I’m hungry," my sister said.

My dad turned around and laughed at his silly daughter. To be honest, it was pretty funny. We played baseball until it got dark outside. It was the best birthday practice ever.

I was so excited for the big soccer game today. The weather was freezing, but I put on my warm jersey. My younger brother wanted to come, so he got in the car too. We looked at the schedule, and my game was first.

When we got to the field, my coach greeted us. "Are you ready to win?" he asked me with a smile. I nodded my head and ran onto the grass. The game started, and I ran very fast with the ball. I kicked it hard, and it touched the back of the net! Everyone was cheering loudly for my great goal.

"That was amazing!" my brother yelled from the sideline.

I discovered that scoring goals feels really good. The referee counted the score, and we were winning. My excitement was growing because we were the champions.

I went on a big adventure to the spooky mountain. My friend Sam came too, and he brought his toy elephant. We walked through the dark woods for a long time. Suddenly, the ground started shaking like a drum with a loud rhythm!

"Hold on tight!" I shouted to Sam.

We gripped a big rock near a water fountain. Then we saw a monster that looked like giant scissors! It was scary, but I remembered my karate class. I trained for this exact moment. I did a cool jump, and gravity helped me land.

"Go away, scissor monster!" Sam yelled really loud.

The monster ran away fast. We were safe, so we ate our snacks. It was the best day ever.

My robot named Zork loved to eat metal for breakfast. One day Zork shouted "I want to go to space!" so we jumped straight into his rocket. We flew past the moon and saw a green alien. The alien screeched and dropped a giant needle on our ship. Zork gripped the wheel and we did a bungee jump with a space rope. It was scary but Zork is a champion flyer. We landed on a purple planet and it was very pleasant. I remembered I had a cookie and I gave it to the alien. He scratched his head and looked grateful. I simply love adventures with Zork throughout the galaxy.

My brother Timmy and I were playing in our apartment. We discovered a secret door behind the couch. Inside was a shiny robot hanging from the ceiling! It was bringing us a metal box.

"Is that real treasure?" Timmy asked with big eyes.

The robot dropped the box and made a groaning sound. Then a tiny green alien jumped out. He looked like a colonel from space.

"Unfortunately, the guard is coming!" the alien yelled loudly.

He blew a whistle and the robot started coaching us. We knew we had to hide fast. The alien zapped the door shut with magic. We were safe, but Mom called us for dinner. We promised to keep the secret forever.

One day I was outside by the big oak tree. I saw a weird bug on the ground. It looked hurt and it struggled to walk. Its leg was twisted in a small piece of string. I knew I had to help it.

"Don't worry little bug," I said. "I will save you from danger."

I put my finger down very slowly. The bug climbed up. It felt like I was loading a tiny passenger. I pulled the string off gently. Then the bug opened its wings and flew away fast! It looked like a king starting his reign in the sky.

"Good luck!" I shouted at the bug. Being outside is the best.

I was playing basketball with my brother in the driveway. He is tall and I am short so he usually wins. The sun was hot and toasted my face. He had the ball and was approaching the hoop fast. I jumped up and waved my arms like a crazy person. The ball went through the air but missed the rim.

"Your shot was terrible!" I yelled at him.

He laughed and passed the ball back to me. I dribbled twice and then I shot the ball high. It sank right into the net perfectly.

"I bet you can't do that again," he said.

I tried but I sent the ball into the neighbor's yard. We heard a loud crash like a broken guitar. We ran inside to play video games instead. I like painting pictures on my game better than basketball anyway.

I was walking in the woods and I discovered a robot. He was very rusty and had a big green stain. I was scared but I touched his metal hand. He suddenly grasped my arm and his eyes turned bright blue.

"Do not be afraid of me," the robot said loudly.

I jumped back and bounced off a tree. My heart was beating super fast. The robot stood up gradually and looked at the sky.

"I am in big trouble," he told me sadly.

I treated his rusty arm with some oil from my dad. He smiled at me and I knew the meaning of friendship. Then he flew away into the clouds.

It was my birthday party and we were waiting for cake. My friend Sam was moaning because he was so hungry. He kept groaning loudly.

"I am going to eat the whole thing!" Sam said.

My mom brought out the big chocolate cake with candles. Everyone started singing the happy birthday song to me. I blew out the candles and made a wish. Then I realized Sam grabbed a piece before Mom cut it! He chewed it really fast.

"Sam, you have to wait for a plate!" I yelled.

He just laughed and gripped another piece. My face grew red but then I laughed too. We went outside for a meeting in the treehouse. We were climbing up the ladder when it started snowing. It was freezing outside so we went back in again. We grabbed blankets and watched a movie instead.

I went to my friend Sam's house for a sleepover. We played in the yard and threw a ball around. Sam has a dog and it looks like a little lamb. It is white and fluffy and really cute. We went inside and chose a movie to watch.

"Do you want popcorn?" Sam asked me.

"Yes please!" I said and gave a thumbs up.

Sam's mom bought us candy too. I was feeling very happy. Then we discovered a box of old toys. There was a weird bungee cord thing in there. We tried to stretch it but it snapped back fast! We laughed a lot and ate our snacks. It was the best sleepover ever.

I was walking my robot dog Sparky in the park. Suddenly a green alien landed his ship right on the grass. The alien had a big gold chain on his neck. He looked like a space champion. He touched a button and the door opened.

"I am simply looking for pizza," the alien said.

Sparky started barking and tearing at the alien's shiny boots. The alien laughed and gave Sparky a space treat.

"Is that treat safe enough for him?" I asked.

The alien nodded and Sparky ate it fast. Then the alien cleared his throat and waved goodbye. He was no longer hungry so he flew away like a fast sailor in the sky. I want to go to space too.

I was walking home when I heard a loud thumping noise. It sounded like a giant drum with a weird rhythm. Suddenly, a blue robot swept down from the sky. It had eight shiny arms and one big green eye. I knew it was an alien robot.

"Please help me fix my ship," the robot said. It held out a broken computer part that looked like a jewel.

I took the part and started to wrap it with tape. My dad drinks caffeine when he fixes things, but I just whistled. The robot brewed a purple potion and poured it on the tape.

"You are in my league now," the robot beeped happily. We fixed the ship and it flew away. I saw a tiny dog following it into the clouds.

It was my birthday and we were running around the yard. My dad started singing a funny song about cake. Then my brother tried to catch me but he tripped. He fell on a rock and hurt his thumb.

"Ouch, that really hurts!" he yelled loudly. He was groaning a lot and making faces.

My dad ran over and looked at his hand. He grinned and said, "You will survive, buddy."

But my mom heard something bad. "Was that swearing?" she asked dad.

Dad shook his head fast and said no. We knew it was a lie though. Then we moved inside to wrap my presents. We had to search for the tape everywhere. It was a good day except for the sore thumb.

I was reading a book about weird animals outside. My brother Sam said he saw a pink elephant yesterday. I told him that was impossible and he was wrong. We went to the backyard to look for it anyway. We looked behind the big oak tree and in the bushes.

"Look over there!" Sam yelled loudly.

I saw a gray creature but it was just a squirrel. We walked more and discovered a funny rock that looked like a face.

"Is that the elephant?" I asked him.

Sam laughed and said his imagination was too big. We didn't find an elephant but we found a cool beetle. It was shiny and green and called a June Bug. Mom called us inside because we were in trouble for getting muddy. We didn't care because exploring is fun enough without elephants. I want to look up the beetle on the computer now. I know real bugs are better than fake elephants.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We pretended my room was a big green jungle. We were running around and jumping on my bed. Suddenly, Sam bounced too high and hit the lamp. It crashed onto the floor and broke into pieces.

"Oh no, we are in big trouble," Sam said.

I looked at the broken lamp and felt scared. My mom came in and saw the mess. She frowned but then she saw we were sad.

"It was an accident," I told her quietly.

Mom grinned a little bit and gave us a hug. She was grateful we didn't get hurt by the glass. Then we went out on the balcony to look at the stars. I have trained my dog to sit out there with us. It was the best sleepover ever.

We went camping in the deep, dark woods. My brother Tim wanted to be the champion of exploring. We walked for a long time on a schedule. Suddenly, a big bear appeared behind a tree!

"Run fast!" yelled Tim.

We scrambled up a big rock to get away. It was freezing cold and my hands hurt. The bear looked at us and then crashed through the bushes. It struggled to climb the hill and went away.

"That was scary," I said.

We ran back to the tent. We kept the door closed all night. We were sleeping in our bags, but I was awake. We are not going back there again.

My friend Sam and I went to the woods early. We wanted to find the old bear cave. We walked on the dirt trail for a long time. The path was not cleared and we got scratched.

"I think we are lost," said Sam.

"No, keep going straight," I told him.

Suddenly we saw a big dark hole. It was scary but we walked closer. I heard a loud knock from inside. We were seeing something move in the shadows! It was just a raccoon keeping us company. We laughed and ran home to play on my computer. Next time we will bring a flashlight.

My nephew Ben came over to play video games. We played a racing game on different tracks. I was leading the race, but Ben is really fast. He crashed into a wall, but he kept going.

"You can't beat me!" I yelled at the screen.

"Wait until the last lap!" Ben shouted back.

Suddenly, my car started spinning because I hit a banana. Ben zoomed past me and crossed the finish line. I did not understand how he won. He was already celebrating.

My mom came in holding a newspaper to wrap a present. She saw the screen and smiled. It felt like a foreign country where I always lose. Next time I will pick a better car.

I was playing my favorite video game called Jungle Bungee. You have to save a little white lamb from bad guys. I was jumping on rocks and the bad guys were screaming at me. My brother Tom wanted to play but it was my turn.

"Give me the controller right now!" Tom yelled really loud.

"No way, I am winning this level!" I said back.

Then a giant monster came out and he was chewing on trees. He was huge and he crushed everything. My hands were trembling because I was scared to lose. I threw a big rock at him in the game. The monster fell down and started sleeping. I won the game and did a happy dance! Tom was mad but we ate pizza after.

I woke up early because today was the big quest. My dad drove me and my best friend Sam to the woods. We had a schedule to follow to find the secret treasure. The trees surrounding us looked huge and scary. I gripped my map tight and Sam held the scissors to cut vines.

We walked for a long time and saw a weird cave.
"I think we should go inside," I spoke bravely.
"It looks like a foreign planet in there," Sam said.

Inside it was dark and we saw a shiny old computer. It was glowing green. Suddenly a big spider greeted us! We ran away fast. We did not learn anything but it was fun. We thought we might find gold but we just found bugs. Next time we will bring more company to help us fight.

I love playing basketball in my driveway. I practice often because I want to be a champion. One day my friend Ben came over to play. We played a big game for everything. I jumped high and almost touched the rim.

"Watch out!" Ben shouted as the ball flew away.

The ball hit the garage ceiling with a loud bang. We had to search for it in the bushes. I simply cannot remember where it went. Then I saw it near the old newspaper pile. I grabbed the ball and made a layup. Ben tried to block me but he was too slow.

"You win this time," Ben said sadly.

I felt happy to receive the win. I told him he can learn to be better. We played until it got dark outside.

I was playing my favorite video game against my brother. We were racing fast cars on the space level. I looked at the screen and my car was floating in the air. I believed I could win this time. But then my brother crashed into me really hard.

"Oh no, I am trapped!" I yelled at the TV.

My car was stuck under a big rock. He was keeping the lead and going so fast. I tried to move but I got crushed by a falling spaceship.

"Ha, you got roasted!" my brother said with a laugh.

I was clinging to my controller but it was over. We had a quick meeting on the couch about the next round. I will beat him next time for sure.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. We saw a cool bug with a neat design on its back. It looked like a foreign bug from far away. We went left down the path near the river. I pointed my finger at a big boat. "Look at that boat!" I yelled to Max. Max barked like he understood my meaning.

We were bearing a heavy backpack full of snacks. We saw a squirrel approaching us slowly. It was gradually getting closer to my sandwich. Max growled and the squirrel disappeared up a tree. "That was the greatest adventure," I said. We heard birds singing and walked home steady and slow.

One day I was playing in my room with my robot named Zorg. Zorg is shiny and he has laser eyes that are green. Suddenly an alien ship landed in my backyard and it was scary. The alien was big and purple and he looked very dangerous. I grabbed my laser blaster and Zorg grabbed his shield. We ran outside to fight the bad alien.

"Go away right now or I will blast you!" I yelled loud.

The alien laughed and tried to grab my younger brother. I used my jet boots and I jumped high in the air. It felt like a bungee jump but way faster. I grasped the alien's arm and Zorg zapped him. The alien ran away fast. My mom says I have a big imagination but I know it was real.

My birthday party was going to be awesome. I invited my friends Sam and Leo for a sleepover. Mom made a big chocolate cake.

"Don't touch it until later!" Mom said to me.

I nodded and went straight to my room. Sam and Leo arrived immediately after school. We played video games for a long time. Then we had a meeting in my fort. The fort was just blankets and chairs.

"Let's go look at the cake," Sam whispered.

We walked carefully to the kitchen. The cake was huge. I wanted to squeeze a little icing, but I didn't. We measured the height with a ruler. It was tall! We didn't eat it either. We went back to playing again. Mom was happy we were leaving the cake alone. It was hard to keep my hands steady, but I waited.

I was walking home from school and I saw something weird. A big metal ball crashed right into Mrs. Miller’s garden! It scorched all her pink flowers and made a huge hole. I was scared but I walked closer to look. Suddenly a green door opened and a robot bounced out. He had thirteen glowing eyes and he looked very confused.

"Where is the pizza shop?" the robot shouted at me.

I pointed down the street and tried not to run away. Then he pressed a blue button and turned invisible! He ran right through the fence and disappeared. Maybe he will come back tomorrow for more pizza.

There was a brave knight named Sir Bob. He wanted to go to a secret island to find gold. He took his friend who was a sailor. They sailed for thirteen days and the waves were huge.

"It is a pleasure to meet you, giant crab!" yelled Sir Bob. A big red crab scrambled out of the sand. It started screaming loudly at them.

The sailor wanted to run away but Sir Bob was brave. He used a bungee cord to jump over the crab. The crab was slow and could not catch him. They found a chest with a cool design on it.

"We won the treasure!" said the sailor happily. It was enough gold for everyone. They did not remain there because it was scary. They sailed home under the stars that looked like heaven.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. I held the map and Sam had a big flashlight. Suddenly we heard a loud stamping noise behind a bush.

"I am really scared," whispered Sam.

"Don't worry, I am stronger than a monster," I said.

We walked closer and I touched a big gray rock. But the rock moved! It was not a rock at all. It was a giant bear and it looked angry. We struggled to run away fast. We crashed through the bushes and I got scratched by a branch. We didn't stop for a single second. I thought we were going to get eaten. We ran all the way home and locked the door. We never found the gold but we were safe.

My nephew Sam came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to make a fort in the living room. We used blankets and pillows and jumped on the couch.

"This fort is trapped by gravity!" Sam yelled loudly.

We pretended we were lost in a dark cave. Suddenly, my big dog Buster walked right into the fort. He stole Sam's favorite pillow and ran away fast. We were trembling because the roof started to fall.

"Oh no! The whole thing is falling down!" I screamed.

The blankets gradually slid onto the floor in a pile. My mom brewed some hot cocoa for us later. We built the fort again but made it stronger. Next time we will keep the dog outside.

My dog Buster loves to explore the woods behind our house. Yesterday we walked through the tall green grass. Suddenly Buster stopped and pointed his nose at a bush. He looked like a guard watching a castle. I walked closer gradually to see what it was.

"What is it, Buster?" I whispered to him.

Then a big fat rabbit jumped out and ran fast! Buster barked and chased it, but gravity pulled him down. He tripped on a big root that looked like a vein. The wind blew his big floppy ears back.

"Stop right there!" I shouted at him loudly.

Buster came back and panted like he had too much caffeine. We found an old piece of paper that was a receipt. It was wet and looked like stewed vegetables. We left it there and went home for a snack.

I woke up late and my dad drove me to school fast. It was raining really hard outside though. I had big trouble because I forgot my backpack.

"Oh no, my homework is inside!" I yelled.

My dad said, "Don't worry, we can get it later."

But my math homework was super important to complete. My heart was pumping fast like I was running. I am in soccer training so I run a lot. It felt impossible to do the test without my lucky pencil.

We got to school and ran inside the big doors. Then my dad saw my bag in the back seat. He laughed and gave it to me.

"Have a good day!" he shouted.

I was so happy I didn't forget it. School is okay but recess is better.

Me and my friend Sam went exploring in the woods. We were looking for a secret base. Suddenly we heard a sounding noise coming from a bush.

"What is that?" asked Sam.

I grabbed a big stick and poked through the leaves. A small green creature bounced out! It looked like a frog but it had thirteen eyes. We were thrilled because we found an alien. It started growing bigger and bigger. We ran away fast. We met a man named Colonel Smith in the field. He was teaching his dog tricks.

"Help us, Colonel!" I yelled. "A monster is coming!"

The creature disappeared into the trees. We did learn one thing today. Never poke strange bushes in the woods.

I was playing a racing game on my tablet. The track was straight for a while, but then it got super curvy. It looked impossible to win because my brother had the fastest car. I stood up and leaned closer to the screen.

"You are going to crash," he grumbled at me.

"No way, I am winning this time," I said back.

We fought for first place for eight whole minutes. I struggled with the controls because my fingers were sweating. The excitement was growing inside me like a fountain. Suddenly, my brother’s car crawled to a stop because he ran out of gas! I crossed the finish line.

"I can't believe I lost," he said.

"We can play again tomorrow," I told him happily. I feared I would lose, but I actually won!

I went boating in space with my robot, Zog. We landed on a plain planet with purple grass. A cold breeze hit my face and I got a bad feeling. Suddenly, a big green alien jumped out! It held a shiny metal chain.

"Give me your spaceship!" the alien yelled loudly.

Zog beeped and his eyes glowed red. "No way, mister alien!"

The alien tried to grab us but Zog froze him with ice. We toasted some space marshmallows over the alien's laser gun. Then I wrote in my diary about our win. Being a space hero is the best job ever.

We had art class today and it was crazy. Mrs. Lee told us to design a castle. I wanted to draw a king's reign but I lost my red marker. Everyone was roaming around the room looking for paper.

"Hey, can I use your scissors?" asked Billy.

I gave them to him but then he ran away. He was screaming because he saw a spider. Mrs. Lee had to seize the spider with a cup. She gave Billy a coaching about running with scissors.

"I will never run again!" Billy screamed.

Then we had to write a story about our castle. My hand hurt from drawing so much. It was the best day ever.

We were camping in the woods last weekend. My dog Max escaped his leash and ran away! I ran through the trees and looked everywhere. The woods surrounding us were very dark and scary. Suddenly I heard a loud sneeze behind a bush. I looked and saw a weird creature there. It bounced up and down like a ball.

"Max, stop jumping!" I yelled at him loudly.

He barked and it sounded like he was speaking. Maybe he was speaking a foreign dog language.

"We have to go back to the tent," I said.

We walked back and stared at the tent ceiling. I kept seeing shadows moving outside all night. We did not stick to our sleep schedule at all. Max snored very loud and I was tired.

My heart was pumping fast because the race was starting. I was approaching the finish line in my favorite video game. My friend Sam was right next to me and he pushed a button. His car went super fast and bumped my car into a dangerous wall.

"Hey! That’s not fair!" I yelled at the screen.

"I didn't mean to!" Sam said, but he was laughing.

My car was trapped for a second, but then I got free. We crossed a bridge and I went left to take a shortcut. I could hear ringing in the game because I got a coin. I was hanging onto the controller tight. Suddenly, something weird happened. Sam’s car started moaning and stopped moving. I zoomed past him and I won the race! My reign as the champion was safe for another day.

I thought today was going to be the greatest day ever. It was pizza day for lunch, which has the most protein. I was steering my tray to my table when disaster struck.

My foot twisted on a pencil and I fell. My pizza flew like a weird creature into the air. It landed right on my shirt.

"Oh no!" I grumbled as I looked at the mess.

My friend Sam laughed and said, "That looks like a red monster."

I had to go to the bathroom for cleaning. I remembered I had a extra shirt in my bag. I changed fast and the cool breeze felt nice. I went back to lunch and Sam gave me half his slice.

"You are in the best friend league," I told him.

I closed my eyes and ate it. I did not receive a bad day after all.

I stood on the playground and waited for my turn. The breeze felt nice on my face. My friend Billy stood next to me on the ground.

"I bet I can swing higher than a ghost," he told me.

"No way, ghosts can fly," I said back.

We grabbed the swing chains and started pumping our legs hard. The sun toasted my arms while we went up and up. We neared the top of the swing set bar. It was a happy feeling to be so high up.

Suddenly, the loud whistle blew from Mrs. Baker. It was time to go inside and learn math. We jumped off and landed in the dirt. I found a shiny rock that looked like a jewel. I put it in my pocket for later. Recess is the best part of school.

My cousin had a sleepover for his birthday. My little nephew was there too and he was loud. We played a game on the computer and I won. Then we went outside to play tag in the yard. I ran fast and reached the big tree first.

Suddenly, a big black bug landed on my arm! I froze because I hate bugs. My nephew was stamping his feet and laughing at me.

"Get it off me!" I yelled really loud.

My cousin rose from the grass and brushed it away.

"It is just a beetle," he said to me.

I realized I was safe, so we started running again. We ran down the path leading to the back door. I knew I would win the race this time.

I was wearing my lucky blue jersey for the big race. My heart was pumping super fast like a drum. We were at the park near the camping spot. All the kids were surrounding the start line. I looked at my friend Sam and gave him a thumbs up. He looked nervous but he smiled back at me.

"Ready, set, go!" yelled the coach sounding very loud.

We all ran fast and dust went everywhere. I was yearning to win that shiny gold medal. I kept running and my legs felt heavy. Suddenly I discovered a burst of energy inside me. I ran past Sam and felt light as a feather. I crossed the line and everyone started cheering.

"You did it!" Sam shouted and gave me a high five.

I opened my hand and held the medal tight. I love winning races more than anything.

I had a cheese sandwich for lunch, but I struggled to eat it. The bread was dry and the cheese didn’t spread right. A big crumb fell on my shirt and made a stain. Then my friend Leo sat down next to me.

"Did you know there is a mountain of homework tonight?" Leo asked me.

I froze because I forgot about the math test. I chewed my sandwich fast and ran to the water fountain. I drank some cold water and felt better.

"I have to learn all the times tables!" I yelled.

We went outside and dug in the earth for worms. I put a newspaper on my desk later to study. School is hard but recess is fun.

I was walking in the jungle and I saw a robot. He looked sad because he had lost his red button. The robot grumbled loudly and kicked a rock with anger. I jumped out from behind a tree to help him.

"Do you need some science help?" I asked him nicely.

"Yes please," he said sounding very sad and lonely.

We searched for fourteen minutes until we found the button. It was hiding under a big green leaf in the breeze. The robot scrambled to get it and he smiled huge. Then he gradually disappeared into the sky like magic. I thought it was a dream but I had a screw in my hand. My mom called me inside because I was grounded but I was happy.

I was so excited for recess today. My friends and I have a soccer league, and my team is the best. But first, we had to finish math. My papers were scattered all over my desk. I scrambled to finish the last problem.

"Time for lunch!" said Mrs. Green loudly.

I grabbed my lunchbox and ran outside. I ate my sandwich fast so I could play. We played soccer throughout the whole recess. I was jumping up and down when I scored a goal.

"That wasn't fair!" grumbled my friend Sam.

"It was totally fair," I said back.

Later, we had computer class and then music. I got to play the guitar for eight minutes. I was grateful when the bell rang. It was time to go home and reign as the soccer champion!

I bought a kite for my dog Max. We woke up early because there was a nice breeze. We went to the big hill behind my house. Max ran fast like a knight on a horse. I was his coach, so I started coaching him.

"Run faster, Max! Catch the wind!" I yelled.

Suddenly, a foreign bird appeared from nowhere. It was huge and blue. It flew right at Max and scared him. Max started barking and groaning.

"Come back here!" I shouted at the bird.

The bird sat on a tree branch like it was a balcony. It was just watching us. Max chased it, and I was cheering for him. He especially likes chasing birds. We didn't fly the kite, but we had fun anyway.

We went camping in the woods with my dad. My dog Buster was thrilled and he ran everywhere. Suddenly we heard a weird sound like moaning from a tree. Buster started barking and I got scared of the danger.

"Be quiet Buster!" I yelled at him.

Dad said he would help me see what it was. He started coaching me on how to go up. I climbed the big oak tree but it felt impossible. My arms are not very stronger than my legs.

"Just grab the big branch!" Dad said loudly.

I looked in the hole and saw a baby owl. It was just hungry and wanted its mom. I came down and we watched it fly away later.

My birthday party was at the big park yesterday. My friends greeted me with lots of presents. We played tag and ran up the grassy mountain. Then my dad brought out a big piñata. I gripped the bat hard and swung fast. I missed it and everyone laughed. Then my friend Sam shook the tree branch. The candy fell out like a candy rain! Everyone was cheering and picking up the sweets.

"I got the most candy!" yelled Sam happily.

"No way, I stole the blue ones," I said.

After that, we cleared the table for cake. My mom used scissors to open a box. It was a bungee jumping toy! I thought it was the best day ever. I feared the party would end too soon. But we danced to a cool rhythm until dark.

We landed the spaceship on the rocky ground. It was a new planet and it looked very foreign. My friend Sam looked at his computer screen.

"I don't know if it is safe," Sam said.

"We have to go out and look," I told him.

The air outside was freezing cold. We walked slow and saw a big cave. Inside the cave something was sleeping. It was a giant green monster! Suddenly it woke up and greeted us with a roar.

My heart was pumping so fast. We ran back to the ship.

"Captain, start the engines!" I yelled.

Sam didn't need me to explain. We flew away fast. We were safe but we were scared.

I was standing on my balcony looking at the stars. Suddenly a weird green light appeared in the sky. It spread throughout the clouds and got very bright. A giant spaceship neared the earth and landed in my yard. It made a loud beeping sounding noise. Then a robot walked out and simply waved at me.

"Do not be scared!" the robot screamed loudly.

I closed my eyes because the light was incredible. The robot said his mission was complete and he wanted to reign over the playground.

"You can play on the swings," I told him.

He was happy and we played all night long. It was the best night ever.

I was at school and it was almost lunchtime. My stomach growled like a hungry ghost. I neared the cafeteria and smelled pizza. It was a beautiful smell. I sat down with my friend Sam. Sam is thirteen days older than me.

"Look at this apple," Sam said. He held up a red apple. "It is huge."

I opened my lunchbox and saw a plastic knife. My mom packed it for my leftover steak. I chewed on the steak but it was tough. Then a big wind blew through the open window. It knocked Sam’s apple onto the floor.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "Now you can't eat it."

We looked outside at the little balcony near the gym. We didn't learn much after lunch because we were hungry. I liked seeing the playground though.

My dad was coaching my soccer team today. We had a big game against the Tigers. I was feeling very nervous about it. We ran around roaming the field for a long time. Then my friend Sam kicked the ball hard. It went right past the goalie and into the net! We all cheered and jumped up and down.

After the game, we went to the park. There was a huge water fountain there. My mom spread a blanket on the grass. She brought cupcakes because it was my birthday. Everyone sang to me and I blew out the candles. I had one slice left on my plate. I was certain it was the best day ever. Later I was sleeping at Sam's house for a sleepover. He understood that I needed my teddy bear. We stayed up late talking.

I looked everywhere for my dog Sparky. He ran off when I opened the gate. I searched the whole park for a single hour. I saw a white thing floating in the pond. It was Sparky's toy boat, but no Sparky!

Then I heard a loud bark near the big oak tree. Sparky was trapped under a heavy branch. He was trembling and scared. I held his paw and told him to wait.

"Don't worry Sparky, I will save you!" I yelled.

I pushed the branch and he came running out fast. We went home and my mom sent us inside for dinner. Sparky grew very sleepy and happy.

"You are a good boy," I said.

He is the king and his reign is forever.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. We pretended we were on an important mission for a captain. Buster barked at a squirrel and ran to the left. I followed him and found an old tree stump. It looked like a tiny boat for a sailor mouse.

"Look Buster, we found a secret ship!" I shouted.

Buster sniffed it immediately and wagged his tail fast. We sat there for an hour and ate snacks. Then I heard a knock on the wood. It was a woodpecker tapping a rhythm on a branch. I was a little afraid but Buster was brave. He stared at the bird like he could read its mind. We were a whole league away from home but we found our bearing. We walked back happy and dirty.

My brother and I were playing a racing video game. I picked the red car and he picked the blue one. The race started and my tires scorched the road. I was winning but then I got trapped behind a truck.

"Move out of the way!" I yelled at the screen.

My brother laughed because he passed me on the corner. I scrambled to catch up to him. We were on lap thirteen and it was the last one. Suddenly I saw a power-up and carefully drove into it. It was a freezing ice blast! I used it and his car spun out.

"Oh no, I fainted!" he joked when he crashed.

I crossed the finish line first and won the gold chain. A big smile spread across my face because I am the best racer.

It was my birthday party at the fun park. My friends and I ran to the bouncy island. It was huge and blue. I jumped up and down to the music's rhythm. Then we played a tug of war game. I pulled the rope with all my weight. My hands were trembling because I pulled so hard.

"Come on, pull harder!" yelled my best friend Sam.

We won the game and everyone was cheering for us. Later, my mom brought out the cake.

"Make a big wish," said my mom with a smile.

I was so thrilled to see the chocolate frosting. I gave my mom a big squeeze. We stayed for another hour and played tag. It was the best day ever.

My brother Tim was acting weird on my birthday. He kept looking at the ceiling and sounding nervous. I counted the candles on my cake. There were nine candles but I am ten now!

"Tim, did you eat a candle?" I asked him.

"No, I was just loading the dishwasher," he grumbled.

He was lying because he had blue frosting on his nose. Then I heard a groaning noise coming from the garage. We ran through the kitchen door. My dad was holding a giant paddle for boating!

"Surprise!" Dad yelled. "We are going to the lake!"

It was loud enough to scare the cat. I was so happy about the boat trip. Tim wiped his nose and smiled. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my dog Buster were exploring the backyard. We were looking for bugs under a big rock. Gradually we lifted it up and saw a black beetle. It was clinging to a tiny root. "Look at that incredible bug!" I yelled at Buster. Buster barked and wagged his tail fast. Then a tiny gnat flew into my eye. It gave me a bad feeling. Unfortunately, I dropped the rock and it broke. My mom came outside with a newspaper. She saw the mess and sighed loudly. "You are off your schedule," she told me. Buster escaped under the fence because of gravity or something. We had stewed carrots for dinner as a punishment. I made a sign that said NO BUGS ALLOWED.

I was eating my sandwich when the bell screeched. It was finally time for recess! I grabbed my red ball and flew out the door. My friend Sam was waiting by the slide.

"Do you want to play kickball?" I asked him.

"Yes, but I lost my shoe!" Sam yelled.

He pointed at his foot and it was just a sock. We looked all over the playground earth for it. We looked near the swings and by the big tree. Suddenly, a squirrel ran by and it had something blue. It was the shoe! The squirrel chewed on the laces and then ran away. It escaped up the tree. Sam grew very sad but then the squirrel dropped it. We cleared the dirt off the shoe and Sam put it back on. Then we played a great game of kickball.

I was in my room painting a picture of a lamb. Suddenly I heard a loud boom outside. My mom ran in and she nearly fainted. A giant robot crashed into our backyard and crushed the fence! It looked scorched and it had glowing red eyes.

"What is that thing?" my mom yelled.

"It looks like a space robot!" I shouted back.

The robot reached down with a giant metal hand. I thought it would grab us, but it just wanted my scissors. It used them to gnaw on a piece of metal. Then it threw a crumpled receipt at me. It flew away fast into the sky. It was the weirdest day ever.

I was wearing my new sneakers for school today. We had science class and we made a volcano. My friend Tommy brewed a special red potion. He grasped the bottle too hard and it slipped.

"Watch out!" I screamed as the red lava spilled.

It went all over my shoes and I was mad. My anger grew big like a balloon. The floor looked like a messy jungle. The teacher grabbed some paper towels for the mess.

"You have to learn to be careful," she said.

I kept my shoes on but they were sticky. I wished I was invisible so nobody could see. Tomorrow I will wear my old boots instead. The day was leading to a bad ending.

My cat Fluffy is very lazy but also funny. Yesterday she slept for a long time on the rug. Then she saw a squirrel outside jumping near the fence. The squirrel had a big bushy tail. Fluffy ran to the door and meowed very loud.

"Let me go outside right now!" she seemed to say.

I opened the door and Fluffy ran into the grass. She tried to climb the big oak tree. The squirrel went higher and stuck out its pink tongue. Fluffy waited but the squirrel did not come down. Then my neighbor Mrs. Green appeared over the fence.

"Did your cat catch the squirrel?" she asked me.

"No, her legs aren't longer than the tree," I said.

Fluffy came back inside and I used a comb on her fur. She cleared her throat and purred. Being a hunter is hard work for a cat.

I loved playing soccer, but I feared the big game. The other team looked huge and mean. My friend Sam was the captain of our team. He touched my shoulder and smiled at me.

"Don't get in trouble," Sam said loudly. "Just kick it!"

The whistle blew and the ball flew high up. I ran very fast and pushed past a defender. I was certain I could make a goal. Suddenly, I discovered the ball right at my feet. I kicked it hard into the net! Everyone cheered for me.

"You are going to be in the newspaper!" my mom yelled.

We won the game and got ice cream after. I was so happy we won the big trophy.

One day me and my friend Sam went exploring. We saw a huge mountain and decided to climb it. We walked for a long time and my legs hurt. Suddenly we discovered a dark cave.

"We should go inside," said Sam quietly.

"Okay but be careful," I whispered back.

We crawled inside and it was very dark and scary. Then something touched my shoulder! I jumped up screaming loudly. It was just a big bat that landed near me. Although I was scared, I used all my strength to keep going. We saw a light approaching us fast. It was a dragon! It roasted a marshmallow for us. The dragon was actually nice. A huge weight fell off my shoulders. We ate the yummy treat and then ran home fast.

I was running late for school this morning. My alarm clock didn't make a ringing sound at all. I ate my toast super fast and almost choked. My mom yelled, "You need more caffeine or something!" I sprinted to the bus stop but I missed it.

My dad had to drive me in his big truck. He drove like a race car driver leading the pack. We screeched into the parking lot right at eight o'clock. I saw my friend Timmy by the slide. He was dressed up like a knight for the play.

"Did you finish the math homework?" Timmy asked me.

"No, my dog crushed it with his paws," I said.

Then the bell rang and we ran inside. A thread on my shirt got caught on the door. I escaped just in time before the teacher saw me. Being late is the worst thing ever.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday and it was freezing outside. We were meeting at the park for a big party. I grasped my present tight because it was important. It was a toy robot with a really big brain.

"Look out!" yelled Sam. He was jumping on the ice.

Then he threw a snowball straight at my face. I ran fast but I crashed into a tree. The toy robot fell and broke into pieces. I was so sad but Sam kept laughing.

"Are you okay?" asked my mom.

I picked up the pieces. We fixed it with glue later. It was still the greatest robot ever.

My friends and I climbed the big hill behind school. It was the greatest adventure ever. We were looking for the lost pirate cave.

"Be quiet," whispered Ben. "I hear something groaning inside."

We walked carefully into the dark hole. I was trembling because it was scary. We turned on our flashlights and saw a pile of rocks.

Suddenly, the ground started shaking and bumping. It felt like a giant was dumping rocks on us! A big stone fell and crushed my backpack. The weight was heavy.

"Run!" I shouted. "We need to get out now!"

We ran fast and escaped the scene just in time. My dad taught me to be brave, but I was scared. That night I slept with the light on keeping me safe. I understand now that caves are dangerous.

On Wednesday, my friends came over for a big sleepover. We ate pancakes for breakfast, but then we got bored.

"Let's play hide and seek!" yelled my friend Sam.

We ran throughout the house to find good spots. I hid under my bed, though it was dusty. I pulled my legs in tight so nobody saw me. It felt like I waited for hours. Gradually, I heard footsteps coming closer. I was a little scared.

"I found you!" Sam shouted and grabbed my foot.

I grumbled because I wanted to win. The weight of my blanket made it hard to get out. Later, we did a search for snacks in the kitchen. We found cookies light as a feather. We looked out the window at the scenery. It was dark outside. I love sleepovers, but I still need to learn how to hide better.

It was my birthday and I had a sleepover. My friends came over bearing lots of presents for me. We ate pizza and it was super yummy. Then my dad toasted some marshmallows on the fire outside.

Suddenly my friend Tom dropped his marshmallow in the dirt. He started moaning because he was feeling very sad.

"Don't worry, Tom," my dad said. "I have more."

Then we discovered a weird creature near the wood pile. It looked like a big frog with leather skin.

"Look at that thing jump!" yelled Sarah loudly.

It jumped like it was on a bungee cord. We tried to learn if frogs like marshmallows. It didn't eat it so we went inside to sleep. It was the best birthday ever.

I had a sleepover with my best friend Sam. We stayed up very late and played lots of games. My mom made us popcorn and it tasted wonderful. Sam wanted to be the king of the castle.

"I will reign over this pillow fort!" Sam shouted loudly.

I shook my head and laughed at him. We pretended different things until we got really tired.

"Are you sleeping yet?" I whispered to Sam in the dark.

He did not answer because he was already asleep. In the morning my dad made us a big breakfast. I was so pleased seeing pancakes on the table. I ate so much that my tummy grew big. I even saw a blue vein pop out on my arm! It was the best sleepover ever.

For my birthday sleepover, we decided to do a science experiment in the kitchen. My friend Sam twisted the cap off the soda bottle really fast.

"Watch out or it will explode!" I yelled.

But he didn't listen and he threw the Mentos in. The soda flew everywhere and it scorched my mom's favorite rug on the ground. Sticky brown stuff was clinging to the cabinets and went through the hallway.

My mom came in and she grumbled about the mess. She stewed for a minute and her face got red.

"That is enough soda for one lifetime," she said.

I drew a sorry picture for her later so I wouldn't get a grounding. We cleaned it up but the rug still smells like grape soda. Next time we will just eat cake.

My birthday party was almost perfect, but then everything went wrong. We were playing outside, and I was trying to seize the flag. Suddenly, I heard screaming from the kitchen. My mom spilled hot coffee, and she needed caffeine badly. She dropped the whole pot, and it looked like a brown fountain!

"Oh no, the floor is scorched!" my brother yelled.

My mom was moaning because her foot hurt a lot. Everyone started cleaning up the mess with towels. I saw a piece of thread floating in the puddle. It was a huge mountain of wet paper towels.

"Don't worry, we can fix it," I said nicely.

We cleaned it all up, and then we ate cake. It was a crazy birthday, but we still had fun.

It was raining so we had inside recess today. I hate inside recess because you have to remain in your seat. My teacher Mrs. Miller said the weather was too bad for the playground.

"Can we play Hangman?" I asked her.

"Sure, but do not be too loud," she said.

My friend Sam had a bag of roasted peanuts for a snack. He said they have lots of protein. I saw a tiny spider hanging from the ceiling on a thread. It looked like it was floating in the air.

"Look out for that spider!" I yelled. "It's in danger!"

Sam tried to save it but he fell over his chair. It was funny though. I think saving bugs is important but Mrs. Miller did not think so. She just told us to sit down again.

I was sitting in math class and feeling very hungry. Mrs. Green was talking about shapes, but I wasn't listening. My tummy made a loud noise like a drum rhythm.

"Is that a monster?" my friend Billy whispered to me.

"No, it's just my stomach," I whispered back.

Finally the bell rang and everyone scattered through the door. I ran to the cafeteria because I needed protein. I opened my lunchbox and saw a big blue vein in my cheese stick. It looked gross, though I ate it anyway. Then Billy screamed because he found a gummy worm in his sandwich. It looked like a tiny bungee cord.

"That is enough playing!" the lunch lady yelled at us.

We ate fast so we could go outside for recess. It was a pretty good day.

One day me and my dog Buster were exploring the woods. We were looking for pirate treasure by the old creek. Buster started running fast and I ran after him. He stopped at a big rock and started digging.

"What is it boy?" I asked him.

He kept digging and made a funny groaning noise. Then he pulled something out and I grabbed it. It was just an old shoe covered in mud. I felt anger but then I started laughing.

"Oh man, I thought it was gold!" I said.

Suddenly Buster froze and looked at the bushes. We heard a low moaning sound like a ghost. I turned around and realized it was just the wind. We left the shoe and walked home. My heavy breathing slowed down. Gravity pulled my tired legs but I felt certain we would find gold next time.

Yesterday was the hottest day ever at school. The sun scorched the playground and it felt like fire. We went outside for recess but everyone just stood still.

"I think the gravity is heavier today," said my friend Billy.

I nodded and wiped my sweaty face. "I am bearing the heat badly," I told him.

We looked at the scenery but the grass was brown. Suddenly a big wind swept across the yard. It felt so good and cleared the hot air away. We were so grateful for the cool breeze. Then the bell rang and we lost our recess time. We walked back inside slowly. I hope tomorrow is colder.

My friend Tommy came over for some company after school. We went straight to my room to play a wrestling game. I picked the giant guy who looked like a mountain. Tommy picked a skinny guy who was super fast.

"You're going down!" I grinned at him.

"No way, I practiced all week," Tommy said back.

We started mashing buttons and my guy was jumping everywhere. Suddenly my mom yelled from the balcony outside my window. We heard her say dinner was ready. I froze for a second. Tommy used that second to body slam me to the ground! My character fainted and lost all his health. I was so roasted by him.

"That wasn't fair!" I yelled, but we just laughed.

Next time I am not listening to anyone while playing. We had enough gaming anyway so we went to eat.

I rode my robot dog Sparky to the moon. We followed a long trail of space dust. Suddenly a green alien jumped out and grabbed me! He was moaning because his tummy hurt bad.

"Help me please!" the alien cried loudly.

I saw he was caught in a trap meant for bears. I used my laser eyes to break the trap. The alien fell to the ground and smiled. He was a space sailor lost in the stars.

"I am so grateful for your help," he said.

We saw a big spaceship approaching fast. It was his mom! I was happy to learn aliens have moms too. I promised not to do any swearing even though I was scared. Sparky barked and we flew home for dinner.

My dog Buster is the champion of chewing things. He chewed my mom's shoes and my dad's hat. One day we went exploring outside in the woods. The wind blew hard and Buster ran away fast.

"Buster! Come back here!" I yelled very loud.

He disappeared behind a big tree near the creek. I ran after him and I discovered a secret cave. It looked like a foreign land inside there. Buster was digging in the earth and he found a bone.

"Look what I found!" I said to Buster.

We cleared the dirt off a shiny rock too. It looked like a science experiment from school. A bird landed on a branch and watched our meeting. We walked home after fourteen minutes because it started raining. Buster thinks he owns the woods like a king's reign.

My nephew Max has the greatest superpower ever. He can talk to squirrels in the backyard. One day, a spaceship crashed right behind our neighbor’s fence. A green alien walked out and grinned at us. He was the same height as me.

"Do not fear," the alien said in a weird voice. "I am just looking for a snack."

Max saw a squirrel trying to gnaw on a sign. He sprinted over and threw a nut at the squirrel. The squirrel chattered and ran to the alien. The alien ate the nut and felt a cool breeze.

"This is good food," the alien said happily.

We were seeing a real alien eat a nut! I was certain nobody would believe us. Max just smiled and waved goodbye as the ship left.

We went to the spooky forest because we were brave. My dog Max is trained to find treasure. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound under the ground.

"What was that scary noise?" I screamed loudly.

Max started jumping and stamping his paws on the dirt. He found a rusty chain and we pulled it hard. A big door opened and we saw gold scattered everywhere. But then the floor sank and we fell down deep. I was hungry and I ate a crumb of my sandwich. Max crushed a bug and then we heard ringing. A ghost appeared and tried to knock us over!

"Run away fast Max!" I yelled at him.

We obtained a gold coin and climbed out quickly. We were safe but we never went back there again.

My cat Fluffy is really funny and likes to jump. Yesterday my mom sent me outside to play for an hour. I decided to do a science test with Fluffy in the garden. I wanted to see her jump high like she was on a bungee cord. Fluffy is big so her weight is heavy. She was moaning a little bit at me.

"Come on Fluffy, jump over this log!" I yelled.

She just looked at me like I was speaking a foreign language. Then I led her to the tree. Suddenly she started to sneeze very loud. Leaves were scattered everywhere on the ground. Dad was loading the car and he saw us.

"Did you receive a scratch?" he asked me.

"No, we are just playing," I said. Fluffy ran inside to sleep.

My dog Barnaby is a very naughty boy sometimes. One day he chewed up my dad’s newspaper. He left little white pieces all over the rug.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "Dad will be mad."

Barnaby looked sad and he was trembling a little bit. I wanted to wrap him in a blanket. But then I saw something else. He had a metal chain in his mouth! It was stuck on his collar.

I ran to get the scissors but they didn't work. I had to wait for my mom. She came home right on schedule.

"Don't worry," she said. "I guarantee we can fix it."

We pulled it straight and it popped off. Barnaby wagged his tail like a little lamb. He is a beautiful dog, even when he eats trash. I will always remember not to leave stuff on the floor. He was just waiting for a snack!

It was my birthday and my friends came over for a sleepover. We rode our bikes around the block very fast. The breeze felt nice on my face. Then we went inside to open presents. My friend Sam brought me a big box. I used scissors to cut the paper off. Inside was a squishy alien from earth! I tried to squeeze it really hard. Suddenly the alien disappeared from my hand.
