It fell on the floor and bounced high.

"Where did it go?" Sam asked me.

"I think it went under the couch!" I screamed.

We looked everywhere but we couldn't find it. Then my dog ran in with the alien in his mouth. We all laughed so much. It was the best birthday ever.

I was playing the greatest soccer game ever on Saturday. My team is called the Rockets and we were winning. But then my nephew came onto the field wearing a ghost costume. He just appeared out of nowhere and started running around! The referee blew his whistle very loud and stopped the game. Everyone was looking at the white sheet hanging off him.

"Get off the field right now!" I yelled with anger.

"But I want to play too," he said while groaning.

He tripped and landed right in a big mud puddle. Now his plain white costume had a giant brown stain. It looked like he was a dirty ghost from a foreign land. My coach laughed and walked him back to his mom. That is what happened at my big game.

I live in a big apartment near my school. One day I was doing my homework at the kitchen table. My dog Buster chewed on my pencil and it broke.

"Hey, stop that right now!" I called to him.

Buster ran away and hid under the sofa. I opened my backpack to get a new pencil. I found an old receipt and a sticky candy wrapper inside. Just then I heard a loud noise. Something crashed in the other room!

I ran to see what happened. Buster knocked over my mom's favorite vase. He looked trapped in the corner like a scared guard.

"Oh no, you are in big trouble," I said.

My mom came home and saw the mess. She pointed a finger at the broken pieces. I knew a grounding was beginning for poor Buster. He looked sad, but he ate his dinner anyway. It was beef that was stewed all day.

Me and my best friend Ben went exploring early in the morning. We were in the woods behind my house swinging sticks. We pretended the sticks were swords. Suddenly, we heard a weird noise. It sounded like singing but it was spooky. I was scared.

"Did you hear that?" Ben asked me.

"Yes, let's go check it out," I said.

We walked deeper into the dark trees. We found an old metal box on the ground. It looked like a science experiment gone wrong. I struck the lock with a rock. Inside, there was just a crumpled receipt and some rusty scissors. We were yearning for gold, but it was just trash!

Then a big dog barked loudly behind us. We sprinted all the way home very fast.

Max and I were playing knight in the backyard. We were running to the big hill behind my house. It looked like a giant mountain. We started climbing up the rocks very fast.

"Watch out for the dragon!" I yelled loudly.

Max nodded and held up his stick sword. We heard a loud thumping sound. It sounded like big feet stamping on the ground.

"I think the dragon is already here," said Max.

We neared the top of the hill carefully. There was no dragon though. It was just my dog Buster. He was jumping around.

"To be honest, I was scared," I said.

We laughed and then we ran back down. We found a cool rock and talked about the meaning of bravery. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods today. The weather was sunny and hot so we walked slow. We found a big hollow log near the creek.

"Look at that scary hole," I said to Buster.

Buster barked and treated the log like a monster. He tried to squeeze inside but he was too fat. I carefully looked in and saw something shiny. It looked like a lost jewel but it was just glass. Then a squirrel broke a stick and we jumped.

"Let's go home now," I whispered to Buster.

He agreed and acted like my guide back home. We were tired but happy after our meeting with the log. My mom brewed some tea and I thought about our adventure.

I was boating in space with my robot nephew named Beep. We saw a big gray building floating near the moon. Suddenly a green alien appeared on the ceiling of our ship! He looked very foreign and strange with three eyes. I was scared but Beep was brave. The alien was bearing a shiny red box.

"Do not fear me," the alien said loudly.

"We understand," said Beep. "What is growing in that box?"

The alien opened it and a blue flower was inside. We knew it was magic because it glowed. We landed on the dusty ground. I had a yearning to touch the flower. An army was approaching us but the flower made a shield. We were safe and happy.

I was walking near the mountain behind my house. I often go there to look for cool rocks. I spread out my blanket on the grass. Suddenly I saw a shiny blue thing. It looked like a big jewel. I picked it up but then a bird screeched loudly!

"Put that down right now!" my brother yelled. He ran over to the scene.

I was scared so I fell backward. I almost crushed the blue thing.

"To be honest, that is just an egg," he said.

We knew we had to be careful. We left it alone throughout the day. Later, my mom bought us ice cream because we were nice to nature. It was enough ice cream for everyone.

My sister Clara is always getting into big trouble. Last Saturday was her birthday and she wanted a princess party. Mom made a cake that looked like a pink castle. But then Clara twisted her ankle running in the yard. She fell down near the water fountain and started groaning.

"My leg hurts so bad!" she yelled loudly.

Mom ran over and called my dad to come help. Clara’s hair was trapped in the rose bush too. Dad had to use a comb to get it out. He turned to me and said, "This is a messy birthday."

It looked like gravity pulled her down really hard. Later she sat on the couch holding her stuffed lamb. She ate cake with ice on her foot. She was okay but the party was definitely over.

I was playing a really important basketball game today. My team is the Tigers and we were bearing down on the other team. We needed earning just two more points to win. I had the ball and I was moving fast.

"Pass it to me now!" screamed my friend Leo.

I saw a big guard in front of me. I did a cool spin move and touched the net. I shot the ball and it went right in! The buzzer screeched really loud. We won the game and everyone was stamping their feet.

"That was amazing!" called my coach, speaking very loudly.

I felt so pleased with myself. It was enough to make me happy all day. I ran to get my scissors to cut the net down. My day was complete.

Yesterday was a very weird day at school. We were playing kickball at recess and I obtained the big red ball. My neighbor Joey was on my team and he looked very pleased. I knew I had to kick it super hard. I ran up and kicked the ball and it flew high up.

"Wow, that is going to heaven!" yelled Joey.

But then the ball crashed right into Mrs. Miller’s window. The glass broke and everyone stopped moving. Mrs. Miller came outside and she looked mad. I thought I might have fainted right there.

"Who did this?" she asked us in a loud voice.

I guarantee I was scared, but I raised my hand. She actually smiled and said it was an accident. I was so happy I didn't get in trouble.

My dog Max loves exploring the woods behind our house. Yesterday we went outside together to find some cool bugs for science class. Max greeted a big squirrel and he barked very loud. The squirrel ran away fast but Max chased it.

"Max, stop!" I yelled, but he did not listen to me.

He ran into some tall bushes that were growing near a creek. Suddenly he cried because there was danger in the bushes. A stinging bee bit his nose! Max ran back to me and I saw a big red bump.

"Oh no, poor Max," I said and hugged him tight.

We escaped the woods and went home to my mom. She said we did not need a hospital but Max needed ice. I drew a picture of us and Max felt better soon.

Tim and I woke up early to explore the forest. We walked for a long time and followed a tiny path. Suddenly, the wind blew hard and it got very dark. We realized we were lost in the deep woods.

"Look at that cave!" I shouted to Tim.

We ran inside because big wolves were surrounding us. Tim was scared, but I started coaching him to be brave. We made a small fire and roasted marshmallows. I thought we were safe, but then we heard a growl. It was just a baby bear who wanted food. We gave him some treats and he was happy. We waited until morning and then ran all the way home. Mom stewed apples for breakfast and we felt safe again.

My neighbor Tim and I went to the scary woods. We wanted to find the secret gold. I brought a big stick and Tim brought his computer. He said it could measure how far we walked. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping sound behind a big tree.

"What is the meaning of that noise?" I asked.

Tim shook with fear and he dropped his bag.

"I think it is a bear!" Tim spoke quietly.

We saw a big shadow and we wanted to run. But then a small bunny hopped out. We laughed very hard. I tried to seize the bunny but it was too fast. We did not find gold but we had fun.

I thought the big green alien was friendly. He walked through the wall of my bedroom. He had four arms and blue slime on his face. I was trembling because he looked scary.

"I need some company," the alien said loudly.

My heart was pumping fast in my chest. I hid under my blankets and was clinging to my teddy bear. The alien zapped my toy robot with a laser. The robot started dancing and beeping.

"Do not be trapped in fear," the robot beeped.

I felt anger because he broke my favorite toy. I threw my pillow at the alien's big head. He laughed and then he flew out the window. It was the weirdest night ever.

My friends and I went into the dark woods. We were looking for the old pirate cave. We walked through the tall trees and it was scary. I held my stuffed lamb tight because I was nervous.

Then we saw a light inside a big rock.

"Are you certain we should go in?" asked Tim.

"Yes, we have to find the treasure," I said.

Inside the cave was very dark and wet. We lit our flashlights and saw something white. It looked like a ghost but it was just a sheet! A sailor left it there a long time ago. We found a box surrounding a big pile of gold coins. We paid for ice cream for everyone later!

Yesterday was the weirdest day at school ever. Mrs. Green said we were learning about animals, but then she scrambled onto her desk. She made a loud trumpet noise like an elephant and simply stared at us.

"Is she okay?" whispered Tommy to me.

"Maybe she has pneumonia or something," I whispered back.

Then Mrs. Green jumped down and grabbed some scissors. She cut a picture of a bear and threw it in the air. We went to recess and played a game about camping. Tommy pretended he roasted a marshmallow on a stick. Suddenly, we heard a moaning sound from the balcony above the playground. It was Mrs. Green again! She dropped a heavy weight on the ground.

"I brewed a magic potion!" she yelled down at us.

School is crazy sometimes, but at least lunch was pizza.

I walked into class and felt very scared. I remembered that my big math homework was due today. I looked in my backpack but I did not see it. Anger brewed in my tummy because I worked hard on it.

"Where is my homework?" I asked my friend Sam.

"Maybe you left it on the bus," said Sam.

I sat at my desk and stewed about it. It was important to complete this work for Mr. Jones. Then Mr. Jones came over to my desk smiling. He was bringing a paper from his big messy desk.

"You gave this to me yesterday," he said happily.

I was so happy I almost jumped up. I forgot that I already turned it in! Now I could go play kickball at recess.

My cousin had a birthday party on Saturday. We spent an hour pumping up lots of blue balloons. Then we started loading the snacks onto the big table. My little nephew was running around and jumping on the couch.

Suddenly, the lights went out and it was super dark!

"Is that a ghost?" I whispered to my best friend.

"No, it's just my dad!" shouted my cousin.

Her dad appeared with a big cake with candles on it. He was leading everyone in singing Happy Birthday really loud. We realized the lights were off for the candles. My cousin blew them all out in one big breath. We were very pleased to eat cake and roasted marshmallows. I was so happy I landed a huge piece with a flower.

I was sitting at the computer doing my science homework. My neighbor came over with his little nephew. They wanted to show me a picture from their camping trip. I dropped my juice box and it made a huge stain. It looked like a big purple blob on the plain rug.

"Oh no! My mom will start screaming!" I yelled.

My neighbor said, "Don't worry, we can clean it up."

We used a newspaper to soak up the mess. Then my mom appeared at the door. Her face turned red and a vein popped out. I did a quick search for cleaning tips. We scrubbed it hard and the spot went away. I was so happy I finished my homework.

I brought my new toy car to school today. It is the greatest car ever because it is bright red. But Mrs. Miller told me to put it away. I grumbled a little bit but I did it. At recess, I took it out to the slide. The slide is not straight. It is twisted like a snake. I wanted to see my car go down fast.

"Watch this!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked over and smiled at me. I let go of the car. It zoomed down but then it flew off! It hit the ground hard. I ran over and looked at it. The wheel was crushed. I was so sad. That was enough playing for today. I put the broken car in my pocket.

I trained really hard for the big soccer game today. My legs were trembling a little bit because I was nervous. The other team looked huge and scary like giants. I looked up and saw a bird floating in the sky. Then the referee blew the whistle and the game started!

I ran fast and jumped over a muddy puddle. My friend Sam kicked the ball right to my foot. I saw the goal and knew everything depended on me. I kicked it super hard with my big toe.

"Did it go in?" Sam yelled loudly from behind me.

"Yes! We won!" I screamed and pointed a finger at the net.

We discovered that we were the best team in the building. Seeing the scoreboard change made me so happy. It was even more fun than boating or video games.

I had a really hard math test today. I struggled with the subtraction part because it seemed impossible. I kept chewing on my pencil and groaning quietly.

"Do you know the answer?" whispered my friend Sam.

"No, I think I did it wrong," I said back.

The teacher looked at us so I stopped talking fast. At recess we ran outside and played a camping game. We crawled under the slide like it was a tent. Sam threw a ball and pretending to be coaching a big team. Even though the test was bad, recess was super fun. Later the teacher explained the math again and I finally understood it. I won't get in trouble next time.

My dog Buster is weird and likes eating everything. One day we went camping in the woods surrounding our house. It was getting dark and my dad started a fire. We put marshmallows on sticks and got them all roasted and toasted. Suddenly Buster barked at a bush. It was a weird sounding noise.

"Is it a ghost?" I asked my dad.

"No, ghosts are not real," my dad spoke softly.

We looked closer and saw a tiny squirrel. It had a little vein on its ear. Buster just wanted some company. The squirrel ran away fast. I had to wrap my blanket around me because it was cold. The most important thing was that Buster was safe. We ate our snacks and went to sleep in the tent.

I had a big science test today and I was scared. My heart was beating really fast like a drum. I sat at my desk and pulled out my pencil. My teacher Mrs. Lee smiled at me.

"Just do your best," she said.

I looked at the paper and I saw thirteen questions. I didn't understand everything at first. But then I took a deep breath. I kept my hand steady and started writing. I looked out the window at the scenery for a minute. The trees were moving in the wind. I believed I could do it.

"I am finished!" I told Mrs. Lee.

She took my paper and gave me a star. I felt very happy.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating down the river. The weather was sunny and hot. We saw a big green meadow with cows roaming around. Sam chewed on some gum and looked at a map.

"We need to find the greatest treasure ever," Sam said.

We rowed hard and my arms hurt. I ate a protein bar for energy. Suddenly we saw a dark cave. A scary bear greeted us with a roar!

"We are going to be a failure!" I yelled.

But the bear just wanted to show us his painting on the wall. He brewed some tea for us. We didn't know bears could write or paint either! It was the best day. We left the cave happy.

The robot named Zog landed in my backyard early today. He was shiny and silver and he grew very tall. I followed him to the swings, but he just beeped. Suddenly, a weird green light appeared in the sky. It neared us very fast and I was scared of the danger.

"Look out for the alien ship!" I yelled loudly.

Zog started singing a funny song in a foreign language. The song sounded like beeps and boops. He shot a laser and the green ship flew away.

"Do you want some caffeine?" I asked the robot.

He shook his head and flew back to space. I hope he comes back tomorrow to play.

I was playing my favorite video game about space. My character appeared on a big red planet. I had to jump over a huge hole with low gravity. It was super hard and I kept falling in.

"Oh no, I lost again!" I yelled at the TV.

My brother walked through the door and grinned at me. He picked up the other controller to help. We fought the aliens surrounding us. Suddenly my character got hurt and started crawling. I was moaning because I had no health left.

"Use the magic water!" my brother shouted.

I found a glowing fountain and drank from it. I stopped groaning and jumped up high. We won the level and I was yearning to play the next one. It was the best game ever.

One day I was eating a plain sandwich in my backyard. Suddenly a green ship flew down from the sky. It landed on the grass and the door opened gradually. An alien walked out and he looked incredible! He had three eyes and purple skin.

"Hello earth boy," the alien greeted me.

"Are you real? That is impossible!" I screamed.

He held up a shiny ray gun and shot a tree. The leaves got scorched and smelled like stewed tomatoes. I was scared but then he smiled.

"I need to explain something," he said. "I am late for a meeting on Mars."

He gave me a robot dog and then he left. The robot dog can fly and do my homework. It was the best day ever.

I woke up early because my dog Barky licked my face. He slept on my bed all night keeping me warm. I looked outside and saw the sun coming up. It was going to be a good day for exploring.

"Come on Barky let’s go to the woods," I called.

We ran to the trees surrounding our backyard. The ground was wet but we didn't care. Suddenly I saw a small bunny near a bush. It looked scared although it didn't run away.

"Look at the baby rabbit," I whispered to Barky.

Barky greeted the bunny with a small woof. I wanted to squeeze it but I knew I shouldn't touch it. My mom always says wild animals are stronger than they look. We watched it hop away bringing a smile to my face. Then we went home to tell my mom and her daughter, my sister, about our adventure.

I walked into my room and turned on the big TV. The loading screen was super slow, but finally, the game started. My character was exploring a new planet called Super Earth. I discovered a giant cave, and it looked very dangerous inside. Suddenly, a huge monster that looked like a blue elephant ran out!

"Oh no, I am going to be crushed!" I yelled.

My friend Sam grabbed his controller and joined the game quickly. We shot lasers, but neither of us could hit it. The monster swept its big trunk and hit my guy. I lost almost all my health points. I feared we were going to lose the whole level.

"Aim for the red vein on its leg!" Sam shouted.

I grew brave and ran close to the beast approaching me. I blasted the leg, and we won the battle just in time.

I woke up early because the sun lit my room. My dog Buster wanted to go outside. We pushed the back door open and ran to the woods. The grass was growing very tall there.

Buster started to dig near a big oak tree. He found a strange wooden box! I opened it and discovered a shiny silver whistle inside.

"What is that?" asked my little sister, who followed us.

"It looks like a magic whistle," I said.

I blew the whistle and a blue bird flew down. It landed right on the box. The bird sang a happy song. It was a sign that we made a new friend. I gave the bird some seeds from my pocket. We were grateful for our fun adventure.

It was my birthday sleepover and my friends came over. We were jumping on my bed and making lots of noise. My mom came in and told us to be quiet.

"Stop stamping your feet!" she said. "Start cleaning this room right now."

We crawled under the bed to hide from her. It was like a secret cave with blankets hanging down. We fought over who would be the leader. Then we decided leading was too hard so we just played monsters.

"I will seize you!" yelled my friend Ben.

We crushed some chips on the floor by accident. The game was complete when my dad brought in pizza. He said he almost sold our pizza to the neighbors! We laughed and ate the whole thing.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. We found a big stick for building a fort. Buster ran fast and his ears flew back. We stopped to eat lunch on a big rock.

"This is the best spot," I said to Buster.

He barked and wagged his tail really hard. We ate sandwiches and pretended we roasted marshmallows. The sun felt warm and spread all over us. Suddenly, a squirrel struck a pose on a branch nearby. Buster chased it but the squirrel won the race easily. By the time we got home, I was so tired. Mom had dinner ready and the carrots stewed in the pot. We toasted bread and ate it all up. Exploring makes you very hungry!

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old cave. It was dark and cold inside and I was feeling scared. Sam had a flashlight and he walked in first. We walked for a long time and saw thirteen big bats.

Suddenly a loud noise screeched from deep in the dark cave.

"What was that noise?" I asked Sam very quietly.

"I think it is a ghost sailor!" Sam whispered back.

We ran fast and I heard a ringing sound behind us. My foot got caught on a rusty metal chain on the ground. I fell down hard but kept clinging to my backpack. We scrambled out and did not stop running until we got home. We are never going back there again.

We were playing the best video game ever. It is called Super Mega Jump. My friend Sam was swinging his controller around like crazy.

"I am going to win this time!" yelled Sam.

"No way, I am jumping over the fire pit," I said.

My character did a cool bungee move and cleared the big wall. Sam’s guy fell in a hole and disappeared. But then the screen went black. The power went out for a whole hour!

We left the room and found a soccer ball outside. We tried to knock down some empty cans. It was actually really fun.

"Maybe we don't need the game," Sam said.

Then the lights came back on inside. We ran back inside super fast to finish the level.

One day my dog Spot and I went to the big mountain. We wanted to climb to the very top. The forest surrounding us was very green and quiet. Spot was running fast but I shouted, "Wait for me Spot!"

He stopped and wagged his tail at me. We walked up the path for a long time. Suddenly we heard a loud noise sounding like thunder. A big rock crashed down and crushed a small bush. I was scared but Spot was brave. I gave him a thumbs up.

"Good boy Spot," I said. He is in training to be a super dog. We ate our sandwiches and then we walked home happy.

I woke up late and ate my breakfast really fast. My mom made oatmeal but it looked brewed and gross. I ran to school and my backpack felt like a huge weight.

In math class, Mrs. Green gave us a worksheet. It looked impossible to finish before recess. I tried to squeeze my pencil hard to write faster.

"Did you remember your homework?" asked my friend Sam.

"Oh no! I threw it on my bed!" I said.

Then the bell rang for recess. We went outside and found a bird feather on the grass. We looked through the fence at the big kids playing baseball in their league. It was a good day even though I forgot my math. Finding a feather is lucky like finding a needle in a haystack.

Everyone got their bags ready for our big camping trip. We wanted to find the lost pirate treasure. My friend Tim wore his thick blue sweater. It was very cold and windy outside today. We hiked for an hour through the dark woods.

"Look at that big cave!" I shouted loudly.

We went inside, but unfortunately it was very scary. Suddenly we heard a loud stamping noise behind us. It sounded like a giant bear was angry. We started screaming and ran out fast.

"That was not on the schedule!" Tim said.

To be honest, we were too scared to go back. We did not find the treasure, but we were safe. Next time we will bring the colonel to help us!

It was my birthday and I woke up super early. I jumped out of bed and ran downstairs. My mom was cooking bacon and it smelled good. She searched for the big knife to cut the cake later. Suddenly the oven made a loud pop and smoke flew out! I was scared because the toast looked scorched and black.

"Oh no, I meant to watch it!" Mom yelled.

I laughed and opened the window. A cool breeze blew inside and the smoke went away. Then we heard a loud knock on the door. It was my best friend Sam for the party.

"Are you sleeping or eating?" Sam asked me.

We ate the bacon but we did not eat the burnt toast. It was the best birthday ever even with the smoke.

I was playing baseball at the park near the big meadow. It was the last inning and my team was losing. My hands gripped the bat really tight because I was scared. The scenery was nice with green grass and blue sky.

"You can do it, Tommy!" yelled my friend Sam.

I knew I had to hit the ball really far. The pitcher threw the ball super fast at me. I swung with every single bit of my strength. Crack! The ball went flying over the fence gradually.

"Run! Run fast!" shouted my coach from the dugout.

I ran around the bases and stepped on home plate. We won the game and everyone was cheering loudly. Later my mom said I didn't need to do any cleaning tonight. It was the best day ever.

We were walking in the dark woods. There were eight of us on the quest. My backpack had a heavy weight inside it. We neared the old castle on the hill.

"Look out!" yelled Timmy. "Something is approaching!"

A giant bear was bearing down on us fast. It looked like the greatest danger ever. I grabbed my sword quickly. The fear grew in my tummy. Timmy caught a rock and threw it hard. The bear stopped and looked at some stewed meat we were loading earlier. It just wanted the food!

"Let’s run away now," I whispered to Timmy.

We ran fast until the castle was far away. The bear’s reign of terror was over for us. We were safe and happy again.

Yesterday my friends and I found a twisted path in the woods. It looked spooky and dark but we had big imaginations. I put on my red sweater because it was cold.

"This is an important quest!" said my friend Leo loudly.

We walked for a long time and ate snacks for breakfast. Suddenly we saw a big bush with thorns like sharp scissors. My foot got stuck and I struggled to pull it out. My heart was pumping fast in my chest.

"Help me!" I started screaming.

Leo grabbed my arm and pulled really hard. I popped out and fell on the grass. We were safe but we ran home fast. Adventures are scary but also really fun.

We were going camping at the greatest lake ever. My dog Sparky bounced around the car while we were loading it. He loves seeing trees and chasing bugs. Dad said, "We are taking the big boat today." I grinned because boating is super fun.

We drove through the woods and then through a big gate. Sparky barked at a squirrel, but keeping him quiet was impossible. He is not very well trained. When we got to the water, I pretended to reign over the lake like a king.

"Do you want to fish or swim?" Mom asked me.

"I don't want to do either," I said. "I want to explore!" So we hiked deep into the forest instead. Sparky found a big stick and looked so happy. It was the best day.

I was dreaming about marshmallows for my big sleepover. My neighbor Sam came over and brought his weird dog. We went to the backyard and started a fire. I feared the fire was too hot but it was okay. We roasted huge marshmallows on long sticks. 

"Watch out, the dog is approaching!" Sam yelled loud.

The dog ran fast and crushed my perfect marshmallow. I struggled to get the sticky stuff off the dog's nose. Then we went up to the balcony to look at stars. We heard water sounding like a fountain from the hose.

"Why is your dad following us?" I asked Sam.

Sam laughed and said his dad just wanted a marshmallow too. It was the best sleepover ever.

I had to complete my big map project for homework. It was about a foreign country called Brazil. I grasped my blue marker and colored the ocean. The scenery was mostly green because of the jungle.

"Are you done yet?" my little brother asked. He was pumping his fist in the air.

"No, I need to draw the river," I said.

Then we went outside for a break. My brother started screaming because he saw a bug. I grinned at him. Neither of us liked bugs very much. We ran back inside fast. I finished my map and it looked good. I hope I get a gold star tomorrow.

I was in art class and it was freezing inside. Mrs. Miller said we had to make a painting of an animal. I decided to paint a big blue whale. I drew the outline first and then grabbed the paint. Suddenly Timmy crashed into my table while walking by.

"Hey! Watch where you are going!" I screamed loudly.

"Sorry, I didn't see you there," Timmy said.

My water cup fell over and blue water went everywhere. It splashed on the floor and even hit the ceiling. It was impossible to clean up all the mess. I scratched my head and didn't know what to do. The kids surrounding us started laughing. I felt a sneeze coming and blew my nose. I did not remain happy, but Mrs. Miller helped me clean. Next time I will sit far away from Timmy.

I have a robot named Zork and he is made of metal. One day Zork was loading the dishwasher and he made a loud beep. Suddenly he flew up and hit the ceiling with a big crash!

"Help me down!" yelled Zork while clinging to the light.

I grabbed my mom’s big scissors to cut his wire but I stopped. I touched his foot and counted to three. Then we floated out the window together. We escaped into the clouds and saw a giant purple alien ship. The aliens were eating stewed carrots and toasted bread.

"Do you want some?" asked a green alien with three eyes.

We ate lunch and then flew back home before dinner.

My nephew Tim and I went exploring in the woods. We knew it was dangerous but we felt brave. Suddenly we heard a loud breathing sound near a cave.

"Stay steady, Tim," I whispered to him quietly.

We saw a big bear approaching us very slowly. It looked like a foreign monster from a movie. We realized we had roasted marshmallows in our pockets! The bear wanted the treats and not us. I threw the marshmallows and the bear disappeared into the dark cave.

"You are a champion!" yelled my neighbor Tim happily.

We ran home fast because it was important to be safe. I will always remember that scary day.

I was playing a video game about space throughout the night. My character was roaming around a big red planet. Suddenly a huge monster with single eye jumped out! It looked like a floating rock but it had sharp teeth.

"Watch out for the fire!" yelled my brother Sam.

The monster scorched the ground and threw hot lava everywhere. I used my jetpack and rode the wind away fast. It felt like I was on a bungee cord. Then I got a power-up called Protein Punch.

"Now you can receive the mega sword!" Sam shouted.

I cut the monster like scissors and I touched the treasure. It was raining gold coins on the screen. I won the level and saved the game.

Yesterday at school was the weirdest day ever. We were learning about space and the **earth** in science class. My teacher Mrs. Gable said we had to **measure** gravity’s **weight**. I was really **yearning** for lunch because I was super hungry. 

"Make sure you look **carefully** at the numbers," said Mrs. Gable.

Then we went to the **computer** lab to type our reports. I typed a story about a **colonel** looking for buried **treasure**. Suddenly, I heard loud **stamping** noises **through** the wall. It sounded like a giant was on the **balcony** outside! But it was just the gym teacher jumping around. 

At lunch, I ate a big sandwich for **protein**. 

"Did you hear that big noise?" asked my friend Sam.

"Yeah, I thought it was a dinosaur," I laughed. It was a funny day.

I was afraid of my math homework last night. It looked like a giant mountain of numbers and problems. I sat at my desk and I just stared at it. My mom came in and she saw me looking sad.

"What is wrong?" she asked me.

"I am bumping into trouble with these problems," I said.

She sat down and she helped me. We wrote the answers down fast. I felt grateful for her help. The next day, my dad drove me to school. A cool breeze hit my face when I got out. At lunch, they served weird soup that looked stewed for too long. I saw my friend dumping his soup in the trash.

"It smells like they brewed old socks," he laughed.

I was keeping my sandwich safe in my lunchbox instead. It was a good day because I finished my work. The feeling of growing smarter is the best.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday party at the park. He is small but he likes big rides. We were approaching the huge bungee jump machine. I felt nervous because Sam wanted me to go first.

"You can do it!" Sam yelled loudly.

"Okay, I will try," I said back to him.

The man put the harness on me and checked my weight. I could see a blue vein popping on my arm. My dad was coaching me on how to jump high. I knew I had to be brave for Sam. I jumped up and down really fast. Everyone started cheering for me. It was the best birthday ever.

Yesterday at recess I played with my friend Sam. We pretended the playground was a giant green jungle. Sam was the colonel of the army and I was a tiger. I grew very big and roared at him. He ran away fast although he tripped on a rock. He crashed into the wood chips but he didn't cry.

"Use your strength to get up!" I yelled loudly.

"I am okay because I am tough," Sam said back.

Then a bee came and was stinging his leg. It hurt a lot so we went to the nurse. She gave him ice and he chewed on some gum. It was a scary recess but we still had fun.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old house. It looked scary but we were brave explorers. We had a flashlight and big scissors to cut the vines.

We walked for an hour inside the dusty rooms. Suddenly, we heard a weird rhythm on the floor.

"Did you hear that noise?" I asked Sam.

"Yes, it sounds like a ghost walking!" Sam called back.

We turned the corner and saw a shiny box. I opened it and saw a bright red jewel inside. But then the floor broke! We almost fell into a dark hole. We ran away fast. Later, we met my mom and showed her the jewel. It was just a piece of glass wrapped in old newspaper. We laughed and ate cookies.

I was sitting in math class and I was so bored. My teacher Mrs. Miller started talking about fractions again. I looked out the window and saw a big bird. It moved through the air like a superhero on an adventure.

"Please listen to the lesson," said Mrs. Miller loudly.

I stopped looking outside and opened my notebook to design a cool fort. It was going to be on a mountain. My friend Sam leaned over and whispered to me.

"Are we going to play tag at recess?" he asked.

"Yes, we can run together by the swings," I whispered back.

Then the bell rang and we ran through the door. I almost tripped but I caught my balance. Recess is the best part of the day because there is no grounding or homework. We played until we were sweaty and tired.

My cat Toby loves climbing trees in our yard. He is very brave and wants an adventure. Yesterday, I saw him yearning to jump on a high branch. He gripped the bark with his claws and pulled himself up. Suddenly, a strong wind started tearing through the leaves. Toby looked scared and gravity pulled him down fast!

"Help me!" I yelled to my dad.

He ran outside and caught Toby just in time. Toby was okay, but his leg looked a bit hurt. We took him to the animal hospital to be safe. The vet said he will get stronger soon.

"No more big trees for you," I told Toby.

He just purred and went to sleep.

One day a big green alien landed in my yard. His spaceship was twisted and smoking. He had only a single purple eye and three arms. I walked up to him and poked him with my finger.

"Do you remember where you came from?" I asked him.

The alien tried to speak but he just let out a giant sneeze! Green slime went everywhere. Then he pressed a button and turned into a shiny knight.

"I am lost and I need a bungee cord," the alien knight said.

I ran to the garage and found a bungee cord for him. He fixed his ship and flew away through the clouds. Everyone in my family missed seeing him, but I saw him wave goodbye.

It was my birthday and I turned eight years old. My mom said we were going on a trip. We got in the car and rode for a long time. Then we saw water and got on a big boat. The boat led us to a beautiful island. We ran to the beach and started jumping in the waves.

"Look at that big crab!" my sister yelled loudly.
"It is trying to pinch you!" I shouted back.

We built a huge sandcastle with a moat. It was complete when we added a shell on top. Then we followed a path to get ice cream. Everything tasted so good and sweet. Suddenly we heard a loud knock on a wooden sign. A monkey jumped down and stole my dad’s hat! That is what happened on my best birthday ever.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house. My dog Rex was roaming around and sniffing trees. Suddenly he barked loud and ran to the creek. I ran after him and looked in the water. Something was floating there like a big green leaf.

"What is that, Rex?" I asked him quietly.

Rex did not know and neither did I. It was a giant frog on a log! Then a snake appeared on the bank. I got scared so I threw a rock. The rock sank fast but the snake stayed.

"Let's go home now," I said to Rex.

We ran back and found eight cool sticks. I used scissors to cut off the leaves later. My mom heard me and said no swearing when I hurt my finger. But I didn't say a bad word! It was a good adventure.

My robot friend Zorp was sitting on the ground. He was wearing a big green hat. It looked silly on his shiny metal head. I was reading a book about space. Zorp grumbled because he was bored. He tried to pick up a tiny needle. He used his giant metal thumb. It was too hard for him.

"I can't do it!" Zorp yelled loudly.

"You have to learn to be slow," I said.

Then he tried to wrap a thread around it. He did it too fast though. The thread snapped and Zorp looked sad. Suddenly, a magic fountain appeared in the yard. The water was freezing cold and purple. We jumped in and turned into aliens!

It was raining very hard at recess today. We had to stay inside the gym and it was super loud. My friend Tom was bumping into everyone because he was running too fast.

"Stop running or the teacher will get mad!" I yelled at him.

He didn’t listen and he almost knocked over a big stack of mats. Our teacher Mr. Green grabbed Tom’s arm gently.

"Running is for outside, Tom," Mr. Green said. "Inside is for growing your brain with puzzles."

Tom looked sad but he sat down. I obtained a puzzle from the box and we started loading the pieces together. It was actually fun. Mr. Green was coaching us on where the corner pieces went. Being safe is important but puzzles are cool too.

One day my dog Buster and I went exploring near the river. We were pretending to be explorers on a big boating trip. Suddenly, a big brown rabbit appeared near a bush.

"Look at that bunny, Buster!" I whispered very quietly.

Buster saw the rabbit and started trembling because he was so excited. The rabbit was digging in the soft earth. Then Buster sprinted right at it! The rabbit got scared and started jumping away fast. I saw a dark storm cloud approaching us from the sky. It started dumping rain on our heads. I had to wrap my coat around Buster.

"We need a knight to save us from this rain!" I yelled.

We ran all the way home and got warm inside. It was a crazy adventure.

I believed my cat Fluffy was a real tiger. He scratched the big tree in our backyard today. He gripped the bark and climbed way up high. I yelled at him to come down quickly.

"Come down, Fluffy! You are too high!" I screeched.

Fluffy did not listen and went higher though. He gradually moved to a big branch and sat. He looked pleased with himself up there. He closed his eyes and spread his paws out.

"Fine, stay there. We are meeting for dinner soon," I said.

Suddenly, a squirrel crashed through the leaves above him. Fluffy got scared and jumped down fast. He ran inside for no reason at all. I guess he likes keeping safe inside the house. I laughed throughout the whole night about it.

I was walking in the woods with my dog. His name is Rex and he runs very fast. We walked for an hour and saw a big sign. It said do not enter but we went anyway. Suddenly a beautiful deer appeared behind a tree. Rex barked loudly and started tearing through the bushes.

"Stop Rex!" I yelled at him.

He did not listen and crashed into a pile of leaves. Although he was dirty, he looked happy. I saw a blue bird and it was my guide. We followed it home immediately.

"That was fun," I said to Rex.

I was thrilled to be home. Mom gave us cookies.

Sam and I were steering our boat down the river. We had done lots of training for this important trip. I felt like a real sailor.

"Look at that big rock!" Sam yelled suddenly.

We were approaching a dark cave. It looked dangerous. We went inside together because we are brave. It was very dark though.

"I wish we had some company," I whispered.

Then we heard a loud buzzing sound. A giant beetle flew right at us! I swatted it away fast.

We found a treasure chest on the sand. We opened it and found golden coins. I had a yearning for a snack. We made a fire and ate toasted marshmallows. I thought it was the best day ever.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house. My dog Rex was following me and sniffing everything. We walked through the tall grass and it touched my knees. Suddenly a big hole appeared in the ground.

"Look out Rex, that could be dangerous," I said.

Rex started barking loud and his tail was pumping fast. I knew something was hiding down in the dark hole. Maybe it was a badger or a fox. My heart beat fast like I was in trouble.

"Let's go home now," I whispered to Rex.

We ran back and saw leaves spreading everywhere. The wind grew very strong and was tearing branches down. I ran inside to my computer and sent a message to my friend. I told him we saw a monster hole.

My robot friend Zip was roaming the woods with me. He was wearing his favorite blue sweater because he gets cold easily. Suddenly, we saw a strange purple fog spread through the trees.

"That looks like danger," said Zip, his red eyes blinking fast.

I pulled out the magic jewel from my pocket. It started glowing bright green and leading us to a cave. Inside, a giant alien was brewing a potion in a big pot. He was swinging a huge spoon around and making noises.

"Hey! Stop brewing that!" I yelled at the green alien.

He looked scared and dropped the spoon. I spent the next hour coaching him on how to make soup instead. The alien was actually really nice.

The alien robot escaped from the big spaceship yesterday. He was green and he had six shiny metal arms. I saw him when I was painting a picture in my yard. The robot moved fast and scorched the green grass with his feet. I looked at him and I had a weird feeling. He looked scary but he didn't have enough power.

"Do you need a battery?" I asked him loudly.

"Yes, I need energy now," the robot said.

I ran inside and got some AA batteries for him. He ate them and his eyes turned bright blue. We fought bad guys together later but then I fainted. I knew meeting a robot would be super cool.

My best friend Ben came over for a sleepover. We played in the backyard until the sun went down. The ground was cold but we didn't care.

"Let's pretend we are knights!" Ben yelled loudly.

I grinned and grabbed a stick from the grass. We ran through the trees and looked at the scenery. Suddenly the wind blew a cold breeze. I got a little scared because it was dark. Then Ben screamed because he saw a big shadow.

"It is a dragon!" he shouted at me.

But it was just my dad seeing if we were okay. Everyone laughed. We remembered the snacks inside. Although it was fun outside, we went in. The reign of the knights was over for the night. Our movie was beginning so we grew happy again.

One day me and my dog Buster discovered a secret path. We walked through the woods and saw a beautiful blue bird. The bird was swinging on a branch like a tiny jewel. Buster barked loudly at the bird and scared it away.

"You are in big trouble now, Buster," I said.

Then we saw smoke coming from a scorched tree stump. It looked like a fire started but then it grew smaller. We ran to get help but then we saw a squirrel. The squirrel looked hurt so we made a tiny animal hospital.

"I guarantee he is just hungry," my mom said later.

She gave him a nut and he ran away fast. It was a crazy scene but we saved the day.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring behind the old barn. We saw a cave that looked different than before. It was super dark inside and had a weird smell. We walked in and saw a shiny gold vein in the rock. Suddenly a big rock fell down and we were trapped!

"Push with all your strength!" I yelled at Leo.

We pushed hard but the rock was heavy. The height of the cave was small so we had to crouch. We heard a loud scratchy noise outside. It meant someone was coming to help us.

"Is everyone okay in there?" shouted my dad.

He moved the rock and saved us. We ran home fast.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. I was wearing my blue boots and Max was running fast. We found a small pond that looked like a fountain. The water was very clear and had fish in it.

"Look at that shiny rock!" I shouted at Max.

It looked like a jewel, but it was just glass. We sat down to eat our snack. My mom packed nuts because they have protein. Max looked at my sandwich and he grumbled. He wanted a bite but I gave him a treat.

"Stop begging, Max," I said and held up my thumb.

We saw a weird plant growing near a tree. It was a cool height, almost as tall as me! I know a lot about science so I looked close. Max started to complain and barked at a squirrel. We cleared the leaves and then walked home.

I hated math class today because Mrs. Jones was grumpy. She wrote the schedule on the board and it was long. I feared that we would miss recess. Then suddenly the fire alarm screeched very loud. We all heard it and covered our ears tightly.

"Everyone line up at the door right now!" Mrs. Jones yelled.

We walked outside and saw a big red truck. My friend Tommy threw a rock at the grass. He struggled to stay still because he was excited.

"Is the school going to the hospital?" Tommy asked me.

I laughed and told him schools don't go to hospitals. A bad smell brewed in the air like burnt toast. It struck me that maybe someone burned their lunch. We waited outside for a long time. It was way better than doing math problems.

On Wednesday I played my favorite video game. It is about a brave knight named Sir Jump. He has to find a big gold treasure. The bad guys are very dangerous and scary. I trained for a long time to beat this level.

My little brother sat next to me and watched. He kept speaking very loudly.

"You are going to lose!" he yelled at me.

"Be quiet or you have to leave," I said back.

Sir Jump fell into a hole and was trapped. My heart sank because I almost lost. But then I used a magic rope to wrap around a rock. I pulled him up and we won!

"I do not understand how you did that," my brother said.

It felt like a huge weight was off my shoulders. I am the best gamer ever.

My dog Buster is the best dog ever. Yesterday we went exploring in the big woods behind my house. We were running fast and following a tiny squirrel. The squirrel sprinted up a huge oak tree.

"Come back down!" I yelled at the squirrel.

Buster barked because he wanted to catch it. He started climbing the tree but he slid down. The tree had a big twisted root that looked like a vein. I saw something shiny hung on a branch. It was a silver knight toy! I grabbed it.

"Look Buster, we found treasure," I said.

Buster wagged his tail fast. We didn't receive any treats but the toy was enough. I treated Buster to a big hug for being good. The only reason we went home was because it got dark. We can find more treasure tomorrow.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. We had science class and my neighbor Tim made a mess. We were learning about frogs and how high they are jumping. Tim opened the box and a big green frog jumped out!

"Catch him before he eats my lunch!" yelled Mrs. Green.

Everyone started running around the room. It was not wonderful scenery. The frog hopped on a desk and then it discovered a window.

"I will complete the mission," said Tim bravely.

He grabbed the frog, but it felt slimy and foreign. He put it back in the box fast. After that, we went to recess and played tag. It was much better than chasing frogs inside. I hope tomorrow is a normal day.

My brother Tim and I played video games together. We played a game about climbing a big mountain. My character was a robot carrying a heavy weight. I used my imagination to pretend I was really there.

"Hurry up, Tim!" I yelled at the TV.

"I am trying but my fingers hurt!" he said.

We were leading the race, but the bad guys were fast. Suddenly, a loud ringing noise started sounding from the game. It was the final boss! I needed to seize the controller tight. We jumped over the monster and won the level.

I was very pleased with our score. It was enough points to get the gold trophy. We high-fived and then we ate pizza for dinner. It was the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam were roaming in the woods. We wore our favorite sweaters because it was cold. Suddenly we saw a dark cave. We heard a weird moaning sound coming from inside.

"I am scared," Sam whispered to me.

"Do not worry, we are brave explorers," I said.

We walked through the dark tunnel. Something was hanging from the ceiling. It was a bat singing a squeaky song! Then we saw a monster at the meeting spot. It screamed at us loudly! It was thirteen feet in height. We ran away fast. We escaped the cave just in time. My mom was teaching us not to go there. Next time I will just drink juice, not caffeine, and stay home.

I was playing my new video game called Dragon Quest. My character was roaming around a dark cave. Suddenly I discovered a big red dragon sleeping on a pile of gold. I tried to sneak past him but I stepped on a stick. The dragon woke up and started moaning very loud. He brewed a giant fireball in his mouth.

"Watch out for the fire!" my brother yelled at me.

I sprinted away as fast as I could on the screen. My character struggled to climb a tall wall. The dragon was screaming and chasing me. I saw a shiny blue jewel at the top. I grabbed it and won the level!

"You actually beat it!" my brother said.

I was so happy I did a victory dance.

My robot Max lived in our apartment with me. He was made of shiny metal and grinned all the time. One day, a green alien stole my favorite painting! I feared I would never see it again.

"Let's go on an adventure!" Max beeped loudly.

We searched the whole city for the alien's ship. We neared a park and saw a glowing light. The alien was sleeping on a bench. Max walked over with steady steps. He greeted the alien and woke him up.

"Please give it back," I said nicely.

The alien believed us and gave the painting back. I was so happy I almost crushed Max in a hug. Max is teaching me how to fly his rocket tomorrow!

I was feeling very hungry before lunch today. My stomach felt like a creature was trying to gnaw on it. I looked at the clock and counted thirteen minutes left. Mrs. Miller was cleaning the whiteboard and we were just sitting there. I saw my friend Tim hanging upside down on his chair.

"Sit up, Tim, or you will fall," I whispered.

"I am the champion of hanging," he said back.

Suddenly he fell down with a loud crash. He looked like a ghost because his face was so white. He was clinging to the desk leg. The whole class laughed but Mrs. Miller did not laugh. Then the bell rang for lunch and we all ran outside fast.

I woke up with a weird feeling in my tummy. My friend Tim came over and we went into the woods. We walked through the big trees and found a cave. It was dark but we had flashlights. 

"Look at that shiny rock!" Tim yelled loudly.

We ran to it but a big bear blocked us. It roared and we got scared. Tim bounced up and down.

"We need to run fast!" I said to him.

We swam across the little river to get away. The bear stopped at the water and did not follow. We were keeping safe on the other side. We sat down and ate eight cookies. I wrote about our adventure in my notebook. We pretended to reign over the forest like kings.

I was playing my favorite video game against my older brother. He is fourteen and thinks he is the best gamer ever. The loading screen took forever, and I was feeling nervous. My younger sister sat next to me and was coaching me.

"Watch out for the traps!" she yelled loudly.

I moved my character through the dark, scary tunnel. Suddenly, a big enemy colonel jumped out with a sword. I started swinging my controller around like crazy. My character fought hard throughout the whole battle.

"You can do it!" my brother shouted, actually helping me.

I finally crossed the finish line and won the level. I thought I was trapped, but I escaped just in time. It was eight o'clock, so we had to stop playing. I felt so happy that I finally beat that hard part.

I walked outside and it was freezing cold today. My dog Max walked with me to the big park. We saw thirteen ducks floating on the pond. Max barked at them but they didn't care.

"Be quiet Max!" I said to him loudly.

Max wagged his tail and ran to the dirt pile. A big truck was dumping sand there. The man was loading more sand into a wheelbarrow.

"That looks heavy," the man said to us.

Max chose to dig a hole near the sand. Suddenly a little mole appeared from the ground! Max tried to seize it but he was too slow. The mole gradually went back down into the dirt. It was important that Max didn't hurt it. We were grateful to see a wild animal. We didn't hear either of my parents calling us for dinner. It was a good day.

My best friend Sam and I heard a noise. It was the greatest mystery in our backyard. We walked to the big tree and looked up. I was certain something was hiding there.

"Do you think we are in trouble?" Sam asked.

Suddenly, a squirrel jumped down like a bungee jumper! I screamed so loud my brain hurt. Sam started screaming too. We ran fast, but the squirrel chased us throughout the yard. I saw a big blue vein pop out on Sam's neck.

"Run faster or we won't receive our snacks!" I yelled.

We made it inside bringing lots of mud. Mom grinned at us. We were earning our dessert today for sure. Being brave is hard work!

Yesterday was the greatest day ever at school. We were playing tag at recess and bumping into everything. Then I saw something shiny in the grass. It was a giant green beetle leading a line of ants.

"Look at that huge bug!" I shouted to Sam.

Sam ran over and he grinned really big. "It looks like a monster!" he said.

We watched the beetle crawl over a pine needle. It seemed impossible for a bug to be that strong. We almost lost it in the tall grass. I feared the bell would ring soon. But we won the game of tag anyway. I hope I can see the beetle again tomorrow.

I was camping in the woods with my big brother. We walked far away from the tent to find sticks. Suddenly I discovered a shiny metal door in a rock. I pushed it open and saw a weird scene. Inside was a robot sitting on a chair! The robot looked sad and held a glowing sword. I realized he was a robot knight.

"Can you help me?" the robot asked with a beep.

"Yes I can help you climb out," I said.

We scrambled up the rocks and got him out. But then my brother caught us. He looked at the robot and his mouth opened wide. It was very important to keep the robot secret but now he knew. The robot knight bowed and gave me a high five. Then he flew away into the sky with fire on his feet.

I discovered a green alien in my backyard yesterday. He was scratching his big purple head and looked lost. He made a moaning sound like a sick cow.

"Are you from heaven?" I asked him quietly.

The alien shook his head and his belly started thumping. He pointed at my mom's garden and looked yearning. I gave him a toasted sandwich and he ate the complete thing. It was a pleasant surprise that he liked cheese. Then he started swearing in alien language because he dropped a crumb.

"Don't complain," I said. "That was my lunch!"

He scratched his ear and jumped back into his spaceship. I waved goodbye as he zoomed away into the clouds.

Me and my neighbor Sam were playing Mario Kart on Saturday. We played for a long time but Sam kept winning every race. I was getting mad because I wanted to be first instead.

"You are cheating!" I yelled at him.

"No I am not, I am just faster," Sam said.

My mom walked through the door and she looked happy. She held up a blue guitar. It was a new controller for a music game! We stopped racing cars and played music. I understood how to play quickly. I hit all the buttons right and my score went higher. It felt like I was pulling a thread of music.

"Wow, you are really good at this," Sam told me.

We played until we got hungry and ate pizza. Then we went outside to the water fountain at the park. Winning felt good.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for a secret castle. Sam had a map but it looked weird. We walked on a dirt trail for a long time. Suddenly we heard a loud noise.

"Did you hear that?" I asked.

Sam nodded and whispered, "Maybe it is a monster roaming around."

We saw a bush shake and something jumped out. It was just a squirrel! We laughed and kept walking. The wind blew hard and it got cold. We found a cave that looked different. I threw a rock inside to see if it was safe. Nothing happened so we went in. It felt like a foreign place.

"I wish we had invisible powers," Sam said.

We did not find a castle but it was good training for next time.

We were loading the big blue car for camping. It was a hot day but I packed my sweater anyway. We drove up a tall mountain. The air got cold and there was a nice breeze.

"Look at that deer!" I screamed.

It was eating grass near our tent. We set up the tent fast because we were behind schedule. Dad made a fire and we roasted marshmallows. I ate three of them even though I was full.

"My marshmallow is burning!" said my little brother.

He dropped it in the dirt. I felt bad for him so I gave him mine. I was feeling happy. We looked at the stars and then went to sleep. It was the best trip already.

I was playing baseball on the big field today. It was a pleasant day but very hot outside. My team is the Tigers and we were losing bad. My friend Sam was clinging to the fence and yelling.

"Hit the ball over the island!" he screamed loud.

I held the heavy bat and waited for the pitch. The ball came fast and sounding like a rocket ship. I swung my bat and I hit it hard! It felt good but my finger hurt a little bit. The ball flew way past the leather glove.

"Run fast before you fell down!" yelled my coach.

I ran to first base and I was safe. We sold lots of tickets so everyone saw me hit. I ate a cookie after and didn't leave a crumb. We won the game!

Me and my friend Sam went into the dark woods. We wanted to find a monster cave for no reason. The scenery was spooky with tall trees swinging in the wind. We crawled under a big log.

Suddenly, we heard a loud ringing noise. It was bumping against the rocks.

"Do you think we will get crushed?" asked Sam.

"No, we have each other for company," I said.

We saw a chest but it was too heavy with weight. We tried to lift it again but failed. Instead of gold, it might contain monster teeth! We heard a screaming sound and ran fast. We were safe at home and happy.

My friends came over for my birthday sleepover yesterday. We were roaming around my room and eating chips. My best friend Sam twisted his ankle on my rug.

"Ow, that hurts a lot!" Sam yelled loudly.

My dad came in and started coaching us on safety. He said walking is important and not running. Then we started dumping all the pillows on the floor. It looked like a giant castle for a king.

"I will reign over this pillow fort!" I shouted.

We played until fourteen minutes past midnight. We stared at the ceiling and told scary stories. I have a dog that is trained but he barked. He jumped on us while we were sleeping. It was the best birthday ever.

I was cleaning my room when I found a glowing rock. It was under my dirty sweater. I picked it up and felt a stinging zap in my hand. Suddenly my brain felt super weird and dizzy.

"What is happening to me?" I yelled loudly.

My arm grew bigger and stronger like a superhero. I struggled to put on my shirt because my muscles were huge. I punched the wall and my hand went right through it!

"This is awesome!" I said to my dog.

The rock brought me superpowers but I have to remain calm. If my mom sees the hole in the wall she will be mad. I hid the rock and pretended to do homework. Being a superhero is hard work.

My teacher Mrs. Bell is nice but she gives hard homework. Today the weather was rainy so we stayed inside for recess. I sat on the rug and played with my new leather ball. I threw it to my friend Sam but he missed it. It rolled under the big desk where the class pet hamster lives.

"That place is dangerous!" Sam yelled loudly.

"Don't be scared," I said. "I can get it."

I crawled under the desk like I was camping in a cave. It was dark and I felt like I was invisible. I found the ball clinging to a dust bunny. I knew I had to complete my mission fast. I grabbed it and ran back out. Then Mrs. Bell started singing the clean-up song so we had to stop. I almost lost my ball again but I put it in my backpack safe.

Yesterday the weather was super hot at recess. It felt like the sun scorched the earth. We started playing tag, but everyone was sweating. My neighbor Billy tripped on a rock.

"Are you okay?" I asked him. He was clinging to his knee.

"I think I scraped it," Billy said.

Just then the bell started ringing so loud. We ran back inside. My teacher Mrs. Green looked mad. A bird had escaped from its cage! It flew around the room like crazy. It chewed on a pencil. Then it landed on my desk. I thought I was in heaven because I love birds.

"What happened here?" asked the principal.

Mrs. Green said her nephew brought the bird for show and tell. It was the best day ever.

My best friend Leo greeted me at the bus stop. We had science class first and it was super hard. We learned about how an island is made. It was boring so I twisted my pencil around. Suddenly I felt a stinging pain in my finger.

"Ouch!" I shouted loudly. "It felt like a sharp needle!"

The teacher looked mad and gave me a warning. I did not want a grounding from my mom. Later at recess we played a game with fourteen kids. Leo has lots of strength and kicked the ball far. We played for longer than usual and it was fun.

"Pass it to me!" yelled Leo, leading the way.

We won the game by eight points. I was grateful when the bell rang for lunch. School is okay but recess is the best part.

I was playing Super Smash Battle on the big TV. My brother greeted me with a loud yell. He grabbed the other controller and sat down fast. We picked the jungle scene because it looked cool. I was a monkey swinging on vines. He was a small green dinosaur on an island.

"I am going to win today!" he shouted.

"No way, I am the real champion," I said back.

My heart was pumping fast in my chest. I got mad and stewed when he hit me. But then my character grew huge and strong. I was growing bigger than the whole screen! I kicked him off the edge. I won the game and did a dance.

It was my birthday and I was so happy. I greeted my friends at the door and we ran inside. We played games on my new computer and ate pizza. Then my mom lit the candles on my big cake.

"Make a wish!" shouted my best friend Sam.

I closed my eyes and blew out the fire. Everyone clapped and we started tearing open the presents. I got a toy elephant and a cool robot beetle. Suddenly, my dog Buster crashed into the table. The cake fell on the floor with a loud thumping sound. My mom cleared up the mess but she grinned at us anyway.

"It's okay, we have ice cream!" she said.

Later we were sleeping in my room in sleeping bags. I used my imagination and pretended we were camping in the woods. It was the best birthday ever.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday last week. We were having a big adventure in the backyard. Dad was reading the newspaper on the porch. Sam and I were climbing the big oak tree. It was fun but then I felt something stinging my arm.

"Ouch! A bee got me!" I yelled really loud.

Dad looked up and started approaching us very fast.

"Come down right now," Dad said. "Are you okay?"

I crawled down through the branches. I pretended I was invisible so the bees couldn't see me. It was not a pleasure at all. Dad ended up coaching me on how to climb down safely. We went inside for cake and it stopped hurting. It was still a good day.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring in the woods. We found a big dark cave behind some bushes. Leo twisted his ankle on a rock, but he kept walking. We walked carefully inside the cave and it was very cold. I remembered I had a sweater in my backpack.

Suddenly, a giant bat flew right at our heads! We both screamed really loud and ran deeper inside. Unfortunately, we hit a dead end and felt trapped.

"Do you see a way out?" I asked Leo.

"Neither of us can fit through that tiny hole," Leo said.

We heard a big sneeze from the dark corner. It was a bear cleaning its fur! We ran out so fast and did not look back. We ran all thirteen blocks home.

The math test today looked impossible. I stared at the paper and my stomach hurt. Mrs. Green said it was important to try our best. I feared I would get a bad grade.

"This looks like a foreign language," I whispered to Sam.

"Just use your imagination," Sam whispered back.

I looked at the numbers again and they crawled around. I tried to learn the steps but I forgot them. The bell rang immediately and everyone jumped up. I sprinted to the teacher’s desk to give it to her. I hope I receive a passing grade tomorrow. Then we went to recess to play tag. It was way better than math class.

My brother Tim is younger than me and loves exploring. We live in an apartment but today we went to the park. The grass was tall like a jungle.

"Look at that bug!" Tim screamed loudly.

I looked down and it was a big green beetle. It appeared from under a rock. I love science class so I knew it was special. Tim tried to touch it but I stopped him.

"Be careful, it might bite you," I said.

Tim started groaning because he wanted to hold it. Suddenly the beetle scrambled away fast. We chased it until it went into a hole. The hole was closed with dirt now.

It was the greatest adventure ever, especially when we found a frog later. My mom said to hold steady or it jumps. We are going back outside tomorrow.

Yesterday at recess was the best day ever. We were climbing on the big red slide. My friend Tim pretended he was a brave sailor on a ship. I was the captain and we were looking for a lost island.

"Look out for the big shark!" yelled Tim.

We jumped off the slide like it was a bungee jump. We ran to the sandbox and built a huge sand castle. A girl named Sarah started following us. She wanted to play too.

"You can be the king's daughter," I said.

She smiled and gave us a crumb of her cookie. Then the bell rang and we had to go inside. I almost fainted because I was so hot and tired. It was a wonderful day because we didn't have any homework.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. We had a really important test in math class. I looked up at the ceiling because I forgot the answer. My hands were trembling a little bit because I was scared. Then the fire alarm struck and made a huge noise!

We all ran outside to the playground. My friend Sam said, "Is there a ghost in the school?"

I laughed and said, "No, ghosts aren't real, Sam."

We ate lunch outside and it was different than normal. I had scrambled eggs in my sandwich. To be honest, it tasted kind of bad. Later, we did art and used scissors to cut paper. It was better than math but I hope we don't have a fire drill tomorrow. Getting a grounding from my teacher for talking would be bad.

I woke up and my robot Zorg was making breakfast. He cooked eggs but he dropped them on the floor. I ate toast instead and then we went to the park.

Suddenly a big green alien spaceship landed on the grass. A slime monster came out and he looked very mean. He held a laser that looked like a shiny knife.

"Give me your robot!" the alien yelled at me.

"No way!" I shouted back and used my superpowers.

I twisted my hands and struck the air with lightning. The alien got scared and he ran back to his ship. He flew away to his home on a space island. I treated Zorg to some oil because he was brave. We almost got lost walking home but it was okay. That is what happened on Saturday.

My nephew Ben and I went exploring in the woods. We walked on the big rocks near the creek. Ben saw something shiny in the dirt. He thought it was a jewel, but it was just glass. We kept walking until we saw a squirrel. It had a bushy tail that looked like a comb. The squirrel ran away fast, so we followed it.

"Where is it going?" asked Ben.

"I don't know," I said. "Maybe it is leaving to find nuts."

The squirrel led us to a huge oak tree. Suddenly, I tripped on a root and fell down. My knee hurt a little, but I was okay. We played there long enough to get hungry. Then we went home for lunch.

One day I walked through the dark woods. I saw a huge metal castle floating in the sky. It was really cool but also scary. I climbed a big tree to get closer. A robot with three red eyes opened the door. It looked hungry for batteries or maybe pizza.

"Who are you?" screeched the robot very loudly.

"I am Max and I like science!" I yelled back.

The robot bounced up and down because it was happy. It did not have a knife or a laser gun. It just wanted a friend. Not a single person ever visits him. We played tag all day long. Then I went home for dinner.

I was so afraid to play the big soccer game today. My tummy felt weird like a storm brewed inside it. But I brought my lucky shin guards and put them on. The coach drew a plan on his whiteboard for us.

"Just run straight for the goal!" he yelled loudly.

The other team was big, but I wanted to win. I ran fast and the ball was right there. I knew I had to seize the moment now. I kicked it hard past the goalie’s hands.

"You did it!" my friend Sam shouted at me.

We won the game and felt like kings in a reign. After the game, we went to the pool and swam all afternoon. It was the best day ever and I can't explain how happy I was.

I was playing my new video game called Mega Jump. My character was wearing a cool red suit. He had to bungee jump off a huge cliff. I was winning gradually but my thumb started hurting.

"Don't sneeze or you will lose!" my brother yelled.

I tried to hold it but I let out a huge sneeze. My character twisted in the air and crashed. He crawled out of the hole but he looked funny. The monster chewed on his leg and he lost health.

"We have to search for a health pack," I said.

My score grew bigger and bigger. The level design was so hard. The monsters were growing giant teeth now. I finally won the game and did a happy dance.

It was my birthday party and all my friends came over. I greeted them at the door and we ran outside. My dad rented a big bouncy house for the backyard. We jumped on it for a really long time. Then we started playing a game of tag.

"You can’t catch me!" I yelled and ran away fast.

My friend Sam grabbed my shirt but I slipped away. I felt a little anger when he pulled too hard. But then I saw my mom approaching with the cake.

"Everyone come get some cake and ice cream!" she said.

We sat down and I made a big wish. I wanted a bungee cord toy or maybe a boating set. I opened my presents and gave my mom a big squeeze. It was the best day ever because we played all day. I didn't want it to end any longer.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. I looked at the schedule on the wall. It said we had math first, but Mrs. Green was sleeping at her desk! She looked tired like she needed some caffeine.

My friend Leo grabbed my arm and whispered, "Look, she is drooling."

I saw a big fly buzzing near her head. Suddenly Mrs. Green woke up and grasped her marker. She started teaching, but she wrote "2 + 2 = fish."

It was funny but also confusing. At recess, we played on the swings. I felt the weight of my backpack was too heavy so I put it down. I ran and pretended I was steering a race car. Then we swam in the imaginary ocean on the grass. It was a pleasure to play outside, but school was crazy.

My dog Buster is the greatest dog ever. We went camping last week in the woods. I brought my science kit to look for bugs. Buster ran around and greeted everyone he saw. He even stood on a big rock like a king.

Suddenly I heard a loud whistle from Dad. "Buster caught something!" Dad yelled.

I ran over and saw Buster holding a newspaper. He looked so thrilled and happy with himself. I don't know where he found it.

"Good boy, Buster!" I said. "You are very well trained."

Maybe he won a prize for being smart. Finding that paper was very important to him. We stewed some beans for dinner and Buster slept. He had a fun day outside.

It was my birthday party and I was so excited. My friends ran through the door and we started playing tag. My brother grumbled because he wanted to play video games instead.

"You have to play with us!" I yelled at him.

He kept groaning but finally he stood up. He is tall so his height makes him fast. I pushed him and he laughed and chased me. Then my mom brought out the cake. The candles were surrounding a big chocolate dinosaur.

"I need some caffeine to keep up with you kids," my dad joked.

I used all my strength to blow out the candles. We ate cake and opened presents until it got dark. It was the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam went boating on the lake. We were looking for a lost island. The scenery was nice and green. Suddenly, we saw a weird cave.

"We have to go inside," Sam said.

We parked the boat and walked in. It was dark and I felt afraid. My heart was thumping hard. We heard a loud roar. A bear was roaming around! He looked very hungry.

"Run!" I yelled.

We ran back to the boat fast. Sam cut a rope with his scissors. We zoomed away together. It was important to escape. We didn't want to go to the hospital. We were safe now. We can explain everything to my mom later. That was a crazy day.

I hate homework but Mrs. Green gives us too much. Last night I had to write fourteen sentences about a newspaper. I did not want to do it so I chose to play video games instead. My mom came in and she was drinking coffee for the caffeine. She saw my papers scattered all over the floor.

"Why aren't you working?" she asked me loudly.

"My dog stole my pencil!" I lied to her.

She looked at my dog and she knew I was lying. My face felt hot and I could see a blue vein pop out on my hand. She told me to stop keeping secrets and finish my work. I sat down and did it fast so I could play.

I hate math class but I love recess. Today I had anger because I forgot my homework. Mrs. Jones looked at me and I feared trouble. She said to remain in my seat during playtime. I chewed my pencil and thought about the big slide.

"Can I please go outside?" I asked Mrs. Jones.

"No, you must finish your work first," she said.

I looked out the window and saw my friends climbing. My leg shook and I grew very sad. I drew a picture of a monster on my paper. Then I did the math problems fast. It was like heaven when I finally finished. I ran outside and went down the slide again and again. It was the best day ever.

I really feared math class today. Mrs. Green said we were earning points for a prize. I scratched my head because the problems were hard. My friend Tom leaned over and whispered to me.

"Do you have any scissors?" asked Tom.

"No, we are doing math, not art," I said.

Then I saw a huge black beetle on the floor. It walked right past my plain white shoe. I wanted to complain but I stayed quiet. The beetle looked like a little sewing needle with legs. Mrs. Green clapped her hands and class was over. I was so happy for lunch. Lunch is way better than math problems.

My brother Tom and I found a weird map. It was scattered on the floor in the attic. We saw a trail that went to the big oak tree.

"Let's go find the treasure immediately!" Tom yelled. He started jumping up and down like a frog.

We ran outside and looked at the map again. We walked eight steps and stopped by a bush. I scratched my arm on a sharp branch. It hurt a little bit but I didn't cry. There was a single red box hidden under some leaves.

"Does it contain gold?" I asked Tom quietly.

We opened the box but it was empty inside. Maybe the treasure was invisible magic gold. We pretended we were rich anyway.

My brother Tim always beat me at Mario Kart. He picked Yoshi and I picked Toad. I gripped the controller super hard. The race started and we moved fast. I discovered a secret shortcut near the volcano. Tim missed it and I zoomed past him. 

"Hey, that's not fair!" Tim shouted loudly.

I grinned and kept driving really fast. I sent a red shell at his car. It hit him and he started groaning. I crossed the finish line first.

"You just got roasted by Toad!" I said.

Tim was mad but we played again. I knew he was sounding angry but it was fun. Mom called us for dinner. If we were late, that meant a grounding. We ran upstairs fast.

I woke up early because today was the big race. My younger brother Sam wanted to play video games, but I grabbed my running shoes. We went to the park and I drew a line in the dirt with my finger. It was the starting line.

"Ready, set, go!" Sam called out loud.

We ran fast down the trail. Suddenly, a squirrel appeared in front of me! I threw my hands up and almost fell. I tried to maintain my speed, but Sam escaped past me. He is fast for a kid who likes science more than sports.

"I win!" Sam yelled when he crossed the finish line.

It was okay though. We went home and played video games after.

My friends and I went into the old science lab. We wanted to find the secret potion that the teacher brewed. The room was dark and papers were scattered everywhere.
