"Look over there!" shouted Ben. "It's glowing green!"

We carefully walked to the back of the room. Suddenly, a big spider crawled out from under a desk. I was trembling because I hate spiders.

"Don't worry," said Sarah. "I will save us."

She drew a picture of a fly and threw it. The spider ran away fast. We grabbed the green bottle and ran outside. We played hospital with my teddy bear and gave him the potion. It was just lime juice!

Yesterday me and my friend Sam went to the creepy forest. It is behind my neighbor Mr. Jones’s house. We were looking for pirate gold.

"I guarantee there is treasure here," said Sam.

We walked for a long time. We saw a big river. Something was floating in the water. It looked like a box! I started pumping my legs and ran fast. It was just an old shoe. Someone was dumping trash there.

Suddenly a bear roared! We were scared. We ran back home super fast. We ate toasted cheese sandwiches for lunch.

"We can try again tomorrow," I said.

Sam nodded his head yes. We are brave explorers.

I stood in the lunch line and my stomach growled loudly. Unfortunately, they were serving mystery meat again. I often complain about school lunch, but today looked extra gross. My friend Sam appeared behind me and poked my back.

"Do you think it's chewed up gum?" Sam asked.

"Maybe, but I am super hungry," I said.

We got our trays and walked to the table. I took a plastic knife and cut the meat. It was hard like a rock. I took a bite and started moaning because it tasted burnt. Then the recess bell rang and we sprinted outside. It was wonderful to run. We played tag until the teacher sent us back inside. I struck a pose when I won the game, earning a high five from Sam. Next time, I will bring a toasted sandwich from home. My nephew eats better than this!

We woke up really early for our camping trip. We crossed the big river and entered the foreign forest. My friend Sam held the map, and I had the compass. The needle pointed north, so we kept walking on the soft earth.

Suddenly, a huge wind blew through the tall trees.

"Look at that cave!" shouted Sam, jumping up and down.

I was scared, but I drew my toy sword. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole in the rocks. Inside, we spread our blankets on the cold floor. It was dark, but we had eight flashlights.

"Are you dreaming?" I asked Sam.

"No, this is real!" he said.

We found a treasure chest, but it was just old rocks. We pretended they were gold anyway.

I rode my bike to the park on Saturday. It was getting cold so I put on my red sweater. My friend Sam was already there near the big oak tree. We saw a squirrel approaching us very slowly. It crawled on the grass and looked hungry.

"We should give him some nuts," Sam said loudly.

I didn't have any nuts, and neither did Sam. We decided to do a science experiment instead. We spread some cracker crumbs on a rock to see what happens.

"Maybe a bird will seize the food," I whispered.

Just then, a man started playing a guitar nearby. The music scared the animals away. We watched some ants loading the crumbs onto their backs. We stayed until the ice cream truck sold us two popsicles. Exploring is fun.

I was playing my new video game about a lost island. My character was stuck in a cave with a low ceiling. Suddenly I heard a loud roar from a monster nearby. My character was trapped and he had low health. I needed a protein shake to make him strong again. I trained hard for this level but the boss was scary. I looked at the pretty scenery but then the monster attacked!

"Watch out for the fire!" my brother screamed at me.

"I am trying my best to win!" I yelled back.

To be honest, I was scared I would lose all my points. I jumped over the lava and hit the monster hard. He fell down and I finally won the big game.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover. We were playing a pirate game in his basement. The rug was our island and the couch was the ship.

"Give me the treasure map!" I yelled at Sam.

"No way, I found the jewel first!" he said back.

He held up a shiny plastic diamond he stole from his sister. Then he threw it at me but missed. It hit the wall with a loud bang. We heard his mom groaning upstairs.

"Keep it down or the party is over!" she shouted.

We got quiet and kept loading our nerf guns. We meant to be steady and quiet pirates. But then Sam tripped on the rug and made a huge scene. We laughed so hard our stomachs hurt. It was the best night ever.

My big brother Max is thirteen, and he thinks he is the best at everything. We were playing a new space game on the TV. You have to jump over holes, and there is no gravity. I tried every single level, but I kept falling. I felt a lot of anger because Max laughed at me.

"You are doing it wrong," Max said.

I tried one more time and pushed the blue button really fast. My little guy flew across the screen and landed safely! I had a happy feeling in my tummy. Max was groaning because I got the high score.

"No fair! You cheated!" he yelled.

I smiled because I finally won the game all by myself.

My dog Rex is the best dog in the world. He thinks he is a champion runner. I know he is wonderful, but he is messy. Yesterday Rex started tearing up my dad’s favorite leather shoe. I feared my dad would be mad immediately. 

"Rex, stop that right now!" I yelled loudly.

Rex looked at me and kept chewing. He thought his reign as king of the house was forever. My neighbor, Mrs. Smith, saw us over the fence. She was groaning at the big mess.

"You need to keep him company more," she said.

My dad came home and saw the shoe. He paid a lot for those. I had to write a note saying sorry. Then I was sent to my room, but Rex just wagged his tail.

I was at my nephew Billy’s birthday party. He is only three and he is very loud. We played tag and I grasped his hand to help him run. Suddenly Billy fell down and started groaning. He struck his knee on a rock and started moaning.

"It feels like a stinging bee!" Billy cried out loud.

"Don't worry, I will be your guard," I said.

My mom came over and checked his knee carefully. She said he would not get pneumonia from a scraped knee. Gradually he stopped crying and we all sang happy birthday. We were singing very loud and Billy smiled. Then my uncle dropped the cake and started swearing. We found forks and ate it off the floor anyway. It was messy but we had to learn to share.

My best friend Ben came over for a sleepover. We were playing cars in the living room. I was steering my red truck straight into the wall. Ben was tearing open a bag of chips.

"Hey, watch out for the lamp!" Ben shouted loudly.

I tried to squeeze my truck past the chair leg. Suddenly, the lamp fell over and broke. My mom walked in and cleared her throat. She looked mad.

"Do you know what happened here?" she asked us.

I wanted to hide the pieces like treasure. But I knew I had to be honest.

"I broke it with my truck," I said quietly.

Mom didn't yell. She helped guide us to clean up. She said she still had the receipt to fix it. I could not contain my happiness because she forgave me. We ate chips and it was okay.

I have a robot named Clank and he is a champion. He looks like a shiny toaster with legs. One day Clank treated me to a trip to Mars. We jumped in his rocket early in the morning.

"Do you remember the snacks?" I asked him.

"I am bringing stewed alien carrots," Clank beeped loudly.

We landed on Mars and saw a green alien. The alien held a newspaper and looked feared. He fainted right on the red dirt! I helped him up and he spread his three arms. It was not my imagination.

"You look like a sailor!" the alien said to Clank.

Then we did a bungee jump off a big crater. It was important to have fun in space. We flew home before dinner.

I was roaming around the playground at recess. My friend Sam was coaching us for tag. He yelled that he was "It" and we ran fast. I jumped over a big puddle near the swings. Then I saw a sign on the fence. It meant we couldn't go past the big oak tree. Sam ran past it anyway and his face grew red. He was steering right for the muddy part.

"Stop running!" the teacher yelled loudly.

Sam stopped and looked like a needle in a haystack. He often forgets the rules when we play tag. I walked over to help him back.

"Sorry, I just wanted to win," Sam said quietly.

We went inside and had math class next.

I was eating my breakfast when a green light appeared. My younger brother stood up and pointed at the window. A huge spaceship was approaching our house very fast. It looked like a giant metal beetle flying in the sky.

"It is jumping up and down!" my brother yelled loudly.

Suddenly a robot came out and started beating a drum. The robot kept hitting the drum with a strange rhythm. My neighbor Mr. Jones ran outside although it was freezing cold. He wanted to be the champion of fighting aliens. But the robot just wanted to go boating on our lake. It did not want to reign over the world at all.

"Can we go too?" I asked the nice robot.

The robot nodded its head and we all jumped in.

One day me and my dog Buster went exploring in the woods. We often go there because Buster loves the tall trees. We neared a big old oak tree by the creek.

"Look Buster!" I said. "There is something hanging from that branch."

It was a funny old boot swinging in the wind. I grinned at Buster and he wagged his tail fast. He started singing a howling song at the boot. I grabbed a stick and threw it far into the bushes. Buster ran after it. He is the greatest dog ever.

Then we found a narrow spot between two rocks. We had to squeeze through to get to the other side. My dad said no swearing if I got stuck! I was steering Buster through the gap carefully.

"Good boy, Buster," I said when we popped out.

Then we found a plastic comb in the dirt. It was a weird day but super fun.

It was recess time and the sun was super hot. Me and my friend Sam ran to the big playground. We wanted to play on the bouncy bridge that feels like a bungee cord. But a big kid was standing there like a guard. 

"You can't pass!" he yelled at us loudly.

"We just want to play," I said back to him.

He didn't move so we left and went to the sand. We built a huge sand castle instead. It took almost an hour to make the tall towers. Then the bell rang a stinging sound in my ears. Our teacher led us back inside for math class. It was a fun scene until we had to do work.

I was playing my favorite game on the computer. It was the last level and I had to get through the dark forest. I gripped the mouse really hard because I was scared. My character moved slowly past a big green monster. Then the screen went black and everything disappeared!

"Oh no, did I break it?" I yelled.

My brother ran in and said, "Let me see."

He wiggled a cord and the game came back on. I was so grateful. It was weird but I finally beat the boss. It felt good to complete the level. I did not have enough points for the bonus though.

"You need more caffeine to win," my brother joked.

I don't even drink coffee. I tried again and didn't have a failure this time. I won the whole game!

I was playing my favorite game called Castle Quest. I am a brave knight in the game. I had to find the magic jewel to win. It was hidden deep in a dark cave. My friend Sam was playing too, but he was losing.

"I am going to beat you!" I yelled loudly.

"No way, I found the sword first," Sam said.

We played for fourteen minutes straight without blinking. Suddenly, the dragon blew fire at my character. I jumped over the fire instead of fighting. That was the secret meaning of the riddle. I ran past the sleeping dragon and grabbed the shiny stone. I won everything! It was just the beginning of my winning streak. I often win because I practice every day after school.

I was in big trouble at school today. Mrs. Green said we had to make a knight costume for history class. I forgot to bring my shield and my sword. I looked at the ground and felt sad. My friend Tim saw me and he touched my shoulder.

"Do you want some help?" Tim asked me nicely.

I nodded and felt very grateful for his help. We found some old newspaper in the recycling bin. I drew a big shield shape on the paper. Then we taped it together so it was strong. At lunch we ate roasted chicken and played tag. I saw a plastic bag floating in the wind. After school I will comb my hair and relax. I am glad Tim is my best friend.

I was walking my robot dog Sparky in the woods. Sparky started barking at a big green bush. I saw a weird glowing trail on the ground. We started following the trail deeper into the trees. Suddenly we saw a small green alien sitting on a rock. He looked very sad and he was holding his foot.

"Are you in trouble?" I asked the little green guy.

He nodded his head and pointed to a big thorn. It was stuck right in a purple vein on his leg. I told Sparky to stay and I pulled it out simply. The alien smiled and gave me thirteen shiny space rocks.

"Thank you for seeing me," the alien said in a funny voice.

He did a loud whistle and a spaceship came down surrounding us. It was thumping loudly and it looked impossible but it was real. Then he flew away into the sky.

One day my brother and I went boating at the lake. The water was very blue and I saw a leaf floating. Suddenly I heard a loud splash near the boat. A big green frog appeared on a rock nearby.

"Look at that giant frog!" I screamed.

"It is incredible," said my brother.

The frog tried to climb up a slippery log. A tiny gnat flew by its head. The frog snapped at the gnat but missed it. Then the boat hit some sand and made a grounding noise. We scrambled out to look for more animals throughout the woods. It was the best day ever.

I was running late for school today. My neighbor Sam was walking his big dog. The dog was pulling on a leather leash. I waved at Sam and kept going.

At recess, we played a new game called heaven. It is like tag but you are safe on the monkey bars. I am not good at hanging on the bars. I fell off because of the height.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Leo.

"Yeah, I just slipped," I said.

After lunch, Mr. Clark was coaching us in gym class. We practiced loading the bases in kickball. It was a really fun day, but I am tired now. I have to do my math homework before dinner.

Me and my friend Sam found a secret map. It showed a path to a spooky island. We got on a boat and moved fast across the water. The waves had a bumpy rhythm.

"Look at that big rock!" yelled Sam.

We jumped out and landed on the sand. The ground shook a little bit. We walked into the dark woods. I did not know where to go.

"Listen," I said. "I hear something huge."

Suddenly, a giant monkey jumped down. He was big and scary. We ran back to the boat fast. Gravity helped us slide down the hill. We were safe, but we will never go back there.

I knew the robot was broken. It was roaming around the backyard and groaning loudly. My nephew Timmy was scared and hid behind a tree. The robot’s metal arm was scorched black from the fire.

"Run away, Timmy!" I yelled at him.

I sprinted to the robot and pushed a big red button. The robot stopped moving and the scene was quiet. Timmy came out and looked at the sad robot.

"Did you use psychology on it?" Timmy asked me.

"No, I just turned it off," I said.

We went inside to get some ice cream. We were safe now.

Yesterday I went exploring in the woods behind my house. My dog Max was following me everywhere I went. We saw a big tree and I wanted to climb it.

"Look how tall that is, Max!" I said.

I started going up, but a tiny gnat flew in my eye. It hurt so I shook my head really hard. Max started barking at a squirrel that was tearing up a nut.

"Be quiet Max, you will scare it!" I yelled down.

I climbed to a big height and looked around. The tree was bearing lots of green apples. I grabbed one but it was sour. That night Max slept on my bed because he was tired. I hope I receive a new flashlight for my birthday so we can explore in the dark.

One day I went outside to find a big bug. I believed that bugs liked to hide under the wet rocks. I flipped over a rock and saw a tiny creature. It was jumping around very fast.

"Hey, don't run away little guy!" I yelled loudly.

I started chasing it, but then something bad happened. I felt a sharp stinging on my leg. Ouch! It was a red ant, and it was mad.

"Go away ant!" I shouted and brushed it off.

I looked back for the jumping bug, but it had disappeared. I was breathing hard from running. I had a yearning for a snack now. I went inside and ate a toasted bagel instead. Exploring is hard work.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. Buster loves roaming around the big trees. We saw a squirrel running up a branch. Buster barked loudly at it but he couldn't catch it. We walked through some tall grass and found a creek.

"Look, Buster! We can go boating!" I shouted.

I put a big leaf in the water like a boat. Then we tried to measure how deep the water was. I used a long stick but it didn't touch the bottom. Buster is stronger than me so he pulled a big log over. We sat on the log and ate our snacks. Finally, we reached the end of the path and went home.

"That was fun," I said to Buster. He wagged his tail because he was happy.

I was camping in my backyard with my dog. It was very dark and scary outside. Suddenly I heard a loud whistle sound above me. Something huge crashed right into my mom’s flower garden! I grabbed my flashlight and ran to look. A shiny silver robot climbed out of the hole. He dropped a glowing blue rock on the grass.

"Do you have any company?" the robot asked me.

"No, just me and my dog," I said.

The robot looked sad and picked up his rock. "I am lost and need to go to Earth," he beeped.

"This is Earth!" I yelled.

He was so happy he danced like a little lamb. Then he flew away into the sky.

My robot friend Zip was acting very strange in February. His metal tummy was growing bigger and making a ringing sound. I thought he ate too many batteries again.

"Zip, are you okay?" I asked him worriedly.

"Danger is coming," Zip told me with blinking red eyes.

Suddenly a giant space beetle landed in our backyard! I ran to the steering wheel of my treehouse spaceship. We flew up high and reached the clouds quickly. Zip shot a laser and scared the bug away. It flew off, leaving green slime everywhere. I understood that Zip saved me.

"Thanks, Zip!" I yelled.

I was so grateful for my robot best friend.

My dog Buster loves to run outside. We went to the park and the sky looked weird. A big storm brewed and clouds turned dark.

"Come here Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't understand and he ran straight away. He crossed the big field and then he disappeared. I was scared because he is short in height. Suddenly, I saw his tail near the swings. I ran fast to seize his collar.

"You are a bad boy," I said to him.

I struck a pose like a superhero. We walked back and the rain cleared up. Then Buster started steering me toward a mud puddle. He jumped like he was on a bungee cord. I can't explain why he loves mud so much.

The weird spaceship crashed into my backyard with a loud boom. My dog Buster barked and I ran to the scene fast. Smoke came out of the ship and it looked scary. A green alien appeared and struggled to open the door.

"Do not be afraid!" the alien said to me.

I neared the ship and saw he held a map. He drew a picture in the dirt with a stick. It looked like he wanted some hot food. My mom was inside making beef stew.

"I can give you some stew," I told him.

I ran inside and got a big bowl of it. The alien ate it all up very fast. He stuck out his purple tongue and smiled. Then he gave me a shiny rock. It was an important gift. He fixed his ship and zoomed away into the sky.

My nephew Ben and I went on a big adventure in February. We wanted to find the lost jewel of the forest. It was very cold, although the sun was out. We packed sandwiches and our science kit. We walked for a long time and saw a dark cave.

"I am scared to go inside," said Ben quietly.

"Don't worry, we have flashlights," I told him brave.

We went inside the cave and it smelled like roasted nuts. Suddenly we saw a dragon sleeping on a pile of gold! He breathed fire and almost toasted our shoes. We ran away fast and forgot the jewel. Next time we will bring a shield.

My dog Buster got lost in the big woods. I heard him barking near the old stone fountain. I ran fast and saw a big chain on the ground. Buster was stuck on a bush but he greeted me nicely.

"Are you okay Buster?" I asked him.

He licked my face with his sloppy tongue. I gripped his collar carefully and pulled him free. Then we heard a weird noise approaching us. We froze because it sounded scary like a bear. But then a squirrel disappeared up a tree.

"It's just a squirrel!" I yelled and laughed.

We scrambled home before it got too cold for us. Mom made us roasted chicken for a wonderful dinner. I felt a heavy weight off my shoulders. I don't want Buster to get pneumonia from the cold. He is my best friend.

I was feeling happy because it was lunchtime. We had stewed tomatoes but I didn't eat them. Then we went outside for recess. My friend Sam was jumping rope near the slide.

"Hey look at me!" Sam yelled really loud.

He started climbing up the big metal slide backwards. Suddenly his foot slipped and he moved fast. He fell down and screeched when he hit the ground. Everyone stopped playing and walked over to see him.

"Are you okay?" I asked because I was scared.

Sam said his leg hurt and he felt danger. The teacher blew her whistle and ran over to help. Sam broke his arm but he got a cast later. It was fourteen days until he could play again. I found his hat on the ground for him.

I was walking to school and the sun felt hot. It almost scorched my back but I kept walking fast. I knew I had a big math test today. Suddenly, I remembered that I forgot my lucky pencil at home. I struggled to not cry because that pencil is special. My nephew gave it to me last year for my birthday.

At recess, I saw my friend Sam by the swings. He looked sad and was looking at the ground.

"What is wrong?" I asked him.

"I discovered my sandwich is crushed," Sam said sadly.

It looked like a flat pancake inside his bag. I turned around and gave him half of my apple. He smiled and said it tasted like heaven. We escaped the hot sun and went inside for class. It was a good day after all.

Today was the best day on earth. We had recess early and I was seeing my friend Sam. Sam had a new toy that looked like a shiny jewel. It was actually just a green marble.

"Can I hold it?" I asked him.

"You have to be careful keeping it safe," said Sam.

Then a tiny gnat flew right into my eye! It hurt so bad. I dropped the jewel in the grass. We looked for eight minutes but we knew it was gone. I was yearning for lunch because I was hungry.

My teacher Mrs. Baker was drinking her coffee for caffeine. She is good at teaching math.

"I know you are sad," she said to me.

I found the marble later near the slide. It felt like heaven!

One day my dog Spot and I went to the park. We wanted to search for treasures in the tall grass. Spot ran ahead with his tongue sticking out. He is very fast and happy.

Suddenly Spot stopped and started to sniff a big rock. I cleared away some leaves to see what he found. It was a bright blue feather! It was so shiny and pretty.

"Look Spot," I said. "This is from a blue jay."

Spot did a little bark and wagged his tail fast. Then he found a stick and wanted to play. I tried to whistle but no sound came out. A bird sang in the tree above us. It was a nice scene. I decided to wrap the feather in a leaf. We walked home feeling lucky.

I was playing my new soccer video game on Saturday. I picked the team with the cool red design on their shirts. My brother wanted to play too, but I said no first. I was trapped in a really hard level against the computer. The score was eight to eight and time was running out. I felt like a ghost because I was holding my breath.

Suddenly my mom walked in with a big mug of caffeine. She accidentally bumped my arm and I spilled my juice! It made a huge stain on the rug.

"Oh no, look at that painting on the floor!" my brother laughed.

I was not thrilled about the mess, but I kept playing. The excitement was growing as I ran down the field. I kicked the ball and scored the winning goal!

"You won even with a juice stain!" my brother yelled. I felt awesome.

My dog Buster loves jumping on my bed. Yesterday I was playing a game on the computer. Buster came in bringing his squeaky toy. He wanted company but I said, "Go away, Buster!" He did not listen. He pushed his nose into my leg and tried to squeeze onto the chair. Then he ran away. Later I made a big castle out of boxes in the living room. Buster came back and crashed right into it! The boxes fell everywhere. "Oh no, you broke my castle!" I yelled. Buster just wagged his tail because he did not know it was bad. Now he is sleeping on the rug. He looks very cute when he is asleep.

My birthday party was going to be impossible. I feared that nobody would come to my house. I sat on my bed reading a comic book. Suddenly I heard a loud knock on the door. I grasped the handle and opened it wide.

"Surprise! Happy birthday!" shouted my friends.

"I thought you forgot!" I said with a big smile.

My friends laughed and we all walked inside together. We played games and enjoyed each other's company. My mom greeted everyone with cake and ice cream. It was the best day ever. We promised to always listen to each other. Being with my friends made me feel so happy.

My brother Tim thinks he is the greatest gamer ever. We played a game called "Super Beetle Castle" on Saturday. I picked the blue beetle and Tim picked the red one. The castle was huge and had fire everywhere.

"You are going down!" Tim screamed at the TV screen.

I didn't say anything because I was breathing really fast. My hands were trembling on the controller. Tim’s beetle got scorched by a dragon, and he started groaning. I crawled my beetle past the dragon and used my invisible power. Then I found the secret gold comb at the top.

"No fair! You cheated!" Tim started to complain.

I just smiled and said, "I win again, thirteen times in a row." It was plain to see that I was the champion.

My robot named Zork landed his spaceship on the grass. He looked like a shiny metal sailor with green eyes. I ran outside because I was excited to see him. Zork dropped a big box right on the ground.

"What is inside that box?" I asked him loudly.

"I obtained some space juice for you," Zork beeped.

It smelled like coffee though, which has too much caffeine. I can't drink that or I will jump around. We went into my building and looked throughout the kitchen. We didn't have any cups for the juice either. So Zork used his laser eyes to melt a spoon into a cup. It was super cool magic. Then we drank the space juice and flew away.

It was a sunny Wednesday and my friend Sam came over. We wanted to explore the old building behind my house. It was a huge height and looked very scary. I brought my lucky scissors just in case we got stuck.

"Look at that weird design on the door," Sam said.

We pushed the door open immediately and saw a dark room. It smelled like old socks and it was not pleasant. We saw a strange box with foreign writing on it. Sam opened it and found a shiny bar inside.

"It looks like a protein bar for space aliens!" I yelled.

It was a pleasure to find treasure but then we heard a noise. We ran home fast because we were scared. Next time we will bring flashlights.

One day my dog Buster ran up a big mountain. I knew he was looking for a shiny green beetle. But then a huge storm appeared and the wind was freezing. Buster got scared and crashed into some bushes.

"Help me! I am trapped!" barked Buster very loudly.

I ran fast but I was breathing hard. I neared the bush and saw he was in big trouble. I did not run away. Instead I grabbed his collar and pulled. A bird flew over us and chirped. It sounded like it greeted us.

"You are safe now, Buster," I said to him.

We saw a bear approaching so we ran home fast. Buster licked my face because he was so grateful. We stayed inside and ate treats.

My brother Tom and I built a fort in the woods. It was big enough for fourteen people but we were only two. We were keeping a secret map inside a hollow log.

"Do you remember where the gold is?" Tom asked me.

"Yes, we have to go past the spooky cave," I said.

We walked fast and I gripped my wooden sword tight. We saw a bear but it was just a big rock. Tom was bearing a heavy backpack with our snacks. We knew we were earning a reward for being brave.

The wind started sounding like a monster. It got dark gradually but we kept walking. Finally we found the X on the ground. We dug it up and found chocolate coins! We ate them all before dinner.

It was my birthday sleepover and we wanted pizza. My dad called the pizza place but they were closed. Unfortunately, we had to make our own pizza instead. My friend Sam grinned because he loves cooking. We spread the red sauce all over the dough. Then we put cheese on top in a cool design.

"I am going to add extra pepperoni!" Sam yelled.

"Don't drop it or gravity will get it," I laughed.

We put it in the oven and waited. Suddenly the smell disappeared and we smelled smoke. The oven broke and our pizza was trapped inside! We had to use our imagination to fix dinner. We ate cereal and cake and it was actually perfect.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. We were doing math and my nose felt itchy so I scratched it. Then I looked out the window and saw a dog roaming around the playground. It was big and looked kind of lost.

"Look at that dog!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

The teacher told me to be quiet but then she looked too. We all ran to the window together. We feared the dog might be scared or hungry.

"We need to go help him," Sam said.

The teacher opened the door carefully and we walked outside. The dog saw us and stopped growing so nervous. He liked our company. We did a search for his tag. It said his name was Buster. We called the number and his owner came. She was so happy to see him again. I am certain that was the best recess ever.

Yesterday at school was crazy. We were painting pictures of the earth in art class. My friend Tim was roaming around the room and bumping into everyone. He twisted his foot and fell straight on the floor! 

"Are you okay, Tim?" I asked him. 

He scratched his head and said, "I think I need a hospital!" 

Mrs. Lee came over fast. She helped him up and he crawled back to his chair. Then I cut out my picture with scissors. Later at lunch, I ate a toasted cheese sandwich. My neighbor Sarah sat with me for company. I did not understand the math homework, but Sarah helped me. I like earning good grades so I was happy. It was a good day even though Tim fell down.

It was my birthday and I was wearing my new pajamas. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We ate pizza and then we grabbed our flashlights. We wanted to find treasure in the backyard.

"Look at that big tree," Sam said loudly.

We neared the tree and discovered a big hole in the ground. I saw something shiny like a silver needle inside.

"Maybe it is pirate gold!" I yelled.

Suddenly thunder struck and it started raining really hard. We crashed into the back door because we were running fast. My mom was sleeping on the couch but her eyes closed tight. She held up a sign that said "Quiet Please." We giggled and went to my room to play legos instead.

I was bearing a heavy backpack into Mrs. Lee’s class. I felt like I was earning a prize for carrying it. Mrs. Lee spoke to the class about a new project. 

"Use your imagination," she said loudly. "Write about a magical bird."

I grabbed my pencil and started thinking. A blue vein popped out on my hand because I squeezed hard. Suddenly, an idea struck me! My bird would have a silver feather. 

At recess, I sprinted outside to tell my friend Sam. We discovered a bug on the ground. 

"Look at those eight legs!" screamed Sam.

We treated the bug nicely and put it on a leaf. Then a bird appeared on the school balcony. It looked just like my story! It was the best day ever.

We woke up early because we wanted to find the ghost cave. My friend Tim grabbed his flashlight and we sprinted outside. The woods were dark and spooky but we kept going. We crawled under a big log and got dirt on our knees.

Suddenly we heard a weird singing sound coming from the trees.

"Did you hear that noise?" Tim asked me.

"Yes, let's go faster!" I screamed back.

We neared the big black hole in the mountain. Something was clinging to the rock above the cave entrance. It was just a bat but it looked scary. We reached the opening and looked inside the deep dark tunnel.

Then a huge bear came tearing out of the bushes! We paid no attention to the cave anymore and ran home fast. We were safe but we never found the ghost.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods today. The breeze felt nice on my face and Buster was leading the way. We pretended we were in a foreign land. I was a brave knight and Buster was my horse. My legs were pumping fast to keep up with him. Suddenly Buster stopped and started sniffing a big bush.

"What is it boy?" I asked him.

Something jumped out and screeched really loud at us! It was just a squirrel but it made me jump. I almost started to sneeze from the dust.

"Let's go home now," I said to Buster.

We ran back and saw the pretty scenery. I have to write about this adventure for school tomorrow. Mom said dinner was already ready so we didn't wait either.

We were playing in the woods and found a cave. It was dark but Ben wanted to go inside. The wind blew hard and scattered leaves everywhere.

"This is an important mission," said Ben bravely.

We walked in and it smelled like someone brewed old tea. Suddenly a bat screeched and flew right at my head! I jumped back and fell but I didn't get hurt. We saw a big box that was closed tight. Ben opened it and found a golden medal inside.

"I am the champion of the cave!" he yelled loudly.

We ran out fast because the cave was spooky. We bungee jumped over a small creek and landed safely. We didn't stay any longer because it was time for a meeting at my house. We had cookies and milk. It was the best day ever.

It was the final level of Super Alien Smash. I sat on the edge of the couch and my hands were sweaty. My brother Tim was player two and he was losing bad.

"Give me the power-up!" Tim yelled at the screen.

"No way, I need it to win!" I shouted back.

I grasped the controller super tight and my thumbs moved fast. The boss alien was huge and green. I thought I was going to lose, though. Suddenly, my character rose up in the air and started glowing. I shot a laser beam right at the alien’s head. The screen flashed bright colors and said "WINNER!"

I couldn't contain my happiness and jumped up high. I grinned at Tim because I was the captain now.

"Okay, you won," Tim said. "But next time you're going down."

Max and I had a weird feeling about the old shed. It was freezing outside and the wind blew hard. We opened the door and our flashlight bounced around. Max was holding his dad's old guitar for some reason.

"Do you think there are ghosts?" Max asked quietly.

"Use your imagination," I said back to him.

Suddenly a bat flew right at our heads! We screamed and ran away fast. I tripped over a box dumping old papers everywhere. I saw a yellow receipt on the floor. It was simply too scary in there for us. We ran home fast enough to beat the dark.

"I especially hated the bat," Max said later.

We decided to stay inside where it was warm.

My birthday party was in the backyard and it was awesome. My mom brewed some iced tea and my dad grilled burgers. My friends greeted me with presents and we ran outside. We played a game where we were knights finding a jewel. The plastic jewels were scattered all over the grass and bushes.

"I guarantee I will find the most!" shouted my friend Sam.

Sam started climbing the old oak tree to look higher up. My mom saw him and she looked worried.

"Get down or you will be in big trouble!" she yelled.

Sam jumped down like he was doing a bungee jump. He held up a shiny red jewel and grinned. We kept playing until it got dark. Then we used scissors to open presents and ate cake. It was the best day ever.

It was my birthday and we were making a huge cake. My mom got the big bowl and I got the scissors to open the mix. I struggled with the bag but then it popped open. We put in eggs and milk and I had to squeeze a lemon too.

"Make sure you measure the sugar right," my mom said.

I poured it in and mixed it fast. My arm felt like a mountain was on it because the spoon was heavy. I thought it would be a failure but it smelled good.

"You are growing so strong," my dad yelled from the door.

He was cheering for me while I stirred. We put it in the oven and looked at the schedule on the wall. We had to wait one hour. I was so happy I didn't get in trouble for making a mess either.

One day I was running up a big mountain. I saw a robot eating a purple elephant. The robot looked really hungry. He needed some protein for his energy. It started raining green slime from the sky. The robot saw me and his eyes turned red.

"You have an important vein in your arm," the robot beeped.

I was scared so I started leaving very fast. I reached the top of the mountain. My mom was there making food. We stewed some magic rocks in a pot. The robot came up and wanted some too.

"I thought you left," my mom said to the robot.

The robot sat down and we had company for dinner.

Me and my friend Leo were pretending to be brave heroes. I was a strong captain steering our big ship. Leo was a shiny knight with a wooden sword. We saw a big hill and started climbing up fast.

"Look at that dark cave!" Leo shouted loudly.

We scrambled over the rocks scattered on the ground. The weather was hot but we kept going up. We neared the top and saw something shiny inside. It looked like gold but it was just old wrappers. We cleared away the trash and sat down.

"This view is like heaven," I said to Leo.

We were tired but happy bringing our treasure home. My backpack could not contain all the cool rocks we found. It was enough fun for one day.

We went exploring in the woods behind my house today. The wind was tearing through the trees really fast. My brother Sam was bearing a big stick like a sword. We walked for a long time and saw a single frog. It jumped into the mud and we both grinned. 

"Look at that big rock!" shouted Sam loudly.

He pointed a finger at a huge gray stone. We climbed up it gradually because it was very slippery. I touched the moss on top and it felt soft. Then we counted all the birds we could see. 

"I see five blue ones," I said to Sam.

We stayed on the rock until it got dark. It was the best adventure ever.

I was sitting in class and my stomach grumbled. It was almost lunchtime and I was so hungry. The teacher was talking about math but I just watched the clock. Suddenly, the lunch bell rang and everyone started running. We flew down the hallway to get in line first.

My friend Sam shouted, "I hope they have pizza today!"

We got our trays and the pizza appeared on them. It smelled so good and the cheese was hot. I touched the crust and it was perfect. We sat down and I knew it was going to be great.

"This is way better than homework," I said.

Then Sam told me a joke about a bungee jump. We laughed until milk almost came out of my nose. Recess was next and we felt full and happy.

It was a cold Wednesday in February and I was bored. My friend Sam came over to keep me company. We decided to play a racing video game. I picked the red car and Sam picked the blue one.

"I am simply going to crush you!" Sam yelled loudly.

"We will see about that," I said back to him.

The race started and I was driving really fast. Suddenly Sam used a cheat code and turned his car invisible! I could not see him on the screen anywhere. I tried reading the map but he was too fast. It was not a pleasure to lose like that.

"Hey, remember that cheating is bad!" I told him.

He just laughed and we played again. Next time I will win for sure.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the jungle yesterday. The weather was hot, and we were sweating a lot. We saw a big green hill, so we started climbing it. Suddenly, we heard a loud noise and a rock crashed down!

"Watch out for the falling rocks!" Sam yelled loudly.

We ran fast and hid behind a huge tree. We waited there for a while, breathing very hard. Then we saw something weird floating in the river nearby. It was a small boat made of old wood. We jumped in and rode it down the river.

"I think we are lost now," I spoke quietly.

"Neither of us knows the way home," Sam said.

Gradually, the sun went down, and we felt tired. We used all our strength to paddle to the shore. We made a fire and toasted marshmallows for dinner. Sam grinned at me because we were safe.

My teacher Mr. Henderson gave us homework about a big mountain. I hate mountains because they are too tall to climb. He said we had to find the meaning of ten hard words. One word was colonel which is like a boss in the army. I did not have enough paper so I used my dad's old newspaper. 

At lunch I sat with my best friend named Sam. Sam had a cool leather belt and he showed it to everyone. I ate a single apple and then we went outside.

"Look at my finger!" Sam yelled loudly. "I got a cut!"

I looked but I did not see any blood throughout the whole recess. Then my little nephew came over because his class was outside too. School is okay but homework is super boring.

We had to measure things for math class today. It was really hard especially when I measured the big map. My friend Ben held the ruler and I pulled the tape. Suddenly Ben crashed into the teacher’s desk and papers scattered everywhere! We froze because Mrs. Green looked really mad. 

"Who made this incredible mess?" she asked loudly.

"I think I tripped on my shoe," Ben said.

We searched for all the papers on the floor. I struggled to pick up the foreign language homework. It was messy but we cleaned it up fast. Then the bell rang for lunch and we left quickly. I was happy about leaving because my face was super red. Next time I will measure something smaller like my height.

It was my best friend Tom’s birthday party on a Wednesday. We were playing outside in the big backyard. Tom’s dad was the guard for our secret fort. He drank a lot of coffee for the caffeine. We wanted to get past him to steal the treasure. The treasure was a heavy weight from his gym. I sprinted fast across the green grass. Tom struggled to lift the heavy weight up high. Suddenly, a big dog barked and we got scared. Tom screamed really loud and dropped the weight. "Run away fast!" I yelled to everyone. We ran inside to eat cake and ice cream. It was the best birthday ever.

My brother Tom and I went to the big jungle gym. It looked so high and dangerous, like a mountain. Tom is younger than me, so I was teaching him to climb. We neared the top and saw a big gap.

"I can’t do it!" Tom shouted and looked scared.

"Just jump like you have a bungee cord!" I yelled back.

Tom struggled to move his feet, but he was brave. He jumped across the gap and landed safely. It was incredible! We felt so strong. Then we found a secret slide. We slid down fast and struck the ground with a thump. We tried to measure how high it was with our arms. It was the best adventure ever.

It was finally the big baseball game on Saturday. I was so excited because I was the captain. We were playing against the Tigers and it was raining a little bit. The rain was steady but we kept playing anyway. I grabbed my bat and walked up to the plate.

"You can do it, Timmy!" my mom yelled.

The pitcher was approaching the mound and he looked scary. He threw the ball fast. I started swinging as hard as I could. crack! I hit the ball and ran fast. Everyone was cheering for me. I saw my dog Sparky near the fence. He looked like a funny creature because he chewed on a newspaper. I ran all the way home and we won! My team greeted me with high fives.

"That was a home run!" shouted my coach.

We were winning and nobody could beat us any longer.

One day my friend Tim and I found a map. It had a big red stain on the corner. We realized it was a treasure map from a sailor. We ran to the old tree house. It was at a very big height. We climbed up the ladder fast.

"Look at this weird writing," Tim said.

"It looks foreign," I said back to him.

We saw a picture of a chest near the creek. We ran there but the box was closed tight. We tried to open it for no reason. Then Tim pulled a key from his pocket. He meant to show me it earlier. We opened it and found old coins inside! We took them home for cleaning. It was the best adventure ever.

I was walking to school and the wind blew hard. My backpack felt heavy and pulled me back. I almost fell but I used all my strength.

At recess we played kickball on the blacktop. Tommy kicked the ball so high it almost disappeared. It came down fast and landed near the fence.

"I got it!" yelled Sarah. She ran super fast.

But then she froze because a big bug was there. I ran over and looked at the bug on the earth.

"It looks like an alien," I said.

Then the bell rang and we all crashed into line. In art class, I drew a picture of the alien bug. My team won the art contest for best drawing. It was the best day ever.

My best friend Sarah was having a sleepover at her house. We played dress-up and Sarah was wearing a big shiny jewel. She looked like a queen in a giant castle. We pretended we were floating on clouds. Then her dad called us for dinner. He made stewed tomatoes and cheese toast. It smelled weird like foreign food but it tasted good.

"I believed you when you said you had pneumonia!" I said.

Sarah laughed and said, "I was just pretending to be sick!"

After we cleared the table, Sarah's mom started coaching us on dancing. We danced until we were tired enough to sleep. Then her little brother followed us into the room. He wanted to sleep there too but Sarah said no way.

I was playing my new video game against my sister. She is the best player in the whole surrounding area. My mom was bringing us snacks and watching the screen. Suddenly my sister moved her character really fast through the level. It happened so quickly I almost dropped my controller.

"You can't beat me today!" she yelled loudly.

"Just watch me win this race!" I shouted back.

My heart was beating like a drum in my vein. I jumped from a big height and landed perfectly. Then the phone started ringing, and my sister looked away. I zoomed past her and crossed the finish line first!

"My daughter is the winner!" Mom cheered for me.

I finally beat her at her favorite game.

It was a hot Wednesday and my brother Tim was bored. We searched the backyard for a big adventure. I saw a huge hole near the fence. It looked dangerous but that was the reason to go in. I grabbed my toy guitar for protection. Tim grumbled because he was scared of spiders.

We climbed down gradually into the dark tunnel. Suddenly, something fuzzy touched my leg! I screamed very loud and jumped back. Tim laughed at me.

"It is just a bungee cord!" he said.

"That was not a failure of my bravery," I told him.

We walked fourteen steps and found a shiny box. It was full of gold coins! But actually, it was just rocks and my imagination. We used a stick to measure the hole. It was deep! We climbed out fast for lunch.

We were playing the greatest game of hide-and-seek ever. My brother Tom was counting by the big oak tree. I ran to the woods and found a small trail. I crawled under a bush and waited for a long time. Suddenly, I heard footsteps crunching on the leaves nearby.

"I know you are here somewhere!" Tom shouted loudly.

I held my breath and tried to stay very still. The weight of my backpack felt heavy on my shoulders. I was scared he would see my bright red shoes. Then Tom walked past me and started to search again. I waited until he was gone and ran back.

"I made it to base first!" I yelled happily.

Tom walked back and he looked really crushed. He grumbled about my height being too small to see. Everyone cheered for me because I finally won the game.

My friend Sam and I loved to explore the big meadow. One day, we heard a weird noise sounding like a whistle. We walked through the tall grass and saw a big hole.

"Look at that!" shouted Sam. "It goes way down deep."

I looked down and saw a shiny blue feather. It meant a magic bird was trapped there.

"We have to save it," I said bravely.

We trained for climbing trees, so we started climbing down. The ground was slippery and I almost fell. I grasped a root quickly. It was real danger! We struggled but we got to the bottom. The bird was stuck in some vines. We cut the vines and it flew away happy. We climbed back up and felt like heroes. We often go back but stay safe now.

On Wednesday, I went exploring in my backyard woods. I cleared some sticks away and found a big hole. Suddenly a bunny came jumping out! It escaped into the bushes very fast. I looked closer and discovered a nest with babies. They were sleeping and looked like tiny fluff balls.

My mom yelled, "Come inside for lunch right now!"

I said, "But I found baby bunnies, Mom!"

She didn't hear me so I ran inside. We had chicken for lunch because my mom says I need protein. I kept the receipt from the pet store in my pocket. I was yearning for a pet bunny to keep me company. Later, a blue bird flew by the window. I understood that wild animals belong outside, but keeping a secret bunny would be fun.

My birthday party was going to be awesome. The weather was freezing outside but it was warm inside. My friends came over for a big sleepover. We played games and ate pizza and cake. Then we wanted to do a science experiment.

"Lets make slime in the kitchen!" said my friend Sam.

We pulled out the glue and the glitter. My mom helped us mix it all together. Suddenly the lights disappeared and it got dark. We were trembling a little bit because it was scary.

"Don't worry, I have a flashlight," my dad said.

He shined the light through the dark room. It looked like heaven with all the glitter shining. We discovered that slime glows in the dark too. We stayed up until fourteen minutes past midnight! It was the best birthday ever.

I was camping near a big mountain with my robot dog named Sparky. Sparky started singing a weird beeping song and his eyes turned red. Suddenly a green alien flew down from the sky. It escaped from a spaceship and it looked very scared.

"Help me find my magic jewel!" the alien screamed loudly.

Sparky sprinted into the dark woods and I ran after him. We found a cave and I had to squeeze inside. I saw something glowing bright blue. It was the jewel! I grabbed it but a giant spider struck at me. I caught the spider in my net just in time.

"You are brave enough to be a space ranger," the alien said.

My ears were ringing from the alien ship but I was happy. We ate marshmallows and looked at the stars.

I was wearing my new sneakers for gym class today. Everyone was trembling because we had to climb the big rope. I saw Timmy bumping into the mat and he looked scared. "You can do it!" I shouted.

Instead of climbing, Timmy crawled under the mat like he was camping. It was funny but Mr. Jones did not laugh. Then it was my turn. My finger felt like a needle poked it, but I kept going. I pulled myself through the air and touched the ceiling. The whole class started cheering for me.

"Good job!" said Mr. Jones when I came down.

We are leaving for lunch now, and I am building a huge sandwich. I hope we learn about dinosaurs next.

My brother Max had a birthday party on Saturday. We played tag in the backyard and it was fun. Dad was the guard of the bouncy castle. He stood straight and tall at the door.

Suddenly, Max twisted his ankle on a rock.

"Ouch, my foot hurts!" Max yelled loudly.

Mom pulled him up and looked at his leg. She saw a blue vein popping out.

"We need ice right now," Mom said.

Unfortunately, the party stopped for a little bit. Max sat down and crushed a juice box. He was sad because he disappeared from the game. But then my friend Sam started bumping into me. We all laughed. The day was a complete mess but still happy. Max felt better because of the cake.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We chose the path that went straight to the old cave. My dad taught us how to use a map. We were waiting for a big adventure.

"Look at that scorched tree!" Sam yelled loudly.

We scrambled over the big rocks to see it better. Unfortunately, a mean dog was sitting there. It looked like it wanted to reign over the forest. We didn't understand why it was alone. We ran through the bushes fast.

"I need some caffeine to stay awake!" I joked.

My dad was our guide, and he saved us. Not a single person got hurt that day. We didn't bungee jump, but it was still scary. Next time, we will bring treats for the dog.

I was swinging on the monkey bars at recess. The sun was hot and my hands were sweaty. I jumped down and ran to my backpack for a snack. I reached inside and my finger touched something sticky.

"Gross!" I yelled. My friend Tim ran over to look.

"What is that?" Tim asked me.

I pulled out a smashed banana. It was all chewed up and gooey. I discovered a big hole in the bottom of the bag. Crumbs were scattered everywhere inside my backpack. I was growing mad because my homework was sticky too.

"My mom is gonna be so mad," I said sadly.

I threw the gross banana in the trash can. Then the bell rang and Mrs. Jenkins greeted us at the door. I hope she likes sticky math sheets.

I was playing the most important basketball game ever. My heart was pumping super fast and I was sweaty. We were losing by two points and the clock moved slowly.

"Pass the ball to me!" shouted my friend Leo.

I looked at the hoop and I saw the net hanging there. I took a big breath and I threw the ball high. Everyone watched to measure if it would go in. It hit the rim and bounced around. Then something amazing happened. It fell right through the net!

"We won the game!" I yelled really loud.

After the game, I was so hungry for pizza. But first we had to help with cleaning the court. It was hard work but winning felt great.

Sam and I were roaming throughout the spooky woods. We were looking for the lost golden cup. My dad was coaching us on how to be brave.

"Keep walking and don't be scared!" shouted Sam.

We heard a loud noise behind a big rock. My heart was pumping very fast in my chest. We saw a big bear waiting for us there. It roared but we didn't run away. Sam threw a stick and the bear left.

"We did it!" I said. "We are safe now."

We found the cup under a tree. It was shiny and gold. We felt like a champion team that day. We knew failure was not an option for us. We ran home to show my dad our prize.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old cave. We love science and wanted to find cool rocks. Sam was steering his bike fast and I followed him. We left our bikes by a big tree.

Inside it was dark and I felt scared. Suddenly we heard a weird moaning sound.

"Did you hear that?" Sam whispered.

"Yes, maybe it's a ghost," I said.

I froze but Sam was brave like a champion. We saw a big bear sleeping near a rock! The weight of my backpack felt heavy. We ran away fast. Later we roasted marshmallows and felt safe. Our mission was complete.

My family went on a big boating trip last summer. We woke up early and had eggs for breakfast. My dad was our guide, but he got lost.

"Which way do we go now?" I asked him.

"I think we turned the wrong way," Dad said.

We were floating down the river for a long time. Suddenly, our boat crashed into a big muddy bank! My mom dropped the scissors she was using to cut an apple. They fell into the water and sank fast. We were not leaving anytime soon.

Then we discovered a guard dog near a small house. He barked loud, but he was nice. The people inside gave us stewed carrots. The wind blew hard, so we stayed there all night. I didn't want to seize the day either. I just wanted to go home and sleep in my bed.

The red robot was roaming in the hot jungle. His name was Beep and he had a big brain. He was following a map to a magic fountain. Suddenly, a giant alien jumped out! It was bumping into trees and stamping its feet. The alien threw a rock and scorched the ground near Beep.

"Go away robot!" the alien yelled loudly.

"I need the magic water for my adventure," said Beep.

Beep scrambled up a tree and his arms grew longer. He toasted the alien with his laser eyes. The alien ran away fast. Beep found the fountain and drank the water. He felt strong and steady again.

One day my dog Buster got loose in the yard. He was running super fast toward the woods. I grabbed his blue leash and chased him.

"Come back, Buster!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and he crashed into some bushes. I reached inside to get him but then I yelled "Ouch!" Something was stinging my arm really bad. It was a big bee. Buster barked and ran away again.

My dad came outside wearing his pajamas. He looked tired because he did not have his caffeine yet.

"Neither of you are listening today," he grumbled.

We had to search for Buster for a long time. Finally we found him near the creek. He was wet and muddy but happy. We walked home and I put a band-aid on my sting. It was a crazy morning.

We went to the big meadow behind my house. My dog Spot ran ahead and started stamping his feet. He found a secret door in the dirt! I knew we had to go inside.

We climbed down thirteen steps and saw a dark tunnel. Something was bumping into the walls.

"What was that noise?" I asked Spot.

Spot just barked and ran deeper into the dark. We walked until we saw a giant castle made of mud. A rat sat there trying to gnaw on a bone.

"Do not enter!" the rat spoke in a mean voice.

Then Spot let out a giant sneeze. The rat got scared and swam away in a puddle. We found a pot of stewed carrots inside. I remembered that carrots are Spot's favorite snack. That is the reason we ate them all up. It was the best adventure that ever happened.

I was walking my dog named Colonel in the woods. Colonel is brown and he loves climbing over big logs. Suddenly he saw a squirrel and ran very fast. He disappeared behind a huge green bush. I heard him sounding like he was in trouble.

"Colonel! Come back right now!" I yelled with anger.

I ran to the bush and saw him stuck. His leash was caught on a sharp branch. He was trembling because he was scared. I struggled to pull the branch away. It was hard work. I finally got him free and I felt pleasure.

"You are a bad dog," I said, but I hugged him.

I thought he learned his lesson, but he didn't. For some reason he just wanted to chase squirrels again. I felt like swearing but I am not allowed. We went home safe.

My friends and I went deep into the scary jungle. There were big green trees and it was hot. Suddenly, a giant monkey jumped down from the ceiling of leaves! It was huge and had eight eyes.

"Run away fast!" screamed my friend Timmy.

We started running very fast but I tripped on a root. The monkey grabbed my shoe but I pulled it back. It was almost impossible to escape. Then a tiny gnat flew right into the monkey's eye. The monkey let go and rubbed its eye. We ran back home to complete our adventure safely. We ate ice cream and were happy.

I was playing soccer against the red team and my heart was pumping fast. We were tied fourteen to fourteen which is a huge score. Suddenly the ball disappeared into the bushes but I found it near a fountain. I ran back and saw a big kid looking like a tough sailor. My legs were trembling a little bit but I didn't stop.

"Pass it here!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball hard and it touched the goalie’s fingers. It went in and we won the game! The other team was groaning and we cheered.

"We crushed them!" Sam shouted happily.

I was so thirsty so I drank water and it cleared my throat. Then I felt a sneeze coming. I sneezed so loud I got a stain on my shirt. My dad drove us home and I gradually fell asleep in the car. It was better than camping.

It was freezing outside so we had indoor recess. I wanted to play on the computer, but Tommy got there first. I was mad and twisted my face up. Then I saw a shiny thing under the teacher’s desk. It looked like a red jewel.

"Look what I discovered!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam ran over and we tried to squeeze under the desk. It wasn't a jewel at all. It was just a piece of red plastic from some scissors.

"That's boring," Sam said. "I thought it was treasure."

Just then, Mrs. Miller appeared. She was stamping papers at her desk. She told us to go sit down because recess was over. It was time for lunch, and the cafeteria smelled like stewed tomatoes. I hope I get a gold star for earning good grades today.

It was the weirdest day at school ever. I had a really bad feeling about math class. I didn't do my homework so I felt like a failure. Mrs. Miller was writing foreign words on the big board. Suddenly my nose started to tickle really bad. I tried to stop it but I let out a huge sneeze!

"Bless you, Jimmy!" shouted my friend Sam from the back.

Then something crazy happened. My pencil started floating in the air. It looked like a magic trick I trained for. I almost fainted because it was so scary. The whole class was staring at my flying yellow pencil. It felt like a video game that was loading too slow. Then the bell rang and we all ran to recess.

I was waiting by the big oak tree for my dog. His name is Buster and he is the best captain ever. We pretend the backyard is a foreign land.

"Come here, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He ran over and licked my thumb. It was gross but funny. We walked together into the tall grass. The dirt felt grounding on my bare feet.

"Look at that bug," I said to Buster.

He sniffed it and wagged his tail fast. We counted five red ladybugs on one leaf. It was a wonderful day to be an explorer. Then my mom called us for lunch, so we ran back home. We were hungry explorers.

I was playing my new video game about camping. My character had to climb a big green mountain. It was full of danger like bears and holes. I had to find the secret treasure at the top.

My brother Max watched me play and kept moaning. "You are going too slow," he said loudly.

I ignored him and kept leading my guy up. My thumbs hurt, but I felt stronger than the boss. I jumped through a ring of fire and won!

"I simply cannot believe you did that," Max said.

I was groaning because my hands were tired. I will write my name on the high score list. Now I am the best player in the house.

We were at recess and it was super hot outside. My friend Billy was climbing up the big slide backwards. He said he simply had to get to the top fast. I told him he was being weird.

"Look at my height!" Billy yelled down at me.

I knew he was going to get in trouble. The teacher blew her whistle really loud. Billy ignored her and kept pumping his legs.

"Get down right now!" the teacher shouted at him.

He stayed up there a little bit longer. Then he found a shiny red rock like a jewel. He slid down and showed me the rock. It was cool but he still got a time-out.

I went camping with my dog Max last week. We often go to the woods near my house. My dad made a big fire and we toasted marshmallows. I touched one but it was too hot! 

Suddenly, a huge moth flew right at my face. "Get away!" I yelled loudly. Max started barking and jumping at the moth. He thought he was a champion hunter. He caught the bug but then he spit it out. 

"Yuck, that tastes bad," I said to Max.

Max made a moaning sound and shook his head. Later, the wind blew hard through the trees. I woke up when a branch fell. It almost crushed our tent! We did not sleep much after that. I did not receive any bug bites though. We didn't see any bears either, which was good.

We drove to the farm on Saturday morning. It took a long time but it was fun. I saw thirteen cows eating green grass. Then we walked to the big red barn. A little white lamb was running around inside. He bounced like a bouncy ball.

"Can I hold him?" I asked the farmer.

"Yes, but you have to be gentle," he said.

I picked up the lamb. He was feeling very soft and warm. I believed he liked me. We watched a duck floating in the pond. We stayed a bit longer to see the pigs. Dad started loading the car with apples. I did not want to leave. But I understood we had to go home. We did not have enough time to play more. I will listen better next time so we can stay longer.

One day I was walking in the woods behind my house. I heard a weird noise near the big oak tree. I looked up and saw my cat Fluffy clinging to a branch! She looked scared and she could not get down. I tried to reach her but she was too high.

"Come down, Fluffy!" I yelled.

"Meow!" she cried back.

I scrambled up the trunk but my shoe caught on the bark. I fell to the ground with a thump. It felt like a failure. But I knew I had to try again. I climbed slower this time and grabbed her paw. She was clinging to my finger. We got down safe enough. My mom came outside and saw us. I was grateful she didn't see me fall. The plain dirt was on my knees though. Fluffy is happy now but she often tries to climb that tree again. Listen to your mom, Fluffy!

My dog Buster looked into the forest and barked loudly. He saw something move behind the big oak tree. I grasped his leash tight and we walked closer. Suddenly a squirrel disappeared up the trunk very fast.

"Come back here!" I screamed at the squirrel.

Buster pulled hard and a vein popped out on my hand. He really wanted to chase it. We stewed there for a minute while Buster grumbled.

"Maybe he went to get nuts," I said.

Then a blue bird sang a happy song above us. It felt like the squirrel’s reign was over. We walked home and Mom brewed us some hot cocoa. I wrote about our big adventure in my journal later.

Me and my best friend Jack went exploring. The weather was rainy but we didn't care. We were playing explorers and roaming near the old science lab. It looked dark and scary.

"I bet there is a monster inside," Jack shouted.

We walked closer and touched the rusty door. Suddenly, we heard a loud sneeze from inside! I was scared and neither of us moved. Then we heard a weird noise like a lamb. We opened the door and saw a tiny white cat. It was just stuck and cold.

"It is not a monster either!" I screamed happily.

We took the cat home. My mom started coaching us on how to feed it. I named him Thirteen because he was lucky.

My friend Sam and I climbed up the big mountain. We wanted to find the secret cave for science class. We neared the top and I saw a dark hole.

"Look at that scary hole!" Sam shouted loudly.

We jumped inside and discovered a huge bear sleeping there. I was trembling so hard. My red sweater got trapped on a sharp rock. Sam pulled me free but he tore it. The tearing sound woke up the bear!

The bear roared and bounced up. It was approaching us fast.

"Run away!" I yelled.

We ran down the path and didn't stop a single time. We were safe at the bottom. We roasted marshmallows later but we did not measure how scared we were. It was a crazy day.

Me and my friend Sam went into the woods. We wanted to find the old castle. People said a king used to reign there. We walked through big trees and tall grass. Suddenly, my heart started thumping really fast. I saw a dark cave. It looked scary though.

"Do you want to go in?" asked Sam.

I grinned and said, "Yes, let's go!"

We grasped our flashlights and walked inside. It was very dark. Then my foot struck something hard. It was a shiny gold box with foreign writing on it! We simply couldn't believe it. We found the treasure! We ran home to show my mom. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is thirteen years old but he acts young. He is trained to find hidden treasure in the woods. One day we went exploring deep in the forest. We walked for a long time and the light gradually faded. Suddenly Buster stopped and kept bumping my leg with his nose. 

"What is it boy?" I asked him quietly. 

He barked and jumped over a big log. I followed him and saw a dark cave. I was certain something scary was inside. I felt my legs shaking but I stayed steady. Then I saw glowing eyes waiting for us!

"Run back to the house!" I yelled loudly.

We ran fast and didn't stop for fourteen minutes. We were glad for each other's company. We spread the map out later to see where we went. Next time we will bring more friends.

Me and my friend Sam went to the dark woods. We were looking for a lost treasure chest. A cool breeze blew and the leaves moved. We bought a map from an old shop yesterday. Sam was steering us with the map in his hand.

Suddenly a big bear appeared from behind a tree! It was roaming around and looking for food.

"Look at that sign!" I yelled loudly. The sign said DANGER very big and red.

My legs were trembling because I was scared. I realized I had my toy knife in my pocket. The bear was approaching us fast.

"Run back home now!" Sam shouted at me.

We ran all the way home and slept safely. We never found the gold but we were safe.

I sat on the couch with my controller in my hand. My big brother Tom sat next to me and looked super serious. We were playing Space Racers and I was losing bad. My thumbs were stinging from pressing the buttons so fast.

"You are going to get toasted!" Tom yelled at me.

"No way, I wrote down all the secret cheat codes," I said.

I searched my brain for the super boost button. I was yearning for a win because he always wins. Suddenly, my spaceship blew past his red rocket. I chewed on my lip and leaned forward. My ship was hanging in the lead right at the end!

"Hey, you cheated!" he shouted.

I just smiled because I finally treated myself to a victory. I will have to learn even more tricks for next time.

My brother Tim and I went camping in the backyard. We were looking at the stars for my science homework. Suddenly a bright green light crossed the sky. It landed near the big oak tree. I was afraid but Tim ran over there fast. A small robot was dumping purple slime on the grass. The robot looked like a shiny silver toaster with legs.

"Hello earthlings!" the robot beeped loudly.

"Wow, you can talk!" I yelled.

The robot started painting the grass blue with a laser. It was the beginning of a big mess. I was thrilled because I love aliens especially funny ones. We played tag with the robot all night long.

One day my friends and I found a secret map. It showed a hidden island with buried treasure on it. We got a boat and sailed across the surrounding ocean. Suddenly a huge storm struck our small boat hard.

"Hold on tight to the ropes!" I yelled loudly.

My friend Sam grasped the rail and looked scared. We almost fell in but we escaped the big waves. When we got to the beach, sand was scattered everywhere. We walked into the jungle and saw a scary cave.

"I hope we have enough food," Sam grumbled quietly.

We found a gold comb inside an old chest. It was the treasure! We struggled to carry it back to the boat. I was happy nobody got sick with pneumonia from the rain. We learned about psychology at school but this was way better. We were rich!

It was Wednesday and we had science class. Mrs. Green told us to write about volcanoes. Suddenly something happened to my experiment. The red lava brewed inside the plastic cup. I looked at the bubbles jumping up.

"Watch out!" yelled Tommy from the next desk.

The lava escaped the cup and went everywhere. It made a big red stain on my shirt. I felt like a failure because my volcano exploded wrong. Mrs. Green was not stamping her feet though. She smiled and stuck out her tongue.

"That looks like a real messy castle!" she said.

I went to the balcony to dry off in the sun. Science is messy but it is still fun.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating. We were wearing our life jackets and looking for adventure. Sam had an old newspaper that looked like a map.

"The treasure should be right here," spoke Sam loudly.

We landed on a small island and walked straight ahead. We heard a loud noise in the bushes nearby. I drew a picture of a monster in the sand. Suddenly, a big dog bearing a stick came running out! He was just roaming around and wanted to play.

"I think this box will contain gold," I said.

We dug up a small box under a tree. It did not have gold but we did receive cool rocks. We pretended to reign over the island until dinner.

Yesterday was the best day ever. It was raining outside so neither of us could play soccer. My big brother was teaching me a new video game about climbing huge mountains.

"Watch out for the danger!" he yelled at the screen.

I kept pushing the buttons super fast. My character did a bungee jump off a cliff. Then I saw a giant green beetle monster.

"I am the captain now!" I shouted back.

I was beating the monster with my magic sword. I heard a loud boom and I won the level. Especially the hard part at the end. My brother high-fived me. He said I was really good at gaming. We played until dinner and ate pizza.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods today. We wanted to see the pretty scenery. I gripped his leash tight because he likes squirrels. Suddenly Buster saw a big rabbit and he ran fast! The leash broke and I fell down.

"Oh no, Buster come back!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and ran into some bushes. My mom's daughter, my sister, came to help me. We caught Buster but his fur was full of burrs.

"We need scissors to cut this mess," she grumbled.

We walked home and I paid my sister a dollar for helping. Buster was happy but I was muddy. "Next time hold on tighter," my sister said.

I went camping with my dad and my big brother. We walked on a dirt trail for a long time. Dad was teaching us how to set up the tent. We cleared all the rocks and sticks from the ground. Then we made a big fire and ate hot dogs.

"Is there any danger here?" I asked my dad.

"Only if you don't clean up your food," he said.

We put our food in a bag hanging from a tree. Later inside the tent, I heard a loud thumping sound. The wind blew really hard against the tent walls. I was scared, but then I fell asleep. I was dreaming about bears reading a newspaper. In the morning, we did a search for animal tracks. We obtained some cool rocks, and then we went home.

I hate math class because the problems are too hard. My teacher put a new schedule on the wall today. It said recess was next and I felt happy again. I ran outside and saw the big slide.

"Hey, watch this!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

I started climbing up the ladder very fast. But then the wind blew my hat off my head. It flew away and landed in a mud puddle. I pushed past Sam to go get it. The mud made a big brown stain on my new blue hat. I tried to wrap it in a paper towel to dry it.

"That looks really bad," Sam said to me.

I scratched my head and sighed. Then the bell rang and I turned around to go inside. The stain grew bigger and it looked like a funny design now. I guess I need a new hat.

I was sitting in class and my stomach struck me with hunger. It was almost lunchtime but math class felt so long. I looked at the clock and sighed really loud. My teacher Mrs. Miller looked at me and frowned.

"Listen to the lesson please," she said to the class.

Finally the bell rang and I ran to the cafeteria. I obtained my lunchbox from my locker and sat down. My sandwich tasted weird and the bread was chewed up. I think my dog got to it before I left.

"Something is wrong with your food," my friend Tim said.

"I know, it smells like danger," I told him.

I struggled to eat it but I was so hungry. Then I threw it in the trash and touched my apple. I caught a ball at recess later and felt stronger. It was good training for baseball practice after school.

My best friend Ben had pneumonia last month. He was very sick but he is better now. It was his birthday yesterday and I went over. We played on the ground in his backyard.

"Let's climb the mountain!" Ben yelled at me.

The mountain was just a big pile of dirt. I tried to keep my weight steady on it. I did not want to fall through the soft dirt.

"Look out for the fountain!" I yelled back.

His mom has a water fountain near the dirt pile. We almost broke it but she did not know. It was the greatest day ever. Then we caught lightning bugs when it got dark. I saw a sign on his door that said Keep Out. His room was closed but we snuck inside anyway. We pretended to reign over a kingdom of toys. It was hard to contain our laughter.

We drew a map on an old napkin. It showed the scary forest behind my house. My friend Ben was thrilled to go exploring. We walked for a while and the grass was growing taller.

"This looks impossible to cross," said Ben nervously.

I grinned and gave him a thumbs up. We kept jumping over logs throughout the woods. Suddenly we saw a giant pit. Someone was dumping trash in there! It was gross. I threw a rock in to check the depth. It was deep though.

"I guarantee there is treasure down there," I said.

We found a rope and climbed down fast. We were in a league of our own! We didn't find gold but we found a cool shiny rock. We were hungry so we ate a cookie down to the last crumb. It was the best adventure ever.

My robot Zog had a big shiny metal head. We climbed the rocky mountain to search for the hidden cave. Zog held a heavy iron chain to pull me up.

"Look out for the space bugs!" I shouted loudly.

Suddenly a green alien jumped out and broke a rock. Zog beeped and his eyes turned bright red. He shot a laser but it wasn't strong enough. The alien wanted to eat my protein bar.

"Here, you can receive this yummy snack," I said.

The alien ate it and burped and then ran away. We were safe and walked back home for dinner.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were freezing outside. My mom said we couldn't go in the pool either. So we ran through the grass and touched the cold water.

"Hey look at that big spider!" screamed my friend Ben.

We saw a huge bug crawling on my dad's grill. It looked like it had thirteen legs and was growing fast. I grasped a stick and poked it a little bit.

"Don't hurt it, maybe it needs protein," said my sister.

We ran inside and scattered our sleeping bags on the floor. My mom read us a scary story about a ghost. Then Ben found a loose thread on his pillow. He pulled it and his pillow ripped open everywhere! Feathers went all over the room and we laughed all night.

My brother and I played a racing video game in our apartment. I was winning and my car was super fast. The scenery on the screen was just a blur. I was steering really hard to stay on the road.

Suddenly, my brother chewed on his lip and paused the game.

"Hey! What happened?" I yelled at him.

"I have to sneeze!" he shouted back. He sneezed so hard he blew his nose on his shirt.

While he cleaned up, I unpaused the game and drove away. His car disappeared behind me and I laughed. He scrambled to grab his controller but it was too late. My reign as the champion was just beginning. I played a little longer until I got hungry for pizza.

"You know I let you win," he said.

"Did not!" I said.
