It was raining very hard outside on Saturday. My best friend Sam came over and we were bored. We decided to go explore my dark basement. I was afraid but I pretended to be brave. We walked down the stairs and discovered a secret door. I pulled the handle with all my strength.

"Look out!" Sam screamed loudly at me.

A giant rat ran out and started stamping its feet. We were both trembling and scared. My heart was pumping fast. Sam grabbed an old newspaper and swatted at the rat. The rat ran away into a hole. We ran upstairs and ate some toasted bread. We smelled like stewed carrots and dust but we were safe.

"That was too scary," I said to Sam.

We never went back down there again.

My brother and I went to the spooky forest today. It was a weird scene with lots of fog. We walked for a long time and heard a whistle. It sounded like wind, but I believed it was ghosts.

Suddenly, we saw a green light floating near a tree.

"Look at that thing!" I yelled at my brother.

"I think it is a monster," he said back.

We ran fast but I struggled to move my feet. We often play games like this, but this was real. Then I remembered my dog was missing. I heard a low moaning sound behind a big rock. It was either a ghost or my dog. I peeked over the rock. It was just my dog Rex! I am trained at finding lost things. We laughed and took turns steering him home.

My neighbor Tim and I wanted to explore the dark woods. We walked through the tall grass and approached a big cave. It was scary but I felt brave. Tim drew a map on a piece of paper.

"Do you think a bear is sleeping inside?" asked Tim.

"Maybe, but we have super powers today," I said.

We went inside and something was bumping around in the dark. My heart rose up to my throat. Suddenly a tiny puppy came jumping out at us! It chewed on my shoe and wagged its tail. We laughed because we thought it was a monster. The puppy led us back to the sunlight and the soft earth. We ran home jumping over logs at a great height. My dad was coaching soccer but we told him our cool story.

I really wanted to win the big race at school. My friend Max is super fast, but I had a plan. We lined up at the start and the whistle blew. I started running as fast as a rocket.

"You can't catch me!" Max yelled from way ahead.

I was yearning to win so bad. I pushed my legs harder and harder. Suddenly, my shoe felt loose like a bouncy bungee cord. I almost fell, but I kept my balance to maintain my speed. Then the finish line appeared right in front of me. I was clinging to hope. Max looked back and slowed down a little bit. I zoomed past him and crossed the line first!

"Let's race again!" I shouted happily. I was the champion.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring in the jungle. It was hot and we searched for a secret trail. We pushed through big green leaves and walked for a long time. Suddenly we saw a big dark cave.

"Do you think a bear lives there?" Leo asked.

I was scared but I wanted to be brave. We went inside the cave and sat on a rock. It was very quiet until we heard a ringing sound.

"What is that noise?" I screamed.

It was just my phone ringing! My mom was calling me. We ran home fast though because it was getting dark. We didn't want to get a grounding so we promised to remain close next time. Exploring is fun but scary too.

Tomorrow is my big birthday party. I helped my dad with loading the car. We put everything in the back for the picnic. The weather is going to be super sunny and hot.

"Can we go boating on the lake?" I asked my dad.

"Maybe if we have time after lunch," he said.

I tried to squeeze my giant floatie into the trunk. It was a tight squeeze! I had to search through my bag for my comb. My hair was messy from the wind. I felt the weight of the cooler. It was really heavy with all the sodas. My little sister tried keeping the beat to a song. She has no rhythm at all. I hope I learn to drive the boat. I want to reign over the lake like a queen! It will be the best day ever.

Me and my friend Sam played a racing video game. We raced cars on a dirt trail throughout the jungle. My car was red and Sam’s car was blue. I moved my controller fast, but Sam was winning.

Suddenly, a little white lamb ran onto the track!

"Watch out for the lamb!" yelled Sam.

I swerved my car and hit a metal chain fence. My car spun around and got stuck in the mud. Sam drove past me and he looked very happy. Even though I crashed, seeing the lamb was funny.

After the race, we ate some roasted peanuts for a snack. To be honest, I meant to win that race today. Maybe next time I will win without crashing. It was fun roaming around the track anyway.

Last Wednesday, my dog Max ran into the woods behind our house. I chased him because he kept barking at something big. We pushed through some bushes and found a secret garden. It had a big stone fountain in the middle with green water.

"Come back here right now, Max!" I screamed loudly.

Max did not listen and he jumped right into the water. Then I discovered a box near the fountain's edge. I opened it with my safety scissors from my pocket. Inside the box were five shiny gold coins that I counted carefully. It seemed impossible but the treasure was real.

"Look what we found, boy," I told him happily.

Max just splashed me and shook his wet fur everywhere. He is good company even when he is messy. We took the coins home and put them in my piggy bank.

It was my sister’s big birthday party. We scattered confetti everywhere and decorated the room. I wanted to maintain the surprise for her. Mom baked a huge chocolate cake in the oven. Unfortunately, the top of the cake got scorched. It looked black and crispy.

"Oh no, it’s impossible to eat!" I yelled.

Mom scraped off the burnt part and iced it again. It looked okay but I feared it tasted bad. When my sister reached for a slice, she smiled. She blew out the candles and took a big bite.

"This is the best cake ever!" she said.

I was so happy she liked it. We meant to play outside, but it rained. So we slept in the living room instead.

One day I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I was wearing my favorite red boots and a blue hat. I pretended I was deep in a thick green jungle. Suddenly I saw a squirrel swinging from a high branch. He jumped and landed right on the soft earth near me.

"Hello Mr. Squirrel!" I shouted at him loudly.

The squirrel looked at me and then he started running away. I chased him throughout the trees until he stopped by a rock. He grasped a tiny nut in his paws and grinned.

"You are very fast," I said to the squirrel.

Later I went inside and read a book about animals. Then I wrote a story about my jungle adventure. I can't wait to go back outside tomorrow.

My best friend Sam had a sleepover for his birthday. We played outside with his neighbor named Leo. We pretended we were strong superheroes. I used my imagination to be the champion of the world. "Use your super strength!" yelled Sam. We started running fast and pumping our arms. Then Leo screeched like a bird and jumped off the swing. He didn't have a bungee cord so he fell. He crushed some flowers but he was okay. His mom came out singing a happy song with cake. We scattered everywhere to get plates. "Do you want chocolate or vanilla?" she asked. I didn't care because I like either one. Following the cake we tried to measure who was tallest. It was the best night ever.

We went to the woods to build a secret castle. My dog Buster came too and he was very excited. We searched for big sticks and some soft green moss. I saw a leaf floating in a puddle nearby. It had a big red vein down the middle.

"Look at this weird bug," said my friend Sam. It looked like a foreign bug from a faraway place.

Buster ran over and accidentally crushed the bug with his paw. We felt bad so we decided to write a note. We spread some dirt over the bug to bury it.

"I think the bug is grateful now," I said.

Sam grinned and we went back to building our fort. My dad was coaching my brother at soccer so we had lots of time. We played until the sun went down.

We were walking through the thick green jungle. My friend Sam was bringing his backpack with snacks. We were looking for the lost red jewel. The scenery was full of big trees and vines. Suddenly a monkey screeched loudly at us from above.

"Look out for that snake!" yelled Sam.

I threw a stick and the snake slithered away. We had to squeeze through a small dark cave. I was scared but I remembered my training.

"We are almost there," I said to Sam.

We saw a box that might contain the treasure. I touched the lid and it opened slowly. Seeing the shiny jewel was so cool! We felt like a brave colonel in a movie. My mom might give me a grounding for being late. But finding the treasure was the best adventure ever.

One day I was walking on a long trail in the woods. I was feeling very happy because the sun was hot. Suddenly I saw a big brown dog running fast. He was tearing through the bushes and barking loud!

"Hey doggy, where are you going?" I asked him.

The dog stopped and wagged his tail at me. Then a girl came running up the path.

"Sorry! I am coaching him to be good," she said.

We had a nice meeting right there in the grass. She told me they were going boating on the lake later. I was certain that the dog would like swimming. I watched them leave and I learn that dogs are very fast. It was a good day to be outside.

My cat Fluffy is certain she is a queen. She sits on the balcony and watches the birds fly through the air. One day I was loading my backpack for a picnic. I carefully packed a toasted cheese sandwich and a juice box.

"Meow!" Fluffy said loudly because she wanted to go.

"You have to stay here simply because you are a cat," I told her.

She started to complain and spread her paws on the glass door. I felt bad so I gave her a piece of string like a thread to play with. Then I went to the park by the big water fountain. An old man was reading a newspaper on a bench nearby. I ate my sandwich and enjoyed the company of the squirrels. They looked like they wanted some stewed carrots, but I didn't have any.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were bearing big sticks for protection because it was scary. We walked straight until we saw a huge, dark cave.

"I think there is a bear in there," Sam said.

"I have trained for this moment," I told him bravely.

Suddenly we heard a loud sounding roar from the cave. My heart was beating like a drum rhythm. A huge monster jumped out and broke a branch! We ran away with all our strength. My pants got caught on a bush tearing a hole. I believed we were in big trouble. We didn't remain there. We ran left and finally got home safe. I need scissors to fix my pants now.

My neighbor Timmy and I were roaming around the playground at recess. We pretended the monkey bars were a big green jungle.

"I bet there is treasure under the slide!" Timmy shouted.

I ran over to the slide and started digging in the dirt. I found a shiny rock and a blue bird feather. It was the best single thing I found all day. Then the bell rang and everyone started moaning. We had to go inside for science class.

"I am the champion of digging," I told Timmy.

Mrs. Green looked tired and she drank a lot of coffee for the caffeine. Although she was tired, she taught us about camping and bugs. It was actually fun. I felt like a colonel leading an army of ants. School is okay but recess is way better.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark forest. It was a dangerous place with lots of stinging bugs. We were looking for the lost treasure of the monkey king. We walked for a long time and saw strange foreign scenery.

"Watch out for that hole!" yelled Sam loudly.

I almost fell in but I grabbed a vine like a bungee cord. My heart was bumping hard in my chest. We kept walking and heard loud stamping noises. It was a giant bear! We ran very fast and escaped to a cave.

"That was scary but wonderful," I said shaking.

We touched the ground and had a happy feeling. We were safe. We heard people cheering for us outside. We didn't find the gold but it was a cool adventure.

It was finally my birthday and I was jumping everywhere. My best friend Sam was approaching my front door. I grinned because he had a huge blue box. We ran to the park near the big stone fountain. Sam threw the ball and it went really high up. I ran fast but I tripped on a rock. I started moaning because my knee hurt a little bit.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked, sounding very worried.

"I am fine, let's keep playing!" I said.

My mom cleared the picnic table for cake. It was chocolate with a shiny jewel on top. I felt so grateful for my party. The day felt complete when I got a new bike. I love birthdays so much.

I was walking past a big grey building yesterday. A green alien jumped out and he was trembling. He looked like a giant frog with blue skin. A big purple vein popped out on his head. He chewed on a metal bar like it was gum.

"Do you have any caffeine?" the alien asked me.

"No, my mom says that makes me crazy," I said.

He blew green smoke out of his nose and crossed his arms. He did not understand why I had no soda. Then a robot flew down and grabbed him. The robot had lasers for eyes and looked scary. They flew away into the sky very fast. I ran home to tell my dog.

One day I was walking outside my apartment building. I saw something shiny in the grass like a jewel. It was my neighbor’s cat, Mittens! She was stuck way up high on a tree branch. Mittens was groaning and looked very scared of the height.

"Oh no, Mittens is in trouble!" I shouted loudly.

I remembered my dad had a ladder in the garage. I ran and got it simply by myself. I climbed up like I was climbing a mountain. Mittens was happy and started jumping into my arms. I felt very brave when I discovered I could save her.

"Thank you for saving her!" my neighbor said.

She was so grateful she gave me five dollars. I used my imagination to think about what candy to buy. Then I saw a newspaper on the ground and we went home.

I was playing my favorite video game against my brother. It was a race game with super fast cars. The track went up into space and there was no gravity. If you drove off the road, it was dangerous! My car was a giant blue elephant with wheels.

"You are going down!" my brother yelled at me.

"No way, I drank too much soda so I have caffeine energy!" I said back.

I was seeing the finish line but then I hit a weird bump. My elephant car spun around and crashed into a water fountain. It was a big failure. My brother reached the end first. He laughed, but I just felt the breeze from the fan. I threw my controller on the ground. Next time I will win for sure.

I was training for the big race at school. My friend Sam said it was impossible to beat him. We neared the finish line on the playground. I jumped over a big rock and climbed a hill. Sam was clinging to the lead but he looked tired.

"I am going to win!" I screamed really loud.

"No way!" Sam shouted back at me.

My legs were trembling but I ran faster. I remembered my dad speaking about never giving up. I pushed hard and crushed Sam at the end. I fell on the earth and got a grass stain. It felt like I was bungee jumping because my heart was fast. Next week we are camping, but today I am the winner.

It was raining outside so we stayed inside. My brother and I were roaming around the living room. We were bored until Mom called us for dinner. But we were not hungry so we played video games. The game was loading forever and it made me mad. Then the screen turned bright like heaven.

"I am going to win this time!" I yelled.

"You already lost last time," my brother said.

We picked our players and went straight to the race. I was simply faster than him. He looked sad but kept playing. I saw the finish line and knew it was over. I won the race and started singing a victory song. My brother was hanging his head down. We played again to complete the level.

I was afraid to go to school today. Mrs. Miller said we had a big test. My stomach was groaning all morning. Mom made me toasted bread with jam, but I couldn't eat. I walked to the bus and greeted my friend Sam.

"Did you complete the homework?" asked Sam.

"No, I forgot!" I said, screaming a little bit.

We got to class and sat down. Then Mrs. Miller smiled at us. She said, "Surprise! No test today. We are doing art instead."

I was thrilled! We discovered new paints and spread blue color everywhere. It was the greatest day ever. We are training to be artists now.

I woke up early because I was yearning for adventure. My friend Max and I ran to the spooky island. The ground was hot and looked scorched by fire. 

"I guarantee a dragon lives here," Max grumbled loudly.

Suddenly, a giant shadow spread over us and we froze. A red dragon landed and it struck the ground hard. It was breathing smoke and bearing huge teeth at us. We were not trained to fight dragons!

"Run for the boat!" I screeched at Max.

We kept running until we jumped into the water. We were safe but we are never going back there.

I was playing my favorite video game about a sailor. He was roaming around a big green mountain. My neighbor Tim came over to play against me. He was wearing his lucky red hat for good luck. We climbed up the rocks in the game really fast. I was afraid I would lose because Tim is good. But then my fingers moved super fast on the controller. I felt stronger than him and I jumped over a trap.

"You are going to lose!" Tim yelled at me loudly.

"No way, I am winning this time!" I shouted back.

I realized I could win if I found the secret treasure. The surrounding monsters tried to stop me but I beat them. My dad was coaching me from the door and smiling. I won the game and Tim was sad but okay. I hope he doesn't get pneumonia from walking home in the rain.

One day I met a alien named Zorg in my backyard. He was green and chewed on a shiny metal rock. I carefully walked up to him and he waved his three hands.

"Do you want some roasted space bugs?" Zorg asked me.

"No thanks, that sounds gross," I said.

Then a big robot came down from the sky with a loud groaning noise. It was Colonel Click-Clack and he wanted to catch Zorg. Zorg threw his metal rock at the robot's head. The robot fell down and made a trail of smoke. I did not understand why they were fighting but it was cool. We used a box to contain the robot. Then Zorg gave me a map to guide him home.

It was a cold night in February and I was scared. A green robot with huge laser eyes was approaching my house. I was clinging to my magic sword behind the sofa. The robot smashed the door open with lots of anger.

"Give me the blue jewel!" the robot yelled loudly.

I jumped up and flew into the air with my cape. "You can never have it!" I shouted back at him.

I zapped him with my laser eyes and he fell down. He started screaming and moaning on the floor. It was loud enough to wake up my mom. I grabbed the jewel and hid it under my bed forever. The robot ran away and never came back again.

My friends and I went into the dark, scary cave. We walked through the cold tunnel for a long time. Suddenly, a big drop of water hit my thumb. I looked up at the high ceiling. It was too dark to see a single thing. 

"Do you know where we are going?" asked Sam.

"We need to find the dragon's gold," I said bravely.

We heard a loud roar echo in the cave. A monster brewed a potion nearby and it smelled like stewed socks. That was enough for us to run away fast! We did not want the monster to reign over us. We escaped by just a finger and ran home.

Me and my friend Sam searched for the hidden treasure. We ran through the woods and felt a cold breeze. Sam wore his blue sweater because it was chilly. We kept running until we saw a big stone castle.

"I think the map leads inside there," Sam said.

We went in and a giant bird landed near us. It made a loud whistle sound that was scary. I reached in my pocket and found some scissors. I also found a receipt for milk, but that was useless.

"Let's scare it away!" I yelled loudly.

We waved our arms and the bird flew away fast. We found a chest and inside was just gold paper. I woke up and realized I was only dreaming.

My brother and I went on a big camping trip. We started loading the car early in the morning. Dad drove us to a beautiful forest for our adventure. We saw a little lamb roaming near the trees.

"Look at that jumping lamb!" I yelled to my brother.

We walked deep into the woods and crossed a river. Suddenly, I dropped my bag and heard a loud groaning sound. It was a bear! We ran fast and I felt like a champion runner.

"We are safe now," my brother said.

We were thrilled to be back at the tent. Mom made a cool design with stones by the fire. I was so grateful for the hot dogs. Camping is scary but it is also very fun.

My robot nephew Zog was boating in the sky. He had a big red jewel on his chest. It was the greatest jewel in the whole galaxy.

"Look out for the ceiling!" I yelled at him.

Zog was running fast but he hit the clouds. The clouds were actually stinging space bees. They were mad and started chasing us to my balcony.

"This is impossible!" Zog said with a loud beep.

We used science to make a force field quickly. The bees were groaning because they couldn't get in. Zog roasted a marshmallow on his hot engine. I hope he doesn't get robot pneumonia from the cold space wind. His reign as the king of flying robots is safe.

I was sitting at my desk groaning because of math. There was a big mountain of homework to do. I had to write the answers on the computer. Suddenly I heard a loud knock on the door. It was my friend Tommy and he looked afraid.

"Come quick!" he yelled. "The water fountain exploded!"

I jumped up and grasped my pencil tight. We ran into the hall and saw water everywhere. A huge stain was spreading on the carpet. I saw the janitor trying to seize the mop. He fought the water but he slipped and sank down.

"I will help!" I shouted like a champion.

I ran over and turned the handle eight times. The water stopped and everyone clapped for me. I felt happy but then I remembered my math. I walked back to class very slowly.

We were playing soccer at recess and I was the captain. The other team was really good but we were following the ball everywhere. Suddenly, my friend Ben kicked it super hard. The ball crashed right into the goal and we all cheered.

"We are totally going to win this!" I yelled.

But then the other team got the ball back. They ran fast and I heard my heart thumping. Their best player kicked it and it hit the pole.

"Oh man, so close!" he shouted while groaning.

The bell rang and the teacher appeared by the water fountain. We were tired and sweaty like roasted chickens. But we won the game and I felt like a champion. It was the best recess ever.

My brother Tom thinks he is the best at everything. We were playing baseball in the backyard on Saturday. I was waiting for my turn to hit the ball. Tom threw the ball really fast at my head! I felt anger inside me but I didn't say anything. I grabbed the bat and started swinging hard.

"That's enough!" my mom yelled from the back porch.

I dropped the bat and started groaning because it wasn't fair. Tom laughed at me like he always does. I tried to explain that he threw it too fast. He said he was using psychology to mess up my game. Next time I will strike him out for sure.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old forest. We started roaming around and looking for treasure. Sam bought a map from our neighbor. It showed a big red X near the twisted tree. We walked for a long time. My backpack had too much weight.

"I see something!" Sam screamed.

It was a big hole. We saw a strange box inside. I threw a rock at it. Nothing happened. Suddenly a colonel came out of the bushes! He looked like a science teacher but scary. He was loading a net gun.

"You aren't leaving with that!" he yelled.

We ran fast and scratched our legs on bushes. We didn't get the gold either. But we spread the news to everyone at school. Next time we will bring flashlights.

I climbed up the tallest tree and sat on a branch. My robot dog Sparky flew up next to me. We saw a plain silver spaceship approaching fast. It landed near the park fountain with a loud thumping noise. A green alien walked out and greeted us with a wave.

"Is that a treasure chest?" asked Sparky loudly.

The alien nodded and opened the box. Smoke spread throughout the air gradually. Inside was a mountain of roasted marshmallows! It seemed impossible, but there was enough for everyone.

"Yum, let's eat!" I shouted happily.

We ate marshmallows all day until our tummies hurt.

Me and my dog Buster went deep into the woods. We were looking for a secret fort. Buster started sniffing a big bush. Suddenly he ran off and I got scared.

"Buster come back!" I yelled really loud.

I heard a whistle sound but it was just the wind. I walked for an hour and felt like I was in trouble. The trees surrounding me looked very tall and scary. Then I saw something floating in the river. It was Buster's red ball!

I struck a stick against a tree to make noise. Buster barked and ran out from behind a rock. He was trembling because he was wet and cold.

"You are a bad dog," I said but I hugged him.

We went home and ate toasted marshmallows by the fire. Next time I will keep him on his leash.

My brother Tim thinks he is stronger than me. We played a new video game about climbing big mountains. The game had a cool design with bright colors. I picked a character from a foreign land with blue hair. Tim picked a big robot guy with huge arms.

"You are playing it all wrong," Tim said loudly.

I ignored him and pushed the buttons really fast. My character sprinted up the mountain and jumped over rocks. I felt my brain working hard to win. Neither of us blinked for a long time. Suddenly I saw a secret path through the trees. I was certain I could win now.

"Hey, how did you do that?" Tim yelled.

I crossed the finish line first and did a happy dance. I beat him and it felt great!

Yesterday I was playing my favorite video game. It was a cold day in February, so I stayed inside. My character was a brave knight roaming through a big castle. I gripped my controller tight because I was nervous. My big brother was sitting next to me and coaching me.

"Watch out for the dragon!" he yelled loudly.

I jumped over the fire and bounced off a wall. Then I crashed into the big boss monster. My score was growing higher and higher. It was a beautiful win!

"You finally beat the level!" my brother said.

I was so happy that I did a victory dance. We played games all afternoon until dinner time.

My robot Sparky and I went to search for space rocks. We were on the red planet Mars. Suddenly, I heard a loud noise behind a big hill. A green alien jumped out and screamed at us!

"Run away fast, Sparky!" I yelled.

We scrambled over the rocks, but my foot got trapped. The alien was getting closer gradually. I tried to pull my foot out, but I didn't have enough strength. Sparky used his metal arms to squeeze the rock. He was groaning because it was so heavy.

"Maintain your power!" I shouted to him.

Sparky broke the rock and we were free. We ran back to the ship for training. Next time we will bring bigger lasers.

My dog Buster loves playing outside in the big woods. Yesterday, he saw a squirrel and ran very fast. I chased him past fourteen big trees. Suddenly, Buster crashed right into a muddy bush. He was swinging his tail but he looked stuck.

"Buster, stop moving!" I shouted loudly at him.

He struggled to get out, but the thorns held him tight. I saw something surrounding his leg. It was an old vine that grew there. I carefully chewed on my lip while I thought. Then I pulled the vine away. Buster jumped out and started dumping mud everywhere.

"You are a messy boy," I said with a laugh.

He was hungry so he led me back home. It was important to give him a big dinner. We were both tired.

My birthday party was a jungle theme. Everyone came to my house for a sleepover. My mom made a big cake with green frosting. It looked like green grass on a computer game. We played a game where we were breathing really quiet. We had to sneak past my dad who was sleeping. He had a newspaper on his face and snored loud.

"Watch out for the danger!" whispered my friend Sam.

I tickled my dad’s nose with a soft feather. He woke up fast and started bumping into the wall. It was so funny and we all started cheering. The noise grew very loud in the living room. Then we ate pizza and watched a movie. It was the best birthday ever.

It was my sister’s birthday and we planned a surprise. Mom brewed some hot chocolate and we started loading the car. We drove to the petting zoo because Sarah loves animals.

"Listen! Do you hear that?" Sarah asked us excitedly.

We saw a tiny lamb floating in a little pond. It was actually just swimming but it looked funny. Then Sarah discovered a shiny rock near the water. It looked like a real jewel but it was just glass.

I tried to pick up the lamb but it was a failure. I got mud on my shirt and made a big stain.

"That is not a pleasant smell," Mom said laughing.

We opened presents on the grass and it was a pleasure. Sarah loved her day even though I was muddy.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old cave. It looked different than before because it was dark and scary. We climbed over big rocks and pushed through some sticky webs. Sam held a small knife to cut the vines.

"Do you see anything?" Sam asked me quietly.

"Neither of us can see in the dark," I said back.

Suddenly, we saw a shiny blue light ahead. We walked slowly and gradually got closer to the glow. It was a huge, bright jewel on a stone. I knew it was magic. I picked it up and felt the heavy weight in my hand. Then a loud roar greeted us from the shadows! We ran very fast all the way home. We were safe but we left the jewel behind.

I was on my balcony and I felt a cool breeze. I was dreaming about a big grey elephant in the jungle. Suddenly I saw my cat Mittens ran outside very fast. She stole my sandwich and scrambled up the big oak tree! 

"Mittens, come down right now!" I yelled at her.

She just looked at me like nothing was wrong. I struggled to climb the tree because it was slippery. I had a bad feeling about this. My dad came outside because he was done cleaning the garage. 

"Is that cat groaning at you?" asked my dad.

We used a ladder and spread a blanket to catch her. Mittens thinks she is the queen and her reign will never end. I think cats are weird and that is just science.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were wearing our explorer hats and we looked brave. We found a scary old house near a fountain. The scenery was spooky and dark like a movie.

"Do we have enough brave in us?" I asked Sam.

Sam yelled, "Yes we do! Let's go inside!"

We neared the door and it opened with a creak. Suddenly a big owl screeched loudly at us! We feared it was a ghost from heaven. Sam dropped his pocket knife and I dropped a receipt. Then we heard a loud whistle from behind a tree. We ran home fast because that was enough exploring.

I was playing a cool game on the computer. It was super late and my eyes felt weird. My character was roaming in a dark forest. Suddenly I heard a loud moaning sound. It sounded like a scary zombie or something dangerous.

"What was that noise?" I whispered to my dog.

He just looked at me and then he blew air. I looked back at the screen to complete the level. I had to jump over a big weight. Then my dad walked in holding a newspaper.

"You should be sleeping right now!" he said loudly.

I got caught playing past my bedtime again. I didn't say any swearing words but I was mad. I turned it off and went to bed. Next time I will be more quiet.

My dog Sparky was wearing his new blue collar today. It was early in the morning, and we went to the park. My nephew Ben came with me because he loves Sparky.

"Let's play tag!" Ben yelled and sprinted across the green grass.

Sparky barked and ran fast, but he struggled to catch Ben. Suddenly, Sparky stopped by a big bush and started digging. I grabbed his collar because I thought something was wrong. But then I saw something shiny in the dirt.

"Look, it’s a jewel!" I said.

It was wonderful and bright like a ghost in the sun. We gradually cleaned the dirt off. I will always remember this day. It was better than dog training!

I bought a robot kit with my birthday money. It was simply the coolest thing ever. I started loading the batteries into its metal back. Suddenly, its green eyes flashed and it flew up!

"My brain feels fuzzy," said the robot loudly.

I jumped back and thumping noises came from its chest. Neither of us knew what to do next. My mom brewed some tea downstairs and didn't hear.

"I have obtained super strength," the robot yelled.

It picked up my heavy desk like a feather. The weight was nothing for its metal arms. Then it swam through the air around my room. I hope it doesn't smash my lamp!

I was sitting in math class and looking at the clock. It was almost time for recess and I was so hungry. My stomach made a loud noise throughout the room. Everyone looked at me and I turned red.

"Is that a bear?" my friend Leo asked me.

"No, it's just my tummy," I whispered back.

Finally the bell rang and we all ran outside. We played tag and I was jumping over a big rock. Then I remembered I had a camping trip this weekend! I was so happy thinking about marshmallows. I counted fourteen kids playing on the monkey bars. I pointed my finger at Leo and he ran away. I followed him but then the teacher blew the whistle. It was time for lunch and I was seeing pizza on the menu! I thought school was actually pretty fun today.

I opened my lunch box and screamed really loud. My sandwich was gone and there wasn't even a crumb left! I looked at my friend Billy and he looked scared. I meant to bring my ham sandwich but now I was hungry.

"Did you eat my lunch?" I asked him.

"No way, I am being honest!" Billy said.

I believed him because Billy is my best friend. Then I saw a squirrel running away with a bag. It was incredible because the squirrel was holding my sandwich!

"Look at that squirrel!" I yelled.

We chased it but it ran up a tree. I did not remember to close my bag before recess. Next time I will use scissors to cut my sandwich so the squirrel can't carry it all.

Me and my best friend Leo went boating on the lake. The water was beautiful and very blue. We were approaching a small island with big rocks. Suddenly, our boat struck a hidden log! We started bumping into the shore hard.

"Jump out!" yelled Leo.

We were jumping onto the sand quickly. We walked through some tall grass and saw an old house. It looked like a scary apartment for a ghost. We opened the door and dust spread everywhere. It was dark, though we saw a shiny box. I opened it and found a map inside.

"It's treasure!" I said.

We ran back to the boat to go home. We were scared but happy about our big adventure.

One day I was walking in the woods near my neighbor's house. It was the beginning of summer and the grass was growing fast. Suddenly I saw a weird glowing trail on the ground. I followed it and found a small green creature. It looked like a baby alien and it held a shiny rock. I was scared but it looked friendly.

"Do you want some candy?" I asked the alien.

The alien grinned and said, "It is a pleasure to meet you."

That was weird because aliens usually make screaming noises. It was bearing a message from space. It said caffeine was very important for fuel on Mars. I was certain my mom had lots of coffee. I had a yearning to help him fly home. We ran to my house to get the coffee beans.

My dog Buster is weird but I love him. One day we went on a big adventure in the woods. Buster ran fast and I scrambled over a big log. Suddenly Buster stopped and sniffed a pile of old leaves. I looked down and discovered a tiny green box.

"What is that, Buster?" I asked him. He just barked and wagged his tail fast.

I opened the box and saw a shiny red rock. It dropped out and rolled onto some newspaper. I was thrilled because it looked like magic treasure. Maybe it grew from the ground! Then it started to glow bright blue.

"Let's go home now," I said to Buster.

We ran back and nothing bad happened. My imagination is wild, but I think the rock is real magic. I trained Buster to find more treasure tomorrow.

I was sitting at my computer playing the best racing game. I was tearing down the track in my red car. My mom swept into the room holding a newspaper.

"You have been on that thing all day," she said.

She meant I was in big trouble. I paused the game right before the finish line. My dog Buster came in bringing his bone. He chewed on it loudly while I looked at Mom.

"I just need to complete this one level," I begged.

Mom sighed and touched my shoulder gently. "Okay, but then you take Buster outside," she said.

I unpaused the game and drove fast. I didn't knock into any walls this time. It felt like the earth shook when I won. I saw the foreign flag waving on the screen. Hanging out with Buster outside was going to be fun too.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating on the lake. The breeze was nice and cool on our faces. We saw a secret island and pushed our boat onto the sand. 

"Look at that cave!" Sam shouted loudly. 

We walked inside the dark cave leading deep underground. Suddenly, a big bear was sleeping right there! We knew we had to be very quiet. We crossed the rocky floor carefully. But I stepped on a stick and it snapped. The bear opened one eye. 

"Run fast!" I yelled and we ran away. 

We got back to the boat and disappeared into the fog. Later, we roasted marshmallows on the beach. My mom brewed some coffee because she needed caffeine. We spread our sleeping bags out at eight o'clock. I don't know the meaning of that map, but it was scary.

I was wearing my new blue shoes at recess today. We played a big game of tag on the grass. Sarah was the captain of the tag team. She is very fast and never gets tired.

"You can't catch me!" shouted Sarah while running away.

I grabbed my friend Tom so he wouldn't fall. He was clinging to the slide. Then I heard the bell ring loudly. Recess was over and it was a complete failure because I didn't tag anyone.

"I will catch you tomorrow," I told Sarah.

We walked back inside for math class. I grasped my pencil tight. I was bringing my homework to the teacher but I dropped it. The teacher’s daughter helped me pick it up. I felt happy seeing my paper was safe. School is fun but I like camping better.

I feared the math test so much today. Mrs. Baker walked in and she looked very weird. She screeched at us to sit down fast. I didn't know what to do so I froze. Then she started laughing and treated us to donuts! She bought them because we all did our homework.

"I thought you were mad!" screamed Tommy from the back.

"No, I just wanted to surprise you," Mrs. Baker said.

I was so grateful for the yummy chocolate donut. I tried to seize the biggest one on the desk. But then gravity made it slip from my hand. It fell right on the floor and got dirty. Everyone roasted me because I had butterfingers. I had to write the test while I was hungry.

It was February and it was freezing outside. My brother and I were bored so we turned on the Xbox. The loading screen took forever but we finally picked our favorite space game. I feared the big boss level because the aliens are super fast.

"You have to jump now!" my brother shouted at the TV.
"I am trying but my controller is stuck!" I yelled back.

Suddenly my character escaped the spaceship and was floating. There was zero gravity and he was just roaming around in the dark. I heard a loud beep and the boss appeared. I got into a good rhythm and I started shooting lasers everywhere. My brother was screaming with excitement when I won. My character greeted the king and got a gold medal. We high-fived so hard my hand hurt.

I was in big trouble because I forgot my homework. My schedule said math was first and I felt scared. I looked in my bag but neither book was there. Then Mrs. Green walked by and touched my shoulder gently. She treated everyone nice but she liked homework a lot.

"Did you remember your worksheet, Sam?" she asked me.

"My dog ate it!" I said, but that was a lie.

Just then the wind blew my paper across the floor! It fell out of my leather jacket pocket. I grabbed it fast. I grew very happy because now I could play at recess. The playground scenery was great and we had an adventure. We played tag until it was eight o'clock.

Yesterday, I saw a robot roaming in my backyard. It was silver and had weird green eyes. It scratched its metal head and looked lost.

"Hey, are you from space?" I asked it.

The robot looked at the freezing cold grass. "I do not remember," it said with a sad beep.

I decided to start coaching it to be a superhero. We did training by the big oak tree. It tried to bungee jump with a rope but it broke. Gradually, the robot got stronger. It scrambled up the wall like a spider. Neither of us knew its name yet.

"My stomach hurts," the robot grumbled, pointing at its tummy.

I saw a tiny foreign object stuck there. It was a toy lamb! I pulled it out. Then the robot flew up to the ceiling of the sky! It was amazing.

I went to my friend Sam’s sleepover on Saturday. We ate pizza and roasted marshmallows in the backyard. The fire was hot but the marshmallows tasted so good. Then we played hide and seek in the dark. I hid behind a big bush near the fence.

Suddenly I felt a sharp stinging on my arm! I yelled and jumped out of the bush fast.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked me and ran over.

"Something bit me!" I said and rubbed my arm.

It was just a mosquito but it hurt a lot. Then I saw a white feather on the ground there. I picked it up and knew it was special. Sam's dad was coaching us on how to be brave. I wasn't scared anymore and we went back inside. We didn't lose a single game of video games after that. It was the best sleepover ever before leaving the next morning.

One day my nephew Timmy and I went exploring. We bought a map from an old shop. The map showed a secret cave in the woods. We started running fast to find the big X. Suddenly a huge wind swept through the trees.

We saw a dark cave and went inside slowly. It smelled like old leather and wet dirt. Then we heard a loud noise. A green creature was jumping around in the corner!

"Watch out for its sharp teeth!" I yelled loudly.

"I think it wants a snack," Timmy said.

I gave it my sandwich and it chewed happily. We ran home fast before it got hungry again.

It was February and it was very cold outside. I simply wanted to play soccer in our big league. But my teacher Mrs. Green said we had to stay inside. I was mad and I almost started to complain. We obtained our lunch trays and sat down fast. The cafeteria lady made beef stewed with carrots today.

"I wish we could go boating instead of school," said my friend Sam.

I laughed and said, "We need water for that, silly!"

We knew we had to complete our math homework next. My dad is coaching my team later tonight anyway. I hope the cold goes away so we can play.

One day, my friend Tim and I went exploring the woods. We were yearning for an adventure. The scenery was full of big green trees. We walked for a long time without a single break.

"I am so hungry," said Tim loudly.

"Me too, but we have a mission," I said.

We were looking for the secret cave. Suddenly, I grasped Tim’s arm because I saw something scary. It was a bear! It was breathing hard and looking right at us.

We ran fast, bumping into trees. It felt impossible to escape. But then we found a hole. Gravity pulled us down deep inside. The bear could not fit. There was no reason to be scared anymore.

"Wow, look at this!" shouted Tim.

We found the cave! It was full of shiny rocks. We were the kings of the cave and our reign had begun.

It was my birthday and I was waiting for my friends. My mom put a big sign on the door. Then the doorbell rang and I sprinted to open it. It was my best friend Sam and he brought a big box.

"Happy birthday!" Sam screamed really loud.

"Thanks!" I said and gave him a big squeeze.

We played tag in the yard until my dad blew a whistle. It was time for cake but I tripped on a rock. I fell and crushed the cake box. I was groaning because it was a total failure. Crumbs were scattered everywhere on the grass. 

"Don't worry, we can still eat it!" Sam said.

We ate the smashed cake and slept in my fort later. It was the best day even with the mess.

I was eating my breakfast when a robot walked in. He looked like a giant shiny beetle made of metal. He shook the ground with his big feet. I knew he was not my neighbor!

The robot pointed at my toast. "Is that fuel?" he asked in a speaking voice like a computer.

I was feeling scared but I wanted to be brave. I stood up like a knight. "No, it is simply bread," I said.

The robot started groaning and then he fell over. I think he was just hungry. My dad came in and saw the robot. "We can't go camping now," my dad said. "We have to fix this robot first." So we did. We had to climb on his head to fix him. To be honest, it was cooler than camping.

I was steering my big cardboard rocket ship through space. My dog Sparky was the co-pilot and he looked scared. Suddenly we crashed on a purple planet. It was freezing cold outside. We saw a green alien floating near a rock. He was groaning loudly.

"Are you okay?" I asked the alien.

The alien pointed at his leg and said, "It hurts!"

I drew a bandage on him with my magic marker. His leg grew better fast. Then we got back in the ship. We flew home for dinner. It was a really good adventure.

Yesterday, my dog Buster escaped through the back gate. He is not trained very well. I was eating my breakfast, but I stopped fast. I ran outside and saw him running near the big tree.

"Come back, Buster!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and kept running. He crossed the street and saw a cat. He likes chasing cats. I waited for him to stop, but he ran longer. He looked like a fast sailor on a boat.

My mom came out and she was breathing hard. "Is that a single cat or two?" she asked.

We caught him finally. He is heavy so his weight is a lot. We need a better schedule for walking him. We also need to fix the gate so we don't need scissors to open it. No caffeine for Buster!

I was afraid of Mrs. Miller’s math class today. I had a big red stain on my shirt from lunch. It looked like a foreign country on a map. I tried to hide it with my arm.

"Take out your homework everyone," Mrs. Miller said loudly.

I looked in my bag but I saw a single problem. My dog Buster had chewed the corner of the paper! It was surrounding the answer to number eight. I counted the rips on the page.

"Is that your homework, Timmy?" my friend Ben asked.

"Yes, but now it looks like trash," I whispered back.

Just then, Mrs. Miller walked by my desk. She saw the paper and she saw the red stain too. I thought I was in trouble.

"That looks like a jewel," she said and smiled.

I was so happy I didn't get a zero.

I was sitting in class and my stomach was growling loudly. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about science and gravity. It was super boring especially because I was hungry. I counted the minutes until lunch on the big clock. Finally the bell rang and everyone started groaning because we had homework.

Mrs. Miller said, "Please finish page ten tonight class."

I grasped my lunchbox and ran outside to the playground. My best friend Sam was approaching the swings. We discovered a new game called grounding where you sit very still. It was almost impossible to stay still for long.

"You moved your foot!" Sam shouted at me.

We played until the teacher blew the whistle. She is the guide for our line. I can't wait to go home and tell my mom and her daughter about my day.

We went boating on the big lake last Saturday. My dad drank his caffeine and felt full of strength. I touched the cold water and it felt nice. Suddenly we heard a loud sounding crash near the shore. Our boat got trapped in some thick green weeds.

"Push harder!" my dad yelled with some anger.

I tried pushing the paddle but it was stuck. We needed some coaching on how to escape. We pushed together for a longer time than I wanted. Finally the boat moved and we could leave.

"Did you receive a scare?" my dad asked me.

"Yes but we are safe now," I said happily. We went home and had ice cream after our adventure.

We went into the spooky woods behind my house. My heart was thumping so loud in my chest. Max brought his dad’s flashlight and I brought snacks.

"Do you know the meaning of danger?" Max asked.

I nodded my head but I was really scared. We walked straight into the dark trees for a long time. Suddenly something heavy was bumping around in the bushes. I feared it was a monster or a bear. The weight of my backpack felt super heavy now.

"Maybe it just needs some caffeine," I whispered.

We ran away fast and I almost tripped. We slept with the lights on that night. I am certain I saw red eyes looking at us!

I was playing my favorite video game against my brother. It was a racing game with fast cars from foreign countries. I really wanted to win the big gold trophy. I grasped my controller super tight and my hands got sweaty.

"You are going to lose!" my brother yelled at me.

"No way, I am earning first place today," I said back.

Suddenly, I felt a huge sneeze coming up my nose. I sneezed so loud that I dropped the controller! My car crashed into a wall but I picked it up fast. I cleared the last jump and crossed the finish line first. I was keeping the lead the whole time.

My brother grumbled and walked away mad. I was so happy to receive the shiny gold cup on the screen.

Me and my friend Sam went into the spooky woods. We were yearning for an adventure. We saw a big gray rock and started climbing it. It was hard work but we did not stop.

"Look at that shiny thing!" yelled Sam loudly.

I saw a gold coin inside a dark hole. I reached in and my shirt started tearing on a branch. I pulled hard and finally obtained the treasure! Then we heard a loud ringing sound. It was scary so we ran home fast. We did not remain there. We ate a cookie and did not leave a single crumb.

"We are brave," I said. Sam just smiled at me. We know we are the best explorers ever.

Me and my best friend Ben are explorers. We found a weird cave behind the school. It smelled like scorched toast inside. Ben said, "Maybe a dragon lives here!"

I counted to three and we ran inside. It was dark but I had my flashlight. We saw a big metal box that looked like science stuff. It was sounding loud beeps. Suddenly something crashed near us!

I wanted to run but Ben is trained in karate. He tried to knock on the metal box. A green alien popped out!

"Do not write on my spaceship," the alien said.

We ran away fast and we never went back.

I ate my breakfast really fast because today was the big race. My friend Tim followed me to the park. We wanted to see who could run the fastest. Tim chewed his gum loud.

"I bet I can beat you to that tree!" I yelled.

"No way, I am super fast today," Tim said back.

We started at the big rock on the ground. A tiny gnat flew near my face. I swatted it away. Then we ran! I ran so hard my feet hurt. Neither of us stopped. I reached the tree first and grasped the trunk. I looked up at the leaves like a green ceiling.

"I knew I would win!" I said.

"You are too fast," Tim told me.

We sat on the grass and I felt happy. We didn't know who would win next time.

My birthday is in February and it is usually freezing. This year we had a sleepover with my three best friends. We built a huge fort in the living room with blankets. Then my friend Sam screeched because he saw a spider. I knew he was scared so I squished it immediately.

"That was incredible!" Sam said and started jumping around.

We ate pizza and I got sauce on my finger. It tasted good on my tongue so I licked it off. Later we played hide and seek in the dark. I hid under the bed but I scratched my arm. Only thirteen minutes were left before bedtime so we told scary stories.

"I am never sleeping!" my friend Mike yelled loudly.

But we all fell asleep fast in our fort.

My dog Buster is very old and sleeps a lot. One day I wanted to teach him a new trick. I read about dog psychology in a big book. I put an old newspaper on the ground outside.

"Come here Buster!" I yelled and he walked over.

I put a treat on the paper and spread it out. He reached for it but he was too slow. His legs are not very steady anymore. He struggled to bend down but he really wanted it. Gradually he got closer and closer to the yummy treat.

"You can do it boy," I said to him softly.

He finally ate it and grew very happy. I will guide him back inside for a nap now.

My neighbor Mr. Smith has a spooky old shed. My friend Ben and I crawled under the fence to see inside. We trained for this mission all week using our imagination. The door was stuck, but Ben pushed it hard.

"It smells like old socks in here," Ben grumbled.

Suddenly, we heard a loud groaning noise from the corner. Neither of us wanted to move, especially me. I thought it was a ghost or a monster.

"Let's get out of here right now!" I yelled.

We ran fast and jumped back over the fence. It was just Mr. Smith's old cat, but we were still scared. We decided to play video games instead.

It was my birthday in February and I was so excited. My dad was coaching my soccer team that morning. After the game, my friends followed us home for a sleepover. We were roaming around the backyard and playing tag.

My mom said, “Come inside, everybody, the cake is ready!”

We walked into the kitchen and saw a giant chocolate cake. My friend Tommy looked at the cake and pretended he fainted. He loves chocolate more than anything in the world.

“This is the best psychology test ever,” my dad joked.

We were waiting for my mom to cut the slices. It was the best day because we ate so much cake. Then we stayed up really late telling scary stories.

My dog Buster loves playing outside in the big garden. Yesterday he tried to catch a squirrel but it was a failure. The squirrel ran up the tree and Buster was sad. Then he saw a shiny blue feather on the grass. He wanted to seize it but the wind blew it away.

"Come here Buster!" I yelled loudly. "We are leaving now."

Buster ran to me and I gave him a treat. He chewed it up and it was crushed. We walked home like a sailor on a boat. The sky grew dark and it started to rain. Mom brewed some hot cocoa for me inside. I was thrilled to be warm and Buster slept on my feet.

Me and my neighbor Tom went to the spooky forest. We walked until the wind blew very hard. Suddenly we saw a big hole in the ground. I tried to look inside but I almost fell in. Gravity pulled me down but Tom caught my arm! It was very scary.

"We need to maintain our balance," Tom yelled loudly.

We squeezed into a small cave to hide. It gradually got darker and darker. Then we saw a bear reading a newspaper. The bear looked very nice and honest.

"I am neither mean nor scary," said the bear.

We had a fun meeting with him. We will never go there again alone though.

I was in big trouble at school today. It started during lunch when I was eating my stewed carrots. I hate carrots but my mom made me eat them. Suddenly, Billy threw his apple and hit me right in the head!

"Hey, watch where you are throwing that!" I shouted at him.

Billy just laughed and started bumping into my table. My face was gradually getting red and I was growing really mad. I stood up and my heart was thumping hard. I didn't know what to do so I just pushed him back. Then the teacher came over seeing us fight.

"Both of you go to the principal's office now," she said.

It was scary but different than a normal boring day. I hope I don't have to go to the hospital or anything crazy. Next time I will just gnaw on my carrots and ignore him.

One day I was walking in a big green meadow. Suddenly a giant silver robot appeared from the sky. It flew down fast and struck the ground hard. I feared it would hurt me, but then it opened up. A tiny green alien jumped out and he was moaning softly.

"Help me fix my ship," said the alien sadly.

"Okay, I can help you," I told him.

I realized the ship had a heavy weight on its wing. I used my super strength that I trained for. I lifted the big rock and drove it away. The alien was so happy to receive my help. He gave me a high five. Then he flew back to space and I won a cool space badge.

I was so excited for my birthday party. My mom drew a big map for the treasure hunt. I was wearing my new blue shirt. My friend Sam came dressed like a sailor. He looked funny but I liked it. We ran straight to the backyard for the game.

"Look over there!" shouted Sam.

We followed the map to the big oak tree. I saw a red string hanging down like a bungee cord. I pulled it hard and a box fell down. I realized it was the treasure! We blew the dust off the top.

"Open it fast!" said my sister.

I had to squeeze the latch to open it. Inside was a lot of candy and tearing paper. We ate it all up. It was the best day ever.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the tall grass. It looked just like a jungle behind my house. Buster ran ahead and I heard his heavy breathing. Suddenly he stopped and his ears spread out wide. I pushed through the leaves to see what he found.

"What is it, Buster?" I asked him quietly.

He was pulling on a stick stuck in the mud. It wasn't a stick though, because it was bearing sharp teeth! It was a snapping turtle. That means danger. I pulled Buster back before the turtle struck.

"We need to learn to be careful," I told him.

It was beginning to get dark so we went home. We can go on a new adventure tomorrow.

I had a huge math test today at school. I feared I would fail because fractions are super hard. My teacher Mrs. Green pulled me aside before recess. She said, "Don't worry, just try your best."

At recess, I climbed the jungle gym with my friend Sam. We talked about how we built a big Lego castle yesterday. Then the bell rang and my stomach felt weird. I tried to maintain my cool but I was scared.

The test was actually easy and I did not feel like a failure! I was so pleased when I saw the questions. I swam through the answers fast. Mrs. Green smiled and said, "Great job today!" I felt like tearing up my study notes because I was done!

I was playing my new video game with my nephew. His name is Sam and he is only five. We were fighting a big dragon in a castle.

"Watch out for the fire!" I yelled at the screen.

Sam pressed the button and his little knight jumped up. He had a silver knife and a shield. The dragon struck at him but missed. Then I saw a shiny jewel behind the dragon.

"Get the jewel, Sam! It is right there!" I shouted.

A cool breeze came from the window but I was sweating. I had a nervous feeling in my tummy. Sam ran past the dragon. He grabbed the blue jewel and the dragon fell down. We won the level! We ate a cookie to celebrate but I dropped a crumb. We spread our arms out and cheered really loud.

Yesterday was the craziest day at school ever. My teacher Mrs. Lee was drinking her coffee for the caffeine. Suddenly she started groaning and pointing at the floor. A huge beetle was clinging to her shoe! Everyone started screaming and jumping on their chairs.

"Get it off me!" Mrs. Lee yelled really loud.

My friend Sam is brave so he grabbed a cup. He trapped the beetle before it escaped under the desk. We all started cheering for Sam because he is cool.

"You saved me from failure," Mrs. Lee said happily.

Then we discovered the beetle had a friend. It was crawling near the younger kids by the door. I didn't want to pick it up either. It looked like part of a chain of bugs. Lunch was way better after that scary morning.

My brother and I were playing soccer in the park. I was keeping the ball away from him. He struggled to get it but he ran fast. Then he stole the ball and kicked it hard. It struck a tree and went left.

"You can't beat me!" I screamed at him.

He just laughed and kept running to the goal. My training schedule was hard but I knew I could win. Suddenly I tripped on a big rock. I fell down and my knee hurt bad.

"Are we going to the hospital?" I asked scared.

My brother stopped steering the ball and ran to me. He threw his water bottle down to help. It was okay though. We didn't need a hospital or anything. We sat on the grass and watched a cat on a balcony. We will remain the best soccer team ever.

It was Wednesday and it was raining outside so we played video games. I was hanging out with my friend Sam. We picked the game about climbing a huge mountain. The first level was easy but the boss level was impossible.

"You have to dodge the big rocks!" Sam yelled at me.

I tried jumping over them but my character got struck by lightning. I felt like moaning because I lost all my points. Then I drank a soda with lots of caffeine. I felt super fast and I twisted the controller hard. I beat the boss and roasted him with fire.

"Wow, that move looked foreign to me!" Sam said.

I won the game and felt like a huge weight was gone.

I was finally going to beat the greatest level ever. My hands gripped the controller super tight and my heart was pumping. I had to build a giant castle to win.

"You can't do it!" my brother screeched from the couch.

"Yes I can, just watch me!" I yelled back.

My character ran fast like a cool breeze. I discovered a secret door and knew I could win. I had thirteen blocks left to place. I built the walls up high. Then I added a cool painting on the front. Suddenly a big monster tried to knock it down. I was certain I would lose. But I jumped on his head three times! The screen flashed bright colors.

"Level complete!" the game said.

I jumped up and did a happy dance because I won. It was the best day ever.

My friends and I were playing a new soccer game. It was a pleasant day for running outside. We made two teams and the company was fun.

Suddenly, the ball went floating into the tall grass. It landed near the spooky old shed. I was a little scared to get it. I walked slowly and heard a stamping sound.

"What happened?" shouted my friend Tim from the field.

"I think I heard a monster!" I yelled back.

Then a single black cat jumped out at me. I laughed because it wasn't a monster at all. I obtained the ball and ran back fast. We played again until we had enough fun. It was even better than science class or boating on the lake. We kept speaking about the scary cat all day.

My friend Sam and I found a secret door behind the school computer. It looked impossible to open but we pushed it hard. Suddenly a dark tunnel appeared and we jumped inside. It was very cold and my hands were trembling.

"Do you think there are monsters?" I whispered, my heart beating fast.

"Maybe, but we are earning a brave badge today," Sam said.

We walked until we saw a glowing blue fountain. I feared it was poison, but Sam touched the water. A giant green slime monster spread out from the fountain! It started speaking in a weird bubbling voice.

"Who dares wake me up from my grounding?" it yelled.

We screamed and ran back to the door very fast. We made it out just in time. It was the scariest recess ever.

I was roaming around the playground at recess looking for bugs. My friend Sam was building a big sandcastle. It looked like a giant fort. Suddenly, I discovered a weird shiny beetle near the swings. It was bright green and moved very fast. I tried to catch it, but it was impossible.

"Hey Sam, come look at this bug!" I yelled.

Sam ran over and the beetle crawled under a leaf. We gradually moved the leaf but the bug was gone. The playground cleared out because the bell rang loudly.

We went inside to learn math. It was so hot in class that I felt roasted. I was grateful when school ended.

"Can we find the beetle tomorrow?" Sam asked me.

"Yes, we will catch him next time," I said.

I was playing soccer with my friend Sam outside. The sun was hot and the grass felt scorched. We searched for the ball near the big tree. Suddenly I discovered a weird bug on my shoe. It looked like a giant gnat with green wings.

"Look at that bug!" I shouted to Sam.

"Don't touch it or you get in trouble," Sam said.

I tried to kick the ball but I dropped it. Then a stinging bee flew right by my ear. It sounded like it was singing a loud song. I ran away fast and counted to eight. My legs grew tired so I stopped running.

"Did you listen to me?" Sam asked.

I nodded and we went back to playing our game. We scored three goals before dinner time.

It was my birthday party and I was so hungry. My friends came over and we played games outside. We found a big rope and pretended to bungee jump off the porch step. Then my mom called us inside for cake. The frosting was pink like a rose and smelled good. We started singing the birthday song very loud. My brother twisted the streamers and was tearing the paper off my gift. I opened the box and saw a cool toy car. A happy feeling spread all over me. We cleared the table and ate the yummy cake.

"This is the best cake ever," said my friend Sam.

"I want another piece please," I told my mom.

It was the best day and we played until dark.

My friends and I went running into the spooky forest. We were looking for the lost golden crown. Suddenly a huge elephant appeared behind a big tree. It was grey and it made a loud noise. My friend Tim started jumping up and down because he was scared.

"Run away fast!" yelled Tim.

We ran until we saw an old man in a uniform. He looked like a colonel from the army. He was dumping rocks into a deep hole.

"Help us please!" I shouted.

The colonel helped us hide from the elephant. The elephant ran past us and shook the ground with its weight. It was incredible and scary. We found the crown in the hole. We started cheering and went home. It was the best day ever.

We went to the big cave behind my house. It was very dark and I heard a beating sound. My friend Tom was scared but he had a flashlight.

"Is something sleeping in there?" Tom asked me.

I thought about it and then I saw red eyes. The monster was huge and had great height. It looked like it chewed on rocks all day. We tried to squeeze through a small hole to escape.

"Run fast before it can seize us!" I yelled.

We ran outside and spread out on the grass. The scary noise grew quiet and we were safe. We paid no money but it was a big adventure. Next time we will bring enough snacks for the monster.

My dog Buster ran through the woods very fast. He saw a squirrel and he yelled a loud bark. The squirrel ran up a tree but Buster did not stop. He jumped like he was on a bungee cord. Buster got stuck in a bush and he was trembling.

"Help me I am trapped!" he seemed to say.

I pulled on his collar and I was groaning loudly. It took thirteen minutes to get him out. My dad was fixing a fountain nearby. He grinned at us and we walked home. We toasted marshmallows outside and ate them.

"Next time we go boating instead," I said.

Buster wagged his tail bearing a big stick. He is a silly dog but I love him.

It was a cold day in February and the breeze was icy. My dog Buster chewed straight through his leash! He ran away and I was scared. I grabbed my coat and ran outside to find him. I heard a loud sneeze from behind the big bush.

"Buster, come here right now!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't come so I had to crawl through the mud. My mom would give me a grounding for getting dirty. I saw Buster eating some stewed carrots someone threw out. He looked thrilled to see me and wagged his tail.

"You are a bad dog," I told him.

I used a special whistle to make him follow me home. Back inside, I saw he chewed my dad's favorite scissors too. I hid them under the rug so I wouldn't get in trouble. We were safe inside throughout the night.

Me and my best friend Leo went on a big search. We wanted to find the lost gold in the scary forest. We walked for a long time and saw a sleeping bear. It was snoring very loud so we tiptoed past it.

Then we found a dark cave with a shiny box. I opened it and obtained a magic map! Suddenly a dragon flew down and roared at us.

"We need to give him a snack!" shouted Leo.

I had some marshmallows so we roasted them on his fire. The dragon liked the toasted treat and let us go.

"I can explain everything later," I said to Leo.

We ran home fast. We found fourteen gold coins under a rock. We are earning lots of money now!

My birthday party was super cool because it was a sleepover. My dad built a huge pillow fort that looked like a castle. We pretended we were knights roaming around the living room. My friend Leo got lost in the blankets and was afraid.

"Don't worry Leo, I will guide you out!" I yelled.

We fought imaginary dragons with soft pillows and laughed a lot. Later, my mom made us dinner with lots of protein. She said it was good for training to be knights. Then we saw a balloon floating up to the ceiling.

"Look, it's stuck near the light," said my friend Sam.

We ended the night reading comic books inside the fort. I am going to write about this meeting in my diary. It was the best birthday ever seeing all my friends happy.

My teacher brought a big box to class today. We all wanted to see what was inside it. She opened the top and I saw colorful paper. It was time for art class and I felt happy.

"Everyone needs to find a partner right now," Mrs. Green said.

I looked at my best friend Tommy and smiled. We ran to the table and grabbed the supplies. I got the scissors and Tommy got the glue. We started cutting out shapes for our big project. My legs were pumping because I was so excited.

"Let's make a giant red dragon," Tommy whispered to me.

We worked together and glued the red wings on. We discovered a stamp pad and started stamping fire. The teacher had to guide us because we made a mess. It was the best day at school ever.

I was playing my new video game called Space Force. My character had lots of strength and big green lasers. I needed to beat level thirteen because it was super hard. My mom came in and was bumping into my chair.

"You need to stop playing that silly game," she said.

"But Mom, I have to save the galaxy from danger!" I yelled.

I drank my soda for extra caffeine and focused my brain. Aliens were surrounding my ship and shooting red fireballs everywhere. I escaped just in time and shot a single missile. Boom! I won the game and felt like a science genius. It was the most important win throughout my whole life. I wanted to remain playing, but it was late. I turned fourteen in the game, but I am only eight.

My big brother Sam and I went into the dark woods. We wanted to find the old bear cave. I scratched my arm on a prickly bush. It hurt a little bit but I kept walking. Sam was coaching me on how to be quiet.

"Be careful or the bear will hear us," Sam whispered.

A tiny gnat flew right into my eye. I rubbed it and we crossed a small creek. The water was cold and went through my shoes. We finally saw the dark cave. It looked scary inside.

"I guarantee a monster lives in there," I said.

We heard a loud growl and ran home fast. We ate toasted marshmallows in the backyard instead. I thought that was much safer than a bear cave. I know we will go back one day.

My friend Sam and I were playing a video game. We were approaching the final level in the dark jungle. My mom walked in bringing us some snacks. She had toasted bread with grape spread on it.

"Watch out for the guard surrounding the castle!" Sam yelled.

I pressed the jump button and my character flew up. But then I fell into a pit of spikes.

"Oh no, now we are in big trouble," I said.

My dad was reading the newspaper and drinking coffee for caffeine. He looked up and laughed at us losing again. Although we tried hard, neither of us could win the game. We just ate our toast and pretended the floor was lava. It was fun even if we lost the game.

My backpack felt heavy like a huge weight today. I walked into class and feared the math test. Mrs. Green yelled at everyone to sit down fast. She started tearing the papers from her big book. I gripped my pencil hard and my hands grew sweaty.

"Don't start until I say go!" she said.

I looked out the window at the playground balcony. I wished I was invisible so I could just leave. My brain felt like a computer that was slowly loading. Then the bell rang loudly and everyone grabbed their bags.

"Recess time is here!" my friend Sam shouted.

I ran outside and the reign of terror was over. We played tag and disappeared behind the slide. I never even paid attention to the test again. We saw the teacher approaching but we just kept running.

My robot dog Sparky ran away to the moon. It was impossible to catch him because he had jet boots. I put on my space suit and it was freezing outside. I flew my rocket ship up to space and I was seeing stars everywhere.

"Come here Sparky!" I yelled into my radio.

Sparky barked and floated by a green alien. The alien was very tall and his height scared me a little. The alien was eating a receipt from a space store. He looked sick so we took him to the space hospital. The doctor gave him medicine and Sparky licked his face. I didn't want to leave either of them but we had to go home. It was a crazy scene but now Sparky sleeps in my bed.

I was walking in the woods in my blue sweater. Suddenly I saw a big silver robot behind a tree. He was making a loud groaning sound like he was hurt. I searched his metal leg and saw a big scratch.

"Don't worry, I can fix you!" I yelled happily.

I used my super speed to wrap a bandage around him. The robot stopped moaning and looked at me. He grinned a big metal smile.

"Thank you, little knight," the robot said in a funny voice.

Then he flew up into the sky like he was going to heaven. It was a wonderful day. I will remember it forever. Now I am going boating with my dad.

Me and my best friend Sam wanted an adventure. We dug a huge hole in my backyard on Saturday. We were looking for pirate gold or maybe dinosaur bones. The earth was hard and dry but we kept digging.

Suddenly, my shovel struck something loud! It was a big metal box with weird writing.

"I bet it's treasure!" Sam yelled.

"We are going to be rich," I said.

We tried to open the lid but it was stuck tight. We pulled and pulled until my hands hurt. Finally, we used a stick to squeeze it open. Inside was not gold. It was just old rusty tools. We were super hungry and tired. My mom called us for dinner. We didn't find gold, but digging was still fun. Next time we will dig deeper.

Yesterday was my younger brother Max’s birthday party. We went to the big pool park and it was so sunny. I swam in the deep end but Max stayed in the baby pool.

He was afraid of the big blue slide because it looked dangerous. "Go on, Max! It is fun!" I shouted.

"No way, I am hungry," Max said. He ran to eat pizza instead.

I went down the slide and flew through the water. It was awesome. Max kept eating cake until his face was blue. My mom said eating too much sugar is a failure. But Max didn't care.

Later we played tag on the grass. I ran too fast and fell. My mom said, "Be careful or you are getting a grounding!"

It was the best day ever.

It was my best birthday ever. My friend Ben came over for a sleepover and he brought a cool game. We pretended to be lost on a desert island.

"I am a brave sailor!" Ben yelled loudly.

I grabbed the scissors and cut some paper leaves. Then we heard a weird noise. It sounded like something was groaning under my bed. I feared it was a monster.

"Maybe it is an alien from earth," I whispered.

Ben screeched and fell down because of gravity. I hurt my thumb trying to help him up. We looked under the bed together. It was just my dog Buster.

"We have to maintain our fort," I said.

We ate cake and played until we fell asleep.

My brother and I met at the park for soccer. He thinks he is the best player ever though. I tried to explain that I am faster than him.

I kicked the beautiful new ball very hard. It struck the goal post and bounced back at me. Then it crashed into a tree behind us.

"That was a terrible shot!" he screamed loudly.

"I was trying to do a trick," I said.

Suddenly a big dog ran out and found our ball. The dog was dressed like a sailor in a little hat. He grabbed the ball and ran away fast. It was like he turned invisible in the bushes. We never saw our soccer ball again.

I was dreaming about boating on a big blue lake. Then my alarm struck seven and I woke up. I got dressed fast and ate my toast. Mom stood by the door and she was holding my backpack.

"Did you finish that math sheet?" she asked me.

"Yes, Mrs. Green taught us how yesterday," I said.

At school, we played kickball during recess. It was a pleasure to be outside in the sun. But then the bell rang way too soon. We were loading our bags to go back inside. My legs were trembling a little because I ran so much. School is okay but recess is the best part.

My dog Rusty discovered a big hole in the yard. He twisted his head and then he crawled right inside! I screamed, "Rusty, get out of there!" But he didn't listen to me and kept digging. The sun scorched my back because it was so hot. I saw a piece of old leather near the hole. Rusty dropped something small and brown on the grass. It was a tiny baby bunny! I picked it up gently. It felt lighter than gravity.

"Oh, you poor thing," I whispered to the bunny.

Rusty looked very grateful that I wasn't mad. I saw a loose thread on his collar. We went inside to give the bunny some water.

I went to my best friend Sam’s house for a sleepover. We were pumping up the air mattress in the living room. It felt like heaven because we could stay up late.

“Can we eat the leftover cake?” I asked Sam.

“Yeah, but watch out for my dog,” Sam said.

We dropped a big crumb on the floor by accident. Sam’s dog came roaming over and ate it fast. Then we discovered a tiny gnat flying around the light. It was annoying.

The next day we went boating on the lake with his dad. It was a different kind of fun. I was simply grateful that Sam is my friend. We greeted his mom when we got back. I have to go home tomorrow, but it was the best time ever.

It was Wednesday and I had a big basketball game. The gym was super loud and my ears were ringing. My friend Sam passed the ball straight to me. I bounced it two times and ran fast.

"Shoot it now!" yelled my coach from the side.

I threw the ball through the hoop and we won! Everyone cheered for me and touched my shoulder. It felt weird because I am not usually the best player.

"Did you see that shot?" Sam asked me later.

I was certain we would lose but we didn't. We will receive a big gold trophy next week. I can't wait to show my mom.

My dog Buster is not very smart but he is funny. Yesterday I was on the computer looking at a schedule for school. Suddenly Buster screeched very loud and ran outside. He saw a squirrel on the ground and wanted to catch it. The squirrel ran up the tree and Buster jumped.

"Come back here Buster!" I yelled at him.

He did not listen because he is not trained very well. He spread his paws and dug a big hole. I remembered that digging holes is bad.

"Stop that right now!" my mom shouted from the porch.
