Buster gradually stopped and looked at us with sad eyes. We opened the door and he came inside for a treat. He thinks eating treats is the most important thing ever.

My brother Tom was having a birthday party. I wanted to give him his big present. It was wrapped in thick paper and tape. I struggled to open the box for him. I needed the big silver scissors.

"Let me help you," said my mom.

I grumbled because I wanted to do it. I pushed the scissors through the paper. I gripped the handle very tight. It was a hard feeling.

Suddenly, the dog ran in! He tried to squeeze under the table. He knocked over the cake and I screamed.

"Rex, stop that!" yelled Tom loudly.

I had to guard the presents from the dog. Rex just wanted to lick the frosting. It was a crazy party.

I thought our trip to the moon would be fun. My nephew Sam came with me on the rocket ship. We flew through space and it was very fast.

"This gravity feels weird," grumbled Sam as he floated.

We landed on a big, gray rock. It was pleasant but dark. Suddenly, a green creature jumped out! It looked scary.

"We have to complete the mission!" I yelled.

We ran back to the ship very fast. It felt impossible to escape. I quickly wrote in the log book. We were safe. It was a crazy adventure.

One day a robot named Zog landed on a mountain. Zog was looking for a special rock with a green vein. He walked until the path cleared. Suddenly, a big purple monster jumped out! It was bearing sharp teeth and chewed on a stick.

"I am the guard of this place!" yelled the monster.

Zog was not scared, and neither was his pet cat. The cat had superpowers and grew very big. The ground shook.

"Please move," said Zog. "I need that rock."

The monster saw the cat growing and felt a cold breeze. He ran away fast. Zog found fourteen green rocks. He was certain his spaceship would fly again now. He walked back, and his cat was following him home especially fast.

My dog Buster is huge and he has a lot of weight. He is thirteen years old but he acts like a puppy. One day we went walking in the woods for no reason. Buster was roaming around sniffing big trees. Suddenly he started moaning and groaning at a bush.

"What are you doing Buster?" I asked him loudly.

He kept barking at a tiny squirrel on a branch. The squirrel looked like a bungee cord bouncing up and down. Then my friend Sam came over to keep us company.

"Buster is the champion of barking," Sam said laughing.

We watched the squirrel gradually climb higher up the tree. Buster stopped speaking in dog language and just wagged his tail. We are in the same league of explorers. It was the best day ever.

I woke up early because today was the big race. My tummy felt funny like a growing mountain of butterflies. I put on my red shoes and went to the park. My friend Sam was there and he looked fast.

"I bet I can beat you to the tree!" Sam yelled.

"No way, I practiced all week," I said back.

We started running and the wind hit my face. I grasped the air with my hands to go faster. Suddenly Sam disappeared behind a big bush but I kept running. I saw the finish line and ran super hard. I won but then I tripped on a rock.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked me.

"Yeah but I almost got in trouble for swearing!" I whispered.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. Max was running very fast through the tall green grass. We saw a big black beetle on a rock.

"Look at that bug!" I yelled to Max immediately.

Max sniffed it and then he barked at it. We kept walking until we saw a huge dirt mountain. I used all my strength to climb up high. Max pulled on his leash because he wanted to go too. We ate a protein bar at the top. Everything looked so small from up there. We saw eight birds singing in a tree. Then we went home because Max was tired. He fell asleep right away in his sleeping bag.

It was a super cold day at school. The weather was freezing, so I wore my thick blue sweater. At recess, we all scrambled out the door to play tag. I stood by the big slide and waited for my friend Sam.

"You're it!" Sam yelled and he jumped over a rock.

I chased him toward the big dirt mountain. The sun scorched my face a little bit even though it was cold. Suddenly, I tripped and fell down hard. I looked down and found something white in the dirt. It looked like a tiny ghost!

"Is that a ghost?" Sam asked me with big eyes.

I looked closer and laughed. It was just a crumb from a cookie. I remembered I had a cookie in my pocket earlier! It wasn't scary enough to be a ghost. We laughed and ran back inside for lunch.

I was feeling sick before my math test today. My hands were trembling a little bit because I forgot to study. The numbers on the paper looked like a foreign language. Then I saw Mrs. Baker walking over to my desk. She looked really nice and she was almost singing.

"Is something wrong, Timmy?" she asked me quietly.

"I feel like a ghost is floating in my tummy," I said.

Mrs. Baker smiled and said she could help with some coaching. I crossed my fingers and picked up my pencil. It felt sharp like a needle. Suddenly the bell started ringing for recess! I ran outside and my neck vein popped out. I was so happy I didn't have to finish the test.

My cat Fluffy discovered a loose thread on my sweater. It was a bright red thread and she pulled it hard. "Stop it Fluffy!" I shouted but she did not listen. The thread grew longer and my sweater started to unravel. I saw a big juice stain on the sleeve too. Fluffy screeched a happy meow sounding very silly. Then she saw a blue bird that flew by the window. She ran to the glass and her paws spoke a tap-tap sound. I counted three birds outside in the big tree. "I will maintain watch here," I told Fluffy. We sat there for a long time watching the birds together.

I sat at my desk and looked at the clock. It was time for science class and I was excited. We were learning about what foods contain good energy. My teacher Mr. Brown put a big chart on the wall.

"You need to eat lots of protein for training," he said.

I opened my lunchbox carefully and checked my sandwich. It was huge and had a crazy height! Then I heard a loud noise from the back. Tommy dropped his glass jar and it broke immediately.

"Oh no!" Tommy yelled really loud.

Mr. Brown looked like a strict army colonel. He walked over and said, "Be careful, and no swearing in class!"

We cleaned it up and then went to recess. I ran fast because I am training for the big race.

It was my birthday and I turned eight years old. My whole family came over for a big party. My cousin Leo climbed up the big tree in my yard. He climbed up to a very high height.

"Look at my strength!" Leo yelled from the branch.

Suddenly, he slipped and he fell on my birthday cake. The cake was completely crushed and my candles disappeared. I was sad because that cake was important. My mom said we had to go to the hospital. Leo hurt his arm and he cried often.

"We will get you a new cake," my dad said.

Later, we had company from a foreign country. They brought special candy especially for me. I followed them into the kitchen. The day was crazy but the candy was good.

My dog Buster was running around the backyard like crazy. He turned around in circles and chased his tail. I knew he wanted to play, so I went outside. Although it was cold, I didn't grab my coat. I carefully walked to the big oak tree.

"Come here, Buster!" I shouted loudly.

He came approaching fast and ended up bumping my leg. He licked my finger and started moaning for a treat. I had enough treats in my pocket for him.

"Good boy," I said and gave him a bone.

It looked like a storm brewed in the sky. Dark clouds covered the sun and looked scary. My imagination made monsters in the clouds. I closed the back door and we went inside. Staying dry was important.

My dog Buster is usually very brave. One day we were playing outside and we saw a weird bird. It looked foreign because it had bright blue feathers.

"Look at that funny bird, Buster!" I yelled.

Buster ran fast but then he suddenly stopped. He saw a squirrel do a bungee jump from a tree branch. The squirrel crashed right onto the grass. Buster almost fainted when he saw the crazy scene.

"Is the squirrel okay?" my mom asked me.

The squirrel got up and ran away fast. I think it defied gravity! Buster’s heart was beating really loud. We crossed the street to go back home. I hope the squirrel doesn't get pneumonia from the wet grass. It was the best meeting with a squirrel ever. I think that squirrel was a sailor in a past life.

I found a big robot sleeping in my backyard yesterday. His metal chest was pumping up and down really fast. I knew something was wrong because sparks were flying everywhere. My dad says he knows psychology, but he doesn't know robots.

"Can you fix my computer leg?" the robot asked me. He was speaking in a funny, buzzing voice.

I ran to the kitchen and grabbed a butter knife. I used the knife to spread some peanut butter on his gears. I guarantee that peanut butter fixes everything! Suddenly, his eyes started glowing blue and seeing everything again.

"Thank you, kid!" he said and flew into the sky. I hope he comes back soon.

I was playing my new video game about climbing a big mountain. It was impossible to win. I kept dying because a giant monster chewed on my character. I simply could not get past the first level.

"I will help you squeeze past the monster," my brother said.

He held the controller and jumped over the rocks. Then a tiny gnat flew on the screen. He tried to sneeze but he messed up. His character fell off the cliff.

"Oh no! I knew that would happen!" I yelled.

We were waiting to respawn when Mom called us for dinner. We ate roasted chicken. I remember it was especially good. I wanted to gnaw on the bones but Mom said no. We went back to play, but the game was still super hard.

Me and my brother Max went into the dark woods. We wanted to find the old king’s lost reign. Max had a map and acted like our guide. Suddenly, I heard a loud groaning sound behind a tree.

"What was that noise?" I asked Max immediately.

He grasped my arm and looked scared. We saw a big bear eating a toasted sandwich! The bear looked at us and stopped chewing.

"Maybe he needs more protein," Max said quietly.

We ran away fast before we got caught. Max was swearing because he tripped on a root. We didn’t find the king, but we were safe. Next time we will understand the danger better. Earning a treasure is hard work!

I was so excited about my sleepover with Ben. My mom was cleaning the kitchen and I was helping her. I was earning my allowance for the party snacks. Suddenly I saw a car approaching our driveway very fast.

"He's here!" I shouted and sprinted to the front door.

I opened the door and greeted Ben with a high five. He was holding a big bag of chips. We ran to my room and started reading comic books. Then my little sister came in. She started moaning because she wanted to play too.

"Go away, this is for big kids," Ben grumbled at her.

She started tearing up, so we let her stay. We played games all night and ate too much candy. It was the best sleepover ever.

Yesterday was the craziest day at school. We were seeing a movie about volcanoes in science class. Suddenly my friend Tom drew a funny face on his paper.

"Look at this!" Tom shouted loudly.

I laughed so hard that I felt a sneeze coming. The sneeze bounced off the desk and scattered all my papers everywhere. My teacher Mr. Brown looked mad. He was reading a newspaper at his big desk.

"Please sit down and do your work again," Mr. Brown said.

Then the fire alarm rang very loud. We all ran outside. It was hot and the sun scorched the grass. We obtained our lunch boxes and ate outside. It was actually a fun day.

One day I was exploring in the woods behind my house. I was running fast because I wanted to see the big rock. I climbed to the top height and looked down. I saw something grey sleeping in the bushes.

"Is that an elephant?" I asked my friend Sam.

Sam laughed and said, "No, elephants are way too big!"

We went closer and touched the grey thing with one finger. It was just a big rock with moss painting on it. It had a long crack like a blue vein. I was certain it was an animal at first. We had a meeting right there on the rock. I thought it was funny that I didn't understand what I saw. Next time I will bring my glasses outside.

It was my birthday sleepover and everyone came over. We were painting pictures on big paper in the kitchen. My friend Sam twisted the cap off the blue paint. It was stuck but he knew how to open it.

"I guarantee this will be the best painting," Sam said.

Mom brewed some hot chocolate for us to drink. Then we cleared the table because the cake was ready. My dad lit the candles and everyone started cheering loudly. I struggled to blow them all out in one breath.

"Don't complain if you don't get a corner piece!" I yelled.

We ate cake and then we lost track of time playing games. I was keeping the score but I forgot to write it down. The weight of all the candy made my tummy hurt later. It was the best night ever.

It was Wednesday and my best friend Tim came over. We wanted to play knights in the backyard. I wore my silver helmet and held a sword. Tim said it was impossible to beat him. 

"I am the strongest knight!" Tim screamed loudly.

He picked up a big rock to show his strength. The weight was too heavy and he dropped it. It struck his toe hard! He started stamping his feet and hopping around.

"Are you okay?" I asked him quickly.

He threw his sword down and we ran inside. My mom cleared off the table and gave us cookies. We understood that playing knights was dangerous. Everything felt better after we ate the cookies. Then my dog escaped the kitchen and licked Tim’s face. We heard a bark and we laughed. We know that next time we will just play video games.

I was so excited for my birthday sleepover. My friends came over and we ate pizza on the balcony. Then we discovered a small creature in the corner. It was a baby bird that struggled to fly.

"Look at his tiny wings!" said my friend Sam.

I ran to get a box and scissors to poke holes. We put soft towels inside for him. My mom came out speaking softly to the bird. She often helps animals so she knew what to do.

"He needs to rest right now," she told us.

We threw a little blanket over the box. Later we made stewed apples and watched a movie. It was important to be quiet for the bird. The next morning, he flew away through the window. I tried to whistle to him, but he was already gone.

My friend Leo and I were playing at recess. We ran to the big slide and I shouted, "Race you to the bottom!"

I was steering my body but I kept bumping the sides. It was freezing outside so my hands were cold. Then we went to the water fountain for a drink.

"Did you complete the math homework?" Leo asked me.

"No, I got in trouble for playing video games," I said.

Just then the bell started ringing so loud. We ran back to class like we were on a bungee cord. Our teacher said we obtained five extra minutes of reading time. I read a book about a colonel in the army. He was in a big league for baseball too. It was a good day.

Me and my friend Sam went to the spooky forest. We walked fast because the scenery was dark and scary. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound near a big rock.

"I think a zombie is over there!" yelled Sam.

I was scared but I had a plan in my brain. We jumped over a log and saw a glowing blue jewel. A monster was guarding it with red eyes full of anger.

"Throw your toasted sandwich at him!" I shouted loudly.

Sam threw his lunch and it made a big stain. The monster slipped and fell down with a weird rhythm. We grabbed the jewel and started jumping up and down. We ran home fast and felt like heroes of science. It was better than sitting in class learning about psychology.

My brother Tim thinks he is the greatest gamer ever. We played a new racing game on Saturday. It was freezing outside so we stayed in the warm house. I picked the fast red car with the stripes. Tim picked a weird green truck with big wheels.

"I will beat you easily," Tim said with a laugh.

"We will see about that," I yelled back at him.

The race started and my heart was thumping hard. I had to climb a huge mountain in the game. It was very difficult but I did not crash. I drove past a sharp needle rock and zoomed ahead. I crossed the finish line first! It felt wonderful to win. Now I know that I am the real champion.

We went to the woods to search for a hidden treasure. My friend Sam brought a map he bought at a sale. We walked for a long time and my legs felt tired. We neared a big old tree with weird marks on it.

"Look at that hole!" Sam yelled and pointed up high.

We climbed the tree carefully but Sam slipped a little. His foot sank into some soft mud near the roots. It was scary but he got back up fast. We looked inside the dark hole and discovered a box. It was rusty and old but it looked very cool.

"I think this is it," I whispered to Sam.

We opened it and found shiny coins inside. We were so grateful we found the treasure before dark. The shadows were growing long so we ran home fast.

My mom woke me up early today. I slept too long and we were almost late. I ran to the car and climbed inside fast. School was fun in the beginning, but math was hard. 

At lunch, I sat with my friend Ben. He was dumping his carrots on his tray. He hates carrots, especially the cooked ones. Then a teacher stood by our table like a guard. 

"Eat your veggies, Ben," she said loudly.

Ben turned red and ate one carrot slowly. We cleared our trays and ran outside to play. We started stamping our feet in a big mud puddle. It was the best part of the day until my mom’s daughter came to pick me up. My big sister is cool.

My brother Tom and I were playing a video game. It was the big league final and I really wanted to win. We were racing fast cars past cool scenery and trees.

"I am definitely beating you today!" I yelled loudly.

Tom just laughed and screeched his tires around a corner. I was clinging to my controller and my hands were sweaty. I feared I might lose again like last time. Suddenly my car did a huge bungee jump off a ramp! I cleared the big gap and landed perfectly.

"Oh no, stop winning!" Tom said while moaning sadly.

I crossed the finish line first and I felt great. It was better than boating or swimming. My mom came in and smiled at her happy daughter. I had a yearning to play again, but Tom was too grumpy.

I went to my friend Ben’s house for a sleepover. We immediately sprinted to the backyard to play. Ben told me he built a huge fort yesterday. We scrambled up the ladder and jumped inside. It was hot and the sun scorched our faces.

"Let's play pirates!" I yelled.
"Okay, we are boating on the ocean!" Ben said.

We pretended we were floating through big waves. I dropped my toy sword and counted to ten. Then we ran inside because we smelled pizza. I will remember this fun day forever. We ate a lot of pizza and then we fell asleep.

One day me and my dog Buster went to the park. It was super windy and the wind blew hard. Suddenly Buster saw a squirrel and he ran fast. He grabbed a stick but then he dropped it.

"Come back here Buster!" I screamed really loud.

Buster did not listen and he ran into the woods. I followed him and I discovered a secret cave. It looked scorched inside like a dragon lived there. I was scared but I went in a little bit. Then something flew right past my head! It was almost invisible but I saw wings.

"Did you see that?" I asked Buster.

He just barked at a rock. I remember thinking maybe it was a bat. We ran home to look it up on my computer. Exploring is fun but caves are spooky.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday and he turned eight. We were hanging streamers in the kitchen for his party. My mom made a big chocolate cake for him. But then my dog Buster jumped up and chewed the corner!

"Oh no, Buster!" I screamed really loud at him.

My mom ran over immediately and looked at the cake. She carefully cut off the bad part with a knife. Then she put new frosting on it so it looked okay.

Later, my dad tried to cook burgers on the grill outside. But the fire was too hot and he scorched them. They looked black like rocks.

"Do we have to eat these?" Sam asked sadly.

"Nope, we are ordering pizza!" said my dad. It was the best foreign pizza ever from the Italian place.

I went outside to explore the woods behind my house. My dog Sparky followed me, and he sniffed everything. We walked for a long time until we saw a big pile of rocks.

"Look, Sparky! It looks like a castle!" I shouted.

Sparky barked at the rocks and wagged his tail. We climbed up, but then I slipped on a wet leaf. I crashed into a bush, but I wasn't hurt. Sparky licked my face because he was afraid I was sad.

I remembered I had a cookie in my pocket. I gave him a crumb, and he ate it fast. Sparky is not trained very well, but he is a good boy. We sat on the castle rocks and watched the birds fly. We have to maintain our secret fort so we can play there tomorrow.

We walked into the dark forest behind my house. My best friend Max held the flashlight and I held the map. The ground was muddy and wet from the rain. Suddenly we heard a scary groaning sound near the big rock.

"What was that?" Max whispered and he shook a little.

"It is simply the wind," I said to be brave.

But then a big shadow rose up from the bushes. It was not a monster but just my big dog Buster! He had a big mud stain on his nose. We laughed because we thought our quest was a failure. We walked home and felt tired so we slept all night. It was impossible to be scared with Buster there.

I was in the backyard and I heard a loud ringing sound. A metal robot walked out of the bushes and he was huge! He told me he was from the robot league on Mars. He said he was roaming Earth to find a special rock.

"Can you help me search for the blue rock?" asked the robot.

"I can help you if you let me fly," I said.

The robot picked me up with a single hand. We flew over the lake and saw people boating. We found the rock near a big tree. The robot was happy to complete his mission.

"You are a good guard for this planet," he beeped.

I watched him fly away into the sky. I hope I can learn to fly like that someday.

My friends and I were playing a new video game. The loading screen took forever, so we ate snacks. Chips were scattered all over the floor. My little nephew wanted to play, but he is too small.

"I bet I can beat you," said Sam.

"Neither of us is going to win," I told him.

We started the race and our cars flew down the track. The sun scorched the road in the game. I touched a boost button and went super fast. My car crossed the finish line first! I spread my arms out like a plane. Then my mom came in and saw the mess.

"You need to clean this up and eat some protein," she said.

We cleaned up and talked about maybe going boating next weekend instead.

I went camping with my dad last week. We set up our tent in a big meadow. The grass was tall and green like a jungle.

"Listen to the birds," my dad said to me.

I looked around and searched for a blue jay. Instead I saw a frog bumping into a rock. I tried to catch him but he was fast. He jumped into the river and sank to the bottom.

"You almost caught him!" Dad yelled from the fire.

I remembered I had my toy castle in the car. I made a house for bugs next to the tent. It was like bug heaven for them. We ate hot dogs and looked at the stars. It was the best night ever.

My friend Sam came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We bought pizza and then we sat in my room. We discovered a big spider on the ceiling! It looked really hairy and I was super scared.

"Don't worry, I have strength!" Sam yelled loudly.

He stood on my bed but then he turned white. The spider appeared to jump down! We were trapped in the corner. Sam started moaning like a ghost.

"It's coming for us!" I screamed.

Suddenly my dad walked in. He was tearing open a bag of chips. He saw the spider and caught it in a cup. We were not boating or doing anything cool, but it was still fun.

I was playing a video game about space and gravity. It was impossible to beat the last boss. My mom told me to clean my room instead. I sat on my bed and looked at the big red stain on the rug. It looked like a foreign planet. I wanted to keep playing but I did not want a grounding. I heard my brother on the balcony.

"Hey, look at my new bike chain!" he yelled.

I ran outside to see. It was shiny and eight feet long.

"Wow that is different," I said.

Then my mom came in. "You are in trouble," she said.

I forgot about the cleaning meaning no video games for me. I hate growing up.

We went to recess and I ran to the swings. The swings are my favorite part of the whole day. I jumped on the seat and gripped the chains tight. I started pumping my legs and went higher and higher. The wind went through my hair and it felt cool.

Suddenly, my swing twisted around and I got really scared. I screamed very loud because I thought I would fall. My friend Sam ran over and stopped me from swinging.

"Are you okay?" asked Sam.

"Yes, thank you for helping me," I said.

I was so grateful that he helped me stop. I touched his shoulder and we walked back to class together. It was a scary time but now I am safe.

My family went camping last weekend. My younger brother Sam and I slept in the big tent. It was fun but also a little scary. We swam in the lake until our lips turned blue. Then we drew pictures in the dirt with sticks.

At night, we heard a weird noise outside. Sam was trembling in his sleeping bag.

"Do you think it is a dangerous bear?" he whispered.

"No, bears are too big," I said bravely.

Something bumped the tent and my flashlight dropped. I pushed Sam behind me. We heard loud crunching sounds. Something chewed on our cooler!

In the morning, the cooler was twisted and broke. A raccoon ate all the hot dogs! We were very hungry. Dad bounced the empty cooler and laughed.

"We have to eat cereal tomorrow," Dad said.

It was my birthday and I wanted a sleepover. My best friend Sam came over for cake. We watched a movie about a big grey elephant. The elephant climbed a huge mountain and it looked very dangerous. Suddenly, the elephant crashed into a tree and started moaning.

"That elephant is not very smart in his brain," said Sam.

"Maybe he needs some special training," I said.

We ate toasted marshmallows and then we sprinted to my room. We were jumping on the bed and cheering really loud. My mom came in gradually because we were too noisy. We pretended to be sleeping so we wouldn't get in trouble. I thought she was mad but she just smiled. I was so grateful for my best birthday ever.

I was playing my favorite video game about a brave knight. It was raining outside so I couldn't play soccer. I grabbed my controller and my heart was pumping fast. The knight had a heavy weight on his back. He struggled to climb the big mountain in the game. I tried jumping over a rock but he fell down.

"Oh no! Try again!" my brother yelled at me.

I pressed the button and the knight bounced back up. He struck the bad guy with his sword. I was growing happy because I was winning. I played hard throughout the whole level. I didn't want to lose either. Finally, I beat the boss!

"You are really good at this," my brother said.

I smiled because I won the game.

My birthday party was going to be the best ever. We were building a huge fort in the living room. My friend Sam started stamping his feet to a rhythm. He was so excited about everything we built.

"This is the best fort in the whole league!" Sam yelled loudly.

Suddenly, my mom appeared with a big pot. It smelled like beef that stewed all day.

"Time for dinner, boys!" she said with a smile.

We meant to keep playing, but we were really hungry. To be honest, the fort grew a little wobbly anyway. I know it was important to eat so we could play more. It was a super fun night.

My friends and I went to the old cave. It was dark but we had flashlights. We walked through the tunnel and saw a big hole. I dropped a rock and gravity pulled it down fast.

"Watch out for the bats!" screamed Tom loudly.

We ran fast and crashed into a wall. Then I saw a shiny gold box. I grasped the handle and opened it with pleasure. Inside was a map but it was not complete.

"This is simply amazing," said Sarah with a smile.

Suddenly a big rock bounced near us. We touched the map and ran away fast. We were safe outside but we need the other piece.

I was playing my new video game all day. It is a game about bugs fighting in a science lab. My player was a big green beetle with huge strength. I had to fight the red spiders surrounding me. They kept coming and I felt a little scared.

"Help me!" I yelled to my brother.

"I am coming," he said and grabbed his controller.

We started tearing through the bad guys together. Suddenly a giant boss spider appeared on the screen. We were trapped in a corner. It meant we had to use our special power. We pushed the buttons at the same time. A beautiful blue light blasted the spider away.

"We did it!" I shouted.

We chose the best prizes after the meeting with the boss. We played throughout the whole night until mom said stop.

I was feeling happy because it was finally recess. My friend Sam and I ran to the sand box. We started building a huge sand castle together. Sam wanted to put a stick on top like a flag. I looked through my pocket and found a toy elephant.

"Let's put the elephant in the castle," I said to Sam.

Sam smiled and put the elephant right near the door. Then we struggled to make a big moat around it. Suddenly the teacher blew her loud silver whistle. We turned around and realized recess was already over.

"I don't want to go inside yet!" Sam yelled.

But we had to line up quickly or get in trouble. It was like finding a needle in a haystack to have fun at school sometimes. We walked back inside for math class.

It was a super weird Tuesday. I went to science class and Mr. Brown told us about the human body. He showed a picture of a blue vein. I feared science because I am bad at it.

“This looks like a map,” said my friend Sam.

“No, it looks like a blue worm,” I told him.

Then the fire alarm struck very loud! Everyone scrambled to the door. We crossed the playground to our special spot. Suddenly, Sam’s lunch disappeared. He thinks a big bird stole it, especially his sandwich. But I saw something else. It looked like a grey elephant near the swings!

“Did you see that animal?” I asked Sam.

“Maybe the captain of the football team ate my lunch,” Sam cried.

It was a total failure of a lunch break. We never found the elephant or the sandwich.

I looked at the clock and sighed loudly. We had one hour until school was finally over. My teacher Mrs. Gable pulled out a big newspaper. She said we had to find words in it. It was boring but then my neighbor Tim poked me.

"Do you hear that beat?" Tim asked me quietly.

I listened hard and I heard a tapping sound. It had a cool rhythm like a drum. It was coming from the radiator by the window. 

"Maybe the King of Rats is starting his reign!" I whispered back.

We laughed but Mrs. Gable knew we were talking. She gave us a look so we stopped. Finally the bell rang and we ran outside fast. School was done and I was super hungry.

I went to the spooky forest with my best friend Sam. We wanted to find the greatest treasure ever. I remembered my dad said a dragon was sleeping there. We walked for a long time and turned left at a big rock.

Suddenly, we saw a tiny cave. We had to squeeze inside. It was dark so I gripped my flashlight tight. Then we heard a loud roar! I was so scared I almost closed my eyes.

"Run!" yelled Sam. "The dragon is awake!"

I bought some candy earlier and earning money is hard, but I threw it at the dragon. The dragon stopped and ate the candy. We ran away fast. I think next time I will learn magic or bring big scissors to fight. We were safe at home.

I feared the big race at school all week. Everyone was standing on the playground surrounding the track. My heart beat super fast and I almost let out a huge sneeze. My dad rose from his seat and waved at me. He was teaching me how to run fast last summer. I was yearning to win the gold medal so bad.

"Ready, set, go!" the teacher screamed loudly.

I ran as fast as a cheetah. My legs felt like they were built of steel. I passed Timmy and then I passed Sarah. I realized I was in first place! The finish line was loading into my view. I crossed the line and everyone cheered.

"You did it!" my best friend shouted.

I was so pleased with myself. I counted to ten to catch my breath. We went boating later to celebrate my big win.

Today was the craziest day in science class. My neighbor Ben shouted that he saw a spider. He threw his pencil across the room. It flew right through the air and hit the wall. Everyone crawled under their desks because they feared the bug. I was clinging to my chair leg and keeping very still.

"It has fourteen legs!" Ben yelled loudly.

"That is just a fuzz ball," said Mrs. Green.

She picked it up with a small blue comb. It wasn't a spider at all. We all sprinted outside for recess after that. I played on the jungle gym island. I was hanging upside down like a bat. Mrs. Green brewed some tea and watched us play. I am glad school is over now.

My dog Buster and I went outside to explore. We walked into the woods behind my house. I held my dad's old guitar for some music. Buster started sniffing the ground and following a smell.

"What is it boy?" I asked him quietly.

He kept walking steady and slow. We neared a big dark cave and I felt afraid. I heard a loud groaning sound inside. I feared it was a bear or a monster. Suddenly a tiny cat appeared! It was just a kitten waiting for help.

"You aren't scary at all!" I laughed.

I searched my pockets for a treat. The cat was almost invisible in the dark. Gradually it came closer to us. It was like a science experiment gone right. We took the kitten home and named him Spooky.

I was walking in the jungle behind my apartment. Suddenly a green alien jumped out of the bushes! He was loading space rocks into a big silver bag. The alien had three eyes and his skin was slimy.

"Hello Earth boy," said the alien in a funny voice.

I was scared but I saw he was friendly. He was bringing magic seeds to plant on his planet.

"Are you bearing gifts?" I asked him bravely.

He nodded and gave me a blue glowing seed. Suddenly a giant purple flower grew right there! My little nephew ran outside and saw the flower. We were following the alien to his ship but it flew away fast. I still have the magic flower in my room.

I had a really big science project due today. I gripped my backpack tight because I was nervous. My project was about a shiny green beetle.

At recess, I searched for my friend Sam. We ran to the swings and pushed each other high. "Are you ready for science?" Sam asked.

"I think so," I said, groaning a little bit.

In class, I drew a picture of the beetle on the computer. Then I realized something bad. My real beetle was missing! I knew it was in a jar. I looked everywhere. I discovered it was dumping out in my lunchbox! The beetle swam in my juice box. My face grew hot and red. But then the teacher laughed and gave me a star anyway.

It was my birthday and we had a sleepover. My friends and I sat on the floor with popcorn. We wanted to tell ghost stories in the dark. My friend Leo climbed onto the sofa with a flashlight. He put a white sheet over his head.

"I am the ghost who stole your pizza!" he screamed loudly.

I threw a pillow at him and we all laughed. Then my dad came in with a knife and cake. He was cutting big slices for everyone. He had a newspaper under his arm.

"Watch your finger, Dad!" I yelled at him.

Suddenly the lights went out and we got scared. My little sister was clinging to my leg tightly. But it was just the cat messing with the plug. We ate cake and looked at the snowy scenery outside. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my robot Zap went on a search through space. We landed on the purple planet and saw a jungle. It was very messy and hard to walk. We crawled under big blue leaves.

"This is spooky," Zap said while bumping into a tree.

We followed a weird trail of green slime. Suddenly, a three-eyed alien jumped out! It was groaning loudly. I was certain it wanted to eat us.

"Run back to the ship!" I yelled to Zap.

We ran fast, bringing lots of mud with us. Zap started swearing in robot beeps because he slipped. We counted ten more aliens coming. But we got inside just in time. We were glad to have each other's company. I will write about this in my diary later. Gradually, the ship flew away and we were safe.

Last Saturday was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover. We played games and ate pizza until our tummies hurt. The party neared the end when Sam had a big idea.

"Let's build a giant fort!" Sam shouted loudly.

We grabbed every blanket and pillow from his room. The scenery in his bedroom looked like a soft castle. We heard his mom walking down the hall so we hid. We thought she was coming to say goodnight.

"Where did all the boys go?" his mom asked.

We giggled inside the fort and then we escaped. But I accidentally crushed a box of juice on the rug. We struggled to clean it up with some old socks. Finally we slept inside the fort all night long. It was the best sleepover ever.

My robot Max is usually very nice. He is made of shiny metal and he likes bringing me snacks. But last February something went wrong. He started to gnaw on the kitchen table leg! My mom heard the noise and she was full of anger.

"Max! Stop that right now!" she yelled.

Max’s eyes turned red and he looked straight at her. I feared he was broken forever. My neighbor Mr. Smith came over to help. He crossed two wires in Max's back. Max stopped chewing.

"Did you contain the glitch?" I asked Mr. Smith.

"Yes, but listen to his gears," he said.

We heard a happy beep. Max was already fixed! I was thrilled because I almost lost my best friend. Now he only eats batteries.

Yesterday I played a racing video game with my brother. We were steering our cars really fast on the track. Suddenly my car hit a big wall and flipped over.

"You are dumping your car in the trash!" my brother shouted.

I felt mad but I kept playing anyway. I pulled my controller back and hit the gas button. My car started tearing down the road again. I was growing faster and faster every second. It felt impossible to catch him but I tried hard.

Then I saw a ramp with a bungee cord trap. I dodged it and he hit it! He went flying up. I grinned big and crossed the finish line first.

"That meant I won the championship!" I yelled.

I opened a soda to celebrate my big win. It was the best bearing him ever.

It was my birthday and I was so excited. I jumped out of bed and ran through the hall. My mom was cooking pancakes and it smelled good.

"Happy birthday!" mom said and gave me a big hug.

I sat down and my dad walked in groaning. He had a big box and he put it down. It made a loud thumping noise on the floor.

"What happened to your back?" asked mom.

"Gravity is strong today," dad joked and rubbed his neck.

I opened the box and discovered a shiny red bike! I simply could not believe my eyes. I grew a huge smile and hopped on the seat. I chose a blue helmet and blew out my candles later. I did not receive any socks either. It was the best day ever surrounding my family.

We went camping in the woods last weekend. My dad was loading the car with big sleeping bags. I scrambled over the seats to find my spot. When we got there, we went hiking through the tall grass.

Suddenly I heard a loud buzzing sound near my ear.

"Watch out for the bees!" my mom yelled.

I started running and screaming because I was scared of stinging. I squeezed my eyes shut and ran very fast. I almost touched a big spider web too. Finally we got back to our tent safely.

Later that night, we made a fire for dinner. We ate toasted marshmallows on sticks. It was the best meeting ever with nature.

"Can I have one more marshmallow?" I asked my dad.

He smiled and said yes. Exploring outside is scary but fun.

My dog Buster is a very messy eater. One day he found a big bowl of stewed beef. He started tearing into the meat so fast.

"Buster, stop making a mess!" I yelled at him.

He didn't listen and kept eating everything in the bowl. Suddenly a piece of meat went floating across the room. It hit my mom’s favorite white rug and left a stain.

"Oh no, Mom will be mad," my sister said.

We tried to clean it but the spot was longer now. It looked like a dark jewel on the floor. Buster ran outside to climb a tree. He was hanging from a branch like a monkey. I had to do some coaching to get him down. I hope he doesn't get pneumonia from the cold air. Next time I will contain him better.

Me and my younger brother Tim went to the woods. We wanted to find the old treehouse. Tim wore his blue sweater because it was cold. We walked for a long time. The path got twisted and hard to see.

Suddenly, we heard a noise! A big bird sang loudly in a tree. Then we saw the treehouse high up.

"Look, I can climb that!" I shouted.

"Be careful, don't fall!" screamed Tim.

I scrambled up the rough bark. It took all my strength. I rose up high and felt very steady. I saw something shiny inside. It was a golden comb! I grabbed it fast. We ran home before a storm brewed. We were safe and happy.

My brother and I went exploring in the woods today. We were looking for bugs for my science project. The surrounding trees were very tall and green. We walked for an hour but saw nothing. It was getting weird and quiet.

Suddenly I saw a big spider on a leaf. It had a red vein on its back. I was approaching it slowly to catch it.

"Watch out!" my brother screamed loudly at me.

I jumped back and dropped my jar. The spider ran away fast. It was like a scary scene from a movie.

"That spider could give you pneumonia!" he yelled.

I laughed because that is not true. We started loading our stuff to go home. It was the beginning of a storm. The clouds looked like a dark castle. I especially love storms, but we had to run inside.

My brother Timmy is always getting into big trouble. Last night was a sleepover for my birthday. We were playing tag and running really fast. Timmy was bumping into everything and making loud noises. He ran into the desk and he fell down hard.

"Watch out!" I yelled at him very loudly.

But it was too late and he hit the desk. My dad's new computer was on that big desk. It wobbled and then it crashed on the floor. I looked at the screen and it was broke.

"Oh no, Dad will be so mad," Timmy said.

He was trembling because he was so scared. We struggled to pick it up but it was heavy. We touched the buttons but nothing turned on. Then Dad walked in and looked at the mess. We are grounded for a whole week now.

My dog Buster is trained to catch anything I throw. One day we were outside breathing the cold air. I threw a stick and it flew very far. Buster ran fast but he did not come back. I heard a loud ringing sound from the woods.

"Buster, come here!" I yelled very loud.

He came back with something shiny in his mouth. It was an old knife with a red thread on it. It looked foreign and weird. I told my mom and she made us lunch. We ate stewed beef because we were so hungry. Buster is the best dog ever.

I was sitting at my desk and leading my pencil across the paper. It was math time, but I heard a loud ringing sound. It was the recess bell! Everyone flew out of their chairs and ran outside. I saw my friend Sam wearing his new blue coat. We played tag and kept a steady pace running around.

"You can't catch me!" Sam yelled while running away.

"I am approaching you fast!" I shouted back.

Suddenly, I smelled something good like roasted peanuts. A teacher was sitting on a bench reading a newspaper. She was singing a funny song too. Neither Sam nor I knew the song, but it was nice. We didn't want to go back inside either. Then the bell rang again, so we walked back to class. Recess is definitely the best part of school.

I was playing my favorite video game about climbing mountains. My character had to guide a team up the big rocks. My big brother came in and he is thirteen.

"I bet I can beat your high score," he said.

I feared he was right because he is very good. We started the boating level next. It was hard and stinging rain hit my character. I was breathing fast. My score flew up high on the screen.

"Wow, you roasted me!" my brother yelled.

I won the game and felt so happy. The next day my picture was in the school newspaper. I didn't get pneumonia from the rain in the game but my hands were tired. I want to design my own game someday where a monster will gnaw on giant rocks.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. We walked for a long time and got very hungry. I sat down on a log and opened my lunchbox.

"I need some protein for my strength," I said.

Buster looked at my sandwich and his tail started thumping. He wanted a bite for a single reason. He loves ham. Suddenly a bright blue bird flew past us. It looked like a shiny jewel. Buster jumped up and struggled to chase it. He moved fast but the bird was faster.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He neither caught the bird nor got my sandwich. He grew tired so we walked home. It was a pleasure to be outside, even if Buster was sad. Next time I will avoid dumping my chips on the ground.

Me and my friend Leo were playing in the woods. We were following a map to find hidden treasure. The map said to go past the big rock. We saw a giant black beetle crawling on it.

"Look at that bug!" Leo shouted loudly.

We kept walking and heard a thumping sound nearby. It was just a rabbit stamping its foot. Then we saw a dark cave. I needed all my strength to be brave. The captain of our team had to go first. Inside, a spider had spread its web everywhere. I felt a sneeze brewed in my nose.

"Don't sneeze or you will wake the bats," whispered Leo.

We found a box and I tried to wrap my hands around it. Something started to gnaw on my shoe! We grabbed the gold coins and ran away fast. We did everything right and we remain the best explorers in the league.

I was in the middle of math class at the beginning of the day. Mrs. Miller was talking about numbers but I was looking at the ceiling. Suddenly I heard a loud ringing sound from the hall. It was the fire alarm!

"Line up fast!" yelled Mrs. Miller. "It is important to be quiet."

We walked outside to the playground. It was hot and the sun scorched the grass. I saw a dog roaming near the water fountain. It must have escaped from a yard. The dog was happy and started singing a weird howl.

"Look at that dog!" shouted my friend Sam.

The fire truck came but there was no fire. Someone just toasted their bagel too long in the teacher's lounge. It smelled bad. We went back inside and finished our math. I didn't finish my worksheet either.

My brother Tim and I knew about the secret cave. We grabbed our flashlights and crossed the old wooden bridge. Tim grasped my hand tight because the height was scary. We followed a muddy path up the big mountain.

Inside the cave, we saw an old painting on the wall. It looked like a map to hidden gold! Suddenly, a loud noise was sounding from the dark.

"Run!" I yelled, and I treated my fear like nothing.

I pulled Tim behind a rock with all my strength. A big bear walked by and sniffed our backpacks. It smelled the stewed apples from breakfast inside. We stayed very quiet. The bear left, so we contain our giggles and ran home fast. It was the best adventure ever!

It was Wednesday and I was playing my favorite video game. My character had a shiny blue jewel and big muscles. He was much stronger than the bad guys. I heard a scary noise coming from the dark cave.

"Watch out for the danger!" shouted my brother from the couch.

"I know what to do," I said and pressed the jump button.

My character jumped over a foreign monster with huge teeth. But then a giant rock fell down with a heavy weight. My hero almost fainted but he managed to remain standing. It was like I was in gaming heaven because I was winning.

"You are so lucky," my brother said with no pleasure.

I knew I was going to win the whole level. I did not do any swearing when I won. I just smiled.

My friends and I found a dark cave in the woods. It gave me a bad feeling but we went inside. The air smelled old and strange like a foreign place. Suddenly, a big rock fell and blocked the door!

"Oh no, we are trapped!" shouted my friend Sam.

I looked around and I saw a tiny light. It was small like a gnat. I thought it might be a way out. We crawled for fourteen minutes until the path cleared up. Then the tiny light immediately disappeared.

"Look at that big hole!" I said to Sam.

We climbed out and saw everything was bright and sunny. We ran home fast enough to eat dinner. I will never go back there again.

One day I went outside to the big meadow. I met a small bunny near a tree. The bunny looked sad and it was not moving. I saw the reason why it was stuck. Its foot was trapped in a twisted vine. I thought about what to do. I ran inside to get my big orange scissors. I left my computer game on the table.

"Don't worry bunny, I will help you," I said.

I cut the vine and the bunny was free! It hopped away very fast. I believed it was happy.

"You are welcome!" I shouted at the bunny.

I went inside and sent a text to my friend. I told him what happened to the bunny. It was a very good day.

My big sister has a dog named Spot. He wears a brown leather collar. One day we went boating on the lake. The weather was very hot and sunny. Spot was yearning to jump in the water. My sister held his leash tight like a chain. She didn’t want him to get wet.

"Please let him swim," I said.

"No, he is afraid of deep water," she told me.

But then Spot saw a duck and jumped! He splashed around and barked. We laughed and ate toasted sandwiches on the boat. Later the sky cleared up and my dad played his guitar. It was a good day, but Spot smelled like a wet grounding hog. He is a funny dog.

My robot named Zork was acting very weird today. He usually follows a strict schedule, but he was floating upside down. He made a loud thumping sound against the ceiling.

"Get down, Zork!" I yelled at him.

Zork just made a groaning noise and his eyes flashed red. He was dumping all my toys on the floor. I feared he was broken. Then a green light struck him. He started growing bigger and looked like a giant metal lamb. He scratched his head and let out a huge sneeze. Dust spread everywhere.

"Sorry, my coaching circuits are mixed up," Zork beeped.

I laughed and helped him steady himself. His new design was funny, but I liked him anyway.

One sunny day my nephew Billy and I went outside. We crawled through the tall grass in the big meadow. Billy had a big imagination and he believed we were tigers.

"Let's hunt for our dinner!" Billy whispered very loudly to me.

We moved with a slow rhythm like real wild cats. It was a pleasure to be a tiger. Suddenly we saw my dog Rover. He was not trained to be a tiger's dinner. Rover barked and jumped on us and licked our faces.

"I don't think he can understand us," I said laughing.

We went inside and Mom had stewed some carrots for lunch. She didn't have a receipt for the food but it tasted good. Being tigers made us very hungry.

My friends and I went to the twisted forest today. We wanted to find the golden needle in the cave. Tom was complaining about the height of the hill.

"Stop being a baby!" I yelled at him.

"I am not complaining!" Tom yelled back.

We kept walking and saw a huge bear. My heart was pumping fast. We started running away very quickly. Suddenly, a great idea struck me. I stopped running and stood very still.

"We need a meeting right now," I said.

I tried to explain my plan, but the bear roared. That was enough for us. We ran home fast. We didn't find the needle or become a champion today. But we were safe on the grounding. I won't go back there either.

I was playing my new computer game about racing animals. It was so hard and I kept crashing. I picked the elephant because he looked strong. My elephant was running straight on the trail. Suddenly he fell off a big cliff! It looked like he was bungee jumping without a rope.

"Oh no, I crashed again!" I yelled at the screen.

My mom came in and said, "Stop the anger, please."

I tried again and this time I was jumping over rocks. I found a magic water fountain that made me fast. I was keeping my eyes on the finish line. I didn't get dropped behind any longer. I won the race and felt very grateful.

"I thought you were going to lose!" my brother laughed.

"Next time I will pick a different animal," I said.

One morning I woke up very early. My dog Rex was yearning for a walk outside. I looked at the schedule on the fridge. It was my turn to guide him around the block. I put on my shoes and we started leaving the house.

The sun was bright and spread throughout the sky. We saw a squirrel approaching a big oak tree. Rex barked loud and pulled on the leash with all his weight.

"Stop it, Rex!" I yelled. "You will get in trouble."

We kept walking and saw my friend Sam loading his bike.

"Do you want some company?" Sam asked me.

"Yes please," I said. "Rex needs a long walk today."

We walked to the park and I found some safety scissors on the grass. I put them in my pocket. When we got home, I played on my computer. It was a good day.

I went camping with my neighbor named Captain Joe. We walked straight into the dark woods. Captain Joe shook a big stick at a bush. He thought a creature was hiding in there.

"Come out!" he yelled really loud.

Nothing happened for a long time. Then a tiny mouse ran out. It ran over my shoe. Captain Joe looked funny.

"I need a bigger brain," he said.

We laughed and then we ate some snacks. My mom bought us cookies. We felt like kings and it was our reign. The trip was complete when we found a blue thread on the ground. It was a good day.

My birthday party was at the big jump park. I woke up so early because I was excited. My mom made a cake and cut it with a knife. Then my friends came over and we drove to the park.

"I am going on the bungee jump first!" I yelled.

My friend Sam looked scared and feared the high jump. But he tried it and he bounced really high. We touched the ceiling almost.

"That was so fun!" Sam said with a big smile.

Then the man blew a loud whistle for lunch time. Seeing all my friends having fun made me happy. We ate pizza and cake until our tummies hurt. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my friend Leo climbed the big mountain. We wanted to find the magic gold fountain. It was scary but we had each other for company.

"Look out for the rocks!" shouted Leo loudly.

I was trembling a little bit but I kept going. We counted ten steps and then we saw a cave. The door opened slowly and it made a loud sound. A big green monster jumped out at us!

He struck the ground and roared like a lion. I tried to maintain my brave face for Leo.

"We have to be the champion today!" I yelled.

We ran fast and we tricked the monster. We found the fountain and filled our water bottles. Then we climbed down the mountain again safely. We did a good job keeping our secret treasure.

We went camping for my birthday last weekend. My dad pitched the tent and I helped him. A cool breeze blew my hat off my head. I ran and caught it before it dropped. Then we looked for bugs near the river. I saw a huge black beetle on a rock. It crawled slowly and I tried to catch it.

"Don't touch that bug!" my mom shouted loudly.

We ate hot dogs and sang funny songs together. My dog Spot is trained to sit and stay. He won a treat because he was so good. At night, we closed the tent flap very tight. I hope we can go camping again tomorrow. It is hard to maintain a fire but dad did it. Being with my family is the best thing ever.

I was walking home when I saw a strange green creature. It crawled out of a spaceship in the park. The creature had a shiny silver guitar and wore a leather jacket. He looked very cool but kind of scary too.

"Please listen to my song," said the alien.

He started playing and the music made me feel stronger. Suddenly a big robot came and crushed a bench nearby. The robot was groaning loud noises and loading a laser. The alien threw his guitar at the robot and it caught it.

"That is the greatest throw ever!" I yelled.

Gradually the robot stopped moving and fell over. The alien was honest and nice. He said he was looking for his nephew on Earth. Then he flew away into the sky.

Me and my friend Sam searched for the lost cave. We walked for a long time and grew tired. Suddenly a huge bat flew right at my head! I almost fainted but I stood steady on the rock.

"Look at that big hole!" Sam yelled loudly.

We went inside and it was very dark. A scary spider hung from the ceiling above us. I knew I had to use my brain. I saw a shiny gold crown on a stone.

"Grab it quick!" I shouted to Sam.

He tried to seize the crown but a trap opened. We understood that the cave was magic. The ghost of a king began his reign again. We ran away fast and did not measure how far we went. We were safe but we never went back.

I was playing my new video game called Jungle Jump. It was freezing in my room so I put on a sweater. I picked the monkey character and the level started. I had to squeeze through a tiny cave to get points. Suddenly a big tiger jumped out and chased me! I felt anger because I hate losing lives.

"Watch out for the lava pit!" my brother yelled.

I pressed the jump button hard and my monkey escaped. Then I realized I was hungry so I chewed some gum. I drew my sword and fought the boss snake. I won the level and got a gold trophy.

"Can I play next?" my brother asked me.

"Okay but don't lose my points," I said.

I was so excited for my birthday sleepover. My best friend Sam came over and we played outside. We ran to the big tree in the backyard. There was a nice breeze blowing the leaves around.

"Look at this huge bug!" Sam yelled loudly.

I was afraid it might bite me. I turned around and ran back to the porch. Sam pushed the bug away with a stick. He is never scared of anything.

We went inside and my mom gave us cake. Then we played a game with a chain made of paper. My dog scratched at the door. He wanted to play too but he is too crazy.

"Listen to that thunder," I said to Sam.

We pretended we were dreaming about flying. It was like a bungee jump in the sky. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. We walked for a long time and saw a cave.

"I think the gold is in there," said Sam.

He grinned and pointed a finger at the dark hole. We went inside and it smelled like wet dirt. Suddenly, we heard something roaming in the back. It was a big bat hanging from the roof!

The bat screeched and flew right at our heads. We started screaming and running back to the light. Sam gripped my arm very hard. We ran all the way home without stopping. We were not loading our pockets with gold today.

"That was too scary," I said.

Sam nodded and we decided to play video games instead.

I was walking to school and the weather was nice. I saw a huge black beetle on the sidewalk. I poked it with my finger but it didn't move. My friend Sam came running and almost crashed into me.

"Look at that bug!" Sam screamed loudly.

We watched the beetle bearing a big leaf on its back. Then the bell rang and we ran inside. Mrs. Jones was singing a funny song about math. We started earning points for our team by being quiet.

At lunch, I was squeezing my juice box too hard. The juice blew out and went all over Sam's shirt! I thought he would be mad but he just laughed. Having company at lunch is the best part of school. Next time I will be careful loading my tray.

I went outside to my tree fort that I built. I was climbing up the ladder when I saw my cat. He held a tiny mouse in his paws. The mouse was bearing a piece of cheese.

"Put him down, Whiskers!" I yelled very loud.

Whiskers looked at me and he did not move. He felt stronger than me today. I drew a picture of a scary dog on a newspaper. I showed it to Whiskers to scare him away.

"Go away right now!" I said to the cat.

He ran away fast and the mouse was safe. Neither of them came back to my fort that day. I was the king and it was my reign. Then I heard my mom call me for dinner.

I was playing my favorite baseball video game today. My player was a big strong sailor named Bob. He had huge muscles and was swinging a big bat. The pitcher threw the ball fast, and I pressed the button.

"Home run!" I yelled really loud at the TV.

The ball bounced off the wall and crashed into a sign. Then Bob ran fast around all the bases. I checked the schedule to see my next game. I was hungry so I chewed some gum. Then I played again and crushed the other team. I counted my points and discovered a secret bonus level.

"You are winning too much," my brother said.

I won a shiny blue jewel for first place. It was the best game ever.

My friends and I woke up really early. We wanted to climb the big mountain. My dog Max came and he chewed on a stick. The wind blew hard and it was cold.

We walked up the path and turned left. Suddenly we saw a giant bear! It looked mean and we were in trouble.

"Run back to the cave!" I yelled loudly.

We ran fast and the bear roared at us. Max caught his foot on a rock. I grabbed him and we jumped inside. We closed our eyes and waited.

"Is it gone yet?" my friend Sam spoke softly.

We looked out and the bear was sleeping. We were safe but we were tired. We went home after earning a good snack.

My friend Sam and I went to the old building. It was near the woods and looked scary. The wind blew hard and it was cold. I had to wrap my coat tight. We saw a long trail behind the house.

"Do you want to go inside?" Sam asked me.

"Yes, let’s go explore!" I said back to him.

We started to climb the big steps. A sign hung on the door but it was broken. We knew we should be careful. Suddenly a bat flew out and greeted us! We screamed and ran down the trail again. It was the greatest adventure ever, especially when we bought ice cream after. We were safe.

One day me and my friend Sam chose a weird adventure. We wanted to be like a brave knight in a movie. We went into the woods behind the old colonel's house. It was dark and my heart started beating really fast.

"Watch out for the monster," Sam whispered to me loudly.

I cleared the path with a big stick I found. Suddenly a huge bear walked out but it looked friendly. I dropped my bag and almost fainted right there. It wasn't a bear though, just a really big dog bearing a stick.

"Maybe he just wants a snack instead of us," I said.

I gave the dog my protein bar and he ate it. We slept in my treehouse that night. It wasn't a total failure because we saw a cool dog.

It was a hot Wednesday and the weather was super crazy. My friend Tom and I stood by the scary old shed. We heard a loud noise inside. Tom started running away but I grabbed his finger.

"Wait! We have to see what that noise was!" I yelled.

Tom was scared but he came back. We opened the door. It was dark but then a green light lit up the room. A tiny goblin was jumping on a pile of old books. He was reading a newspaper! He had brewed a smelly potion in a pot nearby. My heart was pumping so fast.

"Do you know about goblin psychology?" Tom asked me quietly.

"No, let's run!" I shouted.

We ran all the way home and locked the door. We never went back to the shed again.

I was digging in my backyard and I found a robot. It had a big red vein glowing on its metal arm. I felt a bad feeling in my tummy. My neighbor Billy saw it and ran over fast.

"Is that a space robot?" Billy asked me loudly.

The robot opened its eyes and they were bright green. It looked like it had anger inside it.

"We are in big danger," I told Billy quickly.

We searched for a button to turn it off. I saw a switch near its neck. I pushed it and the robot stopped moving. It was already thirteen minutes past dinner time. We ran inside before my mom started leaving to find us.

My dog Buster was sleeping in the meadow near my house. It was a hot day and he was wearing his blue collar. Suddenly a bunny appeared from the tall grass. Buster jumped up running fast but his leash got stuck on a chain.

"Come back here Buster!" I yelled really loud.

Buster barked and pulled but he could not move a single inch. I felt a cool breeze on my face. I walked over and fixed his leash so he was free.

"You have a small brain sometimes," I told him.

I gave him some water but not caffeine because that is bad for dogs. If he gets sick he has to go to the animal hospital. Exploring is important but we have to be safe. It felt like we were in a foreign land but it was just our backyard.

My cat Fluffy is usually very plain and boring. She just sleeps all day on the freezing floor. But yesterday she saw a huge bug. Fluffy jumped so high like she had no gravity! She crashed right into the lamp and it fell over.

"Oh no!" I yelled and grabbed the lamp fast.

My mom drove home right then and walked inside. The glass was scattered everywhere on the rug. Fluffy looked scared and crawled under the couch. She was making a sad groaning noise.

"Is everyone okay?" Mom asked with a worried face.

I told her Fluffy almost fainted from fear. I spent all night coaching Fluffy to be brave. We had a meeting with the bug later. I lit a flashlight and we found it outside. Fluffy hissed at it and felt much better.

I love playing basketball in the big summer league. It was an important game because my mom was watching. The coach blew his whistle loudly and the game started. I got the ball and I sprinted down the court. My heart was beating like a fast drum rhythm. I used all my strength and threw the ball high. It almost hit the ceiling but it went in!

"Good job!" my friend shouted at me while jumping.

"Thanks, I drank my dad's coffee for caffeine!" I said.

It was a beautiful shot and we were winning. We kept playing and I saw the net hanging loose. We won the game and got pizza after.

I was eating my lunch when suddenly I heard a knock. It came from the big tree on the playground island. Everyone stopped eating and walked over to see what happened. My friend Tommy scrambled up the tree to search for the noise. 

"Watch out!" yelled Tommy from way up high.

Something big crashed down and a green feather flew out. It was a giant parrot that appeared from nowhere! It screeched very loud and flapped its wings. We all struggled to catch it but it was too fast. It flew up towards heaven and grew smaller and smaller. 

"That was the coolest recess ever," I said. Then the bell rang and we had to go inside.

My friends and I went to the spooky forest. We wanted to find the lost treasure map. It disappeared a long time ago.

“Look at that weird cave!” said Max.

We walked inside and it was very dark. I heard a drip drop rhythm on the rocks. Suddenly a cold wind blew on my face. I stuck out my tongue. It tasted like dust.

Then we saw a big pot. A witch brewed green soup in it. We did not understand why she was there.

“Run away immediately!” yelled Sam.

We ran fast and we didn't look back either. We did not learn where the map was. But we were safe at home.

My friends and I reached the old spooky forest. It was dark, and a cold wind struck my face. We were looking for the floating gold coin. My brother said it was just a plain rock, though. We kept walking and tried to maintain our speed. Suddenly, I realized something was approaching us fast. It sounded big and scary like a bear!

"Run for the big tree!" I yelled loudly.

We sprinted as fast as our legs could go. I thought we were going to get eaten. We climbed up high and were swearing never to come back. But then a little bunny hopped out. We were earning a lot of scratches for nothing!

"It's just a bunny," my friend laughed.

We were safe, but we never found the gold coin.

I was waiting for the bell to ring for lunch. My stomach was growling so loud in the quiet room. Mrs. Green was reading a newspaper at her big desk. She always drank tea that she brewed in a pot.

"Is it lunchtime yet?" I whispered to my friend Sam.

"No, we have five more minutes," Sam whispered back.

I thought about the pizza they were serving today. Finally the bell rang and everyone swam through the door. The hallway was crowded with kids surrounding the cafeteria. I saw a balloon floating near the ceiling. It was the beginning of the best part of the day. We ate everything on our plates very fast. We wanted to maintain our spot on the swings outside. The playground was approaching and we ran super fast!

One day I found a weird metal box while cleaning my room. It looked like a foreign object from space. I opened the lid and a blue light came out. It was a tiny ghost robot! The robot floated up and screamed a loud beep.

"My mission is not complete!" said the ghost robot.

"I can help you complete it," I told him.

He was light and had no weight at all. He held a silver thread in his hand. We followed the thread outside to the scorched grass in the park. A spaceship landed right there. It was the beginning of a big adventure. The aliens brought snacks and we ate them. I never told my mom I almost sold the box. I will write about it in my diary later.

It was my best friend Sam's birthday sleepover. We climbed up the stairs to his attic to play hide and seek. I knew a super good spot behind some old boxes. I squeezed through a tiny gap and saw something shiny. It looked like a big red jewel on a dusty ring!

"Hey Sam, look at this!" I yelled loudly.

Sam appeared right next to me and grabbed the ring. Suddenly the lights flickered and the ring disappeared from his hand! Not a single person was in the room except us.

"Where did it go?" Sam asked and looked scared.

We followed a weird glow under the door but then we heard his mom. She had crushed ice for our sodas so we ran downstairs fast. We never found the magic ring again but the pizza was really good.

My big brother Max loves science and music. For his birthday, he got a shiny red guitar. He started jumping on his bed and playing loud songs. My dad walked in and his face looked funny. A big vein was popping out on his head.

"Please stop that loud noise right now!" Dad yelled.

Max didn't stop because he was pumping his fist in the air. Then he let out a huge sneeze. He climbed off the bed and moved to the floor. We were all hungry so Mom brought in the cake. We counted the candles and sang happy birthday. Everyone was cheering when he blew them out. It was a complete mess but still fun. Max said he will reign as the king of rock and roll. I hope he doesn't get a grounding for the noise.

We were having a sleepover at my best friend Sam's house. We were watching a scary movie about a monster on an island. Suddenly we heard a loud knock on the bedroom door! I was so scared that I screamed really loud. Sam gripped my arm hard because he was scared too.

"Who is that?" I asked Sam with a shaky voice.

"Maybe it is the monster from the movie," Sam whispered back.

Sam grasped the doorknob and turned it slowly. We were seeing a shadow moving through the hallway. The door opened and a big weight crushed us! It was just Sam's big dog, Buster.

"Oh no, unfortunately he wants to play!" said Sam.

Buster was steering us toward his ball. My mom says dogs don't know psychology, but Buster knew we were scared. Following Buster was way better than being scared of monsters.

I was playing my favorite soccer game on the computer for an hour. My brother Tim wanted to play too, but I said no. He tried to squeeze onto my chair and push me off.

"Move over!" Tim yelled and poked my arm.

"No way, I am winning this level!" I shouted back.

Suddenly the screen went black and I knew something was wrong. We lost the power because Tim pulled the cord. I was so mad I felt like I could bungee jump off the roof. Mom came in and blew her silver whistle.

"Explain what happened right now," she said.

I told her Tim unplugged it, but Tim said he was just reading the instructions. Mom made us stop and go do painting instead. I hate painting, but at least Tim didn't win either.

My brother and I were playing soccer outside. It was a really hot day in July. We were wearing our new jerseys and shorts. My dad was coaching us from the porch.

"Keep running fast to the goal!" he yelled.

I kicked the ball very hard at the net. It went right past my brother's hands.

"That is not fair!" my brother shouted loudly.

We played until it was almost thirteen o'clock. Then we heard my mom calling for lunch. I was so hungry from playing all morning. We ate roasted chicken sandwiches and drank cold water. Seeing the food made my stomach grow loud. It was the best lunch ever after winning.

My dog Rex is silly and he likes playing outside. One day I threw a stick and he chased it. He ran so fast he looked like a ghost. He crossed the big garden and found a muddy puddle. Rex likes dumping mud on the ground and rolling in it.

"Rex, stop getting dirty!" I yelled very loud.

He did not listen and his fur got heavy with weight. He looked like a brown monster now. I pretended I was a brave knight and he was a dragon. I rode my bike over to save him.

"You are a bad boy," I said to Rex.

My mom stewed some meat for dinner and the smell grew strong. Rex smelled it and ran inside before his bath was complete. He trained himself to always come for food. The reign of the muddy dog was over because Mom sang a happy song and washed him clean.

One day I was roaming in my backyard. I saw something floating in the big fountain. It was a frog! I called my nephew Sam to help me.

"Sam, look at this incredible frog!" I yelled.

"Wow, he looks like a champion swimmer," Sam said.

We pulled the frog out because he looked tired. He had a green vein on his leg. I discovered that he was actually very heavy. His weight was big for a tiny frog! We simply put him on the grass. He hopped throughout the garden and then hid under a bush. I drew a picture of him later. It was a fun day outside.

I was yearning for an adventure in the woods. My friend Sam and I walked to the beginning of the trail. The path was cleared but it looked scary. Suddenly we heard a loud moaning sound.

"What was that?" Sam screamed and grabbed my arm.

We saw a dark cave and something invisible moved inside. Then a big dragon jumped out and it was groaning loudly! Its tail was scorched and black. I threw a big rock at the dragon's foot. The dragon fell down and chewed on a stick. It was just hungry and sad. We found some berries and gave them to it.

"He likes them!" said Sam with a smile.

The dragon ate them fast and flew away happy. We were brave heroes that day.

Me and my best friend Sam climbed the big hill behind my house. It took an hour and we were very tired. Suddenly, we discovered a dark cave with groaning noises inside. My heart was thumping hard but I kept my legs steady.

"Let's go inside immediately!" shouted Sam. He grinned at me.

We walked in and it was simply beautiful with shiny crystals. Then we saw a big bear sleeping near a golden comb. The bear woke up and screamed loudly at us!

"Run away now!" I yelled.

We ran fast and didn't stop until we got home. It was the scariest day ever but the cave was cool.

Me and my friend Sam went boating on the lake. We bought a big raft for our adventure. Suddenly we saw a strange island and we rowed fast.

"Look at that big cave!" yelled Sam loudly.

We went inside and it was very dark and scary. I felt something bumping my leg and I screamed. It was just a fish but I almost fainted. We saw a man who looked like a colonel. He was clinging to a rock and looked hungry.

"I have been yearning for food," said the man.

We caught a fish and roasted it for him. The fire grew big and warm. He told us he simply got lost. We helped him maintain his boat and he was happy. We didn't bungee jump, but it was still cool.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover last Saturday. We made a huge fort in the living room with blankets. Sam’s mom brewed some hot chocolate for us to drink. We discovered a box of old costumes in the closet. I put on a cape and Sam found some scissors. We cut paper stars and threw them in the air like magic.

Suddenly, Sam shouted, "Look out, the aliens are coming!"

I jumped on the couch and landed with a big thomp. We pretended the floor was hot lava on earth. The scenery outside was dark and sounding very spooky. I was yearning for some cake so we ran to the kitchen. It was the best night ever because we stayed up super late.

I believed the spooky cave had pirate gold inside. My best friend Sam gripped his flashlight tight. We walked straight into the dark hole. It smelled like wet dirt and old socks.

"Do you think we will find trouble?" Sam asked.

"No, we are trained explorers!" I grinned at him.

Suddenly, my foot got stuck under a big rock. I struggled to pull it out. The weight was too heavy for me. Sam pulled my arm hard. We fell backward and I scratched my knee.

"Are you okay?" Sam called out in the dark.

"I think so, though it hurts," I said.

We saw something shiny near the back wall. It was just a gum wrapper, not gold. We did not find treasure, but we still felt brave. Science class tomorrow will be boring compared to this.

Yesterday was the greatest day at school ever. We played kickball and I joined the big league. My friend Sam bounced the ball to me. I kicked it really hard and it went far!

"Run fast!" yelled Sam.

I ran to first base but I slipped on mud. Now I had a giant brown stain on my pants. I looked like a messy sailor. Although my pants were dirty, I was happy because I was safe.

At lunch, I was hungry enough to eat a horse. I opened my lunchbox but my sandwich was gone. It was like a ghost took it!

"Did you search under the table?" asked my teacher.

I looked and found it, but it was squished. I ate my apple instead. After lunch, the sky cleared up. My excitement for recess was growing again. It was a fun day.

One day my friend Leo and I went to a scary island. We went there for science class to search for rare bugs. The path was twisted and dark.

"I hear a weird whistle sound," Leo said quietly.

We followed the noise deep into the jungle. Suddenly a big monkey hung down from a tree. It grabbed my backpack and crushed my sandwich!

I screamed, "Hey give that back right now!"

The monkey ran away fast but we chose to chase it. We had a yearning to get my lunch back. We found a cave but it was too dark. We decided to go home because we were hungry. It was a crazy adventure.

My dog Rex is the greatest dog ever. We were playing outside in the big forest behind my house. Suddenly, a big brown rabbit appeared near a bush. Rex started thumping his tail really fast.

"Get him, Rex! Be a champion!" I yelled loudly.

Rex ran fast but he didn't catch the rabbit. Instead, he struck a big muddy puddle. Mud spread all over his white fur. I grasped his collar carefully so he wouldn't shake. Although he was messy, he looked happy.

"Oh no, now you need a bath," I said.
