We walked home and I started cleaning him with the hose. It looked like a dog hospital in our yard. Rex shook and water went everywhere. We cleared all the mud off him. He is still my best friend.

I was playing my new knight video game on Saturday. I was waiting for the big boss to come out. He looked scary and was stamping his feet. He knocked me down and my health bar almost disappeared.

"Oh no, I am going to lose!" I yelled.

My brother walked in and started coaching me.

"Use the bungee jump attack now!" he shouted loudly.

I jumped and hit the boss and scattered his armor. It was a breeze after that and I won easily. The boss fainted on the screen. Then my mom came in bumping into the door.

"You guys need to search for your socks," she said.

We felt roasted because our room was a mess. We ran to clean up before she took the game away.

One day I was in science class feeling bored. Suddenly a green alien popped out of my backpack! He had three eyes and he chewed on my pencil. I screamed very loud and the teacher looked at me.

"Hey! That alien stole my homework!" I yelled.

The alien ran to the chalkboard and drew a big smiley face. Then he cleared his throat and started singing a weird song. Everyone started cheering because it was funny. But the teacher was full of anger.

"Get out of here right now!" the teacher shouted.

The alien winked at me and then he disappeared in a cloud of purple smoke. It was the best day of school ever.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old cave. It was dark and wet inside the big tunnel. We had to climb over some big rocks. I was trembling because it was scary.

Suddenly, we heard a knock deep in the cave.

"What was that noise?" asked Sam quietly.

"I think it's a monster," I said back.

We saw a twisted root growing from the wall. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole. My backpack got stuck for a minute. Sam helped me pull it out fast. We were keeping our flashlights on the bumpy path. Finally we saw the sun outside again. I was so grateful to be safe. We ran all the way home.

My friends and I walked to the big park today. It was my birthday and I felt very excited! We saw a huge tree growing near the slide. Everyone started climbing it fast, but I felt scared. I stayed on the ground with my mom. 

She opened a can of soda with caffeine. "Is something wrong?" she asked me kindly.

"I don't know how to climb that high," I said.

My friend Sam yelled down, "Just seize the branch!"

I tried clinging to the bark and pulled myself up. Leaves were scattered everywhere on the ground below me. I went higher and higher. It was the best birthday ever!

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark woods. We were feeling brave. We wanted to find the greatest treasure ever. We climbed a big hill and saw a cave. 

"I think the gold is in there," said Sam. 

We walked inside but then a rock fell down. We were trapped! Then we saw a bear sleeping in the corner. It was bearing its teeth. Suddenly the bear opened a single eye. We ran fast. I was tearing my shirt on a branch. We saw a hole and jumped. We swam across a cold river. We spread out our map on the grass to dry. 

"That was too scary!" I yelled.

We rode our bikes home gradually because we were tired. We were cheering when we saw my house. The door was closed but we were safe.

Me and my best friend Leo went exploring in the woods. We saw an old treehouse, so we climbed up the ladder. It was very high up and scary. Leo gripped the wooden rail tight because he was scared.

Suddenly, a giant bird flew down from the sky! It screeched very loud at us. We ran inside the little house to hide.

"Do you think it wants to eat us?" Leo asked.

"Maybe it just wants a snack," I said.

I had a sandwich wrapped in newspaper in my pocket. I spread the paper open and threw the bread outside. The bird ate it and treated us nice after that. We did not receive any bites, but we felt the weight of fear lifted off our shoulders. We climbed down fast and ran all the way home.

I was feeling thrilled because it was almost recess. But then I looked out the window and saw gray clouds. It was raining really hard outside so we had to stay in.

"Oh no!" yelled my friend Ben. "I wanted to play tag."

"Me too," I said sadly. "I hate inside recess."

We sat at our desks and I drew a picture of a monster. The monster had big muscles and lots of strength. Suddenly I felt a tickle in my nose like a tiny gnat flew in there. I let out a huge sneeze!

Everyone laughed at me especially Ben. Then the teacher blew her whistle.

"Time for math!" she said loudly.

I sighed and started following the directions on the board. Inside days are the worst days ever.

One day my dog Buster was running around the backyard. He was barking at a big hole in the earth. I looked inside and saw thirteen little bugs crawling. They were bearing tiny leaves on their backs.

"Look at those strong bugs!" I yelled to my sister.

She came over gradually because she was sleepy. She looked in the hole and started groaning.

"Eww, bugs are gross," she said.

I laughed and watched the bugs growing their pile of leaves. Buster got tired and was sleeping in the grass. Suddenly I heard a low moaning sound from the trees. It was just the wind blowing hard. We played outside until dinner. It was the best day ever.

I was running late for school today. I grabbed my backpack and followed my brother to the bus stop. The wind blew hard and messed up my hair.

When we got to class, Mrs. Baker said, "Today we will learn about plants growing." I like science class the greatest. But then lunch was kind of bad. The cafeteria lady gave us stewed tomatoes. They looked super gross.

"I am not eating that," my friend Leo said.

"Me neither," I told him.

Suddenly we heard the bell ring for recess. We ran outside fast to play tag. It was the best part of the day even if my stomach was growling. I hope we have pizza tomorrow.

It was my birthday and I turned thirteen. We had a sleepover in my backyard with a tent. It was freezing outside but inside the tent was pleasant. My friends and I sat on our sleeping bags and ate chips. Suddenly the light from my flashlight disappeared.

"Hey, who turned off the light?" I asked.

"I didn't touch it with my finger," said Sam.

We heard a weird noise outside and felt some anger. We were scared but tried to be steady and brave. Then my dad jumped out and yelled "Boo!" We all screamed and ran back inside the house really fast. It was funny later but scary then. We slept in the living room instead.

My friends and I woke up very early today. We wanted to be champions of exploration. We walked into the woods for our science project. The cool breeze felt nice on my face.

"Look at that cave!" shouted Billy loudly.

We saw a dark hole leading into the rocks. It looked scary but we went inside anyway. Suddenly the light disappeared. It was dark like the night sky. I felt something sharp like a needle poke me.

"Ouch! What was that?" I asked my friends.

Then a door opened and we saw bright light. It looked like heaven inside with gold everywhere. We did it! Our quest was complete and we were rich!

My brother and I were playing soccer in the backyard. We kept kicking the ball and bumping into each other. Dad taught us how to dribble but I was faster. I pulled my shirt because it was hot outside.

Suddenly the ball went high up to the balcony. It didn't come down because gravity stopped working!

"What happened to the ball?" asked my brother.

"I think it is stuck in the growing vine," I said.

We climbed up there and saw it was stewed in mud. It looked like gross camping food. We kept following the vine but we fell down. It was funny so we just played video games instead.

My nephew Sam is really weird sometimes. We were at the park for his birthday and he found a big black beetle.

"Look at this giant bug!" Sam yelled loudly.

He held it up and I screamed because it looked scary. He started chasing me and I sprinted away fast. I crossed the playground and hid behind the slide.

"You can't catch me!" I shouted back at him.

Sam tried swinging on the bars but fell down hard. He started crying so we thought he needed a hospital. My mom said that was impossible because it was just a scratch. Neither of us wanted to leave the park yet. We sat together on the grass and ate cake instead. Sam was dumping sand on his shoes but anger brewed inside my mom. She told him to stop or we were leaving right now. Thirteen minutes later we went home happy.

I have a robot named Zorp and he is funny. Yesterday Zorp tried to fly up to the ceiling. He crashed though and it made a loud noise. It was sounding like a giant elephant fell down.

"Are you okay Zorp?" I asked him.

"I am not broken," Zorp said with a beep.

Zorp is small like a lamb but strong like a truck. He can see a tiny gnat from far away. He cannot swim either because his wires get wet. We are going to build a rocket ship tomorrow. We will fly to Mars and maybe meet aliens. I hope the aliens are nice and want to play tag.

I was steering my spaceship through the dark stars. My robot friend Beep was keeping watch for bad aliens. Suddenly a green monster jumped on the glass window! It had big eyes and a shiny leather jacket.

"Go away!" I yelled at the monster.

"I am just very hungry," said the monster sadly.

I looked at Beep and pointed a finger at my lunchbox. I brought a sandwich but I had lost my appetite. I gave the sandwich to the monster and he ate it fast. Neither of us was scared anymore. Beep poured some caffeine into his engine to stay awake. We flew away fast and waved goodbye.

Me and my friend Sam went exploring in the woods. We found a big, dark cave behind some bushes. We went inside and it got super dark. Suddenly a big rock fell and we were trapped!

"I am scared of the dark!" yelled Sam.

"Be brave and don't be a failure," I said.

We waited but nobody came for a long time. It felt longer than school. Sam almost fainted because he was so hungry. Then we heard a loud whistle outside. It was my big brother! He moved the rocks and we climbed out. I was honest and told him we were lost. He gave us crushed ice from his cup. We walked home singing happy songs because we were safe.

It was my best birthday party ever. We went to the trampoline park and everyone was jumping so high. I wasn't afraid of the height at all! My friend Sam jumped near me and almost disappeared into the foam pit.

"Help me up!" Sam yelled, clinging to the edge.

I gripped his arm and pulled with all my weight. He was heavy so I struggled a little bit. Finally, he crawled out groaning but he was laughing too.

"That was scary," I said.

Suddenly the lights dropped and music started pumping. It was raining confetti from the ceiling! Not a single person was sad. We ate pizza and cake until my stomach hurt. It was the best day.

Yesterday me and my dog Spot went exploring. We had a schedule to leave early but we slept late. It was freezing outside so I put on my big coat. The scenery in the woods was really white and snowy. Spot jumped in a big pile of snow and started digging.

I touched his nose and it felt like cold leather. He kept running around and then he saw a squirrel.

"Come back Spot!" I shouted loudly.

He didn't listen and tried to squeeze under a fence. He got stuck and shook his tail. I helped him out and he licked my face. He looked very pleased with himself. We went home to get warm.

Sam and I went into the dark woods behind school. My dad was coaching soccer so we snuck away without leaving a note. We wanted to find the old hidden fort.

Suddenly, Sam screamed because his foot got trapped under a heavy log! A stinging bee flew right near his finger and he was scared.

"Help me get this off!" Sam yelled loudly.

"I will seize the log and lift it," I said.

I scrambled to grab the wood and pulled hard. It finally moved and Sam jumped up fast. We ran back home before it got dark. Mom treated us to toasted marshmallows because we were safe. We did not receive a punishment, but we never went back there again. The clock struck six and we were happy to be inside.

My dog Buster was roaming around the backyard again. I put down my computer game and ran outside. Buster was sniffing a big rock near the woods.

"What did you find, Buster?" I asked him loudly.

He didn't answer but he scratched at the dirt. I saw a tiny trail of ants walking in a straight line. I counted ten of them carrying little leaves. Suddenly Buster started pumping his legs and running in circles. He was moaning a weird sound like a sad cow.

"Oh no, you have a burr on your tail!" I shouted.

I grabbed the scissors from the kitchen to help him. I cut the sticky ball out of his fur carefully. Buster licked my face and ran back to the ants. He is a very silly dog but I love him.

We went to a small island for my birthday. It was a huge pleasure to be there with my family. We swam in the blue water and played games. I was jumping off the dock when something hurt my foot.

"Ouch! Something is stinging me!" I called out loud.

My dad ran over and looked at my big toe. It was a bee but the stinger broke off inside. I was breathing fast because it hurt a lot. Dad carefully pulled it out and put ice on it.

"You are brave," he said and gave me a hug.

Later we had cake and I chose the biggest piece. I especially liked the chocolate frosting on the top. I reached for a second piece but Mom said no. It was still the best birthday ever.

My baseball team is in the big league this year. We played a game last night and it was freezing outside. I was standing in the outfield and almost sleeping. Suddenly I heard a loud crack sounding like thunder. The ball came right at me through the air. I grasped my glove tight and ran fast. A little gnat flew in my eye but I kept running. I jumped up high and caught the ball!

"You did it!" shouted my coach from the dugout.

My mom bought me a hot chocolate after the game. She looked at the receipt and smiled at me. I know she was happy that we won. I felt so grateful for the warm drink. "That was a great catch," she said. It was the best game ever.

I was playing outside with my dog Buster. We went to the woods often because the scenery is nice. Suddenly I saw a weird creature near a big rock. It looked foreign and strange like an alien bug.

"Look at that thing Buster!" I yelled.

Buster barked loudly and scrambled over to smell it. The bug had a long shiny thread on its back. Then it started crawling up the rock but it fell down. It crashed onto the ground and made a tiny groaning sound.

"Maybe the gravity is too strong for it," I said.

The bug tried again but kept bumping into the dirt. It didn't complain though. It just crawled back up. I guess it wanted company. I named him Captain Bug and we watched him climb all day.

My dog Buster escaped from the backyard yesterday. I was scared because he hates being alone. I ran to the woods and my heart was thumping. It felt impossible to find him in the big trees.

"Buster! Buster!" I yelled really loud.

I saw a white shape that looked like a ghost. I got closer as I neared the old creek. It wasn't a ghost, it was just Buster! He was stuck in some mud and fighting gravity. I had to guide him out gradually so he didn't slip.

"You bad dog," I said. "You could get pneumonia out here."

Buster licked my face and wagged his tail. I decided to hold his leash tight to reign him in. I hope he will learn not to run away again.

Me and my brother Max were exploring the old barn. We saw a big box in the corner. Max lit a flashlight and we walked closer. The box was growing darker and scarier.

"I think something is inside!" Max whispered loudly.

We moved closer and I gripped his arm tight. I was reading a sign on the box that said DANGER. Suddenly the top broke open! A tiny dragon flew out. Its breath scorched the wall. I feared it would burn us but it just sneezed.

"Quick, get the scissors!" I yelled to Max.

He grabbed the scissors from his pocket and cut a rope. We tied the dragon up gently. It was not mean. It just wanted a friend.

My backpack felt really heavy this morning. The weight was too much for my small shoulders. I had a big book about psychology in there. I don't know why, but I searched for it at the library. It looked smart, so I took it. I got to school early to show my friends.

"Is that a plain notebook?" asked my friend Max.

"No, it's a huge book for earning extra credit!" I said.

Then recess started and we played kickball. Max kicked the ball high and it landed on the roof. We tried to get it down, but we failed again. The teacher blew the whistle and recess was over. I was sad about the ball, but at least my heavy book was safe inside. School is weird sometimes.

One day in February I was playing outside with my dog Rex. He is a big dog and he loves digging holes. I saw him digging near the big oak tree. He was making a huge mess on the grass.

"Rex, stop that right now!" I yelled at him.

He looked up at me with dirt on his nose. It looked like a big brown stain on his face. My mom says Rex has no psychology because he is just a dog. I think he is smart though.

Suddenly I heard a loud thumping sound behind the bush. Rex started barking and running around in circles. I used my imagination and thought it was a monster. But it was just a plain brown bunny rabbit.

"Look at him go!" I said to Rex.

The bunny ran away fast and Rex wanted company. We went back inside to get scissors for my art project. It was an important meeting with my homework.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. We were learning about a sailor on a big boat. Suddenly, I heard a loud thumping sound. It sounded like someone jumping on the roof! My teacher stopped talking and said, "Listen! Do you hear that?"

We all looked at the window. A bird flew right onto the balcony! It was a beautiful red bird, but it had a blue stain on its wing. I knew what it was. It was the school mascot!

"Look at the sign!" I shouted. The bird hopped on the 'Welcome' sign. Everyone was thrilled to see it. It didn't weight very much, so the sign didn't break. Then the bird crossed its wings and looked at us. It was the best day ever.

I was stamping my feet because recess was almost over. We were playing kickball and my team was losing. The ball bounced away and I ran to get it. I looked at the big clock on the wall.

"Hurry up, it’s approaching lunchtime!" shouted my friend Sam.

I believed I could make a goal before the bell. I ran fast but then I heard a loud whistle. It was Mr. Jones. He was coaching the other team today.

"Okay everyone, simply line up!" he said.

I grew sad because we didn't win. We walked inside keeping our voices quiet. But then I saw my lunchbox. My mom packed a juice box to squeeze and a cookie. Lunch is the best part of the day anyway.

My brother Tom built a huge robot for the science fair. It was made of metal and had a cool design. The robot kept roaming around our kitchen and making loud noises. Suddenly it started climbing up the wall to the ceiling!

"Get down right now!" shouted Tom at the robot.

The robot did not listen and it stole my cookie. I had a bad feeling about this big machine. I used my superpowers to fly up and grab it.

"Thanks for coaching me on how to fly!" I said.

Tom was cheering for me. I put the robot in a cage with a guard dog. Next time we will just make a volcano.

I was playing in the garden with my dog Spot. We searched for bugs under the big rocks. Then I saw something orange near the fence. It was a beautiful cat and it was stuck. The cat struggled to squeeze through the fence hole. 

"Don't worry, I will help you!" I called out.

I ran to the house and I brought some ham. The cat smelled the food and pushed hard. Suddenly it popped through and landed on a rose bush. It meowed very loud but it was okay.

"You are safe now, kitty," I said.

The cat jumped up to the balcony and started sleeping. It was a very lucky day for the orange cat. Then Spot barked at a butterfly and we ran away.

I was playing at recess with my friend Max. We ran to the big slide near the jungle gym. Max climbed up fast but then he suddenly disappeared.

"Max, where did you go?" I yelled loudly.

He didn't answer so I got scared. I scrambled up the ladder to look for him. He wasn't at the top and he wasn't at the bottom. It felt like he was really lost.

Then my younger sister appeared from behind the slide. She was laughing and pointing at a bush. Max jumped out of the bush screaming "Boo!"

"You tricked me!" I said and we all laughed.

We only had five minutes left of recess. We played tag until the bell rang for lunch. It was a fun day but I was hungry.

One day me and my younger brother Sam went exploring. We were leaving the house to find the hidden cave. It was dark inside and the ground was slippery. Suddenly I saw a shiny blue jewel on a rock.

"Look at that shiny thing!" yelled Sam loudly.

I grabbed the jewel but then a big bat flew out! Sam was scared and he almost fainted right there. We started jumping over rocks to get away fast. We ran home and mom treated us with some stewed apples.

"We obtained the treasure," I whispered to Sam.

He smiled and we hid the jewel under his bed. We are never going back to that scary cave again.

I was in big trouble today at recess. We were climbing on the monkey bars and my friend Mike was swinging really fast. He screamed loudly because he almost fell off. Then Mrs. Baker blew her whistle and looked mad. "Get down right now!" she yelled at us. I feared she was going to call my mom. That would mean a grounding for a whole week.

Later we had science class and learned about the sun. The sun felt like it roasted us through the window. My heart was beating super fast because I was still scared. I was just loading my backpack to go home when Mrs. Baker smiled. She wasn't mad anymore so I was safe.

It was my birthday and I was so thrilled. My friends came over for a big sleepover party. We played games and then we heard a knock. It was the pizza man with three boxes! We started eating and everyone was so happy. Then my mom brought out the cake. She lit the candles and the fire looked cool.

"Make a wish!" shouted my best friend Sam.

I closed my eyes and crossed my fingers tight. I grasped the knife to cut the cake. Everyone followed me to the living room for presents. I got a new bike and neither of us could believe the height of the seat! It was growing late but we stayed up anyway. Best birthday ever!

I was playing in my backyard when a spaceship crashed. It landed right on my mom’s favorite rose bushes. Smoke came out and a green door opened immediately. A small robot walked out on eight metal legs. It looked very foreign and strange.

"Hello captain," the robot beeped at me loudly.

"I am not a captain," I said back to him.

The robot held up shiny silver scissors. "I escaped from space jail and these are dangerous!"

I got scared so I turned around and sprinted inside. I grabbed my water gun instead of a sword. The robot followed me but it slipped on the grass.

"I must learn to maintain my balance," the robot said.

It was actually a pleasant robot after all. We played tag until dinner time.

I was playing my new video game on Saturday. It is a really cool game about a brave knight. The knight stood on a big hill with a sword. He was bearing a heavy shield made of gold. I had to fight a giant dragon on the earth.

My mom yelled, "Are you still playing that game?"

"Yes, this is a very important meeting!" I said.

The dragon was stamping his feet and shooting fire everywhere. I was scared because my character almost slept forever. But then I used my special ice power. The dragon was freezing cold and could not move anymore. I won the game and felt so happy!

My dog Barnaby is the best dog in the league. We went exploring in the woods behind my house today. Barnaby started stamping his paws on the soft dirt.

"What do you see, boy?" I asked him quietly.

He was sniffing a big, brown log very hard. Suddenly, a squirrel jumped out and dropped a nut! The nut cracked opened on a rock. Barnaby barked and tried to eat the nut.

"No Barnaby! You need meat for protein," I said.

He looked sad but he didn't eat it either. We walked back home to complete our mission. I guarantee he will find another squirrel tomorrow. He loves chasing them so much.

Max and I went camping in the deep woods. We walked straight through the trees and found a big cave. It looked scary but we went inside anyway.

"This is an important quest," Max said to me.

Suddenly we saw a huge bear sleeping on a rock! I accidentally stepped on a stick and it got crushed. The bear woke up and growled loudly. We were so scared. We scrambled up a tall wall to escape. I used a metal chain to climb higher.

"We escaped the bear!" I yelled down to Max.

We saw a glowing blue light floating above us. It was a magic thread leading us home. We were already safe but we kept running. We ran all the way back to the car. Dad was loading the tent and we jumped inside. That was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is in the super dog league. He is very fast and has big floppy ears. Yesterday we went to the park for science class. We looked for bugs on a little dirt island.

"Look at that beetle!" I yelled to Buster.

Buster did not care about the beetle though. He grabbed a stick and chewed on the end. Then he bounced around in the tall grass. My mom packed us lunch but the apples were stewed. We ate them anyway because we were hungry. We did not follow our schedule at all. I was grateful for the sunny day.

"Let's go home now," said Mom.

Buster barked and ran to the car. We were tired but happy.

My friends and I found a dark cave. It was behind the old school and looked scary. Tim shouted, "I bet there is gold inside!" We moved closer and saw a rusty chain. It was hanging on a plain rock wall. I remembered my dad said not to go there. He said it would mean a grounding for me. But we wanted to explore it anyway.

I had to squeeze through the small opening. It smelled like old stewed carrots inside. Suddenly, we heard a loud growl. Fourteen bats flew out and we all screamed! I drew my flashlight but it was broken. "Run away fast!" I yelled to Tim. We ran back home and felt safe again.

We were camping in the scary woods behind my house. My friend Billy was earning his scout badge for survival. We searched for sticks to make a big fire. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound nearby.

"What was that scary noise?" asked Billy quietly.

I turned around and saw a huge shadow. It was simply a big bear loading up on berries! The bear did not see us hiding there. We felt the weight of our backpacks get heavy. We ran back to the tent very fast.

"That was way too close!" I yelled.

We were safe but we never saw that foreign bear again.

I was sitting in math class and I felt very bored. My teacher spoke about numbers but I looked out the window. Suddenly a big blue creature appeared on the playground grass! It looked like a fish but it swam through the air. It was breathing heavy and singing a funny song very loud.

"Look at that thing outside!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked and said, "It looks like a stinging jellyfish!"

Then the bell rang for recess and we ran outside fast. But the creature was gone and nobody else saw it. Then I remembered I forgot my lunch box on the bus. It was a weird day but at least math was over.

I was steering my bike to school when I fell off. It hurt my knee but I scrambled up fast. I had to maintain my speed because I was late. At school, Mrs. Lee was sounding the bell.

"You are late!" she screamed.

"I am sorry," I said. "I fell."

We learned about a knight who lived on an island. He had a pet lamb that he loved. I believed the story was true. At lunch, I paid thirteen cents for extra milk. I touched the cold carton and opened it. But then it spilled all through my backpack! My bag could not contain the mess. It was a very bad day.

My sister wanted a pony for her birthday. Mom said that a pony is too big. We were roaming around the yard and playing tag. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound near the shed. It sounded like a monster was waking up!

My sister grasped my hand and we walked slowly. We saw a huge mountain of hay behind the shed. Something was jumping and stamping its feet in there.

"Maybe it is a dragon!" I shouted.

"No, look at the tail," my sister whispered.

Dad walked out and he had brewed some tea. He laughed at us. A tiny goat walked out from the hay. We thought it was scary but it was cute. My sister almost fainted because she was so happy. She knew it wasn't a pony but she loved it. We named him Scruffy.

I thought the dark cave was scary. We pushed a big rock and walked inside. It was cold and I saw a bat on the ceiling. My friend Sam held a flashlight and we walked slow.

"Look out for the guard!" Sam yelled loudly.

A big skeleton jumped out and it had a sword. I chose to run but Sam was brave. He threw a feather at the skeleton. The skeleton touched the feather and then it disappeared.

"I guarantee that was magic," I said to Sam.

We walked more and found a chest. The lid was heavy but we spread our arms. We lifted the weight together. Inside was a golden needle that we bought for five dollars later. It was the best meeting ever.

My neighbor Tom and I were playing the greatest video game ever. It was the final level and it looked impossible to win. My heart was pumping fast because this was a really important match. We were fighting a big monster with six arms swinging swords.

"Watch out for his laser eyes!" I yelled at the screen.

Tom shouted back, "I am trying but my controller is weird!"

Suddenly, my character got trapped in a corner by the monster. I felt so much anger because I was about to lose. Then Tom used a special move like an invisible guitar smash. The monster fell down and looked like he fainted. We totally crushed him! It felt like magic but we actually won. Then we ran outside and played rock paper scissors to celebrate.

My teacher put a big sign on the board today. It said we had a special project for lunch. We had to measure our food and see how big it was. I opened my lunch box and saw my sandwich. My mom spread peanut butter on it and put on jelly too. I tried to squeeze the juice box but it squirted everywhere. 

"Oh no!" shouted my friend Leo from across the table.

The juice got on my wrap and my apple. It smelled like brewed tea but sweeter. I threw the wet napkins in the trash can. Then I looked at the clock on the wall. It was almost thirteen minutes past twelve.

"We need to hurry for recess," I said to Leo.

The bell started sounding really loud and we ran outside fast.

One day my dog Max ran out the door. He crawled under the fence and ran to the park. I shouted his name but he did not stop. Max chewed on a stick and looked like a brave knight. Suddenly he saw a big squirrel in a tree. The squirrel stood up and spread its bushy tail.

"Come back here Max!" I yelled very loud.

My neighbor Mr. Jones was walking by the big tree. He grinned at me and waved his hand.

"That dog is fast like a rocket," Mr. Jones said.

Max sat down and greeted Mr. Jones with a bark. I remember he had fourteen spots on his back. A bird flew through the air and Max watched it go. We walked home and Max was very tired.

I was playing a new video game in my room. It was about aliens attacking a big grey building. The aliens looked weird and foreign. They had green skin and scratched at the doors. I grabbed my controller tight and started to shoot.

"Watch out for the gravity ray!" my brother yelled.

"I know, I heard it coming!" I shouted back.

My character escaped the trap and turned around fast. The level looked plain like boring earth dirt. But then the boss appeared. It was giant and looked like a scary painting. I didn’t have any health left either. I shot a different laser and won the game. I jumped up and cheered really loud.

Me and my best friend Leo walked through the dark woods. We were looking for the lost treasure cave. The trees were big and scary.

"Do you hear that noise?" I whispered.

Leo was trembling and he looked very scared. "I think it is a bear!" he said.

We ran fast and the door to the cave was closed. Something started to gnaw on my shoe. I was screaming loud! It was just a tiny squirrel eating a nut.

"I need some caffeine to stay awake," Leo joked.

We ate a protein bar and opened the big door. Inside there was gold everywhere. We were rich!

I was walking to school with my friend Sam. We saw a big green meadow near the playground. Sam threw his backpack on the grass and started running. I ran too but my legs felt heavy.

"Wait up!" I yelled, but he was faster than me.

We got to the doors just as the bell started ringing. Mrs. Green gave us a lot of math homework today. Everyone started groaning because it looked very hard. I looked out the window and saw a red balloon floating away.

"Is that yours?" asked Sam.

"No, maybe it belongs to my little nephew," I said.

The wind was getting stronger and steady outside. I hope recess is inside because I often get cold. Then the lunch bell rang and we ran to eat pizza.

Me and my friend Sam found a secret map. We chose to go to the spooky jungle today. We walked carefully past the big green trees. Suddenly we saw a giant grey elephant eating leaves.

"Look at that huge animal!" shouted Sam loudly.

The elephant looked nice but then a monkey flew by. The monkey grabbed my hat and ran away fast. We chased him and our legs were pumping hard. We climbed up a big rock and almost fell. We were bumping into branches and it hurt a little.

"Give me my hat back right now!" I yelled.

We met a nice sailor by the river. He said he knew about monkey psychology. He gave the monkey a banana for my hat. We got the hat and went home again.

I was sitting in class and Mrs. Green said we had to use the computer. I love computer time because we get to play games. But today was weird because the screen kept loading and loading. Suddenly, a scary noise came through the speakers! It sounded like a monster groaning in a cave. My hands were trembling because I thought it was dangerous.

"What is that sound?" asked my friend Billy.

"Maybe the computer is sick," I said.

Then the screen turned blue and a silly song started. The rhythm was fast and a cartoon frog sang a funny song. We were reading the words on the screen and laughing. Mrs. Green treated us to extra recess for being brave. I struggled to stop laughing all day. It was the best day ever.

I had a sleepover with my best friend Sam. We scrambled up the stairs to my room fast. We played video games in my own little league.

"Listen to this cool sound!" Sam yelled loudly.

He jumped on the bed and hit the wall. My neighbor started moaning and groaning about the noise.

"Be quiet or mom will come!" I said.

We ate cake until there wasn't a crumb left. It was enough sugar to make us crazy though. We looked out the window at the snowy scenery. I guarantee we stayed up all night long. Sam pretended he was a king and started his reign. It was the best sleepover ever.

Me and my best friend Sam wanted an adventure. We packed our bags with snacks and my pocket knife. The weather was hot but the scenery was cool. We walked into the dark woods and followed a trail.

Suddenly we heard a loud knock on a hollow tree. We stopped and spread out to look for trouble.

"Did you hear that noise?" Sam shouted loudly.

"I think it is a monster!" I said back.

We looked behind a big bush and discovered a hidden cave. Inside was just a raccoon eating a crumpled newspaper. We started laughing because we were scared for nothing again. We went home and ate stewed carrots for dinner. It was the best day ever but we couldn't contain our giggles.

One day, my younger brother and I went exploring. We walked into the woods behind our big house. The trees were tall and the sky was beautiful. We wanted to find a secret treasure chest there. Unfortunately, my brother dropped the map in a puddle!

"Oh no, what happened to the map?" I yelled.

"I am sorry, it slipped!" he cried.

We kept walking instead of going home. We saw a dark cave bearing a scary sign. A witch brewed a green potion inside. We knew it was dangerous, so we ran away fast. We found a shiny rock near the river. It looked like it fell from heaven. We took it home, earning a big hug from Mom. Exploration is fun but also very scary sometimes.

One day my robot named Zorg got very big. He grew taller than my house and made a loud thumping sound when he walked. He was supposed to be cleaning my room, but he chewed up my homework instead.

"Hey! Stop dumping trash everywhere!" I yelled at him.

Zorg looked at me and his red eye turned blue. "Sorry, I am following a new schedule," he said in a robot voice.

He brought out a giant needle and sewed my backpack shut. I scrambled away fast because he was acting crazy. Suddenly, everyone started cheering because Zorg started dancing. He did the robot dance perfectly. It was weird but also cool.

I was running super fast at recess today. My friend Billy followed me to the slide. We played tag and I touched the slide first. But then I tripped on a big rock. My knee hit the ground hard and it broke the skin. It was stinging really bad and I started crying.

My teacher saw me and swept me up in a hug. She took me inside to the nurse. The nurse put a needle and some water on it. Then she put a big bandage surrounding the cut. I discovered a lollipop in her jar and felt better. My knee stopped hurting but I was hungry again. At lunch, I ate a toasted cheese sandwich. I tried to contain my excitement for gym class later. I had a good feeling about dodgeball.

I sat on the ground and stared at the screen. The loading bar was so slow but it was important. My heart was thumping hard because this was the final level.

My brother walked in and he was playing his guitar. He stopped playing and looked at my game.

"You can do it, Jake!" he yelled loudly.

"I know I can be the greatest," I said back.

The game started and my character was roaming around. I cleared the first room and then I saw the castle. There was a big guard standing by the door. I believed I could win so I jumped high. I hit the button and the guard fell down fast. I ran inside and finally won the game after an hour. I was yearning for this win all day long!

I was waiting for my turn in the big race. My brain felt weird and my hands were sweaty. I grasped the steering wheel of my go-kart tightly. Then the green flag flew and the race started! I zoomed past the other cars really fast. The wind was stinging my face but I didn't care.

"You can do it!" my dad yelled loudly.

I climbed up the big hill on the track. I saw the finish line and I grinned. I was going to win the shiny jewel trophy! My reign as the racing king would begin today. I crossed the line first and everyone cheered.

"That was awesome," my friend said to me.

I thought I was the fastest kid ever. Even the king’s daughter couldn't beat me today.

I was swinging at recess when I saw the puddle. It was huge and looked like a lake for boating. I had my new shoes on but I didn't care. I jumped right in and the mud touched my socks. My friend Sam rode his bike over and laughed at me.

"You are going to get in trouble," Sam said.

"No I won't because it was an accident," I yelled.

I felt anger inside me like a thumping drum. The teacher blew the whistle and we lined up. My shoes were floating in mud and made squishy sounds. When I got home my mom was mad. She said I was risking a grounding. I told her I sold my clean shoes to a mud monster. She did not believe me.

My birthday party was supposed to be at the bungee park. I woke up with a happy feeling and I ran downstairs. My mom was making toasted waffles and they smelled wonderful. But then my dad walked in groaning.

"Unfortunately, the car won't start," he grumbled.

I felt sad because I wanted to climb the big wall. My friends came over anyway. We couldn't go, so we played in the yard. My dog stole a single cupcake and disappeared behind a bush. We laughed so hard we fell on the ground.

"Look out for the danger dog!" my friend Sam yelled.

My mom cleared the table and we ate cake. It wasn't the bungee park, but I didn't even have to comb my hair. It was still the best day ever.

We went hiking in the big woods yesterday. My friend Sam believed there was treasure near the river. We followed a long trail and we were singing loud songs. Suddenly we saw a big dark cave approaching.

"Look at that scary hole!" I yelled at Sam.

We walked inside and it was very dark and cold. I saw a weird red stain on a rock. Then we heard a bear growl! We ran very fast and we simply grabbed a vine. We started climbing up a tree that someone built a fort in. The bear stopped and looked at us but then it swam away.

"That was important to run away!" Sam said.

We were cheering because we were safe. We made a fire and toasted marshmallows. Seeing the bear was scary but the marshmallows were good.

My friends and I went to the dark forest. We wanted to find the secret gold coin. The trees grew very tall and looked scary. Suddenly, the ground shook hard and we fell down.

"Look out for that big hole!" screamed Timmy.

We almost sank into the mud but we jumped. Then a big bat flew right at our heads. I was so scared but I grabbed a stick. I hit the bat and it flew away fast. We found the shiny gold coin behind a rock.

"I guarantee we are rich now," said Sarah.

We ran home and left the scary scene quickly. We were safe and happy with our treasure.

We woke up really early because my dog Spot was barking. We went outside and the sun was hot and scorched the grass. Spot was roaming around a big bush and sniffing it hard.

"What is that weird thing?" I asked my brother.

He looked closer and then he screamed really loud. It was a giant fat toad with bumps on its back. The toad jumped like it was on a bungee cord. It landed right on my foot and it had a lot of weight!

"Get it off me!" I yelled and kicked my leg.

We ran inside and ate roasted marshmallows for breakfast instead. My dad acted like a colonel and marched us to the table. We heard the birds singing outside but we stayed inside safe.

I was walking to school and looking at the scenery. I saw a big meadow next to the playground. My friend Tim followed me and pointed his finger.

"Look at that bug!" Tim screamed really loud.

It was the greatest bug I ever discovered. It had green spots and big wings. We reached out to touch it but the bell rang.

"Oh no, we have to go inside now," I grumbled.

We ran to class and heard the teacher talking. She said recess was going to be longer today! I raised my hand because I wanted to know why.

"Is it for the bug?" I asked her.

She laughed and said no. But I was swearing inside my head that the bug made recess longer. It was the best day ever.

I woke up early because my dog Spot was barking. We went to the forest for a science project. I was looking for bugs but Spot saw a squirrel. He started jumping and running fast. I screamed, "Stop Spot come back here right now!"

Although he is naughty, he is usually a good boy. Spot was climbing a big tree but then he fell. He landed in a pile of mud. It looked like brown stewed tomatoes. Spot shook his fur and was dumping mud everywhere. He threw mud on my new shoes!

"Oh no Spot, Mom will be so mad," I said.

We walked home and I heard birds singing. I almost sold Spot to the neighbors, but then he licked my face. He is silly but I love him.

My birthday party was in the backyard. It was a warm day with a nice breeze. We played tag and then we started a treasure hunt. I drew a map for my friends. We looked everywhere for the gold coins.

"I found it!" shouted my friend Sam.
"Wait, that is just a rock," said Leo.

We laughed and kept looking for the prize. Finally, we saw a red balloon floating near the bushes. The treasure box was hidden right there! It was a pleasure to open it. Inside was a lot of candy.

Then my dog Buster stole a bag of chips! He chewed them up fast. We all started cheering for the silly dog. My dad roasted hot dogs for us. Even though we lost the chips, it was the best day ever.

Me and my younger brother Sam went exploring in the woods. We were looking for bugs but found a fort instead. It was made of sticks and looked like a secret base.

"Be quiet or the guard will hear us," I whispered.

Sam nodded and grasped a big stick for protection. We pretended an invisible monster was keeping watch. Suddenly, a huge black beetle appeared on a log. Sam screamed and crashed into the stick wall. The whole thing fell down on us. I started tearing the sticks away quickly.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"I think I got pneumonia from the dirt," Sam said.

I laughed and pointed at his finger. The beetle was sitting right there already. It looked very different up close. We trained it to walk on a leaf and then we went home for lunch.

I sprinted out of the apartment door because I was late. My legs were pumping super fast all the way to school. I dropped my bag and ran straight to the playground.

"You are late!" my friend Sam yelled by the water fountain.

"My alarm didn't go off," I grumbled back at him.

We played tag on the grass surrounding the big slide. I felt like a champion when I dodged everyone. It was like I had zero gravity in my shoes. Then I tripped on a twisted root on the trail. I fell down hard.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked and helped me up.

I nodded and used my imagination to pretend I was a brave colonel. Being late wasn't so bad after all.

I was hanging upside down on the jungle gym today. It is the best thing at recess. My friend Leo greeted me. He was sounding happy because he had a new ball.

"Look at this!" Leo yelled loudly. "I am the champion of kickball!"

Unfortunately, the bell rang right then. We groaned and walked back inside. Mrs. Miller was drinking her coffee for the caffeine. She looked tired.

"Take out your math homework," she grumbled to the class.

I looked in my backpack but everything was a mess. I simply could not find it! I saw an old newspaper and my lunch, but no math. My face got hot.

"I think my dog ate it," I whispered to Leo.

He laughed at me throughout the whole math lesson. I felt very small in height. Next time I will put it in my folder.

One day me and my dog Buster were exploring the woods. We walked throughout the big trees and looked for bugs. Suddenly Buster started sounding really loud and barking at a squirrel. The squirrel was climbing up a giant oak tree fast. Buster tried to jump but he fell down on the grass.

"Come back here Buster!" I yelled at him.

But he didn't listen and he kept tearing through the bushes. I feared he would get lost in the dark woods. There might be danger like a bear or a snake. I ran after him and grabbed his collar tight.

"You have to be safe," I said.

We walked home and my dad was cooking dinner outside. We ate roasted marshmallows and Buster fell asleep on my feet.

I was eating my lunch and it was pizza day. I love pizza but the sauce is very messy. My neighbor at the table is named Ben. He always likes to complain about the school food.

"This cheese tastes like rubber," Ben said loudly.

I grabbed my slice and tried to take a big bite. Suddenly, the pepperoni fell off and hit my shirt. It made a huge red stain right on the front.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "My mom will be mad."

Mrs. Green neared our table to see what happened. She said we can learn about gravity now. She helped me guide a napkin onto the spot. It did not come off, but at least recess was next.

I knew today was the big race. My sneakers were steady on the dirt. All the kids were surrounding the starting line. I stuck my tongue out because I was nervous.

"Ready, set, go!" yelled my teacher.

I ran fast but my friend Tim was faster. I had a yearning to win the shiny jewel prize. But then Tim tripped on a rock. I caught him before he hit the ground.

"Are you okay?" I asked him quickly.

He nodded and we started running again. It felt different than just winning. We cleared the finish line at the same time! My mom said I might get a grounding if I was late, but I wasn't. Tomorrow we will climb the big hill and race again. I did not knock anyone down and that was good.

I opened my lunch box and saw something weird. My sandwich was gone and there were just crumbs. I looked around the cafeteria but nobody said anything. Then I saw Tommy chewing really fast.

"Did you take my sandwich?" I yelled at him.

Tommy shook his head but his cheeks looked huge. He swallowed hard and then he smiled.

"No, maybe a bug crawled in there," Tommy said.

I knew he was lying because he had peanut butter on his chin. I was so hungry that I felt like I caught a cold or maybe pneumonia. My stomach felt empty and my throat felt dry. Then my friend Sarah gave me her apple. We went outside for recess and the sun felt hot. It roasted and toasted us while we played tag. Sarah was the queen and began her reign over the playground. We spread our arms and ran until the bell rang.

Max put on his backpack and crawled into the vent. It was tight and the weight of his bag felt heavy. He was on a secret mission. A bad guy trapped his cat in the basement.

"This is impossible," Max whispered to himself.

He saw a red light. It was a robot guard! Max remembered his spy training. He threw a rock at the wall. The guard looked away. Max ran past it fast.

He found the main computer room. A green potion brewed in a pot nearby. Max typed the code his dad was teaching him. The cage opened.

"Meow!" said Fluffy.

They ran back to the vent. Max felt his blood pumping in every vein. They escaped without any trouble. Max thought he was the best spy ever.

My dog Buster and I went to the park. The grass felt like an island surrounding us. A cool breeze touched my face. Buster started tearing through the green field. I ran after him fast.

"Wait for me, Buster!" I shouted loud.

He stopped near a big bush. I put my finger on my lips to be quiet. He was bringing me a stick. I gave him a big squeeze. Then we saw a squirrel leaving the tree. It looked like it was in a secret league. We started to search for it, but it was invisible now. The sun rose higher in the sky. My mom sent a text to come home.

"Let's go, boy," I said.

I will remember this fun day forever.

I was sitting at my desk and staring at the ceiling. Math class was feeling longer than a climb up a mountain. My stomach growled because I was so hungry. Finally the bell rang and I ran outside immediately. 

I saw my friend Sam approaching the swings. He grinned at me and waved his hand.

"Do you want to have a race?" Sam asked.

"Yes, but I have super strength today!" I yelled back.

We ran across the playground and my feet felt like they were floating. Neither of us stopped until we crossed the finish line. I tripped on the ground and got a grass stain on my pants. We laughed really hard and then ate our sandwiches. It was the best lunch ever.

My brother and I played the greatest video game ever. The scene was a dark castle with scary monsters. It looked impossible to win because the boss was huge. He was double the height of our characters!

"Jump now or you will lose!" yelled my brother.

I pressed the red button and my character appeared behind the monster. It was an incredible move. The door opened and we saw the treasure chest. It was important to get the gold to win the level.

"We did it! We are the best team," I grinned.

We were happy to receive the big golden trophy. My mom came in and said, "My daughter is a champion!" It took us two hours to complete the game.

I rode my bike to school very fast today. We had science class and learned about gravity. Mrs. Miller dropped an apple and it fell on the ground. Everyone laughed because it made a loud sounding thud. Then we went to recess and played tag near the trail.

"You can't catch me!" shouted my friend Leo.

I ran faster but I tripped and scrambled back up. My knee hurt a little but I didn't get in trouble. After school I went back to my apartment. I had wonderful pizza for dinner but then I felt anger. My mom said I had to maintain my grades.

"Do your homework or no TV," she said.

It took longer than usual but I finished it all.

My nephew Timmy drew a big robot on the paper. The robot had a long metal tongue and red eyes. Suddenly the paper felt like a cool breeze and shook hard.

"Watch out!" yelled Timmy as the robot jumped out.

The robot escaped the paper and crushed my toy car. It was a scary scene in my messy bedroom. I grabbed my mom's big silver scissors to stop it. I cut the robot's leg but it was too strong. Then a tiny gnat flew into the robot's ear. The robot started spinning fast and crashed into the wall.

"The bug broke its design!" I shouted happily.

We had a meeting with my mom about the mess. Next time we will just draw nice flowers.

It was the big day for our soccer game. The weather was hot and the sun was super bright. My coach chose me to be the goalie first. I was trembling a little bit because the other team looked big. They kicked the ball really hard at me. I jumped and twisted my body to catch it. I felt a sharp pain like a needle poked me.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Sam.

"Yeah, I think I just landed on a beetle," I said.

The beetle was squished but I saved the goal. It was a pleasure to win the game for my team. My dad read the score out loud and we all cheered. It was the best game ever.

My dog Buddy escaped from the yard yesterday. He was jumping over the fence. I yelled at him to stop but he kept running. He ran past the old tree with the swinging tire. My mom and I looked for him for eight hours. It messed up my whole schedule for the day.

"Where did that bad dog go?" I grumbled.

Suddenly, Buddy appeared from behind a bush. He had a blue feather stuck to his nose. My mom was so grateful to see him. She checked his leather collar to make sure it was okay.

"You are keeping us very busy, Buddy!" my mom said.

We went inside to complete our dinner. I hope I receive a treat too for being good.

My nephew and I were playing a cool pirate game. We had to fight a big, scary sailor boss. He looked very mean and had a red hat. I jumped over him, but he scorched me with fire.

"Oh no! I am in trouble now," I yelled loudly.

My nephew laughed and chewed on his gum. He hit the jump button and escaped the fire. Then he landed right on the sailor's head! The bad guy disappeared into a cloud of smoke.

"We did it! We are winning again!" he shouted happily.

But suddenly a giant dragon came through the wall. It was making a scary sounding noise. We struggled to beat it, but we kept playing. Keeping our score high was super hard work.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods today. We believed there was treasure hidden behind the old barn. My legs were pumping fast as I ran to the trees. Buster led the way with his nose to the ground. 

"Look here Buster!" I shouted and pointed at a big rock.

We reached the rock and I touched the cold stone. I pulled away some vines and saw a small hole. I reached in and obtained a dirty metal box. 

"We did it!" I said to Buster.

Inside the box were five shiny rocks that I counted carefully. My mission was complete. We built a secret fort there to keep them safe. I tried to explain to mom later, but she just laughed. Leading Buster back home was the best part of the day.

It was raining hard outside so we had indoor recess. Everyone was groaning because we wanted to play tag. I opened my lunchbox and saw a big black beetle inside! I screamed really loud and dropped my sandwich.

"Is that a beetle?" asked my friend Max.

"Yes, and it is eating my cheese!" I yelled back.

The beetle had a lot of strength for a tiny bug. It was roaming around my apple slices. I am not trained to handle bugs. Max simply grabbed a napkin and picked it up.

"I am keeping it," Max said with a smile.

Just then, Mrs. Green walked in and almost crashed into Max. She told us to complete our puzzles. It was a crazy day.

My dog Rusty loves roaming in the woods behind my house. One day he escaped the yard and I ran after him. I scrambled over a big log and my shirt got caught. A sharp pine needle poked my arm but I didn't cry.

Suddenly, a beautiful deer appeared right in front of us! Rusty stopped barking and just looked at her. It was like they were having a silent meeting.

"Come back here, Rusty!" I yelled.

He looked at me like he didn't understand.

"Be honest, you just want to chase squirrels," I said.

We walked home and it took almost an hour. Mom made us toasted cheese sandwiches because we were hungry. I swept the dirt off my shoes and promised to learn to shut the gate better next time.

I was playing soccer in the park with my friends. The grass was wet and I was clinging to the ball. Then my nose started tickling and I let out a giant sneeze. It was so loud my ears were ringing.

"You messed up!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball hard but it went the wrong way. It landed right in a puddle of mud. Everyone started groaning and moaning because the ball was dirty.

"We need better coaching," I said to Sam.

Then a big dog appeared and grabbed our muddy ball. He ran away simply dumping mud everywhere. That was the end of my reign as soccer king. Our meeting was over so we just went home.

My birthday party was almost ruined by my little brother. Mom was baking a huge chocolate cake and I was bearing the plates to the table. Suddenly my brother ran in with his toy truck and crashed right into my legs! The plates flew up and smashed on the floor.

"Watch where you are going!" I screamed at him.

He started crying and mom came running in. She looked mad but she didn't yell.

"I will help clean up," my brother grumbled quietly.

He helped me pick up the pieces and was actually nice. Later, my friends came over and we played tag. We screamed loudly when we ran around the yard. I was earning points for every person I tagged. My mom brought out the cake and I felt very grateful. It was the best birthday beyond measure.

My robot friend Zap brewed some green tea for me. He was not a good cook but I didn't complain. We were flying to Mars in his shiny silver ship.

Suddenly, a big wind blew us off the path! We spun around and gradually slowed down near a purple planet.

"Where are we?" I asked Zap.

"This looks like heaven for robots," Zap beeped happily.

A robot sailor greeted us at the dock. He reached out his metal hand to shake mine. He had three eyes and very long legs.

"Welcome to Planet Gear," the sailor said. "Do you like oil?"

I laughed and shook my head. It was going to be a fun adventure.

I was waiting for the big game to start. My friends and I are in a soccer league. The other team looked really tough. They had a giant goalie surrounding the net.

My coach told us, "Just keep pumping your legs!"

The whistle blew and everyone scrambled for the ball. I ran fast like a sailor steering a ship. I kicked it hard, but it wasn't enough. The goalie was jumping everywhere! Then, my friend Leo got the ball. He measured his kick carefully.

"Go Leo!" I was screaming loudly.

He kicked it right past the goalie. We counted the seconds until the game ended. We won the game by beating them one to zero! It was the best day ever.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover. We were playing a game in the basement and jumping around. Sam grabbed the pillow and I grasped it back. We were fighting over the pillow island on the floor.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled really loud.

My dad came downstairs because he heard us screaming. He looked like he was coaching a sports team.

"You boys need to calm down now," he said.

We froze because he looked very serious. Dad started bringing us snacks and water. He said we needed protein to grow big. I think he knows about psychology or something smart. We grew tired after eating the snacks. We stopped roaming around the room and finally went to sleep. The height of the bunk bed was scary but fun. Sam’s mom sent us home the next morning. It was the best night ever.

I was playing my favorite video game about space racing. My spaceship was green and it was getting stronger every second. I feared the big boss level because it was full of danger. Suddenly, my ship disappeared from the screen and everything went black.

"What just happened to my game?" I yelled loudly.

My big brother walked in and he greeted me with a laugh. "I unplugged it because you play too much," he said.

I was so mad and I felt tears tearing at my eyes. I struggled to plug it back in but the cord was tangled. Finally, I fixed it and my ship crossed the finish line. My score was growing huge and I won the whole game!

We rode our bikes to the old house. My younger brother Leo was scared but I was certain. We crossed the big yard and saw a balcony. It looked like it was floating in the air. We walked inside and suddenly heard a thumping sound.

"I want to go home now," Leo grumbled.

"We have to maintain our courage," I said.

We walked up the stairs gradually. Something was bumping against the wall. I pointed my finger at a dark shadow. It was just a bird! We trained our flashlight on it. Later we went home and roasted marshmallows. It was the best adventure ever.

It was my best friend Sam's birthday party. We were playing tag in his big backyard. I ran fast but I tripped on a rock. My knee hurt and I grumbled because it was stinging. 

"Are you okay?" asked Sam.

I nodded and used all my strength to stand up. I gripped my knee but I didn't cry. Then we heard a loud noise. Sam's dog escaped from the house and ran fast! He screeched with excitement. 

"Catch him!" yelled Sam’s mom.

We all chased the dog around the big green trees. I was keeping up with him. Finally, Sam grabbed the leash. Everyone started cheering for us. We went inside and spread frosting on the cupcakes. Nothing went wrong and it was the best day ever.

I was playing my new racing game called Super Cars. The weather outside was rainy, so I played all day. I was steering my red car really fast. The scenery looked blurry because of my speed. My big brother came in and he was eating tacos. He spilled some sauce and made a big stain on the rug.

"Hey, watch out for my game!" I yelled at him.

"Sorry, I didn't see you playing," he said while chewing.

I looked back at the TV but my car was floating. It flew off the track and crashed into a wall. I stewed in anger and started groaning loudly. I really believed I was going to win that race. My car parts were scattered everywhere on the screen. I stopped breathing for a second because I was so mad. Next time I will lock my door so nobody bothers me.

One day I found a shiny jewel near the water fountain. It was glowing green and it looked impossible. Suddenly a robot with big metal arms landed next to me.

"Give me that rock!" the robot shouted loudly.

I was scared and I almost froze. The robot grabbed at me but I ran away fast. I hid behind a newspaper stand. The robot screeched and looked everywhere for me.

"You have to listen to me!" I screamed back.

I threw the jewel at the robot's computer brain. The gravity turned off and the robot floated up high. It fought the air but it was stuck. I designed a trap and I won!

I was so hungry when the bell rang for lunch. I ran to the cafeteria with my heavy backpack thumping on my back. I saw my friend Jake hanging by the door. "Do you have pizza today?" I asked him. He nodded his head and smiled really big.

But then I tripped on a loose shoelace. My lunchbox flew open and food went everywhere. My apple went rolling and my chips scattered on the floor. It was a huge scene. Everyone was dumping their trays and looking at me. I screamed inside my head but I just stood there breathing fast. I remembered what my mom said about counting to ten. I counted slow and then Jake helped me clean up. "Don't worry, I will share my pizza," he said. I was so happy I didn't get a grounding for making a mess.

It was raining on my birthday so we sat inside. I was yearning for chocolate cake all day long. My mom made a huge cake and put candles on it. My friends came over and we played video games together.

"Happy birthday to you!" they sang really loud.

I blew out the candles and the smoke flew everywhere. Then my dog stole a piece of cake off the table! He is growing so big and he eats everything.

"Bad dog!" my dad yelled but he was actually laughing.

We ate the cake gradually because it was very rich. I had to learn how to maintain my high score later. The pile of presents grew bigger on the floor. It was the best birthday ever even with the rain.

My younger brother Sam wanted to play in the mud. He was jumping and jumping in a big puddle. I told him our mom would be mad. But Sam did not listen to me for some reason. He pretended he was a brave knight fighting a dragon.

"Look at me splash the monster!" Sam yelled loudly.

Suddenly, we heard a loud thumping noise behind the bushes. It was our big dog, Buster! He ran right into the mud too. Now they were both super dirty.

"Oh no, we have to start cleaning," I said.

We walked home and I decided to be honest. I told Mom what happened. She laughed and gave us the hose. It was actually really fun to wash the dog.

I put on my green sweater because it was cold outside. My dog Rex was jumping up and down by the door. He really wanted to go to the park for some company. I grabbed his leash and we ran out the door. We walked leading the way to the big water fountain.

Suddenly, Rex saw a squirrel running through the bushes. He pulled hard and turned me around in a circle! "Stop it, Rex!" I yelled at him. The squirrel ran up a tree like a sharp needle. Rex barked loud and I started laughing. "You are a silly dog," I said to him. Then we heard people cheering for a soccer game nearby. We sat down and watched the game together. It was a very fun day outside with my best friend.

My teacher gave us a huge project for homework today. We had to design a special island for a bird. I worked hard on my map and used lots of green. I drew a big tree bearing red fruit for the birds to eat.

Then I scrambled to find a real feather for the nest part. My mom helped me measure the cardboard box so it fit. I used glue but I got it on my fingers.

"This looks great!" my mom said to me.

I smiled because I knew I was earning a gold star. But then I accidentally dropped my hot cocoa on it. The hot milk scorched the paper and it turned brown.

"Oh no!" I yelled really loud.

It was ruined, so I just drew a new one quickly.

I sat at my desk and chewed on my pencil. Mr. Brown was teaching us math but I was tired. I feared I got the last answer wrong. Suddenly, my juice box squirted on my shirt. It made a big purple stain right on my belly.

"Oh no, look at your shirt!" whispered Jenny.

"I know, my mom will be mad," I said back.

Then the bell rang and we ran outside for recess. We played tag and I ran super fast. I was training for the big race next week. I knew I could win if I tried hard. We sang a silly song while we played. Then Mr. Brown blew his whistle loudly. He taught us that the whistle means stop. I was earning a gold star for being good today.

It was my big brother Mike’s birthday party. He turned thirteen today and he was acting super cool. Mom was wearing a funny hat and coaching Dad on the grill. The smoke was approaching the patio table so we moved.

"Open my present first!" yelled my friend Leo.

Mike ripped the paper with some scissors. It was a new game for his computer. He smiled big and then he looked at the cake. My little sister started stamping her feet because she wanted cake now.

"Stop that right now," Mom said to her.

Suddenly a big breeze scattered all the napkins everywhere. We all ran to catch them before they flew away. My aunt said she almost fainted from running so fast. We ate cake and then Mike let me climb the big tree. It was the best day ever and I want to do it again.

My nephew Ben and I went to the park. We wanted to find the greatest tree to climb. We saw a big oak tree with low branches.

"I bet I can climb to that height!" said Ben.

He grasped the rough bark and pulled himself up. I followed him up the big, strong trunk. It felt good to use our imagination outside. We pretended we were monkeys in the jungle. Suddenly, a blue bird flew right past my head!

"Did you see that bird?" I asked loudly.

We climbed higher but we were careful about our weight. We finally sat on a branch and looked down. We felt like we won a big game. That night, I slept really well because I was tired. Exploring is the best thing to do.

I was thrilled because today was the big soccer game. My dad was coaching our team and he made a schedule for everyone. We went to the huge building where the indoor field is. I put on my cleats and realized my shoelace snapped like a knife cut it!

"Oh no, I can't play like this!" I yelled.

My dad said simply, "Don't worry, just use this extra lace."

I fixed it and ran onto the field. The other team was dumping water on their heads. They looked scary. But then I got the ball and escaped past two defenders. I kicked it hard and it hit the ceiling! Everyone started groaning. But the ref said play on. I followed the ball and kicked it again. Goal! It felt like a huge weight was off me. I can’t wait to write about this at school.

I was reading a book about space when my computer started thumping. It sounded like a giant heart beating inside the screen. Suddenly a green alien crawled out of the monitor. He was small and trembling with fear. He looked like a tiny sailor but with three eyes.

"Please help me!" the alien squeaked loudly.

"What is wrong?" I asked him quickly.

He said a robot was chasing him through the wires. We ran to the garden fountain and hid behind it. The scary robot came out next, but he slipped on wet grass. He fell in the water and started swearing in robot beeps. It was funny even though we were scared. That was enough adventure for one day. I am earning a medal for saving an alien. Although, my mom will be mad about the wet computer.

One day I walked to school and felt a cool breeze. It was a weird day because the bus was late. I looked at the scenery while I waited a bit longer. Finally the bus came and I had to squeeze inside.

At lunch, the cafeteria lady gave us stewed tomatoes. They looked gross so I did not eat them. My friend Sam said, "I am scared to try it."

I laughed and said, "I knew you would say that!"

Then the bell started ringing so we ran to class. I forgot my homework but my teacher was nice. She let me bring it tomorrow instead. School is fun but sometimes lunch is bad.

My nephew Sam and I walked straight into the dark woods. We were leaving home to find the lost gold. Suddenly, a monkey jumped down like a bungee cord! It screeched loud and stuck out its pink tongue.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Sam.

We sprinted through the mud because it started raining hard. My heart was beating super fast in my chest. We used all our strength to climb a big rock. Sam found a piece of paper on the ground. It was an old receipt for pizza!

"I am so hungry now," Sam said sadly.

We didn't find gold, but we went home and ate stewed apples. It was a scary adventure but we were safe.

I had a big test today in math class. Mrs. Jones said we had to write all the answers fast. My hands gripped the pencil tight and I was scared. I counted my fingers to help with the hard problems. Then the bell screeched really loud and everyone jumped up.

"Did you finish enough problems?" my friend Sam asked me.

"I think so," I said. "I obtained the last answer just in time."

At recess, we ran to the playground and reached the monkey bars. We pretended the bars were a giant castle in the sky. My papers scattered out of my pocket, but Sam helped me. I was grateful he is my best friend. We played until the teacher told us to explain the meaning of subtraction. It was a pretty good day.

Yesterday was the big race at school. I sat on the bench and my legs were trembling. I knew I had to run fast. My friend Sam drank a soda with caffeine. He said it meant he would win the race.

"You aren't fast enough," Sam laughed at me.

"I will beat you," I shouted back loudly.

The teacher blew the whistle and we all sprinted. I pushed my legs hard and ran very fast. Although Sam was fast, I pulled ahead at the end. I won the race and felt great! My dad put my picture in the school newspaper. Tomorrow I will race again but I won't lose either.

I was cleaning my desk at school today. Suddenly, a huge black beetle appeared right on my pencil case! I blew on it, but it was stronger than me. It just held on tight and did not move a single inch.

"Ew, get it away!" yelled my friend Sarah.

"I think it wants to learn math," I said.

The beetle crawled straight across my ruler. Maybe it wanted to measure how long it was. Then the bell rang for recess. We ran out the door and through the hallway to the water fountain. When we came back, the beetle had disappeared. It was the greatest mystery ever. My teacher said it probably grew wings and flew home.

My dog Buster thinks he is a brave knight. We went outside today because it was not freezing. Buster saw a squirrel on the fence. He ran fast and drew a line in the dirt.

"Get down here!" I yelled at the squirrel.

The squirrel was clinging to the wood like a bug. It looked at me like a tiny sailor steering a ship. Buster jumped up, bringing his paws on the fence. He scrambled to get higher but he fell down.

"Try again, Buster," I said.

He has good strength but the squirrel was too high. It looked like it was hiding a jewel in its cheeks. We had to go inside because of my school schedule. Buster was sad but I gave him a treat. He is still my best friend even if he can't catch squirrels.

My friends and I walked into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. Ben had a map spread out in his hands. He pointed at a big red X.

"We need to find the old tree," said Ben.

We walked for a long time. Suddenly, we saw a huge wall. It was closed and locked tight. I saw a tiny thread hanging from a rock. I pulled it and the gate bounced open!

"Wow, you are so strong!" yelled Sarah.

We started jumping over the rocks and climbing up the hill. At the top, we saw a shiny gold box. It was enough gold for everyone! We were so happy we found the treasure.

My papers were scattered all over my messy desk. I looked at the clock and sighed really loud. My schedule said it was time for art class. I grabbed my pencil case and ran to the door.

My friend Leo was waiting for me in the hallway. "Do you want some company?" he asked me.

"Yes please," I said and we walked together.

In art class, we drew giant monsters with green teeth. I obtained the best blue marker from the bin. I grasped it tight and colored the sky. Then the bell rang for lunch and I grinned. I had to complete my drawing later. I was so hungry for pizza day!

One day I was walking on a huge mountain. I saw a shiny robot sitting on a rock. His metal leg was all twisted up. I walked over to him slowly.

"Are you okay?" I asked the robot.

"My leg is stuck," the robot said sadly.

I grasped his leg and pulled hard. I pulled and pulled. Gradually it came loose. The robot stood up and beeped. He had a big oil stain on his chest. We crossed the bumpy rocks together. Throughout the day we walked home. I was certain we were best friends now.

"Thank you for helping me," he said.

Then he flew away into the sky!

I was in my backyard when a spaceship crashed. It made a loud noise and I was scared. A green alien climbed out and he was short in height. He had three eyes and looked very weird.

"Do you understand me?" the alien asked loudly.

I nodded my head and I felt nervous. He said his name was Zog and he liked science. Zog pulled a weird bar from his pocket.

"This is space protein," he said and took a bite.

He kept chewing and then he started stamping his feet. Suddenly a robot daughter came out of the ship too. She was shiny and she gave my hand a squeeze. I used my imagination and we played tag all day. I met two new friends and it was not a failure. I liked seeing them fly away back home.

My cat Fluffy was sick and making weird sounds. His breathing was very loud and it sounded like thumping.

"Is he okay?" my little nephew asked me scared.

"I think he has pneumonia or a bad cold," I said.

We understood that he needed to go to the vet fast. We put him in his box and drove through town. The vet gave him a shot and I counted his heartbeats. Later at home we brewed some warm milk for his breakfast. He drank it all up and looked happy again.

"Look, he stole my toast!" my nephew yelled and laughed.

The vet gave us a long receipt for the medicine. I am glad Fluffy is better now and playing.

Everyone in my class was growing very tired. We were trapped inside for math class forever. I was looking out the window and yearning for recess. The clock neared twelve and my legs were trembling. I just wanted to be jumping outside with my friends.

"Is it time yet?" I whispered to Sam.

"Five more minutes," he whispered back.

The teacher kept talking but I gripped my pencil hard. A blue vein popped out on my hand. Finally, the loud bell screeched! We all jumped up fast. We ran outside and discovered a big mud puddle. We played for a long time but it felt short. I wish recess was longer so we could receive more fun.

Me and my dog Sparky went into the woods yesterday. The weather was nice and sunny. We walked for a long time until we saw a cave.

"Look at that big hole!" I said to Sparky.

Sparky barked and pulled on his leash really hard. We went inside and it was dark. The earth smelled like wet dirt. Suddenly, Sparky disappeared into the shadows. I was scared but I walked faster.

I saw a big rock and Sparky was digging. He found an old box. I put my finger on the lock. It opened! Inside was a newspaper from a long time ago. I thought I was dreaming.

"We won the treasure hunt!" I yelled.

Sparky stuck out his tongue and licked my face. We slept very good that night because of our big adventure. It really happened!

My friends came over for a sleepover last night. We played outside in the meadow behind my house. It was getting dark and the grass was growing tall.

"I am the captain of this ship!" shouted Billy. He was wearing a big red hat.

"No, I am the captain!" said Sarah.

We pretended there was an elephant chasing us. It was invisible so we could not see it either. We ran fast because we did not want trouble. Then we fell down like there was no gravity. It felt like heaven looking at the stars. My mom called us inside for pizza. We had to maintain a quiet volume inside. I love earning extra dessert for being good.

My family went boating on a big lake for my birthday. We felt like real sailors on the water. My dad packed us sandwiches with lots of protein. He said, "You need energy for swimming later."

Then I saw a huge black beetle on my seat! It was just roaming around my life jacket. I got scared and I squeezed my eyes shut tight. My sister laughed and she crossed the boat to help me. She put the beetle in a cup so it was trapped. But then she spilled her soda and made a big stain. Mom said, "I knew you had too much caffeine today!" We jumped in the water to wash it off. It was the best birthday ever.
