My dad was coaching my soccer team after school. But first I had to eat my lunch. I sat down on the cold bench. It was freezing outside! I opened my lunchbox and saw a plain cheese sandwich.

"Oh no," I said. "This is so boring."

Then my friend Tim crashed into me. He was dumping his juice out. It made a huge orange stain on my shirt. I stood up and started moaning about my shirt.

"Sorry!" Tim yelled. "I was trapped by the big kids."

I had to write a note to my mom about the mess. Later we went camping in the backyard. It was way better than school. I hope my dad doesn't have a meeting tomorrow so we can play again.

It was my friend Sam’s birthday and we had a sleepover. We were in the backyard and the breeze felt nice. Sam has a big treehouse and we climbed up the ladder. It looked like an island in the sky.

"Look at that sign," said Sam, pointing at a bird.

We saw a blue jay building a nest in the branches. It was keeping very quiet. Then Sam pushed the tire swing and started swinging. He looked happy. Later, his dad came out with a big brown guitar. He played a funny song and we clapped.

"That was incredible!" I yelled.

Sam caught a firefly in a jar but let it go. We didn’t see a single mosquito all night. It was the best sleepover ever.

Me and my friend Sam found a map in an old newspaper. It had a weird design on it. We crossed the big bridge near the park. A mean dog was the guard at the gate. It started swearing at us with loud barks.

"Run fast!" I yelled.

We ran for an hour until the dog disappeared. The map led us to a cave. We had to do some cleaning to get inside. I twisted my ankle on a rock. Sam helped me up. He drew a stick sword for protection.

"Look at that heavy chest," Sam said.

We pushed the weight off the top. Inside was just old rocks. We felt sad but at least we didn't have to get paid to have fun. It was the best adventure ever.

I was playing my favorite video game called Super Climber. My character was a sailor wearing a blue hat. He had to climb a big mountain to win. I played for thirteen minutes and I kept falling down.

"You need to use the scissors item!" said my brother.

"I can’t find them anywhere," I yelled back.

Then I discovered a hidden cave behind a rock. I bounced inside and found the shiny scissors. I used them to cut the ropes. The big boss fainted when he saw me. I did a search for the treasure chest. It was a meeting place for all the winners. I finally won the game!

I sat in my chair and looked out the window. The scenery outside was very nice and sunny. We were supposed to learn about maps today. My teacher Mrs. Green held up a big globe of the earth.

"Who knows where the ocean is?" asked Mrs. Green.

"I know because I went boating once!" said Timmy.

Then it was time for art class. I got my scissors and cut some blue paper. I was making a picture of the sky. Suddenly I smelled something funny.

"Who is eating lunch early?" I asked my friend.

It smelled like a toasted cheese sandwich. I was so hungry that I almost slept in class. Finally the bell rang for recess and we all ran outside. It was the best part of the whole day.

It was raining outside so recess was inside today. I was certain that meant we had to read books. But Mrs. Miller had a surprise for us. She was bringing out the big box of LEGOs! Everyone yelled and my heart started thumping fast.

"You have twenty minutes to complete a tower," she said.

I grabbed red blocks and my friend Sam grabbed blue ones. Our tower grew very tall gradually. I put my finger on the top piece. Suddenly, a paper airplane flew across the room and hit it!

"Oh no!" Sam shouted. "It broke!"

The tower crashed down. We looked at the clock approaching lunch time. We didn't finish, but at least we smelled roasted chicken from the cafeteria. It was still a good day.

Yesterday something funny happened in my math class. Mrs. Green was wearing a bright blue dress. She was writing important numbers on the board. Suddenly, a big bird flew right into our room!

It looked like a foreign bird with red feathers. It flew up high and crashed into the ceiling.

"Oh no!" yelled Mrs. Green. "Everyone stay in your seats!"

The bird flew around in circles and looked scared. I was yearning for it to fly outside. Finally, it crossed the room and zoomed out the window. We all cheered really loud. It was the best math class ever.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so excited. My mom greeted everyone at the door with pizza. We ran to the basement and counted all the presents. My neighbor came over too and he brought his dog. The dog started thumping his tail on the floor loudly. "He is freezing," said my friend Sam. "No, he just wants food," I said laughing.

We chose a scary movie but found it was boring. We started jumping on the bed instead. My dad yelled, "Stop that thumping right now!" We were keeping him awake with all the noise. We toasted marshmallows in the fireplace later. I ate ten of them and felt sick. My stomach was groaning like a monster. My mom said I had too much sugar and caffeine. I felt like a champion though because I stayed up late. I could feel the blood in my vein pumping fast. It was the best night ever.

I was playing basketball with my friend Sam outside. The sun lit up the court and there was a nice breeze. We were following the rules, but Sam is really good. He bounced the ball fast and it made a loud noise.

"I bet you can't make this shot," Sam yelled.

"It is not impossible," I said back to him.

I held the ball and felt its heavy weight. I chewed my lip because I was nervous. Then I threw it high. It went right in! It was amazing seeing it go through the net. The next day, my dad read the newspaper. He said I scored eight points total. I felt happy because we met at the park and I won.

I was playing soccer in the park with my friends. We were running very fast and kicking the ball hard. My dad was coaching us and yelling from the side. Suddenly, I discovered a big hole in the grass. I fell down and my shoe went flying off. It looked like an invisible monster grabbed my foot.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Sam.

I got up and saw my shoe hanging from a tree branch. Everyone started laughing at me, but I laughed too. Then the referee blew his loud whistle to stop the game.

"What happened to your shoe?" the referee asked me.

I hopped over to get it, but a dog started to gnaw on it. I almost fainted because it was my favorite lucky shoe! We chased the dog, but he was too fast for us. We ended up just painting our faces and eating pizza instead.

We had art class today and it was super messy. I chose the red paint but then I spilled it. My teacher Mr. Clark saw me and he looked mad. "Who made this big mess?" he asked very loudly. I thought I was in trouble but then Jenny helped me. She cleared the table and got some paper towels for me. We used scissors to cut the wet paper off the table.

Then it was lunch time and I sat with Jenny. She had a juice box but I had just water. My mom says caffeine is bad for kids my age. We talked about the school play about a brave knight. Jenny wants to be the knight but I want the dragon. "Being the dragon is impossible," Jenny said with a laugh. I caught the ball at recess and threw it eight times. I like Jenny’s company because she is funny and nice.

I was walking in the woods with my best friend Sam. We saw a big, dark building behind some bushes. It looked scary but we went inside anyway. There was a sign on the door that said "Keep Out."

"Do you hear that noise?" Sam asked me.

It sounded like someone playing a guitar in the basement. We walked down the stairs carefully. The air was misty and it felt like we were floating. Suddenly, a giant rat jumped out! I threw a crumb of my sandwich at it. The rat ate it and ran away.

"That was close!" I yelled.

We found a magic fountain in the corner. The water was bright blue. We roasted marshmallows on a little fire nearby. My backpack felt heavy with the weight of gold coins we found. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is meant to be a good boy. Yesterday I threw his favorite red ball over the fence. Buster sprinted fast and crossed into the neighbor's yard. I gripped the fence but I was too short.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled really loud.

Buster did not listen and he ran through the bushes. My neighbor Mr. Jones drove up in his big truck. He searched his yard and reached for Buster’s collar.

"I counted to three and he stopped," Mr. Jones said.

He was coaching Buster to sit down nicely. I drew a picture of Buster later. I am glad gravity keeps my dog on the ground. Next time I will hold his leash tight.

My friends and I went to the old forest to search for treasure. We found a small trail and followed it deep into the woods. The trees were tall and scary, but we were not afraid.

Suddenly, we heard a loud groaning sound approaching us.

"Did you hear that noise?" asked Tim with a scared face.

"Maybe it is a bear!" shouted Sarah, and she started to run.

We saw a big shadow, so we had to climb a tree fast. The stinging nettles hurt my legs, but I didn't stop. It wasn't a bear, but it was just a cow. The cow looked at us with anger because we were in its way. We realized we went the wrong way. We jumped down and ran home fast. We never found the gold vein, but at least we were safe.

Me and my best friend Sam went to a scary island. We walked through the dark woods and heard a loud moaning sound. "What was that sound?" asked Sam. I held my plastic knife tight. We saw a giant beetle sleeping on a rock. It looked roasted by the hot sun though. Suddenly a monkey screeched in the trees. We ran fast to a big stone fountain. I heard a knock on the stone. "Look out!" I yelled. A hidden door opened and we jumped inside. We were safe but it was very dark. We hoped we could find the treasure soon.

My nephew Sam and I climbed the big mountain. The wind was freezing and my hands were clinging to rocks. We wanted to find the lost jewel. It belonged to a king from a foreign land.

"I am afraid of the dark cave," said Sam.

"Don't worry, we won't get in trouble," I said.

We heard a loud groaning sound inside. It was scary. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole. Suddenly, I heard a whistle blowing. It was ringing in my ears. We saw the shiny jewel on a stone! I grabbed it fast. We were not a failure today. We ran out and felt grateful to be safe. The king's reign was saved!

I was playing a zombie video game with my nephew. We were trapped in a scary house with zombies roaming around. I had to find a needle to win the level.

"Watch out for that big zombie!" my nephew yelled loudly.

"I see him, don't complain!" I shouted back at him.

I found the needle near a painting on the wall. The painting looked like a boating trip or maybe camping. Suddenly a huge monster crushed the door. He was thirteen feet in height! He almost stole my life points but I ran away fast. I needed some caffeine to stay awake because it was late. Finally, I beat the boss and the game was complete. My mom brought us snacks because we won.

My nephew Sam and I went boating on the lake. We wanted to have a big race with our kayaks. The water was blue and the sun was super hot. We started paddling fast near the long hiking trail. Suddenly Sam disappeared behind a big green bush. I kept paddling and looked for him everywhere. 

"Where are you going?" I yelled loudly across the water.

Sam appeared again and he was smiling really big. "I am winning this race for certain!" he shouted back.

We saw a duck roaming near the water's edge. I was stewed because Sam was faster than me. He won the race and started climbing out. Next time I will paddle faster and win the trophy.

One morning, I woke up really early. The weather was simply perfect for exploring. I opened the back door and ran outside. My dog Max was jumping up and down happily. We went through the tall grass in the backyard. Suddenly, Max stopped and started barking at a big tree.

"What happened, Max?" I asked him loudly.

I looked up and saw something strange growing there. It looked like a big green vein on a leaf. I grasped the branch to see it better. It was just a giant caterpillar! I feared it would bite, but it didn't move.

"He looks different than the other bugs," I said.

My mom says understanding animals is called psychology, but I don't know the meaning. I just like watching them crawl around under the blue ceiling of the sky.

My brother Tom and I were playing a new game. It was a video game about knights and dragons. We had to run through a big stone castle. Tom was leading the way, but I was faster.

"Look out for the trap!" Tom yelled loudly.

I jumped over a spinning knife on the floor. It was a scary scene. We saw a dragon hanging from the ceiling. Neither of us wanted to fight it alone. We kept our hands steady on the controllers.

"We have to do this together," I said.

We pressed the buttons at the same time. The dragon fell down and we won the level. The screen flashed big gold letters. I was finally the champion of the game. We caught our breath and high-fived.

I was sitting in math class and I was so hungry. My stomach made a loud noise like a monster. My neighbor looked at me and laughed. I was dreaming about lunch and eating a giant pizza. Suddenly my pencil disappeared from my desk! It appeared on the floor near the water fountain.

"Can I please go get my pencil?" I asked.

"Yes, but be quick," said Mrs. Green.

I ran over and picked it up. I saw a tiny sailor drawn on the wall. He was holding a map to some treasure. It was so cool seeing that little drawing. Then I felt a sneeze coming. ACHOO! I jumped because it was so loud. I went back to my desk and used my scissors to cut paper. I hope I receive an A on this project. The scenery outside looks nice so I want recess now.

I was painting a picture of a big green alien. I drew him with three eyes and a red sweater. Suddenly the paper started shaking and pumping like a heart.

"What is wrong with my drawing?" I asked loudly.

The alien blinked his three eyes and jumped off the paper! He was stamping his feet on my desk. I realized he was real and I was scared.

"Do you have a jewel?" the tiny alien asked me.

He was the size of a gnat but very loud. I closed my eyes and wished he would go away. I felt something soft like a feather on my hand. When I looked again, he was back in the painting. He was holding a shiny blue jewel and smiling. It was weird but cool.

One day my dog Spot ran out of our apartment. He went to the park because he loves nature. I ran after him very fast. Spot found a big water fountain. He jumped in and got all wet!

"Spot, you are in big trouble!" I yelled.

He just wagged his tail and splashed water everywhere. Then I saw something shiny on a leaf. It was a beautiful green beetle. It was sleeping in the sun. Spot tried to eat it, but I grabbed his collar. Catching him was almost impossible because he was slippery.

"We need to go home for cleaning," I said.

He looked sad but he walked with me. We had an important job to do. We had to get all the mud off his paws.

I went to my nephew Sam’s birthday party early. He is only five and he loves pirates. My dad helped him dress up like a sailor. We played outside and rode our bikes in a chain.

Suddenly, a big dog came approaching us fast! I froze because it looked scary. Sam gripped my arm really tight.

"Don't worry, I will guide you," I said brave.

The dog stopped and started groaning at a squirrel. We ran inside immediately. My uncle was cooking hot dogs. They smelled roasted and good. Then my uncle dropped a plate and said a bad swearing word!

"That sounds different than science class," Sam laughed.

We ate cake and it was the best day ever.

My brother and I played a new video game today. It was a racing game in a big green jungle. I picked the fast red car and he picked the blue truck. The race started and I zoomed down the dusty trail.

"I am going to win this time!" I yelled loudly.

My brother just laughed and chewed his gum. Suddenly a big stinging bee hit my car. It blew up my tire and I spun around. I grabbed the controller tight and tried to fix it. My brother drove past me and opened a secret door. He won the race and I lost again. I almost fainted because I was so mad!

"Good game," he said with a big smile. Next time I will pick the blue truck.

My day at school was the greatest ever! At recess, I climbed on the monkey bars. I pushed my friend Sam on the swings. We ran to the water fountain because we were thirsty.

Then we had a secret meeting by the big tree. Sam showed me a bug he found in the dirt. It was crushed a little bit.

"Look at this giant beetle!" Sam grinned.

I touched its wing, and it felt dry like a newspaper. I had a funny feeling in my tummy.

At lunch, I chewed my sandwich very fast.

"Do you want my cookie?" I asked Sam.

He said yes, and we were best friends again. We played tag until the bell rang. It was a really good day.

I woke up very early today because it was the big soccer game. I was wearing my lucky blue shorts and my special red painting shirt. It was my secret luck charm under my jersey. My brain was thinking about winning the big trophy all morning.

We got to the field and my coach greeted us with a smile. "This is a very important game," he said to the team.

The other team looked huge and I thought winning was impossible. But we started playing and I ran really fast throughout the game. Gradually we got better and better at passing the ball.

Suddenly, the ball came to me and I kicked it super hard! It went right into the goal. "Great job!" my dad yelled from the sideline. We won the game and I was so happy.

My best friend Sam was in the hospital. He broke his leg running too fast. I went to visit him for an hour. I heard a loud knock on his door. His mom greeted me and was bringing snacks. Sam looked sad, but then he saw me.

"Look at this big white cast!" Sam said. "It feels like the weight of an elephant."

I laughed and said, "Maybe we can go boating later."

He smiled gradually. We played cards and ate chips. I was dumping crumbs everywhere on his bed. We pretended the bed was floating in the ocean. The nurse came in to check a vein in his arm. It looked scary but Sam was brave. It was the best visit ever, even if his leg hurt.

It was a hot day and the weather was sunny. My friend Sam came over for a big adventure. We were climbing the biggest hill in the park to race. I thought I could win but Sam is fast. We ran straight up and it was hard work.

"You look like you are in trouble!" Sam yelled.

I did not stop running and I kept going. The height of the hill was really big. Then I saw a single rock in the plain dirt. I jumped over it like a colonel leading an army. It was important to remain fast to win the race.

"I am going to receive the gold medal!" I shouted back.

I won the race and we were both tired. Then we went inside for reading comic books.

Me and my friend Sam went through the dark woods. We feared the big monster but we kept walking. Suddenly a giant bear greeted us with a loud roar!

"Run away fast!" Sam shouted and threw a rock.

The rock hit the ground and the bear looked angry. We scrambled up a tall tree and closed our eyes. I remembered I had some stewed carrots in my pocket. I dropped them and the bear ate them up. The bear disappeared into the bushes and stopped groaning.

"That was scary," I said.

Then we saw a ghost of an old colonel floating by. He looked scorched from a fire. We ran home before it got dark.

I was sitting in class trying to write my story. The teacher said we had to make it about camping. I looked out the window and saw a tiny gnat flying around. Then the bell rang for recess and everyone ran outside really fast. I ran to the swings and started pumping my legs hard.

"Watch out!" yelled my friend Tommy from the slide.

I looked over and saw that he crashed into the sand. He was pretending to be a brave knight fighting a dragon. He said his ankle felt twisted but he was okay. Then the recess guard blew the whistle loudly. That meant we were leaving the playground. The only reason I was sad is because recess is the best part. I hope my ankle doesn't hurt later.

My dog Buster is not very smart but he is honest. Yesterday we went to the lake and Buster swam very fast. He saw a duck and scrambled up a big rock. But he slipped and fell down and looked scared.

I said, "Buster, use your brain!"

He just barked at me and wagged his tail. We walked home and saw a cat on a balcony. Buster tried to jump but that was wrong. He is just a plain brown dog and cannot fly.

"We will go to the park tomorrow," I told him.

My dad almost sold Buster once but I cried a lot. I love him even if he is silly.

Yesterday my robot dog Sparky started acting really weird. He was running around and his legs were pumping fast. I searched for his remote but I lost it. Suddenly Sparky moved his metal head and opened his mouth. A long purple tongue came out and it glowed green!

"I am the champion of Mars!" said Sparky loudly.

I was scared so I hid behind the couch. Sparky turned invisible but I could still hear his gears.

"Do not fear my science power," he beeped.

He just wanted a battery snack because he was hungry. He ate eight batteries and then his alien reign was over. He is just a normal robot dog again now.

I was sitting at my desk and my tummy growled loud like an elephant. It was almost lunchtime and I was so hungry. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about gravity but I wasn't listening.

"Remember to do your homework tonight," she said.

I looked at the clock and the big hand was approaching the twelve. Finally the bell rang and everyone grabbed their lunchboxes. I ran to the cafeteria but I tripped. My lunchbox crashed onto the floor and opened up. My sandwich spread everywhere and my juice was dumping out.

I crawled on the floor to pick it up. Everyone was looking at me though.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Leo.

I nodded but I was sad. Mrs. Miller came over and helped me. She was coaching me to breathe.

"Stop stamping your feet," she said nicely. "We can get a new lunch."

I stood up and smiled. No grounding for me today!

Last Wednesday was really weird at school. I reached into my backpack for lunch, but I grasped something fuzzy instead. It was my hamster, Fluffy! He must have crawled in there. I didn't know what to do.

"Oh no, you are in big trouble," said my friend Billy.

I treated Fluffy like a secret spy and hid him. I put him inside my desk gradually so the teacher wouldn't see. But then he started squeaking loudly.

"Who is making that noise?" asked Mrs. Miller.

I couldn't lie, so I showed her Fluffy. I guarantee she was not happy. I didn't get recess either. Next time, I will check my bag before I leave the house!

I rode my bike straight to school today. I had a big test on math and I struggled with it. The teacher Ms. Green was speaking too fast. Then the bell rang and we all heard the whistle for recess. I ran outside leading the way to the swings. My friend Tim was pretending to be a sailor on a ship.

"Look out for the big waves!" Tim yelled loudly.

He shook the swing set like he was steering a boat. I pretended I had a bungee cord and jumped off. But I landed on my lunchbox and my sandwich got crushed. It looked like a mushed jewel.

"Oh no, your mom will be mad," Tim said.

I knocked the dirt off my apple and ate it anyway. School is fun but crushed sandwiches are bad.

I was playing my favorite video game about a ghost island. My brother Tim said beating the final boss was impossible. He kept moaning that I was too slow at running. I drank my chocolate protein shake and I knew I could win.

"You need better coaching!" Tim yelled at me loudly.

The boss was a giant monster bringing fire everywhere. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. I saw the magic sword and I had to seize it quick. I jumped over a rock and pressed the button fast.

"I got him!" I screamed when the monster fell down.

Tim looked surprised because trouble brewed for the boss. I won the game and Tim gave me a high five.

I was waiting for recess all morning long. My legs felt stronger than ever today. I wanted to be the greatest tag player in the whole school. When the bell rang, I grabbed my coat and sprinted outside.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled to my friend Mike.

We ran to the big wooden castle on the playground. I hid behind the water fountain for a second. Then I ran throughout the swings and jumped over a stick. It felt like we were camping in the woods. Mike tried to tag me, but I was too fast.

"I am the champion!" I shouted and did a funny dance.

Suddenly, I heard singing. It was the teacher calling us back inside. I quickly used my fingers as a comb for my messy hair. Recess was over, but I won the game.

My friends and I found a dark cave yesterday. We wanted to explore because it looked very scary. Tim was scared of the height of the entrance. He said, "I think this is impossible to climb." But Sarah and I started climbing up the rocks carefully. 

Inside the cave, we heard a weird groaning sound. It sounded like a monster or maybe a bear. We saw old coins scattered all over the ground. This was an important discovery! Suddenly, we heard footsteps coming from the dark. 

"We need some company!" yelled Sarah. 

We started loading our pockets with the gold coins quickly. We ran out fast and we didn't look back. It was the best adventure ever.

One day me and my dog Buster went exploring. We were playing pirates and I was the captain. We walked to the big woods behind my house. The breeze felt nice on my face. Suddenly Buster started digging in the hard ground.

"What is it boy?" I asked him.

He kept digging and made a loud groaning noise. Then he pulled out a dirty old bone! I screamed because I was so excited. It looked like a dinosaur bone or pirate treasure. I had a happy feeling inside.

"Good dog Buster!" I yelled.

We ran home to explain everything to my mom. She cooked us roasted chicken for dinner. Buster was very grateful for the food. We ate it all up fast. It was the best adventure ever.

I was yearning to win the big soccer game today. My team the Tigers practiced a lot but unfortunately we were losing. The score was two to zero and I was feeling weird. My tummy hurt because I drank my dad’s caffeine soda by mistake. It made me feel shaky and I was in trouble.

"Pass the ball to me right now!" my friend Billy yelled.

I ran fast and kicked the ball but then I had to sneeze. It was a huge sneeze and everyone heard it loud. But the ball went right into the beautiful goal! Everyone started cheering for me and I felt so happy.

"Great job kicking that goal," the coach said to me.

We didn't win the game but scoring was really fun.

My nephew Ben and I went on a big adventure. We found a map for a twisted secret island. 

"We need a boat!" Ben yelled very loud.

We grabbed a raft and went through the big waves. The waves threw us around like toys. It felt impossible to stay on the boat. But my dad taught me how to sail. I felt like the greatest captain ever. 

We landed on the sand and saw a cave. 

"Look inside!" I said. "Use your imagination!"

We chose the left tunnel and saw a monster. But it was just a monkey! We trained the monkey to help us find gold. It was the best day ever.

One day my younger brother and I went exploring outside. We walked to the big park near our house. The leaves were already turning brown and yellow. They were scattered all over the wet grass. We looked up and saw a huge tree.

"I guarantee I can climb that height," my brother said.

"Be careful or you might get hurt," I told him.

He started climbing up but then a bee flew near him. He was scared of getting a stinging bite. He jumped down fast and landed in the dirt. It looked like a foreign land with strange bugs. We discovered a hole under the roots. I knew it was a secret animal house. We treated the hole nicely and left some crumbs. We did not write our names there because it was private. We had enough fun and ran home for lunch.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the woods. We were following a map with a weird red design.

"I think the treasure is close," said Sam.

We walked for a long time and saw a big hill. On top of the hill was a spooky old castle. It had eight tall towers reaching the sky. We heard a loud bell ringing inside.

We started running up the hill very fast. But then a big dog jumped out! Neither of us moved.

"Remember to give him a treat!" I yelled.

Sam threw a cookie and the dog ate it happy. We ran inside and found a big box of gold coins. It was the best adventure ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were bringing snacks for a long trip. Suddenly we saw a weird cave that was glowing green.

"I think we should go inside," said Sam quietly.

We squeezed through the small hole and saw a monster sleeping. It looked very scary and big. I grabbed Sam’s arm because I was scared. The monster woke up and started stamping his feet in anger!

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Sam.

I knew we had to distract him so I threw my juice box. The monster stopped growing bigger and drank the juice. He liked the caffeine inside it. It was wonderful because he let us go. We will always remember this important day.

Me and Sam found a spooky old building in the woods. It looked empty, but we wanted to explore it. We pushed on the door with all our strength.

"I think something is inside," Sam whispered to me.

The door opened slowly and felt like a heavy weight. We crawled inside on the dusty floor. It was dark, but I had my flashlight. We saw a big box in the corner. I thought maybe it was gold or toys.

"Use these to open it!" I said and gave Sam some scissors.

He cut the rope. It was just the beginning of the mystery. Inside the box was a map that was hard to read. We ran home to show my mom.

I was exploring the woods surrounding my backyard. I grabbed a big stick and pretended to be a king. My reign was going to be super long. Suddenly I saw a weird bug on a leaf. I thought it looked like an alien brain.

"Look at that thing!" I shouted to my dog, Buster.

Buster just barked and started sniffing the ground. I wanted to catch the bug for science class. I didn't have a net or a knife either. My heart was beating fast. The bug made a groaning noise and flew away. It escaped up into the blue heaven sky. I could see a tiny vein on its wing.

"We have to maintain our fort," I told Buster.

We went back to the treehouse to eat snacks.

The greatest thing happened at recess today. We were playing tag near the big slide. I gripped the cold metal pole and looked around. Suddenly, I felt a huge sneeze coming on!

"Watch out!" yelled my friend Ben.

I sneezed so hard I fell over in the dirt. It was just plain silly. Then I saw something shiny in the grass. It looked like a tiny needle. I picked it up and saw it was actually a silver pin.

"That's my coaching badge!" said Mr. Miller.

He struggled to find it all morning. He looked really happy. I felt trapped by all the other kids looking at me. They clapped for me. It was hard to maintain my cool face. I felt like I was boating on a sea of happy people.

We were reading quietly in class, but I heard a noise. It sounded like thumping under my desk. I feared it was a monster. I crawled down to look, but I saw nothing. Then I heard groaning and stamping near the door. The teacher stopped talking.

"What is that noise?" Mrs. Green asked.

Suddenly, a creature escaped from the closet! It was the class hamster, Fluffy. He scratched the floor and ran fast. He grinned at us. We all laughed.

"Fluffy is tearing through the room!" shouted Tommy.

Mrs. Green gripped him gently. She put him back in his cage. We gave him some roasted sunflower seeds. He was hungry. School is funny sometimes.

It was my birthday and we went boating at the lake. My dad taught me how to steer the boat. It was really hard but I tried my best. We saw something floating in the water. I thought it was a monster but it was just a log!

Then my brother threw a water balloon at me. It crushed right on my head and I got soaked.

"You are in big trouble!" I yelled at him.

He just laughed and said, "That is the reason I came!"

Mom said that was enough fighting. We ate cake and it was especially good. Seeing my friends there made me happy. Sleeping that night was impossible because I was so excited.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover at my apartment. We brought our sleeping bags into the living room. Sam is the same height as me but I am older. We played a game on my dad's computer and I won. Then we drew pictures of scary monsters with green markers. We got hungry so we ate pizza and drank soda.

"This is the best night ever," Sam said with a smile.

"I know, let's build a fort," I said back to him.

We scattered pillows everywhere and crawled through the tunnel. I accidentally crushed a bag of chips. My dog chewed on a piece of the bag. We laughed so hard that my stomach hurt. I will remember this night until I am eight hundred years old. The scenery outside my window was dark but inside was fun.

Yesterday was the greatest day at school ever. It started when the bell rang for recess. I grabbed my bouncy ball and ran outside. The ball bounced high off the ground.

Then I saw Timmy approaching me fast. He wanted to play tag but I wanted to play ball.

"Hey, can I squeeze into your game?" Timmy asked me.

"Sure, but you have to catch the ball first," I said.

We played until the teacher called a meeting by the swings. It was time for lunch though. I opened my lunchbox and saw a cheese sandwich. It was toasted and smelled so good. Lunch is the best part of the day. After that, we had to do math, but recess was still super fun.

One day I went outside to the big green field. My mom’s friend has a farm there with lots of animals. I saw a little white lamb eating grass near the fence. It was so cute and fluffy. The farmer told me something sad.

"That lamb gets sold tomorrow," said the farmer.

"Oh no, please don't let it go!" I screamed.

Suddenly the wind blew really hard through the trees. A big black bird flew down and sat on the fence. It looked scary. Then lightning struck a tree and made a loud boom. The farmer’s daughter ran out to see what happened. She found a shiny feather on the ground. We didn't know where the bird went. The lamb was safe but I was scared. We went inside to have hot cocoa. Exploring outside is fun but sometimes it is crazy.

I was playing baseball with my brother in the backyard. It was the biggest game of the summer for us. I picked up the bat and I felt super strong. My brother threw the ball really fast at my head! I swung the bat hard and the ball flew away. It went over the fence and smashed a window.

"Oh no, Mom is going to be screaming!" I yelled.

My brother looked scared and he feared big trouble. We heard the glass break and then it got quiet. We thought about running away but we stayed there.

"You broke it, so you tell her," my brother said.

We walked inside and the kitchen was lit up bright. Mom was making tea and it brewed on the stove. I told her the truth and I felt better. She wasn't mad either because it was just an accident. We escaped without getting grounded but the game was over.

I went outside to play with my dog, Buster. He is big and brown and very loud. We walked to the park and saw a squirrel.

"Look at that bushy tail, Buster!" I yelled.

Buster barked and bounced up and down. The squirrel ran up a big tree. Buster tried to climb it, but he just landed in the dirt. I obtained a long stick and threw it far away.

"Go get it, Captain Buster!" I shouted.

He ran fast and cleared the fence. I heard a loud noise. He came back with the stick and grinned at me. I was grateful he didn’t get stuck. Then it started raining, so we opened the door and ran inside. We were wet but happy.

Me and my best friend Sam were exploring the woods. We wanted to find the lost pirate treasure. I was the captain and Sam held the map.

"Look at that dark cave!" yelled Sam.

We walked through the tall grass and it was stinging my legs. We were a little bit afraid but we were brave too. Suddenly a big bear came out of the cave! It looked very hungry and made a loud noise.

"Run away fast!" I shouted to Sam.

We sprinted back to my house as fast as we could. I grasped the doorknob and we jumped inside. It was the greatest adventure ever, but we didn't get the gold. Maybe we will try again tomorrow after lunch.

I was walking to school and I saw a big dog roaming around. He looked really happy and he touched my hand with his cold nose. I petted him and felt his strength. Then I ran to class because I was almost late. We had reading time first and I read a book about space.

At lunchtime I ate a sandwich that was toasted and warm. My friend Sam sat next to me. "Do you want to measure who is taller?" Sam asked. We stood up near the water fountain.

"I think I am winning!" I said. Everyone was cheering for us. It was fun but then the bell rang loudly. We had to go back through the big doors. The teacher was keeping us inside for math but I just wanted to play outside again.

My brother Tom was turning thirteen on Saturday. I wanted to wrap his big gift all by myself. I ran to my room and cleared my messy desk. Then I moved my blue comb so I had space. I opened the box and put the cool red car inside.

"Mom, do we have any tape?" I yelled loudly.

Mom came in and she was holding the tape. "Here you go, buddy," she said with a smile.

The time for the party meeting neared and I got excited. Tom came in and saw the big box. He ripped the paper fast and saw the car. He loved it so much that he gave me a high five!

I was exploring the woods behind my house today. The sun was hot and I was feeling sweaty. I saw some rocks scattered on the ground near the big oak tree. My heart started beating fast because I thought it was treasure!

I reached down to grab a shiny rock but then I heard a buzzing sound. It was a weird bee and it looked angry.

"Watch out for the stinging bee!" yelled my brother Sam.

I dropped the rock and ran away fast. We didn't find any gold but we found a cool stick later. It had a heavy weight and looked like a sword.

"I will guard the fort with this," I said to Sam.

We pretended to squeeze juice from berries for our snack. It was a fun day even without the treasure. We went inside when we heard the dinner bell ringing.

One day my dog Buster ran into the woods. I chased him because he was bringing back a huge stick. We found a weird scene by the big rock. A fat squirrel was sleeping on top of it. He looked like an army colonel with his puffy tail.

"Look at that squirrel!" I yelled to Buster.

Buster barked and blew air out of his nose. The squirrel woke up fast and ran up a tree. My mom says squirrels need nuts for protein. I think he ate too many stewed tomatoes from our garden. We walked home keeping quiet so we wouldn't scare any birds. It was almost eight o'clock and time for dinner. Exploring is fun but now I am hungry.

My brother Tom and I went to the spooky forest today. We were wearing our new hiking boots and leather jackets. I trained for this big adventure for a long time. Suddenly, a big bear appeared behind a twisted tree!

"Run fast!" I yelled to Tom.

He blew his silver whistle very loud. The bear did not like the noise and ran away. We walked more and saw a cave. I felt a heavy weight on my shoulder. It was just a bird. We found a shiny box inside the cave.

"I bet it is gold," Tom said.

We opened it and saw chocolate coins. I was very pleased. We caught a lot of bugs on the way home. It was the best day ever.

My friends came over for a sleepover last Saturday. We decided to be brave and play in the dark. We looked for my dad’s old flashlight. Then we went into the basement and sat in a circle. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping noise upstairs.

"I am so scared!" said my friend Billy.
"Maybe it is a ghost or a knight," I whispered.

We were all trembling and holding hands tight. Then the door opened and a bright light struck our faces. It was just my big brother trying to scare us! We discovered he had a pair of scissors and a sheet. He was moaning like a monster.

"You guys are babies," he laughed at us.

Later my mom roasted marshmallows for us outside. The night was complete and we slept in our sleeping bags.

My robot Z-4 was groaning loudly in our apartment. He was making a really bad thumping noise. I gripped his metal arm to stop him shaking.

"I need to maintain my battery!" Z-4 beeped at me.

I ran to the kitchen and saw a green stain. Z-4 was dumping green slime everywhere. It smelled like roasted garbage.

"This is very important!" I yelled at him.

I pressed the red button and he stopped growing bigger. The slime went back inside his tummy.

"Thank you for saving me," Z-4 said happily.

We cleaned up the mess before my mom came home.

I went to the jungle with my friend Sam. We pushed through big green leaves and looked around. We were looking for a lost golden monkey statue. Suddenly we saw a huge gray elephant by the river. It was drinking water and looked very friendly.

"Look over there at the water!" called Sam loudly.

My heart was pumping fast because I was thrilled. We kept walking and heard something singing in the trees. It was a magic bird that was almost invisible. Then I saw something shiny spread out on a rock. It was the golden monkey statue we wanted! I started jumping up and down because we found it.

"We are the best explorers ever!" I said.

We grabbed the statue and ran all the way home.

Yesterday the weather was super hot at recess. I was wearing my new blue shorts. We played tag on the big field. My friend Sam swept his leg and I fell on the ground.

"You caught me!" I yelled at him.

Sam laughed and helped me up. Then the bell rang loudly. We ran back to class. Mrs. Green greeted us at the door. She spoke about a big word called psychology. I was dreaming about lunch because I was hungry. I had to search for my pencil in my messy desk.

"Where is your homework?" Mrs. Green asked me.

I looked down. It was still at home on my bed.

We went on a boat to a secret island. My friend Tim held the map carefully in his hands. We walked throughout the big jungle and looked for treasure. Suddenly we saw a giant fountain made of gold.

"Look at that shiny water!" I yelled loudly.

Tim grumbled because his heavy backpack was full of snacks. He brought a lamb sandwich and a protein bar. We ate lunch together near the water. Then the ground started to shake really hard! It felt like there was zero gravity. We grabbed the gold coins and ran fast. We did not receive any bites from bugs. It was the best adventure ever.

Yesterday was the best day at school ever. We had art class and I made a cool design. I used a big plastic needle and some red yarn. My friend Sam kept messing up his project.

"Stop roaming around the room, Sam!" the teacher said.

Sam just laughed and sat back down. Later we went outside for recess. A nice breeze blew my hair everywhere. I forgot my comb at home so it looked messy. A big dog was approaching the fence near the swings. It looked friendly but we didn't touch it.

"I bet that dog slept all day," I told Sam.

Then the bell rang and we ran inside fast. I was so hungry for my pizza lunch. It was a really fun day.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark meadow. We wanted to find the lost treasure chest. Sam grasped his map and we walked fast. Suddenly a loud moaning sound happened behind a big rock.

"What was that scary noise?" I screamed loudly.

"Maybe it is a ghost dumping trash," Sam said.

We ran but unfortunately I tripped on a long thread. A giant monster jumped out and looked very hungry. I gripped my flashlight tight and remembered my snack. I threw my protein bar at the monster. It ate it and looked happy. We scrambled away fast and roasted marshmallows at home. Tomorrow I will play on my computer instead.

One day I was roaming in a big green meadow. I saw a shiny metal thing crashed in the grass. It was a robot with one red eye.

"Help me," the robot grumbled sadly. "I am lost."

I grasped his cold metal hand and pulled him up. We walked through the woods for an hour. Suddenly we saw a huge crystal castle.

"That is my home!" the robot shouted. He was thrilled.

We ran to the door but there was a moat. We went boating across the water in a small leaf. Although it was scary, it was a fun adventure. The robot gave me a gold coin meaning we were friends. Then he flew away following a bird. I waved goodbye and went home for dinner.

It was a freezing day at recess and everyone was shivering. We were climbing the jungle gym but my hands were cold. Suddenly, a big blue ball flew over the fence.

"Oh no! That is impossible to get!" screamed Tommy loudly.

We all walked over to look but it was gone. Then Mrs. Baker came outside bringing a big thermos. She brewed hot chocolate for everyone! We started cheering and running over to her. The cups were scattered on the picnic table.

"Careful, or you will get roasted tongues," she said.

I took a sip and it tasted so good. The bell struck twelve so we went back inside. School is the best when you get hot chocolate.

I was playing my new video game on the balcony. It was about aliens roaming the earth and finding treasure. At the beginning of the level, I had to climb a big wall. I saw a sign that said DANGER but I kept going. Suddenly a huge monster was approaching me very fast!

"Watch out for the green slime!" my friend yelled.

"I need some company to help me fight!" I shouted back.

I turned my controller and my character jumped high. Then the monster crashed into a building with a loud thumping noise. I had thirteen lives left so I wasn't scared. After the meeting with the boss, I won the game. It was the best win ever!

My dog Sparky is crazy and he chewed my favorite shoe. It was a plain white sneaker but now it is ruined. I was so mad that I almost threw his ball over the fence. My mom said, "Sparky didn't mean it, he is just a puppy."

I went outside and saw a big bug on the grass. It crawled very slow like it was hurt. Maybe it needed a bug hospital. Then I saw Sparky wearing a leaf on his nose. He looked like a funny elephant with a green trunk. I forgot about my crushed shoe.

"Come here, you silly dog," I yelled.

We played tag and he was bearing his teeth in a smile. Later I made a painting of us playing. It was the best day ever even with one shoe.

My friend Max and I walked to the big woods. We were going on an important quest to find pirate gold. We found a map on a small island in the creek. Suddenly, a big creature came swinging from the trees! It looked scary, and I feared it was a monster.

"Run away fast!" yelled Max.

I started running but my shirt got caught on a branch. I was tearing it, but I didn't care. The creature was jumping closer and closer. It often chased kids away. Max grabbed my arm and pulled hard. We ran back home and drank soda with caffeine. We didn't find gold, but we didn't get eaten either.

"That was too close," I said.

Then my mom sang a song and made us dinner.

My friend Sam and I were supposed to be cleaning his room. But we saw a map in an old newspaper instead. We grabbed flashlights and ran to the woods.

"I bet there is gold in the cave," Sam grinned.

We walked for a long time until we saw a dark hole. Suddenly, we heard a loud growl inside. A big bear was sleeping right there! We ran away very fast. We counted fourteen steps back to the house.

Sam drew a picture of the bear later.

"I am grateful the bear didn't wake up," I said.

We decided to just clean his room next time. It was way safer than bears.

One day at recess everyone was playing on the playground. The ground was shaking because we were running so fast. My friend Tim was wearing his new shoes. He pretended he had super strength like a hero.

"I can lift this whole jungle gym!" Tim yelled loudly.

He grabbed the metal bars and his face turned red. Suddenly there was a loud thumping noise behind us. It was just a big ball hitting the earth.

"Did you hear that ringing sound?" asked Sarah.

The bell rang immediately and we had to go inside. Our lunch boxes contain sandwiches and apples today. After lunch, I felt so tired that I almost fainted. I spread my arms out on my desk. I wished we were camping instead of doing math.

One day me and my best friend Sam went boating. We saw a dark cave and decided to go inside. The cave was wet and we heard a strange moaning sound.

"I am scared," Sam whispered to me in the dark.

"Don't worry, I brought my flashlight," I said back.

We walked deeper and saw a giant beetle on the wall. It was growing bigger and bigger right in front of us! Suddenly fourteen more beetles came out and we both screamed loudly. We ran back to the boat as fast as possible. The sun outside looked so beautiful after the dark cave.

"That was the greatest adventure ever," Sam said and smiled.

We were pleased to be safe and we ate everything for lunch.

It was finally my birthday and I was turning nine. I wanted to have a sleepover with my best friends. We played tag outside in the cool breeze. Suddenly my dad called us inside for cake and presents.

"Happy birthday!" everyone screamed really loud at me.

I blew out the candles and made a big wish. I was yearning for the new video game. I started tearing open the biggest box fast. It was a giant teddy bear instead. I tried to smile but I was sad.

"Wait, there is one more," my mom said smiling.

She handed me a tiny box with a bow. I opened it and saw the game inside! It was the greatest day ever. I will remember this birthday until I am thirteen. I love growing up and having fun.

My friends and I were having a sleepover for my birthday. We wanted to have a science adventure in my backyard. It was dark but we had flashlights. We neared the big oak tree and I heard a noise.

"Something is approaching us!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked scared and neither of us moved. We thought it was an invisible monster. Then something scratched my leg and ran through the grass.

"It's just my cat Fluffy," Sam laughed really loud.

We played throughout the night and talked about boating on the lake. At eight o'clock in the morning my mom made pancakes. I knew it was the best birthday ever. We were tired but happy.

One day me and Max went into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost jewel of the King. The path was twisted and it was hard to walk. Suddenly we heard a scary moaning sound from a cave.

"I am scared," said Max.

"Don't worry because I have a map," I said.

I drew my plastic sword and we walked inside carefully. It was very dark but then we saw something shiny. It was a giant blue jewel sitting on a rock! Max ran to grab it but a big bird flew down. A blue feather fell on the ground. We grabbed the jewel and sprinted out fast. We ran all the way home and ate toasted cheese sandwiches. The only reason we stopped was because we were hungry.

My neighbor Sam and I walked straight to science class. We saw a big sign on the door. It said DO NOT ENTER in red letters. It looked dangerous but Sam opened the door anyway. Inside, there were papers scattered all over the floor. Someone was moaning behind the teacher's desk. It was Mrs. Green! She was holding a cookie crumb.

"Are you okay?" I asked her.

"I am just sad about my cookie," she said.

Sam laughed and went to the water fountain. He saw a truck loading boxes outside. Maybe they were bringing us a fun island project or something important. School is weird sometimes.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods today. We were looking for a secret trail near the creek. The ground was muddy because it rained a lot last night.

Suddenly, Max stopped and froze right in his tracks. He was staring at something shiny on a big rock.

"Look, Max! It looks like a jewel," I whispered loudly.

We walked closer to the scene, but it was just trash. It was a candy wrapper that looked like a blue diamond.

"That is impossible," I said. "I thought we were rich!"

Max barked at a squirrel and then ran away fast. I got lost for a minute, but I followed his footprints back. It was a fun adventure even without the treasure. We walked home and got some snacks.

My brother Tom and I were playing a new video game. It was raining outside so we were trapped in the house. The game was about a strange foreign planet with low gravity. We had to climb a big purple mountain to win.

"I can't understand the controls!" Tom grumbled at the screen.

I knew how to play because I read the newspaper guide. I jumped my character over a hole and opened a secret door. It was a cool scene with lots of bright lights.

"Look, I discovered a shortcut!" I yelled and felt thrilled.

Suddenly, my guy fell off the edge because I wasn't fast enough.

"Do you remember where the extra life is?" I asked Tom.

He laughed and said, "Nope, now it is my turn to win!"

One day my dog Buster and I went to the park. It was freezing outside so I wore my big coat. Buster ran very fast and he looked like a superhero. He jumped high and I thought he had no gravity!

"Come here Buster!" I shouted loudly.

He ran back to me and grinned with his tongue out. We played catch with his favorite red ball. It felt like we were in a big sports league. Suddenly Buster saw a squirrel and chased it up a tree. I started cheering for him but the squirrel was too fast.

"Good try buddy," I said and patted his head.

My dad was coaching my brother's soccer team nearby. When we got home, we roasted marshmallows by the fire. It was the best day ever.

The aliens landed in my backyard with a loud thud. They were green and had big ears and they were stamping their feet. I threw my baseball at them but it just bounced off.

"Take us to the hospital!" the alien leader yelled.

I did not have a car so I blew my whistle. My robot dog Sparky ran out and he started barking. The aliens got scared and crawled under the porch. I knew they were just lost. I spread some peanut butter on bread with a knife.

"Eat this," I said to the green guys.

They ate it all and looked very grateful. Suddenly their ship started bumping and floating without gravity. They flew away fast into the sky. I waved goodbye to my new space friends.

It was lunchtime and I was super hungry. I reached for my lunchbox but Sam grabbed it first. He ran away laughing and I scrambled after him. Mrs. Jones was coaching soccer but she saw us running.

"Stop running inside!" she yelled loudly at us.

We stopped and I finally got my lunchbox back. I sat down and opened it up fast. Mom packed me leftover lamb and some stewed carrots. I hate carrots but I ate the meat. Suddenly I saw a paper airplane floating near the ceiling. It hit me right in the head!

"Did you write a note on it?" asked Jenny.

I opened the newspaper plane and neither of us could read it. It was just scribbles so we laughed. Then the bell rang and lunch was over.

One day a giant alien ship landed in my yard. I was certain it was bad news. A green guy walked straight out and he had fourteen eyes.

"Take me to your leader!" he screeched loudly.

I grasped my magic wand because my dad taught me magic. I felt anger growing inside me. The alien wanted to reign over Earth. I pointed my wand at the beautiful scenery. A giant rose grew up and grabbed the alien.

"Hey let me go!" the alien yelled at me.

My younger brother ran outside to see the meeting. He helped me tie up the alien. We did not receive a thank you but we saved the world. Now the alien lives in a box.

My cousin Sarah was having a huge birthday party. I was waiting for it all week. Sarah is my aunt’s daughter and she is nice. We went to the bouncy castle place and I bounced high. We ate pizza and then Sarah opened her presents. She was tearing the paper off really fast.

I gave her a box with a toy robot inside. Sarah looked weird when she opened it.

"Did you keep the receipt?" she asked me loudly.

My mom cleared her throat and looked mad at Sarah. I thought my mom almost fainted because it was rude. But then Sarah laughed and hugged me tight.

"I'm joking! I love it enough to keep it!" Sarah yelled.

I was happy she liked the robot I gave her. It was the best day ever to receive cake and play.

It was my birthday and I was turning nine. My dad brewed some hot cocoa for breakfast. I ran to the kitchen and grabbed a big mug. My mom cleared the table and brought out a huge box. It was almost my height!

"Open it carefully," said Mom with a smile.

I pulled the ribbon and threw the paper on the floor. Inside was a giant stuffed elephant. It was beautiful and gray. I saw a blue vein on my hand shake because I was so excited.

"Do you like it?" asked Dad.

"I love it!" I yelled and hugged the elephant tight.

I stayed out of trouble all week earning this present. It was the best birthday ever.

I wanted to be the captain of the kickball team. My brother was coaching me every day after school. We did lots of training in the backyard. I practiced jumping over the ball and running fast. One day I woke up early for the big game. My heart was thumping really hard in my chest.

When I got to the field, the other team looked scary. Their pitcher threw the ball super fast at me. I moved my leg back and kicked it hard! The ball disappeared over the fence into the woods.

"Wow! You crushed it!" yelled my best friend Sam.

I ran around all the bases and felt happy. My confidence grew and I felt like a real player. I pulled my team together and we won the game. Afterward, we roasted marshmallows at my house instead of practicing. Everyone listened to me because I was finally the captain.

One day my dog Buster and I went exploring through the tall grass. We were pretending to be in a super hero league. Buster was the sidekick and I was the guide. Suddenly Buster stopped and started barking at a big bush. I grabbed his collar because something was buzzing.

"Watch out Buster!" I shouted.

A huge bee came out and it looked really scary. It was stinging the air with its sharp tail. I gripped Buster tight and we ran away fast. We ran all the way back to the porch. My mom greeted us with cold lemonade.

"No longer are we going near that bush," I said to Buster.

He wagged his tail and pulled a stick from the yard to chew on. We were safe now.

Last weekend I went camping with my dog Buster. We walked in the woods and saw a big squirrel. Immediately, Buster started stamping his feet and barking loud. I grabbed his leash tight so he couldn't run.

"Stop it right now Buster!" I yelled at him.

But he fought the leash and was groaning at the squirrel. Unfortunately, it started to rain really hard on us. My dad said we had to go back to the tent.

"We don't want to catch pneumonia out here," Dad said.

We pretended we were soldiers and Buster was the colonel. We marched back to the tent and ate snacks. It was the best trip ever even with the rain.

I woke up late today because I slept too much. My alarm clock was ringing but I didn't hear it. I ate a protein bar very fast for breakfast. My mom said, "You need to hurry up right now!"

I ran to the bus stop and saw my friends. There were thirteen kids waiting in the cold. At school we had gym class outside. We were hanging upside down on the monkey bars. Then we started swinging really high. It felt like a bungee jump.

At lunch my friend Sam had a soda. The teacher said, "No caffeine is allowed at school, Sam." Sam was sad but he ate his apple. It was a good day even though I was late.

I was loading my spaceship when I heard a loud noise. A green alien appeared right next to my robot dog. The alien had three eyes and looked like a small elephant.

"Why are you here?" I asked the alien.

"I want the greatest jewel in the galaxy," the alien grumbled.

My robot dog barked and grew two times bigger. He understood the alien was bad. I used my laser boots and flew up high. I grabbed the shiny blue jewel from my bag.

"You will never get this!" I shouted at him.

I pressed a button and my dog started boating away in the air. We won the fight and flew home to read comics.

My friends and I climbed the big mountain yesterday. We were scared because a dragon was roaming there. I held my computer map tightly in my hands. The path was not cleared and we walked through bushes. Suddenly we saw the dragon floating above us!

"Run away fast!" shouted my friend Tim.

"We have to complete the quest!" I yelled back.

Unfortunately, the dragon crashed into a big tree. It started screaming really loud because it got scratched. A sharp needle from a pine tree poked its nose. We felt bad so we took it to the dragon hospital. The meeting with the dragon doctor went well. We feared the dragon, but now we are friends.

I ate my breakfast really fast this morning. It was toast with jam. Then I walked to school through the park. The wind was a cold breeze on my face. At school, Mrs. Miller was teaching us math again. Math takes a lot of strength for my brain! I did not understand the numbers.

"Can you explain this part?" I asked my friend Sam.

"You just add the big ones first," Sam said.

Suddenly I felt a tickle in my nose. I let out a giant sneeze! It was so loud and everyone looked at me. Sam started laughing and I turned red. But then the bell rang for recess. We ran outside to play tag. It was a good day after all.

My friends and I found a secret cave in the woods. We saw a strange design on the rock wall. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping noise. It was the beginning of a scary adventure!

"Run fast!" I screamed to my friend Leo.

A giant bear came straight at us and crashed into a tree. We scrambled over big rocks to get away. The rocks scattered everywhere. We found a magic fountain behind the cave. I feared the bear would catch us, but it stopped.

"We are the champion team!" Leo said happily.

We did not want the bear's reign to continue. We had to learn how to be brave. It was a very different day than school. We ran home safely.

My dad drove us to the park for my birthday. It was a super important day because I was turning nine. I grasped my new kite tightly in my hands. My best friend Sam came too and he brought snacks.

"Let's see who is the champion of kites," Sam said.

We ran fast and the kite flew up high. It was windy and the string felt like it was growing. Suddenly the wind stopped and my kite crashed down. It landed right on a man reading a newspaper. I was scared but the man just laughed.

"You almost crushed my hat!" he told us.

We ate cake later and it was the best day ever.

I rode the big yellow bus to school today. It was bumping up and down on the road. When we got there, Mrs. Miller said to listen. We had to do math for a whole hour. I hate math because thirteen plus thirteen is hard. At lunch, I saw my friend dumping his milk on the ground.

"Hey, stop doing that!" I yelled at him.

"I found a bug in it," he said.

I looked at the milk seeing a big black fly. It was gross so I ate my sandwich fast. Then we went to recess and played tag. It was a good day but I was tired.

I was walking straight to school on Tuesday. My backpack felt heavy because I was bringing my science project. It was a model of a jungle with plastic tigers. I believed it was the best one ever. But then I dropped it on the sidewalk!

"Oh no, my tiger is broken!" I yelled loudly.

My friend Sam ran over to help me. He was steering his bike around a big puddle.

"Do not worry, we can fix it," Sam said.

We had a meeting by the bike rack. We used tape to fix the tiger. It looked a little bit like a ghost tiger now. I often worry about school, but today was okay. My teacher said my project showed good training. I got a gold star!

I was waiting for recess all morning because I had a plan. My teacher Mrs. Lee was talking about gravity but I just looked at the clock. Finally the big bell rang and everyone ran outside. I sprinted to the jungle gym because it is the greatest thing ever. My friend Sam was already climbing up the side.

"Look at my new design!" shouted Sam from the top. He spread his arms out like a plane.

I started climbing too but my finger slipped a little. I held on tight though. I got to the top and we looked down at the playground. Then the teacher blew her whistle way too soon.

"Aww man, we just got up here!" I said. We had to go back inside for math.

One day my dog Buster ran into the woods. I yelled for him but he did not come back. I heard a loud bark and I ran fast. Buster was trapped in a deep hole near the big oak tree. He looked scared and was not speaking or barking anymore. I understood that he needed help right now.

"Don't worry Buster, I am coming!" I shouted down.

I threw a long rope down into the dark hole. Buster bit the rope and I pulled hard. It was like earning a gold medal when he popped out. I was feeling so happy and thrilled. My mom was cheering when we got home safe.

"Good job teaching him to hold the rope," she said.

Buster wagged his tail and licked my face. We are never going near that hole again.

My dog Buster is very silly and loves treats. One day I put his blue sweater on him because it was cold. We went outside and I was steering him with the leash. He saw a squirrel and started yearning for it. He barked and pulled but I held on tight.

"Stop it Buster!" I yelled.

"Woof!" he said back to me.

We walked to the park where we built a fort yesterday. Suddenly a big cat appeared near the slide. Buster let out a huge sneeze and the cat ran away. He was hungry so we went home for dinner. I am training him to sit but it takes longer than I thought. After he ate he slept on my bed all night. He is the best dog ever.

It was raining hard outside and the wind blew fast. I put on my shiny armor because I was a brave knight. My dog Spot was my sidekick and he barked loud. We went to the spooky cave at the beginning of the woods. It was freezing cold but we walked carefully inside.

Suddenly a big bat flew right at my head! I yelled and ducked down fast. Spot jumped up and scared the bat away. I knew we had to find the magic cup. We saw a goblin dumping rocks in a pile.

"Stop right there!" I shouted at the goblin.

The goblin turned around and looked very scared. He dropped a tiny crumb of bread.

"Please don't hurt me, Mr. Champion!" said the goblin.

We were not a failure because we found the treasure. It was a good meeting and we went home happy.

It was a cold day in February. My friend Max came over to play my new video game. It is about a brave sailor on a big island. We had to find treasure and fight bad guys. Max is usually good at beating me in games. I tried to explain the buttons but he already knew them.

"I discovered a secret cave!" Max yelled loudly.

"Wait for me!" I shouted back at him.

We moved our characters through the pretty scenery. Then we had a big race on the beach. I used a science trick to go faster. I cleared the last jump and won the race! Max said he needs to learn my tricks. My mom called us for snacks after cleaning up. It was the best day ever.

My dad got sick right before our big holiday party. The doctor said he had pneumonia and had to rest. I had a bad feeling that the party was ruined. Mom brewed some hot tea for him and looked sad. I knew I had to fix it.

I used my imagination and made a fort in the living room. My dog Colonel jumped inside with us.

"Is this the party?" Dad asked with a weak smile.

"Yes, it is a secret camping party," I said.

Suddenly, my friends came over with snacks. We all tried to squeeze into the fort together. It was crowded but fun. Dad laughed and said it was the best party ever. Even though he was sick, we were all happy.

Me and my friend Sam went into the dark woods. We were looking for my dog Spot because he disappeared. We walked for a long time and then we got lost.

"I am scared," said Sam. He was wearing his blue jacket.

Suddenly I heard a loud whistle. We ran fast and we reached a big cave. I saw a tail wagging inside. It was Spot! But he was caught on a big root. I shouted his name and ran to help him.

"You are safe now, Spot!" I said.

We walked home and we were very happy. My mom gave us cookies for being brave. I was honest about getting lost though. Next time I am earning money for a leash!

My dog Sparky is trained to find hidden treasure. Yesterday we went to the big park behind my house. It looks like a jungle there. We crossed the creek on a fallen log.

"Look Sparky," I said. "That hill is a giant mountain!"

Sparky barked and ran up the hill fast. He started digging near a big rock. He remembered where he put his bone last week.

"Good boy, Sparky!" I yelled. "You are earning a treat."

He looked like a brave sailor finding gold. But he was just bearing a dirty old bone in his mouth. Then the park closed so we went home for dinner. It was the best adventure ever.

My brother Tim and I went boating on the lake. We followed a schedule but then we heard a big splash. Something started thumping against the side of our little boat.

"Look at that monster!" I screamed loudly.

A green head appeared and it tried to gnaw on the wood. It was roaming around looking for food. I blew my loud whistle to scare it away. The monster jumped high and landed back in the dark water. We rowed fast back to our house.

"I need to check my computer," said Tim.

We looked up the monster online but we found nothing. We saw a thread from his old shirt on the dock. It was the scariest day ever.

Me and my friend Sam got up very early. We wanted to find the magic fountain in the woods. Sam was steering his bike fast and I was running. We heard a weird sound like a ghost moaning.

"What is that noise?" asked Sam with big eyes.

"I can’t explain it but I am scared," I said.

We kept going and we found a big cave. We saw something shiny inside the dark hole. It was the fountain but a bear was guarding it! The bear was seeing us so we ran away fast. We did not get the magic water that day. My dad is coaching soccer later so I have to go. Exploring is hard work but earning magic is harder.

I was sitting in class and my stomach was groaning. I really wanted lunch because I had a protein bar. Finally the bell rang and everyone started jumping up. I ran to the playground and saw my friend Sam.

"Let's play tag!" I shouted loudly to him.

Sam grasped my arm and said, "You are it!"

I chased him past the water fountain and down the trail. I neither caught him nor tagged him because he was fast. Then I drew a line in the dirt with my foot. I picked up a ball and threw it high.

"I am the champion!" Sam yelled when he caught it.

I obtained the ball back and we laughed. I thought school was actually fun today. Then the teacher blew the whistle for class again.

I really wanted to win the big race at school. My friend Sam drew a line in the dirt for the start. I grabbed my water bottle and took a big gulp. I was nervous throughout my whole body.

"Ready, set, go!" yelled Sam loudly.

I ran fast and my shoes gripped the grass. I knew I had to beat Timmy to the big tree. Suddenly I saw a rock but I couldn't stop. I tripped and almost fell but I kept running hard.

"You can do it!" my mom shouted from the side.

I opened my eyes wide and ran past Timmy. I touched the tree first and was so happy. I was grateful I didn't get in trouble for falling. My heart was thumping like a little lamb inside my chest. Then I heard a knock on my shoulder. It was Timmy saying good game.

Yesterday I played my favorite video game against my brother. It is a racing game with fast cars and boats. I chose the red car and he picked the blue one.

"I will beat you this time!" I yelled loudly.

My brother laughed and said, "In your dreams, little guy."

The race started and we zoomed past the trees. My car twisted around the sharp corners really fast. Then we got to the boating part of the level. My boat escaped a giant shark that jumped up. I remember thinking I was going to lose right there. But I kept going and crossed the finish line first! My reign as the champion finally started. My dad was coaching me from the couch the whole time. After I won, I had to go comb my hair for dinner.

My robot named Zork had super strength. He was thirteen feet tall and made of shiny metal. One day we went boating on the green slime river. Suddenly, I was seeing a giant purple alien roaming on the shore! The alien jumped right at our boat. Zork grabbed a long bungee cord from his chest.

"Hold on tight!" yelled Zork very loudly.

I was clinging to his metal arm with both hands. Zork shot the bungee cord through the air. It stuck to a big tree. We flew up and landed safe.

"That was too close," I said to Zork.

We ran away before the alien could eat our boat.

Me and my best friend Sam wanted to explore the dark forest. Our teacher taught us about hidden treasure, and we wanted to find it. We packed snacks and walked past the old barn.

We heard a loud noise coming from a deep cave. "Listen! What is that groaning sound?" Sam whispered.

I was scared but I led the way inside. It was dark and damp. Suddenly, we saw a giant monster sitting on a pile of gold! It looked like a fluffy lamb, but huge. It chewed on a big bone.

"We must seize the treasure!" I yelled.

The monster roared, and we ran away fast. It was the greatest adventure ever, but we didn't get the gold. Maybe the monster will reign over the forest forever.

My math homework was a big failure. I stared at the huge mountain of numbers. I knew I was going to be in big trouble. Mrs. Green walked by my desk and looked down.

"Are you sleeping in class again, Tommy?" she asked me.

"No, I am just thinking really hard," I said.

Then the bell started ringing for recess and everyone ran. I pushed my paper into my desk and it disappeared. Outside, we played on the swings and I felt better. I jumped off like a bungee jumper. Recess is way longer than math class. Later, I drew a picture of a monster eating my homework. It was the best day ever.

It was raining super hard today so recess was inside. Everyone grumbled because we wanted to play tag on the grass. My friend Billy sat on the ground and looked sad. I opened my lunch box and saw my sandwich was crushed.

"Oh no! My mom forgot to wrap it good," I said.

Billy laughed but then he started coughing really loud. I told him he sounded like a sick elephant.

"Maybe I will get pneumonia if I go outside," Billy joked.

After lunch we went to gym class and swam in the pool. I rode the bus home later and was so tired. To be honest, indoor recess days are actually kind of fun. I turned on the TV and fell asleep on the couch.

I was exploring outside with my younger brother Sam. We saw a baby bird on the grass. It looked scared and I feared it was hurt.

"Look, it can't fly!" said Sam loudly.

I grabbed an old newspaper to help it. I scooped the bird up and felt its weight. It was so light, like a feather. We thought it needed company so we stayed close. Then a breeze came and the bird spread its wings.

"Go on, you can do it!" we started cheering.

Suddenly the bird flew up into the big tree. We watched it for a little bit longer. My smile was growing so big. It was safe now.

My backpack felt super heavy because I was bringing my computer home. I carefully walked down the stairs to my apartment. I feared dropping it on the concrete. Inside, I saw a tiny gnat flying around my snack. I tried swatting it, but it just disappeared. It was weird.

Then my friend Leo came over. He was stamping his feet.

"I have so much homework!" Leo yelled loudly.

"Me too," I said. "Neither of us can play yet."

We sat down and opened our books. We had to wrap our heads around math problems. After ten minutes, we finished the first page. We started jumping up and down because we were done. Then we ran outside to play tag.

It was a cold day in February and raining a little. My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. We walked straight to the big pond near my house. There is a tiny island in the middle of the water.

Suddenly, a big white duck appeared on the shore. He looked very serious like a boss.

"Look at that duck, Buster!" I said.

Buster barked loudly at the duck. The duck did not move at all.

"I think his name is Colonel Quack," I whispered.

We neared the water but the Colonel stared at us. I tried to whistle to him but I am just beginning to learn. It sounded funny. The Colonel jumped into the water and swam away fast. We went home to get dry.

My nephew Sam came over to play in my yard. He loves tearing through the grass and stamping his feet. We pretended we were in a super hero league for animals. Suddenly, we heard a weird sound near the big tree. It sounded like something moaning and groaning in the dirt.

"Is that a monster?" Sam asked me quietly.

"No, it is simply a dog," I said.

We saw a small puppy digging in the soft earth. Although he was muddy, he looked very cute. He was following a trail of ants. My mom was on the balcony drinking tea she just brewed.

"Bring that puppy inside for a bath!" Mom yelled.

We grabbed the puppy and ran inside fast.

My friends and I went into the dark woods yesterday. We were looking for a secret treasure chest. Suddenly my friend Tom disappeared behind a big tree. We got lost and the sun started going down. I took out my compass and checked the needle. It was spinning around like crazy!

"We need to find the right bearing," I yelled.

"I think Colonel Mustard hid the gold here," said Sarah.

We stood there and looked at the scary scene. Then we saw a bear sleeping near a cave! We ran away fast and found our way home. We were safe but we never found the gold.

I was waiting for my turn in the big race. My knee scratched against the start line. I feared the fast kid in the blue shirt. He was stamping his feet and looking really mean.

"Ready, set, go!" yelled the coach loudly.

I sprinted as fast as a cheetah. My legs felt like they were on fire. Suddenly, the blue shirt kid tripped on a rock. I crossed the finish line first and everyone cheered. I felt so grateful that I didn't fall down too.

"Good game," I said to the boy.

He was groaning a little but he smiled. I obtained the gold medal and I felt proud. Now I can go home and finish my science building project. It was the best day ever to complete a race.

My dog Rex is big and has brown fur. One day we went exploring in the woods throughout the afternoon. The sun was hot and it scorched the grass. Rex sniffed a bush and then he barked loudly. I saw eight baby ducks hiding there.

"Don't worry, little ducks," I said to them softly.

Rex wanted to chase them but he is trained well. He sat down and used all his strength to stay still. The mama duck came back and looked very scared. She quacked at us and puffed up her feathers.

"Come on Rex, let's go home," I said.

We walked back and my mom stewed some apples for dinner. I was happy we didn't get in trouble or get a grounding. The ducks grew quiet as we left. We didn't hurt them and they didn't hurt us either.

I was playing basketball with my big brother Sam. He is really tall and good at guarding the hoop. I tried to dribble through his legs but he stopped me. My face got red and a vein popped out on my neck. I was mad because he was winning by ten points.

"Stop moaning and just play harder," Sam said to me.
