I took a break and drank a soda with lots of caffeine. It tasted pleasant and cold. Then I ran back onto the court fast. I spread my arms out and stole the ball from him! I felt like I was coaching myself to win.

"Nice move!" Sam yelled when I finally made a basket.

I didn't win the game, but I felt happy anyway. Next time I will beat him for sure.

I was walking in the woods behind my house. I saw a shiny metal box under a bush. I crawled over to it and grabbed the handle. It was stuck tight though. I pulled really hard and the door popped open! A little green alien jumped out. He had three eyes and crossed his arms.

"Don't squeeze me!" he yelled.

I was surprised seeing him. "Are you lost?" I asked him.

He nodded his big head. "My spaceship broke."

I thought about my toy toolbox at home. "I can fix it," I said. We ran to my house fast. The alien smiled at me. We were best friends now.

I thought my dog Buster was a science genius. We went exploring in the woods behind my house. Buster was leading the way and sniffing everything. We climbed over a big log and saw a squirrel.

"Get him, Buster!" I yelled.

Buster barked loudly and his tail was thumping. He stood up on his back legs like a person. But then he saw a big newspaper on the ground. He feared it for some reason.

"It is just paper," I said to him.

Buster pulled on his leash and waited. He looked like a scared sailor on a boat. Then a bird flew down and landed on the paper. Buster forgot he was scared and chased the bird. Being brave is important for an explorer dog. He rode home in the wagon because he was tired.

My neighbor Tim sits next to me in math class. We were learning to measure shapes with rulers today. The teacher was loading a big box of blocks. She started dumping them all over the floor. It looked like a big castle for a king's reign!

"Grab a block and measure it," said Mrs. Green.

I reached for a blue square, but Tim grabbed it first.

"Hey, I was approaching that one!" I told him.

He just laughed and grasped the blue block tight. So I took a red one instead. Math is okay, but I like recess better. At recess, we play tag and run very fast.

My dog Buster is usually very lazy. He puts all his weight on the rug and sleeps. But today I found something weird. I walked into the kitchen and saw Buster floating! He was up near the ceiling and looking hungry.

"Get down right now, Buster!" I yelled.

He just barked and kept floating in the air. I thought it was impossible for dogs to fly. My mom came running in and she gasped.

"Did you give him the magic beans?" she asked with anger.

I did not remember giving him any beans. Then I discovered the open bag of floating treats on the counter. I brought a ladder and grabbed him. He made a groaning sound because he was full. We have to change his eating schedule now. It was a very crazy day.

We went to the spooky old barn behind my house. My friend Sam believed a monster lived there. We crawled under the fence and landed in the dirt. It smelled funny inside, like old cheese and dust.

Suddenly, we heard a weird noise sounding like a growl. I felt trapped and scared. Sam was hanging onto my arm really tight.

"I think it wants to eat us!" Sam whispered.

"We have to be brave," I said back to him.

We saw glowing eyes in the dark corner. I chewed my lip because I was nervous. Then a tiny cat came out. It wasn't a monster at all! We knew we were safe. We ran home fast before dinner.

Me and my best friend Sam went exploring yesterday. We walked to the old spooky park behind the science lab. There was a big metal gate with a rusty chain on it. I was a little afraid but Sam acted brave.

"We have to be honest, this looks scary," I said.

Sam just laughed and climbed over the fence. "Don't be a chicken! Follow me!"

We found a broken water fountain inside. Suddenly, we heard a loud knock sounding from a shed. We ran away fast but my jacket got caught on a bush! I pulled hard and fought the branches. We kept running until we got home safe.

My mom said not to play outside in the cold or I might catch pneumonia. But we had fun anyway. Next time we will make a better schedule for our adventure.

I was playing my new video game called Monster Castle. My heart was pumping fast because I was on level thirteen. A scary creature jumped out and I almost dropped my controller. My character had a shiny blue jewel and a big sword.

"Watch out for the green slime!" my brother yelled loudly.

I jumped over the slime and spread my wings to fly. It was not easy but I was bearing down on the boss. The monster brewed a magic potion and threw it at me. It bounced off my shield with a loud clang. I was in big trouble now. A cold breeze came from the TV screen.

"You are going to lose!" my brother said laughing.

I was almost swearing but I didn't want to get grounded. I hit the button hard and won the game!

I was walking to school and I heard a loud noise. It sounded like a scary ghost in the bushes. I neared the big tree and I saw something shiny. It was a blue jewel on the dirt trail! I picked it up and ran to class.

My teacher Mrs. Green was simply sitting at her computer. I showed her the jewel and she almost fainted.

"Where did you find this?" she asked me.

"It was on the trail by the ghost tree," I said.

Just then a bird flew in the window. It had messy feathers so I wanted to comb them. It was trained because it landed right on my desk. Then the recess bell rang so I sprinted outside to play. It was the best day ever.

I was playing Mario Kart with my big brother Sam. We neared the finish line and my hands were sweaty. Sam is usually the champion but today I was ready. I grasped the controller tight and leaned forward. My car was steering perfectly around the corners. I was gradually getting faster and faster.

"You're not going to win!" Sam yelled loudly.

"Yes I am!" I shouted back at him.

I saw a blue shell floating above my head. I threw it and it hit Sam right at the end. I crossed the line to complete the race first. Sam looked like he was sleeping because he was so slow. My dad came in and started coaching me on my victory dance. I finally beat him!

Me and my best friend Sam went to the dark woods. We were looking for the greatest treasure in the world. I held the map and Sam led the way. The wind felt like a cold breeze on my face. Suddenly a big wolf jumped out!

"Watch out!" I yelled really loud.

Sam drew his toy sword and waved it at the wolf. The wolf looked scary but it just chewed on a stick. It was actually a nice dog. We petted him and he was very grateful. Then we remembered the map said go to the old tree. We walked fourteen steps and dug a hole. We found a box with shiny rocks inside!

"We are rich!" Sam spoke with a happy smile.

It was already time for dinner so we ran home fast.

My cat Fluffy is a really good jumper. One day I was playing on the balcony with him. He saw a big green bug and started jumping around. Suddenly the bug flew away and Fluffy disappeared too! I was certain he fell off, so I ran downstairs fast.

"Fluffy! Where are you?" I yelled really loud.

I searched the bushes but it looked kind of dangerous in there. Then I saw something white under a big leaf. It was Fluffy! He bounced out and rubbed on my leg. He wasn't the captain of the garden any longer though.

"You are a bad kitty," I said.

He just purred and we went back inside for lunch.

I was feeling tired in math class today. Mrs. Baker was talking about numbers but I was almost sleeping. My eyes felt heavy and the clock was ticking slowly. I counted the seconds until the bell rang loudly. Everyone jumped up and ran to the door screaming.

"Finally it is lunchtime!" my friend Sam shouted.

We opened our lunchboxes and I discovered a surprise. My mom packed a huge chocolate cookie for me. It was better than the sandwich clinging to the wrapper. Suddenly, Sam touched my arm and pointed at his juice. It was floating in the air like magic! We watched it growing bigger and then it popped.

"Oh no, now I am sticky," Sam said groaning.

We cleaned it up but lunch was no longer boring. Then we went outside and screamed on the playground. It was the best day ever.

My nephew Ben and I went boating on the lake. We rowed together for a long time. Suddenly a big storm flew in and the waves got high. Our boat hit a rock and we got trapped on an island. "We need to climb to a safe height!" I yelled. Ben was scared but I started coaching him up the hill. A giant tree almost crushed us but we jumped away. We waited all night. In the morning a helicopter saw us. It took us to the hospital to check for cuts. The doctor checked my weight and said I was okay. "That was scary," Ben said. We were happy to be safe.

My heart was pumping fast because this was the most important race. I was playing Mario Kart with my younger brother, Sam. He thinks he is better, but I am the champion.

"You are going down!" I yelled at him.

"No way, I’m going to win," Sam greeted me back.

We picked the Rainbow Road track, which is super dangerous. There is no gravity, so you can fly really high. I got a mushroom and went faster. Sam tried to push me off the height of the track. But then he crashed into a wall! I was thrilled. I crossed the finish line first. My mom said no caffeine for us because we were too loud. I played longer than Sam because he got mad and quit. Winning feels great.

Yesterday, I met a real alien named Zorg. Zorg flew down from space in a big silver ship. He was green and had four arms for swinging around.

"I am in trouble with the space league," Zorg said. "I spilled a purple stain on my dad's robot."

I told him I could help fix it. We brewed a magic potion in my mom’s kitchen. It smelled funny and was sounding like pop rocks. Zorg was teaching me how to be invisible too. We ran through the backyard and did a bungee jump off the swing set.

"Thanks for the training!" Zorg yelled happily.

Then he went back to reading his map and flew home. Being friends with an alien is super cool.

I sat at my desk and looked at the clock. It was finally time for art class. Mrs. Green gave us old newspaper to put on the tables. We had to make a big mess.

"Make sure you squeeze the glue hard!" Mrs. Green yelled.

I squeezed the bottle with all my strength. Glue went everywhere! It got on my hands and surrounding my paper. Then an idea struck me. I found a shiny red jewel in the box. I put it right in the middle of the glue puddle. It looked awesome throughout the whole drying time.

"Wow, that looks like a king's crown," said my friend Ben.

I was keeping it forever. It was the best art project ever.

My birthday was on a Wednesday and it felt weird. I wanted a sleepover but Mom said no because of school. I was sad and I was hanging my head down. But then my grandma appeared at the door! She was bringing a huge box and she was stamping her feet.

"This box is heavy and I am growing old!" she said.

My dad pulled the box inside and he was groaning loudly. It was a meeting of all my favorite people. Neither Mom nor Dad told me about the surprise. I opened the box and caught a big red ball.

"Don't sneeze on the cake!" my brother yelled at me.

It was the most important day ever. I am so happy I am eight now.

One day it was raining so I stayed inside. I was sad because I wanted to go exploring. My dog Max came over and I grabbed his comb. I brushed his fur until it was soft and plain. Then my mom shouted, "Look outside right now!"

I ran to the window and saw eight baby sheep. One little lamb was very tiny and looked lost. We ran outside and counted them all in the yard. I was thrilled to see them playing in the mud. Max is trained so he did not chase them.

"Can we keep the tiny one?" I asked Mom.

She laughed and said we had to find the farmer. Later we hung up our wet coats to dry. I did not receive a lamb but it was fun. Then I read a book about farm animals to Max.

Yesterday, my friend Sam and I obtained a map. It was hidden in his basement near the old coaching stuff. We discovered a big red X on it.

"Let's be explorers!" Sam yelled loudly.

We started loading our backpacks with snacks and flashlights. Our schedule was tight because dinner is at six. We walked to the woods behind the park. Sam pretended to be the captain of a ship. I was the guide looking for treasure.

Suddenly, we saw a dark cave. It looked scary, especially because it was getting late.

"Do you think a bear is inside?" I asked.

Sam shook his head. We walked in, but we only found a shiny rock. It was still the best adventure ever.

I went camping in the backyard with my brother. We climbed into the tent and closed the zipper tight. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping noise outside. It sounded like big heavy robot feet. My brother looked scared and almost fainted.

"Did you hear that weird noise?" he whispered.

"I think it is a space alien," I said.

We looked through the window and saw a green light. It had a strange design on its chest. The light grew bigger and brighter throughout the yard. I knew we should run but I could not move. Then the robot tripped on a rock and fell down! It got a big grass stain on its metal leg. I thought it was funny so I decided to write about it.

Me and my best friend Jack found a secret map. It showed a big red X on a spooky island. We took my dad’s old boat and sailed across the lake. The island was dark and full of tall green trees.

"Look at that big cave!" Jack screamed loudly.

We went inside the cave and it was very cold. Suddenly we heard a loud knock on the stone wall. It sounded scary but we kept walking deeper inside. We saw a shiny box sitting on a rock. I touched the box with my thumb and it opened.

Inside was the most wonderful gold treasure ever! But then a giant crab jumped out at us! It was simply impossible to fight it. We ran back to the boat fast. I cut my leg on a sharp rock. My mom was cleaning my cut later with scissors and bandages. She said I almost had to go to the hospital. But we were brave throughout the whole adventure.

"We are never going back there," I said.

I was playing my new video game after breakfast. It is a racing game with super fast cars. My brother Tim wanted to play too but I said no. I wanted to keep my reign as the winner. I was about to seize the gold trophy on the screen.

"Let me play or I will tell Mom!" Tim shouted.

I ignored him and kept driving my red car. Suddenly my nose felt funny and I had to sneeze. My car crashed into a wall and got scorched by fire.

"Game over!" the TV screamed really loud at me.

Tim laughed at me so I pushed him. Then Mom came in and saw us fighting. Now I have a grounding for a week and no video games. I should have just been sleeping instead.

One day I went outside to play with my dog Rex. He is a big dog and he loves sticks. I threw a stick and he jumped high. Rex chewed on the stick and ran away fast. I screamed, "Come back here Rex!"

He didn't listen so I ran after him into the woods. I looked everywhere but I was neither happy nor lucky. Then I remembered he likes treats. I had a biscuit in my pocket for him.

Suddenly I saw a tail wagging behind a big bush. Rex was there seeing a tiny squirrel climb a tree.

"I found you!" I yelled.

Rex barked and we started cheering. He was happy to receive his yummy treat. We walked home and my mom was screaming because we were muddy.

My dog Max and I went to the park. It was sunny and I was coaching him to fetch. I threw the ball and he sprinted fast. But he didn't stop and he kept running into the woods!

"Max! Stop!" I yelled loud.

I ran after him and saw a big hole. Max was dumping his nose in the dirt. Suddenly a squirrel appeared on a tree branch. It was swinging its tail and looked funny. Max barked and tried to jump but bumping his head.

"Be careful of danger, Max," I said.

The squirrel spread its arms and jumped away. Max looked sad and his ears sank down. Then a bird sang a song nearby. We walked home happy because nothing bad happened.

Yesterday I went exploring in the woods behind my house. I was wearing my blue boots because it was muddy. I heard a loud noise sounding like a monster. I shouted, "Is anyone there?" but nobody answered me. Then I saw my dog Sparky roaming near a big bush. He was barking at something small and brown.

I looked closer and discovered a tiny hedgehog. It had a sharp needle on its back. The hedgehog was groaning and breathing fast. I was feeling sad for it. I picked it up gently and put it in a box. Sparky looked very pleased with himself. We took it to my mom. "Look what we found!" I said. Then the hedgehog disappeared into the box to sleep.

I was so hungry at school today. My stomach was moaning like a ghost all morning. Finally it was time for art class. We had to use scissors to cut out shapes. I tried to cut a circle but I did it wrong. It looked like a potato. 

"That is a weird circle," said my friend Billy.

"I know but I tried my best," I said.

Then the bell rang for lunch and I ran outside. I ate everything in my lunchbox very fast. After school I walked back to my apartment. I had to write a story for homework but I was tired. My mom said she can guarantee that I will feel better after a nap. She was right and then I finished my work.

I was dreaming about winning the big baseball game. My mom woke me up and told me the schedule. We drove past a big green meadow with cows. The scenery was nice but I felt nervous inside. I stewed in the back seat and looked out the window.

When we reached the field, I grasped my bat tightly. It was my turn to hit the ball. The pitcher threw it very fast and I swung hard.

"Run as fast as you can!" my dad yelled loudly.

I ran to first base and gradually got faster. I grabbed the base with my foot just in time.

"You are safe!" the umpire shouted at me.

We won the game and got ice cream after. It was the best day ever.

My dog Buster is the greatest explorer ever. We woke up early to go on an adventure in the backyard. The sun scorched the grass so it was hot on my feet. We were on a search for a secret treasure. Buster started digging near the old fence.

"Stop that!" I yelled but he didn't listen either.

He scrambled under a bush and found a big bone. It was hanging out of the dirt. I tried to seize it but he growled. He had anger in his eyes! Then I saw my mom on the balcony. She was painting a picture of the garden.

"Is that my stewed beef bone?" she asked loudly.

Buster grumbled and ran away fast. It is hard to maintain a good dog.

My dog Buster is very naughty sometimes. Yesterday he ran outside and crashed into the garden. He chewed up my mom’s favorite red flowers. I counted thirteen broken stems on the ground.

"Oh no! Buster, stop that!" I yelled loudly.

My neighbor Mr. Jones was watching us over the fence. He laughed and said, "That dog is crazy today."

Then the wind blew really hard and struck the big tree. A branch fell down, but I used my pocket knife to move it. I pretended I was an explorer in the jungle. Buster started barking and sounded like people cheering.

Later I had to write a story for school. I wrote about Buster almost getting pneumonia from the cold rain. It was a good adventure but now Buster is sleeping.

My nephew Timmy and I went to the park today. We saw a big, beautiful bird in a tree. It looked incredible because it had bright blue feathers. Timmy pointed his finger at the bird and shouted, “Look at that big bird!”

Suddenly, a squirrel climbed up the tree very fast. The bird got mad and anger brewed inside it. They almost fought right there on the branch! It was scary, but the squirrel ran away fast enough.

“Come back here!” I yelled at the squirrel. It didn't listen though. We followed it to a bush, but it was gone.

“Maybe it knows psychology and tricked us,” Timmy said. We laughed and went home to eat lunch.

My sister Emily chose a trampoline park for her birthday party. We were jumping really high and it felt like floating. I saw a huge bungee jump station in the corner. Emily was scared of the height but I wanted to try.

"I bet you get lost in the foam pit," Emily said.

I climbed up the tall ladder and my stomach felt weird. I jumped off and went bearing down fast. Everyone was groaning because it looked scary but I loved it.

"Did you receive a prize for that?" my mom asked.

"No, just for keeping my lunch down!" I laughed.

It was the best party ever.

My friends and I went to the old scary house. It looked weird and dark but we were brave. I was the captain so I walked in first. We climbed up the big dusty stairs very slowly.

Suddenly we heard a loud noise coming from a box. My friend Sam shouted, "Watch out for the monster!"

I was scared but I used my brain to think. I walked through the dark hall and touched the box. I opened the lid and looked inside carefully.

"It is just a cat!" I said.

We did not receive any gold but we found a new pet. It was a fun adventure for us.

My robot named Zork had super strength. He was made of shiny metal and green wires. Zork was taller than my dad and much stronger. We went to the park and saw a big rock. I pointed my finger at the huge grey rock.

"Can you lift that up?" I asked him.

Zork walked over and neared the heavy stone. He grasped it with his cold metal hands. He lifted it up like it was a pillow! Everyone feared the rock would fall, but Zork held it. Then a mean alien jumped out from behind a tree. The alien grabbed my arm and tried to pull me.

"Put him down!" yelled Zork with his loud voice.

Zork threw the rock through the air and scared the alien. The alien ran away fast and we went home for pizza.

I was walking through the big green meadow behind my house. A soft breeze blew the tall grass around my legs. Suddenly I saw something shiny sticking out of the dirt. I started cleaning the mud off with my hands. It was a metal box and it looked crushed on one side. My heart started pumping fast because I was scared.

"What is that thing?" my sister asked me loudly.

"I think I discovered a robot head," I whispered back.

We opened the metal mouth and saw a blue light inside. It was trembling a little bit like it was cold.

"It must be sleeping," I said and counted to three.

We pushed a red button and the robot eyes turned on! This was going to be a complete adventure, especially since it could talk.

I woke up early and it was freezing outside. My little nephew Ben wanted to play explorers in the woods. He put on his big coat and hung a whistle around his neck.

"I am the captain now!" Ben shouted loudly.

We walked straight into the tall, scary grass. It was hard to keep a steady pace though. Suddenly, a bright blue bird flew right past my head!

"Did you see that impossible bird?" I asked Ben.

"It looked like a dragon instead," Ben said.

We heard a sounding noise like a bear, but it was just a squirrel. To be honest, I was a little scared. We walked until the path was complete and then we ran home for hot cocoa.

I was so hungry for lunch today. My tummy was making loud noises in math class. When the bell rang, I grabbed my lunchbox immediately. I started running to the cafeteria with my friend Sam. We were following the other kids in the hall. Sam was bumping into people because he was excited.

"Watch out!" I yelled at him.

We sat down and I opened my box. Oh no! My mom packed the wrong sandwich. I wanted ham but she gave me tuna. I don't like tuna and Sam doesn't either.

"Do you want my apple?" Sam asked me.

I took the apple and climbed on the jungle gym later. The breeze felt nice outside. Everyone was cheering for a game of tag. I didn't care about the tuna anymore. Recess is the best part of school.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover last night. We built a huge fort in the living room with blankets. It was freezing outside but warm inside our secret fort.

"I bet you can't stay awake all night," Sam said.

"I can too stay awake!" I yelled back, sounding brave.

We told scary stories and ate popcorn until our tummies hurt. Gradually, my eyes started feeling heavy like rocks. I heard Sam breathing loudly next to me. He was sleeping already! I tickled his nose with a soft feather from my pillow.

Sam woke up groaning and rubbed his face. "Hey, that tickles!" he laughed.

I thought I would stay awake, but I fell asleep too. We didn't make it all night, but we didn't care either. It was the best sleepover ever.

It was a pleasant Wednesday at school. My teacher Mrs. Miller said we were earning points for a pizza party. Everyone was bringing in cans of food for the food drive. My backpack felt like a huge weight on my shoulders. I was pumping my arms fast to get to class.

"Did you bring the beans?" asked my friend Sam.

"Yes, I have three cans!" I said.

We walked to the big box in the hallway. We were dumping all the cans inside. It sounded like thunder. Then we went to recess. I played tag with the younger kids. I was leading the game and running fast on the earth. School is fun when you help people.

One day I walked straight through the woods behind my house. The leaves were scattered everywhere on the ground. I moved carefully because I heard a weird noise.

"Listen to that sound," I whispered to my dog max.

Max barked at a big bush and he scrambled inside it. Suddenly a blue bird flew out and went up high. It looked like it struggled to fly at first. We kept walking and saw a wooden sign. It said do not enter but we believed it was okay.

We smelled something like roasted marshmallows nearby. A man was approaching us with a stick.

"Do you have the receipt for this forest?" he asked.

I laughed and ran back home fast. My mom brewed some hot cocoa for us. I was happy we were safe inside.

I was walking to school from my apartment. I saw a dog roaming near the water fountain. It looked hungry so I gave it my toasted sandwich. The dog ate it fast and then ran away.

In science class we learned about the earth. Mr. Jones showed us a painting of a castle. He said, "Who knows where this castle is?"

I raised my hand but I got the answer wrong. Everyone laughed a little bit but I didn't care.

At lunch they sold pizza but it disappeared fast. There was only salad left so I ate that. I looked out the window at the scenery. It was raining hard so we had indoor recess. I played blocks with my friend Sam. It was a good day even without the pizza.

One day my robot Zorp moved very fast. He saw a big green alien approaching the park. The alien looked scary and everyone feared him.

"Stop right there!" Zorp called out loud.

The alien was groaning and holding a shiny feather. He bounced up and down like a bungee cord. Suddenly he fell into the water fountain. The water was freezing cold!

"I just want a friend," the alien said sadly.

Zorp helped him up. They played tag all day. The alien was not scary at all.

I met my friend Sam at lunch time. We were hungry and waiting for our food. The lunch lady turned around and gave us pizza. It smelled like toasted cheese and looked really good.

"I hope I get the biggest slice," Sam said.

We sat down but then a big fly landed on my tray. I tried to shoo it away but it stole a crumb. I felt like I was in fly training because it was super fast.

"Watch out, it is approaching your milk!" I yelled.

I used all my strength and waved my hand. The fly flew through the air and left. Even though it was annoying, I still ate my pizza. Then I drew a picture of the fly in my notebook. It was a funny lunch.

I went to the jungle in my backyard today. My dog Rex came for company and we were ready for an adventure. I gripped his leash tight because he was pulling hard.

"We need to find the lost elephant!" I shouted to Rex.

He just barked and wagged his tail at a squirrel. We climbed the big tree like it was a bungee jump. It felt very important to see everything from up high. My mom was coaching my sister on her bike nearby.

"Do you want some toasted bread?" Mom asked us.

We climbed down fast because we were hungry. Rex greeted Mom with a big lick on her face. Being the king of the backyard is hard work. It was time to end my reign and go inside. Mom doesn't let me have caffeine but I got juice instead.

I wanted to be the fastest runner at recess. I trained all week in my backyard with my neighbor. We ran back and forth until I was breathing hard. I felt stronger every single day. Today at lunch, I ate my sandwich super fast. Then I went outside and saw Tommy by the swings. He is usually the champion of the big race.

"Do you want to race me?" I asked him.

"Sure, I will beat you simply," Tommy said.

We lined up by the big oak tree. My friend yelled go and I sprinted very fast. I felt light like I had no weight. I passed Tommy and felt like I was in heaven. I won the race and everyone was clinging to me. It was the best day ever.

My birthday party was going to be awesome. I feared nobody would come, but then I heard a knock. It was my best friend Sam at the door. He had a big blue box in his hands.

"Happy birthday!" Sam yelled and gave me a hug.

"Thanks for coming!" I said and we ran inside.

We played games and ate pizza with lots of cheese. Then my mom lit the candles on my cake. The cake had a cool superhero design on top. I saw the fire growing bigger and made a wish. I was steering my new remote control car later. We neared the end of the party and had a meeting. We decided it was the best day ever.

I was walking home when a UFO crashed in the park. It hit the ground with a big boom! I pulled my little sister behind a tree. The spaceship door opened and green smoke came out gradually. A tiny alien walked out and he looked sad.

"Are you okay?" I asked the alien.

"My ship is broken and heavy," he said.

The alien stuck out his purple tongue and threw a rock. Suddenly the rock started floating up high. It was the greatest superpower ever! Then my neighbor ran over with his newspaper. He saw the alien and dropped his paper.

"That is heavier than a mountain!" yelled my neighbor.

The alien used his magic to fix the ship's weight. He flew away fast before my mom gave me a grounding. It was cool.

My nephew Timmy was turning five today. The party started at noon, and we neared the park. I had a big gift for him. It was a red ball. 

"I guarantee he will love it," I said to Mom. 

Mom smiled and parked the car. We got out and searched for the party spot. Timmy saw us and ran fast. He threw his arms up. 

"Happy birthday!" I yelled loud. 

Although it was windy, we ate cake outside. Then I gave him the box. He ripped the paper. He started laughing. 

"This is the best!" Timmy shouted.

Mom was swearing the wind would blow the cake away. But we held the plates tight and had fun.

One day my dog Buster ran straight through the open gate. I knew he was going to the park. I ran after him as fast as I could. Buster is not trained very well yet. He ran all the way to the big pond. There is a small island in the middle of the water.

"Come back here Buster!" I yelled loudly.

He didn't listen and jumped in with all his weight. He swam to the island and barked. I saw a sign that said No Swimming.

"You are going to be in big trouble," I said.

My dad came and threw a stick to get him back. Buster swam back to receive the stick. We built a better fence later so he stays safe. Throughout the day Buster slept because he was tired. I tried to explain why he was wet to my mom. She just laughed at us.

I heard a big boom outside my apartment window. It was super loud and the ground shook. I ran outside and saw a trail of green slime. It went all the way to the park. I was waiting for my friends but I went alone.

Suddenly I saw a shiny metal ship that crashed. A little green alien climbed out. He looked sad and lonely.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"I am yearning for some company," the alien said.

He had super strength and lifted his ship up. Then we rode on his ship together. He let me help with the steering. It felt impossible but we flew really high! Then he disappeared into the clouds. Seeing him leave made me sad, but it was the best day ever.

I was playing my favorite video game against my neighbor. We were racing huge spaceships around a big planet. My ship was named the Space Sailor and it was super fast. Suddenly, the loading screen popped up and my game froze. I felt so much anger because I was winning!

"Hey, your ship just crashed into a fountain!" yelled Billy.

"No fair, my screen is trapped!" I shouted back.

I grabbed my controller tight and stewed in my chair. Then my screen came back and I flew really fast. I used zero gravity to float over his head. I roasted him with my lasers and I won the race. I was so happy I almost got pneumonia from sweating too much.

It was raining really hard outside on Saturday. I wanted to go exploring in the woods behind my house. I put on my boots and opened the door. The scenery was all gray and wet and muddy. I walked to the big oak tree and discovered something sad. A little dog was stuck on a heavy chain.

The dog was shaking because he feared the loud thunder. I ran over and he greeted me with a small bark. I saw the chain was stuck on a root. I started tearing at the roots with my hands. finally it came loose!

"You are safe now, puppy," I said to him.

He licked my face and wagged his tail fast. We ran back to my porch where it was dry. I spread out a warm blanket for him. soon he was sleeping soundly. I think he was very grateful.

I was thrilled because it was recess time. I ran outside and saw my friends near the big slide. We wanted to play pirates on the playground. The sand was the ocean and the slide was our island.

"Let's climb to the top!" shouted Max.

We struggled to get up because everyone was bumping into each other. Suddenly, Sarah started screaming. She dropped her special leather bracelet in the sand. We searched everywhere for it. The sand was scattered all around us.

"I found it!" I said and I was so happy.

We grew tired from stamping our feet and running. The bell rang and playtime closed. I thought about lunch and my hungry tummy.

One day I walked outside early in the morning. A cool breeze blew my hair. Suddenly I saw a green alien climbing down a tree. He was hanging from a branch by his tail. I grabbed my super laser blaster and I ran over.

"Stop right there!" I shouted at the alien.

The alien looked scared and held up his hands.

"I am just looking for my robot dog," he said.

We searched everywhere for his dog. Finally we heard a loud whistle. The robot dog drove up in a tiny car. I saw the dog's metal brain glowing blue. It was the greatest design ever. We fought some bad guys together and won. Saving the world is like earning a gold medal. Seeing the alien happy made me smile.

Me and my friend Sam went to the old scary park. We looked for the secret cave behind the big slide. Sam brought a rope because he wanted to bungee jump down.

"This is a bad idea," I said quietly.

"Don't be scared!" Sam screeched and ran fast.

He jumped but he scratched his arm on a rock. Then we realized it was too dark inside. We heard a loud noise though. We ran away very fast to the store. I bought some candy and I paid with my allowance money. We were safe but my mom was mad. She gave me a grounding for a week. We never went back there again.

My cat Fluffy is really funny and sometimes very crazy. One morning I was eating my breakfast and I heard a loud noise. I looked up at the ceiling and saw Fluffy on the high shelf! She climbed up there with all her strength but she looked scared.

"Get down right now, Fluffy!" I yelled at her.

"Meow," she grumbled back at me like she was mad.

She tried to jump but she slipped and fell on my dad's old sweater. It was like she did a bungee jump without a rope. She crushed a box of tissues when she landed. I picked her up and she purred. I think she was grateful for seeing me. She acts like the queen and wants to reign over the whole house.

Yesterday was the greatest day at school. We played soccer at recess and I felt like a champion. My friend Sam greeted me on the field. He is stronger than me but I am faster. I ran fast and my heart was pumping hard. Sam kicked the ball carefully to me. I caught it with my foot and kicked it.

"Nice shot!" Sam yelled loud.

I scored a goal and everyone cheered. I felt like I obtained a gold medal. But then I tripped on my shoelace. It felt like a bungee jump without the rope. I almost fainted because I was so dizzy. I got up and found a rhythm again.

"Are you okay?" asked my teacher.

I nodded and walked back to the apartment building after school. I didn't have much weight in my backpack because I finished my homework. It was a good day.

My brother and I were playing a racing game. I picked the red car and he picked the blue one. We were zooming around the track really fast.

"I am going to win this time!" I screamed loudly.

"No way, you are too slow," my brother grumbled back.

I gripped the controller tight in my hands. The finish line was approaching fast. I was scared I might crash into the wall. My car went straight ahead, although my brother tried to bump me. It felt like we were boating on waves because the screen was shaking. I was yearning to see the winner sign pop up. Suddenly, I crossed the line first! I jumped up and did a happy dance. We played again but this time he won.

One day I found a robot in my backyard. He was often lonely so I gave him a name. His name was Bleep and he liked eating metal. I was bringing him a spoon but he chewed it up fast. He pointed a silver finger at the sky. A big green ship was approaching us very fast. Bleep started beep-beeping because he was yearning to go home.

"Are you bearing gifts?" asked a green alien.

"Yes, take this comb," I said to the alien.

The alien took the comb and his hair grew super long. Then Bleep jumped on the ship and they flew away. I waved goodbye and went inside to eat lunch.

My big brother Tim loves science and coaching soccer. For his birthday, we went boating at the lake. It was a beautiful scene with blue water. Suddenly my hat flew off and landed in the water! I tried to grab it but I almost fell in.

"Watch out for danger!" Tim yelled and he pulled me back.

My hat floated away but Tim jumped in the water. He swam fast and got it back. It was wet but I was happy. Later we ate cake and Tim opened his gifts. He got a science kit and a fake jewel.

"This is the best birthday ever," Tim said.

He won a game of cards later and stole all my chips. We stayed up longer than usual. My brother grew up today but he is still fun.

Yesterday, I played my favorite video game with my brother. It was a game about climbing a huge mountain. We picked our players while the game was loading.

"I bet I can beat you to the top," I said.

My brother laughed and said, "No way, I know all the secrets."

We started the race and ran up the steep hill. Unfortunately, a scary ghost popped out and scared my guy. My player fainted and fell all the way down. I crawled back up slowly, but my brother was too fast. He brewed a magic potion and threw fireballs at the bad guys. He roasted the final boss and won the game.

"Good game," I told him, even though I was sad. Next time, I am going to win for sure.

I ate my breakfast fast because I wanted to go outside. My dog Rex was waiting by the door and he looked excited. We chose to walk in the big woods behind my house. The path was muddy and I almost fell two times.

"Be careful, Rex!" I yelled when he pulled hard on the leash.

Rex is not very well trained yet. He saw a squirrel and struggled to run after it. I held on tight but he is very strong. Gradually, he stopped pulling and we kept walking. Then it started to rain really hard.

"Oh man, I hate getting wet," I grumbled to Rex.

To be honest, I was scared of the thunder. We started leaving the woods very fast. We ran all the way home and got warm towels. Next time we will check the weather first.

My friends and I found a weird old building. It looked scary and dangerous but we went inside. The ceiling was super high and dark. Suddenly, I saw a shiny silver knight standing there. He looked like a statue but he was a guard.

"Don't move or you will be in trouble!" he yelled.

We ran fast and I pulled on a secret lever. The floor opened up and we fell down. We landed on a big pile of soft pillows. I heard my friend Sam groaning because he bumped his arm. Gradually, a light turned on and we saw a treasure chest.

"I think this is the meaning of the map!" Sam shouted.

We opened it and found lots of gold coins inside. It was the best adventure ever.

I walked into the woods behind my house today. My dog Buster came with me and he was happy. We pretended a big rock was a mountain. Buster ran up it and started barking loud.

"Come down, Buster!" I yelled at him.

He jumped down and started bumping into my legs. We kept walking until we saw a big puddle. It looked like a tiny island surrounding by muddy water. I threw a stick into the middle of the water. Buster splashed in to get it. He knew exactly what to do. Then we sat on a log and I played my toy guitar. It was a really fun day outside.

My brother and I were playing the greatest video game ever. We had to make our cars jump off a big bungee cord. It was so hard to complete the level. I threw my controller on the couch because I kept crashing.

"You are dumping all your points!" my brother grumbled at me.

"I knew I could do it!" I yelled back.

Suddenly, a golden feather appeared on the screen for extra speed. It was a pleasant surprise. I drove fast and my car crashed right into the finish line. I won the race and we had a loud meeting about who was best. It was fun but my thumbs hurt now.

My friend Tom and I went to the dark forest. We wanted to find the lost cave. A map led us to a big rock.

"Look at that hole!" Tom shouted loudly.

We pushed the bushes away and scrambled inside. It was very cold and wet in there. Suddenly, eight big bats flew right at us! We fought them off with our sticks. Then we saw something shiny on the ground. It was a bright red jewel.

"Grab it and run!" I yelled at Tom.

We ran fast and escaped the scary cave. The shadows grew long as we followed the path home. We were safe, and we had the treasure.

Recess was finally here and we all ran outside. It was a hot day and the sun scorched the playground. My friend Tom screamed because the slide was too hot.

"Don't touch it or you will get roasted!" I yelled.

We decided to play kickball instead in the big field. I was in a league with my best friends. Tom kicked the ball to an incredible height. I had to squeeze my eyes shut to see it.

"Run fast!" everyone started cheering.

Tom ran around the bases but he slipped near home. It looked like a dangerous scene but he was okay. He discovered a cool rock while he was on the ground. Then the bell rang and school was closed for the day. We remembered we had homework but we didn't care.

Me and Sam went boating on the scary dark lake. We thought we saw a white ghost near the old dock. I had a bad feeling in my tummy. Suddenly, the boat hit a big rock with a loud crash.

"Oh no! We are going to sink!" screamed Sam loudly.

The boat was groaning and water came in fast. I used all my strength to push us away. We paddled super fast and escaped the scary water. We got to the shore and everyone was cheering for us.

"I don't understand how we made it," I said.

My mom was waiting with a warm towel to wrap me up. I felt like a failure before but now I was happy. We were not crushed by the rocks.

I was walking to the big brick building today. It was a cold day with a chilly breeze. My mom said to button up my coat. She said, "You don't want to get pneumonia!"

I got to class and everyone was sitting down. We had a test on math and I was scared. I didn't want to be a failure. I crossed my fingers for good luck. The test had thirteen hard questions. I tried to maintain my focus on the paper.

At recess, my friend Sam brought his new guitar. He played a loud song and we all danced. Sam yelled, "Look at me play this cool song!" It was the best day ever. I got a good grade too.

My teacher gave us homework about a big mountain. I hate homework but I wanted to finish immediately. I went home and my nephew was screaming. He is only a baby though. I tried to focus but the sun scorched me. It was so hot in my room.

"Be quiet please!" I yelled at the baby.

My mom came in and she looked mad. "You are in big trouble," she said.

I grew sad and I carefully put my pencil down. It felt like I was speaking a foreign language. I was certain I would never finish my work. I decided to wrap my head in a pillow. Then I fell asleep.

It was my birthday last Saturday and it was raining. I was sad because I wanted to play outside. Suddenly my mom cleared the table and brought out a big box. She said, "I guarantee you will like this adventure!"

My best friend Sam appeared at the door with his sleeping bag. We opened the box and it was a giant fort kit! We built a castle in the living room and pretended we were growing magical beans.

"Look out for the dragon!" yelled Sam.

"I caught him!" I shouted back.

We ate pizza inside the fort and told scary stories. I am grateful for my family and Sam. It was the best birthday ever even with the rain.

Me and my friend Sam went to the dark forest. It was scary but we felt like the greatest explorers. A cold breeze hit my face and I shivered. We walked until we saw a big, angry bear.

"Run away fast!" yelled Sam.

"I can't move my legs!" I screamed back.

The bear made a loud thumping sound on the ground. My heart was jumping out of my chest with fear. Suddenly, Sam threw a rock and hit a beehive. The bees chased the bear and we ran home. We felt like champion runners. My mom greeted us with cookies. Next time I will go bungee jumping instead. It is safer than bears.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were on an important search for the lost gold vein. It was supposed to be hidden in a weird cave. We counted ten steps from the big oak tree and turned left.

Suddenly, we saw a dark cave that looked closed. "That looks impossible to open," Sam whispered. I touched the heavy rocks and threw one aside. We cleared the path and walked inside. It was spooky. A bear was roaming around near the back!

"Run!" I yelled. We ran out fast. Later, we roasted marshmallows at home. We didn't find gold, but it was still fun.

I walked into school and Mrs. Miller greeted us. We started math class right away and it was impossible. I hate fractions but I tried to be honest about it. Then the recess bell rang and everyone scrambled outside. We were jumping rope when my friend Tim crashed into me.

"Are you okay?" Tim asked while rubbing his knee.

"I think so, but you hit me hard!" I said.

Then we saw something weird near the swings. It looked like a ghost but it was just a bag. Tim trained his eyes on it and laughed loudly. Gravity pulled us down when we sat on the grass. Then the bell rang again and we ran inside. I forgot my scissors on the playground so I was sad. School is fun but sometimes weird things happened.

I was playing soccer with my neighbor Sam in the park. We bought a new ball and were kicking it hard. Suddenly, a tiny gnat flew right into my eye! I screamed loud and lost the ball to Sam. He ran fast toward the goal to score. I rubbed my eye and tried to seize the ball back.

"Hey, wait up!" I yelled, but he kept running.

Then the referee blew his whistle really loud. It was time for a break so we stopped. I drank from the water fountain instead of playing more. The pain in my eye gradually went away. I was grateful because soccer is my favorite game. We started playing again and I was happy.

Last weekend my family went on a big adventure. We drove to a new place that looked very foreign to me. My dad was steering the car and my mom was coaching him on where to go.

"Watch out for that big rock!" my mom shouted.

The tires screeched loudly and I got a little scared. I bit my thumb but I did not complain. My brother was groaning because he was hungry. He wanted to eat everything in the snack bag.

"Please remain in your seat," Dad told him.

We finally stopped at a cool park though. It was fun.

"This is the best trip ever!" I said.

We played until it got dark and then drove home sleepy.

My dog Buster and I went camping in the backyard. We pitched a big green tent on the grass. The scenery was nice with all the tall trees. Buster started tearing at the tent zipper with his teeth.

"Stop that, Buster!" I yelled at him.

He just wagged his tail and ran straight inside. I crawled in after him and it felt like heaven. We had a flashlight and a single bag of chips. Suddenly we heard a loud ringing sound outside. I looked out and discovered my mom bearing a tray.

"I brought you some hot cocoa," she said smiling.

We drank it fast and then fell asleep dreaming. It simply was the best night ever, even without a receipt.

It was my birthday party and I was so excited. All my friends bounced on my new trampoline. My best friend Sam grinned at me and yelled, "You are the champion of jumping!"

We ate pizza on the grass surrounding the porch. Then my mom brought out the cake but the candles disappeared! We looked everywhere for a longer time. Suddenly, we heard a ringing sound coming from the kitchen island.

"I found them!" my dad shouted from inside.

He was holding the box of candles and laughing. I was grateful because now I could make a wish. We ate the cake and talked about our science project for school. It was the most important day ever. No one was swearing or fighting, just having fun.

It was Wednesday and it was my best friend Sam's birthday. I went straight to his house after school. I was bringing him a cool sailor hat as a gift. When I walked in, everyone was singing happy birthday.

"Open my present first!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam ripped the paper and put the hat on his head. It looked beautiful on him. Then we ate cake and simply played games. Sam’s dog came in and started dumping toys everywhere. We laughed so hard my brain hurt.

"What happened to the cake?" Sam asked suddenly.

We discovered the dog ate the last piece! My dad was reading a newspaper in the corner and missed it. Then Sam blew out the candles again for fun. It was the best day ever.

The robot stood at a great height above me. It was made of shiny metal and blinking lights. I cleared my throat and looked at its red eyes.

"Are you the champion of Mars?" asked the robot. It sounded like a loud groaning machine.

"Yes, I am here to receive the prize!" I yelled.

The robot grinned with its metal mouth and stepped back. A golden platform rose up from the ground quickly. On it was a glowing blue rock bearing a strange mark. This rock was very important for my spaceship. I grabbed the rock and ran back to my ship. My mom will be so happy I found it.

My backpack had a huge weight in it today. I had the greatest science project ever, but it was heavy. I carefully walked to the bus stop with my neighbor, Sam. We talked about Minecraft and he showed me a cool rock.

At school, I put my project on the big table. Suddenly, Sam's elbow hit my volcano and it crashed down! I had a bad feeling in my stomach. 

"Oh no! I am so sorry!" Sam yelled.

Our teacher came over and helped us fix the tape. It looked okay. Later, we made the volcano explode with baking soda. Everyone started cheering loudly.

"I still have so much homework for tomorrow," I grumbled. But at least my volcano worked. I felt like I had trained for this day forever.

My brother Tom and I walked through the dark forest. We were bearing big backpacks and looking for hidden gold. Suddenly we saw a scary bridge hanging over a river. It looked like big danger because the ropes were old.

"I can guarantee it is safe," said Tom bravely.

I was trembling but I walked carefully behind him. We crossed the bridge slowly and did not look down. On the other side was a beautiful cave with a chest. Tom used his pocket knife to open the lock. Inside was a note and it said to write our names. We were so happy we found the secret treasure spot.

It was my birthday in February and I turned nine. My friends Sam and Alex came over for a sleepover. We ate pizza and then we played a game. We pretended we were on a big mountain.

"I am a sailor on a boat!" yelled Sam.

"No, we are hiking on the rocks!" I said back.

It was freezing outside but we were warm inside. We made a fort with blankets and pillows. I was the guard and they had to pay to enter. Sam paid me with a cookie. Alex rode on my dad’s back like a horse. It was fourteen minutes past my bedtime. My mom said to go to sleep. We talked for a long time in the dark. It was the best birthday ever.

I went to school today and it was weird. First, my teacher Mrs. Jones greeted us with a big smile. She usually looks tired but today she had lots of energy. I think she drank too much caffeine this morning. We did math and it was super hard.

"I hate fractions," my friend Billy grumbled.

"Me too," I whispered back.

Then Billy said a bad word. He was swearing! Mrs. Jones heard him and got mad. She sent him to the principal's office right away. He disappeared through the door and looked scared. At lunch, I bought a pizza slice. It tasted wonderful. Later, Billy came back and looked different. He did not receive a sticker today. It was a crazy day.

My younger brother and I went exploring in the woods. We saw a fat squirrel roaming near the big oak tree. He was eating a crumb of bread on the ground. I pointed my finger at him and we got closer.

"Look at his tail!" said my brother loudly.

The squirrel dropped the food and ran up the tree. It seemed impossible to catch him because of his weight. We met our neighbor Mr. Smith walking his dog Colonel.

"Did you see the squirrel?" Mr. Smith asked us.

"Neither of us saw where he went," I said.

We went home and ate toasted cheese sandwiches. I like the design on my plate with the blue stars. Exploring is fun but eating lunch is way better.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house. My dog Rex ran ahead and he was thrilled. We found a big hollow log near the creek. Rex crawled inside and started bumping into the sides. Then I heard a weird groaning sound from inside.

"Rex, come out of there right now!" I yelled.

He didn't come out and kept making moaning noises. I grabbed his tail and pulled him backward hard. It felt impossible but he finally popped out. He had a grumpy turtle in his mouth!

"Put that down, you silly dog," I told him.

Rex dropped the turtle and it walked away slowly. We pretended we were boating on the creek after that. It was the best day ever.

It was a cold day in February and snow covered everything. Sir Tom was a brave knight and he walked very carefully. He needed to find the King’s lost golden cup. He crossed a big bridge and saw a huge cave. A giant grey elephant was standing there to guard it!

The elephant looked mad and full of anger. It was eating a giant bone and it liked to gnaw on it. Sir Tom was trembling because he was scared.

"Move out of the way!" yelled Sir Tom loudly.

The elephant chewed its bone and didn't move. Sir Tom threw some stewed carrots on the ground. The elephant ran to eat them fast. Sir Tom grabbed the cup and ran home. He was a hero.

Last week was the big soccer game against the blue team. I was waiting all week for Saturday to come. My team practiced really hard every single day after school. We did lots of training and running around the field.

When the game started, the other team was super fast. They scored a goal and my heart felt crushed.

"Don't give up yet!" my coach yelled loudly.

I ran fast and kicked the ball to my friend Sam. Sam kicked it hard and it went right in! We started jumping up and down because we were so happy. Then I searched for the ball again. I realized I could score too. I crawled under a big player's legs and stole the ball. I kicked it and we won the important game!

"You are the best player!" Sam said to me.

We had to draw a picture for art class today. I chose to make a map of a treasure island. I drew a big X near the sandy beach.

"That looks awesome," my friend Jake told me.

"Thanks, I knew you would like it," I said back.

We pretended we were boating to the island. Jake said he trained a monkey to keep us company. Suddenly the bell rang for recess and we sprinted outside. My heart was thumping hard because I ran so fast.

We played tag with eight other kids throughout the break. A tiny gnat flew in my eye and it hurt. When I got home later, I smelled roasted chicken.

"Get started on your homework," Mom said.

I hope I don't get a grounding for forgetting my math.

One day me and my dad went camping in the woods. It was freezing outside and the wind blew hard. We were stamping our feet to stay warm. My dad said we should be quiet.

"I hear something different in the bushes," I whispered.

"Maybe it is a bear getting into trouble," Dad said.

We looked but it was just a small raccoon. It looked hungry so we threw it a cracker. The dark grew fast and we went into the tent. I thought about my warm bed in our apartment. I missed seeing my TV but camping was fun. My dad was a good guide for the trip. Next time I hope it is not so cold!

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother Sam. I was holding the controller and my heart was pumping fast. I picked Yoshi because he is green like a beetle. We were on the last lap and I was thrilled.

"I am going to win!" I yelled at Sam.

Sam laughed and said, "Not today because I have a red shell."

I was steering my kart carefully around the big corner. Suddenly Sam hit me and I went off the road. I was trembling because I was so mad at him. My kart was jumping over bumps but I got back on. I was screaming at the TV screen. I passed him right at the finish line! I felt like a king starting his reign. I was tearing up because I was so happy.

"You got lucky with that mushroom," Sam grumbled.

I ate a crumb of my cookie and smiled. I checked the schedule on the wall. We had time for one more race.

My robot named Zork had a big imagination. He thought he was a superhero, even though he was just metal. One day we walked into the dark woods behind my house. Zork saw a single squirrel and started screaming very loud.

"Danger! It is a space alien!" Zork yelled.

I pushed him gently and scratched his metal head. "It is not a danger, Zork," I said.

Suddenly the squirrel’s eyes glowed green like a weird vein. The squirrel began its reign of terror right then. It shot a laser beam but it hit the grounding wire. We met a real alien that day. We ran home fast and I never paid attention to squirrels again. It was only the beginning of our trouble.

I was steering my spaceship to Mars when I saw something. It was a giant green alien sleeping on a moon rock. The alien had purple hair growing out of its ears! I wanted to zoom past him immediately. But my robot beeped very loud and woke him up. The alien opened three eyes and looked at my ship.

"Did you bring me any caffeine?" the alien roared loudly.

I was scared but I shook my head no.

"I don't have any soda or coffee either!" I yelled back.

The alien sighed and said he was just very tired. He was actually the greatest alien ever and let me go. I will remember to bring him a cola next time.

I gripped my knife and walked into the dark jungle. My friend Sam was behind me and he looked scared. We were looking for the lost golden elephant statue. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning noise near the bushes.

"What was that scary sound?" Sam whispered to me.

I froze and looked at a big green leaf. A huge black beetle with a red design was on it. It looked mean but it was also kind of beautiful. Then I saw something shiny behind the beetle. It was the golden elephant!

"We found the treasure!" I sang loudly.

We grabbed the statue and ran back to our boat. I was steering the boat fast and we escaped the jungle.

I was reading the game schedule and it was finally time. My team the Tigers had to play the Bears. I felt super strong because I ate eggs for breakfast.

"Pass the ball to me!" shouted my friend Tim.

I grasped the football tightly and ran down the field. I was tearing through the grass and clinging to the ball. A big kid came bearing down on me like a truck. I jumped up high and felt light as a feather. I crashed to the ground but I didn't let go.

"Touchdown!" the referee yelled really loud.

Neither team could stop us any longer. We won by eight points. The other team was sad but we escaped with the trophy. I used all my strength to lift it up high.

I went outside to play on the big mountain. My dog Max was running fast and barking at bugs. I saw a big bee hanging near a flower. It looked like it had a sharp needle.

"Watch out Max!" I yelled very loud. "That is a stinging bee!"

Max ran away and found a stick instead. We pretended we were boating on the green grass. I used the stick like a guitar and sang a song. I was feeling very brave like a strong knight. Suddenly Max started moaning because he was tired. We sat down and I counted his spots. There were ten spots on his back. Then we went inside for lunch.

My brother Timmy built a robot out of old boxes. It grew big and its eyes were bright red. I was trembling because it looked scary. Timmy had a remote and he pushed a button. The robot started swinging its arms like scissors. It knocked over a lamp and scorched the rug!

"Stop it right now!" I yelled at Timmy.

"I can't stop it!" he screamed back.

The robot spread its arms and looked for treasure. It found a cookie crumb on the floor. It ate the crumb and stopped moving. Neither of us knew why it stopped. I think it was just hungry. We are never building robots again.

I was sitting in math class and feeling very hungry. My stomach made a loud noise straight through the quiet room. Mrs. Lee was teaching us how to measure lines on paper. I tried to listen, but I was dreaming about lunch. I thought about pizza and chocolate milk.

"Please focus on your work," Mrs. Lee said nicely.

I looked down at the ground and nodded my head. My younger brother loves school, but I think it is boring.

"I wish we were boating on the lake," I grumbled.

Finally, the bell rang loudly throughout the whole big school. We ran outside for recess and played kickball. My friend Sam was coaching me on how to kick better. It was the best part of the day.

Me and my brother Tom went camping in the backyard. We were pretending to be brave knights on a quest. Tom grabbed his toy sword and bounced around.

"We need to find the dragon’s treasure!" Tom yelled loudly.

We started following a map through the dark grass. Suddenly we heard a weird noise sounding like groaning. It was bumping against the fence near our apartment.

"What is that spooky thing?" I asked Tom.

He opened the gate and we saw a dog. It had a comb stuck in its messy fur. It looked foreign and lost but it was nice. We took the comb out and the dog licked my hand. Our reign as knights was over but we saved the dog.

My friends came over for a sleepover last night. We bounced on my bed and yelled really loud. Mom came in and told us to be quiet. She said, "If you are loud, you can't have s'mores."

We got quiet but then my tummy rumbled. We went outside to the fire pit. Dad was putting wood inside. I held my marshmallow over the fire. It got scorched and turned black. I like them burnt so I ate it fast. My friend scratched his leg because of a bug.

Later we woke up super early. Mom was loading the car for soccer. She made us bread and it was perfectly toasted. I saw a sign on the fridge that said happy birthday. I forgot it was my birthday throughout the whole night! It was the best sleepover ever.

One day I went exploring in the woods behind my house. My dog Buster was leading the way because he is super fast. We looked under a big log and saw a frog jumping around.

"Hey Buster, catch him!" I called out loud.

Buster barked and tried to squeeze under the fence. He got stuck for a second but he wiggled free. Then we found a huge pile of pine needles on the ground. It was soft like a pillow.

"This feels like heaven," I said to Buster.

We played in the woods until the sun went down. Buster is the best dog ever and he is a champion explorer. We were tired but we had so much fun.

Yesterday, my friend Sam came over to play. We were feeling bored so we went outside.

"Let's go look for the secret treasure," Sam said.

We ran to the old park behind my house. There is a big stone fountain there but it is dry. Sam saw something shiny on the ground near the fountain. He grabbed it fast. It was a silver key!

Suddenly, a big dog came jumping out of the bushes.

"Run!" I yelled.

We ran back to my house and locked the door. Unfortunately, we dropped the key in the grass. We were caught by my mom but she was not mad. She was just pleased we were safe.

"You look like you were running from a monster," she laughed.

Sam and I went to play on my computer instead. Maybe the key belonged to the king's daughter. We will remain inside for now. The reason is that dog was scary!

Me and my best friend Sam were playing pirates. I was the captain and Sam was my first mate. We found a map scattered on the floor. It showed where treasure was buried in the backyard.

"Let's go find it together!" yelled Sam.

We ran outside and saw a big X on the grass. Suddenly, a bird flew down and stole the map! It disappeared into the big oak tree.

"Oh no!" I said. "We need that map."

Then I remembered I had a whistle in my pocket. I blew it really loud. The bird got scared and dropped the map. It sank into the bushes. We used scissors to cut the branches. We dug a hole deep enough and found a box. Inside was just old rocks, but we understood they were magic pirate gold. We brewed some mud soup to celebrate.

I walked into Mrs. Miller’s class and the weather was rainy. I greeted my friend Sam and we sat down. Mrs. Miller cleared her throat and started talking about math. She drew a big square on the board.

“Open your books to page ten,” she said loudly.

I opened my book but my hands were trembling. I forgot my homework at home on the table! I crawled under my desk a little bit to hide. Sam looked at me and whispered.

“Did you lose your pencil again?” he asked.

“No, I left my homework!” I grumbled quietly.

I tried to keep my breathing steady so I wouldn't cry. Mrs. Miller walked by but she didn’t see me hiding. At recess, the sun came out like a bright jewel. My dad is coaching my soccer team later so I felt better. I will just bring my homework tomorrow.

We were loading the boat with snacks and juice. My brother Sam wore his old leather boots. We pushed the boat into the dark river. Suddenly, the water turned bright green!

"Look at that big bubble!" Sam shouted loudly.

A giant blue creature came out of the water. It looked slippery and friendly. It had invisible wings that moved the air. We were scared but it smiled at us.

"Do you have any roasted peanuts?" the creature asked.

We gave him our bag of peanuts. He ate them all in one bite. He waved goodbye and swam away fast. It was a wonderful day on the river. We rowed home before it got dark.

It was February and really cold outside. My friend Sam came over to play video games. We opened a new fighting game and picked our guys. I wanted to reign as the champion today. Sam’s guy had a huge knife but my guy had magic.

"You are going down!" Sam yelled at the TV.

I just smiled and pushed the buttons really fast. My character jumped straight up and landed on Sam’s head. Then I grew giant and twisted my controller to dodge. I went through the fire level and didn't get hurt. Sam got mad because he lost three times.

"My big brother taught me that move," I said.

Sam wanted to play again but we ate pizza instead. Being the winner is the best feeling ever.

The cave was dark and scary but we went in. I gripped my flashlight tight and looked at the ground. There were eight big spiders crawling on the walls.

"Watch out for the bugs!" shouted my friend Sam.

We walked deeper and heard heavy breathing in the shadows. A green fog brewed near a shiny rock. It was the magic jewel that ended the dragon's reign! I had a feeling something bad would happen. Suddenly a monster jumped out and treated us like a snack.

I grabbed the jewel fast and we ran away. Sam started to sneeze because of the dust. We were safe and happy to be home.

Max and I were in the backyard jungle. We wanted to go on a quest. I saw a huge tree hanging over the fence. It looked dangerous but exciting.

"Let’s climb that!" I shouted to Max.

We started building a ladder out of old wood. It was hard to maintain our balance. Suddenly, a big black dog appeared. He looked like big trouble. We grew scared and climbed faster.

"Watch out for the bungee cord!" Max yelled loudly.

I grabbed the cord and swung away. It felt like flying. We had a yearning for adventure and we found it. We were certain we were brave explorers. That night, my mom brewed hot cocoa for us. We had a secret meeting in our fort. It was the best day ever.

Today was the weirdest day at school ever. At lunchtime, I opened my lunchbox and saw my sandwich. It was toasted cheese but it looked very green and stewed.

"Ew, what is that smell?" asked my friend Max.

"I think my mom made a mistake," I said.

Suddenly, a big bird flew down and grabbed the sandwich! It flew up high and fought with another bird for it. We all looked up and screamed because it was so loud. Then the sandwich fell down because of gravity. It landed right on the teacher's head. She grew very red and didn't look happy.

Then Max grinned and said, "Do it again!"

Later, I tried to explain to the teacher what happened. I was holding my scissors for art class. She just told me to sit down. Next time I hope I just get pizza.

My hamster Nibbles is very naughty. He escaped from his cage last night. I looked everywhere for him for thirteen minutes. Then I heard a weird noise under my bed. I grasped my flashlight and looked down there. Nibbles was steering a little toy car! He had chewed the tire, but he looked happy. I held him tight so he wouldn't run away again.

"You are a bad boy, Nibbles!" I grumbled at him.

He just twisted his nose at me. He weighed a lot because he ate too many seeds. I put him back and he slept all day. Later I drew a picture of him in the car.

"Maybe he can be trained to race," my brother said.

But then my mom started screaming because Nibbles was loose again!

Me and my best friend Leo formed a super hero league. We found a scary cave near the woods and went inside. It was dark and there were spider webs hanging everywhere. I grabbed a stick and touched a big web. Suddenly, a ghost started floating right in front of us!

"Run immediately!" shouted Leo.

"It’s impossible!" I yelled back. "My foot is stuck!"

A single thread was wrapped around my shoe. I thought I was going to get pneumonia from the cold air. Leo pulled my arm and the thread broke. We left the cave fast. The sign outside read "Closed for Loading," but we missed it. We were safe, but we never went back there again.

My best friend Sam was having a sleepover for his birthday. We were in the backyard and Sam’s dad was teaching us how to set up a tent. But the wind was blowing super hard!

"Hold onto the poles!" Sam yelled at me.

I grabbed the metal pole but it felt like gravity was pulling it away. The tent flap was hanging loose and flapping in my face. Suddenly the whole tent turned sideways and fell down flat. Sam looked really mad but then he started laughing. His anger went away fast.

"I believed we could do it," I said sadly.

Sam’s dad was pleased we tried our best. He helped us fix it and soon we were seeing stars through the mesh. We ate pizza inside and told scary stories until we fell asleep. It was the best meeting of the Super Secret Camping Club ever.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so excited. My friend Sam came over and greeted me at the door. He was bringing a big blue present for me.

"Happy birthday!" he screamed really loud in my ear.

We were eating pizza and then we heard a noise. My hamster Fluffy had escaped from his cage! He ran on the ground and tried to gnaw on the rug. I tried to catch him but he was too fast.

"Watch out, he is dumping his food!" Sam yelled.

Fluffy ran into the bathroom and hid behind the toilet. I had to use a comb to get him out. Then my mom came in speaking softly. She was reading a book but heard the noise. We put Fluffy back and ate cake. It was the beginning of the best night ever.

I was in big trouble at recess today. I found a shiny blue rock near the slide. It looked like a magic jewel. I gripped it tight in my hand. Then Tommy walked over and tried to take it. He treated me bad sometimes.

"Give it to me!" Tommy yelled loud.

"No way, I found it first," I said back.

He reached for it so I simply threw it far away. It landed in the sandbox surrounding the swings. Tommy got mad and started stamping his feet. Then the teacher saw us and walked over fast. We both got sent to the principal's office for fighting. The principal looked at us and grinned a little bit. He said tomorrow we have to be friends for a different reason. I hope school is better then.

We went camping in the dark spooky woods last week. My brother Tim was loading the tent, and I was dumping out the sleeping bags. Suddenly we heard a weird noise. It sounded like a monster groaning near the big tree.

"What is that sound?" I whispered to Tim.

He pointed a shaking finger straight at the bushes. Something was clinging to a branch. It wasn't a monster, but it was huge! It was a giant black beetle with shiny legs.

"I am screaming if it moves!" said Tim.

I had my scissors in my pocket for cutting rope. I tried to squeeze past the beetle, although I was scared. It flew away fast. We were just dreaming of monsters, but the bug was real!

My alarm clock rang and I immediately jumped out of bed. Today was Tuesday, and Tuesday means we have gym class on the schedule! I ate my toast fast and we drove to school. Mom was steering the car through lots of traffic.

At recess, my friend Sam bounced a red ball on the ground.

"Do you want to play a game?" Sam asked me.

"Yes! Let's pretend we are bungee jumping," I grinned.

We used our imagination and jumped off the low wall. We scrambled around the playground like crazy monkeys. It was so much fun. Then the bell rang for lunch. I was sad because I was dreaming about pizza. But I opened my box and saw a ham sandwich instead. I still ate it all because I was super hungry. It was a good day.

One day my dog Buster escaped from our yard. He chewed a big hole in the fence. I saw him running and I yelled, "Buster come back!"

He did not listen and he crossed the street. My neighbor Mrs. Miller was outside loading her car. Buster ran up to her and started barking. Then he saw a butterfly floating on the breeze. He jumped up and tried to catch it. He looked funny jumping off the ground.

Suddenly a big crow flew down. It was screaming at Buster very loud. Buster got scared and ran back to me.

"You are a silly dog," I said.

He spread his paws on the grass. Mom says he needs more protein for growing big. We went inside and I gave him a treat.

I was playing the greatest game of soccer ever. The grass was wet and my shoes were muddy. I sprinted across the field and grasped the ball with my feet.

"Pass it here!" yelled my friend Sam.

"No way, I got this!" I shouted back.

I ran through the defense with a perfect rhythm. I felt like I was painting a picture on the field. Although the goalie was huge, I kicked it hard. The whistle blew loud. It meant I scored the winning goal!

My dad was reading a newspaper on the sidelines. He looked up and smiled. We didn't do any swearing, but we cheered really loud. Later we found ice cream to celebrate. It was the best day.

I woke up early because I was excited for school. My mom made me pancakes but I ate them too fast. I ran straight to the bus stop with my backpack. At school, we learned about a knight in history class. He had a lot of strength and he could seize castles. Then it was lunchtime and I sat with my best friend.

"Did you bring the computer game?" I asked him.

"No, I already told you I lost it," he said.

I was sad so I crushed my juice box flat. A crumb fell on my shirt but I brushed it off. After lunch, we learned a foreign language called Spanish. It was hard to understand the meaning of some words. The day neared the end and I was so tired. I cannot wait to go camping this weekend with my dad.

Me and my friend Sam went exploring in the woods. We saw a big, old building that was falling down. It looked scary but we wanted to see inside. We crawled under a broken fence and found a dark hole.

"Watch out for that spider!" yelled Sam loudly.

I jumped back and almost tripped on a rock. We saw something shiny near a big blue vein in the wall. I grabbed it and it felt cold. Unfortunately, a huge pile of rocks crushed the exit. We were trapped! But Sam found a small tunnel that led outside. We ran home fast.

"We won the treasure hunt," I said happily.

I stuck out my tongue because I was tired. It was enough adventure for one day. We didn't receive a prize, but we were safe.

For my birthday sleepover, my friends came over to play. We pretended my living room was a big scary jungle. My dad made a huge mountain of pillows on the floor. I sprinted to the top and touched the ceiling.

"Watch out for the sleeping tigers!" yelled my friend Sam.

I jumped down but I accidentally dropped my cake on the floor. It got crushed into a million pieces. My mom came in for a meeting about the mess.

"Where did the cake go?" she asked us.

It disappeared fast because my dog ate it off the floor. He licked every crumb off his finger, well, his paw. We just laughed and ate ice cream instead. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the big meadow. We wanted to find a secret treasure for our club. We moved slow through the tall grass. Suddenly we heard a weird noise.

"It sounds like a monster is going to gnaw on us!" Sam yelled.

I was scared but I tried to be brave. It was just a bunny. We kept walking and found a cool rock. It looked like a shiny diamond from heaven.

"We can use this for our science project," I said. "We might be earning an A plus!"

Then we got caught in a rain storm. We ran home fast. To be honest, it was the best adventure ever.

I was at my friend Sam’s sleepover for his birthday. We were playing hide and seek in his big basement. It was dark and I hid behind some old boxes. Suddenly my foot got stuck in a sleeping bag. I felt trapped and my heart started beating really fast.

"Sam! Help me!" I yelled loud.

Sam came running over and he was already laughing. "You look like a swinging burrito," he said.

He helped me but I struggled to get out. It was tearing my sock a little bit. It felt dangerous but Sam pulled really hard. Finally I was free and not stuck any longer. It was important to learn not to hide in messy piles. Then we ate cake and played video games all night.

My brother and I went to a sleepover at Liam’s house. His backyard is like a huge green jungle with big trees. We played tag and I was earning points for hiding well. Suddenly a tiny gnat flew right into my nose! I yelled and started running around the yard like crazy.

"Are you okay?" Liam asked me while I was sneezing.
