I said, "No, there is a bug in my face!"

I was clinging to a tree because I felt dizzy. My brother laughed so hard that he almost fainted on the grass. We had to learn to be careful outside. Later we pretended the backyard was a desert island. It was hard to maintain our fort because it got dark. We went inside and ate pizza instead.

My big sister Sarah had a birthday party yesterday. It was crazy because everything went wrong at first. We neared the park and saw a big sign. It said "Happy Birthday Sarah" but the wind blew it down.

Mom looked trapped in the car with all the balloons. She used all her strength to get the cake out. Then my dad started playing his guitar really loud. He thinks he is a rock star.

"Dad, stop it! You are embarrassing me!" Sarah yelled.

My little brother scrambled up the fountain and got wet. He was screaming because the water was cold. Mom had to comb his hair again. Dad was swearing a little bit under his breath. He drank too much caffeine and was shaking. But then Sarah opened her gifts and she was happy. She is their favorite daughter so she got a bike. The weight of the bike was heavy. We played tag throughout the whole park until dark.

My best friend Leo came over for a sleepover. We were so thrilled to play video games all night. But my mom said we had to help first. We started cleaning my room and it was boring. I twisted my ankle on a toy car.

"Ouch, that really hurts!" I screamed loudly.

Leo looked at my foot and acted like a doctor. He said, "Listen to me, you need ice."

He thinks he knows everything about science now. Suddenly, we heard the doorbell ringing downstairs. It was the pizza guy with a weird foreign accent. We ate the pizza and I stopped breathing for a second because I laughed too hard. It was the best night ever.

I was walking home from school and I saw something weird. A green alien appeared right in the middle of the sidewalk! He was holding a shiny newspaper and he looked lost. He made a loud groaning sound like his tummy hurt.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

The alien looked at me and grasped my hand. "I need a crumb of space cheese," he said in a funny voice.

I didn't have space cheese. I only had my lunchbox. I threw him my sandwich to be honest. He ate it all in one bite! Then his spaceship came down. He waved goodbye and walked onto his ship. My mom is never going to believe this happened.

My neighbor Alex came over to play after school yesterday. We wanted to build a huge fort in the living room. We took all the cushions and made a mountain.

"This is going to be the best fort ever!" I screamed.

Alex crawled through the tunnel and shook the blankets. Suddenly, the whole thing fell down on top of us. We kept building it up again until it was perfect. My mom came in and said she was keeping score of our mess.

"You have fourteen minutes to clean this up," she said.

I think she just needed her caffeine or something. We lit a flashlight inside and closed the flap tight. It was so cozy inside our secret fort. We stayed in there until dinner was ready.

I woke up early because today was the big race. My friend Sam came over to keep me company. We turned on the video game and I picked the knight. He was driving a fast car with gold wheels.

"I am going to win this time," I called out.

Sam laughed and picked a robot car. The race started and I was steering really well. The wind was like a breeze on the screen. Suddenly my car broke down on the track. Sam zoomed past me and disappeared around the corner. I was not earning any points. But I was honest and did not cheat. I reached the finish line last but it was fun enough.

"Good game," Sam said.

We ate snacks and played again until it was complete dark.

One day I was walking in the woods. I saw a weird green light hanging from a tree. It looked sticky and bright. Suddenly a little alien creature jumped down! He had three eyes and blue skin.

"I am so hungry!" the alien shouted loudly.

I gave him my apple from my lunchbox. He ate the whole thing in one big bite.

"What is the meaning of this food?" he asked me.

"It's just an apple," I tried to explain to him.

He used a long tentacle to wrap around my arm. He was nice though. We walked down the trail together. He said he was a king and his reign was over. Then his spaceship came down and picked him up. He waved goodbye and flew away fast.

I met my friend Ben at the bus stop today. He looked scared because he did not do his math homework. He said, "My dog slept on my worksheet last night!" I told him that was silly.

In class, the teacher asked for our papers. Ben gripped his desk and his face turned red. He stuck out his tongue a little bit when he was nervous. I remembered that I had an extra pencil. I grabbed it and pushed it onto his desk to help.

At recess, we played tag near the swings. Ben was the guide for our team. The scenery was nice because the sun was out. Then the bell rang loudly. Ben yelled, "Race you to the door!" We ran fast and forgot all about the homework.

My birthday party was at the lake this year. My dad rented a big blue boat for boating. I felt like the captain when I steered it. Then my friend Leo appeared with a huge present.

"Happy birthday to the champion of video games!" Leo shouted.

I opened it and saw a new controller. It was the best gift ever. Later we went swimming and swinging on a rope swing. I jumped high into the cold water. It felt impossible to be scared because everyone cheered. My mom paid for pizza and we ate every single slice.

"Do you remember to make a wish?" asked Mom.

I blew out the candles and wished for another day like this. I chose chocolate cake for dessert. It was the best day.

I have superpowers and I go to hero training school. My power is shooting green slime from my hands. Everyone feared the slime because it is super sticky. One day a big robot crashed into our playground. It screamed a weird robot noise and stomped around.

"Watch out for the slime!" I yelled loudly.

I touched my hands together and made a huge ball. I threw it and it left a green trail. The slime hit the robot right in the face.

"Good job slime boy!" my teacher said to me.

The robot got stuck and could not move anymore. Science class is way better when you fight robots. I heard cheering throughout the whole school that day.

One day I saw my cat fluffy looking up at the big oak tree. She looked like she wanted to climb it really bad. I walked over and saw a tiny bird sitting on a high branch. The bird was just floating there in the wind.

"Don't eat that bird!" I yelled at Fluffy.

Fluffy meowed at me like I was wrong. Then she jumped up and reached for the branch but she missed. I was scared she would fall.

"Come down right now," I said.

She jumped down and I picked her up. I opened the door and we went inside. I treated her to some tuna because she was a good cat. Being inside with snacks is better than being in bird heaven. We played with her string toy instead. It was a fun day.

I had a mountain of homework to do last night. It was growing bigger and bigger on my desk. I looked at the math sheet and my hand started trembling. I just wanted to go outside and play but I couldn’t. My mom said school is very important.

"Use your imagination," my mom told me. "It will be fun."

I picked up my pencil to write the answers. I had enough strength to finish five problems. Then I saw my dog surrounding my feet. He wanted to play too. It was incredible how fast I finished after that! I can guarantee I will get an A plus on this.

"Can you sign my paper now?" I asked my mom.

She smiled and said yes. I was so happy I wasn't dumping it in the trash.

My brother Tim and I were playing the greatest video game ever. It was freezing in the basement, but we didn't care. We were fighting a giant beetle boss on the screen. My hands were shaking, and I feared we would lose. Tim turned to me and yelled, "Use the feather power-up now!"

I pushed the red button as fast as I could. My character jumped high and flew right through the beetle. Then I realized I had enough magic left. I tried to seize the controller tighter.

"You got him!" Tim grinned at me.

We won the level and felt super happy. Mom says we act like we had too much caffeine. But we just love winning together.

It was the big soccer game and I was afraid. We were losing by a single goal. The ball came fast and struck my knee. It made a stinging pain but I kept running anyway. I scrambled up the field and climbed over a defender.

"Pass it here!" I yelled to my friend Mike.

He kicked it and I followed the ball perfectly. I imagined I was like a bungee cord snapping back. I kicked hard and the ball flew into the net like a shiny jewel. The goalie just spread his arms and missed it completely.

"Oh man," the goalie grumbled while getting up.

We won the game thirteen to twelve. My knee was scratched and groaning but I was happy. I felt like I should be in the newspaper tomorrow!

I was sitting in my treehouse reading a scary book. The wind was brewed up and it started moaning outside. My dog Buster was trembling because he hates loud noises.

"Don't worry Buster, it is just the wind," I said.

Suddenly I heard something huge approaching the tree. My heart was beating fast and I stopped breathing for a second. Was it a monster swinging from the branches? I looked out the window with a scared feeling.

"Achoo!" a loud sneeze came from the leaves.

It was just my brother Tom! He threw a pinecone at me.

"You look like a scaredy cat!" Tom laughed.

I started running down the ladder to chase him. Buster barked and ran too because I trained him to catch Tom. We ran all the way back to the house before the rain started.

It was raining very hard outside my house. Me and my friend Sam put on our raincoats. We wanted to be explorers in the dark woods. We walked until we saw a weird old cave.

"Look at that big sign!" Sam yelled loudly.

The sign had foreign words and a picture of a skull. We went inside the cave anyway. It was dark and cold inside. Suddenly, something pulled my backpack! I screamed really loud and jumped.

"Don't be scared, it is just a branch," said Sam.

Then we saw a shiny gold helmet on the ground. It belonged to a knight. I put it on and pretended to be the captain. We found a treasure chest but it was empty. We ran home before dinner.

I woke up early today because it was science day. I love science class because we do cool experiments. Today we learned about things floating in water. My teacher Mrs. Green put a big bowl on her desk.

"Who thinks this heavy rock will float?" she asked us.

"No way! It will sink fast," shouted my friend Leo.

He was right because the rock sank to the bottom. Then we made little boats out of foil. My boat looked like a camping tent upside down. I was scared it would sink like the rock. But it didn't sink at all! It swam across the water perfectly.

Lunchtime was approaching so we had to clean up. I felt happy because my experiment was complete. School is the best when we don't just do boring worksheets.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the big jungle behind my house. We had a schedule to find the lost gold by lunch. The trees got thicker gradually and it was getting dark. Suddenly I heard a noise near a big rock.

"Watch out for that snake!" Sam shouted really loud.

I started jumping back and my heart was pumping fast. It was just a lizard on the ground but I was scared. We felt stronger after that and kept walking. We found a cool fountain made of stone.

"Look, I scratched the dirt and found a coin!" I said.

It was not gold but it was still an awesome treasure. We ran home to eat sandwiches.

Me and my friend Sam found an old boat. It was by the lake and looked very cool. We pushed it into the water and jumped inside. Sam was steering with a big stick.

Suddenly the boat turned fast and we went down the river! The water crashed over the sides and I got wet.

"Watch out for that rock!" I yelled loudly.

Sam tried to stop but we were going too fast. We almost hit it but Sam touched the water with the stick. It worked just enough to move us away. We were thrilled.

"We almost crashed!" said Sam with a big smile.

We finally caught a rope on the dock. We won the battle against the river today.

My brother Tom wants to be a colonel in the army. He plays army games throughout the whole house all day. Last night we had a sleepover with my cousin Sam. Tom said we had to eat lots of protein for dinner. He made us eat three big eggs and some ham.

"This will make your blood pump fast through every vein," Tom said.

I was dreaming about science class when a loud noise woke me. It was Tom beating a drum in the hallway.

"Wake up troops!" he yelled really loud at six in the morning.

We discovered that sleeping over at Tom's house is not very fun. Next time I am going to Sam’s house instead.

My birthday party was bringing all my friends over for a sleepover. We played outside until the sun neared the ground. My friend Sam found a huge black beetle in the grass. I feared bugs, so I ran away fast. We decided to climb the big tree, but I was scared of the height.

"You can do it!" Sam yelled, coaching me up.

I grabbed a branch and pulled my weight up high. Then I felt a sharp stinging on my arm. A mosquito bit me! I started moaning because it hurt. We went inside and ate cake shaped like a little lamb. Everyone was sleeping in the living room later, but we talked all night. It was the best birthday ever.

I bought a cool sword at the toy store. It was made of plastic but looked very real. Me and my friend Sam went to the dark woods. We were bearing our swords like brave knights.

Suddenly, a big bear appeared behind a tree! It was growling and sounding very scary.

"Run away immediately!" Sam yelled loudly.

I gripped my sword tight in my fingers. The bear looked stronger than us. I almost fainted because I was so scared. The trees surrounding us were tall and dark. It started raining hard on our heads.

"Wait, look!" I said. "It is just a dog."

The dog wagged its tail and licked my hand. My mom sent a text to come home for dinner. We were safe and hungry.

My brother Tim and I found an old map. It showed a secret path to a hidden castle. We packed our bags and looked at the schedule. We had to leave right after soccer coaching.

The path was long and scary. Rocks were scattered everywhere on the ground. We climbed a big hill and saw the castle. It was huge and gray with a tall balcony.

"Look up there!" shouted Tim. "I see a dragon!"

The dragon was green and sleeping. We were especially quiet. I took out a golden comb from my bag. The map said the dragon loved shiny things. I threw the comb and we ran away fast. Later we ate roasted marshmallows by the fire. It was the best adventure ever.

It was a freezing day in February and the snow was deep. Me and my friend Sam went into the woods behind my house. We wanted to find the lost fort of Colonel Mustard. Sam said it was a foreign land because nobody goes there. We walked for a long time and ate sandwiches. I dropped a crumb on the ground and a tiny gnat landed on it. Suddenly we saw a big dark cave.

"Watch out for bears!" I screamed really loud.

Sam laughed and said, "Don't be scared, it's just a shadow."

We went inside and found a heavy box. The weight was too much for just one person. We lifted it together and everyone started cheering in my head. Inside was gold chocolate coins! We treated ourselves to the candy and felt like real explorers.

It was raining so we had inside recess today. Everyone was moaning because we wanted to play tag outside. I sat with my friend Jake near the water fountain. We decided to build a huge tower with blocks.

"This is going to be the biggest castle ever," Jake said.

We built it really high but it started wobbling. It looked dangerous. Just then, our teacher Mrs. Miller walked by.

"Be careful or that will crash," she warned us.

Suddenly the whole thing fell down with a loud crash! It was a total failure. We got in trouble for making a mess. Mrs. Miller said we had to clean it up before lunch. I was hungry and wanted my roasted chicken sandwich. Next time I will just draw a picture instead.

My friends and I were playing kickball outside on Tuesday. The sun was hot but there was a nice pleasant breeze. It was my turn to kick the big red ball. I scratched my arm because a bug was crawling on it. Then I got ready and the pitcher rolled the ball.

I kicked it super hard and it went over the fence! Everyone screamed really loud because it was a home run. I ran around the bases and my face was feeling hot. I crossed home plate and gave my friend a high five. Then we heard a weird sound like a dog moaning. A stray dog was roaming near the fence with our ball. He chewed on the leather but we chased him away gradually.

"That was the best kick ever!" my friend Sam yelled.
"I know, right?" I said back to him.

My dog Barnaby loves roaming around our big backyard. One day, I saw him barking at a bush. I knew he found something special. I walked over carefully and saw a tiny bird trapped in string.

"Don't worry, little bird," I said softly to him.

The string was tight, so I ran to get scissors. It seemed impossible to cut without hurting the bird. My neighbor, Mrs. Green, was outside getting her newspaper. She saw me approaching the bush and came to help.

"Hold him still and I will cut it," she told me.

I had to seize the bird gently in my hands. Mrs. Green snipped the string and the bird flew away fast. We were both very happy.

My friends came over for a sleepover and we wanted snacks. We scrambled to the kitchen but something happened. I tripped on the rug and crashed into the table. The big bowl of popcorn went flying and spread everywhere!

"Oh no!" yelled my friend Sam. "Is gravity broken?"

We laughed because we learned about gravity in science class. We discovered popcorn under the couch and leading down the hall. We feared my mom would be mad but she just smiled.

"This is the beginning of a big mess," she said.

We helped clean up and were grateful she wasn't angry. It was important to clean it all up fast. Often my mom makes us cookies after we clean. It was the best sleepover ever!

Me and my brother Sam played a racing video game. The scenery in the game looked like a science lab. We picked our cars and started the race fast. My car was a green beetle with stripes.

"You can't beat me!" Sam shouted at the screen.

I used psychology to trick him and turned left. He crashed into a wall and I zoomed past. I finished the last lap to complete the race. The game gave me a gold digital receipt.

"I am the champion of the world!" I yelled.

Sam was mad but I was good at keeping calm. We played again and I won five more times.

I rode my bike to the big woods behind my house. My dog Buster was following me and wagging his tail. We found a huge stick that looked like a sword. I used my imagination and pretended we were fighting dragons. Suddenly, Buster started digging near a big rock. He struggled to pull something out of the dirt. He used all his strength and pulled hard. It was just an old, dirty shoe!

"Oh Buster, you are so silly," I said.

He grinned at me with his tongue out. The sun was going down gradually, so we made a small fire. We roasted marshmallows until they were gooey and black. Then I heard a moaning sound from the trees.

"Let's go home now, Buster!" I yelled. We ran fast all the way back to my house.

We walked down the dark trail in the woods. Max held the map and I held the flashlight. Suddenly the path grew very small and tight. We saw a cave and went inside slowly. The ceiling was super high and had bats on it.

"Look at that shiny thing over there!" Max yelled.

It was a big blue jewel sitting on a rock. I grabbed it quickly but then the ground shook. A giant spider came down from the top.

"Run away fast!" I screamed at Max.

We ran out and did not remain there. The spider wanted to reign over the cave forever. We were safe but we left the jewel behind.

I was playing in the woods and found a big cave. My friend Tim was with me and we went inside. It was dark but we searched for treasure for an hour. We crawled through a small hole and saw a dragon sleeping!

Tim was scared but he was brave like a knight. Suddenly the dragon woke up and started screaming loud.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Tim.

He grabbed my hand and we ran out of the mountain. We were keeping to a schedule so we ran home for dinner. I thought we were going to get eaten by the dragon. We were safe but we never went back to that cave.

My neighbor had a big party at her apartment. It was her daughter's birthday and she turned nine. We grasped our presents and walked in carefully. There was a big sign that said "Happy Birthday!"

We played a game with scissors and paper. I won the game and felt really happy. Then my dad said, "We are going boating tomorrow."

"Can we go to that small island?" I asked.

He said yes and I was so grateful. That night I slept very hard. I dreamed about approaching the island on the blue water. It was the best weekend on earth to receive presents and have fun.

We were in the deep green jungle looking for gold. My friend Sam had a map, but he often held it wrong. We walked for a long time and saw a big elephant. It was huge and gray and eating leaves. Suddenly, the ground started shaking and rocks fell down.

Buster barked immediately and tried to chase it. We ran fast and my feet made a loud rhythm. We stopped at the big oak tree. It was fourteen steps away from the creek. A mother duck and her daughter were swimming there. We sat and watched them for a long time.

"I am grateful we came outside," I whispered to Buster.

We were waiting for dinner time. Mom said she stewed some carrots for us later. We walked home happy and tired.

My big brother Max turned thirteen today. We had a party in the backyard. Dad was steering the grill, but the fire grew way too big! He started screaming because he burned the hot dogs. Mom said, "Oh no, that is a total failure."

Then our dog Buster ate the burnt hot dogs. I was waiting for cake, but Max was swearing quietly because he dropped his present. It was a cool leather wallet. We had to search in the grass for his money.

Later, Grandpa read the newspaper and ignored us. I asked him, "What is the meaning of thirteen?"

He laughed and said, "It means trouble!" It was a crazy birthday, but we still had ice cream.

One day I walked my dog Buster to the big woods. We pretended it was a scary jungle. Buster ran fast and I threw his favorite red ball. It got stuck in a bush with sharp thorns. I tried to squeeze my hand in to get it. "Be careful Buster!" I said. Then I saw something shiny clinging to a branch.

I pulled it out and turned it over in my hand. It looked like a big blue jewel from a castle. I thought it was very important treasure. I put it in my pocket to keep it safe. Then Buster started coughing like he had pneumonia. "We have to go home now," I told him. My mom used a comb to get leaves out of his fur. Our adventure was complete and we were safe.

One day me and my friend Sam went to the scary woods. We were looking for a monster that was roaming around. Sam brought his toy sword and I brought the big scissors.

"Watch out!" Sam yelled because a huge bear jumped out.

We fought the bear but it was too strong. We ran away fast and escaped up a tree. My heart was beating like crazy in my vein. Sam drew a map on a piece of paper. He wrote a big X on it.

"We need to find the dragon's cave," I said.

We walked for a long time. We saw the dragon chewed on a bone. It looked scary but we were brave. We knew our reign as kings of the forest was starting. We need more training to contain the dragon next time.

I was walking in the woods and I saw a spaceship. It was huge like a giant elephant. A door opened and a green alien walked out. He looked tired and was moaning loudly.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"I need caffeine," the alien said. "My ship is out of gas."

He fell on the ground and started groaning. I reached into my backpack and touched a soda can. I gave it to him even though it was warm. He drank it fast. Suddenly his skin turned purple and a blue vein popped out.

"This is the greatest drink ever!" he yelled.

He floated up because the weight was gone. It was a crazy scene. He flew away to a different planet.

My friends and I went boating down the big river. We saw a dark cave and wanted to go inside. The air was freezing and we heard a loud noise. It sounded like a bear was sleeping in there!

"Let's get out of here!" yelled Timmy fast.

We tried to leave but our boat crashed into a rock. We scrambled onto the muddy ground and ran away. We escaped just in time before the bear woke up. We were thrilled to be safe outside in the sun.

Later we made a fire and toasted marshmallows. I was cleaning mud off my shoes but it was stuck. Next time we will stay away from dark caves. It was scary but we had fun growing up today.

I was playing Super Racer on my tablet. My heart was thumping really fast. I was in first place but my brother was close.

"You are going to lose!" my brother yelled at me.

"No way, I am winning this time," I said back.

My car sped up and felt like a cool breeze. Suddenly I crashed into a big green wall. My brother laughed and zoomed past me. I was breathing hard and trying to catch up. But then his screen went black.

"Oh no! My battery needs cleaning or something!" he cried.

I spread my arms out and cheered because I won. He was just sleeping on charging his tablet last night. It was nice to have company, even if I won by luck.

One sunny morning, me and my friend Sam went exploring. We wanted to search for a hidden cave. We climbed up a big hill behind my house. My heart was thumping really fast. Suddenly, we saw a dark hole in the rocks.

"Do you think a creature lives inside?" asked Sam.

We went inside and it was very dark throughout. I touched the cold wall and heard something bumping. A bat swept past my head! We ran out fast without seeing anything else. We never obtained the treasure, but earning a scare was enough.

It was too scary to contain our screams. We did not measure how fast we ran home!

It was my nephew Leo's birthday party in the park. The scenery was nice with green trees and flowers. We ate toasted hot dogs and drank juice. My aunt brewed some coffee for the grown-ups.

Suddenly, Leo’s dog Buster escaped from his leash! He started roaming all around the surrounding grass. Buster ran right into the big water fountain.

"Get him out!" my mom yelled loudly.

"He looks so weird!" Leo laughed at the wet dog.

We finally grabbed Buster, but not a single person stayed dry. We ended the day singing happy birthday to Leo. It was the best messy party ever.

I was waiting for recess because I hate math. The big clock neared twelve and my stomach growled loud. Finally the bell rang and everyone shouted with joy. I ran outside to the meeting spot by the slide.

"Did you bring the ball?" my friend Sam asked me.

"Yes I have it right here!" I said back.

We played kickball on the blacktop surrounding the gym. It was a beautiful sunny day with no clouds. Then I kicked the ball way too hard. It flew up and landed on the tiny balcony. We knew we could not get it down. We had to search for a new game to play. I stewed about losing the ball until lunch. But then I ate my pizza and felt better.

I woke up early because I was excited for lunch. My mom packed me a huge sandwich and an apple. I counted the hours until the bell rang for recess. Finally we ran outside and played on the big mountain of dirt.

I got up early because I wanted to see bugs. The grass was wet and my shoes got muddy. I walked carefully to the big tree in the back. I saw a squirrel and it was wearing a tiny hat! That was incredible.

"Hello squirrel," I said to him very nicely.

The squirrel looked at me and blinked his eyes. He was eating a single nut and looked very pleased. I waited longer to see if he would talk back.

He didn't say anything but he made a groaning sound. Then I saw a butterfly floating by the leaves. It was meeting a bee on a yellow flower. I held my hand steady but they flew away fast. I greeted my dog when I went back inside. Exploring is fun but now I am hungry for breakfast.

Yesterday my nephew and I went camping in the backyard. We slept in a big blue tent. Suddenly, a green robot crashed onto our balcony! It crawled towards us and made a loud beep.

"Do not be scared," the robot said simply.

The robot had a giant glass brain. Inside the brain was a single purple flower. He told us he liked painting pictures of space. We discovered he was from Mars and loved science. He stayed for a while but could not stay longer.

I went outside to play with my dog, Buster. We ran to the big woods behind my house. The leaves were scattered all over the ground. Suddenly, Buster stopped and started barking at a bush.

I looked closer and discovered a tiny bird. It had dropped out of its nest. It looked scared and lonely.

I remembered my dad told me not to touch baby birds. So I ran inside to get my dad for company. He was reading the newspaper and drinking coffee he just brewed. We went back outside together. I saw a big green alien in my backyard. It had shiny purple armor like a space knight. The alien pulled a laser gun out of its pocket. I sprinted behind the old oak tree very fast.

I was steering my spaceship through the dark stars. Suddenly a big red alarm light flashed. Something was approaching my ship very fast. I looked out the window and saw a giant green creature. It looked like a beetle but it was the size of a house!

The robot gave me some juice and fixed my engine. The creature was actually a friendly space pet. I petted its head and then flew home for dinner.

My dog Buster is the greatest dog ever. We went to the woods on Saturday because everyone wanted to explore. I saw a big tree and I wanted to climb it. Buster ran around sniffing the growing grass. Suddenly I heard a loud moaning sound.

"What was that?" I screamed.

I crossed my fingers and hid behind my thumb. The bushes moved and a tiny cat came out. It was just a kitten! We gave it some water and spread a blanket for it. We were not boating, but we still found a pirate treasure. It was a new friend.

I woke up super early today because I had a big test. My mom made me eggs, but I was too nervous to eat. I sprinted to the bus stop so I wouldn't be late. When I got to school, my friend Sam met me at the door.

Yesterday was a very weird day at school. We had a super important math test in the morning. I shook my head because the numbers looked crazy. Then the bell rang and we all ran outside for recess. 

I took my favorite red ball and bounced it hard. Suddenly, I threw it way too high in the air. It simply disappeared over the big grey fence!

I was playing my favorite video game with my best friend. We were climbing a huge mountain to fight the boss. Suddenly, a big red dragon was approaching us very fast. My friend got scared and dropped his controller on the ground.

We finished eating and went to the water fountain. Recess neared and I was so happy to play tag.

I was sitting in class and my stomach growled loud. I opened my lunch box but my sandwich looked gross. Then I saw something black on the floor. It was a huge beetle and it crawled near my foot!

My mom drove me to school late today. We saw our neighbor Mr. Smith waiting for the bus. He waved at us and I waved back. My teacher Mrs. Green taught us about healthy food. She said eating protein makes your muscles really big.

My dog Buster was feeling very excited today. We were going to the big park for a meeting with other dogs. Buster is younger than my friend’s dog, but he is very fast. Suddenly, we heard a loud thumping sound on the grass. It was a giant rabbit jumping near the bushes!

We had a big test in math today. Everyone was moaning because it looked very hard. I gripped my pencil tight and counted to ten. The teacher said, "Do not rush through the questions." Me and my best friend Sam went to the old castle. It was very dark and scary throughout the big halls. We were looking for the magic gold cup. Suddenly, a cold wind blew out our only candle! Sam grabbed my arm tight.

Tom said, "This pizza tastes like charcoal!"

I laughed and said, "Just put ranch on it."

We spread blankets on the floor and thought about scary stories. We screamed when the cat jumped on us. It was so loud! We stayed up super late and neared midnight. Tom said a bad word like swearing but only once. My mom didn't hear so we didn't remain in trouble. Finally we slept. In the morning my waffles were plain but tasted like heaven. It was the best birthday ever.

I was playing my favorite video game about a jungle. My character had to run through the big green trees. I was approaching the final boss and I was scared. My big brother was coaching me from the couch.

"You have to maintain your speed!" he yelled loudly.

I tried to keep running but the monster was fast. It was guarding the gold treasure chest. I thought I was going to lose. I saw a single red potion on the ground. I grabbed it and my health bar rose up high. The music was sounding really fast and loud. I jumped over the monster and I won!

"Good job guarding your life points," my brother said.

I was happy because I beat the whole level.

My best friend Ben came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to build a huge fort in the living room. We used blankets and chairs and it looked like a cave. I got the scissors to cut some tape for the door. Then the whole thing fell down and trapped us inside!

"This is a total failure," Ben said sadly.

I laughed and used my strength to push the blankets off. We landed on the soft rug and started giggling.

"We can fix it," I told him. "I will guide you."

We built it again and pretended we were in a meadow. We were dreaming about fighting dragons until my mom came in. She swept the floor and made us popcorn. It meant we could stay up late and tell scary stories.

My homework was simply a mountain of trouble. It was just math but it felt like danger. I grasped my pencil hard and stared at the paper.

"This is going to be a total failure," I grumbled loudly.

My big brother walked in and he heard me. He is taking psychology in high school so he thinks he is smart.

"Just climb the mountain one step at a time," he said.

I knew he was trying to say something important. I immediately started the first problem at the beginning. I often get caught on the hard ones. But this time I did not stop. I guarantee I finished it fast! School is easier when you just start.

My brother Tim and I went boating down the spooky river. The water was gray and the wind made a moaning noise. We were looking for the magic fountain. It was very important because it could make us fly.

Suddenly, we heard something sounding like a monster! Tim started pumping his legs hard to make the boat go faster.

"Watch out for that rock!" I yelled loudly.

Tim swerved the boat and we almost crashed. Then we saw a green light. A witch brewed a potion near the fountain. We knew it was dangerous, so we hid behind a bush.

"Let's grab the magic water and run," Tim whispered.

We filled our cups and ran away fast. We were safe!

My brother Tim thinks he is the best at everything. He is growing taller than me, so he usually wins. We were playing soccer in the backyard yesterday. I grabbed the ball and ran fast to the goal.

"You can't score on me!" Tim yelled loudly.

I kicked the ball super hard and it blew past him. It hit the old newspaper on the porch and crushed it.

"Goal!" I screamed and did a funny dance.

Tim crawled under the bushes to get the ball back. He came out bringing a dirty spider on his shirt. He was clinging to the fence because he was scared. I won the game because he ran inside crying. It was the best day ever.

My friends and I found a map in the dirt. It looked old and foreign so we knew it was special. We started loading our backpacks with snacks and flashlights.

"Let's go to the spooky cave!" shouted Billy.

We walked for a long time and heard a strange noise. It sounded like stamping feet. Suddenly a giant green beetle jumped out! I almost crushed it with my boot but I stopped.

"Look out for the bug!" I yelled.

Billy threw a rock and cleared the path for us. We felt like we were trained explorers. We found a treasure chest inside the cave. Our quest was complete and we were so happy. It felt like bungee jumping but way safer. My dad is coaching soccer tonight so I have to go home now.

My brother Tom and I went exploring in the woods. We were looking for a secret cave through the tall grass. The wind blew very hard and it was cold.

"Look at that big rock!" Tom shouted loudly.

We saw a dark hole and walked inside the cave. It was scary but we had strength and were brave. Something chewed on an old stick near the entrance. We saw a painting on the wall of a bear.

Suddenly we heard bumping sounds in the back.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Tom.

We ran out and simply did not stop running. A spider thread got on my face. We were waiting for a monster but it was just a squirrel. It was teaching us not to go in dark caves.

I was walking in the jungle and I saw a robot. It was silver and it had a bright red jewel on its chest. The robot was crushed under a big rock. I felt scared but I wanted to help him. I tried to lift the rock but it was impossible.

"Please help me!" the robot shouted very loudly.

I used my superpower and suddenly I was super strong. I lifted the rock with a single hand. The robot stood up and sang a happy song.

"Thank you for saving me," he said.

He gave me a space newspaper from Mars. It had pictures of aliens throughout the pages. Then he flew away into the sky. I hung the paper on my wall. I never told anyone about my new friend.

My best friend Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to design a super cool fort in the living room. We brought every blanket and pillow from my bed downstairs.

"This is going to be the best fort ever!" Tim yelled.

We tried to squeeze the big couch cushions together. But something went wrong and the roof fell down on us. It felt impossible to fix it. Then my dad came in to keep us company.

"Do you guys need a needle and thread?" he joked.

He helped us lift the blankets up high like a bungee jump. The pillows flew everywhere when we jumped inside. It was so much fun! We ate popcorn and stayed up way too late.

One day my dog Rex ran into the woods. He disappeared behind a big green bush. I was wearing my blue shoes and I ran fast.

"Rex, come back!" I yelled very loud.

The earth was muddy and my shoes got dirty. I saw Rex digging near a tree. He was groaning and making a funny noise. He was not afraid of the dark woods. I knew he found something special. It was a tiny hole in the ground.

"Look at that," I said to Rex.

Suddenly a small rabbit hopped out. It moved with a fast rhythm. The rabbit ran away and the hole closed up. Rex did not complain at all. The grass grew tall there. We walked home before night was approaching. My mom and her daughter were waiting for us. I was happy we were safe.

I looked at my desk and started groaning. There was a mountain of homework sitting there. My teacher, Mrs. Green, sent us home with fourteen math pages! I felt my worry growing bigger and stronger. Just then, a wind blew through my open window. Papers flew everywhere and scattered all over my floor.

"Oh no!" I yelled loudly. "My homework is everywhere!"

My mom came in and touched my shoulder gently. "We can fix this mess," she said.

We started climbing over toys to get the papers. I discovered one under my bed and another keeping my door open. My heart sank when I saw my dog chewing one. But we taped it up. Finally, it was done. It was hard work, but I finished it all before dinner.

It was Wednesday and I was ready for the big game. My younger brother Timmy wanted to play too. I had to guide him through the jungle level first. He kept getting stuck in a hole.

"Use your super strength!" I yelled at the screen.

Timmy pressed the button and his character jumped high. We escaped the scary pit just in time. Then a dragon flew down and scorched the ground. We almost got roasted by the fire breath!

"Watch out!" Timmy screamed as he dropped his controller.

Our car crashed into a tree but we were okay. I realized we actually won the race anyway. I grinned at Timmy and gave him a high five. My dad walked in and greeted us. He is good at coaching us in video games. We are going to be champions soon.

My dog Buster and I went on an adventure yesterday. We walked to the big woods behind my house. Suddenly I saw a squirrel and Buster started screaming.

"Stop Buster!" I yelled but he didn't listen.

He ran fast and led me deep into the trees. I feared he would get lost forever. Then he stopped near a bush with berries growing on it. Gravity made me trip and I fell on the dirt. I looked up and saw Buster had caught something. It was just an old plastic bag stuck on a branch. I used my scissors from my pocket to cut it free. We spread the bag out on the grass.

"That's enough exploring," I said to Buster.

My mom's daughter was happy to be home safe. Next time I will keep Buster on his leash.

My brother Timmy had a birthday party on Saturday. Mom roasted a big chicken for dinner because it has protein. Timmy dressed up like a cool knight with a plastic sword. He ran around the yard and pretended to fight dragons.

"I am certain I can beat you!" Timmy yelled loudly.

"No way, I am flying and floating!" I shouted back.

We played until my face turned red like a popping vein. Then Mom brought out the cake. I thought it looked so yummy. Timmy tried to explain why he needed the biggest piece. We ate cake and then we watched a movie. It was the best day ever.

Me and my best friend Leo went on a big adventure. We were roaming in the woods behind my house. It looked like a scary jungle. We saw a weird sign on a tree. It had a cool design like a dragon.

"Look at that!" shouted Leo.

"I think it is a treasure map," I said.

We walked deeper into the woods. Suddenly we heard a loud ringing sound. I gripped my stick tight. I trained for this moment. A big dog jumped out! I grabbed a stick and threw it far away. The dog ran after it. We were safe.

We went home and toasted marshmallows. I thought about our fun day.

"Let's go back tomorrow," said Leo.

It was the best day ever.

One day my dog Spot and I went outside to explore. We wanted to find buried treasure in the woods. I pretended to be a brave sailor looking for gold. We walked for a long time and the air felt freezing.

Suddenly Spot stopped and made a moaning sound.

"What is wrong, Spot?" I asked him.

He pushed his nose into a big bush. I was scared but I looked inside. It did not contain gold. It was a tiny kitten sleeping on some leaves! The kitten looked cold so I picked it up.

"We have to help it," I said to Spot.

We dropped our sticks and ran back home fast. My mom gave the kitten some warm milk. We sat by the fire and ate roasted marshmallows. It was better than treasure. We did not learn how to climb trees that day, but we saved a new friend.

My nephew Sam and I went exploring in the woods today. We pretended we were in a big league of explorers. We packed a bag and were loading it with snacks. We walked until the path got all twisted and bumpy. Suddenly, a blue bird flew right past my head!

"Look at that bird!" I shouted loudly.

Sam started stamping his feet on the dirt. He was sounding like a big monster. We walked more and found a tiny island in the creek. We carefully crossed the water on big rocks.

"This is our secret base simply because it is cool," Sam said.

We ate our chips there and felt very brave. It was the best day ever.

My robot friend Zorb had the greatest design ever. He was shiny and green and grasped things easily. One day we found a glowing blue jewel in the park. Suddenly, a big spaceship landed on the grass. An alien came out and looked very mad.

"That is my jewel!" the alien shouted loudly.

"We won it fair and square!" I yelled back.

The alien threw a laser ball at us. Zorb jumped up and caught it. He realized he could use his laser eyes too. They fought together but then the alien left earth. We ate a cookie and did not leave a single crumb. I want to learn more about space now.

My dog Buster loves to play in our big backyard. One day, I heard a loud noise near the bushes. Buster ran over to see what it was. I followed him and discovered a tiny baby bird on the ground. It fell from a great height out of its nest.

"Oh no, poor birdie!" I said to Buster.

Buster sniffed it gently but he didn't touch it. I ran inside and got a soft newspaper for it. Then I saw the mommy bird approaching us fast. She was mad! I threw the paper down and backed away quickly.

"Come on Buster, let's go!" I yelled.

We watched from far away and the mommy bird landed. I felt like I won a prize because the baby was safe. The scenery was nice and sunny. I think gravity is mean for making birds fall down. My dad is coaching my soccer team later, so I told him the story.

It was my birthday last week and I turned eight. My friends came over for a sleepover and we started jumping on my bed. We were loud especially when we played tag. Then my friend Leo tried climbing the tall shelf. He fell down hard and hurt his arm. My mom took him to the hospital fast.

When he came back he had a big white cast. "Does it hurt?" I asked him.

"Only a little bit," Leo said.

We opened my presents later and I got a foreign coin collection. My aunt gave me a shirt but she kept the receipt. I was honest and told her I liked the toys better. Although the party had an accident, it was still fun. I will write Leo a card tomorrow.

One day I found a strange robot in my backyard. He was silver and shiny but he looked broken and sad. I touched his metal arm and he suddenly froze. Then his eyes lit up bright green and he spoke loudly.

"Please help me find my ship," said the robot.

"I can help you search for it," I told him.

We walked through the woods behind my house together. We looked throughout the whole forest for a long time. The robot was very nice and started teaching me alien words. Finally we found a wonderful blue spaceship hidden in the bushes. A small green creature slept inside the ship's big window. The robot was so happy he started swearing in robot language. I didn't understand the words but I knew he was glad. Then he flew away into the sky.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. Max is plain brown and he likes to sniff everything. We walked up a big hill to check the height. Suddenly, Max started barking at a big white sheet.

"Is that a ghost?" I asked Max.

Max just shook his head and kept barking loudly. I was not certain what it was. It looked like it was floating in the air. Then I heard a weird moaning sound. I told Max to listen carefully.

"Maybe the ghost needs caffeine to wake up," I said.

Then the sheet did a big sneeze! It fell down. It was just my brother hiding. A huge black beetle crawled on his shoe. He screamed and ran home fast. Exploring is fun but my brother is silly.

I found a red jewel in the dirt. It was glowing so I put it through a loop of thread. Then I neared the old barn. Suddenly a green alien grew out of the ground! He had three eyes and was swinging a laser.

"Please listen to me!" the alien shouted loudly. "I am hungry for science snacks."

I did not have enough snacks. I blew my whistle for help. A robot colonel flew down from heaven. He was made of shiny metal.

"Stop right there, alien!" said the colonel.

The alien got mad and started swearing in alien language. It sounded like blop-blop-beep. The colonel zapped him and the alien ran away. I was safe.

My brother and I played a new video game yesterday. It was about a big scary castle floating in the sky. My heart was pumping super fast because I wanted to win.

"You have eight lives left," said my brother.

"I know, but the boss is approaching!" I yelled.

Suddenly a giant green monster appeared on the screen. He looked like he was dumping slime everywhere. I used my brain to solve the puzzle quickly. To be honest, I almost fainted when my character fell. But then I realized I had a magic potion. It was like caffeine for my player! I jumped up and hit the monster.

"You won!" my brother screamed.

I was so happy that I did a funny dance. We played again until dinner time.

We played a video game in my apartment last night. It was very important because I wanted to win. My friend Sam came over for company and we ate snacks.

I picked the cool knight character with the big sword. Sam picked the funny green lizard from the island level. We started jumping around and pressing all the buttons fast.

"You stole my power-up!" Sam yelled at the TV.

"No I didn't, I got it first!" I said back.

My hands were trembling because the game was so close. Suddenly, Sam twisted his controller and messed up his move. My knight hit him and won the game! My eyes were stinging because I didn't blink for a long time. Then we were both super hungry so we ate pizza.

My teacher Mrs. Jenkins cleared her throat and looked at me. I sat up straight in my chair because I was nervous. We were learning about a knight who rode a horse. The story was just beginning but then my tummy growled loud. It sounded like an earthquake or a big mountain falling down.

"Did someone bring a lion to school?" asked my friend Billy.
"No, I think my lunch got stole," I whispered back.

Then the bell rang for recess and we ran outside. I froze when I saw the playground because it was huge. We played a game where we were boating on the grass. We crossed the field and pretended to go to the hospital. My friend Sarah was coaching us on how to be doctors. We trained for an hour until the bell rang again. It was the best recess ever.

I woke up early because today was the big soccer game. My dad made breakfast and he drank lots of coffee for caffeine. I packed everything in my bag and walked to the car. The field was far away and looked foreign to me.

"Are you ready to win?" asked my dad, sounding loud.

"Yes, I am going to score!" I said back.

The game started and the ball bounced everywhere. I was breathing hard and running fast. Suddenly the ball landed right at my feet. I kicked it high like it hit the ceiling! It went past the sign that said dangerous. But it went in the goal! It was a pleasant feeling. My coach was happy but the other team was swearing quietly. We won the game and went boating after to celebrate.

My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover. We played in the living room of my apartment. Sam was steering his toy car on the rug. Suddenly, the car disappeared under the big green couch. We scrambled to find it on the ground.

"I see a huge black beetle!" Sam called out.

I looked down and it was just a fuzz ball. We laughed and kept looking for his blue car. Finally, I found it inside my mom’s red sweater.

"That is wonderful news," Sam grinned at me.

We decided to do a science experiment with soda next. My mom said no, but it was still a pleasure. We ate pizza instead and it tasted really good.

We went on a boating trip in February. It was cold but Captain Mike said it was safe. We were loading the big boat with food. I bought some candy and chips for the trip. 

"Stop moving so much," my sister grumbled at me. 

We sailed away from the ground and into the fog. Suddenly a huge monster drew near our boat! It looked like a giant stewed tomato with eyes. It was impossible to fight it. 

"Where is the guard?" I yelled loudly. 

The monster roared but we simply threw chips at it. The monster ate the chips and swam away. We sold the story to a newspaper later. My sister did not complain about me being brave after that.

One day my dog Buster got loose in the big field. He was running fast and jumping over the tall grass. I ran after him, screaming his name really loud. The scenery was nice but I was scared he was lost.

"Buster, come back!" I yelled.

He did not listen and he kept going through the mud. My brain was worried about failure. Then Buster appeared behind a big rock. He was dumping dirt everywhere and his pink tongue was out. I grasped his collar tight so he couldn't run again.

"You are a bad boy," I told him.

He just licked my hand and touched his nose to me. We walked home and I was bearing a big stick. The sun was going down and the shadows were growing long. My search was over and Buster was safe.

I was playing my new video game about jungle animals. It is an incredible game where you race a big elephant. I practiced training my runner every day after school. My mom brewed some hot cocoa and watched me play. She was reading the newspaper but kept looking up.

"You are getting better gradually," she said to me.

I ran straight ahead and jumped over a giant rock. Then my character did a bungee jump off a cliff! I was seeing the finish line coming up really fast. I pressed the blue button as hard as I could.

"I won!" I yelled really loud.

The elephant was slow and I was super fast today. I love this game so much.

I was exploring the big woods behind my house. My dog Buster was with me and he loves adventures. We walked for a long time and saw big trees surrounding us. Suddenly Buster started barking at a tall oak tree.

"What is it, Buster?" I called to him.

I looked up and saw a tiny cat clinging to a branch. The cat looked scared and was groaning quietly. It was in danger because it was stuck so high up. I knew I had to help it right away.

"Don't worry, kitty! I am coming!" I yelled loudly.

I carefully crossed the muddy creek to get closer. I climbed the bottom branches and grabbed the kitty. I was thrilled when I got down safe. Buster licked the kitty and his tail was loading up a wag. I took the cat home before getting a grounding for being late.

I was playing a huge soccer game on Saturday. My coach blew his silver whistle and the game started. We fought hard for the ball but the other team was fast. I grew tired because I was running so much. Although I was tired, I still ran fast to the goal.

"Pass it to me!" I screamed to my friend Sam.

Sam kicked it and I scorched the ball into the net. We won the game and we felt so happy. After the game, I was super hungry so my dad bought pizza.

"You crushed them," my dad said with a big smile.

I was bringing my trophy home when I tripped and crawled. My knee hurt but my dad taught me to be tough. I did not get pneumonia from the wet grass. I will write about my big win in school tomorrow.

I woke up and saw the sun was scorched hot. My dog Sparky ran to the door and sang a happy bark. We went outside to the plain field behind my house.

"Come here, Sparky!" I yelled loud.

Sparky sprinted fast and twisted in the green grass. He found a big stick and chewed it hard. Suddenly a rabbit appeared near the bushes. I was certain Sparky would chase it. But the rabbit disappeared into a hole.

"Where did it go?" I asked Sparky.

He just wagged his tail and looked happy to receive a pat. I knew he was the best dog ever. We walked home before my mom used scissors on my messy hair.

Me and my dog Buster went to the woods today. It looked like a green jungle with tall trees everywhere. Buster loves running and sniffing the dirt. Suddenly he stopped at a big pile of leaves. I saw something weird scattered on the ground. It was trash! Someone was dumping their garbage here.

"That is not honest," I told Buster. He barked at the trash.

We discovered an old bungee cord in the mess. It was bright blue and stretchy. We decided to clean it all up. Keeping nature clean is very important. I put the trash in a bag. Buster helped by wagging his tail.

When we got home, I heard a knock on my door. It was my mom.

"You are earning a big treat for this," she said.

Buster got a bone and I got ice cream. We saved the woods!

I was training for the big race at recess. My friend Sam was climbing on the jungle gym and watching me. I ran around the playground three times fast. My feet touched the ground hard every time I stepped.

"You look like you had too much caffeine!" Sam yelled.

"I am just super fast today," I shouted back.

Suddenly the bell started ringing very loud. Everyone started running to the door but I was still roaming around. I thought I could win one more race to the balcony. I ran past a kid eating roasted peanuts. I felt like a foreign car zooming by. I gradually slowed down when I saw the teacher.

"Good running, but time to go inside," she said.

I was out of breath but I felt like a winner.

It was raining really hard outside. Me and my best friend Sam wanted to explore the old shed. We ran inside and it smelled like old science experiments. Suddenly the door slammed shut and we were trapped! I tried to open it but my finger slipped.

"Push harder!" Sam yelled at me.

I pushed but there was a weird purple stain on the handle. Then we heard a loud ringing sound coming from a box.

"Is that a monster?" I asked.

Something fuzzy touched my shoe and I started screaming. We scrambled up onto a table. It was just a cat with its tongue sticking out! We laughed. The door finally opened and we ran back to my house. The cat followed us home.

One night I woke up because I heard a scary sound. It was like a moaning ghost outside my window. I grabbed my flashlight and I walked into the dark woods surrounding my house. I had a weird feeling in my tummy.

Suddenly I saw a blue light floating near a big fountain. It was a glowing jewel! I drew my toy sword and walked closer. A tiny white lamb jumped out.

"Don't be scared," the lamb spoke to me.

I picked up the jewel and felt a happy rhythm. Then I heard cheering from the trees. I can guarantee that was the best adventure ever!

Sam and I gripped our flashlights tight. We walked into the dark, weird cave.

"This is not on our schedule," Sam grumbled.

"Don't worry," I said. "We have to be brave."

My light bounced off the wet walls. Suddenly, we saw a giant dragon sleeping on a pile of gold! Its breath scorched the rock floor. It looked like it could gnaw on a car.

"We need to be honest," Sam whispered. "I am scared."

I counted to three and we ran fast. The dragon opened one eye but went back to sleep. We escaped its reign of terror! We ran all the way home and felt very safe.

I was walking in the woods and felt a breeze. Then I saw a green light behind a big tree. I was scared but I looked anyway. I found a tiny alien sitting on a rock. He had three eyes and big ears.

"Hello," I told him quietly.

He looked at me and held up his thumb. It was glowing bright purple! Then he pointed at a sign on his spaceship. The sign said 'Help Me' in red letters.

"I can help you squeeze inside," I said.

He screamed a happy noise and jumped in. The ship flew up fast. I waved goodbye to my new friend.

My brother Tom had a birthday sleepover last night. We ate pizza and chips and drank lots of soda. Tom started jumping on the bed and he looked crazy.

"Stop it right now!" my mom screamed from the hallway.

Tom didn't stop and he bounced way too high. Suddenly, the bed frame snapped and broke with a loud crack. Tom fell on the floor and started groaning and moaning.

"My leg hurts so bad!" he screeched loudly.

My dad ran in and said it was just too much caffeine. Mom said he needed more protein and less sugar next time. Then she said the scary word about grounding him for a week. My friends and I left the room fast. The party was over but at least nobody really got hurt.

I was dreaming about a huge blue robot on a mountain. Suddenly I woke up in my apartment and heard a noise. My neighbor plays his guitar too loud sometimes. But this sound was different and really weird.

I looked out the window and saw a spaceship land. A green alien walked out wearing a cool black leather jacket. He looked tired so he drank a cup of caffeine. I was scared but I counted to ten. The alien took out a pen and drew a picture.

"Do you like science?" the alien asked me loudly.

"Yes, but my nephew likes it more," I said back.

Then the alien lifted a car with zero weight. It was super cool and I want to go to space.

On Wednesday my nephew Tom and I went exploring outside. We wanted to play knights in the big woods. I had a stick for a sword and Tom had a chain. 

"I am a brave knight!" I yelled at a tree.

Tom grumbled because he was hungry and wanted a snack. We walked past our neighbor Mrs. Miller’s house. She greeted us with a smile and gave us apples.
