Her dog Spot ran out and he had a collar like a jewel. Neither of us had seen such a shiny thing before. We obtained the apples and counted them all. There were enough for us and for Spot too. We sat on the grass and ate happily.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were so excited. My friends and I were roaming around the backyard in the dark. The grass on the ground was wet and cold.

"Look out, a monster is approaching!" shouted my friend Leo.

We all ran to the tent and tried to squeeze inside. It was freezing out there but warm in our sleeping bags. Then something funny happened. My dog Buster reached his paw through the zipper door. He wanted to be the king and reign over the tent.

"He thinks he is a person," I grinned at everyone.

We let him stay and ate chips all night long. It was the best birthday ever.

I was walking home when a green spaceship landed. It scorched the grass in my backyard and I was thrilled! A small alien with three eyes scrambled out. He looked lost and scared.

"Can you help me fix my ship?" he beeped loudly.

I nodded and grabbed my dad’s toolbox from the garage. We worked together on the engine until it grew bright purple. Suddenly, a big robot trapped us against the ship! It stomped on the ground and looked very mean.

"Watch out!" I yelled and threw a wrench at it.

The robot fell over and we escaped. It was the greatest day ever because I made an alien friend. Then he flew away into the stars.

One day me and my friend Sam went exploring. We woke up early and ran to the big meadow. The grass was tall and green. Suddenly we heard a loud noise. Something was stamping its feet hard on the ground.

"What is that big thing?" I screamed.

It was a huge bear and it looked angry! It started tearing up the dirt with its claws. We were so scared. I grabbed Sam’s arm and we started running. The bear was jumping over logs to catch us.

"We have to hide now!" Sam yelled.

We climbed a tree instead of running more. The bear tried to seize my foot but missed. We grinned when the bear finally walked away. We were lucky to not receive a bite. It was the scariest day ever.

Me and my dog Sparky were exploring in the woods. We were looking for science stuff like big bugs. Suddenly Sparky saw a squirrel and he bounced away.

"Come back Sparky!" I yelled at him.

He was roaming around near a big pile of leaves. I crawled under a bush to see what he found. It was a tiny kitten and she was trembling. Someone was dumping trash there and left her.

"Oh no," I thought. "She looks very scared."

Unfortunately it started raining and the kitten was moaning. I picked her up and put her in my jacket. We ran home stamping in the mud puddles. My mom let us keep her! Now Sparky has a new best friend.

My friends and I were playing a snowball fight outside. It was freezing cold, but we didn't care at all. We built a big fort to hide behind.

"Watch out for the danger!" yelled my friend Sam loudly.

I saw the other team roaming near the old tree. I quickly made a snowball and I threw it hard. It landed right on Sam’s big red hat. He looked funny and we laughed a lot. Then the wind blew very hard and scattered snow everywhere. Everyone scrambled to find cover behind the big bushes.

"My hands are trembling!" I shouted to Sam.

We pulled our gloves up and drank hot chocolate later. My mom roasted marshmallows for us inside the warm house. I felt like a little beetle in a rug. My ears were ringing but we won the big game.

We were playing kickball in the field. My heart was thumping hard because my team was leading. It was a pleasant day with a cool breeze. My neighbor Tim was up to kick next. He stamped his feet and looked ready.

"You can do it, Tim!" I yelled loudly.

Tim kicked the red ball high into the air. It flew past the old colonel who was reading a newspaper.

"Oh no, that is trouble!" Tim shouted.

We ran fast down the trail to find the ball. We neared the colonel's fence and looked around. I drew a map in the dirt to explain my plan. Just then, we heard cheering throughout the park. My friend Sarah found the ball near a bush. We won the big game!

I live in a tall apartment building near the park. One day, I went outside to the very beginning of the trail. I heard a loud whistle coming from a big tree. It was a blue bird singing a funny song.

"Look at that bird!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked up and squinted his eyes at the height. "I can't see him either," Sam said sadly.

Suddenly, the bird flew down near a pine needle on the ground. It looked like he was having a meeting with a squirrel. The squirrel chattered with anger because the bird stole his nut. It was a crazy scene to watch. I wished I had scissors to cut some grass for a bed for them. But we just watched them chase each other around the tree instead. Being outside is the best fun ever.

My cousin Sara came from a foreign country to visit us. She met my best friend Leo and we had a sleepover. We built a huge castle out of blankets in the living room. It was really good but the height was too tall. The whole thing shook and fell down on Leo’s head! We laughed a lot and then we got hungry. Mom brewed some hot cocoa for us to drink. Then I used a plastic knife to put peanut butter on bread.

"Don't spread it too thick," Sara said to me.

I made a mess but it tasted yummy. Before leaving, Sara gave me a shiny blue jewel. It is my favorite thing now.

It was finally my birthday and I woke up early. I ran downstairs and greeted my mom and dad. They were busy loading the car with lots of boxes. 

"Is all that stuff for my party?" I asked. 

My dad smiled and said, "Yes, we have enough cake for everyone!"

We drove to the park and I looked at the scenery. When we got there, my friends were already waiting. I grasped my best friend's hand and we ran to the swings. Then I scratched my arm on a tree but it didn't hurt. We moved to the picnic table for presents. I started tearing the paper off a big blue box. I counted ten gifts total! But then I accidentally dropped my cake on the grass. Everyone laughed, even me. It was the best birthday ever.

Yesterday, me and my brother played soccer in the backyard. I kicked the ball really hard, and it went flying.

"Hey, watch out for the fence!" my brother shouted.

I ran fast to get the ball, but I tripped on the ground. My knee hurt a little, but I didn't want to complain. I got up and I felt stronger this time. I kicked the ball again, and it went right into the goal!

"That was a super good shot!" he said.

I grinned at him because I was winning the game now. Unfortunately, it started to rain, so we had to go inside. I thought we could play more, but Mom said no. We played video games instead and I beat him at that too.

My dog Buster escaped from the backyard yesterday. I saw him running and I dropped my toy. I ran after him and my legs were pumping fast. Buster is fast and catching him felt impossible. He reached the park and started sniffing a newspaper on a bench.

I grew very tired and my breathing was super loud. I finally caught his collar and I pushed him gently.

"Bad dog Buster!" I said to him.

He looked at me and started moaning like a ghost.

"We have to go home now," I told him.

We walked home and Mom made me a toasted cheese sandwich. Buster was happy but my sister was screaming because he licked her face.

I love playing soccer, but I hate losing. Last week, my team played the Tigers. They are huge and good at beating everyone. My dad was coaching us, but it wasn't helping much. I was stewed about the game all week. I spent hours training in the backyard and keeping score against the fence.

On Saturday, I woke up, but my sister was still sleeping. I put on my uniform, but a loose thread was hanging off my shorts. Unfortunately, the game started badly. We ran hard, but the Tigers were faster. I kicked the ball, and it hit the goalie right in the face! He had to go to the hospital.

While we waited, the next game was loading on the field. My friend Sam looked at me.
"This feels like a big failure," he said.
"Maybe we can win next time," I told him.
We drew the game 0-0, which is better than losing.

My robot friend Zap was stuck in a hole. He was wearing his shiny silver suit but he looked sad. A big green alien was keeping him there. The alien blew some purple smoke at us.

"Let my friend go right now!" I shouted loudly.

The alien laughed and simply sat on a rock. I drew my laser sword and it glowed blue. Zap looked scared because he was trapped deep down. I threw a heavy rock and it struck a button. Suddenly a cage came down surrounding the green alien.

"Wow, you did it!" said Zap happily.

I brought a rope and pulled Zap out fast. We had to complete our mission to save Mars. We ran away to learn how to fly the spaceship.

I rode the bus to school this morning. It was super hot outside and the sun scorched the sidewalk. I was breathing hard because I ran to catch the bus. My friend Tim was moaning about our math homework.

"I can't remember how to do subtraction," Tim said sadly.

I told him not to complain because Mrs. Miller is nice. She is always coaching us on the hard stuff.

At recess, we discovered a shiny rock in the dirt. It looked like a giant red jewel. We showed it to Mrs. Miller. She said it was just a plain rock, but we pretended it was magic. That was the beginning of our best game ever. We spent all lunchtime leading an army to protect the jewel.

"This is way better than math," I told Tim.

We rose up and won the battle before the bell rang.

I was feeling tired because it was Monday morning. I walked to school with my neighbor named Sam. We saw a big dog roaming near the playground.

"Look at that dog!" Sam shouted.

The dog appeared very hungry and he climbed the slide. It was weird. Then the bell rang and it was eight o’clock. We had a class meeting about the field trip. Mrs. Jones said we will eat roasted marshmallows next week.

"I love marshmallows," I whispered to Sam.

Then we did math but it was hard. I just wanted to go play with the dog. But when we went outside for recess, the dog was gone. I hope he finds some good food to eat soon.

My birthday party was supposed to be at the park. But it rained so hard we stayed inside instead. My mom cleared the living room so we could play. We pretended to be pirates on a big ship.

"I am the captain now!" yelled my friend Ben.

He had a blue vein popping out on his neck. He was screaming really loud and jumping on the couch. We neared the kitchen because it smelled like cake. My mom reached for the plates and we all sat down.

"Who wants the biggest piece?" asked my mom.

Everyone raised their hands up high. After the cake, we felt a heavy weight in our tummies. My dad said we were way off schedule for games. But we didn't care because we just slept on the floor. It was the best day ever even if it rained.

It was a cold day in February. My dog Max and I went exploring near the river. We saw a big stick floating by. Max wanted to seize it with his teeth. He thinks he is the king and can reign over the park.

"Go get it, Max!" I yelled loudly.

He jumped in the cold water with a splash. He used all his strength to pull the stick out. It was heavy like loading a big truck. Suddenly, an idea struck me.

"That stick is big enough for boating!" I said.

We sat on the log and pretended to sail away. We were pirates looking for treasure until my mom called us for dinner.

I saw a big green alien in my backyard yesterday. It was swinging on my dad's old tire swing. I was scared but he looked very pleased. He was wearing a shiny silver suit and holding a guitar.

"Hello there," the alien said with a funny voice. "I like your planet and this music box."

He started singing a weird song I didn't know the meaning of. Then he drew a picture on a piece of old newspaper. It looked like a map to thirteen stars.

"My robot is sleeping now," he told me quietly.

Then he jumped back into his spaceship and zoomed away fast. I told my mom but she just laughed at me. I hope he comes back to play songs again soon.

My homework disappeared today right before math class started. I looked in my backpack and searched my desk. It was simply gone and I felt really scared. My teacher Mrs. Green loves caffeine and hates missing papers.

"Where is your worksheet, Timmy?" she asked me loudly.

"I think a knight took it," I said quickly.

Then I discovered a scorched piece of paper under my chair. It looked burned like a dragon breathed on it! My friend Sam laughed especially hard at my face. He told me he saw everything happen at recess. A dog came for company and ate my math! Now I know dog psychology is very weird. I guess height doesn't matter to a hungry dog. Next time I will hide my homework much better.

My friends and I went on a big search for gold. We pretended to be a brave knight and a wizard. We walked into the dark woods behind my house. The leaves made a nice crunching rhythm under our feet. Suddenly, a big branch crashed down right in front of us! It was tearing through the old trees and scared us.

"Run away fast!" I screamed loudly to my friend.

We ran back but I tripped on a rock. I fell into a pile of dirt, simply dumping mud all over my new shirt.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend.

I stood up and spread my arms out. We laughed because I looked like a mud monster. We didn't find gold, but we had fun.

I was playing Super Smash Bros with my brother. He always wins and acts like a king. His reign as the best player lasted forever. I discovered a secret move with Pikachu yesterday. I simply pressed two buttons and lightning flew out! I grasped the controller really hard in my hands. My brother looked scared and his face turned red.

"Hey, stop doing that cheap move!" he yelled.

I didn't stop and I hit him again. I felt like electricity was in every vein. Finally, the screen said GAME OVER and I won!

"I am the new champion!" I shouted loudly.

My mom walked in and greeted us with snacks. I smiled because I finally beat him.

One day me and my friend Sam went to the old house. People say a monster lives there but that is impossible. We climbed the big fence and I tore my pants.

"Do you hear that moaning sound?" Sam asked me.

It sounded like someone speaking very quietly. We walked into the kitchen and saw papers scattered everywhere. Someone was dumping books on the floor. I saw a book about psychology. Then a big rat jumped out!

"Ahhh! I screamed so loud!" Sam yelled.

The rat chewed on a piece of toasted bread. I reached for a heavy rock and threw it. It landed right near the rat. The rat ran away fast but got caught in a net. We cut the net with rusty scissors. Then we ran all the way home. It was the scariest day ever.

My neighbor Tim and I played video games last Wednesday. We played the game with the big snowy mountain. My character was a little white lamb who ran fast. Tim’s guy was huge and had lots of height. We raced through the dark forest and neared the castle.

"I am going to win this time!" I screamed.

Suddenly, a giant dragon appeared and lit up the screen. I was scared but I escaped just in time. Tim was not fast enough and he sank in the mud.

"To be honest, you got lucky," Tim said sadly.

I won the race and got the gold trophy!

Me and my best friend Leo found a secret cave. It was behind the big school gym. Leo was coaching me on how to climb the rocks. I got a bad stain on my pants from the dirt.

"Listen! Do you hear that weird noise?" asked Leo.

We went inside and it was super dark and scary. My thumb got stuck in a small crack in the wall. I pulled it out hard and hurt my feeling. Suddenly, a big door slammed shut behind us! We were trapped inside the cave forever!

"We need a bungee cord to jump down there!" I yelled.

We didn't have one but we obtained a long rope. We climbed down and saw a dragon eating toasted bread. We ran away fast and escaped the cave. It was the best adventure ever.

It was my birthday and I was turning thirteen soon. We had a party in the backyard with my friends. My neighbor came over because he is nice. He brought a big pot of stewed apples for dessert.

We played soccer like we were in a big league. I grabbed the ball and ran very fast.
"Look at me go!" I shouted to everyone.
My friend Sam yelled back, "You are the champion!"

We stopped playing and went to the chocolate fountain. It appeared like magic on the table. We counted all the marshmallows on our sticks. I blew out the candles on my cake. Although I was tired, I didn't want to sleep. I will remember this day forever. I was so happy following my friends around the yard. It was the best meeting of my friends ever.

Me and my friend Leo were playing outside. We saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. It looked like a giant castle. I shouted to Leo, "I bet there is treasure at the top!"

We climbed up high and I touched a soft green leaf. Then we saw a blue feather. It was glowing! Suddenly a bird landed next to us. It started singing a weird song. It sounded like a foreign language or maybe a computer code.

"This is important!" said Leo. "Maybe it's a magic map."

We were hungry but we didn't stop. We kept seeing shiny things. Then my mom called us for dinner. The adventure was closed for now. I went to bed dreaming about the bird. I had a grass stain on my pants but I was happy. I felt like a real captain of the tree.

My neighbor moved away last week and left her cat. The cat appeared on my porch looking sad. Mom says cats are like tiny tigers. I pushed a bowl of milk to him.

"Here kitty," I said quietly. "Don't be scared."

He drank it all fast. He had so much energy like he had caffeine! He ran in circles leading me to the big oak tree. The weather was getting windy and cold. I feared the rain was coming soon.

"We need to go inside now," I told him.

He jumped into my arms. I guarantee he will be my best friend. Now he will reign over my house like a king. Science says cats purr when happy, and he is purring loud.

My robot named Zork was acting very weird today. He was swinging his metal arms around the kitchen. I looked at his schedule but it was wrong. He was supposed to be cleaning my room now.

"Stop moving, Zork!" I yelled at him loudly.

Zork did not stop and his red eyes flashed. He pointed a long metal finger at the fridge. I was scared he might zap the milk.

"I am yearning for pizza," Zork said in a robot voice.

Robots do not eat pizza so that was super strange. I had to search for his off button quickly. I tried to wrap a blanket around him too. It didn't work and he kept beeping at me. I didn't know what to do so I ran away. I don't think he will clean my room either.

I was walking in the jungle with my robot dog named Sparky. Sparky is cool because he can fly and shoot lasers. Suddenly we saw a big green alien floating in the air. The alien looked scary and twisted like a pretzel.

"Watch out for danger!" I yelled at Sparky.

Sparky started barking and jumping up and down. The alien spoke in a deep groaning voice.

"I am lost," the alien said sadly.

I felt bad even though he looked weird. I wrote down directions on a piece of paper. The alien smiled and gradually started to glow. Then he flew away into the surrounding trees. Our mission was complete! Sparky was happy and started coaching me on how to fly too.

My robot friend named Zork crashed in the park. He was scorched from the fire but still okay. I climbed inside him to fix his wires. I discovered a loose red thread near his battery. I pulled it and Zork suddenly woke up! He started jumping up and down very fast.

"Stop jumping, Zork!" I screamed loudly at him.

"I need company to play a game," Zork beeped.

We played tag and I ran super fast. I won the game because I have super speed powers. Zork was happy and gave me a metal high-five. We flew home before my mom saw us.

Me and Jake went to the spooky old building. It was dark and the ceiling was really high. We heard a thumping sound on the ground.

"I think we have company," Jake whispered scared.

Something huge was approaching us from the shadows. It looked weird and had big teeth. I dropped a crumb from my sandwich. The monster roared and I felt like swearing.

"Remember the trap!" I shouted at Jake.

We pulled the rope and a net fell down. Gravity pulled the monster to the floor. We ran outside and smelled roasted peanuts.

"We are totally earning a medal for this," Jake said.

We did not wrap up the monster, but we escaped.

Yesterday was the greatest day at school ever. We had a huge science project about rocks. My teacher Mrs. Green put a mountain of clay on the table.

"Start searching for the best rocks," she said loudly.

I was grateful because I love digging in dirt. The whole class was surrounding the table. We were loading our pockets with little stones. The scenery in the classroom looked messy but fun.

Then lunch neared and my tummy growled. I ran to the cafeteria following my best friend Sam.

"Did you find a gold rock?" Sam asked me.

"No, but I found a shiny blue one!" I yelled.

It was the best day because we didn't do any math. I hope we search for bugs tomorrow.

Me and my friend Sam walked into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. A cold breeze blew and the trees shook scary.

"I am scared," said Sam.

"Do not worry," I said. "I have the map."

We neared a big old bridge made of wood. It looked weak but we had to cross it. I held the map tight and stepped on the wood. The bridge moved under my weight! A giant green beetle crawled on my shoe and I screamed loud. Neither of us wanted to fall in the river. We ran fast and crossed to the other side safely. Then the sun disappeared behind a cloud and thunder struck. I remembered the X was near the big rock. We dug fast and found a gold box!

Me and my best friend Ben climbed the big mountain. We wanted to find the secret cave at the top. The wind was sounding really loud and scary. Suddenly, a tiny bug flew in my eye.

"Ow! It's a gnat!" I yelled and rubbed my face.

Ben laughed but then he stopped and looked scared. He pointed his thumb at a dark hole in the rocks. We walked closer and saw a shiny gold coin inside. I was so thrilled.

"I think a pirate captain left this here," Ben spoke softly.

Just then, lightning struck a tree near us. We understood it was time to leave fast. We ran all the way home with the gold coin. We were safe, but we wanted to go back again soon.

It was time for recess and I was so excited. I ran outside fast and almost went bumping into my friend Sam. Sam is really tall and has a lot of height. We wanted to play four-square because I am the champion.

"Watch out!" Sam yelled when the ball came fast.

The sun was hot and it scorched the blacktop ground. I looked at the ball and struck it hard with my hand. It bounced past Sam and escaped the square. My hands were trembling because I wanted to win so bad. Then the teacher pulled a whistle out of her pocket.

"Recess is over, everyone line up!" she shouted loudly.

I was sad but I won the game. We walked back inside for math class. It was a good day.

I knew today was the big race. The weather was hot and sunny for running. I remember my dad training with me all week. My heart was pumping fast at the starting line.

"Listen for the whistle!" my coach yelled loudly.

The whistle blew and every single kid took off. At the beginning I was slow but I grew faster. My legs were moving but my brain was tired. I saw my friend hanging back near the trees. I kept running and did not stop.

"You are doing it!" my mom shouted at me.

I crossed the finish line and crashed into the grass. It was the most important race of the year. I love reading about sports but doing them is better.

Me and my friend Sam were playing Mario Kart. It was the beginning of the big race. My feeling was happy because I picked Yoshi. The race started and we drove very fast through the castle. It was dangerous because of the lava.

Sam hit a banana and his car screeched loudly.

"Oh no! I am in big trouble now," Sam yelled.

I drove past him but then I fell off the track. It felt impossible to win. I scratched my head and tried harder. Suddenly, I got a star power-up! I went faster and no longer felt anger. It was like I bungee jumped over the finish line.

"You won again!" said Sam. "I wanted company on the podium."

We laughed and then we swam in my pool.

It was my birthday and it was raining all day. I was sad because I wanted to go to the park. But my mom said we could have a party inside. My best friend Max came over to my house. He gave me a present with a blue feather on top.

"Open it now!" said Max.

Inside the box was a cool toy car. Then my mom treated us to pizza and plain cake. We drank soda but Mom said it had too much caffeine. We ran around the living room like crazy. Suddenly the pizza disappeared from the table! My dog Sparky ate it all.

"Oh no Sparky!" I yelled.

We laughed because Sparky looked funny with sauce on his nose. I am earning money to buy more pizza next time. It was a good birthday even if we didn't go out. There was enough fun for everyone.

It was my best birthday ever. My neighbor came over for a sleepover and we made a fort. We grasped some blankets and pulled them tight. Then we pretended to be pirates on a ship. We saw a big jewel in the corner of the room. I ran to get it but I tripped on my rug.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Sam.
"I bit my tongue!" I yelled while groaning.

My mom came in with dinner and it smelled good. She stewed some carrots and beef in a big pot. But the soup was super hot and it scorched my mouth.

"Blow on it first," said Mom.

We ate fast and then we flew back to the fort. We talked about science class and stayed up really late.

My brother Tim was having a sleepover for his birthday. We set up a tent in the living room for sleeping. Tim’s friend Jake bounced on the air mattress too hard. He knocked over a bowl of chips and dip.

"You are going to be in so much trouble!" I yelled.

Jake looked like a weird scared creature in the dark. We cleaned it up fast before Mom came in. Then we played a pirate game about finding treasure. I pretended to be a zombie moaning near the door.

"Stop making that noise, I'm loading the game," Tim said.

Mom brought us burgers for dinner because they have protein. It was the best sleepover ever until Jake snored all night.

One day me and my brother Sam went exploring. We walked for a long time until we saw a cave. The breeze was cold and made my finger shake.

"Should we go in?" asked Sam quietly.

"Yes, but be careful," I whispered back.

Inside it smelled like something was roasted or toasted. We saw a green creature sitting by a fire. It brewed a pot of soup and started to gnaw on a bone. The monster spread its big wings.

Suddenly it saw us! We struggled to run but our feet felt heavy. We ran for fourteen minutes without speaking.

"That was scary," said Sam. "Something felt wrong."

We went home and read the newspaper instead. We did not want to receive another scare any longer.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were so hungry. My mom made us scrambled eggs but she scorched them. They were black and smelled really bad. 

"I am not eating that," said my friend Sam. 

"Me either," I said. 

My mom cleared the plates away and sighed. Then we heard a knock at the door. It was our neighbor Mrs. Miller. She had a huge pepperoni pizza in her hands. She found a coupon and wanted to share. We sank our teeth into the pizza and it was so good. Later we played jungle explorers in my room until it was really late. We put our sleeping bags on the floor but it was freezing. 

"Can you turn up the heat?" Sam asked.

It was the best birthday ever.

Yesterday at school was super crazy. We had math first and Mrs. Green taught us big subtraction. It was hard so everyone was groaning loudly. Then it was finally time for lunch. I bought a pizza slice and some chocolate milk.

We ran outside for recess to play tag. Sammy said, “I am stronger than you!” He chased me fast but then he crashed into the slide. He hurt his finger but he didn’t cry. He crawled under the swings to hide.

Later we went to the computer lab. My game was loading forever and it was boring. Then the bell rang and school was over. “See you tomorrow!” I yelled to Sammy. It was a pretty good day.

I grasped my pencil and looked at the math test. It was growing harder every minute. My head hurt and I felt a sneeze coming.

"Don't worry, Sam," said my friend Leo. "Use your brain strength!"

I drew a little picture on the corner of the paper. It was a dog doing a bungee jump off a cliff. Suddenly, the teacher walked by and I had to seize my paper quickly. I accidentally crushed it in my hand.

"Oh no!" I whispered to Leo. "My test is wrinkled."

Neither of us knew the last answer. But then the bell rang for recess. We ran outside to play tag. School is hard but recess is the best part of the day.

Me and my younger brother Tim went to the woods. We were loading our backpacks with snacks and juice. We walked for a long time across a big plain. Suddenly a huge bear appeared near a cave! It looked scary but then it started speaking.

"I need help finding my lost hat," said the bear.

Tim is smart and he used his brain. He saw something shiny up in a tall tree. We climbed up the tree really fast. The bear’s hat was stuck on a branch! We got it down and the bear was so happy.

"You are a true champion!" the bear shouted.

The bear was actually very pleasant and nice. We played tag and stayed a little longer. Then we saw our mom approaching so we ran home. It was the best day ever.

My cat Fluffy is really crazy sometimes. Yesterday she ran straight up the big oak tree. She went to a scary height and got stuck. I was loading my backpack for school when I heard her.

"Meow! Help me!" she cried from the branch.

My neighbor Mr. Jones came outside to look. He grinned and went to get his big ladder. He teaches science at the high school. He is very tall.

Fluffy was clinging to the bark and shaking. Mr. Jones was slowly approaching her with the ladder. He grabbed her and she scrambled onto his shoulder. She looked like a monkey jumping around.

"You are a silly cat," Mr. Jones said.

We were so grateful to him. Fluffy ran inside and hid near the ceiling on her tall cat tower. She is safe now.

It was the beginning of our big adventure. My friend Sam and I wanted to explore the old castle on the hill. Everyone said a king used to reign there, but now it was scary. We walked up the hill and my heart was beating fast.

Suddenly, a loud noise screeched from inside the dark cave. Sam shouted, "Run away fast!" but I did not move. I thought I saw a shiny gold crown on the ground. Maybe I was dreaming, but it looked very real.

I scratched my head and stepped closer to the shiny thing. It was just a gold candy wrapper! We laughed and decided to go home. We did not receive any treasure that day. Sam said he caught a cold, but I hope it isn't pneumonia. We will go back another day to find the real gold.

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old cave. We were jumping over big rocks and felt very brave. I gripped my flashlight tight because it was dark inside. Suddenly Sam disappeared behind a huge wall of stone.

"Sam! Where did you go?" I shouted loudly.

"I found a secret room!" Sam yelled back.

I had to squeeze through a tiny hole to see him. We discovered a big wooden box in the corner. It looked like it was crushed by a rock. Inside was an old newspaper and a map. We were so pleased. We knew the meaning of the map was treasure. Then we heard a loud noise and crashed into each other. We thought it was a bear but we were just hungry.

"Let's go home and eat pizza," I said.

My dog Buster woke me up early today. He was moaning and bumping his nose on me. We went outside and started roaming around the big park. I held his leash tight because he gets scared often.

We saw a sign near the old brick building. It said do not enter but Buster chewed on a stick there. Suddenly a squirrel screeched loudly from a tree! Buster pulled hard and almost fell in the water fountain.

"Stop it Buster!" I yelled at him.

"Woof!" he barked back at the squirrel.

We walked home and mom had stewed some carrots for lunch. I obtained a treat for Buster because he likes company. He is a silly dog but he is my best friend.

I was playing the best video game ever called "Space Jump." My score was growing and growing, and I felt like I was in heaven. I counted eight bad guys on the screen. My fingers moved fast like a feather. Suddenly, the power went out throughout the whole house! The screen disappeared and turned black. I started to complain loudly.

"Hey! I was winning!" I yelled.

My mom grabbed a flashlight and came into the room. "We searched for candles, but we don't have any either," she said.

I used my brain and remembered my dad’s camping lantern. We found it and played cards instead. It was actually really fun. I counted my cards and I won the game!

For my birthday, my dad took me boating on the lake. We started early in the morning while my mom was still sleeping. We were loading the boat with snacks and fishing poles. It felt like a big adventure. I ran straight to the front of the boat. My dad said, “Sit down or you might fall in!” I sat down and looked at the water.

Suddenly, I saw a duck meeting another duck. They were loud. My dad pushed the gas, and we went fast. I pretended to seize the wheel like a captain. I felt like a king starting his reign. Later, we ate lunch on a big wooden balcony by the water.

“This is the best birthday ever,” I told my dad. He smiled and gave me a big hug.

We went on a big adventure in the jungle today. It was raining hard and the wind blew loudly. We crawled through the wet mud to find the treasure. Suddenly a big gray elephant walked straight at us!

"Look out!" I yelled and threw a rock away.

The elephant looked at the rock and then disappeared. We kept walking and bringing our heavy bags with us. My friend obtained a shiny gold key under a leaf. We were yearning to open the secret box. But then my foot got caught in a vine!

"Help me please!" I spoke to my friend.

He cut the vine and we ran home fast. It was scary but fun.

One day my friend Sam came over to play. We went into the basement and saw a weird glowing door. I opened it and suddenly we were in a jungle.

"Where are we?" asked Sam.

"I don't know but we need to run!" I yelled.

A big robot monkey chased us through the trees. My heart was pumping super fast and I was scared. We sprinted to a cave and hid behind a rock. The robot crashed into a tree and fell down.

Then Sam realized something crazy happened. He pulled a computer out of his backpack.

"I think this controls the robot," he said.

He threw a switch on the screen and the robot grew small. A blue vein on the robot stopped glowing. We were safe and we went back home for snacks.

My robot named Zorg crashed into my neighbor's yard. I was scared because Zorg stole my mom's singing flower. The flower grew huge and started groaning loudly. It sounded like a monster! My neighbor came out with a newspaper and looked mad.

"Is that your robot?" he yelled at me.

"Yes, and he grabbed the magic flower!" I shouted back.

Zorg moved his metal finger and pointed at a big sign. The sign said "Do Not Touch." Suddenly, the flower stopped singing and turned into a tiny bug. Zorg won the fight! I was thrilled and ran to get him. Now Zorg and I reign over the backyard. We saw a spaceship approaching but that is a story for tomorrow.

I went to the park with my dog Rex. We saw a squirrel near the big stone fountain. Rex barked and the squirrel ran up a tree. I counted three birds sitting on a branch. They looked weird and stared at us.

"Come here Rex!" I called loudly.

He didn't listen and followed a butterfly instead. He ran toward the surrounding bushes. I feared he would get lost. Suddenly a cat appeared on the ground. It hissed at Rex and he jumped back.

"Stop being scary," I told the cat.

Rex came back to me. We walked home and I could explain everything to Mom. We ate roasted chicken for dinner. I was coaching Rex to sit but he wouldn't. Gravity made his heavy tail hit the floor hard. We didn't want to go back outside either.

I was so excited because it was my birthday party. My mom is the greatest because she planned a sleepover. My friends came over and they were bringing lots of presents. We ate pizza and then my dad pretended to be a sailor. He wore a funny hat and looked through a tube.

"Ahoy matey!" he shouted very loud.

We laughed so hard that I got a weird feeling. Then we played a game with a needle and a balloon. My friend Sarah reached for the balloon but she fell down. She broke a lamp but my mom said it was okay. I was certain she would be mad but she wasn't.

"I am grateful you are not hurt," my mom said.

Sarah felt better already and we ate cake. It was the best night ever until my dad left the room. Then we jumped on the bed like we were bungee jumping.

My nephew Ben and I trained for the meeting. We were going to find the lost jewel. It was hidden deep in a dark cave. We walked for a long time and saw it approaching.

"I am seeing something shiny!" shouted Ben loudly.

The cave was scary but also very beautiful inside. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound nearby. A big rock fell and we were trapped!

"Do you understand the science of leverage?" I asked.

I was yearning to get out fast. We pushed the rock with a big stick. It moved and we grabbed the jewel. We ran home wearing big smiles. Exploring is scary but we were brave.

It was my birthday and I was so excited. My friends came over for a sleepover and we ate pizza. We played a game where we had to search for hidden treasure. I drew a map that looked like a big mountain. My friend Sam found a shiny blue jewel under the couch. Everyone was cheering for him and he was happy.

"I feared I would never find it!" Sam yelled loudly.

Then we went outside because there was a nice cool breeze. We played near the water fountain in the garden. It was already getting dark so we went back inside. My mom said the party was just beginning. It meant we could stay up late and eat cake. I grew very tired but I did not feel like leaving the fun.

"This is the best birthday ever," I told my mom.

My best friend Sam had a sleepover for his birthday. It was the beginning of summer, and we stayed up super late. We played hide and seek in the dark outside. I hid behind a big bush near the fence. Suddenly, I heard a weird noise that sounded totally foreign. It was like an alien from earth, but different.

"Did you hear that?" Sam whispered very loudly.

"I think it came from the shed!" I yelled back.

We ran inside and screeched when the door slammed shut. Snacks were scattered everywhere on the floor. We decided to wrap ourselves in blankets and watch movies instead. My mom says we ate everything in the kitchen that night. It was the best sleepover ever.

I was walking through the woods with my dog. His name is Rex and he likes chasing squirrels. Suddenly a big squirrel appeared on a rock. Rex started barking and he ran very fast.

"Stop Rex!" I yelled but he didn't listen.

He jumped over a log and landed in a mud puddle. The mud went everywhere! I grabbed his collar but he was slippery. We climbed up a small hill that looked like a mountain. Rex was tired and he was groaning a little bit.

"That is enough running for today," I told him.

I counted three pinecones on the ground. My dad is coaching my soccer team tonight. We needed to go home and wash the dog. Being outside is fun but very messy.

I was walking my dog named Buster outside our apartment. He was wearing his blue vest and sniffing a beetle. Buster pulled on his chain because he saw a squirrel.

"Stop pulling, Buster!" I yelled, but he bounced around.

I thought he saw a ghost because he barked at nothing. Then I saw a big thumb tack on the ground. Buster almost stepped on it! I picked it up.

"That was close," I said to Buster.

Suddenly, the squirrel disappeared up a tree like gravity didn't work. We walked home because it was already getting dark. I am dreaming about playing with him tomorrow at the plain park. Gradually, Buster fell asleep on my rug.

I sat at my desk and looked out the window. My teacher was talking about math, but I wasn't listening. I knew I should pay attention, but my imagination was huge. The classroom grew into a big green jungle. Vines hung from the lights and monkeys swung around. 

"Timmy, please stop daydreaming," Mrs. Green said loudly.

"Sorry, Mrs. Green," I said. 

I opened my book, but the numbers looked like bugs. It felt like I was trapped in a boring cage. I wanted to go home to my apartment. I had a new puppy waiting there. I trained him to sit yesterday. School is okay, but I never complain when the bell rings. I grabbed the lunch box I brought and ran outside. Recess is the best part of the day because there is no danger of homework there.

My birthday was on a Wednesday this year. I sat on the ground and waited for my friends. Suddenly there was a loud knock on the door. I ran to open it and it was Sarah! She threw a big present at me.

"Is that a new computer game?" I asked her.

"Open it and see!" she said with a weird smile.

We ate cake and then played outside. A tiny gnat flew in my eye and it hurt. Sarah had the strength to open the pickle jar for lunch. Neither of us wanted to stop playing. Gradually the sun went down and my breathing got slow. It was like heaven when I finally went to sleep. It was an important day.

My friends and I went camping near the big dark forest. We slept in a tent but I wanted to explore. I heard singing so I started walking deeper into the woods. My friend Sam followed me and looked very scared. We saw a giant frog jumping on a big rock.

"That frog is huge!" yelled Sam very loudly.

The frog stopped jumping and looked right at us. I realized it was guarding a golden key on the ground. It was incredible and shiny.

"Let's grab it," I whispered to Sam.

We ran fast but the frog was faster. We ran back to the tent and didn't go back. Our adventure was over but it was super scary. Next time we will just stay in my apartment.

Max lived in a tall apartment in the city. He had an incredible map from his grandpa. It showed where pirate gold was hiding. Max called his friend Sam and they started loading their backpacks.

"I have a yearning for adventure!" shouted Sam.

"I know we will find the treasure," said Max.

They ran to the park and crawled under a big bush. It was dark but they were brave. Suddenly a bird flew out and scared them. Max struggled to get through the thick branches.

They found a box and spread out the gold inside. It was just chocolate coins wrapped in foil! They sat down and ate the roasted peanuts they brought too.

"To be honest, this is better than gold," Sam laughed.

They went home earning tummy aches but feeling happy.

My dog Sparky moved very fast across the grass. He saw a squirrel and pulled hard on his leash. The squirrel flew up a tree and scratched the bark.

"Come back here!" I shouted at Sparky.

Sparky didn't listen to my schedule for our walk. He crashed through a bush and crossed the path. The wind blew his big ears around his face. I was groaning because he was so strong.

Then he stopped and stared at the ground. He was seeing a tiny baby bird there. I thought he would bite it, but he didn't. He just sniffed it gently.

"Good boy, Sparky," I said quietly.

I had to wrap the bird in my jacket. We walked home so I could write about it in my journal.

My dog Max and I went exploring in the woods today. We pretended we were on a secret island in the ocean. Max was jumping over big logs like a trained tiger. Suddenly, I saw something floating in the river nearby. It looked like a pirate ship approaching fast!

"Look out Max, it is danger!" I yelled loudly.

Max barked at the water and wagged his tail. We ran fast and crashed into a pile of leaves. My imagination made everything look scary and fun. Then I opened my backpack and found our lunch. We ate sandwiches and drank juice like kings. Our reign of the forest was over when my nephew called us.

"Come inside, we have stewed carrots for dinner!" he shouted.

We walked home tired but happy.

My dog Buster loves going to the woods for company. We walked on the path leading to the big river. Buster ran straight ahead and barked at a squirrel. The squirrel moved with a funny rhythm up the tree.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled really loud.

Buster did not listen and chased a tiny green creature. It looked impossible to catch because it was so fast. I was a little afraid he would get lost. But Buster came back wagging his tail. He did not complain about missing the creature.

"Good boy," I said and gave him a treat. We walked home happy and tired.

We went to the spooky forest for an adventure. My brother Tom brought his old guitar. He played a song with a fast rhythm. Suddenly we saw a big bear roaming around. It looked very scary and had huge strength. We crawled under a bush to hide from it. The bear sniffed the air and walked past us.

"That was close!" Tom whispered to me.

"I think he wants roasted marshmallows," I said.

We walked deeper and found a golden crown. It was heavy and had a lot of weight. Tom put it on and acted like a king.

"My reign starts now!" he shouted loudly.

We simply ran home before the bear came back. It was the best day ever.

My robot dog Sparky got lost in the jungle yesterday. I looked for him for eight hours. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. Then I saw a trail of scorched grass leading away. It looked like a dragon burned it.

I followed the black marks and saw Sparky clinging to a tree. A green alien was trying to measure him with a ruler!

"Hey! Get away from my dog!" I yelled super loud.

The alien looked scared and dropped his silver scissors.

"Sorry, I thought he was a space toaster," the alien said.

I caught Sparky as he jumped down. It seemed impossible but we ran home safe. I could see electricity like a blue vein glowing on Sparky's side. He was happy to be back.

My brother Max is the greatest superhero ever. He lives in our small apartment and he has a secret. He grabbed his cape and called his robot dog, Sparky.

"We have to save the moon!" Max yelled loudly.

I grumbled because I was cleaning my room. I wanted to go though. Max counted to fourteen and then pushed a red button. Suddenly, the messy room disappeared. We were in space instead! I looked out the window, yearning to see an alien.

"Look at that green slime!" I shouted, seeing a big monster.

The monster especially liked eating rocks. We did not remain there long. Max used his laser eyes and scared it away. We were safe again.

My friend Sam came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to make a fort in the living room. We threw blankets over the chairs and it looked awesome. It was like a big castle for a brave knight.

Suddenly, my little sister appeared and knocked it all down.

"Hey! You ruined our base!" I yelled at her.

"I just wanted to play too," she said sadly.

Sam and I felt bad so we let her help. We toasted some marshmallows in the microwave for a snack. One marshmallow grew huge and exploded inside. It left a sticky stain but we cleaned it immediately. Then my dad drove us to get pizza because of the failure. It was the best sleepover ever and I will always remember it.

My neighbor Sam and I love playing video games together. One day we played a new game called "Bungee Jump Hero." The game was weird but really fun to play. I grasped the controller tight because I was nervous. 

"I bet I can jump farther than you," Sam yelled loudly.

"No way, I am the champion of jumping," I said back.

We had to squeeze the buttons to make our guys jump. I watched my score growing higher and higher on the screen. The computer had to measure who went the longest distance. For some reason, my guy fell off the cliff. I lost the game but we laughed a lot. Next time I will beat Sam for sure.

It was Wednesday and I forgot my lunch box immediately. I felt sad because my mom packed a wonderful sandwich. At lunchtime, my friend Jake saw me looking at the scenery outside. The sun scorched the playground grass and it looked hot.

"Do you want half of my toasted cheese?" asked Jake.

"Yes please!" I said and I started tearing into it.

We pretended the cheese was gold treasure from a pirate ship. Then the strict lunch lady walked by like an army colonel. We stopped talking and ate fast. Later at recess, we found a white feather near the swings. We pretended we were boating on the ocean and saw a bird. It was a good day even without my own lunch.

My nephew Tommy came over for his birthday party today. He is only four, but he was feeling very big. We had lots of company at our house for cake. My mom made a chocolate cake with fourteen candles on it. That was a joke though because Tommy is not fourteen!

We started singing "Happy Birthday" really loud. Tommy was stamping his feet because he was so happy.

"Make a wish and blow!" I yelled at him.

He blew for a long time but missed one candle. I thought he would cry, but he just laughed. He played with his new trucks a little longer. It was a fun party, and I ate two pieces of cake.

Me and my best friend Sam were exploring the woods. We were looking for worms in the ground for science class. Sam dug into the soft earth with his shovel.

"Look at this big one!" Sam yelled loudly.

It was the beginning of our worm collection. We kept digging and found five more worms. Suddenly we heard a noise coming through the bushes. It sounded scary and maybe a little dangerous. We ran fast to the old stone fountain.

"What happened?" I asked Sam because he stopped running.

He pointed at a baby bunny growing in the grass. It wasn't scary, just cute and earning its dinner. We watched it eat enough clover and then we went home. The woods were closed now because it was getting dark outside.

It was lunchtime and I was super hungry. I opened my lunchbox and saw a big mess inside. My juice box had crashed into my apple.

"Oh no, my juice is everywhere!" I told my friend Sam.

Sam looked inside and made a funny face. "That looks like stewed garbage," he said.

I knew he was right because everything was sticky. My sandwich looked scrambled up and gross. I tried to use all my strength to clean it, but it was too wet. I counted my coins to buy a pizza, but I only had ten cents.

"You can share my chips," Sam said nicely.

We read comic books while we ate the chips. It was better than my soggy lunch. Next time I will pack my bag better so I don't get a grounding from my mom for wasting food.

Yesterday was the best day at school ever. We went outside for recess and played kickball in the big meadow behind the playground. I was the team captain so I picked my friends first.

Then my friend Billy kicked the ball super hard. It went way over the fence and dropped into the bushes. We ran to get it and my heart was thumping fast.

"I can't reach it!" Billy yelled.

"Let me try," I said.

I reached way down and finally touched the ball. It was dirty but we kept playing. Later we had to measure things in math class with rulers. I was so thirsty I ran to the water fountain three times. I can't wait for our class camping trip next week. School is actually pretty fun sometimes.

My friend Sam and I found a map. It had a weird design on the back. We knew it was a treasure map. The wind blew hard, but we ran to the old forest.

Sam tripped on a twisted root and fell. He crushed some berries on his shirt.

"Oh no! My mom will see this stain," Sam cried.

"We can clean it later," I said. "Look there!"

We saw a cave with a strange painting. It looked like a giant comb. We went inside to explore. A bat flew out and we screamed! We ran back home fast. We didn't find gold, but we did learn something. Never explore without a flashlight or you might get in trouble.

I woke up early because the weather was sunny. I went outside wearing my big red boots. I walked to the woods behind my house. I discovered a weird rock near the big tree. It looked different from all the other rocks.

Suddenly, I heard something screaming in the bushes! I dropped the rock and ran over there. It was my cat Fluffy bumping into a stick. She was stuck.

"Help me!" she meowed loudly. That meant she wanted company.

I cleared the sticks away and picked her up. She purred, meaning she was happy now. We walked home and I screamed, "Look everyone! I saved Fluffy!"

My mom smiled and said, "Good job being brave."

We went inside and had a snack. Exploring is fun but saving cats is better.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were camping outside. My friends and I looked for sticks throughout the yard. We wanted to make s'mores but suddenly we heard a noise.

"What is that big creature?" shouted my friend Ben.

We feared it was a bear so we ran inside. I struggled to open the door but finally we reached safety. We felt trapped inside because we really wanted marshmallows. My dad came in with a knife for the cake.

"Do you know there is a monster outside?" I asked him.

Dad laughed and discovered it was just our dog, Spot. Spot had scorched his fur a little bit on the lantern. We didn't need a hospital but Spot looked funny. We ate cake inside instead.

My day at school was the greatest ever. We had science class and we grasped heavy rocks. The teacher said to feel the weight of them. Then it was lunchtime and I had a big protein bar. I put it on the table and talked to Sam. Suddenly a big seagull flew down and stole my bar! I was screaming so loud but the bird just flew away.

"Hey that was mine!" I yelled at the sky.

Sam laughed and threw me his apple. "You can have this."

I caught it with my left hand. We ate our food and then the bell rang for recess. We ran outside to play tag. It was a super fun day even with the bad bird.

My dog Buster loves playing outside in the big woods. We went exploring yesterday and saw lots of cool bugs. Buster was jumping over a log and he spotted something shiny. It was a huge green beetle climbing on a rock. Buster tried to catch it but the beetle was too fast.

"You aren't fast enough, Buster!" I shouted and laughed.

Suddenly, Buster slipped and he dropped into a small hole. He landed with a thud but he was totally okay. I reached down and pulled him out by his collar. It was like he was bungee jumping without a cord!

"That was scary," I said while checking his paws.

We treated ourselves to a snack after that big scare. We sat on the grass and ate some roasted peanuts. I was glad gravity works or Buster might have floated away!

My neighbor Mr. Smith is very old and funny. He came to my birthday party on Saturday. We had a big cake with fourteen candles on it. My dog chewed on a present but it was okay. Mr. Smith told us a story about a hidden jewel. He tapped his head and said, “Use your brain to find it!” We looked all over the yard for a long time. I started to complain because it was getting hot outside. Then I saw a blue vein on a rock. It was actually a painted rock he hid for us! “That is wonderful!” my mom yelled when we found it. I will remember this birthday for a long time. It was great seeing everyone have fun together.

Me and my neighbor Sam went into the woods. We were looking for a dragon from my imagination. It was a beautiful day but the woods were weird. We walked for a long time and saw a cave.

"I am scared," said Sam.

"Don't worry," I said. "I have a stick."

Suddenly a bear appeared! It was bearing its teeth at us. We realized it was not a dragon but it was scary. We ran fast and escaped the scene. We did not stop running until we got home. My mom was making dinner. We ate roasted chicken and toasted bread. Neither of us wanted to go back. After seeing that bear, we played inside instead.

I woke up at eight o'clock and missed my alarm. My mom said I need a schedule for waking up. I ate my breakfast very fast and ran to the bus. My stomach felt twisted because I forgot my math homework.

At school, I grasped my pencil tight during the test. I crossed my fingers for good luck. Then it was lunchtime and I was so grateful. I spread peanut butter on my bread and ate it all.

"Did you study for the spelling test?" asked my friend Sam.

"No, I discovered a cool video game instead," I said.

My teacher drank her coffee because she loves caffeine. It was a crazy day but I survived.

Last Saturday was my cousin Ben’s birthday party. My little nephew Sam was roaming around the backyard. He scratched his head and looked very confused. We played tag and then we discovered a big box. It was surrounding the big oak tree by the fence.

I struggled to open it because the tape was strong. Suddenly, a weird smell struck my nose like old cheese. Sam started moaning because he was hungry for cake. 

"What is inside that giant box?" asked Ben loudly.

"I think it is a new bike!" I yelled.

But it was impossible to open without scissors. My mom brewed some iced tea and came outside. She laughed and helped us open the box. It was actually a new playhouse! I thought it was cool but Sam just wanted cake. I will always remember this funny day.

It was a cold day in February and my friends and I went exploring. We were pretending to be in a big boating league for heroes. I am the greatest champion of all time! We walked into the woods and saw a dark cave. Suddenly, we heard a loud moaning sound inside.

"Did you hear that groaning?" asked my friend Sam.

"Yes, but I am not scared," I said bravely.

We started stamping our feet to scare the monster away. Then a big bear ran out immediately! I had a bad feeling in my tummy. We ran home very fast. I do not understand why bears are so scary. Being safe at home is the best.

I was dreaming about cake when my mom woke me up. It was finally my birthday! I ran straight to the kitchen. My dad was holding a small box with a feather on top. I was trembling because I was so excited.

"Open it fast!" said my dad.

I ripped the paper and it made a loud sounding noise. Inside was a new watch! But then my brother crashed into me. The watch fell and broke. I started crying.

"Don't worry, I still have the receipt," my mom said.

My brother looked scared. He thought he was getting a grounding. But we just went to the store and got a new one. It was the best birthday ever.

It was my birthday sleepover and we were so excited. My best friend Sam gripped his sleeping bag tight. We went straight to the backyard to look for bugs. Sam scratched his arm because a mosquito bit him.

Suddenly, I saw a huge black beetle on the grass.

"Look at that giant bug!" I yelled to Sam.

Sam tried to catch it but he dropped his flashlight. The beetle ran away into the bushes gradually. Then my mom came outside and looked mad. She screeched because she stepped on a sharp pine needle.

"You boys need to contain your noise right now!" she said.

I was scared of a grounding so we ran inside. We ate cake and it was the best birthday ever.

My dog Buster loves to dig in the dirt. One day he searched for a bone for an hour. He dug a big hole straight down into the earth. Mud got on his nose and he looked very funny. I opened the back door and yelled at him.

"Buster, stop that digging right now!" I shouted loud.

Buster looked at me and wagged his tail fast. He thought digging was a pleasure and great fun. But my mom saw the mess and was not pleased. She started swearing a little bit under her breath.

"Oh no, look at my nice flowers!" Mom said.

Buster ran to me because he knew he did wrong. We had to give him a bath and he hated it. Next time I will hide his bone better.

My best friend Sam and I went to the old cave. It was the greatest adventure ever. We wanted to find the lost pirate treasure. A cool breeze blew through the dark tunnel.

"This is scary," Sam grumbled.

"We have to be brave," I said.

We walked deeper and saw something shiny. It was a red jewel on a rock! But then we heard a loud stamping noise. A big bear was there! We ran fast and escaped outside. We almost got eaten but we kept the jewel. It was very important to us. Later we sold it for a hundred dollars. We bought lots of candy and hung out all day. It was fun.

My brother and I walked through the big woods. We were looking for a secret treasure map. It was already dark, but we had flashlights. Suddenly, we saw a giant stone fountain. It looked very old and dangerous.

"Look at that weird water," said my brother.

The water was green and bubbling like soda. I was reading a sign on the fountain. It said the king’s reign was over. We found a small box near the water. Inside was a piece of paper like a receipt. It said we had to complete a puzzle.

"This is too hard," I said.

My brother was dumping out his backpack though. He found a chocolate bar with caffeine. We ate it and solved the puzzle fast! We won the treasure!

One day I was walking home from the hospital. I gripped my backpack tight because it was shaking. Inside I had a tiny robot named Zorg. He was growing bigger every single minute!

Suddenly a big spaceship appeared in the plain sky. It was fourteen feet wide and looked scary.

"We need the robot!" the alien yelled down.

"No way, he is important to me!" I shouted back.

I pushed a button on my backpack to hide him. Zorg jumped out and started playing a tiny electric guitar. The music made a forcefield that could contain the aliens. They flew away fast. I looked at the receipt in my pocket. It said NO RETURNS. I am keeping him forever.

My teacher gave us a huge project about space today. I was groaning because I just wanted to go to recess. We had to explain what it feels like in space. I searched through my big blue book for answers.

"Do you know how gravity works?" asked my friend Sam.

"It makes you heavy and keeps you down," I said.

Sam laughed and then let out a huge sneeze. We discovered that astronauts feel like they are floating. It is like doing a bungee jump but really slow. I obtained an A on my paper because I worked hard. My teacher said it was a very pleasant story. I was dreaming about being an astronaut all night. It was fun to seize the day at school.

I was playing baseball with my brother at the park. He is fourteen and throws the ball super fast. I was holding the bat and swinging it hard. Suddenly the ball hit my leg and it was really stinging!

"Ouch, stop throwing it so hard!" I screamed. I was moaning because it hurt a lot.

"You have to be faster," my brother grinned.

I rubbed the red stain on my pants. I wanted to write him a mean note later. But then I saw the ball approaching again. I squeezed the bat tight and hit it! It went flying over the chain fence where people go camping. We discovered the ball later near a plastic knife. I started jumping up and down because I finally won.

My robot friend Zap was wearing a shiny silver suit. We were going on a big space adventure today. Zap looked at the map and pointed a metal finger.

"We are following the blue stars," Zap beeped loudly.

We flew past eight green planets and saw some aliens. The aliens looked friendly although I feared they might eat us. Suddenly, my spaceship started shaking and smoke scattered everywhere!

"Oh no! My science project is broken!" I yelled.

Zap fixed the engine with his laser eyes quickly. We landed on a pink moon and met the king's daughter. She had three eyes and gave us space cookies. It was the best day ever.

It was a sunny Wednesday and me and Sam went exploring. We walked to the old spooky forest behind my house. The trees were twisted and looked like scary monsters. Sam was wearing his lucky red cape. We saw a dark cave and I felt brave. A big bat flew out and almost hit us!

"Look out!" yelled Sam and he ducked down fast.

I grasped my wooden sword and felt strong. A goblin greeted us with a mean growl. I drew my sword and the goblin ran away. I thought we were safe but I stepped on something. It was a bug and it got crushed. Sam started swearing because he stubbed his toe on a rock. We ran home fast before it got dark.

Me and my friend Sam went camping near the big lake. We wanted a real adventure so we went boating in my dad's canoe. The water was very different today and looked dark green. Suddenly we heard a scary moaning sound from the trees. Sam pulled the boat to the shore fast. 

"I knew we shouldn't have come here," Sam whispered.

Then a giant bear appeared behind a big fountain of rocks. I was so scared I almost dropped my sandwich crumb. I thought the bear would eat us but then it sneezed. It was just a robot bear! Someone was controlling it with a computer.

"That is the coolest thing ever," I said.

We counted fourteen other robot animals in the woods. It was the best day ever.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were pretending to be a brave knight and a wizard. The trees got bigger and the shadows got longer. Suddenly, we heard a scary moaning sound.

"Do you think it is a ghost?" whispered Sam.

"No way, ghosts are just floating sheets," I said.

We crawled under a big bush. My leg got scratched by a sharp stick. Then we saw a dark cave. Bones were scattered all over the ground! It looked like big danger. A bat flew out and struck Sam in the face. We screamed and ran all the way home. We are not going back there.

It was my birthday and I was waiting for my friends. My mom was keeping the cake in the kitchen. It was simply the best cake ever because it had blue frosting. My friend Sam came over first and we played tag. We ran to the water fountain at the park near my house. Sam did not complain even though he got wet. Then more friends came and we started cheering loudly.

"Happy birthday to you!" they all yelled at me.

"This is meant to be the best day," I said.

My grandma read me a funny card and gave me money. It was important to say thank you to everyone. We ate the cake and played until it was dark outside.

I was waiting for my favorite game to start loading. The screen showed a guy jumping with a bungee cord. It looked cool because he flipped upside down. My big brother Max walked in and looked at the ceiling. He was groaning because he was hungry.

"We have to beat level fourteen today," I said.

Max sat down and ate a protein bar. He also had some toasted bread with jam. It smelled wonderful.

"I don't understand how to beat the boss," Max said.

His face was twisted up because he was thinking hard. In the game, there was no gravity. We floated around like astronauts. We played for a long time and finally won!

My brother Tim and I went boating near the lake. We were wearing our bright orange life jackets. Suddenly, the boat hit the muddy earth and stopped fast. We were stuck on an island we didn't know.

"I think we are totally lost," said Tim sadly.

I touched his arm with my thumb to help him. "It is okay because we are explorers now!" I yelled.

We walked until we found a spooky cave. Inside was a fire that someone had just toasted huge marshmallows on. But the people were invisible! We ran back to the boat really fast.

Tim pushed the boat and I started rowing hard. We made it home before dinner. Being grounded is better than seeing invisible ghosts.

I was groaning because my homework was impossible. The math problems were super hard and I wanted to go play. I grabbed my backpack and ran through the door. I saw my friend Sam on the trail to school. We were swinging our lunch boxes and jumping over big rocks.

"Did you remember your permission slip?" Sam shouted.

"Oh no!" I yelled back. I scrambled to find it.

We kept walking and we were bumping into each other. Then we heard the bell ringing really loud. We ran fast to explain to the teacher why we were late. My schedule said we had gym first, so that was good. My little nephew loves gym too. It was a crazy morning but at least I had my slip.

One day my neighbor Tim and I went exploring. We wanted to find the secret cave in the woods. We walked for an hour and then we saw it. It looked dark and foreign and scary inside.

"I am honest, I am scared," said Tim.

"We did lots of training for this!" I said back.

We went inside and a big bat landed on Tim! He screamed but I shooed it away fast. We found a shiny rock in the back. I believed it was gold but it was just regular rock. It was growing dark outside so we ran home fast. The trip was not a failure because we were brave. We ate pizza after.

He walked straight through the dark trees until he saw something shiny. "I caught you!" he yelled at a little goblin holding the gold. The goblin dropped it and ran away fast. The knight thought he was super lucky. He grabbed the heavy chest and said, "That is enough adventure for today," and then he went home to eat pizza.
